he served on the bridge of lead ship Shirogane. That
tie got him recommended by Tetsuya for the Hagane.

Bridge operator of the Hagane, the second ship of
the Space Noah-class multipurpose battleships.
　Handles communications. Originally on the second
bridge; moved to the first after the <修羅の乱>.
Quiet and reserved, but a bit scatterbrained. A huge
cat lover with a lovely singing voice.
FIXH\t 鋼龍戦隊オクトパス隊所属のパイロット。\n 脳天気で楽観主義者。勝:
A pilot in the Steel Dragons' Octopus Team.
　A carefree optimist. Loves any contest, and as a
self-styled gambler, he always tests his luck. Breezy
but quick-witted, with keen insight. Deft at magic
tricks, yet hopeless at sports. Second Lieutenant.
FIXH\t 鋼龍戦隊オクトパス隊所属のパイロット。\n ブランシュタイン家の分:
A pilot in the Steel Dragons' Octopus Team.
　Of the Garnstein family, a Branstein branch house.
Cousin of Rai and Elzam. Cool, proud, and willful.
Aloof, but she's always putting on a brave front, so
she's weak to sympathy. Looks like she can do it all,
but she's a bad cook. Second Lieutenant.
FIXH\t 特定の<Ｔ‐ＬＩＮＫシステム>搭載機に取り付けられている\n装置。:
A device fitted to certain units with the
<Ｔ‐ＬＩＮＫシステム>. Nominally a T-LINK auxiliary, it
forcibly activates under certain conditions and
takes over not just telekinetic devices but unit
control, fire control and generator output. The
unit briefly exceeds its catalog specs, at a
heavy toll on the unit and the T-LINK user's
brain. Called "a system to induce superhuman
strength in a pinch," its details are known only
to a few <ＳＲＸ計画> members. One theory says it
came from Ingram Prisken, once a key SRX Project
figure and an Aerogator agent, and that its core
is a black box even T-LINK System developer Dr.
Kenzou Kobayashi can't fully analyze.
FIXH\t エアロゲイターとはＬ５宙域に突如現れた自動惑星「ネビ\nーイーム」:
The Aerogators (an Earth code name) were a force
based on Neviim, an automated planet that appeared
suddenly in the L5 area. They attacked the Earth
Sphere with insectoid weapons such as Megillot.
Eyeing Earthlings' superior combat skills, they
schemed to use them as their own forces, but
lost to Earth in Operation SRW, the final battle
of the L5 War. After the war, they were found to
be Earthlings mentally altered by someone. This
fact is top secret and has not been made public.
FIXH\t <アーマードモジュール>の略称。: Short for <アーマードモジュール>.
FIXH\t ＡＭＮとは、Ａｒｍｏｒｅｄ Ｍｏｄｕｌｅ Ｎｅｔｗ‐\nｏｒｋの略:
AMN stands for Armored Module Network.
A network system that quickly and accurately
relays combat data gained by one <アーマードモジュール>
to other units and shares it across many units.
It was developed by the former <ＥＯＴＩ機関> and
the <ＤＣ>, but problems with data exchange speed
kept it from being adopted.
FIXH\t 強襲用人型機動兵器の開発計画。\n <ＳＲＸ計画>と双璧を成すプロ:
A project to develop assault humanoid weapons.
On a par with the <ＳＲＸ計画>, its units are
built mostly without <ＥＯＴ> at the wish of chief
developer Dr. Marion Radom. Its original goal is
the Federation's next mainline unit, but in
practice it's shifting to custom units for ace
pilots.
FIXH\t 対異星人戦闘用特殊人型機動兵器の開発計画。\n Ｒシリーズなど<Ｅ:
A project to develop special humanoid
weapons for fighting aliens, such as the
R Series, which make heavy use of <ＥＯＴ>.
FIXH\t 敵の攻撃を無効化させる防御的兵器一般を指す「バリア」\nの内、電磁:
A type of "barrier" (any defensive system that
nullifies attacks) that directly projects some
non-material energy: EM waves, gravity waves,
telekinesis, photons, etc. Usually chosen per
attack type. Principles include neutralization,
diffusion, homogenization, compression, canceling
and distortion. The field's surface can form a
crystalline film, so it may "shatter" as it fades.
FIXH\t Ｍａｓｓ Ａｍｐｌｉｔｕｄｅ Ｐｒｅｅｍｐｔｉｖｅ\nｓｔｒｉｋｅ:
Short for Mass Amplitude Preemptive strike
Weapon: weapons for large-scale, wide-area
preemptive strikes. By area of effect, MAPWs are
classed as linear, radial, or scatter types.
Also called "map weapons."
FIXH\t 新西暦１８７年、<ＤＣ>戦争後に起きたエアロゲイターに\nよる争乱:
The conflict caused by the Aerogators in New
Era 187, after the <ＤＣ> War. Pronounced "L-five."
The Aerogators were a force based on Neviim
(code name: White Star), an automated planet
that suddenly appeared in the L5 area. They
attacked the Earth Sphere with insectoid weapons
such as the Megillot. Eyeing Earthlings'
superior combat skills, they schemed to use them
as their own forces, but lost to Earth in
Operation SRW, the final battle of the L5 War.
After the war, they were found to be Earthlings
mentally altered by someone. This is top secret.
FIXH\t 新西暦０７５年に完成した人類初の密閉型スペースコロ\nニー。\n:
Humanity's first sealed space colony, completed
in New Era 075. Home to the Colony Government
and the headquarters of the <コロニー統合軍>.
Colony history up to the 180s was one hardship
after another: in 076, civil strife after failed
space-adaptation surgery on the first emigrants;
in 157, a major terror attack seeking autonomy
(the Nozomi Incident); in 172, a colony bulkhead
bombing (the Hope Incident); and in 184, a terror
attack with BC weapons (the Elpis Incident). Each
claimed many lives.
However, from the early 160s, a movement (NID4)
sought independence from the Earth Federation
by peaceful means.
Its leader, Bryan Midcrid, won over Earth's
public opinion and secured colony independence in
184, becoming the Colony Government's first
President. (At the same time, the Federation Space
Force in the colonies was reorganized as the
<コロニー統合軍>, with Maier as commander.)
There are ten colonies: No. 1 Elpis, 2 Nozomi,
3 Hoffnung, 4 Wish, 5 Espoir, 6 Hope, 7 Space,
8 Esperanza, 9 Speranza, and 10 Nadezhda. All
are located in the L4 area.
FIXH\t 巨大人工冬眠施設<アースクレイドル>の科学者、イーグレッ\nト・フ:
A man-machine interface developed by Eaglet
Feff, a scientist at the huge cryo-sleep facility
<アースクレイドル>, with backing from Adler. It links
pilot and machine directly for smoother control.
The machine can also act on the pilot, forcibly
boosting resolve, reaction speed and more. For
now, pilots can't endure using it for long
without some kind of enhancement.
FIXH\t 風の<魔装機神>、サイバスターの操者。\n 直情径行型で正義感が強:
Pilot of Cybuster, the <魔装機神> of Wind.
  Hot-headed and just, he's great at all sports,
but has an awful sense of direction.
  Though Japanese, he was summoned to Holy Langran
in the underworld of <ラ・ギアス> and became Cybuster's
pilot to stop the disaster of a foretold demon god.
FIXH\t <ＤＣ>総帥ビアン・ゾルダークの一人娘。\n 超人的な運動神経、反:
The only daughter of <ＤＣ> leader Bian Zoldark.
  She has superhuman athleticism, reflexes, and
kinetic vision. A beauty, but a rowdy tomboy who
falls for flattery. A fan of Japanese period dramas,
she likes the obscure ones. Hobby: saving money.
FIXH\t <魔装機神>グランヴェールの操者。元体育教師。故事成語マニ\nアで:
Granveil's <魔装機神> pilot and ex-gym teacher.
A fan of classical idioms, he quotes old texts at
every turn. A bit narcissistic, he's also arrogant.
A fine fighter, he excels at Northern Shaolin Fist.
FIXH\t <魔装機神>ガッデスの操者。涙もろく、素直。ただし、表情や\n態度:
Gaddess's <魔装機神> pilot. Tearful and honest,
but it hardly shows. A strong, steady woman with
a huge sweet tooth. Skills: skiing and driving.
FIXH\t 地上世界から召喚された少女。一見、いくらか年下に見られ\nる程度の:
A girl summoned from the surface world. She looks
like an ordinary, slightly young-seeming girl, but
she's surprisingly mature inside. Yet she's usually
goofing off, so it rarely shows. An aikido master,
she's skilled with ki. A bit self-conscious, too.
FIXH\t マサキを預かった神聖ラングラン王国の剣術師範ゼオルー\nト・ザン・:
The only daughter of Zeoroot Zan Zenosakis, the
Holy Kingdom of Langran's swordmaster, who took in
Masaki. She saw him as a big brother from the start,
and became his sister officially when Zeoroot later
adopted him. Mature for her age, with strong magic.
She unconsciously absorbed Zeoroot's swordplay.
A good cook, best at Japanese dishes Masaki taught.
FIXH\t <魔装機>ジャオームの操者。元オリンピック水泳のゴールド・\nメダ:
Pilot of the <魔装機> Jaohm. A former Olympic gold
medalist in swimming. Serious and rigid, taciturn,
stubborn, and moody, but friendly once you know him.
FIXH\t 神聖ラングラン王国第一王位継承者。王位継承者として必要\nなだけの:
First in line to the throne of Holy Langran. He
lacked the magic an heir requires, but overcame it
through hard work and won the title of first heir.
A man of fine character, full of justice and duty.
FIXH\t 神聖ラングラン王国の王女。しかし、魔力テストに合格しな\nかったた:
A princess of Holy Langran, but with no claim to
the throne, having failed the magic test. Perhaps
why, despite being royal, she treats Masaki's group
as friends. A self-admitted mecha nut, she designs
<魔装機> and computers, and new tech enthralls her.
FIXH\t 神聖ラングラン王国の王女で、セニアの双子の妹。セニアと\n異なり未:
Princess of Holy Langran, Xenia's younger twin.
Unlike Xenia, she has strong magic as a seer and is
second in line to the throne. Gentle at best, a bit
scatterbrained at worst, her grace gives her an
otherworldly air. Her trademark is her subtly broken
grammar, which leaves those around her exhausted.
FIXH\t 神聖ラングラン王国第三王位継承者。前国王、アルザール・\nグラン・:
Langran's 3rd heir; ex-king Alzar Gran Bilseia's
illegitimate son. A listless, apathetic youth.
FIXH\t 若くして十指に及ぶ博士号を持つ天才科学者。\n 影のあるクールな二:
A young genius scientist with ten doctorates.
  A cool, handsome man with a dark side, he's calm
and utterly self-assured. He hates being used and
never forgives anyone who uses him.
  Under Dr. Bian Zoldark at the <ＥＯＴＩ機関>, he
designed Granzon's base and special gear, and is
its test pilot. His identity and past are unknown.
FIXH\t シュウの部下で、「紅蓮のサフィーネ」とも呼ばれる。見た\n目は妖艶:
Shu's subordinate, known as "Crimson Saphine."
A bewitching beauty with many perverse tastes, she
means to give Shu her body and soul, but he treats
her coldly.
FIXH\t ラングラン軍ルザック州軍国境警備隊の隊長。階級は中尉。\n丁寧な物:
Head of the Langran Army's Ruzack Province border
guard. Rank: Lieutenant. A courteous man. Zeoroot,
Masaki's master, was his senior at military academy.
FIXH\t 砂漠育ちの地上人。<魔装機>ソルガディの操者。戦いの中にし\nか自:
A surfacer raised in the desert. Pilot of the
<魔装機> Solgady. He finds a place to live only in
battle, yet in his own way he seeks peace. Skilled
at gathering intel, he sometimes acts alone for it.
FIXH\t シュテドニアスの軍人。戦闘時は男勝りだが、いったん<魔装\n機>を:
A Shtedonias soldier who fights like a man, but
becomes very meek once she's out of her <魔装
機>. Very shy and quick to blush. She likes Rodney.
FIXH\t 神聖ラングラン王国の軍人。以前は凡庸で、家柄のみで将軍\nになった:
A Holy Langran soldier. Once seen as a mediocre
man who became a general by lineage alone, he rose
to prominence in the war by minimizing his losses.
Brave, but also capable of steady tactics.
FIXH\t カークスの長男で、神聖ラングラン王国の軍人。真面目で人\n当たりの:
Kirkus's eldest son, a Holy Langran soldier.
Earnest and likable, but usually a bit timid. He
fell for Lüne at first sight. Known as Zash.
FIXH\t シュテドニアスの軍人。手柄と失敗を繰り返すため、階級が\n上がった:
A Shtedonias soldier whose rank keeps rising and
falling as he swings between feats and failures
(though he never makes the same mistake twice). He
seems a real clown, but is actually shrewd. He
lived in Langran's Troia till 10: hence his accent.
FIXH\t ソラティス神殿のコンピュータ、<ＲＥＢ>に取り憑いた疑似人\n格。:
A pseudo-persona possessing <ＲＥＢ>, the Solatis
Temple's computer. Like a virus with a will.
FIXH\t シュテドニアス軍の特殊工作小隊の隊長。階級は少佐。小隊\n長なのに:
Leader of a Shtedonias special ops platoon, with
the rank of Major. He's a Major despite leading a
platoon because his unit, made up of experts, often
takes key missions. A true pro and career soldier.
FIXH\t フェイル軍の将軍の一人。防御戦で粘りを発揮することに定\n評がある:
A general of Feil's army, renowned for tenacity
in defense. Having once aspired to design <魔装機>,
he knows them inside out and spares no expense
modifying his own unit, the Blowell.
FIXH\t シュテドニアス軍の士官。ラングランへの駐在武官としての\n経歴もあ:
A Shtedonias officer. A former military attache
to Langran, he's well connected.
FIXH\t 元シュテドニアス守備隊隊長。山賊（本人達はゲリラと言っ\nている）:
Former Shtedonias garrison commander, now boss of
bandits (self-styled guerrillas). Falsely suspected
because his wife was from Langran, he deserted. On
hearing she'd died of illness, he turned bandit in
Langran out of despair. A cultured man, he
talked rough on purpose to avoid seeming soft.
FIXH\t シュテドニアスの軍人。戦術指揮は堅実で、教本通りの戦い\n方をする:
A Shtedonias soldier who commands soundly, by the
book. Dutiful, if a little inflexible.
FIXH\t シュテドニアス軍で用いられる<魔装機>。シュテドニアスは\n練金学:
A <魔装機> used by the Schtedonias Army.
Schtedonias lags behind in alchemy overall, so it
used its own technology to compensate. It boasts
high output and plentiful firepower.
FIXH\t 邪霊、怨霊の類を核にして、土から作り出した巨大な泥人\n形。ルオゾ:
A giant mud golem made from earth, with an evil or
vengeful spirit at its core. Summoned by Luozorl's
favorite forbidden art, necromantic puppetry.
FIXH\t ルオゾールが搭乗する咒霊機。半分がアストラル界（精霊\n界）に属し:
The cursed spirit machine Luozorl pilots. Half of
it exists in the Astral Plane (spirit realm), so
it is ghostlike and immune to conventional weapons.
FIXH\t シュテドニアス軍で用いられる<魔装機>。支援戦闘を主眼に製\n作さ:
A <魔装機> used by the Schtedonias Army. Built
mainly for support combat, but it is also strong in
melee. It excels at anti-air combat as well.
FIXH\t シュテドニアス軍で用いられる<魔装機>。精霊との契約は出来\nない:
A Schtedonias Army <魔装機>. Unable to contract
with spirits, it relies on converter power.
FIXH\t <インスペクター>の無人機動兵器。高性能センサーを装備して\nおり:
An unmanned mobile weapon of the <インスペクター>. With
high-performance sensors, it is also used for
recon-in-force and patrols. Earth codename: Urchin.
FIXH\t ゲストが用いる量産型機動兵器。砲撃戦用の機体で、大型の\nドライバ:
A mass-produced Guest artillery unit with a large
Driver Cannon. Not suited to close-range combat.
FIXH\t ゲストが用いる量産型機動兵器。火力を重視した機体で、高\n出力のバ:
A mass-produced Guest mobile weapon. Built with an
emphasis on firepower, it has many high-output
vernier thrusters, suiting it to violent assault.
FIXH\t ゲストが用いる量産型機動兵器。火力や運動性、機動性に優\nれた高性:
A mass-produced Guest mobile weapon. A high-end
multirole unit with superb firepower, agility and
mobility, but costly to build, so few were made.
FIXH\t ゲストが用いる量産型機動兵器。バランスに優れた主力機で\nあり、両:
A mass-produced Guest mobile weapon. A balanced
mainstay unit, its shoulder stabilizers double as
vernier thrusters, giving it high mobility.
FIXH\t かつて<スクール>で養成されていた人型機動兵器のパイロッ\nトのこ:
Pilots trained by <スクール> to fly humanoid
weapons. Orphans with sharp reflexes and keen
eyes underwent mind control, drugs and special
training. Their memories were wiped on arrival,
and many were broken by severe <リマコン>.
Arado, Seolla and Latune are among the few
surviving Boosted Children.
FIXH\t 人の持つ生気。オーラ、気と同類の意味。常に人の表層を\n覆っており:
The life force people possess, akin to aura or
ki. It constantly covers the body's surface and
swells or wanes greatly with emotion. In <ラ・ギアス>,
people's prana varies less than surface folk's.
FIXH\t <ＤＣ>で進められていた中型艦艇による恒星間航行計画。\n恒星間航:
A <ＤＣ> project for interstellar travel using
mid-sized ships. It develops the vessels and
trains their pilots.
　After the DC fell, the project continued under
Federation oversight with support from
<イスルギ重工>. Its resulting units and systems
have also been adapted for military use.
　"TD" means "<テスラ・ドライブ>" and "Terrestrial Dream."
FIXH\t <Ｌ５戦役>において、<エアロゲイター>が本拠地として使用\nして:
A huge spherical fortress the <エアロゲイター> used
as their base in the <Ｌ５戦役>. Its official
name is "Automatic Planet Nebiim"; White Star is
Earth's code name. Inside are weapon plants, a
spaceport, 1G habitats with simulated weather,
multiple farms and more; it's in effect a mobile
colony. One theory says it was built to carry
Earthlings of great Resolve and combat skill to
the Aerogators' homeworld, but this is unproven.
　Near the war's end, the Operation SRW allied
fleet's all-out attack wrecked and disabled it;
postwar, the Earth Federation Army took charge.
　In S.C. 187, the invading <インスペクター> seized it
as their base. Later it fused with <アインスト> leader
Neu Regisseur, becoming the giant weapon Stern
Neu Regisseur, warped to another dimension with
the Kurogane and Hiryu Custom, and was destroyed
after a fierce battle with them.
FIXH\t 新西暦１７６年、ティン・マオがユアン・メイロンらと共\nに、月面の:
A heavy machinery maker founded in S.C. 176 by
Ting Mao, Yuan Mei Long and others in the lunar
permanent settlement of Selevis City. It first
built bipedal machines for lunar work, but now
mainly develops and produces Personal Troopers.
Its president is now Ting's daughter, Ling Mao.
FIXH\t イーグレット・フェフ博士が作り出した自己再生・自己進\n化機能を備:
Self-repairing, self-evolving metal cells by Dr.
Egret Fehu. They can invade and swiftly rework
a touched object's makeup, greatly enhancing its
properties while bringing it under their control.
　Work began before the <ＤＣ戦争>, but performance
leapt with samples of autonomous, self-aware metal
cells (Zfylud Crystal) from the <エアロゲイター>' weapons.
During the <インスペクター事件>, the <ノ
イエＤＣ>'s Thrudgelmir and Belgelmir also used them,
displaying astonishing regenerative power.
FIXH\t <ラ・ギアス>で用いられる人型汎用兵器。本来は神聖ラング\nラン王:
General-purpose humanoid weapons of <ラ・ギアス>.
The term originally meant only the 16 Masouki
built by the Holy Kingdom of Langran, but with the
rise of mass-produced units it now covers all.
FIXH\t 高位の精霊と契約した<魔装機>で、自らの意志で操者を選\nぶ。<ラ:
<魔装機> bound by contract to high spirits that
choose their own pilots. They were built in the
Holy Kingdom of Langran to counter threats to all
of <ラ・ギアス>. There are four in all, each with
Wind, Fire, Water or Earth as its guardian spirit.
FIXH\t 新西暦１７９年、南太平洋マーケサズ諸島沖にあるアイド\nネウス島へ:
A meteorite that struck Aidoneus Island off the
Marquesas in the South Pacific in S.C. 179.
　Research by the <ＥＯＴＩ機関> suggests that the
Aerogators deliberately sent it to Earth.
　Evidence includes its sudden appearance in L5
space before falling to Earth, its slowing itself
before impact, and the <ＥＯＴ> sealed within it,
clearly meant to be examined by others.
　Its name follows Meteors 1 and 2, which struck
New York and Moscow in the old era and gravely
stunted the progress of Earth's civilization.
FIXH\t 「Ｍｏｏｎ Ｏｒｂｉｔａｌ Ｓｅａｒｃｈ Ｓｙｓｔ\nｅｍ」の略称:
Short for "Moon Orbital Search System"; read
"moss." An automated alert system of unmanned
artificial probes spread over a sphere bounded by
lunar orbit. A higher tier of the Satellite Link
System (multi-satellite air defense control), it
was set up by the Colony Alliance before the DC
War. The Federation now manages it.
FIXH\t 地球内部に存在する世界のこと。形状としては地球空洞説\nのように球:
A world inside the Earth. Like the hollow Earth
theory, it takes the form of a sphere's interior,
but it doesn't truly lie beneath the surface; it
lies out of phase. La Gias means "the True Land."
FIXH\t 「Ｒｅ－Ｍｉｎｄ Ｃｏｎｔｒｏｌ」の略語。\n 元々、記憶操作や特:
Short for "Re-Mind Control": adjusting memories
and minds of those under memory manipulation or
special suggestion (e.g. <ブーステッド・チルドレン>) to fit
their missions. Excessive rewriting raises the risk
of mental collapse, and implanting wholly foreign
concepts or memories is also risky, so related data
is normally rewritten gradually. Remacon keyed to
love, Friendship, hostility or grudges especially
helps <ブーステッド・チルドレン> exceed their specs.
FIXH\t ＲｅＥＯＴＨ ＰＬＡＮ。\n ＲｅＥＯＴＨ（レイオス）とは、「Ｒｅ:
The ReEOTH PLAN.
ReEOTH ("Reioth") stands for "Reliable Extra Over
Technological Hybrid," meaning a highly reliable
composite of alien technology.
　A plan to fundamentally re-examine the unstable
<ＥＯＴ>, boosting reliability and stability by
introducing Earth's latest technology.
　Beyond upgrading existing EOT-equipped units,
it also aims to bring ReEOTH to future R Series
successors and mass-production models.
CSB\tＡ．受けるダメージを、他の味方の機体が肩代わりする行動です。: A. An ally unit takes the damage in another's place.
CSB\tＡ．攻撃目標をプレイヤーユニットで囲むことにより発生する効果です。: A. A bonus for surrounding a target with your units.
CSB\t<W=28><H=28>Ａ．<C=FF8000FF>攻撃目標をプレイヤ:
<W=28><H=28>A. <C=FF8000FF>A bonus for surrounding a target with your units.</C></H></W>

　●Damage varies with the number of your units adjacent to the target,
　　excluding the attacking unit.

　<T=30>2-3 Units</T>
　・Damage +5%

　<T=30>4 Units</T>
　・Damage +10%
CSB\tＡ．同一フェイズ内で、攻撃を回避し続けることが困難になる効果です。: A. Evading repeatedly in one phase becomes harder.
CSB\t<W=28><H=28>Ａ．<C=FF8000FF>同一フェイズ内で、:
<W=28><H=28>A. <C=FF8000FF>Evading repeatedly in one phase becomes harder.</C></H></W>

　●Each evasion (including blocking all damage with a barrier, etc.) adds 1
　　to a unit's count, up to 40. Evasion drops by count x 5% in its next
　　battle. The count resets on a failed evasion or at phase end.

　<S=8><Y=-3><W=32><H=32><I=156></H></W></Y><S=3>Evading with Flash, one of the <LINK=0>Spirit Commands</LINK>, isn't counted.
CSB\tＡ．機体が持つ、特殊な能力です。: A. Special powers a unit has.
CSB\t<W=28><H=28>Ａ．<C=FF8000FF>機体が持つ、特殊な:
<W=28><H=28>A. <C=FF8000FF>Special powers a unit has.</C></H></W>

　●Some units have abilities: transforming, HP/EN recovery, evasion
　　types that negate attacks, block types that negate weapon effects,
　　barrier types that reduce damage, and more.

　<S=8><Y=-3><W=32><H=32><I=156></H></W></Y><S=3><LINK=0>Parts</LINK> can grant similar effects.
CSB\t<W=24>Ｑ</W><W=32>２</W>．移動力（移動範囲）を増や: <W=24>Q</W><W=32>2</W>. How can I extend movement range?
CSB\tＡ．特殊能力「変形」「合体」「分離」を利用します。: A. Use Transform, Combine, or Separate.
CSB\t<W=28><H=28>Ａ．<C=FF8000FF>特殊能力「変形」「:
<W=28><H=28>A. <C=FF8000FF>Use Transform, Combine, or Separate.</C></H></W>

　●Units with these abilities can use the unit commands "Transform,"
　　"Combine," and "Separate" to change form, which may change their
　　<LINK=0>Move</LINK> or <LINK=1>Move Type</LINK>. Changing form to suit the terrain
　　can extend a unit's movement range.
CSB\t<W=24>Ｑ</W><W=32>３</W>．敵からのダメージを減らす: <W=24>Q</W><W=32>3</W>. How can I reduce damage taken?
CSB\tＡ．特殊能力「ＡＢフィールド」「Ｅフィールド」「パッシブ・ビット」「Ｔ:
A. Use AB Field, E Field, Passive Bit, TE Sphere, Beam Coat, G-Wall,
　　G-Territory, or TK Field.
CSB\t<W=28><H=28>Ａ．<C=FF8000FF>以下の特殊能力を利:
<W=28><H=28>A. <C=FF8000FF>Use the following abilities.</C></H></W>

　●Use barrier abilities. Barriers spend EN to reduce or nullify a set
　　amount of damage. They won't activate without enough EN, and some
　　also require a minimum pilot Will or another ability.

　<T=30>AB Field</T>
　・Reduces damage by 1200. Costs 10 EN. Beam weapons only.

　<T=30>E Field</T>
　・Reduces damage by 1500. Costs 15 EN. Requires 120 Will.

　<T=30>Passive Bit</T>
　・Reduces damage by 1100. Costs 5 EN. Beam weapons only.

　<T=30>TE Sphere</T>
　・Reduces damage by 1500. Costs 5 EN. Requires 120 Will.

　<T=30>Beam Coat</T>
　・Reduces damage by 900. Costs 5 EN. Beam weapons only.

　<T=30>G-Wall</T>
　・Nullifies up to 800 damage. Costs 5 EN. Requires 120 Will.

　<T=30>G-Territory</T>
　・Nullifies up to 1800 damage. Costs 15 EN. Requires 120 Will.

　<T=30>TK Field</T>
　・Nullifies up to 200 x the <LINK=0>Special Skill</LINK> Telekinesis level. Costs 5 EN.
　　Requires 110 Will.

　<S=8><Y=-3><W=32><H=32><I=156></H></W></Y><S=3>Reducing barriers lower damage by their value. Nullifying barriers
　　　cut damage to 0 if it's at or below their value; otherwise, full
　　　damage is taken.

　●Use Transform, Combine, or Separate. Units with these abilities can use
　　the unit commands "Transform," "Combine," and "Separate" to change
　　form, which may change their Armor.
CSB\t<W=24>Ｑ</W><W=32>４</W>．ステータス異常を受けない: <W=24>Q</W><W=32>4</W>. How do I avoid status ailments?
CSB\tＡ．特殊能力「パイロットブロック」「ロボットブロック」「フルブロック」: A. Use Pilot Block, Robot Block, or Full Block.
CSB\t<W=28><H=28>Ａ．<C=FF8000FF>ブロック系特殊能力:
<W=28><H=28>A. <C=FF8000FF>Use block abilities.</C></H></W>

　●Some weapons have a <LINK=0>Special Effect 1</LINK> that inflicts status ailments
　　on the target. R-type effects affect units, and P-type effects affect
　　pilots. Block abilities can nullify these effects.

　<T=30>Pilot Block</T>
　・Nullifies all P-type effects.

　<T=30>Robot Block</T>
　・Nullifies all R-type effects.

　<T=30>Full Block</T>
　・Nullifies all special effects.
FIXH\t リ・テクノロジストの一人で、エール・シュヴァリアーやブ\nランシュ:
A Re-Technologist and one of the developers of the
Aile Chevalier and Blanche Neige. An eccentric
rationalist. He's close to Josh and Rim, and looks
out for them like a big brother.
FIXH\t 南極で発見された遺跡の発掘と研究に従事するリ・テクノロ\nジストの:
A leading Re-Technologist excavating and studying
the ruins discovered in Antarctica. Josh's father
and Rim's adoptive father. He put research first
and neglected his family, often clashing with Josh.
FIXH\t コモディン島でアイビス達が救出した少女。過去の記憶を\n失っており:
A girl rescued by Ibis's group on Komodin Island.
An amnesiac of unknown origin. Quiet and gentle.
FIXH\t 「マシアフ」、「ガンエデンの巫女」とも呼ばれる強念者。\nその役目:
A powerful psychic also called the "Mashiaf" or the
"Priestess of Gan Eden." Her role is to serve as the
core of the man-made god Gan Eden, and to assess the
power and will of those who would protect Earth and
lead them to Baral. She wasn't created by Gan Eden;
it chose her for her gifts and made her the Mashiaf.
FIXH\t スペースノア級万能戦闘母艦参番艦クロガネの艦長。\n 元々は<コロ:
Captain of the Kurogane, 3rd Space Noah-class ship.
A former <コロニー統合軍> officer, he and Rätsel
joined the <ＤＣ>, serving as the Kurogane's XO. After
the <Ｌ５戦役>, he took command, still with Rätsel.
FIXH\t 破壊神サーヴァ・ヴォルクルスに仕えるシュウの部下。「紅\n蓮のサフ:
Shu's subordinate, who serves Sarva Volkruss, god of
destruction. Known as "Saphine the Crimson," she
spies, sabotages, and disrupts foes on orders from
Shu or Luozorl. A sultry beauty with many fetishes.
FIXH\t 神聖ラングラン王国の神官で、ソラティス神殿の神官長。マ\nサキ達<:
A priestess of the Holy Kingdom of Langran and head
of the Soratis Temple. Close to Masaki and the other
<魔装機神> pilots, she made their familiars.
FIXH\t 「Ｌ＆Ｅコーポレーション」の一員で、エクサランス・レス\nキューの:
A member of L&E Corporation and designer of the
Exxelion Rescue. Earnest and hardworking, she built
the new Exxelion as a rescue unit, her true wish.
FIXH\t リュウセイの母親。\n 見た目はおっとりしているが、芯のしっかりし:
Ryusei's mother.
Easygoing in appearance, but strong at heart. She
raised Ryusei alone after his father died. Frail,
she was in and out of the hospital, but she's now
recovering at home.
FIXH\t <スクール>出身の<ブーステッド・チルドレン>。そのトップであ\n:
One of <スクール>'s <ブーステッド・チルドレン>. A former
member of the Argent Class, second only to the top
Aurum Class. Competitive and proud, fixated on
winning glory and making money.
FIXH\t 日本・浅草地区に住む高校生。\n 街の発明家であるキサブロー・アズ:
A high schooler in Asakusa, Japan, and grandson of
local inventor Kisaburo Azuma. He seems gruff, but
has a strong sense of justice. Hot-tempered, loves
festivals, spends freely, and dotes on his sister.
He dons the Roar Armor to become Fighter Roar.
FIXH\t コウタの妹。\n 明朗活発な女の子。家事全般は何でもこなす。人当た:
Kota's sister. A cheerful, lively girl who does all
the housework. Friendly and popular at school. She
always worries about Kota, but nags him in person.
Unlike spendthrift Kota, she's frugal to the point
of being stingy. She dons the Emmy Armor to become
Fighter Emmy.
FIXH\t 大阪にある萬南無（ばんなむ）高校の３年生（留年中）であ\nり、関西:
A third-year (held back) at Bannamu High in Osaka,
and a delinquent boss famous across Kansai. A wild
man and a ferocious fighter who solves everything
by force, but he's a pushover for cute girls. His
Osaka-born grandpa moved to Tokyo, and they came
back when Michiru was 10. His Kansai drawl is iffy.
FIXH\t かつて、<シャドウミラー>に所属していた男。\n 優れた操縦技術、:
Formerly of <シャドウミラー>. A skilled pilot and
martial artist, cool outside but fiery within. In
his home world, he saw Kyosuke Nanbu, who gained a
mysterious power, and his Gespenst Mk-III, as
threats. Sure this world's Kyosuke would one day
gain similar power, he tried to kill him. But at
the end of the <インスペクター事件>, he lost the
final battle in the <ホワイトスター>, left near death.
Later, the <地球連
邦軍>'s 3rd Special Ops
<ＰＴ> Unit Cry Wolves recovered him and Soulgain. He
fought with Kyosuke's team in the <修羅の乱>.
FIXH\t <アインスト>の中で、唯一人間に近い姿をしている少女。\nエクセレ:
A girl, the only <アインスト> with a near-human form.
A clone-like being made from Excellen Browning's
data, she resembles her in face and voice. During
the <インスペクター事件>, she clashed with Kyosuke's
team many times, but was slowly drawn to the
"power of human feelings" and finally joined them,
fighting the <アインスト> leader Stern Neu Regisseur.
FIXH\t <コロニー統合軍>の軍人で、<ＤＣ戦争>時は<ＤＣ>に出向し、\n:
A <コロニー統合軍> officer, on loan to the <ＤＣ>
as an executive in the <ＤＣ戦争>. Anti-Federation,
he idolizes Bian and Maier and seeks to change
the world radically. Both cautious and bold.
FIXH\t シシオウブレードを携えたガーリオン・カスタム“無明”\nを駆る傭兵:
A mercenary piloting the Guarlion Custom "Mumyou"
which wields a Shishioh Blade.
An ace pilot and master swordsman, he lives to
"cut" people and machines. He is 45 years old.
FIXH\t ガイアセイバーズの旗艦、エア・クリスマスの艦長。\n 頭脳明晰、冷:
Captain of the Air Christmas, the Gaia Savers'
flagship. Brilliant and cold, he believes total
victory means flawless theory, flawlessly executed.
FIXH\t ゲスト傭兵部隊の隊長。愛称はロフ。剛胆な武人だが、傭兵\nであるが:
Leader of the Guest mercenary unit, known as Rof.
A bold warrior, but as a mercenary he carries out
any mission given, but at heart he rejects cruel
tactics and feels torn. From a noted military clan,
he fled home, sick of status being set by lineage.
FIXH\t ゲストの戦闘指揮官。愛称はゼブ。飄々としているが、かな\nりの切れ:
A Guest combat commander known as Zeb. Laid-back but
very sharp, with a drawl. Mekibos of the <インスペク
ター> was his childhood friend.
FIXH\t ゲストの戦闘指揮官。愛称はセティ。理知的な性格で、優秀\nな軍人。:
A Guest combat commander known as Sety. Intelligent
and a capable soldier. Zezenan recognized her talent
and made her his subordinate.
FIXH\t ゾヴォーク枢密院から派遣された特使。<インスペクター事件>\nでは:
An envoy sent by the Zovork Privy Council. In the
<インスペクター事件>, he battled the Steel Dragons as
the <インスペクター>' combat commander.
Rough-spoken but earnest at heart, he reads battles
calmly, and will coldly use any means to reach his
goal. Gallant too, he was once hurt shielding his
younger brother Wendolo.
FIXH\t ゲストの総司令官。性格は傲慢で自信家、計算高い。権力を\n用いた人:
The Guest supreme commander. Arrogant, confident,
and calculating, adept at swaying people with power,
and deeply biased against Earthlings. He'd eyed Earth
before the <ＤＣ戦争>, secretly meddling and bargaining.
FIXH\t ツェントル・プロジェクトで開発されたＴＥアブゾーバーの\nテストパ:
A test pilot for the TE Absorber developed by the
Tsentr Project. Formerly of the Cry Wolves, the
<地球連邦軍>'s 3rd Special Ops <ＰＴ> Unit.
Having faced poverty since childhood, he clings
fiercely to life. Quite emotional, but usually a
man of few words.
FIXH\t <地球連邦軍>の軍人で、ＴＥアブゾーバーのＤＦＣオペレー\nター。:
An <地球連邦軍> DFC operator for the
TE Absorber. Cheerful, if a bit scatterbrained. Her
father is Federation Senator Taylor Centrum. Raised
wanting for nothing, she hated life as a caged bird
and enlisted to seek thrills and test her own mettle.
FIXH\t ツェントル・プロジェクトで開発されたＴＥアブゾーバー、\nメディウ:
Test pilot of the Medius Locus, a TE Absorber built
by the Tsentr Project. Former leader of the Cry
Wolves, the <地球連邦軍>'s 3rd Special Ops
<ＰＴ> Unit. A stern, highly responsible soldier.
FIXH\t 人工知能の研究者であり、戦闘用高性能人工知能「ＡＩ\n０（エーアイ:
An AI researcher who created "AI0" (AI Zero), a
high-performance combat AI. He once taught at the
Federation military academy, where Aqua Centrum was
one of his students.
FIXH\t 通称はジョッシュ。南極で発見された謎の遺跡の研究を行う\nリ・テク:
Known as Josh. Son of Ferio Radcliffe, a
Re-Technologist (Re-Tech) studying mysterious ruins
found in Antarctica. He has a stepsister, Clearna
Rimskaya. Not very sociable but level-headed, though
he has an emotional side too.
FIXH\t ジョシュア・ラドクリフの義妹。南極の遺跡から発掘され、\nリ・テク:
Joshua Radcliffe's stepsister. She spent
a long time in experiments with Sympathia, a system
unearthed from the Antarctic ruins and restored by
Re-Technologists. As a result, she split into two
personalities: Chris and Riana. Each is aware of the
other and can talk. Riana is strong-willed and dry.

Joshua Radcliffe's stepsister. She spent
a long time in experiments with Sympathia, a system
unearthed from the Antarctic ruins and restored by
Re-Technologists. As a result, she split into two
personalities: Chris and Riana. Each is aware of the
other and can talk. Chris is reserved and gentle.
FIXH\t ルイーナの疑似生命体「メリオルエッセ」の一人。“破滅の\n王”を復:
A Meliores Esse, a Ruina pseudo-lifeform that needs
waves of negative emotion to revive the "King of
Destruction," and pilots the Fortis Ara to wreak
ruin and carnage. Calm, cool, and merciless to foes.

A Meliores Esse, a Ruina pseudo-lifeform that needs
waves of negative emotion to revive the "King of
Destruction," and pilots the Impetus to wreak
ruin and carnage. Ferocious and battle-loving.
FIXH\t ルイーナの疑似生命体「メリオルエッセ」の一人。負の感情\nの波動を:
A Meliores Esse, a Ruina pseudo-lifeform whose role
is to convert waves of negative emotion into energy
and send it to the "King of Destruction." Thus he
came to grasp human feelings better than the rest.
FIXH\t ルイーナの疑似生命体「メリオルエッセ」の一人。ジョッ\nシュとシュ:
A Meliores Esse, a Ruina pseudo-lifeform who, after
a psychic link with Josh via Sympathia, resolves to
fight alongside him.
FIXH\t ルイーナの疑似生命体「メリオルエッセ」の一人。“破滅の\n王”を復:
A Meliores Esse, a Ruina pseudo-lifeform that needs
waves of negative emotion to revive the "King of
Destruction," and pilots the Fervularis to wreak
ruin and carnage. Calm, composed, and cold-hearted.
CSB\tＡ．パイロット養成、精神コマンド、強化パーツなどを利用します。: A. Use Pilot Training, Spirit Commands, Parts, and more.
CSB\t<W=28><H=28>Ａ．<C=FF8000FF>以下の方法がありま:
<W=28><H=28>A. <C=FF8000FF>There are several methods.</C></H></W>

　●Shoot down enemies. Will rises even more if the pilot makes the kill
　　personally. Will may also rise when an ally is shot down, but be careful:
　　depending on the pilot, it may drop instead.

　●Have the pilot take part in battle. Will may rise when dealing damage,
　　evading an attack, or taking damage. How much it rises varies by pilot.
　　Will may also rise when an attack fails to damage the target, but be
　　careful: depending on the pilot, it may drop instead.

　●Learn "Will+ (Hit)" or similar skills through <LINK=0>Pilot Training</LINK>.

　●Use the <LINK=1>Spirit Command</LINK> "Spirit" or similar.

　●Equip the <LINK=2>Part</LINK> "Headband" or similar.

　<S=8><Y=-3><W=32><H=32><I=156></H></W></Y><S=3>A pilot targeted by the unit command "Resupply" loses 10 Will.
　　　Boarding a battleship lowers Will by 5. However, boarding will never
　　　drop Will below 100.
CSB\t<W=24>Ｑ</W><W=32>３</W>．敵の気力を下げるためには: <W=24>Q</W><W=32>3</W>. How do I lower enemy Will?
CSB\t<W=28><H=28>Ａ．<C=FF8000FF>以下の方法がありま:
<W=28><H=28>A. <C=FF8000FF>There are several methods.</C></H></W>

　●Use the <LINK=0>Spirit Command</LINK> "Exhaust" or similar.

　●Attack with a weapon that has the <LINK=1>Special Effect 1</LINK> "Will Down L (P)".

　<S=8><Y=-3><W=32><H=32><I=155></H></W></Y><S=3>Boss-class enemies won't lose Will from allies being shot down or
　　　from battle. Their Will also maxes out quickly, so lower it right before
　　　you attack. Few pilots have Spirit Commands that lower Will, so tactics
　　　that keep the enemy's Will from rising are also important.
CSB\tＡ．マップのマスに設定された、防御や回避、ＨＰ・ＥＮ回復の効果です。: A. Defense, evasion and HP/EN recovery bonuses of map squares.
CSB\t<W=28><H=28>Ａ．<C=FF8000FF>マップのマスに設定:
<W=28><H=28>A. <C=FF8000FF>Defense, evasion and HP/EN recovery bonuses of map squares.</C></H></W>

　●Each map square has terrain effects that depend on its terrain type.
　　Terrain effects give the unit on that square the following bonuses.

　<T=30>"Defense Rate"</T>
　・How much a unit's defense increases when it's attacked on that terrain.

　<T=30>"Evasion Rate"</T>
　・How much the enemy's hit rate drops when a unit on that terrain is
　　attacked.

　<T=30>"HP Recovery Rate"</T>
　・What percentage of max HP a unit on that terrain recovers at the start
　　of the player phase.

　<T=30>"EN Recovery Rate"</T>
　・What percentage of max EN a unit on that terrain recovers at the start
　　of the player phase.

　<S=8><Y=-3><W=32><H=32><I=156></H></W></Y><S=3>Press <S=-4><Y=-3><W=32><H=32><I=116></H></W></Y><S=-4> on a square to view its terrain effects.
CSB\t<W=24>Ｑ</W><W=32>２</W>．敵からのダメージを減らす: <W=24>Q</W><W=32>2</W>. How do I reduce enemy damage?
CSB\tＡ．高い防御率が設定されているマスへユニットを移動させます。: A. Move the unit to a square with a high defense rate.
CSB\t<W=28><H=28>Ａ．<C=FF8000FF>高い防御率が設定さ:
<W=28><H=28>A. <C=FF8000FF>Move the unit to a square with a high defense rate.</C></H></W>

　●Units in the air don't receive the defense rate bonus.

　<S=8><Y=-3><W=32><H=32><I=155></H></W></Y><S=3>Terrain with little cover, like roads and plains, gives no bonus,
　　　while terrain with lots of cover, like buildings and forests, gives
　　　a high bonus.
CSB\tＡ．高い回避率が設定されているマスへユニットを移動させます。: A. Move the unit to a square with a high evasion rate.
CSB\t<W=28><H=28>Ａ．<C=FF8000FF>高い回避率が設定さ:
<W=28><H=28>A. <C=FF8000FF>Move the unit to a square with a high evasion rate.</C></H></W>

　●Units in the air don't receive the evasion rate bonus.

　<S=8><Y=-3><W=32><H=32><I=155></H></W></Y><S=3>Terrain with little cover, like roads and plains, gives no bonus,
　　　while terrain with lots of cover, like buildings and forests, gives
　　　a high bonus.
CSB\tＡ．ＨＰ・ＥＮ回復率が設定されているマスへユニットを移動させます。: A. Move the unit to a square with an HP/EN recovery rate.
CSB\t<W=28><H=28>Ａ．<C=FF8000FF>ＨＰ・ＥＮ回復率が:
<W=28><H=28>A. <C=FF8000FF>Move the unit to a square with an HP/EN recovery rate.</C></H></W>

　●HP/EN recovery from terrain happens at the start of the player phase.

　<S=8><Y=-3><W=32><H=32><I=155></H></W></Y><S=3>Terrain with HP/EN recovery rates mainly includes facilities
　　　like bases and buildings, as well as energy tanks.
CSB\tＡ．通常攻撃後に他の味方のユニットが行う追加攻撃のことです。: A. A follow-up attack by another ally after a normal attack.
CSB\t<W=28><H=28>Ａ．<C=FF8000FF>通常攻撃後に他の味:
<W=28><H=28>A. <C=FF8000FF>A follow-up attack by another ally after a normal attack.</C></H></W>

　●When the attacking unit makes a <LINK=0>Normal Attack</LINK>, an allied unit follows up
　　with its own attack. A unit can make a Support Attack if it:

　・Is adjacent to the attacking unit.
　・Has not finished its action.
　・Has a <LINK=1>Movement Type</LINK> that can enter the attacking unit's terrain.
　・Has a main pilot with the <LINK=2>Special Skill</LINK> "Support Attack" and supports
　　remaining.
　・Has a weapon that can attack the target.
　・Is not taking part in the attacking unit's <LINK=3>Combination Attack</LINK>.

　<S=8><Y=-3><W=32><H=32><I=156></H></W></Y><S=3>Support Attacks get +20 hit rate but deal 75 percent of normal damage.
　　　The number of supports per phase equals the skill level.
FIXH\t <ＳＲＸ計画>で開発された<パーソナルトルーパー>・Ｒシリー\nズ:
The first R Series <パーソナルトルーパー> developed
by the <ＳＲＸ計画>. Official name:
"REAL PERSONAL TROOPER TYPE-1."
A close-combat unit with high mobility and
attack power. It inherits the strengths of its
predecessors, the RTX-009 "Hückebein 009
(Plasma Generator Model)" and PTX-006
"Wildraubtier." Like the Wildraubtier, it can
transform into a flight mode (R-Wing), so it
often leads the R Series as vanguard, using its
speed for surprise attacks and recon in force.
It carries solid-ammo weapons for short and mid
range to ensure real damage. It also mounts the
<Ｔ‐ＬＩＮＫシステム>, enabling attacks that apply
its special force field, the TK Field.
FIXH\t Ｒ‐１の飛行形態。\n 主に移動や威力偵察時に使用される。機首部分:
The R-1's flight mode, used mainly for travel and
recon in force. The nose is the shield the R-1
uses in <パーソナルトルーパー> mode.
FIXH\t <ＳＲＸ計画>で開発された<パーソナルトルーパー>・Ｒシリー\nズ:
The second R Series <パーソナルトルーパー> developed
by the <ＳＲＸ計画>. Official name:
"REAL PERSONAL TROOPER TYPE-2 POWERED."
A heavy artillery <パーソナルトルーパー> armed mainly
with beam weapons, it carries the <トロニウム> Engine
that powers the SRX. It has high firepower and
thick armor, but its unstable engine output and
low mobility are flaws. In the R Series, it
provides suppressive fire and fire support.
Adding plus parts such as the Hi-Zol Launcher
heavy-metal particle cannon and shoulder armor
makes it the R-2 Powered. In the SRX, the R-2
pilot adjusts <トロニウム> Engine output, handles
damage control, and runs medical checks on the
R-1 and R-3 pilots. As the R-2 lacks the
<Ｔ‐ＬＩＮＫシステム>, its pilot needn't be telekinetic.

The third R Series <パーソナルトルーパー> developed
by the <ＳＲＸ計画>. Official name:
"REAL PERSONAL TROOPER TYPE-3 POWERED."
A light long-range command <パーソナルトルーパー>
with remote weapons using the <Ｔ‐ＬＩＮＫシステム>
and superior target lock and intel gathering.
Only telekinetics can pilot it; in practice, it
is SRX Team Captain Aya Kobayashi's own unit.
Plus parts with the T-LINK Flight System turn it
into the R-3 Powered, a heavy bomber form.
FIXH\t <ＳＲＸ計画>で開発された<パーソナルトルーパー>・ＲＷシ\nリー:
The first RW Series <パーソナルトルーパー> developed
by the <ＳＲＸ計画>. Official name:
"REAL PERSONAL TROOPER TYPE-GUN."
Originally a high-output heavy-metal particle
cannon, it was shrunk for a certain purpose and
given a <パーソナルトルーパー> mode to fight alone.
Its new <トロニウム> Engine outstrips the R-2's,
so its output and firepower top the R Series,
but that output is extremely unstable.
In effect the fourth R unit, it was not named
"R-4," but was developed in secret under the
codename "ARGAN" at <マオ・インダストリー> on the Moon.
Fitted with plus parts such as the Hi-Twin
Launcher on its back, it's called the R-Gun
Powered. After the <Ｌ５戦役>, an improved
<Ｔ‐ＬＩＮＫシステム> allowed T-LINK Twin Contact with
the R-3.
FIXH\t <ＳＲＸ計画>で開発された試作汎用戦闘一撃必殺型<パーソ\nナルト:
A prototype all-purpose, one-hit-kill
<パーソナルトルーパー> built by the <ＳＲＸ計画>, made
up of the R-1, R-2 Powered, and R-3 Powered.
Official name: "SUPER ROBOT X-TYPE."
Its design concept: "A humanoid mobile weapon
with the traits of both special humanoid weapons
(<特機>s) and <パーソナルトルーパー>s, able to turn
the tide of battle as one unit or three."
In the <ＳＲＸ計画>, the SRX was defined as a
split/combine weapon in which three standard-size
(20 m class) <パーソナルトルーパー>s combine into one
50 m class <特機>, so its combat power can be
used flexibly and effectively by splitting or
combining as the situation demands. Against many
weak foes, or when it must coordinate with other
<パーソナルトルーパー>s, it fights separated; against a
few strong foes, it combines into the SRX to
concentrate the R Series' combat power.
Its attack power is outstanding, but it has flaws:
the <トロニウム> Engine's output is hard to regulate,
and in combat the <Ｔ‐ＬＩＮＫシステム> must keep a TK
Field up at all times to hold the combination
(a heavy strain on the <Ｔ‐ＬＩＮＫシステム> user). Thus,
combinations per sortie and combat time are
currently limited.
FIXH\t ＡＲＴ‐１（アートワン）とは「ＡＤＶＡＮＣＥＤ ＲＥＡ\nＬ ＰＥ:
ART-1 ("Art One") is short for "ADVANCED REAL
PERSONAL TROOPER TEST TYPE-1."
A new <パーソナルトルーパー> built in the RXR Project, a
next-gen R Series program that is part of the
<レイオス・プラン> to make <ＥＯＴ> more reliable and stable.
It was built experimentally from R-1 and
Hückebein Mk-III data in preparation for next-gen
units. (As a prototype for prototypes, it wears
test-unit colors instead of the R-1's tricolor.)
Only one exists. It can transform into a flight
mode (ART-Wing) but cannot combine with other R
Series units. Even so, it outperforms the R-1.
FIXH\t ＡＲＴ‐１の飛行形態（フライヤーモード）。この状態で\n念動フィー:
ART-1's flight mode (Flyer Mode). In this form,
it can raise a TK Field and charge the enemy.
FIXH\t <シャドウミラー>隊のアクセル・アルマーが駆るソウルゲイン\nとの:
A heavy overhaul of the Alteisen, which lost its
limbs when wrecked fighting the Soulgain flown by
Axel Almer of the <シャドウミラー> unit.
Dr. Marion Radom built it based on (or rather,
loosely inspired by) pilot Kyosuke Nanbu's input.
It uses Weissritter spare parts and carries the
Revolving Bunker, once rejected for wrecking the
unit's balance. All its other weapons were also
swapped for larger versions.
It has a <テスラ・ドライブ>, but it's used for balance
and charge speed, so it cannot fly for long.
As a result, the Alteisen Riese has firepower and
charge power rare in a <パーソナルトルーパー>, but
is even harder to handle than the Alteisen.
"Riese" is German for "giant."
FIXH\t ヴァイスリッターが謎の技術によって変貌し、パワーアッ\nプした姿。:
The Weissritter transformed and powered up by an
unknown technology. Over 60 percent of it has become
something that defies analysis.
Its main weapon is the Howling Launcher, likely
evolved from the Weissritter's Oxtongue Launcher.
It can also deploy a powerful <エネ
ルギーフィールド> and attack with thought waves.
FIXH\t プロジェクト・イデアランツで開発された機動兵器の試作\n型、それも:
A rush job built from a Project Idealands
prototype mobile weapon that had been slated for
scrapping as a failure, using Alteisen parts and
Rapiecage spare parts.
It has a high-output generator called the "Vau
Kern," but as a failed design, it can never
fully deliver on that power. It excels at close
to mid-range combat using the Alteisen Revolving
Stake and Machine Cannon mounted on its arms.
FIXH\t プロジェクト・イデアランツで開発された重機動兵器。\n 「ファウ・:
A heavy mobile weapon from Project Idealands.
It carries a high-output generator called the
"Vau Kern" and is a power fighter skilled at both
melee and ranged combat, though its heavy weapons
and armor leave its mobility somewhat lacking.
FIXH\t <アインスト>シリーズと呼ばれる生体兵器の一種で、アルフ\nィミィ:
Alfimi's unit, one of the bioweapons known as the
<アインスト> Series. An <アインスト> optimized to fight
<パーソナルトルーパー>s, it has high mobility, defense,
and the ability to warp through space on its own.
Its skeleton and hide are hard yet supple, with
soft muscle-fiber parts. It wields the Onirenge
(sword) for melee and Onibosatsu (demon-face
cannon) for range, mixing both in tricky attacks.
FIXH\t ヒュッケバインＭｋ‐Ⅱを基に開発された量産型<パーソナル\nトルー:
A mass-production <パーソナルトルーパー> based on the
Hückebein Mk-II, adopted as the new mainstay unit
in the <地球連邦軍>'s "Aegis Project" arms
buildup. A standard <テスラ・ドライブ> lets it fly solo in
gravity. It lacks <ＥＯＴ> and EOT-based weapons, but
its basic specs nearly match the mass-production
prototype's. It also uses the Gespenst-line G-II
Frame, improved from the prototype's, instead of
the Hückebein-line H Frame, keeping costs low.
FIXH\t 大破した<パーソナルトルーパー>「エクスバイン」をベースに\nし、:
Hastily built from the wrecked <パーソナルトルーパー>
"Exbein" using its spare parts. "Ash" was its
development codename; its official name is "Exbein
Ash." The name comes from the French "H" (ache),
the initial of Hückebein, and also means "ash,"
after the phoenix that rises from the ashes.
The Exbein was to be modified as a data and test
unit for new Hückebein Series machines, but was
wrecked by a mysterious unit. It was then fitted
with emergency add-on "Patch Armor" and an
anti-beam mantle, the "Coating Cloak," and sent
into battle. Repairs were still unfinished even
then, and some armor is held on with "AD Tape,"
prized for flexibility and durability. It is a
true stopgap machine.
It also carries a <Ｔ‐ＬＩＮＫシステム> (a telekinesis
sensor-amplifier), but it reacted abnormally when
Ing boarded, and from then on, only he could
pilot the Ash.
FIXH\t ヒュッケバインＭｋ‐Ⅲが使用する砲撃戦用ＡＭパーツ。\n有人の<パ:
The Hückebein Mk-III's artillery AM Part.
A manned <パーソナルトルーパー> carrier that can also
operate alone, armed with four G-Impact Cannons
and several kinds of Missiles.
FIXH\t エクスバイン・アッシュを基にして作り上げられたスーパー\n・<パー:
A Super <パーソナルトルーパー> based on the Exbein Ash.
The culmination of the Hückebein Series, it uses
tech from the Hückebein Mk-III's development and
the RXR Project. The name "Exexbein" comes from
"EX Exbein," but as the sixth Hückebein, after
the Hückebein, Hückebein EX (Exbein), Hückebein
Mk-II, Mass-Production Huckebein Mk-II, and
Hückebein Mk-III, it also nods to "Sechs"
(German for six). Codenames during development:
"Mk-X" (Mark X) and "Double EX."
An ultra-high-performance unit able to run a
<トロニウム> Engine and Black Hole Engine together, it
wields telekinetic weapons such as the
"T-Link Slider."
FIXH\t ハイ・パーソナルトルーパーと呼ばれる高性能機。斧と銃が\n合体した:
A high-performance unit called a High Personal
Trooper. Wielding the Bustax Gun, its own axe-gun
hybrid, it shows great mobility and agility. It
likely uses Hückebein Series data, but details are
unknown. Also called "Code 'Evil'" or "Evil."
FIXH\t マシンナリー・チルドレンが搭乗する人型機動兵器。\n 量産型ヒュッ:
The Machinery Children's humanoid weapon: a
Mass-Production Huckebein Mk-II reshaped and
upgraded by <マシンセル>. With a <ゲイム・システム>
and remote weapons, it also self-repairs well,
as its frame and armor use <マシンセル>.
FIXH\t 地球圏防衛委員会の依頼を受けて<テスラ・ライヒ研究所>が\n開発し:
A special humanoid weapon for fighting aliens,
built by the <テスラ・ライヒ研究所> for the Earth
Sphere Defense Committee. Its core concept is
physical attack by sheer mass, and its size and
shape aim to intimidate intelligent foes.
Built for foes too big for <パーソナルトルーパー>s, it
has immense output and attack power. Its giant
sword, the "Type 0 Zankantou" (ship-cleaving
blade), can split battleship-sized targets.
Its back mounts high-thrust boosters and trim
balancers for swordplay, letting it swing the
Zankantou freely in any direction. Its joints use
TGC Joints, which control inertial mass with
gravity tech to reduce load. Modified after the
<インスペクター事件>, it now uses a plasma reactor.
FIXH\t グルンガストは、<テスラ・ライヒ研究所>にてグルンガス\nト零式や:
The Grungust is a special humanoid weapon built
at the <テスラ・ライヒ研究所> using data from the
Grungust Type 0 and PTX-007-02 Gespenst Mk-II
(Type S).
To excel in many roles, it can transform into a
flight mode (Wing Gust) or heavy tank mode (Gust
Lander). Its armor uses VG alloy (Variable
Geometric Alloys), a type of active metal, which
allows transformation that partly ignores the
structural and shape limits of armor.
It runs on a plasma reactor, and its joints use
TGC Joints, which control inertial mass with
gravity tech to reduce load.
Its built-in weapons, such as the Boost Knuckle
and Final Beam, make it strong in close combat.
A brainwave control unit and voice-activated
weapon selector assist the pilot.
In the Grungust Series, whose units choose their
pilots, it has the best overall balance, earning
the nickname "Super Fighter."
The Grungust Kai is an upgraded Grungust fitted
with the booster-equipped Roundel Wing and Beam
Cannons for better mobility and firepower. Even
with the Roundel Wing, it can still turn into
Wing Gust (flight) or Gust Lander (heavy tank).
FIXH\t グルンガスト改の飛行形態。ラウンデル・ウィングの装着\nにより、航:
The Grungust Kai's flight mode. The Roundel Wing
extends its cruising range.
FIXH\t グルンガスト改の重戦車形態。超闘士形態時と同様、火力が\n向上して:
The Grungust Kai's heavy tank mode. As in Super
Fighter mode, its firepower has been increased.
FIXH\t <Ｌ５戦役>後、凍結処置が解除された<ＳＲＸ計画>において、\n<:
The third (SRG-03-3) of the newest Grungust Series
units, made by the <テスラ・ライヒ研究所> under the
<ＳＲＸ計画>, which was unfrozen after the <Ｌ５戦役>.
Based on the Grungust (Type 1) but even more
melee-focused, it has the series' top output and
attack power. It splits into the G-Raptor, a
large fighter (upper half), and the G-Bison, a
heavy tank (lower half), each with one pilot.
After the <インスペクター事件>, Unit 3 gained a
<Ｔ‐ＬＩＮＫシステム>, a <テスラ・ドライブ>, and the Type 3
Shishioh Blade, sized for <特機>s.
FIXH\t グルンガスト参式の分離形態で、上半身部分が変形した\n大型戦闘機。:
The Grungust Type 3's separated form: a large
fighter transformed from its upper half.
FIXH\t 「レブ」と読む。ソラティス神殿にある量子コンピュータ\nの愛称。:
Pronounced "Reb." The nickname of the quantum
computer in the Solatis Temple.
FIXH\t 機体周辺に発生させた均質化力場によって、球状フィール\nド外縁を通:
A homogenized force field around the unit warps
kinetic energy crossing the spherical field's
edge, diffusing it as tension along the boundary.
Even EM waves lose their wave form, so both beams
and solid rounds can be rendered ineffective.
FIXH\t グルンガスト参式の分離形態で、下半身部分が変形した\n重戦車。:
Separated form of the Grungust Type 3. The lower
half transforms into a heavy tank.
FIXH\t 中国・山東地区にある遺跡・蚩尤塚（しゆうづか）から発掘\nされた<:
A <超機人> unearthed from the Chiyou Mound ruins in
Shandong, China. Said to be a semi-organic weapon
made by the ancients to fight the demons and spirits
called the Hyakuja. It thinks for itself and can act
alone, but cannot unleash its true power unless a
telekinetic it accepts as pilot (a Kyounensha) is
aboard. Compared to its other form, KoRyuOh, it
excels at aerial, underwater and long-range magic
combat, and has tremendous attack power.

A <超機人> unearthed from the Chiyou Mound ruins in
Shandong, China. RyuKoOh is made of two <超機人>,
RyuOhKi and KoOhKi. Combined with KoOhKi on top and
RyuOhKi below, they become KoRyuOh. Compared with
RyuKoOh, it excels at ground and close combat and is
skilled with weapons. It cannot fly, but it moves
well on land and can create afterimages with its
body-splitting technique.
FIXH\t 四神・青龍の<超機人>。龍王機単体でも高い戦闘能力を有し、\n空中:
The Four Gods' Azure Dragon <超機人>. Strong
even solo, it excels in the air and underwater.
FIXH\t 四神・白虎の<超機人>。虎王機単体でも高い戦闘能力を有し、\n地上:
The Four Gods' White Tiger <超機人>. Strong
even solo, it excels at fast ground combat.

The Four Gods' White Tiger <超機人>. Even alone, it
excels at fast ground combat. As Baral's servant, it
fights Brit's team. Now black, it seems as strong
as with a Kyounensha aboard, if not stronger.
FIXH\t 大破した<超機人>・龍王機にグルンガスト・シリーズの予備\nパーツ:
The wrecked <超機人> RyuOhKi, rebuilt as a humanoid
mobile weapon using spare Grungust series parts. It
can no longer return to its original form. It keeps
RyuOhKi's specs, excelling in air and magic combat,
yet melees with its telescoping Ruyi Golden Stick.
FIXH\t 「百邪」と呼ばれる悪魔や妖怪と戦うため、古代人が作り上\nげた半生:
A semi-organic weapon built by the ancients to fight
the demons and spirits called the Hyakuja. Like
RyuKoOh and KoRyuOh, it is a Four Gods <超機人>,
formed by combining the <超機人> JakuOhKi, modeled
on the Vermilion Bird, and BuOhKi, modeled on the
Black Tortoise. Armed with the slender Kokuja Blade
and the Burinkou shield, it excels at close and
mid-range combat. The Kokuja Blade is a chain of
Datourin segments: it bends freely, extends, and can
even become BuJakuOh's Kokuja Kyuuhou. This is due
to the Soufu, special talismans used to build Four
Gods <超機人> and enable their godlike
transformation and combining. JakuBuOh is fierce and
proud, and female in human terms. Badly hurt in past
wars, it has been reshaped often. Kanan and Taihoku
rebuilt it with Soufu parts modeled on super robots.

A semi-organic weapon built by the ancients to fight
the demons and spirits called the Hyakuja. Like
RyuKoOh and KoRyuOh, it is a Four Gods <超機人>,
formed by combining the <超機人> JakuOhKi, modeled
on the Vermilion Bird, and BuOhKi, modeled on the
Black Tortoise. Its huge back shell and the barrier
called Shinjuujun give it the best defense of the
Four Gods. Its Soufu, the special talismans used to
build <超機人>, regenerate far better than others'.
It also has Soufu parts modeled on super robots,
including modern missile launchers. Its main weapon
is the Kokuja Kyuuhou, transformed from JakuBuOh's
Kokuja Blade, built for bombardment. It can further
become the Genten Shouten Hou for extreme range.
Slow, poor at melee. BuJakuOh is cool and patient.
FIXH\t 朱雀の姿を模して作られた四神の<超機人>。高速空中戦闘を\n得意と:
A Four Gods <超機人>, the Vermilion Bird.
A fast aerial fighter that outflies RyuOhKi.
FIXH\t 玄武の姿を模して作られた四神の<超機人>。防御力は高いが、\n運動:
A Four Gods <超機人>, the Black Tortoise. High
defense, low mobility. Its role is to shield
others; it's weak at fighting in this form.
FIXH\t 「百邪」と呼ばれる悪魔や妖怪と戦うため、古代人が作り上\nげた半生:
One of the Four Spirits, the highest rank of the
<超機人>: semi-organic weapons the ancients made to
fight the Hyakuja demons. A Yinglong in form, it is
among the largest <超機人>, with vast attack power.
FIXH\t 「とうてつおう」と読む。「四凶」の<超機人>で、人面羊身、\n虎の:
Read as "Toutetsuoh." A Four Fiends <超機人> with a
human face, a sheep's body and tiger fangs. Always
greedy and starving, it devours human souls.
FIXH\t 「きゅうきおう」と読む。「四凶」の<超機人>で、翼を持った\n虎の:
Read as "Kyuukioh." A Four Fiends <超機人> shaped
like a winged tiger. It handles not only fast ground
combat but aerial combat as well.
FIXH\t 「ていこう」と読む。バラルが使役する妖機人の一種。: Read as "Teikou." One of Baral's Yokijin.
FIXH\t 「もうかい」と読む。バラルが使役する妖機人の一種。: Read as "Moukai." One of Baral's Yokijin.
FIXH\t 「からぎょ」と読む。バラルが使役する妖機人の一種。: Read as "Karagyo." One of Baral's Yokijin.
FIXH\t 「ほうきょう」と読む。バラルが使役する妖機人の一種。: Read as "Houkyou." One of Baral's Yokijin.
FIXH\t 「くしんこうしゅ」と読む。バラルが使役する妖機人の一\n種。: Read as "Kushinkoushu." One of Baral's Yokijin.
FIXH\t ククルが使用する女神の姿を模した人型兵器。元は彼女の国\nでまつら:
A humanoid weapon used by Kukuru, modeled on a
goddess. It was apparently a divine statue worshiped
in her homeland, but how it moves is unknown.
FIXH\t 「神僕」と呼ばれる鷲の姿をした空戦型の機動兵器。<地球連\n邦軍>:
A Shinboku: an eagle-shaped aerial mobile weapon.
The <地球連邦軍> calls it a "Custos."
FIXH\t 「神僕」と呼ばれる鮫の姿をした宙間・水中戦闘型の機動\n兵器。<地:
A Shinboku: a shark-shaped space/underwater unit.
The <地球連邦軍> calls it a "Custos."
FIXH\t 「神僕」と呼ばれる豹の姿をした陸戦型の機動兵器。<地球連\n邦軍>:
A Shinboku: a leopard-shaped ground mobile weapon.
The <地球連邦軍> calls it a "Custos."
FIXH\t バラルの園を防衛する機動兵器。ケレンを小型化し、量産し\nたものだ:
A mobile weapon that defends Baral's Garden. Likely
a downsized, mass-produced version of the Keren.
FIXH\t <ＥＯＴ特別審議会>が推進していたプロジェクト・アーク\n（種の保:
A huge cryosleep facility built for Project Ark,
the species preservation plan promoted by the
<ＥＯＴ特別審議会>. Located under Kenya,
Africa, it is run by Dr. Sophia Nate's autonomous
supercomputer Magus. Thousands would hibernate
there to survive the coming war with the
Aerogators, but the <ＤＣ
戦争> halted construction.
Seized by DC remnants as a base after the war, it
was wrecked in battle with the Kurogane team and
is now under a special Federation Army research
agency. The Moon has a similar site: Moon Cradle.
FIXH\t 戦闘機から発展した対異星人戦闘用の機動兵器の総称。\n 重力質量・:
Anti-alien mobile weapons derived from fighters.
With the high-efficiency <テスラ・ドライブ>, a reaction
drive that splits gravitational and inertial mass,
they fly unaided, outmaneuvering any fighter.
They were the DC's main force in the DC War.
Postwar, <イスルギ重工> kept making them
and they serve as the Federation Army's main arms.
FIXH\t 「Ｉｄｅｎｔｉｆｉｃａｔｉｏｎ Ｆｒｉｅｎｄ \nＦｏｅ」の略称で:
Short for "Identification Friend or Foe," a
system that tells allies from enemies.
FIXH\t 南太平洋マーケサズ諸島沖の孤島で、新西暦１７９年に\n謎の隕石メテ:
A remote island off the Marquesas in the South
Pacific where the mysterious Meteor 3 fell in
N.C. 179. To study it, the <ＥＯＴＩ機関> put
its HQ there, and the <ＥＯＴ> and anti-alien arms
it studied became the core of the <ＤＣ>'s forces.
The whole island is fortified, ostensibly to keep
<ＥＯＴ> secrets. Given its geography, the fortress
is built mainly around air defense and air power.
Its facilities were nearly destroyed in the fight
with the Septuagint in the <Ｌ５戦役>. Rebuilt by
the GS, it is now their HQ, Grand Christmas.
FIXH\t 新西暦１８７年から１８８年にかけて地球圏に出現した\n異形の集団。:
A bizarre group that appeared in the Earth Sphere
from N.C. 187 to 188. Its main force was the Einst
Series, mysterious bio-weapons, and at first it
fought puzzling local battles again and again.
Only the high-ranking Regisseur and a girl named
Alfimi had clear will, intelligence, or the means
to communicate, and they're organized like bees or
ants. The Einst have existed since ancient times
in another dimension (Einst Space), apparently
watching the actions of intelligent life, though
details are unknown. They sought to wipe out
humans, who never stop fighting and disturb the
universe's peace, and create new intelligent life,
but in the end they tried to link Einst Space to
our world and invade it. They clashed many times
with the Hagane, Kurogane, and Hiryu Custom. In
the last battle, Neu Regisseur merged with the
White Star, becoming the giant Stern Neu Regisseur
but fell to the Kurogane and Hiryu Custom. After
its end, Einst units everywhere followed suit.
FIXH\t <テレキネシスαパルス>の測定数値の表し方の代表例。\n集中力に優:
A common measure of the <テレキネシスαパルス>.
Those who concentrate well tend to score high, and
past a set level, one possesses Telekinesis, an
uncanny power of the mind. It also shows how well
a subject matches the <Ｔ‐ＬＩＮＫシステム>.
FIXH\t Ｅｘｔｒａ Ｏｖｅｒ Ｔｅｃｈｎｏｌｏｇｙの略で、\nアイドネウス:
Short for Extra Over Technology, the general term
for the alien super-technology found in Meteor 3,
the meteorite that fell on Aidoneus Island.
Dr. Bian Zoldark's <ＥＯＴＩ機関> studied it,
bringing revolutionary advances to many fields,
above all military technology. Its tech and data,
however, were managed by the <ＥＯＴ特別審議会>
and seldom applied to society at large.
FIXH\t Ｅｘｔｒａ Ｏｖｅｒ Ｔｅｃｈｎｏｌｏｇｙ \nＩｎｑｕｉｒｙ Ｏ:
Extra Over Technology Inquiry Organization.
Formed in N.C. 180 to analyze and study the <ＥＯＴ>
found in Meteor 3, the mysterious meteorite that
fell on Aidoneus Island. Top scientists worldwide
were gathered, with Bian Zoldark, hailed as a
genius scientist of his era, as its director. It
became the basis of the <ＤＣ>, and its scientists
went on developing weapons, systems, and more for
the <ＤＣ>.
FIXH\t メテオ３やエアロゲイターにまつわる機密を扱う連邦政府\nの高等機関:
A high-level Federation body handling secrets tied
to Meteor 3 and the Aerogators, made up of 13 key
members of the Federal Security Committee. It also
oversees the <ＥＯＴＩ機関>. Its chair was Carl
Streissman, vice-chair of the Security Committee.
Learning the Aerogators' might from studies of
Meteor 3 and the <ＥＯＴ>, they saw Bian's call for
all-out war as dangerous and watched and hindered
him--which in turn helped drive Bian to raise the
<ＤＣ>. Carl Streissman and all other members died in
the L5 Campaign, and the council ceased to exist.
FIXH\t 造船、発電所設備、航空機などを総合的に扱う企業。\n業界大手で歴史:
An old, leading firm in shipbuilding, power plant
gear, aircraft, and more. Strong in aerospace, it
holds a key place in the arms industry. It once
supplied the Federation's main fighter, the F-32
Schwert, yet had ties to the <ＥＯＴＩ機関> and
secretly mass-produced the Lion Series in the
<ＤＣ戦争>. Ironically, after the <Ｌ５戦役>, they
became the Federation Army's main units, and its
DC aid was overlooked to secure stable production.
FIXH\t インスペクターとは、別の星系より到来し、地球の文明\nを監査してい:
The Inspectors are aliens who came from another
star system to audit human civilization. Deeming
that humanity's endless resolve for battle would
in time upset the galactic order, they schemed
to rule the Earth Sphere. Vigagi, their combat
Commander, used Inspectors as a handy label in
battle with the Hiryu Custom; Earth took it as a
code name. Their true name remains unknown.
They invaded in N.C. 187 and, in a blitz, seized
the <ホワイトスター>, the Moon, and key parts of North
America. But amid the Earth Federation Army's
counteroffensive, Operation Plantagenet, and the
chaos of the <アインスト> Series' mass outbreak, they
had to withdraw from Earth. Later, at the White
Star, the Kurogane and Hiryu Custom beat them,
killing supreme commander Wendolo and other key
members. The Inspectors were destroyed--though
some say they were only an advance force.
FIXH\t 新西暦１８７年から１８８年にかけて起きたインスペク\nターによる争:
The upheaval caused by the Inspectors from N.C.
187 to 188. The Inspectors were aliens who came
from another star system to audit human
civilization. Deeming that humanity's endless
resolve for battle would one day upset the
galactic order, they schemed to rule the Earth
Sphere. They invaded in N.C. 187 and, in a blitz,
seized the Moon and North America. But caught in
the chaos of the Einst Series' mass outbreak, they
had to withdraw from Earth, and were wiped out
after losing to the Kurogane and Hiryu Custom.
FIXH\t シュウが搭乗する対異星人戦闘用<アーマードモジュール>。動\n力源:
An anti-alien <アーマードモジュール> piloted by Shu.
Powered by an annihilation engine, its armor is
super-resistant titanium reinforced at the subatomic
level. It favors firepower, armor and defense over
mobility, and its attack power is fearsome. One of
its designers, Eric Wong, said, "If the pilot had
superhuman abilities, Granzon could wipe out the
whole world's forces in a day." Shu's Kabbalah
Program reportedly lets it use astral energy, too.
It hides many black boxes, but since the <ＤＣ戦争>,
Shu has run it alone, its secrets and aims veiled.
FIXH\t 水の精霊ガッドを守護精霊とする<魔装機神>。汎用性が高い\nが、攻:
A <魔装機神> guarded by Gad, the water spirit. It
is versatile but somewhat weak in attack. It wields
the spear Gungnir, given a special orichalconium
alloy treatment that boosts magic amplification.
Used as a medium, it greatly empowers magic weapons.
FIXH\t 炎の精霊グランバを守護精霊とする<魔装機神>。高い攻撃力を\n誇る:
A <魔装機神> guarded by Granba, the fire spirit. It
boasts high attack power but weak defense. To
control the caloric (heat element) overexcited
inside the unit by Granba, it has a dedicated heat
circulation engine, the "Caloric Recycler." It also
converts surplus caloric into drive energy, helping
drive Granveil's high output.
FIXH\t 大地の精霊ザムージュを守護精霊とする<魔装機神>。他の<魔装\n機:
A <魔装機神> guarded by Zamuuj, the earth spirit.
Less mobile than the other <魔装機神> but sturdier,
it can also regenerate itself. Its left-arm
vibration generator can lock an enemy's drive system
for a time on a direct hit, or be driven into the
ground to cause earthquakes through resonance. Its
large weapon bay can carry three familiars.
FIXH\t サフィーネの愛機で、彼女が自ら設計開発した。コンセプト\nは<魔装:
Saphine's own unit, which she designed and built.
It follows the <魔装機> concept, but she calls it a
Yousouki. Getting a normal <魔装機>'s power without
a spirit contract is unique Volkruss Cult tech. As
a prototype, its output is still unstable.
FIXH\t ソルガディを元にして造られた<魔装機>で、同機と遜色ない性\n能を:
A <魔装機> based on the Solgady, just as capable.
Second only to the Blowell in numbers. Spirit: a
shard of Soreid, lesser wind spirit of sandstorms.
FIXH\t 雷の精霊ガルナンサと契約した<魔装機>。<魔装機>計画の最後に\n:
A <魔装機> bound to Garnansa, the lightning spirit.
The last unit of the <魔装機> project, it nearly
matched a <魔装機神>, but no will awoke within it.
Its four arms shine in close combat, but since
<魔装機> piloting syncs with the body's senses, only
experts are said to unlock its full potential. Its
lines echo Granveil's, as both had the same exterior
designer, but in concept it's closer to Cybuster.
FIXH\t ラングランの正<魔装機>第１号機。陽炎の精霊ジャノクを守護\n精霊:
Langran's first official <魔装機>, guarded by Janoc,
the spirit of heat haze. Its powerful <プラーナ>
converter can give it <魔装機神>-level power with
the right pilot. Built fairly early, it uses some
reinforced ceramic armor and is a bit fragile, but
its fine motion control system became the base for
later <魔装機>. Lacking firepower, it carries a
handheld gun as standard, rare for a <魔装機>.
FIXH\t 森の精霊ディアノスと契約した<魔装機>。中距離からの砲撃支\n援を:
A <魔装機> bound to Dianos, the forest spirit. Built
for mid-range fire support, it has a large twin
Linear Railgun on each shoulder. Not designed for
melee, it's surprisingly nimble thanks to its
weight balance and can fight close in good hands.
It was later the basis for mass-produced <魔装機>.
FIXH\t <魔装機>計画の試作１号機。精霊との契約テストをするため、\n都合:
The <魔装機> project's first prototype. Three were
built in all to test spirit contracts. One could
not endure the contract and broke. The other two
awaited disposal until Feilord renewed the pacts;
Xenia and Monica got them as ceremonial <魔装機>.
Not combat units, they're weak but got repair gear.
FIXH\t セニアとモニカがノルスに改修を施し、戦闘能力を向上させ\nた機体。:
Xenia and Monica's upgrade of the Norse, boosting
its combat ability. Base specs barely changed, but
some weapons were improved or added. Rear support,
especially repair, was boosted more than combat.
"Rei" means "modified" in the Langran language.
FIXH\t シュテドニアス軍で用いられる<魔装機>。オールラウンド・タ\nイプ:
A <魔装機> used by the Schtedonias army. Designed as
an all-rounder, it has no real weaknesses, but by
the same token it lacks a decisive edge.
FIXH\t シュテドニアス軍で用いられる<魔装機>で、ギルドーラの簡易\n量産:
A Schtedonias army <魔装機>, a simplified mass-
production Gildora. Its <プラーナ> converter is
improved, but spirit limits keep its rank low.
FIXH\t 機動力に富み、一撃離脱を得意とする風系<魔装機>。通常武装\nが他:
A highly mobile wind <魔装機> built for hit-and-run.
Its standard arms trail other <魔装機>, so its
performance depends heavily on pilot skill. Its
output is stable, and its spirit's nature suits
nearly any pilot, which led to the mass-produced
Gadifor. Spirit: Soreid, lesser spirit of sandstorms.
FIXH\t セニアが設計した超<魔装機>。従来の<魔装機>と異なり、ヒュッ\n:
A super <魔装機> designed by Xenia. Unlike others,
it draws on Huckebein series data, giving it a
unique look. It has no spirit contract, but its
pseudo-<プラーナ> generator lets high-<プラーナ> pilots
reach <魔装機神>-level power. The trade-off is a
fairly short operating time.
FIXH\t シュテドニアス軍で用いられるＢクラス<魔装機>。本来はＣク\nラス:
A B-class <魔装機> used by the Schtedonias army.
Planned as C-class, it proved better balanced than
expected during tuning and was rated B-class.
FIXH\t ディアブロの簡易量産型<魔装機>で、ラングラン軍の主力機。: Simple mass-model Diablo, Langran's main unit.
FIXH\t オールトの愛機で、金に糸目を付けず改造を行った。そのた\nめ、大幅:
Oort's personal unit, modified with no expense
spared, giving it a massive power boost.
FIXH\t Ｄクラス<魔装機>の一種。本来は土木作業用に作られたもので、\n<:
A D-class <魔装機>. Originally built for construction,
it hardly deserves the name <魔装機>, but as global
tensions rose, it was hastily refit with weapons
and came to be called a <魔装機>.
FIXH\t <ラ・ギアス>の各国で用いられている移動要塞で、高射砲やバ\nリオ:
A mobile fortress used by the nations of
<ラ・ギアス>. Armed with Anti-Aircraft Guns, Barrion
Beam Cannons and more; it holds several <魔装機>.
FIXH\t 正確にはヴォルクルスの分身の一つ。本体よりかなり力は劣\nるが、Ａ:
Strictly, one of Volkruss's avatars. Far weaker
than the real one, but on par with A-class <魔装機>.
FIXH\t カークスが搭乗する超<魔装機>。<魔装機神>グランヴェールやザ\n:
A super <魔装機> piloted by Kirkus, based on data
from the <魔装機神> Granveil and Zamzeed. Though
the project was axed, Kirkus secretly kept building
the Eulid. It outclasses even the <魔装機神>.
FIXH\t 神殿の警護などに用いられるロボット。無人機で、戦闘能力\nはさほど:
A robot used for guarding temples and the like.
It's unmanned, and its combat ability is modest.
FIXH\t 本来は無人偵察機であり、イオノクラフト効果で飛行可能。\nその汎用:
Originally an unmanned scout using ionocraft flight.
Prized for versatility, <ラ・ギアス> nations armed it.
LDBI\t「私も手伝いたいんだけど……@ やらなきゃならない仕事がたくさんあっ: I'd like to help too, but...@I've got so much work I need to do,@I don't think I can make it.

LDBI\t「連邦軍の通信を再度傍受！@ 間違いありません、エクアドル東岸部で@: Federation comms intercepted again!@No doubt about it, they're engaging Ruina@forces on Ecuador's east coast!
LDBI\t「ルイーナが複数地点を同時に襲撃しているため、@ 連邦軍は対処し切れ: The Ruina are hitting multiple points at once,@so the Federation can't keep up!
LDBI\t「……最大戦速でエクアドル東岸部に向かった場合、@ 到達までの時間は: ...If we head for Ecuador's east coast at@maximum combat speed, how long until we arrive?
LDBI\t「およそ３０分といった所ですが……@ 転針されるおつもりで？ 連邦軍: About 30 minutes... but do you intend to change@course? We'd be more likely to run into the@Gaia Savers, not just the Federation.
LDBI\t「この事態を看過するわけにはいきません。@ それに、彼らも地球の守護: We cannot overlook this situation.@Besides, if they claim to be Earth's guardians,@they'll surely put fighting the Ruina first.
LDBI\t「それでも、リスクは高いですぞ？」: Even so, the risk is high, you know.
LDBI\t「副長……@ 我々もまた地球の危機に立ち向かう者であることを、@ 行: XO...@We must show through our actions that we, too,@stand against the threats to Earth.
LDBI\t「では、直ちに転針。ＡＴＸチーム、ＳＲＸチーム、@ 特殊戦技教導隊を: Then change course immediately. Send the ATX@Team, SRX Team and Special Tactics Training Unit@ahead to the areas the Federation can't cover.

LDBI\t「ここで退けるか！ 援軍が来るまで持ち堪えるぞ！」: We can't fall back now!@Hold out until reinforcements arrive!
LDBI\t「鋼龍戦隊ＡＴＸチーム、キョウスケ・ナンブ中尉だ。@ これより、そち: This is Lieutenant Kyosuke Nanbu, Steel Dragons@ATX Team. We're moving in to support you.
LDBI\t「ええ。@ 義を見てせざるは勇無きなり……などと@ 言われたくありま: Yes.@We'd rather no one said we saw what was right@and lacked the courage to do it.

LDBI\t「なら、こちらは好きにやらせてもらう」: Then we'll do as we please.
LDBI\t「だからこそ、頼もしいとも言える」: Which is exactly what makes him reliable.
LDBI\t「まあ、こっちもメンツが足りないもんねぇ」: Well, we're short on people too, huh?
LDBI\t「……アサルト１より各機。他地区のことも気になる。@ ここは速攻で片: ...Assault 1 to all units. I'm worried about@the other sectors. We finish this fast.
LDBI\t「……このままでは時間が掛かり過ぎるな。@ アサルト１より各機。フォ: ...This is taking too long.@Assault 1 to all units. Formation A3.@Crush the enemies dead ahead in one push.
LDBI\t「チッ！@ 止められると思うな！ クレイモア！」: Tch!@Don't think you can stop me! Claymore!
