LDBI\t「前回は限仙境にて、@ なるべく穏やかに説伏しようとしたが……」: Last time, at Gensenkyo,@I tried to persuade you as gently as I could...
LDBI\t「君達に対しては、@ もっと直接的な方法が効果的なようだ」: But with you people,@a more direct approach seems to work better.
BMD\t「このククルをここまで追い込むとは……！！」: To think I, Kukuru,/　would be driven this far...!!
BMD\t「ええい！ 老いぼれめが！！」: Blast it! You doddering old fool!!
BMD\t「せ、青龍はさらなる力を得たか……！！」: Th-The Azure Dragon has gained/　even greater power...!!
BMD\t「四神の超機人め……よくも、よくも！」: Choukijin of the Four Gods.../　How dare you... How dare you!
BMD\t「ぬうう……無敵青龍の称号は、/ 伊達ではないな！」: Nngh... So the Invincible Azure Dragon/　title is no empty boast!
BMD\t「うぐっ！/ 虎龍王にこれ以上翻弄されるわけにはいかぬ！」: Ugh!/　KoRyuOh shall toy with me no longer!
BMD\t「な、何……！？/ あやつの斬艦刀は八握剣とでも言うのか！！」: Wh-What...!?/　Is that Zankantou a Yatsukaken!?
BMD\t「くっ！ 僕を止められぬ！！」: Ngh! I cannot stop this servant!!
BMD\t「うぬっ！ このままでは、また縛られる！」: Nngh! I'll be bound again at this rate!
BMD\t「妾に触れるだけでなく、/ 手傷を負わせるとは！」: Not only touching me, but/　wounding me as well!
BMD\t「我が舞を見切ったとでも……！？」: Has my dance been seen through...!?
BMD\t「くうっ！/ マガルガがこのように揺らぐとは……！」: Ngh!/　To think Magaruga would waver like this...!
BMD\t「只者ではないようじゃの……！」: You are no ordinary foe, it seems...!
BMD\t「くっ！ このマガルガに傷を付けたか！」: Ngh! You managed to scratch Magaruga!
BMD\t「ふふふ……そなたの舞、気に入ったぞ！」: Heh heh heh... I like your dance!
BMD\t「私に触れるだけでなく、/ 手傷を負わせるとは……！！」: Not only touching me, but/　wounding me as well...!!
BMD\t「口先だけではないようじゃの、/ ゼンガー……！」: It seems you are not all talk,/　Sänger...!
BMD\t「あやつの気迫に押されるとは！」: To think I'd be pushed back by his Drive!
BMD\t「人の業と力が、/ このような結果を招いたか……！」: Human sin and power have/　led to such an outcome...!
BMD\t「四神としての力は、/ 衰えておらぬようじゃの……！」: Your power as one of the Four Gods/　has not faded, it seems...!
BMD\t「それで妾を屠る気か？」: You intend to slay me with that?
BMD\t「妾を捉えたことは、褒めてやろうぞ」: I shall praise you for catching me.
BMD\t「何の真似じゃ、それは？」: What is the meaning of that?
BMD\t「ふふふ、我が衣に触れたか……」: Heh heh heh, you touched my robes...
BMD\t「見えるだろう？ 冥府の扉が……」: You see it? The gate to the underworld...
BMD\t「老いぼれが……効かぬわ」: Old fool... That has no effect.
BMD\t「くっ、妾をいたぶる気か……！」: Ngh, you mean to torment me...!
BMD\t「妾は、言いなりにはならぬと言った……！」: I told you I would not be your puppet...!
BMD\t「光龍め、遊んでおるつもりか？」: Koryu, do you think this a game?
BMD\t「それがそなたの新たな力か、青龍」: So this is your new power, Azure Dragon.
BMD\t「龍虎王の力は、その程度か？」: Is that all RyuKoOh's power amounts to?
BMD\t「そなたの剣では、我が命に届かぬわ」: Your blade cannot reach my life.
BMD\t「そなたでは相手にならぬ」: You are no match for me.
BMD\t「見るがいい、我が舞を……/ そなたの命尽きるまで！」: Behold my dance.../　until your life runs out!
BMD\t「ふふふ……妾はここにおるぞ」: Heh heh heh... I am right here.
LDBI\t「へえ、意外だな。@ 怖い物なしかと思ってたぜ」: Huh, that's a surprise.@I figured you weren't scared of anything.
LDBI\t「ま、カチーナ中尉の@ 数少ないチャーム・ポイントでもあるわよねぇ」: Well, it's one of Lieutenant Katina's@few charm points, isn't it?
LDBI\t「……クスハ、嫌な予感がする。気をつけるんだ」: ...Kusuha, I've got a bad feeling. Be careful.
LDBI\t「ここで足止めされるわけにはいきません。@ 早急に妖機人の撃破を！」: We can't afford to be held up here.@Destroy the Yokijin at once!
LDBI\t「艦長、@ 損傷部の応急措置は短時間で終わるようです」: Captain, emergency repairs to the damaged@sections shouldn't take long.
LDBI\t「あ、あんなものを至近距離で見るなんて@ 耐えられない……」: S-Seeing those things up close...@I can't bear it...
LDBI\t「あ、いえ……@ 弾幕をもっと厚くし、敵を近づけさせないように」: Ah, no... Thicken the barrage@and keep the enemy from getting close.
LDBI\t「では、彼らを出します」: Then I shall send them out.
LDBI\t「其は罪科の色……」: That is the color of sin...
LDBI\t「主の恩寵を忘れ、@ 俗人に身を許した罪……その穢れぞ」: The sin of forgetting its master's grace@and yielding itself to mortals...@That is its defilement.
LDBI\t「俺達と一緒に、人界を護るために戦ったことが@ 罪だと言うのか！」: You're saying fighting alongside us to@protect the human world was a sin!?
LDBI\t「その通り。@ 虎王機はあるべき姿、然るべき立場に戻ったのじゃ」: Indeed. KoOhKi has returned to its true form@and its rightful station.
LDBI\t「あの色……私には、あなた達が虎王機を@ 無理矢理ねじ伏せた証のよう: That color... To me, it looks like proof@that you forced KoOhKi into submission!
LDBI\t「虎王機は四神、白虎の超機人……@ その色が失われた状態が、あるべき: KoOhKi is a Chokijin, the White Tiger of the@Four Gods... How can it be in its true form@when it's lost its color? That makes no sense!
LDBI\t「ふむ、理にかなっておるのう。@ あの青龍の少女、夏喃が目を付けただ: Hmm, that is reasonable. No wonder Kanan,@the girl of the Blue Dragon, took an interest@in her.
LDBI\t「……そもそも、虎王機を強制的に連れて行ったこと@ 自体が怪しい。お: ...Taking KoOhKi away by force was suspicious@in itself. If your master is the rightful one,@KoOhKi and RyuOhKi would've obeyed willingly!
LDBI\t「白虎の強念者は真直な気を持っておるの。@ 善哉、善哉」: The White Tiger's psychic has a true heart.@Splendid, splendid.
LDBI\t「……其は、そなたらの理。@ 全ての超機人は、我が主の眷族……@ 青: ...That is your logic.@All Chokijin are kin to my master...@The Blue Dragon and White Tiger resist, fools.
LDBI\t「虎王機と龍王機は、@ クスハとブルックリンと共に@ 人界を脅かす敵: KoOhKi and RyuOhKi fought alongside@Kusuha and Brooklyn against the enemies@threatening the human world...
LDBI\t「俺もこの目でそれを見た。@ 人外の理など、我らには通用せんぞ」: I saw it with my own eyes.@Inhuman logic means nothing to us.
LDBI\t「人外……@ ふっ、そうじゃな。今の妾は然り」: Inhuman...@Heh, true enough. As I am now, that I am.
LDBI\t「じゃが、他の四神の超機人は、我が主に従っておる。@ 道を誤っておる: But the other Chokijin of the Four Gods@obey my master. It is the Blue Dragon and@White Tiger who have strayed from the path.
LDBI\t「現にそなたらは超機人の色どころか、@ 姿を歪めておるじゃろうが」: Indeed, you have warped not only their color,@but their very forms.
LDBI\t「惑わされるな、クスハ。@ 龍人機を信じるんだ、今までそうしてきたよ: Don't let her get to you, Kusuha.@Trust RyuJinKi, just like you always have.
LDBI\t「俺も虎王機を信じる……そして、取り戻す」: I trust KoOhKi too... And I'll get it back.
LDBI\t「黒くなって出て来たってのが、@ いかにもって感じのパターンだからな: Coming out all black is a classic pattern.@They definitely did something to it over there.
LDBI\t「そうだ……@ Ｇサンダーゲートも出て来た時は黒かった。@ その後は: Yeah...@G-Thundergate was black when it showed up too.@And you know how that turned out.
LDBI\t「わかったわ……虎王機を取り戻しましょう！」: All right... Let's get KoOhKi back!
LDBI\t「それはこちらの台詞じゃ！@ 白虎よ、そなたは青龍を！ 妾はあの天鳥: That is my line!@White Tiger, you take the Blue Dragon!@I shall take that sky-bird ship!
LDBI\t「大丈夫だ、イルイ。みんなを信じるんだ」: It's okay, Irui. Believe in everyone.
LDBI\t「ヒリュウの近くにいる者は、ヒリュウを護れ！@ ブルックリン、お前は: Those near the Hiryu, defend it!@Brooklyn, hold KoOhKi back!
LDBI\t「了解！@ クスハ、俺が虎王機を説得してみる！@ 援護してくれ！」: Roger!@Kusuha, I'll try to talk KoOhKi down!@Cover me!
LDBI\t「お前は人界を守護する超機人なんだろう！？@ そのために、俺の力を必: You're the Chokijin guarding our world, right!?@That's why you needed my power, isn't it!?@Remember that!
LDBI\t「応えないのか……！@ だが、俺はお前を……初めて出会った時、@ 俺: You won't answer...!@But I believe in the words you spoke to Kusuha@and me when we first met!
LDBI\t「お前に掛けられた呪縛、@ 力尽くでも解いてみせるぞ！」: I'll break the curse on you,@even if I have to use force!
LDBI\t「まず虎王機の動きを止めなければ……！」: First I have to stop KoOhKi...!
LDBI\t「何とかして虎王機の動きを止めなきゃ……！@ 龍人機、力を貸して！」: We have to stop KoOhKi somehow...!@RyuJinKi, lend me your strength!
LDBI\t「お願い、応えて！@ 私やブリット君、龍人機に！」: Please, answer!@Answer me, Bullet, and RyuJinKi!
LDBI\t「あなたが妖機人と一緒に@ 私達の世界へ災いをもたらすなんて……@: You, bringing disaster to our world@alongside the Yokijin...@I don't want to see you like that...
LDBI\t「だから、私はあなたを止めますっ！」: So I'm going to stop you!
LDBI\t「ククルよ、お前もかつては人だったのか？」: Kukuru, were you once human as well?
LDBI\t「もしや、お前も虎王機と同じく……」: Could it be that you, like KoOhKi...
LDBI\t「黙れ！ @ 妾の邪魔をするなら、そなたから先に@ 打ち倒してやろう: Silence!@If you stand in my way, I shall strike@you down first!
LDBI\t（……何だ？ @ この……俺の中に別の誰かがいるような感覚は……？@: (...What? This... feeling like there's@someone else inside me...?@It's cold, dark... What is this...?)
BMD\t「ほ～れ、ほれ」: Here ya go, here ya go.
BMD\t「そ～れ、斬っちゃうよ」: Heeere goes, I'm gonna slice ya.
BMD\t「さ～、派手にい～くぜ」: Okaaay, let's go out with a bang.
BMD\t「狙いはバ～ッチリ」: Got ya riiight in my sights.
BMD\t「こ～れで終わりなんだな！ 悪いけど！」: This is the end of the liiine! Sorry!
BMD\t「ほ～れ、ほれ！」: Here ya go, here ya go!
BMD\t「さ～て、終わりにしますか」: Welp, shall we wrap this up?
BMD\t「も～う逃げられない！ 潰れろって！」: No escaaape now! Just get crushed!
LDBI\t「さらに、いったん王都へ戻って欲しいとも言っている。@ ……おそらく: They also ask that we return to the capital.@...I suspect Lord Zabod's illness is a lie.@Something may have happened over there.
LDBI\t「あるいは、罠か……。@ 私がカークス将軍に連絡し、問い質しましょう: Or perhaps it's a trap...@Allow me to contact General Kirkus and demand@an explanation.
LDBI\t「いや、いい。@ ……テツヤ中佐、先方に受諾したと@ 返答していただ: No, that won't be necessary.@...Commander Tetsuya, please reply that@we accept.
LDBI\t「ええ、しばらく様子を見ます。@ ハガネはここで待機していただきたい: Yes, I'll wait and see how things unfold.@I'd like the Hagane to remain on standby here...
LDBI\t「殿下、いったいどういうことなんだ！？」: Your Highness, what the hell is going on!?
LDBI\t「構わんよ、マサキはそうでなくては面白くない」: It's fine. Masaki wouldn't be any fun otherwise.
LDBI\t「カークスの野郎はこっちをなめてやがるんだ！@ 俺達はガキの使いじゃ: That bastard Kirkus is making fools of us!@We're not a bunch of errand boys!
LDBI\t「いや、私は向こうで不測の事態が@ 起きたと考えている」: No, I believe something unforeseen@has happened over there.
LDBI\t「カークス将軍にとって都合が悪いこと……@ そして、殿下に知られたく: Something inconvenient for General Kirkus...@and something he doesn't want you to know?
LDBI\t「ええ、ハガネの戦力に関する資料は@ 一通り目を通しているので」: Yes. I've looked over the files on@the Hagane's forces.
LDBI\t（……さすがだな。@ 一軍の長を務めるだけのことはある）: (...Impressive.@He's earned his place at the head of an army.)
LDBI\t「あ、殿下……す、すみません。@ ここにいらっしゃると思っていなかっ: Oh, Your Highness... I-I'm sorry.@I didn't realize you were here...
LDBI\t「構いません。それで、何が？」: It's quite all right. Now, what is it?
LDBI\t「緊急放送の映像を受信して……@ 今から戴冠式が始まるとわかったんで: We picked up an emergency broadcast...@The coronation is starting right now!
LDBI\t「これは……@ 殿下のご予想が的中したかも知れませんな」: This is...@It seems your suspicions may have been right,@Your Highness.
LDBI\t「……マサキ、その映像を@ ここで見られるように出来るか？」: ...Masaki, can you put that broadcast@on screen here?
LDBI\t「……厳かな雰囲気の中、神聖ラングラン王国@ 第２８８代国王、テリウ: ...Amid solemnity, the coronation of His Majesty@Tellius Gran Bilseia, 288th King of the Holy@Kingdom of Langran, is about to begin.
LDBI\t「大神官ザボド卿の即位宣言が、@ 静寂の中にこだましています」: The accession proclamation of Grand Priest@Lord Zabod echoes through the silence.
LDBI\t「……において、精霊の祝福と共にあり、@ そなたが母、ナタリア・ゾラ: ...shall abide with the blessing of the spirits.@Son of thy mother, Natalia Zoram Lakshmi,@and thy father, Alzaar Gran Bilseia...
LDBI\t「ノボス、私と共に来てくれ。話がある」: Novos, come with me. We need to talk.
LDBI\t「マサキ、ノボスと二人だけで話せる場所はないか？」: Masaki, is there somewhere Novos and I@can speak alone?
LDBI\t「だったら、ハガネの俺の部屋を使ってくれ」: Then use my room on the Hagane.
LDBI\t「マサキ、あんまし掃除してニャいでしょ。@ そこに殿下を案内するニャ: Masaki, you nyever clean your room.@Showing His Highness in there, meow...
LDBI\t「そ、そんなことを言ってる場合じゃねえだろ！」: Th-This is no time to be talking about that!
LDBI\t「その通りだ。すまないが、案内を頼む」: He's right. Sorry, but please show us the way.
LDBI\t「ノボス……@ あのテリウスは、本物ではないかも知れん」: Novos...@That Tellius may not be the real one.
LDBI\t「テリウスと私は異母兄弟だ。@ 彼の母はナタリア……世間では貴族出身: Tellius and I are half-brothers. His mother@was Natalia... Officially, she was of noble birth.
LDBI\t「私もそう伺っておりますが……」: That is what I have heard as well...
LDBI\t「実は違うのだ。彼女はれっきとした王族だった。@ 今、このことを知っ: In truth, she wasn't. She was genuine royalty.@Now, the only ones who know that are@Tellius and I...
LDBI\t「それは……しかし、何故、そのような……？」: That's... But why would it be kept secret...?
LDBI\t「それは違う！@ あれには隠された真相があったのだ。@ 私はテリウス: That's not true!@There was a hidden truth behind all that.@So Tellius told me.
LDBI\t「テリウスは母の出自を誇りに思っていた。@ その証拠に、大人しかった: Tellius was proud of his mother's lineage.@As proof, gentle as he was, there was one time@he flew into a rage.
LDBI\t「それは、ナタリアに関する件だった。@ テリウスは、彼女を貶める者を: It was over a matter concerning Natalia.@Tellius never forgave anyone who demeaned her.@To him, his mother was a true royal.
LDBI\t「では、先程の名乗りでゾラムと呼ばれていたのは@ 何故です？ 王族な: Then why did that proclamation call her Zoram?@As royalty, her name should be Grania...
LDBI\t「そこだ。@ テリウスは母に関して、強烈なプライドを持っている。@: That's just it. Tellius is fiercely proud@of his mother. If that were really him, he'd@never let her be named that way.
LDBI\t「なるほど……。@ それで、殿下を戴冠式に出席させぬよう@ 取り計ら: I see... Now I understand why Kirkus arranged@for you to miss the coronation, Your Highness.
LDBI\t「ああ……@ 私やセニアが直に会えば、すぐにわかることだからな」: Yes... Xenia or I would see through it the@moment we met him face to face.
LDBI\t「いかが致しましょう？ @ カークスに抗議なさいますか？」: What shall we do?@Will you lodge a protest with Kirkus?
LDBI\t「いや、証拠がない。ナタリアの件については、@ 私とテリウスしか知ら: No, we have no proof. Only Tellius and I@know the truth about Natalia.
BMD\t「私もラトゥーニみたいにやってみますわ！」: I shall try it just like Latune does!
BMD\t「まだ終わりませんわよ！」: It isn't over yet, I assure you!
BMD\t「これでお終いですわ！」: And that is the end of you!
BMD\t「おやおや、/ こんなに大きな標的を外すとは。/ なってませんな」: My, my,/　missing a target this big?/　Sloppy work.
BMD\t「ふう……何とか回避できましたね」: Phew... We managed to dodge it.
BMD\t「艦長の美貌のおかげですな」: All thanks to your beauty, Captain.
BMD\t「か、関係あるんですか？」: D-does that have anything to do with it?
BMD\t「また私のブロマイドですかっ？」: Not another one of my photos!?
BMD\t「いやいや、もっと別の……フフフフ」: No, no, something else entirely... Heh heh heh.

BMD\t「エア・クリスマスはまた仕掛けてきます。/ 各員、気を緩めぬように」: The Air Christmas will strike again./　All hands, stay alert.

BMD\t「このままルイーナを引き離します！」: We'll pull away from the Ruina like this!
BMD\t「出来れば、あの気持ち悪いものを/ もう近づけないで……」: If possible, keep that disgusting thing/　from getting near us again...
BMD\t「応龍相手でも、/ 我ら鋼龍は戦ってみせます！」: Even against the Yinglong,/　we of the Steel Dragons will fight!
BMD\t「その程度の攻撃、通用しません！」: An attack like that won't work on us!
BMD\t「あの……。他人事のように言われても……」: Um... You say that like it's/　someone else's problem...
BMD\t「これからは節約を徹底しませんとな」: We'll need to be thorough about/　conserving from now on.
BMD\t「あ、あそこじゃないですか？」: U-um, isn't that them over there?

BMD\t「ドラゴン２よりアイアン３へ！/ これより援護します！」: Dragon 2 to Iron 3!/　Moving to support!

BMD\t「この機を逃してはなりません！」: We can't let this chance slip!

LDBI\t「それにしても、ヒューゴ……@ あそこでお前が親父に噛みつくとは@: Still, Hugo... I never thought you'd@bite back at my old man like that.
LDBI\t「俺だって、ミタールの言いなりになって@ 犬死にするつもりはない。そ: I'm not about to throw my life away on Mitar's@orders, either. And the captain...

LDBI\t「構わん。@ お前達がツェントル・プロジェクトに対して@ 疑問を抱い: Don't worry about it.@I knew you both had doubts about@the Tsentr Project.
LDBI\t「それと、フォリア准尉……@ お前がチームの一員に徹したことが、@: And Warrant Officer Foglia...@Your commitment to being part of the team@is what led to today's result.

LDBI\t「また、君がデータを送っていた先についてだが……@ 多くの経由点を経: As for where you'd been sending the data...@After tracing it through many relay points, we@found it was a British firm, Horsham Company.
LDBI\t「その名に心当たりは？」: Does that name ring a bell?
LDBI\t「そうだろうな。@ 部下に調べさせたが、ダミー会社だった。@ その先: I thought not.@My people checked. It was a shell company.@We're still investigating what's behind it.

LDBI\t「はい……。@ ジンライが実戦へ投入され、ダイゼンガーと@ アウセン: Yes...@If Jinrai has been deployed in combat and is@targeting the Dygenguar and Aussenseiter...
LDBI\t「この艦に乗っていれば、遭遇できるのではないかと……@ そして、ジン: I thought that aboard this ship, I might@encounter it... And then I must stop Jinrai...@stop my father...

LDBI\t「その……用って程じゃないんだけど……@ 手空きのメンバーでお茶を飲: Well... It's not that I need anything...@Some of the off-duty crew are having tea,@so I thought I'd invite you.
LDBI\t「私は……遠慮させていただきます」: I... will have to decline, thank you.
LDBI\t「だけど、この艦に乗ってから、@ 部屋にこもりっぱなしだろ？@ 少し: But you've been shut up in your room@ever since you came aboard, right?@A little break might do you good...
LDBI\t「……私や父のせいで、@ 皆さんにご迷惑をお掛けしているのです。@: ...Because of my father and me,@I'm causing trouble for everyone.@I'm hardly in the mood for that...

LDBI\t「トロンベ印のスイーツは、@ そんじょそこらのパティシエが@ 裸足で: Trombe-brand sweets would send any@run-of-the-mill pastry chef running@for the hills.

LDBI\t「ボケたぁ何だ、ボケたぁ！」: Who're you callin' an idiot, huh!?

LDBI\t「大丈夫、大丈夫。@ クリフだったら、もうちょっとって言うもの」: It's fine, it's fine.@Cliff would say they've got a bit more to go.
LDBI\t「じゃあ、紅茶は私が……@ イルイちゃんはコーヒーの方をお願い」: Then I'll take the tea...@Irui, could you handle the coffee?
LDBI\t「あら、イルイもお手伝いしてるの？」: Oh, Irui, are you helping out too?

LDBI\t「リオン系の新型機を持っていることから、@ イスルギと関係があるのか: Given they have a new Lion-type machine,@they may be connected to Isurugi, but...
LDBI\t「もしかして、噂の『ＧＳ』？@ 研究所を守ってくれたことには感謝する: Maybe they're that 'GS' we've heard about?@I'm grateful they protected the institute,@but something about them seems shady...
LDBI\t「……全機撃破したな。@ ベータ１から各機。帰投するぞ」: ...All units destroyed.@Beta 1 to all units. We're heading back.
LDBI\t（指定された時間との誤差がなさ過ぎる……@ <ＭＯＳＳ>で得たデータ: (It matched the appointed time too precisely...@I can't believe that was predicted just from@<ＭＯＳＳ> data.)
LDBI\t（もしや、上層部はゲスト襲来のタイミングを@ 予め知っていたのでは…: (Could the brass have known in advance@when the Guests would attack...?)
LDBI\t「私まで呼び出しを受けたとなると……@ ルイーナ絡みで何かあったのか: If they've called me in as well...@has something come up concerning the Ruina?
LDBI\t「わからない。@ 聞きたいことがあるから、来いと言われただけだ」: I don't know.@All they said was to come, they had questions.
LDBI\t「しかも、相手は軍のお偉方でしょ。@ 何故、直接あたし達に……」: And it's some military bigwig, right?@Why come to us directly...?
LDBI\t「どうせ、ろくな話じゃないだろうさ」: Whatever it is, it won't be anything good.
LDBI\t「さあ、行こう。待たせると悪い」: Let's go. We shouldn't keep him waiting.
LDBI\t「君達を呼んだのは、ガイアセイバーズの拠点の一つ、@ トーチカ８でリ: I called you here because we've learned that@Tochka 8, one of the Gaia Savers' bases, may be@developing a unit that uses Re-Tech.
LDBI\t「そ、それって、ブランシュネージュや@ エール・シュヴァリアーみたい: Y-You mean something like Blanche Neige@or Aile Chevalier...!?
LDBI\t「可愛いお嬢さん、@ ＮＶユニットという言葉に聞き覚えはあるかな？」: My charming young lady,@does the term NV Unit ring any bells?
LDBI\t「俺も初耳です。クリフは？」: It's news to me, too. Cliff?
LDBI\t「……知っている。@ ラドクリフ教授が発案し、私が設計した兵器だ」: ...I know of it. It's a weapon conceived by@Professor Radcliffe and designed by me.
LDBI\t「何？ 俺はそんな話、一度も……」: What? Nobody ever told me anything about that...
LDBI\t「教授から口止めをされていたからな」: The professor swore me to secrecy.
LDBI\t「ＮＶユニットは設計を行ったものの、@ 技術面や資金面の問題で製作が: We finished the design for the NV Units,@but we expected technical and funding issues@would make them hard to actually build.
LDBI\t「教授は、出来るかどうかわからない物のことで……@ さらなる保険を必: The professor probably didn't want to argue@with you about why he needed more insurance...@over something that might not even be possible.
LDBI\t「そして、彼は私が仕上げた設計図を@ アルテウル・シュタインベックと: He then gave the blueprints I completed to@Arteur Steinbeck and Dr. Eric Wang.
LDBI\t「アルテウルから研究資金を得るためさ。@ どのみち、あの規模の物を南: To get research funding from Arteur.@Besides, something of that scale could never@have been built at our Antarctic Mother Base.
LDBI\t「いったい、どんな物なの？ @ そのＮＶユニットって……」: So what exactly is it...@this NV Unit thing...?
LDBI\t「エール・シュヴァリアーとブランシュネージュ用の@ 超大型ウェポン・: A gigantic Weapon Box Hanger for Aile Chevalier@and Blanche Neige... Several times the size of@Ars Nova--a flying arsenal.
LDBI\t「それとドッキングすることによって、@ レース・アルカーナの出力変換: Docking with it improves Race Arcana output@conversion efficiency, as well as firepower@and mobility.
LDBI\t「なお、エール・シュヴァリアー用の物は@ “ジェアン・エール”、ブラ: The one for Aile Chevalier is called Geant Aile,@and the one for Blanche Neige is called@Excelsior Ars Nova.
LDBI\t「他にも機体開発プランがあったが、@ 色々と課題が多くてね……」: There were other unit development plans too,@but they had a lot of problems...
LDBI\t「もし、本当にガイアセイバーズがＮＶユニットを@ 建造しているのだと: If the Gaia Savers really are building NV Units,@it'll only be Geant Aile and Excelsior Ars Nova.
LDBI\t「それらはスタンドアローンで……@ レース・アルカーナなしでも運用で: Those two are standalone...@they can operate without a Race Arcana.
LDBI\t「つまり、ガイアセイバーズ側でも使える……。@ 何故、グランド・クリ: Meaning the Gaia Savers can use them too...@But why build them at Tochka 8@instead of Grand Christmas?
LDBI\t「さあ……そこまではわからんよ」: Who knows... That much, I can't tell you.
LDBI\t「ジェイコブ中将、この話には@ どれぐらいの信憑性があるのでしょうか: Lieutenant General Jacob, how credible@is this information?
LDBI\t「ガイアセイバーズの関係者を詰問して得た@ 情報なのでね……真偽は君: We got it by interrogating someone tied to@the Gaia Savers... I'd like you to see for@yourselves whether it's true.
LDBI\t「つまり……トーチカ８へ行き、@ 威力偵察を行えということですか？」: In other words... you want us to go to Tochka 8@and conduct a reconnaissance in force?
LDBI\t「それだけではない。@ 実際にＮＶユニットが作られていたら、@ それ: Not only that.@If NV Units really are being built there,@I want you to seize them.
LDBI\t「ジェアン・エールとエクセルシオ・アルスノーヴァが@ 真価を発揮する: For Geant Aile and Excelsior Ars Nova to show@their true potential, they absolutely need@Aile Chevalier and Blanche Neige...
LDBI\t「入手できれば、@ 今後のルイーナとの戦いで大いに役立つ」: If we can get them,@they'll be a huge help against the Ruina.
LDBI\t「それは……@ 設計図通りに作られていた場合の話だろう？」: That's...@assuming they were built to spec, right?
LDBI\t「今回の件を依頼するきっかけとなったのは、@ ＮＶユニットの存在だけ: The NV Units aren't the only reason@I've asked this of you.
LDBI\t「私が報告したガリルナガンですね？」: You mean the Galilnagant I reported on?
LDBI\t「そうだ。我々としては、強硬手段を用いても@ ガイアセイバーズが隠し: Correct. We want to know what the Gaia Savers@are hiding, even if it takes force.
LDBI\t「ＮＶユニットの情報が@ 彼らの罠だという可能性もあるが……@ 私か: The NV Unit intel could be a trap of theirs...@but will you accept my request,@Colonel Lefina?
LDBI\t「こちらからガイアセイバーズの基地に@ 仕掛けるというのか？」: You're saying we go on the offensive@against a Gaia Savers base?
LDBI\t「ええ。トーチカ８には、エール・シュヴァリアーと@ ドッキング可能な: Yes. Tochka 8 might have a Weapon Box Hanger@that can dock with Aile Chevalier.
LDBI\t「あったら、どないするんや？ パチるんか？」: So if it's there, whatcha gonna do? Pinch it?
LDBI\t「つまり、かっぱらうんかっちゅーこっちゃ」: I mean, ya gonna steal it or what?
LDBI\t「エリック・ワンって人が、クリフの設計図通りに@ ウェポン・ボックス: I just hope this Eric Wang person built the@Weapon Box Hanger according to Cliff's@blueprints...
LDBI\t「エリック・ワン博士はグランゾンの設計者の一人だ。@ 今はガイアセイ: Dr. Eric Wang was one of Granzon's designers.@So he's with the Gaia Savers now...
LDBI\t「シュウと関わりがあったってんなら、@ それだけで胡散臭いぜ」: If he's had anything to do with Shu,@that alone makes him shady.
LDBI\t「その点には同意できる、これがな」: That much I can agree with, that's how it is.
LDBI\t「うぅ～、じゃあ、@ ウェポン・ボックス・ハンガーは……」: Ugh... So then,@the Weapon Box Hanger...
LDBI\t「確かに胡散臭い男だが、悪人ではなかった」: He's a shady man, sure, but he wasn't a bad one.
LDBI\t「ええ……私の脱走の手助けをしていただきました。@ そして、ガイアセ: Yes... He helped me escape.@And he has doubts about the way@the Gaia Savers operate.
LDBI\t「それなら、期待できそうじゃない？」: Then there's reason for hope, isn't there?
LDBI\t「ですが、エリック・ワン博士が@ ウェポン・ボックス・ハンガーの開発: But isn't it possible that Dr. Eric Wang@isn't involved in developing@the Weapon Box Hanger at all...?
LDBI\t「そこは……賭けだ」: That's... a gamble we'll have to take.
LDBI\t「皆さんは、@ ようやく地上へ戻れるようになったのです。@ これ以上: But all of you are finally able@to return to the surface.@We can't trouble you any further...
LDBI\t「送還の準備が整うのは、明後日だ。@ つまり、俺達には時間がある。地: We won't be sent home until the day after@tomorrow, so we still have time. Maybe there's@still something we can do before we go back...
LDBI\t「俺はそう考えた。@ 一時とは言え、ラングランに平和をもたらすために: That's what I concluded.@After all, I believe we've also been fighting@to bring peace to Langran, if only for a time.
LDBI\t「それに、この世界の情勢に関わってしまった以上、@ 事の顛末を見届け: And now that we're caught up in this world's@affairs, I feel duty-bound to see how it ends.
LDBI\t「立つ鳥跡を濁さずって言うし、@ 私は艦長の判断に賛成よん」: Gotta tidy up before you leave the nest, right?@So I'm all for the Captain's call!
LDBI\t「ま、乗りかかった船だしな」: Well, we're already in this boat.
LDBI\t「……お前は真っ先に反対すると思ってたがな」: ...Figured you'd be the first to object.
LDBI\t「過去に似たような経験がある……。@ もっとも、その場には居合わせな: I've been through something similar before...@Though I wasn't there when it happened,@and I couldn't stop it with my own hands.
LDBI\t「これ以上の干渉は危険だと思うが……@ 俺達の存在が抑止力になるので: I think meddling any further is dangerous...@but if our presence can serve as a deterrent,@I suppose it can't be helped.
LDBI\t「今回の件に関して、強制をするつもりはない。@ 各自に判断の時間を与: I won't force anyone's hand on this matter.@Take some time to decide for yourselves.@Think it over carefully.
BMD\t「観念しろ……ハイゾルランチャー、発射！！」: Give it up... Hyzol Launcher, fire!!
BMD\t「これを受けて塵となれ！」: Take this and turn to dust!
BMD\t「バーストモード……全て叩き落とす！」: Burst Mode... I'll shoot them all down!
BMD\t「一点集中……ターゲット・ロック！」: Focus on a single point... Target locked!
BMD\t「跳弾は……かわせばいい！」: Ricochets... I just have to dodge them!
BMD\t「１機たりとも逃がしはせん！ 行けっ！」: Not a single one gets away! Go!
BMD\t「扱いづらい銃だが……やってみせる！」: It's a tricky gun, but I'll manage!
BMD\t「ＢとＥ……同時に発射する！」: B and E... I'll fire both at once!
BMD\t「ジガンから逃げられると思うな！」: Don't think you can escape the Jigan!
BMD\t「ここが切り札の使い時か！」: Time to play my trump card!
BMD\t「この距離……/ 危険だが、見返りは充分にある！」: At this range.../　It's risky, but the payoff's worth it!
LDBI\t「モ、モガモガモガモガ！ モガモガガモガガガモッ！@ （ご、ご主人様: Mmph, mmph-mmph! Mmph-mmph-mmmph!@(M-Master, don't grab me like that!)
LDBI\t「シュウ様、ここは私が引き受けますわ。@ 先に行って下さい」: Master Shu, leave this to me.@Please go on ahead.
LDBI\t「あなた達と戦うつもりはなかったんだけど……@ 少しの間、付き合って: I had no intention of fighting you people, but...@I'll keep you company for a little while.
LDBI\t「私はサフィーネ……@ サフィーネ・ゼオラ・ヴォルクルス。@ 紅蓮の: I'm Saphine...@Saphine Zeola Volkruss.@Though some call me Saphine the Crimson.
LDBI\t「ああ、サフィーネもヴォルクルスの信者だ」: Yes. Saphine is a Volkruss worshipper too.
LDBI\t「サフィーネ、シュウを甦らせたのは@ お前とルオゾールか？」: Saphine, were you and Luozorl the ones@who brought Shu back?
LDBI\t「あんた、あいつと一緒に何をやろうってのよ！？」: What are you planning to do with him?!
LDBI\t「そりゃもう、あんなことやこんなこと§@ 教えてあげてもいいけど、昼: Oh, all sorts of naughty things§@I'd tell you, but not in broad daylight.
LDBI\t「シャイン王女、彼女の言うことを@ 真に受けてはいけません」: Princess Shine, you mustn't take@anything she says seriously.
LDBI\t「あ～ら、相変わらず固いわねえ、ヤンロン。@ まあ、柔らかいよりはい: Oh my, stiff as ever, aren't you, Yang Long?@Well, stiff beats soft§
LDBI\t「あのアマ、ふざけてんのか！？」: Is that bitch screwing with us?!
LDBI\t「さあ、いらっしゃいな、仔猫ちゃん達。@ いい声で鳴くのよ？」: Come now, my little kittens.@Let me hear you cry sweetly, hm?
LDBI\t「今回は戦うことになっちゃったわね、ヤンロン」: Looks like we're fighting this time, Yang Long.
LDBI\t「もう貸し借りはないからな……遠慮なく行くぞ！」: We're even now... So I won't hold back!
LDBI\t「何者か知らんが……邪魔をするなら、撃ち貫く」: I don't know who you are...@But if you get in my way, I'll pierce you.
LDBI\t「貫く？ 私を？ ああん、楽しみ§」: Pierce me? Ooh, I can't wait§
LDBI\t「ああん、その目付き、その緊張感……！@ ゾクゾクしちゃう§」: Ooh, that look in your eyes, that tension...!@It gives me shivers§
LDBI\t「シュウの手下なら、@ 黙って見過ごすわけにはいかないよ！」: If you're Shu's lackey,@I can't just let you go!
LDBI\t「手下だなんて……@ 私はシュウ様に身も心も捧げた下僕よ§」: Lackey? How rude...@I'm Master Shu's servant, body and soul§
LDBI\t「行くぜ、色気ババア！」: Here I come, you sexy old hag!
LDBI\t「だ、誰がババアよ！@ あんたとそう歳は変わらないでしょ！」: Wh-who are you calling a hag?!@I'm not much older than you!
LDBI\t「あ、あの色気と胸……只者じゃねえ！」: Th-that sex appeal... that chest...@She's no ordinary woman!
LDBI\t「あら、可愛い坊やじゃない。@ たっぷりいじめてあげるわ§」: My, what a cute little boy.@I'll torment you plenty§
LDBI\t「ちょ、ちょっと楽しみかも……！」: I-I might be kinda looking forward to this...!
LDBI\t「……はあ、とても良かったわよ。@ それじゃ、また会いましょ」: ...Haah, that was wonderful.@Well then, until we meet again.
LDBI\t「世の中には色々な人がいるものだと思って……」: I was just thinking it takes all kinds...
LDBI\t「まあ、艦長とは逆の路線ですからな。@ 多少は見習っていただいてもよ: Well, she's your polar opposite, after all.@It wouldn't hurt to learn a little from her.
LDBI\t「ああ……。@ ルオゾールかサフィーネが蘇生させたのかも知れんな」: Yes...@Perhaps Luozorl or Saphine revived him.
LDBI\t「でも、何故、記憶を失っていたんでしょう？」: But why had he lost his memory?
LDBI\t「ルオゾールが絡んでるのなら、@ 今のシュウの目的はヴォルクルスの復: If Luozorl's involved,@is Shu out to revive Volkruss now?
LDBI\t「ヤンロン、あいつらを放っておいていいの？」: Yang Long, are we just gonna let them go?
LDBI\t「追うとしても、手掛かりがない。@ 精霊レーダーにも反応しないという: Even if we pursue, we have no leads.@If they're not showing up on the spirit radar...@they're most likely using a concealment spell.
LDBI\t「シュウやサフィーネのことは気になるが、@ 今はカークス将軍の所へ急: Shu and Saphine concern me, but for now,@let's hurry to General Kirkus.
LDBI\t「カーラ、@ あなたはコモディン島へ行ったことがあって？」: Carla,@have you ever been to Comodin Island?
LDBI\t「絶海の孤島で、訳ありなセレブのリゾート地。@ ルスランさんって人が: A remote island resort for celebrities with@shady pasts. A man named Ruslan runs it.
LDBI\t「訳ありなセレブって……どういうこと？」: Celebrities with shady pasts...? Meaning what?
LDBI\t「犯罪に関与しているような所なのかしら？」: Is it the sort of place that's involved in crime?
LDBI\t「う～ん、まあ……スレスレかも。@ だけど、堅気の人とか芸能人も@: Hmm, well... it might be skirting the line.@But I hear law-abiding folks and celebrities@come to play there, too.
LDBI\t「堅気とか言っている時点で、どうなのかしら……」: The fact you have to say "law-abiding"@says a lot...
LDBI\t「それに、リゾート地って言っても@ 空があんな様子じゃね……」: Besides, resort or not, with the sky@looking like that...
LDBI\t「ネットがつながりにくいので、詳しいことは@ わかりませんが……政府: The network's unreliable, so I don't know the@details... but since the government issued a@statement, the unrest seems to be spreading.
LDBI\t「ゲストが特殊なバリアで@ 地球をすっぽり覆ってしまったと……」: That the Guests have completely enveloped@the Earth in a special barrier...
LDBI\t「すぐにわかるような嘘ね」: A lie anyone could see through.
LDBI\t「そんな荒唐無稽な話、@ みんなが信じると思ってるのかな」: Do they really think everyone will buy@such a ridiculous story?
LDBI\t「ルイーナと直接接触して、@ 事情をある程度知っている私達ならともか: That's fine for us. We've faced the Ruina@directly and have some idea what's going on...
LDBI\t「正直に正体不明の敵や謎の現象だなんて言うと、@ みんな混乱する一方: Admit it's an unknown enemy or a mysterious@phenomenon, and people will just panic more.@Especially after watching the sun vanish.
LDBI\t「政府は、敢えて比較的受け入れられ易い@ 説明をしたということですか: So the government deliberately gave an@explanation that's easier to accept?
LDBI\t「ええ。それに、連邦軍やガイアセイバーズは@ 一度ゲストを撃退してる: Yes. Plus, the Federation Army and the Gaia@Savers drove off the Guests once before, so@people will think they can handle this, too.
LDBI\t「希望を持たせるために？@ 誤魔化してるだけじゃん」: To give people hope?@That's just covering it up!
LDBI\t「政治家なんて、そんなものよ。@ 自分達が敵と戦うわけじゃないからね: That's politicians for you.@They're not the ones fighting the enemy.
LDBI\t「その場しのぎの説明で安心させておいて、@ とりあえず時間を稼いで…: Calm everyone with a stopgap explanation, buy@some time... then dump it all on the military.
LDBI\t「あのような事件が起きましたからね……@ もう彼に義理立てる必要はあ: After that incident...@there's no need to stay loyal to him anymore.
LDBI\t「だが……何故、アルテウルは@ ファブラ・フォレースに興味を示したの: But... why was Arteur@interested in Fabula Fores?
LDBI\t「それは、彼と直接やり取りをしていた@ ラドクリフ教授にしかわかりま: Only Professor Radcliffe, who dealt with him@directly, would know that.
LDBI\t「……エール・シュヴァリアーや@ ブランシュネージュのデータは、@: ...So the data on the Aile Chevalier and@Blanche Neige went to the Gaia Savers...
LDBI\t「彼らは色々な所で絡んでくるな。@ ジョッシュが特殊戦技教導隊へ出向: They keep turning up everywhere. Josh being@sent to the Special Tactical Instructor Corps@must have been part of someone's plan.
LDBI\t「でも、何だって言うんです？@ 俺達をガイアセイバーズじゃなく、@: But what would that be?@Why send us to the <教導隊>@instead of the Gaia Savers...?
LDBI\t「レーツェル……少佐。自分に話とは？」: Rätsel... Major. You wanted to talk to me?
LDBI\t「階級は不要だよ、ヒューゴ少尉。@ 本当は、カイ少佐を交えて話をした: No need for ranks, Lieutenant Hugo.@I'd actually hoped to have Major Kai join us.
LDBI\t「ハガネに搬入されたフリッケライ・ガイスト……@ あれにイェッツトの: The Flickerei Geist brought aboard the Hagane...@I heard Jetzt's core was transplanted into it.
LDBI\t「そのフリッケライのパイロット、@ アリエイル・オーグ少尉から聞いた: According to that Flickerei's pilot,@Lieutenant Ariel Org...
LDBI\t「ツェントル・プロジェクトは@ ガイアセイバーズの管理下にあるようだ: the Tsentr Project appears to be@under Gaia Savers control.
LDBI\t「その様子では、君も知らなかったらしいな」: From your reaction, you didn't know either.
LDBI\t「え、ええ……現在のトーチカ１の所在地……@ ミタール・ザパトの居場: Y-Yes... Tochka 1's current location...@Mitar Zapad's whereabouts are classified.@Aqua and I were kept in the dark.
LDBI\t（ミタールが言っていた権力者とは、@ アルテウルのことだったのか……: (So the man in power Mitar spoke of@was Arteur...!)
LDBI\t「リ・テクとツェントル・プロジェクトの機体が@ 時を同じくして教導隊: Re-Tech and Tsentr Project units being@entrusted to the Instructor Corps at the same@time can hardly be a coincidence.
LDBI\t「その裏に隠された意図は何だ？」: What's the intention hidden behind it?
LDBI\t「自分には……わかりません。@ ですが、ミタールがガイアセイバーズの: I... don't know.@But if Mitar is a member@of the Gaia Savers...
LDBI\t「ツェントル・プロジェクトに対する@ 猜疑心は一層深まりました」: my suspicion of the Tsentr Project@runs even deeper.
