LDBI\t「今や立場は逆転した。@ 地球圏の平和は、君達の代わりに僕達が守って: Now the tables have turned.@We'll guard the Earth Sphere's peace for you.
LDBI\t「それが本意ではあるまい」: That is not your true aim.
LDBI\t「そうだよ。@ マシンナリー・チルドレン、そのオリジネイターたる@: That's right. I'm the Originator of the@Machinery Children, and you humans shattered@my body and my pride...
LDBI\t「特にゼンガー・ゾンボルト。@ お前がもがき苦しみ、死んでいく姿を@: Especially you, Sänger Sombold.@How many times in the Moderator did I dream@of watching you writhe in agony and die?
LDBI\t「ならば、再び地の底へ戻り、@ その夢を見続けるがいい」: Then return to the depths of the earth@and dream that dream forever.
LDBI\t「フン……あの時の雪辱を果たしてやるよ」: Hmph... I'll pay you back for that humiliation.
LDBI\t「副長、戦域離脱までに要する時間は？」: Commander, how long until we can withdraw?
LDBI\t「では、各機に伝達。@ 本艦は５分後に現戦域からの離脱を試みる。各機: Inform all units. We'll attempt to withdraw in@five minutes. Priority one is guarding the ship@and securing space for acceleration.
LDBI\t「許可します。口火を切ったのは向こうですし……@ ここで反撃せずとも: Permitted. They're the ones who fired first...@And even if we hold back, that fact will@be twisted anyway.
LDBI\t「アルファ１より各機。@ リ・テクのマシンと指定した機体は破壊せず、: Alpha 1 to all units.@Don't destroy the Re-Tech or marked units--@capture them. The rest, feel free to crush.

LDBI\t「彼らの判断に任せます」: I'll leave it to their judgment.
LDBI\t「ねえ、どうするのよ、ヒューゴ！」: Hey, what are we going to do, Hugo?!

LDBI\t「ミタールの掌上で踊らされているとしても@ これ以上、下手を打つわけ: Even if we're dancing in Mitar's palm,@I can't afford another misstep.
LDBI\t「わかったわ。ガイアセイバーズに対しては、@ 私の忍耐力も品切れだし: Got it. When it comes to the Gaia Saviors,@my patience is all sold out, too.
LDBI\t「貴様はあの時、<アースクレイドル>で@ 斬り捨てたはず」: I cut you down back then,@at the <アースクレイドル>.
LDBI\t「ああ、おかげで再生にかなりの時間を要した。@ これ以上ない屈辱だっ: Yes, and thanks to you, regeneration took ages.@It was the greatest humiliation.
LDBI\t「今度はお前が斬られる番だ。@ 反乱者として、惨めに死んでいくがいい: Now it's your turn to be cut down.@Die a wretched death as a rebel!
LDBI\t「リー・リンジュン……@ どの面を下げて、その艦に乗っている？」: Lee Linjun...@How can you show your face on that ship?
LDBI\t「軟弱な連邦軍は、理想の軍隊たり得ん。@ シャドウミラーなき今、ガイ: The spineless Federation can't be an ideal army.@With Shadow Mirror gone, the Gaia Saviors are...
LDBI\t「最高権力者の剣こそが、我が理想の軍隊。@ 私を拾って下さったアルテ: The sword of the supreme ruler is my ideal army.@To repay Commander Arteur for taking me in,@I swallow my shame and stand here.
LDBI\t「ガイアセイバーズが理想の軍隊だと？@ サマ師の集団にしか見えんな」: The Gaia Saviors, an ideal army?@Looks like a bunch of con men to me.
LDBI\t「マシンナリー・チルドレンの坊やと言い、@ あなたと言い……懐かしい: First that Machinery Children kid, now you...@Quite the reunion of familiar faces, huh?@Not that I'm happy about it.
LDBI\t「エクセレン・ブロウニング……@ そのふざけた態度は相変わらずか」: Excellen Browning...@Still as flippant as ever, I see.
LDBI\t「事情は色々とあったんでしょうけど、@ カーリーって名前はどうなのか: I'm sure you had your reasons, but what's@with the name "Curly"? Kinda obvious, isn't it?@Like, really obvious.
LDBI\t「あなたも仮面をつけた方が@ 良かったんじゃない？」: Maybe you should've worn a mask too?
LDBI\t「黙れ。@ 貴様らは反逆者であり、大統領を殺害した罪人だ。@ 立場を: Silence. You are traitors, criminals who@assassinated the President. Know your place.
LDBI\t「……大統領さんがあんなことになって、@ こっちが得をすることなんて: ...We gained nothing from what happened@to the President, you know.
LDBI\t「ドサマギで企んだことでしょうけど……@ いずれバレるわよ、あなたの: You schemed this up in the confusion, I bet...@But your boss's plans will come out eventually.
LDBI\t「よくもまあ、いけしゃあしゃあと@ そんな所にいられるもんだな！」: You've got some nerve, showing your face@in a place like that!
LDBI\t「大義のためならば、生き恥をさらすことも厭わん」: For a just cause, I don't mind living in shame.
LDBI\t「あたしらと大統領をはめておいて、何が大義だ！@ ゲストより質が悪い: You framed us and the President!@What just cause?!@You bastards are even worse than the Guests!
LDBI\t「あの機体にあいつらの謎を解く鍵があるとはね」: So that machine holds the key to their secret.
LDBI\t「あいつ……あの動き、何をするつもりだ！？」: That guy... those moves... What's he up to?!
LDBI\t「リ・テクのマシンか。@ 戦闘能力を奪って、ろ獲する」: The Re-Tech machine, huh?@I'll disable it and capture it.
LDBI\t（かつて、俺達クライウルブズが@ <アースクレイドル>へ赴いた時……: (Back when we Cry Wolves went to@the <アースクレイドル>... was he being moved out@of there?)
LDBI\t（もしかして、@ 俺はその片棒を担いでしまったのか……？）: (Could it be...@I helped them do it...?)
LDBI\t「全機に撤退命令！@ ＥＡをかけつつ、現戦域より離脱します！」: Order all units to retreat!@We'll withdraw from the area under EA!
LDBI\t「ドラゴン２より各機！@ まもなく本艦は現戦域より離脱する！@ 直近: Dragon 2 to all units!@This ship will soon withdraw from the area!@Nearby and slow units, attach to the ship!

BMD\t「この世界だけではない……/ お前とは、これまでに幾度も刃を交えている: Not just in this world.../　We have crossed blades many times before.

BMD\t「古からの因縁を断つ」: I will sever this ancient bond of fate.
BMD\t「我が前世と違い、お前達の世界は狭い……」: Unlike my past life,/　your world is a narrow one...
BMD\t「アウレフを失った痛みはもう癒えたか？」: Has the pain of losing Aureph healed yet?

BMD\t「レビの人格を甦らせるまでもない。/ 消え失せよ」: No need to revive Levi's personality./　Vanish.
BMD\t「魔装機神サイバスター……/ そして、マサキ・アンドー。/ お前のこと: Masou Kishin Cybuster.../　And Masaki Andoh./　I "remember" you as well.
BMD\t「シュウ・シラカワ……/ あの時とは違うようだな」: Shu Shirakawa.../　You seem different from that time.
BMD\t「ギリアム……/ 我と似て非なる宿命を背負った男……」: Gilliam... A man who bears a fate/　so like mine, yet so different...
BMD\t「今の我にはわかる……/ お前には欠けているものがある」: Now I understand.../　You are missing something.

BMD\t「ゲートを開く鍵は二つもいらぬ……」: The gate needs only one key...

BMD\t「変えてみせる……/ 呪われた宿命を！ 必ずや！」: I will change it.../　This cursed fate! I swear it!
BMD\t「凡人共に、何故ここまで……！」: How can mere mortals go this far...!

BMD\t「我は呪輪廻を乗り越えたのだぞ」: I have overcome the cursed cycle!

LDBI\t「かろうじて魔力テストには合格したが、@ 無理な修練と薬物の副作用で: I barely passed the magic aptitude test, but@reckless training and the side effects of drugs@had pushed my body to its limit...
LDBI\t「それに加え、王都のテロ事件で負った傷が@ 致命的となり……私の命は: On top of that, the wound I took in the capital@terror attack proved fatal... I have six months@at most.
LDBI\t「だ、だからって、何もこれほど急いで@ 力で全てを解決しようなんて…: B-But that doesn't mean you have to rush to@settle everything by force!!
LDBI\t「これまでの戦いを経て、わかったのだ……@ 私は本質的に軍人なのだと: Through these battles, I came to understand...@that I am, at heart, a soldier.
LDBI\t「そして、軍人は力による解決を尊ぶものだ。@ その私に対し、手心を加: And a soldier values resolution through force.@To think of holding back against me...@That is nothing short of an insult.
LDBI\t「私に残された時間は少ない……@ 故に、悲願成就を妨げる者は@ 何人: I have little time left... So I will remove@anyone who stands in the way of my cherished@dream, no matter who they may be.
LDBI\t「地上人召喚事件の責任を取ると言うのなら、@ あなたが選んだ方法は間: If you mean to take responsibility for the@surface dweller summoning, you've chosen@the wrong way to do it...!
LDBI\t「そうです！@ ラ・ギアスへ呼び込まれた地上人を見つけ出し、@ 地上: That's right!@Finding the surface dwellers brought to La Gias@and sending them home is the real answer...!
LDBI\t「召喚プログラムが暴走した時点で、@ 賽は投げられたのだよ」: The die was cast the moment the summoning@program ran out of control.
LDBI\t「無論、君達を巻き込んでしまったことは@ 申し訳ないと思っているが…: Of course, I do regret dragging all of you@into this, but...
LDBI\t「各国が地上人召喚事件の真相を知れば、@ 様々な手段で我々を糾弾する: If the other nations learn the truth behind the@summoning incident, they will condemn us by any@means. And that will only breed further chaos...
LDBI\t「そうなる前にラ・ギアスを統一しようってんなら、@ 本末転倒も甚だし: So you're unifying La Gias before that happens?@That's putting the cart way before the horse!
LDBI\t「事実隠蔽や責任転嫁のための手段ではない。@ 地上人召喚事件が起きず: It is not a means of concealment or shifting@blame. Even without the summoning incident, a@calamity brought by a Demon God is prophesied.
LDBI\t「全てが手遅れになる前に、@ 私は力を以てラ・ギアスを統一し、@ 秩: Before all is lost, I will unify La Gias@by force and bring order to it...!
LDBI\t「君達もこの世界の行く末を案ずるのならば、@ 全力で私を阻止してみせ: If you truly care about this world's future,@then stop me with everything you have!
LDBI\t「あんたが仕掛けようとしてる戦争は@ 私闘以外の何物でもねえ……！」: This war you're trying to start is nothing@but your own private fight...!
LDBI\t「フェイル！ 俺は魔装機神操者として、@ あんたの野望を叩き潰すぜ！: Feil! As a Masoukishin pilot, I'm gonna@crush your ambitions!!
LDBI\t「もう引き返せねえんだな、フェイル……！@ だったら、せめてこの俺が: So there's no turning back, Feil...!@Then at least let me be the one to end it!
LDBI\t「まだ終わるわけにはいかないのだよ、マサキ。@ ラ・ギアス全土の未来: I cannot end things yet, Masaki. For the@future of all La Gias... and to take@responsibility.
LDBI\t「あんたには別の方法で責任を取ってもらう！@ そのデュラクシールから: You'll take responsibility some other way!@Right after I drag you out of that Duraxyll!
LDBI\t「どうした！？ 遠慮などいらん！@ 私を倒すのが、お前達魔装機神操者: What's wrong!? There is no need to hold back!@Defeating me is your duty as Masoukishin@pilots!
LDBI\t「いいだろう、手加減はしねえぜ！！」: Fine, then! I won't hold back!!
LDBI\t「私がもっと早く陛下のことに気づいていれば……@ 他に手立てがあった: If only I'd realized your condition sooner...@There might have been another way!
LDBI\t「君が悔やむ必要はない……@ 全ての責任は、この私にあるのだからな」: You need not feel regret...@All the responsibility lies with me.
LDBI\t「駄目よ、兄さん！@ こんな責任の取り方なんて……@ もっと他に方法: No, brother!@This isn't how you take responsibility...@There has to be another way!
LDBI\t「セニア……お前には感謝している……@ デュラクシールという力を与え: Xenia... I am grateful to you...@For giving me the power that is Duraxyll.
LDBI\t「あたしが、そんな物を造ってしまったから……！@ こんな……こんなこ: It's because I built that thing...!@If I'd known it would come to this...!
LDBI\t「命があと僅かだから……責任を取るためだからって、@ 戦争を起こすな: Just because you don't have long, or to take@responsibility... starting a war? I can't@accept that!
LDBI\t「それが君とザムジードの心の声か……！」: So that is the voice of your heart and@Zamzeed's...!
LDBI\t「本当に……本当に@ これしかなかったんですか、殿下……！？@ こん: Was this really... really the only way,@Your Highness...!? This is just too sad...!
LDBI\t「今の私は……悲しむ時間すら惜しいのだよ、@ プレシア」: Right now... I cannot even spare the time@to grieve, Precia.
LDBI\t「あなたには生きて責任を取ってもらう！」: You're going to live and take responsibility!
LDBI\t「ラ・ギアス全土の統一以外に方法はないのだよ、@ ライディース」: There is no way but to unify all La Gias,@Raidiese.
LDBI\t「それは独善に過ぎない！@ 残される人間のことを考えていないのか、@: That's nothing but self-righteousness!@Don't you think about the people you'll@leave behind!?
LDBI\t「陛下、まだ間に合います！@ その機体から降りて下さい！」: Your Majesty, it's not too late!@Please get out of that machine!
LDBI\t「ここで立ち止まるわけにはいかぬのだ、中尉……@ 私の命令によって戦: I cannot stop here, Lieutenant... I must repay@the subordinates who went to battle on my@orders and fell!
LDBI\t「義のためなどとは申しませぬ！@ それがしは、それがしの信ずる所に従: I shan't claim 'tis for justice!@I stand upon this field in accordance with@that which I believe!
LDBI\t「マサキに拠り所を見出したか……@ それは彼の成長を意味する。良きこ: So you've found someone to rely on in Masaki...@That means he has grown. A fine thing.
LDBI\t「あなた達がマサキ達に協力するとは……@ いや、予測はついていた」: So you'd side with Masaki and the others...@No, I expected as much.
LDBI\t「自分は陛下のご意志を理解し、@ ラングランに平和をもたらすためにも: I understood Your Majesty's intentions, and@I believe I fought to bring peace to Langran@as well.
LDBI\t「一方的に巻き込まれてしまったとは言え、@ 我々地上人の存在はラ・ギ: Though we were dragged here against our will,@we surface dwellers have affected the@situation in La Gias...
LDBI\t「ならば、それを少しでも収拾するのが@ 我らの役目でありましょう」: If so, it falls to us to help set@things right, if only a little.
LDBI\t「ふ……あなた達に出会えたのは僥倖だった。@ だが、この混乱した事態: Heh... Meeting you was a stroke of fortune.@But restoring order to this chaos is my@duty...!
LDBI\t「終わった……な……全てが……@ これで……良かったのかも知れん……: It's over... everything... Perhaps... this@was for the best...
LDBI\t「セニア……モニカ……テリウス……@ わかってくれとは……言わない…: Xenia... Monica... Tellius...@I won't ask... you to understand...@Only... to forgive me...
LDBI\t「私も……君達と同じ時を歩みたかった……@ さぞ楽しかったろうなあ…: I wanted to... walk the same path as you...@How much fun it would have been...
LDBI\t「兄さん、脱出して！ 脱出装置があるでしょ！？」: Brother, get out!@You have an ejection system, don't you!?
LDBI\t「は……はは……セニア……@ 強制脱出装置は取り外しておいたよ……」: Ha... haha... Xenia...@I had the emergency ejection system removed...
LDBI\t「どっちにしろ、私の命は……もう……」: Either way, my life is... already...
LDBI\t「？……モニカか……？@ そうか……無事だったんだね……良かった……: ?... Monica, is that you...?@So... you're safe... I'm glad...
LDBI\t「えっ……！？@ 兄さん、何言ってるの……？ 私は……」: Huh...!?@Brother, what are you saying...? I'm...

BMD\t「油断したら、あれに吸収される……！」: If I let my guard down, it'll absorb me...!

LDBI\t「カークス将軍の目論見は、@ 私達の予想を上回っていましたね……」: General Kirkus's plans went further@than any of us expected...
LDBI\t「テリウス殿下を推戴して、権力を握るだけでなく……@ ラ・ギアス全土: Not only seizing power by enthroning@Prince Tellius... but even planning to unify@all of La Gias.
LDBI\t「上手くいけば、結果的にラ・ギアスが@ 平和になるかも知れないけど…: If it works, La Gias might end up@at peace in the end...@but it'd start a massive war!
LDBI\t「目的や大義はともかく、それを成し遂げるまでの@ 過程に大きな問題が: Whatever his goals or cause, there are serious@problems with how he means to achieve them.
LDBI\t「フェイル殿下は、そのことを承知の上で@ カークス将軍の申し出を受け: Did Prince Feil accept General Kirkus's offer@knowing all that...?
LDBI\t「現状ではカークス軍の力を借りねば、@ シュテドニアス軍を撃退するこ: He must have judged that without the Kirkus@Army's help, there was no way to drive back@the Schtedonias Army.
LDBI\t「まず、ラングランを解放しなければ、@ その後のことなど成り立たない: After all, unless Langran is liberated first,@nothing that comes after will matter.
LDBI\t「でも……もし、当面の事態の対策として、@ フェイル殿下がテリウス殿: But... if Prince Feil accepted Prince Tellius's@ascension just to deal with the situation@at hand...
LDBI\t「後でフェイル軍とカークス軍が@ 戦うことになるかも知れませんよね…: Then later, the Feil Army and the Kirkus Army@might end up fighting each other, right...?
LDBI\t「国は違えど、私も王族の一人です。@ 王位継承権がどのような意味を持: Our countries differ, but I too am royalty.@I believe I understand full well what@the right of succession to a throne means.
LDBI\t「我がリクセント公国でも@ 旧西暦時代に王位を巡っての争いがありまし: In the Old Calendar era, even our Principality@of Riksent saw a struggle over the throne.@Though it never came to war...
LDBI\t「フェイル殿下のご決断に対しては、@ 周りの方々が激しく反対したはず: Those around Prince Feil must have fiercely@opposed his decision.
LDBI\t「それを押しのけてまで@ ご自身の王位継承権を譲り、テリウス殿下の@: For him to override them, give up his own@claim to the throne, and accept Prince@Tellius's ascension...
LDBI\t「この戦乱の収拾以外にも、何か理由が……@ 並々ならぬご決意があるの: There must be another reason besides ending@this war... some extraordinary resolve.
LDBI\t「フェイル殿下も@ 何か別の目的を持ってるっていうこと……？」: You mean Prince Feil's got some other@goal too...?
LDBI\t「ああ……僕は君達をセブ神殿へ送り届けた後、@ それを直接確認しに行: Yes... After I deliver you all to Sebu Temple,@I plan to go see for myself.@His Highness should be in the capital now.
LDBI\t「もしかしたら、@ マサキ達もそこにいるかも知れない」: Masaki and the others@may be there as well.
LDBI\t「ねえ、通信で確認することは出来ないの？」: Hey, can't you just check over comms?
LDBI\t「またエーテル流の乱れが激しくなっている。@ 長距離通信は困難な状況: The ether currents are turbulent again.@Long-range communication is difficult.
LDBI\t「それに、セブ神殿を確保しなければ、@ 君達や他の地上人達を送還する: Besides, if we don't secure Sebu Temple,@there'll be no way to send you or the other@surface dwellers home.
LDBI\t「カークス将軍が送還準備を整えてるってんなら、@ あいつの部下が守り: If General Kirkus is setting up the return trip,@shouldn't his men be guarding it already?
LDBI\t「そうだとは思うが……@ ルオゾール達の動きが気になる」: I'd think so... but I'm concerned about@what Luozorl and his people are up to.
LDBI\t「彼らの手を借りて、@ 潜伏しているシュテドニアス軍部隊は@ 他にも: There are likely other Schtedonias units@hiding out with their help.
LDBI\t「ねえ、ヤンロン。あたしも……」: Hey, Yang Long. I'll go too...
LDBI\t「これ以上、君達を巻き込むことは出来ない。@ 鋼龍戦隊の他のメンバー: I can't drag you any further into this.@Gennacy and I will take responsibility for@searching for the rest of the Steel Dragons.
LDBI\t「君達はセブ神殿で待っていてくれればいい」: All you need to do is wait at Sebu Temple.
LDBI\t「ここまでは無事に……」: We've made it this far safely...
LDBI\t「艦長！@ セブ神殿周辺で、戦闘が行われているようです！」: Captain!@There seems to be fighting around Sebu Temple!
LDBI\t「ヤンロンの予想が当たりましたね。@ 総員、第一種戦闘配備。@ 針路: Looks like Yang Long guessed right.@All hands, level-one battle stations.@Hold course, all ahead at third battle speed!
LDBI\t「機装兵のデータは事前に手に入れてたし。@ 僕のアヴニールなら、これ: I got the Mechanical Soldier data beforehand.@For my Avenir, this is a piece of cake.
LDBI\t「さっさとやられちゃってよね」: Hurry up and get beaten already.
LDBI\t「偵察しに来ただけなんだけど……@ 意外にあっさり制圧できそうだし」: I only came here to scan the place...@but looks like I can take it pretty easily.
LDBI\t「さて、どうするかな……@ 準備が整ってるとして、先に地上へ帰ったら: Now what... If things are ready and I go back@to the surface first, Sienne and Cyan will@probably get mad...
LDBI\t「あ……やっぱり、こっちに来ちゃったか」: Ah... Figures they'd come here after all.
LDBI\t「あの機体は……@ 地上で我らを襲撃した３機の内の１機だ」: That unit...@One of the three that struck us on the surface.
LDBI\t「ならば、３人目の<ブーステッド・チルドレン>……」: Then that's the third of the <ブーステッド・チルドレン>...
LDBI\t「あれは神殿警備用の機装兵だ」: They're Mechanical Soldiers for temple defense.
LDBI\t「じゃあ、どうしてカークス軍の魔装機を……！？」: Then why attack the Kirkus Army's Masouki...?!
LDBI\t「機装兵は無人機だ。@ もしや、奴にハッキングされ、操られているので: Mechanical Soldiers are unmanned.@Could he have hacked them and taken control?
LDBI\t「てめえ、あのシエンヌやシアンの仲間だな！@ いったい何者なんだ！？: You're with that Sienne and Cyan, aren't ya!@Who the hell are you?!
LDBI\t「そして、何故、あの時……我らを襲った？」: And why... did you attack us that day?
LDBI\t「では、何のためにここへ来た？」: Then why have you come here?
LDBI\t「地上へ帰れるって聞いたから、ちょっと偵察にね」: Heard there's a way back to the surface,@so I came to do a quick scan.
LDBI\t「誰からその話を聞いた？@ まさか、カークス将軍ではあるまいな？」: Who told you that?@Surely not General Kirkus?
LDBI\t「……ラングランの人間じゃないってことだけ@ 教えておくよ」: ...I'll just tell you it wasn't@someone from Langran.
LDBI\t「お前達がわざわざここへ来たってことは、@ 話は本当みたいだし。面倒: Since you guys came all the way here,@seems the story's true. I hate hassle,@so I'm heading back. Bye.

LDBI\t「このままでは、神殿に累が及ぶ！@ やむを得ん、機装兵を破壊するぞ！: At this rate, the temple will be caught in it!@No choice--destroy the Mechanical Soldiers!
LDBI\t「……あのガキ共は@ シュテドニアスに雇われてるんだったな。@ いっ: ...Those brats were hired by Schtedonias,@weren't they? Where the hell did they@hear about this?
LDBI\t「機装兵を制御するには、@ そのデータを入手しなければなりませんし…: And to control the Mechanical Soldiers,@they'd have needed to get the data...

LDBI\t「あたしはアルジャン・クラス……@ アウルム１が死んだ今となっちゃ、: I'm Argent class...@With Aurum 1 dead, that makes me@the top of the Boosted Children.
LDBI\t「ラトゥーニから@ ブーステッド・チルドレンの生き残りがいるとは@: Latune did tell me there were@surviving Boosted Children, but...

LDBI\t「ハッ！ 薬漬けだった連中と@ 一緒にしてもらっちゃ困るね。@ あた: Ha! Don't lump me in with those@drugged-up washouts.@This line of work just suits me.
LDBI\t「それに、この世界にいた方が稼げそうだからね……@ しかも、相手がお: Besides, it looks like there's more money@to be made in this world...@And with you lot as targets, all the better.
LDBI\t「あなた、どこの所属なの？@ もしかして、<ノイエＤＣ>の残党？」: Who do you belong to?@Are you one of the <ノイエＤＣ> remnants?
LDBI\t「そんなことを教える必要はないね。@ 手柄が立てられりゃ、戦場はどこ: No need to tell you that.@As long as there's glory to win,@any battlefield will do.

LDBI\t「フン、あいつらは欠陥品さ。@ ブーステッド・チルドレンとして@ 本: Hmph, they're defective goods.@What the Boosted Children are meant to be...@that's me.

LDBI\t「ハハッ、そうこなくちゃね！ 行くよ！」: Haha, that's more like it! Here I come!
LDBI\t「チッ、ケルベリオンが……！@ 調整不足が祟ったか！@ 今日の所は引: Tch, the Kerberion...!@Guess it wasn't tuned enough!@I'll back off for today!
LDBI\t「そもそも、どうしてこんな所まで来たのかしら？」: Why did she come all the way out here, anyway?
LDBI\t「何となく傭兵っぽい感じがしたけどね。@ シュテドニアス軍に雇われて: She gave off a kind of mercenary vibe.@Maybe Schtedonias hired her,@or maybe she just came after us...
LDBI\t（地上人召喚事件……@ ちょっとやそっとじゃ片付きそうにねえかもな…: (The surfacer summoning incident...@Looks like this won't be settled easily...)
LDBI\t「ゴーレム共め、さっさと片づけてやるぜ！」: Damn golems, I'll finish you off quick!
LDBI\t「この世界じゃ、魔装機神は極上の獲物だってねぇ！」: Word is, in this world,@a Masoukishin is the ultimate prize!
LDBI\t「お前らみたいな@ ブーステッド・チルドレンがいるとはな」: Didn't know there were Boosted Children@like you.
LDBI\t「言ったろ！ あたしの方が本流なのさ！」: Told you! I'm the genuine article!
LDBI\t「ＡＴＸチームのメンバーを仕留めれば、@ いい手柄になるさね！」: Taking down a member of the ATX Team@would be a nice feather in my cap!
LDBI\t「おいたが過ぎると高くつくわよ、お嬢ちゃん！」: Misbehave too much and it'll cost you,@little miss!
LDBI\t「……お前さん達のおかげで@ ガテゼルクを消去することが出来た。@: ...Thanks to you all, we were able@to erase Gatezeruku.@You have my gratitude.
LDBI\t「ああ。恩に着てくれよ、婆さん」: Yeah. You owe us one, granny.
LDBI\t（マサキったら、ここぞとばかりに……）: (Masaki, milking it for all it's worth...)

LDBI\t「演技って言うか……本音でもあるわね」: Acting... It was also how we really felt.

LDBI\t「だが、このままだと@ ラングランとシュテドニアスの戦いに@ どんど: But at this rate, we'll keep getting dragged@deeper into the war between@Langran and Schtedonias.
LDBI\t「まあ、もう他人事じゃないしねぇ」: Well, it's not someone else's problem anymore.

LDBI\t「そうね、ケルベリオンという名前だったし」: Yes, it was called the Kerberion, after all.
LDBI\t「連邦軍の機体だったら、@ こっちに突っ掛かってくるわけがないし……: If it were a Federation unit,@it wouldn't be coming after us...@So is it Neo DC remnants and Isurugi again?
LDBI\t「イスルギに関しては、疑惑があります。@ ラ・ギアスへ来る前、私達は: We have our suspicions about Isurugi.@Before coming to La Gias,@we ran into the Vegalion...

LDBI\t「もしかして、そいつを奪われちまったのか？」: Wait, did someone steal it from you?
LDBI\t「ううん、@ こっちで作ったのはアルテリオンだけ……」: No...@the only one we built was the Altairion...
LDBI\t「あたし達が見たベガリオンは、@ フィリオの設計図を基にして@ イス: I think the Vegalion we saw was made@by Isurugi on their own,@based on Filio's blueprints...
LDBI\t「ベガリオンと遭遇した後、@ ラ・ギアスに来てしまったから、@ 詳細: We ended up in La Gias right after@running into the Vegalion,@so we couldn't look into it further...
LDBI\t「まずは王都に行くことじゃな。@ フェイル殿下もそこへ向かっておるし: First, you should head to the royal capital.@Prince Feil is headed there, and above all,@I worry for the captive Princess Monica.
LDBI\t「仰る通りです。@ 罠の可能性を念頭において行動すべきかと」: You're right. I believe we should proceed@with the possibility of a trap in mind.
LDBI\t「ああ、コースを変えるべきかどうか……」: Yeah. Question is, do we change course...
LDBI\t「ここでの戦闘は回避できましたが、@ 次は困難でしょう。ここは一刻も: We avoided a fight here, but next time it@won't be so easy. I believe we should join up@with the convoy as quickly as possible.
LDBI\t「そうだな。@ 敵は連中だけじゃない……賭けに出るか」: Right.@They're not the only enemy out here...@Guess we roll the dice.
LDBI\t「……遅れてしまいましたね。@ 鋼龍戦隊の出迎えは？」: ...We're running late.@Is the Steel Dragons' escort here yet?
LDBI\t「そろそろだと思うが……@ さっき、レーダーに引っかかった連中が@: Should be any time now...@But I'm concerned about that group@that showed up on radar earlier.
LDBI\t「ガイアセイバーズですね。@ 近づきもせず、離れていきましたけど……: The Gaia Saviors, right?@They moved off without ever getting close...
LDBI\t「こちらは避難民輸送船の識別コードを@ 出している。迂闊に手は出せん: We're broadcasting the ID code of a refugee@transport. They shouldn't try anything rash.
LDBI\t「彼らなら臨検をやりかねません。@ それをしなかったということは、@: They're the type to board us for inspection.@The fact that they didn't means@something else might be going on...
LDBI\t「いざとなれば、我々が説明する。@ 時間稼ぎにしかならないかも知れん: If it comes to that, we'll explain things.@Though it may only buy us some time.
LDBI\t「いや、鋼龍戦隊には恩があるからな」: Don't be. We owe the Steel Dragons.
LDBI\t「む……ラーダさん、迎えが来たようだ」: Hm... Radha, looks like your ride is here.
LDBI\t「輸送隊を目視で確認。@ 他の機体は確認できません」: Visual on the convoy.@No other units detected.
LDBI\t「やれやれ、最悪のケースは避けられたか」: Whew, guess we dodged the worst-case scenario.
LDBI\t「ですが、嫌な感じがします」: But I have a bad feeling about this.
LDBI\t「そいつは俺も同感だ。@ もっとも、念動力じゃなく、勘だがな。@ み: I'm with you on that.@Not Telekinesis, though--just a hunch.@Everyone, form up around the transport.
LDBI\t「本当にあの状態で使い続けているとは……@ いい度胸ですわね」: They're really still using it in that state...@You have to admire the nerve.
LDBI\t「でも、思っていたより@ 安定しているように見えますが……」: But it looks more stable@than I expected...
LDBI\t「ラーダ、@ ガイアセイバーズがこの辺りをうろついている。@ すぐに: Radha,@the Gaia Saviors are prowling around here.@We're pulling out immediately.
LDBI\t「浅はかだったな、アリエイル。@ こちらに捕捉された時点で、さっさと: Foolish of you, Arieil.@You should've just changed course the moment@we picked you up.
LDBI\t「それでは、輸送隊が危険にさらされます」: That would have put the convoy in danger.
LDBI\t「お前達を泳がせたことで、あの輸送艦が@ 避難民などを乗せていないと: By letting you run loose, we learned that@transport isn't carrying any refugees.
LDBI\t「そして、@ 積荷がお前達にとって重要な物であることも。@ ＩＦＦ発: And that its cargo matters a great deal to you.@Sending that IFF signal was your undoing.
LDBI\t「だが、お前が深読みをしたおかげで、@ こっちは先に輸送隊と接触する: But thanks to you overthinking it,@we got to the convoy first.
LDBI\t「それで大義名分が成った。@ 鋼龍戦隊に与する者は同罪だ」: Which gives us all the justification we need.@Anyone who sides with the Steel Dragons@shares their guilt.
LDBI\t「……イルム中尉、私がドゥバンを引き付けます。@ その間に輸送隊を離: ...Lieutenant Irm, I'll draw Duban off.@Get the convoy out while I do.
LDBI\t「いや、敵の別働隊がいる可能性が高い。@ ここは全員でしのぎ、ハガネ: No, odds are they've got a second unit nearby.@We all hold out here until the Hagane arrives.@We'll turn Duban's goal against him.
LDBI\t「そう、あいつはハガネにアルフィミィがいると@ 思ってるんじゃないか: Right. Don't you think he believes@Alchemie is aboard the Hagane?
LDBI\t「各機、アリエイルはおれに任せろ。@ 輸送艦は撃沈して構わん。かかれ: All units, leave Arieil to me.@Feel free to sink the transport. Go!
LDBI\t「……レッド・オーガが見当たらん。@ もしや、奴は……」: ...I don't see the Red Ogre.@Don't tell me...
LDBI\t「アルフィミィはあの後、姿を消したままです。@ 当てが外れましたね、: Alchemie has been missing since then.@You guessed wrong, Duban.
LDBI\t「案の定、伏兵を用意していやがったか」: Just as I figured, they had an ambush ready.
LDBI\t「各機、輸送艦を死守しろ！」: All units, defend the transport at all costs!
LDBI\t「高速飛行物体、接近！ ０時方向、俯角２０！@ 数は１！」: Fast mover incoming! 12 o'clock, 20 degrees low!@Just one!
LDBI\t「手こずっているようだな、ドゥバン」: You seem to be having trouble, Duban.
LDBI\t「アーマラ、貴様の手を借りずとも……！」: Amala, I don't need your help to...!
LDBI\t「こちらにも任務があるのでな」: I have a mission of my own.
LDBI\t「あれって、リョウト少尉からもらった@ データにあった……」: Isn't that from the data@Lieutenant Ryoto gave us...?
LDBI\t「ええ、コード“エビル”……@ オルレアンでヒュッケバイン・シリーズ: Yes. Code name "Evil"...@The unit that destroyed the Huckebein@series in Orleans.
LDBI\t「念の力は感じられない……けど……」: I can't sense any psychic power... But...
LDBI\t「聞こえるか、鋼龍戦隊。@ 私はガイアセイバーズ、オメガ・セイバーの: Can you hear me, Steel Dragons?@I am Amala Burton of the Gaia Saviors'@Omega Saber.
LDBI\t「やっぱり、ガイアセイバーズだったのね！」: I knew it was the Gaia Saviors!
LDBI\t「そ、それで！ @ よろしければ、シャ、シャイン……あ、いえ！@ サ: A-And, um! If it's not too much trouble,@could I get your Sh-Shine... I mean, no!@Could I get your autograph?
LDBI\t「ところで、シャイン王女……@ 国に戻られなくても大丈夫なんですか？: By the way, Princess Shine...@Don't you need to return to your country?
LDBI\t「ラ・ギアスでの事件の参考人として、@ もうしばらく鋼龍戦隊にいて欲: I was asked to remain with the Steel Dragons@a while longer as a witness regarding@the incidents in La Gias...
LDBI\t「あ、でも、国には先程連絡致しました。@ ジョイスが大変喜んでおりま: Oh, but I did contact my country just now.@Joyce was absolutely overjoyed.
LDBI\t「……それにしても、@ みんな揃ってラ・ギアスへ行っていたとはな」: ...Still, to think you all@ended up in La Gias together.
LDBI\t「まあ、話すとホントに長くなるんだけどさ」: Well, it's a really long story.
LDBI\t「あの……コウタとアクセルさんは？@ 一緒じゃないんスか？」: Um... what about Kota and Axel?@They weren't with you?
LDBI\t「その二人とは会っていない。@ ラ・ギアスへ召喚されたかどうかも不明: We didn't meet them.@We don't know if they were even summoned.
LDBI\t「そうでございますですか……」: Is that so, then, is it...
LDBI\t「鋼龍戦隊のメンバーは全員戻って来たんだが……@ 俺達以外でラ・ギア: All the Steel Dragons came back, but...@Masaki and his crew are gonna search for any@other surface dwellers who got sent to La Gias.
LDBI\t「もし、あの二人があっちにいたら、@ あいつらが地上へ戻してくれるだ: If those two are over there,@those guys'll send 'em back to the surface.
LDBI\t「あと、アラド……それに、ラトゥーニとゼオラに@ お伝えしなければな: Also, Arado... There is something I must tell@you, as well as Latune and Seolla.
LDBI\t「ええ……私達はラ・ギアスで@ シエンヌ、シアン、シオという者達と戦: Yes... In La Gias, we fought@people named Sienne, Cyan, and Shio.
LDBI\t「その三人は……アルジャン・クラスの……！」: Those three are... from the Argent Class...!
LDBI\t「いけすかねえガキ共だったぜ。@ まだラ・ギアスにいると思うがよ」: Bunch of obnoxious brats.@I figure they're still in La Gias, though.
LDBI\t（もし、あの三人がこちらへ戻って来たら……@ 私達は……）: (If those three come back here...@what will we...)
LDBI\t（スクールの生き残りが……@ よりにもよって、あいつらだなんて……）: (The School's survivors... and of all@people, it has to be them...)
LDBI\t「向こうじゃ、色々あったが……@ 地上の方でも面倒事が起きてるようだ: A lot went down over there...@but looks like there's trouble up here too.
LDBI\t「ああ……それについては、レフィーナ司令達との話が@ 済み次第、報告: Yeah... I'll report on that once I'm done@talking with Commander Lefina and the others.
LDBI\t「ロブも呼ばれてんのか？」: They called you in too, Rob?
LDBI\t「ああ、オブザーバーとしてね。@ おそらく、ゲスト襲撃後の戦況につい: Yeah, as an observer.@They'll probably explain how the war's gone@since the Guest attack, too.
LDBI\t「はい。@ ゲストはパリや各方面軍基地、重要施設に対し、@ 空間転移: Yes. Reportedly, the Guest used warp tactics to@launch surprise attacks on Paris, regional army@bases, and other key facilities, but...
LDBI\t「連邦軍や『ＧＳ』……『ガイアセイバーズ』によって@ 阻止されたとの: they were repelled by the Federation Army and@the GS, or Gaia Savers.
LDBI\t「ガイアセイバーズ……@ それが例の大統領直轄部隊の正式名称ですか」: Gaia Savers...@So that's the official name of that@presidential unit.
LDBI\t「ええ。先程、グラスマン大統領の演説で@ ゲスト襲来による非常事態宣: Yes. President Glassman announced its existence@in a speech just now, along with a declaration@of a state of emergency over the Guest invasion.
LDBI\t「地球を護る剣ある限り、@ 地球人の主権が侵されることはない…… @: As long as Earth has a sword to protect it,@the sovereignty of its people will never be@violated... or so the President stated.
LDBI\t「剣……か。@ それがガイアセイバーズのみを指しているのなら、@ 連: A sword, is it...@If that refers to the Gaia Savers alone,@then he slights the Federation Army.
LDBI\t「それ以前に、解せぬ点がある。@ ゲストはオルレアン工場にヒュッケバ: Before that, there is something I cannot fathom.@The Guest knew the Hückebein was at the Orleans@factory, and had sensed the Kurogane's movements.
LDBI\t「我らにも兵を差し向けたのは、@ <インスペクター事件>から得た教訓: That they sent forces against us too was surely@a lesson learned from the <インスペクター事件>,@but...
LDBI\t「事前に情報収集を行っていなければ、無理な話だ。@ そして、<インス: That would be impossible without prior intel.@And learning from the failure of the <インスペクター>,@they struck at Earth's core from the outset...
LDBI\t「つまり、彼らは情報を集めた上で、@ 必勝を期し、多方面への同時奇襲: In short, they gathered intel, aimed for certain@victory, and struck many fronts at once. For that@to be thwarted so easily...
LDBI\t「何が言いたいのだ、レーツェル？」: What are you getting at, Rätsel?
LDBI\t「統合参謀本部やガイアセイバーズは、@ ゲストが仕掛けてくるタイミン: Is it possible that the Joint Chiefs of Staff@and the Gaia Savers knew beforehand when the@Guest would make its move?
LDBI\t「以前にも言った通り、連邦政府と異星人の間には@ パイプが存在してい: As I said before, there was a pipeline between@the Federation government and the aliens. And it@remains connected in some form even now...
LDBI\t「また、先程のゼブという男の言葉から推測して、@ インスペクターとゲ: Also, judging from what that man Zeb said, the@Inspectors and the Guest don't get along, even@though they belong to the same faction.
LDBI\t「もしかしたら、@ インスペクター側からゲスト襲撃に関する情報が@: Perhaps, then,@the Inspectors were the ones who supplied@intel on the Guest attack.
LDBI\t「同勢力ならば、地球を制圧するという目的も@ 同じであるはずだが……: If they're the same faction, their goal of@conquering Earth should be the same too...
LDBI\t「インスペクターとゲストの間で@ 派閥争いめいたものがあって、@ そ: Are you saying there's some kind of factional@rivalry between the Inspectors and the Guest,@and it's been dragged here?
LDBI\t「ええ。ゲストの失敗は、インスペクターにとって@ 都合がいいのかも知: Yes. The Guest's failure may well be@convenient for the Inspectors.
LDBI\t「だとしたら、@ もっと早い段階でゲストの地球侵攻を@ 阻止してくれ: If that's the case,@I wish they'd stopped the Guest's invasion@of Earth a lot sooner...
LDBI\t「それが出来なかったからこそ、@ 情報をリークしたとも考えられる」: It's also possible they leaked the intel@precisely because they couldn't do that.
LDBI\t「どこの世界でも派閥争いはあるんだな。@ 使っている兵器の系統は同じ: Guess every world has its factional squabbles.@Their weapons even share the same lineage...
LDBI\t「ざっとですけどね。@ 先程の敵機は、どれも初出でしたが……」: Only a rough one.@The enemy units we just saw were all new, but...
LDBI\t「その内の一機種にジェミニラと同じような@ パーツが使われていた」: One of those models used parts similar@to the Geminillah's.
LDBI\t「ジェミニラ……インスペクター事件で@ 確認されたという可変機のコー: Geminillah... That was the code name for the@transformable unit confirmed in the Inspector@Incident. We never encountered it, though...
LDBI\t「インスペクターと違い、@ ゲストは結構な数の自前の機体を@ 持ち込: Unlike the Inspectors, it's safe to assume@the Guest has brought a fair number of@its own machines.
LDBI\t「わかりました。@ では、今後の行動についてですが……」: Understood.@Now, regarding our next course of action...
LDBI\t「極東方面軍司令部に連絡を入れた所、@ 直ちに出頭し、一連の事情を説: When I contacted Far East Command HQ, we were@ordered to report there immediately and explain@the whole series of events.
LDBI\t「よって、本艦とハガネは@ これより伊豆へ帰投します」: Therefore, this ship and the Hagane@will now return to Izu.
LDBI\t「その前に、お願いしたいことがあるんですが……」: Before that, there's something I'd like to ask...
LDBI\t「さようなら、ヒューゴ・メディオ。@ 陳腐な台詞だけど、言っておくわ: Goodbye, Hugo Medio. It's a cliche, but...@I'll say it anyway... Play nice with Albero,@Foglia and the others in the afterlife.
LDBI\t「逃がすものかよ、エルデ・ミッテ！@ 追え、アクア！！」: You're not getting away, Erde Mitte!@After her, Aqua!!
LDBI\t「あなたの気持ちはわかる……私だってそうよ」: I know how you feel... I feel the same way.
LDBI\t「でも、ここは生き残ることを最優先に考える……@ あなたが戻って来て: But right now, we have to put survival first...@Not after you finally came back to me.
LDBI\t「何があっても生きて帰る……@ それが、アルベロ少佐の教えなんでしょ: Come home alive, no matter what...@That's what Major Albero taught you, right?
LDBI\t「ええ……この通り、ですが……」: Yes... As you can see, but...
LDBI\t「フッ……どうやら、悪運は尽きていなかったようだな」: Heh... Looks like your luck hasn't run out yet.
LDBI\t「で、でも、今までどこにいたんスか！？」: B-But where've you been all this time?!
LDBI\t「話は後で聞く。各機、攻撃を開始しろ！」: We'll hear the story later.@All units, commence attack!
LDBI\t「あ～、その前に。ちょっとええかの、艦長」: Ahh, before that. Got a moment, Captain?
LDBI\t「あそこの２機……@ ＴＥアブゾーバーの８号機と９号機じゃが、@ 手: Those two units over there...@TE Absorber Units 8 and 9...@Any chance we could get our hands on 'em?
LDBI\t「あれの開発にはワシも関わっておっての。@ 壊してしまうのは、もった: I had a hand in developin' those, y'see.@Be a waste to just smash 'em.
LDBI\t「回収してくれたら、後でワシが改修するでの。@ ヒューゴ少尉が戻って: If you bring 'em back, I'll refit 'em later.@With Lieutenant Hugo back, we could even@put 'em to use.
LDBI\t「わかりました。@ 各機に伝達。ＴＥアブゾーバー８号機と９号機は@: Understood.@Relay to all units: TE Absorber Units 8 and 9@are to be captured, not destroyed.
LDBI\t「ＴＥアブゾーバー９号機、機能停止！」: TE Absorber Unit 9 has shut down!
LDBI\t「ＴＥアブゾーバー８号機、機能停止！」: TE Absorber Unit 8 has shut down!
LDBI\t「全周警戒を厳となせ。@ 各機を収容後、現戦域から離脱します」: Maintain full-perimeter alert.@Once all units are aboard, we leave the area.
LDBI\t「いや、驚いたの。@ メディウスに……ラズムナニウムに取り込まれて、: Well, that's a surprise.@Swallowed by the Medius... by Lazmanium...@and you came back alive.
LDBI\t「理由はわからんが、@ 割と綺麗に排出されたみたいじゃの」: Dunno why, but looks like it spat you out@pretty cleanly.
LDBI\t「もしかしたら、ヒューゴ少尉の身体に@ ラズムナニウムが組み込まれて: Perhaps it's related to the Lazmanium that@was implanted in Lieutenant Hugo's body.
LDBI\t「んむ……ミタールが補った部分は@ そのままじゃからの……」: Mm... The parts Mitar filled in@are still there, after all...
LDBI\t「いったい、メディウスの中にいた時は、@ どんな案配だったんかの？」: So what was it like in there,@inside the Medius?
LDBI\t「ずっと眠っていたような……。@ ただ、このまま死ぬわけにはいかない: Like I'd been asleep the whole time...@But I kept thinking I couldn't die like that...@That I had to make it back...
LDBI\t「それで……アクアの声が聞こえて……」: And then... I heard Aqua's voice...
LDBI\t「ふむ……お主のその意志が@ ＡＩ１に何らかの影響を与えたのかの」: Hmm... Maybe that will of yours@had some sort of effect on AI1.
LDBI\t「そもそも、あれはどうしてヒューゴを@ 取り込んだんでしょうか……」: Why did it take Hugo in@in the first place...?
LDBI\t「偶然か、故意かはわからんが……@ お主達と戦っていて、興味を持った: Whether by chance or on purpose, I dunno...@Maybe fightin' you two made it curious about ya.@As beings who pilot TE Absorbers.
LDBI\t「でも、それはエルデが望んでいたことでは@ なかったんじゃ……」: But that wasn't what Erde wanted...@was it?
LDBI\t「それはお互い様よ、ヒューゴ……。@ あなたが戻って来てくれて、嬉し: That goes both ways, Hugo...@I'm so glad you came back.@I thought you'd died...
LDBI\t「だが、アルベロ隊長は……@ エルデやミタールに騙されて……」: But the Commander... Albero was deceived@by Erde and Mitar...
LDBI\t「辛い道を……選択せざるを得なかったのだな、@ 彼は……」: So he had no choice but to take@a painful path...
LDBI\t（今、思えば……ヒューゴを引き入れようとしたのは@ 彼を助けるためだ: (Looking back... maybe he tried to recruit Hugo@to save him...)
LDBI\t「ミタール……エルデ……@ あの連中を許すことなど出来ない……」: Mitar... Erde...@I can never forgive them...
LDBI\t「ツェントル・プロジェクトを叩き潰さなければ……@ 隊長やフォリア、: If we don't crush the Tsentr Project...@the Commander, Foglia, and my comrades@in the Cry Wolves can't rest in peace...
LDBI\t「んむ……ＡＩ１がこのまま進化すれば、@ あのプロジェクトは危険な方: Mm... If AI1 keeps evolvin' like this,@that project's headed somewhere dangerous...
LDBI\t「おそらく、メディウスはまた現れるの。@ お主達はサーベラス・イグナ: The Medius'll prob'ly show up again.@You two oughta use the Cerberus Ignite@and the Garmraid Blaze.
LDBI\t「ミタールが組み込んだ物を完全に取り除く方法が@ あるかどうかわから: Dunno if there's a way to fully remove what@Mitar put in ya, but the more mechanical bits@I can fix myself.
LDBI\t「それでも、薬が……もうほとんどないんです」: Even so, I'm nearly out of medicine.
LDBI\t「あるでの。こんなこともあろうかと思って、@ トーチカ８へ行く前に拝: Got some. Figured somethin' like this might@happen, so I borrowed some before Tochka 8.
LDBI\t「んむ。ミタールはもう不要だと思っておったのか、@ あれの管理のガー: Mm-hm. Mitar musta figured it wasn't needed,@'cause the guard on it was lax.@So I swapped out the meds.
LDBI\t「こちらを潰す気なら、初手でやっている。@ それをしないと言うことは: If they wanted to crush us, they'd have done it@right away. Since they haven't, they may have@some other goal.
LDBI\t「各機、臨戦態勢のまま待機。@ クロガネから離れるなよ」: All units, stay at combat readiness and hold.@Don't stray from the Kurogane.
LDBI\t「で、でも、向こうから仕掛けられたら……！」: B-But if they attack us first...!
LDBI\t「闇雲に口火を切るのは危険だ。@ カイ少佐の命令に従いたまえ」: Opening fire blindly is dangerous.@Follow Major Kai's orders.
LDBI\t「では、出来得る限り時間を稼ごう」: Then let's buy as much time as we can.

BMD\t「チッ、アルブレードに/ 食いついてきやがったか！」: Tch, it's latched onto/　the R-Blade!
BMD\t「アーマラめ、/ 絶妙にタイミングを合わせてきやがる！」: Damn that Amala,/　her timing is spot-on!
BMD\t「何でこうも/ アーマラに動きが読まれるんだ！？」: Why does Amala keep/　reading my moves!?
BMD\t「何だよ、その程度の攻撃しかできねえのか？」: What, that's all you can dish out?
BMD\t「こ、こいつ……！！ 弱すぎる……！」: Th-This thing...!! It's way too weak...!
BMD\t「ちっ、少しはやるじゃん！/ ハンデにしといてやらあ！」: Tch, not bad!/　I'll call that your handicap!
BMD\t「これが若さゆえの過ちか……/ なんてカッコつけてる場合じゃねえ！」: So this is the folly of youth.../　No, this is no time to act cool!
BMD\t「あいてっ！ よけ損なっちまったか……！」: Ow! Guess I didn't dodge that one...!
BMD\t「どこがやられた！？/ ……何だ、装甲に傷がついた程度かよ」: Where'd I get hit!?/　...Huh, just a scratch on the armor.
BMD\t「くそっ、/ 相手の機体に気ィ取られて当たっちまったぜ」: Dammit, I got distracted by/　their machine and took a hit.
BMD\t「あ、あれ？ よけたと思ってたのに……」: Huh? I thought I dodged that...
BMD\t「こ、こんなんじゃ、/ またヴィレッタ隊長に特訓されちまう！」: Th-This is bad! At this rate,/　Captain Viletta's gonna drill me again!
BMD\t「おい、よそ見でもしていたのか？」: Hey, were you looking the other way?
BMD\t「うるせえ！/ ちゃんと前見て操縦してらあ！！」: Shut up!/　I'm watching where I'm going!!
BMD\t「回避に失敗したようだな……」: Looks like you failed to evade...
BMD\t「わりぃ！/ 今のは無かったことにしてくれ！」: My bad!/　Let's pretend that never happened!
BMD\t「ＳＲＸの損傷は軽微だ。問題ない」: Damage to the SRX is minimal. No problem.
BMD\t「天下無敵のスーパーロボットが、/ そう簡単にやられるかってんだ！」: An invincible super robot/　isn't going down that easy!
BMD\t「リュウ、/ フィールドをあてにしてくれていいわよ！」: Ryu,/　you can count on the field!
BMD\t「俺のＲ‐１に傷をつけやがって……！/ 許さねえ！」: You scratched my R-1...!/　I won't forgive you!
BMD\t「Ｒ‐１の相手をするのは……/ 十年はやいんだよ！」: You're ten years too early/　to take on the R-1!
BMD\t「くそっ……/ また俺のＲ‐１に傷がついちまったぜ！」: Dammit.../　My R-1 got scratched again!
BMD\t「この程度で/ ＡＲＴ‐１を止められると思うなよ！」: Don't think that's enough/　to stop the ART-1!
BMD\t「くっ！ こいつに何かあったら、/ ロブ達にどやされるぜ」: Ugh! If anything happens to this thing,/　Rob and the others'll chew me out.
BMD\t「そんなもんが/ ゲシュペンストに通用するかよ！」: Like that'll work/　on a Gespenst!
BMD\t「笑わせんな！/ このゲシュペンストがその程度で！」: Don't make me laugh!/　Like that'd stop this Gespenst!
BMD\t「グルンガストの装甲はダテじゃねえんだよ！」: The Grungust's armor isn't just for show!
BMD\t「グルンガストの装甲をブチ抜くには、/ パワーが足りねえ！」: You'll need more power than that/　to punch through the Grungust's armor!
BMD\t「くっ！/ ヒュッケバインに当てるなんざ、/ 大したもんだ！」: Ugh!/　Landing a hit on the Hückebein,/　that's impressive!
BMD\t「ちっ！ アルブレードがこれぐらいで！」: Tch! That won't stop the R-Blade!
BMD\t「よくも俺のアルブレードに/ 傷をつけやがったな！」: How dare you scratch/　my R-Blade!
BMD\t「指揮官機相手に油断は禁物だってのに！」: You never let your guard down/　against the Commander's unit!
BMD\t「チッ、あの口調に騙されたぜ！」: Tch, that tone of voice threw me off!
BMD\t「くっ！/ 打ち込みの速さは、さすがダブルＧってことか！」: Ugh! Those strikes are fast.../　Guess that's Double G for you!
BMD\t「チッ、あの斧は要注意だな！」: Tch, gotta watch out for that axe!
BMD\t「あの図体でいい動きしやがる！」: It moves pretty well for its size!
BMD\t「くっ！ 邪神なんぞに！」: Ugh! Not to some evil god!
BMD\t「くっ、ユーゼス……/ てめえの思い通りにはならねえぞ！」: Ugh, Euzeth.../　Things won't go your way!
BMD\t「ヘッ、さすが超機人ってことか！」: Heh, that's a Choukijin for you!
BMD\t「ラ・ギアスのメカもやるじゃねえか！」: La Gias mechs are pretty good too!
BMD\t「百年早いんだよ！」: You're a hundred years too early!
BMD\t「うおっ！？ ……あぶねぇあぶねぇ」: Whoa!? ...That was close, way too close.
BMD\t「惜しい！ ホントに惜しかったぜ！」: So close! That was really close!
BMD\t「ゲシュペンストと戦うのも、/ 十年早いんだよ！」: You're ten years too early/　to fight a Gespenst, too!
BMD\t「グルンガストと戦うのも、十年早いんだよ！」: You're ten years too early/　to fight a Grungust, too!
LDBI\t「残された時間をどう使うか……@ それはお主次第での」: How you spend the time you have left...@that's up to you.
LDBI\t「なら、ワシについてくるでの。@ 銃を向けたままでの」: Then follow me.@And keep that gun pointed at me.
LDBI\t「アレス・ガイストの前に作られた試作機での。@ プロジェクト・イデア: It's a prototype built before the Ares Geist.@Project Idealands was going to scrap it, but...
LDBI\t「ツェントル・プロジェクトの方で@ 使えるかも知れないと思っての」: I thought the Tsentr Project@might have some use for it.
LDBI\t「んで、かつて<シャドウミラー>が回収した@ アルトアイゼンの腕やラ: And the spare parts <シャドウミラー> once salvaged@for Alteisen's arm and a unit called Rapiecage@made their way here in a roundabout fashion.
LDBI\t「それらを組み込んで仕上げた……@ フリッケライ・ガイストでの」: I built those into it and finished it...@The Flickerei Geist.
LDBI\t「まあ、見ての通り、継ぎ接ぎじゃからの」: Well, as you can see, it's a patchwork job.
LDBI\t「ですが、この機体にもファウ・ケルンが……」: But this unit has a Fau Kern too...
LDBI\t「アレスの物とは違い、欠陥品での。@ ジェネレーターとして使えるが、: Unlike the Ares's, it's defective.@It works as a generator,@but it can't do anything more than that.
LDBI\t「これに乗って、テスラ研に行くがええ。@ あそこなら、ファウ・ケルン: Take this and head to the Tesla Reich Institute.@They can prove the dangers of the Fau Kern@there with hard data.
LDBI\t「しかし、私を逃がせば、博士が……」: But if you let me escape, Doctor, you'll...
LDBI\t「ワシにはまだ仕事があるでの。@ ＴＥアブゾーバーやフェリオから託さ: I've still got work to do. I need to finish@the TE Absorber and the NV Unit@that Ferio entrusted to me.
LDBI\t「ワシはお主に脅されて、やむなく従っただけでの。@ さあ、その銃でワ: You forced me at gunpoint, and I had no choice.@Now, shoot me with that gun.
LDBI\t「……ワシはオヅヌ博士を助けてやれんでの。@ せめて、お主だけでもと: ...I couldn't save Dr. Ozunu.@I thought I could at least save you.
LDBI\t「ワシを案ずるなら、撃つでの。@ その方が言い訳をし易いでの」: If you're worried about me, shoot.@It'll make my excuse easier to sell.
LDBI\t「さ、さあ、早く行くでの……@ 後はお主次第での……」: N-Now, hurry and go...@The rest is up to you...
LDBI\t「はい……このご恩は忘れません……！」: Yes... I'll never forget your kindness...!
LDBI\t（こ、これでええんじゃろ、エンジ・オヅヌよ……）: (Th-This is what you wanted, right, Enji Ozunu...?)
LDBI\t「ブリット、クスハ、よく戻ってきたのう」: Bullet, Kusuha, good to have you back.
LDBI\t「なに、あと１週間もすれば動けるようになるわい。@ それより、すまな: Bah, I'll be up and about in a week.@Never mind that. I'm sorry. Even with me@there, RyuOhKi and KoOhKi ended up like that...
LDBI\t「あの後、妖機人はテスラ研に現れていないと@ 聞きましたが……」: I heard the Yokijin haven't shown up@at the Tesla Institute since then...
LDBI\t「うむ、残った龍王機を奪いに来るのではないかと@ 思っておったが……: Yes, I thought they might come back@to take the remaining RyuOhKi, but...
LDBI\t「クスハ、龍人機のマインド・センシングの@ 準備が整ったわ」: Kusuha, we're ready for RyuJinKi's@mind sensing.
LDBI\t「あら、所長はまだ話してなかったのね。@ その説明もするから、格納庫: Oh, the director hasn't told you yet?@I'll explain that too, so come to the hangar.
LDBI\t「……見ての通り、龍王機の失われた部分を@ グルンガスト系のパーツで: ...As you can see, we've replaced RyuOhKi's@missing sections with Grungust-series parts.
LDBI\t「その結果、龍王機は人型となり……@ 呼称を区別するため、龍人機と名: As a result, RyuOhKi became humanoid...@To tell them apart, we named it RyuJinKi.
LDBI\t「組み込んだパーツの癒着が進んでいますね」: The installed parts are fusing further.
LDBI\t「ああ。@ 君の読み通り、自力での融合を図っているが……@ 五行器の: Yes.@Just as you predicted, it's trying to fuse@on its own... But the Gogyo Unit's output is weak.
LDBI\t「クスハ、君の念で龍人機を完全に@ 覚醒させることが出来れば、残って: Kusuha, if your mind can fully Awaken RyuJinKi,@we may be able to attach the remaining parts@without trouble.
LDBI\t「わかりました。すぐに乗り込みます」: Understood. I'll board it right away.
LDBI\t「アンザイ博士、ネート博士、モニターを頼む」: Dr. Anzai, Dr. Nate, please monitor it.
LDBI\t「クスハ、コックピット・モジュールは@ 軽傷で済んだから、<Ｔ‐ＬＩ: Kusuha, the cockpit module only took light@damage, so the <Ｔ‐ＬＩＮＫシステム> settings@are the same as before.
LDBI\t「今はアッシュ……@ エクスバイン・アッシュと呼ばれているんだ」: It's called Ash now...@The Exbein Ash.
LDBI\t「いえ、フランス語の『Ｈ』では？」: No, isn't it the French letter H?
LDBI\t「不死鳥は灰の中から甦る……@ 凶鳥もまた、ということですか？」: The phoenix rises from the ashes...@So the bird of ill omen will too?
LDBI\t「装甲が半分近くなくなっているようですが……」: It looks like nearly half its armor is gone...
LDBI\t「そこはパッチ・アーマーや@ コーティング・クロークで補う予定なんだ: We plan to cover that with Patch Armor@and a Coating Cloak.
LDBI\t「まさに応急措置ですね」: A stopgap measure if ever there was one.
LDBI\t「本来、エクスバインに装着する予定だったパーツは、@ 月の<マオ・イ: The parts originally meant for the Exbein were@in development at <マオ・インダストリー> HQ on the Moon,@but the Guests made shipping them impossible.
LDBI\t「幸い、武装の一部はオルレアンで調整中だったから、@ ここへ持ち込め: Luckily, some weapons were being tuned in Orleans,@so we could bring those here, but...
LDBI\t「もしかして、エクスバインに@ 強化改造を施す予定だったのですか？」: Were you planning to give the Exbein@a major upgrade?
LDBI\t「そうだ。Ｍｋ－Ⅲ同様、Ｔ‐ＬＩＮＫシステムを@ 搭載した高性能機と: Yes. Like the Mk-III, it was to be a high-end@unit equipped with the T-Link System.
LDBI\t「何か手伝えることがありましたら、言って下さい」: If there's anything I can help with, let me know.
BMD\t「四凶と言えど、負けるわけにはいかない！」: Four Fiends or not, I won't lose!
BMD\t「地球圏の封印なんて、やらせるものか！」: I won't let you seal the Earth Sphere!
BMD\t「あんなものが地球の守護神だなんて……！」: That thing is supposed to be/　Earth's guardian god...!
BMD\t「ＡＩ１……これ以上はやらせないぞ！」: AI1... I won't let you go any further!
BMD\t「ユーゼス・ゴッツォ……/ 何としても、ここで倒してみせる！」: Euzeth Gozzo.../　I'll take you down here, no matter what!
BMD\t「ユーゼス、お前の思い通りにはさせないぞ！」: Euzeth, I won't let things go your way!
BMD\t「このまま終わってたまるものか！」: I won't let it end like this!
BMD\t「出来れば、次で終わらせる……！」: If I can, I'll end it next turn...!
BMD\t「まだ！ ここからだ！」: Not yet! This is where it starts!
BMD\t「そっちの思惑どおりにいくと思うな……！」: Don't think things'll go your way...!
BMD\t「うわあっ！ これじゃやられる……！」: Whoa! At this rate, I'm done for...!
BMD\t「うっ！ このまま死を待つだけか……！？」: Ugh! Am I just waiting here to die...!?
BMD\t「な、何！？ 動力部に当たった……！？」: Wh-What!? It hit the power plant...!?
BMD\t「は、判断ミスが、ここまで響くなんて……！」: I-I can't believe one bad call/　cost me this much...!
BMD\t「ぐうっ！ ま、まだあきらめないぞ……！」: Gah! I-I'm not giving up yet...!
BMD\t「まだまだ！ 正念場はここからだっ！」: Not yet! The real test starts now!
BMD\t「うぐっ！ も、もう少しもってくれ……！」: Ugh! H-Hold out a little longer...!
BMD\t「そ、損傷した装甲をパージ……！/ あと一撃くらえば、終わりか……！？: P-Purging damaged armor...!/　One more hit and I'm finished...!?
BMD\t「げ、撃墜されなかっただけでも/ マシなのか……！？」: I-I guess not getting shot down/　is something, at least...!?
BMD\t「ゲシュペンストの装甲じゃ、/ もう限界か……！？」: Is the Gespenst's armor/　already at its limit...!?
BMD\t「子供だからって、/ 油断したわけじゃないが……！」: I didn't go easy on you/　just because you're a child, but...!
BMD\t「お、恐れるな……/ 恐れちゃ、向こうの思う壺だ！」: D-Don't be afraid.../　Fear is exactly what they want!
BMD\t「相手が四霊だろうと、受け止めてみせる！」: Four Spirits or not, I'll hold my ground!
BMD\t「まだだ！/ まだ終わっちゃいないぞ、ゼゼーナン！」: Not yet!/　It's not over yet, Zezenan!
BMD\t「まだだ、まだ邪神の攻撃に耐えられる！」: Not yet!/　I can still take the dark god's attacks!
BMD\t「まだ受け止められる、あの斧を！」: I can still block that axe!
BMD\t「ちょ、超機人……敵に回すとこれ程の……！」: Ch-Choukijin... This is what they're/　like as enemies...!
BMD\t「な、何をやったんだ、あの化け物は！」: Wh-What did that monster just do!?
BMD\t「つ、次も耐えてみせるぞ、四凶の攻撃に！」: I-I'll survive the Four Fiends' next hit!
BMD\t「ま、まずい！/ このままじゃ、取り込まれる！」: Oh no!/　At this rate, I'll be absorbed!
BMD\t「ううっ、/ ガンエデンに屈してなるものか……！」: Ugh.../　I won't yield to Gan Eden...!
BMD\t「何とか直撃は免れたか……」: Managed to avoid a direct hit...
BMD\t「この程度で落ちるほど、ヤワじゃない……！」: I'm not weak enough to fall to this...!
BMD\t「ぐあっ！ これ以上の被弾は危険だ……！！」: Gah! Taking more hits is dangerous...!!
BMD\t「損傷度確認……。/ あまり機体状況は良くないな……」: Checking damage.../　The unit's not in great shape...
BMD\t「カチーナ中尉のカミナリに比べれば、/ これぐらい何ともない！」: Compared to Lieutenant Katina's yelling,/　this is nothing!
BMD\t「くそっ！ このザマじゃ、/ 中尉の足を引っぱってしまう……！」: Damn it! Like this,/　I'll just drag the lieutenant down...!
BMD\t「これぐらいの損傷で、/ 動かなくなる機体じゃない」: This unit won't stop working/　over damage like this.
BMD\t「ぐっ！ もっと上手く扱えれば、/ 被弾なんてしないのに……！」: Ngh! If I handled it better,/　I wouldn't be getting hit...!
BMD\t「う、うわっ！/ この機体に当てられるなんて！」: Wh-Whoa!/　They actually hit this unit!?
BMD\t「やはり、/ ゲシュペンストの弱点を知られている……！？」: Do they know/　the Gespenst's weak points after all...!?
BMD\t「やっぱり、カチーナ中尉のようには……！」: I knew I couldn't do it/　like Lieutenant Katina...!
BMD\t「こんなもの、当たった内には入らない……！」: That doesn't even count as a hit...!
BMD\t「く……！ この程度で退くものか！」: Ngh...! I won't back down over this!
BMD\t「くうっ！/ グランゾン、これ以上はやらせないわよ！」: Ngh!/　I won't let you do any more, Granzon!
BMD\t「ヒュッケバインの成れの果てが、/ こんなに強いなんて……！」: What's left of the Hückebein/　is this strong...!
BMD\t「あ、あの機体、/ ヒュッケバインを超えている……！？」: Th-that unit... It surpasses/　the Hückebein...?!
BMD\t「あらら……思ってたより手間取りそう」: Oh dear.../　This might take longer than I thought.
BMD\t「こっちの見積もりが甘かったみたいね……」: Looks like my estimates were off...
BMD\t「まだまだ！ これからよ！」: Not yet! This is just the start!
BMD\t「ゼゼーナン！ いつまで抵抗する気なの！？」: Zezenan!/　How long do you intend to resist?!
BMD\t「グランゾンを/ 甘く見たつもりはないけど……！」: I didn't think I was taking/　Granzon lightly, but...!
BMD\t「どうやら欠陥機じゃないみたいね……！」: Seems it isn't a defective/　unit after all...!
BMD\t「ヒュッケバイン以上の/ 性能を持ってるみたいね……！」: It seems to outperform/　the Hückebein...!
BMD\t「もっと強いのかと思ってたのに」: And here I thought you'd be stronger.
BMD\t「意外に大したことないのね」: You're not as impressive as I expected.
BMD\t「ま、こんなものかしらね」: Well, I suppose that's about it.
BMD\t「そんな攻撃じゃ、あたしは倒せないわよ」: An attack like that won't bring me down.
BMD\t「このあたしに当てたことは、褒めてあげるわ」: I'll give you credit for hitting me.
BMD\t「案外大したことないのね、サイバスターは」: Cybuster's not so tough after all.
BMD\t「シュウ・シラカワ……油断できないわね」: Shu Shirakawa.../　I can't let my guard down.
BMD\t「不様なのは、外見だけじゃないのね」: So it's not just your looks/　that are pathetic.
BMD\t「前より多少は強化されたようだけど……！」: Seems it's been upgraded a bit/　since last time, but...!
BMD\t「ビュードリファーには追いつけないわよ」: You can't keep up with the Beautrifa.
BMD\t「その程度の攻撃、予測済みよ」: I already predicted an attack like that.
BMD\t「所詮、付け焼き刃なのよ、ゼゼーナン」: In the end, it's all a quick fix,/　Zezenan.
BMD\t「あらら、無駄な攻撃をするのね」: Oh my, what a wasted attack.
BMD\t「そういうのは、効かないの」: That sort of thing doesn't work on me.
BMD\t「このまま押し切られるわけにはいかないわね」: I can't let them overwhelm me like this.
BMD\t「戦法としては正しいけど、面白くないわね」: Sound tactics, but no fun at all.
BMD\t「今は見逃してあげるわ」: I'll let you go for now.
BMD\t「ここで何もしないわけにはいかないわね」: I can't just stand by and do nothing.
BMD\t「ロフ、後は任せて」: Rof, leave the rest to me.
BMD\t「ロフ、あなたの力になるわ」: Rof, I'll lend you my strength.
BMD\t「面倒見はいい方なのよね」: I do look after my own, you know.
BMD\t「これで決めたいわね」: I'd like to finish this here.
BMD\t「見逃すわけにはいかないの」: I can't let you get away.
BMD\t「僕が相手をしよう。光栄に思いたまえ」: I shall be your opponent. Consider it an honor.
BMD\t「僕が、然るべき道を示そう」: Allow me to show you the proper path.
BMD\t「君達に、炎帝の慈悲があらんことを」: May the Flame Emperor have mercy on you.
BMD\t「君達の目には、苦界しか映っていない」: Your eyes see only a world of suffering.
BMD\t「朱夏を愛でるが如く、/ 君達の命を慈しむとしよう」: As one admires the vermilion summer,/　I shall cherish your lives.
BMD\t「ここで朱を散らすつもりかい？」: Planning to spill your crimson here?
BMD\t「君達も、あと数百年生きれば/ わかるようになるのだけどね」: You'd understand too, if you lived/　a few hundred years more.
BMD\t「自らの朱で紅に染まるか……それも良かろう」: Stained red by your own blood.../　That will do as well.
BMD\t「全ては、大千世界のためなのさ」: All of it is for the Great Chiliocosm.
BMD\t「君達には、入仙できる可能性があるのにな」: And yet you have the potential/　to become immortals.
BMD\t「入仙すれば、苦界での困苦は全て消える」: Become immortal, and every hardship/　of this world of suffering vanishes.
BMD\t「一度、命を終わらせてみるのも手か」: Ending your life once might not be/　a bad idea.
BMD\t「肉の体を捨てれば、/ さらなる力が得られるというのに……」: Cast off your flesh, and you would/　gain even greater power...
BMD\t「僕達も/ 三千大千世界を守るつもりなのだけどね」: We intend to protect/　the Trichiliocosm too, you know.
BMD\t「クスハ、僕の力を君に見せよう」: Kusuha, let me show you my power.
BMD\t「クスハ、君は僕の下に来るべきなんだよ」: Kusuha, you belong at my side.
BMD\t「クスハ、君なら上手く尸解出来る」: Kusuha, your corpse liberation would/　go splendidly.
BMD\t「ここで死んでも大丈夫だよ、クスハ。/ 僕が念入りに尸解を施すから」: It's all right to die here, Kusuha./　I'll perform your corpse liberation/　with great care.
BMD\t「君を殺せば、クスハも諦めるかな？」: If I kill you, will Kusuha give up?
BMD\t「悪いが、クスハは僕の物にするよ」: Sorry, but Kusuha will be mine.
BMD\t「凜とした気、ふくよかな体……/ 君は僕の好みだよ」: Such dignified ki, such a voluptuous/　body... You're just my type.
BMD\t「いいね、君は実にいいよ。好みだ」: Nice. You're very nice indeed./　Just my type.
BMD\t「僕は、君のような子が好きなのさ」: I'm partial to ones like you.
BMD\t「フフフ……僕好みの子だ」: Heh heh heh... Just my type.
BMD\t「心配はいらない。/ ここで死んでも、僕が尸解させる」: No need to worry. Even if you die here,/　I'll see to your corpse liberation.
BMD\t「強念を持ちながら……勿体ないな、君は」: Such strong psychic power.../　What a waste you are.
BMD\t「尸解すれば、/ さらなる強念を得られるのだけどね」: Through corpse liberation, you could/　gain even stronger psychic power.
BMD\t「君には、闘仙になれる資格がある」: You're worthy of becoming/　a Battle Immortal.
BMD\t「念が強まれば、/ 肉体が保たなくなる日が来るのだよ」: As your psychic power grows, the day/　will come when your flesh can't/　contain it.
BMD\t「ククル……僕の力はよく知っているだろう？」: Kukuru... You know my power well,/　don't you?
BMD\t「主に逆らうか、ククル。愚かだね」: Defying your master, Kukuru?/　How foolish.
BMD\t「昔から聞き分けが悪いな、青龍は」: The Blue Dragon always was disobedient.
BMD\t「青龍よ。クスハと共に来るのなら、/ これまでのことは許そう」: Blue Dragon. Come with Kusuha,/　and I'll forgive what's past.
BMD\t「白虎……君には厳しい仕置きが必要だな」: White Tiger... You need/　harsh discipline.
BMD\t「またそちら側に戻るとは……酔狂だね、白虎」: Back on that side again.../　How eccentric of you, White Tiger.
BMD\t「今日はここまでにしておこうか」: Shall we call it a day?
BMD\t「フフフ……よくやったと言っておこう」: Heh heh heh... I'll grant that/　you did well.
BMD\t「……僕を怒らせると、君のためにならないよ」: ...Angering me won't do you any good.
BMD\t「遊びが過ぎたか……」: I toyed with you too long...
BMD\t「僕は泰北ほど我慢強くないんだ」: I'm not as patient as Taihoku.
BMD\t「短命で終わるつもりなのかな？」: Do you mean to die young?
BMD\t「……殺してしまってもいいのだけどね」: ...I could just kill you, you know.
BMD\t「やはり、/ 幼子にはさらなる力を示さねばならないか」: It seems children must be shown/　even greater power.
BMD\t「出来れば、穏便に事を済ませたかったのだが」: I'd hoped to settle this peacefully.
BMD\t「クスハ……/ 僕に選ばれたことを光栄に思って欲しいな」: Kusuha... I'd like you to feel/　honored that I chose you.
BMD\t「クスハ、その力が/ 苦界に埋もれるのは実に勿体ない」: Kusuha, it'd be a true waste to bury/　that power in this world of suffering.
BMD\t「その念の力を、/ もっと効率よく使えばいいものを」: If only you'd use that psychic power/　more efficiently.
BMD\t「その強念を/ より良い方向へ導こうと言うのに……」: And here I'm offering to guide that/　power down a better path...
BMD\t「後手に回るつもりはない！」: I don't intend to play catch-up!
BMD\t「撃破あるのみ！」: Nothing to do but destroy you!
BMD\t「さあ、覚悟を決めろ！/ 己の運命を受け入れる覚悟を！」: Now, steel yourself!/　Steel yourself to accept your fate!
BMD\t「ここは俺の判断でいく！」: I'll handle this my own way!
BMD\t「わかりました。お任せします」: Understood. I'll leave it to you.
BMD\t「データの収集を開始します。/ 後はよろしく」: Beginning data collection./　The rest is up to you.
BMD\t「ＡＩ１が敵機のＷＰデータを表示しました」: AI1 has displayed the enemy's WP data.
BMD\t「フン……参考程度にさせてもらおう」: Hmph... I'll treat it as a reference.
BMD\t「ＡＩ１に余計な真似をさせるなよ」: Don't let AI1 do anything unnecessary.
BMD\t「エルデ、ＡＩ１の補助は不要だ」: Erde, I don't need AI1's assistance.
BMD\t「実行するのはこの俺だ。/ 奴に手出しはさせるな」: I'm the one who'll carry it out./　Don't let it interfere.
BMD\t「ここはＡＩ１に任せた方が賢明です」: It would be wiser to leave this to AI1.
BMD\t「効率重視の戦闘で、奴らは倒せん。/ そのことをＡＩ１に教えてやる！」: Efficiency-first combat won't beat them./　I'll teach AI1 that lesson!
BMD\t「奴の……/ ＡＩ１の手綱を引き絞っておけ！」: That thing... AI1.../　Keep it on a tight leash!
BMD\t「ＡＩ１に余計なゆらぎは不要です。/ くれぐれも……」: AI1 needs no unnecessary fluctuations./　Please, be careful...
BMD\t「黙っていろ。これは俺の戦いだ……！」: Be quiet. This is my fight...!
BMD\t「さて……/ どこまで成長したか、見せてもらおうか」: Now then.../　Show me how much you've grown.
BMD\t「俺を止められるか、カイ・キタムラ！」: Can you stop me, Kai Kitamura?!
BMD\t「退けぬ理由があるのだよ、カイ・キタムラ！」: I have reasons I can't back down,/　Kai Kitamura!
BMD\t「旧教導隊……相手にとって不足はない！」: The old Kyoudoutai... A worthy opponent!
BMD\t「黒い竜巻の技量、見せてもらおうか！」: Show me the Black Tornado's skill!
BMD\t「ゲスト……貴様らの好きにはやらせんぞ！」: Guests... I won't let you have your way!
BMD\t「特機と言えど、このメディウスならば！」: Super Robot or not,/　this Medius can handle it!
BMD\t「逃げ切れると思うな！」: Don't think you can get away!
BMD\t「逃げ場など、与えはせん！」: I'll give you nowhere to run!
BMD\t「了解。データの収集を忘れるな！」: Roger. Don't forget to collect data!
BMD\t「敵はこちらを迎え撃つつもりのようです」: The enemy seems intent on meeting us head-on.
BMD\t「くっ！ ここまでとはな！」: Kh! So this is as far as I go!
BMD\t「そうだ……！ 全力で来るがいい！！」: That's it...! Come at me with everything!!
BMD\t「この結果が……/ メディウスにさらなる力を与えるのだ！」: These results.../　will make the Medius even stronger!
BMD\t「くっ……まさか、このような形で/ 陛下と刃を交えねばならんとは……」: Ngh... To think I'd have to cross/　blades with Your Majesty like this...
BMD\t「陛下、おやめください！/ 今ならばまだ間に合います！」: Your Majesty, please stop!/　It's not too late!
BMD\t「私は……私には、/ 今の陛下のお気持ちがわかりません！」: I... I can't understand what you're/　feeling now, Your Majesty!
BMD\t「敵対する地上人に容赦はしない！」: No mercy for hostile surface dwellers!
BMD\t「侵略者共め、/ これ以上貴様達の好き勝手にはさせん！」: Invaders! I won't let you/　run rampant any longer!
BMD\t「このような戦い、一刻も早く終わらせねば！」: This fight must end as soon as possible!
BMD\t「我が国土を、/ これ以上荒らされてたまるものか！」: I won't let our homeland/　be ravaged any further!
BMD\t「せめて一矢報いる！」: I'll at least get one hit in!
BMD\t「こ、こちらにも国境警備隊の意地がある！」: W-we of the Border Guard have pride too!
BMD\t「や、奴に/ ここまでのパワーがあるとは……！！」: T-to think it/　had this much power...!!
BMD\t「ぐっ！ ブローウェルはまだ保つ！！」: Ngh! The Blowell can still hold!!
BMD\t「……致命傷は避けられたか」: ...At least I avoided a fatal blow.
BMD\t「こちらへ/ 召喚されただけのことはあるか……！」: I suppose there's a reason you/　were summoned here...!
BMD\t「そう簡単にやられるものか！」: I won't go down that easily!
BMD\t「これでも実戦経験は豊富でね」: I've seen plenty of real combat, you know.
BMD\t「地上人に後れは取らない！」: I won't fall behind a surface dweller!
BMD\t「一時後退するしかないか……！」: I'll have to fall back for now...!
BMD\t「ミオ殿、後はお任せを！」: Mio, leave the rest to me!
LDBI\t「……と言うわけで、@ 今のラングランは混乱の真っ只中なんだ」: ...So that's why Langran's in@total chaos right now.
LDBI\t「つまり、お隣さんのシュテドニアス軍が@ 攻め込んで来て、わやくちゃ: So basically, your neighbors in the Schtedonias@army invaded and turned everything upside down.
LDBI\t「おまけに、私達や<ノイエＤＣ>残党まで@ 召喚されちゃってるし……: Plus, they've gone and summoned us and the@<ノイエＤＣ> remnants too... What a mess, huh?
LDBI\t「この混乱のきっかけとなったのは、@ ラングラン王都の壊滅だ。@ 俺: It all started when Langran's@capital was destroyed. And I...@I couldn't stop it.
LDBI\t「そして、あの事件にシュウが一枚噛んでいると思い、@ 俺は奴を追って: I figured Shu had a hand in that,@so I chased him up to the surface.
LDBI\t「で、<南極事件>が起きた後、@ シラカワ博士とご対面……ってわけね: And then after the <南極事件>,@you ran into Dr. Shirakawa... Right?
LDBI\t「ああ。その後で<ＤＣ戦争>が起きて、@ <Ｌ５戦役>、<インスペク: Yeah. After that came the <ＤＣ戦争>,@the <Ｌ５戦役>, the <インスペクター事件>,@and then the Shura Uprising just recently...
LDBI\t「ダークブレインを倒した後、@ シュウは俺達に宣戦を布告した。そして: After we beat Dark Brain, Shu@declared war on us. And then...
LDBI\t「み……見事です……@ このネオ・グランゾンを倒すとは……」: W-well done...@To think you could defeat the Neo Granzon...
LDBI\t「これで……私も悔いはありません……@ 戦えるだけ戦いました……」: Now... I have no regrets...@I fought for as long as I could...
LDBI\t「今度は私の番であった……それだけのことです……」: This time, it was my turn... That is all...
LDBI\t「これで私も……@ 全ての鎖から解き放たれることが……」: Now, I too...@can be freed from every chain...
LDBI\t「あの後、色々あって……@ ようやく俺はラングランに戻って来られたん: A lot happened after that...@but I finally made it back to Langran.
LDBI\t「色々って？ <修羅の乱>の後、マーサは@ すぐに<ラ・ギアス>へ行: A lot? Didn't you say you were going to@<ラ・ギアス> right after the <修羅の乱>, Masa?
LDBI\t「説明すると色々ややこしいんでな。@ ……あ、そうそう、地上でキョウ: It's complicated to explain.@...Oh, right. Kyosuke and Ryusei went@missing on the surface, didn't they?
LDBI\t「本人達から聞いたのさ。@ 俺は、とある所であいつらと合流して……@: They told me themselves.@I met up with them somewhere...@and we fought together for a while.
LDBI\t「ああ。今頃、あいつらは地上に戻って……@ いや、もしかしたら、ラ・: Yeah. By now, they're probably back on the@surface... Or hell, they might even be@here in La Gias.
LDBI\t「ともかく、キョウスケとリュウセイ君は@ 無事ってことね？」: Anyway, so Kyosuke and Ryusei@are safe, then?
LDBI\t「多分、大丈夫だろ。@ 俺もラ・ギアスへ戻って来られたんだし」: Probably, yeah.@I made it back to La Gias, after all.
LDBI\t「ただ、あいつらが今どこにいるかまでは@ わからねえけど……」: Though I couldn't tell you@where they are right now...
LDBI\t「もし、地上だとしたら……。@ ねえ、あっち側に戻れる方法はあるの？: If they're on the surface...@Hey, is there a way to get back over there?
LDBI\t「あるけど、今すぐってわけにはいかねえな。@ 鋼龍戦隊の連中がラ・ギ: There is, but not right away. If the Steel@Dragons might've been summoned to La Gias,@we've gotta find them first...
LDBI\t「さて、ナブロ州は完全にシュテドニアスの@ 勢力下だし……これからど: Now, Nabro Province is totally under@Schtedonias control... So what do we do?
LDBI\t「マサキ殿、シュテドニアス軍が@ ケナク河を越えて侵入して来ました！: Masaki! Schtedonias forces have crossed@the Kenak River and are advancing on us!
LDBI\t「敵は<魔装機>の数を揃えてきています。@ 現状、我が方で出せる機体: The enemy has massed a number of <魔装機>.@All we can field right now are my Blowell@and two Lujanor Kai...
LDBI\t「マサキ殿、申し訳ありませんが、@ ご加勢いただけませんか？」: Masaki, forgive me for asking,@but would you lend us your aid?
LDBI\t「構わねえが、何で３機しか出せないんだ？@ そこのハンガーにディアブ: Sure, but why can you only field three?@You've got the Diablo in that hangar there.@What happened to old man Madock?
LDBI\t「誰？ マーサの知り合い？」: Who's that? A friend of yours, Masa?
LDBI\t「あ、ああ……。@ 地上人でな……色々と世話になった……」: Y-yeah...@A surfacer... He helped me out a lot...
LDBI\t「そうか……マドック爺さんは死んだのか……」: I see... So old man Madock's dead...
LDBI\t「……それ以来、ディアブロは乗り手が現れず、@ この基地に保管されて: ...Since then, no one has piloted the Diablo.@It's been kept in storage at this base.
LDBI\t「そして、当方の戦力は@ これまでのシュテドニアスとの戦闘で@ かな: On top of that, our forces have been@badly worn down by the fighting@with Schtedonias so far...
LDBI\t「そうか……@ せめて、ヤンロンかテュッティがいてくれたらな」: I see...@If only Yang Long or Tytti were here.
LDBI\t「それがしも加勢致しますぞ」: I, too, shall lend my aid!
LDBI\t「そ、それは、あまりなお言葉で……」: Th-that is rather unkind of you...
LDBI\t「あたしも来たよ。何か取り込み中みたいだね」: I'm here too! Looks like you're all busy.
LDBI\t「お前にゃ関係のない話だ。大人しくしてろ。@ その内、地上に帰してや: This doesn't concern you. Just sit tight.@I'll send you back to the surface eventually.
LDBI\t「お前に何が出来るってんだ。引っ込んでろ」: What could you even do? Stay out of it.
LDBI\t「……でも、サイバスターがいると言っても、@ まともに当たるのは、ち: ...Still, even with the Cybuster, taking@them head-on might be a little risky.
LDBI\t「では、イモータル峡谷で迎え撃ちましょう。@ あそこなら、大部隊の展: Then let us intercept them at Immortal Canyon.@A large force can't deploy there, so we@will have a chance of victory.
LDBI\t「しかし、万が一そこを抜かれると、@ 以後敵の進撃を止めることが@: However, should they break through there,@it will be very difficult to halt@their advance afterward.
LDBI\t「それに、魔装機が出払っちまったら、@ この基地の守りが手薄になるし: Plus, if all the Masouki head out,@this base's defenses'll be wide open.
LDBI\t「背水の陣ってことね」: So our backs are to the wall, huh?
LDBI\t「ああ。@ せめて、ディアブロが使えればな……」: Yeah.@If only we could use the Diablo...
BMD\t「リュウセイみたいにやってみる……」: I'll try it like Ryusei does...
BMD\t「ラトゥーニ、/ ロイヤル・ハート・ブレイカーを使いますわよ！」: Latune, we shall use/　the Royal Heart Breaker!
BMD\t「王女、ここはシングルで！」: Princess, single mode for this one!
BMD\t「後は任せますわよ、ラトゥーニ！」: I leave the rest to you, Latune!
BMD\t「終わりでございますわ！」: And that is the end of you!
BMD\t「この機体なら、/ ガーリオン以上にやれる……！」: With this unit, I can do/　better than in a Guarlion...!
LDBI\t「おや、何の真似かな？」: Oh? And what's this supposed to be?
LDBI\t「孫光龍……貴様の比興、見るに堪えん」: Sun Koryu... Your treachery is beyond bearing.
LDBI\t「何言ってんの？@ そいつは、君達を何度も殺そうとした女だよ？」: What are you saying?@That woman tried to kill you time and again!
LDBI\t「そう仕向けたのは、貴様だろうが」: And you're the one who made her do it.
LDBI\t「甘い、甘いなあ。@ でも、巫女は君達のそういう所が@ 気に入ってい: Soft. So very soft.@But maybe that's just the side of you@the shrine maiden took a liking to.
LDBI\t「まあ、いいや。@ 次の相手は四凶の超機人、饕餮王と窮奇王だ」: Oh well, whatever.@Next up are TotetsuOh and KyukiOh,@Choukijin of the Four Fiends.
LDBI\t「知っての通り、情け無用だからね、彼らは。@ あと、老婆心ながら言っ: As you know, they don't do mercy.@And just a friendly word of warning...
LDBI\t「饕餮王と窮奇王に喰われたら、@ 尸解もへったくれもないから。@ 魂: If TotetsuOh or KyukiOh eats you,@forget shikai or any of that nonsense.@They devour your soul. Total annihilation.
LDBI\t「そ、孫光龍……！@ 許さぬ！ そなただけは断じて許さぬ！！」: S-Sun Koryu...!@I shall not forgive you! You, above all,@I shall never forgive!!
LDBI\t「僕らに刃向かうつもりかい、ククル？@ それがどういうことになるか、: You mean to turn your blade on us, Kukuru?@You of all people should know full well@what that would mean.
LDBI\t「主の恩寵が途切れることになれば、@ 君の虚魂は消滅するんだよ？」: Once our master's grace runs out,@your hollow soul will vanish, you know?
LDBI\t「妾は黄泉の巫女……然るべき処に還るだけのこと。@ じゃが、そなたは: I am the Maiden of Yomi...@I shall merely return whence I belong.@But you... you and yours I cannot forgive!
LDBI\t「妾の父母の無念、妾が晴らしてくれる！」: I shall avenge my father and mother myself!
LDBI\t「あ、そう。@ じゃあ、精々頑張ってくれたまえ」: Oh, okay.@Well then, knock yourself out.
LDBI\t「じゃが、妾はたった今、バラルと袂を分かち、@ 妾を謀った者共を討つ: But as of this moment, I break with Baral,@and I shall strike down those who deceived me!
LDBI\t「良かろう……その言葉、信じるぞ」: Very well... I will trust your word.
LDBI\t「四凶の超機人……あなた達には負けない！」: Choukijin of the Four Fiends...@We won't lose to you!
LDBI\t「俺達を……白虎と青龍を@ 易々と止められると思うな！！」: Don't think you can stop us so easily...@the White Tiger and the Blue Dragon!!
LDBI\t「フン、本気になったというわけか？」: Hmph. So now you're getting serious?
LDBI\t「良き仕上がり具合じゃ。善哉、善哉」: They've turned out nicely. Splendid, splendid.
LDBI\t「クスハ、いつぞやの続きだ。@ 君達の心を手折りに来たよ」: Kusuha, let's pick up where we left off.@I've come to pluck your hearts like flowers.
LDBI\t「あなた達のような存在が地球の守護者だなんて……@ 認めるわけにはい: Beings like you, the guardians of the Earth...?@I refuse to accept that!
LDBI\t「悲しいかな、人の身では万魔百邪を@ 打ち払うことは出来ない。魂の格: Alas, mere humans cannot drive off@the myriad demons and evils. Without raising@your souls' rank, you'll never achieve your aim.
LDBI\t「そんなことはない！@ 俺達は、“破滅の王”も退けたんだ！！」: That's not true!@We even drove back the "King of Destruction"!!
LDBI\t「我が主の加護あっての話だよ、それは」: That was only thanks to our master's protection.
LDBI\t「だが、お前達は我らを地球に封印した」: Yet you sealed us away on Earth.
LDBI\t「幼き君達には理解できぬだろうが……@ 星難を払拭するには、それが最: Young ones like you couldn't understand, but...@it's the best way to spare the planet disaster.@Right, Koryu?
LDBI\t「龍王機と同じ……龍の超機人……！？」: Like the RyuOhKi... a dragon Choukijin...!?
LDBI\t「そう。君の龍王機は青龍の超機人……@ 僕の龍王機は、応龍の超機人だ: Yes. Your RyuOhKi is a Blue Dragon Choukijin...@My dragon king is an Oryu Choukijin.
LDBI\t「やはり、そうか。@ 黄龍は神精、応龍は四龍の長……すなわち、@ 青: As I thought. The Yellow Dragon is a divine@spirit; the Oryu leads the four dragons, a being@surpassing the Blue, Red, White and Black.
LDBI\t「おっ、そこの君はなかなか詳しいねぇ。@ そう、<超機人>にはいくつ: Oh, you know your stuff, don't you?@That's right, <超機人> come in several ranks.
LDBI\t「君達もよく知っている四神、@ そして、君達が先程倒した四凶……@: There are the Four Gods you know so well,@the Four Fiends you just defeated...@and there were also the Four Sinners.
LDBI\t「そして、僕の応龍皇は@ 最上位である“四霊”の超機人なのさ」: And my OryuOh is a Choukijin of the highest@rank: the "Four Spirits."
LDBI\t「ああ、全ての超機人を束ねる存在であり、@ 俗界桃源郷の守護機さ」: Yep. It rules over all Choukijin,@and guards the earthly Peach Blossom Paradise.
LDBI\t「ただ、残念ながら……他の四霊の超機人を@ お見せすることは出来ない: Sadly, though... I can't show you the other@Four Spirits Choukijin.
LDBI\t「何故だ？@ せっかくだから、見せてもらいたいもんだぜ」: Why not?@Since we're at it, I'd love to get a look.
LDBI\t「理由は色々あるけど……まあ、教える必要はないか」: There are all sorts of reasons... but I guess@there's no need to tell you.
LDBI\t「それじゃ……僕の力をちょっとだけ見せようかな」: Well then...@maybe I'll show you just a bit of my power.
LDBI\t「な、何てえ念だ！！」: Wh-What kind of psychic power is that!?
LDBI\t「そうそう、言い忘れてたけど、僕も強念者なんだ。@ 色々面倒だから、: Oh, right, I forgot to mention...@I'm a powerful psychic too.@It's a hassle, so I usually hold it back.
LDBI\t（ふうん、なるほど。純水仕立てか。@ だけど、僕と違って混ざり物が多: (Hmm, I see. Brewed in pure water, huh?@But unlike me, he's got plenty of impurities.)
LDBI\t「さて、もう一度聞くけど……@ 大人しく頭を垂れ、僕達の所へ来る気は: Now, let me ask once more...@Won't you meekly bow your heads and join us?
LDBI\t「飽きもせず、同じような話を何度も……！」: You never tire of repeating the same pitch...!
BMD\t「こういう展開もある！」: Things can go this way too!
BMD\t「いい流れだ！ 行ける！」: Good momentum! I can do this!
BMD\t「これが私の運命ならば……やってみせよう」: If this is my fate... then I will see it through.
BMD\t「私は戦うために生まれたのだ。/ 相手が何であろうと……！」: I was born to fight./　Whatever my opponent may be...!
BMD\t「私はジョッシュ達の力になると決めた」: I have decided to lend my strength/　to Josh and the others.
BMD\t「今は人と共に……仮初めの生を生きる」: For now, alongside humanity.../　I live this borrowed life.
BMD\t「あれも地球の護り手か……」: So that too is a protector of Earth...
BMD\t「あの護り手達と戦うのは、初めてではない」: This is not the first time/　I have fought those protectors.
BMD\t「お前達が護っているものは、何だ……？」: What is it that you protect...?
BMD\t「凍らせば、静かになる」: Once frozen, you will be silent.
BMD\t「ジョッシュにとって敵である者は、/ 私にとっても同じだ」: Josh's enemies/　are my enemies as well.
BMD\t「私の生は、お前の下にはない」: My life is not yours to command.
BMD\t「イグニス……私の決意は変わらない」: Ignis... my resolve has not changed.
BMD\t「アクイラ……私をも砕けるか？」: Aquila... can you shatter even me?
BMD\t「私が相手をしよう、アクイラ」: I shall be your opponent, Aquila.
BMD\t「どちらが先に滅びるか……/ 試してみるか、コンターギオ」: Which of us will perish first.../　Shall we find out, Contagio?
BMD\t「恐怖にも、お前達にも抗ってみせよう。/ ジョッシュやリムのように」: I will defy both fear and you./　Just like Josh and Rim.
BMD\t「滅びの宿命は変えられずとも、/ そこへ至る過程は変えられる……！」: Though our fated ruin cannot be changed,/　the path to it can...!
BMD\t「ウンブラ……私を滅ぼせるか、お前に」: Umbra... are you able to destroy me?
BMD\t「ペルフェクティオ……お前を倒す。/ 私が……生きるために……！」: Perfectio... I will defeat you./　So that I... may live...!
BMD\t「“破滅の王”……私を生み出したもの。/ だが、お前には囚われない……: "King of Ruin"... my creator./　But you will not hold me captive...!
BMD\t「強い負の波動を放っている……」: It emits a powerful negative wave...
BMD\t「お前達の導きなど、私には必要ない」: I have no need of your guidance.
BMD\t「私はお前達と戦う。/ ジョッシュ達が、人で在り続けるために」: I will fight you,/　so that Josh and the others/　may remain human.
BMD\t「お前が与える命など、私には必要ない」: I have no need of the life you would give.
BMD\t「光龍……お前の時を凍らせよう」: Koryu... I shall freeze your time.
BMD\t「たとえ、相手がお前達であっても/ やることは変わらない」: Even if my opponent is you,/　what I must do does not change.
BMD\t「私はもう、破滅の導き手ではない」: I am no longer a herald of ruin.
BMD\t「相手がお前達でも、私は戦う」: Even against you, I will fight.
BMD\t「お前の時間を凍らせよう。/ そうすれば、進化できぬ」: I shall freeze your time./　Then you cannot evolve.
BMD\t「あれも破滅の導き手か……」: So that too is a herald of ruin...
BMD\t「四凶……/ 私が、お前達に破滅を与えよう」: Four Fiends.../　I shall be the one to bring you ruin.
BMD\t「ガンエデン……/ お前の加護など、私には必要ない」: Gan Eden.../　I have no need of your protection.
BMD\t「たとえ神であろうと、私は戦う。/ ジョッシュ達と共に！」: Even if you are a god, I will fight./　Together with Josh and the others!
BMD\t「ユーゼス……/ お前の行き先は、久遠の氷獄だ……！」: Euzeth.../　Your destination is an eternal frozen hell...!
BMD\t「ユーゼス、お前は何も創り出せない。/ ここで滅びるのだ！」: Euzeth, you cannot create anything./　You will perish here!
BMD\t「次はこちらから行くぞ」: Now it is my turn to strike.
BMD\t「どこへ行くつもりだ？」: Where do you think you're going?
BMD\t「ここまでか……！」: So this is as far as I go...!
BMD\t「こ、ここで敗れるわけにはいかない……/ ジョッシュ達のためにも……！: I-I cannot lose here.../　For Josh and the others' sake...!
BMD\t「くうっ！/ ファービュラリスを圧倒するとは……！」: Ngh!/　To overwhelm Fabularis like this...!
BMD\t「まだ退けぬ……！ そう、私はまだ……！」: I cannot withdraw yet...!/　Yes, I am still...!
BMD\t「例え、この身が砕かれようとも……！」: Even if this body is shattered...!
BMD\t「ドゥバン、私はまだ倒れていない……！」: Duban, I have not fallen yet...!
BMD\t「コンターギオ、/ お前の手で滅ぼされるなど……！」: Contagio,/　I refuse to be destroyed by your hand...!
BMD\t「くっ！/ ウンブラ、お前とは道を違えたのだ……！」: Tch!/　Umbra, our paths have diverged...!
LDBI\t「では、ヒューゴ少尉とＴＥエンジンは@ ラズムナニウムによって取り込: Then Lieutenant Hugo and the TE Engine@were absorbed by the Razmnanium...?
LDBI\t「アルベロ少佐の意図とは関係なく……？」: Regardless of what Major Albero intended...?
LDBI\t「ＴＥエンジンはともかく、@ ヒューゴ少尉が取り込まれた理由……@: Setting the TE Engine aside, why Lieutenant@Hugo was absorbed... I lack the factors@needed to derive that answer.
LDBI\t「ラズムナニウムを制御する何かが、@ 関係しているかも知れませんわね: Something that controls the Razmnanium@may be involved, I should think.
LDBI\t「いずれにせよ……ヒューゴ少尉を失ったという事実に@ 変わりはないの: Either way... it doesn't change the fact@that we've lost Lieutenant Hugo...
LDBI\t（ヒューゴ・メディオ……お前の悪運は尽きたか。@ それとも……）: (Hugo Medio... has your luck finally run out?@Or...)
LDBI\t「私のジンライが奪取された！@ お、お前はいったい何をやっていたのだ: My Jinrai's been stolen!@W-What on earth were you doing!?
LDBI\t「お言葉ですが、ターゲットを捕捉するまで@ こちらはデルタの指示通り: With respect, I followed Delta's instructions@until the target was acquired. And I helped@the Jinrai escape, too...
LDBI\t「その後が問題なのだ！」: It's what came after that's the problem!
LDBI\t「ターゲット捕捉後、独自の行動を取らせていただくと@ 申し上げたはず: I believe I told you I'd act independently@once the target was acquired?
LDBI\t「こちらとしても残念な結果でしたが……@ これまで通り、ＡＩ１とＡＩ: It's a disappointing result for us as well...@but we'll continue sharing data between AI1@and AI0, as before.
LDBI\t（もっとも、ＡＩ１のデータはダミーだけど）: (Not that the AI1 data is anything but a dummy.)
LDBI\t「ＡＩ１などより、@ 私のシステムＺＬＡＩの方が遙かに重要だ！」: My ZLAI system is far more important@than any AI1!
LDBI\t「……ザパト博士へ報告せねばなりませんので、@ 失礼致します」: ...I must report to Dr. Zapato,@so if you'll excuse me.
LDBI\t「お、おのれ……！ おのれ、鋼龍戦隊……！@ このままでは済まさん！: D-Damn you...! Damn you, Steel Dragons...!@You won't get away with this!
LDBI\t「それに、ミナキ！@ このような時に何故、連絡が取れん！@ いったい: And Minaki!@Why can't I reach you at a time like this!?@Where on earth are you, and what are you doing!?
LDBI\t「そうか……ヒューゴ少尉が死んだか」: I see... So Lieutenant Hugo is dead.
LDBI\t「アルベロ少佐、ご苦労だったな。正直言って、@ ヒューゴ少尉の件に関: Good work, Major Albero. Frankly, I had my@doubts about you concerning Lieutenant Hugo...@I suspected you meant to save him in the end.
LDBI\t「フォリア准尉のことは、引き続き任せてくれたまえ。@ ……では、下が: Leave Warrant Officer Foglia to us, as before.@...You may go now.
LDBI\t「その前に聞きたいことがある」: Before that, there's something I want to ask.
LDBI\t「メディウスの形状変化についてだ。@ ＡＩ１とラズムナニウムであのよ: It's about Medius's transformation. No one told@me AI1 and Razmnanium could do something@like that.
LDBI\t「機密事項だったのだよ。@ それに、君が関与することではない。@ パ: That was classified.@Besides, it doesn't concern you.@Just focus on being a pilot.
LDBI\t「それが、君の息子のためでもある」: It's for your son's sake as well.
LDBI\t「……アルベロの件、このままでよろしいのですか？」: ...Are you sure about leaving Albero as is?
LDBI\t「ああ、まだ御者は必要なようだ。@ 今回のようなことが起きるのであれ: Yes. It seems we still need someone at the reins,@if things like this are going to happen.
LDBI\t「何かご不満な点が？」: Is something not to your satisfaction?
LDBI\t「メディウス・ロクスの進化については認めよう。@ だが、ＴＥエンジン: I'll grant that Medius Locus has evolved.@But absorbing a TE Engine and parts...@Did you give it those instructions?
LDBI\t「それは……君がＡＩ１を制御し切れていないと@ いうことではないかね: Doesn't that mean you haven't fully@gotten AI1 under control?
LDBI\t「私達が望む結果を出すために、@ あの子自身がさらなる力を必要とした: That child needed more power in order@to deliver the results we desire.
LDBI\t「これまでの経験を経て、@ そのような判断が出来るようになったのです: Through its experiences so far, it's become@capable of making such judgments.@I'd call that remarkable growth.
LDBI\t「いや、危険な兆候だな。ＡＩ１がこのまま学習を続け、@ より強い力を: No, it's a dangerous sign. What will you do if@AI1 keeps learning and starts wanting@even greater power?
LDBI\t「子が望む物を与えるのは、親の務めですわ」: Giving a child what it wants is a parent's duty.
LDBI\t「暴走する可能性があると言っているのだ、私は」: What I'm saying is that it could go berserk.
LDBI\t「ラズムナニウムを制御するのは、ＡＩ１の役目です」: Controlling the Razmnanium is AI1's job.
LDBI\t「私が懸念しているのは、そのＡＩ１だよ。@ ここがボーダーラインだ。: AI1 is exactly what concerns me.@This is the line. What's been absorbed can't be@helped, but readjust its limiters.
LDBI\t「君がＡＩ１を御せぬようであれば、@ ＭＯＤＥＬ‐Ｘの件は再考せざる: If you can't keep AI1 in hand,@I'll have to reconsider the MODEL-X matter.
LDBI\t（まさか、あのようなことになるとは……）: (I never thought it would come to that...)
LDBI\t（俺は取り返しのつかないことをしてしまった……）: (I've done something that can't be undone...)
LDBI\t（これでは……フォリアが目を覚ましても@ 合わせる顔がない……）: (At this rate... even if Foglia wakes up,@I won't be able to face her...)
LDBI\t（ヒューゴ……俺はお前を救えなかった……@ お前の道を閉ざしてしまっ: (Hugo... I couldn't save you...@I closed off your path...)
LDBI\t「ふん……ジンライとメディウス・ロクスでは@ 神僕を呼び寄せるまでに: Hmph... So the Jinrai and Medius Locus weren't@enough to summon the divine servants.
LDBI\t「引き続き、アルファとベータに追撃させます」: I'll have Alpha and Beta continue the pursuit.
LDBI\t「場合によっては、オメガも出す」: If need be, I'll send out Omega as well.
LDBI\t「デルタはどうなさいます？」: What will you do about Delta?
LDBI\t「量産型は後々の作戦で……@ そして、人身御供としても使えるだろう。: We'll need the mass-production models for later@operations... and as sacrificial lambs, too.@Leave things as they are.
LDBI\t「はっ。@ それと、メディウス・ロクスが興味深い結果を@ 出しました: Yes, sir.@Also, Medius Locus has produced some intriguing@results. Here is a summary of the data.
LDBI\t「ザパト博士は難色を示しているようですが」: Though Dr. Zapato seems to have reservations.
LDBI\t「これがどこまで化けるか、だな。@ その結果次第では、私の計画の要の: The question is how far it can develop.@Depending on that, it could become one of the@keystones of my plan.
LDBI\t「では、エルデ・ミッテのプランを優先させますか？」: Then shall we give Erde Mitte's plan priority?
LDBI\t「いや、ザパトだ。@ そうすれば、彼女は奮起するだろう？」: No, Zapato's.@That'll light a fire under her, won't it?
LDBI\t「まもなく、第二次生産分のサイリオンが納入されます。@ 今回はパイロ: The second batch of Cylions will arrive soon.@This time with a pilot... Araceli Garcia,@a mercenary in Mitsuko Isurugi's pocket.
LDBI\t「ああ……確か、そのようなことを言っていたな」: Ah... Yes, I believe she mentioned that.
LDBI\t「こちらの腹を探る気でしょうか？」: Do you think they mean to probe our intentions?
LDBI\t「だろうな。@ その男の部隊には、鋼龍戦隊の追撃命令を出しておけ」: Likely.@Order his unit to pursue the Steel Dragons.
LDBI\t「セイバーへの組み込みを望むなら、こちらへ来る前に@ サイリオン以外: Tell him that if he wants a place in Saber,@he'll need to bring a gift other than Cylions@before he comes here.
LDBI\t「申告致します。@ アルテウル司令宛で電文が送られて来ました」: Reporting, sir.@A message has come in for Commander Arteur.
LDBI\t「ここへ直接だと……？ 発信者は誰か？」: Sent directly here...? Who's the sender?

BMD\t「と言っても、かなり物騒なお星様だけどね！」: Though it's a pretty dangerous star!
BMD\t「かくれんぼは昔から得意なの！」: I've always been great at hide-and-seek!
BMD\t「お目当てのあの子は何処かしら？」: Now where's my little sweetie hiding?
BMD\t「特大のをお見舞いしちゃうから！」: I'll treat you to an extra-large one!
BMD\t「その隙は逃がさないわよ？」: I won't let that opening slip by!
BMD\t「今の私は誰にも止められないわよ！！」: Nobody can stop me right now!!
BMD\t「好きにはさせんぞ！」: I won't let you have your way!
BMD\t「くっ！！ まさか、これほどとは……」: Kuh!! I never expected this much...
BMD\t「いかん、このままでは！」: This is bad. At this rate...!
BMD\t「ぐぅっ！ い、いかん！/ ダメージを受け過ぎたか……」: Gah! Th-This is bad!/　Have I taken too much damage...?
BMD\t「むうっ！！ 甘く見過ぎたか……」: Hmph!! Did I take this too lightly...?
BMD\t「ま、まだだ！ まだ墜ちん！」: N-Not yet! I won't go down yet!
BMD\t「ああ、僕はな。/ だがグランヴェールは危険な状態だ」: I am, yes./　But Granveil is in bad shape.
BMD\t「これがメリオルエッセの力か……！」: So this is a Meliol Esse's power...!
BMD\t「ぐうっ！！/ や、やはり、一筋縄ではいかん相手か」: Gah!!/　A-As expected, no easy opponent.
BMD\t「ぬうっ！ 仙才故の技ということか！」: Nngh! The art of one with a sage's gift!
BMD\t「光龍……やはり、只者ではないか！」: Koryu... He's no ordinary man after all!
BMD\t「ちいっ！ ゼゼーナンめ、思ったよりやる！」: Tch! Zezenan's better than I thought!
BMD\t「ぐうっ！ あれを世に放つわけにはいかん！」: Gah! That must not be unleashed!
BMD\t「ぐうっ！ この力……やはり捨て置けん！」: Gah! This power... I can't ignore it!
BMD\t「ぐうっ！！/ 見くびったとは思いたくないが……/ サフィーネの力がこ: Gah!!/　I hate to think I underestimated her.../　Who knew Saphine was this strong?
BMD\t「何っ！？/ モニカ王女に押されるとは……/ 何としたことか」: What?!/　Pushed back by Princess Monica.../　How could this happen?
BMD\t「ぬうっ、/ ブローウェルをここまで仕上げるとはっ！」: Nngh,/　to think Blowell has been honed this far!
BMD\t「伊達に戦歴を重ねてはいないと/ いうことですか……！」: So your many battles/　were no mere show...!
BMD\t「ちいっ！！/ ここまでの力を持つとは……/ 予想外だった！」: Tch!!/　To have this much power.../　I didn't expect it!
BMD\t「い、いかん……/ これ以上こいつと関わるのは得策ではない」: Th-This is bad.../　Fighting this one further is unwise.
BMD\t「あのような物の怪に押されるとは……！」: Pushed back by such a monstrosity...!
BMD\t「やはり、瑞祥などもたらさぬようだな……！」: As I thought, it brings no good omens...!
BMD\t「ぐっ、四凶を名乗るだけのことはある！」: Guh, it lives up to the Four Fiends name!
BMD\t「ぐうっ！ これが応龍の力か！」: Gah! So this is Oryu's power!
BMD\t「うぬっ！ あの妄念に呑まれるわけには！」: Nngh! That delusion won't consume me!
BMD\t「くっ、/ 神を名乗るだけのことはあるようだな……！」: Kuh,/　you live up to calling yourself a god...!
BMD\t「あのような者が、新たな人祖になるなどと！」: Such a being, the new progenitor of man?!
BMD\t「むうっ！！/ これが……デュラクシールの力か！」: Hmph!!/　So this... is Duraxyll's power!
BMD\t「ぬっ！！ だが、この程度ならっ！！」: Nngh!! But this much I can handle!!
BMD\t「やるな……だが、/ その程度でいい気になるなっ！！」: Not bad... But/　don't get cocky over that much!!

BMD\t「くっ……まともに当たったか！/ だが、まだっ！」: Kuh... A direct hit!/　But not yet!

LDBI\t「ええい、ここまでか！」: Blast it, this is as far as I go!

LDBI\t「……我々はシュテドニアス軍から@ 王都を奪還することが出来た。@: ...We've retaken the capital from the@Schtedonias army. Allow me to thank you@once again for all your efforts.

LDBI\t「ああ、シュテドニアス軍が王都から撤退したとは言え、@ 全ての戦いが: Yes. Schtedonias may have left the capital,@but the fighting isn't over. They're gathering@their forces around the Redna Gorge.
