LDBI\t「ここでなら、本当にやりたいことが@ 見つかるんじゃないかと……そう: I thought maybe here... I could finally find@what I really want to do with myself.

LDBI\t「と言っても、@ この艦でお前の働き口なんてあるのかよ」: Even so,@is there even any work for you on this ship?

LDBI\t「その代わり、しばらくの間は雑用係よ。@ あと、鋼龍戦隊と関わる以上: But you'll be our errand boy for a while.@And with the Steel Dragons involved, you'll face@plenty of restrictions. Is that still okay?
LDBI\t「もちろん！ よろしくお願いするよ！」: Of course! I'll do my best!
LDBI\t「ま、頑張れよ、ルーキー」: Well, give it your all, rookie.
LDBI\t「……私、この船から降りたくない……」: ...I don't want to get off this ship...

LDBI\t「ルスランさんと一緒にいた方が安全よ。@ それに、あなたの家族を捜し: You'll be safer with Ruslan.@And he'll look for your family, too...
LDBI\t（過去の記憶がないんだもの……@ 不安を感じて当然だろうけど……）: (She has no memories of her past...@It's only natural she'd feel anxious, but...)

LDBI\t「ルスランさん、あと５分程で海岸へ着きます」: Ruslan, about 5 more minutes to the coast.
LDBI\t「わかった。@ それにしても……快適だな、@ エクサランス・レスキュ: Got it.@Still... the Excellence Rescue sure is@comfortable.

BMD\t「サイバスター……/ スピードは大したものだがな」: Cybuster.../　Your speed is impressive, at least.

BMD\t「こいつで今度こそ、今度こそ終わりだ！」: This time, this time for sure, it's over!

LDBI\t「ヘンドリックス大統領より、@ 証人喚問は回避不可能だという連絡が入: President Hendrix reports that the summons@to testify cannot be avoided.
LDBI\t「あの方では、さほど長く議会を抑えられないと@ 思われますが……いか: I doubt he can hold back the Assembly for long.@...How would you like to proceed?
LDBI\t「フッ、虚偽の映像に踊らされおって……。@ だが、議会など、もうどう: Heh, dancing to a fabricated video...@But the Assembly no longer matters.@Find some excuse and have it postponed.
LDBI\t「承知致しました。@ それと、“グレイ”から返答がありました。@ 既: Understood.@Also, "Gray" has responded.@They say they're already on the move.
LDBI\t「アルテウル司令があの場に赴かれたおかげで、@ ゼゼーナンの陰謀が暴: Because you went there yourself, Commander,@we were able to record Zezenan's scheme@being exposed...
LDBI\t「あの映像を見れば、早急にこちらへ赴き、@ 真偽を確かめようとするで: Once they see that footage, they'll surely@hurry here to confirm whether it's true.
LDBI\t「“グレイ”は、お前の素性に感づいているのか？」: Does "Gray" suspect who you really are?
LDBI\t「前任者には疑われましたがね。@ あの哀れな放浪者達の一味ではないか: Their predecessor had suspicions, yes.@That I might be one of those pitiful wanderers...
LDBI\t「哀れな、か……フフフ、確かにな」: Pitiful, eh... Heh heh, true enough.
LDBI\t「私もそうでしたので。@ なので、アルテウル様には感謝しております」: As I once was myself.@That is why I am grateful to you, sir.
LDBI\t「多少の恩はありますよ。@ 私の命を救って下さったのは、あの方ですか: I owe him somewhat.@He was the one who saved my life, after all.
LDBI\t「しかし、私は道具として利用されていただけ……@ もっとも、そのおか: But I was merely a tool to him...@Though thanks to that, I was able to@establish a line to "Gray."
LDBI\t「そして、ゼゼーナン卿の陰謀が明らかになった以上、@ 我らが介入する: Now that Lord Zezenan's plot is exposed,@there should be no need for us to intervene.
LDBI\t「ああ。@ 後は、バラルやルイーナ、鋼龍戦隊の動き次第だ」: Yes.@The rest depends on what Baral, Ruina, and@the Steel Dragons do.
LDBI\t「ギャスパル・ギラン元帥が@ 彼らの逮捕命令を取り下げたということは: The fact that Marshal Gaspar Gillan withdrew@the order for their arrest... does it mean he@intends to bare his fangs at us eventually?
LDBI\t「鋼龍戦隊を使って、牽制は行うだろうが……@ 連邦軍部隊を直接差し向: He'll use the Steel Dragons to check us...@but he won't send Federation troops directly.
LDBI\t「あの男は、ガイアセイバーズを利用できる所まで@ 利用する気だ。そう: That man intends to use the Gaia Savers as far@as they'll serve him. Otherwise, he'd have@fiercely opposed them before they were formed...
LDBI\t「ゲストとの緒戦で、こちらに花を持たせるような@ 真似はしない。そし: He wouldn't have let us win glory in the first@battle with the Guests. And he'd have caught the@Steel Dragons and handed them to us long ago.
LDBI\t「真っ当な軍人ならば、そうしますね」: That's what any proper soldier would do.
LDBI\t「自分の立場を守りつつ、ガイアセイバーズを利用し、@ 鋼龍戦隊を我ら: Protecting his own position while using the Gaia@Savers, and letting the Steel Dragons roam free@as a check against us...
LDBI\t「優れた知将であるが故、@ 彼は私の思い通りに動いてくれている。@: Because he's such a brilliant strategist,@he's moving exactly as I intend.@All that's left is a matter of timing.
LDBI\t「俺とアルテウルの計画のためだ。従え」: It's for my plan and Arteur's. Obey.
LDBI\t「どうして、そこまであの男に肩入れするんだ？」: Why are you siding with that man so much?
LDBI\t「前にも言ったろう……大いなる目的のためだ」: I told you before... It's for a greater purpose.
LDBI\t「<アースクレイドル>で全てを……命まで失いかけた@ 俺だが、アルテ: At the <アースクレイドル>, I nearly lost everything...@even my life. But meeting Arteur showed me@the stairway to even greater heights.
LDBI\t「俺の計画は、彼の力を得て昇華しつつある。@ そのおかげで、お前を…: My plan is being elevated by his power.@Because of that, I was able to save you...@you, who were collapsing due to Mitar's blunder.
LDBI\t「全てアルテウルのおかげってわけかい。@ だけど、僕が一番気に入らな: So it's all thanks to Arteur, huh?@But what I hate most of all is... him.
LDBI\t「何故、あの劣化コピーが自我を有し、脱走したんだ？@ どうして、追跡: Why does that degraded copy have its own will,@and why did it escape? And why did you stop us@when we went after it?
LDBI\t「それに……何であいつがオリジネイターである@ この僕にない力を持っ: And... why does it have a power that I,@the Originator, don't have?
LDBI\t「その理由を調べるためにも、俺の命令に従うのだ」: Obey my orders. That's how we'll find out why.
LDBI\t（本当は知っているんじゃないか……？@ パパとアルテウルが仕組んだこ: (He knows, doesn't he...?@Isn't this something Papa and Arteur@set up...?)
LDBI\t「……そう言えば、リューネは？@ 一緒にこっちへ来たがってたんじゃね: ...Come to think of it, where's Lüne?@Didn't she want to come here with you?
LDBI\t「あいつは向こうでセニアやプレシア達と留守番だ。@ さんざん駄々をこ: She's holding down the fort over there with@Xenia, Precia and the others. She sure threw@a tantrum about it, though.
LDBI\t「今頃、ザッシュさんが猛アプローチしてたりして」: I bet Zash is hitting on her hard right now.
LDBI\t「何、その反応？ つまんないの」: What kind of reaction is that? Boring.

LDBI\t「そうそう、ＢＦベースみてえだった」: Yeah, it was just like the BF Base!
LDBI\t「島の地下空洞を広げる形で造ったドックとか、@ 隠蔽式カタパルトとか: There's a dock built by expanding a cavern@under the island, a concealed catapult, launch@elevators for super robots...
LDBI\t「他には、ヤシの木が倒れたりとか、@ プールがスライドしたりとか？」: What else? Palm trees that fall over?@A swimming pool that slides open?
LDBI\t「後は建物の中からロケットが……って、@ さすがにそういうのはなかっ: And a rocket out of a building-- okay, no,@there wasn't anything quite like that.
LDBI\t「偽装地上滑走路のギミックは見られたな。@ ちょうど輸送機が着陸する: We did get to see the fake runway gimmick.@A transport plane was landing right then.
LDBI\t「輸送機？@ ダブルＥＸのパーツが届いたのか？」: A transport?@Did the parts for the Double EX arrive?
LDBI\t「いや、補給物資だと聞いたけど……」: No, I heard it was a resupply shipment...
LDBI\t「それにしても、いつの間にこんな基地が……」: Still, when did they build a base like this...?
LDBI\t「元々はビアン・ゾルダーク博士の命令で@ 造られた<ＤＣ>の秘密基地: Apparently it was originally a secret <ＤＣ>@base built on Dr. Bian Zoldark's orders.
LDBI\t「<ＤＣ戦争>後、建造が中断されたんだけど……@ レーツェルさん達が: Construction stopped after the <ＤＣ戦争>, but...@Rätsel and the others took it over and@finished it while remodeling it.
LDBI\t「……それで、私に話とは？」: ...So, what did you wish to speak to me about?
LDBI\t「あの……さっき届いた補給物資なんですが……@ もしかして、私の父が: Um... that resupply shipment that came in...@Did my father arrange it, by any chance?
LDBI\t「女性用の支給品の中に、@ 私がいつも使ってる化粧品とかアロマオイル: Among the supplies for women were the@cosmetics, aroma oils, and supplements@I always use...
LDBI\t「それらは珍しい物なので……@ 私の好みを知っていないと……」: Those are hard to find... Someone would@have to know my tastes to...

BMD\t「凶鳥の宿命に準じ、消え失せろ！」: Meet the ill-omened bird's fate and vanish!

BMD\t「くっ……、/ この逆境が俺を奮い立たせるのだ！！」: Ngh.../　Adversity only spurs me on!!

BMD\t「ただでは死なん！/ 貴様も地獄へ連れて行く！」: I won't die alone!/　I'll drag you to hell with me!
BMD\t「むうっ！ 命を賭けるに相応しい戦いだ！」: Hmph! A fight worth staking my life on!
BMD\t「この打ち込み……！ ただ者ではないな！」: This strike...! You're no ordinary foe!
BMD\t「ぐあっ！/ だが、参式はまだ倒れたわけではない！！」: Gah!/　But the Type-3 has not fallen yet!!

BMD\t「……あと一太刀振れれば、充分だ……！」: ...One more swing is all I need...!
BMD\t「ぬぐっ！/ ダイゼンガー、ここが正念場だ！！」: Nngh!/　Dygenguar, this is the moment of truth!!
BMD\t「奴の炎に焼かれるわけには！」: I won't be burned by his flames!
BMD\t「これが奴の実力か……！」: So this is his true strength...!
BMD\t「夏喃！ 俺の剣はまだ折れていない！」: Kanan! My sword is not yet broken!
BMD\t「ぬうっ！ “破滅の王”め、俺はまだ！」: Nngh! "King of Destruction," I'm not done!
BMD\t「ふん、ダブルＧの名は伊達ではないか」: Hmph, the Double G name isn't for show.
BMD\t「あの魔装機、/ 俺の機体と互角に戦うとは……！」: That Masouki.../　It fights my machine as an equal...!
BMD\t「うぐっ！ 邪神に屈するわけにはいかん！」: Ugh! I will not bow to an evil god!
BMD\t「くうっ！ 四凶に屠られるわけにはいかん！」: Ngh! I won't be slain by the Four Fiends!
BMD\t「あの凶獣をここで食い止めなければ！」: I must stop that beast here!
BMD\t「こ、これが四霊の実力か！」: S-so this is the Four Spirits' power!
BMD\t「ぐうっ！ 貴様が人祖になるなどと！！」: Guh! You, the progenitor of mankind?!
BMD\t「そうだ……/ その気迫でなければ、この俺は倒せんぞ！！」: Yes.../　Only with that Drive can you defeat me!!
BMD\t「必殺の一撃でなければ、意味はないぞ！！」: Only a killing blow will mean anything!!

BMD\t「まだ俺の命には届かんぞ！！」: That's not enough to take my life!!
BMD\t「俺の相手をするには、まだ力が足りん！」: You lack the strength to face me!
BMD\t「我が間合いに踏み込んでくるとはな……！」: So you dared step into my range...!
BMD\t「なかなかの腕だが……/ 零式相手にはまだ足りん！！」: Impressive skill.../　But not enough against the Type-0!!
BMD\t「参式にここまでの/ ダメージを与えるとは……！」: To inflict this much/　damage on the Type-3...!
BMD\t「この俺とダイゼンガーを/ 押しとどめるとはな！」: To hold off both me/　and the Dygenguar!
BMD\t「奴の剣に血を吸わせるわけには……！」: I can't let his blade drink blood...!
BMD\t「くっ！ 邪剣に打ち負けるとは！」: Ngh! Outmatched by a wicked sword!
LDBI\t「……艦長、カークス軍の魔装機が接近中です。@ 当方とのコンタクトを: ...Captain, a Masouki from Kirkus's forces@is approaching. It's requesting contact.
LDBI\t「わかりました。@ こちらからも移動して、落ち合いましょう」: Understood.@We'll move toward them as well and rendezvous.
LDBI\t「ルオゾールに手を貸すことが@ どういう結果を招くか、わかっているの: Do you understand what helping Luozorl@will lead to?!
LDBI\t「ヴォルクルスの復活か？@ フン、邪神だろうが何だろうが利用してやる: Volkruss's revival?@Hmph, evil god or whatever, I'll use it...@if it means bringing Langran to its knees!

LDBI\t「ならば、その身を以て知るがいい！@ 我がダイゼンガーに込められた剣: Then learn it firsthand!@Feel the sword spirit forged into my Dygenguar!
LDBI\t「そのマシン、何の冗談だ？@ それに、子供の出る幕じゃねえぜ！」: What kind of joke is that machine?@Besides, this is no place for a child!
LDBI\t「私のフェアリオンを誹ることは@ 許しませんわよ！」: I won't allow anyone to insult@my Fairlion!
LDBI\t「あの男が……ルオゾールが@ 素直に協力すると思っていて？」: Do you really think that man... Luozorl@will cooperate honestly?
LDBI\t「奴が何を企んでいようが……@ この戦争で我が軍が勝利を収めれば、@: Whatever he's scheming...@as long as our army wins this war,@that's all that matters!
LDBI\t「目先の利益を追って、@ この世界を混乱に陥れる気！？」: Chasing short-term gains,@you'd plunge this world into chaos?!
LDBI\t「混乱の源となっているのは、ラングランだ！@ 地上人にどうこう言われ: Langran is the source of the chaos!@I don't need to hear it from a surface dweller!
LDBI\t「ほう、その動き……@ ちったあ手応えがありそうだな！」: Oh, those moves...@Looks like you might put up a bit of a fight!
LDBI\t「移動要塞などで@ このおれを止められると思うな……！」: Don't think a mobile fortress@can stop me...!

LDBI\t「両舷停止。対地高度５０でＴＤ滞空」: All stop. TD hover at altitude 50.
LDBI\t「……どうやら、僕達が救援に来る必要は@ なかったようですね」: ...It seems we didn't need@to come to your rescue after all.

LDBI\t「ザッシュか！？@ 変わったなあ、２年ぶりか？@ 軍に入っていたとは: Zash?!@You've changed! Has it been two years?@I didn't know you'd joined the army.

LDBI\t「坊や……！？@ 君だって、僕とそんなに変わらないじゃないか。@ 僕: Kid...?!@You're not much different from me, you know.@I'm 18!

LDBI\t「ホントさ。君に似て可愛いし」: I mean it. It's cute, just like you.
LDBI\t「ザッシュ！@ 何をちゃらちゃらとしたナンパなんぞしとる。@ 男なら: Zash!@What's with this flimsy, flirty sweet talk?@If you're a man, go in hard! Hard, I say!
LDBI\t「あ、父さん……じゃなかった、カークス将軍！」: Ah, Dad... I mean, General Kirkus!
LDBI\t「ヤンロン、ご苦労だったな。@ 先程のシュテドニアス軍部隊の狙いは、: Good work, Yang Long.@That Schtedonias unit earlier...@they were after me, weren't they?
LDBI\t「……君からの質問を受ける前に、@ 話しておくことがある」: ...Before you ask your questions,@there's something I must tell you.

LDBI\t「だいたい、あんたの目は@ あたしの親父にそっくりなんだよ」: Besides, your eyes@look just like my old man's.
BMD\t「その程度で、/ サイバスターがやれると思ってんのか！」: You think that's enough/　to take down Cybuster?

BMD\t「ま、インスペクターと大差ねえな」: Eh, no different from the Inspectors.
BMD\t「ゼゼーナンめ、当ててきやがったか！」: Damn you, Zezenan, you landed one!

BMD\t「ヘッ、俺を相手にするのはやめときな！」: Heh, you don't want to fight me!
BMD\t「よせ、フェイル！/ サイバスターのスピードに/ ついてこられる機体な: Stop it, Feil!/　No machine can keep up/　with Cybuster's speed!
BMD\t「どうしちまったんだ、フェイル……/ あんたは、そんな人じゃなかったは: What's happened to you, Feil.../　You were never that kind of man!
BMD\t「俺に魔装機神操者の権利と義務を/ 教えてくれたのは、あんただったよな: You're the one who taught me the rights/　and duties of a Masoukishin pilot, Feil.../　And yet...!
BMD\t「へっ！ いくら改造した所で、/ このサイバスターのスピードにゃ/ つ: Heh! No matter how much you modify it,/　it'll never keep up with/　Cybuster's speed!
BMD\t「山賊ごときの攻撃が当たるかよ！」: Like a bandit's attack could hit me!
BMD\t「おおっと！/ てめえのやり口はお見通しなんだよ、/ ルオゾール！」: Whoa there!/　I see right through your tricks,/　Luozorl!
BMD\t「けっ、/ 偉そうな口を叩いといてそれかよ！/ 雑魚が！」: Tch,/　all that big talk and this is it?/　Small fry!
LDBI\t「表向きは<イスルギ重工>が改修を行っていることに@ なっていますが: Officially, <イスルギ重工> is@supposedly renovating it, but...
LDBI\t「実際はガイアセイバーズの管轄下にあり、@ 宙間拠点として使用される: In reality, it's under the Gaia Saviors'@jurisdiction, slated for use as a space base.
LDBI\t「その通りですが、セイバーではありません」: There are, but they aren't Saviors.
LDBI\t「ルイーナがヘブンゲートに向かっていると@ いうことは……彼らも宇宙: If the Ruina are heading for Heaven's Gate...@does that mean they too require a base@in outer space, perchance?
LDBI\t「そうだろうな。@ それで、艦長……どうするつもりだ？」: Most likely.@So, Captain... what do you intend to do?
LDBI\t「連邦軍やガイアセイバーズから追われる身とは言え、@ 次元断層の突破: We may be fugitives from the Federation Army@and the Gaia Saviors, but finding a way through@the dimensional rift is our top priority.
LDBI\t「意思疎通が可能なルイーナ……@ メリオルエッセがヘブンゲートへ向か: If the Meliolesse--the Ruina we can@communicate with--headed for Heaven's Gate,@then I believe we should go there too.
LDBI\t「だが、宇宙にはゲストもいる。@ 孤立無援の……辛い戦いになりかねな: But the Guests are in space too.@Cut off and unsupported... it could get ugly.
LDBI\t「かと言って、逃げ回るわけにはいきません。@ 軍籍を剥奪されても、我: Even so, we can't just keep running.@Even stripped of our commissions, if we still@have the strength to fight...
LDBI\t「しかも、このような状況なら……@ 外敵に対し使うべきかと」: And in a situation like this...@we should turn it on the enemy from outside.
LDBI\t「フッ……指揮官にブレがなければ、@ 兵隊は存分に戦える。行こう、ヘ: Heh... If the commander holds steady,@the troops can fight all out. Let's go--to@Heaven's Gate, for the key to taking Earth back.
LDBI\t「いや、ま～ったく……@ 想像以上の魔窟だ～ね、地球は」: Man, seriouslyyy...@Earth's a bigger den of devils than I thoughttt.
LDBI\t「事象の解析は出来ても、@ いったいどんな装置であんなことを@ やっ: We can analyze what happened, but@I have no idea what kind of device@could pull off something like that.
LDBI\t「そ～れ以前に地球が消～えたら、@ 俺達が来た意味がなくな～い？」: Beeefore that, if Earth's gooone,@doesn't that make our trip here pointlesss?
LDBI\t「いや……かえって好都合ではないか」: No... if anything, this works in our favor.
LDBI\t「今の内に月を制圧するのだ。@ 現状では猿共もまともに対抗できまい。: Seize the moon while we can.@The apes can't put up a real fight right now.@Do it at once.
LDBI\t「南極から出～て来たアンノウンは@ ど～すんの？ 宇宙にも現れるか～: And whaaat about the unknowns that came out@of Antarctica? They might shooow up in space too.
LDBI\t「無論、奴らも撃退する。@ そのための拠点として、ヘブンゲートが必要: Naturally, we will repel them as well.@We need Heaven's Gate as our base for that.@Send forces there too.
LDBI\t（地球の消失は予想外の出来事だったが……@ それを成し遂げたアンノウ: (Earth's disappearance was unexpected...@but if we can obtain the unknowns' technology@behind it, the prize would be beyond measure...)
BMD\t「私の前に立った不幸を悔いろ！」: Regret the misfortune of facing me!
BMD\t「こちらスレイ・プレスティ、/ 攻撃を開始する！」: This is Sleigh Presty,/　commencing attack!
BMD\t「来るなら来い！/ 相手が誰であろうと受けて立つ！」: Come if you dare!/　I'll take on anyone!
BMD\t「見せてやろう。実力の違いというものを！」: I'll show you the difference in skill!
BMD\t「私とベガリオンに敵はいない！」: No one can match me and the Vegalion!
BMD\t「ＴＤのエースは誰なのか教えてやる！」: I'll show you who the TD's ace is!
BMD\t「スピードでベガリオンに勝てると思うな！」: Don't think you can outrun the Vegalion!
BMD\t「このスピードについてこられるか！」: Can you keep up with this speed?!
BMD\t「兄様の設計した機体だ。使いこなすさ！」: My brother designed this machine./　I'll master it!
BMD\t「見せてやるぞ。/ テスラ・ドライブの使い方というものを！」: I'll show you/　how a Tesla Drive is really used!
BMD\t「パーソナルトルーパーだろうと/ この私の腕ならば！」: Personal Trooper or not,/　my skills can handle it!
BMD\t「力で押し切るのも、また一興か……！」: Overpowering them has its own charm...!
BMD\t「破壊力は折り紙つきだ！ いくぞ！！」: Its destructive power is proven!/　Here goes!!
BMD\t「お前達が与える絶望などに屈するか！」: As if I'd yield to the despair you bring!
BMD\t「メリオルエッセ！ 私が恐怖を与えてやる！」: Meliores Esse!/　I'll teach you the meaning of fear!
BMD\t「ゼゼーナン！ その野望と共に果てろ！」: Zezenan! Die along with your ambitions!
BMD\t「お前にアルテリオンに乗る資格はない！」: You aren't fit to pilot the Alterion!
BMD\t「アイビス！ 実力の違いを見せてやる！」: Ibis!/　I'll show you the difference in skill!
BMD\t「お前さえ……お前さえいなければ！」: If only... if only you weren't here!
BMD\t「お前にも実力の差を見せ付けてやる！」: I'll show you the gap in our skill too!
BMD\t「あの時の決着を、この場でつけてやる！」: I'll settle things from that day/　right here and now!
BMD\t「お前を倒して、/ 私の実力を証明してやる……！」: I'll defeat you/　and prove my skill...!
BMD\t「たとえ相手があなたでも、/ 退けない事情がある！」: Even if it's you,/　I have reasons I can't back down!
BMD\t「地球は地球人のものだ……！/ それを教えてやる！」: Earth belongs to the people of Earth...!/　I'll teach you that!
BMD\t「ガイアセイバーズなどに後れを取るか！」: As if I'd fall behind the Gaia Saviors!
BMD\t「お前達は、守るものをはき違えた愚か者だ！」: You fools have mistaken what to protect!
BMD\t「まだＤＣの名にすがるか……！」: Still clinging to the DC's name...!
BMD\t「ＤＣの亡霊め！ まだ目が覚めないか！」: DC ghosts! Still haven't woken up?!
BMD\t「プロジェクトＴＤとツェントル・プロジェクト……/ どちらが上か、教え: Project TD versus the Tsentr Project.../　I'll show you which is superior!
BMD\t「貴様らごときが、カリオンの後継機を/ 使いこなせるものか……！」: As if trash like you could master/　the Calion's successor...!
BMD\t「カリオンの真の後継機は、その機体ではない！/ 私のベガリオンだ！」: The Calion's true successor/　isn't that machine!/　It's my Vegalion!
BMD\t「兄様のリオンシリーズを汚す者達め！」: You defile my brother's Lion series!
BMD\t「新型リオンシリーズ……/ その性能を試してやる！」: The new Lion series.../　I'll test its performance!
BMD\t「その機体とシリーズ７７……/ 格の違いを教えてやる！」: That machine versus Series 77.../　I'll show you which is in a higher class!
BMD\t「化け物に後れをとる私ではない！」: I won't fall behind some monster!
BMD\t「待っていろ、イルイ！/ お前を呪縛から救い出す！」: Wait for me, Irui!/　I'll free you from that curse!
BMD\t「ガンエデン！ 人の心を縛る魔神め！」: Gan Eden! Demon that binds human hearts!
BMD\t「兄様と私達の夢を、/ お前にくれてやるわけにはいかん！」: My brother's dream and ours/　aren't yours for the taking!
BMD\t「高速戦闘で、私に勝てると思うなよ！」: Don't think you can beat me/　in a high-speed battle!
BMD\t「ナンバー０１のスピードに/ ついてこられるか！」: Can you keep up with/　the speed of Number 01?!
BMD\t「ルイーナめ！ 好きにはやらせんぞ！」: Ruina! I won't let you do as you please!
BMD\t「怯えるのは、お前達の方だ！」: You're the ones who should be afraid!
BMD\t「地球に手を出した愚かさを知るがいい！」: Learn the folly of laying hands on Earth!
BMD\t「ゲストもインスペクターも/ やることは同じか……！」: Guests or Inspectors,/　you all do the same thing...!
BMD\t「受けたダメージは倍にして返す！！」: I'll pay back that damage double!!
BMD\t「仕掛けたからには、覚悟は出来ているな？」: You started this, so you're ready, right?
BMD\t「あんな広範囲の攻撃、よく避けたな、俺」: Dodged an attack that wide? Nice one, me!
BMD\t「そんなもん、効かねえぜ！」: That stuff won't work on me!
BMD\t「そ～ら、おウチに帰んな！」: There ya go, run on home!
BMD\t「や、やっべえ！ これじゃ攻撃できねえ！」: Uh-oh! I can't attack like this!
BMD\t「くそっ、手札がなくなっちまった！」: Damn, I'm all out of cards!
BMD\t「おいおい！ 正々堂々と勝負しろってんだ！」: Hey, hey! Fight fair and square!
BMD\t「かーっ、逃げ足のはええ奴だな！」: Geez, that guy's quick on his feet!
BMD\t「真打ちは最後に登場するもんだぜ！」: The headliner always shows up last!
BMD\t「このチャンスを見逃すタスク様じゃねえ！」: The great Tasuku ain't one to/　let a chance like this slip by!
BMD\t「レオナちゃん、少しは頼りにしてくれよ！」: Leona, rely on me a little, will ya!
BMD\t「二人のラブラブアタックの前に敵はねえ！」: No enemy can stand up to/　our lovey-dovey attack!
BMD\t「よし！ 俺も行くぜ、レオナ！」: All right! I'm going too, Leona!
BMD\t「リョウト、とどめはもらうぜ！」: Ryoto, the finishing blow is mine!
BMD\t「わりぃがユウキ、手柄はもらったぜ！」: Sorry, Yuuki, but the glory's mine!
BMD\t「リオ、あいつは俺に任せろ！」: Rio, leave that one to me!
BMD\t「クスハ、俺が手伝ってやるぜ！」: Kusuha, I'll lend you a hand!
BMD\t「カーラ、後はドーンと俺に任せな！」: Carla, just leave the rest to me!
BMD\t「キョウスケ中尉、その賭け乗ったぁ！」: Lieutenant Kyosuke, I'm in on that bet!
BMD\t「分の悪い賭け、合点承知！」: A long-odds bet? You got it!
BMD\t「エクセ姐さん、お呼びとあらば即参上ッス！」: Big Sis Exce, you call, I come runnin'!
BMD\t「姐さん、頼りにして下さいよ！」: Sis, you can count on me!
BMD\t「カチーナ中尉、援護するッス！」: Lieutenant Katina, I got your back!
BMD\t「ここで援護しなきゃ、/ 後でブン殴られるんだろうなぁ」: If I don't back her up now,/　she's gonna pound me later...
BMD\t「ラッセル、後は任せな！」: Russel, leave the rest to me!
BMD\t「ラーダ姉さん、手を貸すぜ！」: Big Sis Radha, I'll lend a hand!
BMD\t「べらぼうめぃ！ こいつも持ってけぃ！」: Blast it all! Take this too, ya hear!
BMD\t「アクアさん、頼りにしてくれよ！」: Aqua, you can count on me!
BMD\t「手ェ貸すぜ、アリエイル！」: I'll lend ya a hand, Arieil!
BMD\t「クールビューティ、たまんないねえ！」: Cool beauty... I can't get enough!
BMD\t「リムちゃん、ここはタスク兄さんに任せな！」: Rim, leave this to Big Bro Tasuku!
BMD\t「ジョッシュ、後は任せろ！」: Josh, leave the rest to me!
BMD\t「よっしゃ！ 続くぜ、ミオ！」: All right! I'm right behind ya, Mio!
BMD\t「プレシアちゃん！/ タスク兄さんが助太刀するぜ！」: Precia!/　Big Bro Tasuku's here to help!
BMD\t「王女様のフォローは、このタスクめが！」: Yours truly will back up the princess!
BMD\t「テュッティ姉さんのためなら、頑張るッス！」: For Big Sis Tytti, I'll give it my all!
BMD\t「カチーナ組のよしみだ、手ェ貸すぜ！」: We're Team Katina--I got your back!
BMD\t「ここはこのタスク様にお任せあれ！」: Leave this to the great Tasuku!
LDBI\t「操舵手、艦を安定させろ！@ エイタ、重力異常の原因はわかったか！？: Helmsman, stabilize the ship!@Eita, what's causing the gravity anomaly?!
LDBI\t「制御装置の故障ではなく、@ 緊急作動したものと思われます！」: It's not a malfunction in the control unit--@it seems it was activated in an emergency!
LDBI\t「艦周辺の空間に重力異常が……@ いえ、違います！ 宇宙です、宇宙空: A gravity anomaly around the ship...@No, that's not it! It's space! Outer space!
LDBI\t「馬鹿なことを言うな！ 俺達は地球にいたんだぞ！」: Don't be ridiculous! We were on Earth!
LDBI\t「外の映像をメイン・スクリーンに出します！」: Putting the outside view on the main screen!
LDBI\t「エイタ、現在位置を確認しろ！@ アヅキはヒリュウ改との交信を！」: Eita, confirm our current position!@Azuki, contact the Hiryu Custom!
LDBI\t「おかしいな、サテライト・リンクが使えない。@ アヅキ、そっちはどう: That's weird, the satellite link isn't working.@Azuki, how about on your end?
LDBI\t「<ＭＯＳＳ>にもつながりにくい……@ 地球と月の位置から割り出すし: Even <ＭＯＳＳ> is hard to reach...@Guess I'll have to work it out from the Earth@and Moon's positions.
LDBI\t「いや、待てよ！？ 何なんだ、これ！？@ おかしいぜ！」: Wait, huh?! What the heck is this?!@Something's wrong!
LDBI\t「か、艦長……地球が……地球がありません！@ 消えてしまっています！: C-Captain... Earth is... Earth is gone!@It's disappeared!
LDBI\t「正確に言えば、見えなくなった……かな。@ 月は軌道上にあるし、ラグ: More like it's become invisible... I think.@The Moon's still in orbit, and there's nothing@unusual at the Lagrange points either.
LDBI\t「まだ推測段階に過ぎませんが……@ ルイーナがバリアのような物で@: It's still only a hypothesis, but...@it seems the Ruina have covered the Earth@with something like a barrier.
LDBI\t「次元断層とも言える物です。@ そのせいで、地球との交信は一切不可能: You could call it a dimensional rift.@Because of it, all communication with Earth is@impossible... and travel likely is too.
LDBI\t「それがルイーナの仕業だという根拠は？」: What grounds do you have that it's the Ruina?
LDBI\t「この異常事態の前触れとなったＥＳウェーブが@ 南極方面から広がった: Because the ES wave that preceded all this@spread out from around the South Pole.
LDBI\t「そして、それはハガネとヒリュウ改の間を@ 通過し、一気に外側へ膨張: It passed between the Hagane and Hiryu Custom,@then rapidly expanded outward. That may be@what threw us out into space.
LDBI\t「じゃあ、地球は……@ 地球は今、どうなっているんです？」: Then Earth...@What's happening on Earth right now?
LDBI\t「多分、太陽の光が次元断層で遮断されて……@ 暗闇に閉ざされているだ: The dimensional rift is probably blocking@sunlight... leaving it shrouded in darkness.
LDBI\t「その状態が続けば、大変なことになるわね」: If that continues, it'll be disastrous.
LDBI\t「まず、大気の循環に影響が出て……その次は海流」: First, atmospheric circulation is affected...@then ocean currents.
LDBI\t「そう。海洋が熱を蓄えているとは言え、@ 陸と海の寒暖差によって海岸: Right. Even though the oceans store heat,@the temperature gap between land and sea will@cause violent storms along the coasts.
LDBI\t「大雑把に言えば、地球へ入ってくるエネルギーは@ 可視光線、出て行く: Roughly put, energy comes into Earth as visible@light and leaves as far-infrared radiation...
LDBI\t「その出入りが釣り合っているため、地球の気温は@ おおよそ保たれてい: Because that exchange is balanced, Earth's@temperature stays more or less stable, but if@that balance is upset...
LDBI\t「スノーボールアース……@ すなわち、全地球凍結もあり得るよ」: A Snowball Earth...@In other words, the whole planet could freeze.
LDBI\t「氷河期が来るってことですか……？」: You mean an ice age is coming...?
LDBI\t「すぐにそうなるってわけじゃないが……@ 近々で深刻な問題となるのは: Not right away, but...@the more pressing problem is the power lines.
LDBI\t「太陽の光がなく、気温が下がれば、@ 世界的規模で一斉に照明や暖房が: With no sunlight and falling temperatures,@lighting and heating will be used worldwide@all at once...
LDBI\t「そうなったら、電力の需要過多で@ パワーラインがパンクしかねない」: The surge in demand could end up@overloading the power lines.
LDBI\t「その他に、心理的な悪影響も考えられますね。@ 異常事態が続けば、人: There could also be psychological effects.@As the crisis drags on, people's minds waver...@and that turns into despair.
LDBI\t「じゃあ、ルイーナの思う壺じゃねえか」: Then it's playing right into the Ruina's hands!
LDBI\t「ああ……世界は彼らが必要とする負の波動で@ 満たされることになる」: Yes... The world will be filled with the@negative waves they need.
LDBI\t「私達は、これからどうなるのでしょうか……。@ グライエン大統領閣下: What will become of us now...?@We took the life of President Graien...@and now we've lost our way home as well...
LDBI\t「こちらへ接近中の艦隊は、@ 宇宙軍の軌道哨戒第３戦隊です」: The approaching fleet is the Space Force's@3rd Orbital Patrol Squadron.
LDBI\t「逆らえば、攻撃も辞さずということか……。@ 俺達は許されざる罪を背: Meaning they'll attack if we resist...@After all, we bear an unforgivable crime.
LDBI\t「……先方と接触する。各員、第一種戦闘配置」: ...We'll make contact with them.@All hands, level-one battle stations.
LDBI\t「念のためだ。@ いざという時は急速離脱する。その準備をしておけ」: Just in case. If it comes to it,@we'll make a quick escape. Prepare for that.
LDBI\t「こちらは地球連邦軍宇宙軍所属、@ 軌道哨戒第３戦隊司令、ハンフリー: This is Colonel Humphrey Innes, commander of@the Earth Federation Army Space Force's 3rd@Orbital Patrol Squadron. Respond, Hagane.
LDBI\t「極東方面軍所属、第１独立特殊戦隊、@ ハガネ艦長、テツヤ・オノデラ: Lieutenant Colonel Tetsuya Onodera, captain@of the Hagane, 1st Independent Special Squadron,@Far East Command.
LDBI\t「……ハンフリー・イネス大佐か。@ こりゃ難儀しそうだ」: ...Colonel Humphrey Innes, huh?@This is gonna be rough.
LDBI\t「どんな方なんですか？」: What kind of person is he?
LDBI\t「宇宙軍の中じゃ珍しい、地球上がりの艦長さ。@ オペレーションＳＲＷ: A captain who came up from Earth--rare in the@Space Force. He survived the S08 Field, one of@Operation SRW's fiercest battlegrounds.
LDBI\t「ハンフリー大佐、地球消失について@ 宇宙軍では何か情報を……」: Colonel Humphrey, does the Space Force have@any information on Earth's disappearance...
LDBI\t「貴様が知る必要はない。@ 鋼龍戦隊に所属する全将兵は、本日１２００: You have no need to know. As of 1200 today,@all personnel of the Steel Dragons have been@stripped of their military status.
LDBI\t「よって、貴様らがその艦を運用する行為は、@ 私的占有と見なされ、連: Therefore, your operation of that ship is@deemed illegal seizure, and constitutes treason@against the Federation government and military.
LDBI\t「速やかに武装解除し、投降せよ。@ なお、貴様らには大統領殺害の嫌疑: Disarm immediately and surrender.@Furthermore, you are also suspected@of assassinating the President.
BMD\t「ヒューゴ、後は任せて！」: Hugo, leave the rest to me!
BMD\t「リム、後はあたしが！」: Rim, I'll take it from here!
BMD\t「先生、後は任せてください！」: Doc, leave the rest to me!
BMD\t「テュッティさん、後は任せて！」: Tytti, leave the rest to me!
BMD\t「ゼンガー少佐、続かせてもらうよ！」: Major Sänger, I'm following your lead!
BMD\t「妖精と流星のコンビネーションで！」: A fairy and shooting star combination!
BMD\t「フィリオの趣味って、/ よくわからないけど……」: I don't really get Filio's taste,/　but...
BMD\t「あたしだってカバーぐらいは！」: I can at least provide some cover!
BMD\t「大丈夫！ 歯を食いしばって耐えてみせる！」: I'm fine! I'll grit my teeth and take it!
BMD\t「牽制ぐらいなら、あたしだって！」: I can at least keep them pinned down!
BMD\t「スレイはやらせないよ！」: I won't let them get Sleigh!

BMD\t「当てただけかよ、ロフ！」: Is that all, Rof? Just a hit?
BMD\t「遊びのつもりか、ゼブ！」: You think this is a game, Zeb!?
BMD\t「そんなもんかよ、孫光龍！」: Is that all you've got, Son Koryu!?
BMD\t「それが“破滅の王”の力かよ！」: That's the power of the "King of Ruin"!?
BMD\t「ガイアセイバーズ……！/ お前らには負けられねえ！」: Gaia Savers...!/　I'm not losing to you guys!
BMD\t「ガイアセイバーズって言っても、/ 大したことねえな！」: Gaia Savers, huh?/　You're nothing special!
BMD\t「それがメリオルエッセの力かよ！」: That's the power of the Meliores Esse!?
BMD\t「見た目と比べて、非力じゃねえか！」: You're a lot weaker than you look!
BMD\t「くっ！ 凍らされてたまるかよ！」: Ngh! Like I'm gonna let you freeze me!
BMD\t「どうした、夏喃！ それだけか！」: What's wrong, Kanan? That all you got!?
BMD\t「仙人の力ってのは、その程度かよ！」: So that's all a sage's power amounts to!?
BMD\t「全力で来やがれ、ゼゼーナン！」: Come at me with everything, Zezenan!
BMD\t「お前の忍術は通用しねえぜ！」: Your ninjutsu won't work on me!
BMD\t「あいつはアップで見たかねえな……」: I don't wanna see that thing up close...
BMD\t「くっ！ しつこいんだよ、エルデ・ミッテ！」: Ngh! You don't give up, Erde Mitte!
BMD\t「四神の超機人はそんなもんかよ！」: That's all a Four Gods Choukijin's got!?
BMD\t「化け物に喰われるわけにはいかねえ！」: I'm not gonna get eaten by some monster!
BMD\t「くそっ、ルイーナに足止めされるわけには！」: Damn it, I can't let the Ruina stop me!
BMD\t「ゲストの雑魚に手間取るわけには！」: Can't waste time on Guest small fry!
BMD\t「ゲストめ、邪魔すんじゃねえ！」: Damn Guests, get outta my way!
BMD\t「インスペクターの方が強かったぜ！」: The Inspectors were tougher than you!
BMD\t「ゲストにやられてたまるか！」: Like I'd lose to the Guests!
BMD\t「ユーゼス！/ てめえの思い通りにいくと思うな！」: Euzeth!/　Don't think things'll go your way!
BMD\t「ユーゼス……！ 何なんだ、あいつの攻撃は！」: Euzeth...! What the hell are those attacks!
BMD\t「ユーゼス！/ てめえがどんな攻撃をしてこようと！」: Euzeth!/　No matter what you throw at me!
BMD\t「おれだって、これぐらいは！」: Even I can handle this much!
BMD\t「パターンさえ読まれなけりゃ！」: As long as they don't read my pattern!
BMD\t「見えるっ！/ ……って言ってみたかったんだよな」: I can see it!/　...Always wanted to say that.
BMD\t「下手な鉄砲、数撃ちゃよけるっ！/ ……って、あれ？」: Dodge enough and something's gotta miss!/　...Wait, what?
BMD\t「そっちの的なんかにゃならないぜ！」: I'm not gonna be your target!
BMD\t「当たるも八卦、当たらぬはヒュッケ！」: Hit or miss? Huckebein says miss!
BMD\t「パイロットがダメでも、/ 機体の性能がよけりゃ……って、ありゃ？」: Even if the pilot's no good,/　a good machine can still... Huh?
BMD\t「落ちこぼれのおれに当てられねえのかよ！」: You can't even hit a washout like me!?
BMD\t「アルジャン・クラスが何だってんだよ！」: Who cares about the Argent Class!
BMD\t「昔のおれじゃねえんだ！」: I'm not the guy I used to be!
LDBI\t「エクアドル東岸部における対ルイーナ戦の@ 結果ですが……敵の撃退に: As for the battle with the Ruina off eastern@Ecuador... We repelled the enemy, but three@Federation bases suffered catastrophic damage.
LDBI\t「なお、今回の戦いでメリオルエッセは@ 確認されておりません」: Also, no Meliores Esse were sighted@in this battle.
LDBI\t「エア・クリスマスとアルファ・セイバー、@ ベータ・セイバーによって: Air Christmas, Alpha Saber, and Beta Saber@shot down roughly 60 Ruina units... Our losses@were minimal.
LDBI\t「司令、意見を具申してもよろしいでしょうか」: Commander, may I offer my opinion?
LDBI\t「南米は旧西暦時代の国家の枠組みを色濃く残しており、@ 軍組織におい: South America retains much of the national@framework of the Old Western Era, and its@military is no exception...
LDBI\t「地球連邦軍の名を冠していても、@ 旧国軍同士の連携が上手く成されて: They may bear the Earth Federation Army name,@but the former national armies barely cooperate,@and regional command doesn't fully control them.
LDBI\t「やむを得まい。@ 中近東やアフリカほどではないが、欧米主体の@ 連: It can't be helped.@Less so than in the Middle East or Africa, but@many surely resent a Western-led Federation.
LDBI\t「そこで、ＰＧＳの早期承認を……@ 特次副大統領権限で、対ルイーナ戦: So, early approval of the PGS... If you would@give Gaia Savers command in the Ruina conflict@under your Special Vice President authority...
LDBI\t「より効率的かつ効果的な作戦の展開が@ 可能になると考えます」: I believe we could carry out operations@far more efficiently and effectively.
LDBI\t「しかし、我らの敵はルイーナだけではないのです。@ それに……戦後、: But the Ruina aren't our only enemy. And to keep@anti-Federation forces in check after the war,@we must begin unifying South American forces...
LDBI\t「それでは、適度なガス抜きが不可能となる。@ 仕事を失う者も多かろう: That would leave no way to let off steam.@And many people would lose their jobs.
LDBI\t「ですが、ガイアセイバーズの存在意義は……」: But the whole purpose of Gaia Savers is...
LDBI\t「いつの時代にも必要悪の存在は不可欠だ。@ “敵”がいなくなると困る: Every era needs its necessary evils.@Many would be troubled if the "enemy" vanished.
LDBI\t「司令、他にもお耳に入れたいことが」: Commander, there's something else@you should hear.
LDBI\t「ルイーナの襲撃を受けた基地の一つに@ 鋼龍戦隊が現れ……その後、デ: The Steel Dragons appeared at one of the bases@the Ruina attacked... Then they reportedly@engaged the Demons.
LDBI\t「ここしばらく、デモンは一貫して@ 鋼龍戦隊を狙っているようだな。@: Lately, the Demons seem to be targeting@the Steel Dragons consistently. Likely because@they have <超機人> on their side.
LDBI\t「そうだと思われますが……@ その場に出現したのは、デモンだけではあ: That seems to be the case... But the Demons@weren't the only ones to appear there.
LDBI\t「基地の生き残りが、@ 豹型と魚型のアンノウンを目撃したと@ 証言し: Survivors from the base reportedly saw@leopard-shaped and fish-shaped unknowns.
LDBI\t「映像記録は残っておりませんが、@ 白い彫刻のような物体だったと……: There's no video record, but they were described@as objects resembling white sculptures...
LDBI\t「豹型と魚型……もしや、神僕か？」: A leopard and a fish... Could they be Shinboku?
LDBI\t「私もその可能性が高いと思い……ご報告した次第です」: I thought that likely as well... hence my report.
LDBI\t「鳥型が現れれば、確定と言っても良かろうが……@ ２体のアンノウンの: If a bird-type appears, we can call it certain...@And the movements of the two unknowns?
LDBI\t「デモンと敵対するような素振りを見せ、@ すぐに姿を消したそうです」: They appeared hostile toward the Demons,@then vanished at once.
LDBI\t「ええ……@ オーダー・ファイルによれば、超機人や妖機人の主は@ バ: Yes...@According to the Order File, the master of the@Choukijin and Yokijin is said to be Baral's god.
LDBI\t「同種の存在ならば、神僕とデモンは争わぬはずです」: If they're the same kind of being, the Shinboku@and the Demons shouldn't fight each other.
LDBI\t「鋼龍戦隊を守った……とも受け取れるな」: It could also mean they protected@the Steel Dragons.
LDBI\t「伝承によれば、神僕を操ることが出来る存在は@ 二つしかない。つまり: Legend says only two beings can command the@Shinboku. Which means one of the pair may be@with the Steel Dragons.
LDBI\t「既にマシアフが彼らに接触していると？」: You think Mashiaf has already contacted them?
LDBI\t「そうだ。鋼龍戦隊には優秀な念動力者が揃っている。@ そして、反逆者: Yes. The Steel Dragons have skilled telekinetics.@And though hunted as traitors, they fight outside@threats like the Ruina and the Guests.
LDBI\t「私利私欲でなく、自らの信念や使命に従ってな。@ 我々が鋼龍戦隊を選: Not for personal gain, but by their own beliefs@and sense of duty. Just as we chose the Steel@Dragons, Mashiaf too may have chosen them...
LDBI\t「そうであれば、これまでの策が功を奏しましたね」: If so, our schemes thus far have paid off.
LDBI\t「ああ。並の者ならば、反逆者の汚名を着せられ、@ 身内から追撃を受け: Yes. Most would break once branded as traitors@and hunted by their own comrades.
LDBI\t「試練を与えれば与えるほど、彼らは強靱になる。@ それは、Ｌ５戦役で: The more trials we give them, the stronger they@become. The L5 Campaign proved that.@All that remains is how to perfect them.
LDBI\t「各セイバーに鋼龍戦隊を追撃させる。@ それが、現状の最優先事項だ」: Have each Saber pursue the Steel Dragons.@That is our top priority for now.
LDBI\t「ナンバー２２や念動力者達はともかく……@ マシアフが鋼龍戦隊にいる: Number 22 and the telekinetics aside...@if Mashiaf is with the Steel Dragons, prodding@them may draw the Shinboku out.
LDBI\t「それで３体目を確認できれば、確定だ。@ 我らが欲するもう一つの答え: If we can confirm a third, it's certain.@The other answer we seek may then@reveal itself as well.
LDBI\t「確定するまでは、保険として必要だ。@ ＮＶユニットの完成までに@: We need them as insurance until it's certain.@I'd like them in hand before the NV Unit@is complete...
LDBI\t「パイロット込みでなければ、意味がない。@ 慎重に事を運べ。場合によ: They're useless without their pilots.@Proceed cautiously. If need be, you may even@make use of the Steel Dragons.
LDBI\t（彼らがこのタイミングで現れたのであれば、@ これぞまさに……神の導: (If they've appeared at this moment, then this@is truly... nothing less than divine guidance...)
LDBI\t「まもなく、８号機と９号機がロールアウトする。@ 本来はヒューゴ少尉: Units 8 and 9 will roll out soon.@I'd meant for Lieutenants Hugo and Aqua@to be their pilots, but...
LDBI\t「残念ながら、彼らの協力が得られそうにないのでね。@ 今、代わりのパ: Sadly, it seems they won't cooperate with us.@So we're selecting replacement pilots now.
LDBI\t「量産型ジンライのように、@ ＡＩ０を搭載すれば済む話ですのに……」: You could simply install AI0, as with the@Mass-Production Jinrai...
LDBI\t「以前にも言った通り、ＡＩ１やＡＩ０で@ ＤＦＣを行うことは不可能だ: As I said before, DFC is impossible@with AI1 or AI0.
LDBI\t「いえ……いずれ、可能にしてみせますわ」: No... In time, I will make it possible.
LDBI\t「そうだとしても、そこへ至るには@ 人間が得たＤＦＣデータが必要だろ: Even so, to get there you'll need DFC@data gathered from human pilots, won't you?
LDBI\t「今の所、メディウスと同じ仕様にしてある。@ つまり、人間のパイロッ: For now, it has the same specs as the Medius.@That is, a human pilot and AI1 together@control the unit.
LDBI\t「もちろん、人間だけでも運用が可能だがね」: Of course, a human can also operate it alone.
LDBI\t「では、次の任務で結果を出してみせます。@ ＡＩ１が、人間とＤＦＣの: Then I'll prove it on the next mission.@That AI1 is superior to a human paired@with DFC...
LDBI\t「ＴＥエンジンとラズムナニウム、その両方を@ 制御するに相応しい存在: I'll show that it's worthy of controlling both@the TE Engine and the Rasmnanium.@Judge for yourself then.
LDBI\t「いいだろう。@ サーベラスとガルムレイド、そのいずれかを@ 倒せる: Very well.@If you can defeat either the Cerberus@or the Garmraid, that is.
LDBI\t「……ヒューゴとアクアは、もう不要だということか？」: ...So Hugo and Aqua aren't needed anymore?
LDBI\t「……我々はバラルのバリアが展開された後、@ 統合参謀本部の指示でグ: ...After Balar's barrier went up, Joint Staff HQ@sent us to Grand Christmas, where we fought the@Gaia Savers...
LDBI\t「アルテウル・シュタインベック以下、@ 各セイバーを倒しました」: We defeated each of the Savers,@including Arteur Steinbeck.
LDBI\t「そうですか……彼らは外敵の討伐より、@ こちら側の戦力接収を優先し: I see... So they prioritized seizing our forces@over defeating the invaders.
LDBI\t「ええ……それを受け入れるわけにはいかず、@ アルテウルの拘束を試み: Yes... We couldn't accept that, so we tried to@detain Arteur and expose his scheme, but...
LDBI\t「結局の所、彼の真意は不明なまま……」: In the end, his true aims remain unknown...
LDBI\t「オペレーション・レコンキスタ連合宇宙艦隊と合流し、@ ゲストとの戦: We joined up with the Operation Reconquista@Combined Space Fleet and took on the Guests.
LDBI\t「そして、緒戦のヘブンゲート奪還作戦中に@ メキボスが現れたのです」: Then, during the opening battle to retake@Heaven's Gate, Mekibos appeared.
LDBI\t「メキボス……！？ あの<インスペクター>の……？@ 彼が生きていた: Mekibos!? The one with the <インスペクター>...?@He's alive?
LDBI\t「ええ。@ 彼はゾヴォーク……その枢密院の特使として@ 地球圏へ派遣: Yes.@He was sent to the Earth Sphere as an envoy from@Zovorg... from its Privy Council.
LDBI\t「ゾヴォーク……それが彼らの本国の正式名称ですか」: Zovorg... So that's the formal name of their@homeland?
LDBI\t「そうです。ゾヴォークにはヴォルガ、ゾガルという@ 二つの大きな派閥: Yes. Zovorg has two major factions, Volga and@Zogal... The former are the Inspectors, and the@latter are the Guests.
LDBI\t「そして、メキボスはゼゼーナンに枢密院からの@ 本国召還命令を伝え、: Mekibos relayed the Privy Council's recall order@to Zezenan, hoping to make him pull back and end@the Guests' war with Earth, but...
LDBI\t「ゼゼーナンはそれを拒否。@ やむなく、我々はムーンクレイドルにて@: Zezenan refused.@We had no choice but to face him in a decisive@battle at Moon Cradle... and we won.
LDBI\t「なお、メキボスは我が隊に同行することを望み、@ 私はそれを許可しま: Mekibos also asked to accompany our unit, and I@allowed it, on the basis that we would hold him@in custody until this war is over.
LDBI\t「あの男が我々に協力するとは……」: To think that man would cooperate with us...
LDBI\t「こちらの実情を調査するためだそうです。@ その代わり、戦闘にも参加: He says it's to investigate our situation here.@In exchange, he'll fight alongside us.
LDBI\t「彼の行動を見て、そうだと判断しています」: Judging by his actions, I believe he can.
LDBI\t「また、シュウ・シラカワ博士も@ 私達への協力を表明し、同行していま: Dr. Shu Shirakawa has also pledged to help us,@and is accompanying our unit.
LDBI\t「ええ……シラカワ博士の提案のおかげで、@ 私達は地球へ帰還すること: Yes... Thanks to Dr. Shirakawa's proposal, we@were able to return to Earth.
LDBI\t「いったい、どうやって……？」: How on earth did you manage that...?
LDBI\t「簡単に説明すれば、バラルのバリアと@ ルイーナの結界の境界面を滑り: Put simply, we slid down the interface between@Balar's barrier and the Ruina's field, with the@Hyperlion and Granzon guiding us in.
LDBI\t「では、バラルのバリアを突破したわけではないと……」: Then you didn't actually break through Balar's@barrier...
LDBI\t「ええ。@ 逆に言えば、ルイーナの結界がなければ、@ 私達は地球へ戻: Right.@Put another way, without the Ruina's field, we@couldn't have returned to Earth.
LDBI\t「そして、南極へ降下した後、@ 私達はルイーナに包囲されたのですが…: After we descended to the South Pole, we were@surrounded by the Ruina, but...
LDBI\t「クストースがその危機から私達を救ってくれました」: The Custos rescued us from that crisis.
LDBI\t「！ 何故、彼らがそんなことを……！？」: What? Why would they do something like that!?
LDBI\t「バラルはルイーナと戦うつもりのようですから……@ 敵を同じくする私: Balar seems intent on fighting the Ruina...@so we suspect they lent us a hand since we share@the same enemy.
LDBI\t「我々にルイーナを倒させるために……@ いや、総人尸解計画発動までの: So that we'd defeat the Ruina for them...@Or rather, to buy time until they can launch@the Total Human Shikai Plan...?
LDBI\t「……統合参謀本部は、バラルよりルイーナの@ 討伐を優先させ、オペレ: ...Joint Staff HQ chose to prioritize the Ruina@over Balar and launched Operation Icebreaker...@That's why we came to the South Pole, but...
LDBI\t「わかっています。@ ここでルイーナとの決着を付けましょう」: I understand.@Let's settle things with the Ruina here.
LDBI\t「……というわけで、よろしくお願いするわね、@ ハガネの皆さん」: ...So that's how it is. I'm counting on you all,@Hagane crew.
LDBI\t（す、凄い……セクシー度１２０％の服だわ……。@ 私、あんなの着られ: (W-Wow... That outfit is 120% sexy...@I could never wear something like that...)
LDBI\t「皆様、お食事中に申し訳ございません。@ 不束者ですが、私もよろしく: Pardon me for interrupting your meal, everyone.@Unworthy though I may be, I humbly request your@kind regards, I do does.
LDBI\t「まあ、ともかく……飯だ、飯。@ 次は長丁場になるだろうから、今の内: Well, anyway... Food, food. The next fight's@gonna be a long haul, so we'd better eat while@we can.
LDBI\t「この艦のお食事は豪華ですのね」: The meals on this ship are quite lavish.
LDBI\t「そいつが鋼龍戦隊の強さの源なのさ。@ 特に金曜日のスティールドラゴ: It's the source of the Steel Dragons' strength.@The Friday Steel Dragon Curry is the best--@there's even talk of putting it on the market...

BMD\t「ほほう……/ いや、これはこれは。見くびっておりましたぞ。/ 確か…: Oho.../　My, my. I underestimated you./　Mio, was it?
BMD\t「ふむ……/ 地上のメカというのも、なかなか侮れぬものですな」: Hmm.../　Surface mechs are not to be taken lightly.
BMD\t「ほう……地上人もやるものですな」: Oh... So surface dwellers can fight, too.
BMD\t「あなたの力は、その程度でしたか。/ どうやら私の見込み違いでしたな」: Is that the extent of your power?/　It seems I misjudged you.
BMD\t「それで精一杯ですかな？/ ククク……非力、あまりにも非力」: Is that truly your best?/　Heh heh heh... Weak. Utterly weak.
BMD\t「憐れな……所詮、あなたはその程度なのですよ」: How pitiful.../　In the end, that is all you amount to.
BMD\t「おやおや……その程度ですか？/ 失望いたしましたぞ」: Oh my... Is that all?/　How very disappointing.
BMD\t「いつまで無駄なあがきを/ 続けられるおつもりですかな？」: How long do you intend to keep up/　this futile struggle?
BMD\t「その程度で、/ このナグツァートに歯向かおうとは……/ 身の程知らず: With power like that,/　you dare defy this Nagzadd.../　You truly don't know your place.
BMD\t「無駄だというのが、おわかりになりませんかな？/ ランドール殿」: Do you not see that it is futile,/　Randall?
BMD\t「ヤンロン殿、何度やっても無駄なこと」: Yang Long, it is futile/　no matter how often you try.
BMD\t「くくく……わかりましたかな、/ 我がナグツァートの力が」: Heh heh heh... Do you understand now/　the power of my Nagzadd?
BMD\t「これがアストラルシフトの力なのですよ」: This is the power of the Astral Shift.
BMD\t「ククク……まだまだ修行が足りませんな」: Heh heh heh... You need more training.
BMD\t「ふ、やはりそう来ましたか。予測通りですな」: Heh, so you came at me that way./　Exactly as I predicted.
BMD\t「ふっふっふ……/ 当てることさえ出来ませんか、テュッティ殿」: Heh heh heh.../　You can't even land a hit, Tytti?
BMD\t「面白い動きですが……無駄が多過ぎますな」: Interesting movements.../　But far too much wasted motion.
BMD\t「む……射程外からの攻撃とは……」: Hm... An attack from beyond my range...
BMD\t「さて、この攻撃に耐えられますかな？」: Now, can you withstand this attack?
BMD\t「まだ終わりではありませんぞ。ククク……」: It is not over yet. Heh heh heh...
BMD\t「では、後は私が引き受けましょう」: Then I shall take it from here.
BMD\t「ククク……まだ続きがありますでな」: Heh heh heh... There is more to come.
BMD\t「さあ、/ もうしばらくお付き合いいただきますぞ」: Now then,/　indulge me a little longer.
BMD\t「我が祈念に応じ、深き冥界より出でよ」: Answer my prayer,/　and come forth from the deep netherworld.
BMD\t「我が矛となりて敵を穿て！」: Become my spear and pierce the foe!
BMD\t「具現化せよ、我が刃……/ 射干玉の常闇を纏いて……」: Take form, my blade.../　Clad in pitch-black eternal night...
BMD\t「天地晦冥して、光届かず……/ 化現せよ、霊異の刃……」: All is dark; no light can reach.../　Manifest, O blade of the arcane...
BMD\t「死ぬのです……あなたも」: You will die... you as well.
BMD\t「ヴォルクルス様の命によりて、/ ルオゾール・ゾラン・ロイエルの/ 名: By the command of Lord Volkruss,/　in the name of Ruozol Zolan Royel,/　I decree...
BMD\t「彼岸の命脈を絶ち、此岸の現世を侵蝕せよ……」: Sever the life-vein of the far shore,/　and corrode the world of this shore...
BMD\t「真の恐怖を味わっていただきましょう」: Allow me to show you true terror.
BMD\t「あなたを冥府の底へ/ 誘って差し上げましょう」: Allow me to escort you/　to the depths of the underworld.
BMD\t「怯えなさい。恐怖に打ち震えなさい。/ それこそがヴォルクルス様の求め: Cower. Tremble in terror./　That is what Lord Volkruss desires!
BMD\t「生きる者全て、死に抗うことは出来ませぬ」: No living thing can resist death.
BMD\t「……ラ・ギアスの機動兵器を/ 侮るわけにはいかないわね」: ...I can't underestimate/　La Gias's mobile weapons.
BMD\t「予測しにくい動きをする……！」: Its movements are hard to predict...!
BMD\t「見た目は速そうでも、それではね」: It may look fast, but that won't do.
BMD\t「エルデ・ミッテ……完全に暴走しているわね」: Erde Mitte... She's completely/　out of control.
BMD\t「今度は別の相手を狙いなさい」: Next time, aim for someone else.
BMD\t「次に期待させてもらうわ」: I'll look forward to next time.
BMD\t「ある意味、呼吸が合う……これは……」: In a way, we're in sync... This is...
BMD\t「進歩していないようね、/ マシンナリー・チルドレンは」: The Machinery Children/　haven't improved, it seems.
BMD\t「インスペクターが得たデータを/ 活用していないようね」: It seems you're not using/　the data the Inspectors gathered.
BMD\t「過去の教訓を活かせていないようね」: You've learned nothing from the past.
BMD\t「インスペクターと大差ないわね」: You're no different from the Inspectors.
BMD\t「それで戦くほど、柔ではないわ」: I'm not soft enough to flinch at that.
BMD\t「メリオルエッセと言えど、この程度なら！」: Meliores Esse or not,/　if this is all you've got...!
BMD\t「ガイアセイバーズ……/ お前達に後れは取らない」: Gaia Savers.../　I won't fall behind you.
BMD\t「油断は出来ないわね、あの機体相手で」: I can't drop my guard against that unit.
BMD\t「見た目はパーソナルトルーパー、……しかし」: It looks like a Personal Trooper... but...
BMD\t「やはり、運動性には難があるようね」: As expected, its mobility is lacking.
BMD\t「お前という神の存在を信じる気はないわ」: I won't believe in you as some god.
BMD\t「ユーゼス、お前の望みは成就しない……/ 私達がいる限り」: Euzeth, your wish won't come true.../　not while we're here.
BMD\t「ＰＴ戦の応用で戦えるわね」: I can fight this like a PT battle.
BMD\t「この世界で果てる気はないわ」: I don't intend to die in this world.
BMD\t「ルイーナに捕まるわけにはいかない」: I can't let the Ruina capture me.
BMD\t「直撃など受けないわ」: I won't take a direct hit.
BMD\t「そんなに怖がらなくてもいいわ……」: You don't have to be so scared...
BMD\t「ラーダ、後は任せて」: Radha, leave the rest to me.
BMD\t「リュウセイ、後は私に任せなさい」: Ryusei, leave the rest to me.
BMD\t「リュウセイ、攻撃はもっと正確に行いなさい」: Ryusei, make your attacks more precise.
BMD\t「マイ、後は私に任せて」: Mai, leave the rest to me.
BMD\t「援護するわ、ギリアム少佐」: I'll back you up, Major Gilliam.
BMD\t「援護するわ、キョウスケ中尉」: I'll back you up, Lieutenant Kyosuke.
BMD\t「エクセレン、後は任せなさい」: Excellen, leave the rest to me.
BMD\t「リオ、後は引き受けるわ」: Rio, I'll take it from here.
BMD\t「時間をかけるつもりはない……！」: I don't intend to drag this out...!

BMD\t「もう一度地の底へ墜ちろ……！」: Fall back into the depths once more...!

BMD\t「大尉、俺の邪魔をするのであれば！」: Captain, if you stand in my way!
BMD\t「オレグ大尉……もはやＤＣに義はない！」: Captain Oleg... the DC has lost its cause!
BMD\t「その大義は理解できる。/ だが、今の俺には、/ その手段が過ちだとわ: I understand your cause./　But now I can see/　that your methods are wrong...!
BMD\t「あえてその道を選んだのか……/ ビアン総帥と同じように……！」: You chose that path knowingly.../　just like Commander Bian...!
BMD\t「メリオルエッセ……油断は出来んな」: Meliores Esse... I can't let my guard down.
BMD\t「俺達は、破滅の運命など受け入れん！」: We won't accept a fate of ruin!

BMD\t「正念場だ、ゼゼーナン！ 覚悟を決めろ！」: This is it, Zezenan! Prepare yourself!
BMD\t「ふん……要は選民思想というわけか」: Hmph... So it's elitism, in other words.
BMD\t「孫光龍、お前の念と言葉には惑わされん！」: Son Koryu, your will and words won't sway me!
BMD\t「応龍皇……非常識極まりないな」: OryuOh... It defies all common sense.
BMD\t「ガイアセイバーズ……/ 俺達まで組み伏せられると思うな」: Gaia Savers.../　Don't think you can subdue us too.
BMD\t「お前達のやり方を認めるわけにはいかん」: I can't accept the way you do things.
BMD\t「ガイアセイバーズ……/ 体制側にいるだけに、始末が悪いな」: Gaia Savers.../　Being on the establishment's side/　makes them all the more troublesome.

BMD\t「あの斧は要注意だな」: I'd better watch out for that axe.
BMD\t「奴も凶鳥か……！」: That one's an ill-omened bird too...!
BMD\t「メディウス・ロクス……/ 油断するわけにはいかん」: Medius Locus.../　I can't afford to let my guard down.

BMD\t「ダブルＧの量産型と言えど！」: Even if it's a mass-produced Double G!

BMD\t「もはや非常識などと言ってられんな」: I can't keep calling things absurd now.

BMD\t「エルデ、お前の妄想に付き合う気はない！」: Erde, I won't indulge your delusions!
BMD\t「ゲスト……お前達の好きにはやらせん」: Guests... I won't let you do as you please.

BMD\t「あんたの覚悟はわかった。だが！」: I understand your resolve. But still!
BMD\t「こりゃもうロボット物じゃないな」: This isn't a robot show anymore.
BMD\t「おっとっと、/ 退治される側になるつもりはないのさ」: Whoa, whoa!/　I'm not the one getting exterminated.
BMD\t「それじゃ、あと百回狙っても結果は同じだぜ」: At that rate, a hundred more tries/　won't change a thing.
BMD\t「惜しいな。だが、外れは外れだ」: Close. But a miss is a miss.
BMD\t「そういうお誘いは/ 受けないことにしているのさ」: I make a point of not/　accepting invitations like that.
BMD\t「ま、ヒュッケバイン相手にゃ頑張った方だな」: Well, not bad against a Hückebein.
BMD\t「メリオルエッセなんて言ってもな！」: So what if you're a Meliores Esse!
BMD\t「俺を恐怖させるには、足りないねぇ」: Not nearly enough to scare me.
BMD\t「あんたら、こっちのデータを持ってんだろ？」: You guys have data on us, don't you?
BMD\t「ふん、喋りはあれでも手は早いんだな」: Hmph. Odd talker, but quick on the draw.
BMD\t「そういうきつい所がまた……」: That sharp edge of yours is just...
BMD\t「ガイアセイバーズ……/ お前達の好きにはやらせないぜ」: Gaia Saviors.../　I won't let you do as you please.
BMD\t「俺を本気で潰す気なら、他の手を考えな！」: If you're serious about crushing me,/　try something else!
BMD\t「ガイアセイバーズ……/ お前達の手には乗らないぜ」: Gaia Saviors.../　I'm not falling for your tricks.
BMD\t「ま、ＡＩじゃ、そんなもんだろ」: Well, what do you expect from an AI?
BMD\t「ふん、そんなご大層な物を振り回してもな」: Hmph. Swinging that fancy thing around/　won't help you.
BMD\t「インスペクターはもうちょっと強かったぜ？」: The Inspectors put up more of a fight.
BMD\t「何度襲ってこようと、結果は同じだぜ？」: Attack me as often as you like--/　the result won't change.
BMD\t「学習能力がないなぁ、ホントに」: You really never learn, do you?
BMD\t「そういう溶け合い方は御免被る！」: I'll pass on that kind of melding!
BMD\t「ユーゼス、/ あんたは神になんてなれないのさ！」: Euzeth,/　you'll never become a god!
BMD\t「おっと！ こっちにゃ、バリアがあるんでね」: Whoa! I've got a barrier, you know.
BMD\t「気の毒だが、無駄だったってこと！」: Sorry, but that was a waste!
BMD\t「これぐらいの備えはしているさ！」: I came prepared for this much!
BMD\t「追いかけられるのは女の子だけで充分だぜ」: Only girls get to chase me, thanks.
BMD\t「女性以外はノーサンキュー、ってね！」: Ladies only--no thanks to the rest!
BMD\t「弾切れだと？ チッ、最悪だな、こりゃ」: Out of ammo? Tch, this is the worst.
BMD\t「ちょいと気前が良すぎたか」: Guess I was a bit too generous.
BMD\t「サービスし過ぎんのも問題だな」: Giving too much away has its downside.
BMD\t「やれやれ、逃げ足の速い奴だな」: Sheesh, quick to run, aren't they?
BMD\t「手の早さには自信があるんでね！」: I pride myself on being quick!
BMD\t「こういう時は、抜け目なく！」: At times like this, stay sharp!
BMD\t「ほらよ、リュウセイ……手伝ってやるぜ！」: Here, Ryusei... I'll lend you a hand!
BMD\t「カイ少佐、ここは俺が！」: Major Kai, leave this to me!

LDBI\t「ええ。@ 後方部隊と連絡を取り、ここの警戒を依頼します」: Yes.@I'll contact the rear units and ask them@to keep watch here.
LDBI\t「……結局、俺達がどうしてクロスゲートに@ 見覚えがあるか、わからず: ...So in the end, we never found out why the@Crossgate looks familiar to us.
LDBI\t「ああ、多くの謎が残っているな。@ 何故、このタイミングでクロスゲー: Yeah, plenty of mysteries remain.@Like why the Crossgate activated@at this particular moment...
LDBI\t「そりゃ、“破滅の王”が出て来たからじゃねえの？」: Isn't it 'cause the "King of Destruction"@showed up?
LDBI\t「ペルフェクティオが言っていた、別因子……@ アルテウル・シュタイン: The other factor Perfectio mentioned...@You mean the Sympathia improvements that came@from Arteur Steinbeck?
LDBI\t「確か、<Ｔ‐ＬＩＮＫシステム>を@ 応用した物だとか……」: They were supposedly an application@of the <Ｔ‐ＬＩＮＫシステム>...
LDBI\t「アヤ大尉、その件について何か御存知ですか？」: Captain Aya, do you know anything about that?
LDBI\t「……もし、アルテウルがイリーガルな手段で@ Ｔ‐ＬＩＮＫシステムの: ...Even if Arteur obtained data on the@T-Link System through illegal means...
LDBI\t「何故、シュンパティアを改良するだけでなく、@ クロスゲート始動のき: Why could he not only improve the Sympathia,@but also build in an element that could trigger@the Crossgate's activation... That bothers me.
LDBI\t「ガイアセイバーズは色んな新兵器の開発と@ テストをやってたんだ。そ: The Gaia Savers were developing and testing@all kinds of new weapons. Maybe something@like that just happened to work out by chance?
BMD\t「効きはしませんよ、カークス将軍」: That won't work on me, General Kirkus.
BMD\t「ふっ……やはり、その程度か」: Heh... So that's all you've got after all.
BMD\t「どうした、シュウ。/ 貴様の力、その程度ではあるまい」: What's wrong, Shu?/　Surely you're stronger than that.
BMD\t「心根が軟弱だから、/ その程度なのだ、サフィーネ！」: Your heart is soft, Saphine!/　That's why you're this weak!
BMD\t「その程度か……見込み違いだったな」: Is that all...? I misjudged you.
BMD\t「ふん……存外大したことはないな」: Hmph... Not as impressive as I thought.
BMD\t「貴様の相手などしていられるか！」: I don't have time to deal with you!
BMD\t「相変わらず恐ろしい力だ。/ だが、かわしてしまえば！」: Fearsome power, as always./　But if I can just dodge it!
BMD\t「ふっ……ふざけているからそうなる」: Heh... That's what you get for fooling around.
BMD\t「いい腕だが、当たらなければな」: Good skill, but it's no use if you miss.
BMD\t「いくらパワーがあろうと、当たらなければ！」: No matter how much power you have,/　it's useless if it doesn't hit!
BMD\t「まだまだだな」: You've still got a long way to go.
BMD\t「後は任せろ、テュッティ」: Leave the rest to me, Tytti.
BMD\t「プレシア、詰めが甘いぞ」: Precia, you didn't finish the job.
BMD\t「いかん、プレシア！ 俺の後ろに回れ！」: Look out, Precia! Get behind me!
BMD\t「こいつはおまけだ！ とっときなっ！！」: Here's a little extra! Take it!!
BMD\t「まだだっ！ 次は俺が行く！」: Not done yet! I'm up next!
BMD\t「リューネ、手を貸すぜ！！」: Lüne, I'll give you a hand!!
BMD\t「後は俺に任せろ、リューネ！」: Leave the rest to me, Lüne!
BMD\t「リューネ！ 後は俺に任せなっ！」: Lüne! Leave the rest to me!
BMD\t「シュウ……！ 妙な真似をしやがったら……/ このままてめえを撃つ！」: Shu...! Try anything funny.../　and I'll shoot you right here!
BMD\t「ちっ、シュウめ。/ てめえの後始末くらい自分でやれっての！」: Tch, Shu./　Clean up your own mess, will ya!
BMD\t「手を貸すぜ、リュウセイ！」: I'll lend you a hand, Ryusei!
BMD\t「リュウセイ！ 後は任せな！」: Ryusei! Leave the rest to me!
BMD\t「正面突破はおめえらの十八番だろ！/ 先に行け！」: Charging head-on is your specialty!/　Go on ahead!
BMD\t「アイビス！ 後は任せな！」: Ibis! Leave the rest to me!
BMD\t「リム、後は任せな！」: Rim, leave the rest to me!
BMD\t「アリエイル、後は俺がやる！」: Arieil, I'll take it from here!
BMD\t「イング、後は任せな！」: Ing, leave the rest to me!
BMD\t「ミチル、後始末は任せな！」: Michiru, leave the cleanup to me!
BMD\t「テュッティ、後は任せな！」: Tytti, leave the rest to me!
BMD\t「どうした、ヤンロン？/ 俺がとどめ刺していいのか？」: What's wrong, Yang Long?/　Mind if I finish this one?
BMD\t「よーし、ミオ！ 俺が片を付けてやるぜ！」: All right, Mio! I'll finish this!
BMD\t「後は俺がやってやるぜ、ゲンナジー！」: I'll take it from here, Gennacy!
BMD\t「おし、おっさん！/ 後は俺が片を付けてやるぜ！」: Okay, old man!/　I'll settle this from here!
BMD\t「討ち漏らしたな、ザッシュ。/ ま、後は俺がやってやるよ」: You missed one, Zash./　Well, I'll handle the rest.
BMD\t「てめえの手伝いなんざ御免だが、/ ま、今回は特別だ」: I don't do favors for you,/　but this time's special.
BMD\t「ちっ！ やらせるかよっ！」: Tch! Like hell I'll let you!
BMD\t「このっ！ させるか！」: Why you! Not on my watch!
BMD\t「リューネ！ 突っ込み過ぎだ！」: Lüne! You're charging in too far!
BMD\t「させるかっ！ リューネ、俺に任せろっ！」: Not a chance! Lüne, leave it to me!
BMD\t「ちっ、シュウ、てめえを守るとはな。/ まったく、世も末だぜ」: Tch, me protecting you, Shu.../　The world's really going to hell.
BMD\t「ちっ、/ ザムジードのタフさを過信しすぎだぞ、ミオ！」: Tch,/　Don't overrate Zamzeed's toughness, Mio!
BMD\t「戦いは正を以て合い、奇を以て勝つ」: In battle, engage with the orthodox,/　and win with the unorthodox.
BMD\t「勝つべからざるは守にして、/ 勝つべきは攻なり」: Defend when you cannot win,/　attack when you can.
BMD\t「炎の魔装機神の力、身を以て知るがいい」: Learn firsthand the power of/　the Masoukishin of flame!
BMD\t「邪魔をするのならば、容赦はせん！」: If you stand in my way,/　I'll show no mercy!
BMD\t「ああ、先んずれば人を制す。/ 我がグランヴェールの攻撃力ならばなおさ: Yes. Strike first, and you hold sway./　Even more so with my Granveil's power.
BMD\t「残念ですよ、カークス将軍。/ 僕はあなたの義を信じてきましたが……/: This is a shame, General Kirkus./　I trusted in your honor, but.../　you've betrayed me.
BMD\t「将軍、あなたは道を誤りました！/ 僕は魔装機神操者として……/ あな: General, you've strayed from the path!/　As a Masoukishin pilot.../　I will defeat you!
BMD\t「将軍、奸臣に成り果てましたね……/ ならば打ち倒すのみ！」: General, you've become a traitor.../　Then I have only to strike you down!
BMD\t「ふん……そう感情的になっては、/ 魔装機の扱いはおぼつかんぞ」: Hmph... Get that emotional,/　and you'll never master a Masouki.
BMD\t「面白い気を持ってはいるが……/ まだまだ荒削りだな」: You possess an interesting energy.../　but you're still quite raw.
BMD\t「こうも感情的になるとは……御し難い女だ」: Getting this emotional.../　What a difficult woman to handle.
BMD\t「ええい、邪魔をするな！/ 貴様などに拘っている暇はない！」: Blast it, out of my way!/　I've no time to waste on you!
BMD\t「相変わらず卑怯な手を使っているな、/ ルオゾール！」: Still using your cowardly tricks,/　Luozorl!
BMD\t「あんな奴の相手をしている場合では/ ないというのに……/ しつこいぞ: I have no time to be dealing/　with the likes of him.../　You're relentless, Luozorl!
BMD\t「もう貸し借りはないからな。/ 遠慮なく倒させてもらうぞ、/ サフィー: We're square now./　So I'll defeat you without holding back,/　Saphine!
BMD\t「何を企んでいるのかは知らんが、/ どうせろくでもないことだろう。/: I don't know what you're scheming,/　but it's surely nothing good./　I'll stop it now, Saphine.
BMD\t「何を企んでいるか、正直に言え。/ 場合によっては見逃してやらんことも: Tell me honestly what you're plotting./　Depending on it, I may let you go.
BMD\t「ほう、なかなかの手練れのようだな。/ だが、相手が僕だったのが君の不: Oh, you seem quite skilled./　But it's your misfortune to face me.
BMD\t「あの動き……ただの雑魚ではないな。/ 少し気を付けておくか」: Those moves... That's no mere grunt./　I'd best be a little careful.
BMD\t「なるほど、少しは出来ると見える。/ 油断禁物だな」: I see, you seem to have some skill./　I mustn't let my guard down.
BMD\t「女子と小人とは養い難し、か……！」: Women and petty men are hard/　to manage, as they say...!
BMD\t「子供の相手をしている暇はない！」: I've no time to deal with a child!
BMD\t「その邪気、我がグランヴェールの力にて/ 振り払ってみせよう！」: With the power of my Granveil,/　I shall drive away that malice!
BMD\t「所詮は夜郎自大の輩か……！」: In the end, just a frog in a well...!
BMD\t「大巧は拙なるが若し……というが、/ お前はそれに当てはまらぬようだな: Great skill appears clumsy, they say.../　but that doesn't seem to apply to you.
BMD\t「手強い相手には、機先を制するのが一番」: Against a tough foe,/　it's best to seize the initiative.
BMD\t「さすがに気を抜けぬ相手だな」: A foe I truly can't take lightly.
BMD\t「戦いは先手必勝。この機は逃さんよ」: In battle, he who strikes first wins./　I won't let this chance slip.
BMD\t「仙才鬼才は、/ 強制的に与えられるものではあるまい！」: Divine gifts and demonic genius/　are not meant to be bestowed by force!
BMD\t「仙を羨まず……人は、与えられた寿命を/ 全うして然るべきだ！」: Envy not the immortals... People should/　live out the lifespan they're given!
BMD\t「強敵です。ご油断なきよう」: A formidable foe. Do not be careless.
BMD\t「孫光龍、お前の妄言には惑わされん！」: Koryu Son, your ravings won't sway me!
BMD\t「白眼を以て迎えるべき客だな」: A guest to be greeted with cold eyes.
BMD\t「お前達にどのような義があろうと、/ 地球を蹂躙する権利はない！」: Whatever your cause may be,/　you have no right to trample the Earth!
BMD\t「捲土重来というわけか。/ だが、僕達がいる以上、画餅に帰すことになる: Making a comeback, are you?/　With us here, it'll come to nothing!
BMD\t「メリオルエッセ……気の抜けぬ相手だな」: Meliore Esse.../　Foes I can't take lightly.
BMD\t「異なる気といえど、臆しはせん！」: Your aura may be alien,/　but I won't flinch!
BMD\t「地球の守護者などと……魚目燕石の輩め！」: Earth's guardians? You're pebbles posing/　as jade, the lot of you!
BMD\t「兵は詭道なりというが……お前達は論外だ！」: All warfare is deception, they say.../　but you're beyond the pale!
BMD\t「ガイアセイバーズ、/ お前達にもはや大義はない！」: Gaia Savers,/　you no longer have any just cause!
BMD\t「まず、その繰り糸を断つ！」: First, I'll sever those puppet strings!
BMD\t「ヴォルクルスか……/ 確かに捨て置けぬ相手だな」: Volkruss.../　Truly a foe I can't ignore.
BMD\t「尋常でない量の、負の気を感じる……/ やはり、ラ・ギアスに/ 脅威を: I sense an immense mass of dark energy.../　So this is the being that threatens/　La Gias after all...
BMD\t「何とも禍々しい怪物だな。/ このままには出来ん。/ 葬り去ってくれよ: What an ominous monster./　I can't leave it be./　I'll send it to its grave.
BMD\t「兵は多きを益とするにあらざるなり。/ 数で僕を止められると思うな」: In war, more troops is no advantage./　Don't think numbers can stop me.
BMD\t「天に順う者は存し、天に逆らう者は亡ぶ。/ ガンエデン、それはお前にも: Who follows Heaven survives,/　who defies Heaven perishes./　That goes for you too, Gan Eden!
BMD\t「人心を惑わす偽神を討つ！」: I'll strike down this false god/　who leads hearts astray!
BMD\t「亢竜有悔……/ いや、お前が栄華を極めることはない！」: The haughty dragon will have regrets.../　No, you'll never even reach the peak!
BMD\t「怪力乱神を語らずといえど、/ 人に仇なすものであれば！」: The wise speak not of the supernatural,/　but if it brings harm to people...!
BMD\t「四神と言えど、人に仇なすのであれば、/ 瑞獣ではないな」: Four Gods or not, if you harm people,/　you're no auspicious beasts.
BMD\t「虎に翼と言うが、僕を止めることは出来ん！」: Like a tiger with wings, they say,/　but even you can't stop me!
LDBI\t「カイ少佐、ヒューゴ少尉達は気を失っています！」: Major Kai, Lieutenant Hugo and the others are out cold!
LDBI\t「了解した。@ そちらに行くまで、何とかもたせろ」: Understood.@Hold out until we get there.
LDBI\t「ククッ、やっと会えたねえ、あいつらと」: Heh heh, we finally get to meet them.
LDBI\t「久しぶりじゃないか、ブロンゾ２７、２８。@ いや、今はゼオラにアラ: Long time no see, Bronzo 27, 28.@Or should I say Seolla and Arado now?
LDBI\t「あたしらのことは知ってんだろ？」: You know who we are, don't you?
LDBI\t「その呼び名、久々に聞いたぜ」: Haven't heard that name in a while.
LDBI\t「ま、あたしらは<スクール>の中でも@ 浮いてたからな。もっとも、お: Well, we were outcasts even in <スクール>.@Not that we ever wanted to hang out with@a buddy-buddy clique like yours.
LDBI\t「お前らがどうしてガイアセイバーズに！？」: Why are you guys with the Gaia Savers?!
LDBI\t「あなた達はスクールが解散した時に……」: When The School was disbanded, you were...
LDBI\t「アギラからどう聞いていた？@ 処分されたか、野垂れ死んだとでも？」: What did Agira tell you?@That we got disposed of, or died in a ditch?
LDBI\t「スクールの解散が決まった時、@ あたしらは脱走したんだよ」: When they decided to shut The School down,@we broke out.
LDBI\t「ついでにアードラーやアギラを@ ブッ殺してやろうと思ったが、ジジイ: We meant to kill Adler and Agira on the way@out, too, but all we managed was to wound@the old geezer.
LDBI\t「……そのせいですんなり脱走できなかったし」: ...Which is why our escape didn't go smoothly.
LDBI\t「で、その後、ある組織に拾われて@ ガイアセイバーズに入ったのさ」: After that, a certain organization picked us up,@and we joined the Gaia Savers.
LDBI\t「スクールのモルモットだったあたしらが、@ 今や大統領の直轄部隊だ。: We were lab rats at The School, and now@we're the President's own unit. Moving up, huh?
LDBI\t「そんなの、別にうらやましくねえよ！」: That's nothing to be jealous of!
LDBI\t「だけど、お前達も<インスペクター事件>で@ そこそこ名を挙げたみた: But you lot made a bit of a name for yourselves@in the <インスペクター事件> too, didn't you?
LDBI\t「あのアウルム１と何度も渡り合って、倒したんだろ？ @ 話を聞いた時: You fought Aurum 1 again and again and took@her down, right? I was shocked when I heard.
LDBI\t「いい加減なことを言わないでよ！」: Don't talk about things you know nothing about!
LDBI\t「だが、てめえらが関わったせいで、@ あの女が死んだことに違いはねえ: But it's still a fact that she died@because you got involved. Ain't that right?
LDBI\t「あいつら、ラトゥーニ達の気持ちも知らねえで！」: Those jerks don't know how Latune and the others feel!
LDBI\t「ラトゥーニやアラド達は、望んで姉君と@ 戦ったわけではありませんの: Latune and Arado never wanted to fight@their sister...!
LDBI\t「ふふん、@ ブロンゾやラトゥーニ・クラスの落ちこぼれが、@ 今や特: Heh.@Bronzo and Latune Class washouts, now part@of the Special Tactical Instructor Unit...
LDBI\t「なかなかの出世だが、鋼龍戦隊に関わったのが@ 運の尽きだ。結局、て: Quite the promotion, but getting mixed up with@the Steel Dragons was your bad luck. In the end,@you're just losers.
LDBI\t「落ちこぼれ共はさっさと死にな。@ スクールのよしみで、あたしらが@: Now hurry up and die, washouts.@For old times' sake at The School,@we'll send you off ourselves.
LDBI\t「ここに来て、スクールの出身者同士で@ 戦うことになるなんて……！」: To think we'd end up fighting other kids@from The School now, of all times...!
LDBI\t「嫌だってか？@ 甘ちゃんなんだよ、てめえらは。@ 俺達は相手が誰だ: Don't like it?@You're soft, the lot of you.@We don't care who we're up against.
LDBI\t「勝ち組になるためだったら、@ どんなものも踏み台にしてやるぜ」: If it means coming out on top,@I'll step on anything to get there.
LDBI\t「あなた達、ガイアセイバーズが@ どういう組織だか、わかってるの！？: Do you even understand what kind of@organization the Gaia Savers are?!
LDBI\t「わかってるさ！@ 強い者が生き残り、正義ってのを得る！」: Sure we do!@The strong survive and get to call it justice!
LDBI\t「それにてめえらは犯罪者、反逆者だ、@ くびり殺すのに理由なんていら: Besides, you're criminals and traitors.@We don't need a reason to wring your necks!
LDBI\t「相変わらず吹っ切れたガキ共だぜ。@ あたしらに喧嘩を売ったら、仕置: You brats are as unhinged as ever.@Pick a fight with us and you'll get way more@than a slap on the wrist. You know that, right?
LDBI\t「ハッ！ ここはラ・ギアスじゃねえ、地上だ！@ てめえらが何を言おう: Hah! This ain't La Gias, it's the surface!@Whatever you say, the moral high ground@is ours!
LDBI\t「その大義名分に疑惑があるのよ！」: That moral high ground is under suspicion!
LDBI\t「なら、ゼオラ……お前は何で戦ってるんだ？@ 正義か？ 地球の平和を: Then, Seolla... what are you fighting for?@Justice? To protect peace on Earth?
LDBI\t「そうよ……@ もう私達やオウカ姉様みたいな子が@ 戦わなくてもいい: That's right...@So that kids like us and Ouka@never have to fight again...
LDBI\t「違うな！@ あたしらは<ブーステッド・チルドレン>だ、@ 敵を倒す: Wrong!@We're <ブーステッド・チルドレン>, drilled@in the skills to take enemies down!
LDBI\t「戦わなきゃ、生きていけないんだよ！@ その証拠に、お前も結局パイロ: We can't survive without fighting!@Proof is, you've kept on being a Pilot@yourself, haven't you!
LDBI\t「それ以外に生きていく手段を教えられてないのさ、@ あたし達は！」: Nobody ever taught us any other way to live!
LDBI\t「戦うのが嫌なら、その機体から降りな！@ 一瞬でお前を蒸発させてやる: If you hate fighting, get out of that machine!@I'll vaporize you in an instant!
LDBI\t「……そこまで言うんなら、@ こっちだって引き下がるわけにはいかねえ: ...If you're gonna go that far,@then we can't back down either...
LDBI\t「お前らが言う通り、@ 他にメシを食ってく方法を知らねえよ、おれ達は: You're right,@we don't know any other way to put food on the table.
LDBI\t「だけど、今は守るべきものを守るために@ 戦ってんだよ！」: But right now, we're fighting to protect@the things worth protecting!
LDBI\t「おほっ、感動的な決め台詞、いただきました！@ だが、ありがちだ！」: Ooh, a moving catchphrase, thank you very much!@But it's so cliche!
LDBI\t「……人間、誰だって死ぬし。@ 戦って生き残ったって、死ぬんだよ」: ...Everybody dies.@Even if you fight and survive, you still die.
LDBI\t「どうせなら、面白おかしく生きて、@ 死ぬ方がいいじゃねえか、なぁ！: So you might as well live it up and have fun@before you die, right?!
LDBI\t「こんなのの何が面白いんだ！？」: What's fun about any of this?!
LDBI\t「てめえ、どういう<リマコン>を受けたんだ？@ そんなのでよく今まで: What kind of <リマコン> did they give you?@How'd you make it this far like that?
LDBI\t「お前こそ！@ まだリマコンを引きずってんじゃねえのかよ！？」: Look who's talking!@Aren't you still under remote conditioning?!
LDBI\t「言っとくが、あたしらは最初からこうさ。@ アギラも楽だったろうよ」: For the record, we've always been this way.@Bet Agira had it easy with us.
LDBI\t「あたしらは頭まで薬漬けじゃないんだよ。@ だから、ゼオラ……お前よ: Our heads aren't soaked in drugs like yours.@So, Seolla... we're better than you.@As <ブーステッド・チルドレン>, that is.
LDBI\t「ヘッ、そんなもんが当たるかってんでぇ！@ 怪我したくなかったら、す: Heh, like that's gonna hit me!@If you don't wanna get hurt, butt out!
LDBI\t「口で言ってもわからねえなら！@ くらえ！ ファイター・ビームガン！: If talking won't get through to you...!@Take this! Fighter Beamgun!
LDBI\t「く、くそっ！ 駄目だ！ 退け、退け！！」: D-Damn it! It's no good! Fall back, fall back!!
LDBI\t「……ホッホッホ、ヒーロー参上じゃの」: ...Ho ho ho! The hero has arrived, I see.
LDBI\t「慌てるでないの、怪人ではないの」: Now, now, don't panic. I'm no evil monster.
LDBI\t「ワシの名はエリック・ワンでの」: The name's Eric Wang, you see.
LDBI\t「ちょうど良かったでの。@ ウェポン・ボックス・ハンガーに貼り付けら: Your timing's perfect, you see.@I'd like you to help me remove the bombs@planted on the Weapon Box Hangar.
LDBI\t「さあ、今から隔壁を開けてやるでの。@ 騎士と白雪姫を呼ぶとええでの: Now then, I'll open the bulkhead for you.@Go on and call your knight and Snow White...
BMD\t「ガンエデン……/ あの光に囚われるわけにはいかない……！」: Gan Eden.../　I can't let that light ensnare me...!
BMD\t「当たるもんですか！」: As if that would hit me!
BMD\t「こう見えて、動体視力には自信あるのよ！」: Don't let looks fool you--/　my dynamic vision is top-notch!
BMD\t「あなたの攻撃パターンはお見通しよ！」: I can see right through your attack pattern!
BMD\t「狙い所が丸わかりね」: Your aim is easy to read.
BMD\t「くっ、さすがは殿下！ でもかわせた！」: Ngh, impressive, Your Highness!/　But I dodged it!
BMD\t「あなたの攻撃パターンは予測済みよ、/ ルオゾール！」: I've predicted your attack pattern,/　Luozorl!
BMD\t「さすがに速い！ でも、当たらなければ！」: That's fast!/　But it means nothing if it misses!
BMD\t「ライオネス少尉、/ あなたの腕でガッデスに立ち向かうのは無謀よ」: Lieutenant Lioness, with your skills,/　challenging the Gaddess is reckless.
BMD\t「そう簡単に絶望などしないわ」: I won't give in to despair that easily.
BMD\t「ペルフェクティオ！ 元いた所へ還りなさい！」: Perfectio! Go back where you came from!
BMD\t「もう地球圏に干渉するのはおよしなさい！」: Stop interfering with the Earth Sphere!
BMD\t「夏喃、あなたの手には乗らないわ！」: Kanan, I won't fall for your tricks!
BMD\t「仙人と言っても、互角に戦えそうね」: You may be a sage, but I can match you.
BMD\t「凄い攻撃だけど……無駄よ、光龍」: Impressive attack... but it's futile,/　Koryu.
BMD\t「ユーゼス、あなたに進む道などないわ」: Euzeth, there's no path ahead for you.
BMD\t「エルデ……あなたに取り込まれるわけには！」: Erde... I won't let you absorb me!
BMD\t「ゲスト……量産機は、大したことなさそうね」: Guest mass-production units.../　not much of a threat, it seems.
BMD\t「妖機人に捕まるわけにはいかないわ」: I can't let a Yokijin catch me.
BMD\t「超機人……動きをよく見れば、大丈夫ね」: Choukijin... if I watch their moves/　closely, I'll be fine.
BMD\t「神を騙る者などに！」: Not to one who poses as a god!
BMD\t「あら、今の、私を狙ってたの？」: Oh, was that aimed at me?
BMD\t「きゃっ？/ 今のはちょっと危なかったかも……」: Eek?!/　That one was a little close...
BMD\t「ふう……/ 確かに以前に比べると雲泥の差ね、カークス将軍。/ でも、: Phew.../　You've come a long way, General Kirkus./　But it's useless if it doesn't hit!
BMD\t「ふう、いい腕ね。油断ならないわ」: Phew, you're good. I can't let my guard down.
BMD\t「何とかかわせたけど……要注意ね」: I managed to dodge, but... careful now.
BMD\t「ふう、危ない所だったわ。/ さすがに当たると、ただでは済みそうにない: Phew, that was close./　A direct hit would've cost me dearly.
BMD\t「そう簡単に、逃げられると思って！？」: You think you can escape that easily?!
BMD\t「隙を見せた……あなたの負けよ！」: You left an opening... you lose!
BMD\t「もう一撃、いくわよ！」: One more hit, here I go!
BMD\t「後は任せて、ヤンロン！」: Leave the rest to me, Yang Long!
BMD\t「ゲンナジー、後は任せて！」: Gennacy, leave the rest to me!
BMD\t「もう……しょうがないわね。/ これっきりよ、サフィーネ」: Oh... fine, you win./　Just this once, Saphine.
BMD\t「モニカ様……お手伝いします」: Princess Monica... allow me to help.
BMD\t「下がって！ 私が盾になる！」: Stand back! I'll be your shield!
BMD\t「下がって！/ ガッデスなら、受け止められるはず！」: Stand back!/　The Gaddess should be able to take it!
LDBI\t「そこは、賭けです。@ クスハという意志疎通者がいない現状で、龍王機: That's where we gamble.@I know it's risky to take a scalpel to RyuOhKi@without Kusuha here to communicate with it...
LDBI\t「このままでは、死を迎えるだけです。@ ある程度まで道をつけてやれば: Left as it is, it'll simply die.@If we pave the way for it to a certain point,@it may handle the fusion on its own from there.
LDBI\t「それに、龍王機自身も@ このまま終わるつもりはないと思いますが……: Besides, I doubt RyuOhKi itself@intends to let things end like this...
LDBI\t「だが、君にはオルレアンに行く用事があるだろう？」: But don't you have business in Orleans?
LDBI\t「あちらの方は立ち会うだけですし、@ カークもいますから、５日ほどの: I'm only observing there, and Kirk's going too,@so it'll just be a trip of five days or so.
LDBI\t「ありがとうございます。メンテでバラした弐式と@ 壱式の予備パーツを: Thank you. I'll use Type-2, which we stripped@down for maintenance, plus spare Type-1 parts.
LDBI\t「それから、アンザイ博士、ネート博士……@ <超機人>の研究を続けて: Also, Dr. Anzai, Dr. Nate...@You've both been studying the <超機人> for years,@so I'd like your help as well.
LDBI\t「……ラウル、フィオナ君。@ 君達にはしばらくの間、テスラ研に@ 滞: ...Raul, Fiona.@I'd like you two to stay at the Tesla Institute@for a while. Would that be all right?
LDBI\t「復旧作業と警護任務を兼ねて、ですか？」: To help with repairs and provide security?
LDBI\t「ああ。@ いつかまた妖機人がここを襲ってくると@ 予測はしていたが: Yes.@I had predicted the Yokijin would attack@here again someday...
LDBI\t「ブリットやクスハ君、それに鋼龍戦隊の面々が@ 行方不明になっている: But with Bullet, Kusuha, and the Steel Dragons@all missing... Naturally, we'll keep asking@the Federation Army for security as well.
LDBI\t「わかりました。あたし達もお手伝いします」: Got it. We'll help out too.
LDBI\t「……これまで妖機人は組織立った動きを@ 見せていませんでしたが、こ: ...Until now, the Yokijin haven't shown any@organized activity, but now we've finally@glimpsed who's backing them.
LDBI\t「もしかしたら、@ あの鳥型の機体は妖機人ではなく、超機人……@ そ: Perhaps...@that bird-shaped unit wasn't a Yokijin, but a@Choukijin... One of the Four Gods, even...?
LDBI\t「あの……四神とは？」: Um... What are the Four Gods?
LDBI\t「四方角を司る霊獣です。@ 東の青龍、西の白虎、南の朱雀、北の玄武…: Sacred beasts of the four directions. Seiryu,@east; Byakko, west; Suzaku, south; Genbu, north.@Suzaku's often a bird, and Genbu a turtle...
LDBI\t「そして、龍王機は青龍の、虎王機は白虎の超機人……@ あの鳥は朱雀の: RyuOhKi is the Choukijin of Seiryu, KoOhKi of@Byakko... That bird may be Suzaku's Choukijin...
LDBI\t「だとしたら……何故、同じ四神の超機人である@ 龍王機と虎王機を襲っ: If so... why attack RyuOhKi and KoOhKi, fellow@Choukijin of the Four Gods? Aren't their enemies@the Yokijin? And that woman, Kukuru...?
LDBI\t「教えて。@ 今は少しでも情報が必要な時だと@ あなたもわかっている: Tell us.@You know as well as I do that we need@every bit of information we can get right now.
LDBI\t「私からも頼む、アンザイ博士」: I ask you as well, Dr. Anzai.
LDBI\t「……わかりました。@ 彼らが実在していて、行動を開始したのなら……: ...Very well.@If they truly exist and have begun to act...@there's no point in keeping it secret.
LDBI\t「私が所属しているＬＴＲ機構には、@ オーダー・ファイルという門外不: The LTR Organization I belong to keeps@a top-secret document called the Order File@that's never allowed to leave its walls...
LDBI\t「そこには、旧西暦時代の世界大戦前後に@ 超機人や妖機人を用い、暗躍: It describes an organization that operated in@the shadows around the world wars of the Old@Calendar era, using Choukijin and Yokijin.
BMD\t「外道の攻撃に当たってたまるものか！」: Like I'd let a lowlife's attack hit me!
BMD\t「まぐれでも、成功は成功だ！」: Fluke or not, a success is a success!
BMD\t「いいぞ、雷鳳！ 反応はばっちりだ！」: Nice, RaiOh! Your response is spot-on!
BMD\t「当たらなければ最後には勝つ……！」: As long as I don't get hit, I'll win...!
BMD\t「いいぞ、雷鳳！ 俺達はやれる！」: Nice, RaiOh! We can do this!
BMD\t「実戦はからっきしってタイプかよ、/ ゼゼーナン！」: Not much for actual combat, are you,/　Zezenan!
BMD\t「余裕かましておいて、それかよ、孫光龍！」: All that swagger, and that's it,/　Son Koryu!?
BMD\t「この程度で地球の守護者気取りかよ！」: This is all you've got, and you call/　yourselves Earth's guardians!?
BMD\t「どうした、ガンエデン！ 俺はここだぞ！」: What's wrong, Gan Eden! I'm right here!
BMD\t「そんな攻撃、屁でもないぜ！」: An attack like that is nothing!
BMD\t「くそっ！ 調子に乗り過ぎたか！」: Damn! Did I get too cocky!?
BMD\t「ちっ！ 射程が短いのは泣き所だ……！」: Tch! Short range is my weak spot...!
BMD\t「届かなければ接近するだけだ……！」: If I can't reach, I'll just close in...!
BMD\t「俺だってサポートぐらいは出来るさ！」: I can handle a little support too!
BMD\t「俺だって、少佐に続いてみせる！」: I'll follow your lead too, Major!
BMD\t「カイ少佐！ 特訓の成果をお見せします！」: Major Kai! Time to show you/　the results of my training!
BMD\t「さすがはリシュウ先生！ いいお手本だ！」: That's Rishu-sensei for you!/　A perfect example!
BMD\t「やるな、コウタ！ 俺も続くぜ！」: Nice one, Kota! I'm right behind you!
BMD\t「アイビスが隙を作ってくれたからには……！」: Ibis made an opening for me, so...!
BMD\t「見てろよ、ラウル！ 次は俺だ！」: Watch this, Raul! I'm up next!
BMD\t「リシュウ先生をやらせるかよ！」: I won't let them get Rishu-sensei!
BMD\t「レスキューがやられちゃ意味ないぜ！」: A rescuer who gets shot down is no use!
BMD\t「一発で済むと思うなよ！」: Don't think one hit is all you get!
BMD\t「攻撃が一度だけなんて決まりはないぜ！」: Nobody said I only get one attack!
BMD\t「プラズマビュート！ 奴を逃がすな！」: Plasma Beute! Don't let them get away!
LDBI\t「ああ。ヴォルクルス神殿で@ サイフラッシュを使ってから、@ どうも: Yeah. Ever since I used Cyflash@at the Temple of Volkruss, it hasn't@been running right.
LDBI\t「じゃあ、ハガネから降ろしといて。@ あたしが精密検査をやるわ」: Then unload it from the Hagane.@I'll give it a thorough inspection.
LDBI\t「わかった、頼むぜ。@ ……ところで、手に持ってるのは何だ？」: Got it, thanks.@...By the way, what's that in your hand?
LDBI\t「これ？ 新しい魔装機の資料よ」: This? It's the specs for a new Masouki.
LDBI\t「地上の機体を参考にした機体なんだろ？」: It's modeled on a surface unit, isn't it?
LDBI\t（ううっ、確信しちゃってるわね。@ リョウト達に最終調整データを@: (Ugh, he's already sure of it. I was hoping@to have Ryoto and the others secretly look@over the final tuning data...)
LDBI\t「わかった、わかったわ、白状するわよ。@ ヒュッケバイン・シリーズを: Okay, okay, I confess.@It's a Masouki based on the Hückebein series.
LDBI\t「ええ。超高性能の魔装機で、名前はデュラクシール。@ 明日、ロールア: Yes. It's an ultra-high-performance Masouki@called the Duraxyll. It rolls out tomorrow.
LDBI\t「つーか、もうそこまで出来てんのか」: Wait, you've already gotten that far?
LDBI\t「ヒュッケバインＭｋ－ⅡやＭｋ－Ⅲの@ 実機を見たがってた理由がわか: So that's why you wanted to see the real@Hückebein Mk-II and Mk-III...
LDBI\t「……何故、ヒュッケバイン・シリーズを@ 参考にしたんだ？」: ...Why base it on the Hückebein series?
LDBI\t「地上の機体データを色々見たんだけど……@ 個人的には、ヒュッケバイ: I looked at all sorts of surface unit data...@and personally, I thought the Hückebein series@had the best-balanced frame of them all.
LDBI\t「見た目は華奢だけど、大出力ジェネレーターの@ 搭載を想定した高い剛: It looks delicate, but it's very rigid, built@to carry a high-output generator... It's also@highly mobile and very versatile.
LDBI\t「ああ。ご指摘通り、いい機体なんだが……@ 色々と曰く付きでな」: Yeah. You're right, it's a good machine...@but it's got a bit of a history.
LDBI\t「知ってるわ。@ 今、ここにいる人って、当事者なんでしょ」: I know. Everyone here was involved@in it, right?
LDBI\t「ええ、マサキからもらったデータに@ 大まかな経緯が記録されてたから: Yes, the data Masaki gave me had@a rough record of what happened.
LDBI\t「あたしが折を見て、記録してたニャ」: I logged it whenever I had time, meow.
LDBI\t「そうなんだ。@ まあ、マサキ君がコツコツとデータ打ちを@ してる所: Oh, I see.@Well, I can't picture Masaki sitting down@and patiently typing in data anyway.
LDBI\t「それで……デュラクシールはどんな機体なの？」: So... what kind of machine is the Duraxyll?
LDBI\t「火力重視の魔装機よ。ヒュッケバイン・シリーズより@ 大型化されてい: A firepower-focused Masouki. It's larger than@the Hückebein series, with a more rigid frame@and a high-output generator.
LDBI\t「あと、精霊とは契約してないんだけど……@ 疑似<プラーナ>発生装置: It also hasn't contracted with a spirit... but@its pseudo-<プラーナ> generator lets it match a@Masoukishin, depending on the pilot's <プラーナ>.
LDBI\t「精霊と契約してねえのか。@ 話だけ聞いてりゃ、<魔装機>って言うよ: No spirit pact, huh?@From the sound of it, it's less a <魔装機>@and more like a <特機> from the surface.
LDBI\t「そうね、ラングラン軍のフラグシップ機に@ なり得る機体よ」: Right. It could become the flagship@of the Langran military.
LDBI\t「セニア様、マサキ、@ そろそろフェイル殿下の所へ行く時間よ」: Princess Xenia, Masaki,@it's almost time to go see Prince Feil.
LDBI\t「わかった。@ 俺はサイバスターを出さなきゃならないから、@ 先に行: Got it.@I need to take Cybuster out,@so go on ahead.
LDBI\t「カークス軍残党やシュテドニアスとの問題が@ 落ち着かぬ現状では、由: With the Kirkus remnants and Schtedonias still@unresolved, this is a grave matter indeed.
LDBI\t「ああ……ヴォルクルスの復活に@ シュテドニアスが一枚噛んでいるとな: Yes... If Schtedonias had a hand in@Volkruss's revival, we cannot overlook it.
LDBI\t「どっちかって言うと、@ シュテドニアスの特殊部隊はルオゾールに@: If anything, I'd say the Schtedonias@special forces were just being used@by Luozorl.
LDBI\t「事の大小でなく、彼らの間につながりがあるという@ 事実を重要視しな: Regardless of scale, what matters is the fact@that there's a connection between them.
LDBI\t「シュテドニアス軍が、ヴォルクルスによって@ 破壊活動を目論む輩と結: If Schtedonias has joined hands with those@who would use Volkruss to wreak havoc...@we must assume they intend to invade again.
LDBI\t「でも、兄さん……@ 向こうも軍勢を引き揚げたばかりだから、@ すぐ: But, Brother...@they only just pulled their forces back.@I don't think they'll attack right away.
LDBI\t「いや、悠長なことを言ってはいられない。@ 我が方は一刻も早く態勢を: No, we can't afford to be complacent. We must@rebuild our forces at once and show that we're@ready for any foreign invasion.
LDBI\t「それはそうだけど……シュテドニアスやバゴニアを@ 下手に刺激するこ: That's true, but... won't that provoke@Schtedonias and Bagonia needlessly?
LDBI\t「彼らに動きがなければ、な。@ だが、現にシュテドニアスは特殊部隊を: It would, if they weren't moving.@But Schtedonias has in fact sent special@forces into Langran.
LDBI\t「ここで日和っては、彼らを付け上がらせるだけだ」: If we waver now, it'll only embolden them.
LDBI\t「……ルオゾール達への対応はどうすんだよ？」: ...And what about Luozorl and his crew?
LDBI\t「ヴォルクルスの件は、クリストフも絡んでいると@ 思うし……モニカや: I think Christoph is involved in the Volkruss@affair too... and with Monica and Tellius to@consider, we need a follow-up investigation.
LDBI\t「情報局の専任調査員の数を増やして……@ 場合によっては、<魔装機>: We should increase the Intelligence Bureau's@dedicated investigators... and maybe form a@task force including <魔装機> and <魔装機神>.
LDBI\t「わかった、検討しよう。@ ヴォルクルスのみならず、有事の際に動ける: Very well, I'll consider it. Along with forming@an independent unit that can mobilize in any@emergency, not just against Volkruss.
LDBI\t「独立部隊……鋼龍戦隊みたいな感じのか？」: An independent unit... Like the Steel Dragons?
LDBI\t「イメージは近いが、権限はもっと拡大させたいと@ 思っている。ただ、: Similar in concept, but I want broader authority@for it. However, it's not my decision alone.@Establishing it will take some time.
LDBI\t「それまで、ヴォルクルス出現のような@ 非常事態が発生した場合は、君: Until then, should an emergency like Volkruss's@appearance arise, I'd like you to handle it.
LDBI\t「それと、地上人送還の件だが……@ 戴冠式と新体制政府の発表後に行う: As for sending the surfacers home... I intend@to do so after the coronation and the@announcement of the new government.
LDBI\t「戴冠式……じゃあ、殿下が……！」: A coronation... So, you're going to...!
LDBI\t「そうだ。私が第２８８代ラングラン国王となる」: Yes. I will become the 288th King of Langran.
LDBI\t「おめでとうございます、殿下……@ いえ、陛下とお呼びしなければなり: Congratulations, Your Highness...@No, I should say Your Majesty now.
LDBI\t「気が早いな、テュッティ」: You're getting ahead of yourself, Tytti.
BMD\t「こ、ここまでか……！」: Th-this is as far as I go...!
BMD\t「僕は……ここで……！？」: Am I... going to end... here?!
BMD\t「うぐっ！ 対応しきれない……！？」: Ugh! I can't keep up with this...?!
BMD\t「こんな所で……終われないんだ、僕は！」: I can't end it in a place like this.../　Not me!
BMD\t「くうっ！ ４番モーターが灼けたか！」: Kuh! Did the No. 4 motor burn out?!
BMD\t「Ｒバランサー、カット２秒！/ ＤＨＢＭコントロール！」: R Balancer, cut for 2 seconds!/　DHBM control!
BMD\t「くっ、反応が鈍い……！/ このままでは……！」: Ngh, the response is sluggish...!/　At this rate...!
BMD\t「損傷部への動力伝達カット！ これで……！」: Cutting power to the damaged sections!/　That should do it...!
BMD\t「ううっ、アッシュの脆い部分に……！！」: Ugh, right in Ash's weak spot...!!
BMD\t「くうっ！/ エグゼクスバインなら、耐えられる！」: Kuh!/　The Exexbein can take it!
BMD\t「エグレッタ……凶鳥は滅びない……！」: Egretta.../　The bird of ill omen won't perish...!
BMD\t「うぐっ！/ アレス・ガイストを止められない……！？」: Ugh!/　I can't stop the Ares Geist...?!
BMD\t「ううっ、アレスに押し切られるとは……！」: Ugh, to be overpowered by the Ares...!
BMD\t「こ、これがオリジネイターの実力か……！」: S-so this is what/　an Originator can do...!
BMD\t「ぐううっ！ ガリルナガンに対応できない！」: Gwah!/　I can't keep up with the Galilnagant!
BMD\t「ア、アーマラ……/ 僕をいたぶっているのか……！」: A-Amala.../　Are you toying with me...?!
BMD\t「くっ！ アーマラに翻弄されている……！？」: Kuh! Is Amala playing with me...?!
BMD\t「こ、これがデュラクシールのパワーか……！」: S-so this is the Duraxyll's power...!
BMD\t「ペルフェクティオ……/ お前に僕達の運命を決める権利はない……！」: Perfectio.../　You've no right to decide our fate...!
BMD\t「うぐっ！ 孫光龍、僕はまだ……！」: Ugh! Sun Koryu, I'm not done yet...!
BMD\t「ここでヴォルクルスを食い止めなければ……！」: I have to stop Volkruss here...!
BMD\t「くっ！/ 進化する時間を与えるわけには……！」: Kuh!/　I can't give it time to evolve...!
BMD\t「これが雀武王の力か……！」: So this is the JakuBuOh's power...!
BMD\t「ガンエデンの念に……蝕まれる……！？」: Gan Eden's will... is eroding me...?!
