LDBI\t「原因は調査中なんですが、@ めぼしい手掛かりは掴めていないんです」: We're still investigating the cause,@but we haven't found any real leads.
LDBI\t「消えちまったおれ達の知り合いは、@ これまでの激戦をくぐり抜けてき: The people we know who vanished have made it@through some brutal fights before...@so I believe they're safe.
LDBI\t（不可解な事件は、妖機人だけじゃないのね……）: (So the Yokijin aren't the only@strange incidents...)
LDBI\t「アニキ、戦闘があったんだって？」: Hey bro, I heard there was a battle?
LDBI\t「……リアナ、いきなり代わるのはよせよ」: ...Riana, don't just switch out of nowhere.
LDBI\t「ごめん、ごめん。@ ずっと黙ってるの、辛いからさ」: Sorry, sorry.@Keeping quiet the whole time is tough, y'know.
LDBI\t「すまないな、窮屈な思いをさせて」: Sorry for cramping you like this.
LDBI\t「しょうがないよ。@ あたしとクリスのことを知ったら、@ 他の人は驚: Can't be helped.@If people found out about me and Chris,@they'd freak out.
LDBI\t「さっき、食堂に行った時……@ ついうっかりリアナと喋って、@ 軍人: When I went to the mess hall earlier...@I accidentally started talking with Riana,@and a soldier gave me a weird look.
LDBI\t「わかってるよ、アニキ。@ でも、いつまで秘密にしておくの？」: I know, bro.@But how long are we keeping it a secret?
LDBI\t「しばらくの間はな。@ 教導隊のメンバーがどういう人間か、@ まだよ: For a while.@I still don't really know what kind of people@the Training Squadron members are.
LDBI\t「悪い人達じゃないと思うけど……」: I don't think they're bad people, though...
LDBI\t「ねえ、お兄ちゃん……@ 今頃……お父さん達、心配してるよね」: Hey, Brother...@Dad and everyone must be worried by now, huh?
LDBI\t「黙ってお前を連れて来たからか？」: Because I brought you here without telling them?
LDBI\t「南極から連絡は入って来ていない。@ 連れ出したのが俺だとわかってい: There's been no word from Antarctica.@They must know I'm the one who took you.
LDBI\t「もっとも、親父が気にしているのは@ お前達じゃなく、シュンパティア: Though what the old man's worried about@might not be you two, but the Sympathia.
LDBI\t「何にせよ、あんな所に@ お前達を置いておくわけにはいかない」: Either way, I couldn't leave you two@in a place like that.
LDBI\t「シュンパティアに触れるのは、俺と親父だけで充分だ。@ 二度とお前達: The old man and I are enough for the Sympathia.@I'll never let them use you two@as test subjects again...!
BMD\t「１機たりとも逃しはしない！」: Not a single one gets away!
BMD\t「……さすがに弾を使い過ぎたわね」: ...I did use a bit too much ammo there.
BMD\t「打点は固定しない！」: I won't strike the same spot twice!
BMD\t「見るがいい、二凶星の煌めきを」: Behold the gleam of the twin baleful stars.
BMD\t「魅入られたわね、凶方位に」: The baleful quarter has claimed you.
BMD\t「ガイアセイバーズっていう名前だけは、/ ご大層だけどね」: Gaia Saviors... At least the name/　sounds impressive.
BMD\t「イケメンならぬインケンメンは、/ ノーサンキューってことで」: Not so much a hunk as a skunk./　No thank you!
BMD\t「逆恨みのお相手をするつもりはないのよ」: I'm not here to humor your misplaced grudge.
BMD\t「ドゥバン、/ あなたの思い通りにならないわよ！」: Duban,/　things won't go the way you want!
BMD\t「あらら、熱血君ねぇ」: Oh my, aren't you Mr. Hot-Blooded?
BMD\t「ホント、あの人、何類なのかしらん？」: Seriously, what species is that one?
BMD\t「あなた、男なの？ 女なの？」: Are you a man? Or a woman?
BMD\t「マンモスじゃないんだから、氷づけは勘弁ね」: I'm no mammoth, so spare me the deep freeze.
BMD\t「セティちゃん、/ こっちも速さには自信があるのよん」: Sety,/　I'm pretty confident in my speed too!
BMD\t「やっぱ、他人って気がしないわよね」: I just can't think of you as a stranger.
BMD\t「クスハちゃんに目を付けるなんて、/ いい趣味してるわね」: Setting your sights on Kusuha?/　You've got good taste.
BMD\t「あなたのお誘いには乗れないのよね」: Sorry, I can't accept your invitation.
BMD\t「霞を食べる生活なんて、/ つまらないじゃない？」: Living on thin air?/　Doesn't that sound boring?
BMD\t「ぜんざいよりお汁粉の方が好みだったりして」: Actually, I think I like oshiruko/　better than zenzai.
BMD\t「こっちの世界に居座られちゃ、困るのよね！」: We can't have you/　squatting in our world!
BMD\t「ペルフェクティオ、こっちの水は苦いわよ！」: Perfectio,/　the water over here's bitter!
BMD\t「面白可笑しく生きるのはいいけど、/ あなた達の下じゃね」: Living for fun is fine and all,/　but not under you guys.
BMD\t「さてと、次行ってみましょっか！」: Okay, on to the next one!
BMD\t「わお、ちょっと危なかったかな？」: Whoa, was that a little close?
BMD\t「おりこうさんねえ、ヴァイスちゃんは」: What a smart cookie you are, Weiss.
BMD\t「最強の盾が避けて、これがホントの最強の避け……/ おそまつ！」: The strongest shield dodges, making it/　the strongest dodge... Ba-dum-tss!
BMD\t「もっとダイエットした方が楽に/ 避けられるんじゃなぁい？/ グルンち: Wouldn't dodging be easier/　if you went on a diet?/　Right, Grun?
BMD\t「グルンっと避けて！ ガスっと反撃？」: Spin and dodge! Then smack back?
BMD\t「あんなので殴られたら、痛そうよね」: Getting hit with that would sure hurt.
BMD\t「丸焼きになるつもりなんてないのよね」: I'm not planning on getting roasted whole.
BMD\t「雀さん、こっちこっち！」: Little sparrow, over here, over here!
BMD\t「あなた達の餌になる気なんてないわよ！」: I'm not about to become your food!
BMD\t「私達を封じ込めようったって、/ そうはいかないわよ！」: Trying to seal us away?/　Not gonna happen!
BMD\t「ガイアセイバーズさん、私はここよん！」: Yoo-hoo, Gaia Saviors! I'm over here!
BMD\t「そんなんじゃ、お姉さんは怯まないわよ？」: That won't make big sis flinch, you know?
BMD\t「レディーの扱いがなってないんじゃない？」: Don't you know how to treat a lady?
BMD\t「わわっ、まぶしっ！/ バリアはこれだからイヤなのよね」: Whoa, so bright!/　That's what I hate about barriers.
BMD\t「びっちりばっちり完全防御！/ いいんじゃない？」: Airtight, watertight, total defense!/　Not bad, huh?
BMD\t「便利ねえ、これって！ かなりホクホクよ？」: This is so handy! I'm all warm and fuzzy!
BMD\t「んふふ～、/ お姉さんの魅力でクラクラしたようねぇ」: Mm-hm-hm~,/　dazzled by big sis's charms, huh?
BMD\t「機体がおなかをすかしてるみたいね……」: Looks like my machine's getting hungry...
BMD\t「もう、冗談じゃないわよ！」: Oh, come on, you've gotta be kidding!
BMD\t「ちょっとぉ、/ フェアにいきましょ、フェアに！」: Hey now,/　let's play fair, okay? Fair!
BMD\t「はあい！ こっちもどうぞ！」: Here you go! Have one from me too!
BMD\t「わお！ いい位置じゃなぁい？」: Ooh! Isn't this a nice spot?
BMD\t「私も結構つくすタイプよね」: I'm pretty devoted myself, aren't I?
BMD\t「どいてどいて～！/ 援護しちゃうわよ、キョウスケ」: Out of the way~!/　Here comes your backup, Kyosuke!
BMD\t「もう、あんまり/ 世話焼かせないでよね、キョウスケ」: Jeez, don't make me/　babysit you so much, Kyosuke.
BMD\t「キョウちゃ～ん！/ あらいやん、私ってば大胆？」: Kyo~!/　Oh my, am I being too forward?
BMD\t「あふんの呼吸よ、キョウスケ。/ ……阿吽だっけ？」: Total sinchronicity, Kyosuke./　...Wait, is it synchronicity?
BMD\t「言わなくてもわかってるわよ、キョウスケ！」: No need to say it, I know, Kyosuke!
BMD\t「ブリット君、お姉さんが援護してあ・げ・る」: Bullet, big sis is here to back you up~
BMD\t「ブリット君、こういうトコも奥手ねえ」: Bullet, you're shy even about this, huh?
BMD\t「貴様達の死も苦しみも、全て我らの糧とせん」: Your deaths and your suffering/　shall all become our sustenance.
BMD\t「貴様達の希望とするもの全て……/ この俺が打ち砕く！」: Everything you place your hopes in.../　I will crush it all!
BMD\t「恐怖の中で死ぬがいい」: Die in the grip of terror.
BMD\t「貴様達に抗えるか、この“破滅”の力に」: Can you resist this power of "Ruin"?
BMD\t「貴様達の意思……この俺が叩き潰す！！」: Your will... I'll smash it to pieces!!
BMD\t「このアクイラが、お前達の命を打ち砕く！」: I, Aquila, will shatter your lives!
BMD\t「貴様達を待つのは、“破滅”の運命のみ……」: Only a fate of "Ruin" awaits you...
BMD\t「人間、お前のマシーンは目障りだ」: Human, your machine is an eyesore.
BMD\t「そのマシーン、システム……破壊する」: That machine and its system.../　I will destroy them.
BMD\t「人間……お前とそのマシーンは他と違うな」: Human... you and that machine/　are unlike the others.
BMD\t「人間であろうがなかろうが、/ “破滅”の運命からは逃れられん」: Human or not, none can escape/　the fate of "Ruin".
BMD\t「お前も人間と共に滅びろ」: You too shall perish with the humans.
BMD\t「容赦はせん。人間と運命を共にしろ」: No mercy. Share the fate of the humans.
BMD\t「面白い。この俺の攻撃が、受けられるか」: Interesting. Can you take my attack?
BMD\t「ふふふ……/ 貴様達は、いずれ絶望に辿り着く……！」: Heh heh heh.../　In the end, you will all reach despair...!
BMD\t「変わらんぞ、貴様達の運命はな……！」: Your fate won't change... not one bit...!
BMD\t「ぬう……この俺相手に、ここまでやるとはな」: Ngh... To push me this far...
BMD\t「貴様達がその憎悪を糧に戦う限り、/ 我らには勝てぬ……！」: So long as you fight fueled by hatred,/　you can never defeat us...!
BMD\t「くっ、なおもこれほどの力があるか……！」: Ngh, you still have this much power...!
BMD\t「ふふふ……/ よかろう、全力で打ち砕いてやる！」: Heh heh heh.../　Very well, I'll crush you at full power!
BMD\t「面白い……/ どこまで抗えるか、この俺に見せてみろ！」: Interesting.../　Show me how long you can resist me!
BMD\t「これが“破滅”に抗うお前達の力か……」: So this is your power to defy "Ruin"...
BMD\t「お前達にある希望……全て叩き潰してくれる」: Every hope you hold.../　I will crush it all.
BMD\t「当てるだけでは、どうにもならん」: Merely hitting me won't change a thing.
BMD\t「そうだ……/ もっとあがけ、あがいてみせろ」: Yes.../　Struggle more. Show me your struggle.
BMD\t「“破滅”の運命には、抗えぬぞ」: You cannot defy the fate of "Ruin".
BMD\t「見えるぞ……貴様達の恐怖が」: I can see it... your fear.
BMD\t「無駄を繰り返し、絶望に辿り着くがよい」: Keep repeating your futile efforts/　until you reach despair.
BMD\t「ふん、それでこの俺を倒すつもりか」: Hmph, you think that will defeat me?
BMD\t「ふん、戦いが長引き過ぎたか」: Hmph, this battle has gone on too long.
BMD\t「お前の恐怖……俺には見えるぞ」: Your fear... I can see it.
BMD\t「さらなる恐怖を与えてやる」: Let me show you greater terror.
BMD\t「お前の苦しみは、まだ終わらん」: Your suffering is not over yet.
BMD\t「さあ、怒りと憎しみを込めて！」: Now, with all your anger and hatred!
BMD\t「このフォルティス・アーラが、/ 貴様達を屠る！」: This Fortis Ala/　shall slaughter you all!
BMD\t「さあ、受け入れよ！ “破滅”の運命を！」: Now, accept it! The fate of "Ruin"!
BMD\t「さあ、憎悪と共に心へ刻め！」: Now, carve it into your hearts/　along with your hatred!
LDBI\t「積年の我が疑問！@ 今こそ、その全てを解き明かす時だ！！」: My long-held questions! Now is the time@to unravel every last one of them!!
LDBI\t「ダークブレインを倒した後で@ ショウコ達が落ちた境界に似てる……？: Isn't this like the boundary Shoko and the@others fell into after Dark Brain was beaten...?
LDBI\t「南極にあったはずなのに！」: But it was supposed to be in Antarctica!
LDBI\t「つーか、俺達はいつクロスゲートの中に@ 入ったんでえ！？」: Wait, when the heck did we end up@inside the Cross Gate?!
LDBI\t「ガンエデンは！ イルイはどうなったの！？」: What about Gan Eden?! What happened to Irui?!
LDBI\t「ま、まさか、ＡＩ１に取り込まれたの！？」: D-Don't tell me AI1 absorbed them?!
LDBI\t「その通り。@ 我が主、アルテウル様は本懐を遂げられた」: Precisely.@My master, Lord Arteur, has fulfilled his@long-cherished wish.
LDBI\t「フン、アルテウル様の世界に@ お前達が紛れ込んでいるとはな」: Hmph. So you lot have strayed into@Lord Arteur's world.
LDBI\t「答えろ！ あいつは何をやったんだ！？」: Answer me! What did he do?!
LDBI\t「ククク……@ 祝福する者は、多ければ多いほどいいか」: Heh heh heh...@I suppose the more there are to bless this,@the better.
LDBI\t「そうだ！@ お前達も祝え！ 新たな神の誕生を！！」: Indeed!@You too shall bless it! The birth of a new god!!
LDBI\t「……失われた記憶の輪が……@ 虚憶の欠片がつながっていく……@ 我: ...The ring of lost memories...@The fragments of false memory are connecting...@My nephesh takes its true form...
LDBI\t「理解した……我が何処より来たか……@ 何者であったか……」: I understand... whence I came...@what I once was...
LDBI\t「ゼルファート……ズフィルード……ゼスト……@ ジュデッカ……それら: Zelfirt... Zfylud... Zest...@Judecca... Having passed through them all...
LDBI\t「新たなアダムであり、メタトロン……@ すなわち、“アダマトロン”が: As the new Adam, and Metatron...@that is, "Adamatron" shall be my true body.
LDBI\t「禍々しい姿……邪神そのものだな」: What a sinister form... An evil god incarnate.
LDBI\t「ガンエデンのボディにＡＩ１……@ それに、頭の上に浮かんでるのは！: Gan Eden's body with AI1...@And that thing floating above its head!
LDBI\t「まさか、クロスゲート……！？」: Don't tell me... the Cross Gate...?!
LDBI\t「なら、下にあるのは何なんだよ！？」: Then what the heck's that below us?!
LDBI\t「あれは別のゲートの出口だ。@ その先に何があるのかはわからん」: That is the exit of another gate.@What lies beyond it, I cannot say.
LDBI\t「ど、どうなってんだよ、いったい！？」: Wh-What the heck is going on here?!
LDBI\t「何故、アルテウルがクロスゲートを……！？」: Why would Arteur have the Cross Gate...?!
LDBI\t「我が名はユーゼス……ユーゼス・ゴッツォ」: My name is Euzeth... Euzeth Gozzo.
LDBI\t「あ、あの仮面……見覚えが……！？」: Th-That mask... I've seen it before...?!
LDBI\t「ゴッツォ……！？ 聞き覚えがあるぞ！@ 確か、イングラム教官が言っ: Gozzo...?! I've heard that name!@Instructor Ingram mentioned it!
LDBI\t「もしや、あの男が私とイングラムの……！？」: Could that man be the one who made@Ingram and me...?!
LDBI\t「フフッ、ようやく気づいたか、ヴィレッタ。@ いや、ヴェート・バルシ: Heh, so you've finally realized it, Viletta.@No... Vete Balshem.
LDBI\t「それとも、お姉様とでも呼んでやろうか？」: Or shall I call you 'big sister'?
LDBI\t「ああ。帝国繁栄のため、ゴッツォの先遣りたりて@ 礎となるが我らバル: Yes. To serve as Gozzo's vanguard and lay the@foundation for the Empire's prosperity--that is@the purpose of us Balshem, our reason to exist.
LDBI\t「帝国……？@ なるほど、見えてきたぜ。てめえらの正体が」: The Empire...?@Now I see what you bastards really are.
LDBI\t「バルマー……ゼ・バルマリィ帝国監察軍だな」: Balmar... You're the Ze Balmary Empire's@Inspection Army.
LDBI\t「そうだ、ゾヴォークの者よ」: That's right, one of the Zovorg.
LDBI\t「バ、バルマーちゅうんは何やねん！？」: Wh-What in the world's a Balmar?!
LDBI\t「<エアロゲイター>と言えば、お前にもわかるだろう」: You'd know them as the <エアロゲイター>.
LDBI\t「なら、アルテウルは地球人じゃなく……！」: Then Arteur isn't from Earth, he's...!
LDBI\t「そ、それが連邦政府の中枢にいたって言うの！？」: A-And you're saying he was at the core@of the Federation government?!
LDBI\t「その通りだ、地球人共よ。お前達の統治府は、@ 知らぬ間に……グライ: Precisely, Earthlings. Unbeknownst to you...@unnoticed even by Graien Grassman, your@government was being devoured by our Empire.
LDBI\t「そして、ガイアセイバーズは、@ 地球戦力でありながら、その尖兵とな: And the Gaia Savers, though an Earth force,@had become its vanguard--without even its own@members knowing.
LDBI\t「全ては、アルテウル様の計画を遂行し、@ 成就させるために！ 我がゼ: All to carry out Lord Arteur's plan and@bring it to fruition! All for the prosperity@of our Ze Balmary Empire!
LDBI\t「愚帝、ゴッツォ……帝国に関わる者は、@ 全て我が焼滅させる。そして: The foolish emperor, the Gozzo... all who are@tied to the Empire, I shall incinerate.@And as for you, Amala...
LDBI\t「我が尖兵となり、任務を果たした功績に報いよう。@ 帝国ではなく、創: You served as my vanguard and fulfilled your@mission; I shall reward that. Offer yourself not@to the Empire, but to me, your creator.
LDBI\t「私は！ 生きて、あなたのためにと！」: I wanted to live! To serve you!
LDBI\t「我と一体になるのだ。享受せよ」: You shall become one with me. Accept it.
LDBI\t「そ、そう言って、私を捨てるのですか！？」: A-And with those words, you discard me?!
LDBI\t神聖ラングラン王国 ラングラン州 ガジェッタ山: Holy Kingdom of Langran, Langran Province@Mt. Gajetta
LDBI\t「艦長、合流ポイントに到着しました」: Captain, we've reached the rendezvous point.
LDBI\t「では、俺とヴィレッタ大尉、マサキ達で@ フェイルロード殿下に会って: Then Captain Viletta, Masaki's group, and I@will go meet with Prince Feilroad.
LDBI\t「各員は第二種戦闘配置のまま待機。@ 対空対地警戒を厳となせ」: All hands, remain at level-two battle stations.@Keep a strict watch on air and ground.
LDBI\t「……やれやれ、ようやく殿下に会えたぜ」: ...Jeez, I finally get to see the prince.
LDBI\t「マサキ、ご苦労だった。@ それに、地上の方々にもご尽力いただき、@: Masaki, thank you for your hard work.@And to our friends from the surface, I cannot@express my gratitude enough for your efforts.
LDBI\t「これまでの通信での無礼をお許し下さい。@ 殿下のご尊顔を拝謁し……: Please forgive our rudeness in our previous@transmissions. It is an honor to stand before@Your Highness...
LDBI\t「あ、いや、そのままで結構です。@ 私も堅苦しいのは好きじゃありませ: Ah, no, there's no need for that.@I'm not fond of formalities myself.
LDBI\t「では、殿下……@ いくつかお聞きしたいことがあるのですが、@ よろ: Then, Your Highness...@There are a few things I'd like to ask you,@if you don't mind.
LDBI\t「地上人召喚事件の原因について、@ 判明したことはありますか？」: Have you learned anything about what caused@the summoning of people from the surface?
LDBI\t「……それについては、依然調査中です。@ ただ、各所でのゲートの発生: ...That is still under investigation.@However, the gates that have been appearing@in various places seem to be subsiding.
LDBI\t「ならば、この世界へ来ていると思われる@ 鋼龍戦隊旗艦ヒリュウ改の消: Then, do you know anything about the Steel@Dragons' flagship, the Hiryu Custom, which we@believe came here, or about our other members?
LDBI\t「それに関する情報も掴めておらず……@ シュテドニアス軍のこともあり: We have no information on that either...@And with the Schtedonias Army to deal with, a@proper search is impossible. It pains me deeply.
LDBI\t「……ラングランの事情は理解しているつもりです。@ ですが、我々には: ...I believe I understand Langran's situation.@But we have our own duties on the surface,@and we can't stay here indefinitely...
LDBI\t「わかっています。@ 事が収まり次第、あなた方の同胞の捜索や、@ 地: I understand. Once matters settle, we will@search for your comrades and make preparations@for your return to the surface.

LDBI\t「何故、こんな所に１機だけで……？」: Why is it out here all by itself...?
LDBI\t「もしかして、@ 次元断層の消滅と何か関係があるんじゃ……」: Could this have something to do with@the dimensional rift disappearing...?
LDBI\t「ともかく、ブランシュネージュの回収を。@ それと、アヅキ……ヒリュ: Anyway, recover the Blanche Neige.@And Azuki... try to make contact@with the Hiryu Custom.
LDBI\t「はい……@ ハガネの皆さんも無事で良かったです……」: Yes...@I'm glad everyone on the Hagane is safe, too...
LDBI\t「我々は次元断層の外へ……@ 地球が消失した宇宙へ放り出されてな」: We were thrown out of the dimensional rift...@into Space, with the Earth gone.
LDBI\t「その後、ガイアセイバーズの追撃を受け、@ 月へ侵攻を開始したゲスト: Then, pursued by the Gaia Savers, we fought@the Guests, who'd begun invading the Moon.
LDBI\t「じゃ、じゃあ、今、月は……！？」: Th-Then what's happening on the Moon now!?
LDBI\t「宇宙軍とゲストが交戦中だ。@ また、ルイーナも宇宙へ現れ、@ ヘブ: The Space Force is fighting the Guests.@The Ruina have also appeared in Space@and seized Heaven Gate.
LDBI\t「でも、ゲストがヘブンゲートを襲撃して……@ メリオルエッセは地球方: But then the Guests attacked Heaven Gate...@and the Melior Esse broke off toward Earth.
LDBI\t「それで、私達は彼らを追い、@ 北極上空付近で戦っている時に@ さっ: So we went after them,@and we were fighting above the North Pole@when what you just saw happened.
LDBI\t「いったい、地上で何があった？ 説明してくれ」: What exactly happened on the surface? Tell us.
LDBI\t「アートルム・エクステリオル……次元断層のせいで@ 太陽や星の光が遮: Atrum Exterior... The dimensional rift blocked@the light of the sun and stars, and the world@was shut away in darkness.
LDBI\t「私達は連邦軍やガイアセイバーズに追われ、@ ルイーナと戦って……」: We were chased by the Federation Army and@the Gaia Savers, and fought the Ruina...
LDBI\t「その中でお兄ちゃんがグラキエースと@ 精神をリンクさせてしまって…: And during all that, my brother ended up@linking minds with Glacies...
LDBI\t「女性のメリオルエッセです……。@ お兄ちゃんはシュンパティアを通じ: She's a female Melior Esse...@Through the Sympathia, my brother@saw into her heart...
LDBI\t「……<Ｔ‐ＬＩＮＫシステム>による@ 念の相互感知と似ているわね」: ...That's similar to the mutual psychic@sensing of the <Ｔ‐ＬＩＮＫシステム>.
LDBI\t「でも、ジョッシュに念の力はないのに……。@ リム、あなたはどうだっ: But Josh doesn't have any psychic power...@Rim, what about you?
LDBI\t「私は……他のメリオルエッセと戦った時と@ そう変わりがなくて……」: Me... It wasn't that different from@when I fought the other Melior Esse...
LDBI\t「それで、ルイーナが北極の北磁軸極に@ セプテンプルム……結界を張っ: Then we learned that the Ruina had put up@a barrier... the Septemplum... over the@geomagnetic north pole in the Arctic...
LDBI\t「もしや、そのセプテンプルムとやらが@ 次元断層の出入り口だったのか: Could this Septemplum have been the@gateway to the dimensional rift?
LDBI\t「それはわかりませんが、@ セプテンプルムはアートルム・エクステリオ: I don't know about that, but@Ventus said the Septemplum was there@to sustain Atrum Exterior...
LDBI\t「ウェントス……それもメリオルエッセなの？」: Ventus... Is that another Melior Esse?
LDBI\t「私達だけじゃなく、連邦軍やガイアセイバーズも……@ ルイーナの軍勢: Not just us--the Federation Army and Gaia@Savers too... We knew the Ruina's forces@were gathering around it...
LDBI\t「それで……次元断層が消滅した理由は？」: And... why did the dimensional rift vanish?
LDBI\t「お兄ちゃんとグラキエースがそうだったように……@ 私もシュンパティ: Just like my brother and Glacies...@I ended up linking with Ventus@through the Sympathia...
LDBI\t「私はセプテンプルムの中に引き込まれて……@ 外へ弾き飛ばされ……ウ: I was pulled into the Septemplum...@then flung back out... and then Ventus...@with Atrum Exterior...
LDBI\t「わ、私にも訳がわからなくて……@ 気づいたら、宇宙に……そして、地: I-I don't understand it either...@Then I was in Space... and I could see Earth...
LDBI\t「あれが何だったのか、私には……。@ ウェントスは私を見て……私が…: I don't know what that was...@Ventus looked at me... and I...
LDBI\t（で、でも、ウェントスは@ 私達が二人いるって気づいた……）: (B-But Ventus realized@　there are two of us...)
BMD\t「奴の間合いは、俺の間合いでもある！」: His range is my range too!
BMD\t「試作機とは言え、敵ならば遠慮はせんぞ！」: Prototype or not,/　I won't go easy on an enemy!
BMD\t「少佐は本当に/ あの機体を制御できているのか！？」: Is the Major really/　in control of that machine!?
BMD\t「各機、メディウス・ロクスを止めるぞ！」: All units, stop the Medius Locus!
BMD\t「フン、名前と機体を変えたところで！」: Hmph, new name, new machine--/　it changes nothing!
BMD\t「黒い凶鳥……奴だけは！」: The black bird of ill omen.../　That one, at least, goes down!
BMD\t「今度は貴様が狩られる番だ！」: Now it's your turn to be hunted!
BMD\t「あれが完全無欠の兵器などと！」: That thing, a flawless weapon? Hardly!
BMD\t「あれには、/ アルベロ少佐がいるのか……！？」: Is Major Albero/　really in that thing...!?
BMD\t「ＭＯＤＥＬ‐Ｘ……/ 打ち崩す隙はあるはずだ！」: MODEL-X.../　There has to be an opening!
BMD\t「ＡＩ１そのものだと言うのか、あれは……！」: Are you saying that thing/　is AI1 itself...!?
BMD\t「あんなものが、全てを取り込むなどと！」: As if that thing/　could absorb everything!
BMD\t「フッ、/ 正面から打ち合い甲斐のある奴だな！」: Heh,/　a worthy foe to trade blows with head-on!
BMD\t「奴の刀の間合いに気をつけねばな……！」: I must watch out/　for the reach of his sword...!
BMD\t「まずは奴のガードを打ち崩す！」: First, I'll break down his Guard!
BMD\t「フン、いい面構えの超機人だな！」: Hmph, a Choukijin with a fine look to it!
BMD\t「四凶の超機人と言えども！」: Choukijin of the Four Evils or not!
BMD\t「連中が/ 俺達の前に立ちはだかるのであれば！」: If they mean to/　stand in our way, so be it!
BMD\t「相手が神魔であろうとも、/ この拳で戦ってみせる！」: Even against gods and demons,/　I'll fight with these fists!
BMD\t「各機！ ガンエデンの結界を消し去るぞ！」: All units! Let's wipe out/　Gan Eden's barrier!
BMD\t「ユーゼス！/ お前が行き着く未来は、ただ一つだ！」: Euzeth!/　There's only one future waiting for you!
BMD\t「ルイーナめ、これ以上はやらせんぞ！」: Ruina, I won't let you go any further!
BMD\t「貴様らが何度地球圏に現れようとも！」: No matter how many times/　you come to the Earth Sphere!
BMD\t「奴らが妖機人だとしたら、/ 何故ここに……！？」: If those are Yokijin,/　what are they doing here...!?
BMD\t「化け物との戦いは、/ アインストで慣れているのでな！」: I'm used to fighting monsters,/　thanks to the Einst!
BMD\t「化け物共の好きにはやらせん！」: I won't let these monsters run wild!
BMD\t「油断したな……！ 逃がさん！」: You got careless...!/　You're not getting away!
BMD\t「すまん！ 後は頼むぞ！」: Sorry! I'm leaving the rest to you!
BMD\t「ぐっ！ さすがにこれは……！！」: Ngh! This is too much, even for me...!!
BMD\t「ふん、とどめを刺し損ねたな！」: Hmph, you failed to finish me off!
BMD\t「詰めの甘さは命取りになる！」: A sloppy finish can cost you your life!
BMD\t「こ、ここで引退する気などない！」: I-I have no intention of retiring here!
BMD\t「ぐうっ！ 直撃を受けるとは！！」: Guh! To take a direct hit!!
BMD\t「ええい、これでは教導隊の名が泣くわ！」: Blast it, I'm shaming/　the Instructors' name!
BMD\t「手を緩める気は/ さらさらないということだな」: So you have no intention/　of letting up at all.
BMD\t「こ、これが“破滅の王”の力か……！」: S-So this is the power/　of the "King of Ruin"...!
BMD\t「ガイアセイバーズに屈するものか！」: As if I'd yield to the Gaia Savers!
BMD\t「貴様には負けられんのだよ！」: I can't afford to lose to you!
BMD\t「ええい、早く雷鳳を止めねば！」: Blast it, I have to stop the RaiOh fast!
BMD\t「ぐっ！ 無人機ならではの反応速度か！」: Ngh! That's an unmanned unit's/　reaction speed for you!
BMD\t「フッ、技の切れはさすがだと言っておこう」: Heh, I'll admit your technique is sharp.
BMD\t「メディウス……/ さっきよりも反応が鈍いぞ！」: Medius.../　You're reacting slower than before!
BMD\t「向こうは手練れ……油断は出来ん！」: He's a seasoned fighter.../　I can't let my guard down!
BMD\t「クククッ、行くぞ」: Heh heh heh. Here I come.
BMD\t「メリオルエッセ・コンターギオが/ お前達に死を与える」: I, Meliolesse Contagio,/　shall grant you all death.
BMD\t「ククククッ、私が相手をしよう」: Heh heh heh. I shall be your opponent.
BMD\t「感じるぞ、お前達の憎しみを……！」: I can feel it... your hatred...!
BMD\t「ここがお前達の墓場となるのだ」: This place shall become your grave.
BMD\t「ククククッ、我らの力の前に滅びるがいい」: Heh heh heh. Perish before our power.
BMD\t「恐怖の中で死ぬがいい。クククッ！」: Die in terror. Heh heh heh!
BMD\t「暗黒の世界へと消えるがいい！」: Vanish into the world of darkness!
BMD\t「止められぬ悔いの中で、/ 絶望に包まれるがいい」: Amid regrets you cannot stop,/　let despair engulf you.
BMD\t「人間、お前がそのマシーンで/ 何をしようと無駄なこと」: Human, whatever you do in that machine,/　it is all in vain.
BMD\t「お前のマシーンは面白いな、ククククッ」: Your machine is interesting. Heh heh heh.
BMD\t「我らと縁があるようだが……/ 糧になってもらうぞ」: You seem to share a bond with us.../　but you shall become our sustenance.
BMD\t「あのマシーン……/ まあよい、ここで滅ぼすだけのこと」: That machine.../　No matter. It shall simply perish here.
BMD\t「お前のその情熱は、恐怖に転じることになる」: That passion of yours will turn to fear.
BMD\t「クククッ、気が済むまで吠えるがいい」: Heh heh heh. Howl all you like.
BMD\t「その熱き波動は、絶望で彩られることになる」: Despair will color those fiery waves.
BMD\t「その顔は、恐怖で歪むことになる」: That face of yours will twist in terror.
BMD\t「ククククッ、その余裕がどこまでもつかな」: Heh heh heh./　How long will that composure last?
BMD\t「さあ、憎しみと怒りを表に出すがいい」: Come, let your hatred and rage show.
BMD\t「ククククッ、/ 人間であろうとなかろうと結果は同じだ」: Heh heh heh./　Human or not, the result is the same.
BMD\t「他とは違うか。/ だが、ここで消失することに変わりはない」: So you're different from the others./　Even so, you will still vanish here.
BMD\t「グラキエース……壊れた貴様に用はない」: Glacies... I have no further use/　for a broken thing like you.
BMD\t「クククッ、壊れたか、グラキエース」: Heh heh heh. So you've broken, Glacies.
BMD\t「では、欠陥体を始末しよう」: Then I shall dispose of the defective one.
BMD\t「ククククッ、出来損ないに何が出来る」: Heh heh heh./　What can a failure like you do?
BMD\t「今度は私から行くぞ」: This time, I'll come at you.
BMD\t「ククククッ……/ お前にかわせるか、私の攻撃が！」: Heh heh heh.../　Can you dodge my attack?!
BMD\t「宴はまだ終わらない」: The feast is not over yet.
BMD\t「私が墜ちるか……ククククッ、なるほど」: I am falling...? Heh heh heh. I see.
BMD\t「クククッ、このようなことも起きるか」: Heh heh heh. So even this can happen.
BMD\t「この私が……ククククッ、そうか」: I, of all beings... Heh heh heh. I see.
BMD\t「感じる……感じるぞ、/ お前達の負の感情を……！」: I can feel it... I can feel it,/　your negative emotions...!
BMD\t「クククッ、この力……/ そうか、そういうことか……！」: Heh heh heh. This power.../　I see... So that's how it is...!
BMD\t「ぬううっ！ 信じられぬが、/ 直撃を受けたのか……！？」: Nngh! I can't believe it.../　Did a Pierce attack get through?!
BMD\t「あのシステムが、/ 人間に力を与えているのか……！？」: Is that system/　giving the human power...?!
BMD\t「グラキエース、よくもこの私に……！」: Glacies, how dare you do this to me...!
BMD\t「クククッ、まだだ。まだ足りぬよ」: Heh heh heh. Not yet. It is not enough.
BMD\t「これで私を倒せると思っているのか？」: You think this is enough to defeat me?
BMD\t「無駄なことだ……“破滅の王”には抗えぬ」: It is futile.../　None can resist the "King of Ruin."
BMD\t「そうだ……もっとあがけ。命ある限り」: Yes... struggle more./　For as long as you live.
BMD\t「負の感情が増しているな……ククククッ」: The negative emotions are growing.../　Heh heh heh.
BMD\t「やるな、人間。興味が増してきたぞ」: Not bad, human. My interest grows.
BMD\t「やるな、グラキエース。だが、私は倒せぬぞ」: Not bad, Glacies./　But you cannot defeat me.
BMD\t「ちっ、欠陥体ごときに……！」: Tch! Bested by a mere defective...!
BMD\t「クククッ、無駄無駄。無駄なこと」: Heh heh heh./　Futile, futile. Utterly futile.
BMD\t「怒りと憎しみが足りぬなぁ」: Your anger and hatred are lacking...
BMD\t「憎め、私をもっと憎むのだ」: Hate me. Hate me even more.
BMD\t「ククククッ、遠慮はいらぬぞ」: Heh heh heh. Don't hold back.
LDBI\t「アンノウン群、急速接近！@ レンジ２まで食い込んで来ます！」: Unknown group closing fast!@They've pushed in to Range 2!
LDBI\t「レフィーナ大佐、我らも出撃します」: Colonel Lefina, we'll sortie as well.
LDBI\t「我が隊と途中合流してから@ さほど時間が経っていませんが、大丈夫で: You only joined up with us a short while ago.@Are you sure you're up to it?
LDBI\t「ええ、戦力の出し惜しみをしている場合では@ ないでしょう」: Yes. This is no time to be holding back@our forces.
LDBI\t「では、お願いします」: Then I'll leave it to you.
LDBI\t「さっきのと違うタイプが多いわ……！」: Most of these are a different type...!
LDBI\t「生物じゃなく、機械兵器だな。@ ああいうのもいるのか」: Those aren't living things, they're machines.@So there are ones like that, too.
LDBI\t「アインストじゃなく、@ エアロゲイターに近い連中なのか……？」: Not the Einst...@Are they closer to the Aerogators...?
LDBI\t「強い気塊に引かれて来てみれば……なるほど。@ ウンブラが言っていた: I followed a strong aura here... I see.@It seems the one Umbra spoke of is here too.
LDBI\t「ア、アニキ、また声が聞こえる……！@ 南極の時とは別の……！」: B-Brother, I hear a voice again...!@Not the same one as at the South Pole...!
LDBI\t「そっちもか。@ くっ、いったい何だって言うんだ……！？」: You too?@Dammit, what the hell is going on...!?
LDBI\t（また声が聞こえる……@ 南極で聞いたのとは違うが……！）: (I'm hearing a voice again...@Not the one I heard at the South Pole, but...!)
LDBI\t（それに、シュンパティアの調子もおかしい……@ くっ、いったい何だっ: (And the Sympathia's acting strange too...@Dammit, what the hell is going on...!?)
LDBI\t（リ、リアナ……また声が聞こえる……！@ 南極で聞いたのと違うみたい: (R-Riana... I hear a voice again...!@It's not the one we heard at the South Pole...)
LDBI\t（それに、シュンパティアの調子も変……@ どうしたの、この子……！？: (And the Sympathia's acting weird too...@What's wrong with it...!?)
LDBI\t「ヒューゴ少尉、奴らが南極から現れた連中か？」: Lieutenant Hugo, are those the ones that@came out of the South Pole?
LDBI\t「ええ。@ ジョッシュによれば、ルイーナと名乗ったそうです」: Yes.@According to Josh, they called themselves Ruina.
LDBI\t「ということは、乗ってるのは人間なのかしらん？」: Sooo, does that mean there are people inside?
LDBI\t「わかりません。@ 南極で人影のようなものは見ましたが、@ あれが人: I don't know.@I saw a humanlike figure at the South Pole,@but whether it was really human...
LDBI\t「それよか、@ あんな連中が南極のどこにいたってんだ？」: More importantly,@where at the South Pole were those guys hiding?
LDBI\t「艦長、前方のアンノウンから通信が！」: Captain, transmission from the unknown ahead!
LDBI\t「いえ、通常電波を用いた全方位通信です！」: No, it's an omnidirectional broadcast on@normal frequencies!
LDBI\t（！ 今度は普通に声が聞こえる……！）: (! This time I can hear a normal voice...!)
LDBI\t「人間……それも、ゴリマッチョ！」: A human... and a total muscle-bound brute!
LDBI\t「あらら、意外な組み合わせで。@ マシンの方は割とスマートなのにねぇ: Oh my, what an unexpected combo.@And his machine's so sleek, too.
LDBI\t「見た目はともかく、@ 意志の疎通は出来るみたいですね……」: Looks aside,@it seems we can communicate with him...
LDBI\t「奴の言っていることが@ 理解できるかどうかはわからんがな」: Whether we can understand what he's saying@is another matter.
LDBI\t「人間達よ、新たな知識を得よ。@ 我らは“破滅”をその名に持つ者にし: Humans, gain new knowledge.@We bear "Ruin" as our very name, bringing@despair to all... and then destruction.
LDBI\t「あたしらをぶっ潰すってか。@ 初っ端からわかりやすい目的で助かるぜ: So you're gonna crush us, huh?@Nice of you to make your goal so damn clear!
LDBI\t「助かる……？ ふむ、面白い。@ 我が姿を見ても畏怖せず、そのような: Nice...? Hmm, interesting.@You show no awe at my form, and yet speak@such words.
LDBI\t「余裕見せてんじゃねえぞ、ハゲ！@ それとも、てめえも剃ってんのか！: Don't get cocky, baldy!@Or do you shave it too!?
LDBI\t「……向こうの方が理解できていないか」: ...Seems he's the one who can't understand.
LDBI\t「さすが、カチーナ中尉と言うか、何て言うか」: That's Lieutenant Katina for ya... I guess?
LDBI\t「おい、ハゲ！@ てめえにも名があるんなら、名乗りやがれ！」: Hey, baldy!@If you've got a name, spit it out!
LDBI\t「俺はメリオルエッセ……@ 破滅の軍勢を指揮する者の一人、アクイラ」: I am a Melioresse...@Aquila, a commander of the armies of ruin.
LDBI\t「指揮官はお前だけではないということか」: So you're not the only commander.
LDBI\t「そうだ。@ “破滅の王”によって５人のメリオルエッセが@ 生まれ、: Yes.@The "King of Ruin" created five Melioresse,@and each was granted power and a vessel.
LDBI\t（それじゃ、@ まるで私やティス、ラリアーのような……）: (Then they're@just like me, Tis, and Lalia...)
LDBI\t「“破滅の王”……そいつが大ボスってわけか！」: The "King of Ruin"... So he's the big boss!
LDBI\t「我らルイーナ……メリオルエッセが操る@ ミーレス達によって世界は絶: By the Miles we Melioresse of Ruina command,@the world will be shrouded in despair, and you@shall perish within it.
LDBI\t「絶望の果てに滅びを与える、か。@ それが果たせるか否か、我が剣に問: Doom at the end of despair, you say.@Whether you can do it... put it to my sword!
LDBI\t「その意志、人が力の糧とするもの……@ 人が拠り所とするものか。@: That will... what humans turn into strength,@what they rely upon.@Then show me your power.
LDBI\t「言われるまでもねえ！」: Don't need to tell me twice!
LDBI\t「エレーブ１から各機！ 攻撃を開始せよ！」: Eleve 1 to all units! Commence attack!
LDBI\t「……なるほど、強い意志に相応しい力だ。@ そう簡単に恐怖や絶望には: ...I see, power befitting a strong will.@Fear and despair won't color you so easily.
LDBI\t「だが、お前達が我らを憎悪し、@ 我らに対して恐怖を抱けば……@ そ: But should you hate us,@and come to fear us...@those emotions--that negative wave--nourish us.
LDBI\t「糧……？ どういうことだ？@ それに、“破滅の王”とは何だ！？」: Nourish? What do you mean?@And what is this "King of Ruin"!?

LDBI\t「その悪逆魔道、ここで断つ！」: I shall sever your evil path here and now!
LDBI\t「こ、これからなんだよ、あたしは！@ あいつらを倒して、名を売って！: Th-This is just the beginning for me!@I'm gonna beat them and make a name for myself!!
LDBI\t「死んでたまるか、死んで！@ そうさ、ブーステッド・チルドレンは@: Like hell I'm gonna die!@That's right, Boosted Children are known@for being tough to kill!
LDBI\t「逃げ切ってやる、逃げ切って……！」: I'll get away... I'll get away...!
LDBI\t「て、てめえら！ よくも、よくも！！」: Y-You bastards! How dare you, how dare you!!
LDBI\t「これは……さすがにどうでもよくないし……！」: This is... actually not okay for once...!
LDBI\t「ま、負け組は嫌だ！！@ 勝ち組になるんだよ、勝ち組にぃぃっ！！」: I-I don't wanna be a loser!!@I'm gonna be a winner, a winnerrrr!!
LDBI\t「そうだよ、ここを切り抜ければ、@ 必ず俺は勝ち組……！！」: That's right, if I make it through this,@I'm a winner for sure...!!
LDBI\t「こ、こんなの、こんなの聞いてないし！@ あり得ないし！！」: Th-This... Nobody told me about this!@This can't be happening!!
LDBI\t「こ、殺してやる！ @ お前らも！ お前らも殺してやるしぃぃぃ！！」: I-I'll kill you!@You! And you! I'll kill you allll!!
LDBI\t「くそっ！ てめえら！ てめえら、ぶっ殺す！！」: Damn it! You bastards! I'm gonna kill you all!!
LDBI\t「だから言ったんだ……ここから退けって……」: I told you... to back off from here...
LDBI\t「ぬうっ！ ぐっ！ 見事！@ だが、まだ俺の剣は……！！」: Nngh! Guh! Well done!@But my sword is not yet...!!
LDBI\t「血の滲むような修練の末、再テストに挑まれ、@ 見事合格された」: After grueling, bloody training, he retook@the test and passed with flying colors.
LDBI\t「その時からだ、殿下は力に対し@ コンプレックスを抱かれ始めた……」: It was from then on that His Highness began@to harbor a complex about power...
LDBI\t「それは、権力でも武力でも同じだ。@ フェイル殿下は力を追い求めてお: That goes for political and military power.@Prince Feil seeks power above all.
LDBI\t「すなわち、地上の技術と戦力を手に入れる……@ そのために今回の大量: In other words, to obtain the surface world's@technology and military strength... Couldn't@that be why he decided on this mass summoning?
LDBI\t「無論、断定は出来ん。@ だが、そうであれば、由々しきことだ」: Naturally, I can't say for certain.@But if it's true, it's a grave matter.
LDBI\t「地上人と兵器を大量に召喚するなど、@ この世界を混乱させるだけだか: Summoning surface dwellers and weapons en masse@will only throw this world into chaos.
LDBI\t「確かに……。@ 今回の召喚は意図的なものではなく、@ 事故だったの: Indeed...@This summoning was so chaotic, it almost seems@like an accident rather than something deliberate.
LDBI\t「殿下は目的のために手段を選ばぬ所がある。@ しかも、必要以上にな。: His Highness will stoop to any means to reach@his goals--and further than necessary. That's@why I'm uneasy. Should I really help him...?
LDBI\t「そして……正直に言えば、私とて野望はある。@ この混乱の中で、自分: And to be honest, I have ambitions too.@In this chaos, I want to test just how far@my own strength can take me.
LDBI\t「……なるほど、殿下に対する疑惑はわかりました。@ 今の所はあなたを: ...I see. I understand your doubts about him.@For now, I'll trust you.
LDBI\t「しかし、僕は魔装機神の操者です。@ もし、あなたが自分の野望に溺れ: But I am a Masoukishin pilot.@If you drown in your own ambitions and bring@chaos upon this world...
LDBI\t「わかっている。@ ……では、ヤンロン、私は本陣に戻る。@ 君はヒリ: I know.@...Now, Yang Long, I'll return to headquarters.@Stand by here with the Hiryu Custom.
LDBI\t「今後の作戦を練った後、改めて要請を出す」: Once we've worked out our next operation,@I'll send you a formal request.
BMD\t「上手く対応してみせろ」: Let's see you handle this well.
BMD\t「先が読みやすいモーションだ」: Your motions are easy to predict.
BMD\t「あがくがいい、このサイリオンの前で」: Struggle all you like before the Cylion.
BMD\t「サイリオンの真価を見せてやろう」: I'll show you the Cylion's true worth.
LDBI\t「メキボスの戯言を信じるな。@ あれを使えば、どういう罰を受けること: Don't believe Mekibos's ravings.@I know full well what punishment awaits@anyone who uses that.
LDBI\t「……ならば、召還命令を受け、@ 本国で申し開きをなさってはいかがで: ...Then why not accept the recall order@and plead your case before the homeland?
LDBI\t「フン、そんなことをすれば、@ 最悪の場合は消されかねんぞ。@ グロ: Hmph. Do that, and at worst,@they might well have me eliminated.@Just like Grovis Raclain.
LDBI\t「メキボスを倒した後で地球圏を制圧し、@ 猿共が独自に昇華させた軍事: After Mekibos falls, we seize the Earth Sphere@and take control of the military tech the apes@developed alone and the tech from other worlds.
LDBI\t「そうすれば、本国の連中の態度も変わる。@ 他星での利権や新技術に群: Then the homeland's attitude will change.@There's no shortage of those who swarm over@offworld interests and new technology.
LDBI\t「しかし、反逆者の烙印を押されては……」: But if we're branded as traitors...
LDBI\t「それは一時の問題だ。@ ここまでの功績を捨てて本国に戻り、断罪され: That's a passing issue.@Return home, abandon all I've achieved, and be@condemned... or carve my own path? It's obvious.
LDBI\t「……メキちゃんに恨みはな～いけど、@ 捨て駒にさ～れるのは御免だ～: ...I got no gruuudge against Meki,@but bein' a throwaway paaawn? No thaaanks.
LDBI\t「シャフラワース……いや、セティ。お前はどうだ？」: Shaflawers... no, Sety. What about you?
LDBI\t「……ロフを殺した者達を@ 許すわけにはいきません……」: ...I can't forgive the ones@who killed Rof...
LDBI\t「ならば、お前達はメキボスを迎え撃て。@ 私はバラン＝シュナイルを起: Then you two will intercept Mekibos.@I'll activate the Baran-Schneil.
LDBI\t「あれも投入するのですか？@ 後々の地球制圧作戦の切り札では……」: You're deploying that as well?@Wasn't it meant to be our trump card@for the later conquest of Earth...
LDBI\t「まずは、この戦いに勝利することが肝要だ。@ お前達の奮戦を期待して: First, winning this battle is what matters.@Hope for victory rests on your efforts.
LDBI\t（……フン、時期が早まっただけのことだ。@ 枢密院が動くとは思わなか: (...Hmph. It merely moves up the timetable.@I didn't expect the Privy Council to move...@but it's my chance to purge the opposition.)
LDBI\t（私を切り捨てようとした@ ゾガルの日和見主義の連中も同様だ……）: (The same goes for those fence-sitters in Zogal@who tried to cast me aside...)
LDBI\t（私が地球を掌握した後、@ 次にお前達がどのような顔で接触してくるか: (Once Earth is mine, I'll look forward to@seeing what faces you wear when you next@come to me...)
LDBI\t「テイニクェット・ゼゼーナンは@ 召還命令に応じるのでしょうか……？: Will Teinikuet Zezenan comply@with the recall order...?
LDBI\t「あの様子じゃ、駄目だな。@ おそらく、ロフを殺したのは奴だ。@ 口: Not the way he's acting. He won't.@Most likely he's the one who killed Rof.@To keep him quiet.
LDBI\t「迂闊だった……そこまで早く手を回すとは……。@ あいつを一人で行か: My mistake... I didn't think he'd act so fast...@I never should've let him go alone...
LDBI\t「ゾガルの者はゼゼーナンが命令に応じるよう@ 説得しないのか？」: Won't anyone in Zogal persuade Zezenan@to obey the order?
LDBI\t「本国じゃ、もうグランゾンの件が明らかになってる。@ ゾガルの連中は: The Granzon business is already out back home.@Zogal's lot are desperate to dodge the blame.
LDBI\t「例の物の仕込みはゼゼーナンが独断でやったこと……@ ま、これは事実: Planting that thing was Zezenan's own call...@which is true, mind you. They're pushing that@line to minimize the damage to their faction.
LDBI\t「つまり、彼は身内から切り捨てられたのか」: So his own people have cut him loose.
LDBI\t「ああ。@ ここでゼゼーナンを庇えば、もろともに@ 失脚する羽目にな: Yeah. If they cover for Zezenan now,@they'll go down with him.
LDBI\t「奴が地球遠征の全権を握り、本星にいないことを@ 逆手に取って、諸々: I'd say they're exploiting his absence from@the homeworld while he runs the Earth campaign,@pinning every responsibility and crime on him.
LDBI\t「むしろ、俺の手でゼゼーナンが倒されることを@ 望んでいる節もある。: If anything, it seems they want me to be the one@to take Zezenan down. Dead men tell no tales.
LDBI\t「ラ・ギアスと言い、ゾヴォークと言い……@ どこの世界でも似たような: Be it La Gias or the Zovorg...@every world seems to have@its share of similar squabbles.
LDBI\t「俺達の世界は星系単位じゃ@ まとまってるが……共和連合全体となると: Our world's united at the star-system level...@but the whole Republic Union is another story.
LDBI\t「で、ゼゼーナンはこれからどうする気なんだ？」: So what's Zezenan planning to do now?
LDBI\t「グランゾンの件が明るみに出た以上、@ 召還命令に応じて本星に戻った: Now that the Granzon thing's out, if he heeds@the recall and returns home, he's finished.
LDBI\t「奴は開き直って俺達を倒し、地球圏に居座る……@ そして、混乱に乗じ: He'll stop pretending, beat us, and dig in@here in the Earth Sphere... Then he'll use the@chaos to seize control.
LDBI\t「ルイーナやバラルの出現は予想外だったろうが……@ 今となっては、好: He couldn't have expected Ruina or Balar...@but now they're convenient. He'll size up the@situation, then make his move again.
LDBI\t「じゃあ、最初の降下作戦が失敗してから、@ 彼らが地球へあまり手を出: Then the reason they've hardly touched Earth@since the first descent operation failed...
LDBI\t「<アインスト>みたいな連中に対する警戒心はあるさ。@ かつての俺達: He's wary of the likes of the <アインスト>, sure.@They gave us a rough time once, too.
LDBI\t「だからこそ、ゼゼーナンは極力月から動かず、@ 地球軍とルイーナ、バ: That's exactly why Zezenan stayed on the Moon@as much as he could, watching how the fight@between Earth, Ruina, and Balar would play out.
LDBI\t「最後に立つ者が勝利を得る……それが狙いか」: The last one standing wins... That's his aim?
LDBI\t「だろうな。そして、その後で地球圏を掌握し、@ そこで得たものをゾヴ: Probably. Then he'd seize the Earth Sphere, sell@what he gains there to Zovorg war merchants, and@use them to pressure the Privy Council.
LDBI\t「まあ、それは奴の当初からの目的だとは思うがな」: Though I think that was his goal from the start.
LDBI\t「建前は銀河の秩序維持、@ 本音は金と権力の獲得ということか」: Officially, preserving galactic order.@In truth, grabbing money and power.
LDBI\t「やれやれ、俺達を下等生物だの猿だのと@ 言っておきながら、やってる: Geez, they call us lower life-forms and apes,@yet what they're doing is no different from@Earth's shady politicians.
LDBI\t「まったくです。@ 別の意味でゾヴォーク人に親近感が湧きますな」: Quite so.@I feel a certain kinship with the Zovorg,@in a rather different sense.
LDBI\t「……ゼゼーナンが逆ギレすんのがわかってんなら、@ 奴が悲鳴を上げる: ...If you knew Zezenan would flip out,@you shoulda brought an army big enough@to make him scream!
LDBI\t「こっちにも色々な事情があってな。@ 辺境の紛争に割ける戦力には限り: We've got our own situation to deal with.@There's only so much force we can spare for@a frontier squabble.
LDBI\t「辺境たあ言ってくれるじゃねえか。@ 問題を解決する気があるのかない: Frontier, huh? That's rich.@Do you wanna fix this or not?@Which is it?
LDBI\t「枢密院としては珍しく即決だったんだが……@ そんなことを言っても、: The Privy Council decided unusually fast...@but I doubt saying that'll satisfy you.
LDBI\t「ゼゼーナンに必殺の爆弾をブチ込んだ後なら、@ そうしてやってもいい: I might buy it after we shove a killer bomb@down Zezenan's throat.
LDBI\t「駄目よ、それではムーンクレイドルまで@ 破壊されてしまうことになる: No, that would end up destroying@Moon Cradle too.
LDBI\t「……メキボス、ゼゼーナンが月の住民を@ 人質にする可能性については: ...Mekibos, what about the possibility@of Zezenan taking the lunar residents hostage?
LDBI\t「一応、釘は刺しておいた。@ それに、奴は地球圏を自分の地盤にする@: I've warned him, at least.@Besides, he means to make the Earth Sphere@his own power base...
LDBI\t「民間人の虐殺なんぞをやって@ 地元の反感を不用意に煽ったら、後々で: He must know that massacring civilians would@needlessly stir up local resentment and come@back to bite him later.
LDBI\t「侵略を仕掛けてきた時点で、@ 反感もへったくれもねえだろうが」: You came here to invade us! Resentment's@a done deal already, dammit!
LDBI\t「その通りなんだが……@ 俺達は民間人に手を出すことを良しとしていな: True enough... but we don't approve@of laying hands on civilians.
LDBI\t「対抗軍事勢力は見せしめも兼ねて潰すが、@ 生産能力を有するものは極: Opposing military forces we crush, partly as@an example, but production capacity we preserve@as much as possible. What we can absorb, we do.
LDBI\t「智将は務めて敵に食む……孫子だっけか？@ 基本的にはそういうことだ: A wise general feeds off the enemy... Sun Tzu?@That's basically the idea.
LDBI\t「優れた将は、遠征においては@ 敵から食糧や兵器を調達するという意味: It means that on campaign, a skilled general@procures food and arms from the enemy.
LDBI\t「いや、民間人からの略奪や虐殺の類は避ける。@ 結果的に自分達の首を: No, we avoid looting and slaughtering civilians.@It'd only end up putting a noose on our necks.@A lesson from the Republic Union's long history.
LDBI\t「だから、俺達の軍勢はそのほとんどが@ 統制の利くバイオロイドで構成: That's why most of our forces are made up@of easily controlled Bioroids.
BMD\t「フリッケライより重いけど、/ 問題はありません」: Heavier than Flickerei, but/　no problem.
BMD\t「ドゥバン、あなたの思い通りにはなりません」: Duban, things won't go as you wish.
BMD\t「コンターギオ、その手には乗りません」: Contagio, I won't fall for that.
BMD\t「地球をあなた達の好きにはさせない」: You won't have your way with Earth.
BMD\t「ゼブ、その手は通用しません」: Zeb, that trick won't work on me.
BMD\t「セティ、あなたの的にはなりません」: Sety, I won't be your target.
BMD\t「孫光龍、あなたの戯言を聞く気はありません」: Sun Koryu, I have no interest in your/　nonsense.
BMD\t「大いなる破滅……必ず阻止します」: The Great Destruction... I will stop it.
BMD\t「あなた達は、/ あの男に利用されているだけ……」: You're only being used/　by that man...
BMD\t「ヒュッケバインを上回る動き……しかし」: It outmaneuvers a Hückebein... and yet.
BMD\t「ルイーナに足止めを食らうわけには/ いきません」: I can't afford to be held up/　by the Ruina.
BMD\t「デモンに足止めを食らうわけにはいきません」: I can't afford to be held up by Demons.
BMD\t「特異なモーションですが、見極めは可能です」: Unusual motions, but I can read them.
BMD\t「エルデ、/ あなたの望みを叶えるわけにはいきません」: Erde, I can't let you/　have what you want.
BMD\t「インスペクター戦のデータが応用できますね」: Our data on the Inspectors applies here.
BMD\t「反撃不能……間合いを取らなければ」: Can't counter... I need to open distance.
BMD\t「動かなければ、的にされる……」: If I don't move, I'll be a target...
BMD\t「正確に敵の動きを読まなければ……」: I must read the enemy precisely...
BMD\t「アリエイル・オーグ、/ バックアップに入ります」: Arieil Org,/　moving to back you up.
BMD\t「エクセレン少尉、後は私が」: Ensign Excellen, I'll take it from here.
BMD\t「クスハ少尉、後は任せて下さい」: Ensign Kusuha, leave the rest to me.
BMD\t「ラミア少尉の動き……合わせ易いです」: Ensign Lamia's moves are easy to match.
BMD\t「ゼオラ、後は私が」: Seolla, I'll take it from here.
BMD\t「アラド、まだ状況は終わっていませんよ」: Arado, the situation isn't over yet.
BMD\t「ラトゥーニ、後は私が」: Latune, I'll take it from here.
BMD\t「ジョッシュ、後は私が」: Josh, I'll take it from here.
BMD\t「リオ少尉、後は任せて下さい」: Ensign Rio, leave the rest to me.
BMD\t「そらそらそらぁーっ！！」: Take that, and that, and thaaat!!
BMD\t「大人しくくらいやがれっ！！」: Just sit still and take it!!
BMD\t「てめえは鯉だ、まな板の上のな！」: You're a fish on the chopping block!
BMD\t「ヘッ、いい武器積んでるぜ！」: Heh, this thing's packing some sweet gear!
BMD\t「今度の鉄拳も痛いぜぇ！」: This iron fist hurts just as much!
BMD\t「見せてやるぜ、超闘士の本気を！」: Behold a super fighter's true power!
BMD\t「さぁて、/ ブッちぎりで不幸な目に遭ってもらおうか」: All right, time for the worst luck/　of your life.
BMD\t「こいつはデカい砲台だ！ 行けぇ！！」: This is one big gun emplacement! Go!!
BMD\t「ドリル付きの方に乗ってりゃ良かったな！」: Shoulda ridden the one with the drill!
BMD\t「やっぱこれだぜ！/ ドリル・アタッカー！！」: This is what I'm talkin' about!/　Drill Attacker!!
BMD\t「連打もいいが、一発で決めるとするか！」: Rapid hits are fine,/　but let's end it in one shot!
BMD\t「そーら、ド正面から！」: Here it comes, right down the middle!
BMD\t「遠慮はしねえ！ 請求書は上に回す！！」: I'm not holding back!/　The brass can foot the bill!!
BMD\t「ヘッ、豪勢なミサイルだぜ、こいつはよ！」: Heh, now that's one deluxe Missile!
BMD\t「月のねえ晩は、頭の上に気を付けろよ！」: On moonless nights,/　watch the sky above you!
BMD\t「僕の邪魔をするな、エルデ・ミッテ！」: Don't get in my way, Erde Mitte!
BMD\t「エルデ・ミッテ……/ こちらも後には退けない……！」: Erde Mitte.../　I can't back down either...!
BMD\t「ＡＩ１……/ これ以上、進化などさせるものか……！」: AI1.../　I won't let you evolve any further...!
BMD\t「エグレッタ、/ 僕はここで終わるわけにはいかない……！」: Egretta,/　I can't let it end here...!
BMD\t「エグレッタ、/ お前がオリジネイターであろうと……！」: Egretta,/　even if you are an Originator...!
BMD\t「言ったはずだ……/ 僕とエグゼクスバインには勝てないと！」: I told you.../　you can't beat me and the Exexbein!
BMD\t「ここで……/ このエグゼクスバインで、/ お前との決着を付ける……！: Here.../　with this Exexbein,/　I'll settle things with you...!
BMD\t「雷鳳を止めなければ……！」: I have to stop the RaiOh...!
BMD\t「アーマラ、/ お前に狩られるわけにはいかない……！」: Amala,/　I won't let you hunt me down...!
BMD\t「アーマラ、/ お前は僕の何を知っている……！？」: Amala,/　what do you know about me...!?
BMD\t「アーマラ……/ 僕を狙う本当の理由は何だ！？」: Amala.../　what's your real reason for targeting me!?
BMD\t「ガリルナガン……/ 甦った凶鳥の力をお前に示す！」: Galilnagant.../　I'll show you the power/　of the reborn Bird of Ill Omen!
BMD\t「アーマラ、僕の行く手を阻むのならば……！」: Amala, if you stand in my way...!
BMD\t「記憶を失ったまま……/ このラ・ギアスで死ぬつもりはない！」: Without my memories.../　I don't intend to die here in La Gias!
BMD\t「魔装機相手でも、やってみせる」: Even against a Masouki, I can do this.
BMD\t「あんな物が存在するとは……」: I can't believe something like that exists...
BMD\t「あんなものが神だというのか……」: That thing is supposed to be a god...?
BMD\t「あれが/ 災いをもたらす存在だというのなら……！」: If that thing/　is a bringer of calamity...!
BMD\t「四凶の超機人……充分に警戒しなければ」: A Choukijin of the Four Fiends.../　I need to stay on my guard.
BMD\t「お前達の暴虐を止めてみせる……」: I'll put a stop to your tyranny...
BMD\t「ルイーナを放っておくわけにはいかない」: I can't leave the Ruina alone.
BMD\t「ルイーナを排除しなければ……！」: I have to eliminate the Ruina...!
BMD\t「こちらイング。ゲスト機を排除します」: This is Ing. Eliminating Guest unit.
BMD\t「武雀王……/ あの守りを突き崩さなければ……！」: BuJakuOh.../　I have to break through that defense...!
BMD\t「虎王機を阻止しなければ……！」: I have to stop the KoOhKi...!
BMD\t「ガンエデンという言葉に聞き覚えがある……/ 何故だ……！？」: Gan Eden... I've heard that name before.../　Why...!?
BMD\t「あの念は……強力過ぎる……！」: That psychic energy... it's too strong...!
BMD\t「今のお前に因果を操る力はない……！/ ここはまだ、僕達の運命分岐点な: You can't control causality now...!/　This is still our fate's turning point!
BMD\t「ユーゼス、お前を倒す……！/ それが……イルイから託された/ 僕の役: Euzeth, I'll defeat you...!/　That is the task Irui/　entrusted to me...!
BMD\t「エグレッタ、終わるのはお前の方だ！」: Egretta, you're the one who's finished!
BMD\t「凶鳥の眷属、その真の力を……！」: The kin of the Bird of Ill Omen.../　its true power...!
LDBI\t「それどころじゃないんだけどさ」: I've got bigger problems than that, y'know.
LDBI\t「こっちも太陽が消えちまったせいで、節電中だ。@ 帰るに帰れなくなっ: We're saving power too, since the sun went out.@A few hotel guests are stuck here, but otherwise@we're open with no business to speak of.
LDBI\t「仕事はあるさ。@ 早速だが、修理と補給物資の積み込みを頼む」: There's work for you.@Let's get right to it--repairs, and loading our@resupply cargo.
LDBI\t「この非常事態……@ しかも、今のあんた達は本格的なお尋ね者だ。@: With this emergency...@and with you lot now wanted for real...@30% extra, all paid up front.
LDBI\t「ちょっと、ルスランさん！@ 足下を見過ぎじゃない！？」: Hey, Ruslan!@Aren't you taking advantage of us a bit much!?
LDBI\t「カーラちゃん、@ こっちだって危ない橋を渡ってるんだぜ？」: Carla,@I'm taking a big risk here too, you know?
LDBI\t「よかろう。@ キャッシュはここに用意してある」: Very well.@I have the cash ready here.
LDBI\t「……よし、引き受けた。@ アンドリュー、作業を始めさせろ」: ...All right, deal.@Andrew, get the work started.
LDBI\t「ところで、レーツェル。@ そこのご婦人が戦隊司令の……」: By the way, Rätsel.@This lady here would be your fleet's commander...
LDBI\t「ああ、レフィーナ・エンフィールド大佐だ」: Yes, this is Colonel Lefina Enfield.
LDBI\t「このような状況下で我々を受け入れていただき、@ 感謝に堪えません。: We're deeply grateful you'd take us in under@these circumstances, Mister...
LDBI\t「ルスラン・マカロフです。@ ミスターなどという無粋な敬称は結構。@: Ruslan Makarov.@No need for anything as stiff as "Mister."@Just call me Ruslan.
LDBI\t「では、ルスランさん……@ しばらくの間、ご厄介になります」: Then, Ruslan...@we'll be imposing on you for a while.
LDBI\t「スタッフがほとんどいないので、@ 大したもてなしは出来ませんが……: With hardly any staff around, I can't offer@much in the way of hospitality, but...@please, make yourselves at home.
LDBI\t「お言葉に甘えたい所ですが、そうもいきません。@ そちらの人手が足り: I'd love to take you up on that, but we can't.@If you're short-handed, we'll handle loading@the supplies ourselves.
LDBI\t「あたしも作業するからね、その分は値引いといてよ？」: I'm pitching in too, so knock that@off the price, okay?
LDBI\t「やれやれ、カーラちゃんには敵わないな」: Jeez, I can never win against you, Carla.
LDBI\t「ああ、聞いている。ここへ通してくれ」: Yeah, I was told. Send them in.
LDBI\t「マルベリー島で拾った奴でな。@ 見所があったんで、雑用係として雇っ: Picked him up on Mulberry Island.@He showed promise, so I hired him as a gofer.
LDBI\t「事情は知っている。色々と災難だったな……」: I know what happened. You've been through a lot...
LDBI\t「早速ですが、ギリアム少佐……@ 例の事件について、統合参謀本部の見: Let's get straight to it, Major Gilliam...@What's the Joint Chiefs' view on the incident?
LDBI\t「……鋼龍戦隊を大統領殺害の犯人と見なし、@ 軍籍を剥奪……逮捕命令: ...They've named the Steel Dragons as the@President's killers, stripped you of your@military status... and ordered your arrest.
LDBI\t「軍籍剥奪……。@ もしかして、統合参謀本部と連絡が取れないのは……: Stripped of our status...@Then that's why we can't reach the Joint Chiefs...
LDBI\t「それなのに、あんたはここへ来たってのか？@ 大丈夫なのかよ？」: And you came here anyway?@You sure that's okay?
LDBI\t「ジェイコブ・ムーア中将は、鋼龍戦隊が@ アルテウル・シュタインベッ: Lieutenant General Jacob Moore believes the@Steel Dragons fell into Arteur Steinbeck's trap.@That's why he sent me.
LDBI\t「以後は、中将の指示で……@ 独立遊撃部隊として動いてもらうことにな: From now on, under the General's orders...@you'll operate as an independent strike force.@Officially, though, your status won't change.
LDBI\t「地球連邦政府やガイアセイバーズに対する@ 統合参謀本部の体面もあり: Given the Joint Chiefs' standing with the Earth@Federation Government and the Gaia Savers, they@can't support you openly.
LDBI\t「ジェイコブ中将は、@ そのようなことを考えておられませんよ」: Lieutenant General Jacob@doesn't think that way at all.
LDBI\t「以後、私は鋼龍戦隊と行動を共にします。@ 表向きの主任務は、ガイア: From now on, I'll be traveling with the Steel@Dragons. My official mission is investigating@the Gaia Savers, but I'll join your sorties too.
LDBI\t「ねえ、ギリアム少佐。その、ジェイコブ中将って？」: Say, Major Gilliam. This Lieutenant General@Jacob--who's that?
LDBI\t「私が所属する情報部のトップだ。@ 政財界にも太いパイプを持つ切れ者: He's head of the intelligence division I'm in.@A sharp one, with deep ties in politics@and business.
LDBI\t「あのお方が後ろ盾となって下さるのなら、@ 心強いですが……」: If he's willing to back us,@that's reassuring, but...
LDBI\t「それでも、アルテウル・シュタインベックが@ 大統領暗殺を目論んだ証: Even so, we need proof that Arteur Steinbeck@plotted the President's assassination.
LDBI\t「ジェイコブ中将は、アルテウルの台頭を@ 快く思っていない議員達に働: Lieutenant General Jacob said he'd reach out@to Councilors who aren't happy about Arteur's@rise, but...
LDBI\t「確固たる証拠が見つかるまで、@ 連邦軍とガイアセイバーズは@ 鋼龍: Until there's solid proof, the Federation@Forces and the Gaia Savers will keep hunting@the Steel Dragons.
LDBI\t「ただ、然るべき時、然るべき場所で@ 申し開きを行うという姿勢の表明: Still, it's vital to make clear you're willing@to make your case at the proper time and place.
LDBI\t「非常に厳しい状況ですが……@ 証拠を得るまで、切り抜けてもらわねば: It's an extremely difficult situation...@but you'll have to hold out until we have proof.
LDBI\t「その覚悟は……出来ています。@ この状況下で同士討ちをするわけには: I'm... prepared for that.@We can't afford to fight our own in this crisis.@Nor will we ignore the threat from outside.
LDBI\t「わかりました。@ そのご意志、ジェイコブ中将に伝えておきます」: Understood.@I'll relay that to Lieutenant General Jacob.
LDBI\t「……レーツェル、他に話したいことがある。@ タイプＲＶをヒリュウへ: ...Rätsel, there's something else to discuss.@After we move the Type-RV into the Hiryu,@can you spare me some time?
LDBI\t「わかった。では、私もヒリュウへ行こう」: All right. Then I'll come to the Hiryu as well.
LDBI\t「あと、怪しいのはＤＦＣのサブ・サーキット……@ ここはオーバーホー: The other suspect is the DFC's sub-circuit...@I was told there's no need to open it up@unless it's getting an overhaul.
LDBI\t（……薬は残り少なくなってきている。@ ミタールと接触しない限り、補: (...My medicine is running low. Without@contacting Mitar, I can't get more.)
LDBI\t（１回の分量を減らして、もたせるしかないか……）: (I'll have to cut my doses@to make it last...)
LDBI\t「メディウス・ロクスは強奪されたんじゃなくて、@ 最初からガイアセイ: Maybe Medius Locus wasn't stolen at all...@maybe it belonged to the Gaia Savers from@the very start...
LDBI\t「でも、どうして私達とメディウスで実戦を……」: But why have us and Medius fight for real...
LDBI\t「下手をすれば、両方とも壊れてしまうかも@ 知れないのよ？ データが: If things went wrong, both of us could've been@destroyed! If they wanted data, and from two@prototypes, a mock battle's the normal way.
LDBI\t「大統領閣下の御志に感服致しました。@ 当職の全力を挙げて、お応え致: Your Excellency's resolve is truly admirable.@I shall give my all to see it done.
LDBI\t「なお、大統領閣下には専用機にて@ 現空域から離脱していただきます」: Your Excellency, meanwhile, will depart this@airspace aboard your personal aircraft.
LDBI\t「わかった。後は任せるぞ」: Very well. I leave the rest to you.
LDBI\t「……艦長。鋼龍戦隊に対し、威嚇攻撃開始。@ 包囲網を狭める必要はな: ...Captain. Begin warning fire on the@Steel Dragons. No need to tighten the encirclement.
LDBI\t「それでは彼らに時間を与え、@ 結果的に取り逃がすおそれがあります」: That would give them time, and we may@end up letting them escape.
LDBI\t「では、かつてスペースノア級の艦長を@ 務めていた者としての意見を聞: Then let's hear your opinion as someone who@once commanded a Space Noah-class ship.
LDBI\t「おそらく、ハガネとヒリュウ改は縦一列陣形を組み、@ <テスラ・ドラ: Most likely, the Hagane and Hiryu Custom will@form a single-file line and link their@<テスラ・ドライブ>s to escape the area at high speed.
LDBI\t「アンノウンとの戦闘を踏まえ、消耗を抑えるためにも、@ ここは大統領: After their fight with the unknowns, and to keep@losses down, I suggest the President order the@Steel Dragons directly.
LDBI\t「模範的な回答だ。@ しかし、それでも私は彼らが素直に従うと@ 思っ: A textbook answer.@Even so, I don't believe they'll obey@so meekly.
LDBI\t「大統領閣下を目前にして、@ 反抗的な態度を取るほど愚かだとは思えま: With the President right in front of them,@I doubt they'd be foolish enough to defy him.
LDBI\t「わからんぞ？@ 窮鼠猫を噛むということもあり得る」: Who can say?@Even a cornered rat will bite the cat.
LDBI\t（そもそも、鋼龍戦隊を屈服させるために@ 大統領をここまで連れて来た: (Didn't he bring the President all this way@precisely to make the Steel Dragons submit?)
LDBI\t（それに、大統領は正確に状況を把握していないように@ 見受けられたが: (And the President didn't seem to have@an accurate grasp of the situation...)
LDBI\t「艦長。大統領閣下のご命令通り、@ 彼我の損耗を最小限に抑えつつ、@: Captain. As His Excellency ordered, minimize@losses on both sides and get the Steel@Dragons to surrender.
LDBI\t「先程も言ったが、包囲網を狭める必要はない。@ 不必要に彼らを煽るな: As I said, there's no need to tighten the@encirclement. Don't provoke them needlessly.
LDBI\t「艦長、@ ガイアセイバーズ各艦が攻撃態勢に入りました！」: Captain,@all Gaia Savers ships are moving to attack!
LDBI\t「レフィーナ大佐、@ ここは我々クロガネのメンバーが出て、@ 彼らを: Captain Lefina,@we of the Kurogane will sortie and hold them@in check. Use that time to leave this airspace.
LDBI\t「ええ。@ ギリアムやアリエイル・オーグからの情報で、@ ガイアセイ: Yes.@From what Gilliam and the Arieil Org tell us,@the Gaia Savers are suspicious in many ways...
LDBI\t「私やギリアムの伝手を使って、連邦議会にも@ 働きかけましょう。ここ: Gilliam and I will work the Federation Assembly@through our contacts. For now, escape. Once we@have proof, we take them on in the proper forum.
LDBI\t「それは……私も考えていました。@ しかし、ここでの出撃、並びにガイ: That... I had considered as well.@But I cannot authorize a sortie here, nor any@attack or counterattack against the Gaia Savers.
LDBI\t「後々で不利になる要素を、少しでも減らしたいと？@ それでは、ヒリュ: So nothing can be used against us later?@Then the Hiryu Custom and Hagane will bear@the brunt of a concentrated attack.
LDBI\t「彼らの目的は、こちら側の兵器の接収です。@ 我々を殲滅する気なら、: Their goal is to seize our weapons.@If they wanted to annihilate us, they'd have@taken the necessary steps already.
LDBI\t「つまり、向こうは手加減してくると……？」: So you think they'll hold back...?
LDBI\t「ある程度は。@ それを逆手に取って、ここから離脱するまで@ Ｅフィ: To a degree.@We'll use that against them and hold out with@our E-Fields until we're clear of this area.
LDBI\t「それに、各機を発進させれば、@ フォーメーション・ブレイクアウトに: Besides, any units we launch could be left@behind when we accelerate with Formation@Breakout.
LDBI\t「ここは本艦とハガネで耐えて、@ 活路を切り開くしかありません。@: We have no choice but to endure with this ship@and the Hagane and carve a way out.@Is that all right, Commander Tetsuya?
LDBI\t「では、我々はあのポイントを目指します」: Then we'll head for that point.
LDBI\t「なるほど、包囲網の切れ目から@ 加速空間を確保するのですな」: I see. We'll use the gap in their encirclement@to secure space to accelerate, yes?
LDBI\t「ええ、敵包囲網が狭められる前に何としても到達を。@ ただし、ガイア: Yes. We must reach it before they close in.@However, all attacks and counterattacks against@the Gaia Savers are strictly forbidden!
LDBI\t「こ、これでは向こうの思う壺に……！！」: Th-This is playing right into their hands...!!
LDBI\t「くっ！ Ｅフィールドで防げ！」: Ngh! Block it with the E-Field!
LDBI\t「司令、ハガネとヒリュウ改は@ 包囲網の切れ目を目指しています」: Commander, the Hagane and Hiryu Custom are@heading for the gap in our encirclement.
LDBI\t「やはり、高速航行による脱出を目論んでいるかと。@ 包囲網を狭め、そ: They must be planning a high-speed escape.@We'll tighten the net and stop them.
LDBI\t「彼らを不必要に煽るなと言ったぞ」: I told you not to provoke them needlessly.
LDBI\t（鋼龍戦隊を逃がせとでも言うのか、司令は……）: (Does the commander want the Steel Dragons@to escape...?)
LDBI\t「両艦共、目標ポイントへ到達しました」: Both ships have reached the target point.
LDBI\t「あのフォーメーションは……！@ 目標の推進装置を集中攻撃！」: That formation...!@Concentrate fire on their propulsion!
LDBI\t（思っていた以上に事が上手く運んだ。@ チェックメイトだな）: (This went even better than I'd hoped.@Checkmate.)
LDBI\t「艦下方、海面下に熱源反応！ 数は８！@ 浮上して来ます！」: Heat signatures under the sea below us! Eight!@They're surfacing!
LDBI\t「ゲストか！ こんな時に！」: The Guests! At a time like this!
LDBI\t「アルファ１から各機。@ 命令するまで、アーチンに手を出すなよ」: Alpha 1 to all units.@Don't touch the Urchins until I give the order.
LDBI\t「このまま突撃し、蹴散らす！ カウント続行！」: Charge through and scatter them! Keep counting!
LDBI\t「こ、後部デッキから大統領機が発進します！！」: Th-The President's plane is launching from the@rear deck!!
LDBI\t「馬鹿な、このタイミングで！？@ すぐにやめさせろ！！」: What!? Now, of all times!?@Stop them at once!!
LDBI\t「ま、間に合いません！！」: W-We can't stop it in time!!
LDBI\t「スノーボールアース……@ すなわち、全地球凍結もあり得る」: Snowball Earth... In other words,@the entire planet could freeze over.
LDBI\t「もっとも、今日明日の話ではないがね。@ だが、それよりもっと早く問: Of course, that won't happen tomorrow.@But a far more pressing problem will be@the power lines.
LDBI\t「そうですね……@ 常夜となり、気温が下がれば、世界的規模で@ 一斉: Right... With the world in endless night and@temperatures dropping, everyone will turn on@lights and heaters at the same time.
LDBI\t「そうなれば、電力の需要過多で@ パワーラインがパンクしかねませんよ: With that much demand,@the power lines could easily overload.
LDBI\t「さらに……人間への心理的効果か。@ 陽の光を失えば、人心は乱れる。: On top of that... the psychological toll.@Without sunlight, people's minds will falter.@And that will turn into despair...
LDBI\t「不幸中の幸いは、@ ゲストの襲撃を受けずに済むことだな」: The one silver lining is that@we won't have to deal with Guest attacks.
LDBI\t「その代わりにルイーナが出て来たんだ、@ 何の慰めにもならない」: Instead, we got the Ruina.@That's hardly any consolation.
LDBI\t「ともかく、早急に次元断層を破らねば、@ ルイーナの思う壺になるな」: Either way, we must break the dimensional rift@soon, or the Ruina will get just what they want.
LDBI\t「くっ、親父のせいで……こんな……！」: Damn it, because of my old man... all this...!
LDBI\t「起きてしまったことを悔やんでも仕方がない。@ 重要なのは、それをど: There's no use regretting what's happened.@What matters is how we clean it up.
LDBI\t「次元断層の発生がルイーナの仕業なら、@ その謎を解く鍵もまた、奴ら: If the Ruina caused the dimensional rift,@then they're also the key to solving it, right?
LDBI\t「キョウスケの言う通りだ。メリオルエッセとの会話で@ 何か手掛かりに: Kyosuke's right. Did anything the Meliores Esse@said give you a clue?
LDBI\t「ああ。@ 確か、ラキ……北の果てと言っていたな」: Yeah.@If I remember right, Raki mentioned... the far north.
LDBI\t「北の果て？ 北極のことか？」: The far north? You mean the North Pole?
LDBI\t「……レフィーナ大佐、態勢を立て直すためにも@ コモディン島へ急ぎま: ...Colonel Lefina, we should regroup by heading@straight to Comodin Island.
LDBI\t「そこでギリアムと落ち合う予定です。@ 彼から情報が得られるでしょう: We're scheduled to meet Gilliam there.@He should have information for us.
LDBI\t（そ、それだと、お父さん達が……）: (B-But then, Dad and the others would...)
LDBI\t（父さん達のことは気になるけど、@ 次元断層を何とかしなきゃ、南極に: (I'm worried about Dad and the others too, but@unless we deal with the rift, we can't even@go back to Antarctica...)
LDBI\t（この事態……@ どうやって収拾しろと言うんだ、親父……！）: (This situation... How the hell am I supposed@to clean this up, old man...!)
LDBI\t「こちらからの攻撃がきっかけとなったかも知れんが……@ いずれ、バラ: Our attack may have been what set it off...@But Baral likely meant to do that eventually.
LDBI\t「言い訳として受け取っておこう。@ それで、用件は？」: I'll take that as an excuse.@So, what do you want?
LDBI\t「バリア展開と共に南極の結界の直径が縮小し、@ その高度を増した」: When the barrier went up, the Antarctic field@shrank in diameter and grew in altitude.
LDBI\t「こちらでは、南極上空が遮断されることを防ぐため、@ そのように変形: We believe it changed shape that way to keep@the sky over Antarctica from being sealed off.
LDBI\t「また、バラルを警戒してか、@ ルイーナの動きが沈静化しつつある。@: Also, perhaps out of wariness toward Baral,@the Ruina have begun to settle down.@For us, this could be called an opportunity.
LDBI\t「なるほど……催促というわけか」: I see... So you're pressing me.
LDBI\t「ああ。オペレーション・アイスブレイカーへの@ 参加を急いでもらいた: Yes. We'd like you to hurry and join@Operation Icebreaker.
LDBI\t「こちらにも都合が色々とあるのだが……いいだろう。@ ただし、条件が: I have my own affairs to manage... Very well.@But I have one condition.
LDBI\t「鋼龍戦隊をこちらに引き渡せ」: Hand the Steel Dragons over to us.
LDBI\t「引き渡すも何も、@ 彼らは今、我々の管轄下ではないのだがな」: Hand them over? They aren't under@our jurisdiction at the moment.
LDBI\t「ふん……では、言い方を変えよう。@ そちらの方でも鋼龍戦隊を追撃す: Hmph... Then let me put it another way.@You will pursue the Steel Dragons as well.@But we will be the ones to take them in.
LDBI\t「随分と都合のいい話だが……@ 我らの方にも体面というものがある」: That's rather convenient for you... But we@have our reputation to consider as well.
LDBI\t「鋼龍戦隊の逮捕と引き渡しは@ 我が方だけに任せてもらいたい」: The arrest and transfer of the Steel Dragons@should be left to us alone.
LDBI\t「今更、体面などと……@ 彼らの追撃を取りやめろと言うのか？」: Reputation, at this late stage...?@Are you telling me to call off the pursuit?
LDBI\t（フッ、鎌を掛けて来たか……。@ お互い様だがな）: (Heh, he's trying to draw me out...@Then again, so am I.)
LDBI\t「元帥、本気ですか……！？@ 鋼龍戦隊をガイアセイバーズに引き渡すな: Marshal, are you serious...!?@Giving the Steel Dragons to the Gaia Savers...!
LDBI\t「これは化かし合いだよ。@ さて、奴がどう出て来るか……」: This is a battle of wits.@Now, let's see how he responds...
LDBI\t「……本命はナフード砂漠でしたね」: ...So the real target was the Nafud Desert.
LDBI\t「フッ……自分でも恐ろしいぐらいに@ 事が上手く運んでいるよ」: Heh... Things are going so well,@it frightens even me.
LDBI\t「あの空中庭園にバラルの神が鎮座しているのであれば、@ あれもまた…: If Baral's god sits in that floating garden,@then that may also be...
