LDBI\t「そうだな、手元に置いといた方が育て易いはずだ。@ それとも……可愛: Right. He'd be easier to raise close at hand.@Or is it 'a loving parent sends the child out@into the world'?
LDBI\t「鋼龍戦隊には、念動力や精神感応力を有した人間が@ 多く属しているか: Because many in the Steel Dragons possess@telekinesis or telepathic powers. Contact with@them will spur Ing's growth.
LDBI\t「そして、お前達がガンエデンに選ばれると@ 推測したからでもある」: And also because I surmised you would be@chosen by Gan Eden.
LDBI\t「お前達はＤＣ戦争、Ｌ５戦役、@ インスペクター事件、修羅の乱……@: The DC War, the L5 Campaign,@the Inspectors Incident, the Shura Uprising...@in those battles, you showed exceptional power.
LDBI\t「私利私欲ではなく、@ 地球圏存続のために剣を振るい続けてきた。@: Not for selfish ends, but to preserve the Earth@Sphere, you have kept wielding your swords.@In short, you have what Gan Eden looks for.
LDBI\t「なるほど。@ イルイがガイアセイバーズを選ぶとは@ 思えないしな」: I see.@I can't imagine Irui choosing@the Gaia Savers, after all.
LDBI\t「故に我は、お前達に試練を与えた」: Therefore, I gave you a trial.
BMD\t「貴様らを見逃すわけにはいかん！」: I can't let you scum get away!
BMD\t「ユウキ……/ 見所のある奴だと思っていたがな！」: Yuuki.../　I thought you had promise!
BMD\t「貴様、バン大佐の恩義を忘れたか！」: Have you forgotten what you owe/　Colonel Bhan!?
BMD\t「ビアン総帥の娘と言えど、/ 敵対するのであれば！」: Bian's daughter or not,/　if you stand against us...!
BMD\t「ＤＣ再興に協力しないのなら、/ 死んでもらう！」: If you won't help rebuild the DC,/　then you die!
BMD\t「邪魔をするのであれば、総帥の娘と言えど！」: If you get in our way, I don't care/　if you're the Commander's daughter!
BMD\t「エルザム少佐……/ 我ら側について然るべきではないのか！」: Major Elzam.../　Shouldn't you be on our side?
BMD\t「エルザム少佐……/ 何故、父親の遺志を継いで立ち上がらんのだ？」: Major Elzam.../　Why won't you rise up to carry on/　your father's will?
BMD\t「トロイエ隊の生き残りが、/ 鋼龍戦隊にいるとはな……！」: A Troye Squad survivor/　among the Steel Dragons...!
BMD\t「ゼンガー・ゾンボルト……/ ＤＣを混乱させた罪、許すわけにはいかん！: Sänger Sombold.../　I can't forgive you for throwing/　the DC into chaos!
BMD\t「ゼンガー……/ 貴様はＤＣの理念を理解していたはずだ！」: Sänger.../　You of all people understood/　the DC's ideals!
BMD\t「鋼龍戦隊……貴様らとの因縁を断つ！」: Steel Dragons... This ends our feud!
BMD\t「連邦の力の象徴……鋼龍戦隊を討つ！」: The Federation's symbol of power.../　The Steel Dragons will fall!
BMD\t「今度は貴様らが煮え湯を飲む番だ！」: Now it's your turn to eat dirt!
BMD\t「相手が貴様らなら、戦う理由がある！」: Against you, I have reason to fight!
BMD\t「どこであろうと、連邦に与する者は死ね！」: Anyone who sides with the Federation/　dies, no matter where!
BMD\t「この異界の地で果てるがいい！」: Meet your end in this alien land!
BMD\t「アインスト！/ 貴様を生かしておくわけにはいかん！」: Einst!/　I can't let you live!
BMD\t「この傷の痛み……貴様にも味わってもらう！」: The pain of this wound... Now you'll/　feel it too!
BMD\t「アインストは残らず駆逐せねばならんのだ！」: Every last Einst must be wiped out!
BMD\t「奴さえ仕留めれば、鋼龍戦隊は！」: Take him down, and the Steel Dragons...!
BMD\t「奴も/ アインストになるかも知れんからな……！」: He could become/　an Einst too, after all...!
BMD\t「この世界じゃ、/ 魔装機神は極上の獲物だからな……！」: In this world,/　a Masoukishin is the ultimate prize...!
BMD\t「ただで済むと思うな！」: Don't think you'll get off easy!
BMD\t「くそっ、これ以上は！！」: Damn it, I can't take any more!!
BMD\t「くそ！ この機体では勝てんのか！」: Damn! I can't win with this machine!
BMD\t「ぐっ！/ 俺とて、修羅場は何度もくぐってきたのだ！」: Ngh!/　I've been through hell plenty of times!
BMD\t「こ、こんな所で終われんのだ、俺は！」: I-I can't end it in a place like this!
BMD\t「くそっ！ この機体では対応しきれん！！」: Damn! This machine can't keep up!!
BMD\t「ぐうう……悲願を果たすまで死ねるか！」: Ngh... I can't die until my wish/　is fulfilled!
BMD\t「ユウキ、貴様に後れを取るとは……！」: Yuuki, outdone by you of all people...!
BMD\t「くそっ！ 裏切り者がよくもこんな！！」: Damn! How dare a traitor do this!!
BMD\t「こ、これがヴァルシオーネの力なのか！」: I-Is this the power of the Valsione!?
BMD\t「ううっ、アインストにやられてたまるかよ！」: Ugh, I won't lose to the Einst!
LDBI\t「でも、退屈はしなかったよ。@ お父さんやお兄ちゃんが一緒だったし…: But I was never bored.@I had my dad and my brother with me...
LDBI\t「リ・テクには変わった人が多いけど、@ 優しくしてくれたし。あと、お: There are a lot of odd people at Re-Tech,@but they were all kind to me. And I helped@Dad and the others with their research.
LDBI\t「ええ、お兄ちゃんのエール・シュヴァリアーに@ 搭載されてるシュンパ: Yeah. The Sympathia installed in my brother's@Aile Chevalier... I helped test it.
LDBI\t「エール・シュヴァリアーの@ マン・マシーン・インターフェース……@: It's the Aile Chevalier's@man-machine interface...@Apparently it links with the pilot's brainwaves.
LDBI\t「じゃあ、<Ｔ‐ＬＩＮＫシステム>みたいなものか？」: So it's something like the <Ｔ‐ＬＩＮＫシステム>?
LDBI\t「概念は近いけど、念動力のような特殊能力は@ 必要ないって……」: The concept's similar, but apparently it@doesn't require powers like telekinesis...
LDBI\t「でも……どうして、リムが@ シュンパティアのテストを……」: But... why was Rim@the one testing the Sympathia...?
LDBI\t「それは、私が一番最初にあれを動かしたから……」: Because I was the first one who got it to move...
LDBI\t（ジョッシュさんが言ってたように、@ リムも実験台にされてたってこと: (Like Josh said... does that mean Rim@was a test subject too...?)
LDBI\t「へえ、凄いんだな。@ じゃあ、リムもエール・シュヴァリアーを@ 操: Whoa, that's amazing.@So can you pilot the Aile Chevalier too, Rim?
LDBI\t「あれはお兄ちゃんにしか動かせないけど、@ 私も訓練を受けてたから…: Only my brother can pilot it,@but I went through training too, so...
LDBI\t「ごめんって？ どうして、謝るの？」: Sorry? What are you apologizing for?
LDBI\t「あ、何でもない、何でもないのよ」: Oh, it's nothing, nothing at all!
LDBI\t「レーツェル様、@ こちらへ高速飛行物体が接近中です」: Master Rätsel,@a high-speed flying object is approaching.
LDBI\t「ならば、連邦軍ではないか……」: Then it's not the Federation Army...
LDBI\t「彼らが頭上からこちらを見ているとすれば、@ もっと近い所に手勢を転: If they were watching us from above,@they'd teleport their forces in much closer.
LDBI\t「警告を出し、@ それでも接近してくるようであれば、攻撃せよ。@ 我: Issue a warning. If they keep approaching@after that, open fire.@We'll board our units and stand by.
LDBI\t「レーツェル様、目標群が警告を無視し、@ レンジ３へ侵入しました」: Master Rätsel, the targets ignored the warning@and have entered Range 3.
LDBI\t「了解した。各機、直ちに出撃を！」: Understood. All units, launch at once!
LDBI\t「奴らの機体……@ 伊豆で俺達を襲った連中と同じだな」: Those machines...@They're the same ones that attacked us in Izu.
LDBI\t「こんな所にも現れるなんて……@ 結構、行動範囲が広いのね」: Showing up all the way out here...@They sure cover a lot of ground.
LDBI\t「フッ、我らは運がいい。地上へ戻って来て@ すぐにクロガネと相見える: Heh, luck is with us. We return to the surface@and immediately cross paths with the Kurogane.
LDBI\t「隊長、回収艦から連絡が来ました。@ 合流ポイントの変更を要請して来: Captain, the recovery ship has contacted us.@They're asking to change the rendezvous point.
LDBI\t「了解した。我々で彼らの目を引き付け、@ その間に別働隊と回収艦を接: Understood. We'll draw their attention,@while the other unit meets up with the ship.@Tell them to have our pickup ready.
LDBI\t「目の前の連中は、ボーナスだ。@ 上手くやれば、データにさらなる箔が: The ones in front of us are a bonus.@Pull this off and our data's worth even more.
LDBI\t「機体のことは、もう気にしなくていい。@ 連邦でも解析は進んでいるだ: Don't worry about the machines anymore.@The Federation's surely analyzing them by now.@...Rack up that data.
LDBI\t（フッ……欲に目がくらんだ連中は、盾になる）: (Heh... Men blinded by greed make good shields.)
LDBI\t「あの戦闘機、カリオンに似てる……!」: That fighter looks like the Calion...!
LDBI\t「緋色の機体……もしかして」: A scarlet machine... Could it be...?
LDBI\t「シリーズ７７、ベガリオン……@ あれが作られていたとは……！」: Series 77, Vegalion...@So they actually built it...!
LDBI\t「レーツェル・ファインシュメッカーだ。@ その機体に乗っているのは、: This is Rätsel Feinschmecker.@Sleigh Presty... is that you@in that machine?
LDBI\t「なるほど、顔見知りだったな。@ どうする？ ここは私に任せて、後退: I see, so you two know each other.@What'll it be? Leave this to me and fall back?
LDBI\t「相手が何者であろうと、交戦データを収集する……@ それがスポンサー: Whoever the enemy is, we gather combat data...@That's what the sponsor wants.@My personal affairs are irrelevant to the job.
LDBI\t「よかろう、プロフェッショナルだ」: Very well. Spoken like a professional.
LDBI\t（アイビスをアルテリオンから引きずり降ろし、@ 私が兄様のプロジェク: (I'll drag Ibis out of the Alterion@and complete my brother's Project TD myself...)
LDBI\t（そのためには、イスルギ重工だろうと何だろうと@ 利用するまで……！: (I'll make use of anything to that end, even@Isurugi Heavy Industries...!)
LDBI\t「……ねえ、ゼオラ。@ あの緋色の機体のパイロット、@ 知り合いなの: ...Hey, Seolla.@That scarlet machine's pilot...@Do you know her?
LDBI\t「正確に言えば、知り合いの知り合いですけど。@ でも、レーツェルさん: To be precise, she's a friend of a friend.@But Rätsel...
LDBI\t「レーツェル、単機ならともかく、@ あれだけの敵機がいる以上……」: Rätsel, if it were a single unit, fine, but@with that many enemies around...
LDBI\t「こいつ、他の機体と動きが違うな」: This one moves differently from the others.
LDBI\t「特殊戦技教導隊の隊長機か。@ いい交戦データを得られそうだな」: The leader's unit from the Special@Tactics Instruction Corps, eh?@That should give us some good combat data.
LDBI\t「初見の機体だ……お手並み拝見といこうか」: A machine I've never seen... Let's see what it can do.
LDBI\t「そう簡単にデータが取れると思うなよ！」: Don't think you'll get your data that easily!
LDBI\t「ふふふ、私は運がいい。@ 何機もの新型機と巡り会えるとはな」: Heh heh heh, I'm a lucky man.@To run into so many new models at once...
LDBI\t「データ取得はお互い様かも知れないが……@ 命まで渡すつもりはない！: We may both be gathering data, but...@I'm not handing over my life!
LDBI\t（レーツェル・ファインシュメッカー……@ あなたであっても容赦はしな: (Rätsel Feinschmecker...@Even you will get no mercy from me!)
LDBI\t「あくまでアイビスとの決着にこだわるか。@ フィリオ亡き後も……いや: Still fixated on settling things with Ibis?@Even after Filio's death... no, because of it.
BMD\t「ほらほら、ぼーっとしてんじゃないよ！！」: Come on, come on, quit spacing out!!
BMD\t「すぐにカタを付けてやるよ！」: I'll settle this in no time!
BMD\t「邪魔するなら容赦しないよ！」: Get in my way and I won't hold back!
BMD\t「さあ、ヴァルシオーネの力、/ 身を以て知ってもらうよ！」: Now you'll learn the Valsione's power/　the hard way!
BMD\t「パワーなら、負けやしないっ！」: When it comes to power, I won't lose!
BMD\t「あたしの力、見せてやるよ！」: I'll show you what I've got!
BMD\t「結局の所、/ あんたは自分の野心を抑え切れなかっただけさ！/ 覚悟し: In the end,/　you couldn't rein in your own ambition!/　Brace yourself, Kirkus!
BMD\t「カークス！/ あんたのやり方を、あたしは絶対に認めない！」: Kirkus!/　I'll never accept the way you do things!
BMD\t「なりふり構わず権力にしがみついて……/ 見苦しいんだよ、カークス！」: Clinging to power by any means.../　It's pathetic, Kirkus!
BMD\t「うわっ、何よ、あいつっ！？/ まともに戦うだけ無駄じゃないの？」: Whoa, what is that thing!?/　Isn't fighting it head-on pointless?
BMD\t「ダメージを与えられないっていうけど、/ 最大出力で当たれば……」: They say we can't damage it, but/　if I hit it at full output...
BMD\t「あたし、ああいう奴、/ 生理的に駄目なのよね……虫唾が走るよ！」: I just can't stand guys like that.../　They make my skin crawl!
BMD\t「何が記憶喪失だい！/ マンガじゃあるまいし、誰が信じるもんか！」: Amnesia, my foot!/　This isn't a comic book--who'd buy that!?
BMD\t「確かに、ちょっとだけ/ 雰囲気が変わったことは認めてやるよ。/ けど: Okay, I'll admit/　you've changed a little./　But I'm not letting you off!
BMD\t「う……何かあいつと戦うの、/ 生理的に嫌なんだけど……」: Ugh... I really don't want/　to fight that guy...
BMD\t「シュウの手下だね！/ 黙って見過ごすわけにはいかないよ！」: You're one of Shu's lackeys!/　I can't just stand by and let you go!
BMD\t「へぇ……/ ちょっとは手応えのありそうな相手じゃないか。/ 面白いね: Heh.../　You look like you'll put up a fight./　This'll be fun!
BMD\t「なるほどね、/ あいつはただの雑魚じゃなさそうだ。/ 気を引き締めて: I see.../　That one's no small fry./　Time to tighten up!
BMD\t「面白い動きするじゃない。/ 何かの特殊部隊にいた経験ありってトコかな: Nice moves you've got there./　Special forces experience, maybe?
BMD\t「ドゥバン！/ あんたがこれ以上の力を得ることはないよ！」: Duban!/　I won't let you gain any more power!
BMD\t「メリオルエッセ……手応えはありそうだね！」: A Meliores Esse.../　This should be a real fight!
BMD\t「メリオルエッセか。気を引き締めていくよ！」: A Meliores Esse, huh?/　Time to tighten up!
BMD\t「ヘラヘラ笑うんじゃないよ、コンターギオ！」: Wipe that grin off your face, Contagio!
BMD\t「アクイラ！ 力勝負なら負けないよ！」: Aquila!/　I won't lose a contest of strength!
BMD\t「ペルフェクティオ！ 元いた世界に還りな！」: Perfectio!/　Go back to the world you came from!
BMD\t「ロフ！ この勝負、受けてもらうよ！」: Rof! You're gonna accept this fight!
BMD\t「そもそもは、あんた達が/ 一方的に仕掛けてきた戦いだろうが！」: Hey, you guys are the ones/　who picked this fight in the first place!
BMD\t「シャキッとさせてやるよ、ゼブ！」: I'll snap you out of it, Zeb!
BMD\t「所詮、/ あんたには不相応な野望だったんだよ！」: In the end,/　that ambition was too big for you!
BMD\t「後がないよ、ゼゼーナン！ 覚悟しな！」: You're out of options, Zezenan!/　Brace yourself!
BMD\t「夏喃、あんたの誘いには乗らない！」: Kanan, I'm not falling for your bait!
BMD\t「光龍！ そこから引きずり降ろしてやるよ！」: Koryu! I'll drag you down from up there!
BMD\t「大きさだけで勝負が決まるわけじゃない！」: Size alone doesn't decide a fight!
BMD\t「ガイアセイバーズ、/ あんた達のやり方は認められないね！」: Gaia Savers,/　I can't accept the way you do things!
BMD\t「ある意味、ＤＣより始末に悪い連中だよ！」: In a way, they're worse than the DC!
BMD\t「どう手を加えようと、ヴァルシオンなんて、/ あたしにとっちゃ旧型なん: However you tweak it, the Valsion's/　an old model as far as I'm concerned!
BMD\t「こんなトコで/ ヴァルシオンと戦う羽目になるなんてね……」: Never thought I'd have to/　fight the Valsion in a place like this...
BMD\t「ちょうどいいじゃないか。/ ヴァルシオンとヴァルシオーネ、/ どっち: Perfect timing./　Valsion versus Valsione--/　let's settle which one's better!
BMD\t「うわっ、こりゃ気味が悪いね……/ 破壊神だとか言っても、/ ただの化: Ugh, that's creepy.../　They can call it a god of destruction,/　but it's just a monster.
BMD\t「まったく、/ あんな化け物のどこが神だっていうのさ！」: Seriously,/　how is a monster like that a god!?
BMD\t「あたしは別に、/ 神様なんて信じちゃいないけどさ……/ あんなのは、: I don't really believe in gods.../　but that's nothing anyone/　should worship as one!
BMD\t「ガンエデン！/ あんたに守られるつもりなんてない！」: Gan Eden!/　I don't need your protection!
BMD\t「その斧、ヘシ折ってやるよ！」: I'll snap that axe in two!
BMD\t「その翼、もぎ取ってやるよ！」: I'll rip those wings right off!
LDBI\t「その格好じゃ、寒くて当たり前だ。@ さっさと防寒服を着ろ」: Of course you're cold, dressed like that.@Hurry up and put on some cold-weather gear.
LDBI\t「わ、わかってるわよ！@ コックピットの中じゃ、着られなかったのよ！: I-I know that!@I couldn't put it on in the cockpit!@I was running the DFC!
LDBI\t「ごちゃごちゃ言ってないで、早くしろ。@ 凍傷になるぞ」: Stop complaining and hurry up.@You'll get frostbite.
LDBI\t「って言うか、あなたは平気なの？@ 手足がかじかまないなんて、鉄か何: Besides, how are you fine with this?@Your hands and feet aren't even numb. Are you@made of iron or something?
LDBI\t「ど、どうしたの……？ 気に障ること、言った？」: Wh-what's wrong...? Did I say something bad?
LDBI\t（あ、あの子も薄着で、よく大丈夫ね……若いから？）: (H-how is she okay dressed that lightly, too...@Because she's young?)
LDBI\t「ああ……ゲストとは遭遇せずに済んだよ」: Yeah... We made it without running into the Guests.
LDBI\t「うぅ～、寒かった。私、ココア淹れてくるね。@ お兄ちゃんも飲むでし: Brrr, that was cold. I'll go make some cocoa.@You want some too, big brother?
LDBI\t「濃くし過ぎるなよ。@ ……で、親父は下に籠もりっぱなしなのか？」: Don't make it too strong.@...So, is Dad still holed up down below?
LDBI\t「そうだ、シュンパティア０２を持ち込んでな。@ 門を開ける目処が付い: He is, with Sympathia 02.@It seems he's found a way to open the gate.
LDBI\t「門……親父がフォレースと呼んでた奴か。@ いったい、どんな物なんだ: The gate... That thing Dad called the Fores?@What exactly is it?
LDBI\t「さあ……@ 私はまだ最下層の奥に入ったことがないのでね」: Who knows...@I've yet to enter the depths of the lowest level.
LDBI\t「奥？@ もしかして、俺達が外へ行っている間に@ 発見されたのか？」: The depths?@Don't tell me that was discovered@while we were out?
LDBI\t「ああ。@ だから、エール・シュヴァリアーが必要なんだ。@ 調査と…: Yes.@That's why we need the Aile Chevalier.@For the survey... and as a precaution.
LDBI\t「ブランシュネージュは？@ どうせ用意しているんだろう？」: And the Blanche Neige?@You've got it ready anyway, don't you?
LDBI\t「……備えあれば憂いなしと言うからな」: ...Better safe than sorry, as they say.
LDBI\t「誰が何と言おうと、リムをあれには……」: I don't care what anyone says, I won't put Rim@in that thing...
LDBI\t「だが、ブランシュネージュは@ 彼女にしか動かせないのだ」: But the Blanche Neige can only@be operated by her.
LDBI\t「はい、ココア。ごめんね、アニキ。@ クリスがちょっと入れ過ぎちゃっ: Here's your cocoa. Sorry, bro.@Looks like Chris made it a little too strong.
LDBI\t「他の人達の分も淹れようと思ってるんだけど……@ クリフはどう？」: I was thinking of making some for the others,@too... How about you, Cliff?
LDBI\t「ああ、もらおう。私は濃い方が好みだ」: Yes, I'll have some. I prefer mine strong.
LDBI\t「そうだったね。ちょっと待ってて」: Oh, right. Hang on a sec.
LDBI\t「ジョッシュ……彼女はまだあの調子か？@ 彼女達が、という意味だが」: Josh... Is she still like that?@They, I should say.
LDBI\t「ああ……@ ここを離れれば、多少は変化があると思ったが」: Yeah...@I thought getting away from here might change@things a little.
LDBI\t「どちらが本当のクリアーナなのか、@ わからないままか……」: So we still don't know which@is the real Clearna...
LDBI\t「本人達は気にしていない。@ まるで、最初からああだったように……」: They don't mind it themselves.@It's as if they've always been that way...
LDBI\t「だが、俺はそういうわけにはいかない。@ 親父のやったことが原因だと: But I can't just let it go.@Knowing that Dad's the cause of it,@how could I be okay with that?
LDBI\t「私がここへ来る前の話だ、詳細は知らんが……」: That was before I came here, so I don't know@the details, but...
LDBI\t「当事者はどいつもこいつも口を閉ざしている。@ あいつらは信用できな: Everyone involved is keeping their mouth shut.@I can't trust them. That's why I took Rim@and got out of here...!
LDBI\t「ヒューゴ少尉達や鋼龍戦隊の人間には@ 彼女のことを説明したのか？」: Have you told Lieutenant Hugo and the others,@or anyone in the Steel Dragons, about her?
LDBI\t「いや……まだ気づかれていないからな。@ クリスとリアナには口止めを: No... They haven't noticed yet.@I've told Chris and Riana to keep quiet.
LDBI\t「遅かれ早かれ、わかることだ。@ 怪しまれる前に言っておいた方がいい: They'll find out sooner or later.@Better to tell them before they get suspicious.@For the girls' sake, too.
LDBI\t「アクアさん、ココアいかがですか？」: Aqua, would you like some cocoa?
LDBI\t「あの……ヒューゴさんと喧嘩したんですか？」: Um... Did you have a fight with Hugo?
LDBI\t「でも、喧嘩するほど仲がいいって言いますよね」: But they say the more you fight, the closer you are.
LDBI\t「ただのパートナーよ、パートナー。@ それに私、年下は好みじゃないし: He's just my partner, that's all.@Besides, I'm not into younger guys.
LDBI\t「ええ、素敵だと思うわ。@ リムは、どういう人がタイプなの？」: Yes, I think he's wonderful.@What's your type, Rim?
LDBI\t（クリス、ココアが冷めちゃうよ？）: (Chris, your cocoa's getting cold, you know?)
LDBI\t「……デモンのデータは見た。@ あれがエール・シュヴァリアーを@ 狙: ...I've seen the data on the Demon.@If it's targeting the Aile Chevalier...
LDBI\t「理由はシュンパティアか、@ レース・アルカーナのどちらかだろうな」: The reason is likely either the Sympathia@or the Lace Arcana.
LDBI\t「未知の物同士で引き合うとでも？」: You mean unknown things attract each other?
LDBI\t「まあな。@ 場合によっては、謎を解く鍵に……」: Something like that.@It might even be the key to the mystery...
LDBI\t「警報……！@ ファブラ・フォレースで何かあったようだな」: An alarm...!@Something must have happened at Fabula Fores.
LDBI\t「地下との回線がつながらん。@ それに、高エネルギー反応が検出されて: I can't reach the underground levels.@And high-energy readings are being detected.
BMD\t「何や、そら？ 本気でやっとんか？」: What's that supposed to be? You serious?
BMD\t「そんなもんでどうにかなると思とったんか？/ 嬢ちゃん」: You really thought that'd work,/　little missy?
BMD\t「ふーん、ガッデスっちゅうてもこの程度かいな」: Huh. So this is all a Gaddess can do?
BMD\t「何や、見かけ倒しやな、/ ヴォルクルスっちゅーんも」: Huh, all bark and no bite,/　this Volkruss thing.
BMD\t「ガハハハ！/ 当たるかいな、このヘタクソが！」: Gahahaha!/　Like that'd hit me, ya klutz!
BMD\t「どわっ！？/ 何すんねん！ 危ないやないか！」: Whoa!?/　What're ya doin'!? That's dangerous!
BMD\t「おおっと、惜しい、もうちょっとやな」: Whoa there! Close, but not quite.
BMD\t「なぁ～にをやっとるんや、アホが」: Whaaat are ya doin', ya idiot?
BMD\t「ガハハ！ 出直してこいや！」: Gahaha! Come back when you're better!
BMD\t「おっとっと。危ないトコやった」: Whoa-ho-ho. That was a close one.
BMD\t「自分、動きが見え見えやで」: I can see right through yer moves.
BMD\t「手の内見せすぎやで。若いなぁ」: Showin' too much of yer hand. So green.
BMD\t「やめとき、嬢ちゃん。ワシのが腕は上や」: Give it up, missy. I'm the better pilot.
BMD\t「魔装機神ゆうても、/ 当たらんかったらええだけの話や！」: Masoukishin or not,/　it's nothin' if ya can't hit me!
BMD\t「けっ、これじゃ反撃できひんやないか」: Tch, I can't counter like this!
BMD\t「何やねん！/ どっから攻撃しくさるんや、このボケが！！」: What the!?/　Where're ya attackin' from, ya moron!!
BMD\t「もう一回やらな、気が済まん！」: One more, or I won't be satisfied!
BMD\t「おらおら、/ ぼーっとしとるともう一丁かましたるでっ！！」: Hey, hey!/　Space out and I'll hit ya with another!!
BMD\t「よっしゃ！ 一発かましたろか！」: All right! Let's let one rip!
BMD\t「まだ終わってへんで！/ 油断大敵火がボーボーや！」: It ain't over yet!/　Get careless and ya go up in flames!
BMD\t「ボコボコにしたる！」: I'll beat ya black and blue!
BMD\t「ワシの力、目ん玉ひんむいてよう見とけ！」: Peel yer eyes back and see what I got!
BMD\t「ほな、一発かましたろか！」: Well then, let's let one rip!
LDBI\t「……危険な兆候だ。@ あの人間達は新たな力を手に入れ、グラキエース: ...This is a dangerous sign.@Those humans have gained new power, and their@sync with Glacies and Ventus grows stronger.
LDBI\t「ああ、彼らはそのせいで壊れつつあるようだな。@ 修復は可能なのか？: Yes, and it seems to be breaking them.@Can they be repaired?
LDBI\t「手は打ったが、良い効果は見られぬ」: I've taken measures, but to little effect.
LDBI\t「では、そろそろ見切り時かな、クククッ」: Then perhaps it's time to cut our losses. Heheheh.
LDBI\t「……やはり、あの人間とシステムを破壊せねば、@ 問題は解決せぬよう: ...It seems the problem won't be solved@unless we destroy that human and the system.
LDBI\t「確かめたいことがあると言っていたが、いいのか？」: You said there was something you wished to@confirm. Are you sure about this?
LDBI\t「それを踏まえた上での判断だ。@ あの人間がウェントスに悪影響をもた: I've taken that into account.@If that human has an ill effect on Ventus,@the quality of our sustenance could suffer.
LDBI\t「ならば、今の役目から外しておくのが無難であろうよ。@ 奴がおらずと: Then the safe choice is to relieve him of his@current role. We can offer up sustenance@even without him.
LDBI\t「それでは、“破滅の王”の目覚めが遅れるぞ」: But that will delay the awakening of the@"King of Destruction."
LDBI\t「どのみち、今のウェントスでは同じことよ。@ 別の役目を与えた方がい: Either way, it makes no difference with Ventus@as he is now. Better to give him another role.
LDBI\t「今、私が建造しているオフィチナスの@ エネルギー供給源とするのだよ: We'll make him the energy source for the@Officinas I'm constructing.
LDBI\t「そうすれば稼働率が上がり、@ 破滅の軍勢をより早く増やすことが出来: That will raise its operating rate and let us@grow the Army of Destruction all the faster.@In short, quantity will make up for quality.
LDBI\t「確かに、オフィチナスの数を増やすことは急務ね。@ これまでは“破滅: True, more Officinas are an urgent need. Until@now, the power of the "King of Destruction" has@transmuted this land's matter into our army...
LDBI\t「出所は多ければ多いほど良い。@ 様々な地の人間達に効率よく恐怖や絶: The more sources, the better.@That lets us efficiently inflict fear and@despair on humans in many lands.
LDBI\t「だが、ウェントスを使うのであれば……@ あの人間達がシステムを通じ: But if we use Ventus...@those humans will likely learn of it through@the system and appear there.
LDBI\t「クククッ、それはそれで狙い通りよ。@ その際はウェントスのみならず: Heheh, that suits my aims just fine.@When they do, I'll make use of not only Ventus@but Glacies too. Hehehehe.
LDBI\t「ラキ……俺とお前、ウェントスとで@ コンターギオのオフィチナスへ行: Raki... you and I are heading to Contagio's@Officinas with Ventus.
LDBI\t「壊れかけた私にも、@ まだ与えられる役目があるのか……」: Even half-broken as I am,@I still have a role to play...
LDBI\t（外に出れば、@ ジョシュア・ラドクリフと出くわす可能性も……）: (Out there, I might run into@Joshua Radcliffe...)
LDBI\t「何だ、ラキ？ どうして、そんな顔をする？」: What is it, Raki? Why that look?
LDBI\t（……おかしい、おかしいぜ。@ ラキの変調はおかしいんだ。あり得ない: (...Something's wrong. Something's not right.@This change in Raki is wrong. It's impossible.)
LDBI\t（俺達は、メリオルエッセの中でも俺達だけが@ 同時に生まれた。同じも: (Of all the Meliores Esse, we alone were born@at once. We were supposed to be the same...)
LDBI\t（あの人間とシステムのせいだということは@ わかっているが……）: (I know that human and the system@are to blame, but...)
LDBI\t「ヒューゴ少尉も無事に戻って来られましたし……@ 快気祝いも兼ねてと: Lieutenant Hugo has come back safe and sound...@so it's also a celebration of his recovery.
LDBI\t「あたし達で簡単なお料理を作ろうと思ってるんです」: We're planning to make some simple dishes.
LDBI\t「カイ少佐の許可も取っています。@ どうでしょうか……？」: Major Kai has given his permission.@What do you think...?
LDBI\t（……これから大変な戦いが待ち受けてるけど、@ それだけに英気も養っ: (...A tough fight lies ahead, but that's all@the more reason to recharge...)
LDBI\t「気を遣ってくれて、ありがとう。@ ヒューゴを誘って、参加させてもら: Thanks for being so thoughtful.@I'll bring Hugo along, and we'll join you.
LDBI\t「それでは、ヒューゴ・メディオ少尉の@ 奇跡の生還を祝って、かんぱ～: And now, to celebrate the miraculous return of@Lieutenant Hugo Medio... Cheeeers!
LDBI\t「さて、ヒューゴ少尉！@ ここで一言ご挨拶をお願いします！」: Now then, Lieutenant Hugo!@A few words from you, please!
LDBI\t（こ、こんな大げさなことになるとは……）: (I-I never thought it'd be such a big deal...)
LDBI\t「み、皆さん……自分のことで大変な@ ご迷惑とご心配をお掛けしました: E-Everyone... I've caused you all a great deal@of trouble and worry. The situation remains@unpredictable, but going forward...
LDBI\t「ヒューゴ君、硬い、硬いってば」: Hugo, too stiff, way too stiff!
LDBI\t「まったくだぜ、カイ少佐かっつーの」: No kidding. Who're you, Major Kai?
LDBI\t「そんなこと……ただいまとでも言えと？」: Then what... I should've just said "I'm home"?
LDBI\t「何やねん、それ。@ 家に帰って来たんとちゃうんやで」: What's that s'posed to mean?@It ain't like he came back home.
LDBI\t（家……か。@ そうでなくても、戻ってくる場所があるというのは@ あ: (Home, huh...@Even if it isn't, having a place to come back to@is something to be grateful for...)
LDBI\t（そうだ……こんな身体になっても、俺にはまだ……）: (Right... even with this body, I still have...)
LDBI\t「……ヒューゴ君、@ はしゃいでられない気持ちはわかるけど……@ こ: ...Hugo, I know you're not in the mood to@celebrate, but... think of it as a change of@pace, okay?
LDBI\t「この和食、プレシアが作ったの？」: Precia, did you make this Japanese food?
LDBI\t「ええ、お兄ちゃんから@ 日本の料理のことを色々聞き出して……@ お: Yes, I asked my brother all about@Japanese cooking... I hope you like it.
LDBI\t「私の勤務地は日本の下田だもの、最近は和食派なの。@ 喜んでいただく: I'm stationed in Shimoda, Japan, so lately I'm@all about Japanese food. I'll gladly dig in.
LDBI\t「肉じゃがにサワラの西京焼、@ ホウレン草のおひたしかぁ。日本人には: Nikujaga, Saikyo-grilled Spanish mackerel,@and boiled spinach... A Japanese guy's dream!
LDBI\t「うん、この味……とってもいいわよ、プレシア。@ お店を出せるぐらい: Mm, this flavor... It's wonderful, Precia.@You're good enough to open your own restaurant.
LDBI\t「ありがとうございます。@ この艦、思っていたより食材が揃っていて…: Thank you.@This ship was better stocked than I expected...
BMD\t「オラオラオラ！！」: Take that, and that, and that!!
BMD\t「ＡＲＴ‐１の力を見せてやるぜ！」: I'll show you what the ART-1 can do!
BMD\t「こいつはただのテストタイプじゃねえぜ！」: This is no mere test type!
BMD\t「ゲシュペンストの実力、見せてやるぜ！」: I'll show you what a Gespenst can do!
BMD\t「このゲシュペンストを/ 甘く見るんじゃねえぞ！」: Don't you dare/　underestimate this Gespenst!
BMD\t「グルンガストの力を見せてやるぜ！」: I'll show you the Grungust's power!
BMD\t「グルンガストを相手にして/ タダで済むと思うな！」: Don't think you can take on the Grungust/　and walk away unscathed!
BMD\t「ヒュッケバインの実力、見せてやるぜ！」: I'll show you what a Hückebein can do!
BMD\t「この俺とＳＲＸを止められると思うな！！」: Don't think you can stop me and the SRX!!
BMD\t「エグレッタ！ てめえ、性懲りもなく！」: Egretta! You just never learn, do you?!
BMD\t「自分の欲が最優先だってのか、/ てめえらは……！」: Your own greed comes first,/　is that it...?!
BMD\t「ラトゥーニ達は、てめえらと違うんだよ！」: Latune and the others aren't like you!
BMD\t「てめえらは自分の過去を/ そういう風に受け止めんのか……！」: So that's how you face/　your own pasts...?!
BMD\t「パワー勝負なら、/ こっちだってお手の物だぜ！」: If it's a contest of power,/　that's right up my alley!
BMD\t「ドゥバン、/ てめえ一人だけで何が出来るってんだ……！」: Duban, what do you think/　you can do all by yourself...?!
BMD\t「あいつ、前にもどこかで……！？/ いや、今は！」: Have I seen that one somewhere before...?!/　No, not now!
BMD\t「念じゃねえが、この感じは……/ いや、それより！」: It's not psychic, but this feeling.../　No, focus!
BMD\t「コンピューターなんぞにやられてたまるか！」: Like hell I'll lose to some computer!
BMD\t「カークス将軍！/ あんたは力の使い方を間違ってるんじゃねえのか！」: General Kirkus!/　Aren't you using your power all wrong?!
BMD\t「メリオルエッセを目の前にして、/ 引き下がるわけにはいかねえ！」: With a Meliores Esse right before me,/　I can't back down now!
BMD\t「あのメリオルエッセは俺に任せろ！」: Leave that Meliores Esse to me!
BMD\t「乗り越えてやるさ、/ てめえらが与える恐怖って奴をな！」: I'll overcome it--/　this fear you're trying to inflict on us!
BMD\t「あいつ、/ 他のメリオルエッセと違うぞ……！？」: That one's different/　from the other Meliores Esse...?!
BMD\t「ペルフェクティオ！ てめえの勝手な理屈で、/ 世界を滅ぼされてたまる: Perfectio! I won't let your selfish logic/　destroy the world!
BMD\t「てめえにあっさり潰されるほど/ この世界は脆かねえぜ！」: This world isn't so fragile/　that you can crush it so easily!
BMD\t「正面からブチ当たってやるぜ、ロフ！」: I'm coming at you head-on, Rof!
BMD\t「俺達に目を付けたのが、/ そもそもの間違いだったんだよ！」: Targeting us was your mistake/　from the very start!
BMD\t「夏喃！ 俺は仙人なんぞになる気はねえ！」: Kanan! I've got no intention of becoming/　some hermit sage!
BMD\t「デカさも念も、化け物クラスか！ けどな！」: Monster-class in size and psychic power!/　But still!
LDBI\t「……北極海のアンノウンに対し、@ <地球連邦軍>の北米、北欧、極東: ...The <地球連邦軍>'s North American,@Northern European and Far Eastern commands will@jointly move against the Arctic Ocean unknown.
LDBI\t「そして、我らガイアセイバーズも@ それに参加することになった」: And we, the Gaia Savers, will be taking part.
LDBI\t「エア・クリスマスとアルファ・セイバーは@ ベーリング海峡からボーフ: Air Christmas and Alpha Saver, enter the@Beaufort Sea via the Bering Strait.
LDBI\t「アルベロ・エスト……ガンマ・セイバーは@ イグアスと共にグリーンラ: Albero Est... Gamma Saver will proceed with@the Iguazu from the Greenland Sea into the@Arctic Ocean.
LDBI\t「投入する戦力は、それだけ？@ オメガとベータは相変わらず、音信不通: That's all you're sending?@Still no word from Omega and Beta, huh?
LDBI\t「ああ、彼らは宇宙に上がっていたのでな」: Yes. They had gone up to space.
LDBI\t「アルテウル司令、デルタ・セイバーは……@ 私のジンライは引き続き鋼: Commander Arteur, I take it Delta Saver...@my Jinrai... will continue pursuing the@Steel Dragons?
LDBI\t「いや、デルタ・セイバーは、@ グランド・クリスマスで待機せよ」: No. Delta Saver is to stand by@at Grand Christmas.
LDBI\t「お言葉ですが、司令……@ 前回の結果を懸念されておられるのでしたら: With all due respect, Commander...@If you're concerned about last time's outcome,@that was...
LDBI\t「今、我々が優先すべきは@ 外敵の排除と陽光の奪還だ」: Our priority now is eliminating the@external threat and reclaiming the sunlight.
LDBI\t「現在、民衆が最大の関心を寄せている@ 今回の作戦で成果を出せば、我: The public's attention is focused on this@operation. If we deliver results, fewer will@doubt our reason for existing.
LDBI\t「大統領は守れなくても、@ 地球は守れるってことを証明しなきゃね」: Couldn't protect the President, sure,@but we've gotta prove we can protect Earth.
LDBI\t「ふん……抜け駆けはありってことでいいのかな？」: Hmph... So getting the jump on everyone@else is fair game?
LDBI\t「そのためのキャニスとエア・クリスマスだ。@ お前達の実力を示せ」: That's what Canis and Air Christmas are for.@Show me what you can do.
LDBI\t「司令、もし北極圏へ向かう途中で、@ 鋼龍戦隊と接触した場合は、@: Commander, if we encounter the Steel Dragons@en route to the Arctic, how should we@handle them?
LDBI\t「接収を試みろ。@ リ・テクノロジストの機体を最優先でな。@ あれは: Attempt to seize them.@The Re-Technologist's units take top priority.@They may prove useful against the unknown.
LDBI\t「接収が不可能だと判断した場合、@ または北極圏での作戦に支障が出る: If you judge seizure impossible, or that it@would hinder the Arctic operation, don't pursue@too far. Wait for another opportunity.
LDBI\t「……僕としちゃ、アンノウンより@ あの連中とやり合いたいんだけどね: ...Personally, I'd rather tangle with that@bunch than the unknown, y'know.
LDBI\t「私のジンライも、@ 本来はダブルＧを倒すために……」: My Jinrai, too, was originally@meant to defeat the Double G...
LDBI\t「お前達がそれぞれ何らかの形で@ 鋼龍戦隊と因縁を持っていることは@: I'm aware that each of you has some@history with the Steel Dragons, but...
LDBI\t「後々のことを踏まえ、@ 極力無傷で彼らの機体を入手したい」: With an eye to the future, I want their@units acquired as intact as possible.
LDBI\t「それは、ツェントル・プロジェクトの機体も@ 含めてということでよろ: Does that include the Tsentr Project's@units as well?
LDBI\t「その件については、ザパト博士の指示に従え」: On that matter, follow Dr. Zapad's@instructions.
LDBI\t（……随分と信用が厚いのだな、あの男は。@ それとも、単に利用されて: (...That man certainly enjoys a lot of trust.@Or is he simply being used?)
LDBI\t（いずれにせよ、@ ヒューゴが真相を知るのは時間の問題か……）: (Either way, it's only a matter of time@before Hugo learns the truth...)
LDBI\t「では、エア・クリスマス、アルファ・セイバー、@ ガンマ・セイバーは: Air Christmas, Alpha Saver and Gamma Saver,@sortie as soon as you're ready.@That is all.
LDBI\t「ああ、俺はヒリュウから降りる。@ もう決めたことだ。今からレフィー: Yeah. I'm leaving the Hiryu. It's decided.@I'm going to Colonel Lefina and Major Gilliam@to request it now.
LDBI\t「何の相談もなく、勝手に！@ あなただけの問題じゃないでしょう！」: Deciding on your own without consulting me!@This isn't just your problem!
LDBI\t「いや、俺だけの問題だ。お前はここに残れ」: No, it is just my problem. You stay here.
LDBI\t「な、何でよ！？ @ 私が足手まといだって言うの！？」: Wh-Why!?@Are you saying I'm dead weight!?
LDBI\t「お前も気づいているだろうが、@ 俺とミタール・ザパトには浅からぬ因: You've probably noticed too, but there's@deep history between me and Mitar Zapad.@I can't drag you into that.
LDBI\t「いいか、アクア……@ お前は、ツェントル・プロジェクトから降りろ。: Listen, Aqua...@Get out of the Tsentr Project.@Your father can sort things out, can't he?
LDBI\t「ああ、テイラー・ケントルム上院議員……それに、@ ケントルム・エク: Yeah. Councilor Taylor Centrum... and Centrum@Express. I thought it was just the same name,@but you really are his daughter.
LDBI\t「……娘が反乱者の一員なのよ。@ 今頃、父達は大わらわだわ」: ...Their daughter's one of the rebels.@Dad and the others must be in a frenzy by now.
LDBI\t「ともかく、これ以上俺に付き合う必要はない。@ いいな？」: Anyway, there's no need to stick with me any@longer. Got it?

BMD\t「これぐらいのことはさせてもらう！」: I can at least do this much!
BMD\t「アヤをやらせはしない！」: I won't let them get Aya!
BMD\t「リュウみたいにやってみる……！」: I'll try it like Ryu does...!
BMD\t「連続攻撃……かわせるか！」: Continuous Attack... can you dodge it?!
BMD\t「リュウ譲りのコンボだ！」: A combo I learned from Ryu!
LDBI\t「仮に知っていたとしても、教える必要はない！@ お前はここで死ぬんだ: Even if I did, I don't have to tell you!@You're going to die here anyway!
LDBI\t「Ｍｋ－Ｘよりスティール２へ！@ ＢＢＣを使用します！」: Mk-X to Steel 2!@I'm using the BBC!
LDBI\t「何をしようと終わりなんだよ！@ コピーごときが！」: It's over, no matter what you do!@You're nothing but a copy!
LDBI\t「違う！ 終わるのは、お前の方だ！」: No! You're the one who's finished!
LDBI\t（……ついにウルズをも倒したか。@ 上々の仕上がりだ、イング……@: (...So he's defeated even Urz.@Fine work, Ing...@This should open the way.)
LDBI\t「……大罪を犯し、それを認めぬばかりか……@ このグランド・クリスマ: ...Not only do you refuse to own your crimes...@you resort to the folly of attacking@Grand Christmas itself.
LDBI\t「地球圏の英雄と謳われた鋼龍戦隊も@ 愚昧の輩に落ちぶれたものだな」: How far the Steel Dragons, hailed as heroes@of the Earth Sphere, have fallen into folly.
LDBI\t「嫌疑については、然るべき時に然るべき場所で@ 釈明すると再三表明し: We've repeatedly stated that we'd answer the@charges at the proper time and place.
LDBI\t「にも関わらず、そちらは強引な接収命令を出し、@ 我らに攻撃を行った: Despite that, you issued a forcible seizure@order and attacked us.
LDBI\t「不当な命令を受け入れる気はない。@ これは私の意思だ」: I won't accept an unjust order.@This is my own will.
LDBI\t「そして、ギャスパル・ギランも……@ 彼はお前達を利用し、我々を陥れ: And Gaspar Gilan as well...@He's using you in a plot to bring us down.
LDBI\t「アルテウル・シュタインベック……この状況は、@ お前が故意に導き出: Arteur Steinbeck... didn't you deliberately@engineer this situation?
LDBI\t「何を根拠にそのようなことを言う？」: On what basis do you say that?
LDBI\t「鋼龍戦隊の討伐が目的であるならば、今までに@ その機はいくらでもあ: If destroying the Steel Dragons were your goal,@you've had countless chances. After all, you@created the pretext for striking us yourself.
LDBI\t「にも関わらず、決定的な手を打たなかった。@ それが、我らの戦力をそ: Yet you never made a decisive move. Even if@that was to take our forces into your own@hands...
LDBI\t「軍勢を送り込む他に、@ もっと効率的かつ効果的な手段があったはずだ: There had to be a more efficient and effective@means than sending in an army.
LDBI\t「むしろ、その手を使うため……@ 鋼龍戦隊を社会的に抹殺するためにも: Or rather, didn't you orchestrate that incident@precisely to use that means...@to socially destroy the Steel Dragons?
LDBI\t「……私がグラスマン前大統領の暗殺を目論んだと？@ 地球の統制権を得: ...You say I plotted to assassinate former@President Grassman? To seize control of Earth?
LDBI\t「我々も一時はそう考えた。@ だが、手段としてはあまりにも@ 強引過: We thought so for a time.@But as a method, it's far too heavy-handed,@and full of holes.
LDBI\t「現に、連邦議会でもお前が黒幕ではないかと@ 囁かれているぐらいだか: In fact, even in the Federation Assembly,@there are whispers that you're the mastermind.
LDBI\t「確かに、前大統領を守り切れなかった責はある。@ だが、言い掛かりに: I admit I bear responsibility for failing to@protect the former President. But this is@nothing more than a false accusation.
LDBI\t「そこだ。@ あれが本当に事故だとしても、@ お前は責を逃れられない: That's the point.@Even if it truly was an accident,@you can't escape responsibility.
LDBI\t「今は非常時ということで@ 有耶無耶にしているのだろうが……@ 議会: You've likely used the state of emergency to@muddy the matter... but you can't escape@scrutiny from the Assembly.
LDBI\t「そうでなくても、@ ガイアセイバーズには疑義が多いのだ」: Even setting that aside,@there are many doubts about the Gaia Savers.
LDBI\t「必要とあらば、毒を用いることも厭わない。@ お前達もそうではないか: When necessary, I don't shy from using poison.@Isn't the same true of you?
LDBI\t「反連邦勢力に属していた者達のみならず、@ メリオルエッセでさえも戦: You field not only former anti-Federation@forces, but even the Meliores Esse.
LDBI\t「地球圏防衛という大義のために@ 清濁を併せ呑むその姿勢……@ それ: That willingness to take the good with the bad@for the cause of defending the Earth Sphere...@In that, we are the same.
LDBI\t「だが、目的が違う。@ お前にとって、地球圏の防衛やその統制は@ 過: But our goals differ. To you, defending and@controlling the Earth Sphere is merely one@step along the way, isn't it?
LDBI\t「今、お前が手にしている権力や軍事力……@ それら全てをなげうってで: Don't you have a goal you'd pursue even if it@meant casting aside all the power and military@might you now hold?
LDBI\t「ほう……私も随分と買い被られたものだ」: Oh? You think rather highly of me.
LDBI\t「お前に全く別の目的があるとしたら、@ 後先を考えていないような行動: If you had an entirely different goal, it would@go some way to explaining your seemingly@reckless actions.
LDBI\t「そして、お前の目的には、@ 我らの何かが関与している」: And something of ours is involved in that goal.
LDBI\t「だからこそ、鋼龍戦隊を故意に泳がせ、@ 最終的にここへ誘き寄せた。: That's why you deliberately let the Steel@Dragons run free, and finally lured them here.@Even while Earth is in a state of emergency.
LDBI\t「お前には、今ここで我らと雌雄を@ 決しなければならない理由があるの: Isn't there some reason you must settle things@with us here and now?
LDBI\t「大層な推論だな。@ 私が自らの手勢を失うために、事を進めていたと？: Quite a theory.@You're saying I arranged to lose my own forces?@What would be the point of that?
LDBI\t「かつてのビアン・ゾルダークや、お前の父親である@ マイヤー・Ｖ・ブ: Like Bian Zoldark once did, or your father,@Maier V. Branstein...
LDBI\t「自らに取って代わる戦力の存在を@ 見出そうとしているとでも？」: You think I'm trying to find a force that@could take my place?
LDBI\t「ビアン総帥や父には、異星人の脅威を払拭し、@ 地球の主権を確立する: Bian and my father sought to dispel the alien@threat and secure Earth's sovereignty.@But you're different...
LDBI\t「いったい、何を目論んでいる？@ いや、それ以前にお前は何者なのだ？: What exactly are you plotting?@No--before that, who are you?
LDBI\t「私とガイアセイバーズは地球を護るための剣……@ 持てる力の全てを地: The Gaia Savers and I are the sword that@protects Earth... We wield all our power for@the defense and survival of the Earth Sphere.
LDBI\t「……僕という存在を作り出し、@ アーマラ達を差し向けた理由も@ そ: ...Is that also why you created me,@and sent Amala and the others after me?
LDBI\t「単に興味が湧いただけだ。@ 不具合が生じ、脱走したマシンナリー・チ: Simple curiosity. A defective Machinery Child@escaped and displayed unexpected power...
LDBI\t「それがどの段階まで至るか、試してみただけに過ぎん」: I merely wanted to test how far it would go.
LDBI\t「イングのことは、偶然だったとでも言うの！？@ あの子に記憶がないの: You're saying Ing was just a coincidence?!@His lack of memories, and his Telekinesis?!
LDBI\t「ああ、イレギュラーに過ぎん。@ 結局は記憶も元に戻らず、私に弓を引: Yes, a mere irregularity. In the end, his@memories never returned, and now he dares@to raise his bow against me.
LDBI\t「つまり、欠陥品だ。ここで消去する」: In short, he's defective. He'll be erased here.
LDBI\t「アルテウル様の命令が出た。@ お前を壊してやるよ、イーグレット・イ: Lord Arteur has given the order.@I'll break you, Ing Egret.
LDBI\t「もう語ることはない。連邦政府特次副大統領と@ ガイアセイバーズの名: Enough talk. In the name of the Federation's@Special Vice President and the Gaia Savers,@I will purge the traitors.
LDBI\t「状況を良く見て喋れ。@ お前の喉元には、もう刃が突き付けられている: Look at your situation before you talk.@There's already a blade at your throat.
LDBI\t「拘束しろと言うのだな？」: You want me to take him alive?
LDBI\t「各員へ！ 真実を明らかにするためにも、@ ここでの敗北は許されん！: All hands! If we're to bring the truth to light,@we can't afford to lose here! Give it your all!
BMD\t「くうっ！ / ペルフェクティオ、/ あなたの糧になるつもりはなくてよ: Ngh!/　Perfectio, I refuse to become/　your sustenance!
BMD\t「妖機人を振り切れないなんて……！」: I can't shake off the Yokijin...!
BMD\t「パワーもスピードも/ ヒュッケバイン以上……！」: More power and speed/　than a Hückebein...!
BMD\t「さすが、ダブルＧ……！」: As expected of the Double G...!
BMD\t「虎龍王並の/ 運動性を持っているというの……！？」: It has mobility on par/　with the KoRyuOh...?!
BMD\t「武雀王……侮れないわね……！」: The BuJakuOh... I mustn't underestimate it...!
BMD\t「あなたの餌食になるつもりはなくてよ……！」: I have no intention/　of becoming your prey...!
BMD\t「これが四凶の実力……！」: So this is the power/　of the Four Fiends...!
BMD\t「私のプライドまで/ 飲み込めると思わないことね……！」: Don't think you can swallow/　my pride as well...!
BMD\t「ううっ……ガンエデン、/ あなたは人類の未来を閉ざす存在よ！」: Ugh... Gan Eden,/　you exist to shut out humanity's future!
BMD\t「くうっ！/ 私達がいる限り、/ あなたが新たな人祖になることはなくて: Ngh!/　As long as we're here,/　you'll never become the new progenitor!
BMD\t「くっ……！ 思ったよりもやるようね……！」: Ngh...! You're better than I thought...!
BMD\t「やるわね。おかげで面白くなってきたわ」: Not bad. This is getting interesting.
BMD\t「くっ！/ だけど、その攻撃はもう通用しなくてよ！」: Ngh!/　But that attack won't work on me anymore!
BMD\t「この程度で引き下がる私ではなくてよ……！」: I'm not one to back down over this...!
BMD\t「これぐらいの損傷……/ 何とでもしてみせるわ」: Damage like this.../　is nothing I can't handle.
BMD\t「！ ズィーガーリオンが、/ 直撃を受けるなんて……！」: What?! The Siegerlion,/　taking a direct hit...!
BMD\t「ラ・ギアスにも手練れはいるようね……！」: So La Gias has its veterans too...!
BMD\t「私としたことが……油断したわね」: How unlike me... I got careless.
BMD\t「常に氷の如く冷静に……/ それがエルザム様の教え」: Always stay cool as ice.../　That is Lord Elzam's teaching.
BMD\t「私に触れるだけで精一杯のようね」: It seems merely touching me/　is the best you can do.
BMD\t「くっ、かわし切れなかったなんて……！」: Ngh, I couldn't fully dodge it...!
BMD\t「！ 追いつかれた！？」: What?! It caught up to me?!
BMD\t「！/ ズィーガーリオンの動きを捉えるなんて……」: What?!/　To think you could catch/　the Siegerlion's movements...
BMD\t「インスペクターより少しはやるようね」: You're a bit better than the Inspectors.
BMD\t「私を絶望させるには程遠いわ」: You're far from making me despair.
BMD\t「何の真似かしら、コンターギオ？」: What are you playing at, Contagio?
BMD\t「孫光龍……遊んでいるつもりなの……！？」: Son Koryu... Are you toying with me...?!
BMD\t「そんなものかしら、ゼゼーナン」: Is that all you've got, Zezenan?
BMD\t「“破滅の王”の力……/ こんなものではないはず！」: The power of the "King of Destruction".../　It can't be only this!
BMD\t「あの斧に気をつけなければ……！」: I must watch out for that axe...!
BMD\t「さすが最新鋭機、と言っておくわ」: Impressive. Fitting for the latest model.
BMD\t「反応速度は、/ アウセンザイターと同レベル……！」: Its reaction speed is/　on par with the Aussenseiter...!
BMD\t「あの妄念に飲み込まれるわけには……！」: I can't let that obsession swallow me...!
BMD\t「慈悲の心、とでも言うつもりかしら？」: Do you mean to call that mercy?
BMD\t「ユーゼス……この力、やはり危険ね」: Euzeth... This power is truly dangerous.
BMD\t「その程度で私に戦いを挑むなんて……」: Challenging me with only that much...
BMD\t「本当に私を狙ったのかしら？」: Were you really aiming at me?
BMD\t「気安い相手ではなくてよ」: I'm not one to be taken lightly.
BMD\t「回避パターンを変えるまでもないわね」: No need to change my evasion pattern.
BMD\t「私に触れることは出来なくてよ」: You can't lay a finger on me.
BMD\t「ズィーガーリオンには/ ついてこられないようね」: It seems you can't/　keep up with the Siegerlion.
BMD\t「この機体は、ガーリオンと一味違うわよ」: This machine is a cut above the Guarlion.
BMD\t「正攻法だけに読み易くてよ、ロフ」: Textbook tactics are easy to read, Rof.
LDBI\t「だいたい、お前は<ノイエＤＣ>の手先だったろうが。@ 偉そうにあた: Besides, you were a <ノイエＤＣ> pawn. Who are you@to talk about us? A little <リマコン>, and@friends turn into enemies, right?
LDBI\t「ちょっと、あなた！ いい加減にしなさいよ！」: Hey, you! Knock it off already!
LDBI\t「今のゼオラは、昔と違いますわ！」: Seolla isn't the person she used to be!
LDBI\t「ゼオラ、彼女の言葉に聞き入っては駄目よ。@ あなたの動揺を誘ってい: Seolla, don't listen to her.@She's trying to rattle you.
LDBI\t「無駄さ。あたしは、そいつがアギラに@ 何をされてきたか知ってる」: Waste of breath. I know what Agira@did to her.
LDBI\t「女だったら、あんな目に遭うのは辛いよなぁ！@ 何をされたか、ここで: That kind of thing's rough on a girl, huh!@Should I tell everyone what they did to you?!
LDBI\t「シエンヌ！ それ以上、ほざいたら許さねえぞ！！」: Sienne! Say one more word and you're dead!!
LDBI\t「フン……弱い犬ほど、よく吠えるゆうてのう」: Hmph... The weakest dogs bark the loudest, they say.
LDBI\t「あ！？ 何だ、お前は！？」: Huh?! Who the hell are you?!
LDBI\t「おどれらがナンボのもんか知らんけどな……@ 街を平気で焼き討ちにす: Dunno how big a deal you lot think you are...@but folks who torch a city without blinkin'@ain't worth a damn.
LDBI\t「場違いなんだよ、引っ込んでろ！」: You don't belong here! Butt out!
LDBI\t「いくらワイでもな、@ どいつがホンマもんのワルかぐらいわかるわい。: Even I can tell@who the real scumbags are.@And you're the dogs waggin' your tails for 'em.
LDBI\t「そんな連中にな、@ ワイらの道を塞ぐことは出来んわい！」: And mutts like that@ain't gonna block our way!
LDBI\t「脇へ行って、電柱にションベンでも引っ掛けとれ！@ チャーッとな！」: Go off and take a leak on a telephone pole!@Psssh!
LDBI\t「ふざけやがって！ ブッ殺すよ！！」: You son of a--! I'll kill you!!
LDBI\t「……まんまと相手の口車に乗せられてるし」: ...And she fell right for his bait.
LDBI\t「ああ、上手く彼らの気勢を削いだな」: Yes, he took the wind right out of their sails.
LDBI\t「ミチルさん、それを計算の内に入れて……？」: Michiru, did you plan that all along...?
LDBI\t「あいつ、腕っ節だけかと思ったら、@ 口もそこそこ回るじゃねえの」: Thought the guy was all muscle,@but he's got a pretty sharp tongue too.
LDBI\t「相手を怒らせるのが上手い……@ カチーナ中尉みたいだ」: He's good at making people mad...@Just like Lieutenant Katina.
LDBI\t「ともかく、あんなイケ好かんガキ共の寝言聞いて、@ ショボくれること: Anyway, ain't no reason to mope@over the sleep-talk of some snotty brats.
LDBI\t「そこには同意するぜ。@ ゼオラ、アラド、気にするこたあねえ！@ 奴: I'm with you there.@Seolla, Arado, don't let it get to ya!@Go knock some sense into those punks!
LDBI\t「ああ……！@ おれにはまだやらなきゃならないことがあるんだ！@ あ: Yeah...!@I've still got things I have to do!@No way I'm dying as their stepping stone!
LDBI\t「そう……@ オウカ姉様……クラスの子達の分も、@ 私達は生きなきゃ: Right...@We have to live on for Big Sister Ouka...@and for the other kids in our class.
LDBI\t「そうしてくれって、頼まれたわけじゃないくせに」: Not like anybody asked you to.
LDBI\t「私は、みんなが存在していた証の一つ……@ だから、まだ死ねない」: I'm one of the proofs that they all existed...@That's why I can't die yet.
LDBI\t「そして、間違ったことのために力を使いたくない。@ それが、望んで与: And I don't want to use my power for wrong.@Even if it's not something I asked to be given.
LDBI\t「だから、言ったろうが！@ 何が正しくて、何が間違ってるか、@ そい: I told you already!@What's right and what's wrong@gets decided by whoever wins and survives!
LDBI\t「何や、そら？@ アラドにあないなこと言うといて、@ おどれの台詞も: Huh? What's that?@After talkin' to Arado like that,@you're spoutin' the same cliché stuff!
LDBI\t「て、てめえ、いちいちうるせえんだよ！」: Y-You, shut the hell up already!
LDBI\t「……私は、あなた達と違う道を選んだの」: ...I chose a different path from you.
LDBI\t「なら、その道をここで断ち切ってやるよ！@ 各機、仕掛けな！」: Then I'll cut that path short right here!@All units, attack!
LDBI\t「迷うな、ゼオラ。@ この道を選んだ以上、生き残らなければ意味がない: Don't hesitate, Seolla.@You chose this path, so it means nothing@unless you survive.
LDBI\t「例え、死に行く任務を与えられようとも、@ 生き残る意志を失えば、事: Even when you're given a mission to die,@if you lose the will to survive, you'll fail.
LDBI\t「メディウスに乗っていたのは、あなただったのか！？」: You were the one piloting the Medius?!
LDBI\t「連邦軍特殊ＰＴ部隊、クライウルブズの隊長……@ つまり、ヒューゴ少: Leader of the Cry Wolves, the Federation's@special PT unit. In other words, he was@Lieutenant Hugo's commanding officer.
LDBI\t「込み入った事情……という言葉では@ 済まなさそうだな」: Calling it complicated@doesn't seem to cover it.
LDBI\t「ああ。ますます胡散臭くなってきたぜ、@ ツェントル・プロジェクトが: Yeah. The Tsentr Project is looking@shadier by the minute.
LDBI\t「アルベロ少佐、@ 何故、あなたがガイアセイバーズに……@ いや、知: Major Albero,@why are you with the Gaia Savers...?@No--you knew, and attacked Hugo's team anyway?!
LDBI\t「その通りだが、お前達が理由を知る必要はない。@ ヒューゴ・メディオ: That's right, but you have no need to know why.@Nor do Hugo Medio and Aqua Centrum.
LDBI\t（同一部隊の出身者同士で戦わせていたとは……。@ 現場での意思疎通も: (Pitting members of the same old unit against@each other... They could collude in the field,@and information could leak.)
LDBI\t（その危険を冒してまで、実戦でデータを取ることに@ 何の意味がある？: (What's the point of gathering combat data@if it means taking that risk? Besides...)
LDBI\t「カイ少佐。@ アルベロ少佐は何故、この状況で@ わざわざ通信を入れ: Major Kai.@Why would Major Albero go out of his way@to contact us in this situation?
LDBI\t「自分もその点が気になります」: That point concerns me as well.
LDBI\t「わかっている。@ ……アルベロ少佐、ヒューゴ達をどうする気だ？」: I know.@...Major Albero, what are your plans@for Hugo and the others?
LDBI\t「ろ獲する。リ・テクの機体と共にな」: Capture them. Along with the Re-Tech machine.
LDBI\t「その機体には、ルイーナの秘密を解く鍵が@ あるのだろう？」: That machine holds the key to unlocking@the Ruina's secrets, does it not?
LDBI\t「鋼龍戦隊司令、@ レフィーナ・エンフィールド大佐に告ぐ。@ 直ちに: Attention, Steel Dragons commander,@Colonel Lefina Enfield.@Disarm and surrender immediately.
BMD\t「雀武王相手に油断は出来ない……！」: I can't let my guard down/　against JakuBuOh...!
BMD\t「私が信じる四神の超機人は、/ 龍虎王と虎龍王です！」: The Four Gods Choukijin I believe in/　are RyuKoOh and KoRyuOh!
BMD\t「四神同士の戦いが、/ 避けられない宿命だというのなら！」: If the Four Gods are fated/　to fight each other, then so be it!
BMD\t「武雀王の守りは固い……/ でも、隙は必ずあるはず！」: BuJakuOh's defenses are tough.../　But there has to be an opening!
BMD\t「私は、龍虎王や虎龍王と共に戦います！」: I'll fight alongside RyuKoOh and KoRyuOh!
BMD\t「私は、/ 人間の味方をしてくれる龍虎王を信じます！」: I believe in RyuKoOh,/　who stands on humanity's side!
BMD\t「朱雀の超機人……油断は出来ない！」: The Suzaku Choukijin.../　I can't let my guard down!
BMD\t「玄武の超機人なら、スピード勝負で！」: Against the Genbu Choukijin,/　speed is the way to win!

BMD\t「ふん、なめられたものだな……/ その程度で俺の相手をしようとは！」: Hmph, you underestimate me.../　Thinking you could face me with that!
BMD\t「手加減したとでも言うつもりか？/ テュッティ」: Are you going to tell me you held back,/　Tytti?
BMD\t「ふん、/ 攻撃力が自慢のグランヴェールでこのザマか？」: Hmph. Granveil boasts such firepower,/　and this is all it can do?
BMD\t「子供の出る幕ではないぞ、プレシア！」: This is no place for a child, Precia!
BMD\t「所詮、ノルスではそれが限界」: That's the most a Norse can manage.
BMD\t「ふん、当てただけでも褒めてやろう、/ ザシュフォード」: Hmph, I'll credit you for landing a hit,/　Zashford.
BMD\t「どうした？/ こんなもの、本気ではあるまい？ シュウよ」: What's wrong?/　Surely that wasn't your best, Shu?
BMD\t「相手がいつまでも/ 止まっていてくれると思わんことだな」: Don't expect your opponent/　to just sit still forever.
BMD\t「攻撃のパターンが単純過ぎるな」: Your attack patterns are too simple.
BMD\t「機動力では負けんよ、ヤンロン」: I won't lose on mobility, Yang Long.
BMD\t「ふん、そんな腕ではリカルドも浮かばれんな」: Hmph, with skills like that,/　Ricardo can't rest in peace.
BMD\t「セニア様、戦場はお遊びではないのですよ」: Princess Xenia,/　the battlefield is no playground.
BMD\t「ふん……グランゾンといえど、/ 当たりさえしなければ！」: Hmph... Granzon or not,/　it can't hurt me if it can't hit me!
BMD\t「貴様の趣味に付き合ってなどおれん！」: I won't indulge your little hobby!
BMD\t「お姫様のお遊びに付き合っているほど/ 暇ではないのですよ」: I'm not so idle that I can play along/　with a princess's games.
BMD\t「やはりな……そう来ると思っていたぞ」: Just as I thought.../　I knew you'd try that.
BMD\t「そうくると思っていたぞ、ゲンナジー」: I knew you'd try that, Gennacy.
BMD\t「む、射程外か……少しは考えているようだな」: Hm, out of range.../　So you've given this some thought.
BMD\t「戦場で隙を見せれば死に繋がる。/ 覚えておけ！」: Leave an opening in battle and you die./　Remember that!
BMD\t「よし、とどめは俺に任せろ！」: Right, leave the finishing blow to me!
BMD\t「よし、手伝ってやるぞ、マサキ」: All right, I'll lend you a hand, Masaki.
BMD\t「それで当てるつもりか！」: You expect to hit me with that?
BMD\t「こっちだって/ 避ける気がないわけじゃない……！」: I'm not about to just sit here/　and take it, either...!
BMD\t「ただでは当たってやれん……！」: I won't let you hit me that easily...!
BMD\t「これくらいはアルトでもやれる」: Even the Alt can manage this much.
BMD\t「重いからって甘く見るなよ……！」: Don't think I'm a pushover/　just because I'm heavy...!
BMD\t「見た目よりは動けるんでな……！」: I move better than I look...!
BMD\t「避けられなければ始まらん……！」: If I can't evade,/　it's over before it starts...!
BMD\t「機動性が頼りなら……避けてみせろ！」: If mobility's all you've got.../　then dodge this!
BMD\t「所詮はそんなものか、ドゥバン」: Is that all you've got, Duban?
BMD\t「メリオルエッセなどと……/ 名ばかりは大層だがな」: Meliores Esse... A grand name/　for so little.
BMD\t「お前の御託はもういい」: I've heard enough of your drivel.
BMD\t「インスペクターと大差ないようだな」: You're no different from the Inspectors.
BMD\t「結局、言うこととやることは/ インスペクターと同じか」: In the end, your words and deeds/　are the same as the Inspectors'.
BMD\t「破滅するのはお前の方だ」: You're the one who'll be destroyed.
BMD\t「超機人……見た目だけか」: A Choukijin... All show, it seems.
BMD\t「超機人の力はその程度か？」: Is that all a Choukijin can do?
BMD\t「お前と溶け合う気などない」: I have no intention of merging with you.
BMD\t「今回の賭けは俺の勝ちだ……！」: This time, the bet goes to me...!
BMD\t「なるほど……/ 慣れれば使える機体だな、こいつは」: I see... Once you get used to it,/　this machine is quite usable.
BMD\t「仙人だけあって、酔狂な手だな」: A whimsical trick, fitting for a hermit.
BMD\t「ガイアセイバーズ……/ お前達のショーに付き合う気はない」: Gaia Savers... I have no interest/　in playing along with your show.
BMD\t「その手には乗らんぞ、ガイアセイバーズ」: I won't fall for that, Gaia Savers.
BMD\t「ガイアセイバーズ……/ 目論み通りに行くと思うなよ」: Gaia Savers... Don't think things/　will go as you planned.
BMD\t「確かに、/ ヒュッケバイン以上の運動性だが……」: It's certainly more agile/　than a Hückebein, but...
BMD\t「ダイゼンガーほどの切れはないようだな」: But it lacks the Dygenguar's edge.
BMD\t「神を名乗っておいて、それか？」: You call yourself a god, and that's it?
BMD\t「ユーゼス、/ お前の計画にほころびが見えているぞ」: Euzeth, your plan/　is starting to unravel.
BMD\t「ブラフ混じりの手などに……！」: I won't fall for a bluffing hand...!
BMD\t「サマ臭いが……バリアの世話になるか」: Smells like cheating, but.../　I'll take the barrier's help.
BMD\t「これを抜いても装甲がある。/ 食ってはやれん」: Get through this and there's still armor./　I won't be easy prey.
BMD\t「……ちっ、序盤で無駄が多かったか……！」: ...Tch, I wasted too much early on...!
BMD\t「……ちっ、実弾は扱いやすいが、弾数がな」: ...Tch, live ammo's easy to handle,/　but the ammo count...
BMD\t「寄らなければ話にならんか……」: Can't do anything unless I close in...
BMD\t「この距離ならば……援護する！」: From this range... I'll cover you!
BMD\t「何をやっている。/ おれがとどめを撃つぞ、エクセレン」: What are you doing? I'll take/　the final shot, Excellen.
BMD\t「下がれ、エクセレン！ おれも仕掛ける！」: Fall back, Excellen! I'm going in too!
BMD\t「カチーナ中尉、援護に入るぞ……！」: Lieutenant Katina, I'll back you up...!
BMD\t「リュウセイ、後は任せろ」: Ryusei, leave the rest to me.
LDBI\t「いえ、御身がご無事で何よりです、@ シャイン・ハウゼン王女」: Not at all. Your safety is what matters most,@Princess Shine Hausen.
LDBI\t「いや～、ホント、絶妙のタイミングだったよ」: Man, you guys sure had perfect timing.
LDBI\t「って言うか、リューネ……@ お前、その格好のまんまで潜入したのか？: Wait, Lüne...@you infiltrated the place dressed like that?
LDBI\t「黒豹連れで、よくバレなかったもんだ」: With a black panther in tow? Amazing nobody@caught on.
LDBI\t「そうね……この上なく目立つと思うけど」: Yes... I'd think you'd be impossible to miss.
LDBI\t「まあ、誰かさんが完璧な変装をしてたからね。@ あんた達にも見せたか: Well, a certain someone had a flawless disguise.@I wish you could've seen it.
LDBI\t「僕は冷や汗ものだったがな」: I was in a cold sweat the whole time.
LDBI\t「ところで、シャイン王女は@ どのような経緯でラ・ギアスへ？」: By the way, Princess Shine, how did you@end up in La Gias?
LDBI\t「リクセントでフェアリオンのコックピットを@ 掃除していましたら、突: I was cleaning the Fairion's cockpit in Rixent,@and suddenly I was in this world...
LDBI\t「その後、王女がシュテドニアス軍に@ 捕まった所に私とブリット君が@: After that, Bullet and I came across the@Princess just as the Shtedonias Army@captured her, but...
LDBI\t「王女を人質に取られてしまい、@ やむなく彼らに投降したんです」: They took the Princess hostage, so we had@no choice but to surrender.
LDBI\t「それで、彼らに協力するよう強要されたの？」: So then they forced you to cooperate?
LDBI\t「ううん……あの人達は、私達三人を@ どこかに移送するつもりだったみ: No... It seems they were planning to transport@the three of us somewhere.
LDBI\t「ええ。@ そのためか、尋問は受けたものの、@ 手荒な真似はされませ: Yes.@Maybe that's why they interrogated us@but didn't rough us up.
LDBI\t「その割にゃ、人質にする気だったみてえだがな。@ ま、こうやって助け: Funny, they sure seemed ready to use you as@hostages. Eh, we got you out, so let's just@call it all good.
LDBI\t「……では、ゼンガー少佐は@ どこからラ・ギアスへ？」: ...And you, Major Sänger? How did you@get to La Gias?
LDBI\t「俺は再調整を行ったダイゼンガーのテストを@ 行うため、ユウキやカー: I'd taken the recalibrated Dygenguar out over@the Pacific for testing, along with Yuuki,@Carla and the others...
LDBI\t「そこで、３機の新型リオンシリーズらしき機体と@ 遭遇し、交戦した」: There, we encountered and engaged three units@that looked like new Lion-series machines.
LDBI\t「もしや、それはシエンヌ達では……？」: Could that have been Sienne and the others...?
LDBI\t「<地球連邦軍>や<ノイエＤＣ>の機体には@ 見えなかったが……その: They didn't look like <地球連邦軍> or@<ノイエＤＣ> units... Afterward, we were suddenly@engulfed in light and brought to this world.
LDBI\t「その後、ダイゼンガーを谷間に隠して、@ 単独行動を取り……地上人が: Then I hid the Dygenguar in a valley and set out@alone... and learned that surface dwellers were@being held captive in that place.
LDBI\t「……じゃあ、少佐と一緒にいた@ ユウやカーラもラ・ギアスへ来ている: ...Then Yuu and Carla, who were with you, Major,@might be in La Gias too.
LDBI\t「あの……ライディ様や他の皆様は……」: Um... What of Raidi and everyone else...?
LDBI\t「この世界へ召喚された可能性が高いのですが……@ 消息はまだ掴めてい: It's likely they were summoned here too...@but we still have no word of them.
LDBI\t「何だかんだでみんな無事だったんだし、@ 他の連中もそうだと思いたい: One way or another, we all made it out okay,@so I'd like to think the others did too...
LDBI\t「カークス将軍が鋼龍戦隊のメンバーに関する@ 情報を持っていて、僕達: General Kirkus may have information on the@Steel Dragons' members that he's hiding from us.
LDBI\t「彼の所へ行き、諸々の件を直接問い質そう」: Let's go to him and question him directly@about all of this.
LDBI\t「ねえねえ、トロニウムって何なの？@ どっかで聞いたような気がするけ: Hey, hey, what's Tronium?@I feel like I've heard of it somewhere.
LDBI\t「凄えエネルギーを引き出すレアメタルだ。@ ＳＲＸのエンジンやハガネ: A rare metal that puts out insane energy.@It's used in the SRX's engine and@the Hagane's Buster Cannon.
LDBI\t「ハガネに……@ あ、それで聞き覚えがあるんだ」: In the Hagane...@Oh, so that's why it sounds familiar.
LDBI\t「確か、<トロニウム>は地球上に６個しかなくて……@ その内、１個は: Supposedly there's only six pieces of <トロニウム>@on Earth, and one of 'em had gone missing...@Shu, so you're the one who had it.
LDBI\t「ええ、ビアン博士から託されていたのです」: Yes. Dr. Bian entrusted it to me.
LDBI\t「何で今になってそれを……俺に？」: Why give it to me... now of all times?
LDBI\t「鋼龍戦隊で使っていただければと思いましてね。@ この後、あなたは彼: I thought the Steel Dragons could put it to use.@You intend to join up with them after this, yes?
LDBI\t「では、ケースごと渡しますから、受け取って下さい」: Then I'll hand it over, case and all.@Please take it.
LDBI\t「マサキ、ケースに妙な仕掛けはニャいニャ。@ ただ、トロニウムが本物: Masaki, the case isn't booby-trapped, meow.@But I can't tell whether the Tronium@is real or not...
LDBI\t「シュウ……てめえの本当の目的は、@ いったい何なんだ？」: Shu...@what the hell are you really after?
LDBI\t「先程のゼゼーナン卿との話から、@ 察していただいていると思っていま: I thought you'd have gathered that from my@conversation with Lord Zezenan just now.
LDBI\t「それだけじゃねえだろうが」: That ain't all of it, and you know it.
LDBI\t「確かに、@ まだ調べなければならないことがありますが……@ あなた: Admittedly,@there are still things I must look into...@But I have no intention of fighting you.
LDBI\t「その言葉を信用しろってのか？」: And you expect me to trust that?
LDBI\t「ちょっと、ちょっと。@ 私達、あなた達に協力してあげたんだけど？」: Hold on, hold on.@We just helped you out, didn't we?
LDBI\t「お前の言葉は尚更信用できん。@ そもそも、今回の件はシュウが仕組ん: I trust your word even less.@Shu set up this whole affair to begin with.
LDBI\t「地上は、あなた達が思っている以上に@ 危険な状況なのですよ。場合に: The surface is in a far more dangerous state@than you realize. Depending on how things go,@it could bring grave peril to La Gias as well.
LDBI\t「私の言葉を信用していただき……@ 先程、マサキが言ったように魔装機: Why not trust my word... and fulfill your duty@as Masoukishin pilots, just as Masaki said@a moment ago?
LDBI\t「……行けよ。@ ただし、妙な真似をしやがったら、その時は……」: ...Go.@But if you try anything funny, then...
LDBI\t「フッ……覚えておきましょう。それでは」: Heh... I'll keep that in mind. Farewell.
LDBI\t「……本当の所は、どうなのかしらね」: ...I wonder what the truth really is.
LDBI\t「あいつを信頼することなんぞ出来ねえが……@ さっきの言葉は、まあ信: There's no way I can trust that guy, but...@I'll take what he just said at face value.
LDBI\t「ビミョーな言い方ニャ」: That's a pretty fine line, meow.
LDBI\t「マサキ、こっちに何か近づいて来るニャ」: Masaki, something's heading this way, meow.
LDBI\t「やっぱり、魔装機神……マサキ君達だわ！」: It is the Masoukishin... Masaki and the others!
LDBI\t「もしかして、@ あいつらもシュウに呼び出されたのか？」: Don't tell me@Shu called them out here too?
LDBI\t「ちょうどいい所に来てくれたぜ。@ 鋼龍戦隊と合流しよう。さっきのシ: You showed up at just the right time. Let's@regroup with the Steel Dragons. Everyone needs@to hear what Shu told us.
LDBI\t「サイバスター……どれほどのスピードとパワーか、@ 見せてもらおうか: Cybuster... Let's see just how much speed@and power you've got!
LDBI\t「ついでに痛い目も見せてやるぜ！」: And I'll show you some pain while I'm at it!
LDBI\t「こっちもスピードには自信があるのよ」: We're pretty confident in our speed too, you know.
LDBI\t「前にも似たようなことを言ってやがった女がいたな。@ 同じ目に遭わせ: Another woman said the same kinda thing before.@You'll get what she got, so brace yourself!
LDBI\t「アルテウルとゼゼーナンの会見映像は、@ こちらでも確認した。もっと: We've confirmed the footage of Arteur's meeting@with Zezenan on our end as well. However, its@credibility is low, so it's hardly hard proof.
LDBI\t「まあ、捏造された映像であることは@ 事実ですからな」: Well, the footage is a fabrication,@after all.
LDBI\t「だが、火のない所に煙は立たぬということで、@ 連邦議会ではアルテウ: Still, there's no smoke without fire. Some in@the Federation Assembly are moving to summon@Arteur and demand an explanation.
LDBI\t「無論、呼び出されるのは彼だけでなく……@ レフィーナ大佐、君もだが: Of course, he won't be the only one called...@You will be too, Captain Lefina.
LDBI\t「召喚命令には応じます。@ ですが、アルテウルは……」: I'll comply with the summons.@But Arteur...
LDBI\t「こちらからも彼に説明を求めた。@ だが、例の映像の信憑性の低さと@: We demanded an explanation from him as well.@But he brushed it off, citing the footage's low@credibility and his ongoing operations.
LDBI\t「そして、我が軍による大統領の事件の調査と検証も@ 依然として拒んで: He also still refuses to let our military@investigate the incident with the President.
LDBI\t「では、連邦議会に対しても……」: Then to the Federation Assembly as well...
LDBI\t「もちろん、ゲストとの共謀や大統領の暗殺は@ 濡れ衣だと主張している: Naturally, he claims that colluding with the@Guests and assassinating the President are@false charges.
LDBI\t「ただ、アルテウルといえど、@ 召喚命令を完全に拒否することは不可能: Still, even Arteur can't refuse@a summons outright.
LDBI\t「公の場で身の潔白を証明できないのであれば、@ 嫌疑ありと見なされて: If he can't prove his innocence in public,@he can't complain if he's treated as a suspect...
LDBI\t「また、君達のようにリスクを承知した上で@ 行方不明を装うわけにもい: Nor can he fake his disappearance the way you@did, knowing full well the risks involved.
LDBI\t「しかし、召喚を先延ばしにすることは可能でしょう。@ 体調不良による: Still, he can put off the summons.@By the old ploy of a lengthy stay in hospital.
LDBI\t「さすがに入院はしないだろうが……@ 今は非常事態下であり、ルイーナ: I doubt he'll check into a hospital... But we're@in a state of emergency, with counteroffensives@against the Ruina and the Guests coming up...
LDBI\t「彼はそれを理由にして時間を稼ぎ、@ 証拠を揃え、根回しをするつもり: He'll use that as an excuse to buy time,@gather evidence, and work behind the scenes.
LDBI\t「例の映像の流布によって、世間では@ ガイアセイバーズの陰謀説……君: As the footage spreads, a growing number believe@in a Gaia Savers conspiracy... that you were@caught in their trap.
LDBI\t「また、連邦議会でも反グラスマン派の議員達が@ ガイアセイバーズにま: And in the Assembly, anti-Grassman Councilors@are loudly demanding the truth behind the dark@rumors surrounding the Gaia Savers.
LDBI\t「そして、それがＰＧＳの議会承認を@ 遅らせることになると踏んだギャ: Marshal Gaspar figured that would delay the@Assembly's approval of the PGS, so he withdrew@the order for your arrest.
LDBI\t「ああ、元帥はアルテウルとの駆け引きで@ それを認めさせた。ただし、: Yes. The Marshal got Arteur to agree to it as@part of their bargaining. However, you remain@stripped of your military status...
LDBI\t「我々も表立って君達を支援することは出来ない。@ ただし、連邦軍に追: And we can't openly support you, either.@That said, the Federation military won't be@chasing you anymore.
LDBI\t「それだけでも、助かります……」: Even that much is a great help...
BMD\t「何としてでも、助けてみせるっ！」: I'll save them, no matter what!
BMD\t「この状況、放ってはおけないわ！」: I can't just leave things like this!
BMD\t「リョウト君、ディフェンスは私に任せて！」: Ryoto, leave the defense to me!
BMD\t「クスハ！ あなたは早く逃げて！」: Kusuha! Get out of here, quick!
BMD\t「ラーダさん、今の内に逃げて！」: Radha, get away while you can!
BMD\t「中尉、私が時間を稼ぎます！」: Lieutenant, I'll buy you some time!
BMD\t「カーラ！ ちゃんと集中しなきゃダメよ！」: Carla! You've got to stay focused!
BMD\t「アラド君！ 装甲を過信しちゃダメ！」: Arado! Don't trust your armor too much!
BMD\t「コウタ君、よそ見しちゃダメだって！」: Kota, I told you not to look away!
BMD\t「アクア、早く逃げて！」: Aqua, get out of here, quick!
BMD\t「一気に仕掛けるわよ！！」: Let's hit them all at once!!
BMD\t「アーマリオンの必殺技、見せてあげるわ！」: I'll show you the Armorlion's finisher!
BMD\t「リョウト君が作ったモーションパターンよ！」: This motion pattern was made by Ryoto!
BMD\t「一気に行くわよ！ ビルガー！」: All at once! Let's go, Bilgern!
BMD\t「このスピードなら、絶対負けない！」: At this speed, I can't lose!
BMD\t「これではいいデータが取れん」: I can't get good data like this.
BMD\t「次に期待するしかないか」: I'll just have to hope/　for better next time.
BMD\t「凡庸なデータは不要なのだよ」: I have no use for mediocre data.
BMD\t「ちっ、データより速いな」: Tch, faster than the data said.
BMD\t「軽傷だ、気にするまでもない」: A minor wound. Nothing to worry about.
BMD\t「アルトアイゼンが/ この程度だとは思えんが……」: I can't believe that's all/　the Alteisen has...
BMD\t「もう少し手強いはずだ、アルトアイゼンは」: The Alteisen should be/　tougher than this.
BMD\t「所詮は欠陥機ということか」: So it's just a defective/　machine after all.
BMD\t「ヴァイスリッター……/ 以前より弱体化しているのか？」: Weissritter.../　Has it grown weaker than before?
BMD\t「アインストの力を手に入れたと/ 聞いていたが……」: I'd heard it had gained/　the power of the Einst...
BMD\t「それでは、改造した意味がないようだな」: Then it seems the upgrades/　were pointless.
BMD\t「グルンガストならば、/ もう少しやると思っていたがな」: I expected more/　from a Grungust.
BMD\t「グルンガストがこの程度などと……/ 物足りんな」: The Grungust, this weak.../　How unsatisfying.
BMD\t「ジガンスクード……所詮は旧型機か」: Giganscudo.../　Just an old model after all.
BMD\t「他のパーソナルトルーパーと/ 変わらんようだな」: Seems it's no different/　from any other Personal Trooper.
BMD\t「特機ならば、/ もう少し手応えがあるはずだがな」: A super robot should/　put up more of a fight.
BMD\t「鋼龍戦隊の特機なら、/ いいデータが得られると思っていたが……」: I thought a Steel Dragons super robot/　would give me good data...
BMD\t「アルテリオンの力は、/ その程度ではあるまい？」: Surely the Alteriion's power/　is greater than that?
BMD\t「ダブルＧは、/ これほどまでに非力だったのか？」: Was the Double G/　always this feeble?

BMD\t「魔装機神の力、侮れんな」: I mustn't underestimate/　the Masoukishin's power.
BMD\t「Ｒシリーズ……期待外れだな、これでは」: The R Series.../　This is disappointing.
BMD\t「ヴァルシオーネ……/ もう少しやってもらわねばな」: Valsione.../　I'll need more from you than that.
BMD\t「くっ！ ハイペリオンを振り切れん！」: Tch! I can't shake the Hyperlion!
BMD\t「チッ！ サイリオン以上のスピードか！」: Tch! It's faster than the Cylion!
BMD\t「それでは、スレイには勝てまい」: You'll never beat Sleigh like that.
BMD\t「その機体では、サイリオンを捕捉できん」: That machine can't lock onto/　the Cylion.
BMD\t「それで風の魔装機神だと？」: And you call yourself/　the Masoukishin of wind?
BMD\t「手が出せんとはな」: So I can't lay a hand on it.
BMD\t「ひとまず様子を見るしかないか」: I'll have to wait and see for now.
BMD\t「上手く姿をくらませたつもりだろうが……」: You think you've given me/　the slip, but...
BMD\t「ここでロストするとはな」: To lose track of it here...
BMD\t「いい対応だ。さすがだと言っておこう」: Good response. I'll give you that.
BMD\t「この隙を見逃すほど甘くはないのだよ」: I'm not soft enough to let/　an opening like this slip.
BMD\t「さあ、どう対処する？」: Now, how will you handle this?
BMD\t「フッ、離脱が遅れたか」: Heh, I was slow to disengage.
BMD\t「怯むものか、魔装機神が相手でも！」: I won't flinch,/　even against a Masoukishin!
BMD\t「魔装機神でも、隙はどこかにあるはずだ！」: Even a Masoukishin/　must have an opening somewhere!
BMD\t「ザムジード……我らの敵になるのであれば！」: Zamzeed.../　If you stand against us, so be it!
BMD\t「ううっ……！ 大義を成すまでは！」: Ngh...! Not until our cause is won!
BMD\t「ぬうっ！ 我らにも意地がある！」: Nngh! We have our pride too!
BMD\t「ええい、地上人め！/ これ以上はやらせんぞ！」: Damn you, surface dweller!/　That's as far as you go!
BMD\t「うぐっ……やはり、魔装機神には……！」: Ugh... As I feared,/　a Masoukishin is too much...!
BMD\t「ぐっ！/ 覚悟なくして、魔装機神には挑まん！！」: Ngh!/　I'd never face a Masoukishin/　unprepared!!
BMD\t「こ、これが炎の魔装機神の力か！」: S-so this is the power/　of the Masoukishin of flame!
BMD\t「ガッデス……/ せめて、足止めだけでも……！！」: Gaddess.../　If I can at least slow you down...!!
BMD\t「くっ！ 致命傷じゃない！」: Ngh! It's not a fatal hit!
BMD\t「これぐらいのダメージ、覚悟はしていた！」: I was prepared to take this much damage!
BMD\t「臆するものか！ まだ戦う！」: I won't cower! I can still fight!
BMD\t「くっ！ 魔装機神……やはり、強い！」: Ngh! A Masoukishin really is strong!
BMD\t「これ以上、魔装機神を進ませるわけには！」: I can't let the Masoukishin/　advance any further!
BMD\t「くっ！ ザムジードを止められんのか！？」: Ngh! Can't we stop the Zamzeed?!
BMD\t「そんなもので我らを止められるものか！」: You think that will stop us?!
BMD\t「思っていたほどのパワーではないな！」: Not as much power as I expected!
BMD\t「ぐっ！ サイバスターに食いつかれたか！」: Ngh! The Cybuster's on my tail!
BMD\t「魔装機神の力がこの程度だとは思えんが……」: That can't be all a Masoukishin has...
BMD\t「よし、魔装機神と渡り合えるぞ！」: Good, I can keep up with a Masoukishin!
BMD\t「グランヴェール……そんなものなのか？」: Granveil... Is that all you've got?
BMD\t「ザムジードの力を/ 使いこなせていないようだな！」: You can't seem to/　master the Zamzeed's power!
BMD\t「魔装機神と言えど、動きをよく見れば！」: Masoukishin or not,/　I can read its movements!
BMD\t「手出し出来んとは……！」: I can't lay a hand on it...!
LDBI\t「あの状態で出すなんて！」: Sending it out in that state!?
LDBI\t「ロブ、コントロールをこちらに！@ アッシュで彼らを援護する！」: Rob, switch control over to me!@We'll use Ash to back them up!
LDBI\t「リモート・コントロール不能！@ そ、それに、<Ｔ‐ＬＩＮＫシステム: Remote control isn't responding!@What's more, the <Ｔ‐ＬＩＮＫシステム>@is up and running!
LDBI\t「システムは休止モードにしていたんです！@ コックピット内で操作しな: The system was in sleep mode! It shouldn't@be able to start up unless someone operates@it from inside the cockpit!
LDBI\t「なら、何で勝手に動いているんだ！？」: Then why is it moving on its own!?
LDBI\t「フッ、凶鳥の眷属がまだ残っていたとはな」: Heh. So some kin of the bird of ill omen@still remain.
LDBI\t「だが、そんな継ぎ接ぎだらけの機体に@ 何が出来る！」: But what can a patchwork machine like that@possibly do!
LDBI\t「あの機体は無人……！？@ イングが呼び寄せたのか！？」: That unit is unmanned...!?@Did Ing call it to him!?
LDBI\t「ハーモニクス・アジャスター、リセット。@ サイコ・クラッチ、切断。: Harmonics Adjuster, reset.@Psycho Clutch, disengaged.@RTE level, reconfigured.
LDBI\t「それに、アッシュのＴ‐ＬＩＮＫシステムから@ テレキネシスαパルス: And Ash's T-LINK System is picking up@Telekinesis Alpha Pulses!
LDBI\t「イング君であって、イング君でないような……！」: It's Ing, but it's like it isn't Ing...!
LDBI\t「イングの念はＴ‐ＬＩＮＫシステムだけでなく、@ <ウラヌス・システ: Ing's mind isn't just linked to the@T-LINK System, but to the <ウラヌス・システム> too...!
LDBI\t「私の一撃をかわすとはな。@ だが、次はその程度の傷では済まんぞ」: So you dodged my strike. But next time,@you won't get off with a scratch like that.
LDBI\t「お前こそ、無事で済むと思うな！！」: You're the one who won't get out of this unhurt!!
LDBI\t「フッ、本性を出したか。@ なら、お前が得た力を見せてみろ」: Heh, so you've shown your true colors.@Then show me this power you've gained.
LDBI\t「それが出来なければ、@ このガリルナガンで狩ってやる！」: If you can't, I'll hunt you down with@this Galilnagant!
LDBI\t「ああ、ヒュッケバインと同じようにな！」: That's right, just like the Hückebein!
LDBI\t「狩られるのは、お前の方だ！ このアッシュでな！」: The one being hunted is you! And with this Ash!
LDBI\t「フン、諸々の確認は出来た。後は……」: Hmph. I've confirmed what I needed to. Now...
LDBI\t「潮時だな。@ イング……次に会う時まで生きていれば、@ また相手を: Time to go.@Ing... if you're still alive the next time we@meet, I'll take you on again.
LDBI\t「ネート博士、イングの容態は……？」: Dr. Nate, how is Ing doing...?
LDBI\t「彼は力を使い果たして昏倒したようね……@ 先程、目を覚ましたわ」: It seems he collapsed after using up all his@strength... He woke up a little while ago.
LDBI\t「落ち着きも取り戻したけど、@ アッシュに乗ってから後のことは@ 覚: He's calmed down, too, but he doesn't seem@to remember anything after he got into@Ash.
LDBI\t「事後検査でもテレキネシスαパルスは検出されたわ。@ つまり、彼は念: The follow-up tests detected Telekinesis Alpha@Pulses too. In other words, he's Awakened@as a Telekinesis user.
LDBI\t「そんな……以前の検査では、@ その片鱗すら見せていなかったのに……: But... in his earlier tests, he didn't@show even a trace of it...
LDBI\t「ああいう形で、突然覚醒するケースはあると@ コバヤシ博士から聞いて: Dr. Kobayashi did say there are cases where@someone Awakens suddenly like that, but...
LDBI\t「で、でも、Ｔ‐ＬＩＮＫシステムを@ 外部から起動させ、機体そのもの: B-But activating the T-LINK System@from outside and remotely controlling@the unit itself...
LDBI\t「しかも、わずかな時間でアジャストさせた……。@ 僕やクスハも以前に: And he adjusted it in almost no time...@Kusuha and I have pulled off similar things@before, but...
LDBI\t「オオミヤ博士、@ あれは理論的に説明できることなんですか？」: Dr. Omiya, can that be explained@theoretically?
LDBI\t「い、いや……データを検証して、@ コバヤシ博士の意見を聞いてみない: W-Well... I'll need to check the data and@ask Dr. Kobayashi's opinion first...
LDBI\t（おそらくは、<ウラヌス・システム>の@ ブラックボックスによるもの: (It's most likely due to the black box@in the <ウラヌス・システム>, but...)
LDBI\t（あれをもたらしたイングラム少佐がいない今、@ 解析は困難だ）: (With Major Ingram, who brought it to us,@gone now, analyzing it will be difficult.)
LDBI\t「でも……突然覚醒したとしても、@ あそこまでの念の力を発揮するなん: But... even if he Awakened suddenly,@to unleash that much psychic power...
LDBI\t「イングの卓越した操縦と戦闘技術は、@ ガイアセイバーズでの訓練によ: Ing's outstanding piloting and combat skills@were likely honed through his training@with the Gaia Savers, but...
LDBI\t「コード“エビル”に追い詰められたことによって、@ 眠っていた能力が: Being cornered by Code "Evil" may have made@his dormant abilities blossom all at once.
LDBI\t「あの黒い羽根付きのヒュッケバインもどきの@ コードネームですよ。ア: It's the code name for that black-winged@Hückebein knockoff. That's what Ash's@development team calls it.
LDBI\t「タイトル画面で『ＬＩＢＲＡＲＹ』を選択し、@ さらに『攻略Ｑ＆Ａ』: Select "LIBRARY" on the title screen,@then select "Strategy Q&A"...
LDBI\t「『インターミッション』で@ 『オプション』内の『ライブラリ』から@: Or go to "Library" under "Options" during@the "Intermission" and pick "Strategy Q&A."
LDBI\t「では、これで戦闘マップのガイダンスは終了だ」: That concludes the battle map guidance.
LDBI\t「あれくらい朝飯前ッス！@ で、ここが『インターミッション』なんです: That was a piece of cake!@So, is this the "Intermission"?
LDBI\t「いや、違う。この『シナリオデモ』が終了すると@ 『インターミッショ: No. The "Intermission" comes once this@"Scenario Demo" is over.
LDBI\t「そこでは、次のシナリオへ進むための準備を行う」: That's where you prepare to move on to the@next scenario.
LDBI\t「例えば、ここまでのゲームのデータを@ セーブしたり……」: For example, you can save your game@data up to this point...
LDBI\t「次のシナリオのために部隊を組み直したり、@ 『強化パーツ』を機体に: Reorganize your team for the next scenario,@equip your units with "Enhancement Parts"...
LDBI\t「戦闘マップで得た『資金』で機体を改造したり、@ 『ＰＰ』でパイロッ: Upgrade units with "Funds" earned in battle,@and train pilots using "PP."
LDBI\t「その役割を理解するには、@ 本編で実際に『インターミッション』を見: To really understand it, you should see an@actual "Intermission" in the main story.@Then try out the various functions yourself.
LDBI\t「了解ッス。@ じゃあ、早速、本編をプレイしてみます！」: Roger that!@Then I'll jump right into the main story!
LDBI\t「その前に少し復習だ。@ 何かわからないことがあった時は、どうする？: But first, a quick review.@What should you do if something confuses you?
LDBI\t「とりあえず、何とかしてカイ少佐を呼び出すッス！」: First, I find some way to call Major Kai!
LDBI\t「うむ、そうすると俺が画面に出て来て、答えを……」: Yes. Then I appear on the screen and give@you the answer...
LDBI\t「バカモン！ そんな機能などないわっ！！」: You fool! There's no such feature!!
LDBI\t「トホホ……@ プレイヤーの皆さんなら、答えはわかるッスよね？」: Aww, man...@You players out there know the answer, right?
LDBI\t「では、これで『ガイダンスシナリオ』は終了だ。@ プレイヤー諸君の健: With that, the "Guidance Scenario" is complete.@I wish you all luck, players. Until we meet@again in the main story.

BMD\t「アリエイル、後は任せたまえ」: Arieil, leave the rest to me.
BMD\t「イング、私が力を貸そう」: Ing, I shall lend you my strength.

BMD\t「友よ、あの敵は私が引き受けよう！」: My friend, I'll take on that enemy!
BMD\t「ヤンロン、ここは私に任せたまえ！」: Yang Long, leave this to me!
BMD\t「テュッティ殿、後は私が！」: Tytti, leave the rest to me!
BMD\t「後はお任せ下さい！」: Please, leave the rest to me!
BMD\t「マサキ殿をやらせるものか！」: I won't let you harm Masaki!
LDBI\t「枢密院は、奴の真意に気づいている。@ 証拠も揃い、本国への召還命令: The Privy Council knows his true intentions.@The evidence is in, and he's been ordered@to return home.
LDBI\t「シュウ・シラカワを止められなかったのが@ 致命的だった。ゼゼーナン: Failing to stop Shu Shirakawa was fatal.@Zezenan's downfall is certain. How long do you@plan to keep taking orders from a guy like that?
LDBI\t「……それが傭兵としての務めだ」: ...That is my duty as a mercenary.
LDBI\t「傭兵か……お前なら、黙っていても@ 将軍の座につけただろうによ」: A mercenary, huh... You could've sat back and@still landed yourself a general's seat.
LDBI\t「だとしても、それは俺の実力ではない。@ 家柄によって手に入れた地位: Even so, it wouldn't have been my own doing.@A position won through lineage means nothing.
LDBI\t「だから、家を捨てて傭兵になったのか」: So that's why you left your family and became@a mercenary.
LDBI\t「……俺は門閥だけで一生が決まる、@ あの閉塞した社会が好きになれな: ...I could never stand that closed-off society,@where your lineage alone decides your life.@That's why I've thrown myself into frontier wars.
LDBI\t「ならば、尚更ゼゼーナンにつく必要などねえ。@ あの男こそ、門閥の弊: Then there's even less reason to back Zezenan.@That man is the very symbol of clan corruption.
LDBI\t「ゾガルとウォルガの派閥争いを@ 連合非加盟星である地球にまで持ち込: He's the one who dragged the Zogal-Wolga feud@all the way to Earth, a planet that isn't even@in the Union. Him and no one else.
LDBI\t「だが、そこには未熟な地球文明を監査し、@ 銀河の秩序を保つという大: But he has a pretext: to audit Earth's immature@civilization and keep order in the galaxy.
LDBI\t「ああ……かつての俺もそう思っていた。@ だが、ゼゼーナンが先に動い: Yeah... I used to think that way, too.@But it was Zezenan making the first move that@made Wolga send Wendolo and me out here.
LDBI\t「銀河の秩序維持という大義名分を持ってはいたが、@ 結局は派閥の利益: We had the pretext of keeping galactic order,@but in the end, we were just used for our@faction's gain...
LDBI\t「そうさ、俺達も地球人のことを笑っちゃいられねえ。@ 枠組みの大きさ: Yeah, we can't laugh at the Earthlings either.@The scale may be different, but we're squabbling@among ourselves just the same.
LDBI\t「そして、地球人と直接やり合って、@ ウェンドロやゼゼーナンが主張し: And after fighting the Earthlings head-on, I@learned they aren't nearly as immature a race@as Wendolo and Zezenan claimed.
LDBI\t「お前も気づいているだろう？@ ゼゼーナンは、この戦いを自分の野心の: You've noticed it too, haven't you? Zezenan is@using this war to further his own ambitions.
LDBI\t「そもそも、奴がお前を拾ったのは、@ 後でデルファルテの名を利用する: Besides, he only picked you up so he could@exploit the Delfarte name later, I'd bet.
LDBI\t「なあ、ロフ。@ お前がやりたかったのは、こんなことだったのか？@: Listen, Rof. Is this what you wanted to do?@To be a tool that just moves when it's told to?
LDBI\t「……確かに、お前の言う通りだ。@ 俺は、この戦いに意義を見い出せな: ...You're right. I can't find any meaning in@this battle...
LDBI\t「だが、お前のように割り切ることは出来ない……」: But I can't be as clear-cut about it as you...
LDBI\t「なら、どうする気だ？」: Then what are you going to do?
LDBI\t「俺に時間をくれ。この目で確かめたいことがある」: Give me time. There's something I need to see@with my own eyes.
LDBI\t「ゼゼーナンの所へ戻れば、@ ただでは済まんかも知れねえぜ？」: If you go back to Zezenan, you might not get@off easy, you know.
LDBI\t「承知の上だ。@ しかし、あの男の下にはセティやゼブがいる」: I'm aware of that. But Sety and Zeb are still@serving under that man.
LDBI\t「……わかった。@ ただし、ここのバイオロイド達の主導権は@ 枢密院: ...All right. But I'm taking command of the@Bioroids here, in the name of the Privy Council.
LDBI\t「野郎、逃がすかよ！！」: You bastard, you're not getting away!!
LDBI\t「待て。@ ここは俺の顔に免じて、奴を行かせてやってくれ」: Hold on. For my sake, let him go this time.
LDBI\t「何を言ってやがる！@ てめえの顔を引っぱたくだけじゃ済まねえぞ！」: What are you talking about!@A slap across your face won't be nearly enough!
LDBI\t「……お前達とやり合う気はないと言った。@ 今、その証拠を見せてやる: ...I told you I've no intention of fighting you.@Now I'll show you the proof.
LDBI\t「艦長、戦域内の敵機が次々に活動を@ 停止していきます！」: Captain, enemy units in the combat area are@shutting down one after another!
LDBI\t「他艦隊と戦闘中の敵機は？」: And the enemies fighting the other fleets?
LDBI\t「……この宙域にいるゾガルの機体は、@ まもなくその全てが戦闘を中止: ...All Zogal units in this sector will soon@cease combat. I hope that's enough for you to@trust me.
LDBI\t「で、あんたはどうする気だ？」: So, what are you planning to do?
LDBI\t「お前達と直接話がしたい。@ もっとも、歓迎は期待してねえが」: I want to talk with you all directly.@Not that I have much hope of a welcome.
LDBI\t「……いいでしょう。彼の着艦を許可します」: ...Very well. He has permission to land.
LDBI\t「地球が危機に晒されているにも関わらず、@ ここへ来るとはな！」: So you'd come here even with Earth in peril!

LDBI\t「シュテドニアスの奴らめ、@ マジでヴォルクルスを何とかしようと@: Those Schtedonias bastards...@Are they seriously trying to do something@with Volkruss!?

LDBI\t「その力を以て、再びこの地を混乱させる……@ それが私の狙いなのです: With that power, I will plunge this land@into chaos once again... That is my aim.
LDBI\t（先日、感じた波動が強まっていますな。@ ただ、ヴォルクルス様の復活: (The waves I sensed the other day are stronger.@Though they're unlikely to be of any use@in reviving Lord Volkruss...)
LDBI\t「てめえ、そこを動くんじゃねえぞ！@ 今からぶっ倒してやる！」: Don't you move from that spot, you bastard!@I'm gonna take you down right now!
LDBI\t「相変わらず気の短い御方ですな。@ あなた方はここで遊んでいて下され: Impatient as ever, I see.@Do stay here and amuse yourselves.
LDBI\t「あいつらがシュテドニアス軍の特殊部隊か」: So those are Schtedonias's special forces.
LDBI\t「ルオゾールめ、連中と手を組んでやがったのか！」: Luozorl, you bastard! You teamed up with them!
LDBI\t「それでは、私はこれにて失礼致します。@ カンツォート・ジョグ少佐、: Now then, I shall take my leave.@Major Canzort Jorg, I leave the rest to you.

LDBI\t「ああ。ラングランは滅び、@ 俺達の国が脅かされることもなくなる。@: Sure. Langran gets destroyed,@and our country won't be threatened anymore.@Sounds great to me.
LDBI\t「あなた達は騙されているのよ！@ あのルオゾールが信用できると思って: You're being deceived!@Do you really think you can trust Luozorl!?
LDBI\t「てめえも奴と同じことを言うか。@ 今は手段を選んでる場合じゃねえっ: You sound just like him.@This is no time to be picky about methods.

LDBI\t「そうそう、一つお教えしておきましょう。@ 先程、私がヴォルクルス様: Oh yes, allow me to tell you one thing.@Earlier, I said I could control Lord Volkruss,@but that was not the truth.
LDBI\t「シュテドニアスや地上人の方々に@ 手伝っていただくための方便です。: It was merely a ploy to secure the help of@Schtedonias and the surface dwellers. Once Lord@Volkruss awakens, its destruction knows no end.
