BMD\t「こ、これが教導隊の実力か……！」: S-So this is the might/　of the Instructor Corps...!
BMD\t「ううう…！ あれがＳＲＸ計画の機体か！」: Ugh...! So that's an SRX Project unit!
BMD\t「が、合体前でこの攻撃力か！？」: Th-This much firepower/　before they even Combine?!
BMD\t「奴らめ、何という機体を作ったんだ！」: What kind of machine have they built?!
BMD\t「お、お前のデータ取りに協力する気はない！」: I-I won't help you gather your data!
BMD\t「駄目だ、奴のスピードにはついていけん！」: No good, I can't keep up with its speed!
BMD\t「こ、このままではこちらが幽霊に……！！」: A-At this rate, we'll be the ghosts...!!
BMD\t「うぐっ！ 何で旧型にここまで！？」: Ugh! Why is an old model this strong?!
BMD\t「うぐっ！ 見かけによらず素早い！」: Ugh! It's faster than it looks!
BMD\t「くっ！/ ただ大きいわけではないらしいな！」: Tch!/　It's not just big, apparently!
BMD\t「ううっ！/ 攻撃力がパーソナルトルーパーとは段違いだ！」: Ugh! Its firepower is in another/　league from a Personal Trooper's!
BMD\t「しまった！/ 奴の見た目に惑わされた！」: Damn!/　I was fooled by its looks!
BMD\t「ぐうう……！/ 失敗作の後継機ごときに、なぜだ！？」: Grr...!/　Why?! It's the heir to a failure!
BMD\t「ま、魔装機神の名は/ 伊達じゃないらしいな……！」: S-So the Masoukishin name/　isn't just for show...!
BMD\t「その程度で我々に刃向かうとは！」: You dare defy us with that?!
BMD\t「俺の前に立った者がどうなるか……/ 身を以て知れ！」: You'll learn firsthand what happens.../　to those who stand before me!
BMD\t「俺が相手だった事を不運と思うのだな」: Consider yourself unlucky to face me.
BMD\t「では、小手調べといくか」: Now then, let's test the waters.
BMD\t「我が名はアハマド・ハムディ！/ この名を脳裏に刻み込め！」: My name is Ahmad Hamdy!/　Burn it into your mind!
BMD\t「生死の狭間でこそ、得られるものがある……」: Some things can only be gained/　on the edge between life and death...
BMD\t「さあ、俺の相手を務めてもらおうか」: Now, you'll serve as my opponent.
BMD\t「御前試合以来か……遠慮はいらんぞ、マサキ。/ 全力を出してみろ！」: Not since the royal tournament.../　Don't hold back, Masaki./　Give it everything you've got!
BMD\t「今回は敵味方に別れたな、マサキ。/ こういう自由な所は、/ 風の魔装: We're enemies this time, Masaki./　Isn't such freedom fitting/　for the wind Masouki's pilot?
BMD\t「何が正しく、何がそうでないか……/ 一義的に決めるなど、傲慢だと思わ: What is right, and what is not.../　Isn't it arrogant to call it clear-cut,/　Tytti?
BMD\t「ガッデスは俺との戦いを是としたか。/ だが、他にも/ 戦うべき相手が: So Gaddess deems fighting me just./　But aren't there others/　you ought to be fighting?
BMD\t「俺は、俺の信じた道を征く。/ 貴様がそうであるようにな、ヤンロン」: I walk the path I believe in./　Just as you do, Yang Long.
BMD\t「貴様の大義など、所詮は井の中の蛙。/ いつか手痛いしっぺ返しを食らう: For all your grand cause, you're a frog/　in a well. Someday it'll bite you back!
BMD\t「リューネとか言ったな。/ 少しは慎みというものを覚えたらどうだ」: Lüne, was it?/　Why not learn a little modesty?
BMD\t「ふん……/ まだザムジードを使いこなせておらんようだな、/ 小娘！」: Hmph.../　You still haven't mastered Zamzeed,/　little girl!
BMD\t「ザムジードに選ばれたとはいえ、/ まだまだ位負けしているぞ！」: Zamzeed may have chosen you,/　but you're still not worthy of it!
BMD\t「ほう、いたのか、ゲンナジー。/ 危うく見落とす所だったぞ」: Oh, you were here, Gennacy?/　I nearly overlooked you.
BMD\t「ディアブロに乗るようになったか、プレシア……/ となれば、一人前。手: So you've taken up Diablo, Precia.../　Then you're no longer a child./　I won't go easy on you!
BMD\t「自ら望んで戦いに赴くか、プレシア。/ 修羅の道を選ぶとは、父親譲りだ: You choose to fight, Precia?/　Taking the path of Shura.../　You take after your father.
BMD\t「例えセニア様とて、ここは戦場。/ 覚悟していただこうか」: Even for you, Princess Xenia,/　this is a battlefield. Brace yourself.
BMD\t「貴様の選んだ道なのだ。/ 後悔だけはするなよ、ザッシュ」: This is the path you chose./　Just don't regret it, Zash.
BMD\t「シュウ……相手にとって不足はない。/ ソルガディの機動力、見せつけて: Shu... You're a worthy opponent./　I'll show you Solgady's mobility!
BMD\t「ふふふ……凄まじいまでのプラーナを感じる……！/ これほどの強敵、/: Heh heh... I sense incredible prana...!/　So formidable a foe/　is a rare sight indeed.
BMD\t「やれやれ……/ 貴様と戦うのは俺の性に合わんのだ、/ サフィーネ」: Good grief.../　Fighting you just isn't my style,/　Saphine.
BMD\t「貴様と戯れ合うほど、俺は暇ではない。/ さっさと済ませるぞ、サフィー: I've no time to play around with you./　Let's get this over with, Saphine.
BMD\t「おやおや、/ 姫様ともあろう者がはしたない事だ」: My, my,/　how unbecoming of a princess.
BMD\t「戦場は、王族のお遊びが通用するほど、/ 甘い世界ではないのですよ」: The battlefield isn't so lenient/　as to allow royalty their games.
BMD\t「機動兵器ごとラ・ギアスに召喚されたか……」: Summoned to La Gias, machine and all...
BMD\t「不運だったな、/ この動乱の最中に召喚されるとは」: Unlucky of you,/　to be summoned amid this turmoil.
BMD\t「ふ……/ 地上の戦の理が、どこまで通用するかな？」: Heh.../　How far will surface warfare get you here?
BMD\t「強い相手と戦うことこそ、我が望み！」: Fighting strong foes is all I desire!
BMD\t「いいぞ……互いに身を切るこの間合い。/ これが戦場よ！」: Good... A range where both of us bleed./　This is the battlefield!
BMD\t「強敵を相手にしてこそ、/ 戦う甲斐があるというものよ」: Only against a strong foe/　is a battle worth fighting.
BMD\t「お返しをさせてもらうぞ！」: Allow me to return the favor!
BMD\t「ぐっ……しまった。/ ダメージを受け過ぎたか……」: Ugh... Damn./　I've taken too much damage...
BMD\t「何っ！？/ ここまでのパワーがあったとは……」: What?!/　I never expected such power...
BMD\t「こ、これほどとは……/ 俺に慢心があったか」: I-I never imagined this.../　Was I overconfident?
BMD\t「ぬうっ！？/ ソルガディがここまで押されるとは……」: Nngh?!/　Solgady, pushed back this far...
BMD\t「ぬうぅっ！！ や、やる！/ さすがはサイバスターか」: Nngh!! N-not bad!/　As expected of Cybuster.
BMD\t「や、やはり、/ グランヴェールのパワーは桁外れだ……！」: A-as I thought,/　Granveil's power is off the charts...!
BMD\t「うおっ！？ み、見かけに騙されたわっ！」: Whoa?! I-I was fooled by appearances!
BMD\t「むうぅっ！！/ ザムジードに選ばれただけのことはある、か」: Mmgh!!/　So Zamzeed chose you for good reason.
BMD\t「や、やるなゲンナジー……/ この俺をここまで追い詰めるとは……」: N-not bad, Gennacy.../　To drive me this far...
BMD\t「ぬううっ！！/ さ、さすがに剣皇の娘……侮れん」: Nnngh!!/　Th-the Sword Emperor's daughter indeed.../　I can't take you lightly.
BMD\t「まさか……/ セニア様がここまでやるとは/ 思いませんでしたぞ」: Impossible.../　I never thought you'd be this capable,/　Princess Xenia.
BMD\t「ぬうっ！ や、やってくれるな、若造が！」: Nngh! N-not bad, you young pup!
BMD\t「侮っていたつもりはないが……/ やりおるな、サフィーネ」: I didn't mean to underestimate you.../　but you're good, Saphine.
BMD\t「ま、まさかモニカ王女に/ ここまでやられるとはな……」: I-I never thought Princess Monica/　would push me this far...
BMD\t「ペルフェクティオ！/ この世界にてめえの居場所はねえ！」: Perfectio!/　There's no place for you in this world!
BMD\t「狙うは将軍首だ！」: I'm going for the general's head!
BMD\t「指揮官機を仕留めてやる！」: I'll bring down that Commander unit!
BMD\t「ガチの勝負、受けてやるぜ！ ロフ！」: You want a real fight? You got it, Rof!
BMD\t「セティ！/ すばしっこい奴との戦闘は慣れてんだよ！」: Sety!/　I'm used to fighting slippery ones!
BMD\t「もう逃げ場はねえぞ、ゼゼーナン！」: You've got nowhere left to run, Zezenan!
BMD\t「夏喃、てめえの言いなりにはならねえ！」: Kanan, I'm not taking orders from you!
BMD\t「あの爺さんを何とかしなきゃ、/ 亀野郎を倒せねえ！」: Unless we deal with that old man,/　we can't beat the turtle bastard!
BMD\t「泰北！ 根性勝負なら、負けねえぜ！」: Taihoku! When it comes to Vigor,/　you can't beat me!
BMD\t「あんたのダンスを見るつもりはねえんだよ！」: I didn't come here to watch you dance!
BMD\t「あんたが見下す人間の底力を見せてやるぜ！」: I'll show you the Potential of the humans/　you look down on!
BMD\t「孫光龍！ あんたの好きにはやらせねえ！」: Son Koryu!/　I won't let you have your way!
BMD\t「早く雷鳳を止めなきゃ……！」: I've got to stop RaiOh, fast...!
BMD\t「お前らが何度現れようと！」: No matter how many times you show up!
BMD\t「何なんだよ、あの忍者ロボは！」: What the hell is that ninja robot?
BMD\t「そのマントを剥ぎ取ってやるぜ！」: I'll rip that cape right off you!
BMD\t「分身とかするんじゃねえぞ！」: Don't you go using Afterimage on me!
BMD\t「取り押さえてやるぜ、メディウス・ロクス！」: I'll pin you down, Medius Locus!
BMD\t「これ以上、化けさせるかよ！」: I won't let you transform any further!
BMD\t「形が変わる前に何とかしなきゃ！」: Gotta stop it before it changes shape!
BMD\t「あいつの斧には気をつけねえとな……！」: I'd better watch out for that axe...!
BMD\t「ルイーナ！ そこを動くんじゃねえぞ！」: Ruina! Don't you move from that spot!
BMD\t「サーベラスとガルムレイドの合体型か！」: A Combined form of Cerberus and Garmraid!
BMD\t「あいつをこれ以上進化させてたまるかよ！」: I won't let that thing evolve any more!
BMD\t「ＡＩ１！ てめえの成長を終わらせてやるぜ！」: AI1! I'm putting an end to your growth!
BMD\t「お前らが何度地球へ攻めて来ようと！」: However many times you invade Earth!
BMD\t「宇宙人の好きにはやらせねえ！」: I won't let aliens do as they please!
BMD\t「インスペクターと同じ目に遭わせてやるぜ！」: You'll end up just like the Inspectors!
BMD\t「化け物を放っておくわけにはいかねえ！」: Can't leave a monster running loose!
BMD\t「雑魚は引っ込んでやがれ！」: Small fry, stay out of the way!
BMD\t「その見た目にゃ騙されねえぜ！」: I won't be fooled by how you look!
BMD\t「行くぜ、鳥野郎！」: Here I come, you damn bird!
BMD\t「文字通り、焼き鳥にしてやるぜ！」: I'll turn you into literal roast chicken!
BMD\t「何とかしてあいつのガードを下げなきゃな！」: I gotta find a way to break its Guard!
BMD\t「亀だけに動きはそう速くねえはずだ！」: Being a turtle, it can't be that fast!
BMD\t「何とかして取り押さえなきゃ……！」: I have to pin it down somehow...!
BMD\t「四凶相手でも、やってやらあ！」: Four Fiends or not, bring it on!
BMD\t「さしものおれも、/ あいつの食欲にゃ負けるぜ……！」: Even I can't compete/　with that thing's appetite...!
BMD\t「あんなのに喰われてたまるかよ！」: Like hell I'm getting eaten by that!
BMD\t「窮奇王！ その翼をもぎ取ってやるぜ！」: KyukiOh! I'll rip those wings off!
BMD\t「クストース！/ おれ達の邪魔をするんじゃねえ！」: Custos!/　Stop getting in our way!
BMD\t「お前が守るべきものは、/ 地球だけじゃねえだろうが！」: What you should be protecting/　isn't just Earth, dammit!
BMD\t「イルイ！ お前を止めてみせる！」: Irui! I'll stop you, I swear!
BMD\t「ユーゼス！/ ここで消えるのはてめえの方だ！」: Euzeth!/　You're the one who's vanishing here!
BMD\t「ユーゼス！/ てめえと因縁を持つ気なんてねえんだよ！」: Euzeth!/　I don't want any bad blood with you!
BMD\t「陛下のためなら、この命！/ 喜んで差し上げましょうぞ！」: For Your Majesty, I would gladly/　offer up my very life!
BMD\t「例え一縷の望みと言えど、/ 可能性があるのならば諦めはせぬ！」: Even if it's but a thread of hope,/　I'll not give up while a chance remains!
BMD\t「私が手塩にかけて改造した/ ブローウェルカスタムの力……/ 今こそ見: The power of the Browel Custom/　I have so lovingly modified.../　Now I shall show it to you!
BMD\t「我が愛機を、/ そこらの量産機と同じと思っていては/ 痛い目に遭いま: If you take my beloved machine/　for some common mass-produced unit,/　you'll come to regret it!
BMD\t「もはやならぬ道とは、わきまえているが……/ 敢えてその道を進むもまた: I know full well this road is hopeless.../　Yet walking it regardless may also/　serve those who come after me.
BMD\t「地上のメカに後れは取らぬ！」: I'll not lose to surface machines!
BMD\t「反撃させていただきますぞ」: Allow me to return the favor.
BMD\t「むうっ……/ 陛下、お役に立てず、/ 申し訳ありません……！」: Mmh.../　Forgive me, Your Majesty,/　for failing you...!
BMD\t「くうっ……これだけの/ 改造を重ねても駄目だというのか……」: Ngh... Even with all these/　modifications, it's still not enough...?
BMD\t「もはや、これまでか……/ 無念です、陛下……！」: So this is the end.../　My deepest regrets, Your Majesty...!
BMD\t「わ、我がブローウェルカスタムが/ ここまで押されるとは……！」: M-my Browel Custom,/　pushed back this far...!
BMD\t「ぬうっ！/ し、しかし、まだ負けてはおりませぬぞ！」: Nngh!/　B-but I am not beaten yet!
BMD\t「ぐううっ！/ ここで諦めるわけにはいかぬのだ！」: Grrgh!/　I cannot give up here!
BMD\t「マサキ殿！/ 私もここで退くわけにはいかぬのです！」: Masaki!/　I cannot retreat here either!
BMD\t「ぬうう、グランヴェールのパワー……/ 恐るべし！」: Nngh, the power of the Granveil.../　Fearsome!
BMD\t「ぬうう、魔装機神……/ 侮り難し……！！」: Nngh, a Masoukishin.../　Not to be underestimated...!!
BMD\t「つっ！/ しかし、この程度のダメージならば！」: Tch!/　But damage like this is nothing!
BMD\t「何のっ！ まだまだやられはしませんぞ！」: Not yet! I'll not be beaten so easily!
BMD\t「装甲を強化していなければ、/ 危ない所だったか……！」: Had I not reinforced the armor,/　that would have been close...!
BMD\t「ぐっ！ ヤンロン殿、さすがですな……！」: Ngh! Impressive as ever, Yang Long...!
BMD\t「くっ、サイバスター……本気でかからねば！」: Ngh, the Cybuster... I must go all out!
BMD\t「これがガッデスのパワー……！」: So this is the Gaddess's power...!
BMD\t「いかがですかな、/ 我がブローウェルカスタムの防御力は」: How do you like/　my Browel Custom's defenses?
BMD\t「その程度の攻撃など、効きはしませんぞ！」: An attack like that won't work on me!
BMD\t「うむ、さすがは我が愛機。/ この程度の攻撃など寄せ付けぬ」: Hmm, my beloved machine indeed./　Attacks like these can't touch it.
BMD\t「このブローウェルカスタム、/ 伊達に何度も改造を重ねておりませんわい: This Browel Custom hasn't been/　modified time and again for nothing!
BMD\t「耐久力ならば、/ そこらの魔装機など足元にも及びませんぞ」: In durability, the average Masouki/　can't even compare!
BMD\t「ヤンロン殿、踏み込みが甘いようですな」: Yang Long, your step lacks commitment.
BMD\t「地上のメカは、/ その程度のものなのですかな？」: Is that the best/　surface machines can do?
BMD\t「魔装機神と言えど、この程度ならば！」: Masoukishin or not,/　this much I can handle!
BMD\t「そう簡単には当たりませんぞ」: You won't hit me that easily.
BMD\t「我がブローウェルカスタム、/ 機動力においても引けはとりませんぞ」: My Browel Custom is no slouch/　in mobility either!
BMD\t「ふっ、まだ私の腕は衰えておらんな」: Heh, my skills haven't dulled yet.
BMD\t「くっ、私としたことが、/ 残弾確認を怠るとは……！」: Ngh, how careless of me,/　neglecting to check my ammunition...!
BMD\t「むう……この距離では反撃は無理か」: Mm... I can't counter from this range.
BMD\t「陛下、後は私にお任せを」: Your Majesty, leave the rest to me.
BMD\t「陛下、お下がりください！ ここは私が！」: Your Majesty, please fall back!/　I shall handle this!
BMD\t「体勢を崩しましたな？ ならば遠慮なく！」: Off balance? Then I won't hold back!
BMD\t「ここは戦場ですからな！/ 隙を見せたそちらが悪いのです！」: This is a battlefield!/　Showing an opening is your own fault!
LDBI\t「お久しぶりです、テイニクェット・ゼゼーナン卿。@ 南極でお会いした: It's been a while, Lord Teinikwet Zezenan.@Not since we met in Antarctica. As I recall,@you were Chief Secretary back then.
LDBI\t「ふん。貴様が反乱を起こしたせいで@ 会談が御破算となり……あの場か: Hmph. Your rebellion wrecked the talks...@and getting out of there alive cost me@no small amount of effort.
LDBI\t「さらに、地球圏へ舞い戻って来るまで@ 時と金を必要とした。全て、貴: And then it took time and money to make my way@back to the Earth Sphere. All of it your fault.
LDBI\t「ですが、そのおかげで@ あなたにとって目障りだったと思われる@ ウ: Yet thanks to that, Wendolo--who I imagine@was a thorn in your side--is gone.@Am I wrong?
LDBI\t「奴は我が計画の隙を突き、@ 枢密院の反対派が送り込んだ小者に過ぎん: He was a mere underling the Privy Council's@opposition sent in to exploit a gap in my plans.@Naturally, he lost to the apes.
LDBI\t「ところで、ゼゼーナン卿……@ 事前に申し上げておいた通り、@ ここ: By the way, Lord Zezenan...@as I mentioned beforehand, I must ask@that you refrain from combat here.
LDBI\t「私に命令できる立場だと思っているのか？」: Do you believe you're in a position@to give me orders?
LDBI\t「我々で戦火を交えれば、ここへ招待している@ 他の方々にとって迷惑と: If we come to blows, it will inconvenience@the others I've invited here.
LDBI\t「何……？@ 我ら以外にも、ここへ来る者がいるのか？」: What...?@Others besides us are coming here?
LDBI\t「ええ。@ 戦闘になれば、あなたが必要としている情報は@ 手に入りま: Indeed.@If it comes to a fight, you won't obtain@the information you need, you know.
LDBI\t「やれやれ……とんだ先客だな」: Well, well... Looks like someone beat us here.
LDBI\t「やはり、罠か！@ 前部主砲、ＥＡＡＭランチャー、攻撃用意！」: So it is a trap!@Fore Main Cannon, EAAM Launcher, ready to fire!
LDBI\t「シュウ・シラカワの座興に乗ってやろうではないか。@ 現に、ゲスト軍: Let's humor Shu Shirakawa's little show.@The Guest forces aren't attacking, after all.
LDBI\t「し、しかし、シラカワ博士は@ ゲストについて何も……」: B-But Dr. Shirakawa said@nothing about the Guests...
LDBI\t「全軍、私の指示あるまで待機。いいな？」: All forces, stand by until my order.@Understood?
LDBI\t「司令、グランゾンのシュウ・シラカワ博士より@ 入電です」: Commander, an incoming transmission from@Dr. Shu Shirakawa of the Granzon.
LDBI\t「……艦長室で受ける。@ ＳＳＳ回線を使用、傍聴及び録音は禁ずる。@: ...I'll take it in the captain's quarters.@Use the SSS line. No monitoring or recording.@Tell him the same.
LDBI\t「艦長、ここは任せるぞ」: Captain, I leave things here to you.
LDBI\t「アルテウル様には何かお考えがあるのだ。@ 黙って待機していろ」: Lord Arteur has something in mind.@Shut up and stand by.
LDBI\t「フッ、トップであるオメガ・セイバーの@ ご命令だ、従ってやるよ」: Heh. Orders from the top, Omega Saber herself.@Fine, I'll go along with it.
LDBI\t「……聞こえるか、シラカワ博士。@ ガイアセイバーズ司令、@ アルテ: ...Can you hear me, Dr. Shirakawa?@This is the commander of the Gaia Saviors,@Arteur Steinbeck.
LDBI\t「アルテウル司令……@ わざわざのご足労、痛み入ります」: Commander Arteur...@I'm grateful you took the trouble to come.
LDBI\t「これはどういうことか。@ ゲストがここにいるとは聞いていなかったぞ: What is the meaning of this?@I was not told the Guests would be here.
LDBI\t「ですが、あなたは攻撃命令を下さなかった。@ つまり、私の申し出に興: And yet, you didn't give the order to attack.@Which means my offer interested you...@Am I wrong?
LDBI\t「ふん……お前の真意は何だ？」: Hmph... What are you really after?
LDBI\t「まず、引き合わせたい人物がいます。@ ご紹介しましょう、あちらがゲ: First, there is someone I'd like you to meet.@May I present the Guest supreme commander,@Lord Teinikwet Zezenan.
LDBI\t「ゼゼーナン卿、@ あの艦にはガイアセイバーズのアルテウル・@ シュ: Lord Zezenan,@aboard that ship is Commander Arteur Steinbeck@of the Gaia Saviors.
LDBI\t「ゼゼーナン卿は<ＤＣ戦争>以前から@ 地球との水面下交渉を行い、不: Lord Zezenan has held secret talks with Earth@since before the <ＤＣ戦争>, scheming to force@an unequal treaty upon it.
LDBI\t「そして、アルテウル司令は前大統領を“暗殺”し、@ 地球圏の主権を手: And Commander Arteur "assassinated" the former@president in a bid to seize sovereignty over@the Earth Sphere.
LDBI\t（そういうことか。@ その手には乗らんぞ、シュウ・シラカワ）: (So that's his game.@I won't fall for it, Shu Shirakawa.)
LDBI\t「大統領を殺害したのは、鋼龍戦隊だ。@ 下らぬ話を吹聴するのはやめて: The Steel Dragons killed the president.@I'll thank you not to spread such nonsense.
LDBI\t「はたして、そうでしょうか？@ 巷では、あなたの陰謀だという説もある: Is that truly so?@Word has it that it was your plot.
LDBI\t「根も葉もない、低俗な噂だ。@ それとも、何か証拠でもあるのか？」: Baseless, vulgar rumors.@Or do you have some sort of proof?
LDBI\t「いえ。@ ただ、私は鋼龍戦隊と行動を共にしたことも@ ありますから: No.@It's only that I have fought alongside@the Steel Dragons myself...
LDBI\t「彼らが大統領を暗殺するなど、@ 妙な話だと思っただけです。むしろ、: The notion of them assassinating the president@struck me as strange. Indeed, it fits far better@to think it your doing.
LDBI\t「猿共の陰謀など、どうでもいい。@ シュウ・シラカワ、我らをここへ呼: I care nothing for the apes' schemes.@Shu Shirakawa, what is the real reason@you called us here?
LDBI\t「地球圏は今、ルイーナやバラルの脅威に@ 晒されています。先日、地球: Ruina and Balar now threaten the Earth Sphere.@The black veil that recently shrouded Earth...@Something like that could happen again.
LDBI\t「あなた達がそれぞれの目的を達成するためには、@ 地球とそこに住まう: For each of you to achieve your goals,@Earth and its people must continue to exist...
LDBI\t「どうでしょう？@ ここは一つ、地球側とゲストで一時休戦条約を@ 結: What do you say?@Why not conclude a temporary ceasefire treaty@between Earth and the Guests?
LDBI\t「そして、あなた方が協力すれば、@ ルイーナやバラルを撃退できるかも: And if you cooperate,@you may well be able to drive back@the Ruina and Balar.
LDBI\t「下らん。我らは月を掌中に収めつつある。@ 猿共が降伏するならともか: Nonsense. The moon is nearly in our grasp.@If the apes surrendered, perhaps. But a truce?
LDBI\t「我らは地球圏の守護者たるガイアセイバーズだ。@ 異星人と手を結ぶな: We are the Gaia Saviors, guardians of the@Earth Sphere. Allying with aliens is unthinkable.
LDBI\t（いや、待て……@ この場を設けることこそが、あの男の目的なのか？）: (No, wait...@Is arranging this meeting his true objective?)
LDBI\t（だが、ゲストは彼にとっても敵であるはず……@ 我らを陥れて、何の得: (But the Guests should be his enemy, too...@What does he gain by entrapping us?)
LDBI\t「地球圏の守護者と仰いましたね、アルテウル司令。@ では……先日、日: Guardians of the Earth Sphere, Commander Arteur?@Then how do you explain the mass-produced super@robots that recently attacked Asakusa in Japan?
LDBI\t「同地区にはゲストの偵察機も現れたとのことですが……@ ゼゼーナン卿: Guest scouts were reportedly sighted there too...@Lord Zezenan, what have you to say about that?
LDBI\t（ふん……シュウ・シラカワめ、@ 我らを利用して、ガイアセイバーズを: (Hmph... So Shu Shirakawa means to use us@to bring down the Gaia Saviors.)
LDBI\t（良かろう、その芝居に乗ってやろう）: (Very well. I'll play along with his act.)
LDBI\t「では、グラスマン大統領が死亡する直前に現れた@ 偵察機については？: Then what of the scout craft that appeared@just before President Grassman's death?

LDBI\t「ええっ、カークス軍とフェイル軍が！？」: What?! Kirkus's forces and Feil's forces?!
LDBI\t「はい。近場にいる部隊の交信を傍受したんですが……@ 情報が錯綜して: Yes. We intercepted comms from units nearby...@The reports conflict, so we can't confirm it.
LDBI\t「中央からの情報を得ようとしても、@ エーテル流の乱れが原因で、まま: We tried to get word from the capital,@but the ether flow disruption is blocking us...
LDBI\t「交戦が行われたとして……@ 仕掛けたのは、どちらだと思う？」: Assuming they did clash...@who do you think struck first?
LDBI\t「まだ何とも言えない。@ カークス軍はシュテドニアス追撃のため、@: Hard to say yet.@Kirkus's army had deployed units far and wide@to pursue the Schtedonias forces, but...
LDBI\t「フェイル軍がその隙を突き、@ カークス将軍の本隊に攻撃を仕掛けたと: Even if Feil's army exploited that opening@to attack General Kirkus's main force,@the timing raises questions.
LDBI\t「今、内乱が勃発すれば……@ シュテドニアス軍に格好の機会を@ 与え: Because a civil war breaking out now...@would hand the Schtedonias army@the perfect opportunity.
LDBI\t「カークス軍がフェイル軍に@ 仕掛けたという可能性は……？」: Could Kirkus's army have been@the one to attack Feil's...?
LDBI\t「カークス将軍はテリウス殿下の後ろ盾だし……@ 王位を譲ったフェイル: General Kirkus backs Prince Tellius...@and Prince Feil gave up the throne,@so I don't see why he'd turn on him...
LDBI\t「これを機に、後で邪魔になるフェイルを始末する……@ ってことはねえ: Taking the chance to get rid of Feil early...@Nah, can't be. If he pulled that,@Kirkus would end up the villain.
LDBI\t「未確認だが、カークス将軍が敗走し、@ 投降命令を出したという情報も: Unconfirmed, but there are reports that General@Kirkus was routed and has ordered his men to@surrender.
LDBI\t「何か……しっちゃかめっちゃかだな」: Man... this is a total mess.
LDBI\t「エーテル流の乱れは、@ 何とかならないものなんでしょうか？」: Isn't there anything we can do@about the ether flow disruption?
LDBI\t「ここまで不安定なのは、珍しいです。@ もしかすると、ヴォルクルスと: It's rare for it to be this unstable.@It may have some connection@to Volkruss.
LDBI\t「いずれにせよ、@ 通信網の乱れが錯綜に拍車をかけている」: Either way, the disrupted communications@are only adding to the confusion.
LDBI\t「少しでも中央に近づき、@ 僕達の耳目で正確な情報を集めるしかない…: We'll just have to get closer to the capital@and see and hear the truth for ourselves...
LDBI\t「カークス軍部隊、２時方向へ転換！ 離脱する！」: Kirkus unit turning to 2 o'clock! Withdrawing!
LDBI\t「こちらに気づいて、逃げ出しましたか。@ 怪しいですな」: They noticed us and fled, did they?@Rather suspicious.
LDBI\t「カークス軍部隊、停止！ 反転する！」: Kirkus unit stopping! They're turning around!
LDBI\t「両舷停止、現在高度でＴＤ滞空！@ 各機、出撃せよ！」: All engines stop, hold altitude on TD!@All units, launch!
LDBI\t「あ、あの移動要塞は、父さんの……！」: Th-That mobile fortress is my father's...!
LDBI\t「じゃあ、あれにカークス将軍が乗ってるのか！？」: Then General Kirkus is aboard that thing?!
LDBI\t「移動要塞も魔装機も@ かなりのダメージを負っているわね」: The mobile fortress and the Masouki@have both taken heavy damage.
LDBI\t「カークス将軍が敗走したという情報は、@ 真実だったのか？」: So the report that General Kirkus was routed@was true?
LDBI\t「僕は……リューネさん達と共に戦う。@ 父さんが心を改めない限りね」: I'm... fighting alongside Lüne and the others.@Until you change your ways, Father.
LDBI\t「そうか……ならば、お前とは親子の縁を切る。@ あくまでも私の邪魔を: I see... Then you are no longer my son.@If you insist on standing in my way...@I will show no mercy.
LDBI\t「カークス将軍……@ あなたが戦った相手はフェイル軍ですか？」: General Kirkus...@Was it Feil's army you fought?
LDBI\t「そうだ。魔装機神サイバスター、ガッデス……@ そして、ハガネの部隊: Yes. The Masoukishin Cybuster and Gaddess...@and the Hagane's unit.
LDBI\t「ハガネのみんなは、フェイル軍に……！？」: The Hagane crew is with Feil's army...?!
LDBI\t「そして、彼らに敗れたのですね？」: And they defeated you, didn't they?
LDBI\t「フ、フフフ……おかげでこの様だよ。@ やはり、魔装機神の力は侮れん: Heh heh heh... Thanks to them, look at me now.@The Masoukishin are formidable after all...@And so are the Hagane's warriors.
LDBI\t「それを知って何とする？」: What would you do with that knowledge?
LDBI\t「ハッ、答えられないってのかい？@ じゃあ、仕掛けたのはあんただね。: Hah, can't answer, huh?@Then it was you who started it.@Bet you had something shady going on, right?
LDBI\t「事情は後でお聞きします。@ シュテドニアスとの戦いがようやく終わる: I'll hear your reasons later.@The war with Schtedonias is finally ending,@and you start a civil war...? Unthinkable.
LDBI\t「ここまで踏み出した以上、@ 後戻りは出来んのだ」: Having come this far,@there is no turning back.
LDBI\t「それに付き合わされる兵は、@ たまったもんじゃないよ！」: The soldiers you drag into this@are the ones who'll suffer!
LDBI\t「ラングラン解放のため、父さんの下に@ 集った多くの人達を反逆者にす: Will you make traitors of all the people who@rallied to you to liberate Langran?!
LDBI\t「……部下達にはフェイル軍への投降命令を出してある。@ それでも、ま: ...I have ordered my men to surrender to Feil.@Even so, some still choose to@follow me...
LDBI\t「少ない戦力で、@ どうやってラ・ギアスを統一すると言うのです？」: With so few forces,@how do you intend to unify La Gias?
LDBI\t「……お待たせしました、カークス殿」: ...Sorry to keep you waiting, General Kirkus.
LDBI\t「ここは私にお任せいただき、あなたは例の場所へ」: Leave this to me,@and proceed to the place we discussed.
LDBI\t「カークス将軍！@ ルオゾールなどと手を組んだのですか！？」: General Kirkus!@You've joined hands with Luozorl?!
LDBI\t「ラングランの統一方法って、まさか！？」: That way of unifying Langran... Don't tell me?!
LDBI\t「力だよ、ヤンロン、ザッシュ。@ 時代を作るには魔装機神のような……: Power, Yang Long, Zash.@An era demands power like the Masoukishin's...@No--power that surpasses it.
LDBI\t「馬鹿な！@ ルオゾール達の目的が何なのか、御存知でしょう！@ あな: Madness!@You know what Luozorl and his ilk are after!@He's only using you!
LDBI\t「利用しているのは、お互い様なのですよ。@ さあ、カークス殿……早く: We are both using each other, you see.@Now, General Kirkus... withdraw quickly.
LDBI\t「それでは……@ しばしの間、お付き合いいただきましょうか」: Well then...@Shall I keep you company for a while?
LDBI\t「それだけではありませんぞ。@ あの後、私はヴォルクルス様の分身の復: That is not all.@Since then, I have succeeded in reviving@an Afterimage of Lord Volkruss...
LDBI\t「そうだとしても、@ 赤い鎧を着て、空飛ぶ板に乗っていましたから、@: Even if he was, he was wearing red armor and@riding a flying board. I think he'll be all right.
LDBI\t「コウタ一人ならともかく、@ ロア・アーマーを着てるんなら、ロアも一: Kota alone'd be one thing, but if he's wearing@the Roa Armor, Roa's with him too.@He'll pull through somehow, won't he?
LDBI\t「俺もどうなることかと思ったが、@ 何とかこっち側に辿り着いたからな: I wasn't sure how things'd turn out either,@but I made it back to this side somehow.@...Though I was surprised to end up in La Gias.
LDBI\t「……では、アクセルをお願い致しますの」: ...Then I leave Axel in your care.
LDBI\t「直に目覚めると思いますので、@ よろしく伝えておいて欲しいですの。: He should wake up soon, so please give him@my regards. ...Farewell.

LDBI\t「それに、調べたいこともありますので……@ ごきげんよう」: Also, there's something I wish to look into...@Good day.
LDBI\t「お前が……お前の存在が、@ おれの運命を切り開く鍵となる！」: You... your very existence will be the key@that opens up my destiny!

LDBI\t「不安定な要素を重ねたところで、@ あなたがエクセレン少尉のようにな: Stacking unstable elements doesn't mean@you'll end up like Lieutenant Excellen!
LDBI\t「違うな、おれはその上を行ってやる！」: Wrong. I'll go even beyond her!

LDBI\t「現状では見受けられません。@ これまで通り、制御が可能です」: None that I can see at present.@It remains controllable, as before.
LDBI\t「しかし、アレス・ガイストが@ レッド・オーガのコアを入手すれば……: However, if Ares Geist obtains@the Red Ogre's core...

LDBI\t「艦長の意見に賛成だ。@ 月方面に行けば、Ｌ４宙域のコロニー群に@: I agree with the Captain.@Near the moon, we'll be well placed to respond@if anything happens to the L4 colonies.

LDBI\t「いえ、ロストしたままです」: Negative. We still haven't reacquired it.
LDBI\t（このまま捜索を続けるより、@ ハガネをマークした方がいいか……@: (Rather than continue searching, maybe I should@keep tabs on the Hagane... They were headed@for Heaven's Gate, too.)

LDBI\t「<ＩＦＦ>確認……オメガ・セイバー、ガリルナガン。@ 本艦への着艦: <ＩＦＦ> confirmed... Omega Saber, Galilnagant.@It's requesting permission to land aboard.

LDBI\t「おそらく、ガイアセイバーズの罠にはめられたんだ。@ しかし、俺達が: The Gaia Saviors probably set a trap for us.@But it's a fact that we helped them@pull it off...

LDBI\t「……主立ったメンバーは揃っておりますな。@ では、着席を」: ...It seems the key members are all present.@Please, be seated.
LDBI\t「現在の状況を説明します。@ 結論から言えば、イグニスの言葉は@ 正: I'll explain our current situation.@To put it simply, it seems Ignis's words@were true.
LDBI\t「正体不明の障壁……@ 私達は次元断層と仮定していますが、@ それに: An unidentified barrier... We're assuming@it's a dimensional fault, but it appears@to have enveloped the Earth.
LDBI\t「太陽や月、星が観測できず……サテライト・リンクも@ 断絶、各宇宙ス: This is likely why the sun, moon and stars are@unobservable, satellite links are severed, and@contact with stations, Luna and colonies is out.
LDBI\t「なら、ルイーナが本当に太陽の光だけでなく、@ 地球と宇宙の間を遮っ: So you're saying the Ruina didn't just block out@the sunlight, but sealed off Earth from space?
LDBI\t「南極を不可視の障壁で覆ったぐらいだ……@ 不可能な話ではあるまい」: They shrouded Antarctica in an invisible wall...@It wouldn't be impossible.
LDBI\t「宇宙から見たら、地球はどうなっているんです？」: How does the Earth look from space?
LDBI\t「これは仮説に過ぎないが、目に見えない状態……@ つまり、消えている: This is only a hypothesis, but it's invisible...@In other words, it has likely vanished.
LDBI\t「地球と宇宙の間が次元断層で遮断されたのなら、@ 私達は宇宙へ行くこ: If a dimensional fault cut us off from space,@then we can't... get into space...?
LDBI\t「実際に試してみなければ、確証は得られないが……@ 断層にぶつかって: We'd need to test it to be certain, but...@we'd either be smashed to pieces on the fault,@or be flung into another dimension.
LDBI\t「南極から拡散したＥＳウェーブは、@ ハガネとヒリュウ改の間を通過し: The ES Wave that spread from the Antarctic@passed between the Hagane and Hiryu Custom.
LDBI\t「それに弾き飛ばされ、地球の外へ放り出されたか、@ あるいは……」: It may have been blown clear off the planet,@or else...
LDBI\t「次元断層ってのはいったい何なんだ、@ クリフ……！？」: Just what is this dimensional fault,@Cliff...?!
LDBI\t「現状の地磁気シールドの形が判明すれば、@ もう少し詳しいことがわか: If we knew the current shape of the geomagnetic@shield, we could learn more... but at present,@I can't say anything for sure.
LDBI\t「なら、このまま地球が次元断層に覆われ続けたら、@ どうなっちまうん: Then what happens if Earth stays covered@by this dimensional fault...?!
LDBI\t「遠からず大気の循環に影響が出る。@ その次は海流だ。海洋が熱を蓄え: Atmospheric circulation will soon be affected,@then ocean currents. Though the seas store heat,@land-sea contrasts mean violent coastal storms.
LDBI\t「大雑把に言えば、地球へ入ってくるエネルギーは@ 可視光線、出て行く: Roughly, energy enters Earth as visible light@and leaves it as far-infrared radiation...
LDBI\t「その出入りが釣り合っているため、地球の気温は@ おおよそ保たれてい: Because those balance out, Earth's temperature@stays roughly stable. But if that balance@were to collapse...

BMD\t「きゃあっ！！ も、もうダメ！」: Kyaa!! I-I can't take any more!
BMD\t「うあぁぁぁっ！？/ マ、マジでヤバいかも……」: Waaah!?/　Th-This might be seriously bad...

BMD\t「ま、まずいなあ……/ デュラクシールって化け物ね……」: Th-This is bad.../　That Duraxyll is a monster...

BMD\t「あ、ヤバ……/ やってくれるじゃないの、おじさん！」: Ah, crap.../　Not bad, old man!
BMD\t「あうっ！！ こ、これが経験の差だって事？」: Augh!! Is this what experience does?
BMD\t「くうぅっ！！/ こんなの相手にしてちゃ身がもたないよっ！」: Nngh!!/　I won't last long fighting this thing!
BMD\t「ちょっと、嘘でしょ？/ なんでこんなダメージ食らうのよ！」: Hey, you're kidding, right?/　Why am I taking this much damage!?
BMD\t「ま、まずいって！ 何とかしなきゃ！」: Th-This is bad! I gotta do something!
BMD\t「ま、まったく手加減無しってこと？/ こりゃキツいわ」: S-So no holding back at all, huh?/　This is rough.
BMD\t「ぐぅっ！！/ ほ、本気で来たわね……結構ピンチ」: Gngh!!/　S-So you're serious now... This is bad.
BMD\t「あうぅっ！！ こうまで押されるなんて……」: Augh!!/　It's pushing me back this hard...
BMD\t「つうっ！！/ やっぱ、本物のバケモンだわ、こいつ」: Ow!!/　This thing really is a genuine monster.
BMD\t「や、やるじゃない！/ でも、まだまだこれからっ！」: N-Not bad!/　But I'm only just getting started!
BMD\t「あいたたた……/ ちょっと調子に乗り過ぎたかな？」: Ow ow ow.../　Guess I got a little carried away?
BMD\t「あぅっ！！/ やるじゃねぇか、とっつぁんよぉ……」: Augh!!/　Ya got me good, ol' timer...
BMD\t「フフ……効いたぜ、今のはよぉ」: Heh... That one hit hard, I'll give ya that.
BMD\t「なんの！/ ザムジードは百人乗っても大丈夫っ！」: Not a chance!/　Zamzeed's tough enough for 100 people!
BMD\t「嘘っ、当たっちゃった！」: No way, it actually hit me!
BMD\t「あ～、でも、/ まだまだ大丈夫みたいですよ～」: Ah~, but/　looks like we're still fine~
BMD\t「つっ、言うだけのことはあるわね、/ カークス将軍」: Ngh, you live up to your talk,/　General Kirkus.
BMD\t「あのブローウェルで/ ここまでのパワーが出せるなんて……/ どんな改: To get this much power/　out of a Blowell.../　What kind of mods did you do?
BMD\t「あたた……思った通り、結構なやり手ね」: Ouch... Knew it. You're a real pro.
BMD\t「くっ、/ こんなの相手にしてられないってのに！」: Ngh,/　I don't have time to deal with this thing!
BMD\t「あいたた……参ったなぁ、/ 油断したつもりはないんだけど」: Ow ow... Jeez,/　I wasn't trying to slack off, either.
BMD\t「ひゃあ、/ 顔だけじゃなくて攻撃も結構えげつない」: Yikes,/　its attacks are as nasty as its face!
BMD\t「うひゃあ！/ 相手が風系じゃ、相性が悪いよ！」: Yikes!/　A wind type? That's a bad matchup for me!
LDBI\t「命に別状はありませんが……@ かなり神経が高ぶっていたため、鎮静剤: His life isn't in danger, but...@he was extremely agitated, so I sedated him.@As you can see, he's asleep now.
LDBI\t「ミナキ……@ 君はシステムＬＩＯＨにあのような機能が@ あることを: Minaki...@did you know System LIOH had a function@like that?
LDBI\t「い、いえ……。@ 信じていただけないと思いますが……@ ＢＳＫモー: N-No...@You may not believe me, but...@I had no idea there was any such BSK Mode...
LDBI\t「巧妙にブラックボックス化されていたということか。@ トオミネ博士に: So it was cleverly hidden in a black box...@by Dr. Tohmine.
LDBI\t「システムＬＩＯＨは、パイロットの身体能力や@ 特性をスキャンし、ベ: System LIOH scans the pilot's physical abilities@and traits, selects a Basic Battle Style,@and then optimizes itself to match...
LDBI\t「つまり、機体がパイロットに合わせ、@ その者が得意とする戦法……モ: In other words, the machine adapts to its pilot@and builds the tactics that pilot excels at...@their motion patterns.
LDBI\t「はい……トウマの場合は事前のデータ入力がなく、@ 武器のセッティン: Yes... In Touma's case, there was no prior data@input, and no weapons had been set up, so...
LDBI\t「システムＬＩＯＨは内蔵武器を併用した@ 接近戦……格闘戦を行えるよ: System LIOH seems to have adjusted itself@for close combat using its built-in weapons...@hand-to-hand fighting, that is, but...
LDBI\t「彼が乗った後、強制起動し……@ こちらからのリセットも受け付けず、: After he got in, it force-activated...@rejected our reset commands from outside...@and even triggered that mode, so...
LDBI\t「緊急時を想定した上で、パイロットの能力を@ 限界まで引き出す機能が: If it was built to push a pilot to the limit@in an emergency, I could see the logic, but...
LDBI\t「それをお前に隠し、@ さらにダイゼンガーとアウセンザイターが@ タ: But it was hidden from you,@and Dygenguar and Aussenseiter were designated@as targets...
LDBI\t「いまだあれには、トオミネ博士の妄念が@ こびりついているようだな」: It seems Dr. Tohmine's obsession still clings@to that machine.
LDBI\t「しかし、ジンライがシステムＺＬＡＩで@ 動いていた以上、彼はあれに: But since Jinrai ran on System ZLAI,@he must have opposed putting a human in it...
LDBI\t「なのに、何故、システムＬＩＯＨに@ あのような機能を？」: So why would he give System LIOH@a function like that?
LDBI\t「万一、ジンライを徴集され、@ 自分の手元から離れることになっても…: In case Jinrai was ever requisitioned@and taken out of his hands...
LDBI\t「例えば、ガイアセイバーズで@ 有人機として改修されることになっても: Or if, say, the Gaia Savers modified it@into a manned unit...
LDBI\t「アウセンザイターとダイゼンガーを倒すという@ 目的を達成する。その: He'd still achieve his goal of defeating@Aussenseiter and Dygenguar. That's the insurance.
LDBI\t「今後、雷鳳をどうするか、レフィーナ大佐達と@ 相談せねばならん。最: We'll have to consult Colonel Lefina and the@others about what to do with RaiOh. At worst, it@may be dismantled. Minaki, be ready for that.
LDBI\t（私の父の……いえ、私のせいで……）: (Because of my father... No, because of me...)
LDBI\t「量産型ジンライが最後に送ってきたものです。@ あれを改修して運用す: The Mass-Production Jinrai sent it at the end.@Apparently modifying and deploying it was easy.
LDBI\t（システムＺＬＡＩを取り外したとしても、@ ＬＩＯＨの調整を行えるの: (Even with System ZLAI removed, the only ones@who can tune LIOH are Minaki and me...!)
BMD\t「ははっ！/ 狙いは良かったが、相手が悪かったな！」: Ha ha! Nice aim,/　but you picked the wrong opponent!
BMD\t「やめとけ！ やるだけ無駄だっての！」: Give it up! It's a total waste of time!

BMD\t「それじゃ、サイバスターに/ 触れることは出来ねえぜ！」: With moves like that, you'll never/　lay a finger on Cybuster!
BMD\t「結果オーライでいいんだよ！」: Hey, it worked out, didn't it!
BMD\t「ヘッ、おととい来やがれってんだ！」: Heh, get lost and don't come back!
BMD\t「あれぐらい、軽いもんだぜ！」: That was a piece of cake!
BMD\t「てめえじゃ、/ サイバスターに触れることも出来ねえぜ！」: Someone like you/　can't even lay a finger on Cybuster!

BMD\t「ちったぁやるようだが……詰めが甘いぜ！」: Not bad... but you got careless!
BMD\t「あんたの腕じゃ、俺に当てんのは無理だな」: With your skills, you'll never hit me.
