BMD\t「てめえの忍法なんざ、通用しねえんだよ！」: Your ninja tricks won't work on me!
BMD\t「どう見ても妖怪そのものだな、ありゃ」: No matter how you look at it,/　that thing's a straight-up yokai.
BMD\t「どうした、化け物！ それで終わりか！」: What's wrong, monster?! Is that it?!
BMD\t「てめえなんぞに食われてたまるか！」: Like hell I'm getting eaten by you!
BMD\t「ヘッ、虎龍王の方が速いぜ！」: Heh, KoRyuOh is faster than that!
BMD\t「遅い、遅い！ 亀だけにな！」: Slow, slow! Just like a turtle!
BMD\t「エルデ！/ サイバスターを取り込めると思うなよ！」: Erde!/　Don't think you can absorb Cybuster!
BMD\t「それで究極の兵器だと？ 笑わせるぜ！」: That's your ultimate weapon?/　Don't make me laugh!
BMD\t「ガンエデン！/ てめえの加護なんざいらねえ！」: Gan Eden!/　I don't need your protection!
BMD\t「ユーゼスめ、/ わけのわからねえこと言いやがって！」: Damn you, Euzeth,/　spouting nonsense like that!
BMD\t「そんなもんが効くかよっ！！」: Like that's gonna work on me!!
BMD\t「使える武器がねえだと！？」: What?! No weapons I can use?!
BMD\t「いったん離れるニャ！」: Let's back off for now, nya!
BMD\t「どこ見てんだ！ 隙だらけだぜ！！」: Where're you looking?!/　You're wide open!!
LDBI\t「無駄話をしている余裕があるのか。@ 返答は如何に？」: Have you the leisure for idle chatter?@Your answer?
LDBI\t「てめえもウェンドロと同じだな。@ 俺達地球人をどこまでも見下しやが: You're just like Wendolo.@Always looking down your nose at us Earthlings.
LDBI\t「猿を猿と呼んで、何が悪い？@ 姿形は似ていても、この銀河において@: What's wrong with calling monkeys monkeys?@You may look like us, but in this galaxy,@you're nothing but savages.
LDBI\t「己の国すら一つにまとめられぬ愚かな種族を@ 我々が導いてやろうと言: Your race is too foolish even to unite its own@nations, so we will deign to guide you.@Be grateful.
LDBI\t「それで地球に攻め込んで来たってんなら、@ ここから先に行かせるわけ: If that's why you invaded Earth,@then I ain't letting you go any further.
LDBI\t「マサキ、地上での争いに荷担するのは@ 避けるべきだ」: Masaki, we should avoid getting involved@in the surface world's conflicts.
LDBI\t「いや、フェイル殿下はこう言っていた……」: No. Prince Feil told me this...
LDBI\t「魔装機神操者に課せられた義務……@ それは、世界存続の危機に際して: The duty placed on Masoukishin pilots...@is to throw away everything and stand against@any crisis threatening the world's survival.
LDBI\t「今、地上は危機に瀕してる。@ 俺は、それを見過ごすわけにはいかねえ: Right now, the surface is in danger.@I can't just stand by and let that happen.
LDBI\t「ラ・ギアスだけじゃない、@ 地上にも守りたいものや大切な仲間達がい: It's not just La Gias. The surface has things@I want to protect, and friends I care about.
LDBI\t「だから、俺は戦うぜ！ 今、ここでな！！」: So I'm gonna fight! Right here, right now!!
LDBI\t「私も。@ 彼らに地球を好きにさせるわけにはいかないわ」: So will I.@We can't let them do as they please with Earth.
LDBI\t「地上の煩わしいことに@ あまり首を突っ込みたくなかったが……@ マ: I didn't want to stick my nose too far@into the surface world's troublesome affairs...@but Masaki has a point.
LDBI\t「僕も加勢しよう」: I'll lend my strength as well.
LDBI\t「やはり、貴様らは愚者だな。@ この数の差を何とする？」: As expected, you are fools.@What do you intend to do against these numbers?
LDBI\t「兵は多きを益ありとするに非ざるなり。@ 数で勝敗が決するわけではな: In war, numbers alone confer no advantage.@Numbers don't decide the outcome.
LDBI\t「サフィーネ、テリウス、モニカ。@ あなた達は先に戻りなさい」: Saphine, Tellius, Monica.@You should return ahead of me.
LDBI\t「あら、シュウ様は？」: Oh, and what about you, Master Shu?
LDBI\t「ゼゼーナン卿にグランゾンの力を@ もう少し思い知っていただきます」: I intend to show Lord Zezenan a little more@of the Granzon's power.
LDBI\t「ほ～う。@ てっきり、さっさと帰るつもりだと思ってたぜ」: Ohh?@I figured you'd be heading straight home.
LDBI\t「ご主人様、何か魂胆あってのことでは？」: Master, could he have some scheme in mind?
LDBI\t「失敬な！@ ご主人様は、こう見えても意外にいい人なんですよ！」: How rude!@He may not look it, but my master's a nice guy!
LDBI\t「あ、言っときますけど、@ いわゆるツンデレの類じゃありませんからね: Oh, and just so you know,@he is NOT one of those tsundere types!
LDBI\t「……面倒なのは嫌だから、僕は帰るよ。@ じゃあね」: ...Sounds like a hassle, so I'm going home.@See ya.
LDBI\t「では、私もお暇させますわ。@ マサキ、ヤンロン、またお会いしましょ: Then I shall take my leave as well.@Masaki, Yang Long, until we meet again.
LDBI\t（モニカ王女……いや、もう忘れなくてはな）: (Princess Monica... No, I must forget her now.)
LDBI\t「私は残って、お手伝いをさせていただきますわ。@ このまま帰ったら、: I'll stay behind and lend you a hand.@If I went home now, I'd be terribly frustrated.
LDBI\t「グランゾンが残ったか。相手にとって不足はない」: So the Granzon remains. A worthy opponent.
LDBI\t「こんなチャンス、滅多にないわよね。@ 魔装機神とグランゾン、まとめ: A chance like this doesn't come often.@I'll grab both the Masoukishin and the Granzon!
LDBI\t「ちっ、よもやここまで食い込んでくるとはな。@ その蛮勇だけは褒めて: Tch. I never imagined you'd cut this deep.@I'll at least commend your reckless courage.
LDBI\t「だが、茶番を見せられた上、@ 手傷まで負わされては、沽券に関わる。: But to be shown this farce and wounded besides@would be beneath my dignity.@I am withdrawing.
LDBI\t「あら、もう引き揚げちゃったの？@ 戦う前は鼻息荒かったのにね」: Huh, he's pulling out already?@He was so full of himself before the fight.
LDBI\t（状況を見ての決断が早いと思っておかねばな……）: (I suppose I should call it a quick decision@based on the situation...)
LDBI\t「あの野郎……@ さんざん偉そうなことを言ってやがったくせに、@ も: That bastard...@After all his big talk,@he's already running away?
LDBI\t（フッ……またお会いしましょう、ゼゼーナン卿）: (Heh... Until we meet again, Lord Zezenan.)
LDBI\t「くうっ！ まさか、ビュードリファーを@ ここまで追い込むなんて……: Ngh! I can't believe they pushed@the Beautrifa this far...!
LDBI\t「悔しいけど、ここは退くしかなさそうね……！」: I hate it, but I'll have to fall back here...!
LDBI\t「ぐっ、このゼイドラムが後れを取るとは……！@ まだ調整が必要だと言: Ngh, the Zeidram, outmatched like this...!@It must need further tuning.
LDBI\t「よもやここまで食い下がってくるとはな。@ その蛮勇だけは褒めておい: I never imagined you'd hold out this long.@I'll at least commend your reckless courage.
LDBI\t「だが、茶番を見せられた上、@ これ以上の損害を被っては、沽券に関わ: But after this farce, to suffer further losses@would be beneath my dignity.@I am withdrawing.
LDBI\t「総司令官が退いちゃった以上、@ ここで粘る理由はないわね……」: With the supreme commander gone,@there's no reason to stick around here...
LDBI\t「今日のところは負けを認めておくわ。じゃあね」: I'll admit defeat for today. See ya.
LDBI\t「引き際を見誤るのは禁物か。@ 魔装機神、そしてグランゾン……@ や: Mustn't misjudge when to withdraw.@The Masoukishin, and the Granzon...@Formidable opponents indeed.
LDBI\t「マサキ、敵機の反応が全部消えたニャ」: Masaki, all the enemy signals are gone.
LDBI\t「……マサキ、あなたに預かって欲しい物があります」: ...Masaki, there is something I'd like you@to hold on to for me.
LDBI\t「どういう風の吹き回しだ、@ てめえがそんな頼み事をするなんてよ。@: What's gotten into you,@asking me for a favor like that?@Sounds fishy.
LDBI\t「あなた達にお渡ししようと思っているのは……@ トロニウムですよ」: What I intend to hand over to you...@is Tronium.
BMD\t「このイグニスが、/ 貴様を絶望の中へ叩き落としてやるよ！」: I, Ignis, will hurl you/　down into the depths of despair!
BMD\t「死して、我らルイーナと/ “破滅の王”の糧となれ！」: Die, and become food for us, the Ruina,/　and the "King of Destruction"!
BMD\t「メリオルエッセ、/ イグニスがお前達を滅ぼす！」: Ignis of the Meliorese/　will destroy you all!
BMD\t「クククッ、貴様の中に恐怖を刻んでやるよ」: Heheheh, I'll carve fear into you.
BMD\t「さあ、恐怖し、憎悪しろ！」: Come on, fear me! Hate me!
BMD\t「さあ、負の感情の波動を、我らに！」: Now, give us your waves of negative emotion!
BMD\t「この俺に、怒りを、憎しみを抱け！」: Feel rage at me! Feel hatred!
BMD\t「人間め、ラキに何をした？」: Human, what did you do to Lakhi?
BMD\t「貴様、混じっているな。/ だが、邪魔をするのなら、死ね！」: Something's mixed in you. But if you/　stand in my way, die!
BMD\t「ふん、面白いな、貴様は。/ だが、ここで死んでもらう！」: Hmph, you're an interesting one./　But you're dying here!
BMD\t「何だ、作り物の人間か？/ まあいい、ここで消えろ！」: What, an artificial human?/　Whatever. Vanish here!
BMD\t「人間でなくても構わん……消え失せろ！」: Human or not, I don't care... Disappear!
BMD\t「邪魔するのなら、/ 何者であろうと消えてもらう！」: If you get in my way, whatever/　you are, you're going to vanish!
BMD\t「ラキ、お前も人間達と共に滅びろ！」: Lakhi, perish along with the humans!
BMD\t「ラキ……共に生まれた俺とお前だ。/ せめて、俺の手で死を与えてやる」: Lakhi... You and I were born together./　The least I can do is kill you myself.
BMD\t「目障りだよ。/ 欠陥体など、さっさと消し去ってやるぜ！」: You're an eyesore. I'll wipe out/　a defect like you in no time!
BMD\t「ハハハッ！/ 欠陥体ごときが俺に楯突くなど！」: Hahaha!/　A mere defect dares defy me?!
BMD\t「そうだ、もっと恐怖し、憎悪しろ！」: That's it, fear more! Hate more!
BMD\t「ハッ、感じるぞ、貴様の苦悶を！」: Ha! I can feel your anguish!
BMD\t「ハハハッ！ 俺を退けるとはな！！」: Hahaha! So you drove me back!!
BMD\t「感じるぞ、貴様達の怒りを！ 憎悪を！！」: I feel it, your anger! Your hatred!!
BMD\t「ハハッ、いいぜ！ 楽に死ねると思うなよ！」: Haha, good! Don't think you'll die easy!
BMD\t「くっ……！/ それでいい！/ 感じるぞ、負の感情の波動を！！」: Ngh...!/　That's it!/　I feel the waves of negative emotion!!
BMD\t「ちいっ！/ 怒り、憎み、そして俺の手で死んでいけ！！」: Tch!/　Rage, hate, and then die by my hand!!
BMD\t「ぬうっ！/ ここまでやるとはな！ 面白いぞ！」: Nngh!/　You've got some fight! Interesting!
BMD\t「まさか……こうもやられるとはな。/ 他の人間共とは違うか……！」: To think I'd take this much damage.../　You're not like the other humans...!
BMD\t「あのマシーンだ！ あれが奴に……！」: It's that machine! That's what's making him...!
BMD\t「そのシステムに上手く順応していれば、/ 貴様はそうならなかったものを: Had you adapted to that system,/　you wouldn't have ended up like this!
BMD\t「憎むか！？/ ハハッ、俺を憎むのか、ラキ！！」: You hate me?!/　Haha, you hate me, Lakhi?!
BMD\t「そうだ……憎め、憎むんだ、この俺を！」: That's right... Hate me, hate me!
BMD\t「ハハッ、面白い。もっと抵抗してみせろよ」: Haha, interesting. Resist me some more.
BMD\t「貴様達のその意思が、我らの力となるのだ！」: That will of yours becomes our strength!
BMD\t「ふん……人間にしては、やるじゃないか」: Hmph... Not bad, for a human.
BMD\t「ちっ、あのマシーンのおかげということか！」: Tch, so it's all thanks to that machine!
BMD\t「ハハハッ！/ 貴様は、なり損なったのかも知れんな！」: Hahaha!/　Maybe you're the one that came out wrong!
BMD\t「ハハハッ、やるじゃないか、ラキ！/ 本気だな！」: Hahaha, not bad, Lakhi!/　You're serious!
BMD\t「欠陥体の攻撃など、どうということもない」: A defect's attack is nothing to me.
BMD\t「いいぜ、どこまであがくか見てやるよ」: Fine, let's see how long you can struggle.
LDBI\t「なるほど……『通常攻撃』じゃ、@ 隣の人が手伝ってくれることがある: I see... So with a Normal Attack,@the unit next to me might lend a hand.
LDBI\t「その通りだが、いつでも『援護攻撃』が@ 出来るというわけではない」: That's right, but you can't always@perform a Support Attack.
LDBI\t「『援護攻撃』や『援護防御』を行うためには、@ メインパイロットに特: To perform a Support Attack or Support Defense,@the main pilot needs the Support Attack Lv or@Support Defense Lv special skill.
LDBI\t「わかりました！@ そこらはプレイしながら覚えます！」: Got it!@I'll pick that stuff up as I play!
LDBI\t「これまで紹介した以外の攻撃の種類として、@ 『コンビネーション攻撃: Besides the attacks I've covered, there are@other types, such as Combination Attacks@and Maximum Break.
LDBI\t「『コンビネーション攻撃』は、@ 『コンビネーション攻撃』用の武器を: A Combination Attack uses a dedicated@Combination Attack weapon to hit@up to five enemies at once.
LDBI\t「なお、『Ｃ』マークがついている武器が@ 『コンビネーション攻撃』に: Weapons marked with a C are the ones@that can be used for Combination Attacks.
LDBI\t「また、攻撃目標同士は隣接している必要があり、@ 攻撃を行うパイロッ: Also, the targets must be next to each other,@and the attacking pilot must have learned the@special skill Continuous Attack Lv.
LDBI\t「『ツインユニット』同士が隣接していて、攻撃を行う@ パイロットが特: If Twin Units are adjacent to each other@and the attacking pilot has learned the special@skill Leadership, a Maximum Break is possible.
LDBI\t「『マキシマムブレイク』は@ ４機が『Ｆ』マークのついた支援武器で@: In a Maximum Break, four units unleash@a barrage with support weapons marked F,@followed by an attack with the main weapon.
LDBI\t「なお、『ＡＬＬ』マークがついた武器は@ メインの武器としては使用で: Note that weapons marked ALL can't@be used as the main weapon.
LDBI\t「そして、全員の『気力』が１４０以上でなければならん。@ また、攻撃: Also, everyone's Will must be 140 or higher.@And afterward, their Will drops by 10.@So think carefully about when to use it.
LDBI\t「今までにレクチャーした攻撃を@ 状況に応じて使い分けることが勝利の: The key to victory is using the attacks I've@taught you as the situation demands.
LDBI\t「『通常攻撃』に『全体攻撃』、@ 後はえ～っと……何だったっけ？」: Normal Attack, ALL Attack,@and, uh... what was the other one?
LDBI\t「そういう時にはどうすればいいか、教えたはずだ」: I already told you what to do at times like this.
LDBI\t「お前な……一番最初に教えただろうが」: Seriously... I taught you that first thing.
LDBI\t「そっか！@ ＳＥＬＥＣＴボタンを押すんスね！」: Oh, right!@I press the SELECT button!
LDBI\t「今度は能力画面等での用語説明……@ メニューヘルプの出し方をレクチ: Next lesson: looking up terms on the Status@screen and elsewhere... using Menu Help.
LDBI\t「『個別コマンド』の『能力』を使うと、@ そのユニットの様々な能力を: Using Status in the Unit Commands lets you@see all sorts of info about that unit.
LDBI\t「アラド、先程話した武器の種類についての@ ヘルプを出してみろ」: Arado, bring up the help for the weapon@types we just talked about.
LDBI\t「え～と、『個別コマンド』の『能力』を開いて……@ 『武器性能』画面: Uh, I open Status in the Unit Commands...@then press SELECT on the Weapon Data screen.
LDBI\t「なるほど……ヘルプで色んなことがわかるんだ」: I see... Help can tell you all kinds of stuff.
LDBI\t「なお、『全体コマンド』や@ 『個別コマンド』が表示されている時も@: SELECT Help can also be used while@the Main Commands or Unit Commands@are displayed.
LDBI\t「その場合、画面の下部にコマンドの説明が出る」: In that case, a description of the command@appears at the bottom of the screen.
LDBI\t「困った時は、ＳＥＬＥＣＴヘルプですね！」: When in doubt, use SELECT Help, right?
LDBI\t「敵に攻撃を当てたり、@ 撃墜すると『経験値』が入手できる」: You earn EXP by hitting@or shooting down enemies.
LDBI\t「『経験値』５００毎にレベルアップし、@ パイロットは強くなっていく: Every 500 EXP, the pilot levels up@and grows stronger.
LDBI\t「また、『修理』や『補給』コマンドを@ 使っても『経験値』を入手する: You can also earn EXP by using@the Repair or Resupply commands.
LDBI\t「ユニットの戦闘をサポートする@ 特殊なコマンドのことだ」: They're special commands that@support other units in combat.
LDBI\t「使用できるユニットは限られているが……@ それを使いこなさなければ: Only certain units can use them...@but if you don't master them, you won't@win the tough battles.
LDBI\t「なお、その能力を持ったユニットを@ 部隊長にすれば、コマンドが『個: If a unit with that ability is made squad@leader, the command will appear@in the Unit Commands.
LDBI\t「例えば、敵の攻撃でダメージを受けた後に……」: For example, after taking damage from@an enemy attack...
LDBI\t「修理装置を装備させている@ 量産型ヒュッケバインＭｋ‐Ⅱをメインに: I'll set the Mass-Production Huckebein Mk-II@equipped with a Repair Module as the main unit.
LDBI\t「『補給』は、ユニットが消費したＥＮや武器の弾数を@ 回復させること: Resupply restores a unit's spent EN@and weapon ammo.
LDBI\t「どちらのコマンドも、『補給』や『修理』が可能な@ 範囲内にいる部隊: Keep in mind both commands only work on@squads within Repair or Resupply range.
LDBI\t「また、敵を撃墜すれば『資金』と『ＰＰ』、@ そして時には『強化パー: Shooting down enemies also earns Funds and PP,@and sometimes even Enhancement Parts.
LDBI\t「それらは、マップクリア後の@ 『インターミッション』で使用すること: Those are used during the Intermission@after you clear a map.
LDBI\t「よし！@ まずは敵を倒してマップをクリアだ！」: All right!@First, I'll beat the enemies and clear the map!
LDBI\t「敵も反撃してくるから、気をつけろ」: The enemy will fight back, so be careful.
LDBI\t「では、最終ＬＥＳＳＯＮを始める」: Now, let's begin the final lesson.
LDBI\t「これがクリア出来れば、@ すぐにでもゲームを始められるぞ」: Clear this one, and you'll be ready@to start the game right away.
LDBI\t「今回は勝てたけど、難しいマップも@ あったりするんだろうなぁ。@: I won this time, but I bet there are@some tough maps out there.@Think I can clear them?
LDBI\t「本当なら、ここでゲームオーバーになるぞ」: Normally, that'd be a Game Over.
LDBI\t「ト、トホホ……どうしよう」: Aw, man... What do I do?
LDBI\t「心配はいらん。@ ゲームオーバーになると、そのマップの@ 最初から: No need to worry.@On a Game Over, you restart the map@from the beginning, but...
LDBI\t「ゲームオーバー前に稼いだ『資金』と『経験値』は、@ 持ち越しになっ: The Funds and EXP you earned before the@Game Over carry over.
LDBI\t「じゃあ、レベルアップしてから@ ゲームオーバーになると、再チャレン: So if I level up and then get a Game Over,@I get to retry at that level?
LDBI\t「そうだ。@ 難しいマップでも何度も挑戦すれば、クリア出来る」: That's right.@Even tough maps can be cleared if you keep at it.
LDBI\t「それなら安心ッス！」: Then I've got nothing to worry about!
LDBI\t「さらにゲーム攻略に役立つコツや@ 情報をまとめた『攻略Ｑ＆Ａ』も存: There's also a Strategy Q&A with tips@and info to help you beat the game.
LDBI\t「それを読めば、難しいマップを攻略する時の@ 参考になるだろう」: Reading it should help when you're@tackling difficult maps.
LDBI\t「それって、どうやって見るんですか？」: So how do I view that?
LDBI\t「それをいつも付けてたら、ＤＭＬシステムを@ 使いこなすトレーニング: Wear those all the time and they'll be part of@your training to master the DML System.
LDBI\t「一大決心して、雷鳳に乗ったんでしょ。@ あれがどうなるかわからない: You made up your mind to pilot the RaiOh, right?@No idea what'll happen to it, but...@don't give up. Keep at it, just in case.
LDBI\t（フフフ……この情報は使えるわ。@ 後は８号機と９号機を……）: (Heh heh... This info will be useful.@Now for Units 8 and 9...)
LDBI\t「エルデ、試作８号機と９号機の巡航テストを行う。@ データ収集はそれ: Erde, we'll be running cruise tests on prototype@Units 8 and 9. Data collection is left to their@AI0s and you. Escort them in the Medius Locus.
LDBI\t「了解しましたが……@ 万が一、会敵した場合の対処は？」: Understood, but...@what should we do if we encounter the enemy?
LDBI\t「こちらの勢力圏内でテストコースを@ 設定しているのだがね。ゲストは: The test course is set within our sphere of@influence. Guests aside, the odds of meeting@Ruina or the Steel Dragons should be low.
LDBI\t「もし、敵と出くわした場合は速やかに撤退したまえ。@ ８号機と９号機: If you do run into the enemy, withdraw at once.@We can't afford to lose Units 8 and 9.
LDBI\t（これはチャンスね……@ 目的を同時に果たせるかも知れない……）: (This is my chance...@I may be able to achieve both goals at once...)
LDBI\t「……以上が、ＴＥアブゾーバー試作８号機、９号機、@ そして１０号機: ...And those are the rough specs for TE Absorber@prototype Units 8, 9, and 10.
LDBI\t「１０号機ＭＯＤＥＬ‐Ｘでの。@ ８号機と９号機はその過程でこさえた: Unit 10, MODEL-X. Units 8 and 9 are@manned TE Absorbers I knocked together@along the way.
LDBI\t「ガイアセイバーズでも運用できるようにした機体での。@ スポンサーか: Built so the Gaia Savers could operate them, too.@Just deliverables to wring funds from sponsors,@but they outperform the Cerberus and Garmraid.
LDBI\t「でも、ＭＯＤＥＬ‐ＸにはＡＩ１が……」: But MODEL-X has AI1 in it...
LDBI\t「そこは黄色信号での。@ ミタールは、ＡＩ１の暴走を懸念しておるから: That's the yellow light, you see.@Mitar's worried about AI1 going berserk.
LDBI\t「ワン博士、サーベラスやガルムレイドと@ メディウスが模擬戦ではなく: Dr. Wong, about how the Cerberus and Garmraid@were steered into real combat with the Medius@instead of mock battles...
LDBI\t「経緯はワシもよく知らんでの。@ おそらくは、エルデが言い出したこと: I don't know the details myself.@Most likely it was Erde's idea.
LDBI\t「ガチンコ勝負の方が、双方とも真剣になるでの。@ すると、いいデータ: A no-holds-barred fight gets both sides serious.@And that yields good data. Likely a measure to@train and raise AI1 more efficiently, I'd say.
LDBI\t「構わんということじゃの。@ エルデにとって、本命はあくまでもＡＩ１: Wouldn't matter, no.@For Erde, the real prize is AI1...@She dotes on it like it's her own child.
LDBI\t「では、アルベロ・エスト少佐が@ ツェントル・プロジェクトに従ってい: Then why is Major Albero Est@following the Tsentr Project?
LDBI\t「ワシにはわからんの。妙だと思って調べてはみたが、@ ミタールのガー: Couldn't say. It seemed odd, so I dug around,@but Mitar's guard was awfully tight. And Albero@and Erde both kept their mouths shut about it.
LDBI\t（相当の理由があるということか……）: (So there must be a serious reason...)
LDBI\t「ワシは全てを知っておるわけではないからの。@ 前大統領の件やガリル: I don't know everything, mind you. The former@President's affair, the Galilnagant, Canis,@the Machinery Children, Ing...
LDBI\t「そこら辺のことは、よくわからんでの」: I don't know much about any of that.
LDBI\t「……では、最後にお聞きします。@ 博士はアルテウル・シュタインベッ: ...Then one last question. Doctor, what do you@really think of Arteul Steinbeck?
LDBI\t「あやつの真意は見えんが……@ 白か黒かと言われたら、かなり黒に近い: I can't read his true intentions...@But if you made me pick black or white,@I'd say he's pretty close to black.
LDBI\t「ガイアセイバーズを隠れ蓑にして、@ 何か良からぬことを企んでおるよ: I've a feeling he's using the Gaia Savers as@cover to scheme something unsavory.
LDBI\t「まあ、ワシの勘じゃがの。@ ビアン・ゾルダークなどとは@ 根本が違: Just an old man's hunch, mind you. But I feel@he's fundamentally different from the likes of@Bian Zoldark.
LDBI\t「シーちゃんもそこら辺がわかっておったから、@ あのようなことをした: Shuey must've seen that too, which is likely@why he did what he did.
LDBI\t「シーちゃん……？@ もしかして、シュウ・シラカワ博士ですか？」: Shuey...?@You don't mean Dr. Shu Shirakawa?
LDBI\t「んむ。@ ワシも食っていくためにガイアセイバーズに@ 協力しとった: Mm-hm.@I cooperated with the Gaia Savers to put food@on the table, but... no more.
LDBI\t「あやつらに対するお主らの判断と行動は、@ 間違っておらんとは思うが: Still, I don't think your judgment and actions@regarding them have been wrong.
LDBI\t「……お話を聞かせていただいて、@ ありがとうございます、博士」: ...Thank you for speaking with us, Doctor.
LDBI\t「艦長、まもなく浮上の時間です。@ ブリッジにお戻り下さい」: Captain, we'll be surfacing soon.@Please return to the bridge.
LDBI\t「……私は哨戒任務がありますので、これで」: ...I have patrol duty, so if you'll excuse me.
LDBI\t「ああ、そうだったな。気をつけて行ってこい」: Ah, that's right. Be careful out there.
LDBI\t「天気晴朗なれども波高し、@ 海は広いな、でっかいな♪ ってね」: The weather's fair, but the waves are high!@Oh, the sea is so wide, the sea is so big♪
LDBI\t「もう……遊びに来たんじゃないのよ、ミオ。@ これは哨戒任務なんだか: Come on... We're not here to play, Mio.@This is a patrol mission.
LDBI\t「わかってますって。@ ちゃんとレーダーはチェックしてるから」: I know, I know.@I'm keeping an eye on the radar.
LDBI\t「見てるのは俺達ですけど～」: We're the ones watching it, though~
LDBI\t「ホンマ、ファミリア使いの荒いお人やさかいに」: Honestly, she sure works her familiars hard.
LDBI\t「……いいなあ、ファミリア。@ 色々なお手伝いをしてくれるものね」: ...Familiars are nice.@They help you out with all kinds of stuff.
LDBI\t「うん。@ 暇な時には、漫才の練習相手にもなるよ」: Yep.@When I'm bored, they help me practice comedy!
LDBI\t「そ、そういうのは求めてないけど……」: W-Well, that's not what I'm after, but...
LDBI\t（……やっぱり、一人でＴＥアブゾーバーに乗るのは@ 寂しいしね……ヒ: (...Flying a TE Absorber alone does get@lonely... I always had Hugo with me...)
LDBI\t「ねえねえ、もしファミリアが作れるんだったら、@ どういうのがいいの: Hey, hey, if you could make a familiar,@what kind would you want?
LDBI\t「って、何でトカゲなのよっ！！」: Wait, why would I want a lizard!!
LDBI\t「艦前方、ルイーナ機多数確認！」: Multiple Ruina units sighted ahead of the ship!
LDBI\t「各砲、攻撃用意。@ 何が起きるかわからん、慎重に対応する。@ 指示: All guns, prepare to fire.@We don't know what'll happen, so be cautious.@Hold until ordered.
LDBI\t「……艦長、どうやらここが最深部のようですな」: ...Captain, it seems this is the deepest point.
LDBI\t「開口した孔の下に、@ これほどまでの巨大な空間があるとは……」: To think there was such a vast space@beneath that open hole...
LDBI\t「南極の氷床下には、氷底湖がいくつもあります。@ その中でも最大なの: There are many subglacial lakes beneath the@Antarctic ice sheet. The largest is Lake Vostok,@250 km long and 40 km wide, near here...
LDBI\t「無論、ここは例外中の例外ですが、@ 南極の氷の下に何かがあるという: Of course, this is the exception of exceptions,@but the idea of something lying beneath the@Antarctic ice isn't all that unusual.
LDBI\t「そんなさらっとした話で済むとは思えませんが……@ ここがファブラ・: I doubt it's as simple as you make it sound...@But can we take it this is the heart@of Fabula Fores?
LDBI\t「ええ。そして、前方にあるのが@ ファブラ・フォレースそのものですが: Yes. And what lies ahead of us is@Fabula Fores itself, but...
LDBI\t「……まるで、何かの出入り口のような……@ それに、あの光は……？」: ...It looks almost like some kind of gateway...@And that light...?
LDBI\t「あのような構造物は、私も見たことがありません。@ 発光現象も含めて: I've never seen a structure like that either.@Nor that luminescence.
LDBI\t「おそらく、ファブラ・フォレースが動き出した後、@ 遺跡の中から現れ: I'd guess it emerged from within the ruins@after Fabula Fores began to move.
LDBI\t「つまり、ファブラ・フォレースの真の姿……？」: You mean it's Fabula Fores' true form...?
LDBI\t「構造物の下に元々存在していたか、@ あるいは封印が解け、あのような: Either it was there beneath the structure all@along, or a seal broke and it took that form...
LDBI\t「いずれにせよ、@ ドクトルも予測していなかった事態となると……」: Either way, if even the Doctor didn't@foresee this...
LDBI\t「……ともかく、各機を前に」: ...In any case, send our units forward.
LDBI\t「……クリフ、さっきの話は本当なのか。@ あの構造物を見たことがない: ...Cliff, were you telling the truth?@That you'd never seen that structure...
LDBI\t「ああ。知っていれば、事前に教えている。@ 教授も予期していなかった: Yeah. If I knew, I'd have told you beforehand.@Maybe even the professor didn't expect this.
LDBI\t「ラキ、ウェン、お前達もそうか？」: Raki, Wen, is it the same for you?
LDBI\t「僕も初めて見るよ。@ だけど、負の波動はあそこへ流れ込んでいる……: It's my first time seeing it too.@But the negative waves are flowing in there...@The King of Destruction is probably inside.
LDBI\t（やはり、この世界にも存在していたか……）: (So it exists in this world too...)
LDBI\t「あれ、どこかで見たことがあるような気が……」: That thing... I feel like I've seen it somewhere...
LDBI\t「何となくそう思うだけで、確証はない……」: It's just a feeling. I have no proof...
LDBI\t「あ、あたしとアニキだって、@ ファブラ・フォレースそのものは初めて: B-But even my brother and I are seeing@Fabula Fores itself for the first time...@So how could you...?!
LDBI\t「リュウセイ君達だけじゃない、私も……」: Ryusei and the others aren't the only ones. Me too...
LDBI\t「ちょっと、ちょっと。@ いくらデジャヴでも、そんなに大勢で言い出し: Hold on, hold on.@Deja vu or not, if that many of you say so,@it can't just be coincidence, can it?
LDBI\t「ジャブだかストレートだか知らねえが、@ 俺はあれと似たような物を見: Deja vu, deja-blue, whatever you call it,@I've seen something like that thing before.@Right, Axel?
LDBI\t「そうだ。@ おれ達が跳ばされた『向こう側』の世界でな」: Yeah. In the world on the 'other side'@where we got sent.
LDBI\t「ああ。@ 異なる時空間、異なる世界をつなぐ門……@ そこでは、“ク: Yeah.@A gate linking other times and other worlds...@Over there, it was called the Cross Gate.
LDBI\t「そいつのおかげで様々なものが入り交じり、@ 闘争していた世界を、お: I saw a world where, because of that thing,@all kinds of beings had mixed and were at war.
LDBI\t「どうして、そんな物が南極に……！？」: Why would something like that be@in Antarctica...?!
LDBI\t「こっちが聞きてえぐらいだよ、そいつは」: That's what I'd like to know.
LDBI\t「もしかして、あれはお前達が行っていた世界と@ つながっているのか？: Could that be connected to the world@you two went to?
LDBI\t「まさか、ルイーナもそこから……！？」: Could the Ruina have come from there too...?!
LDBI\t「いや。@ あっちの世界じゃ、ルイーナなんて見たことねえよ」: Nah.@I never saw any Ruina over in that world.
LDBI\t「クロスゲートの由来は知らんが、@ 様々な世界に存在していたらしい。: I don't know where the Cross Gates came from,@but they apparently existed in various worlds.@Meaning there's more than one of them.
LDBI\t「……ロア、お前はどうだ？@ 向こうの世界じゃ、眠ってたから……@: ...Roa, what about you?@You were asleep over in that world...@so this might be your first time seeing one.
LDBI\t「いや。こことは違う世界で、あれを見たことがある。@ アクセルの言っ: No. I've seen one in a world other than this.@What Axel says is true.
LDBI\t「なら、誰が何のためにクロスゲートを作ったか、@ 知ってんのか？」: Then do you know who made the Cross Gates,@and why?
LDBI\t「悪いが、俺も詳しくはない。@ だが、クロスゲートが存在していた世界: Sorry, but I don't know much either. But in the@worlds where Cross Gates existed, calamity came@through them and fierce wars broke out.
LDBI\t「ルイーナが出て来たみてえに、か……」: Just like how the Ruina showed up, huh...
LDBI\t（クロスゲート……私の“虚憶”の中にある言葉と@ 一致しましたね。な: (Cross Gate... That matches a word in my false@memories. I see, so that's how it is...@It was worth coming all this way.)
LDBI\t（地球周辺の境界線が曖昧になっている理由……@ 様々な事象が集中し、: (The reason the boundaries around Earth have@blurred... Why phenomena focus here and foreign@elements intrude...)
LDBI\t（それは、グランゾンのブラックボックスだけでは@ ありません。あれが: (It isn't only Granzon's black box. That thing's@presence here must also have a great deal@to do with it.)
LDBI\t「……では、クスハ少尉やリュウセイ少尉達が@ 既視感を感じたことにつ: ...Then how are we to be explaining the deja vu@that Lieutenant Kusuha and Lieutenant Ryusei and@the others felt, if you would so kindly?
LDBI\t「もしかして、前世の記憶とか、そっち方面？」: Maybe it's memories from a past life,@or something along those lines?
LDBI\t「何て言うか、パッと見てそう思っただけで……@ 確証はねえんだよ」: I mean, I just took one look and thought so...@I don't have any proof.
LDBI\t「覚えがあるような気がするだけで、@ それ以上のことはわからない……: It just feels familiar somehow.@Beyond that, I don't know...
LDBI\t「でも、そうとしか言いようがないのよ」: But there's no other way to put it.
LDBI\t「そのような感じ方をした人が複数いる以上、@ 何らかの根拠があると考: Since more than one person felt that way,@shouldn't we assume there's some basis for it?
LDBI\t「そうね……条件として挙げられるのは、@ 念動力者であること……？」: Let's see... One common factor might be@having Telekinesis...?
LDBI\t「でも、僕に覚えはありません」: But it doesn't seem familiar to me.
BMD\t「それがしの目を覚まさせてくれた/ マサキ殿のためにも、/ ここは功名: For the sake of Masaki,/　who opened my eyes,/　I must win glory on this field!
BMD\t「この戦い、大義はマサキ殿にあり！/ ならば、それがしはそれに従うのみ: In this battle, justice is Masaki's!/　Then I shall simply follow it!
BMD\t「さあさあさあ、/ 我こそはゴルド・バゴルドなり！/ 死にたい者からか: Come, come, come!/　I am Gordo Bagordo!/　Whoever wishes to die, step forward!
BMD\t「ほほう、存外に出来る相手と見た。/ いざ、尋常に勝負と参ろう！」: Hoho, you're abler than I expected./　Now, let us duel fair and square!
BMD\t「では、それがしも遠慮せずに参りますぞ」: Then I shan't hold back either!
BMD\t「さて、反撃と参りますかな」: Now then, shall I strike back?
BMD\t「申し訳ござらん！/ このゴルド・バゴルド、一生の不覚！」: My deepest apologies!/　A lifelong disgrace for Gordo Bagordo!
BMD\t「ぐううっ！/ こ、これほどの力の差があろうとは」: Gwuuh!/　S-such a gap in strength...
BMD\t「ぐうっ！！/ こ、これは予想外のダメージでした……」: Gnngh!!/　Th-that was more damage than I expected...
BMD\t「な、何とっ！？！？/ これほどのダメージを受けようとは……」: Wh-what?!/　To take this much damage...
BMD\t「むっ！/ なかなかの使い手……侮れませぬ」: Hm!/　A skilled foe... not to be underestimated.
BMD\t「さ、さすがにやりますな。/ しかし、この程度の被害は織り込み済み！」: Y-you're good, I'll grant you./　But I'd accounted for this much damage!
BMD\t「なかなかの腕ですな。/ ですが、詰めが甘いようで」: Quite skilled./　But your finish is lacking.
BMD\t「ほほう、お見事。/ しかし、こちらにはまだ余力があります」: Hoho, splendid./　But I still have strength to spare.
BMD\t「はっはっはっ！/ 蚊に刺されたほどにも感じませんな！」: Hahaha!/　I've felt mosquito bites worse than that!
BMD\t「それで精一杯ですかな？」: Is that the best you can do?
BMD\t「この程度の攻撃では、/ ビクともしませんわい！」: An attack like this/　won't budge me one bit!
BMD\t「ふっふっふっ、/ 甘く見てもらっては困りますな」: Heh heh heh,/　you'd do well not to underestimate me.
BMD\t「おっと、危ない所でしたな」: Whoa, that was a close one.
BMD\t「ええい、こんな時に弾切れとは！」: Blast! Out of ammo at a time like this!
BMD\t「射程外からの攻撃とは……やりますな」: Striking from beyond my range... well done.
BMD\t「マサキ殿、それがしが盾になります！」: Masaki, I shall be your shield!
LDBI\t「なるほど……いい仕上がり具合だね。@ 神僕も現れてないんだろう？」: I see... Nicely done.@And no divine servants have shown up, have they?
LDBI\t「はい、彼らの力が増した証かと思われます」: Yes. I believe it's proof that their power has grown.
LDBI\t「僕らの神も、ルイーナのおかげで@ ようやく目を覚ましそうだしね。@: And thanks to the Ruina, our god looks ready@to finally wake up, too.@Taihoku, I'd say it's time. What do you think?
LDBI\t「いつも通りの、そして望み通りの答えをありがとう。@ では、憐れな俗: Thanks--as usual, that's just what I wanted.@Bless these poor mortals with our god's grace...@So if you'd be so kind as to get going.
LDBI\t「夏喃、ここへ連れて来る者を間違えちゃ駄目だよ。@ 青龍の少女にご執: Kanan, don't bring back the wrong one here.@I know you're fixated on the Blue Dragon girl,@but we do have priorities.
LDBI\t「ふん……出迎えは蓬にやらせるさ」: Hmph... I'll have Hou do the welcoming.
LDBI\t「うむ。その間、ワシと夏喃で彼奴らの気を引こう。@ ……蓬、抜かりな: Good. Kanan and I will draw their attention.@...Hou, see that nothing goes wrong.
LDBI\t「光龍、受け入れの用意を怠るなよ」: Koryu, have everything ready to receive them.
LDBI\t「もちろん。@ 今回は派手にデビューしたいからねぇ、@ 出立の準備も: Of course.@I want to make a flashy debut this time,@so I'll get ready to head out, too.
LDBI\t「あの２機は、強いて言えば魔装機神に近いな」: Those two are rather like the Masoukishin.
LDBI\t「こちら側の人型機動兵器と似た概念を持ちつつ、@ 独自のシステムを有: They share concepts with our humanoid weapons,@but also have systems all their own.
LDBI\t「これまでに撃墜したルイーナのマシンを@ 解析して、ある程度予測はし: I'd predicted that to some degree by analyzing@the Ruina machines we've downed so far...
LDBI\t「他のメリオルエッセの機体もそうだという@ 確証はない。コンターギオ: But there's no proof the other Meliores units@are the same. Some, like Contagio's machine,@seem to be some kind of bioweapon.
LDBI\t「ああ……@ あれはどちらかと言えば、<アインスト>に近い」: Yeah...@That thing's closer to the <アインスト>, if anything.
LDBI\t「グラキエースが人間の知識や心象を抽出した上で@ 作られたメリオルエ: About Glacies being a Meliores created by@extracting human knowledge and impressions...@If that's true...
LDBI\t「ファービュラリスやストゥディウムの構造が@ こちら側の人型機動兵器: Then it's no surprise Fabularis and Studium@are built like our humanoid weapons.
LDBI\t「……誰の知識や心象が元になったんだ？」: ...Whose knowledge and impressions@were they based on?
LDBI\t（だが、あの場にいた人間となると……）: (But considering who was there at the time...)
LDBI\t「また、あの２機に用いられている材質の全てが@ 未知の物というわけで: Also, not all of the materials used in those two@are unknown to us.
LDBI\t「そして、エール・シュヴァリアーや@ ブランシュネージュと似通った部: And parts of them resemble the Aile Chevalier@and the Blanche Neige.
LDBI\t「予想していた通り、レース・アルカーナと@ シュンパティアに似た装置: Just as I expected, they had devices similar to@the Res Arcana and the Sympathia installed.
LDBI\t「ただし、後者の方は破損しており、@ 現時点でその詳細はわからないが: However, the latter is damaged,@so I can't give details at this point...@Can you fight in that state?
LDBI\t「パワーは落ちてしまうが……@ 機体はコントロールできる」: Our power will drop...@but we can control our units.
LDBI\t「あのシステムが破損しているからこそ、@ 私達は“破滅の王”の支配を: Precisely because that system is damaged,@we're free from the "King of Ruin's" control.
LDBI\t「あれがそういう類の装置であることはわかるが……@ 人間の精神と同調: I can see it's that sort of device...@but why was it able to sync with human minds?
LDBI\t「僕には人間の感情を理解する役目が@ 与えられていたから……」: Because I was given the role@of understanding human emotions...
LDBI\t「私はただ、与えられた物を使っていただけだ」: I was simply using what I was given.
LDBI\t（メリオルエッセと言えど、@ 肝心なことは知らされていないのか……）: (Even the Meliores aren't told@the important things, then...)
LDBI\t「ウェントス、@ あたしとあんたの役目が似ているって話……@ いった: Ventus,@what you said about our roles being similar...@What did you mean by that?
LDBI\t「君はシュンパティアに触れたことによって、@ 二つの魂を持つようにな: When you touched the Sympathia,@you came to have two souls...@That's what I sensed during our first sync.
LDBI\t「そして……それは、人間の複雑な心を@ より深く理解するためだと思っ: And... I thought it was so you could understand@the complex human heart more deeply...
LDBI\t「あたしは……ううん、あたし達は人間なのよ？@ 何でそんな役目が……: I'm... No, we're human, you know?@Why would we have a role like that? And who@would give it to us?
LDBI\t「わからない……。@ 今にして思えば、君の中にいる僕を@ 見たからな: I don't know...@Looking back, maybe it's because I saw@myself inside you...
LDBI\t「自分で自分を見たから、そう思ったって……？@ 明確な根拠があって、: You thought that because you saw yourself...?@So you had no real basis for saying it?
LDBI\t「ああ、僕は感じたままのことを……。@ それで、君を混乱させてしまっ: Right. I just said what I felt...@If that confused you,@I'm sorry...
LDBI\t「……クリフ、俺達が使っているシュンパティアや@ レース・アルカーナ: ...Cliff, the Sympathia and Res Arcana we use--@are they Ruina...
LDBI\t「似ているが、全く同じ物ではない。@ だが、あれを作った者が参考にし: They're similar, but not identical.@Still, it's possible whoever made them@used those as a reference.
LDBI\t「ファブラ・フォレースを作った者達か……。@ 心当たりはあるのか、グ: The people who built Fabula Fores...@Any idea who they were, Glacies?
LDBI\t「いや……ウンブラ達からも聞かされてはいない」: No... Umbra and the others never told me either.
LDBI\t「それに……@ 僕達は君達がファブラ・フォレースと呼ぶ場所……@ そ: Besides...@we've never set foot in the depths@of the place you call Fabula Fores.
LDBI\t「じゃあ……遺跡の中で父さん達を見たことは……？」: Then... you never saw my dad and the others@inside the ruins...?
LDBI\t「やはり、真相を確かめるには@ ファブラ・フォレースへ行くしかないか: I guess the only way to find the truth@is to go to Fabula Fores.
LDBI\t「だが、すぐにというわけにはいかないだろう」: But we can't do that right away.
LDBI\t「わかっているさ。俺達だけでルイーナは倒せない。@ 鋼龍戦隊と行動を: I know. We can't beat the Ruina on our own.@As long as we're with the Steel Dragons,@we'll have to fight their other enemies too.
LDBI\t「……面倒なことだな。存在をやめれば、楽になるぞ？」: ...What a bother. You'd be better off@if you ceased to exist.
LDBI\t「人間は死ぬのが怖い。誰だって、死にたくないんだ。@ お前にも……い: Humans are afraid of dying. Nobody wants to die.@You'll understand... someday.
LDBI\t「私の命など、偽りのものに過ぎない」: My life is nothing but a fake.
LDBI\t「それでも生きている者がいるのさ、この部隊には」: There are people like that in this unit,@and they're living all the same.
LDBI\t「略称か。ならば、私はラキと呼べ」: A short name. Then call me Laki.
LDBI\t「だから、認識し易い」: That's why it's easy to recognize.
BMD\t「先手を取れば、/ いささかなりとも勝率は上がりましょう」: If we seize the initiative,/　our odds should improve somewhat.
BMD\t「こちらから仕掛ければ、/ 多少ではあるが勝機はあるはず」: If I make the first move,/　I should have at least some chance.
BMD\t「我がシュテドニアスのため、/ ここから退くことは出来ません」: For the sake of Shtedonias,/　I cannot retreat from here.
BMD\t「地上人相手でも怯みはしません」: I won't flinch,/　even against a surface dweller.
BMD\t「魔装機神……油断するわけにはいきませんな」: A Masoukishin.../　I can't afford to let my guard down.
BMD\t「そのまま帰すわけには参りませんな」: I can't simply let you go home, can I?
BMD\t「こ、ここまでですか！」: I-Is this the end for me?!
BMD\t「こ、これほど甚大なダメージを被るとは……！」: I-I never expected/　to take such heavy damage...!
BMD\t「かなり危険な状態ですが……/ まだ退くわけには！」: This is quite dangerous.../　but I can't retreat yet!
BMD\t「私にも意地がありましてね……！」: I have my pride too, you know...!
BMD\t「ぐうっ！/ 地上人にここまで追い込まれるとは！」: Ngh!/　To be pushed this far by a surface dweller!
BMD\t「くううっ……/ 魔装機神には敵わないのか……！？」: Nngh.../　Am I no match for a Masoukishin...?!
BMD\t「これはこれは……存外強力でしたね」: Well, well.../　That was stronger than I expected.
BMD\t「なめていたわけではありませんが、/ 予想外に強力でした」: Not that I underestimated you,/　but that was unexpectedly strong.
BMD\t「まだまだ……ここからです」: Not yet... I'm just getting started.
BMD\t「この程度で私は止まりませんぞ」: This won't be enough to stop me.
BMD\t「地上人を/ 甘く見ていたわけではありませんが……！」: I didn't take you surface dwellers/　lightly, but...!
BMD\t「さ、さすがにパワーでは押されますか……！」: S-So in raw power,/　I'm outmatched after all...!
BMD\t「ふむ、まだまだ余裕がありますね」: Hmm, I still have plenty to spare.
BMD\t「案外、大した威力ではありませんでしたね」: That wasn't as powerful as I'd feared.
BMD\t「その程度の力で、私に勝つことは出来ませんよ」: With power like that,/　you can't hope to defeat me.
BMD\t「地上人よ、本気を出してそれですか？」: Surface dweller, is that your best?
BMD\t「魔装機神、思っていたほどではありませんね」: Masoukishin, you're not what I'd thought.
BMD\t「魔装機神がこの程度とは……」: So this is all a Masoukishin can do...
BMD\t「狙いが甘かったようですね」: Your aim was a little off, it seems.
BMD\t「そう簡単に当たるものではないんですよ」: I'm not so easily hit, you know.
BMD\t「間合いの取り方が上手ですね」: You're skilled at keeping your distance.
BMD\t「敵を見失うとは……！」: I've lost sight of the enemy...!
BMD\t「好機は逃すべからず」: Never let an opportunity slip by.
BMD\t「得難いチャンスをいただきましたな。/ それでは遠慮なく」: A rare opportunity indeed./　I won't hold back.
BMD\t「隙を見つけました。いきますよ」: I see an opening. Here I come.
LDBI\t「アルテウル様、特次副大統領へのご就任、@ おめでとうございます」: Congratulations on your appointment as@Special Vice President, sir.
LDBI\t「とは言え、大統領権限継承順位は、@ ダン・ヘンドリックス副大統領よ: Still, in the presidential line of succession,@I rank several places below@Vice President Dan Hendrickson.
LDBI\t「それでも異例の抜擢です。@ グラスマン大統領が『ＧＳ』の存在を重要: Even so, it's an unprecedented appointment.@It shows President Grassman values the GS@and places high hopes in its work.
LDBI\t「リ・テクの機体は、ご指示通り@ 伊豆の特殊戦技教導隊へ出向させまし: As instructed, the Re-Tech unit has been@seconded to the Special Tactics Instruction@Corps in Izu.
LDBI\t「パイロットはラドクリフ教授の息子だったな。@ 我らの意思が介在して: The pilot is Professor Radcliffe's son, yes?@No one knows we had a hand in this, I trust?
LDBI\t「教授には口止めをしてあります。@ また、<教導隊>の面々に詳細を教: The professor has been sworn to silence.@And I've told Kenneth not to share the details@with the <教導隊> members.
LDBI\t「わかった。@ いいデータが得られることを期待しよう。@ ……他には: Very well.@Let's hope we get good data from it.@...Anything else?
LDBI\t「“グレイ”から連絡がありました。@ 彼らの先遣はすでに到来し、調査: We've heard from "Gray." Their advance team@has already arrived and begun investigating...@X-Day is within a week.
LDBI\t「ふむ……読み通りだな。狙いは？」: Hm... Just as I predicted. Their target?
LDBI\t「こちらの頭と腕……それに、凶鳥です」: Our head and arm... and the Bird of Ill Omen.
LDBI\t「フッ、まだそれに拘るとはな。@ それとも、グランゾンが行方不明のま: Heh, still fixated on that, are they?@Or is it because the Granzon is still missing?
LDBI\t「凶鳥はオルレアンの工場にて@ オーバーホール中とのことです」: The Bird of Ill Omen is reportedly being@overhauled at the Orleans factory.
LDBI\t「では、全機をこちらへ移送させろ。@ 特次副大統領権限で<マオ・イン: Then have all of them moved here.@Notify <マオ・インダストリー> on my authority...@and have the Federation Army handle transport.
LDBI\t「念のため、オメガも派遣しておく。@ “グレイ”もまた、凶鳥と縁のあ: I'll dispatch Omega as well, just in case.@"Gray" is also a man with ties to the Bird...@He may be planning to outmaneuver us.
LDBI\t「彼……いや、もう片方が@ 凶鳥の所在位置を知っていると？」: You think he... no, the other one knows@where the Bird of Ill Omen is?
LDBI\t「ああ……事前に偵察をしているだろうからな」: Yes... He's surely scouted it out in advance.
LDBI\t「では、Ｘデーの対処については？」: Then how do we deal with X-Day?
LDBI\t「手はず通りだ。@ それと、連邦軍のギャスパル・ギラン元帥に@ 一報: As planned.@Also, send word to Marshal Gaspar Gilan@of the Federation Army.
LDBI\t「パリは候補地から外しておくのですな？」: So we're taking Paris off the list of targets?
LDBI\t「ああ。そこへは、私がアルファと共に@ エア・クリスマスで赴く」: Yes. I'll go there myself with Alpha@aboard the Air Christmas.
LDBI\t「ギャスパル元帥が“グレイ”の忠告を@ 信じなかった場合は？」: And if Marshal Gaspar doesn't heed@the warning from "Gray"?
LDBI\t「その時は、彼の首が飛ぶだけだが……@ ミッション・ハルパーを看過し: Then it'll simply cost him his head...@But he turned a blind eye to Mission Halper@to preserve the system... He's no fool.
LDBI\t「ギャスパルは、必ず手を打つ。@ 残念ながら、その急先鋒たる鋼龍戦隊: Gaspar will definitely take action.@Sadly, the Steel Dragons who'd lead the charge@are nowhere to be found...
LDBI\t「ですが、そのおかげで『ＧＳ』は@ センセーショナルなデビューを飾れ: But thanks to that, the GS will get to make@a sensational debut.
LDBI\t「ああ。まもなく、我らの時代が来る……」: Yes. Our era will soon be upon us...
LDBI\t「……ヒュッケバイン・シリーズ移送の@ 護衛任務でありますか？」: ...An escort mission for transporting@the Hückebein series, sir?
LDBI\t「そうだ。貴様らは明朝０６００をもって@ 伊豆から進発、マオ・インダ: That's right. You'll depart Izu at 0600 tomorrow@and head for Mao Industries' Orleans factory.
LDBI\t「なお、移送の目的地はハワイのヒッカム基地だ」: The units are bound for Hickam Base in Hawaii.
LDBI\t「何故、南欧方面軍の部隊ではなく、@ 我々がその任務に？」: Why are we being given this mission instead@of a unit from the Southern Europe Command?
LDBI\t「マオ社の方から、わざわざお前達教導隊を@ 指名してきおったのだ。そ: Mao Industries asked for you Instruction Corps@people by name. Then the Aviano bunch took it@at face value and dumped it all on me.
LDBI\t「ヒュッケバインが絡んでいるだけに、@ 面倒事だと思ったのだろうが…: With the Hückebein involved, they probably@figured it was trouble...
LDBI\t「……了解しました。@ 特殊戦技教導隊は明朝０６００より@ 任務に就: ...Understood. The Special Tactics Instruction@Corps will begin the mission at 0600 tomorrow.
LDBI\t「護衛対象は、曰く付きのバニシング・トルーパー共だ。@ 新しい伝説な: You're escorting those notorious Vanishing@Troopers. I don't need any new legends.@My reputation's on the line.
LDBI\t「それと、ツェントル・プロジェクトから@ 出向して来たアクア・ケント: And about Lieutenant Aqua Centrum,@who's on loan from the Tsentr Project...
LDBI\t「くれぐれも扱いは丁重にな」: Make sure you treat her with the utmost care.
LDBI\t「……彼女を特別扱いする気はありませんが。@ それとも、ツェントル・: ...I've no intention of giving her special@treatment. Or did the Tsentr Project@request it?
LDBI\t「だとしたら、こちらから問い質したいことが@ 多々あるのですが」: If so, there are quite a few things@I'd like to ask them.
LDBI\t「ツェントル・プロジェクト絡みの件は、@ 大統領特別補佐官直々の命令: Anything involving the Tsentr Project comes@straight from the Special Presidential Aide.@Even I don't know the details.
LDBI\t「アクア少尉の父親だ。@ ワシの所へ直接連絡を入れてきおった」: Lieutenant Aqua's father.@He contacted me directly.
LDBI\t（なるほど……そういうことか）: (I see... So that's how it is.)
LDBI\t「……アクア、もう一度考え直してくれないか」: ...Aqua, won't you reconsider one more time?
LDBI\t「また話を蒸し返す気？@ ようやくパイロットになれたのよ、@ 家に戻: You're bringing that up again?@I've finally become a pilot.@I have no intention of going home.
LDBI\t「叔父さんも心配しているよ。@ 女だてらに軍人など……万が一のことが: Your uncle is worried too.@A woman joining the military... He wants to know@what you'll do if the worst should happen.
LDBI\t「あの人は自分の地盤維持が気になってるだけでしょ。@ 言っとくけど、: He only cares about keeping his power base.@And just so you know, I have no intention of@taking over the company or going into politics.
LDBI\t「アクア、いったい何が不満で……」: Aqua, what on earth are you so unhappy...
LDBI\t「だから、私を縛り付けようとする人達が嫌なの。@ 何を言われたって、: That's just it. I hate people who try to@tie me down. Whatever you say,@I won't change my mind.
LDBI\t「ううっ、頑固な所はアマリア譲りだな……」: Ugh, you got that stubborn streak from Amalia...
LDBI\t「母様が生きていたら、きっと賛成してくれたわ」: If Mother were alive, I know she'd support me.
LDBI\t「そ、そんなはずはない。@ 子供を軍隊に取られて、心配しない親など…: Wh-What nonsense.@What parent wouldn't worry with their child@taken by the military...
LDBI\t「お前が出向している特殊戦技教導隊は、@ あの鋼龍戦隊とも縁が深いじ: The Special Tactics Instruction Corps you're@with has deep ties to the Steel Dragons!@You could end up on the front lines too...
LDBI\t「父様、もう仕事の時間だから。@ それと、基地に直電するのはやめてね: Father, I have to get to work.@And please stop calling the base directly.
LDBI\t「連邦議会の上院議員から連絡があったって、@ ちょっとした騒ぎになっ: Word that a Federation Assembly senator had@called caused quite a stir, you know.
BMD\t「この角度なら、回避は間に合わんはず……」: From this angle, you can't evade in time...
BMD\t「踏み込み過ぎたようだな」: Looks like you stepped in too far.
BMD\t「後は結果を出すだけだ」: All that's left is to deliver results.
BMD\t「その動き……命取りだったな」: That move... was a fatal one.
BMD\t「目立つ標的から片付ける」: I'll clear out the conspicuous targets first.
BMD\t「これは、いただきでありんす」: This one's mine, I daresay-ish, darling.
BMD\t「回避は不可能でございましょうのことよ」: Evasion is quite impossible, as it were-ly.
BMD\t「いい間合いだったりしちゃうの」: That was, like, totally a nice range-y thing.
BMD\t「いただきますですわ……と、いかんな」: I shall partake, darling... No, that won't do.
BMD\t「行きますですの……ゴホン、行くぞ……！」: Here I go-ey, please... Ahem. Here I come...!
BMD\t「悪くない距離でございますです……！」: Not a bad distance, if I may humbly say...!
BMD\t「シミュレーション通りですのことね」: Just like the simulation, so it is-ish, dear.
BMD\t「前に出過ぎでございますですわね」: You're too far forward, if I may say, darling.
BMD\t「踏み込み過ぎだったりしちゃいますです……/ いかん、さらに調子が」: You stepped in too far-ish and stuff-ity.../　Damn, it's getting even worse.
BMD\t「ボクの狙いから逃げられると……/ む？ 何の言語モードだ？」: You think you can escape my sights, huh.../　Hm? What language mode is this?
BMD\t「そこでございますわ！/ ……語尾はともかく、これでは……」: Right there, if you please!/　...Speech quirks aside, this is...
BMD\t「いてこましたるでぇ！/ ……こんな言語モードまで……」: I'mma mess ya up good, ya hear!/　...Even a language mode like this...
BMD\t「うふふ、お・し・お・きよん！/ ……これもいかんな」: Ufufu, pun-ish-ment time~!/　...This won't do either.
BMD\t「ボクに任せときんしゃーい！/ ……プロト・コードだと？」: Y'all just leave it to me now!/　...A proto-code?
BMD\t「アリエイルに手出しはさせん」: I won't let you lay a hand on Arieil.
BMD\t「アリエイルの生き方を認めないと/ 言うのなら……！」: If you refuse to accept/　the way Arieil chooses to live...!
BMD\t「お前は、/ 己の存在意義の見出し方を誤っている」: You've gone wrong in how/　you seek your reason to exist.
BMD\t「宿命に抗う方法は、他にもあるはずだ……！」: There must be other ways to defy fate...!
BMD\t「ドゥバン、/ お前は至高の支配者にはなり得ん……！」: Duban,/　you can never be the supreme ruler...!
BMD\t「虚ろな存在による支配は、/ 虚構に過ぎん……！」: Rule by a hollow being/　is nothing but a sham...!
BMD\t「目指すものはＤＣやシャドウミラーと同じか」: So your goal is the same as/　the DC's and Shadow Mirror's.
BMD\t「メリオルエッセ……/ 私に絶望を与えられるか？」: Meliores Esse.../　Can you give me despair?
BMD\t「恐怖、絶望……/ その何たるかを私に教えてもらおうか」: Fear, despair.../　I'd like you to teach me what they are.
BMD\t「お前達もこの世界へ干渉するか……！」: So you'll meddle in this world too...!
BMD\t「コンターギオ……/ お前の享楽に付き合う気はない」: Contagio.../　I have no interest in your amusements.
BMD\t「ウンブラ、お前の言葉に惑わされはしない」: Umbra, your words won't lead me astray.
BMD\t「あの男は……/ 他のメリオルエッセと違う……！」: That man is.../　different from the other Meliores Esse...!
LDBI\t「で、カークスの行方はわかったのかよ？」: So, did you find out where Kirkus went?
LDBI\t「捜索はしているけど、報告は入って来てないわ。@ カークス軍の全てが: We're searching, but no reports yet.@Not all of Kirkus's army has surrendered,@so the skirmishes may go on for a while.
LDBI\t「ま、カークスが生きてる以上、@ あいつの命令に逆らってでも@ つい: Well, as long as Kirkus is alive,@there'll be guys who'll follow him,@even if it means defying his orders.
LDBI\t「王都はともかく、方々で混乱してるわよ。@ 各方面部隊の様子も掴み切: The capital's fine, but it's chaos elsewhere.@We can't even track all our regional units...@let alone search for the summoned surfacers.
LDBI\t「しかも、どさくさに紛れて@ シュテドニアス軍の特殊部隊が舞い戻って: On top of that, we've heard Schtedonias's@special forces slipped back in amid@all the confusion.
LDBI\t「あの連中、まだラングランで何かやろうっての？」: What, they're still up to something in Langran?
LDBI\t「敗残兵もまだいるでしょうし……@ こちらの混乱に乗じて、破壊工作を: There are probably stragglers too...@There's a good chance they'll exploit our@confusion to stage sabotage.
LDBI\t「……ところで、俺達はいつ地上へ戻れるんだ？」: ...So when do we get back to the surface?
LDBI\t「もう少ししたら、各地に避難していた@ 神官達が王都に戻って来るから: Soon the priests who evacuated across the land@will return to the capital, and their power@can open the Gate.
LDBI\t「そ、それより、あのイングって奴、@ なかなかやるじゃねえか。@ こ: A-anyway, that Ing guy's pretty good.@Are you gonna have him join our@next operations too?
LDBI\t「ヴィレッタ隊長は、そのつもりのようだが」: Captain Viletta seems to think so.
LDBI\t「行動に不審な点は見受けられなかったが、@ 初めて乗った機体をああも: I saw nothing suspicious in his actions, but@to pilot a new machine that well right away...
LDBI\t「そういう奴、鋼龍戦隊には割と多くねえか？」: Aren't there a lot of guys like that@in the Steel Dragons?
LDBI\t「……天性の才能なら、いいのだがな」: ...If it's natural talent, that'd be fine.
LDBI\t「フェイル殿下から新たな要請が来た。@ シュテドニアス軍の特殊部隊が: We've received a new request from Prince Feil.@Schtedonias special forces apparently invaded@Troia Province and clashed with local units.
LDBI\t「その後、敵はグリモルド山付近へ潜伏したようだ」: After that, the enemy apparently went into@hiding near Mount Grimold.
LDBI\t「俺達に要請が来たってことは……@ 現地の連中じゃ、手に負えなかった: If they're asking us...@it means the locals couldn't handle it.
LDBI\t「グリモルド山には、@ 敵にとって重要な物が存在しているのですか？」: Is there something on Mount Grimold@that's important to the enemy?
LDBI\t「ああ、オリハルコニウムの採掘場が@ いくつかあると聞いている」: Yes. I hear there are several@Orichalconium mines there.
LDBI\t「<ラ・ギアス>で産出される特殊な金属よ。@ このペンダントもオリハ: It's a special metal produced in <ラ・ギアス>.@This pendant's made of Orichalconium too.
LDBI\t「オリハルコニウムは軽くて丈夫な上、@ 精神感応性もあるから、魔装機: Orichalconium is light and durable, and it's@psychically responsive, so it's also used@in the armor of Masouki.
LDBI\t「もしや、ＳＲＸにも使われている@ ゾル・オリハルコニウムと関係が…: Could it be related to the Zol Orichalconium@used in the SRX...?
LDBI\t「データを見たけど、ラ・ギアス産の@ オリハルコニウムが使われてるみ: I looked at the data, and it seems to use@Orichalconium from La Gias.
LDBI\t「もしかして、クリストフが@ 地上へ持って行ったんじゃないかしら……: Maybe Christoph took some@to the surface...
LDBI\t（そして……ＳＲＸ計画に提供したというのか……？）: (And then... provided it to the SRX Project...?)
LDBI\t「あと……こっちじゃ、プロポーズ代わりに@ オリハルコニウムの小物を: Oh, and around here, giving someone a little@Orichalconium trinket is a popular way@to propose.
LDBI\t「マサキにも覚えがあるニャ」: Masaki's got some experience with that, meow.
LDBI\t「ムキになって否定する所が怪しい～！@ リューネはそのことを知ってる: Denying it so hard is suspicious~!@Does Lüne know about this?
LDBI\t「なになに？ その話、あたしも興味あるぅ」: What, what? I wanna hear that story too~
LDBI\t「だーっ！@ 今はそんなこと言ってる場合じゃねえだろ！」: Gaaah!@This is no time to be talking about that!
LDBI\t「そうだ。私語を慎め、お前達。@ フェイル殿下は、敵の目的が産出量の: Right. Cut the chatter, all of you.@Prince Feil suspects the enemy is after the@scarce Orichalconium, but...
LDBI\t「今というタイミングで@ 彼らがグリモルド山へ向かったことに@ 疑問: he has doubts about why they've headed@to Mount Grimold at this particular time.
LDBI\t「オリハルコニウムの採掘場以外にも@ 何かあるんですか？」: Is there something there besides@the Orichalconium mines?
LDBI\t「グリモルド山と言えば、@ 破壊神サーヴァ・ヴォルクルスが@ 眠って: Speaking of Mount Grimold, there are rumors@that the God of Destruction, Sarva Volkruss,@sleeps there.
LDBI\t「破壊神……そんなものが存在しているとは」: A God of Destruction...@To think such a thing exists.
LDBI\t「サーヴァ・ヴォルクルスの正体は@ よくわかっていないのだけど……」: No one really knows@what Sarva Volkruss truly is...
LDBI\t「今の所は古代に滅亡した超知性体の残留思念……@ つまり、幽霊みたい: The current leading theory is that it's the@lingering thoughts of an extinct ancient@super-intelligence... In short, a kind of ghost.
LDBI\t「巨人族の残留思念の塊って説もあるけど」: There's also a theory that it's a mass of@the giant race's lingering thoughts.
LDBI\t「超古代文明に巨人族ときたか。@ ま、精霊が実在する世界だしな……」: A super-ancient civilization and giants, huh?@Well, this is a world where spirits are real...
LDBI\t「昔からいる怪しげな存在っていう点じゃ、@ <アインスト>とちょっと: Being shady things that've been around forever,@aren't they kinda like the <アインスト>?
LDBI\t「でも、ルオゾールのように@ ヴォルクルスを神と崇める信者達は存在す: But there are believers like Luozorl@who worship Volkruss as a god. And now@the Barrier of Harmony is gone...
LDBI\t「邪神を復活させようとする動きがあっても、@ おかしくはないわね」: It wouldn't be strange if someone@tried to revive the evil god.
LDBI\t「それにシュテドニアスが絡んでるかも@ 知れねえのか。こいつはキナ臭: And Schtedonias might be mixed up in that?@This is way past just being fishy now.
LDBI\t「神頼みならぬ、邪神頼みってわけ？@ そもそもヴォルクルスって、@: Not praying to a god, but to an evil god?@Can humans even control@something like Volkruss?
LDBI\t「無理だと思うわ。@ だから、シュテドニアス側にも@ 大きなデメリッ: I don't think so.@Which means there's a big downside@for Schtedonias, too.
LDBI\t「そもそも、@ どうやってヴォルクルスを復活させるの？」: And how would anyone revive@Volkruss in the first place?
LDBI\t「出来れば、枢密院の心証を悪くしないためにも@ 大人の扱いを期待した: Ideally, I'd hope to be treated like an adult,@if only to keep the Privy Council's opinion@of you from souring.
LDBI\t「ケッ、都合のいいことばかり言いやがって」: Tch, you're just saying whatever suits you.
LDBI\t「さて、いかが致しますか、艦長？@ 彼が持つゾヴォーク関連の情報は、: So, what shall we do, Captain?@The intel he has on the Zovorg would be@hard to come by otherwise.
LDBI\t「……上層部へ判断を仰ごうにも、現状で@ それは叶わない……また、ト: ...Seeking a ruling from HQ isn't possible@as things stand... And to keep trouble to a@minimum, I'll handle this on my own authority.
LDBI\t「メキボス・ボルクェーデ。@ あなたの身柄は、引き続き我が隊が預かり: Mekibos Borkeede.@You'll remain in our unit's custody.
LDBI\t「そうしてくれると助かる。@ ここには見知った顔が多いからな」: I'd appreciate that.@There are plenty of familiar faces here.
LDBI\t「ただし、行動にはかなりの制限が付きますよ」: However, your movements will be@heavily restricted.
LDBI\t「もちろん。@ 何なら、俺のグレイターキンを戦力として@ 使ってくれ: Of course.@If you want, you're welcome to use my@Greytarkin as part of your forces.
LDBI\t「俺自身の興味もあると言っただろう。@ ルイーナやバラルってのがどん: I told you I've got my own interest in this.@I want to see for myself what these Ruina@and Balar types are like.
LDBI\t「艦長命令だから仕方がねえが……@ 妙な真似をしやがったら、とっちめ: Captain's orders, so I'll put up with it...@but try anything funny, and roughing you up@won't be the end of it.
LDBI\t「ああ、覚えておくぜ」: Yeah, I'll keep that in mind.
LDBI\t「では、次の議題に移りましょう。@ ……シラカワ博士」: Now, let's move on to the next item.@...Dr. Shirakawa.
LDBI\t「バラルのバリアの件ですが……@ それを突破する方法の目処が付きまし: Regarding Balar's barrier...@I've found a likely way to break through it.
LDBI\t「ええ。@ 既にご承知の通り、地球にはバラルのバリアで@ 覆われてい: Yes.@As you're already aware, there's only one place@on Earth not covered by Balar's barrier.
LDBI\t「そうです。@ 依然、ファブラ・フォレース上空は@ ルイーナの結界で: Correct.@The skies over Fabula Phores remain@covered by the Ruina's barrier...
LDBI\t「バラルのバリアと言えど、@ そこを侵蝕するのは不可能のようです」: and it seems even Balar's barrier@cannot encroach upon it.
LDBI\t「だが、ルイーナの結界もまた突破不能ではないか」: But isn't the Ruina's barrier just as@impenetrable?
LDBI\t「その通りですが……@ バラルとルイーナの結界の間には、@ 相互不干: Indeed, but...@between the Balar and Ruina barriers, there@exists a boundary where neither interferes.
LDBI\t「そして、@ それをこじ開け、結界表面を滑り落ちれば……@ 南極へ降: And if we were to force that open@and slide down the barrier's surface...@it may be possible to descend to Antarctica.
LDBI\t「その境目をどうやってこじ開けるのだ？」: And how do you intend to force that@boundary open?
LDBI\t「鍵となるのは、アルテリオンとベガリオンです」: The key lies in the Arterion and the Vegalion.
LDBI\t「第３世代テスラ・ドライブを搭載した両機は、@ ツイン・モーダルと呼: Both units carry third-generation Tesla Drives@and achieve synchronized operation of their@two drives, called Twin Modal.
LDBI\t「大まかに言えば、これは互いの<テスラ・ドライブ>を@ 空間内で認識: Roughly speaking, each recognizes the other's@<テスラ・ドライブ> in space. So if one causes spatial@interference that would destroy its stability...
LDBI\t「相方がその作用を自己領域のみ局所中和するのです」: the partner neutralizes that effect locally,@within its own domain alone.
LDBI\t「そして、アルテリオンとベガリオンが@ 組み合わさり、ハイペリオンと: And when the Arterion and Vegalion@combine into the Hyperlion and push their@Tesla Drive output to the maximum...
LDBI\t「ツイン・モーダルはクワッド・モーダルとなり、@ 機体周辺にディスク: Twin Modal becomes Quad Modal, manifesting@a perfect sphere around the unit called@the Discrete Sphere.
LDBI\t「このスフィアは完全鏡面となり、@ その内部は球外と不連続な宇宙であ: This sphere is a perfect mirror, and theory@predicted that its interior would be a space@discontinuous with the outside.
LDBI\t「ハイペリオンは条件が揃えば……リミッターを@ 解除し、クワッド・モ: Given the right conditions... if its limiter is@released and Quad Modal manifested... the@Hyperlion can generate a powerful barrier.
LDBI\t「フィリオ少佐は時空連続体をも切り裂くことが@ 可能かも知れないと言: Major Filio said it might even be able to@cut through the space-time continuum... but@at this stage, that's a pipe dream.
LDBI\t「見えてきたぜ。@ 要は、結界の隙間にハイペリオンのディスクリート・: I'm starting to get it.@So we drive the Hyperlion's Discrete Sphere into@the barrier's gap like an awl, right?
LDBI\t「はい。@ 非常に危険度の高い方法ではありますが……」: Yes.@Though it's an extremely risky method...
LDBI\t「突っ込んで行って駄目だったら、@ 全員でお陀仏ってわけかよ」: And if we charge in and it fails,@we all kick the bucket, huh?
LDBI\t「保険はかけますよ。私のグランゾンでね」: I'll provide insurance. With my Granzon.
LDBI\t「まず、降下点に向けて充分な加速空間を確保し、@ ハイペリオン、グラ: First, we secure ample room to accelerate@toward the descent point. The Hyperlion, Granzon@and Hiryu Custom then accelerate, in that order.
LDBI\t「加速しつつ、境界面突入直前に@ ハイペリオンはディスクリート・スフ: While accelerating, just before hitting the@boundary, the Hyperlion deploys the Discrete@Sphere and forces a hole open.
LDBI\t「そして、グランゾンは<歪曲フィールド>で@ 摩擦によって生じる諸々: Then the Granzon uses its <歪曲フィールド> to@disperse the various aftershocks caused by@friction, while widening the hole further.
LDBI\t「最後にヒリュウ改はブレイク・フィールドを@ 展開したまま突入……ル: Finally, the Hiryu Custom plunges in with its@Break Field deployed... slides down the Ruina@barrier, decelerates, and lands on the ice.
LDBI\t「決して高くありませんが……@ バラルの園へ正面から突入するよりは@: It's by no means high... but it's far better@than charging head-on into the Garden of Balar.
LDBI\t「二心はないだろうな、シュウ」: You're not plotting anything, are you, Shu?
LDBI\t「もちろん。この私も身体を張るのですから」: Of course not. I'll be putting myself on the line too.
LDBI\t「他の問題点として、@ 降下前にバラル、降下後にルイーナの@ 襲撃を: Another concern is the possibility of attack@by Balar before the descent, and by the Ruina@after it.
LDBI\t「それは……私達で何とかするしかないわね」: That's... something we'll just have to handle.
LDBI\t「ええ……これからの事態に対処するためにも@ 我々は本来の力を取り戻: Yes... To deal with what lies ahead, we must@regain our true strength. We'll adopt the plan@of Dr. Shirakawa and Chief Takakura...
LDBI\t「本艦は地球へ帰還します。@ 各員に作戦内容を伝達し、準備を始めて下: and this ship will return to Earth.@Brief all personnel on the operation and begin@preparations.
LDBI\t「……ここまでは何事もなく来られたか」: ...We've made it this far without incident.
LDBI\t「こないだみたいに@ バラルの軍勢が現れると思っていたけど……」: I thought Balar's forces would show up@like last time, but...
LDBI\t「こちらには気づいているはずだ。@ 何か理由があって、仕掛けて来ない: They must have noticed us.@Is there some reason they aren't attacking...?
LDBI\t「今、そんなことを考えても仕方ない。@ あたし達は、ディスクリート・: No point thinking about that now.@All we need to do is focus on manifesting@the Discrete Sphere.
LDBI\t「そうね。コース取りとタイミングは@ あなたに懸かっているわ。しっか: Right. The course and timing are@all on you. Stay sharp.
LDBI\t（神の子、イルイよ……@ 汝は我の強念を受け継ぎし者……）: (Irui, child of God...@You are the heir to my strong will...)
LDBI\t「よく覚えてないけど、@ 誰かに呼ばれたような気がした……」: I don't really remember, but...@it felt like someone was calling me...

LDBI\t「アイビスさん……@ もしかして、イルイちゃんの記憶が@ 戻る前兆な: Ibis...@Could this be a sign that Irui's@memories are coming back...?
LDBI\t「記憶が戻ったら……@ アイビス達と一緒にいられなくなるの……？」: If my memories come back...@will I have to leave you all, Ibis...?

LDBI\t「で、でも……昔のことを思い出すのが@ 何だか不安で……」: B-But... remembering the past@makes me kind of scared...

LDBI\t「イルイとは事情が違うけど……@ 私も過去の記憶がないから」: It's not the same as your situation, Irui...@but I don't have any memories of my past, either.
LDBI\t「ゼオラだけじゃない……おれとラトもだ」: It's not just Seolla... Lato and I don't, either.
LDBI\t「記憶が戻ったら、@ 何かが変わってしまうかも知れない……@ そうい: I used to worry, too...@that if my memories came back,@something might change.
LDBI\t「だけど、アラドやラト達がいてくれたから、@ 何とかやってこられた。: But I got by because Arado, Lato and the@others were there for me. The bonds I share@with everyone kept me going.

LDBI\t「イルイはあたし達の大切な友達……@ 記憶を取り戻しても、それは変わ: You're our precious friend, Irui...@That won't change, even if you get@your memories back.
LDBI\t「そう、エーテル通信機に連絡を入れて来たの。@ 今、リュウセイ達が話: Yes, he reached us via the ether communicator.@Ryusei and the others are talking to him now.@Would you like to join them?

LDBI\t「初手を封じられたせいか、意外に慎重でね。@ とは言え、月は連中に抑: Cautious, surprisingly. Probably because their@opening move got shut down. Still, they're@taking the moon bit by bit.
LDBI\t「連邦軍が早く反攻作戦を実行へ移さないと、@ 制宙権を全て握られかね: If the Federation Army doesn't launch a@counteroffensive soon, they could end up@taking full control of space.
LDBI\t「私達も気になってるんだけど、@ 今の立場じゃ、どうしようもないしね: We're worried about it too, but there's not@much we can do in our current position.
LDBI\t「すまねえな、大変な時に連絡しちまって……」: Sorry for calling at a time like this...
LDBI\t「まあ、マーサ達が元気でやってるって@ わかっただけでも、喜ばしいこ: Well, just finding out Masa and the gang@are doing fine makes me happy~
LDBI\t「そちらの方はどうなの？」: How are things on your end?
LDBI\t「何とか落ち着きを取り戻しつつあるよ。@ それで、本題なんだが……お: Things are finally starting to settle down.@So, down to business... I called you guys@'cause there's something I wanna ask.
LDBI\t「実は……ルオゾール達を見掛けなくなってね。@ あなた達が<ラ・ギア: The thing is... we haven't seen any sign of@Luozorl and his lot. They were pretty active@when you were in <ラ・ギアス>, but lately, nothing.
LDBI\t「それはそれで、いいことなんじゃねえの？」: Isn't that a good thing, though?
LDBI\t「そうなんだけど、かえって不気味なのよね」: It is, but that makes it even creepier.
LDBI\t「確かに……戦後の混乱期は@ 彼らにとって好都合のはず……」: True... The postwar chaos should@play right into their hands...
LDBI\t「シュウも相変わらず行方知れずだ。@ で、もしかしたら、地上にいるん: Shu's still missing, too.@So I figured, maybe he's up on the surface.

LDBI\t「念のため、ギリアム少佐にも聞いておくよ」: Just in case, I'll ask Major Gilliam, too.
LDBI\t「すまねえ。@ それと……もうしばらくしたら、@ 俺は地上に行って、: Thanks.@Also... in a little while,@I'm gonna head up to the surface and join you.

LDBI\t「お前らが大変な目に遭ってるってのに、@ 放っておけねえだろ。こっち: You guys are in a real bind--I can't just@leave you hanging. I'll leave things here to@Lüne, Yang Long and the others.

LDBI\t「ああ。お前達が向かってる場所のデータを@ 後で送っといてくれ」: Yeah. Send me the data on where you're@headed later.
LDBI\t「わかったけど、迷子にならないでね。@ ……って、言うだけ無駄でしょ: Okay, but don't get lost, huh?@...Not that saying it'll do any good.
LDBI\t「来ちゃ駄目だ、リム。@ 僕は……ここに来る前から、こうするつもりだ: Don't come, Rim.@I meant to do this... even before I came here.
LDBI\t「内緒にしていて、すまない。@ でも、言えば、君は僕を止めるだろうか: I'm sorry I kept it from you.@But if I'd told you, you'd have stopped me...
LDBI\t「“破滅の王”の力を受け、@ アートルム・エクステリオルの片極を@: As one who received the King of Ruin's power@and served as one pole of Atrum Exterior,@I can seal the Cross Gate as it is now...
LDBI\t「駄目だ、リム。@ そして、ジョッシュ、ラキ……君達も。@ これは、: No, Rim.@And Josh, Laki... you too.@This is my duty.
LDBI\t「悲しまないで。僕は君に感謝している……@ 束の間だったけど、君は僕: Don't be sad. I'm grateful to you...@It was only for a short while, but you gave me@new life and taught me what it means to live.
LDBI\t「だから、僕は君に……君達に恩返しがしたい。@ そして、これからも生: So I want to repay you... all of you.@And I want you to keep on living.
LDBI\t「い、言ったでしょ……！@ ウェン、あなたも一緒だって……！」: I-I told you, didn't I...!@You're coming with us too, Ven...!
LDBI\t「君達がここで死んでしまったら、何の意味もない……@ 彼女も……クリ: If you all die here, it'll all be for nothing...@She... Chris says so too...

LDBI\t「シュンパティアによって植え付けられた、@ メリオルエッセのなり損な: I'm just a failed Meliores Esse@planted in you by the Sympathia!

LDBI\t「私がいなくなっても、リアナがいれば……@ クリアーナ・リムスカヤは: Even if I'm gone, as long as you're here...@Clearna Rimskaya can go on living...
LDBI\t「それは、私も生きてるってことなんだよ……」: And that means I'm alive too...
LDBI\t「悲しまないで……リアナの傍にお兄ちゃんや@ グラキエースがいるよう: Don't be sad... Just as you have Big Brother@and Glacies by your side, Riana...
LDBI\t「私の傍にはウェントスがいてくれるから……」: I'll have Ventus by my side...
LDBI\t「ラキ……僕の分も生きてくれ……彼らと共に……」: Laki... Live for me too... alongside them...

LDBI\t「待って、クリス！ @ 嫌よ！！ クリスがいなくなるなんて！！」: Wait, Chris!@No!! I don't want you to go!!

LDBI\t「各機に伝達！ @ メリオルエッセに攻撃を集中させろ！」: To all units!@Concentrate fire on the Meliores Esse!
