BMD\t「あんな化け物が神だなんて……/ 僕は認めないっ！ 絶対に！」: Calling a monster like that a god.../　I won't accept it! Not ever!
BMD\t「くっ……この圧倒的なプラーナ……/ これが魔装機神グランヴェール……: Ngh... This overwhelming prana.../　So this is the Masoukishin Granveil...
BMD\t「相手はグランヴェール……/ 生半な方法で勝てる相手じゃない。/ なら: It's Granveil.../　I can't beat it with half measures./　Then I'll strike first!
BMD\t「あなたの理屈を/ 一方的に押し付けられたって！」: You can't just force your logic/　on everyone else!
BMD\t「あなたのやることは、加護なんかじゃない……/ 呪縛ですよ！」: What you offer isn't a blessing.../　It's a curse that binds us!
BMD\t「自分の妄想に、/ 世界と僕達を巻き込まないで下さい！」: Don't drag the world and us/　into your delusions!
BMD\t「お礼はするよっ！！」: I'll pay you back for that!!
BMD\t「そうそう好きにはさせないっ！」: I won't let you have your way so easily!
BMD\t「ぐあっ！？ ま、まずい！ 出力低下！」: Gah?! Th-this is bad! Output dropping!
BMD\t「ぐうぅっ！！/ ガルガードがここまで押されるなんて……」: Grrgh!!/　The Galguard, pushed back this far...?
BMD\t「と、父さん……/ 何で……何でここまでしてっ！」: F-Father.../　Why... Why go this far?!
BMD\t「う、嘘だろ！？/ 何でブローウェルにここまでやられるんだ！？」: N-no way?!/　How is a Blowell doing this much to me?!
BMD\t「だ、駄目だ！/ グランヴェールが相手じゃ、もうもたない……」: I-it's no good!/　Against Granveil, I can't hold out...
BMD\t「くっ！ このくらいでっ！」: Ngh! Not from something like this!
BMD\t「まだいけるな、ガルガード！」: We can still keep going, Galguard!
BMD\t「くっ……父さん！ 本気なんだね……」: Ngh... Father! You're serious about this...
BMD\t「くっ、デュラクシールの力、想像以上だ……/ けど、まだ！」: Ngh, Duraxyll's power.../　It's beyond anything I imagined.../　But I'm not done yet!
BMD\t「ブローウェルのパワーとは思えないな、/ これは……！」: I can't believe this is/　a Blowell's power...!
BMD\t「やるっ！/ 破壊神って言われるだけのことはある！」: Impressive!/　It's earned the name Destruction God!
BMD\t「うっ、これがソルガディの力か……/ でも、まだいける！」: Ugh, so this is Solgady's power.../　But I can still fight!
BMD\t「グランヴェールにやられてこの程度なんて……/ 運がいいってことか」: Granveil hit me, and only this much.../　I guess I got lucky.
LDBI\t「そのコード“エビル”はピンポイントで@ イングを狙ってきました……: Code "Evil" targeted Ing specifically...@It must have something to do with his past.
LDBI\t「もしかしたら、@ あれもガイアセイバーズの機体なのかしら……？」: Maybe that's a Gaia Savers unit too...?
LDBI\t「アリエイルは見覚えがないと言っていたけど……@ コード“エビル”が: Arieil said she didn't recognize it, but...@if Code "Evil" came here chasing Ing,@I think that's very likely.
LDBI\t「何にせよ、イングの記憶が戻らなかった以上、@ 手掛かりとなるのはア: Either way, with Ing's memory still gone,@our only lead is Arieil...
LDBI\t「イングのデータが存在していなかった？」: There was no data on Ing?
LDBI\t「あると思いますが、彼が脱走した理由を含めて、@ 詳細は不明です」: I believe so, but the details are unknown,@including why he deserted.
LDBI\t「ふむ……。@ ならば、ガイアセイバーズでは念動力者の@ 育成や訓練: Hmm...@Then were the Gaia Savers developing and@training telekinetics?
LDBI\t「いえ、私が知る限りでは。@ ただし、人造人間の研究は行われていまし: Not that I know of.@But they were researching artificial humans.
LDBI\t「それは、プロジェクト・イデアランツ……@ 私はそこで造り出された人: It was called Project Idealants...@I'm an artificial human created there.
LDBI\t「ふむ……見た目ではそうだとわからんな」: Hmm... I'd never have guessed by looking.
LDBI\t「機械ベースではなく、@ ハイブリッド・ヒューマンに近いのです」: I'm not machine-based.@I'm closer to a hybrid human.
LDBI\t「構成物質は人間のそれとだいたい同じですが、@ 各機能が強化されてい: My makeup is mostly the same as a human's,@but all my functions are enhanced.
LDBI\t「まあ、色々と訳ありでね。@ 知り合いの人造人間は、他にもいるわよ」: Well, it's complicated.@We know other artificial humans, too.
LDBI\t（それで、私が正体を明かしても@ さほど驚かなかったのね……）: (So that's why they weren't that surprised@when I revealed what I am...)
LDBI\t「アリエイル……君は戦闘用の人造人間なのか？」: Arieil... Were you built for combat?
LDBI\t「本来は違います。@ イデアラントは支配階級となるべく生み出された@: Not originally.@Idealants were made as a superior breed meant@to rule... Duban and I are test subjects.
LDBI\t「支配階級って……@ あんた達が人間を支配するってこと？」: Ruling class...?@You mean you'd rule over humans?
LDBI\t「プロジェクトの最終目的はそうでした。@ 人間の不確定要素を可能な限: That was the project's goal: to minimize human@unpredictability and create an ideal race for@perfect governance and crisis management...
LDBI\t「ですが、私達試験体はその過程の一つに過ぎず……@ 生みの親であるエ: But we test subjects were merely one step...@With our creator, Dr. Enji Ozunu, now dead,@the plan has all but collapsed.
LDBI\t「だが、ガイアセイバーズは@ そのオヅヌ博士の目的に着目し、@ 研究: But didn't the Gaia Savers take an interest@in Dr. Ozunu's goals and fund his research?
LDBI\t「はい……彼らが必要としていたのは、@ 優れた戦闘能力を持つ人造人間: Yes... What they needed were Idealants@as artificial humans with superior@combat abilities...
LDBI\t「ただし、それはオヅヌ博士が目指していたものでは@ ありませんでした: However, that was not what Dr. Ozunu@was aiming for.
LDBI\t（淡々と話すのだな……@ それもイデアラントである所以か？）: (She speaks so matter-of-factly...@Is that also because she's an Idealant?)
LDBI\t「アリエイル……君がガイアセイバーズから脱走してまで@ 伝えようとし: Arieil... You fled the Gaia Savers to tell us@the truth. There's more to it, isn't there?
LDBI\t「ええ……私の機体やドゥバンのアレス・ガイスト……@ その動力源であ: Yes... My unit and Duban's Ares Geist...@Their power source, the Fau Kern... is@the core of a Jetzt.
LDBI\t「イェッツトって、あの<アインスト>もどきの！？」: Jetzt? You mean those <アインスト> knockoffs!?
LDBI\t「はい。@ あれのコアを機動兵器の動力源として利用したのです」: Yes.@They used their cores to power mobile weapons.
LDBI\t「何とまあ、大それたことを……」: My word, what an audacious thing to do...
LDBI\t「そ、それって、物凄く危なくない！？@ ライン・ヴァイスリッターなら: W-Wait, isn't that super dangerous!?@Rein Weissritter is one thing, but can you@really control a Jetzt core!?
LDBI\t「フリッケライ・ガイストのファウ・ケルンは@ 欠陥品であるため、ジェ: Flickerei Geist's Fau Kern is defective, so it@seems it can only be used as a generator.
LDBI\t「しかし、ドゥバンのアレス・ガイストは@ コアだけでなく、イェッツト: But Duban's Ares Geist incorporates not only@the core, but also the Jetzt's organic parts.
LDBI\t「アインストでありながら性質が変貌し、@ 人間の手で制御可能なライン: So it's nothing like Rein Weissritter, then--@an Einst whose nature changed until it could@be controlled by human hands.
LDBI\t「最悪の場合は、アレス・ガイストが@ イェッツトそのものになってしま: So at worst, the Ares Geist runs the risk of@becoming a Jetzt itself...
LDBI\t「アレス・ガイストを開発したのも、@ プロジェクト・イデアランツなの: Was the Ares Geist developed by@Project Idealants too?
LDBI\t「表向きにはそうですが……@ ツェントル・プロジェクトの関与があった: Officially, yes... But I suspect@the Tsentr Project was involved.
LDBI\t「ということは……あのプロジェクトは@ ガイアセイバーズの管理下にあ: Which means... that project is under@the Gaia Savers' control.
LDBI\t「あの二人……ヒューゴとアクアだったか、@ 彼らはそのことを知ってい: Those two... Hugo and Aqua, was it?@Do they know about this?
LDBI\t「そうだとしたら、何らかの報告があって@ 然るべきだが……ガイアセイ: If they did, they should have reported it...@That's one more suspicious thing about@the Gaia Savers.
LDBI\t「それと関連性があるかどうかわからんが……@ この映像を見てくれ」: I don't know if this is related, but...@take a look at this footage.
LDBI\t「あ、これって……こないだテスラ研に現れて、@ ゲストと戦ってた機体: Oh, that's... the unit that showed up at@Tesla Labs the other day and fought the Guests.
LDBI\t「ラ・ギアスから地上へ戻って来ていたのか……」: So they'd returned to the surface@from La Gias...
LDBI\t「うん……あたし達に何度かちょっかいを@ 出して来た連中だよ」: Yeah... They're a bunch who've messed@with us a few times.
LDBI\t「ジンライ、ケルベリオン、コード“エビル”……@ それらがガイアセイ: Jinrai, Cerberion, Code "Evil"... If those@are all tied to the Gaia Savers...
LDBI\t「我らと敵対する意思あり、ということか」: Then they mean to oppose us.
LDBI\t「そう言い切れるかどうか、まだわからんがな。@ ……アリエイル、君は: We can't say that for certain yet.@...Arieil, what do you plan to do now?
LDBI\t「ガイアセイバーズには他にも疑わしい点があると@ 思います。私の目的: I believe there are other suspicious things@about the Gaia Savers. My goal is... to expose@them before it's too late.
LDBI\t「承知した。@ カーラ、他のメンバーを招集してくれないか」: Understood.@Carla, would you gather the other members?
LDBI\t「現在、鋼龍戦隊はヒッカム基地に@ 滞在しているそうだ。私はアリエイ: I hear the Steel Dragons are currently@at Hickam Base. I'll take Arieil with@Ryoto and the others to the waters off Hawaii.
LDBI\t「そこでギリアムと落ち合い、@ 重要参考人として彼女の身柄を委ねるつ: There, I'll meet Gilliam and hand her over@to him as a key witness.
LDBI\t「いや、クロガネはテスラ研近辺で待機させておく。@ クスハと龍人機が: No, the Kurogane will stand by near Tesla Labs.@Even after Kusuha and the RyuJinKi leave,@the Yokijin may still attack.
LDBI\t「二度あることは三度あるって言うし……@ あのククルって女が、また来: Things come in threes, they say...@That Kukuru woman might come back again.
BMD\t「やるしかない……なら！」: If I have to do it... then fine!
BMD\t「甘く見てると後悔するわよ！」: Underestimate me and you'll regret it!
BMD\t「この距離なら、行けるわ！」: At this range, I can make it!
BMD\t「ブランシュネージュなら、やれるわ！」: With Blanche Neige, I can do it!
BMD\t「頼むわね、ブランシュネージュ！」: I'm counting on you, Blanche Neige!
BMD\t「大丈夫、任せて！」: It's fine, leave it to me!
BMD\t「わかってるわよ！ ここはやってみせる！」: I know! I'll pull this off!
BMD\t「ちょっと黙ってて！」: Just be quiet for a sec!
BMD\t「濡れ衣を着せられたままで終わりはしないわ！」: I won't let this end with me framed!
BMD\t「こっちにも言い分があるのよ！」: We've got our side of the story too!
BMD\t「あんた達、いい加減にしなさいよ！」: You people, knock it off already!
BMD\t「あんた達の踏み台なんかにならないから！」: I'm not gonna be your stepping stone!
BMD\t「アレス・ガイストよりこっちの方が速いはず！」: We should be faster than the Ares Geist!
BMD\t「ドゥバン、あんたを止めてみせる！」: Duban, I'm going to stop you!
BMD\t「アルテウル、あんたにこの子は渡さないわ！」: Arteur, you're not getting this girl!
BMD\t「ウェントス！/ それ以上喋るなら、あたしはあんたを……！」: Ventus!/　Say one more word, and I'll...!
BMD\t「駄目よ、クリス！ 引き込まれる！」: No, Chris! It's drawing us in!
BMD\t「クリス、あいつに気を取られないで！」: Chris, don't let him distract you!
BMD\t「何であんたとアニキが……！」: Why are you and my brother...!
BMD\t「この子は、/ アニキの機体ほど影響を受けていない……！」: This one isn't affected/　as much as my brother's unit...!
BMD\t「グラキエース、/ あたし達は太陽の光を取り戻す！」: Glacies,/　we're taking back the sunlight!
BMD\t「グラキエース、アニキに何かあったら……！」: Glacies, if anything happens to him...!
BMD\t「この感じ……ウェントスとは違う……！」: This feeling... It's not like Ventus...!
BMD\t「あんた達が破滅をもたらすと言うのなら！」: If you say you'll bring ruin...!
BMD\t「“破滅の王”の糧になんかならないわよ！」: I won't be food for the "King of Ruin"!
BMD\t「火傷する気なんてないから！」: I've got no plans to get burned!
BMD\t「クリス……あたしは戦うよ。/ 破滅を食い止めるために！」: Chris... I'm going to fight./　To hold back the ruin!
BMD\t「我が手に掛かって死ねることを/ 光栄に思いなされ」: To die by my hand--/　consider it an honor.
BMD\t「諦めなさい。/ あなたの前には、死への道しかありませぬ」: Give up./　Only the road to death lies before you.
BMD\t「ククク……/ 勇気と無謀は別物だと教えて差し上げましょう」: Heh heh heh.../　Allow me to teach you that courage/　and recklessness are not the same.
BMD\t「万物全てに平等なるは、これ、死のみ。/ 至高にして絶対の真理を、/: All things are equal only in death./　Allow me to bestow that supreme and/　absolute truth upon you as well.
BMD\t「あなたも、/ ヴォルクルス様の下へ送って差し上げましょう」: Allow me to send you, too,/　to Lord Volkruss.
BMD\t「喜びなさい。/ あなたもヴォルクルス様の下へ赴けるのですぞ」: Rejoice./　You too shall go unto Lord Volkruss.
BMD\t「死によってのみ、全ての生命は救われるのです。/ そう、あなたも……」: Only in death is all life saved./　Yes, even yours...
BMD\t「恐れることはありませんぞ。/ ヴォルクルス様は、あなたの様な下賤の者: There is nothing to fear./　Lord Volkruss will save even/　lowly ones such as you.
BMD\t「忌むべきランドールの名を持つ者よ、/ お前達がいくらあがこうとも、/: Bearer of the accursed name Randall,/　struggle as you might,/　you cannot change fate...
BMD\t「わざわざ倒されに来るとは……/ 酔狂なお方ですな、ランドール殿」: Coming all this way to be defeated.../　How eccentric of you, Randall.
BMD\t「くくく……/ お忘れですかな、ランドール殿。/ 我がナグツァートに攻: Heh heh heh.../　Have you forgotten, Randall?/　Attacks do not work on my Nagzadd.
BMD\t「ふふふ……テュッティ殿。/ いつぞやのような、/ エクトプラズム処理: Heh heh... Tytti./　That ectoplasm treatment of yours/　will not work a second time.
BMD\t「私と戦った所で益がないことなど、/ おわかりでしょう？ テュッティ殿: Surely you understand that nothing/　is gained by fighting me, Tytti?
BMD\t「迂闊に出てきたのが命取りになりましたな、/ テュッティ殿」: Showing yourself so carelessly/　will prove fatal, Tytti.
BMD\t「ふふふ……/ いくら攻撃力の高いグランヴェールでも、/ 我がアストラ: Heh heh.../　Even Granveil's great firepower/　cannot break my Astral Shift.
BMD\t「攻撃力さえ封じてしまえば、/ グランヴェールなど恐るるに足らず。/: Once its firepower is sealed,/　Granveil is nothing to fear./　Are you prepared, Yang Long?
BMD\t「迂闊でしたな、ヤンロン殿。/ 私の間合いに足を踏み入れるとは」: Careless of you, Yang Long,/　to set foot within my reach.
BMD\t「子供と言えど、/ ヴォルクルス様に逆らうのであれば、/ 死あるのみ」: Child or not, those who defy/　Lord Volkruss/　shall meet only death.
BMD\t「ザムジードが新たな操者を選びましたか。/ しかも、あのような小娘を…: So Zamzeed has chosen a new operator./　And a mere girl at that.../　Then I shall not let my guard down.
BMD\t「ふん、リカルドに比べれば、/ あのような小娘、御しやすい相手」: Hmph. Compared to Ricardo,/　that little girl is easily handled.
BMD\t「いくらザムジードとはいえ、/ 操者が素人では足取りも覚束なかろう」: Zamzeed or not, with an amateur/　at the controls, it will stumble.
BMD\t「そこまでして/ 人に似せる必要があるものなのか……/ 理解に苦しみま: Must one go to such lengths/　to make it look human?/　I fail to understand.
BMD\t「ヴァルシオーネ、でしたか。/ 興味深い技術を使っているようですが、/: Valsione, was it?/　It seems to use intriguing technology,/　but it is no match for my Nagzadd.
BMD\t「地上人のお手並み拝見といきましょうか」: Let us see what this surfacer can do.
BMD\t「地上のメカとは、/ 何故ああも奇妙なものが多いのか……/ 興味深いで: Why are surface machines/　so often so peculiar.../　How intriguing.
BMD\t「地上人の増大が、/ この世界の混乱に拍車をかける……/ ふふふ、よい: The surfacers' growing numbers/　only fuel the chaos in this world.../　Heh heh, a fine trend indeed.
BMD\t「私に歯向かおうとは……身の程知らずな」: To defy me... You know not your place.
BMD\t「そのまま帰すとお思いか？」: You think I will let you simply leave?
BMD\t「何もお返しせずに帰すのは、/ 失礼に当たりましょう」: It would be rude to send you off/　without a parting gift.
BMD\t「倍にして返して差し上げましょう」: Allow me to repay you twice over.
BMD\t「こ、これは何としたこと……」: Wh-what is the meaning of this...
BMD\t「ぐうぅっ！ な……何としたことか……」: Gnngh! Wh-what is the meaning of this...
BMD\t「こっ……これはっ……/ こんなことがあってはならぬ！」: Th... This...!/　This cannot be allowed to happen!
BMD\t「ぐうっ、ランドール・ザン・ゼノサキス/ ……やはり捨て置けぬ」: Ngh... Randall Zan Zenosakis/　...I truly cannot ignore you.
BMD\t「な、何と……/ ガッデスにまだこれほどの力があったとは……」: Wh-what...?/　Gaddess still has this much power...?
BMD\t「ぐううっ！！/ さ、さすがと言わねばなりますまい……/ グランヴェー: Gnnngh!!/　I-I must admit it is impressive.../　Granveil's power is formidable indeed.
BMD\t「こ、これは何としたことか……/ このような小娘に……」: Wh-what is the meaning of this.../　Bested by a mere girl...
BMD\t「ぬうう……/ ヴァルシオーネ、と言いましたかな？/ お、覚えておきま: Nnngh.../　Valsione, was it?/　I-I shall remember that name...
BMD\t「ち、地上人に/ ここまで追い込まれるとは……！！」: To be cornered like this/　by a surfacer...!!
BMD\t「地上のメカに/ このナグツァートが押されるなどと……！」: That my Nagzadd should be pushed back/　by a surface machine...!
BMD\t「なかなか……/ しかし、詰めが甘いですな」: Not bad.../　But your finish is lacking.
BMD\t「ふむ……/ まだこの程度なら問題はないでしょう」: Hmm.../　This much is still no problem.
BMD\t「なるほど……そういう手もあるのですな。/ よろしい、そろそろ本気を出: I see... So there is that approach./　Very well, I shall get serious.
BMD\t「ほほう……/ こちらの予想より力を付けておられる」: Oho.../　You have grown stronger than I expected.
BMD\t「ククク……なかなかの攻撃ですな。/ ですが、まだまだ力不足……」: Heh heh heh... A fine attack./　But still far too weak...
BMD\t「ほう……/ まさか、ここまでやるとは。/ いや、お見事です、ランドー: Oh?/　I never thought you'd go this far./　Splendid work, Randall.
BMD\t「なるほど、/ さすがは力が売りのグランヴェール……/ なかなかですな: I see.../　As expected of mighty Granveil.../　Quite impressive.
LDBI\t「あいつら、プレシアを捕まえて@ どうする気なのよ……！？」: What are they planning to do@with Precia...!?
LDBI\t「ご、ごめんなさい……。@ あたしが上手く逃げられなかったせいで……: I-I'm sorry...@It's all because I couldn't get away...
LDBI\t「ふふふ……@ 貴様達の怯え、焦り、戸惑いを感じるぞ」: Heh heh heh...@I sense your fear, your panic, your confusion.
LDBI\t「人間よ、我らルイーナに恐怖せよ。@ そして、負の波動を放て」: Humans, fear us, the Ruina.@And give off your negative waves.
LDBI\t「こ、怖くなんかないもん！@ あ、あたしだって魔装機の操者なんだから: I-I'm not scared of you!@I-I'm a Masoukishin pilot too, you know!
LDBI\t「その感情の裏に隠された畏怖の念が、@ 我らにとってこの上ない美酒と: The dread hidden behind that emotion@is the finest of wines to us.
LDBI\t「貴様はここで殺さぬ。@ 我が王の下へ連れ帰るとしよう」: You will not die here.@I shall take you back to my king.
LDBI\t「貴様の波動が他の者と少し違うからだ。@ 興味深い」: Your waves are a bit different from the rest.@How intriguing.
LDBI\t「多勢に無勢……！@ どうやってプレシアを助けます！？」: We're badly outnumbered...!@How are we going to rescue Precia!?
LDBI\t「サイコブラスターで雑魚を一気に片づける！@ その後、あたしが指揮官: My Psychoblaster will wipe out the grunts!@Then I'll hold off their commander's unit,@and you go rescue Precia!
LDBI\t「い、いえ、いいんです。@ リューネさんと一緒なら、僕は……。@ 出: N-No, it's fine.@As long as I'm with you, Lüne, I...@I'd like it to stay that way, if I could...
LDBI\t「プレシア、待ってて！ 必ず助けるから！」: Hang on, Precia! We'll save you, I promise!
LDBI\t（……さっきの、聞こえてなかったよな）: (...She didn't hear that just now, did she?)
LDBI\t「さあ、あがくがいい。@ そして、今、貴様らが抱いている微かな希望は: Go on, struggle.@And the faint hope you cling to now@will turn into despair.
LDBI\t「どこのどいつだか知らないけど、@ あんた達に生まれ変わったヴァルシ: I don't know who the hell you are,@but I'll show you the power of@the reborn Valsione!
LDBI\t「まだ動いていない敵がいます。@ こっちをいたぶるつもりなんでしょう: Some of the enemies haven't moved yet.@Are they planning to toy with us...!?
LDBI\t「だったら、プレシアを助け出すチャンスが@ あるってこと！ 諦めちゃ: Then that means we've still got a chance@to rescue Precia! Don't give up, Zash!
LDBI\t「マサキ！ それに、鋼龍戦隊のみんなも！」: Masaki! And the rest of the Steel Dragons too!
LDBI\t「ディアブロとガルガード……@ プレシアとザッシュさんなの！？」: The Diablo and the Galguard...@Is that Precia and Zash!?
LDBI\t「どうして、あの子達がこんな所に……！？」: What are those two doing out here...!?
LDBI\t「やい、リューネ！ @ こりゃいったいどういうことだ！？」: Hey, Lüne!@What the hell is going on here!?
LDBI\t「そんなことより、@ プレシアちゃんを助けなきゃ、まずいんじゃない？: Forget that for now--@won't it be bad if we don't rescue Precia?
LDBI\t「わかってるよ！@ リューネ、後できっちり説明してもらうからな！」: I know that!@Lüne, you're explaining all of this later!
LDBI\t「あいつら、あの機体を連れ去る気か！」: They're trying to carry off that unit!
LDBI\t「シュンパティアにノイズが走っている……！@ なら、聞こえるはずだ、: There's noise on the Sympathia...!@Then you can hear me, Aquila!@What are you going to do with that unit!?
LDBI\t「人間よ、お前がそれを知る必要はない。@ 知ったところで、何も出来ぬ: Human, you have no need to know.@Even if you did, you could do nothing.
LDBI\t「いや、その子を助けることは出来る！」: Wrong. I can still save that girl!
LDBI\t「貴様とそのマシーンの存在は、@ 我らルイーナにとって目障りだ。消滅: You and that machine of yours are@an eyesore to us Ruina. You will be erased.
LDBI\t「プレシア、すぐに行くからな！ もう少しの辛抱だ！」: Precia, I'm coming right now!@Just hang on a little longer!
LDBI\t「各機、攻撃開始！@ マサキの妹の救出を最優先で行え！」: All units, commence attack!@Rescuing Masaki's sister is top priority!
LDBI\t「プレシア、お前は下がれ！ @ 無理をするんじゃねえぞ、いいな！」: Precia, fall back!@And don't do anything reckless, got it!?
LDBI\t「う、うん。心配かけてごめんね、お兄ちゃん」: O-Okay. Sorry for worrying you, big brother.
LDBI\t「……以前より力が増しているな。@ だが、貴様達は着実に破滅へ進んで: ...You've grown stronger than before.@But you are steadily marching toward ruin...@The promised day is nearly upon you.
LDBI\t「負け惜しみを言うんじゃねえ、ハゲマッチョ！」: Save the sore-loser crap, you bald meathead!
LDBI\t「ふん……また会おう、人間共よ」: Hmph... We shall meet again, humans.
LDBI\t「メリオルエッセ機、戦域から離脱していきます！」: The Meliore Esse unit is leaving the area!
LDBI\t「その必要はありません。各機は残敵の掃討を！」: That won't be necessary.@All units, mop up the remaining enemies!
LDBI\t「全周警戒を厳となせ。@ 各機収容後、トーチカ８へ向かいます」: Maintain full-perimeter alert.@After recovery, we proceed to Tochka 8.
LDBI\t「あんた達が何者だろうと、@ このヴァルシオーネＲを止めることは@: I don't care who you are,@there's no way you're stopping@this Valsione R!
LDBI\t「ふふふ、@ 糧となるものは強ければ強いほどいいのだ」: Heh heh heh...@The stronger the sustenance, the better.
LDBI\t「リューネさんの足手まといになるわけにはいかない！@ お前が何者だろ: I can't let myself be a burden to Lüne!@Whoever you are, I'm giving this everything!
LDBI\t「ふん、恐怖を押しのけたところで、結果は同じだ」: Hmph. Push aside your fear all you like--@the outcome will be the same.
LDBI\t「あたしの波動が違うって、どういうことなの！？」: What do you mean my waves are different!?
LDBI\t「理由など知らぬ。@ 俺はただそう感じ、興味を持っただけだ」: I know not why.@I simply sensed it, and grew curious.
LDBI\t「滅びよ、人間。そのマシーンと共に」: Perish, human. Along with that machine.
LDBI\t「エール・シュヴァリアーが目障りだと言うんなら、@ こいつでお前達を: If the Aile Chevalier's such an eyesore to you,@then I'll use it to back you into a corner!
LDBI\t「諸君……知っての通り、鋼龍戦隊のハガネが@ このグランド・クリスマ: Gentlemen... As you know, the Steel Dragons'@Hagane is headed here to Grand Christmas.
LDBI\t「彼らは過去の大戦で功績を挙げた強者だが……@ あろうことか反連邦勢: They distinguished themselves in past wars...@but they've sided with anti-Federation forces,@rebelled against us, and killed the President.
LDBI\t「地球連邦軍との協議により、@ ハガネはその身柄を我らに差し出すべく: Per an agreement with the Earth Federation Army,@the Hagane is supposedly coming here@to surrender itself to us...
LDBI\t「その背後にはシュウ・シラカワが流布した@ 虚偽の映像を信じ、我らに: But behind them are those who believe the false@footage Shu Shirakawa spread and suspect us...
LDBI\t「ガイアセイバーズを疎むギャスパル・ギラン元帥の@ 思惑が見え隠れし: ...and the schemes of Marshal Gaspar Gillain,@who resents the Gaia Savers.
LDBI\t「おそらく、ハガネはこちらの出頭命令に応じると@ 見せかけ、可能な限: The Hagane will likely pretend to comply with@our summons, get as close as they can, and@try to probe our intentions.
LDBI\t「だが、戦うべき相手をはき違えた彼らを@ 看過するわけにはいかぬ」: But we cannot overlook those who have mistaken@who their true enemy is.
LDBI\t「このグランド・クリスマスへ誘き寄せ、@ その戦力を接収し、我らが外: We will lure them here to Grand Christmas,@seize their forces, and put them to good use@in our fight against the alien enemies.
LDBI\t「なお、彼らがこちらの命令に応じぬ場合は@ 攻撃を許可する。多少の損: Should they refuse our orders, you are cleared@to attack. Some damage is unavoidable, but...
LDBI\t「リ・テクとメリオルエッセの機体は@ 極力無傷でろ獲せよ。以上だ」: Capture the Re-Tech and Meliorhesse units@as intact as possible. That is all.
LDBI\t（……あの連中が接収命令に応じようが、@ イングやゼンガー達は僕の手: (Whether they accept the seizure order or not,@I'll kill Ing and Sänger and the rest myself.)
LDBI\t（大人しく首を差し出されても、斬り甲斐がないわ）: (If they just hand over their necks, there's no@joy in the cut.)
LDBI\t（直接対決せずとも、鋼龍戦隊の戦力を@ 接収する方法はある……しかも: (We could seize the Steel Dragons' forces@without a direct clash... and more reliably...)
LDBI\t（あの時もそうだ……@ アルテウル司令は彼らを追い込んでおきながら、: (It was the same that time...@Commander Arteur had them cornered, and then@all but let them escape...)
LDBI\t（その後も逐次戦力を送り込み、@ 決定打を打とうとしなかった……）: (And after that, he sent in forces piecemeal@and never tried to land a decisive blow...)
LDBI\t（司令には、何か他の意図があるのか……？）: (Does the commander have some other motive...?)
LDBI\t「その件については、却下したはずだ」: I believe I already rejected that proposal.
LDBI\t「ですが、鋼龍戦隊との決戦でＭＯＤＥＬ‐Ｘは@ 必要です。そして、そ: But MODEL-X is essential against the Steel@Dragons. And no one can draw out its power@better than my AI1.
LDBI\t「では、どうするのです？@ ドゥバン・オーグは逐電したのですよ？」: Then what will you do?@Duvan Ogg has run off, you know.
LDBI\t「私の子以上に優れた者なのですか？@ この機会にＭＯＤＥＬ‐Ｘの実力: Are they superior to my child?@If we don't show what MODEL-X can do now,@the Tsentr Project will...
LDBI\t「この際だ、はっきり言っておこう。@ これ以上、君の歪んだ愛情に付き: Let me make this perfectly clear.@I have no intention of indulging your twisted@love any further.
LDBI\t「ＡＩ１は危険だ。@ 何度でも言うが、あれをＭＯＤＥＬ‐Ｘに@ 搭載: AI1 is dangerous.@I'll say it as many times as it takes: I have no@intention of installing it in MODEL-X.
LDBI\t「私のＴＥアブゾーバーにあのような物は@ 不要なのだよ」: My TE Absorber has no need@for a thing like that.
LDBI\t「エ、エルデ！ 正気か！？」: E-Erde! Have you lost your mind?!
LDBI\t「こ、ここで私を殺せば、君もただでは済まんぞ！」: I-If you kill me here, you'll pay for it too!
LDBI\t「わ……わかった！ 君の言う通りにしよう！@ だから、命だけは……」: A-All right! I'll do as you say!@So please, spare my life...
LDBI\t「へえ……案外、素直にやって来たね」: Huh... They came quietly after all.
LDBI\t「まさか、あいつら……このまま降伏する気か？」: Don't tell me they're just gonna surrender?
LDBI\t「馬鹿言え、それじゃ手柄が立てられねえよ」: Are you nuts? Then we won't get any credit!
LDBI\t「心配はいらん。@ 連中は、腹の中に刃を呑んでいる」: No need to worry.@They're hiding a blade in their bellies.
LDBI\t「だったら、嬉しいね。@ こないだの借りをここで返してやる。@ つい: Then I'm happy.@I'll pay them back for last time right here.@And I'll be done with that lot for good, too.
LDBI\t「よう、さっさと仕掛けようぜ。@ どうせ殺り合うことになるんならよ」: Hey, let's make our move already.@We're gonna end up fighting to the death anyway.
LDBI\t「焦るんじゃないよ。@ 今、誰かがハガネを沈めたら、手柄は@ そいつ: Don't get hasty.@If somebody sinks the Hagane now, they'll@take all the credit for themselves.
LDBI\t「貴様ら、黙して待て。獲物は多い方がいい」: Silence, and wait.@The more prey, the better.
LDBI\t「ほら、隊長がそう言ってんだ。@ 抜け駆けはなしだよ、シアン」: See? The boss has spoken.@No jumping the gun, Cyan.
LDBI\t「鋼龍戦隊に告ぐ。@ 私はガイアセイバーズ旗艦艦長、@ カーリー・ナ: Attention, Steel Dragons.@I am the captain of the Gaia Savers' flagship,@Colonel Curly Naumann.
LDBI\t「貴様らの度重なる反逆行為は許し難い。@ 直ちに武装解除し、所有する: Your repeated acts of treason are unforgivable.@Disarm immediately and surrender all of your@mobile weapons to us.
LDBI\t「なお、これはアルテウル・シュタインベック@ 特次副大統領の命令であ: This order comes from Special Vice President@Arteur Steinbeck.
LDBI\t「そちらの武装解除後、全員の身柄を拘束する。@ これに従わぬ場合は総: Once you have disarmed, all of you will be@taken into custody. Refuse, and we will launch@an all-out attack.
LDBI\t「……リー……いや、カーリー大佐。@ 一つ聞きたいことがある」: ...Lee... No, Colonel Curly.@There's one thing I want to ask you.
LDBI\t「貴様に質問を行う権利はない。命令に従え」: You have no right to ask questions.@Follow your orders.
LDBI\t「ガイアセイバーズは……@ アルテウル・シュタインベックは、@ 我々: What do the Gaia Savers... What does@Arteur Steinbeck intend to do@with us?
LDBI\t「それはすでに述べた。命令に従え」: I have already stated that. Follow your orders.
LDBI\t「グラスマン前大統領の件について、@ そちら側にも疑惑が生じ、連邦議: You must know that, regarding former President@Grasman, suspicion has fallen on your side too,@and the Federal Assembly has its doubts...
LDBI\t「例の流出映像のことか。あんなものに信憑性はない。@ それ以上、質問: That leaked footage? It has no credibility.@Ask one more question, and we will deem it@intent to rebel and open fire.
LDBI\t「我々に掛けられた嫌疑に関しては、@ 地球圏を覆う脅威を振り払った後: Regarding the charges against us, we wish to@answer them in the proper venue... once we've@repelled the threat facing the Earth Sphere.
LDBI\t「じゃあ、ますます忙しくなるわね、兄さん」: Then you'll be busier than ever, brother.
LDBI\t「ああ。私が国王になっても、ついてきてくれるか？@ ラングランだけで: Yes. Will you still follow me once I'm king?@Not just to bring order and peace to Langran,@but to all of La Gias.
LDBI\t「……その言葉に期待させてもらうよ、マサキ。@ これから私がやろうと: ...Hope I can count on that, Masaki.@What I'm about to undertake will require@your power and that of the Masoukishin.
LDBI\t「今までと同じく、私に協力してもらえるとありがたい。@ これは、次代: I'd be grateful for your continued help.@This isn't only a request from the next king--@it's my own earnest, personal wish.
LDBI\t「……どうしたんだ、今日は？ 妙に改まって」: ...What's with you today? You're awfully formal.
LDBI\t「それだけ私の決意が固いということさ。@ 以後は、相当の覚悟で事を進: It shows how firm my resolve is.@From here on, I must proceed prepared@for whatever it takes.
LDBI\t「兄さん……いったい、何をするつもりなの？」: Brother... what are you planning to do?
LDBI\t「まもなく、わかるよ。それと、デュラクシールを@ 動かせるようにして: You'll know soon enough. Also, get the Duraxyll@ready to move. I want to unveil it when the new@government is announced.
LDBI\t「でも、操者はどうするの？」: But who's going to pilot it?
LDBI\t「デュラクシールには、私が乗る」: I will pilot the Duraxyll myself.
LDBI\t「いけません。殿下は国王になられる身ですぞ。@ 軽率な行動は慎んでい: I must object. Your Highness is to be king.@I must ask that you refrain from rash behavior.
LDBI\t「わかっているが、人々の規範となるのが王だ。@ 私は、脅威に対して自: I know, but a king must be an example to his@people. I wish to be one who does not shrink@from facing threats himself.
LDBI\t「では、セニア……調整を頼む」: Then, Xenia... I leave the adjustments to you.
LDBI\t「……すぐに戦線へ出るわけじゃないわよね？」: ...You won't head straight to the front, right?
LDBI\t（……どうしたのかしら、兄さん……@ 気負って……いや、焦っているよ: (...What's gotten into him?@He seems so tense... no, he seems impatient...)
LDBI\t「……というわけで、みんなを地上へ送還するのは@ 戴冠式と政府の新体: ...So, sending you all back to the surface will@happen after the coronation and the new@government's announcement.
LDBI\t「それまで、@ ハガネには王都の警備を担当してもらいたいとさ」: Until then, he wants@the Hagane to handle security for the capital.
LDBI\t「私達、ようやく地上へ戻れるんですね……」: We're finally going back to the surface...
LDBI\t「マサキ、お前はラングランに残るんだよな？」: Masaki, you're staying in Langran, right?
LDBI\t「ああ、テュッティ達と一緒に@ フェイル殿下の手伝いをするつもりだ」: Yeah. I'm gonna help Prince Feil out@along with Tytti and the others.
LDBI\t「それじゃ、クロちゃんやシロちゃんと@ 会えなくなっちゃうんですね…: Then we won't be able to see Kuro and Shiro@anymore...
LDBI\t「また地上に行くことにニャるかも知れニャいし……@ 今生の別れってわ: We might go to the surface again, meow...@It's not like this is goodbye forever.
LDBI\t「艦長、王都内で大規模な爆発が！」: Captain, a massive explosion inside the capital!
LDBI\t「いえ、王都周辺に敵影は見当たりません！」: No, there are no enemies around the capital!
LDBI\t「艦長、セニア王女から通信が入っています！」: Captain, a transmission from Princess Xenia!
LDBI\t「テツヤ中佐、マサキ、大変よ！@ サイバスターのエーテル・スラスター: Commander Tetsuya, Masaki, we've got trouble!@A fragment of Volkruss was stuck to Cybuster's@Ether Thrusters!
LDBI\t「小さかったから、整備員も見落としてたのよ！@ それで、破片を引き剥: It was so small the mechanics missed it!@And the moment they pulled it off, it started@regenerating!
LDBI\t「じゃあ、さっきの爆発の原因は！？」: Then that explosion just now was...!?
LDBI\t「な、なら、王都の中にあの化け物が！？」: Th-Then that monster's inside the capital!?
LDBI\t「総員、第一種戦闘配置！@ 直ちに各機を出撃させろ！」: All hands, level one battle stations!@Launch all units at once!
LDBI\t「ええ。@ 事が起きたのは破片を除去した後だったから……」: Yes.@It happened after the fragment was removed...
LDBI\t「よし、すぐにそっちへ行く！ 俺も出るぜ！」: Right, I'm on my way! I'm sortieing too!
LDBI\t「再生したヴォルクルスって、@ １体だけじゃないの！？」: Wait, there's more than@one regenerated Volkruss!?
LDBI\t「分裂して、増殖したのよ。@ 早く倒さなきゃ、さらに数が増えるかも知: It split and multiplied.@Unless we beat them fast, there could be more.
LDBI\t「くそっ、俺のせいだ！@ 俺がヴォルクルスを始末できなかったから……: Dammit, this is my fault!@It's because I couldn't finish Volkruss off...!
LDBI\t「今、それを言っても始まらないわ。@ ここで確実に仕留めることを考え: Saying that now won't get us anywhere.@Focus on making sure we finish it here.
LDBI\t「フェイル殿下、トロイアへ派遣した部隊を@ 王都へ呼び戻しましょう」: Prince Feil, let us recall the forces@dispatched to Troia back to the capital.
LDBI\t「それは駄目だ。後々の作戦に支障が出る」: No. That would hinder our later operations.
LDBI\t「しかし、大事の前です。@ 王都がこれ以上の損害を被れば、@ 殿下の: But the great undertaking is at hand.@If the capital suffers any more damage,@Your Highness's plans will...
LDBI\t「今、王都に在留している戦力で@ ヴォルクルスの分身を撃退することに: There is meaning in repelling Volkruss's@Afterimages with the forces now in the capital.
LDBI\t「マサキ達の力を借りることにはなるが……@ 新たなラングランの力を国: We will have to borrow Masaki and the others'@strength... but it will be a chance to show@the new Langran's power at home and abroad.
LDBI\t「まさか、殿下！ デュラクシールでご出陣を！？」: Surely not, Your Highness! You mean to sortie@in the Duraxyll!?
LDBI\t「ああ。先程も言った通り……@ 脅威に際しては、自ら立ち向かう王であ: Yes. As I said earlier...@I wish to be a king who faces threats himself.
LDBI\t「で、ですが、御身に万一のことがあれば！」: B-But if anything were to happen to you!
LDBI\t「ここで敗れるようであれば、@ 大事を成し遂げることなど出来ぬよ」: If I were to fall here,@I could never accomplish the great undertaking.
LDBI\t「殿下、私もお供致しますぞ」: Your Highness, I shall accompany you.
LDBI\t「いや、将軍は民の避難誘導と護衛を頼む。@ それと、くれぐれもザボド: No, General, I need you to guide and protect@the evacuating citizens. And take care that@no harm comes to Lord Zabod or the priests.
LDBI\t「彼らに何かあれば、戴冠式や地上人送還が@ ままならなくなる」: If anything happens to them, the coronation@and sending the surfacers home will be in doubt.
LDBI\t「レコンキスタ……聖地奪還ですか」: Reconquista... Retaking the holy land, is it?
LDBI\t「ああ。月奪還作戦の名として、相応しかろう？」: Yes. A fitting name for an operation to@retake the moon, wouldn't you say?
LDBI\t「わかりました。@ オペレーション・アルファの正式名称は@ いかが致: Understood.@And what shall we officially name@Operation Alpha?
LDBI\t「アイスブレイカーだ。@ 片方の名は、わかり易いものにしようと思って: Icebreaker.@I wanted one of the two names to be simple.@Besides, you prefer plain names, don't you?
LDBI\t「ええ。では、今後はアルファを@ オペレーション・アイスブレイカー、: Very well. From now on, Alpha will be called@Operation Icebreaker, and Bravo will be@Operation Reconquista.
LDBI\t「それでは、報告を聞こうか」: Now then, let's hear your report.
LDBI\t「現在、ゲストは散発的に地球への威力偵察を@ 行っておりますが……大: The Guests are currently making sporadic@probing attacks on Earth... but we haven't@observed any major movements.
LDBI\t「また、ルイーナは@ 南アメリカのみならず、アフリカ西南部や@ オー: In addition, the Ruina have appeared not only in@South America, but also in southwestern Africa,@Australia, and Oceania...

LDBI\t「我が大義を理解せぬ愚か者が！@ 容赦はせんぞ、ザシュフォード！」: You fool, blind to my great cause!@I'll show you no mercy, Zashford!
LDBI\t「地上人に我が大義を否定され、@ 妨害される謂われはない！」: Surfacers have no right to deny my cause@and stand in my way!
LDBI\t「その怒り……わからんでもない。@ だが、お前の野望こそが、おれ達を: ...I can't say I don't get your anger.@But your ambition is what dragged us into this.
LDBI\t「カークス！@ てめえもビアン・ゾルダークと同じ結末を@ 迎えること: Kirkus!@You're gonna end up just like Bian Zoldark!
LDBI\t「大義に殉ずる覚悟はある……@ だが、今はその時ではない！」: I am prepared to die for my cause...@but now is not that time!
LDBI\t「あなたの行動は、@ いたずらに戦火を広げるだけです！」: Your actions will only spread@the flames of war needlessly!
LDBI\t「今、この時はな……！@ だが、私はラ・ギアスの将来を見据えている！: For now, perhaps...!@But I am looking to the future of La Gias!@This era demands overwhelming power!
LDBI\t「超が付く魔装機ってのがどんなもんか、@ 見せてもらうぜ！」: So you're a Super Masouki, huh?@Let's see what you've got!
LDBI\t「このエウリード、@ 地上のマシンに後れは取らぬぞ！」: This Eulid will not fall behind@any surface machine!
LDBI\t「カークス将軍、あなたの野望もここまでです！」: General Kirkus, your ambitions end here!
LDBI\t「貴公も敵に回るか、ゲンナジー！@ 何故、誰も私の成果を評価せぬ！？: You turn against me too, Gennacy!?@Why will no one recognize what I've achieved!?
LDBI\t「急激な力の行使は、混乱を招くだけよ！」: Using force so abruptly will only cause chaos!
LDBI\t「それは一時のこと！ 悠長に時間を掛けて、@ 事態を収拾している場合: Only temporarily! We can't afford to take@our time bringing this under control!
LDBI\t「貴公らが麾下に加われば、ラ・ギアスの統一を@ いち早く成し遂げられ: If you all joined my command, La Gias could@be unified that much sooner...!
LDBI\t「あなたの大義は理解できます……！@ ですが、それを成就する方法に問: I understand your cause...!@But the way you're pursuing it is the problem!
LDBI\t「お前がラ・ギアスにもたらすものは、平穏に非ず！@ 邪神の力を借りよ: What you bring La Gias is not peace!@The moment you sought an evil god's power,@you lost any claim to justice!
LDBI\t「正義とは勝者が語るものよ！@ その大剣で我が大義を断てると思うな！: Justice is what the victor says it is!@Don't think that great sword can sever my cause!
BMD\t「こいつで叩き斬る！」: I'll cut you down with this!
BMD\t「多少無茶でも、これを使うしかないっ！！」: It's reckless, but I have no choice/　but to use this!!
BMD\t「こいつで撃ち抜いてやる！！」: I'll blast right through you with this!!
BMD\t「二の太刀があると思うなよ！」: Don't count on a second stroke!
BMD\t「その目でしかと見ろ！/ ジガンテ・ウンギア！！」: Behold it with your own eyes!/　Gigante Unghia!!
BMD\t「敵の動きを見切るんだ……！」: I have to read the enemy's movements...!
BMD\t「受けろ！ 獅子王の太刀を！」: Take this! The blade of the Shishioh!
LDBI\t「セニア姉さん、マサキ……@ 僕はクリストフと一緒に行く。@ もう決: Xenia, Masaki...@I'm going with Christoph.@I've made up my mind... Don't get in my way...!
LDBI\t「待て、テリウス！@ お前は王位継承権を放棄する気か！？」: Wait, Tellius!@Do you mean to give up your claim to the throne?!
LDBI\t「に、兄さん……兄さんでも@ 僕を止めることは出来ない……」: B-Brother... Not even you@can stop me...
LDBI\t「くっ！ まさか、あの男が邪魔に入るとは！」: Damn! I never thought that man would interfere!
LDBI\t「モニカ王女に続いて、テリウス殿下まで……！@ シュウめ、いったい何: First Princess Monica, and now Prince Tellius...!@Shu, what the hell are you up to?!
LDBI\t（クリストフ……あなた、テリウスに@ 何をさせるつもりなの……？）: (Christoph... What are you planning@to make Tellius do...?)
LDBI\t「……シュウと殿下を@ 追いかけた方がいいんじゃないか？」: ...Shouldn't we go after Shu@and the prince?
LDBI\t「それは……あの部隊がどう出てくるか次第ね」: That depends on what that unit does next.
LDBI\t「では、ラテル……どうするの？」: All right, Ratel... What will you do?
LDBI\t「仕方ありません。@ ありのままをカークス将軍に報告します」: There's no other choice.@I'll report to General Kirkus exactly what happened.
LDBI\t「確かに、捕らえるのが無理であれば、@ 暗殺せよとの命令が出ているが: True, we were ordered to assassinate him if@capture proved impossible... but I can't do it.
LDBI\t「ですが、それでは偽りのテリウス殿下を立てて@ 戴冠式を行ったことが: But then it'll come out that a fake Prince@Tellius was crowned, and General Kirkus's@reputation will be ruined!
LDBI\t「当たり前だ！ あいつは簒奪者だぞ！」: Damn right it is! He's a usurper!
LDBI\t「さ・ん・だ・つ・しゃ！@ 力で上の地位を奪う奴のことだ！」: U-SUR-PER!@Someone who grabs a higher position by force!
LDBI\t「あらん、マーサってば難しい言葉を知ってるのね」: Ooh, Masa, look at you knowing big words!
LDBI\t「それが悪いことだと言うのか、マサキ？@ 力のある者が、より正当な地: And you say that's wrong, Masaki?@Those with power seek a more rightful place.@I'd call that their natural right.
LDBI\t「今のラングランの状況を見て、物を言え！」: Take a look at Langran right now and then talk!
LDBI\t「……俺は戦争がどういうものか、@ 嫌というほど知っている。@ 地上: ...I know all too well what war is like.@Both on the surface and in this world.
LDBI\t「いいか？ 戦争が勃発してしまった以上、@ 一刻も早く終結させるのが: Listen. Once a war has broken out,@the best thing is to end it as soon as possible.@That's why I back whoever has the power.
LDBI\t「神の前では、一人の悪意などたかが知れている。@ それにカークスは、: Before God, one man's malice counts for little.@Besides, Kirkus isn't so bad a man.
LDBI\t「貴様らの推すフェイル王子とて、@ 俺から見れば善人とは思えん」: And this Prince Feil you all back@doesn't strike me as a good man either.
LDBI\t「あの男、何という無礼なことを！」: How dare that man say such a thing!
LDBI\t「見解の相違って奴だな、アハマド。@ それで、どうするつもりなんだ？: Guess we just see things differently, Ahmad.@So, what are you gonna do?
LDBI\t「貴様らにはここで死んでもらう。口封じだよ」: You all die here. To keep you quiet.
LDBI\t「てめえ、フェイル殿下を目の前にして@ それを言うか！」: You'd say that right in front of@Prince Feil?!
LDBI\t「フェイル王子がここにいるなら、尚更のこと@ 都合がいい。この一戦が: If Prince Feil is here, all the better.@This battle may be what ends the turmoil@in Langran.
LDBI\t「ああ。俺は、俺が信じた道を征く」: Yes. I walk the path I believe in.
LDBI\t「待って下さい、アハマド殿！@ 私が全責任を負います！ ですから、こ: Please wait, Ahmad!@I'll take full responsibility! So please, here...
LDBI\t「貴公が責任を取って死んだ所で、@ 事実が変わるわけではないのだ。@: Even if you die taking responsibility,@it won't change the facts. Bring Kirkus down@now, and war will break out all over again.
LDBI\t「いずれ事実が白日の下に晒されると言っても、@ 今というタイミングは: The truth may come to light someday, but@right now is the worst possible time. So...
LDBI\t「俺の邪魔をするなら、貴様らも斬る」: If you get in my way, I'll cut you down too.
LDBI\t「アクロス少佐、ライオネス少尉、@ アハマド殿の仰ることはもっともで: Major Akros, Lieutenant Lioness,@Ahmad is absolutely right...!
LDBI\t「大義はカークス将軍にあるのです！@ フェイル王子に付き従う魔装機神: Right is on General Kirkus's side!@Let us bring justice down upon the Masoukishin@pilot who serves Prince Feil, and the surface folk!
LDBI\t「ラシッド中尉の言う通りだ。@ 貴様らがカークスに従っている理由を思: Lieutenant Rashid is right.@Remember why you follow Kirkus.
LDBI\t「あいつ、部隊を連れて来てたのか！」: He brought a whole unit with him!
LDBI\t「……ここで我々が退いても、@ カークスは兵を差し向けてくるでしょう: ...Even if we withdraw now,@Kirkus will send his troops after us.
LDBI\t「テリウスの一件で、@ 彼は我が方との戦いを決意したはず。@ もはや: After what happened with Tellius,@he must have resolved to fight us.@An all-out clash can no longer be avoided...
BMD\t「あえて苦難の道を選ぶか。それも善哉」: You choose the path of hardship?/　That, too, is good.
BMD\t「さあて、どこまで耐えおるかのう」: Now then, how long will you endure?
BMD\t「生々流転の輪を回すとするかのう」: Let us turn the wheel of endless change.
BMD\t「いかなる意志も事象も、太極の内」: All will and events lie within the Taiji.
BMD\t「事に従うか、抗うか……/ お主らの思うままにするがよい」: Submit to fate, or defy it.../　Do as you see fit.
BMD\t「仙道に沿わぬか。それも善哉」: You stray from the sage's path?/　That, too, is good.
BMD\t「善き実が結べば、それで良いのじゃ」: So long as good fruit is borne, all is well.
BMD\t「無為自然、有為転変……いずれも然り」: Nonaction, ceaseless change.../　Both hold true.
BMD\t「参るぞ、青龍の操者よ」: Here I come, pilot of Seiryu.
BMD\t「強念者よ、意のままに戦うがよい」: Strong psychic, fight as you will.
BMD\t「参るぞ、白虎の操者よ」: Here I come, pilot of Byakko.
BMD\t「尸解をよしとせぬか。それも善哉」: You refuse to shed your mortal shell?/　That, too, is good.
BMD\t「お主らが真理に達するのであれば、/ それも善哉」: If you can reach the ultimate truth,/　that, too, is good.
BMD\t「ワシに抗うか、ククル。それも善哉」: You defy me, Kukuru? That, too, is good.
BMD\t「偽魂が人道を往く……それも善哉」: A false soul walking the path of man.../　That, too, is good.
BMD\t「偽魂も道を究めれば、真魂となろう」: Even a false soul, mastering the Way,/　may become a true soul.
BMD\t「青龍……我らの下に戻らぬか。それも善哉」: Seiryu... You won't return to us?/　That, too, is good.
BMD\t「白虎よ、そこがお主の在所か。それも善哉」: Byakko, is that where you belong?/　That, too, is good.
BMD\t「では、流れのままに」: Then, let us go with the flow.
BMD\t「魚心あれば水心」: Give and take, as they say.
BMD\t「人の身でここまでやるとはの！」: To think a mere human could do this much!
BMD\t「フハハハ！ まさになすがままじゃのう！」: Fuhahaha!/　Truly, whatever will be, will be!
BMD\t「これは刮眼せねばならんのう」: Now this calls for a closer look.
BMD\t「この泰北、油断したわい」: I, Taihoku, let my guard down.
BMD\t「玄武の守りを崩すとは……善哉、善哉」: To breach Genbu's defense.../　Splendid, splendid.
BMD\t「ふむう……/ 夏喃が目を付けただけのことはあるわ」: Hmm.../　No wonder Kanan took an interest in you.
BMD\t「白虎の操者よ、よい気迫じゃ」: Pilot of Byakko, you show fine Drive.
BMD\t「その力、人のために使うか。それも善哉」: You use that power for others?/　That, too, is good.
BMD\t「うむ！ 四神の力、しかと見た！」: Yes! I've seen the power of the Four Gods!
BMD\t「ほほう、多少は揺らいだのう」: Oho, that shook me a little.
BMD\t「お主の気と力、確かに受け止めた」: Your spirit and strength--/　I've received them in full.
BMD\t「事に従うも肝要じゃ」: Sometimes it's vital to go with the flow.
BMD\t「お主の血汗もやがては甘露となろうぞ」: Your blood and sweat will one day/　turn to sweet nectar.
BMD\t「これもまた、道を究めるための術なり」: This, too, is a means of mastering the Way.
BMD\t「ふむう……今しばらく様子を見るべきかのう」: Hmm... Perhaps I should watch a while/　longer.
BMD\t「それで良い、良いぞ、青龍の操者よ」: Yes, good, very good, pilot of Seiryu.
BMD\t「ふむ……/ 尸解すれば、天仙にまで至るかも知れんのう」: Hmm.../　Shed your shell, and you might become/　a celestial immortal.
BMD\t「あくまで人として力を使うか。それも善哉」: You'd wield your power purely as a human?/　That, too, is good.
BMD\t「これも四神の宿命よのう」: This, too, is the fate of the Four Gods.
BMD\t「もそっと気迫を込めい」: Put some more Drive into it.
BMD\t「ワシを倒す気か。それも善哉」: You'd defeat me? That, too, is good.
LDBI\t「善く戦う者は、これを勢に求めて人に責めず……@ そういうこともやり: A skilled warrior seeks victory in momentum,@not in his men... That kind of thing's@a lot easier that way.
LDBI\t「確かに……@ 自我を持たず、命令通りに動く兵であれば」: True... with soldiers who have no will of@their own and simply follow orders.
LDBI\t「以前から思っておりましたが、@ こちらの文化を良く研究しているよう: I've thought so for some time, but you seem to@have studied our culture quite thoroughly.
LDBI\t「異文明監査官だったからな。@ ゼゼーナンも下調べは念入りにやってい: I was an Alien Culture Inspector, you know.@Zezenan did his homework thoroughly too.@Mostly so he could start by negotiating.
LDBI\t「シュウ・シラカワが<南極事件>を起こさなければ、@ 今頃奴の計画は: If Shu Shirakawa hadn't caused the@<南極事件>, his plan would be further@along by now. We'd never have come to Earth.
LDBI\t「チッ、あいつが関わるとロクなことにならねえんだよ」: Tch. Nothing good ever happens when@that guy's involved.
LDBI\t「そうとは言い切れねえ。@ 現にゼゼーナンの失脚の原因を作ったのは、: Can't say that for sure. After all,@he's the one who set up Zezenan's fall.
LDBI\t「シュウのおかげだなんて、思いたくねえぜ！」: I don't wanna think we owe Shu for anything!
LDBI\t「……ともかく、ゼゼーナンが月の住民に@ 危害を加える可能性は低いと: ...In any case, we can assume Zezenan is@unlikely to harm the lunar residents?
LDBI\t「でも、彼が保身のためにロフを始末したのなら……@ 追い詰められた結: But if he got rid of Rof to protect himself...@then once cornered, he might do something rash.
LDBI\t「否定は出来ねえな。@ だから、速やかに事を進める必要がある」: Can't deny that. Which is why we need to@move fast.
LDBI\t（まあ、こいつを相手にして@ 地球人の人質を取っても意味はないだろう: (Well, against this guy, taking Earthling@hostages probably wouldn't mean a thing...)
LDBI\t「ここからは身内の揉め事だ。@ あんた達は戦闘に参加しなくていいぜ。: From here on, it's a family squabble.@You guys don't need to join the fight.@I know what's going on down on Earth too.
LDBI\t「ハンフリー司令と相談します。@ 各員は第２種戦闘配置のまま待機を」: I'll consult with Commander Humphrey.@All hands, remain at Level 2 battle stations.
LDBI\t「……異星人の話を鵜呑みにすることは出来んが、@ ここで我が方の戦力: ...I cannot take an alien's word at face value,@but if we can avoid depleting our forces here,@so much the better.
LDBI\t「だが、メキボス・ボルクェーデの監視は必要だ。@ 奴が掌を返す可能性: However, Mekibos Bolquede must be watched.@He may yet turn on us.
LDBI\t「そこで……我々鋼龍戦隊はメキボスと共に@ ムーンクレイドルへ降下し: That's why... the Steel Dragons intend to@descend on Moon Cradle together with Mekibos.
LDBI\t「何？ 異星人に手を貸すのか？」: What? You'd lend aid to an alien?
LDBI\t「ええ、後顧の憂いを速やかに断つために。@ また、ムーンクレイドルへ: Yes, to swiftly remove the threat at our backs.@We must also keep the damage to Moon Cradle@to a minimum.
LDBI\t「火中の栗を拾うと言うのだな」: You'd pull the chestnuts from the fire, then.
LDBI\t「虎口に身を投ずるのが、@ 鋼龍戦隊の責務でもありますから」: Throwing ourselves into the tiger's jaws@is the Steel Dragons' duty, after all.
LDBI\t「……地球圏の異常事態に対処するためにも、@ ゲストとの決着は早急に: ...To deal with the crisis in the Earth Sphere,@we must settle things with the Guests quickly...
LDBI\t「良かろう、貴官の申し出を認める。@ 我が第一艦隊は戦線後方に位置し: Very well, I approve your request.@My First Fleet will hold position behind the@front lines in case of the unexpected.
LDBI\t「第二艦隊は予定通り月面都市奪還任務に、@ 第三艦隊はその援護に回す: The Second Fleet will proceed with retaking the@lunar cities as planned, and the Third Fleet@will support them.
LDBI\t「了解です。後はお任せします」: Understood. We leave the rest to you.
LDBI\t「私は、鋼龍戦隊という戦力の在り方について、@ 諸手を挙げて認めるつ: I have no intention of wholeheartedly endorsing@the way the Steel Dragons operate as a force.
LDBI\t「だが、大統領暗殺に関する貴官らの言い分は信じる。@ 地球圏の行く末: But I believe your account of the President's@assassination. And that you act out of concern@for the Earth Sphere's future.
LDBI\t「貴官らの健闘を祈る。以上だ」: Good luck to you all. That is all.
LDBI\t「……石頭がかなり柔らかくなってきましたな」: ...His hard head has softened up considerably.
LDBI\t「そのようですね。ハンフリー司令の期待に@ 応えるためにも、オペレー: So it seems. To live up to Commander Humphrey's@hopes, let's see Operation Reconquista succeed@and free the Moon from the Guests.
LDBI\t「総員、第一種戦闘配置！@ これよりムーンクレイドル上空へ向かいます: All hands, Level 1 battle stations!@We're heading for the skies over Moon Cradle!
LDBI\t「第４、第５、第６機動部隊が押されているわ。@ 向こうはあたし達同様: Mobile Units 4, 5 and 6 are being pushed back.@They've brought new models, just like us...@A Raig-Geios has been spotted too.
LDBI\t「ありゃ～、メキちゃんてば、容赦ないんだ～から」: Oh my~ Our Meki sure doesn't pull any punches~
LDBI\t「どうやら、そのメキボスが来たようよ」: Looks like that Mekibos has arrived.
LDBI\t「すまねえな、肝心な所で@ あんた達の力を借りることになって」: Sorry for having to borrow your strength@when it really counts.
LDBI\t「こっちは万事納得してるわけじゃねえ。@ 妙な真似をしやがったら、生: We're not exactly happy about all this.@Try anything funny, and you'll get way more@than a slap on the wrist.
LDBI\t「しかし、まさかお前と肩を並べて@ 戦うことになるとはな」: Still, never thought I'd be fighting@side by side with you.
LDBI\t「なあ、こないだみたいに@ バイオロイドの機能を停止させることは@: Hey, can't you shut the bioroids down@like you did the other day?
LDBI\t「残念だが、向こうは対策済みだ。@ 前回、俺達はシュウ・シラカワがば: Unfortunately, they've got countermeasures now.@Last time, we got done in by the worm@Shu Shirakawa spread around...
LDBI\t「そういう事態を想定し、特殊な自閉モードが@ 設定されている。指揮官: They've set up a special lockdown mode for@that situation. Unless their Commander lifts it,@they won't stop.
LDBI\t「その指揮官って、あんたの知り合いなんでしょ。@ 何とか説得できない: That Commander's someone you know, right?@Can't you talk some sense into them somehow?
LDBI\t「そうよ、人間相手なら話が通じるでしょう？」: Yeah, you can reason with a human, can't you?
LDBI\t「一応そのつもりだが、素直な連中じゃねえし……@ 大元の解除コードは: That's the plan, but they're not the cooperative@type... And Zezenan's surely got the master@release code locked down.
LDBI\t「つべこべ言わず、行動してもらいたいわね」: I'd like you to stop talking and start acting.
LDBI\t（やれやれ、向こうでもこっちでも@ 周りに気の強い女が多いことで）: (Geez. Back home or here, I'm always surrounded@by headstrong women.)
LDBI\t「聞こえるか、ゼブ、セティ」: Can you hear me, Zeb, Sety?
LDBI\t「降伏しろという話なら、聞けないわよ。@ あなた達はロフを殺した。絶: If you're telling us to surrender, forget it.@You killed Rof. I'll never forgive you.
LDBI\t「奴の死は残念だった……@ が、手を下したのは俺じゃない」: His death was a shame... but I'm not the one@who did it.
LDBI\t「補足しておくが、俺とロフの戦闘中、@ あいつを庇ったのはメキボスだ: For the record, during my fight with Rof,@Mekibos was the one who covered for him.
LDBI\t「真実がどうであれ、@ あの人が死ぬきっかけを作ったのは@ メキボス: Whatever the truth,@you're the one who set his death in motion...@Mekibos.
LDBI\t「もしかして、彼女はロフを……？」: Don't tell me she and Rof...?
LDBI\t「それでゼゼーナンと運命を共にする気か。@ もはや、この戦いには何の: So you mean to share Zezenan's fate?@This fight has no meaning anymore.
LDBI\t「意味……？ それなら、あるわ。@ あたしはロフの仇を討つ！」: Meaning...? Oh, it has one.@I'm going to avenge Rof!

LDBI\t「ガンエデンは、彼らがもたらす災厄から逃れ……@ 最後の楽園として選: Gan Eden escaped the calamities they bring...@and is the guardian of this planet,@chosen as the last paradise...
LDBI\t「最後の楽園……選ばれた星、ね。@ つまり、ガンエデンとバラルの園は: The last paradise... a chosen planet, huh?@So Gan Eden and the Garden of Baral@aren't native to Earth?
LDBI\t「じゃあ、どこのだ？@ まさか、てめえらと関係がある星じゃねえだろう: Then where are they from?@Don't tell me it's some planet tied to you lot.
LDBI\t「ご冗談を。@ あんなのがあったら、俺達はとっくの昔に@ 銀河の覇者: You've gotta be kidding.@If we had something like that, we'd have@conquered the galaxy ages ago.
LDBI\t「地球は、以前から多くの者達によって@ 干渉を受け続けてきました……: For a long time, Earth has been subject to@interference from many beings...
LDBI\t「幾度となく星難が訪れ、@ 激しい戦いが繰り広げられ……@ 星そのも: Time and again, calamities have befallen it,@and fierce battles have been waged...@The planet itself has been wounded...
LDBI\t「強い力は災いを生み出し、それを広げていく……@ あなた達鋼龍戦隊も: Great power breeds disaster, and spreads it...@The same is true of you, the Steel Dragons...
LDBI\t「もし、戦いの中であなた達が力尽きたら……@ あなた達の力を上回る存: If you were to fall in battle...@or if something stronger than you appeared...
LDBI\t「その時はこの楽園が最期を迎えることに@ なるのです」: Then this paradise would meet its end.
LDBI\t「そんなこと、俺達が許すものかよ！」: Like hell we'd let that happen!
LDBI\t「どんな強敵が現れようと、@ 俺達はこの世界を守るために戦う！」: No matter how strong our enemies are,@we'll fight to protect this world!
LDBI\t「あなた達の命は、無限ではありません……。@ 今はその力で地球を護る: Your lives are not infinite...@Even if your power can protect Earth now...
LDBI\t「これから先……@ そう、未来永劫この星を護ることは@ 不可能なので: From here on... Yes, protecting this planet@for all eternity...@is impossible...
LDBI\t「確かに、人の命は短い。@ じゃが、その意志は時を越えて@ 受け継が: True, a man's life is short.@But his will transcends time and is@passed on to those who follow.
LDBI\t「例え、ワシらが命を全うしても、@ ワシらの意志を受け継ぐ者は必ず現: Even when our lives run their course,@someone will always come to carry on our will.
LDBI\t「……それはわかります……。@ 私もガンエデン……アウグストスとも呼: ...That I understand...@For I, too, inherited that will and power@from Gan Eden... the one also called Augustus...
LDBI\t「アウグストス……@ ローマ帝国初代皇帝の名前ですね」: Augustus...@The name of the first Roman emperor, I believe.
LDBI\t「同じ名の、別の存在ということでしょう」: A different being with the same name, no doubt.
LDBI\t「そう、他にも様々な名称を持っていますが……@ 最初の強念者のことで: Yes, it is known by many other names as well...@It is the first great psychic.
LDBI\t「かつて……ガンエデンによって@ 強念者の血を組み込まれた者達がいま: Long ago... there were those into whom@Gan Eden implanted a great psychic's blood...
LDBI\t「そして、彼らには@ ガンエデンや３体の神僕達の代わりに@ この星を: And they were given the mission@of protecting this planet in place of@Gan Eden and its three divine servants...
LDBI\t「しかし、長い時が……人々との交わりが、@ 彼らの血を薄めていきまし: But long ages... and mixing with others,@gradually thinned their blood...
LDBI\t「ですが……時折、隔世遺伝によって……@ 強念を持つ者が現れたのです: However... on occasion, through atavism...@those with great psychic power appeared.
LDBI\t「ならば、@ 彼女はガンエデンに造り出された存在ではなく……」: In that case,@she is not a being created by Gan Eden...
LDBI\t「じゃあ、イルイはガンエデンに操られて……！」: Then Irui is being controlled by Gan Eden...!

BMD\t「アヤ、早く逃げろ！」: Aya, get out of here, quick!

BMD\t「このグラキエースが、お前達を破滅へと導く」: I, Glacies, shall lead you to ruin.
BMD\t「私は破滅の導き手……」: I am the guide to ruin...
BMD\t「“破滅の王”が欲するのは、/ お前達の負の波動そのものだ」: What the "King of Ruin" desires is/　your negative energy itself.
BMD\t「全ての存在の死と滅びを、我らの力と成さん」: The death and ruin of all that exists/　shall become our power.
BMD\t「私は導き手……/ お前達に……滅びを与える者」: I am the guide.../　the one who brings... ruin to you.
BMD\t「憎悪と恐怖、絶望と苦悶は、我が主の糧……」: Hatred and fear, despair and agony.../　all are sustenance for my master.
BMD\t「あれを……早急に排除せねば……！」: I must... eliminate that at once...!
BMD\t「貴様は私の機能を損なう。/ 故に排除する……！」: You impair my functions./　Therefore, I will eliminate you...!
BMD\t「我らルイーナと貴様達は、/ 相容れることはない……！」: We, the Ruina, and you/　can never coexist...!
BMD\t「やはり、お前の存在は……/ 消さねばならぬ……！」: As I thought, your existence.../　must be erased...!
BMD\t「私が壊れる前に……/ お前を殺してみせる……！」: Before I break down.../　I will kill you...!
BMD\t「あの人間、妙なノイズを……」: That human gives off a strange noise...
BMD\t「やはり、お前は違う……！」: As I thought, you are different...!
BMD\t「何処へ逃げようと無駄だ」: Run wherever you like. It is futile.
BMD\t「お前達にさらなる恐怖を……」: Let me give you even greater fear...
BMD\t「さあ、恐怖せよ。後悔の中で死ぬがいい」: Now, tremble. Die amid your regrets.
BMD\t「その怒り、その恐怖……我らの力と成さん」: That rage, that fear.../　shall become our power.
BMD\t「このファービュラリスからは逃れられぬ」: There is no escape from Fabularis.
BMD\t「我らに抗うその意思……/ 絶望と……恐怖に変えてみせよう！」: This will of yours to resist us.../　I shall turn it into despair... and fear!
BMD\t「これ以上はやらせん……！」: I will not let you go any further...!
BMD\t「いずれ、お前達は最上の糧となる……！」: In time, you will become/　our finest sustenance...!
BMD\t「あ、あの人間との接触を断ち切らねば……！」: I-I must sever my contact/　with that human...!
BMD\t「やめろ……貴様の意識が……/ 私を圧迫する……！」: Stop... Your consciousness is.../　pressing down on me...!
BMD\t「う、うう……私が……私でなくなる……！？」: Ugh... I am... ceasing to be myself...!?
BMD\t「あの人間も……貴様も排除しなければ……！」: I must eliminate that human.../　and you as well...!
BMD\t「そうだ……憎むがいい、この私を」: Yes... Go on and hate me.
BMD\t「そう……怒りを、憎しみをたぎらせるのだ」: Yes... Let your rage and hatred boil.
BMD\t「その闘志は、まもなく絶望に転じる……」: Mettle like yours will soon turn to despair...
BMD\t「あの人間を倒せば、/ この不調は消えるのか……！？」: If I defeat that human,/　will this malfunction disappear...!?
BMD\t「黙れ、人間……私に語りかけるな……！」: Silence, human... Do not speak to me...!
BMD\t「その程度では、破滅の力を止められぬ」: That is not enough to stop the power of ruin.
BMD\t「我らルイーナを退けられると思うな」: Do not think you can repel us, the Ruina.
BMD\t「フッ、何の真似だ？」: Heh. What are you playing at?
BMD\t「何をしても宿命は変えられぬ」: Nothing you do can change your fate.
BMD\t「あの人間の意識が同調してくる……」: That human's consciousness.../　is coming into sync with mine...
BMD\t「剣じゃなくても、やってみせる……！」: It may not be a sword, but I'll make it work...!
BMD\t「思い知ったか、羅¶剣の斬れ味を！」: Now you know the edge of the Rahu Blade!
BMD\t「お前の行く先は、凶方だ……！」: Your path leads only to ruin...!
BMD\t「これが、壱式改の奥義だ！」: This is the Type-1 Kai's secret technique!
BMD\t「参式にはこういう戦法もある！」: The Type-3 has tactics like this too!
BMD\t「一意専心、一刀両断……！」: With singular purpose... one clean cut...!
BMD\t「思い知ったか、獅子王刀の斬れ味を！」: Now you know the edge of the Shishioh Blade!
BMD\t「これが、参式改の新奥義だ！」: This is the Type-3 Kai's new secret technique!
LDBI\t「るせえ。それじゃ、ハガネに行くぜ」: Shut it. Anyway, let's head to the Hagane.
LDBI\t「……なるほど、だいたいの事情はわかった。@ ヒリュウ改もこの世界へ: ...I see. I've got a general grasp of things.@So it's quite likely the Hiryu Custom has@come to this world as well.
LDBI\t「ああ。@ もしかしたら、演習に参加してない連中も……」: Yeah.@Maybe even the people who weren't in the exercise...
LDBI\t「そもそも、召喚が多発してる理由は何だ？@ 偶然か？」: So why are summonings happening so often?@Is it just chance?
LDBI\t「その可能性は低いな。@ 誰かが企んだことだと思うが……」: I doubt it.@I'd say someone's behind it, but...
LDBI\t「ラ・ギアスへ召喚される@ 条件みたいなものはあるの？」: Are there any conditions for being@summoned to La Gias?
LDBI\t「あるにはあるんだが、俺がこの世界へ来た時とは@ どうも訳が違うみて: There are, but things seem to be different@from when I came to this world.
LDBI\t「マサキ君にもわからないことが多いのね……」: So there's a lot even you don't know, Masaki...
LDBI\t「ああ。こうなったら、事情を知ってそうな人間に@ 聞いた方がいいかも: Yeah. At this point, we'd better ask someone@who might know what's going on...
LDBI\t「もしや、ソラティス神殿のイブン様ですか？」: Would that be Lady Ibn of the Solatis Temple?
LDBI\t「当たり。@ あの婆さんなら、地上へのゲートを開くことも@ 出来るん: Bingo.@That old lady could open a gate to the surface,@but... she's a stubborn one.
LDBI\t「口説き方次第ってんなら、相談に乗るぜ？」: If it's all about how you sweet-talk her,@I'd be glad to give you some pointers.
LDBI\t「いや……多分、あんたでも無理だ」: Nah... I doubt even you could pull it off.
LDBI\t「どんな人なのか、@ 何となく想像できちゃうわねぇ」: I can kinda picture@what she's like already~
LDBI\t「どのみち、消息不明の部下達を発見しない限り、@ 地上へ戻るわけには: Either way, we can't go back to the surface@until we find our missing men... but we need@every clue we can get.
LDBI\t「わかった。今からソラティス神殿へ行こう。@ 俺が案内するぜ」: Got it. Let's go to the Solatis Temple now.@I'll show you the way.
LDBI\t「さっきロフ達に連絡し、本国へ帰るよう命令した。@ 今頃は空間転移し: I just contacted Rof and the others and@ordered them home. By now they've warped out@and said goodbye to the Earth Sphere.
LDBI\t「事後報告ですまないが、@ こっちとしても無駄な揉め事を避けたかった: Sorry for telling you after the fact, but@we wanted to avoid any pointless trouble too.
LDBI\t「それで……君が残ったというわけか」: And so... you're the one who stayed behind.
LDBI\t「ああ……今度はニブハルを介さず、@ ダイレクトなパイプ役としてな」: Yeah... As a direct line this time,@without going through Nibhal.
LDBI\t「なるほど……君が“グレイ”だったのか」: I see... So you were the "Gray."
LDBI\t「そういうことだ。紳士的な待遇を頼むぜ？」: That's right. I'll expect to be treated@like a gentleman, okay?
LDBI\t「中将……この後、私達はどこへ向かえば@ よろしいのでしょうか？」: Lieutenant General... Where should we@head from here?
LDBI\t「日本の水鳥島へ行き、そこで待機してくれたまえ。@ その後のことにつ: Go to Mizutori Island in Japan and stand by@there. I'll send further orders later.
LDBI\t「ただし、軍属でない者達の扱いについては、@ 本人達と君の判断に任せ: However, how to handle the non-military members@is up to them and to you.
LDBI\t「早いもんやのう……。@ あのガンエデンとの戦いから一ヶ月……。@: Time sure flies... It's been a month since@that fight with Gan Eden... Never thought I'd@walk through Kaminarimon alive again.
LDBI\t「ミチルさん、何言ってるの？@ まだ一週間ぐらいしか経ってないでしょ: Michiru, what are you talking about?@It's only been about a week.
LDBI\t「つーか、何でこいつが……」: More like, why is HE here...
LDBI\t「仕方ないでしょ。@ あの事件の関係者ってことで、しばらく@ ウチに: Can't be helped.@He was involved in that incident, so he has to@stay at our place for a while.
LDBI\t「こんな奴、監視でも何でも付けて、@ さっさと大阪に帰しちまえばいい: Stick a guard on this guy or whatever@and ship him back to Osaka already.
LDBI\t「そういうわけにはいかないんだから……。@ ショウコ達だって、特別措: It doesn't work like that... Even we're only@home on standby as a special measure, you know?@Normally we'd still be on Mizutori Island...
LDBI\t「まあ、ワイの生まれは東京やから、@ こっちにも多少は馴染みがあるし: Well, I was born in Tokyo, so I'm@sorta familiar with this place anyway.
LDBI\t「せや。１０歳の頃に大阪へ引っ越したんや」: Yup. Moved to Osaka when I was 10.
LDBI\t「何より、ショウコはんと一緒にいられるのが@ 嬉しいわ」: Best of all, I get to be with you, Shoko.@Couldn't be happier.
LDBI\t「てめえ……ショウコに妙な真似しやがったら、@ オーバー・カイザー・: You bastard... Try anything funny with Shoko@and I'll slice you in half@with the Over Kaiser Sword!
LDBI\t「そんなもん、Ｇバンカランで跳ね返したるわい！」: Ha! I'll just knock it right back with@the G-Bankaran!
LDBI\t「ＧコンパチカイザーとＧバンカランで@ 喧嘩するなんて、冗談じゃない: A fight between the G-Compatible Kaiser and@the G-Bankaran? You've gotta be kidding me!
LDBI\t「二人共、仲良くしなかったら@ ご飯を作ってあげないからねっ！」: If you two don't get along,@I'm not making you dinner!
LDBI\t「ちぇっ、この野郎……@ 全国制覇とか何とか言ってやがったくせによ！: Tch, this jerk...@And here he was going on about conquering@the whole country!
LDBI\t「おう、そのことやけどな。@ コウタ、ワイとおどれで全国の高校をシメ: Oh yeah, about that.@Kota, how 'bout you and me take over every@high school in the country?
LDBI\t「ワイとおどれやったら、出来るわ。@ どや？ ワイの舎弟になって……: You and me, we could pull it off.@Whaddya say? Become my underling and...
LDBI\t「フン、誰がてめえの舎弟なんぞになるか。@ それに、シメる相手が間違: Hmph, like I'd ever be your underling.@Besides, you've got the wrong target.
LDBI\t「俺がシメるのは、@ この浅草を……地球を狙ってくる奴らだ」: The ones I'm gonna take down are the guys@coming after Asakusa... after Earth.
LDBI\t「そいつらが現れやがったら、@ おれはファイター・ロアとして……@: If those guys show up,@I'll fight as Fighter Roar...@in the G-Compatible Kaiser!
LDBI\t「……特別措置でＯＫが出たんなら、@ 俺達はラ・ギアスに帰るぜ。@: ...If we got the OK as a special measure,@we're heading back to La Gias.@We finally got through to Granny Ibn too.
LDBI\t「そうか……寂しくなるな」: I see... It'll be lonely around here.
LDBI\t「また何かあったら、エーテル通信機で呼んでよ。@ すぐに駆け付けるか: If anything comes up, call us on the ether@communicator. We'll come running right away.
LDBI\t「でも、あなた達には向こうで@ やらなければならないことがあるのでし: But you all have things you need to@take care of over there, don't you?
LDBI\t「僕達は、魔装機神操者としての義務を@ 果たさなければならない」: We must fulfill our duties@as Masoukishin pilots.
LDBI\t「もうちょっと地上でのんびりしたかったけど……@ 向こうのことも心配: I wish we could hang out up here longer...@but I'm worried about things back there too.
LDBI\t「みんな、ラ・ギアスに戻っても頑張れよ」: Keep it up back in La Gias, everyone.
LDBI\t「ザッシュは別の意味でもな」: And Zash, in more ways than one.
LDBI\t「あの……ゲンナジーさんによろしくお伝え下さい」: Um... Please give my regards to Gennacy.
LDBI\t「ジャオームの操者だよ。会ったことあるだろうが」: Jaohm's pilot. You've met him before!
LDBI\t「あ～、思い出した。あの人ね」: Oh, now I remember. That guy.
LDBI\t「って言うか、ラッセルとゲンナジーって@ いつの間に仲良くなってたん: More importantly, when did Russel and Gennacy@get so chummy?
LDBI\t「ラ・ギアスにいた時、話をしてたらしいぜ。@ 俺は言われるまで気づか: Apparently they talked while we were in@La Gias. I didn't notice till someone told me.
LDBI\t「クロちゃん、シロちゃん……@ また会うことがあったら、肉球をプニプ: Kuro, Shiro... If we ever meet again,@can I squish your paw pads?
LDBI\t「アヅキも元気でニャ」: You take care too, Azuki, meow.
LDBI\t「ああ、ハガネがラ・ギアスへ行った時にな。@ アヅキは無類の猫好きな: Yeah, back when the Hagane went to La Gias.@Azuki's crazy about cats.
LDBI\t「向こうで何事もなかったら、遊びに行くよ」: If nothing's going on over there, I'll come visit.
LDBI\t「リューネ……君は魔装機神操者ではないが、@ その義務と心得というも: Lüne... You may not be a Masoukishin pilot,@but the duties and mindset that come with it...
LDBI\t「わかったわかった、こんな時にお説教しないでよ」: Okay, okay, no lectures at a time like this!
BMD\t「ルイーナ！ あたしの邪魔をしないで！」: Ruina! Stay out of my way!
BMD\t「くっ！ ジンライを振り切れない！」: Ngh! I can't shake off the Jinrai!
BMD\t「しつこいのよ、あんた達は！」: You guys just don't give up, do you!
BMD\t「ガンエデン、あんたなんかに……！」: Gan Eden, not to the likes of you...!
BMD\t「このぐらいなら、あたしだって！」: I can handle something like this too!
BMD\t「スピードはこっちの方が上ね！」: Looks like I'm the faster one!
BMD\t「あたしを狙ったって！」: Even if you aim for me!
BMD\t「見え見えなのよ！」: I saw that coming a mile away!
BMD\t「この子を狙っても無駄なんだから！」: It's no use aiming for this one!
BMD\t「そんなもの、この子には！」: That won't work on this one!
