LDBI\t「私が知る限りでは、ないな。@ だが、今は彼らの意図を詮索している場: Not that I know of.@But now is not the time to guess at their intent.
LDBI\t「然り。眼前の敵を打ち砕くのみ」: Indeed. We need only crush the foe before us.
LDBI\t「ふっ……待っておったぞ」: Heh... I have been waiting for you.
LDBI\t「彼奴らと同じにするでない。@ 妾はククル……黄泉の巫女じゃ」: Do not lump me in with them.@I am Kukuru... the shrine maiden of Yomi.
LDBI\t「ククルだと……？@ ならば、師匠に手傷を負わせたのはお前か」: Kukuru...?@Then you are the one who wounded my master.
LDBI\t「師匠……@ ああ、あの老いぼれは黄泉路へ去んだか？」: Your master...@Ah, has that old fool departed for Yomi?
LDBI\t「それは、お前自身が赴いて、@ その目で確かめるがいい」: Go there yourself,@and see with your own eyes.
LDBI\t「ふふふ……妾に向かってよく言う。@ 名を聞いておこう」: Heh heh heh... Bold words to say to me.@I shall have your name.
LDBI\t「ならば、ゼンガーとやら……@ そなたがまず黄泉へ行くがよい！」: Then, Sänger, was it...@You shall be the first to go to Yomi!
LDBI\t「妾の舞にて冥府へ誘ってやろうぞ！」: My dance shall lead you to the netherworld!
LDBI\t「師が受けた借りは、門人である俺が返す！」: As his disciple, I will repay my master's debt!
LDBI\t「妾が素直にそれを教えると思うておるのか？」: Do you think I would simply tell you?
LDBI\t「フッ、想定内の返答だ。@ 当面の狙いは、陽動か？」: Heh, an expected answer.@Is your immediate aim a diversion?
LDBI\t「待っていた、と言ったな。@ 目的は俺達の陽動か？」: You said you'd been waiting.@Is your goal to draw us away?
LDBI\t「街を襲うなんて……@ 民間人を巻き込むなんて、許せないよ！」: Attacking a city...@Dragging civilians into this is unforgivable!
LDBI\t「じゃあ、あんたにはどんな都合があるってのさ！？」: Then what's your concern supposed to be!?
LDBI\t「それを知る必要はない……@ マガルガの舞にて、冥府へ堕ちよ！」: You need not know...@Fall to the netherworld by Magaruga's dance!
LDBI\t「ダンスなら、負けない！ 覚悟しなよ！！」: If it's dancing, I won't lose! Get ready!!
LDBI\t「くっ、こうも押されるとは……！！」: Ngh, to be pushed back this far...!!
LDBI\t「……ここが潮時か。蓬、後は任せるぞ」: ...Enough for now. Yomogi, the rest is yours.
LDBI\t「今、テスラ研から通信が入った。@ 向こうは妖機人の襲撃を受けている: I just received word from the Tesla Institute.@They're under attack by Yokijin.
LDBI\t「救援活動は連邦軍に任せ、我らはテスラ研へ戻るぞ」: Leave the rescue to the Federation Army.@We're returning to the Tesla Institute.
LDBI\t「これじゃ、こないだと同じだな……！」: This is just like last time...!
LDBI\t「ええ。@ 彼らの狙いは、龍人機と見て間違いなさそうね」: Yes.@There's no doubt their target is the RyuJinKi.
LDBI\t「でも、どうしてこのタイミングで……」: But why now, of all times...
LDBI\t「クスハ少尉がセンシング・マインドを@ 行ったからかも知れません」: It may be because Lieutenant Kusuha@performed the Sensing Mind.
BMD\t「超魔装機の力、身を以て知れ！」: Feel a Super Masoukin's power/　firsthand!
BMD\t「前部砲塔、斉射用意！ 撃て！」: Forward turrets, ready a salvo!/　Fire!
LDBI\t「我らに大統領暗殺の罪を被せたのは……！」: The one who framed us for the president's@assassination was...!
LDBI\t「やはり……。ゲストやルイーナのみならず、@ ガイアセイバーズ、そし: As I thought... Make enemies of the Guests,@Ruina, the Gaia Savers, and the Federation,@and one is left utterly alone... Quite a trial.
LDBI\t「その通り。窮地に陥ったお前達が@ さらなる力を発揮し、終極点へ至る: Precisely. I arranged it so that, cornered,@you would unleash even greater power@and reach the ultimate end point.
LDBI\t「だから、あの時……逃げ道が用意されていたのか」: So that's why an escape route was ready@for us back then...
LDBI\t「そして、グランド・クリスマスでの決戦が@ 最後の試練……いや、茶番: And the decisive battle at Grand Christmas@was the final trial... No, a farce.
LDBI\t「シエンヌ達もユーゼスの掌の上で踊らされて……」: Even Sienne and the others were just dancing@in the palm of Euzeth's hand...
LDBI\t「アルベロ隊長も……そして、俺達も……！」: Captain Albero too... And us as well...!
LDBI\t「ユーゼス……イングラム教官を操ってた@ てめえらしい手口だぜ……！: Euzeth... Typical of a bastard like you,@who manipulated Instructor Ingram...!
LDBI\t「裏で糸を引いて、てめえ自身はのうのうと！」: Pulling the strings from the shadows while you@sit back all smug!
LDBI\t「それが十重二十重の我が計画だ」: That is my plan, woven layer upon layer.
LDBI\t「よく言うぜ。@ 俺達がエアロゲイターを倒したから、@ 慌てて地球へ: Yeah, right.@We took out the Aerogators, so you came@rushing to Earth in a panic, didn't you?
LDBI\t「否。@ その事態も想定し、水面下で事を進めていた。@ ニブハルはそ: No.@I foresaw that too and moved in secret.@Nibhal was a pawn to that end.
LDBI\t「フン……あいつがそうなら、ウェンドロやゼゼーナンも@ てめえの茶番: Hmph... If he was, then Wendolo and Zezenan@were stuck playing along with your farce too.
LDBI\t「最終目的が地球の主導権掌握でないのなら、@ ガイアセイバーズの行動: If your final goal isn't seizing control@of Earth, it's only natural that some of the@Gaia Savers' actions made no sense.
LDBI\t「では……最大の疑問に答えていただきましょうか、@ ユーゼス・ゴッツ: Then... perhaps you'll answer the greatest@question of all, Euzeth Gozzo.
LDBI\t「何故、あなたはクロスゲートやガンエデンの@ 詳細を知っているのです: How is it that you know the details@of the Cross Gate and Gan Eden?
LDBI\t「ゼ・バルマリィ帝国にそれらに関する@ 伝承や文献があり、そして……: The Ze Balmary Empire has legends and@records concerning them, and also...
LDBI\t「我に虚憶の欠片があったからだ」: ...because I held fragments of phantom memory.
LDBI\t「一大劫を経て再有生し、受け継がれる記憶……@ 言わば、前世の記憶だ: Memories inherited through re-existence@after a great kalpa... Memories of a past life,@so to speak.
LDBI\t「お前達の中にも虚憶を持っている者がいるだろう？@ 見聞なきはずのク: Some among you must also have phantom memories.@Those who recognize the Cross Gate or Gan Eden,@names and forms they should never have known.
LDBI\t「記憶を辿ろうとも明確な答えは出ず、おぼろげに@ 存在している知識…: Knowledge that exists only vaguely, which@yields no clear answer however one searches...@Without a trigger, one lives and dies unaware.
LDBI\t「な、なら、俺は前世でクロスゲートを@ 見たことがあるってのか……！: Th-Then you're saying I saw the Cross Gate@in a past life...!?
LDBI\t「あらら、本当にそっち方面の話だったのね」: Ooh, so we really are going down that road.
LDBI\t「リュウセイ・ダテ……@ 我はお前を知って……いや、“覚えて”いるぞ: Ryusei Date...@I know you... No, I "remember" you.
LDBI\t「マサキ・アンドー……そして、サイバスター。@ その存在も“覚えて”: Masaki Andoh... and Cybuster.@I "remember" their existence as well.
LDBI\t「俺はてめえなんぞに覚えはねえぜ！」: Well, I don't remember a damn thing about you!
LDBI\t「我とお前の前世は交わっていた……@ いや、お前だけではなく、他の者: Your past life and mine crossed paths...@And not only yours, but others' as well.
LDBI\t「今生が初めての縁となる者が多いが……@ 深浅の差あれど、我との因縁: Many of you meet me for the first time in this@life... But a few share ties of fate with me,@some deep, some shallow.
LDBI\t「こっちには覚えがないのに、@ 一方的にそんなこと言われてもね」: Easy for you to say when we don't remember@any of it.
LDBI\t「虚憶を持つ者、持たない者……その差は何だ？」: Those with phantom memories and those without...@What makes the difference?
LDBI\t「虚憶の有無、内容については個体差がある。@ その要因となるものは縁: Whether one has phantom memories, and their@content, varies by person. The cause is fate...@bonds that reach back beyond a great kalpa.
LDBI\t「別の形で生まれ変わる者もいれば、@ 一大劫を経て再有生する者もいる: Some are reborn in another form, while others@undergo re-existence after a great kalpa.@Most who hold phantom memories are the latter.
LDBI\t「一大劫とは仏教の言葉での。世界が誕生してから@ 消滅するまでの過程: It's a Buddhist term. A world's life from birth@to its end is said to pass through four kalpas:@formation, existence, destruction, emptiness...
LDBI\t「それら全ての時間を一大劫と呼ぶのじゃ」: And all that time together is called a great kalpa.
LDBI\t「そして、再有生とは一大劫を経て@ 同じような姿、気性、能力を保つこ: And re-existence means passing through a great@kalpa while keeping a similar form, temperament,@and ability.
LDBI\t「例えば、@ マサキ・アンドー……そして、シュウ・シラカワ。@ お前: For example,@Masaki Andoh... and Shu Shirakawa.@You two have undergone re-existence, bound by fate.
LDBI\t「そう……並行世界だけでなく、一大劫を経てもなお、@ お前達は強固な: Yes... Not just across parallel worlds, but even@through a great kalpa, you two remain bound by@an unbreakable tie.
LDBI\t「そんな気の遠くなるような因縁、願い下げだぜ！」: Count me out of some mind-numbingly ancient bond!
LDBI\t「だいたい、@ 俺には再有生なんてものをやった実感なんてねえ！@ 普: Besides,@I've got no sense of any re-existence crap!@I was born a normal human kid, plain and simple!
LDBI\t「再有生という言葉の意味を知っただけであれば、@ そうだろう。四劫は: If you merely learned the word's meaning, then@yes. The four kalpas are the universe's truth...@Known or not, worlds are broken and remade anew.
LDBI\t「再有生を遂げなくとも、虚憶がなくとも、@ それらに気づかずとも、人: Whether one achieves re-existence or not, has@phantom memories or not, knows of them or not,@people are born... and they die.
LDBI\t「ただ……仮に再有生の実感があるとすれば、@ お前はそのような姿では: However... were you truly aware of your@re-existence, you could not remain in that form.
LDBI\t「……運命、宿命とでも言っておこう」: ...Call it destiny. Fate, if you will.
LDBI\t「神だとでも認識するがいい」: Think of it as God, if you like.
LDBI\t「あらら……@ 肝心な所を曖昧に答えられちゃったわね～」: Aw, man...@He dodged the key part with a vague answer~
LDBI\t「もう一つ聞こう。@ 再有生は、自らの意思で行えるものなのか？」: One more question.@Can re-existence be undertaken by one's own will?
LDBI\t「希にそれを知り、四劫の超越を試みる者……@ いや、そうせざるを得な: Rarely, some learn of it and attempt to@transcend the four kalpas... No, rather, some@who have no choice but to.
LDBI\t「そう……そして、我と深き因縁を持ち、@ 幾度も我の前に現れるイング: Yes... As does Ingram Plissken, bound to me by@deep fate, who appears before me time and again.
LDBI\t「だが、彼奴は己の虚憶に気づく前、@ お前達の手によって消滅した。@: But he was destroyed by your hands before he@became aware of his phantom memories.@Never again will he stand in my way.
LDBI\t「今にして思えば、ネビーイームの損失を@ 補って余りある結果だ。我が: In hindsight, it was a result that more than@made up for losing Nebiim. For you severed one@of the chains of my karma.
LDBI\t「ま、まずい！@ あれをやられたら、消耗戦になるぜ！！」: Uh-oh!@If they do that, it's a war of attrition!!
LDBI\t「フォッホッホッホ！ それも善哉！」: Fohohoho! That is good as well!
LDBI\t「何を悠長な！」: How can you be so calm?!
LDBI\t「何や！？ いつものズルをせえへんのか！？」: Huh?! Ain'tcha gonna pull your usual cheat?!
LDBI\t「ともかく、ラッキーだぜ！@ これで勝ち目が見えて来たってもんよ！」: Anyway, lucky for us!@Now we've actually got a shot at winning!
LDBI\t「泰北、まだ装符を一気に修復できないのか？」: Taihoku, you still can't restore@the charms all at once?
LDBI\t「うむ。武雀王には思う所があるようでの」: Indeed. BuJakuOh seems to have@thoughts of its own.
LDBI\t「そんなことを言っている場合か！ 僕に代われ！」: Is this really the time?! Let me take over!
LDBI\t「さあ、仕切り直しだ。@ 僕と雀武王が君達に往くべき道を示す！」: Now, let's start over.@JakuBuOh and I will show you the path to take!
LDBI\t「ふむ、なかなかやりおるわい。@ 装符を修復しておこうかのう」: Hmm, they're quite good.@I'd best restore the charms.
LDBI\t「武雀王には思う所があるようでの」: BuJakuOh seems to have thoughts of its own.
LDBI\t「そんなことを言っている場合か！@ 僕に代われ！」: Is this really the time?!@Let me take over!
LDBI\t「さあ、仕切り直しだ。@ 僕と雀武王が君達の往くべき道を示す！」: Now, let's start over.@JakuBuOh and I will show you the way to go!
LDBI\t「やるじゃないか……@ 俗人が、雀武王をここまで追い込むとはね」: Not bad...@For mere mortals to push JakuBuOh this far.
LDBI\t「だが、君達は南北仙の何たるかを知らない。@ 泰北、強執術にて武雀王: But you know nothing of the true@Northern and Southern Immortals.@Taihoku, use the binding art on BuJakuOh...
LDBI\t「夏喃……いや、潤よ。@ 我らには唯一抗えぬものがあることを忘れたか: Kanan... no, Jun.@Have you forgotten the one thing we can't defy?
LDBI\t「馬鹿な、こんな結果が天命であるはずがない！」: Nonsense! This outcome can't be Heaven's will!
LDBI\t「いや、武雀王と雀武王も気づいておる。@ 己が宿命の歪みにのう」: No, BuJakuOh and JakuBuOh sense it too.@The distortion in their own fate.
LDBI\t「彼らが僕らの強執術に……@ いや、ガンエデンに逆らうと言うのか！」: They'd defy our binding art...@No, defy Gan Eden?!
LDBI\t「生々流転……万物は絶えず生じては変化し、@ 移り変わっていくのじゃ: Endless birth and change... All things arise@and transform without cease. Our fate, too,@is no exception.
LDBI\t「何を言う、僕らこそが地球の守護者！@ 俗界桃源郷の主！ 尸解による: What are you saying? We are Earth's guardians!@Masters of this mundane Shangri-La!@Guiding mankind through shikai...!
LDBI\t「じゃが、彼らは“破滅の王”という大邪を退け、@ 四凶をも降し、ワシ: Yet they repelled that great evil, the King of@Ruin, subdued the Four Fiends, and now face us.
LDBI\t「わかるのう、潤？@ ワシらは此方に在り、彼らは彼方に在るのじゃ」: You understand, Jun?@We stand on this side, and they on the other.
LDBI\t「わかるものか！@ 僕らの悲願、総人尸解計画を水泡に帰す気か！？」: Understand?! Never!@Would you let our great dream, the Total@Shikai Plan, come to nothing?!
LDBI\t「例え、正邪が逆転しようと@ 善き実が結べば、それで良いのじゃ」: Even if right and wrong are reversed,@so long as good fruit is borne, that is enough.
LDBI\t「賢者が愚者を導かずに何とする！@ 忘れたか、僕らがガンエデンに恭順: Who guides fools if not the wise?!@Have you forgotten why we@submitted to Gan Eden...?!
LDBI\t「全ては流れのままに……@ 巫女が新たな剣を見出した時点で@ 我らの: All things follow the flow...@Our fate changed the moment@the priestess found a new sword.
LDBI\t「青龍、そして白虎の操者よ。新たな剣達よ。@ 我が言魂に耳を傾けよ」: Pilots of the Blue Dragon and White Tiger...@New swords...@Heed the words of my soul.
LDBI\t「ワシらは天命に殉ずる。@ お主らは、お主らの道を往け」: We shall die by Heaven's will.@You must walk your own path.
LDBI\t「されど、其は艱難辛苦の道。心せよ」: But it is a road of hardship and suffering.@Steel yourselves.
LDBI\t「いかなる意志も事象も、太極の内。@ 善き哉、善き哉。フワッハッハッ: All wills and events lie within the Taiji.@Good, good. Fwahahahahaha!!
LDBI\t「消滅……したのか、泰北、夏喃……雀武王は……！？」: Are they... gone?@Taihoku, Kanan... and JakuBuOh...?!
LDBI\t「……やれやれ、ご老体も戯れが過ぎる。@ 後のことは僕に丸投げとはね: ...Good grief, the old man's games go too far.@Dumping everything that's left on me, huh?
LDBI\t「残るは貴様だ、孫光龍！」: You're all that's left, Son Koryu!
LDBI\t「いいねぇ、盛り上がって来たよ。@ そろそろフィナーレといこうか、は: Nice, now things are heating up.@Time for the grand finale, hahahahaha!!
LDBI\t「あららら……歴史は繰り返すってか？」: Oh my, my... History repeats itself, huh?
LDBI\t「チェッ、天命ってのは意地悪だねぇ。@ いい退屈しのぎだったのにさ」: Tch, Heaven's will sure is mean.@And it was such a nice way to kill time.
LDBI\t「ま、総人尸解計画を遂行するのは@ 僕じゃなく、ガンエデンだし……@: Well, it's Gan Eden carrying out the Total@Shikai Plan, not me... so I guess I'll let@you have this one.
LDBI\t「じゃあ、お言葉に甘えて@ もっと言わせてもらおうか！」: Well then, if you insist,@I'll say a little more!
LDBI\t「バラルの門を開いてやるから、@ 神の慈悲にすがるがいいさ！」: I'll open the Gate of Baral for you,@so go cling to God's mercy!
LDBI\t「そして、君達には@ とっても楽しい神役が課せられる！@ 仙体ならぬ: And you'll all be given@a very fun divine duty!@As mere mortals, not immortals!
LDBI\t「戦い続けるのさ、万魔百邪と！@ いや、既に君達がそうかな！？」: You'll fight on against the countless evils!@Or wait, maybe you already are them?!
LDBI\t「何はともあれ、護るより壊す方が楽だからね！@ 命でも星でもどんどん: Anyway, destroying is easier than protecting!@So go on, wreck lives and planets alike, and@dig your own graves!
LDBI\t「あ、もうそれはやっちゃってるか！@ こりゃ失敬、失敬！ ははははは: Oh, but you already have, haven't you!@Pardon me, pardon me! Hahahahaha!
LDBI\t「チェッ、いい退屈しのぎだったのにさ」: Tch, and it was such a nice way to kill time.
LDBI\t「そ……そんなの……決まってるじゃねえか……@ あんたがクライウルブ: Th-that's... a no-brainer...@Before you're captain of the Crai Wolves...
LDBI\t「チッ……また同じ夢を見るようになっちまった……」: Tch... I'm having that same dream again...
LDBI\t「う、うぐっ……薬が切れたか……」: Ugh, nngh... The meds wore off...
LDBI\t「ヒューゴ、いる？ 話があるんだけど」: Hugo, are you there? I need to talk to you.
LDBI\t「ヒューゴ、また顔色が悪いわよ？」: Hugo, you look pale again, you know.
LDBI\t「ねえ、医務室へ行ったら？」: Hey, why don't you go to the infirmary?
LDBI\t「大丈夫だ。で、話とは何だ？」: I'm fine. So, what did you want to talk about?
LDBI\t「あなた、レーツェルさんと話してた時、@ ツェントル・プロジェクトの: When you were talking to Rätsel, you said you'd@been at the Tsentr Project's Tochka 1, right?
LDBI\t「私、ハワイのトーチカにしか行ったことないし……@ トーチカ１の場所: I've only ever been to the Tochka in Hawaii...@They said Tochka 1's location is classified,@so nobody would tell me where it is.
LDBI\t「俺もトーチカ１の所在地は知らん」: I don't know where Tochka 1 is either.
LDBI\t「え？ だって、そこにいたことがあるって……」: Huh? But you said you'd been there...
LDBI\t「それは昔のトーチカ１だ。@ 事故が起きたせいで、今は廃棄されている: That was the old Tochka 1.@It's been abandoned since the accident.
LDBI\t「当時、ツェントル・プロジェクトの連中は@ 奴を飼い慣らせず、暴走さ: The Tsentr Project people back then couldn't@tame it, and it ran out of control.
LDBI\t「その後、クライウルブズ達に追撃命令が出たが……@ 結果はお前も知っ: The Crai Wolves were ordered to pursue it...@and you know how that turned out.
LDBI\t（生き残ったのはアルベロ・エスト少佐と@ ヒューゴだけ……その後、イ: (Only Major Albero Est and Hugo survived...@and afterward, Major Kai and the others@defeated Jetzt...)
LDBI\t「……前にも聞いたけど、@ ツェントル・プロジェクトは@ 何のために: I asked you this before, but...@what did the Tsentr Project@want with Jetzt...?
LDBI\t「兵器として応用するつもりだったようだが、@ 詳しくは知らん」: Seems they meant to use it as a weapon,@but I don't know the details.
LDBI\t「まさか、プロジェクトでは@ 今もイェッツトの研究を……？」: Don't tell me the project is@still researching Jetzt...?
LDBI\t「ね、ねえ……@ 私達は正しいことをやってるのよね……？」: H-hey...@We're doing the right thing... aren't we?
LDBI\t「<アインスト>や<インスペクター>みたいな敵から@ 地球を守る……: Protecting Earth from enemies like the <アインスト>@and the <インスペクター>... The Tsentr Project@is for that too, right...?
LDBI\t「ミタールもそんなことを言っていたが、@ 建前だろうな」: Mitar said something like that too,@but it's probably just a front.
LDBI\t「建前って……じゃあ、あなたは？」: A front...? Then what about you?
LDBI\t「あそこのハンガーにあるのは……@ アクセル隊長のソウルゲインですね: The one in that hangar over there...@That's Captain Axel's Soulgain, isn't it?
LDBI\t「ああ。彼が消えた後、我々が回収したのだ」: Yes. We recovered it after he vanished.
LDBI\t「あの事件の報告書は読んだ。@ コウタとアクセル・アルマーが正体不明: I read the report on that incident.@Kota and Axel Almer fought an unknown enemy@and were pulled into a dimensional gate.
LDBI\t「ええ。キョウスケ中尉とリュウセイ少尉、鋼龍戦隊、@ シャイン王女、: Yes. I believe it's tied to the disappearances@of Lieutenants Kyosuke and Ryusei, the Steel@Dragons, Princess Shine, and Sänger's group...
LDBI\t「個々別々に理由が存在しているのかも知れんぞ。@ 異なる世界の扉を開: Each may have its own separate cause.@There's more than one way to open a door@to another world, after all.
LDBI\t「ラ・ギアスから来たマサキは別として、@ シャドウミラーやアインスト: Setting aside Masaki, who came from La Gias,@there's Shadow Mirror, the Einst, the Shura,@and the string of disappearances...
LDBI\t「時が経つにつれ、境界の変事が頻発し……@ 特にここ最近はその間隔が: As time passes, these boundary anomalies grow@more frequent... and lately, the intervals seem@to be getting shorter.
LDBI\t「これは何か大きな異変の前触れではないのか。@ そんな気がする……」: Could this be a sign of some great upheaval?@I can't shake that feeling...
LDBI\t「わあ、あの雲に島……いかにも南の海って感じ」: Wow, the clouds, the islands... So tropical!
LDBI\t「輸送機に乗ってる時もそうだったけど、@ 景色を見るのが好きなのね」: You were like this on the transport too.@You really love looking at the scenery, huh?
LDBI\t「うん、珍しくて。@ 私、子供の頃からずっと南極にいたから」: Yeah, it's all new to me.@I've been in Antarctica since I was a kid.
LDBI\t「じゃあ、南極の外に出たのは……」: So the last time you left Antarctica was...
LDBI\t「ずっと氷の世界に閉じこもってたのか。@ おれだったら、耐えられねえ: Cooped up in a world of ice the whole time?@Man, I couldn't take that...
LDBI\t「いえ、もう試作機ではないわ。@ ガルムレイドとサーベラスの特徴を併: No, it's no longer a prototype.@Combining the traits of Garmraid and Cerberus,@and surpassing even Blaze and Ignite, it is...
LDBI\t「ツェントル・プロジェクトの一つの到達点。@ ＡＩ１とラズムナニウム: ...one culmination of the Tsentr Project.@With AI1 and Lazmanium, this Garberus is@the ultimate humanoid mobile weapon.
LDBI\t「そいつのために俺とアクアは……@ アルベロ隊長は……！」: Because of that thing, Aqua and I...@Captain Albero was...!
LDBI\t「哀れだったわね、あの男は」: That man was pitiful, wasn't he?
LDBI\t「このガルベルスが完成した今となっては、@ どうでもいいわ。アクア、: Now that Garberus is complete,@none of that matters. Nor do you, Aqua.@You can both disappear right here.
LDBI\t「愚かで、恩知らずな女……あなたには、@ 今まで色々なことを教えてき: Foolish, ungrateful woman...@after all I've taught you over the years.
LDBI\t「エルデ・ミッテ……！@ 俺達を……いや、アルベロ隊長のみならず、@: Erde Mitte...!@You used us... not just Captain Albero,@but even Foglia. Now you'll pay for it.
LDBI\t「利用だなんて……@ あの男も承知の上でやっていたことなのよ？@ 最: Used? Oh, please...@That man knew exactly what he was doing.@Though he did learn the truth at the very end.
LDBI\t「それに、元々はザパト博士が……@ いえ、もう死んでしまったから、ど: Besides, originally it was Dr. Zapato who...@No, he's dead now, so it hardly matters.
LDBI\t「ええ。私のＡＩ１を否定したから、殺したわ」: Yes. He rejected my AI1, so I killed him.
LDBI\t「正気か、貴様……！？」: Are you out of your mind...!?
LDBI\t「もちろん。@ 私はただ、自分の探究心に素直なだけ。@ その邪魔をす: Of course not.@I'm simply being honest with my curiosity.@Anyone who gets in its way deserves to die.
LDBI\t「ホント、呆れるぐらいに見事な悪女っぷりねぇ」: Wow, you're such a perfect wicked woman,@it's actually kind of impressive.
LDBI\t「あら、ヒューゴ少尉の仇討ちを@ 手伝ってあげたことにもなるのだけど: Oh, but I also helped Lieutenant Hugo@get his revenge, you know.
LDBI\t「あの男が原因で、クライウルブズは@ 壊滅したようなものだから……@: That man is practically the reason@the Cry Wolves were wiped out...@You ought to be thanking me, Lieutenant.
LDBI\t「……ミタールの口を封じたのか？@ それとも、プロジェクトの独占を目: ...Did you silence Mitar?@Or did you want the project all to yourself?
LDBI\t「前にも言ったでしょう？ 全てはＡＩ１のためよ。@ あの子がラズムナ: Didn't I tell you before? It's all for AI1.@I want to see the world that child weaves@with Lazmanium.
LDBI\t「そんなものは研究室か、夢の中で見ていろ……！@ お前の妄念に付き合: Then go see it in a lab or in your dreams...!@I've had enough of being dragged into@your delusions!
LDBI\t「アルベロ隊長やフォリア達の無念を@ ここで、俺の手で晴らす！！」: Captain Albero, Foglia, the others...@I'll avenge them here, with my own hands!!
LDBI\t「フフフ……持てる力の全てを発揮し、ガルベルスに@ 挑んで来なさい。: Heh heh heh... Come at Garberus with everything@you've got. The data from that fight will@fuel AI1's further growth and evolution.
LDBI\t「そう……@ あなた達は全てを私の子に捧げ、そして死ぬのよ」: Yes...@You'll give everything to my child, and then die.
LDBI\t「でも、以前ほどじゃないわ。@ もしかしたら、調整が不完全で……！？: But not as well as before.@Could the adjustments be incomplete...!?
LDBI\t「ならば、修復が追いつかないほどの@ ダメージを一気に与えればいい！: Then we just hit it with so much damage@at once that the repairs can't keep up!
LDBI\t「ガルベルスの近くにいる者は、集中攻撃を！@ 奴に時間を与えるな！」: Everyone near Garberus, concentrate your fire!@Don't give it any time!
LDBI\t（……問題はクリアしたはず。テストも良好だった。@ なのに、何故……: (...I solved the problem. The tests went fine.@So why...?)
LDBI\t（内的ではなく、外的な問題だとでも言うの……？）: (Are you saying the problem is external,@not internal...?)
LDBI\t「このガルベルスの完成を以て、@ ツェントル・プロジェクトは次の段階: With Garberus complete, the Tsentr Project@moves on to its next stage. It's a shame@I can't show you what lies ahead.
LDBI\t「そんなもの、見たくはない！@ それに、お前とＡＩ１が行き着く先は、: I don't want to see it!@And we're the ones who'll decide@where you and AI1 end up!
LDBI\t「アクア、この間の話……@ 私の最後の頼みを聞いてもらうわよ」: Aqua, about what we discussed the other day...@You're going to grant my final request.
LDBI\t「何が頼みよ！ エルデ・ミッテ、@ 今までのこと……あなたがしてきた: Request? Don't make me laugh! Erde Mitte,@everything until now... everything you've done!@I'm settling it all right here!
LDBI\t「イング！ お前はここに至ってもなお、@ 真実を知ることなく死ぬんだ: Ing! Even now, you'll die without@ever learning the truth!
LDBI\t「言ったはずだ！@ 僕とエグゼクスバインには勝てないと！」: I told you!@You can't beat me and the Exexbein!
LDBI\t「なら、その真価を発揮する前に潰してやる！@ お前の過去と共にね！」: Then I'll crush it before it shows its worth!@Along with your past!
LDBI\t「イング……俺の子よ。@ まだ記憶は戻っていないようだな」: Ing... my child.@It seems your memories haven't returned yet.
LDBI\t「お前達は何を企んでいる！？@ 何故、僕は念動力を持っているんだ！？: What are you people plotting!?@Why do I have Telekinesis!?
LDBI\t「いや、僕はいったい何なんだ！？@ 僕に何をさせようと言うんだ！？」: No... what am I!?@What do you want me to do!?
LDBI\t「エグレッタが言っていなかったか？@ それを知る必要はない、と」: Didn't Egretta tell you?@That you have no need to know.
LDBI\t「ならば、力ずくでも聞き出す！」: Then I'll get it out of you by force!
LDBI\t（……それでいい。その疑念がお前の力を引き出す）: (...That's it. That doubt will draw out@your power.)
LDBI\t（選ばれし存在への階段を上るか、ここで果てるか。@ お前は運命の分岐: (Will you climb the steps to becoming a chosen@being, or perish here? You stand at the@crossroads of your fate...)
LDBI\t「ブロンゾ２８……これ以上、君という汚点を@ 放置しておくのは望まし: Bronzo 28... I can't allow a blemish like you@to be left alone any longer.
LDBI\t「今日ここで、その存在を消してやるよ。@ この世界から……完全にね！: Today, right here, I'll erase your existence.@From this world... completely!
LDBI\t「こっちもこれ以上お前に付き合う気はねえ！@ ここできっちりケリを付: And I'm done putting up with you too!@I'm settling this here, once and for all!
LDBI\t「ゼンガー・ゾンボルト！@ 今度はお前が地の底へ堕ちる番だ！」: Sänger Sombold!@This time it's your turn to fall into the abyss!
LDBI\t「笑止！@ お前こそ水底で眠るがいい、永久に！」: Absurd!@You shall sleep beneath the waves... forever!
LDBI\t「イーグレット・フェフ……貴様が戦場に赴くとはな」: Egret Fehu...@So you've come to the battlefield yourself.
LDBI\t「ああ、この目で直に確かめたいことがあってな」: Yes. There's something I must confirm@with my own eyes.
BMD\t「ああいう喋り方をして、疲れないのかしらん」: Doesn't talking like that wear you out?
BMD\t「むしろ、/ あなたの方が猿山の大将さんって感じ？」: If anything,/　aren't you more the big monkey on the hill?
BMD\t「ゼゼーナン！/ 悪いけど、あなたの出番はもう終わりよ！」: Zezenan!/　Sorry, but your part's already over!
BMD\t「クスハちゃんに目を付けるなんて、/ いい趣味してるじゃない？」: Setting your sights on Kusuha?/　You've got good taste, huh?
BMD\t「人類皆平等ならぬ皆仙人って、/ どうなのかしらん」: Not equality, but hermits for everyone?/　What's with that, hm?
BMD\t「悪いけど、人間やめる気ないのよね」: Sorry, but I've got no plans/　to quit being human.
BMD\t「仙人を増やして千人に……って、/ 冗談言ってる場合じゃないわね」: So many hermits, they're hardly/　hermits anymore... Okay, no time/　for jokes, huh.
BMD\t「あれで坊やが背中に乗ってたら、/ 昔話が始まっちゃうわね」: If a little boy rode on its back,/　we'd be starring in a fairy tale.
BMD\t「清々しいぐらいの上から目線ね。/ もっとも、ホントに上の方にいるけど: That's refreshingly condescending./　Then again, you really are up there.
BMD\t「女は義理堅くなくっちゃ。お返しっ！」: A lady always repays a favor./　Here's yours!
BMD\t「さてさて、今度はこっちの番ね！」: Okay, okay, now it's our turn!
BMD\t「二度目はなくってよ？」: There won't be a second time, okay?
BMD\t「お礼は受け取ってもらわないと！」: You've gotta accept my thank-you gift!
BMD\t「……これで落ちるか……賭けてみない？」: ...Will this take it down...? Wanna bet?
BMD\t「いい女に手を出すっていうのには/ リスクが付きものよん？」: Making a move on a fine woman/　always comes with risks, y'know?
BMD\t「ああっ、キョウスケぇっ！/ ……って乗ってくる人じゃないのよね」: Ahh, Kyosuke!/　...Not that he'd ever play along.
BMD\t「ちょっとお！ なんかインチキしてない！？」: Hey! Aren't you cheating or something!?
BMD\t「わ、ちょっとお！ タンマタンマ！」: Wh-Whoa, hey! Time out, time out!
BMD\t「やっばあ……！/ まだ動くけど……もう……」: Yikes...!/　It still moves, but... it's about to...
BMD\t「いたた……話が違くない……！？」: Ow ow... That's not what I was told...!?
BMD\t「いやん！ 未婚のまま死ねないって！」: Eek! I can't die an unmarried woman!
BMD\t「ちょっと！ 女の子いじめすぎよ！」: Hey! Quit bullying a girl so much!
BMD\t「女の子にはフェザータッチが基本よ！」: A girl calls for a feather touch!
BMD\t「ヴァイスちゃんの珠のお肌……/ もうボロボロねえ……」: Poor Weiss's jewel-like skin.../　It's all in tatters now...
BMD\t「ヴァイスちゃん、/ もうちょっとがんばってよ！？」: Come on, Weiss,/　hang in there a bit longer, okay!?
BMD\t「当たっちゃ駄目でしょ！/ やわこいんだから！」: You can't get hit!/　You're all soft!
BMD\t「アルトちゃん、丈夫さが取り柄なんでしょ！」: Alt, being tough is your whole/　selling point, isn't it!
BMD\t「いやん、これじゃキョウスケに/ お仕置きされちゃう！」: Eek, at this rate Kyosuke's/　gonna punish me!
BMD\t「わお、ゲシュちゃんじゃ限界？/ これじゃ、ほんとに幽霊に……」: Whoa, is Gesh at its limit?/　At this rate, I'll really be a ghost...
BMD\t「ジガンちゃんも、もうヘロヘロね……」: Poor Jigan's all worn out too...
BMD\t「最強の盾って言われてるんでしょ？/ 頑張ってよね、ジガンちゃん！」: You're the ultimate shield, right?/　Hang in there, Jigan!
BMD\t「ちょっと、これじゃ見かけ倒しじゃない、/ グルンちゃんってば！」: Hey, you're all show and no go,/　Grun!
BMD\t「あっちゃあ～、/ 大きな体して、ちょっとだらしなくない！？」: Oh boy.../　All that bulk and still this flimsy!?
BMD\t「ヒュッケバインでもこのダメージ！？/ おかしくない！？」: This much damage, even on a Hückebein!?/　Isn't that weird!?
BMD\t「くっ！ 斧だけにＯＨ！ ＮＯ！/ ……とか言ってる場合じゃないわね」: Ugh! That axe is axe-tremely painful!/　...Okay, no time for puns.
BMD\t「こ、こっちはドロンする気なんてないのよね！」: I-I've got no plans to vanish/　in a puff of smoke, you know!
BMD\t「さ、さすがにやるわね、/ 四凶の超機人は……！」: Y-You really are tough,/　Choukijin of the Four Fiends...!
BMD\t「こ、ここは神頼みってわけには/ いかないわよねぇ……！」: I-I guess I can't just pray/　to the gods this time, huh...!
BMD\t「い、色々言ってる割には、/ 私を倒せないじゃない……！？」: F-For all your big talk,/　you still can't beat me, can you...!?
BMD\t「だから、アインストじゃないってのに！」: I told you, I'm not an Einst!
BMD\t「くう～！ 見た目通りの剛腕ね！」: Ugh! You're as strong as you look!
BMD\t「くっ！/ たった一人でやれることなんて、/ 限られてるんじゃない！？: Ugh!/　There's only so much one person/　can do alone, you know!?
BMD\t「くううっ！/ 反省はしても、絶望なんてしないから！」: Ngh!/　I'll reflect on it, but I won't despair!
BMD\t「ペ、ペルフェク、ペルフェテ……/ やっぱり、言いにくいわ～」: P-Perfek, Perfet.../　It's still such a mouthful...
BMD\t「くっ！ まだここからよ、仙人さん！」: Ugh! I'm just getting started, hermit!
BMD\t「わお、なかなか大胆な攻撃じゃなぁい？」: Whoa, pretty bold attack, isn't it?
BMD\t「蝶のように舞い、蜂のように……/ って、あ、痛った！ 痛ったぁい！！: Float like a butterfly, sting like a.../　Ah, ow! Owww!!
BMD\t「あたた！ なかなかパンチのある攻撃ねえ！」: Ouch! That attack's got some real punch!
BMD\t「なんか気合い入ってない？/ 楽にいきましょ？」: Putting a lot of Spirit into it, huh?/　Let's take it easy, 'kay?
BMD\t「いやん、これじゃジリ貧じゃなぁい！」: Eek, I'm getting whittled down here!
BMD\t「遊びが過ぎたか」: Seems I played around too long.
BMD\t「それほど困りはしない」: That's hardly a problem for me.
BMD\t「では、僕も行くとしよう」: Well then, I suppose I'll go too.
BMD\t「泰北、後は僕がやろう」: Taihoku, leave the rest to me.
BMD\t「まだ僕がいるのさ」: You still have me to deal with.
BMD\t「まあ、見逃すわけにはいかないか」: Well, I can't exactly let this slide.
BMD\t「まあ、守る必要はないだろうが……」: Not that he needs protecting, but...
BMD\t「バラルの神に手出しはさせない」: I won't let you lay a hand on Baral's god.
BMD\t「さあ、肉の体を捨てるがいい！」: Now, cast off your body of flesh!
BMD\t「焔天大聖前朱雀避口舌」: Great Sage of Flame Heaven, Vermilion/　Bird before me, ward off all slander!
BMD\t「黒蛇よ、空を裂き、地を疾れ！」: Black serpent, rend the sky and race/　across the earth!
LDBI\t「いずれにせよ、アルテウルは死んだのよ。@ 今、詮索しても仕方がない: Either way, Arteur is dead.@There's no point digging into it now.
LDBI\t「うん……あの子にあんな力があったなんて……。@ もしかして、バラル: Yeah... I never knew she had that kind of power...@I'm starting to wonder if she's tied to Baral...
LDBI\t「あたし達の所からいなくなって、バラルに行って……@ もしかしたら、: She left us and went to Baral...@Maybe she and the Custos are...
LDBI\t「……思い当たる節はいくつかあるわね」: ...A few things do come to mind.
LDBI\t「イルイちゃんとクストースに関係があるとしたら……@ 私達を何度か助: If Irui's connected to the Custos...@then the times they saved us...
LDBI\t「だが、バラルの園が浮上した後、@ 魚型のクストースは私達に牙を剥い: But after the Garden of Baral surfaced,@the fish-type Custos bared its fangs at us.
LDBI\t「でも、メリデンプルムへの道を開いてくれた……」: But it opened the way to Meridemplum...
LDBI\t「それは、利害関係が一致したからだ。@ クストースはバラルに与するも: Only because our interests aligned.@The Custos side with Baral... They're our enemy.
LDBI\t「イルイも……そうだって言うの？@ ペルフェクティオが負の波動を放っ: Are you saying Irui is too?@When Perfectio unleashed its negative waves,@Irui was the one who gave us courage...
LDBI\t「……もしかしたら、イルイが私達と出会ったのは@ 偶然じゃないのかも: ...Maybe it wasn't by chance@that Irui met us...
LDBI\t「じゃあ、何のために？@ あの子はあたし達と接触して、@ 何をするつ: Then why? What did she want@by getting close to us?@What was she planning to do?
LDBI\t「もし、バラルがイルイを連れ去ったのだとしたら、@ その理由は……」: If Baral really did take Irui away,@then the reason must be...
LDBI\t「あの子が見せた力と関係があるんだろうな……」: It's gotta have to do with that power she showed...
LDBI\t「それに、イルイちゃんが言っていた@ 最後に出来ることって……？」: And what did Irui mean by@the last thing she could do...?
LDBI\t「……イルイの所在も含めて、@ 我らの目で確かめるしかあるまい。@: ...We have no choice but to see for ourselves,@Irui's whereabouts included.@We go to the Garden of Baral.
LDBI\t（そうだ……あそこへ行くしかない。そして……）: (That's right... I have to go there. And then...)
LDBI\t「艦長、各機の収容が完了しました。@ なお、ドクトル・クリフやワン博: Captain, all units have been recovered.@Also, Doctor Cliff, Dr. Wang, and the others@will stay behind to investigate the Cross Gate.
LDBI\t「まもなく、連邦軍部隊がここへ到着します。@ ここの警備は……」: A Federation Forces unit will arrive shortly.@As for guarding this site...
LDBI\t「バラルの孫光龍から通信が入っています！」: We're receiving a transmission from Baral's Son Koryu!
LDBI\t「祝電……というわけではないでしょうな」: I doubt he's calling to congratulate us.
LDBI\t「やあ、バラルの孫光龍だよ！」: Hi there, it's Baral's Son Koryu!
LDBI\t「何だ、ノリが悪いねぇ……@ こっちはハッピーなんだ、君達が“破滅の: What, no enthusiasm? Tough crowd...@I'm in a great mood, thanks to you sealing@away the "King of Destruction."
LDBI\t「そこで、そのお礼として@ 君達をバラルの園へご招待することにした」: So, as thanks, I've decided to invite@you all to the Garden of Baral.
LDBI\t「君達を労うためさ。盛大な酒宴を用意するよ」: To reward your efforts. I'll throw a grand feast.
LDBI\t「そこで出されるのは……四凶の超機人や雀武王、@ 妖機人ですかな？」: And on the menu would be... the Four Evils@Choukijin, the JakuBuOh, and Yokijin, perhaps?
LDBI\t「何だ、やる気満々だねぇ」: My, aren't you raring to go.
LDBI\t「人間をやめる気はありませんので」: I have no intention of giving up being human.
LDBI\t「まあ、直接会ってじっくり話そうか。@ バラルの門を開けるから、来て: Well, let's have a nice long chat in person.@I'll open the Gate of Baral, so do come by.
LDBI\t「その名の通り、僕達の居処に通じる入口……@ 結界にちょっと穴を開け: Just what it sounds like, an entrance to our home...@I'll poke a little hole in the barrier.
LDBI\t「ただし、招待するのは君達だけだからね。@ 他の者を連れてくると、み: But the invitation's for you alone, got it?@Bring anyone else and they'll all die, okay?
LDBI\t「何とも大胆不敵ですな。いかが致します？」: How brazen of him. What shall we do?
LDBI\t「ジェイコブ・ムーア中将に報告し、@ バラルの園へ向かいます」: I'll report to Lieutenant General Jacob Moore,@and then we head for the Garden of Baral.
LDBI\t「バリアを突破する手間は省けますが、@ 確実に罠が仕掛けられておりま: It saves us the trouble of breaching the barrier,@but they've surely set a trap for us.
LDBI\t「しかし、今という状況では@ 私達が対応するしかないでしょう」: Even so, given the current situation,@we're the only ones who can deal with this.
LDBI\t「副長、直ちにバラルの園との@ ランデヴー・シーケンスの構築を。@: XO, set up a rendezvous sequence with the@Garden of Baral at once. I'll contact Lieutenant@General Jacob and request resupply.
LDBI\t「……現在対地高度２５０キロメートル。@ バラルの園とのランデヴー・: ...Current altitude, 250 kilometers.@Rendezvous sequence with the Garden of Baral@is moving to Phase 3.
LDBI\t「バラルの門が開かれる素振りはありますか？」: Any sign of the Gate of Baral opening?
LDBI\t「いえ、まだのようです。念のため、@ 艦首超重力衝撃砲とトロニウム・: No, not yet. Just in case, shall we prepare@the Hypergravity Impact Cannon and the@Tronium Buster Cannon for firing?
LDBI\t「バラルの門が開かれたと同時に先制攻撃……ですか」: A preemptive strike the moment the gate opens...?
LDBI\t「まあ、招かれておいて不躾ではありますが」: Granted, it'd be rude after being invited.
LDBI\t「バラルの園はＨ‐ＭＡＰＷの直撃を@ しのいでいますし、孫光龍の口振: The Garden of Baral withstood a direct H-MAPW@hit, and judging from Son Koryu's words,@a first strike would likely be pointless.
LDBI\t「やはり、後手に回らざるを得ませんか……」: So we have no choice but to react, then...
LDBI\t「……ここからだと、地球は青く見えるんだな」: ...From up here, the Earth looks blue.
LDBI\t「うん……バラルのバリアの下だもんね」: Yeah... we're under Baral's barrier, after all.
LDBI\t「地球は黄緑だった、って……何か語呂が悪いもんね。@ やっぱり青くな: "The Earth was yellow-green"... just doesn't sound@right, does it? It's gotta be blue.
LDBI\t「そうだな。@ そのためには、何としてもバラルの連中を@ ブッ飛ばさ: Yeah.@And for that, we gotta blast those Baral@creeps no matter what.
LDBI\t「そうか……初めてだったな」: Right... It's your first time seeing it.
BMD\t「格闘戦の訓練もしてたんだから！」: I trained in close combat too, you know!
BMD\t「何としても当ててみせるっ！」: I'll land this hit no matter what!
BMD\t「天からの一撃、受けなさい！！」: Take this strike from the heavens!!
BMD\t「それで終わりか、人間！」: Is that all you've got, human?
BMD\t「ふん、そのマシーン……目障りだな」: Hmph, that machine... It's an eyesore.
BMD\t「そんなものを介さず、/ ストレートに憎しみをぶつけろ！」: Don't hide behind that thing!/　Hit me with your hatred, straight on!
BMD\t「ふん、貴様もある意味欠陥体だな」: Hmph. In a way, you're defective too.
BMD\t「ラキ、そんなもので俺は倒せんぞ！」: That won't take me down, Lakhi!
BMD\t「ハハハッ！ 欠陥体のお前じゃ無理だ！」: Hahaha! A defective like you can't do it!
BMD\t「ハハハッ！ 何だよ、それは！」: Hahaha! What the hell was that?
BMD\t「そんなもので俺を倒そうってのか！」: You think that's enough to beat me?
BMD\t「馬鹿め、そんな攻撃で！」: Fool! With an attack like that?
BMD\t「クククッ、感じるぞ、貴様の憎しみを！」: Heh heh heh... I can feel your hatred!
BMD\t「チッ、これ以上はやれねえか」: Tch, can't push it any further.
BMD\t「こっちのレンジ外か。/ 少しは考えているじゃないか」: Staying out of my range, huh?/　So you do use your head a little.
BMD\t「ハハハッ！/ 感じるぞ、貴様の恐怖を、怯えた心を！」: Hahaha!/　I can feel your fear, your cowering heart!
BMD\t「貴様もこれで終わりだ！」: This is the end for you too!
BMD\t「恐怖に抱かれて死ね！」: Die in the embrace of fear!
BMD\t「俺とお前がいりゃ、/ あんな人間共、あっと言う間だ！」: With you and me together,/　we'll wipe out those humans in no time!
BMD\t「安心しろ！ 今、消し去ってやる！」: Relax! I'll erase you right now!
BMD\t「さあ、焼き尽くしてやるぞ！」: Now, I'll burn you to ashes!
BMD\t「慌てなくても、端から死なせてやる！」: No need to rush. You'll all die in turn!
BMD\t「さあ、悔しさに胸をかきむしれ！」: Now, claw at your chest in frustration!
BMD\t「絶望の果てに憎悪を抱えて！」: Clutching hatred at the end of despair!
BMD\t「何者であろうと、敵ならば！」: Whoever you are, if you're an enemy...!
BMD\t「うぐっ！ 動力系にダメージが！」: Ugh! The power systems are damaged!
BMD\t「こ、これ以上はもたんか……！？」: I-I can't hold out much longer...?!
BMD\t「ぐっ！ 国境警備隊の意地を見せてやる！」: Ngh! I'll show you the Border Guard's grit!
BMD\t「ぐううっ……！/ 中尉達の足を引っ張るわけには……！」: Nggh...!/　I can't be a burden to the Lieutenants...!
BMD\t「まだだ、まだいける！」: Not yet, I can still go!
BMD\t「致命傷じゃない、まだ戦える！」: It's not fatal. I can still fight!
BMD\t「くっ、対応できなかった！」: Ngh, I couldn't react in time!
BMD\t「リューネ殿、後は自分が！」: Lüne, leave the rest to me!

BMD\t「どうした？ 鋼龍戦隊の意地を見せてみろ」: What's the matter? Show me/　the Steel Dragons' spirit.

BMD\t「ほう、エア・クリスマスに目を付けたか」: Oh? So you've set your sights/　on the Air Christmas.

BMD\t「どうした、イング？ それで終わりか？」: What's wrong, Ing? Is that all?
BMD\t「お前の力は、その程度ではあるまい」: Surely that's not all you've got.
BMD\t「フン、蛮勇だけでこの艦は沈められんぞ」: Hmph. Reckless courage alone/　won't sink this ship.
BMD\t「鋼龍戦隊の力は、そんなものではなかろう？」: The Steel Dragons' power is/　greater than that, surely?
BMD\t「鋼龍戦隊など、恐るるに足らん」: The Steel Dragons are nothing to fear.

BMD\t「その程度でこの艦に挑んでくるとはな」: And with only that, you dare/　challenge this ship?
BMD\t「我らに歯向かう愚かさを知れ」: Learn the folly of defying us.
BMD\t「フッ、面白い見せ物だった」: Heh. That was an entertaining show.
BMD\t「艦長、仕留めてみせろ」: Captain, show me you can finish it.

BMD\t「はっ。上部主砲、撃て！！」: Yes, sir. Upper Main Cannon, fire!!
BMD\t「艦長、遠慮はいらん。主砲を使え」: Captain, don't hold back./　Use the Main Cannon.

BMD\t「分の悪い賭けは嫌いじゃない……！」: I never did mind a long shot...!

BMD\t「好き勝手にはやらせん！」: I won't let you do as you please!
BMD\t「賭けるか？ これで落ちるかどうか……！」: Want to bet on whether this drops you...?

BMD\t「その動き……命取りになる！」: That move... will be your undoing!
BMD\t「その手では勝てんぞ……！」: You can't win with that hand...!

BMD\t「おれとアルト向きの距離だ……！」: Just the range for Alt and me...!
BMD\t「出る杭は、撃ち貫かれる……！」: The nail that sticks out gets shot...!
BMD\t「アラドのかつての仲間と言えど、/ 敵ならば容赦はしない……！」: Arado's former comrade or not,/　if you're the enemy, I won't hold back...!
BMD\t「道を正すつもりがないのなら……！」: If you won't change your ways...!

BMD\t「お前は、/ 己の運命の受け入れ方を間違った……！」: You chose the wrong way/　to accept your fate...!

BMD\t「お前の野心がどうであろうと、/ おれには関係ない……！」: Whatever your ambitions may be,/　they don't concern me...!
BMD\t「メリオルエッセ……おれを止められるか？」: Meliores Esse... think you can stop me?
BMD\t「そう簡単に絶望などせんぞ……！」: I don't give in to despair that easily!

BMD\t「ウンブラ、お前の御託に興味はない」: Umbra, I've no interest in your drivel.
BMD\t「孫光龍……お前のショーに興味はない」: Son Koryu... I've no interest in your show.
BMD\t「光龍、お前の暇潰しに付き合う気はない」: Koryu, I'm not here to help you kill time.
BMD\t「龍ならば、その逆鱗ごと打ち砕く……！」: If you're a dragon.../　I'll crush you, reverse scale and all...!
BMD\t「あの大きさなら、/ 狙いをそれほど絞る必要はないな」: At that size,/　I hardly need to aim carefully.
BMD\t「桃源郷などに興味はない……！」: I've no interest in your Shangri-La...!
BMD\t「真っ向勝負というわけか、ロフ。/ いいだろう……！」: Head-on, is it, Rof?/　Fine by me...!
BMD\t「そのふざけた態度がどこまで保つか……！」: How long will that smug act last...!
BMD\t「セティ……/ やることはインスペクターと同じか」: Sety.../　You're no different from the Inspectors.

BMD\t「お前がルイーナの頭ならば……潰す！」: If you lead the Ruina... I'll crush you!
BMD\t「お前達は最後の一手でしくじる……！」: You'll blow it on your final move...!
BMD\t「お前達の題目が、/ いつまでも通用すると思うな」: Don't think that slogan of yours/　will work forever.
BMD\t「名誉などいらん。無論、汚名もな……！」: I don't want honor. Or infamy, either!
BMD\t「お前達の真意はわかった。/ ならば、やることは一つだ」: Now I know your true intent./　Then there's only one thing to do.
BMD\t「ガイアセイバーズ……ただで済むと思うなよ」: Gaia Savers... you'll pay for this.
BMD\t「その機体を止める。待っていろ……！」: I'll stop that machine. Just wait...!
BMD\t「胡散臭さは、見た目だけではないらしいな」: So you're shady in more than looks.
BMD\t「相応の代償を払ってもらうぞ。/ こちらの手を知りたければな」: You'll pay a fitting price/　if you want to see my hand.
BMD\t「全部入りというわけか。豪勢だな」: All the bells and whistles, huh? Fancy.
BMD\t「隊長機……頭を取る！」: The commander unit... I'll take the head!

LDBI\t「頭目はてめえだったな。聞きてえことがある」: You were the ringleader, right?@I've got some questions for you.
LDBI\t「ほう、まだそんな口が利けるのか。@ その生意気な口は……この口か！: Oh, still got some lip on you, huh?@Is this the smart mouth right here?!
LDBI\t「いっ！！ いひゃいっ！ いひゃいっ！！@ ふ、ふいわへん、いいわふ: Ow!! Owwie! Owwie!!@I-I'm thowwy, I'll talk! I thaid I'll talk!!
LDBI\t「そうそう、人間素直が一番だぜ」: That's right. Honesty's the best policy.

LDBI\t「拾ったって言うか……@ 酷い目に遭ったって言うか……」: Not so much picked her up as...@got clobbered by her...
LDBI\t「あらん、人聞き悪いわね。@ か弱い乙女をいきなり襲ったのは、@ ど: Ooh, you make it sound so bad.@And who was it who jumped@a poor, delicate maiden out of nowhere?
LDBI\t「……山賊は、機体を奪おうとして@ 返り討ちにあったのね」: ...So the bandits tried to steal her unit@and got beaten for their trouble.

LDBI\t「まあ、話の流れもあるし、情報収集のためにもね。@ いきなり<ラ・ギ: Well, one thing led to another, and I needed info.@I got dragged into <ラ・ギアス> out of nowhere,@so I was in a bit of a pickle.
LDBI\t「ええ。@ ラ・ギアスの話は、前にマーサからも聞いてたし、@ 山賊さ: Yep.@You'd told me about La Gias before, Maasa,@and the bandits filled me in, but...
LDBI\t「多分、この世界へ来たのは私だけじゃないわ。@ もしかしたら、一緒に: I doubt I'm the only one who ended up here.@Everyone in the Steel Dragons who was@on maneuvers with me might be here, too...
LDBI\t「ここしばらくのラ・ギアスの状況……@ 各勢力の動き、特にカークス軍: Fill me in on La Gias lately...@what the factions are up to, especially@the Kirkus army and the Schtedonias army.

LDBI\t「承知しました。お話し致しましょう」: As you wish. I shall tell you all.

LDBI\t「それがしはゴルド・バゴルドと申します。@ 今でこそ山賊なぞをやって: My name is Gold Bagold.@I may be a mere bandit now, but I once served@as a garrison captain in the Schtedonias army.

LDBI\t「……言っとくが、きびダンゴはねえぜ」: ...Just so you know, I've got no millet dumplings.

LDBI\t「じゃあ、まずは食い物でも……」: All right, first let's grab some food...

LDBI\t「あれは……ルザック州軍の機体だな」: Those are... Ruzac Provincial Army units.

LDBI\t「ああ。@ ルザックにはまだシュテドニアスの手が@ 伸びてねえようだ: Yeah.@Looks like Schtedonias hasn't gotten@its hands on Ruzac yet.

LDBI\t「……ねえねえ、マーサってば@ 地上じゃ迷子の子猫ちゃんだけど、@: ...Hey, hey, Maasa.@On Earth you're a lost little kitten,@but here you're some kind of big shot?

BMD\t「受けた痛みは、倍にして返す！！」: I'll pay you back double for that!!

BMD\t「売られたケンカは買ってやるぜ！」: You want a fight? You got one!
BMD\t「こっちは引き下がるつもりなんてねえんだ！」: I've got no intention of backing down!
LDBI\t「……殿下、カークス将軍から@ 戴冠式の日時と場所について連絡があり: ...Your Highness, General Kirkus has sent word@regarding the date and place of the coronation.@The details are here.

LDBI\t「ああ、開発スタッフも既に招集してある」: Yes, and the development staff is already here.

LDBI\t「兄さんやテリウスのことが心配だもの。@ デュラクシールについては、: I'm worried about you and Tellius.@As for the Duraxyll, I'll instruct the staff,@then finish it in one go once I'm back.

LDBI\t「そうよね……。@ でも、今、ここで私達が議論しても仕方がないわ。@: I know...@But arguing about it here won't help.@We have to guard His Highness at the ceremony...

LDBI\t「……あれがラングランの王子様……@ モニター越しで見るより素敵です: ...So that's Langran's prince...@He's even dreamier than on the monitor.
LDBI\t「ご一行は、艦に興味津々って感じだね。@ やっぱり、ラ・ギアスには宇: They seem really curious about the ship.@I guess La Gias doesn't have space@battleships.

LDBI\t「先方は戴冠式を延期すると言ってきた。@ 理由は……大神官ザボド卿の: They say the coronation has been postponed.@The reason... High Priest Zabod has fallen ill.
BMD\t「あとは実践あるのみ！」: Now all that's left is to put it into action!

BMD\t「メリオルエッセ相手でも怯むもんですか！」: Meliores Esse or not, I won't flinch!
BMD\t「ペルフェクティオ！/ 元いた世界へ帰りなさい！」: Perfectio!/　Go back to the world you came from!

BMD\t「ガイアセイバーズ……/ あなた達の思い通りにはさせない！」: Gaia Savers.../　I won't let things go your way!
BMD\t「こっちだって、/ 黙って引き下がるつもりはないわ！」: We're not about to just/　back down quietly either!
BMD\t「エルデ……もう倒すしかない……！」: Erde... There's no choice but to beat her!
BMD\t「あれは……エルデの怨念そのもの……！」: That thing... It's Erde's grudge itself!
BMD\t「エルデ・ミッテ……/ これで終わりにするわ……！」: Erde Mitte.../　This is where it ends...!
BMD\t「先生は、最初から知っていて……！」: She knew it all from the very start...!
BMD\t「ミッテ先生と戦いたくない……！/ だけど……だけど！」: I don't want to fight Professor Mitte!/　But... But!

BMD\t「ガンエデン……/ 地球の封印なんてさせないわ！」: Gan Eden.../　I won't let you seal the Earth away!
BMD\t「邪神などという代物が/ 存在しているとはな……！」: To think something like an evil god/　actually exists...!
BMD\t「ここでルイーナを阻止しなければ……！」: If we don't stop the Ruina here...!

BMD\t「四神であろうと、敵ならば倒す！」: Four Gods or not, I'll defeat any enemy!

BMD\t「！ これ以上は、/ いくらＲ‐２と言えども……！」: ! Any more of this,/　and even the R-2 won't...!

BMD\t「損傷度チェック……。/ 装甲の厚さが功を奏したか……！」: Checking damage.../　The thick armor paid off...!

LDBI\t「よくもまあ、量産機のブローウェルに@ あれだけの改造を施せたものね: I can't believe you managed to modify@a mass-produced Blowell that much...@I'm impressed, General Oort.
LDBI\t「お褒めに預かり、恐悦至極。@ ですが、陛下の大義を否定なさるのなら: I'm deeply honored by your praise.@But if you deny His Majesty's cause,@not even you will be spared, Lady Xenia!
LDBI\t「間近で見れば、噂通りの機体だとわかる……！@ 見た目は似ていても、: Up close, it lives up to the rumors...!@It may look like my unit, but its power@is on a whole other level!
LDBI\t「ルザック州の警備を任されていた@ トールス・ゼテキネス中尉だったな: Lieutenant Torres Zetekines, charged with@guarding Luzak Province, as I recall...
LDBI\t「ラングランの軍人でありながら、@ 陛下に弓引くとは……その罪、許し: A Langran soldier raising arms against@His Majesty... That crime is unforgivable!
LDBI\t「それがしにも資金があれば、@ あの機体と同様の改造を施すものを……: Had I but the funds, I would give mine@the very same modifications...!
LDBI\t「ふん、金だけでここまでの改造は出来ん！@ ブローウェルの全てを知り: Hmph, money alone can't buy mods like these!@It takes knowing every inch of the Blowell!
LDBI\t「見た目をさほど変えず、あそこまでのパワーを@ 引き出すなんて……か: Drawing out that much power without@changing the look much... You'd need serious@knowledge and dedication to pull that off...!
LDBI\t「むっ、見所のある少年よの。@ 敵にしておくのが惜しいわ」: Hmm, a promising lad, that one.@A shame he's on the enemy side.
LDBI\t「……ここまで来て、遠慮はいらぬ。@ 全力で来なければ、このデュラク: ...We've come this far. Hold nothing back.@Unless you come at me with everything you have,@you'll never stop this Duraxyll.
LDBI\t「フェイル！ 何があんたをこんな無謀な戦いに@ 駆り立ててるんだ！？: Feil! What's driving you into@such a reckless fight!?
LDBI\t「理由を知らねば、本気で私を討てぬか……」: So you can't strike me down in earnest@without knowing the reason...
LDBI\t「教えてやろう……@ 地上人をこの地に召喚し、混乱を引き起こした@: Then I'll tell you...@The blame for summoning surface dwellers here@and causing chaos... lies with me.
LDBI\t「言い訳に聞こえるだろうが……@ 召喚プログラムが事故で暴走してしま: It may sound like an excuse, but...@an accident sent the summoning program haywire,@and far more were summoned than we intended.
LDBI\t「事故の原因はいまだに不明……@ いや、事故ではなく、何者かが@ 仕: The cause of the accident is still unknown...@No--perhaps it was no accident, but@something someone engineered.
LDBI\t「だが、大量の地上人召喚により、@ ラ・ギアスを混乱させてしまったの: But the fact remains that summoning so many@surface dwellers threw La Gias into chaos.@There's no denying it.
LDBI\t「まさか、それを収拾する気で……！？」: Don't tell me you meant to clean that up...!?
LDBI\t「私とて、最初からラ・ギアス統一計画を@ 強行する気はなかった。だが: I never meant to force through my plan@to unify La Gias from the start. But when I@learned I had little time left to live...
LDBI\t「この命ある限り、責任を取ってみようと@ 考えたのもまた事実だ」: I resolved to make amends for as long@as I lived. That, too, is the truth.
LDBI\t「に、兄さん……命があと僅かって……！？」: B-Brother... What do you mean,@little time left...!?
LDBI\t「私は……理想実現のために@ 何としても王座が必要だった……」: I... needed the throne at any cost@to realize my ideals...
LDBI\t「そのためには、生来不足していた魔力を@ 強化しなければならなかった: And for that, I had to strengthen@the magic power I'd lacked since birth.
BMD\t「朱雀王って言うと、悪霊退散な感じね」: With a name like Suzaku King, it should/　be out exorcising evil spirits!

BMD\t「おおっと！ 意外にやりやがるぜ！」: Whoa! You're better than I thought!
BMD\t「結果を出せば、/ 過程なんざどうでもいいんだよ！」: As long as you get results,/　who cares how you get there!

BMD\t「チッ！ 勝負はまだこれからだぜ！」: Tch! This fight's just getting started!

LDBI\t「ば、馬鹿な……！@ あれだけの戦力で、ここまで……！！」: I-Impossible...!@Against forces like that... to come this far...!!
LDBI\t「答えろ、イーグレット・フェフ！@ お前の本当の目的は何だ！？@ 何: Answer me, Egret Fehu!@What's your true objective?!@Why did you give me life and power?!
LDBI\t「す、全てを……見届けられなかったのが……@ 残念だ……」: T-To think I couldn't... see it all through...@A pity...
LDBI\t「くっ！ あの男を引きずり出してでも、答えを！」: Tch! I'll drag him out if I have to@and get my answers!
LDBI\t「む、無駄だ……これもまた、一つの結果……」: I-It's no use... This too is one outcome...
LDBI\t「だが、あの様子では例え口を割ったとしても、@ それが真実かどうか定: But in that state, even if he talked,@there'd be no telling whether it was the truth.
LDBI\t「まだアルテウルとアーマラが残っている。@ 全てが闇に葬られたわけで: Arteur and Amala still remain.@Not everything has been buried in darkness.
LDBI\t「フッ、パパを殺されて@ 僕が悲しんだり、激昂するとでも思ったかい？: Heh. Did you think I'd grieve or rage@over Papa being killed?
LDBI\t「まあ、仕方がないよね。@ パパはマシンナリー・チルドレンの創造主だ: Well, it couldn't be helped.@Papa may have created the Machinery Children,@but he's not like me.
LDBI\t「……パパっ子だと思ってたけど、@ そうじゃなかったってわけ？」: ...I had you pegged as a daddy's boy,@but I guess not, huh?
LDBI\t「フッ……オリジネイターである僕が残っていれば、@ 目的は果たせるの: Heh... As long as I, the Originator, remain,@the goal can still be achieved.
LDBI\t「だが、その前にイング……お前を殺す。@ パパがお前に何をさせようと: But first, Ing... I'm going to kill you.@I don't know what Papa had planned@for you, but...
LDBI\t「僕の世界にイーグレット・イングという存在は@ 必要ないからね」: There's no place for anything called@Egret Ing in my world.
LDBI\t「そうだ、イング！@ コピーがオリジナルを超えるなど、@ 許されない: That's right, Ing!@A copy surpassing the original...@is something that can't be allowed!
LDBI\t「……フン、ここまで来ただけのことはあるか……！@ だが、言ったはず: ...Hmph, guess you earned your way here...!@But I told you...
LDBI\t「ハハハ！ 僕は何度でも甦る！@ <マシンセル>がある限り、何度でも: Hahaha! I'll rise again and again!@As long as I have <マシンセル>,@I'll come back every time!
LDBI\t「お前達が死んでも、僕は存在し続ける！@ 真のガイアセイバーズとして: Even when you're all dead, I'll go on existing!@As the true Gaia Savers!@No, as the ruler of Earth!

LDBI\t「この世界で彼らが栄えていたのは、数千万年前……@ 我々と同等か、そ: They flourished here tens of millions of years@ago... It seems they were as intelligent as we@are, if not more so. Fossils have shown as much.
LDBI\t「だが、巨人族は大異変により、滅亡した。@ 生きとし生けるもの全てに: But the giants were wiped out in a cataclysm,@leaving behind a terrible grudge against@every living thing...
LDBI\t「いかん！ みんな、機体に戻れ！」: This is bad! Everyone, back to your machines!
LDBI\t「マジでモンスターが出て来やがったぜ！」: Whoa, actual monsters just showed up!
LDBI\t「あれは、死霊の霊気を土塊に宿らせた兵器だ」: They're weapons made by binding the spirits of@the dead into lumps of earth.
LDBI\t「ヤンロン、@ デモンゴーレムが現れたとなると……」: Yang Long,@if Demon Golems are here...
LDBI\t「ああ、近くに術者がいる可能性が高い。@ 事態は僕達が思っているより: Yes, there's likely a sorcerer nearby.@Things may be further along@than we thought.
LDBI\t「それは何とも言えん。@ ヴォルクルスの神殿は複数存在するからな。@: I can't say for sure.@There are several temples to Volkruss.@Either way, let's defeat them and push deeper.
LDBI\t「よし、ここのデモンゴーレムは全て倒したな。@ 奥へ進もう」: Good, that's all the Demon Golems here.@Let's go deeper.
LDBI\t「やはり、祭壇が……！」: An altar, just as I thought...!
LDBI\t「ズィーガーリオン！ レオナか！？」: That's the Siegerlion! Leona, is that you!?
LDBI\t「ほう……やはり、彼らとお知り合いでしたか」: Oh my... So you are acquainted with them after all.
LDBI\t「お久しぶりですな、ヤンロン殿」: It has been a long time, Master Yang Long.
LDBI\t「何なんだ、あいつは！？」: Who the hell is that guy!?
LDBI\t「魔神官ルオゾール……@ ヴォルクルスに仕える闇の神官だ」: The dark priest Luozorl...@A servant of Volkruss.
LDBI\t「ご紹介いただき、ありがとうございます。@ それにしても、地盤崩落を: Thank you for the kind introduction.@Still, to come here so soon after learning of@the cave-in... Impressive as always.
LDBI\t「てめえ、レオナをどうする気だ！？」: You bastard, what're you doing with Leona!?
LDBI\t「彼女は、なかなか興味深い波動を@ 持っておられましたので……ヴォル: She possessed a most intriguing wave pattern...@so I thought she might serve as a sacrifice@to Lord Volkruss.
LDBI\t「そこにも彼女と同じものを持っておられる方が@ 二人ほどいらっしゃる: Though it seems two among you possess the same@thing she does.
LDBI\t「レオナを生け贄にして、@ ヴォルクルスが甦るのか？」: If Leona is sacrificed,@will Volkruss be revived?
LDBI\t「魔術の法則に“類似の法則”というものがある。@ ヴォルクルスは恐怖: Magic has what's called the Law of Similarity.@Volkruss is a mass of emotions like fear,@hatred and rage.
LDBI\t「類似の法則に従えば、@ 外形や本質の似たものは互いに影響し合う」: By the Law of Similarity, things alike in form@or essence influence one another.
LDBI\t「つまり、生け贄の恐怖が同じ負の存在……@ ヴォルクルスを召喚するキ: In other words, the victim's fear is the key to@summoning a being of the same negativity...@Volkruss.
LDBI\t「お詳しいですな、ヤンロン殿。@ 我がヴォルクルス教団にご入信いただ: You are well informed, Master Yang Long.@Were you to join our Volkruss cult, you might@become a priest of some standing.
LDBI\t「怪力乱神を語らず、と言うがな。@ 貴様の妄言には惑わされんぞ」: The wise don't speak of the uncanny, they say.@I won't be swayed by your ravings.
LDBI\t「これ以上、この神殿を荒らされては困りますのでな。@ 大人しく立ち去: I cannot let you defile this temple any further.@Would you be so kind as to leave quietly?
LDBI\t「貴様を見逃すわけにはいかんな」: I can't let you go free.
LDBI\t「やれやれ、わかりました。@ では、生け贄の儀式が終わるまで、@ こ: My, my. Very well.@Then until the sacrificial ritual is complete,@I shall have you entertain these creatures.
LDBI\t「ここは我が神の神殿内……@ 先程のデモンゴーレムより@ 力が増して: This is within my god's temple...@These are stronger than the Demon Golems@you faced earlier.
LDBI\t「あのルオゾールって奴をやっつければ、@ 何とかなるんじゃないの？」: If we just take out that Luozorl guy,@won't that solve everything?
LDBI\t「今の僕達の装備では不可能だ。@ 奴の咒霊機ナグツァートは、その半身: Not with our current equipment.@Half of his cursed machine, Nagzadd, exists in@the astral plane, so we can't damage it.
LDBI\t「どうにもなりませんよ。@ あなた方もこの状況に恐怖なさい。@ それ: There is nothing you can do.@Fear this situation, all of you.@That fear will nourish my god.
LDBI\t「いえ、むしろあなた方も生け贄にして@ 差し上げましょう。拒否される: No--in fact, I shall make sacrifices of you too.@Should you refuse, you will instead be cast@into the depths of the netherworld.
LDBI\t「ふむ……@ 恐怖のあまり、おかしくなられましたかな？」: Hmm...@Has the fear driven you mad?
LDBI\t「いや、むしろ嬉しいぐらいだぜ。@ ようやく愛しのレオナちゃんを@: Nah, I'm actually kinda happy.@I finally found my sweet Leona,@after all.
LDBI\t「フッ……身の程知らずのお方ですね」: Heh... You don't know your place, do you?
LDBI\t「てめえこそ、あたしらを甘く見るんじゃねえぞ！@ こっちにゃ、鋼龍戦: Don't you underestimate us either, pal!@We've got three of the Steel Dragons' wildest@Assault junkies right here!
LDBI\t「俺達の仲間を生け贄なんかにはさせねえぞ！」: We won't let you sacrifice one of our friends!
LDBI\t「ここまで来ると言うのですか？ 愚かな……」: You mean to come all the way here? Fools...
LDBI\t「馬鹿野郎！ 俺の愛の力をなめんじゃねえぜ！！」: Moron! Don't you dare underestimate my love!!
LDBI\t（む……負の念の集束率が……@ あの者達の覇気に影響されているとでも: (Hm... The convergence of negative energy...@Could it be affected by their fighting spirit?)
LDBI\t「生け贄の儀式は進行中だ。@ １０分以内に彼女を助けなければ、@ 手: The sacrificial ritual is in progress.@If we don't save her within 10 minutes,@it may be too late.
LDBI\t「それだけありゃ、充分だ！@ 行くぞ、野郎共！ まずはレオナを助け出: That's plenty!@Let's go, boys! First, we rescue Leona!
LDBI\t「みんな、タイムリミットまで@ あと１分ほどしかないぞ！」: Everyone, we've only got about@a minute left before time runs out!
LDBI\t「でも、誰かが陛下を止めないと……@ マサキ達がやってきたことが無意: But someone has to stop His Majesty...@Or everything Masaki's group did means nothing.
LDBI\t「……今までフェイルロード陛下と幾度か@ 話をした上での所見だが……: ...Having spoken with His Majesty a few times,@I don't take him for a man who jumps to@rash conclusions.
LDBI\t「それに、急激な力の行使は強い反発を生む。@ <ＤＣ戦争>の時、我々: Besides, a sudden show of force breeds fierce@resistance. Just as we stood up to Bian Zoldark@during the <ＤＣ戦争>.
LDBI\t「フェイルロード陛下もそのことは承知しているはずだ。@ にも関わらず: His Majesty must be aware of that as well.@And yet, if he's still rushing things...@he may have reasons of his own.
LDBI\t「個人的には、それが知りたい。@ 奇縁とは言え、共に戦った間柄として: Personally, that's what I'd like to know.@Odd as our meeting was, we fought side by side.
LDBI\t「殿下の心変わりの理由か……」: Why the prince changed his mind, huh...
LDBI\t「だが、我々には地上での責務がある。@ ヒリュウ改と共に自分達の世界: But we have our duties on the surface.@We must take the Hiryu Custom back to our world.@Sorry, Masaki... Can you guide us to Seb Temple?
LDBI\t「ここでお会いしたのも何かの縁です。@ しばらくの間、相手をしていた: Running into you here must be fate of a sort.@Allow me to keep you company for a while.
LDBI\t「ちっ、こんな時に！ 艦長、出撃するぜ！」: Tch, of all times! Captain, I'm heading out!
LDBI\t「……一つお聞きしますが、@ 何故、あなた方はフェイルロード陛下の@: ...May I ask you one thing?@Why have you not joined@His Majesty Feilroad's forces?
LDBI\t「てめえにそんなことを教える義理はねえ！」: I don't owe you any answers!
LDBI\t「そうですか……。@ あなた方がフェイル軍に加わらないのなら、@ 私: I see...@If you will not join Feil's army,@that is quite convenient for us.
LDBI\t「ラングラン、シュテドニアスの両軍が@ 決定打に欠けた戦力で交戦すれ: If the Langran and Schtedonias armies clash@with forces lacking a decisive edge,@they will soon fall into a stalemate.
LDBI\t「そして、それはラングランにさらなる混乱を招き……@ 私達は行動し易: And that will bring Langran further chaos...@making it easier for us to act.
LDBI\t「つまり、フェイルロード陛下の行いは、@ 間接的にヴォルクルス様の復: In other words, one might say King Feilroad's@actions are indirectly aiding the resurrection@of Lord Volkruss.
LDBI\t「誰も陛下を止められぬのでしたら、尚更よし。@ 結果的に、我らの悲願: If none can stop him, so much the better.@It only hastens the day our dearest wish@is fulfilled.
LDBI\t「では、行きますぞ。@ 邪魔者の数は、少しでも減らしておきたいので」: Now then, let us begin.@I would like to reduce the number of nuisances,@even if only a little.
LDBI\t「うるせえ！ @ 邪魔してきたのは、てめえの方だろうが！」: Shut up!@You're the one who's been getting in our way!
LDBI\t（……地上人の部隊を合流させると@ カークス将軍が不利になりますから: (...If the surfacers' unit joins them,@General Kirkus will be at a disadvantage.@I must stall them here.)
LDBI\t「……さて、そろそろいいでしょう。@ ランドール殿、またどこかでお会: ...Well, I think that will do.@Sir Randall, until we meet again.
LDBI\t「ここで深追いは禁物よ、マサキ！@ 残ったデモンゴーレムを片づけまし: Don't chase him too far, Masaki!@Let's clean up the remaining Demon Golems!
LDBI\t「ここで深追いは禁物よ、マサキ！」: Don't chase him too far, Masaki!
LDBI\t「デモンゴーレムの反応、全て消えました！」: All Demon Golem signatures are gone!
LDBI\t「よし、対地対空警戒を厳となせ。@ 各機を帰艦させろ」: Good. Maintain a strict air and ground watch.@Recall all units.
LDBI\t「……懸念していたことが、実際に起きたわね」: ...What we feared has actually come to pass.
LDBI\t「ええ。ルオゾールは、現在の情勢を@ 好機と見なしていました」: Yes. Luozorl saw the current situation@as an opportunity.
LDBI\t「今回はデモンゴーレムで済んだけど、@ あれがヴォルクルスの分身だっ: This time it was only Demon Golems, but@if it had been one of Volkruss's Afterimages...
LDBI\t「……認めたくはねえが、@ ルオゾールの言うことは、もっともだ」: ...I hate to admit it,@but Luozorl's got a point.
LDBI\t「フェイル殿下の動きは、混乱の源になってる。@ そして、そこに付け込: Prince Feil's actions are causing this chaos.@And there are guys who'll take advantage of it...
LDBI\t「ルオゾールだけじゃねえ、下手すりゃカークスも。@ やっぱり、今、殿: Not just Luozorl--Kirkus too, if we're unlucky.@We've gotta stop the prince, and right now.
LDBI\t「フェイル陛下は部隊を引き連れて、@ ナゴール湾に向かっているんでし: King Feil is leading his troops@toward Nagor Bay, isn't he?
LDBI\t「今からサイバスターで追いかける。@ そして、もう一度……殿下と話し: I'm going after him in Cybuster right now.@And I'll try talking to the prince... once more.
LDBI\t「それでも向こうが引き下がらなかったら、@ どうするつもりだ？」: And if he still won't back down,@what do you plan to do?
LDBI\t「そん時は……力ずくでも殿下を止めるぜ」: Then...@I'll stop the prince, even if it takes force.
LDBI\t「ああ。世界存続の危機に際しては、全てを捨てて@ 立ち向かえ……俺に: Yeah. When the world's in peril, cast aside@everything and face it... Prince Feil himself@taught me that's a Masoukishin pilot's duty.
LDBI\t「……そういうことなら、私も行くわ。@ ただし、殿下と戦うためでなく: ...If that's how it is, I'm going too.@But not to fight the prince...@to talk with him and stop this war.
LDBI\t「俺だって、そのつもりさ」: That's what I've got in mind, too.
LDBI\t「あたしも行くよ。まだ間に合うと思うし」: I'm going too. I think there's still time.
LDBI\t「セニア、お前はこのままハガネに乗って、@ セブ神殿へ向かってくれ」: Xenia, you stay on the Hagane@and head for Seb Temple.
LDBI\t「ううん、あたしも一緒に行くわ。@ 兄さんの考えは間違ってると思うし: No, I'm coming with you.@I think my brother's wrong... and I want to@know why he changed his mind...
LDBI\t「マサキ殿、私もお供致します」: Master Masaki, I shall accompany you as well.
LDBI\t「あたしも行くよ、お兄ちゃん。@ ミオさんが言った通り、まだ殿下を@: I'm going too, Big Brother.@Like Mio said, I think we can still@stop the prince...
LDBI\t「……これまでと同じで、拒否してもいいのよ。@ 特に今回はね」: ...Like before, you're free to refuse.@Especially this time.
LDBI\t「いえ、僕に出来ることがあるなら、行きます」: No. If there's something I can do, I'll go.
LDBI\t「……僕には過去の記憶がありませんし、@ 寄る辺なき身ですから……何: ...I have no memories of my past, and nowhere@to call home... So whatever it is, being@needed puts me at ease.
LDBI\t「すまねえな、イング。お前の力も借りるぜ」: Sorry, Ing. I'm gonna need your help too.
LDBI\t「これでパイロットは全員参加か」: So every pilot's taking part, then.
LDBI\t「ええ。@ 一時退艦を希望するクルーもいなかったそうよ」: Yes. Apparently no crew members asked@to disembark, even temporarily.
LDBI\t「整備員のみんなは、セニア王女が行く所なら@ どこでも行くって、一致: The mechanics were all united on it, too--@they'd follow Princess Xenia anywhere~.
LDBI\t「まるで、アイドルのファン・クラブみたいだ……」: It's like an idol's fan club...
LDBI\t「ところで、フェイル陛下の部隊の動向は？」: By the way, what about King Feil's forces?
LDBI\t「ナゴール湾に駐留中よ。@ このまま何事もなければ、間に合うわ」: They're stationed at Nagor Bay.@If nothing happens, we'll make it in time.
LDBI\t「では、各員は機乗し、待機しなさい」: Then all hands, board your units and stand by.
LDBI\t（フェイル殿下……今から行くぜ。@ あんたを止めるためにな……！）: (Prince Feil... I'm coming for you now.@To stop you...!)
LDBI\t神聖ラングラン王国 バルディア州 ナゴール湾: Holy Kingdom of Langran, Baldia Province,@Nagor Bay
LDBI\t「これで全ての采配は我らに委ねられました」: Now every decision has been entrusted to us.
LDBI\t「ああ、そうだな。@ ……それで、ハガネは？」: Yes, so it would seem.@...And the Hagane?
LDBI\t「依然、こちらへ接近中……@ まもなく現戦域内へ進入します」: Still approaching...@It will enter the current battle zone shortly.
LDBI\t「戦域、か。@ 衝突が避けられぬのであれば、そうなるな」: A battle zone, is it?@If a clash can't be avoided, then so it will be.
LDBI\t「オールト将軍、貴公らは撤退してくれ。@ そして、来るべき戦いに備え: General Oort, withdraw with your men.@And prepare for the battle to come.
LDBI\t「そのご命令には従えませぬ。@ どこまでもお供させていただきますぞ、: That is an order I cannot obey.@I will follow you to the end, Your Majesty.
LDBI\t「ならん。命を無駄にするな」: No. Do not throw your lives away.
LDBI\t「いえ……陛下の理想と苦しみ、@ 私は身に染みてわかっておるつもりで: No... I believe I know Your Majesty's ideals@and suffering to the very marrow.
LDBI\t「そして、ここにいる者全てが@ 陛下のために心身を捧げる決意をしてお: And every soul here has resolved to devote@body and mind to Your Majesty.
LDBI\t「それでも我らが不要と仰るのでしたら、@ まず私めからお討ち下さいま: If you still say you have no need of us,@then strike me down first, sire.
LDBI\t「ただし、私が手塩に掛けたこのブローウェル……@ 陛下のデュラクシー: However, this Blowell I raised by hand...@will lag behind neither Your Majesty's@Duraxyll nor the Masoukishin.
LDBI\t「その後のお言葉は、@ 事を成した後でいただきまする」: Those words I shall receive@once the deed is done.
LDBI\t「マサキ……@ 考えを改め、協力してくれる気になったか」: Masaki...@Have you reconsidered and decided to help me?
LDBI\t「いや……俺達はあんたを止めに来た」: No... We came to stop you.
LDBI\t「それは……魔装機神操者としての判断か」: Is that... your call as a Masoukishin pilot?
LDBI\t「やはり、私の行いが<ラ・ギアス>に@ 災厄をもたらすと考えているの: So you still believe my actions will bring@calamity upon <ラ・ギアス>?
LDBI\t「そうだ。@ 現に、ルオゾール達は混乱に乗じて動き出している。@ そ: That's right. Luozorl's lot are already using@the chaos to make their move. And Kirkus,@who's still missing...
LDBI\t「カークス将軍は先程戦死したよ。@ ヤンロンやヒリュウ改との決戦でな: General Kirkus was killed a short while ago,@in a decisive battle against Yang Long@and the Hiryu Custom.
LDBI\t「これで後顧の憂いを断つことが出来た。@ マサキ、君達には済まないと: With that, my worries at home are laid to rest.@Masaki, I regret this for all of you, but...@I will walk the path I believe in.
LDBI\t「兄さん！ 今、成すべきことは@ シュテドニアスへの侵攻じゃなく、@: Brother! What needs doing now isn't@invading Schtedonias--it's stabilizing@Langran!
LDBI\t「言ったはずだ、セニア。@ 武力によるシュテドニアス制圧が、@ ラ・: I told you, Xenia. Conquering Schtedonias@by force will bring peace to all of La Gias.
LDBI\t「シュテドニアスだけじゃないわ！@ ラ・ギアス全ての国を敵に回すつも: It's not just Schtedonias!@Are you going to make enemies of every nation@in La Gias!?
LDBI\t「無茶です、陛下！ 仮に全ての魔装機神が@ あなたの下に集っても、周: This is madness, Your Majesty! Even if every@Masoukishin gathered under you, you couldn't@possibly defeat all the surrounding nations!
LDBI\t「目的のためならば、手段は選ばぬ……@ 非情に徹しなければ、大願は果: To achieve my goal, I will use any means...@A great ambition cannot be fulfilled without@utter ruthlessness.
LDBI\t「そんな言葉で片づけられると思ってんの！？」: You think you can just brush it off like that!?
LDBI\t「わかってるよ！@ でも、やらなくていい戦争に巻き込まれた人達は@: I know that!@But what about the people dragged into a war@that never had to happen!?
LDBI\t「必然性の有無は、国王たる私が決めること。@ 我が悲願の成就を阻むと: As king, it is I who decide what is necessary.@If you mean to stand in the way of my dream,@not even you will be spared.
LDBI\t「くっ！ フェイル、本気か！？@ 本気で俺達とやろうってのか！？」: Damn! Feil, are you serious!?@You really want to fight us!?
LDBI\t「ああ、そうだ。君達に魔装機神操者の@ 義務が課せられているように、: Yes. Just as you bear the duties of@Masoukishin pilots, I too have obligations@I must fulfill as king.
LDBI\t「そう、今は非常の時なのだ。私とて戦争を@ 起こしたくはないが、ここ: Yes. These are extraordinary times. I have no@wish to start a war either, but if I hesitate@now, an even greater conflict will soon follow.
LDBI\t「そうなってからでは遅いのだよ」: By then, it will be too late.
LDBI\t「馬鹿な！ そうならないようにするのが@ あんたの役目だろ！？ 時間: That's crazy! Keeping that from happening is@your job, isn't it!? If you take the time@to mend relations with other nations...!
LDBI\t「……それは出来ん……出来んのだ、マサキ」: ...I cannot do that... I cannot, Masaki.
LDBI\t「どうあっても、シュテドニアスとの戦端を@ 開かれると仰るのですね？: So no matter what, you intend to open@hostilities with Schtedonias?
LDBI\t「くっ！ 自分の国を危機に陥れて、何が国王だ！@ あんたはカークスと: Damn it! What kind of king puts his own@country in danger!? You're obsessed with@ambition, just like Kirkus was!
LDBI\t「野望ではない、大義だ。私はラングランだけでなく、@ ラ・ギアス全土: Not ambition--a great cause. I act not just for@Langran, but for all of La Gias.
BMD\t「タスク少尉！ ツッコミ二番手、いきます！」: Lieutenant Tasuku!/　Backup straight man, cutting in!
BMD\t「カイ少佐！ おれ、ちゃんとやりますから！」: Major Kai! I'll do this right, I promise!
BMD\t「ここは突っ込んでいいんスよね、少佐！」: I can charge in here, right, Major?
BMD\t「ラミア少尉、援護しますです！」: Lieutenant Lamia, I'll back you up!
BMD\t「ラミア少尉、こっちからも突っ込みます！」: Lieutenant Lamia, I'm charging in too!
BMD\t「王女さん、/ ラトの代わりにおれが手伝うッス！」: Princess,/　I'll help out in Lato's place!
BMD\t「シャイン王女、援護するッス！」: Princess Shine, I'll back you up!
BMD\t「コウタ！ 手伝うって言っただろ！」: Kota! I said I'd help, didn't I!
BMD\t「フィオナさん、後はお任せッス！」: Fiona, leave the rest to me!
BMD\t「アクア少尉、後はおれが！」: Lieutenant Aqua, I'll take it from here!
BMD\t「ジョッシュさん、後はおれが！」: Josh, I'll take it from here!
BMD\t「リム、後は任せろ！」: Rim, leave the rest to me!
BMD\t「リム、手を貸すぜ！」: Rim, I'll lend you a hand!
BMD\t「トウマさん、後はおれが！」: Touma, I'll take it from here!
BMD\t「ショウコ、後は任せろ！」: Shoko, leave the rest to me!
BMD\t「アルト譲りの突進力、見せてやるぜっ！！」: Check out the charging power I got from Alt!!
BMD\t「ＡＴＸ計画コンボ、行くぜぇっ！！」: ATX Project combo, here we go!!
BMD\t「出番と味方を失ってたまるか！」: I won't lose my big moment or my friends!
BMD\t「打たれ強さにゃ、自信があるんだ！」: I'm pretty sure I can take a beating!
BMD\t「縦になる！ いや、盾になるっ！！」: I'll stand tall! No, I'll stand guard!!
BMD\t「守ってみせる！ 必ず！！」: I'll protect you! No matter what!!
BMD\t「ゼオラ！ お前との約束、守ってみせるっ！」: Seolla! I'll keep my promise to you!
BMD\t「ゼオラに手を出すな！ 後でうるせえぞ！！」: Hands off Seolla!/　She'll nag me about it later!!
BMD\t「キョウスケ中尉、/ 装甲はこっちの方が上ッス！ 多分！」: Lieutenant Kyosuke,/　my armor's thicker than yours! Probably!
BMD\t「エクセレン少尉、/ 蝶のように逃げちゃって下さい！」: Lieutenant Excellen,/　float like a butterfly and run for it!
BMD\t「ラト、こういう時は頼ってくれよな！」: Lato, lean on me at times like this!
BMD\t「ラトをやらせはしねえぞ！」: I won't let them get Lato!
BMD\t「ここはおれの出番ッスよ、ユウキ少尉！」: This is my moment, Lieutenant Yuuki!
BMD\t「すみません、タスク少尉！/ ツッコミ入れます！」: Sorry, Lieutenant Tasuku!/　I'm butting in!
BMD\t「カイ少佐！ 頑丈なのが取り柄ッスから！」: Major Kai! Being tough is my specialty!
BMD\t「ラーダさん、早いとこ逃げて下さい！」: Radha, hurry up and get out of here!
BMD\t「シャイン王女、早く逃げるッス！」: Princess Shine, get out of here, quick!
BMD\t「ロイヤルガードだ！ いっけぇ！」: I'm the Royal Guard! Here goes!
BMD\t「コウタ！ おれが言うのも何だが、/ 無茶は禁物だぜ！」: Kota! I know I'm one to talk,/　but don't do anything reckless!
LDBI\t「テイラー・ケントルム氏です。@ 彼は、ハルパーの鎌には触れていませ: Taylor Kentrum.@He had no hand in the Harpe's Sickle, though.
LDBI\t「ケントルム……@ あの一族が、身内から出た反逆者をどう扱うか……」: Kentrum...@How will that family deal with a traitor@from their own ranks...
LDBI\t「では、ケントルムには手出し無用だ。@ それと、調査の件だが……あら: Then leave the Kentrums alone.@As for the investigation... use every means@and get me results, fast.
LDBI\t「……以上が現地よりもたらされた第一報です。@ 要点を繰り返し伝えま: ...That was the first report from the scene.@Let me repeat the key points.
LDBI\t「本日連邦標準時１０時２２分、@ 地球連邦軍極東方面軍第１独立特殊戦: At 10:22 Federation Standard Time today, the@Earth Federation Army's Far East 1st Independent@Special Unit, the Steel Dragons, mutinied...
LDBI\t「ガイアセイバーズ旗艦、エア・クリスマスから@ 脱出しようとしたグラ: They fired on President Graien Grassman's plane@as it tried to escape the Gaia Saviors flagship,@Air Christmas, and shot it down.
LDBI\t「大統領を含む搭乗者は全員死亡。@ 鋼龍戦隊は戦域からの離脱を図り、: Everyone aboard, the President included, died.@The Steel Dragons fled the battle zone and@remain at large.
LDBI\t「なお、事件発生時、ガイアセイバーズは@ ゲストと戦闘中だったという: We have also received reports that the Gaia@Saviors were engaged with the Guest at the time...
LDBI\t「……やはり、あの機体には大統領が……。@ 自分は……自分は、取り返: ...So the President really was aboard...@I... I've done something@that can never be undone...
LDBI\t「あのような発表をする以上、どこかで大統領が@ 生存している可能性は: Given that announcement, it's unlikely the@President survived somewhere.
LDBI\t「あの場で私が接収に応じていれば、@ このようなことには……。@ 私: If I had accepted the requisition back there,@none of this would have happened...@My... My judgment was wrong...
LDBI\t「いえ、責めを受けるべきは自分です……@ 大統領機を破壊したのは、本: No, I'm the one who should take the blame...@It was this ship that destroyed his plane...
LDBI\t「結果的にはそうなってしまったが、@ あのタイミングで大統領機を発進: That's how it turned out, but launching the@President's plane at that exact moment@strikes me as deliberate.
LDBI\t「これは事故ではない……@ それを装った大統領暗殺ではないか」: This was no accident... It was an assassination@disguised as one.
LDBI\t「ガイアセイバーズの……@ アルテウル・シュタインベックの目的は、@: The aim of the Gaia Saviors... of Arteur@Steinbeck... wasn't just to seize our units...
LDBI\t「大統領の殺害……しかも、それに我々を@ 関わらせることだったようで: ...but to kill the President, and to involve us@in it, it would seem.
LDBI\t「そして、我々を反乱者に仕立て上げて……」: And then frame us as rebels...
LDBI\t「陰謀説も散見されますが、@ 我々を弾劾する意見が圧倒的です」: There are some conspiracy theories, but the@overwhelming majority are condemning us.
LDBI\t「ガイアセイバーズの対応に関しては？」: And regarding the Gaia Saviors' response?
LDBI\t「責任を追及されていますが、ゲストとの交戦中、@ 我々が反乱を起こし: They're being held responsible, but some say it@was unavoidable they couldn't cope, with us@rebelling mid-battle with the Guest.
LDBI\t「そもそも……何故、あのタイミングで@ アーチンが現れたのか……」: Come to think of it... why did the Urchin@appear right at that moment...
LDBI\t「偵察機だけというのも不自然……@ 後々の弁明のために用意された物だ: And only recon units--that's unnatural too...@They may have been planted as a later excuse.
LDBI\t「おそらく。ガイアセイバーズは我々の行動を予測……@ いえ、フォーメ: Probably. The Gaia Saviors anticipated our@moves... no, they steered us into escaping the@area with Formation Breakout.
LDBI\t「ですが、解せません。@ 元々、ガイアセイバーズには疑わしい部分が@: But it doesn't make sense.@There was plenty about the Gaia Saviors@that was suspicious from the start...
LDBI\t「それを大統領権限でグレーにしていたはずなのに、@ 肝心の大統領が亡: Those gray areas were covered by presidential@authority. With the President gone, losing@their backing won't be the end of it.
LDBI\t「ですな。@ ゲストと交戦中の出来事というお膳立てをしても、@ アル: Indeed. Even with the setup of it happening@during a battle with the Guest, Arteur himself@should face accountability eventually...
LDBI\t「今は非常時ということで抑えが効いても、@ ガイアセイバーズ自体が不: The state of emergency may keep a lid on it@for now, but the Gaia Saviors themselves could@end up in a tight spot.
LDBI\t「単に鋼龍戦隊を潰し、@ 大統領を亡きものにすることが目的だったのな: If the goal were simply to crush the Steel@Dragons and do away with the President, there@were other ways...
LDBI\t「今というタイミングで、我々に大統領殺害の@ 濡れ衣を着せ、あえて逃: Framing us for the President's murder now@and deliberately letting us flee--that must be@where Arteur's true intent lies.
LDBI\t「現状ではまだわかりません。@ アルテウルの策は、巧妙なように見えて: We don't know yet. Arteur's plan seems clever,@but it's full of holes...
LDBI\t「それは、鋼龍戦隊のラ・ギアスへの召喚、@ ルイーナ出現という想定外: Is that because unforeseen events--the Steel@Dragons' summoning to La Gias, the Ruina's@appearance--threw his plans into disarray...
LDBI\t「あるいは、それすらも踏まえた上でのことなのか」: Or was even that taken into account?
LDBI\t「いずれにせよ、状況は圧倒的に不利です。@ ガイアセイバーズのみなら: Either way, we're at a severe disadvantage.@Not just the Gaia Saviors--the Earth Federation@Army will be coming after us as well.
LDBI\t「友軍と交戦するわけにはいきません。@ 統合参謀本部へ直接連絡し、事: We can't fight our own allies.@We'll contact the Joint Chiefs of Staff@directly and explain the situation.
LDBI\t「我々に叛意がないことを……@ アルテウル・シュタインベックによる@: We must convince them we aren't rebels...@that this may be a conspiracy by@Arteur Steinbeck...
LDBI\t「しかし、この場に留まるのは危険です。@ 統合参謀本部とコンタクトを: But staying here is dangerous.@Why not head for Komodin Island while@contacting the Joint Chiefs?
LDBI\t「そこはクロガネの寄港地であり、@ 整備と補給も可能です」: It's the Kurogane's port of call. We can handle@maintenance and resupply there.
LDBI\t「……統合参謀本部は@ 我々の言い分を聞いてくれるでしょうか……」: ...Will the Joint Chiefs hear us out, I wonder...
LDBI\t「だが、グライエン・グラスマン大統領は、@ 我々とは違った形で地球圏: But President Graien Grassman, in his own way,@was concerned for the Earth Sphere's future and@for establishing humanity's sovereignty...
LDBI\t「その意志を利用した@ アルテウル・シュタインベックを弾劾し、@ そ: Condemning Arteur Steinbeck, who exploited@that will, and exposing his conspiracy...
LDBI\t「大統領暗殺に荷担してしまった我々の責務であり、@ 大統領に対する償: ...is our duty, having been party to his@assassination, and our atonement to him.
LDBI\t「……テスラ・ドライブ１号基の出力が低下しています。@ 先程の戦闘と: ...Tesla Drive Unit 1's output is dropping.@It's damage from the last battle and the@high-speed flight.
LDBI\t「２号基の方は異常ありませんが、@ 今後のことを踏まえて、応急処置が: Unit 2 shows no problems, but given what's@ahead, I'd recommend emergency repairs.
LDBI\t「では、一度着水します。@ ハガネは上空で対空警戒を」: Then we'll set down on the water for now.@The Hagane will stay aloft on anti-air watch.
LDBI\t「艦長、着水完了しました」: Captain, we've landed on the water.
LDBI\t「では、直ちにテスラ・ドライブの応急処置を。@ 全周警戒を厳となせ」: Then begin emergency repairs on the Tesla Drive@at once. Maintain full all-around alert.
LDBI\t（……敵……ゲストやルイーナだけでなく、@ ガイアセイバーズも……）: (...Our enemies... not just the Guest and the@Ruina, but the Gaia Saviors too...)
BMD\t「何としても/ シェードの外まで行かなければ……！」: No matter what, I have to/　get outside the Shade...!
BMD\t「くっ、何としてでも可視領域へ……！」: Ngh... I have to reach visible range somehow...!
BMD\t「推力低下が仇になったか……！」: So the drop in thrust came back to bite me...!
BMD\t「このまま逃げ切ってみせる」: I'll get away from here, just watch me.
LDBI\t「ねえ、ヤンロン。@ フェイル王子って、テリウス王子の兄貴で@ 第一: Hey, Yang Long.@Prince Feil is Prince Tellius's older brother@and first in line to the throne, right?
LDBI\t「あんた、カークス将軍と同じぐらい@ その人のことが気になってるでし: You're as curious about him@as you are about General Kirkus, aren't you?
LDBI\t「ほう……ただガサツなだけかと思っていたが、@ 結構鋭いな」: Oh? I thought you were just crude,@but you're pretty sharp.
LDBI\t「……あのねぇ、@ 女の子にそういうこと言うもんじゃないよ！」: ...Look,@that's not something you say to a girl!
LDBI\t「そのような台詞はもっとお淑やかになってから@ 言うべきだな」: Save lines like that for when@you've become more ladylike.
LDBI\t「まったく、口が減らないんだから。@ で、フェイル王子と何かあったの: Geez, you always have a comeback.@So, did something happen with Prince Feil?
LDBI\t「あっ、そう。@ それじゃ、フェイル王子ってどんな人なの？」: Oh, fine.@Then what kind of person is Prince Feil?
LDBI\t「悪い人物ではないが……@ 時折、目の光に暗いものが混じる。@ 僕は: He's not a bad man, but...@at times, there's a darkness in his eyes.@That's what concerns me.
LDBI\t「話はここまでだ。ブリーフィング・ルームへ行くぞ」: Enough talk. Let's head to the briefing room.
LDBI\t「本来、あの拠点はラングランのものですから、@ 構造データが存在して: That base originally belonged to Langran,@so we have its structural data. First, though,@we must identify the captive surface dwellers.
LDBI\t「確かに、<ノイエＤＣ>の残党とかだったら、@ 救出作戦を展開する必: Yeah, if they're <ノイエＤＣ> leftovers or something,@there'd be no need to stage a rescue.
LDBI\t「僕とランシャオが行く。@ シュテドニアス軍兵の制服を着て、“隠れ蓑: Ranshao and I will go.@In Schtedonias uniforms and with the "Cloak,"@we can get inside without the enemy noticing.
LDBI\t「あと、腕の立つ者がもう一人か二人いれば……」: One or two more capable fighters would help...
LDBI\t「なるほど、リューネなら適任だぜ」: Yeah, Lüne's perfect for the job.
LDBI\t「あたし、運動神経と動体視力には自信があるんだ。@ 拳銃の弾丸なんか: I've got great reflexes and sharp eyes.@I can block pistol rounds with this wristband.
LDBI\t「うん、@ チタンワイヤーとアラミド繊維で出来てるからね。@ あんた: Yep.@It's made of titanium wire and aramid fiber.@What about you? Will you be okay?
LDBI\t「僕は北派少林拳の心得がある」: I'm trained in Northern Shaolin kung fu.
LDBI\t「では、内部調査は二人に任せます。@ もし、鋼龍戦隊のメンバーが囚わ: Then we leave the inside search to you two.@If any Steel Dragons members are being held,@please attempt to rescue them.
LDBI\t「私達はあなた達からの合図があり次第、@ 拠点への攻撃を開始します」: As soon as we receive your signal,@we'll begin our attack on the base.
LDBI\t「問題となるのは、合図があってから我々が@ 駆け付けるまでのタイムラ: The issue is the lag between the signal@and our arrival. If we move in too soon,@the enemy may see through our plan.
LDBI\t「こっちはこっちで何とかするよ。@ 後はなる早で来てもらうしかないね: We'll handle things on our end.@You'll just have to get there ASAP.
LDBI\t「では、僕達は一足先に敵拠点へ向かいます」: Then we'll head to the enemy base ahead of you.
LDBI\t「あっはっはっは！ 似合ってるよ、ヤンロン！@ どっから見てもシュテ: Ahahaha! That looks great on you, Yang Long!@You look like a Schtedonias soldier@from every angle!
LDBI\t「……笑っている場合か。君も制服を着るんだ」: ...Stop laughing. You need a uniform too.
LDBI\t「やだよ、そんな格好。@ あたしはこのままの方が動き易いし」: No way, not in that getup.@I move easier like this anyway.
LDBI\t「まあ、どうしても着なきゃならなくなったら、着るよ。@ それより……: Well, if I really have to wear it, I will.@Anyway... I think a bit better of you now.
LDBI\t「あんたがあたし達の手伝いをしてくれるとは@ 思ってなかったんだ。す: I didn't think you'd help us out.@I figured you'd go straight to@General Kirkus...
LDBI\t「そうしたいのは山々だが、現状で最優先すべきは@ シュテドニアス軍と: I'd like nothing more, but right now the top@priority is ending the war with Schtedonias.
LDBI\t「それに、君達に色々と手伝ってもらっておいて、@ 素知らぬふりをする: Besides, after all the help you've given me,@I can hardly turn my back on you.
LDBI\t「あんた、意外にいい奴なんだね」: You're a pretty nice guy, huh? Who knew.
LDBI\t「ご主人様、南側の地下水路は封鎖されて@ おりませんでした」: Master, the underground waterway on the south@side was not sealed.
