BMD\t「魔装機神など、相手にならん！」: The Masoukishin are no match for me!
BMD\t「見かけ倒しか、超機人！」: All show and no substance, Choukijin!
BMD\t「何が超機人だ！ 笑わせるな！」: Choukijin, my foot! Don't make me laugh!
BMD\t「ガイアセイバーズに刃向かう愚かさを知れ！」: Learn the folly of defying/　the Gaia Saviors!
BMD\t「後退するしかないか！」: I have no choice but to fall back!
BMD\t「このままでは的になる！」: At this rate, I'll be a sitting duck!
BMD\t「うぬっ、使える武器は！？」: Ngh, what weapons do I have left?!
BMD\t「くそっ、どこから攻撃して来た！？」: Damn, where did that attack come from?!
BMD\t「ええい、これでは狙い撃ちされる！」: Blast, they'll pick me off like this!
BMD\t「死角に入られたか！」: They got into my blind spot!
BMD\t「逃げ損なったか！」: Missed your chance to run, huh?!
BMD\t「俺が盾になれば！」: If I can be the shield...!
BMD\t「こちらで受け止めれば！」: If I can take the hit here...!
BMD\t「叩き落としてやる！」: I'll knock you out of the sky!
BMD\t「避けられると思うな！」: Don't think you can dodge this!
BMD\t「新型リオンの力を！」: Behold the power of the new Lion!
BMD\t「このミサイルは一味違うぞ！」: This missile's a cut above the rest!
BMD\t「高速で追い詰める！」: I'll run you down at high speed!
BMD\t「このサイリオンで翻弄してやる！」: This Cylion will run rings around you!
BMD\t「テスラ・ドライブのミサイルだ！」: These missiles have a Tesla Drive!
LDBI\t「それに、フェイル殿下がカークスの寝言を@ 黙って聞き入れるわけがね: Besides, there's no way Prince Feil would just@sit there and listen to Kirkus's drivel.
LDBI\t「でも、ここで私達とカークス軍が争ったら、@ シュテドニアスの思う壺: But if we fight Kirkus's army here,@we'll be playing right into Schtedonias's hands.
LDBI\t「艦長、俺達を集めたってことは@ フェイル殿下から作戦への参加要望が: Captain, if you've gathered us here, then@Prince Feil wants us in on the operation, right?
LDBI\t「ああ。そして、俺は艦長として、それを受諾した。@ 殿下やマサキ、テ: Yes. And as captain, I accepted.@Hearing from His Highness, Masaki, Tytti and the@rest, I understand Langran's circumstances...
LDBI\t「殿下は諾否に関わらず、@ 本艦への補給支援を請け負ってくれた」: Whether we accepted or not, His Highness@promised to support this ship with Resupply.
LDBI\t「我々が地上へ帰るまで、しばしの時を要するが……@ この世界で同盟者: It'll be some time before we return to Earth...@and if we need an ally in this world, I judged@that Langran's army is the only choice.
LDBI\t「鋼龍戦隊がしばらく協力してくれるんなら、@ ありがてえ話だぜ」: If the Steel Dragons will back us for a while,@that's a real help.
LDBI\t「３日後、シュテドニアス軍に対し、レドナ峡谷で@ 大攻勢をかける。こ: In three days, we launch a major offensive on@Schtedonias at Redna Gorge with Kirkus's army.@We'll raid their left flank in a Violent Assault.
LDBI\t「脇腹を突くってわけね。柔らかければいいけど」: A jab to the side, huh? Hope it's a soft one.
LDBI\t「今回の作戦でラングラン軍が勝利すれば、@ シュテドニアス軍はさらな: If Langran wins this battle, Schtedonias@will be forced to retreat even further.
LDBI\t「ああ……上手くいけば、@ 奴らをこの大陸から追い出せるかも知れねえ: Yeah... if this goes well, we might just@drive them off this continent.
LDBI\t「兄さん達がカークス将軍と@ 手を結んでまで立案した作戦だもの。@: My brother and the others even teamed up@with General Kirkus to plan this operation.@We have to make it succeed, no matter what.
LDBI\t「ええ、兄さんからも言われているのよ。@ こっちには魔装機神が３体も: Yeah, my brother told me to. Since there are@three Masoukishin deployed here, he figured@it'd be more convenient if I was around.
LDBI\t「それに、地上の機体を間近で見られるしね」: Besides, I get to see surface machines up close.
LDBI\t「そっちが本音じゃねえだろうな？」: That's not your real reason, is it?
LDBI\t「なお、本艦は明日０１００、王都を進発する。@ 各員、備えは万全にな: Also, this ship departs the capital at 0100@tomorrow. Everyone, be fully prepared.
LDBI\t「クワイアー大佐、９時方向より飛行物体が接近！@ 地上人の戦艦です！: Colonel Quire, aerial object approaching@from 9 o'clock! It's the surface dwellers' ship!
LDBI\t「ちっ、あともう少しの所で……！@ こちらの意図を読まれたか」: Tch, we were so close...!@They must've read our intentions.
LDBI\t「やむを得ん、迎撃する！@ それと、第４中隊をこちらへ向かわせろ！@: No choice. We'll intercept!@And send the 4th Company our way!@We'll catch them in a pincer!
LDBI\t「あの部隊、進行方向から判断して@ カークス将軍の部隊を奇襲するつも: Judging by its heading, that unit meant@to ambush General Kirkus's forces.
LDBI\t「あいつを助けることになるのは癪だが、@ そんなことは言ってられねえ: I hate the idea of helping that guy, but@we can't afford to be picky...@Everyone, I'm counting on you!
LDBI\t「ええい、援軍が来る前に撃破されるとは！@ やはり、奴らの存在はラ・: Damn, wiped out before reinforcements arrive!@As I thought, their presence could upset@the balance of La Gias...!
LDBI\t「この機体はもう動けん……脱出するしかないか！」: This unit can't move... I'll have to eject!
LDBI\t「よし、これで……」: All right, that should do it...
LDBI\t「敵機接近！ ６時方向より真っ直ぐ！@ シュテドニアスの魔装機、数は: Enemies approaching! Straight from 6 o'clock!@Schtedonias Masouki, ten of them!
LDBI\t「艦長、３時方向より高速飛行物体群が接近！@ 味方の識別信号を出して: Captain, high-speed flying objects approaching@from 3 o'clock! They're showing friendly IFF!
LDBI\t「ベガリオン……！！@ ラ・ギアスに来ていたの！？」: The Vegalion...!!@It came to La Gias!?
LDBI\t「スレイ！ @ ベガリオンに乗ってるのは、あんたでしょ！？」: Sleigh!@It's you in the Vegalion, isn't it!?
LDBI\t「……なるほど、因縁のある連中だったな」: ...I see. So they're the ones with a history.
LDBI\t「あの連中もフェイル殿下に協力してんの……！？」: Those guys are helping Prince Feil too...!?
LDBI\t「いえ、違うわ。おそらく、彼らは……」: No, they're not. Most likely, they're...
LDBI\t「依頼された仕事は終えた。これで我々は……」: The job you hired us for is done. Now we...
LDBI\t「わかっている。@ 後ほど、丁重に送り返して差し上げよう。@ ここは: I know.@Later, I'll see you're courteously sent back.@You may withdraw now.
LDBI\t「うむ、それもわかっている」: Yes, I understand that as well.
LDBI\t「あれがベガリオン……その他の機体は、@ アイビスとツグミが遭遇した: So that's the Vegalion... and the other units@are the ones Ibis and Tsugumi ran into...
LDBI\t「カークス軍側にも地上人がいたのか……」: So Kirkus's side has surface dwellers too...
LDBI\t「詳細は本人に聞いてみたら？@ あのガルガードに乗ってるんだし」: Why not ask the man himself?@He's in that Galguard, after all.
LDBI\t「ああ、そうだな。@ ……カークス将軍、聞こえるか？@ マサキ・アン: Yeah, good idea.@...General Kirkus, can you hear me?@It's Masaki Andoh.
LDBI\t「ふん……雰囲気が変わったな、将軍。@ あの地上人は何者だ？」: Hmph... You've changed, General.@Who's that surface dweller?
LDBI\t「我が軍の機密事項だ。教えるわけにはいかん」: That is our army's secret. I can't share it.
LDBI\t「将軍……何故、テリウス殿下を担ぎ出したのです？@ さらなる混乱をお: General... why prop up Prince Tellius?@Do you wish for even more turmoil?
LDBI\t「私は、フェイル殿下こそが混乱の源だと考えている」: I believe that Prince Feil is the very@source of this turmoil.
LDBI\t「本艦も助力致します。@ マサキ達と共に王都へ突入する予定でしたので: Our ship will lend its aid as well.@We'd already planned to storm the capital@alongside Masaki and the others.
LDBI\t「それはありがたい。@ では、バナン市で待っています」: We'd be grateful.@Then we'll be waiting for you in Banan.
LDBI\t「……いや～、ウチの色男さんも@ 顔負けな感じの王子様だこと。@ あ: ...Wow, now there's a prince who'd put our@resident lady-killer to shame. Oh, but their@voices? That one's too close to call~
LDBI\t「バナン市なら、ここから近い。急いで行こうぜ」: Banan's not far from here. Let's hurry over.
BMD\t「そうそう、その調子、その調子！」: That's it, that's it! Keep it up!
BMD\t「ようやく面白くなってきたよ」: Now things are finally getting fun.
BMD\t「退屈しのぎにはちょうどいい」: Just the thing to kill some boredom.
BMD\t「お気に入りのスーツを/ 汚したくないんだけどな」: I'd rather not get my favorite/　suit dirty, you know.
BMD\t「ほう……応龍皇をここまで追い込むとはね」: Oh... Pushing the OryuOh this far, eh?
BMD\t「さーて、どうするかな」: Now then, what shall I do?
BMD\t「こういう展開も悪くない」: This turn of events isn't bad either.
BMD\t「ははは！ やってくれたね！」: Ha ha ha! You got me good!
BMD\t「うん、刺激的だった！ ありがとう！」: Yes, that was thrilling! Thank you!
BMD\t「クライマックスが楽しみだよ！/ ははははは！」: I can't wait for the climax!/　Ha ha ha ha ha!
BMD\t「クスハ君、/ 僕の息の根を止められるかな……？」: Kusuha, can you/　really finish me off...?
BMD\t「君は、ストレートに念をぶつけてくるな」: You hurl your psychic power/　straight at me, don't you?
BMD\t「君は面倒な代物を呼び込んでるなぁ。/ ま、壊しちゃえばいいんだけど」: You've brought in some nasty baggage./　Well, I'll just smash it anyway.
BMD\t「その機体は災いを呼ぶよ。後々でもね」: That machine will bring calamity./　Even down the line.
BMD\t「偶然でその力を/ 得るわけがないんだけどね……」: You couldn't have gained that/　power by mere chance...
BMD\t「いちいち格好つけるねぇ……/ あの男と同じだ」: Always striking a pose, aren't you.../　Just like that man.
BMD\t「時を経て因縁の者達が巡り会う……/ 実にドラマティックだ」: Fated foes meeting again across time.../　How truly dramatic.
BMD\t「ほう、君の念が高まっているね」: Oh? Your psychic power is rising.
BMD\t「この念の集まり具合……気に入らないな」: This gathering of psychic power.../　I don't like it.
BMD\t「一時的とは言え、/ その念の高まりはなかなかのものだ」: It may be temporary, but that surge/　of psychic power is quite something.
BMD\t「四神の超機人が/ 応龍皇をひるませるとはね……」: So one of the Four Gods' Choukijin/　can make the OryuOh flinch...
BMD\t「運命は繰り返されるというのか……？」: Is fate going to repeat itself...?
BMD\t「フッ……まさに猛虎、ってわけかい」: Heh... A raging tiger indeed, huh?
BMD\t「油断ぐらいしてあげないとねぇ」: Gotta give you an opening now and then.
BMD\t「うん、驚いたね。ちょっとだけ」: Yes, that surprised me. Just a little.
BMD\t「さあ、どんどん盛り上がっていこうか！」: Come on, let's really get this going!
BMD\t「ん？ 君の出し物はそれで終わりかな？」: Hm? Is that all your act has to offer?
BMD\t「もうちょっと派手な方がいいんだけどな」: I'd prefer something a bit flashier.
BMD\t「必死になるのはいいことさ。/ 人間にとってはね」: Desperation is a good thing./　For humans, anyway.
BMD\t「限りある命ってのは、悲しいなぁ」: How sad it is, to have a finite life.
BMD\t「まあ、/ 簡単に諦めてもらっちゃ、つまらないし」: Well, it'd be boring/　if you gave up so easily.
BMD\t「クスハ君、/ 可愛い顔して割と乱暴なことをするね」: Kusuha, for such a cute face,/　you do some pretty rough things.
BMD\t「クスハ君の真っ直ぐな目、眩しいなぁ」: Kusuha, those honest eyes of yours/　are just dazzling.
BMD\t「尸解すれば、念の力はもっと強まるのにさ」: If you'd just shed your flesh,/　your psychic power would grow stronger.
BMD\t「どうして念の力を持った者の数が増えたか、/ わかるかい？」: Do you know why the number of people/　with psychic power has grown?
BMD\t「念の力の差を感じ取れないかい？」: Can't you sense the difference/　in our psychic power?
BMD\t「君の機体の装置はちょっと厄介かもね。/ ま、後でどうとでもなるけどさ: That device in your unit may be a pain./　Well, I can deal with it later.
BMD\t「その装置、君の手に余ってるんじゃない？」: Isn't that device too much for you?
BMD\t「さて、君の行く末はどうなるかねぇ」: Now, I wonder what fate awaits you.
BMD\t「不自然な所があるんだよ、君の念は」: There's something unnatural/　about your psychic power.
BMD\t「その前口上は思いつきなのかな？」: Did you just ad-lib that speech?
BMD\t「もう少し若ければ、/ あの男のように戦えたものを」: If only you were younger,/　you could've fought like that man.
BMD\t「四神の超機人なら、/ それぐらいやってくれなきゃ」: A Choukijin of the Four Gods/　should manage at least that much.
BMD\t「格下の龍が何をしたところで……」: Whatever a lesser dragon may do...
BMD\t「もっと盛り上げようよ、/ 龍虎の戦いって奴をさ」: Come on, let's heat up this/　so-called battle of dragon and tiger.
BMD\t「ノーダメージだと盛り上がらないからねぇ」: Taking no damage would be no fun at all.
BMD\t「まあ、一方的だとつまらないからなぁ」: Well, a one-sided fight would be boring.
BMD\t「もう少し頭を使って攻撃してきたまえ」: Use your head a bit more when attacking.
BMD\t「ふむ……いい手応えだね」: Hmm... Now that's a nice hit.
BMD\t「もうちょっと頑張った方がいいね」: You'd better try a little harder.
BMD\t「揺れた、揺れた……ほんのちょっとだけどね」: That shook me, that shook me.../　Just a tiny bit, though.
BMD\t「グランゾンの力……身を以て知りなさい」: The power of Granzon.../　Learn it firsthand.
BMD\t「あなたにグランゾンの力を/ お見せしましょう」: Allow me to show you/　the power of Granzon.
BMD\t「何人たりとも、/ 私を縛ることなど出来ないのですよ」: No one, whoever they may be,/　can ever bind me.
BMD\t「私の行く手を阻む者には……容赦はしません」: Those who stand in my way.../　will be shown no mercy.
BMD\t「私の前に立ち塞がるとは、いい度胸です」: You have nerve, standing in my way.
BMD\t「ご主人様に歯向かおうなんて、/ 身の程知らずですね！」: Trying to defy my master?/　You don't know your place!
BMD\t「さあ、チートなグランゾンの力を、/ 思いっきり見せつけちゃいますよ！: Okay, let's go all out and show off/　Granzon's cheat-tier power!
BMD\t「チカ……/ どこでそんな言葉を覚えてきたんですか？」: Chika.../　Where did you learn words like that?
BMD\t「なるほど……これが魔装機神グランヴェール……/ 確かに、一度ならず、: I see... The Elemental Lord Granveil.../　Indeed, it seems we've crossed paths/　more than once.
BMD\t「ホワン・ヤンロン……/ なるほど、データと記憶がまだ一致しませんが…: Yanlong Huang.../　Data and memory don't line up yet, but.../　he seems to be quite a formidable foe.
BMD\t「グランヴェール……/ 火力に秀でるも防御力に難あり……ですか。/ な: Granveil.../　Strong firepower, weak defenses, is it?/　I see, then there are ways to fight it.
BMD\t「態度、物言い、性格……/ 確かに何か私の中に引っかかります」: His attitude, his words, his nature.../　Something about him does nag at me.
BMD\t「ヴァルシオーネ……ほう、興味深いデータです。/ 確かにこれは、因縁浅: Valsione... Hmm, intriguing data./　Our ties do run deep, it seems.
BMD\t「おおよそのデータは把握しました……/ が、どうやら、あのリューネとい: I've grasped most of the data.../　but that girl Lüne, it seems,/　is beyond what data alone can measure.
BMD\t「ラングランに召喚された魔装機操者……/ アハマド・ハムディ……/ 聞: A Masouki pilot summoned to Langran.../　Ahmad Hamdi.../　The name does sound familiar.
BMD\t「なるほど……/ ソルガディという機体、その性能は把握しました。/ 後: I see.../　I've grasped the Solgady's capabilities./　Now, just how strong is Ahmad himself...
BMD\t「面白いですね……このアハマドという男。/ 敵でなければ、/ 色々と融: Interesting... this man, Ahmad./　Were he not an enemy,/　he might prove quite accommodating...
BMD\t「もはやあなたの出る幕ではないのですよ、/ ルオゾール。退場しなさい」: You have no part to play here anymore,/　Luozorl. Leave the stage.
BMD\t「私の自由を奪った……/ その罪は万死に値します。/ 覚悟はいいですね: You robbed me of my freedom.../　That crime merits a thousand deaths./　Are you prepared, Luozorl?
BMD\t「ある意味、/ 必要悪と言える存在なのでしょうが……」: In a sense,/　you could call them a necessary evil, but...
BMD\t「ドゥバン・オーグ……/ 大人しく自分の運命を受け入れなさい」: Duvan Ohg.../　Accept your fate quietly.
BMD\t「あなたは、完全な存在にはなり得ませんよ」: You can never become a perfect being.
BMD\t「あなたの正体を見せていただきましょうか」: Now, shall we see your true form?
BMD\t「フッ……/ この私に恐怖と絶望を与えることが出来ますか？」: Heh.../　Can you instill fear and despair in me?
BMD\t「本当の恐怖というものを教えてあげましょう」: Allow me to teach you what true fear is.
BMD\t「まず、/ あなた達から滅んでいただきましょうか」: First,/　I'll have you be the ones to perish.
BMD\t「あれも偶然では片付けられない存在ですね……」: That, too, is no mere coincidence...
BMD\t「混沌に飲み込まれるのは、あなたの方ですよ」: It's you who'll be swallowed by chaos.
BMD\t「あのままにしておけば、/ 後々で厄介なことになるかも知れませんね……: If left as it is,/　it may become troublesome later on...
BMD\t「あなた方ゲストは、/ 私にとって倒すべき敵なのです」: You Guests/　are enemies I must defeat.
BMD\t「インスペクターと/ 同じ運命を辿っていただきましょうか」: I'll have you share/　the same fate as the Inspectors.
BMD\t「この私が昇華させたグランゾンの力……/ 身を以て思い知りなさい」: Granzon's power, refined by my own hand.../　Feel it firsthand.
BMD\t「ゲストもインスペクターも、/ このグランゾンの前では無力なのです」: Guests and Inspectors alike/　are powerless before Granzon.
BMD\t「さあ、報いを受けなさい……ゼゼーナン卿」: Now, receive your due... Lord Zezenan.
BMD\t「前にも言ったはずですよ、/ あなたの権力はそう長く続かないと」: I told you before, didn't I?/　Your power won't last much longer.
BMD\t「そろそろお終いにしましょうか、/ ゼゼーナン卿」: Shall we bring this to an end,/　Lord Zezenan?
BMD\t「私に尸解など必要ありませんよ」: I have no need for corpse liberation.
BMD\t「桃源郷ですか。/ 別の世界なら、垣間見ましたがね」: A paradise, you say?/　I have glimpsed another world, though.
BMD\t「あなたも一度、/ 死を経験してみてはいかがです？」: Perhaps you should try/　dying once yourself?
BMD\t「あなたの退屈しのぎに付き合ってあげましょう。/ その後は、/ もう時: I'll play along to ease your boredom./　Afterwards, you'll never again have/　time to kill. Heh heh heh...
BMD\t「フッ……/ 私から何を学び取ろうと言うのです？」: Heh.../　And what is it you hope to learn from me?
BMD\t「曰くありげな機体ですね……」: A machine with quite a history, it seems...
BMD\t「ある意味、/ 私のグランゾンと似た存在なのでしょうが……」: In a sense,/　it may be something akin to my Granzon, but...
BMD\t「後々厄介な存在になるかも知れませんね……」: It may become a nuisance later on...
BMD\t「グランゾンを取り込もうなどと……愚かな」: Trying to absorb Granzon... How foolish.
BMD\t「エルデ・ミッテ……/ ＡＩ１が行き着く先など、/ 容易に想像できるで: Erde Mitte.../　Surely you can easily imagine/　where AI1 will ultimately lead?
BMD\t「私も地球を愛する者の一人のつもりでしてね……」: I like to think I love the Earth, too...
BMD\t「神と言えど、私を縛ることは出来ません。/ 人造の神ならば、尚更です」: Not even a god can bind me./　Least of all a man-made one.
BMD\t「なるほど……/ あなたがユーゼス・ゴッツォですか」: I see.../　So you are Euzeth Gozzo.
BMD\t「あなたが迎える結末は同じ……/ 輪廻からは逃れられませんよ」: Your end will be the same.../　There's no escaping the cycle of rebirth.
BMD\t「あなたは、因果の鎖を解くことなど出来ませんよ。/ ここに私達がいる時: You cannot undo the chains of causality./　Not so long as we are here.

LDBI\t「あれがジェスハ将軍を退けたっていう@ 地上人の連中ね。何て言うか…: So those are the surface folk who drove back@General Jesuha. How do I put it...@Most of their machines look kinda tacky.
LDBI\t「グレノール少尉！ せめて作戦行動中ぐらい、@ その喋り方を何とかし: Ensign Grenoir! At least during operations,@do something about the way you talk!
LDBI\t（いちいちうるさいのよね。@ 私のポリシーだもの、そう簡単に変えられ: (She nags about every little thing.@It's my personal style--I can't just change it.)
LDBI\t「ちょいと厄介だな。ヤンロンを呼ぶか」: Bit of a pain. Maybe we should call Yang Long.
LDBI\t「ほら、ほらほらほら！ @ ヒリュウ改ッスよ、カチーナ中尉！」: Look, look, look! It's the Hiryu Custom,@Lieutenant Katina!
LDBI\t「よし、これで仕置きはチャラにしてやるぜ」: All right, that squares away your punishment.
LDBI\t「何て大きな艦……！@ ソディウム級以上じゃないの！」: What a huge ship...!@It's bigger than a Sodium-class!
LDBI\t「もしや、地上人の戦艦か！@ グランヴェールと共に現れたということは: Could that be a surface-folk battleship!?@If it showed up with Granveil, has it sided@with Langran!?
LDBI\t「ええ。カチーナ中尉達を取り込もうとし、@ それが叶わぬとなると、追: Yes. They tried to bring Lieutenant Katina's@group into their fold, and when that failed,@they came after them.
LDBI\t「わかりました。@ では、本艦も戦闘に加わります。@ 前部全主砲、Ｖ: Understood.@Then this ship will join the battle.@All forward Main Cannons, VLSM, stand by!
LDBI\t「ヒリュウを連れて来てくれるなんて……@ お手柄じゃないの、ヤンロン: You brought the Hiryu with you...@Nice work, Yang Long.
LDBI\t「僥倖だった。@ 彼らは胞子の谷から出ようとしていたからな」: It was a stroke of luck.@They were about to leave the Valley of Spores.
LDBI\t「ヒリュウが来てくれたんなら、こっちのもんだ！@ 一気にシュテドニア: With the Hiryu here, this fight's ours!@Let's smash those Schtedonias punks in one go!
LDBI\t「くうっ、またしても！ この屈辱、忘れんぞ！」: Grr, not again! I won't forget this humiliation!
LDBI\t「や、やるじゃないの！ 覚えておきなさいよ！」: N-Not bad! Don't think I'll forget this!
LDBI\t「では、各機に帰艦命令を。@ 彼らの話を詳しく聞きましょう」: Then order all units back to the ship.@Let's hear their story in detail.
LDBI\t「……なるほど、状況は理解しました。@ カチーナ中尉達が無事で何より: ...I see, I understand the situation now.@I'm glad Lieutenant Katina's team is safe.@And you too, of course, Lieutenant Kyosuke.
LDBI\t「ご心配をお掛けし、申し訳ありませんでした」: I'm sorry to have caused you worry.
LDBI\t「それで、あの……@ レオナやエクセレン少尉達の行方は@ わからない: So, um...@there's still no word on where Leona@and Ensign Excellen and the others are...?
LDBI\t「ええ……本艦がラ・ギアスへ召喚された後、@ 機関部が破損したため…: Yes... After this ship was summoned to La Gias,@the engine section was damaged... so we stayed@in the Valley of Spores for repairs.
LDBI\t「でも、ヒリュウが一緒なら、@ マサキ達を捜し易くなるんじゃないの？: But with the Hiryu along, won't it be@easier to look for Masaki and the others?
LDBI\t「ですが、それは同時に我々がラ・ギアスの戦乱へ@ 本格的に巻き込まれ: However, that would also mean getting truly@caught up in La Gias's war.
LDBI\t「その通りですが……行方不明の者達を見つけるまでは@ この世界に留ま: True... but we'll have to stay in this world@until we find our missing people.
LDBI\t「あたしらはシュテドニアス軍の追撃を受けたんだ。@ あいつらに気を遣: The Schtedonias army came after us.@We don't owe those guys any consideration.
LDBI\t「それに、この戦乱が鎮まれば、ラングランで@ 地上送還の手配をしてく: Besides, once this war settles down, Langran@will arrange to send us back to the surface.
BMD\t「私はガンエデン……地球の守り神」: I am Gan Eden... guardian deity of Earth.
BMD\t「古の人々の願い……それが私達を形作った」: The prayers of the ancients... made us.
BMD\t「私はイルイ……バラルの主であり、マシアフ」: I am Irui... ruler of Baral, the Mashiach.
BMD\t「楽園に住まう者達にガンエデンの加護を……」: Gan Eden protects all who dwell here...
BMD\t「最後の楽園に久遠の安らぎを……」: Eternal peace to the final paradise...
BMD\t「災厄より逃れし者達の楽園……/ それを護るために……」: A paradise for those who fled calamity.../　I must protect it...
BMD\t「ガンエデンの加護により、/ この星は真の意味で最後の楽園となるのです: Under Gan Eden's protection, this planet/　will truly become the final paradise.
BMD\t「あなた達は人類を星の海へ導く存在……/ 排除すべき対象です」: You would lead humanity/　to the sea of stars.../　You must be eliminated.
BMD\t「もうあなたの夢が叶うことはない……」: Your dream will never come true now...
BMD\t「星の海へ……/ 外界へ出る必要はないのです」: To the sea of stars.../　There is no need to venture outside.
BMD\t「超機人は我が下僕……/ 刃向かうものは百邪……」: The Choukijin are my servants.../　Those who defy me are Hyakuja...
BMD\t「あなた達の主が誰なのか、/ 今一度知らしめましょう」: I shall remind you once more/　who your master is.
BMD\t「四神の超機人……/ あなた達を罰します」: Choukijin of the Four Gods.../　I shall punish you.
BMD\t「あなたは……私と同じ……？」: You are... the same as me...?
BMD\t「私と同じ血を受け継ぐ者達よ、/ ガンエデンに従わぬのであれば……」: You who inherit the same blood as I,/　if you will not obey Gan Eden...
BMD\t「あなた達のルーツはこの私、ガンエデン……」: Your roots lie with me, Gan Eden...
BMD\t「この時、この場所に強念者が集ったのは、/ 偶然ではありません」: It is no accident that powerful psychics/　have gathered here, at this time.
BMD\t「何故、この時代に強念者が数多く生まれたか……/ その理由を考えるので: Why have so many powerful psychics/　been born in this era...?/　Consider the reason.
BMD\t「あなた達もまた、アウグストスの意志と力を/ 受け継いでいると言うのに: You too have inherited the will and power/　of Augustus, and yet...
BMD\t「私はこの楽園を未来永劫守護します」: I shall guard this paradise for eternity.
BMD\t「あなた達の力は、/ 新たな災いを生み出してしまうのです」: Your power will only/　give birth to new calamities.
BMD\t「人の意志が、/ この星にさらなる災いを呼ぶのです」: The will of man/　brings further calamity to this planet.
BMD\t「後は私に任せて、眠りにつきなさい……」: Leave the rest to me, and sleep...
BMD\t「あなた達には、/ 力なき人々の願いがわからないのですか……？」: Do you not understand/　the wishes of the powerless...?
BMD\t「まだ不毛な争いを続ける気ですか？」: Will you continue this futile conflict?
BMD\t「あなた達は楽園を壊すつもりなのですか……？」: Do you intend to destroy paradise...?
BMD\t「ここは約束の地……/ あなた達の運命もまた……」: This is the promised land.../　And your fate, too...
BMD\t「もう一度言います。私こそが神なのです」: I will say it again. I am God.
BMD\t「私が護る楽園こそが、/ 安住の地だと言うのに……」: The paradise I protect/　is the only safe haven, and yet...
BMD\t「アイビス……/ あなたの翼を折るしかないようですね」: Ibis.../　It seems I must break your wings.
BMD\t「あなたが飛ぶべき空は、/ 楽園の中にあると言うのに……」: The sky you are meant to fly/　lies within paradise...
BMD\t「龍虎王……/ 彼らと運命を共にするのであれば……」: RyuKoOh.../　If you would share their fate...
BMD\t「クスハ……/ 龍虎王と共に戦い続けると言うのなら……」: Kusuha... If you insist on fighting/　alongside RyuKoOh...
BMD\t「ブリット……/ ガンエデンに従う気はないのですね……」: Bullet.../　You will not follow Gan Eden, then...
BMD\t「ゼンガー……/ ガンエデンの加護は、呪縛ではないのです」: Sänger... Gan Eden's protection/　is not a curse that binds you.
BMD\t「私の剣にはなってくれないのですね、/ ゼンガー……」: You will not become my sword,/　Sänger...
BMD\t「アラド……/ あなたが考えを改めないのであれば……」: Arado.../　If you will not change your mind...
BMD\t「ゼオラ……/ 私もあなた達を救うつもりだったのに」: Seolla.../　I meant to save you, too.
BMD\t「あなた達に血と力を分け与えたのは、/ ガンエデンなのです」: It was Gan Eden who gave you/　your blood and your power.
BMD\t「自らのルーツを否定するのですか、/ あなた達は……」: Would you deny your own roots,/　all of you...?
BMD\t「人の念で神の念を破ることは不可能です」: Man's will cannot overcome a god's will.
BMD\t「あなた達はガンエデンの末裔でもある……/ なのに……」: You are descendants of Gan Eden as well.../　And yet...
BMD\t「私はあなた達の敵ではありません……/ 神なのです」: I am not your enemy.../　I am God.
BMD\t「共に楽園を護る気はないのですか……？」: Will you not protect paradise with me...?
BMD\t「抗わず、ガンエデンの祝福を受け入れるのです」: Do not resist. Let Gan Eden bless you.
BMD\t「未来への道を/ 自ら閉ざすつもりなのですか……？」: Do you mean to close off/　your own path to the future...?
BMD\t「あなた達の力は、わかっています」: I know the extent of your power.
BMD\t「こいつは四霊……応龍の超機人なのさ」: This is one of the Four Spirits.../　the Choukijin Oryu.
BMD\t「応龍皇の力、君に見せてあげよう」: Let me show you the power of OryuOh.
BMD\t「四霊の超機人……その力を見たまえ」: A Choukijin of the Four Spirits.../　Behold its power.
BMD\t「人類みんなが仙人になれば、/ ハッピーに暮らせるのにね」: If all of humanity became immortals,/　everyone could live happily ever after.
BMD\t「さあて……行こうか、応龍皇」: Now then... Shall we go, OryuOh?
BMD\t「君達、桃源郷で/ 面白可笑しく生きる気はないのかい？」: Wouldn't you like to live a life/　of fun and games in paradise?
BMD\t「バラルの神こそが、地球の守護者なんだよ」: The gods of Baral are Earth's protectors.
BMD\t「安心したまえ。/ 君達が死んだ後は、僕達が地球を護るよ」: Rest easy./　Once you're dead, we'll protect the Earth.
BMD\t「この僕……孫光龍がお相手しよう」: I, Son Koryu, will be your opponent.
BMD\t「ふふふ……君の限りある命は、/ どこまでもつかな？」: Heh heh heh... I wonder how long/　your finite life will last?
BMD\t「応龍の力、君に見せてあげよう」: Let me show you the power of Oryu.
BMD\t「君の人生のラストシーン……/ この僕が演出してあげよう」: The final scene of your life.../　I'll direct it for you myself.
BMD\t「運命だと思って諦めるんだね」: Just call it fate and give up.
BMD\t「命乞いをするなら、手短に頼むよ」: If you're going to beg for your life,/　keep it short.
BMD\t「ふっ……君を見ていると、/ 昔戦った男を思い出すよ」: Heh... Looking at you reminds me/　of a man I once fought.
BMD\t「闘志だけではどうにもならないということを/ 教えてあげよう」: Allow me to teach you that Mettle alone/　won't get you anywhere.
BMD\t「ふふふ……その物言い、昔が懐かしいねえ」: Heh heh heh... That talk takes me back.
BMD\t「あの男の子孫なら、容赦しないよ」: No mercy for that man's descendant.
BMD\t「ふっ……/ 君も僕と同じ力を持っているようだね」: Heh.../　It seems you have the same power as me.
BMD\t「強念者たる僕の力を受けたまえ」: Feel the power of a strong psychic like me.
BMD\t「君と僕じゃ、念の力のレベルが違うんだよ」: Your psychic power is nowhere near mine.
BMD\t「なかなかの念を持っているようだね。/ けど……」: You seem to have quite a strong will./　But...
BMD\t「君達の力のルーツを知ってるかい？」: Do you know the roots of your power?
BMD\t「尸解すれば、/ 僕達にとっていい戦力になりそうだね」: Once you shed your mortal shell,/　you'd make a fine addition to our forces.
BMD\t「超機人に選ばれし者よ……/ その力を、バラルの神に捧げたまえ」: O chosen one of the Choukijin.../　offer your power to the gods of Baral.
BMD\t「尸解すれば、長生き出来るのにさ」: If you shed your mortal shell,/　you could live a long, long time.
BMD\t「ブリット君……クールにいこうよ、クールに」: Bullet... Stay cool, my friend. Cool.
BMD\t「クスハ君……/ 僕の誘いを断ったら、死んじゃうよ」: Kusuha.../　Refuse my invitation, and you'll die.
BMD\t「超機人はバラルの下にいて然るべきなんだよ」: The Choukijin rightfully belong to Baral.
BMD\t「君なら上手く尸解できると思うんだけどな」: I bet you'd shed your mortal shell nicely.
BMD\t「クスハ君……僕の所へ来てくれないのなら、/ 痛い目に遭ってもらうしか: Kusuha... If you won't come to me,/　I'll just have to hurt you a little.
BMD\t「虚ろな魂に強念か……アンバランスだね」: A hollow soul with strong psychic power.../　How unbalanced.
BMD\t「危ないものが混じってるみたいだねえ、/ 君には」: Seems there's something dangerous/　mixed into you.
BMD\t「君達の魂は虚ろだね。/ いや、そもそも魂なんてものは……」: Your souls are hollow./　No, come to think of it, souls are...
BMD\t「残念だけど、君は尸解できないね」: Sadly, you can't shed your mortal shell.
BMD\t「悪いけど、君は仙人になれないなぁ」: Sorry, but you can't become an immortal.
BMD\t「君の機体には/ なかなか興味深い装置が積んであるね」: Your machine carries/　quite an interesting device.
BMD\t「僕は君のご先祖様と縁があってね」: I have a connection to your ancestor.
BMD\t「Ｖ・Ｂの子孫でも、遠慮はしないよ」: Even a V.B. descendant gets no mercy.
BMD\t「四神の超機人……/ 再び僕の前に立ち塞がるか」: A Choukijin of the Four Gods.../　Standing in my way once again?
BMD\t「超機人としての格の差を教えてあげよう」: Let me show you the difference in rank/　between Choukijin.
BMD\t「青龍ごときが、/ 応龍に勝てると思っているのかい？」: Does a mere Seiryu think/　it can beat an Oryu?
BMD\t「四霊と四神……力の差は歴然なのさ」: Four Spirits versus Four Gods.../　The gap in power is obvious.
BMD\t「フフフ……機人大戦の再来だね」: Heh heh heh.../　The Kijin War all over again.
BMD\t「文字通り尻尾を巻いて逃げ出すなら、/ 今の内だよ」: If you're going to turn tail and run,/　literally, now's your chance.
BMD\t「鋼の龍が応龍に勝てるものか」: As if a steel dragon could beat an Oryu.
BMD\t「あの艦を沈めれば、/ ゲームオーバー……かな？」: If I sink that ship,/　it's game over... right?
BMD\t「神に逆らう者は、/ 悪魔に決まってるじゃあないか」: Those who defy the gods/　are devils, obviously.
BMD\t「それじゃ、こっちの出し物を」: Well then, time for my act.
BMD\t「いやいや、いいものを見せてもらったよ」: Well, well, that was quite a show.
BMD\t「ふふふ……フェアにいこう、フェアに」: Heh heh heh... Let's play fair. Fair.
BMD\t「悪いけど、もう少し付き合ってもらうよ」: Sorry, but bear with me a bit longer.
BMD\t「ここまでか。楽しませてもらったよ！」: That's it, then. You were fun!
BMD\t「また会えるかな？ あははははは！」: Will we meet again? Ah ha ha ha ha!
BMD\t「こいつはとっておきの武器だよ！/ とっといて！！」: This one's my ace in the hole!/　Here, take it!!
BMD\t「ガツーンと行くよ！ ガツーンと！！」: Gonna hit you hard! Really hard!!
BMD\t「抜いたら凄いんだからっ！！」: Once I whip it out, it's amazing!!
BMD\t「そらそらそら！」: Take that, and that, and that!
BMD\t「アップ・ロック！ 怒濤の６連発！」: Up Rock! A raging six-hit combo!
BMD\t「今度は超本気で行くよ！」: This time I'm getting super serious!
BMD\t「６でもない目に遭ったでしょ？」: Bet that made you sick... six, get it?
BMD\t「さあ、派手に撃ち出すよっ！」: Okay, let's fire it off with a bang!
BMD\t「最後はあたしも撃ち出すっ！」: And to finish, I'll launch myself too!
BMD\t「あたし達の華麗なステップ、/ 見せてあげるよ！」: Let us show you/　our dazzling steps!
BMD\t「外れたら、/ 名実共にタダじゃ済まないんだから！」: If it misses,/　it'll cost me in more ways than one!
BMD\t「どっからどうやって撃ってんのか、/ 実はよくわかんないんだけど……」: To be honest, I'm not really sure/　where or how it fires from...
BMD\t「必殺の一撃だってことは、知ってるよ！」: But I know it's a finishing blow!
BMD\t「無駄に火薬ばかり多くてな」: It's got far more powder than it needs.
BMD\t「威力は受けて確かめろ！」: Take the hit and see how strong it is!
BMD\t「もらう……！ こちらの牙は鋭いぞ……！」: You're mine...! These fangs are sharp...!
BMD\t「これがこちらの手札だ……！」: This is the hand I'm playing...!
BMD\t「もらう……！ こちらの翼は斬れるぞ！」: You're mine...! These wings can cut!
BMD\t「最大出力……！/ グルンガスト、やってみせろ！」: Maximum output...!/　Grungust, show me what you can do!
BMD\t「剣も使い勝手は悪くない……！」: A sword handles well enough too...!
BMD\t「角ばかりだと思うなよ！」: Don't think the horns are all I've got!
BMD\t「博士の趣味はわからんが……」: I don't get the Doctor's taste, but...
BMD\t「伊達や酔狂で/ この鋏をつけているわけではないぞ……！」: I don't carry these pincers/　just for show...!
BMD\t「この攻撃に賭けさせてもらうぞ……！」: I'm betting it all on this attack...!
BMD\t「チップは払った……もう後戻りはできん」: The chips are in... no turning back now.
BMD\t「ビルガー、やってみせろ……！」: Bilgear, show me what you can do...!
BMD\t「このような装備もあるんでな……！」: I've got gear like this too...!
BMD\t「Ｅモードにセット。/ ……なんとか当ててみせる……！」: Set to E Mode./　...I'll land it somehow...!
BMD\t「遠くからの攻撃は性に合わんが……/ 仕方あるまい……！」: Long-range attacks aren't my style.../　but it can't be helped...!
BMD\t「Ｂモードにセット。/ ……なんとか当ててみせる……！」: Set to B Mode./　...I'll land it somehow...!
BMD\t「これも実弾だ。/ ……とはいえ、同じとは言えんか」: These are live rounds too./　...Not quite the same, though.
BMD\t「ヴァイスの後継機なら、やってみせろ……！」: If you're Weiss's successor, prove it...!
BMD\t「当たりさえすれば……ただでは済まんぞ！」: If this connects... you won't walk away clean!
BMD\t「殴り合いなら……ひけはとらんぞ！」: In a slugfest... I won't be outdone!
BMD\t「悪いが、この距離なら慣れている……！」: Sorry, but I'm used to this range...!
BMD\t「まとめて面倒を見る……！/ ジガン、頼むぞ！」: I'll take you all on at once...!/　Jigan, I'm counting on you!
BMD\t「悪いが、ぶつかるのは得意でな……！」: Sorry, but ramming is my specialty...!
BMD\t「格闘戦なら、ひけはとらんぞ！」: In close combat, I won't be outdone!
BMD\t「止められると思うな！」: Don't think you can stop me!
BMD\t「こういう武器も得意ではないんだがな」: Not that I'm much good with weapons like this.
BMD\t「一発でも多く当たれば……それでいい！」: If just a few more shots hit... that's enough!
BMD\t「かわせるか？ 獅子王の刃を！」: Can you dodge the Shishioh's blade?!
BMD\t「射撃は苦手なんだがな。/ ……四の五の言っていられんか」: Shooting's not my strong suit./　...But no time to complain.
BMD\t「多少古くさい武装だが、威力は関係ない！」: It's a bit dated, but power is power!
BMD\t「前より大口径だ……/ 威力は受けて確かめろ！」: It's a bigger caliber than before.../　Take the hit and see how strong it is!
BMD\t「撃ち貫くのみ！」: I'll just shoot right through it!
BMD\t「私の邪魔は、誰にもさせない！」: I won't let anyone get in my way!
BMD\t「悔い改めるなら、今の内よっ！！」: If you're going to repent, do it now!!
BMD\t「そこのあなた、後悔しても遅いわよ！」: You there, it's too late for regrets!
BMD\t「必ず当ててみせる！」: I'll hit you, no matter what!
BMD\t「そこのあなた、正々堂々と勝負よ！」: You there, let's have a fair fight!
BMD\t「ガンナーの力、見せてあげるわ！」: I'll show you the Gunner's power!
BMD\t「彼らの連係を崩さなきゃ！」: I have to break up their teamwork!
BMD\t「ラトゥーニ達に手出しはさせない！」: I won't let you touch Latune and the others!
BMD\t「イグニス、あなた達の横暴を私は許さない！」: Ignis, I won't tolerate your tyranny!
BMD\t「メリオルエッセ……/ あなた達がまき散らす恐怖、食い止めてみせる！」: Meliores Esse.../　I'll stop the terror you're spreading!
BMD\t「メリオルエッセが相手でも、/ 引き下がりはしない！」: Even against the Meliores Esse,/　I won't back down!
BMD\t「コンターギオ、笑ってられるのも今の内よ！」: Contagio, laugh while you still can!
BMD\t「ペルフェクティオ！/ 破滅するのは、あなたの方よ！」: Perfectio!/　You're the one who'll be destroyed!
BMD\t「あなた！ しゃきっと喋ったらどうなの！」: You! Why don't you speak up properly!
BMD\t「ゼゼーナン、あなたに正義なんてないわ！」: Zezenan, there's no justice on your side!
BMD\t「その仮面、剥がしてやるわ！」: I'll tear that mask right off you!
BMD\t「それが……/ あなたの正義だと言うのなら……！」: If that.../　If that's what you call justice...!
BMD\t「孫光龍！ あなたの好きにはさせないわ！」: Son Koryu! I won't let you have your way!
BMD\t「孫光龍！ あなたは間違いなく悪よ！」: Son Koryu! You're evil, without a doubt!
BMD\t「ノイエＤＣ……こんな所にまで！」: The Neo DC... even out here!
BMD\t「召喚された者同士で戦ったって！」: Why should the summoned fight each other?!
BMD\t「あなた達の行動は、/ ラ・ギアスを混乱させるだけじゃないの！？」: Your actions will only plunge/　La Gias into chaos!
BMD\t「ガイアセイバーズ、/ あなた達には屈しないわ！」: Gaia Savers,/　I won't bow to you!
BMD\t「機体さえ何とかすれば…！」: If I can just take care of that machine...!
BMD\t「メディウス・ロクス……油断は出来ない！」: The Medius Locus... I can't let my guard down!
BMD\t「さあ、化け物退治よ！」: All right, time to slay a monster!
BMD\t「ルイーナを食い止めなきゃ……！」: We have to stop the Ruina...!
BMD\t「ルイーナは私達の手で止めてみせる！」: We'll stop the Ruina with our own hands!
BMD\t「ゲスト！ 地球圏から出て行きなさい！」: Guest! Get out of the Earth Sphere!
BMD\t「どうした？ それで終わりなのか？」: What's wrong? Is that all you've got?
BMD\t「さすがだと言っておこうか」: I'll grant you that much. Impressive.
BMD\t「ふん、諦めの悪い連中だな」: Hmph. You lot just don't know when to quit.
BMD\t「私に逆らった罪、万死に値する！」: Defying me merits a thousand deaths!
BMD\t「バラン＝シュナイル……よく保つ」: The Baran-Schneil... It holds up well.
BMD\t「勢いだけで、/ このバラン＝シュナイルは倒せんぞ」: Momentum alone won't/　bring down the Baran-Schneil.
BMD\t「バラン＝シュナイルは/ 我が軍最強の兵器……/ 貴様らもそのことを知: The Baran-Schneil is our/　army's mightiest weapon.../　Surely even you know that.
BMD\t「それが魔装機神の力か？」: Is that the power of a Masoukishin?
BMD\t「それでヒュッケバインの後継機などと……」: And you call that the Hückebein's successor...
BMD\t「貴様らの力など、所詮その程度よ」: That's all your power amounts to.
BMD\t「ふん、大人しく投降した方が身のためだぞ」: Hmph. Surrender quietly, for your own good.
BMD\t「思っていた程ではないな」: Not as good as I expected.
BMD\t「ふっ、意気込みだけではな」: Heh. Enthusiasm alone won't cut it.
BMD\t「グランゾンの力は、その程度か？」: Is that all the Granzon has?
BMD\t「私に刃向かった罪……許し難い」: The crime of defying me... is unforgivable.
BMD\t「サイバスター……素早いだけか」: Cybuster... Is speed all you have?
BMD\t「大仰な得物だが、大したことはないな」: A grandiose weapon, but nothing to fear.
BMD\t「猿とじゃれ合う気はない」: I've no interest in playing with monkeys.
BMD\t「ちっ、リロードが間に合わんとは……！」: Tch! I can't reload in time...!
BMD\t「まあいい、奴だけに構ってはいられん」: Very well. I can't waste all my time on one foe.
BMD\t「くっ、死角に入られたか……」: Ngh! They slipped into my blind spot...
BMD\t「さあ、観念するがいい……！」: Now, resign yourself to your fate...!
BMD\t「貴様らの好きにはやらせん！」: I won't let you do as you please!
BMD\t「このバラン＝シュナイルから/ 逃げられると思うな」: Don't think you can escape/　the Baran-Schneil.
LDBI\t「行くぞ！ 総員、対衝撃防御！」: Here we go! All hands, brace for impact!
LDBI\t「こ、これはどういうことだ！？@ 何故、発進させた！？ アルテウルッ: Wh-What is the meaning of this!?@Why did you launch!? Arteuru!!
LDBI\t「か、艦長！ 艦前方に輸送機が！@ 距離８００！！」: C-Captain! A transport plane dead ahead!@Distance 800!!
BMD\t「おぬしの命が翳っておるぞ……！」: The shadow of death hangs over you...!
BMD\t「行く手を阻むものは、全て打ち倒す！」: I will strike down all who bar my path!
BMD\t「『剣ハ抜クベカラザルモノ』……/ じゃが、ここは致し方あるまい」: 'A sword is not meant to be drawn'.../　But here, it cannot be helped.
BMD\t「超闘士の力、とくと見よ！」: Behold the might of the Super Fighter!
BMD\t「我ら地球人の意地を見よ！」: Behold the resolve of us Earthlings!
BMD\t「異星の者よ、いざ尋常に勝負！」: Alien, face me in fair combat!
BMD\t「その邪念、ここで断ち切ってくれる」: I will sever that malice here and now.
BMD\t「不肖の弟子は斬らねばならぬか……！」: Must I cut down my unworthy pupil...!
BMD\t「おぬしの剣は邪なものに染まっておる」: Your sword has been tainted by evil.
BMD\t「おぬしの理想ごと、断ち切ってくれる！」: I'll cut you down, ideals and all!
BMD\t「ふん……死に時と場所は、自分で見極めるわ」: Hmph... The time and place of my death/　are mine to decide.
BMD\t「仙人になってまで/ 長生きしようと思っておらぬ」: I've no desire to become a hermit/　just to live a long life.
BMD\t「泰北……いざ尋常に勝負！」: Taihoku... face me in fair combat!
BMD\t「この戦、負けるわけにはいかぬ」: This is one battle I cannot lose.
BMD\t「ふふ……まさに、一世一代の勝負じゃな」: Heh heh.../　This truly is the fight of my life.
BMD\t「ここで破滅するのは、お主だけでよいわ！」: The only one meeting ruin here is you!
BMD\t「お主らに、/ 地球の守護者を名乗る資格はない！」: You have no right/　to call yourselves Earth's protectors!
BMD\t「孫光龍……/ 我が先祖に代わり、お主を討つ！」: Son Koryu.../　I'll strike you down for my ancestor!
BMD\t「お主との一戦……我がトウゴウ家の宿命よの」: This battle with you.../　is the destiny of the Togo family.
BMD\t「戦うべき相手を違えるでない！」: Do not mistake who your true enemy is!
BMD\t「おぬし達に地球は渡さぬ！」: We will not hand Earth over to you!
BMD\t「あんなものがおるとは……/ 長生きはしてみるもんじゃ」: To think such a thing exists.../　It pays to live a long life.
BMD\t「偽神は、我が剣にて湮滅すべし！」: The false god shall be/　annihilated by my blade!
BMD\t「ユーゼス……因果地平の彼方へ去れい！」: Euzeth.../　Begone beyond the horizon of causality!
BMD\t「妖機人め、成敗してくれるわ！」: Yokijin, I'll cut you down where you stand!
BMD\t「四神の超機人……相手にとって不足なし！」: A Choukijin of the Four Gods.../　A worthy foe indeed!
BMD\t「四神でありながら、人界に仇なすか……！」: One of the Four Gods,/　yet you would harm humankind...!
BMD\t「四凶は滅すべし！」: The Four Fiends must be destroyed!
BMD\t「なんの、ここからじゃ！」: Not yet! This is where it begins!
BMD\t「もう一踏ん張りしようかの」: Time to push a little harder.
BMD\t「……年寄りの出番は、ここまでのようじゃ」: ...It seems this old man's part ends here.
BMD\t「むうう……こちらは/ 老骨に鞭を打っておるというのに」: Hrrm... And here I am/　pushing these old bones to their limit.
BMD\t「こりゃ！ 年寄りはもっと大切にせんか！」: Hey! Show your elders some respect!
BMD\t「そんなもので/ 我が意地を砕くことは出来んぞ！」: That won't be enough/　to break my resolve!
BMD\t「ぐうっ！ このワシを退かせるとは……！！」: Gah! To think you'd force me back...!!
BMD\t「おぬしに討たれるワシではないわ！！」: I'm not one to fall to the likes of you!!
BMD\t「ううっ……！ 昔のようにはいかんのう」: Ugh...! I'm not what I used to be.
BMD\t「むうっ、奴の舞に惑わされたか！」: Hrm, I was misled by its dance!
BMD\t「むう、やはりただの老いぼれではないのう」: Hmm, you're no mere old geezer after all.
BMD\t「法外な攻めよの。/ じゃが、光龍……お主には負けぬ！」: Outrageous attacks./　But Koryu... I won't lose to you!
BMD\t「水の魔装機神の力、見せてあげるわ」: I'll show you the power of the/　Elemental Lord of water!
BMD\t「私の前に立ったのが、あなたの不運だったわね」: Crossing my path was your misfortune.
BMD\t「殿下！ 理由を教えて下さい！/ そうでないと、私は……私は！」: Your Highness! Tell me your reasons!/　Otherwise, I... I'll...!
BMD\t「何故……何故なんですか、殿下！？/ 私には、殿下の御心がわかりません: Why... Why, Your Highness!?/　I cannot fathom your heart...
BMD\t「殿下……何を隠しておられるのです？/ 本当の理由を教えて下さい！」: Your Highness... What are you hiding?/　Tell me the real reason!
BMD\t「殿下……心中の苦しみ、お察し致します……/ しかし、私はガッデスの操: Your Highness... I sense your anguish.../　But I am Gaddess's pilot!
BMD\t「……もはや、退く道は/ 残されていないのですね、殿下……/ ならば、: ...So there's no turning back/　anymore, Your Highness.../　Then this farewell is all I can offer!
BMD\t「私が……/ もっと早く殿下のことに気付いていれば……/ 他に手立てが: If only I had realized sooner/　what was happening to Your Highness.../　there might have been another way!
BMD\t「カークス将軍、力は抑制するためにあるのです！/ むやみに振り回すのは: Power is meant to be held in check,/　General Kirkus! Swinging it around/　recklessly is what a child does!
BMD\t「いったい、/ 何があなたをそこまで変えてしまったんですか、/ カーク: What on earth/　changed you so much,/　General Kirkus!?
BMD\t「確かにあなたの実力は認めます、カークス将軍。/ しかし、簒奪行為は見: I acknowledge your skill, General Kirkus./　But I can't overlook usurpation!
BMD\t「さすがはオールト将軍……/ ブローウェルをここまで改造してしまうなん: As expected of General Oort.../　To modify Blowell this far...
BMD\t「オールト将軍……/ あくまでも殿下と共に戦うのなら……/ 私も力の限: General Oort... If you insist/　on fighting beside His Highness.../　then I'll give it everything I have!
BMD\t「あなたの忠誠心には敬意を表します、/ オールト将軍……/ しかし私は: I respect your loyalty,/　General Oort.../　But I am an Elemental Lord pilot!
BMD\t「ザムジードは、/ あなた達が勝手に使っていいような/ 機体じゃないの: Zamzeed isn't some machine/　you can just use/　however you please!
BMD\t「シュテドニアスの手に渡ってるなんて……/ 必ず取り戻してあげるわ、ザ: So Schtedonias has its hands on you.../　I'll take you back, Zamzeed. I swear it!
BMD\t「あのザムジードを/ 無理矢理従わせるなんて……許さない！」: Forcing Zamzeed/　to obey against its will... Unforgivable!
BMD\t「この反応速度……ただの兵士ではないようね。/ 気をつけないと」: These reflexes... No ordinary soldier./　I have to be careful.
BMD\t「意外とやり手ね、この相手……/ 心してかからないと」: This one's better than I expected.../　I'd better take this seriously.
BMD\t「構えに隙がない……油断ならない相手ね」: No openings in that stance.../　A dangerous foe.
BMD\t「お決まりのアストラルシフト装甲……/ しかも、対エクトプラズム処理ま: The usual Astral Shift armor.../　plus anti-ectoplasm treatment, too./　Fighting it is a waste of time.
BMD\t「あなたを相手にしている暇はないの、ルオゾール！/ さっさと退散しなさ: I don't have time for you, Luozorl!/　Just go away already!
BMD\t「いつもみたいにさっさと逃げ出せば？/ ルオゾール！」: Why not run off like you always do,/　Luozorl?
BMD\t「いい動きをしてるわ……/ かなりの手練れね。気をつけないと」: Nice moves.../　Quite the expert. I must be careful.
BMD\t「一筋縄ではいきそうにない相手ね。/ 慎重にいかないと」: This one won't go down easily./　I'll have to be cautious.
BMD\t「どういうつもりなの、アハマド！/ あなたのやっていることは、/ 魔装: What are you thinking, Ahmad!?/　What you're doing is unforgivable/　for a Masouki pilot!
BMD\t「ラングランの魔装機操者同士が戦うなんて……/ こんなの、おかしいと思: Masouki pilots of Langran fighting.../　Don't you think this is wrong!?
BMD\t「アハマド、/ あなたにはあなたの正義があるんでしょう……/ けど！: Ahmad,/　I'm sure you have your own justice.../　But! I won't side with it!
BMD\t「ラテル！/ こんな無意味な戦いを続ける必要はありません！/ 投降しな: Ratel!/　No need to keep up this pointless fight!/　Surrender!
BMD\t「……仕方ないわね。/ あくまでも抵抗するというなら、/ 実力を行使し: ...It can't be helped./　If you insist on resisting,/　I'll use force!
BMD\t「テリウス王子を奪われた以上、/ 戦う意味なんてないでしょうに！」: With Prince Tellius taken from you,/　there's no reason left to fight!
BMD\t「ライオネス少尉、でしたわね。/ こんなことに命を懸ける必要はありませ: Lieutenant Lioness, wasn't it?/　You needn't risk your life over this./　Please withdraw.
BMD\t「どうしても戦うというのなら、/ 遠慮はしませんよ、ライオネス少尉！」: If you insist on fighting,/　I won't hold back, Lieutenant Lioness!
BMD\t「あなた……/ もしかして、ラテルのために戦ってるの？」: You... Could it be/　you're fighting for Ratel's sake?
BMD\t「あなた達に/ 地球の守護者を名乗る資格はないわ」: You have no right/　to call yourselves Earth's protectors.
BMD\t「戦う相手を間違っているでしょう、/ あなた達は！」: You're fighting the wrong enemy,/　all of you!
BMD\t「これ以上、/ 地上世界を混乱させてどうするの！」: What do you gain by throwing/　the surface world into further chaos!?
BMD\t「炎には水……このガッデスなら！」: Water beats fire... Gaddess can do this!
BMD\t「メリオルエッセ……油断は出来ないわね」: A Meliorlesse... I can't let my guard down.
BMD\t「“破滅の王”……容赦はしないわよ！」: "King of Ruin"... I won't show any mercy!
BMD\t「待っていて……必ず助けるわ！」: Hold on... I'll save you, I promise!
BMD\t「私達の星を蹂躙することは許さない！」: I won't let you trample our planet!
BMD\t「ゲスト……地球圏から出て行きなさい！」: Guests... Get out of the Earth Sphere!
BMD\t「異星人の中にも変わった人がいるのね……」: So even aliens have their oddballs...
BMD\t「不老不死が/ 人を本当に幸せにするとは思えない……！」: I can't believe immortality/　could ever make people truly happy...!
BMD\t「夏喃、あなたの誘いには乗らないわ」: Kanan, I won't fall for your invitation.
BMD\t「人が人でなくなることに、/ 幸福は見出せないわ……！」: There's no happiness to be found/　in ceasing to be human...!
BMD\t「孫光龍……一筋縄ではいかない相手ね」: Sun Koryu... He won't go down easily.
BMD\t「光龍、/ あなたの価値観に賛同する気は毛頭ないわ！」: Koryu,/　I have no intention of sharing your values!
BMD\t「あんな化け物が神の名を騙るなんて……/ おこがましいにも程があるわ！: That monster claims to be a god.../　The arrogance is beyond belief!
BMD\t「やられたままでいるものか！」: I won't just sit here and take it!
BMD\t「この距離なら撃ち返すことも出来る！」: At this range, I can shoot back!
BMD\t「まだやれるわよ、アイビス！」: We can still do this, Ibis!
BMD\t「まだレンジ内よ！ 反撃、いけるわ！」: Still in range! We can counter!
BMD\t「ピンチの後にチャンスありよ！」: After every crisis comes a chance!
BMD\t「レンジ内よ！ 反撃、いけるわ！」: It's in range! We can counter!
BMD\t「やられた分はきっちり返す！」: I'll pay back every hit in full!
BMD\t「まだだ！ まだ落ちちゃ駄目だ！！」: Not yet! I can't go down yet!!
BMD\t「く……！ こ、このままじゃ/ やられるのを待つだけだ！」: Ngh...! A-at this rate,/　I'm just waiting to get shot down!
BMD\t「や、やられる……/ このままじゃやられる！」: I-I'm gonna get hit.../　At this rate, I'm done for!
BMD\t「まずい……これ以上は……！」: This is bad... Any more and...!
BMD\t「これ以上のダメージはさばききれない……！」: I can't handle any more damage...!
BMD\t「ダメージ大！ もって、あと一発よ！」: Heavy damage! One more hit, at most!
BMD\t「その前に何としてもあいつを倒す……！」: Before then, I have to beat that thing...!
BMD\t「損傷率レッドゾーン！/ ここは一時、退いて！」: Damage in the red zone!/　Pull back for now!
BMD\t「まだやれる……ううん、やってみせるよ！」: I can still go... No, I'll prove I can!
BMD\t「損傷度をチェックして！ まだ戦えるよ！」: Check the damage! I can still fight!
BMD\t「くっ！/ ハイペリオンでも、ここまでなのか！」: Ngh!/　Is this the Hyperlion's limit!?
BMD\t「スレイ！ 自分で限界を決めちゃ駄目だよ！」: Sleigh! Don't go deciding your own limits!
BMD\t「まずいぞ！ テスラ・ドライブ出力低下！」: Not good! Tesla Drive output dropping!
BMD\t「ごめん、スレイ！ あと少しだけもたせて！」: Sorry, Sleigh! Hold out a little longer!
BMD\t「ぜ、絶望なんて……するもんか！！」: I-I won't... give in to despair!!
BMD\t「だ、駄目だ！/ あたしの腕じゃ勝てない……！」: I-it's no good!/　I'm not skilled enough to win...!
BMD\t「あいつに勝てなきゃ、/ あたし達の夢が終わっちゃう……！」: If I can't beat it,/　our dream will be over...!
BMD\t「このままじゃ、/ あいつの思い通りになってしまう……！」: At this rate,/　it'll get exactly what it wants...!
BMD\t「駄目だ……あいつの力に飲まれてる……！」: No good... Its power is swallowing me...!
BMD\t「く……こいつの力……/ やっぱり並じゃない……！」: Ngh... This thing's power.../　It really is no joke...!
BMD\t「駄目だ……。/ やっぱり、あたしじゃスレイには……！」: It's no good.../　I just can't match Sleigh after all...!
BMD\t「スレイ！ あたしは最後の瞬間まで戦うよ！」: Sleigh! I'll fight to the very last moment!
BMD\t「スレイ……/ 最後の最後まであたしは諦めない！」: Sleigh.../　I won't give up until the very end!
BMD\t「あの黒い奴……！ 動きが追えない！」: That black one...! I can't track it!
BMD\t「こ、超えてみせる……！/ あの超機人のスピードを！」: I-I'll surpass it...!/　That Choukijin's speed!
BMD\t「あ、あいつの頭上を飛び越えなきゃ！」: I-I have to fly right over its head!
BMD\t「こ、これが邪神の力……！！」: S-so this is the evil god's power...!!
BMD\t「あんなのと一つになってたまるものかっ！！」: Like I'd ever become one with that thing!!
BMD\t「ここでやられたら、イルイを助け出せない！」: If I go down here, I can't rescue Irui!
BMD\t「ぐうっ！ ユーゼス、/ あたしはまだ飛べる！ 飛ぶんだ！」: Gah! Euzeth,/　I can still fly! And I will!
BMD\t「く……！ かわしきれない！」: Ngh...! I can't dodge it all!
BMD\t「損傷率イエローゾーン！ このままじゃ！」: Damage in the yellow zone! At this rate...!
BMD\t「まだ飛べる！ あたしはまだ飛べるよ！」: I can still fly! I can still fly!
BMD\t「こ、これ以上の被弾は/ 機体を失うことになる！」: A-any more hits/　and we'll lose the machine!
BMD\t「や、やられる前に/ せめて一撃でも返すんだ！」: B-before I go down,/　I'll land at least one hit!

LDBI\t「そのシステムにより、@ 我は意のままに因果律を操作することが可能と: With that system, I will be able to@manipulate causality at will.@It is omnipotence, the power of a true god...
LDBI\t「まさか、ユーゼスが呼び出したの！？」: Don't tell me Euzeth summoned it!?
LDBI\t「あれ、本物じゃないわよ。分身でもないけど」: That's not the real one.@It's not an Afterimage, either, though.
LDBI\t「そういうわけでもないみたいだけど……」: Doesn't look like that's it either, though...
LDBI\t「本物でも偽物でも、@ 何でユーゼスがヴォルクルスを@ 召喚できるん: Real or fake, how the hell@is Euzeth able to summon Volkruss!?
LDBI\t「おそらく、彼ではなく……@ クロスゲートの力によるものでしょう」: Most likely, it isn't his doing...@but the power of the Crossgate.
LDBI\t「あれは、私達が知っているヴォルクルスとは@ 少し違うようですから…: That Volkruss seems a little different from@the one we know... so it was most likely@summoned from some parallel world.
LDBI\t「だとしても、よりにもよって@ あんな奴が……！」: Even so, of all the things@to call up, it had to be that...!
LDBI\t「それは……ユーゼスが言った、私とあなたの@ 再有生を経た因縁が原因: That may stem from the bond Euzeth spoke of...@yours and mine, carried through rebirth.
LDBI\t「クストースと四凶が！」: The Custos and the Four Evils!
LDBI\t「あれもクロスゲートの仕業かよ！？」: Is that the Crossgate's doing too!?
LDBI\t「我こそはアルファであり、オメガである。@ 我こそは終わりであり、始: I am the Alpha and the Omega.@I am the end and the beginning.@I am all of Space and all of time.
LDBI\t「もはや、起因など知る必要はない。@ 過去の因果、因縁、虚憶、忌憶に: I no longer need to know the origin.@Nor am I bound by past causality, fate,@false memories, or cursed memories.
LDBI\t「愚帝、監察者、監査者、そして神ですら@ 我を沮止すること能わず」: Neither the Foolish Emperor, the Observers,@the Inspectors, nor even God can stop me.
LDBI\t「我に纏わるもの全てを隠滅させ、@ 我が新たな、数多の世界を創り出し: I shall erase all that is tied to me,@create countless new worlds,@and become the law that governs them.
LDBI\t「因果、因縁、輪廻すらも我が新たに構築する」: Causality, fate, even reincarnation itself...@I shall build them all anew.
LDBI\t「そして、四劫を超越し、@ 我が新たな人類の祖……新人祖となるのだ」: Then, transcending the Four Kalpas, I shall@become the forebear of a new humanity...@the New Progenitor.
LDBI\t「あ、新たな世界を創り出すって……@ 神にでもなるつもりなのか！？」: Y-You're gonna create new worlds...?@What, are you trying to become a god!?
LDBI\t「人造の神が本物の神に……！？」: A man-made god becoming a real one...!?
LDBI\t「思いっ切り広げたわねぇ、大風呂敷を」: My, my, he sure went all out with the big talk.
LDBI\t「フン、黙って御託を聞いていれば……@ 要は、この宇宙を滅ぼすと言う: Hmph. I've sat through your drivel...@and it boils down to destroying all of Space.
LDBI\t「長い口上の割には、シンプルな目的だな」: Simple goal for such a long speech.
LDBI\t「新人祖の誕生を讃えつつ、消散せよ。@ 我が創造する世界、永久の楽園: Praise the birth of the New Progenitor as you@fade away. The eternal paradise I create@has no need for the old bloodlines.
LDBI\t「今のあなたが本当に因果律を操作できるのであれば、@ 私達の存在を消: If you truly can manipulate causality now,@wouldn't erasing our existence be simple?

LDBI\t「死に至るお前達の苦悶、絶望を@ 新人祖誕生の賛美歌へと変えるのだ」: Your agony and despair as you die@shall become a hymn celebrating@the birth of the New Progenitor.
LDBI\t「自分の手でケリをつけなきゃ、気が済まねえってか。@ そいつは俺も同: So you won't be satisfied unless you settle@it yourself, huh? Well, same goes for me!

LDBI\t「ユーゼス……イングラムに代わって、お前を討つ。@ 例え、私の創造主: Euzeth... I'll strike you down in Ingram's@place. Even if you are my creator.
LDBI\t「あたしは、イルイが消えたなんて信じない……@ あんたがガンエデンを: I won't believe Irui is gone...@Not as long as you've taken over Gan Eden@and you're right there like that...

LDBI\t「もはや、お前達は輪廻転生、再有生すること能わず。@ あらゆる宇宙、: You can no longer be reincarnated or reborn.@I shall purge you from all of Space@and from every world in existence.
LDBI\t「その前にてめえが消えろ！@ 前世の記憶、俺達との因縁もろともにな！: You disappear first! Along with your past-life@memories and your whole history with us!!

LDBI\t「奴らまで来ているとなれば……@ フン、もうしばしこの異界にいるのも: If even they've come... Hmph. Lingering in this@other world a while longer may prove amusing.
LDBI\t「ヤンロン！ 何しに来たのよ！？」: Yang Long! What are you doing here!?
LDBI\t「君達を助けに来たんだ。応援を連れてな」: I came to help you. And I brought backup.
LDBI\t「ゲンナジー・Ｉ・コズイレフだ。@ こいつは<魔装機>ジャオーム。よ: Name's Gennacy I. Kozyrev.@This here's the <魔装機> Jaohm. Glad to help.
LDBI\t「やれやれ、さっきのことを根に持っているな？@ 何も僕は彼らを助ける: Honestly, you're still sore about earlier?@I never said I was against helping them.
LDBI\t「彼を知りて己を知れば、百戦して危うからず……@ 敵の情報を得ぬまま: Know the enemy, know yourself, and you'll never@fall in a hundred battles. I was only cautioning@against rushing in without intel on the enemy.
LDBI\t「わかった、わかったよ！@ お説教なら、後でたっぷり聞いてやるから！: Okay, okay, I get it!@I'll listen to all the lecturing you want later!
LDBI\t「……雇い主は逃げたか。@ ならば、この勝負、預けておくぞ」: ...My employer has fled.@Then we'll settle this another time.
LDBI\t「……よし、追っ手は片付いたか。@ 礼を言うぜ、キョウスケ、リューネ: ...Good, looks like we're rid of the pursuers.@Thanks, Kyosuke, Lüne.
LDBI\t「タイミングが良かったよ。@ でも、何であいつらに追われてたの？」: Lucky we showed up when we did.@But why were they chasing you?
LDBI\t「こっちも聞きてえことが色々ある。@ 情報交換といこうぜ」: We've got plenty of questions of our own.@Let's trade info.
LDBI\t「……演習中に召喚されたのなら、@ ヒリュウ改やハガネもこっちへ来て: ...If you were summoned during an exercise,@we'd better assume the Hiryu Custom and Hagane@came over here too...
LDBI\t「俺やカチーナ中尉とラッセルは@ 同じ所へ出て来たんだが、レオナや他: Lieutenant Katina, Russel, and I ended up in the@same spot, but Leona and the others seem to've@been sent somewhere else...
LDBI\t「で、仲間を捜してる途中で@ あのスットコドッコイ軍に出会ったわけよ: So while we were looking for our friends,@we ran into the Shtinkydonias army.
LDBI\t「おう、それそれ。@ 奴らはあたしらを保護するとか言い出して、@ 協: Yeah, that's the one.@They said they'd take us under their wing,@and asked for our cooperation, but...
LDBI\t「連中の中にあの武者ガーリオンがいてな。@ それで胡散臭いと思って断: That samurai Guarlion was with 'em.@Smelled fishy, so we turned 'em down,@and they jumped us out of nowhere.
LDBI\t「味方にならねば、敵に回る……@ 早い内に片づけておこうと考えたか」: If you won't join them, you're against them...@So they decided to deal with you early on.

BMD\t「汝らの力は、我が与えしもの……」: Your power is that which I bestowed...
BMD\t「始祖に刃向かう愚念は滅すべし」: Foolish wills that defy their/　progenitor must be destroyed.
BMD\t「汝らの血と念は、我に連なるもの……」: Your blood and will descend from me...

BMD\t「終焉の時は近い……」: The time of the end is near...

BMD\t「人が神に仇なすなどと……」: That man would oppose a god...
BMD\t「最後の楽園なくして、人に未来はない……」: Without the last paradise,/　mankind has no future...
BMD\t「古人の願いを無に帰す気か……」: Would you render the ancients'/　wishes meaningless...
BMD\t「愚かな選択を認めるわけにはいかぬ……」: I cannot accept such a foolish choice...

BMD\t「ためらわないで、アイビス……/ 私を……早く……！」: Don't hesitate, Ibis.../　Destroy me... hurry...!

BMD\t「ゼンガー……/ ガンエデンを……私に構わず……！」: Sänger.../　Gan Eden... don't worry about me...!
BMD\t「神を断つなどと……不遜な輩が……」: Insolent wretches who would/　cut down a god...
BMD\t「お願い、アラド……/ 私ごとガンエデンを……！」: Please, Arado.../　Destroy Gan Eden, and me with it...!
BMD\t「ゼオラ……私のことはいい……/ ガンエデンを……！」: Seolla... forget about me.../　Stop Gan Eden...!
BMD\t「その念……汝の創造者の狙いは……」: That will... What your creator seeks is...
BMD\t「越界者よ……終焉の時はまだ……」: Otherworlder.../　The time of the end is not yet...
BMD\t「非力な念で我を倒そうなどと……」: To think you could defeat me/　with such feeble will...
BMD\t「人の念が我が念を妨げるとは……」: That human will could obstruct mine...

BMD\t「古の大戦……あのような結果は……」: The ancient war... An outcome like that...
BMD\t「神たる我には通じぬ」: I am a god. That will not work on me.
BMD\t「楽園を乱す者よ……己の愚かさを知れ」: Disturber of paradise.../　Know your own foolishness.

LDBI\t「例え、機先を制したとしても、@ 僕を倒すことは出来ないぞ！」: Even if you seize the initiative,@you won't be able to defeat me!
LDBI\t「何だ、その機体は！@ そうまでして、人の姿に……しかも、@ 女に似: What is that machine?! Why go so far as to@give it a human form... and a woman's, no less?!@What's the point? What's the need?!

BMD\t「ファービュラリスの相手ではないな」: You are no match for the Fabularis.
BMD\t「私に当てられると思ったのか？」: Did you think you could hit me?
BMD\t「お前の負の波動を受けるつもりはない」: I will not be struck by your negative waves.
BMD\t「もう……私に負の波動は必要ない」: I... no longer need negative waves.
BMD\t「ここで破滅するのはお前だ、/ ペルフェクティオ」: You're the one who meets ruin here,/　Perfectio.
BMD\t「光龍、お前の思い通りにはならん」: Koryu, things won't go as you wish.
BMD\t「四霊と言えど、私には触れられん」: Even the Four Spirits cannot touch me.
BMD\t「お前が夢見る世界に、興味はない！」: I have no interest in the world you dream of!

BMD\t「四凶の餌食にはならぬ」: I will not fall prey to the Four Fiends.
BMD\t「地球の封印などさせんぞ！」: I won't let you seal away the Earth!
BMD\t「お前も……/ “破滅の王”と同じ道を辿ることになる」: You too.../　will follow the same path as the "King of Ruin."
BMD\t「ユーゼス、お前の力は通用しない」: Euzeth, your power won't work on me.
BMD\t「それが神の力か？」: Is that the power of a god?
BMD\t「私には効かぬ」: That has no effect on me.
BMD\t「何も出来んとは……」: To be able to do nothing...
BMD\t「私に出来ることであれば……」: If there is anything I can do...
BMD\t「逃げる隙は与えん」: I'll give you no chance to escape.

BMD\t「ウェントス、後は任せろ」: Ventus, leave the rest to me.
BMD\t「ジョッシュをやらせはしない！」: I won't let you harm Josh!

BMD\t「我が敵を穿て、氷の刃達よ！」: Pierce my foes, blades of ice!
LDBI\t「ここはワシの零式に任せて、お主らは下がれ！」: Leave this to my Type-0. You lot, fall back!
LDBI\t「いえ、そういうわけにはいきません！」: No, sir, we can't do that!
LDBI\t「こっちもです！@ 所長達が避難する時間を稼がなきゃ！」: Same here!@We need to buy time for the director and@the others to evacuate!
LDBI\t「先生一人で彼らと戦うのは、非効率的ですよ」: Fighting them alone would be inefficient, sir.
LDBI\t「すみません、先生。@ ……ミズホ、分析結果はどう？」: I'm sorry, sir.@...Mizuho, how's the analysis coming?
LDBI\t「あれは……生物でもあり、機械でもある……」: That thing... is both a living creature@and a machine...
LDBI\t「機械って……そんな風には見えないぞ！」: A machine...? It sure doesn't look like one!
LDBI\t「人は乗っていません……。@ 代わりに魂のようなものが封入されている: There's no one aboard...@I believe something like a soul has been@sealed inside in its place.
LDBI\t「見当はついておる。@ おそらく、あやつらは妖機人……@ <超機人>: I have an idea of what they are.@Most likely, those are Yokijin...@said to be the enemies of the <超機人>.
LDBI\t「<修羅の乱>の最中にも@ あれとは違うタイプがここへ現れおった」: During the <修羅の乱>, a different type@from those showed up here as well.
LDBI\t「なら、彼らの狙いは@ 地下ケージの龍王機と虎王機なんですか！？」: Then they're after RyuOhKi and KoOhKi@in the underground cage!?
LDBI\t「そう見て間違いなかろう。@ じゃが、今はブリットとクスハがおらん…: That's a safe assumption.@But Bullet and Kusuha aren't here now...@We'll have to protect the Choukijin ourselves.
LDBI\t「妖機人共を研究所へ近づけるでないぞ！」: Don't let those Yokijin near the institute!
LDBI\t「アンザイ博士、ここは危険だ！ 早く避難を！」: Dr. Anzai, it's dangerous here!@You need to evacuate, now!
LDBI\t「ですが、@ 龍王機と虎王機が目覚めようとしているんです！」: But RyuOhKi and KoOhKi are about to awaken!
LDBI\t「妖機人に反応しているのは間違いないと@ 思われますが、前回の時とは: They're definitely reacting to the Yokijin,@but it's different from last time!
LDBI\t「だが、今はブリットやクスハ君がいない……@ 彼らを制御することは出: But Bullet and Kusuha aren't here now...@We have no way to control them!
LDBI\t「上では先生達が頑張ってくれている！@ 私達が避難しなければ、それが: Rishu and the others are fighting hard up there!@If we don't evacuate, it'll all be for nothing!
LDBI\t「ラウルさん、@ こちらへ高速で接近してくる物体が！」: Raul, something's closing in on us fast!
LDBI\t「彼奴も妖機人か？」: Is that one a Yokijin too?
LDBI\t「外見を見た感じでは、系統が違うようですね。@ でも、<ＰＴ>や<Ａ: From its appearance, it's a different lineage.@But it's not a <ＰＴ>, an <ＡＭ>,@or a <特機>...
LDBI\t「……青龍と白虎はまだ目覚めぬのか。@ 蓬が言った通り、強念者がおら: ...The Blue Dragon and White Tiger still sleep?@As Hou said, there may be no strong psychic,@or else...
LDBI\t「我が名はククル。@ そなたらがかくまっている青龍と白虎の@ 超機人: My name is Kukuru.@I have come to reclaim the Blue Dragon and@White Tiger Choukijin you are harboring.
LDBI\t「超機人はそなたらのものではない。@ 我らの下にいて然るべき存在なの: The Choukijin do not belong to you.@They are beings who rightfully belong with us.
LDBI\t「さあ、大人しく超機人を差し出すがよい」: Now, meekly hand over the Choukijin.
LDBI\t「……ククルとやら、聞くがいい。@ 龍王機と虎王機は、ワシの弟子達と: ...Listen well, Kukuru, or whoever you are.@RyuOhKi and KoOhKi fought alongside my pupils@against the enemies of mankind...
LDBI\t「お主らもそうだと言うのであれば、@ このような手段であの二体を取り: If you claim the same of yourselves,@you'd have no need to take those two back@by such methods.
LDBI\t「つまり、お主らは人界に仇なす者。@ 違うかの？」: Which means you are enemies of mankind.@Am I wrong?
LDBI\t「ふん、人間風情が……何も知らぬくせに」: Hmph. Mere humans... You know nothing.
LDBI\t「それでも素直に従うのであれば、@ しばしの生を謳歌させてやっても良: Had you obeyed meekly, I would have let you@savor life a while longer, but...
LDBI\t「所詮、そなたらは苦界の底で喘ぐ輩！@ 我が主の御心など、理解できる: In the end, you are wretches writhing in the@depths of a world of suffering!@You could never grasp my master's will!
LDBI\t「ならば、我がマガルガの舞にて黄泉の国へ……」: Then by Magaruga's dance, I shall send you@to the land of the dead...
LDBI\t「我が名はリシュウ！ リシュウ・トウゴウ！@ 我は悪を断つ剣なり！！: My name is Rishu! Rishu Togo!@I am the sword that cuts down evil!!
LDBI\t「黄泉路へは我が零式が案内つかまつる！！」: My Type-0 shall be your guide@on the road to the underworld!!
LDBI\t「ええい、老いぼれが！@ その限りある命、ここで散らすがいいわ！！」: Grr, you old fool!@Let your numbered days end right here!!
LDBI\t「くっ、マガルガが後れを取るとは！」: Ngh, for Magaruga to be outmatched!
LDBI\t「まろび出たか、青龍と白虎！」: So you've tumbled out at last,@Blue Dragon, White Tiger!
LDBI\t「プレイヤーの皆さん、@ 『スーパーロボット大戦』の世界へようこそ！: To all you players out there,@welcome to the world of Super Robot Wars!@I'm Arado Balanga!
LDBI\t「そして、おれのコーチ役を務めてくれるのが、@ 泣く子も笑う鬼教官の: And serving as my coach is the demon drill@instructor who makes crying kids laugh...
LDBI\t「まあ、いい。@ 俺は特殊戦技教導隊隊長、カイ・キタムラ少佐だ」: Whatever. I'm Major Kai Kitamura, leader@of the Special Combat Training Unit.
LDBI\t「こう見えても、少佐は意外に若いんスよ」: He may not look it, but the Major's actually@pretty young.
LDBI\t「ぐっ！ どういう意味だ！@ 余計なことを言わんでいい！」: Ngh! What's that supposed to mean!?@You don't need to say that!
LDBI\t「……ゴホン。@ では、プレイ方法のレクチャーを始めるぞ」: ...Ahem.@Now, let's begin our lesson on how to play.
LDBI\t「は、はいっ！ よろしくお願いします！」: Y-Yes, sir! I'm counting on you!
LDBI\t「アラド、今までに『スーパーロボット大戦』を@ プレイしたことはある: Arado, have you ever played@Super Robot Wars before?
LDBI\t「……解説書は事前に熟読してあるだろうな？」: ...I trust you've read the manual@cover to cover?
LDBI\t「読んでません！ ぶっつけ本番ッス！」: Nope! I'm going in totally blind!
LDBI\t「バカモン！@ 『スーパーロボット大戦』を何だと思っている！」: You fool!@What do you take Super Robot Wars for?
LDBI\t「……うむ、その通りだ。@ では、一から説明していくぞ」: ...Hmm, that's correct.@Then I'll explain everything from the start.
LDBI\t「あ、あの、カイ少佐……@ おれ、物覚えがあんまし良くないんスけど、: U-Um, Major Kai...@I'm not so great at remembering stuff.@Will I be okay?
LDBI\t「ならば、まずこれを頭に叩き込んでおけ。@ 何かわからないことがあっ: Then drill this into your head first.@If there's anything you don't understand,@press the SELECT button.
LDBI\t「ＳＥＬＥＣＴボタンって、@ ワイヤレスコントローラのですか？」: The SELECT button...@You mean on the wireless controller?
LDBI\t「ああ。@ 状況に応じて、操作や機能の説明が出てくる」: Right.@Depending on the situation, it'll explain@the controls and features.
LDBI\t「困ったら、ＳＥＬＥＣＴボタン。@ これを忘れるなよ」: When in doubt, press SELECT.@Don't forget that.
LDBI\t「では、順を追って@ 『スーパーロボット大戦』の遊び方を説明する」: Now, I'll explain step by step@how to play Super Robot Wars.
LDBI\t「今、こうやって我々が@ 会話している場面を『シナリオデモ』と@ 呼: Scenes like this one, where we're talking,@are called Scenario Demos...
LDBI\t「『シナリオデモ』は、○ボタンを押すことで進行する」: You advance a Scenario Demo by pressing@the Circle button.
LDBI\t「そして、Ｒ１ボタンと○ボタンを@ 同時に押すと、早送りすることが出: And if you press the R1 and Circle buttons@at the same time, you can fast-forward.
LDBI\t「さらに、ＳＴＡＲＴボタンと@ Ｒ１ボタンを同時に押すと、『シナリオ: Furthermore, pressing the START and R1 buttons@together skips the entire Scenario Demo.
LDBI\t「待て。ここで試すと、この『シナリオデモ』が@ 終わってしまうぞ」: Wait. If you try it here, this Scenario Demo@will end.
LDBI\t「けど、さっきの機能は@ ２回目以降のプレイの時とかに@ 便利だから: But that feature'll be handy@for second playthroughs and stuff,@so I'd better write it down.
LDBI\t「いい心がけだが、@ 内容を正確に覚えているのか？」: Good attitude, but do you actually@remember exactly what I said?
LDBI\t「え、え～っと……その……あの……@ どうだったっけ？」: Uh, um... well... er...@How did it go again?
LDBI\t「……やはりな。そういう時は△ボタンを押せ」: ...Just as I thought. In that case,@press the Triangle button.
LDBI\t「そうすると『バックログ』が表示され、@ 今までの会話をある程度まで: That brings up the Backlog, which lets you@scroll back and reread the conversation@up to a certain point.
LDBI\t「じゃあ、うっかり台詞を読み飛ばしちまっても@ 大丈夫ッスね！」: So it's fine even if I accidentally@skip past some lines!
LDBI\t「だが、読み直しが出来る量には制限がある。@ 気をつけろ」: However, there's a limit to how much you@can reread. Keep that in mind.
LDBI\t「それから、@ 時々会話の中に色の変わった文字が@ 出る場合があるが: Also, sometimes words in a different@color will appear in the conversation...
LDBI\t「それは『キーワード』と言って、□ボタンを押せば、@ 説明ウィンドウ: Those are called Keywords. Press the Square@button to open a window explaining them.
LDBI\t「<インスペクター事件>。@ ……こういう時に□ボタンを押すと、その: <インスペクター事件>.@...At times like this, press the Square button@to bring up its explanation.
LDBI\t「<インスペクター事件>。@ □ボタンを押して、試してみろ」: <インスペクター事件>.@Press the Square button and try it.

LDBI\t「……簡素なものではあるが、戴冠式は先程終了した。@ フェイルロード: ...It was a simple affair, but the coronation@has just concluded. His Majesty Feil has taken@the throne as the 288th King of Langran.
LDBI\t「こ、これ！ 何をする！」: H-Here now! What are you doing?!
LDBI\t「あたし達に何も言わず、@ 戴冠式を終えるなんて……！」: To hold the coronation without@telling us a thing...!
LDBI\t「ともかく、ここはお引き取り下さい。@ 例え王族の方でも通してはなら: In any case, please withdraw. Our orders are@to let no one through, not even members of@the royal family.
LDBI\t「冗談じゃねえ！ このまま引き下がれるか！」: No way! I'm not backing down like this!
LDBI\t「ここで揉め事を起こしても、何にもならないわ。@ 後で、魔装機神操者: Making a scene here won't accomplish anything.@Later, we'll submit a formal request to Prince@Feil as Masoukishin pilots.
LDBI\t「ノボス筆頭参謀、殿下にもそうお伝え下さい」: Chief of Staff Novos, please tell His Highness@as much.
BMD\t「動くと、余計痛い目に遭うぞ！」: Move, and it'll only hurt more!
BMD\t「このまま黙って見過ごすことは出来ない！」: I can't just stand by and let this happen!
BMD\t「こんなことで争ってる場合では/ ないというのに……！」: We shouldn't be fighting like this/　at a time like this...!
BMD\t「カークス将軍にこそ大義がある。/ いたずらに抵抗を重ねるな！」: Justice is on General Kirkus's side./　Stop this pointless resistance!
BMD\t「これでは内乱と同じだ……/ こんな戦い、一刻も早く終わらさねば！」: This is no different from civil war.../　This fight has to end, and soon!
BMD\t「本来なら、味方同士のはずなのに……/ どうしてこんなことに！」: We should be on the same side.../　How did it come to this!?
BMD\t「カークス将軍にも、フェイルロード殿下にも大義はある。/ しかし……！: General Kirkus and Prince Fehrlord/　both have just cause. But still...!
BMD\t「これ以上、我が国を好きにはさせない！/ 覚悟しろ、賊共！」: You'll ravage our country no more!/　Prepare yourselves, bandits!
BMD\t「くっ……ここまでか……！」: Ngh... Is this as far as I go...!?
BMD\t「こ、これ以上は危険ね……！」: I-It's too dangerous to keep going...!
BMD\t「パ、パワーの差があり過ぎる！」: Th-The difference in power is too great!
BMD\t「ううっ、魔装機神には敵わない……！」: Ugh, I'm no match for a Masoukishin...!
BMD\t「ガ、ガッデスと距離を取らなければ！」: I-I have to get away from the Gaddess!
BMD\t「まともに当たった！？ しかし、まだ！」: A direct hit!? But I'm not done yet!
BMD\t「この程度で落ちはしない！」: This won't be enough to bring me down!
BMD\t「まだだ！ まだいける！」: Not yet! I can still go on!
BMD\t「思ったよりやるわね。けど、まだ戦える！」: Better than I thought. But I can still fight!
BMD\t「くっ、こうも好き勝手やられるなんて！」: Ngh, to be toyed with like this!
BMD\t「ま、魔装機神を甘く見たつもりはないが……！」: I-I didn't mean to underestimate/　a Masoukishin, but...!
BMD\t「くっ！ やはり、ガッデスには……！」: Ngh! As I thought, the Gaddess is...!
BMD\t「こんなもの、当たっただけ！」: That was just a lucky hit!
BMD\t「サイバスター……さすがに速い……！」: Cybuster... As fast as they say...!
BMD\t「魔装機神……思っていたほどでは……！」: A Masoukishin... Not as strong as I thought...!
BMD\t「テュッティ殿、もしや手加減を……！？」: Tytti, could you be holding back...!?
BMD\t「そう簡単に当たるものか！」: You won't hit me that easily!
BMD\t「くっ、使える武器がない！」: Ngh, I have no usable weapons!
BMD\t「このままでは的になるだけか！」: At this rate, I'm just a sitting duck!
BMD\t「敵機を見失うとは！」: I lost sight of the enemy!
BMD\t「アクロス少佐をやらせるものか！」: I won't let you touch Major Across!
BMD\t「この私に隙を見せるなんてね！」: Leaving yourself open in front of me!
BMD\t「喧嘩上等！」: Bring it on! I love a good fight!
BMD\t「面倒なのは御免だが……やるしかねえ！」: I hate a hassle, but... no choice!
BMD\t「喧嘩は先手必勝！」: In a fight, first strike wins!
BMD\t「油断するなよ、コウタ」: Don't let your guard down, Kota.
BMD\t「コウタ、クリスタルに意識を集中させるんだ」: Kota, focus your mind on the crystal.
BMD\t「頼むぞ、コウタ。この世界を守るのだ」: I'm counting on you, Kota./　Protect this world.
BMD\t「いちいち言われなくたって！」: I don't need you telling me every time!
BMD\t「コウタ、前回の戦闘の反省点を生かすんだ」: Kota, learn from the mistakes/　of our last battle.
BMD\t「そんなの、もう覚えてねえよ！」: Like I remember that stuff now!
BMD\t「勢いだけでは駄目だ。/ 戦いには冷静な心と……」: Momentum alone won't do./　Battle requires a cool mind and...
BMD\t「俺とお前、二人の意志と力の結晶……」: Your will and mine, our power combined...
BMD\t「そういうのは性に合わねえんだよ！」: That kind of thing just ain't my style!
BMD\t「あの機体、気になる……何故だ？」: That machine... it concerns me. Why?
BMD\t「ヘッ、いかにもライバルロボって感じだな！」: Heh, that's a textbook rival robot!
BMD\t「あの炎の模様は気に入った！/ だが、それ以外は気にくわねえ！」: I like those flame decals!/　Everything else, though, ticks me off!
BMD\t「コウタ、迂闊に奴と接触するな。危険だ」: Kota, don't rush into contact with him./　It's dangerous.
BMD\t「なら、一気にブッ叩いてやる！」: Then I'll smash him in one go!
BMD\t「パワー勝負なら負けねえぜ！」: Nobody beats me in a power contest!
BMD\t「腹ン中にヤべえもん抱えやがって！」: You've got something nasty in your gut!
BMD\t「今だ……/ “破滅の王”を止めるのは、今しかない！」: Now.../　It's our only chance to stop/　the "King of Destruction"!
BMD\t「ああ、きっちりケリをつけてやるぜ！」: Yeah, I'll settle this for good!
BMD\t「奴も次元の門の解放者……！/ 何としてもここで食い止めるんだ！」: He can open the dimension gate too...!/　We have to stop him here, no matter what!
BMD\t「ああ、引導を渡してやる！」: Yeah, I'll send you to your grave!
BMD\t「てめえの名前が一番言いにくい！/ ペル公で充分だ！」: Your name's the hardest one to say!/　Perf'll do just fine!
BMD\t「行くぜ、チョンマゲ野郎！」: Here I come, you topknot jerk!
BMD\t「面倒くせえ、てめえら略してメッセだ！」: What a pain--I'm calling you guys Messe!
BMD\t「てめえらの名前は覚えにくいんだよ！」: Your names are too hard to remember!
BMD\t「てやんでえ、てめえらなんぞにビビるかよ！」: Hah! Like I'd be scared of you lot!
BMD\t「ああいう相手はやり易いぜ！」: Guys like that are easy to fight!
BMD\t「ああいう相手はやりにくいぜ！」: Guys like that are a pain to fight!
BMD\t「尸解だか誤解だか知らねえが、/ てめえらの思い通りにいくと思うなよ！: Shikai, schmikai, whatever it is,/　don't think things'll go your way!
BMD\t「夏喃！ ショウコに手出しはさせねえぞ！」: Kanan! You're not laying a hand on Shoko!
BMD\t「てめえなんざ、焼き鳥にしてやるぜ！」: I'll turn you into grilled chicken!
BMD\t「ああいうゴツい爺さんはちと苦手だぜ……！」: Tough old geezers like him/　kinda get to me...!
BMD\t「その甲羅、叩き割ってやる！」: I'll crack that shell wide open!
BMD\t「光龍……あの野郎、ふざけやがって！」: Koryu... that bastard's messing with us!
BMD\t「ルイーナなんざ、蹴散らしてやるぜ！」: I'll scatter you Ruina like dust!
BMD\t「片っ端から落としてやるぜ、ルイーナ！」: I'll shoot down every last one, Ruina!
BMD\t「ルイーナの雑魚相手で、/ 手間取るわけにはいかねえ！」: I can't waste time/　on Ruina small fry!
BMD\t「ゲストめ、これ以上はやらせねえ！」: Guests! You're not getting any further!
BMD\t「ガンエデン！/ てめえなんざ、神でも何でもねえ！」: Gan Eden!/　You ain't any kind of god!
BMD\t「ユーゼス！/ 俺達がここにいる以上、/ てめえの好きにはやらせねえぜ: Euzeth!/　As long as we're here,/　you won't get your way!
BMD\t「カイザー搭乗時と同じ感覚で戦うな。/ より慎重に……」: Don't fight like you do in the Kaiser./　Be more careful...
BMD\t「バトルレーサーでぶっちぎってやる！」: Battle Racer'll leave you in the dust!
LDBI\t（何故、奴はいつもの手を使って離脱しないのだ……？）: (Why isn't it pulling out@with its usual trick...?)
LDBI\t「まだあれだけの数がいたか」: So there were still that many left.
LDBI\t「後詰めの可能性もある。ここは……」: There may be more behind them.@For now...
LDBI\t「承知。@ 突貫し、もろともに斬り捨てるのみ！」: Understood.@I'll charge in and cut them all down!
LDBI\t「ゼンガー、後続が来たぞ」: Sänger, the next wave is here.
LDBI\t「了解です。@ ジンライは、逃げる素振りを見せておらぬようですな」: Understood.@It appears Jinrai shows no sign of fleeing.
LDBI\t「艦長、@ ミナキ・トオミネ女史から通信が入っています。@ ジンライ: Captain, Ms. Minaki Tohmine is calling.@She says she wants to talk about Jinrai.
LDBI\t「わかりました。つないで下さい。@ なお、ゼンガー少佐、レーツェルさ: Understood. Put her through.@And open a channel to Major Sänger, Rätsel,@and Major Kai as well.
LDBI\t「……トオミネです。@ 艦長、無理を承知でお願いしたいことがあります: ...This is Tohmine.@Captain, I know it's unreasonable, but I have@a request.
LDBI\t「戦闘中ですので、出来れば手短に」: We're in combat, so please keep it brief.
LDBI\t「はい。@ ジンライを破壊するのではなく、@ ろ獲していただきたいの: Yes.@Instead of destroying Jinrai,@I'd like you to capture it.
LDBI\t「ここでジンライがダブルＧに破れても、@ 私の父はその妄念を強めるだ: Even if Jinrai falls to the Double Gs here,@it will only deepen my father's obsession...
LDBI\t「ですから、私の手でジンライを生まれ変わらせ、@ その有用性を示した: That's why I want to give Jinrai a new life@with my own hands and prove its worth.@Not by defeating the two Double Gs...
LDBI\t「戦うべき相手と戦い、@ 地球圏を覆う脅威を振り払うことによって」: But by fighting the enemies it should fight,@and repelling the threat to the Earth Sphere.
LDBI\t「今、その脅威の中に@ ジンライも含まれているのですよ？」: At present, Jinrai is one of those@threats, you realize?
LDBI\t「理解しています。@ ですが、歪んだ目的のために作られた物であっても: I understand.@But even if it was built for a twisted purpose,@please give it the chance to make that right.
LDBI\t「……その言葉に二心はありませんね？」: ...You have no ulterior motive in this?
LDBI\t「艦長、ミナキは本気です！@ 量産型ジンライが浅草を襲った時から、@: Captain, Minaki means it!@Ever since the Mass-Production Jinrai attacked@Asakusa, it's been tearing her up!
LDBI\t「確かに、ジンライは脅威です。しかし、転じれば@ 我々にとって頼もし: Jinrai is indeed a threat. But if turned,@it could be a reliable force for us.@...Minaki, what's your specific plan?
LDBI\t「ジンライからシステムＺＬＡＩを排除し、@ 人間が操る機体として改修: We'd remove System ZLAI from Jinrai@and refit it as a human-piloted machine.
LDBI\t「はい。ビアン・ゾルダーク博士の設計段階では、@ ジンライは人機一体: Yes. In Dr. Bian Zoldark's original design,@Jinrai was meant to be one with its pilot. It@doesn't carry JINKI-1, but...
LDBI\t「パイロットとの連動を想定した、@ “システムＬＩＯＨ”が組み込まれ: It does have System LIOH built in,@designed to link with a pilot.
LDBI\t「現状ではそれを休眠状態にし、@ 代わりに人工知能であるシステムＺＬ: Right now it's dormant,@and System ZLAI, an artificial intelligence,@controls the machine in its place.
LDBI\t「そこで、それを完全に排除し、@ 人間によって制御される機体として@: So we purge ZLAI completely@and give Jinrai new life@as a machine controlled by people.
LDBI\t「文字通り、心を入れ替えるということであれば……@ 我らにとって頼も: If it truly means a change of heart...@it would be a fine addition to our forces.
LDBI\t「ろ獲が不可能と判断した場合、@ 撃破許可が出るのであれば」: As long as we're cleared to destroy it@if capture proves impossible.
LDBI\t「では、作戦目的を変更。@ 量産型ジンライを全機撃破した後、@ ジン: Then we change the operation's objective.@After destroying all Mass-Production Jinrai,@lure Jinrai in and capture it.
LDBI\t「ゼンガー、まずは量産型を片づけるぞ！」: Sänger, the mass-produced ones go first!
LDBI\t「では、ジンライを指定エリアに誘導」: Then lure Jinrai into the designated area.
LDBI\t「その後、二方から挟み、行動不能にせよ」: Then pin it from two sides and disable it.
LDBI\t「ガーディアン１より各機。@ ジンライの狙いはダイゼンガーだ。@ 俺: Guardian 1 to all units.@Jinrai is after the Dygenguar.@I'll lure it into the designated area.
LDBI\t「そして、２機で奴を取り押さえ、攻撃。@ 抵抗できぬ状態にするのだ」: Then two units will pin it down and attack@until it can no longer resist.
LDBI\t「直ちに２機でジンライを取り押さえるのです！」: Two units, pin Jinrai down at once!
LDBI\t「そのままジンライを行動不能にせよ！」: Keep at it and disable Jinrai!
LDBI\t「そのまま拘束し、システムＺＬＡＩを排除。@ ……よろしいですね、ミ: Keep it restrained and remove System ZLAI.@...Is that acceptable, Minaki?
LDBI\t（後は、メディウス・ロクスですね……）: (Now there's only the Medius Locus left...)
LDBI\t「アルベロ、@ ヒューゴ少尉が単機で追って来ました」: Albero,@Lieutenant Hugo has come after us alone.
LDBI\t「わかった。ここまで引き離せば良かろう」: Good. This should be far enough away.
LDBI\t「迷いは捨て切れたか、ヒューゴ？」: Have you cast off your doubts, Hugo?
LDBI\t「“敵”と戦うことにためらいはしない……@ それがあなたの教えだった: I won't hesitate to fight an "enemy"...@That's what you taught me.
LDBI\t「だが、何故、ミタール・ザパトの話に乗った？@ どうしてガイアセイバ: But why did you go along with Mitar Zapad?@Why are you siding with the Gaia Savers?
LDBI\t「俺はともかく、@ あんたが連中に手を貸す理由はないはずだ！」: Never mind me,@you have no reason to lend them a hand!
BMD\t「これまでの分を取り返すのさ！」: I'm taking back everything I'm owed!
BMD\t「お前らは踏み台なのさ！/ あたしが出世するためのね！」: You're all just stepping stones!/　Stepping stones for my promotion!
BMD\t「あたしにリマコンなんて必要ないんだよ！」: I don't need any remote control!
BMD\t「さあ、逝っちまいなよ！」: C'mon, time to kick the bucket!
BMD\t「楽にしてやるよ！」: Let me put you out of your misery!
BMD\t「手柄になりゃ、相手は誰だっていいのさ！」: If it earns me credit, any target'll do!
BMD\t「手柄が立てられれば、/ 戦場はどこだっていいのさ！」: As long as I get the credit,/　any battlefield'll do!
BMD\t「この世界にいた方が、稼げそうだからね！」: Looks like there's more to earn here!
BMD\t「どのみち、/ ベータ・セイバーは目障りだったからねぇ！」: Either way, Beta Saber/　was always an eyesore!
BMD\t「馬鹿だね、/ ガイアセイバーズにいれば、/ いい思いが出来たのにさ！: You idiot! You could've had it/　easy if you'd stayed with/　the Gaia Saviors!
BMD\t「アルジャン・クラスのあたしに/ 勝てると思っているのか！」: You think you can beat me,/　an Argent Class?!
BMD\t「お前らとつるむ気なんてないんだよ！」: I've got no interest in hanging with you!
BMD\t「あたしら以外の/ ブーステッド・チルドレンは、/ 死ねばいいのさ！」: Every Boosted Child/　who isn't one of us/　can just die!
BMD\t「ＡＴＸチームをやりゃあ、いい手柄になる！」: Taking out ATX Team'll be real credit!
BMD\t「ＶＩＰだろうが何だろうが、/ お構いなしなのさ！」: VIP or whatever,/　I couldn't care less!
BMD\t「ラトゥーニと一緒にあの世へ逝きな！」: Go to hell along with Latune!
BMD\t「鋼龍戦隊か。望む所だよ！」: The Steel Dragons? Bring it on!
BMD\t「鋼龍戦隊の連中を落とせば、/ いい手柄になる！」: Shooting down the Steel Dragons/　will earn me real credit!
BMD\t「鋼龍戦隊、お前らは死ねばいいんだよ！」: Steel Dragons, you all deserve to die!
BMD\t「今、あいつらを始末しといた方がいいかもね」: Might be best to finish them off now.
BMD\t「ガイアセイバーズに逆らうなんて、/ 馬鹿な連中だよ！」: Defying the Gaia Saviors?/　What a bunch of idiots!
BMD\t「アルトアイゼン……金星だね！」: Alteisen... Now that's a big prize!
BMD\t「ヴァイスを落とせば、手柄になる！」: Shoot down Weiss and I get the credit!
BMD\t「特機はいい稼ぎになるからね！」: Super Robots make for good money!
BMD\t「雑魚より大物狙いさ！」: Forget the small fry! Superior targets!
BMD\t「あの特機は、あたしの獲物だよ！」: That Super Robot is my prey!
BMD\t「ダブルＧは大金星だ！ やってやるよ！」: Double G's a huge prize! Bring it on!
BMD\t「ダブルＧを仕留めりゃ、/ この上ない手柄だよ！」: Take down the Double G and/　there's no greater credit!
BMD\t「この世界じゃ、/ 魔装機神は極上の獲物だからねぇ！」: In this world, the Masoukishin/　are the finest prey there is!
BMD\t「魔装機神はここで落とした方が得なのさ！」: Better to drop a Masoukishin here!
LDBI\t「あの……もし良かったら、@ 家で何か作って持って来るけど……」: Um... If you'd like, I could make something@at home and bring it over...
LDBI\t「うん。あたし、日本料理が得意なの。@ お兄ちゃんから色々聞き出した: Yeah. I'm really good at Japanese cooking.@I got my brother to tell me all about it.
LDBI\t「じゃあ、お願いしてもいい？」: Then, could I ask you to?
LDBI\t「……では、現在の状況をノボス筆頭参謀に@ 説明してもらおう」: ...Now, I'll have Chief of Staff Novos@explain the current situation.
LDBI\t「現在、シュテドニアス軍は大陸南東部に@ 勢力を張っており……さらに: At present, the Schtedonias army holds the@southeastern part of the continent... and to its@east, Kirkus's army has taken up position.
LDBI\t「この図で説明しますと、@ グリーンが我が軍、ブルーがカークス軍、@: On this map, green is our army,@blue is Kirkus's army,@and red is Schtedonias.
LDBI\t「我が軍とカークス軍とで@ シュテドニアスを挟んだ形となっていますが: Our army and Kirkus's army have Schtedonias@caught between us, but one could also@argue the reverse...
LDBI\t「我が軍はシュテドニアスとバゴニア軍に、@ カークス軍はシュテドニア: Our army is caught between Schtedonias and@Bagonia, while Kirkus's army is caught between@Schtedonias and its homeland.
LDBI\t「目下の所、我が軍は連勝を続けており、@ 優勢であるように見えますが: We have won battle after battle so far and@appear to have the upper hand... but we@cannot ignore the enemy's latent strength.
LDBI\t「絶対数において、@ いまだシュテドニアスの戦力は我が軍に優っており: In sheer numbers, Schtedonias's forces@still exceed our own...@A head-on decisive battle would be unwise.
LDBI\t「……やはり、@ カークスといったん手を結ぶしかないか……」: ...So we have no choice but to@join hands with Kirkus for now...
LDBI\t「愚考致しますに、それが最善の策かと」: In my humble opinion, that is the best course.
LDBI\t「……何だ？ こちらは軍議中だぞ」: ...What is it? We're in a war council.
LDBI\t「殿下、カークス将軍から連絡が入っているそうです」: Your Highness, General Kirkus is contacting us.
LDBI\t「お久しぶりですな、フェイル殿下。@ そろそろ私めの軍との同盟をお考: It has been some time, Prince Feil.@I thought you might be considering an alliance@with my forces about now, so I contacted you.
LDBI\t（カークスめ、よくもそのようなことを……）: (Kirkus, how dare he say such a thing...)
LDBI\t「……いいタイミングだった、カークス将軍。@ 本来ならば、正式に会談: ...Your timing is good, General Kirkus.@Ordinarily, I'd want to hold formal talks,@but we can't afford that luxury now.
LDBI\t「今、最優先すべきは、一刻も早くこの国から@ シュテドニアス軍を追い: Our top priority now is to drive the@Schtedonias army out of this country as soon@as possible. Surely you don't object to that.
LDBI\t「どうだ、同盟の話を受けてもらえぬか？」: Well? Will you accept an alliance?
