BMD\t「フン……黒い竜巻の名が泣くぞ」: Hmph... You disgrace the name/　Black Tornado.
BMD\t「旧教導隊を買い被り過ぎたか……」: Did I overestimate the old Instructors...?
BMD\t「サーベラス……運動性はなかなかのものだ」: The Cerberus.../　Its mobility is impressive.
BMD\t「ぐっ！ 性能差を腕でカバーしたか！」: Ngh! Your skill made up/　for the performance gap!
BMD\t「ほう、これがガルムレイドのパワーか」: Oh? So this is the Garmraid's power.
BMD\t「ほう、俺に食らいついてきたか」: Oh? You're keeping up with me.
LDBI\t「いや、お前の扱いを良くしてもらえるよう、@ 基地司令にお願いをして: No, I just asked the Base Commander@to treat you a little better, that's all...
LDBI\t「そ、そんなことをやったの！？@ し、信じられない！ 過保護にも程が: Y-You did that?!@I-I can't believe it!@You're way too overprotective!
LDBI\t「はああ……ただでさえＤＦＣスーツのせいで@ 目立ってるかも知れない: Haaah... The DFC suit might already make me@stand out, and now with Father doing that...@Haaah...
LDBI\t「えっ、フランスに出張ッスか！？ やったぁ！」: Whoa, a business trip to France?! Awesome!
LDBI\t「アラド、遊びに行くんじゃないのよ」: Arado, we're not going there to play.
LDBI\t「だけど、フランスって言ったら、@ クロワッサンにバゲット、バタール: But when you say France...@croissants, baguettes, batards...@Ugh, I wanna eat 'em already!
LDBI\t「で、我々はフランスで何を？」: So what are we to do in France?
LDBI\t「マオ社のオルレアン工場にある@ ヒュッケバイン・シリーズ全機を受け: We'll pick up every Hückebein Series unit@at Mao Industries' Orleans plant and transport@them to Hickam.
LDBI\t「何故、そんな所へヒュッケバインを……？」: Why would they send the Hückebeins there...?
LDBI\t「理由は俺も聞いとらん。@ 出発は明朝０６００だ。各員、準備をしてお: Nobody told me why either.@We leave tomorrow at 0600. Everyone, get ready.
LDBI\t「あの、少佐……@ 私達も行くということで、よろしいのですね？」: Um, Major...@So it's all right for us to come along, then?
LDBI\t「ああ、お前を特別扱いする気はない」: Yeah. I've no intention of giving you@special treatment.
LDBI\t「だが、父親の気持ちも少しは理解してやれ。@ 俺も娘親だからな……他: But try to understand how your father feels.@I've got a daughter myself...@so I can't say this doesn't hit close to home.
LDBI\t「あの……@ アクアさん、お父さんと何かあったんですか？」: Um...@Aqua, did something happen with your father?
LDBI\t「ううん、別に。気にしないで」: No, it's nothing. Don't worry about it.
LDBI\t「お久しぶりです、カイ少佐」: It's been a while, Major Kai.
LDBI\t「常務……あなたがいらしたとは」: Director... I didn't expect to find you here.
LDBI\t「ええ、３日前に月から降りて来ましてね」: Yes, I came down from the Moon three days ago.
LDBI\t「……鋼龍戦隊のことですが、いまだに行方は……」: ...About the Steel Dragons. There's still no word@of their whereabouts...
LDBI\t「どうかお気になさらず。@ リオは……私の娘は、きっと息災なはずです: Please, don't trouble yourself.@Rio... My daughter is surely safe and well.
LDBI\t「どこにいようと、頼もしい仲間達と@ 一緒でしょうから……」: Wherever she is, she'll be with@her dependable comrades...
LDBI\t「フライヤー・モード時の@ レールガンの重心位置を見直しました。@: I readjusted the Railgun's center of gravity@in Flyer Mode. It was wobbling a little...
LDBI\t「そうか。じゃあ、後でデータを見ておくよ」: I see. I'll look over the data later, then.
LDBI\t「ハミル博士、オオミヤ博士、@ ヒュッケバインの準備は？」: Dr. Hamill, Dr. Omiya,@how are the Hückebeins coming along?
LDBI\t「００８Ｌ、Ｍｋ－Ⅱ、Ｍｋ－Ⅲ……@ 全機、後は輸送機に積み込むだけ: The 008L, the Mk-II, the Mk-III...@They just need to be loaded onto the transport.
LDBI\t「もっとも、ＥＸはこの工場に残しておきますがね」: Though we're keeping the EX here at the plant.
LDBI\t「ＥＸ……パーツを集められたのか？」: The EX... You managed to gather the parts?
LDBI\t「ええ。あれは表向きにはヒュッケバインじゃなく、@ 社内開発用データ: Yes. Officially, it's not a Hückebein but the@Exbein, an in-house data-gathering testbed...@So we don't have to hand it over this time.
LDBI\t「エクストラ・ヒュッケバインの略ですよ。@ まあ、方便ですがね」: Short for Extra Hückebein.@Well, it's just a convenient excuse.
LDBI\t「それより、どうしてヒュッケバイン・シリーズを@ ヒッカムへ移送する: More importantly, why are the Hückebeins@being transported to Hickam?
LDBI\t「何？ そちらも理由を聞いていないのか？」: What? They didn't tell you why either?
LDBI\t「ええ……シュタインベック特次副大統領の@ 命令だとしか」: No... Only that it's on the orders of@Special Vice President Steinbeck.
LDBI\t「その男……確か、『ＧＳ』の中心メンバーだったな」: That man...@If I recall, he was a core member of the "GS."
LDBI\t「こっちも色々怪しいと思って、教導隊による@ 移送護衛を申し出たんで: We had our doubts too, so we requested an@Instructor Unit escort... But if you don't know@the details either, Major, this smells fishy.
LDBI\t「もしや、ヒュッケバインは『ＧＳ』に……？」: Could the Hückebeins be bound for the "GS"...?
LDBI\t「だとしたら、ヒッカムは単なる経由地……？@ ならば、何故、我々教導: If so, Hickam is just a stopover...?@Then why were we, the Instructor Unit, ordered@to escort them?
LDBI\t「確かに……@ 腹を探られたくなければ、こちらからの依頼を@ 握り潰: True...@If they didn't want anyone poking around, they@could've just quashed our request.
LDBI\t（ギリアムに連絡して、調べてもらうか……）: (Maybe I should get Gilliam@to look into this...)
LDBI\t「マオ社の工場ともなると、広いのね……@ 南極のマザー・ベースとは大: A Mao Industries plant sure is big...@Nothing like the Mother Base in Antarctica.
LDBI\t「あそこは量産のことなんて考えていないからな」: That place was never built with@mass production in mind.
LDBI\t「でも、工場のラインはたくさんあったのに、@ 機体がほとんどなかった: But even with all those production lines,@there were hardly any units here.
LDBI\t（こんなご時世だ、パーソナルトルーパーの発注は@ 多いはず……経営状: (With times like these, they should have plenty@of Personal Trooper orders... Are their finances@slipping?)
LDBI\t「カイ少佐、こちらへ所属不明機が接近中です」: Major Kai, unidentified units are approaching.
LDBI\t「このタイミングで……狙いはヒュッケバインか？」: Right now... Are they after the Hückebeins?
LDBI\t「その可能性は高いと思うです」: I think that's highly likely, I do believe.
LDBI\t「教導隊とヒューゴ、アクアは直ちに出撃！@ 急げ！」: Instructor Unit, Hugo, Aqua, launch at once!@Move it!
LDBI\t「全機発進完了。目標群、依然接近中」: All units launched. Targets still closing in.
LDBI\t「エレーブ１より各機。迎撃準備」: Eleve 1 to all units. Prepare to intercept.
BMD\t「一気に終わらせるぞ」: Let's finish this in one go!
BMD\t「負けるつもりなど、さらさらない」: I have no intention of losing.
BMD\t「カークス将軍！ 討ち取らせていただく！」: General Kirkus! I'll be taking you down!
BMD\t「あなたの野心もここまでです、/ カークス将軍！」: Your ambitions end here,/　General Kirkus!
BMD\t「む……女か。だが、手は抜かん」: Hm... A woman. But I won't go easy.
BMD\t「ほう、気の強い女だ。だが、それもまた……」: Oh, a strong-willed woman. But that, too...
BMD\t「また貴様か、ルオゾール……/ しつこい男だ」: You again, Luozorl.../　You're a persistent one.
BMD\t「怪しげな呪い師が……/ どうせろくでもないことを/ 企んでいるのだろ: A shady sorcerer.../　No doubt you're plotting/　something wicked.
BMD\t「サフィーネか……/ その腐った性根、叩き直してくれるわ！」: Saphine.../　I'll beat that rotten nature out of you!
BMD\t「相も変わらず、不真面目な奴め……/ 貴様の道楽などに付き合っていられ: Frivolous as ever.../　I won't play along with your games!
BMD\t「ほう、いい反応だ。/ 気を引き締めてかからんとな」: Oh, good reflexes./　I'd better stay on my guard.
BMD\t「むう……何という威圧感だ。/ 破壊神と呼ばれるだけはあるな」: Ngh... What an overwhelming presence./　Worthy of the name God of Destruction.
BMD\t「好きにはさせん！」: I won't let you have your way!
BMD\t「ぐあぁっ！！ ま、まだだ……/ まだやられてはおりませんぞ、/ カー: Gaaah!! N-Not yet.../　I'm not finished yet,/　General Kirkus!
BMD\t「俺をここまで追い詰めるとは……/ やるな、サフィーネ！」: To push me this far.../　Well done, Saphine!
BMD\t「こ、これがデュラクシールの力かっ！」: S-So this is the Duraxyll's power!
BMD\t「ぬうっ！！/ な、何という力だ……/ 恐るべし、ヴォルクルス……」: Nngh!!/　Wh-What power.../　Volkruss is fearsome indeed...
BMD\t「む、さすがはカークス将軍。やるものですな」: Hm, just what I'd expect of you,/　General Kirkus.
BMD\t「ちっ、貴様と遊んでいるヒマはない！/ さっさと立ち去れ、ルオゾール」: Tch, I have no time to play with you!/　Begone, Luozorl.
BMD\t「む……シュウ・シラカワ…………/ やはり、ただ者ではない」: Hm... Shu Shirakawa.../　As I thought, he's no ordinary man.
BMD\t「ぬ、甘く見すぎていたか。/ やるな、サフィーネ」: Nn, I underestimated you./　Well done, Saphine.
BMD\t「ええい、/ この程度の攻撃を避け損なうとは……」: Blast it,/　failing to dodge an attack like that...
BMD\t「くっ……デュラクシール……/ さすがにパワーがある」: Tch... The Duraxyll.../　It certainly has power.
BMD\t「むうっ！ ブローウェルに/ これほどのパワーがあるとは……」: Ngh! I never thought the Blowell/　had this much power...
BMD\t「ぬっ！ なるほど、破壊神と呼ばれるのは/ 伊達ではないということか」: Ngh! I see, it's not called/　the God of Destruction for nothing.
BMD\t「その程度か！」: Is that the best you've got?!
LDBI\t「はい。<修羅の乱>の最中にも@ 出現が確認された敵性体です」: Yes. They're hostile entities that were also@sighted during the <修羅の乱>.
LDBI\t「ＬＴＲ機構では妖機人と呼ばれ、@ <超機人>の敵であるとされていま: The LTR Organization calls them Yokijin and@considers them enemies of the <超機人>...@Ghosts and goblins, the lot of them.
LDBI\t「ふん、次から次へと……。@ この短期間によくもこれだけの事件が起き: Hmph, one thing after another...@So many incidents in such a short time.@It can no longer be dismissed as coincidence.
LDBI\t「そう思いたくもなるが……デモンの件を私の所まで@ 上げたということ: Tempting as that is... If you brought the@Demon matter all the way to me, you must think@they're likely to appear again.
LDBI\t「はい。@ 我々にとって新たな脅威になる可能性があります」: Yes.@They could become a new threat to us.
LDBI\t「そのための『ＧＳ』だ。@ グランド・クリスマスの方はどうなっている: That's what the GS is for.@How are things going with Grand Christmas?
LDBI\t「現在、シュタインベック特別補佐官が@ アイドネウス島で陣頭指揮を執: Special Assistant Steinbeck is currently@directing operations on Aidoneus Island.
LDBI\t「機動兵器の試験や配備の進行度は予定通り。@ 部隊編成もまもなく終了: Mobile weapon testing and deployment are@on schedule, and unit formation is nearly@complete.
LDBI\t「構成員には、色々と裏があるようだが？」: Some of its members have shady pasts, I hear?
LDBI\t「連邦軍とは別系統の軍事組織……@ それが『ＧＳ』のコンセプトではあ: A military organization separate from the@Federation Forces... That's the GS concept,@but given the times we live in...
LDBI\t「軍やＤＣとまったく関係のない人員を@ 集めるのは、至難の業……清濁: Finding people with no ties to the military@or the DC is next to impossible... We must@take the good with the bad to get top talent.
LDBI\t「大統領……@ ミッション・ハルパーを計画したあなたなら、@ ご理解: Mr. President...@As the man who planned Mission Halper,@I trust you'd understand.
LDBI\t「ご心配なく。@ 『ＧＳ』には、与えられた任務を@ 忠実に遂行する者: Rest assured.@The GS is staffed with people who will@faithfully carry out their assigned missions.
LDBI\t「……ご指摘通り、経歴に瑕疵を持つ@ メンバーが幾人かおりますが……: ...As you point out, some members do have@blemishes on their records, but...
LDBI\t「選考はシュタインベック特別補佐官と私で行いました。@ 大統領直轄部: Steinbeck and I made the selections ourselves.@No one who'd tarnish the President's own unit...@or plot against the current regime was chosen.
LDBI\t「……手綱は引き絞れるのだな？」: ...You can keep them on a tight leash?
LDBI\t「もちろんです。@ さもなくば、大統領特別補佐官である@ 私達の立場: Of course.@Otherwise, our own positions as Special@Assistants to the President would be at risk.
LDBI\t「『ＧＳ』メンバーの素性に探りを入れる者は@ 必ず出てくる。今という: Someone is bound to start digging into the@GS members' backgrounds. Right now, I can't@let the Assembly use a scandal to drag me down.
LDBI\t「金の流れについては、非常時ということで抑えが効く。@ だが、『ＧＳ: The emergency keeps the money trail quiet.@But once the GS is fully revealed, the@conservatives and the military will push back.
LDBI\t「となると、ツェントル・プロジェクトあたりは@ 格好の標的となる。反: Which makes the Tsentr Project a prime@target. Anticipate the opposition's probing@and take precautions.
LDBI\t「承知しております。@ ですが、まもなく連邦の人民は喝采と共に@ 『: I'm well aware.@But soon, the people of the Federation will@welcome the GS with cheers.
LDBI\t「ええ、信頼できる筋からの情報です」: Yes. The information is from a reliable source.
LDBI\t「それを知っていて、何故、事前に抑えられん？」: Knowing that, why can't you stop it in advance?
LDBI\t「かつての連邦政府が、@ ビアン・ゾルダークの反乱を予期していながら: Just as the Federation Government of old@foresaw Bian Zoldark's rebellion, yet@failed to prevent it...
LDBI\t「向こうにも色々と都合があるようなのです」: It seems they have their own circumstances.
LDBI\t「身内の不始末をこちらに押しつける気か」: So they mean to dump their own mess on us.
LDBI\t「彼らも一枚岩ではありませんから……@ 我々にとっては、格好の機会か: They're hardly a monolith, after all...@I'd call this a perfect opportunity for us.
LDBI\t「裏返せば、こちらを陥れる絶好の機会にもなる。@ そこで、お前とシュ: Flip it around, and it's also a perfect chance@to trap us. I'll use it to test where you and@Steinbeck truly stand, once again.
LDBI\t「疑り深くなければ、務まらぬのでな」: A man can't hold this office without suspicion.
LDBI\t「私が提出した鋼龍戦隊の処遇案……@ あれを保留されたのも、そのため: My proposal on how to handle the Steel Dragons...@Is that why you shelved it?
LDBI\t「彼らは故意に姿を消したわけではない。@ それに、保険としてあの戦力: They didn't disappear deliberately.@Besides, we need that force as insurance.
LDBI\t「もう二度と戻って来ないかも知れませんよ？」: They may never come back, you know.
LDBI\t「とは言え、彼らの戦績は無視できん。@ 民間にもその存在は知れ渡って: Even so, their record can't be ignored.@The public knows all about them, after all.
LDBI\t「それ故に、『ＧＳ』は鮮烈なデビューを飾り、@ 鋼龍戦隊以上の実績を: Which is why the GS must make a dazzling debut@and outdo the Steel Dragons' record.@That's why I went along with your gamble.
LDBI\t「我らには時間がない。@ 連邦軍以外の軍事組織の是非を問われ、大統領: We're out of time. Even if I'm challenged on@a military outside the Federation Forces and@accused of abusing presidential powers...
LDBI\t「即時に行動できる特化戦力が必要だ。@ 地球人による地球圏の存続……: We need a special force that can act at once.@Earthlings preserving the Earth Sphere... to@assert firm sovereignty against the aliens.
LDBI\t「その清濁を併せ呑む度量……@ そして、慎重さと大胆さを併せ持つご決: Your capacity to take the good with the bad...@Your decisions, both cautious and bold...@I admire them, and so I serve as your aide.
LDBI\t「『ＧＳ』……ガイアセイバーズは@ 軍や議会にその動きを制限されるこ: The GS... the Gaia Saviors...@Unrestrained by the military or the Assembly,@a sword to guard the Earth Sphere at your will.
LDBI\t「来るべき時……@ ガイアセイバーズがその力を示せば、@ 疑いを持つ: When the time comes...@and the Gaia Saviors prove their strength,@the voices of the doubters will fall silent.
LDBI\t（グライエン・グラスマン……@ やはり、素晴らしい人材ですね）: (Graien Grassman...@An excellent asset indeed, as I thought.)
LDBI\tハワイ 連邦軍北米方面軍 ヒッカム基地: Hawaii: Hickam Base,@Federation Forces North American Command
LDBI\t「あまり芳しくない結果だな、ヒューゴ・メディオ」: Not a very impressive result, Hugo Medio.
LDBI\t「いくらあいつが不慣れとは言え、@ ＴＥエンジンの調子があれではな」: Sure, my partner's green, but what do you@expect with the TE Engine acting like that?
LDBI\t「調整込みでのテストだ。@ それに、君の能力を見込んでパイロットに@: The test includes tuning.@Besides, I appointed you as pilot because@I had faith in your abilities.
LDBI\t「よく言う。@ あんたにとっちゃ、ちょうどいい素材が@ 転がり込んで: That's rich.@For you, I was just convenient material@that happened to fall into your lap.
LDBI\t「素質や能力がない者を救ったりはせんよ。@ それに、特別措置で少尉へ: I don't save those without talent or ability.@And I had you promoted to Second Lieutenant@as a special measure... You should be grateful.
LDBI\t「頼んだ覚えはない。@ そもそも、俺があんな目に遭ったのは……」: I never asked for it.@The whole reason I went through that...
LDBI\t「またその話を蒸し返すのか。@ あれは事故だったと何度も説明したろう: Dredging that up again?@I've told you time and again it was an accident.
LDBI\t「それで納得できるか……！@ あんたのせいでクライウルブズは……@: Like I'd accept that...!@Because of you, the Cry Wolves...@Foglia and my comrades...!
BMD\t「同胞をやらせはせん！」: I won't let you harm my comrades!
BMD\t「落とさせるか！」: I won't let you shoot them down!
LDBI\t「これより、敵の陽動を行う。@ 前部全主砲、全副砲、ＶＳＬＭ、攻撃用: We will now begin our diversion.@All forward Main Cannons and secondary guns,@VSLMs, prepare to attack!
LDBI\t「やはり、連中はこちらへ来ましたな。@ 狙い通りです」: Just as I thought, they came this way.@Exactly according to plan.
LDBI\t「貴公の勘もたまには当たるんやな。@ せやけど、あいつらの相手は骨が: So your hunches pay off now 'n' then, huh.@Still, that lot's a real pain to deal with.@And they went an' swiped the Zamzeed, too.
LDBI\t「今回は切り札を用意しています。@ 心配はいりませんよ」: This time, I've prepared a trump card.@There's nothing to worry about.
LDBI\t「ほう、初耳やな。何や、その切り札て？」: Oh? First I've heard of it.@So what's this trump card?
LDBI\t「こればかりはジェスハ将軍と言えど、@ お教え出来ません。我が隊の特: Not even you may be told, General Jesuha.@That is my unit's privilege, after all.
LDBI\t「ちっ、けったくそ悪い。@ これやから、特殊工作隊ちゅうんは嫌いやね: Tch, what a pain in the neck.@This is why I hate you special ops types.
LDBI\t「まあ、ええわ。@ とにかく、あの地上人部隊は厄介や。@ 何とかせん: Well, whatever.@Anyway, that Surfacer outfit's trouble.@We gotta do somethin' about 'em.
LDBI\t「将軍、この場は私に指揮権が……」: General, I'm the one in command here...
LDBI\t「わかっとる、わかっとる。@ 今は居候みたいな身の上やからな。@ 命: I know, I know.@Right now I'm basically a freeloader here.@I'll follow orders, and the credit's all yours.
LDBI\t「……フン、やるな。@ だが、こちらには切り札があるんだよ」: ...Hmph, not bad.@But we've got a trump card.
LDBI\t「地上人に告ぐ。直ちに武装解除し、降伏しろ」: Attention, Surfacers.@Disarm at once and surrender.
LDBI\t「我らの命令に従わぬ場合、@ モニカ王女が報いを受けることになるが、: If you fail to obey our orders,@Princess Monica will pay the price.@Are you fine with that?
LDBI\t「まさか、モニカ王女を人質にしてやがるのか！？」: Don't tell me... You've taken@Princess Monica hostage!?
LDBI\t「私の時と同じだ……あいつらは……！」: It's just like what happened to me...@Those people...!
LDBI\t「人質を取ることが常套手段だと言うの……！？」: Are you saying taking hostages@is standard practice for you...!?
LDBI\t「何とでも言え。 @ 我々は、無駄な血をこれ以上流したくないだけだ」: Say what you like.@We simply want no more needless bloodshed.
LDBI\t「ふざけんな！@ ラングランへ攻め込んで来やがったくせに！」: Don't screw with me!@You're the ones who invaded Langran!
LDBI\t「兄ちゃん、言うとくけど、@ ワシらにはワシらの理由があるんやで」: Listen here, kid, I'll have you know@we've got our own reasons, y'know.
LDBI\t「人質を取るなんて卑怯な真似をする連中が、@ 何を言いやがる！」: Who're you to talk, when you pull cheap tricks@like taking hostages!?
LDBI\t「王女を人質にしたと言うなら、@ その証拠を見せてもらおうか？」: If you claim to have the princess hostage,@how about showing us some proof?
LDBI\t「いいだろう。@ ……おい、モニカ王女をここへ連行しろ」: Very well.@...You there, bring Princess Monica here.
LDBI\t「……何！？ どういうことだ、それは！？@ 貴様ら、何をやっていた！: ...What!? What do you mean by that!?@What were you fools doing!?
LDBI\t「……事情が変わった。@ 人質の命が惜しくば、今すぐ撤退してもらおう: ...Circumstances have changed.@If you value the hostage's life, withdraw now.
LDBI\t「何だ、てめえ……@ 本当にモニカ王女はそこにいるのか？」: What's with you...?@Is Princess Monica really there?
LDBI\t「うるさい！ 撤退するのか、しないのか！？」: Silence! Will you withdraw or not!?
LDBI\t「ええい！ 急いで取り押さえろ！」: Blast it! Hurry up and restrain her!
LDBI\t「みんな、あの魔装機にモニカ王女が乗ってる！@ 援護してくれ！」: Everyone, Princess Monica's in that Masouki!@Cover her!
LDBI\t「あ、ちょっと待って。@ んもう、こんなの着せて……」: Ah, wait a moment.@Honestly, making me wear this...
LDBI\t「そ、その髪の毛の色……セニア様ですか！？」: Th-that hair color...@Princess Xenia, is that you!?
LDBI\t「ええ、私よ。@ あいつら、モニカを奪われちゃったんで、@ 私を身代: Yep, it's me.@They lost Monica, so they planned@to use me as her stand-in.
LDBI\t「悪いけど、マサキ……援護してもらえるかしら？」: Sorry, Masaki... Could you cover me?
LDBI\t「メッキが剥がれた以上、意味ないわな。@ ま、人質を取るなんざ、気に: The jig's up, so there's no point anymore.@Besides, takin' hostages ain't my kinda play.
LDBI\t「作戦はまだ失敗したわけではない！@ 王女を取り戻し、奴らを撃退しろ: The operation hasn't failed yet!@Retake the princess and drive them back!
LDBI\t「ええい、またしても！ 撤退だ、撤退するぞ！」: Blast it, not again!@Retreat! We're pulling out!
LDBI\t「……これで陽動作戦の第一段階は@ 成功ってことかしらん？」: ...So I guess phase one of the diversion@was a success, hmm?
LDBI\t「だが、この辺りにいるシュテドニアス軍は、@ あいつらだけじゃねえは: But those guys can't be the only@Schtedonias troops around here.@We can't let our guard down yet.
LDBI\t「アヅキ、各機に伝達。@ 直ちに帰艦し、弾薬の補給や応急修理を」: Azuki, relay to all units:@Return to the ship at once for ammo resupply@and emergency repairs.
LDBI\t「本艦はしばらくこの場に留まる。@ 対空対地警戒を厳となせ」: This ship will hold position for now.@Maintain strict anti-air and anti-ground watch.
LDBI\t「ちっ！ しゃあない、引き揚げや！@ 降格は確実やろうけど、命には代: Tch! No helpin' it, we're pullin' out!@I'm sure to get demoted, but it beats dyin'!
LDBI\t「ザムジードに加えて、セニアまで！@ こいつは高くつくぜ！」: First the Zamzeed, and now Xenia!@You're gonna pay big for this!
LDBI\t「おいおい！ @ ワシ、王女さんの件とは関係ないで！」: Whoa, whoa!@I got nothin' to do with the princess business!
LDBI\t「何や、前回のお嬢ちゃんか。@ 子供相手ちゅうんは、どうも気が進まん: Oh, it's the little lady from last time.@Fightin' a kid just don't sit right with me.
LDBI\t「てめえ、卑怯な真似をしやがって！」: You pulled a cheap stunt, you coward!
LDBI\t「あなた達には、@ その贄になっていただきましょう」: And you shall all serve@as its sacrifice.
LDBI\t「尋常ではない負の気を感じる……！」: I sense an extraordinary negative energy...!
LDBI\t「正確に言えば、その一部ですが……@ 我が神は一度目覚めたが最後、@: To be precise, merely a part of him...@Once my god awakens, he will@wreak destruction without limit.
LDBI\t「これら分身に知性はございません。@ 破壊衝動のみで行動されるのです: These Afterimages possess no intellect.@They act purely on the urge to destroy.
LDBI\t「そ、そんな物が神だなんて……！」: C-Calling a thing like that a god...!
LDBI\t「あんな怪物を使って、ラ・ギアスに@ 平和がもたらされるわけなんてな: Using a monster like that is never@gonna bring peace to La Gias!
LDBI\t「それどころか、全てが滅ぼされかねん。@ カークス将軍は、本気でヴォ: If anything, it could destroy everything.@Does General Kirkus seriously think he@can control Volkruss...!?
LDBI\t「私共はラングランの混乱が長引けば長引くほど、@ 活動し易くなります: The longer the chaos in Langran drags on,@the easier it becomes for us to operate.
LDBI\t「それに、死にゆく者の怨念や悲嘆は@ ヴォルクルス様への良質な供物で: Besides, the grudges and grief of the dying@make fine offerings to Lord Volkruss.
LDBI\t「では、あなた方にヴォルクルス様による@ 救いがもたらされんことを…: Now then, may Lord Volkruss bring@salvation upon you all...
LDBI\t「は、破壊神ヴォルクルス……！@ あんな物を倒せるのか……！？」: Th-The god of destruction, Volkruss...!@Can we really beat something like that...!?
LDBI\t「しっかりしなよ、ザッシュ！@ 破壊神って言っても、あいつらは@ デ: Pull yourself together, Zash!@God of destruction or not, those things@are just dead copies, right!?

LDBI\t「各機、攻撃開始！@ ヴォルクルスの分身を殲滅するのです！」: All units, commence attack!@Annihilate Volkruss's Afterimages!
LDBI\t「戦域内の敵機反応、全て消えました！」: All enemy signals in the area are gone!
LDBI\t「ハガネの行方がわかったのは幸いですが、@ カークス将軍を放っておく: It's fortunate we learned where the Hagane is,@but leaving General Kirkus be is dangerous.
LDBI\t「レフィーナ大佐、将軍を追いましょう。@ ここで僕達が彼を止めなけれ: Colonel Lefina, let's pursue the general.@We have to be the ones to stop him here.
LDBI\t「わかりました。@ 本艦はこれよりカークス将軍を追撃します」: Understood.@This ship will now pursue General Kirkus.
LDBI\t「あんな物を使うなんて……@ 父さんのやり方はどう考えても間違ってる: Using something like that...@No matter what, Father's way is just wrong!
LDBI\t「カークス将軍……己の野望を成就させるためには@ 本気で手段を選ばぬ: General Kirkus... So you'll truly stop at@nothing to fulfill your ambitions!
LDBI\t「まったく、あんな化け物のどこが@ 神だって言うのさ！」: Seriously, how is a monster like that@supposed to be a god!?
LDBI\t「ヴォルクルス……破邪の剣にて、貴様を断つ！」: Volkruss... With the sword that smites evil,@I shall cut you down!
LDBI\t「化け物の一つや二つで@ あたしらを止められると思うんじゃねえぜ！」: Don't think one or two monsters are@gonna be enough to stop us!
LDBI\t「人に仇なす邪神か。@ ある意味、能書きをたれる人間よりわかり易い」: An evil god that preys on people.@In a way, it's easier to read than@humans who spout excuses.
LDBI\t「あんな怪物を野放しにするわけにいくか！」: We can't let a monster like that run loose!
LDBI\t「ヴォルクルス……@ あなたの生け贄になる気はなくてよ」: Volkruss...@I have no intention of becoming your sacrifice.
LDBI\t「ゴーレムに邪神か！@ ますますファンタジー物っぽくなって@ きたじ: Golems and now an evil god!@This is turning into a real fantasy@story, huh!
LDBI\t「あれが邪神ヴォルクルス……でも、退きませんわ！」: So that's the evil god Volkruss...@But I won't back down!
LDBI\t「同じ物が何体もいるということは……@ 自己増殖や再生能力を持ってい: If there are several of the same thing...@could they self-replicate or regenerate!?

LDBI\t「ガルガード……@ 父さん以上に使いこなしてみせる！」: Galguard...@I'll master you even better than Father did!
LDBI\t「こいつ……もしや、カークスの息子か！？」: This guy... Could he be Kirkus's son?!
LDBI\t「そうだと言ったら、どうするつもりだ！？」: And if I am, what do you plan to do about it?!
LDBI\t「捕虜にしてやるぜ！ 後々で使えるからな！」: I'll take you prisoner!@You'll come in handy later!
LDBI\t「……あれから時間が経ちましたが、@ この周辺にシュテドニアス軍はい: ...Some time has passed since then, but there@seem to be no Schutedonias forces around here.
LDBI\t「これで彼らとの戦争が終結すれば@ いいのですが……」: I hope this brings an end@to our war with them...
LDBI\t「カークス軍内での交信を@ 傍受していてわかったのですが……@ 状況: I learned this while intercepting@communications within the Kirkus Army...@The situation there seems to be in chaos.
LDBI\t「混乱？@ まだどこかでシュテドニアス軍との@ 戦闘が行われているの: Chaos?@Is there still fighting with the@Schutedonias army somewhere?
LDBI\t「いえ、それが……カークス軍本隊が敗北したという@ 情報や戦闘中止命: No, it's just... Reports say the Kirkus main@force was defeated, and orders to cease fire,@surrender, and regroup are all flying about...
LDBI\t「カークス軍本隊が敗北？ どういうことだ？」: The Kirkus main force defeated? How?
LDBI\t「今回の作戦で、@ 父の本隊は前線に出ていないはずですが……」: In this operation, my father's main force@shouldn't have been on the front lines...
LDBI\t「では、何と戦って敗北を……」: Then who did they fight and lose to...
LDBI\t「！ まさか、フェイル軍と！？」: ! Don't tell me... Against Feil's forces?!
LDBI\t「そんな馬鹿な……！@ シュテドニアス軍との戦争が終わったか@ どう: That's absurd...!@To start a civil war right as the war with@Schutedonias may or may not be over...!
LDBI\t「何か重大な事件が起きたのかも知れませんな」: Perhaps some grave incident has occurred.
LDBI\t「レフィーナ大佐、@ 至急、王都方面へ向かっていただけませんか？@: Colonel Lefina,@could you head toward the capital at once?@We may be able to learn more there.
LDBI\t「やるじゃないか……@ 俗人が、応龍皇を追い込むなんてね」: Not bad...@Imagine mere mortals driving OryuOh this far.
LDBI\t「だが、君達は南北仙の何たるかを知らない。@ 泰北、強執術にて応龍皇: But you don't understand what the Sennin of@North and South really are.@Taihoku, seize OryuOh with the Coercion Arts...
LDBI\t「武雀王と雀武王も気づいておる。@ 己が宿命の歪みにのう」: BuJakuOh and JakuBuOh have noticed it too...@The distortion in their own destinies.
LDBI\t「じゃが、彼らは“破滅の王”という大邪を退け、@ 四凶と四霊をも降し: Yet they have repelled the great evil, the@"King of Ruin," bested the Four Fiends and the@Four Spirits, and now they stand before us.
LDBI\t「わかるものか！@ 僕らの悲願、総人尸解計画を@ 水泡に帰す気か！？: What does that prove!?@You'd let our cherished dream, the Mass Shikai@Project, come to nothing!?
LDBI\t「やれやれ、天命ってのは意地悪だねぇ」: Good grief, Heaven's will sure is spiteful.
LDBI\t「まあ、見事なまでの負け惜しみ台詞だったわねぇ」: My, my... That was a truly magnificent@sore-loser speech.
LDBI\t「チッ、最後の最後まで舐めた野郎だったぜ」: Tch, that bastard mocked us right till the end.
LDBI\t「元の空間に戻るのか……！？」: Are we returning to our original space...!?
LDBI\t「クスハ君、君は龍虎王に騙されているんだよ。@ 僕と僕の応龍皇こそが: Kusuha, you're being deceived by RyuKoOh.@My OryuOh and I are justice itself.@To put it in simple terms, that is.
LDBI\t「あの人の言葉に惑わされてはダメ……！@ 私は龍虎王を信じる！」: I mustn't let his words sway me...!@I believe in RyuKoOh!
LDBI\t「そして、応龍皇の逆鱗を砕いてみせる！」: And I'll shatter OryuOh's reverse scale!
LDBI\t「クスハ、何度でも言うよ。@ 僕にその身を委ねたまえ。そして、僕と共: Kusuha, I'll say it as many times as it takes.@Give yourself to me. And together, let's live@out eternity in Shangri-La.
LDBI\t「私が共に生きるのは、ブリット君やみんな……@ そして、龍虎王と虎龍: I'll live alongside Bullet and everyone else...@And with RyuKoOh and KoRyuOh!
LDBI\t「尸解や入仙なんて、絶対にしない！@ 私は人間として、あなたと戦いま: I'll never undergo shikai or become a sennin!@I'll fight you as a human being!
LDBI\t「ふむ、揺るぎない決意を持っておるな。@ 護り手としての経験が、お主: Hmm, your resolve is unshakable.@So your years as a guardian are your bedrock.@Splendid, splendid.
LDBI\t「四神の力で応龍皇は倒せないよ。@ まあ、気が済むまでやってみればい: The power of the Four Gods can't defeat OryuOh.@Well, go ahead and try until you're satisfied.
LDBI\t「超機人のランクなど、乗り越えてやる！@ 一意専心、俺と虎龍王の打と: Chokijin rank or not, we'll overcome it!@Single-minded, KoRyuOh and I will break through@with our blows and our grit!!
LDBI\t「クスハにとって本当に必要なのは、@ 君や虎龍王じゃなく……この僕さ: What Kusuha truly needs isn't you@or KoRyuOh... It's me.
LDBI\t「思い込みじゃない、愛だよ。@ クスハは僕の愛を得て、より美しく咲く: It's not a delusion, it's love.@Kusuha will blossom all the more under my love.@Yes, like a violet in a steep ravine.
LDBI\t「その谷には白虎がいる！@ クスハをお前の好きにはさせない！」: There's a White Tiger in that ravine!@I won't let you have your way with Kusuha!
LDBI\t「相変わらず、真っ直ぐな心を持っておるのう。@ だが、それ故に折れ易: As straightforward a heart as ever, I see.@Yet that also makes it brittle. Take heed.
LDBI\t「余計なお世話だ！@ その前に、お前の盾を叩き割ってやる！！」: Mind your own business!@First, I'm gonna smash that shield of yours!!
LDBI\t「孫光龍！ この身、果てようと！@ この命、尽きようとそなたを討つ！: Sun Koryu! Though this body fall!@Though my life be spent, I'll strike you down!
LDBI\t「……とか言ってる間に、消えちゃうかも知れないよ。@ 仇討ちをするな: ...Then again, you might vanish while you talk.@If you want revenge, better be quick. Hahaha!
LDBI\t「夏喃！ @ もはや、そなたらの言いなりにはならぬ！」: Kanan!@I shall no longer do your bidding!
LDBI\t「どのみち消えることになるんだ、@ 悔いのないようにな。フフフフ」: You'll vanish either way,@so make sure you've no regrets. Heh heh heh.
LDBI\t「我らに刃を向けるか。それも善哉」: You'd turn your blade on us? Splendid, too.
LDBI\t「もうそなたらの掌上で踊りはせぬ！@ 妾を謀った報いを受けるがいい！: I shall dance upon your palm no more!@Now pay for deceiving me!
LDBI\t「君の剛剣を以てしても、応龍皇は斬れないよ？」: Even your mighty sword can't cut OryuOh,@you know?
LDBI\t「ならば、その逆鱗！ 貫き、打ち砕くまで！」: Then I shall pierce that reverse scale@and shatter it!
LDBI\t「なかなか面白い屁理屈だ！ はははは！」: What an amusing bit of sophistry! Hahaha!
LDBI\t「朱雀の超機人、そして夏喃！ @ 我が剣を受け、己が炎で焼滅せよ！」: Vermilion Bird Chokijin, and Kanan!@Receive my sword and perish in your own flames!
LDBI\t「フッ、その前に黒蛇刀にて@ お前の心と剣を折ってやるよ！」: Heh. First, my Black Serpent Blade will break@your spirit and your sword!
LDBI\t「稲郷の血を引く者は、いい退屈しのぎになる。@ が、容赦はしないよ」: Anyone of Togo blood makes for a good diversion.@But I won't hold back.
LDBI\t「不退転、それが我らの流儀！@ そして、我が血脈、我が意地がお主を両: Never retreat--that is our way!@And my lineage and pride will cleave you in two!
LDBI\t「とか言って、@ 君は龍虎王に選ばれなかったじゃないか」: Big talk,@but RyuKoOh didn't choose you, did it?
LDBI\t「されど、ワシには先祖より受け継いだ魂力がある！@ それをお主の身に: Even so, I have the spirit handed down from my@ancestors! And I'll carve it into your hide!
LDBI\t「虚ろな魂に強念か……アンバランスだね」: A hollow soul, yet a strong psychic will...@How unbalanced.
LDBI\t「ま、君を我が神の下へ行かせるわけにはいかないか。@ ここで死んでも: Well, I can't let you go to my god, can I?@So you'll die here. Best to eliminate any@future worries, after all.
LDBI\t「後顧の憂い……！？ どういう意味だ！」: Future worries...!? What do you mean by that!
LDBI\t「同族嫌悪って奴かな！ ははははは！」: Call it hatred of one's own kind! Hahahaha!
LDBI\t「……艦長、本艦とハガネは@ 通常空間に戻ったようです」: ...Captain, it seems this ship and the Hagane@have returned to normal space.
LDBI\t「現在位置と……各機は？」: Our current position... and the units?
LDBI\t「位置は確認中……ですが、元いた所と@ ほぼ変わりないでしょう。また: We're still confirming our position... but it's@likely almost unchanged from where we were. And@all our units are intact.
LDBI\t「今のところ、見当たりません。@ 針路上にバラルの園があるのみです」: None in sight at present.@Only the Garden of Baral lies on our heading.
LDBI\t「では、修理及び補給が必要な機体は着艦を。@ 全周警戒を厳となせ。ラ: Then, units needing repair or Resupply, land.@Full alert on all bearings. After we revise the@rendezvous sequence, on to the Garden of Baral.
LDBI\t「フッ……@ これじゃ、僕達の出番はなさそうだね」: Heh...@Looks like there's nothing left for us to do.
LDBI\t「アルテウル司令、ゲスト部隊を撃破しました」: Commander Arteur,@the Guest force has been destroyed.
LDBI\t「ご苦労、カーリー・ナウマン艦長。@ いい指揮だった。今後も期待させ: Good work, Captain Curly Naumann.@Excellent command. I have high hopes for you.
LDBI\t「はっ。私を拾って下さった上に、@ このような名誉ある役職まで……。: Sir. You took me in, and even gave me@a post of such honor...@I'll do all I can to repay that debt.
LDBI\t「……アルテウル、お前が言った通りだったな」: ...It went just as you said, Arteur.
LDBI\t「ええ。@ このパリ以外に現れた敵軍の撃退にも@ 成功しております」: Yes.@We've also repelled the enemy forces@that appeared outside Paris.
LDBI\t「超高々度からの砲撃に対しては？」: And the bombardment from extreme altitude?
LDBI\t「連邦軍の軌道哨戒戦隊の他、@ オメガ・セイバーとベータ・セイバーを: Besides the Federation's orbital patrol fleet,@we've dispatched Omega Saber and Beta Saber.@Any move will be dealt with in advance.
LDBI\t「では、未然に防いだか……@ そもそも、彼らにそのつもりがなかったか: So we headed it off...@or they never intended to in the first place.
LDBI\t「後者だと思われます。@ 前任者より権力志向が強いようですから、@: The latter, I suspect. He's more power-hungry@than his predecessor, so he likely avoided@anything that would undermine his future base.
LDBI\t「なお、各方面軍基地やターゲットとなった都市は@ 連邦軍が防衛してい: The Federation defended the regional bases and@targeted cities, but this ship and Alpha Saber@are what saved the capital, Paris...
LDBI\t「連邦軍とガイアセイバーズ、@ そのどちらの活躍が人民の目に焼き付い: The Federation or the Gaia Savers...@whose deeds the people will remember...@I hardly need say.
LDBI\t「大統領閣下が以前に仰っていた、@ ガイアセイバーズが鮮烈なデビュー: Mr. President, you once set us a task: that the@Gaia Savers make a dazzling debut and achieve@a greater record than the Steel Dragons...
LDBI\t「これで成し遂げられたと思いますが、@ いかがでしょうか？」: I believe it's now been accomplished.@What do you think?
LDBI\t「うむ……お前達に任せて正解だったようだ」: Yes... Leaving it to you was the right call.
LDBI\t「軍には私のシンパを通じて根回しをしてあるが……@ 議会の反対派と組: I've laid groundwork in the military via my@sympathizers... but some will surely team up@with the Assembly's opposition to probe us.
LDBI\t「特に、ゲストの襲撃を予測していた件……@ これが焦点になり得る。情: Especially the fact that we foresaw the Guest@attack... That could become the focus. See that@the information is managed flawlessly.
LDBI\t「承知しております。状況が落ち着き次第、@ 閣下には演説を。ガイアセ: Understood. Once things settle, please give a@speech, Mr. President. Show the people that the@Gaia Savers are the sword that protects Earth.
LDBI\t「ああ。@ これよりのゲストとの戦い……必ずや勝利を得よ」: Yes.@In the battles against the Guests ahead... win.
LDBI\t「元帥、各方面軍からの報告がまとまりました。@ 緒戦は我が方の圧勝で: Marshal, the regional armies' reports are in.@The opening clashes were a landslide for us.
LDBI\t「向こうはさぞかし面食らっているだろうな。@ それで、敵本隊の位置は: They must be quite taken aback.@And where's the enemy's main force?
LDBI\t「現在、捜索中ですが……<ＭＯＳＳ>のプローブが@ 攻撃を受けていな: We're searching now... but since the <ＭＯＳＳ> probes@haven't been attacked, they're most likely@in space beyond lunar orbit.
LDBI\t「おそらく、次の狙いは月とヘブンゲート……@ 初手でそこへ仕掛けなか: Their next targets are probably the Moon and@Heaven Gate... I'm surprised they didn't strike@there first. Heighten alert everywhere.
LDBI\t「はっ。@ ところで、先程の大統領の演説ですが……@ よろしいので？: Sir.@About the President's speech earlier, though...@Are you sure about it?
LDBI\t「我らの最高司令官が述べたことだ、構わんさ」: Our commander-in-chief said it. It's fine.
LDBI\t「ですが、ガイアセイバーズの功績が喧伝され……@ あれでは、我が軍の: But he trumpeted the Gaia Savers' feats...@That leaves our forces without any standing.
LDBI\t「こちらの予算を圧迫せず、新兵器の実験が出来る上に@ ゲストとも積極: They test new arms without draining our budget,@and they'll take the fight to the Guests too.@What's not to be grateful for?
LDBI\t「アルテウルはガイアセイバーズを足掛かりにして、@ 軍への発言権を強: Arteur may plan to use the Gaia Savers as a@foothold to increase his sway over the military.
LDBI\t「あるいは、旧国際連合安全保障理事会の@ 常任理事国以外の旧国軍と結: Or he may be plotting with old national armies@outside the old UN Security Council's permanent@five to topple the current Federation setup...
LDBI\t「心配性だな、君は。さすがにそれはなかろう。@ ま、そう考えていたと: You worry too much. Surely not that far.@Well, even if he did think so, I wouldn't mind.
LDBI\t「下手をすれば、内戦……由々しき問題ですぞ」: At worst, civil war... That's a grave problem.
LDBI\t「共通の外敵は、結束を固める要因となる。@ かつて、ビアン・ゾルダー: A common foe strengthens unity. Long ago,@Bian Zoldark and Maier V. Brancstein proved it.
LDBI\t「しかも、ＤＣ戦争は反連邦勢力のガス抜きにも@ なったのだ。しばらく: What's more, the DC War let off steam for the@anti-Federation factions. No big civil war will@break out for a while. And a new foe is here too.
LDBI\t「ですが、@ いまだＤＣ残党と反連邦主義者達の問題は……」: But...@the DC remnants and anti-Federationists are still...
LDBI\t「我が軍の仕事が増え、戦争商人達の懐も潤う。@ しかも、我らが画策し: Our forces get more work, and the war merchants@get richer. And with no plotting on our part,@some even volunteer to play the villain.
LDBI\t「そのおかげで我らは大義の下、任務を遂行できるのだ。@ 語弊はあるが: Thanks to them, we can carry out our mission@under a just cause. Crude as it sounds,@it's a give-and-take relationship.
LDBI\t「この世界に完全な平和など成立せんよ。@ それに、軍隊は敵と戦い、勝: Perfect peace can never exist in this world.@Besides, an army faces a challenge as hard as@defeating the enemy... or even harder.
LDBI\t「そうだ。@ 敵対者の根絶は、自らの足場を危うくすることに@ つなが: Exactly.@Eradicating your enemies endangers your own@footing, Daniel.
LDBI\t「……ガイアセイバーズは劇薬かも知れませんぞ」: ...The Gaia Savers may be a dangerous drug.
LDBI\t「こちらにも特効薬がある。@ 鋼龍戦隊以外の駒……カルロやエッケハル: We have our own remedy. Pieces besides the@Steel Dragons... Carlo, Eckhart and the others@are making preparations, aren't they?
LDBI\t「ならば、次期大統領選に向けた@ グライエンやアルテウル達のパフォー: Then turn a blind eye to@Graien and Arteur's performance@ahead of the next presidential election.
LDBI\t「それに、大木は風に折らると言う。@ 戦時下を理由にした大統領の強引: Besides, tall trees are broken by the wind.@I doubt the conservatives in the Assembly will@long tolerate his heavy-handed wartime policies.
LDBI\t「木が倒れるその時まで、@ アルテウル達には精々働いてもらおうではな: Until that tree falls,@let's have Arteur's lot work their hardest...
LDBI\t「色々と心配させて済まなかったな、ラトゥーニ」: Sorry I made you worry so much, Latune.
LDBI\t「ううん、きっと無事に戻って来てくれると@ 信じてたから……」: It's okay. I believed you'd come back@safe...
LDBI\t「新型機の写真も色々撮っておいたの……」: I took lots of photos of the new units, too...
LDBI\t「おっ、そりゃ嬉しいな。ありがとう。@ 後で見せてくれ」: Oh, that's great. Thanks.@Show me later.
LDBI\t「シャイン王女、よくご無事で……」: Princess Shine, I'm so glad you're safe...
LDBI\t「わ、私、リクセント公国に行ったことがあって！@ パレードでお姿を見: I-I've been to the Principality of Riksent!@I saw you at a parade!
BMD\t「超闘士の力、見るがいい」: Behold the power of a Super Fighter.
BMD\t「超闘士たる所以を教えてやろう」: Let me show you/　what makes a Super Fighter.
BMD\t「星の巡りに恵まれていなかったな」: The stars weren't aligned in your favor.
BMD\t「参式には、こういう攻撃パターンもある！」: The Type-3 has attack patterns/　like this, too!
BMD\t「凶方の果てに消えるがいい……！」: Vanish into the depths of misfortune...!
BMD\t「気づいた時には……撃ち抜かれている！」: By the time you notice.../　you've been shot through!
BMD\t「ほ～ら、次から次へとどんどん行くわよ～！」: Here we go~! One after another, nonstop~!
BMD\t「明日のためのその１！/ とりあえず殴っとくってことで！」: Rule No. 1 for a better tomorrow!/　When in doubt, just punch 'em!
BMD\t「ジガンちゃん、まとめてお願いね～」: Jigan, take 'em all out at once~
BMD\t「ギガでワイドなブラスター、大発射！」: Giga and wide! Blaster, big fire!
BMD\t「赤くてワイドだと、６の次よね～！/ ……わかんないか」: Red and wide? That comes after 6, right~!/　...Guess you don't get it.
BMD\t「これを受けたら叫ぶのが決まりよん！」: If this hits you, you have to scream!
BMD\t「ちょっと変わった武器だけど、/ そこが私のお気に入り……！」: It's a bit of an odd weapon,/　but that's why I love it...!
BMD\t「ハルバートは『矛盾』って意味なの。/ 勉強になるでしょ？」: A halberd is a kind of shield, y'know./　Learned something, didn't you?
BMD\t「ごめん、『矛槍』だったわ」: Oops, sorry. I meant a spear-ax.
BMD\t「この武器は、すでに私の虜なの」: This weapon's already head over heels for me.
BMD\t「お姉さんがまとめて相手をしてあ・げ・る！/ 凄いの行くわよぉ～！」: Big sis'll take you all on at o-n-c-e!/　Here comes something amazing~!
BMD\t「グラビ、ド～ンといっちゃいましょか！」: Gravi, let's go out with a boom!
BMD\t「グラ・ヴィトンって分けると、/ 女の子が喜びそうよね」: Split it into 'Gra-Vuitton,'/　and girls would go crazy for it.
BMD\t「リッパーちゃん、ちゃんとお仕事してね？」: Ripper, do your job properly, okay?
BMD\t「ガッツーンと行くわよ、ガッツーンと！！」: Gonna hit 'em with a big WHAM! A big WHAM!!
BMD\t「これ、アルトちゃんなりきりグッズ？」: Is this some kind of Alt cosplay kit?
BMD\t「ん～、確かにインパクトはあるわよね」: Hmm~ It sure does make an impact.
BMD\t「貫く……！ 止めてみる？」: Piercing through...! Wanna try stopping it?
BMD\t「って、捨てちゃイヤ～ン」: Wait, don't toss it, pretty please~
BMD\t「誰が考えたのかしらね、これって」: Who came up with this, anyway?
BMD\t「我が名はエクセレン・ブロウニング！/ 悪を断っちゃう剣なの！」: My name is Excellen Browning!/　I'm the sword that cuts down evil!
BMD\t「射撃はおまかせ！/ んふふ～、どこを狙って欲しい？」: Leave the shooting to me!/　Mmhmhm~ Where would you like it?
BMD\t「寄らば斬る！ ……とか言ったりしてね」: Come close and I'll cut you! ...Or so I say.
BMD\t「あんま接近戦はやりたくないんだけど！」: I'd really rather not do close combat!
BMD\t「んふふ～、/ そんなに固まってちゃダメダメよん！」: Mmhmhm~/　Bunching up like that is a no-no!

LDBI\t「……追っ手は何とか撃破した」: ...We managed to take out our pursuers.
LDBI\t「感謝する。@ おかげで何とか南極圏から出られたよ」: I'm grateful.@Thanks to you, we made it out of the Antarctic.
LDBI\t「それと、鋼龍戦隊から連絡があった。@ 上手くいけば、あと３０分ほど: Also, the Steel Dragons got in touch with us.@If all goes well, they should be able to@rendezvous with us in about 30 minutes.
LDBI\t（ハガネとヒリュウ改ならではの話だな）: (Only the Hagane and Hiryu Custom@could pull that off.)
LDBI\t「クリフ、ファブラ・フォレースは……@ 親父達は、あれからどうなった: Cliff, what about Fabula Fores...@What's happened to Dad and the others since?
LDBI\t「音信不通のままだよ。あの黒い雲の中の様子は、@ まったくわからない: Still no word from them. We have no idea@what's going on inside that black cloud.
LDBI\t「あの怪物共の出所は、地下の遺跡だろう。@ 知っていることを教えて欲: Those monsters came from the underground ruins,@didn't they? Tell me what you know.
LDBI\t「ああ……@ こうなった以上、機密というわけにはいかないな」: Yes...@Given what's happened, I can't keep it classified.
LDBI\t「ファブラ・フォレースとは、@ ラテン語で“真実の門”という言葉を意: Fabula Fores means@"Gate of Truth" in Latin.
LDBI\t「これまでの調査の結果、ラドクリフ教授……@ ジョッシュとリムの父親: Our research so far led Professor Radcliffe...@Josh and Rim's father, that is... to theorize@that it was a gate leading to another world.
LDBI\t「アインストや修羅との戦いを経た今では、@ 驚くほどのことではなかろ: After fighting the Einst and the Shura,@that shouldn't come as much of a surprise.
LDBI\t「それで、ファブラ・フォレースは@ どんな世界とつながっているんだ？: So what kind of world does@Fabula Fores connect to?
LDBI\t「詳しいことはわかっていない。@ 門は、ずっと閉ざされたままだったか: We don't know the details.@The gate has remained closed all this time.
LDBI\t「そして、それを調査するためのツールが@ シュンパティアとレース・ア: And the tools for investigating it were@the Sympathia and the Race Arcana.
LDBI\t「その二つで、どうやって調査を……」: How would you investigate it with those two...?
LDBI\t「ラドクリフ教授は、人間の精神とリンクする@ 機能を持ったシュンパテ: To Professor Radcliffe, the Sympathia, with its@ability to link with the human mind, was a means@of seeing what lay beyond the gate...
LDBI\t「または、門を開ける鍵なのではないかと@ 推測していた」: Or else, he theorized, a key that@could open the gate.
LDBI\t「では、レース・アルカーナは？」: Then what about the Race Arcana?
LDBI\t「ファブラ・フォレースに関わる装置の@ 動力源だと考えられていたが…: It was thought to power the devices related to@Fabula Fores... But in hindsight, perhaps how@it's being used now is the right way after all.
LDBI\t「機動兵器の動力源であることが、か？」: You mean as a power source for mobile weapons?
LDBI\t「なら、親父はスポンサーに売り込むためじゃなく、@ ファブラ・フォレ: Then Dad didn't build the Aile Chevalier to@sell to sponsors, but to fight whatever comes@out of Fabula Fores...?
LDBI\t「私は、保険だとしか聞いていないがね」: All I was told is that it was insurance.
LDBI\t「もしかして、親父は予期していた……？@ だとしたら、何で俺に黙って: Could Dad have seen this coming...?@If so, why didn't he tell me...!
LDBI\t「……確証が持てなかったからだろう。@ 逆に、可能性が高ければ、もっ: ...Probably because he wasn't certain.@If he'd thought it likely, he'd have taken@other measures.
LDBI\t「ジョッシュ……@ あなた、さっき声が聞こえると言ってたわね。@ そ: Josh...@Earlier, you said you could hear voices.@What did you mean by that?
LDBI\t「彼らが話していたんです。@ ルイーナ……人間に恐怖や絶望を与え、@: They were talking among themselves.@Calling themselves Ruina... beings that bring@humanity fear and despair, and then ruin.
LDBI\t「ルイーナ……@ ラテン語で『破滅』、または『死』という意味だな。@: Ruina...@That's Latin for "ruin," or "death."@So they're intelligent, and know our language.
LDBI\t「だが、連中の声を聞いたのは俺と……」: But the only ones who heard them were me and...
LDBI\t「ジョッシュとリムだけが@ 彼らの声を聞いたのなら……シュンパティア: If only Josh and Rim heard@their voices... then the Sympathia may@have something to do with it.
LDBI\t「こ、この反応……ルイーナじゃないかしら！？」: Th-This signature... Could it be the Ruina?!
LDBI\t「お前は駄目だ。@ もうブランシュネージュに乗る必要はない」: No, you're not.@You don't need to pilot the Blanche Neige anymore.
LDBI\t「そんなこと言ってられないよ！@ この輸送機にはリ・テクの人達が@: This is no time to say that!@There are Re-Tech people@aboard this transport!
LDBI\t「みんなで生き残るためよ！ @ でなきゃ、お父さん達を助けられない！: It's so we all survive!@Otherwise, we can't save Dad and the others!@I'm going out!
LDBI\t「ジョッシュ、ブランシュネージュのシステムは@ 私がモニターしておく: Josh, I'll monitor the Blanche Neige's systems.@If anything happens, I'll let you know.
LDBI\t「ジョッシュ、あいつらは俺とお前で食い止める。@ リムは輸送機の護衛: Josh, you and I will hold them off.@Rim will guard the transport.
LDBI\t「了解です。@ ……気を遣ってもらって、ありがとうございます」: Understood.@...Thanks for looking out for us.
LDBI\t「礼を言うのはまだ早い。@ 鋼龍戦隊が来るまで、何としても……」: Save your thanks for later.@Until the Steel Dragons get here, we have to...
LDBI\t「後方からルイーナらしき物体群が接近中！@ 数が多いわ！」: Possible Ruina approaching from behind!@There are a lot of them!
LDBI\t「リム、輸送機と一緒に離脱するんだ！」: Rim, get out of here with the transport!
LDBI\t「……減速終了、ブレイク・フィールド解除。@ 間に合いましたな、艦長: ...Deceleration complete. Releasing Break Field.@We made it in time, Captain.
LDBI\t「ええ、フォーメーション・ブレイクアウトによる@ 高速航行の針路を確: Yes, we were fortunate to secure a course for@high-speed travel via Formation Breakout.
LDBI\t「まあ、宇宙空間でも難しい荒技ですが……非常時で@ 太平洋上の民間機: It's a rough trick even in space... But civilian@air and sea traffic over the Pacific was banned@for the emergency, and our people made way.

BMD\t「さーて、虎狩りといくか！」: Alright, time for a tiger hunt!

BMD\t「ルイーナなんざブチのめしてやる！」: I'll beat the Ruina to a pulp!

BMD\t「桃源郷への誘いは、断らせていただく！」: I'll decline the invitation to paradise!

LDBI\t「アルテウル、@ 僕が力を得たのは偶然じゃない……@ お前達が仕組ん: Arteur,@I didn't gain my power by chance...@You people must have arranged it.

LDBI\t「いくら何でも、それはないんじゃない？」: Come on, that can't be it, can it?
LDBI\t「後のことはお前達に託すぞ、鋼龍戦隊……」: I leave the rest to you, Steel Dragons...

LDBI\t「……諸君、ご苦労だった。@ 事後処理は連邦軍部隊が行う」: ...Good work, everyone.@Federation Army units will handle the aftermath.

LDBI\t「それに関しては、遺された物から推測するしかない」: As for that, we can only speculate@from what he left behind.

LDBI\t「かえって謎が増えたようなものね……@ 事後調査で真相が判明すればい: If anything, it's only added more mysteries...@I hope the investigation reveals the truth...

LDBI\t「だからって……<スクール>の仲間だったからって、@ おれ達の命をく: Still... just 'cause they were from <スクール>,@we can't hand over our lives to 'em...

LDBI\t「はい……@ グランド・クリスマスではなく、@ 皆さんと共に南極へ行: Yes...@Rather than stay at Grand Christmas,@I'll go to the Antarctic with all of you.

LDBI\t「ウチへの出向者とは、お前のことだったのか……！」: So you're the one being transferred to us...!

LDBI\t（だが、あの隊はイェッツトとの戦闘で……）: (But that unit, in the fight with the Jetzt...)

LDBI\t「高熱源体、海中より急速浮上！ 数は１！」: High heat source rising fast from underwater!@Just one!
LDBI\t「さっきの機体と違う！」: It's different from the ones before!

LDBI\t「……艦長、ヒリュウ改との交信に成功しました。@ 現在、北極ボーフォ: ...Captain, we've reached the Hiryu Custom.@They're over the Beaufort Sea in the Arctic.

LDBI\t「地球へ降下し、合流するようにと。@ ポイントも指定されています」: They want us to descend to Earth and join them.@They've specified a rendezvous point.
LDBI\t「よし、大気圏突入シーケンスに移行。@ 地球へ降り、ヒリュウ改と合流: All right, begin atmospheric entry sequence.@We'll descend to Earth and join the Hiryu Custom.
LDBI\t「やれやれ、一時はどうなることかと思ったぜ。@ まあ、アートルム・エ: Man, I thought we were done for back there.@Well, the Atrum Exterior's gone, so all's well@that ends well.
LDBI\t「ああ、心配かけてすまなかったな。@ アクセルさんとアルフィミィは@: Yeah, sorry for worrying you.@I hear Axel and Alchemie joined up@with you guys?
LDBI\t「今、その二人は？」: Where are the two of them now?
LDBI\t「アルフィミィは眠りにつくと言って去り……@ アクセル隊長はハガネが: Alchemie said she would go to sleep and left...@And Captain Axel went and left the ship all@by himself after the Hagane came down to Earth.
LDBI\t「こっちに挨拶なしで？@ んもう、照れ屋さんなんだから」: Without even saying hi to us?@Geez, he's such a shy guy.
LDBI\t「そんなわけがあるか。奴はどこへ行った？」: As if. Where did he go?
LDBI\t「クロガネです。@ ソウルゲインがあの艦に収容されていますので」: The Kurogane.@Soulgain is being housed aboard that ship.
LDBI\t「あらら、せっかちさんねぇ」: My my, what an impatient one.
LDBI\t「いつぞや、浅草で焼きそばを買ってくれた子？」: Aren't you the kid who bought yakisoba@from me in Asakusa that one time?
LDBI\t「そうそう。@ 鉄板に乗ってたのを全部買ってくお客さんなんて@ 珍し: Yeah, yeah.@It's rare to get a customer who buys out the@whole griddle, so... that's why I remembered.
LDBI\t「言われてみれば、そんなことがあったような……」: Come to think of it, that did happen...
LDBI\t「俺はトウマ・カノウ……@ Ｌ＆Ｅコーポレーションのアルバイトだ」: I'm Touma Kanou...@a part-timer at L&E Corporation.
LDBI\t「トウマにはエクサランス・レスキューの@ 整備手伝いをやってもらって: Touma's been helping with maintenance on the@Excellence Rescue. All his part-time jobs have@made him pretty handy.
LDBI\t「それに、掃除とかもテキパキやってくれるし……@ あたし達も助かって: Plus, he's quick about cleaning and stuff...@He's a big help to us.
LDBI\t「あら、アイビス……そのペンダント、素敵ね」: Oh, Ibis... that pendant is lovely.
LDBI\t「トウマの他にも新入りがいるのか？」: There's another new face besides Touma?
LDBI\t「そう、みんなにも紹介するよ。@ ……イルイ、こっちにおいでよ」: Yeah, I'll introduce her to everyone.@...Irui, come over here.
LDBI\t「コモディン島がジンライに襲われた時、@ あたし達が助けた子なんだ」: She's a girl we rescued when Jinrai attacked@Commodin Island.
LDBI\t「でも、記憶を失ってて……@ 色々あって、ヒリュウで面倒を見ることに: But she's lost her memory...@One thing led to another, and now she's in the@Hiryu's care.
LDBI\t「過去の記憶が……なら、僕と同じですね」: Lost her memories... Then she's just like me.
LDBI\t「もしかして、イルイちゃん……@ イング君に見覚えがあるの？」: Irui... do you recognize Ing,@by any chance?
LDBI\t「ひょっとして、一目惚れとか？」: Ooh, could it be love at first sight?
LDBI\t「ところで、さっきジンライに襲われたと言ってたな。@ 奴はまたダブル: By the way, you mentioned a Jinrai attack.@Was it going after the Double G again?
LDBI\t「ええ……@ ギリアム少佐達は、あれがガイアセイバーズに@ 所属する: Yes...@Major Gilliam and the others suspect it@belongs to the Gaia Savers.
LDBI\t「あと、北極で出会ったガイアセイバーズ部隊の中に@ メディウス・ロク: Also, the Gaia Savers unit we ran into in the@Arctic had the Medius Locus and Kelberion.
LDBI\t「このままだと……@ 間違いなく、あいつらと衝突することになるか……: At this rate...@we're definitely going to clash with them...
LDBI\t「それに、メディウス・ロクス……@ 強奪されたという話は嘘だったよう: And the Medius Locus... It seems the story@about it being stolen was a lie.
LDBI\t「ああ……ツェントル・プロジェクトは、@ 俺が参加する以前からガイア: Yeah... The Tsentr Project was under Gaia@Savers control from before I even joined.
LDBI\t「私とヒューゴはそのことを知らされていなくて……」: Hugo and I were never told about that...
LDBI\t「メディウス・ロクスには誰が乗っていたのだ？」: Who was piloting the Medius Locus?
LDBI\t「ミタール・ザパトに確認したい所だが……@ 迂闊にコンタクトすれば、: I'd like to check with Mitar Zapad, but...@if we contact him carelessly, they'll learn@our position and movements.
BMD\t「俺の子ら……/ マシンナリー・チルドレンが/ この世界を粛正するのだ: My children... the Machinery Children/　will purge this world.
BMD\t「不良品に興味はない」: Defective goods hold no interest for me.
BMD\t「ここで奴らを消さねば、俺の計画が……！」: If I don't erase them here,/　my plan will...!
BMD\t「欠陥品がここまでの力を発揮するとは……！」: To think a defective product could/　show this much power...!
BMD\t「おのれ、ゼンガー……！ 貴様だけは！」: Damn you, Sänger...!/　You, at least, I will end!
BMD\t「チッ、力押ししか出来ん輩が……！」: Tch, brutes who know nothing/　but brute force...!
BMD\t「無能な連中の相手をする時間はない」: I have no time to waste on incompetents.
BMD\t「不良品ごときに倒される俺ではない」: I won't be beaten by mere rejects.
BMD\t「ゼンガー……貴様のやり方は通用せんぞ」: Sänger... your ways won't work on me.
BMD\t「フッ……兵の代わりはいくらでもいるのでな」: Heh... I have soldiers to spare.
BMD\t「フッ、当てただけではな」: Heh, a mere hit won't do it.
BMD\t「フン、こちらを翻弄する気か」: Hmph, trying to toy with me, are you?
LDBI\t「ね、念が……負の念が溢れ出してくる……！！」: Th-The thoughts... Negative thoughts are@pouring out...!!
LDBI\t「こ、これが“破滅の王”の！？」: S-So this is the "King of Ruin's"...!?
LDBI\t「大山鳴動して鼠一匹、というわけでは@ なかろうが……！」: It's hardly a case of the mountain laboring@to bring forth a mouse...!
LDBI\t「奴が“破滅の王”……ペルフェクティオか」: So he's the "King of Ruin"... Perfectio.
LDBI\t「ペルフェクティオとは、我が宿りし、@ 仮初めのこの身体の名……」: Perfectio is the name of this temporary body@in which I dwell...
LDBI\t「我は破滅、我は混沌……全てをただ消し去る。@ 無限に広がり続ける宇: I am ruin, I am chaos... I simply erase all.@Endlessly I return the infinitely expanding@reaches of Space to the primordial darkness.
LDBI\t「フン……@ “破滅の王”と呼ばれるだけのことはあるか」: Hmph...@I suppose he lives up to the name "King of Ruin."
LDBI\t「ふざけるな！@ 余所の世界から来たお前に、俺達の世界を、@ 宇宙を: Like hell!@We won't let some outsider from another world@destroy our world and all of Space!
LDBI\t「そうね。@ ところで、あのペルフェクさん……誰かに似てない？」: True.@By the way, doesn't Perfec-whatsit there look@like someone we know?
LDBI\t（……若い……若いが、あれはジョッシュに@ 良く似ている。あの身体は: (...Young... He's young, but he looks just@like Josh. Then that body must be...)
LDBI\t「お前は……我が得た知識の中にあるぞ。@ ジョシュア・ラドクリフ……: You... I know you from the knowledge I gained.@Joshua Radcliffe...
LDBI\t「お前達がフェリオ・ラドクリフと認識する@ 知的生命体……その魂は、: The intelligent life form you know as Ferio@Radcliffe... its soul has already perished.@This flesh is merely my temporary vessel.
LDBI\t「我にこの世界の知識を与え、虚無に還った」: He gave me knowledge of this world,@and returned to the void.
LDBI\t「お前を引き込んだのは……親父の意志なのか！？」: Was it Dad's will that pulled you in!?
LDBI\t「否。@ フェリオ・ラドクリフはここで“鍵”を見つけ、@ “門”を開: No.@Ferio Radcliffe merely found the "Key" here@and sought to open the "Gate."
LDBI\t「お前達がシュンパティアと呼ぶ物……@ それが最も近しい」: What you call the Sympathia...@is the nearest thing to it.
LDBI\t「本来、“鍵”は我が赴く先の世界、その知識所有者……@ 負の波動の源: The "Key" serves to study the knowledge-holders@of each world I go to... the sources of negative@waves... to read the hearts of those I feed on.
LDBI\t「どうして、あたし達やアニキに@ そんなのが扱えたのよ！？」: Then how could Bro and the rest of us@use something like that!?
LDBI\t「お前達のシュンパティアは、“鍵”を歪めた物。@ おそらくはこの封印: Your Sympathia are warped copies of the "Key."@Most likely they were created by those who@built this Sealed Temple.
LDBI\t「古の知識所有者……@ 我の目覚めに備え、我が眷属との戦いで@ 得た: The knowledge-holders of old...@Bracing for my awakening, they took what they@won from my kin to make the Temple, Sympathia...
LDBI\t「そして、お前達がレース・アルカーナと@ 呼ぶ物を作り、遺した知的生: And the intelligent life forms that created and@left behind what you call the Race Arcana.
LDBI\t「姿形は、今のお前達とよく似ていた。@ だが、既に死滅している。我の: In form, they resembled you as you are now.@But they are long extinct--the price of my seal.
LDBI\t「ルイーナは、@ 過去の地球にも出現していたのか……！？」: So the Ruina@appeared on Earth in the past, too...!?
LDBI\t「もしや、かつて超機人が戦ったという@ 百邪の中にルイーナも含まれて: Could it be that the Ruina were among the@Hundred Evils the Choukijin once fought?
LDBI\t「だとしたら、バラルが真っ先にここへ来るはず。@ 彼らは、百邪とは別: If so, the Baral would have come here first.@Might they be a hostile force entirely@separate from the Hundred Evils?
LDBI\t「そうだと思います。@ 龍虎王も彼らに関する知識は@ 持っていないよ: I think so too.@RyuKoOh doesn't seem to have@any knowledge of them either.
LDBI\t「ならば、ルイーナはいったい……」: Then what on earth are the Ruina...?
LDBI\t「……古の知識所有者達も@ フェリオ・ラドクリフも、“鍵”の全てを@: ...Neither the knowledge-holders of old@nor Ferio Radcliffe could unravel@all of the "Key's" secrets.
LDBI\t「“鍵”に触れた者は、@ その知識と引き替えに魂を蝕まれる……@ い: Those who touch the "Key" trade their souls for@its knowledge, and are slowly devoured...@to become guides for the ruin yet to come.
LDBI\t「そう、お前達がメリオルエッセと呼ぶ存在……@ 我が下僕、我が尖兵と: Yes... what you call the Meliolesse...@They become my servants, my vanguard.
LDBI\t「知らぬことか。ならば、フェリオ・ラドクリフの@ 記憶を垣間見るがい: You do not know? Then glimpse the memories of@Ferio Radcliffe... They shall be the seed of@yet deeper despair for you.
LDBI\t「ああ……。@ あれが、人の精神に反応する装置だという所までは@ 解: Yes...@We've established that it's a device that@responds to the human mind.
LDBI\t「だが、私が試しても動かなかった。@ 高感応力を持ったテスター達も同: But it didn't activate when I tried it.@The same went for our highly sensitive testers.
LDBI\t「もちろん、要因はあれが発掘された時点で@ 破損していたことだ。しか: Naturally, it was already damaged when we dug@it up. But I've been considering the cause@from a different angle.
LDBI\t「それが……被験者の質だと？」: And that is... the quality of the test subject?
LDBI\t「そうだ。あれは、より純粋な精神の持ち主に@ 反応するのではないか…: Yes. Perhaps it responds to those whose minds@are purer... That's my theory.
BMD\t「殺しはしないわ。/ 死んじゃったら楽しめないものね……」: I won't kill you./　It's no fun once you're dead...
BMD\t「ふふふふ……耐えてみせてね、仔猫ちゃん」: Hehehehe... Do try to hold out, kitten.
BMD\t「ふふ、いい子ねぇ、気に入ったわ」: Hehe, what a good little pet. I like you.
BMD\t「各種元素を融合させ、/ 新しい力を生み出す……」: Fusing the elements together/　to give birth to a new power...
BMD\t「なんて、原理はどうでもいいわよね」: Oh, who cares how it works, right?
LDBI\t「うん、ミチルさんは@ お兄ちゃんと会うためにウチまで来てね。@ い: Yeah, Michiru came all the way to our place@to see you. I told him you weren't here,@but he said he'd wait...
LDBI\t「だからって、家に上げたのかよ！？」: So you just let him into the house!?
LDBI\t「だって、お兄ちゃんが帰って来るまで@ ウチの前でずっと野宿するって: Well, he said he'd camp out in front of our@house until you came back... I felt sorry@for him.
LDBI\t「あの時はショウコはんが天使に見えたわ」: Lemme tell ya, Shoko looked like an angel@ta me right then.
LDBI\t「爺ちゃんもどういうつもりなんでえ！？@ ショウコに押し切られたのか: And what were you thinking, Gramps!?@Did Shoko just steamroll you!?
LDBI\t「いや、居候の件はワシが言い出したことじゃ」: No, letting him stay here was my idea.
LDBI\t「ミチルはいい身体つきをしておるし、@ 腕っぷしも強いからのう……そ: Michiru's got a fine build, and he's strong@to boot... I saw potential there, so I've had@him helping me with my work.
LDBI\t「モーション・パターンのサンプル取りじゃ。@ 何と言うか、渡りに船で: Collecting motion pattern samples. It was@a real stroke of luck, you see.@He's been a big help.
LDBI\t「居候させてもらってますさかい、@ 働くのは当然ですわ」: I'm stayin' here on yer dime,@so workin' is the least I can do.
LDBI\t「バーニングＰＴの新型モデルや。ドツキ合い用で、@ モーション・トレ: A new Burning PT model. It's fer fistfights,@an' it's a motion-trace type, so they said@I'd make a great model fer it.
LDBI\t「バーニングＰＴって……@ 爺ちゃん、そんな仕事もやってたのか？」: Burning PT...?@Gramps, you've been doing that kind of work too?
LDBI\t「まあ、詳しい話は後でする。@ ともかく、お前が無事に戻って来てくれ: Well, I'll explain the details later.@Anyway, I'm just glad you made it back safe.@Tonight, we celebrate.
LDBI\t「色々あって、ほとんどのお店が閉まってるから@ お寿司とかは取れない: A lot's happened, and most shops are closed,@so we can't get sushi or anything... but@I'll make something with what we've got!
LDBI\t「いや、またすぐに出かけなきゃならねえんだ」: No, I've gotta head out again right away.
LDBI\t「……ミチル。すまんが、席を外してくれんか。@ 少々、込み入った話に: ...Michiru. Sorry, but would you excuse us?@This is going to get a little complicated.
LDBI\t「……爺ちゃん、@ 俺はコンパチカイザーを取りに来たんだ。@ その後: ...Gramps, I came for the Compati Kaiser.@After that, I've gotta get back to the@Steel Dragons.
LDBI\t「こないだ太陽を消しちまった連中……@ 爺ちゃんやショウコも知ってる: The ones who blotted out the sun recently...@You and Shoko know about 'em, right, Gramps?
LDBI\t「うむ……@ 浅草だけでなく、日本中が大騒ぎじゃったわ」: Mm... It wasn't just Asakusa.@All of Japan was in an uproar.
LDBI\t「電気の使用量が制限されて、みんな困ってた……@ 今度こそ世界が終わ: Power usage got rationed, and everyone was@struggling... Some people were even shouting@that this time the world really was ending...
LDBI\t「<修羅の乱>からようやく立ち直りつつあった所で、@ 今回の騒ぎじゃ: We'd only just begun to recover from@the <修羅の乱> when this happened.
LDBI\t「連邦軍がこれまでの戦を平定してきたこともあって、@ 人々は彼らに望: The Federation Army has put down every conflict@so far, so people had pinned their hopes on@them... Then came the President's incident.
LDBI\t「鋼龍戦隊はガイアセイバーズの罠にはめられたんです。@ ああなるよう: The Gaia Savers trapped the Steel Dragons.@They set things up so it'd turn out that way.
LDBI\t「しかも、彼らは鋼龍戦隊の機体の接収を@ 目論んでいます」: What's more, they're plotting to seize@the Steel Dragons' machines.
LDBI\t「それに、ルイーナの次元断層が消滅するきっかけを@ 作ったのは、ガイ: And it wasn't the Gaia Savers who made the@Ruina's dimensional rift disappear.@It was our friends.
LDBI\t「じゃあ、ニュースで言ってたことは嘘なのね……」: Then what they said on the news was a lie...
LDBI\t「人々の不安を和らげるためだとしても、@ やり方があざといのう」: Even if it's meant to ease people's fears,@that's a shameless way to go about it.
LDBI\t「だけど、ガイアセイバーズが何とかしてくれるって@ 思ってる人は多い: But lots of people think the Gaia Savers@will take care of everything...
LDBI\t「光の点がいっぱい近づいてくる……！」: Lots of lights are closing in...!
LDBI\t「爺ちゃん、カイザーはすぐに出せるのか！？」: Gramps, can the Kaiser launch right away!?
LDBI\t「いや、今は整備中での……」: No, it's undergoing maintenance right now...
LDBI\t「だったら、ファイター・ロアで戦うぜ！」: Then I'll fight with Fighter Roar!
LDBI\t「くっ！ いったい、何が！？」: Ngh! What the heck is going on!?
LDBI\t「あ、足が……足が動かない！」: M-My legs... I can't move my legs!
LDBI\t「くそっ、このままじゃ街が！」: Damn it, at this rate the city's gonna...!
LDBI\t「すぐに地下街へ逃げて！@ そこにシェルターがあるから！」: Get to the underground mall, now!@There's a shelter down there!
LDBI\t「艦長、各員の配置が完了しました」: Captain, all personnel are in position.
LDBI\t「補充戦力……と遠慮した割には、@ ど真ん中に放り込まれましたな」: We modestly called ourselves reinforcements,@yet they've thrown us into the thick of it.
LDBI\t「私達はバルトール事件の時、@ ヘブンゲートへ突入した経験があります: We have experience storming Heaven's Gate@from the Bartoll Incident.
LDBI\t「あの時とは状況が違いますが……ハンフリー大佐の@ 考え方が変わった: Things are different from back then, but...@Colonel Humphrey must have changed his mind.
LDBI\t「艦長、第１、第２、第３艦隊が@ ヘブンゲートへの突入を開始しました: Captain, the 1st, 2nd, and 3rd Fleets have@begun their assault on Heaven's Gate.
LDBI\t「さて、我々の腕の見せ所ですな」: Well, time to show them what we can do.
LDBI\t「ええ、我々も突入します。@ 針路このまま、両舷前進第三戦速！」: Yes, we're going in too.@Maintain course! All ahead, battle speed three!
LDBI\t「目標群マイク、リバー、ノベンバー、@ ０時方向、仰角１０より接近！: Target groups Mike, River, November,@approaching from 12 o'clock, elevation 10!
LDBI\t「第２艦隊、第３艦隊も会敵！」: 2nd and 3rd Fleets have also engaged the enemy!
LDBI\t「予定通り、ヘブンゲートへの突入を開始しました！」: Right on schedule, they've begun their assault@on Heaven's Gate!
LDBI\t（この状況でもＩＳＡ戦術が通用するか、@ 見せてもらおうか、レフィー: (Show me whether ISA tactics still work@in a situation like this, Lefina Enfield.)
LDBI\t「全艦に告ぐ！ この戦いの結果が、@ オペレーション・レコンキスタの: Attention, all ships! This battle's outcome@will decide the success or failure@of Operation Reconquista!
LDBI\t「だが、ここで無駄死にをするな！@ 敵の陽動に徹するのだ！」: But don't throw your lives away here!@Focus solely on drawing the enemy off!
LDBI\t「三方からの敵……@ 攻め方から判断して、その中に本命はいるまい」: Enemies from three directions...@Judging by their approach,@the main force isn't among them.
LDBI\t「高速移動物体、エリアＦ２に侵入。@ 識別……地球軍ヒリュウ改。エリ: High-speed object entering Area F2.@Identified: Earth Forces' Hiryu Custom.@Approaching Area A1.
LDBI\t「やはり、差し込んで来たか。@ 全機、迎撃用意！」: As expected, they're driving a wedge in.@All units, prepare to intercept!
LDBI\t「各機、発進！@ 主砲、１番から３番まで攻撃用意！」: All units, launch!@Main Cannons 1 through 3, prepare to fire!
LDBI\t「母星の危機を目の当たりにしながら、@ 我らに噛み付いてくるとはな。: Even with their home planet in peril,@they choose to sink their teeth into us.@Is it reckless courage, or...
LDBI\t「あの機体……指揮を執っているのは、ロフか」: That unit... So Rof's the one in command.
LDBI\t「確か、シュウがグランゾンの秘密を明かした時も@ いやがったな」: If I remember right, he was there when Shu@revealed the Granzon's secret, too.
LDBI\t「どういう奴なんだ？」: What kind of guy is he?
LDBI\t「生真面目と言うか、堅いと言うか……@ まあ、お前にとっちゃ扱い易い: Earnest, or maybe just stiff...@Let's just say he's easy for you to deal with.
LDBI\t「なるほど、殴り甲斐があるってわけだな」: Got it. So he's worth punching, huh?
LDBI\t（わかり易い相手、ってことじゃないんだろうか……）: (I think he meant someone easy to figure out...)
LDBI\t「ゴースト１より各機。@ 知っての通り、地球圏は予断を許さぬ状況下に: Ghost 1 to all units.@As you know, the Earth Sphere@is in a precarious situation.
LDBI\t「ヘブンゲートを奪還できなければ、@ オペレーション・レコンキスタに: If we can't retake Heaven's Gate,@Operation Reconquista will be badly hampered.@Give it everything you've got.
LDBI\t「行くぞ、ロフ。@ こっちは後で大仕事が控えてるんでな……@ さっさ: Here we go, Rof.@We've got a big job lined up later...@so we'll be wrapping this up fast!
LDBI\t（何という侵攻の速さだ。@ 特化戦力で一点を叩く……そんな無謀な戦術: (How swiftly they advance.@Hitting one point with a specialized force...@To think such a reckless tactic would succeed.)
LDBI\t（彼らの戦力が秀でているだけではない……@ 護るべきもの、背負ってい: (It isn't just that their forces are superior...@Is it the difference in what they protect,@and in what they carry on their shoulders?)
LDBI\t（俺は……俺は、何のために戦っている？@ いや、そんな迷いは禁物だ。: (What... What am I fighting for?@No, I can't afford such doubts.@I must simply carry out my orders...!)
LDBI\t「くっ、さすがにやる……！@ だが、ここを明け渡すわけにはいかんのだ: Ngh, they're good...!@But I cannot surrender this position!
LDBI\t「ヘッ、尻に火がつきやがったか！？」: Heh, feeling the heat now, are they!?
LDBI\t「もう一息だ、押し込んでやるぜ！」: Just a little more! Let's push through!
LDBI\t「そこまでだ！ 双方共、戦闘を止めろ！」: That's enough! Both sides, cease fire!
LDBI\t「ど、どうやって生き残ったんだよ、あの状況で！」: H-How the heck did you survive that mess!?
LDBI\t「悪運が強かったのさ」: Guess I had the devil's own luck.
LDBI\t「いや、そういう問題じゃねえだろ！@ <ホワイトスター>は<アインス: No, that's not the point!@The <ホワイトスター> got swallowed up@by the <アインスト>!
LDBI\t「ゲストより前に現れた<インスペクター>の指揮官……@ でも、<ホワ: The commander of the <インスペクター>,@who showed up before the Guests...@But he should've died at the <ホワイトスター>...!
LDBI\t「詳しい話は後だ。@ ともかく、俺はお前らとやり合う気はねえ」: Details can wait.@Anyway, I've got no intention of fighting you.
LDBI\t「その言葉を信用しろっての！？」: You expect us to believe that!?
LDBI\t「現にあんたはロフを助けたじゃないの！」: You just saved Rof, didn't you!?
LDBI\t「一応、奴は身内なんでな。@ だが、そっちと事を構えるつもりがねえの: He's one of my own, after all.@But it's true I don't want a fight with you.
LDBI\t「それをどのようにして証明する？」: How do you intend to prove that?
LDBI\t「武装を解除する。@ それでも信用できねえのなら、撃ちな。@ ただし: I'll disarm.@If you still can't trust me, go ahead and shoot.@But you won't lose anything by hearing me out.
LDBI\t「ギリアム少佐、彼の話を聞きましょう。@ ただし、警戒を怠らぬように: Major Gilliam, let's hear him out.@But stay on your guard.
LDBI\t「ロフ……俺は枢密院の特命を受け、ここに来た」: Rof... I'm here on special orders@from the Privy Council.
LDBI\t「枢密院……！？ 何のために！？」: The Privy Council...!? For what purpose!?
LDBI\t「ゼゼーナンの私闘を終わらせるためにだ」: To put an end to Zezenan's private war.
BMD\t「その隙は見逃さない！」: I won't let that opening slip by!
BMD\t「キョウスケ中尉、援護します！」: Lieutenant Kyosuke, I'll back you up!
BMD\t「さすがだ……！/ このタイミングなら、いける！」: Impressive...!/　With timing like this, I can do it!
BMD\t「あの人には余計な真似かも知れないけど……/ 逃がすわけには！」: Maybe I'm just getting in the way, but.../　You're not getting away!
BMD\t「エクセレン少尉！ 後は任せて下さい！」: Lieutenant Excellen! Leave the rest to me!
BMD\t「ゼンガー少佐、援護します！」: Major Sänger, I'll back you up!
BMD\t「ゼンガー少佐、連携攻撃で行きます！」: Major Sänger, let's do a Cooperative Attack!
BMD\t「タスク、詰めが甘いぞ！」: Tasuku, you're too sloppy on the finish!
BMD\t「悪いが、タスク……とどめは俺が刺す！」: Sorry, Tasuku... the finishing blow is mine!
BMD\t「リョウト、手を貸すぞ！」: Ryoto, I'll lend you a hand!
BMD\t「少佐、後は自分が！」: Major, I'll take it from here!
BMD\t「ユウ！ 後は任せてくれ！」: Yuuki! Leave the rest to me!
BMD\t「一本決めるまで油断するな！ カーラ！」: Don't let your guard down till it's over! Carla!
BMD\t「ラミアさんは次のターゲットを！」: Lamia, go for the next target!
BMD\t「ラミアさん、後は引き受けます！」: Lamia, I'll take care of the rest!
BMD\t「リュウセイ、後は任せろ！」: Ryusei, leave the rest to me!
BMD\t「レーツェルさん、後は任せて下さい！」: Rätsel, please leave the rest to me!
BMD\t「ヴィレッタ大尉、援護します！」: Captain Viletta, I'll back you up!
BMD\t「ヒューゴ少尉、援護します！」: Lieutenant Hugo, I'll back you up!
BMD\t「アクア少尉、後は自分が！」: Lieutenant Aqua, I'll take it from here!
BMD\t「後は任せろ、ジョッシュ！」: Leave the rest to me, Josh!
BMD\t「ジョッシュ、/ お前が嫌だと言っても援護する！」: Josh, I'm backing you up/　whether you like it or not!
BMD\t「リム、後は任せてくれ！」: Rim, leave the rest to me!
BMD\t「ミオ、後は任せろ！」: Mio, leave the rest to me!
BMD\t「ヤンロンさん、自分が援護を！」: Yang Long, let me back you up!
BMD\t「虎龍王！ お前のスピードなら！」: KoRyuOh! With your speed, we can do it!
BMD\t「エクセレン少尉！ 早く後ろへ！」: Lieutenant Excellen! Get behind me, quick!
BMD\t「リョウト！ 奴は俺に任せろ！」: Ryoto! Leave that one to me!
BMD\t「こき使ってくれるねえ、少佐も」: The Major sure likes working me hard.
BMD\t「キョウスケ、後は任せろ！」: Kyosuke, leave the rest to me!
BMD\t「こっちがエスコートされてちゃ、/ しょうがねえな」: Can't have me be the one/　getting escorted, now can we?
BMD\t「手を貸すぜ、メキボス！」: Lemme lend you a hand, Mekibos!
BMD\t「お礼はデートってことでよろしく！」: You can thank me with a date!
BMD\t「ラトゥーニ、後は任せな！」: Latune, leave the rest to me!
BMD\t「可愛い子には援護しろ、ってね！」: Cute girls deserve cover, as they say!
BMD\t「後でお茶に付き合ってくれよな」: Join me for tea later, okay?
BMD\t「キョウスケの代わり、ってわけじゃないが！」: I'm no stand-in for Kyosuke, but here goes!
BMD\t「ラミア、後は任せろ！」: Lamia, leave the rest to me!
BMD\t「アクア、後は先輩に任せてもらおうか」: Aqua, let your senior handle the rest.
BMD\t「テュッティ、後でお茶でもいかがかな？」: Tytti, how about some tea later?
BMD\t「そっちの好きにやらせるかっての！」: Like I'd let you have your way!
BMD\t「しゃあない、一肌脱ぐとするか！」: Oh well, guess I'll do my part!
BMD\t「そういうアプローチは許せないな！」: I can't allow that kind of approach!
BMD\t「強引なやり方は女に嫌われるぜ？」: Women hate the pushy type, you know?
BMD\t「ま、あいつにゃ余計なお世話かも知れないが」: Well, not that they needed my help...
BMD\t「ここはお兄さんに任せなさい！」: Leave this one to your big bro!
BMD\t「王女様を守るのは、男の務め！」: Protecting a princess is a man's duty!
BMD\t「これも先輩の務め、ってね！」: Just doing my duty as a senior!
BMD\t「無茶な武器だが、/ 威力は半端じゃないんでね！」: Crazy weapon, but/　it packs a serious punch!
BMD\t「まとめて片付けてやるぜ！」: I'll take care of you all at once!
BMD\t「抜けば珠散る氷の刃……」: Drawn, it scatters jewels... a blade of ice...
BMD\t「心に刻め、この俺の名を！」: Carve it into your heart--my name!
BMD\t「その恐怖、その憎悪と共に！！」: Along with that fear and that hatred!!
LDBI\t「お前達もルイーナと戦う気なのか？」: You're planning to fight the Ruina too?
LDBI\t「そうだ。@ 彼らの主は、的殺の彼方から到来する羅¶神……@ 日を蝕: That's right. Their master is Rahu, come from@beyond the fatal quarter... An ill-omened god@who devours the sun and brings destruction.
LDBI\t「いや、ルイーナだけでなく、@ 大羅天へ至る道を求めて、万魔百邪が@: And not only the Ruina. Countless demons and@evils will come to this world, seeking the@road to the Highest Heaven.
LDBI\t「君達が住まう地球は、君達が思っている以上に@ 危ういのだよ。だから: Your Earth is in far more danger than you@realize. That's why we wish to protect this@planet and guide humanity down a better path.
LDBI\t「出たな、てめえらみたいな連中が言う@ お決まりの文句が」: There it is. The same old line every@bastard like you spouts.
LDBI\t「お前達が人間を……@ いや、この地球を支配するってのか？」: You're gonna rule humanity...@No, the whole Earth?
LDBI\t「支配なんかじゃないさ。この世界は、@ 無為自然の状態に戻すのが一番: Not rule. This world is best returned to its@natural, untouched state... And upon that, we@hope to create an "Earthly Shangri-La."
LDBI\t「俗界とは、私達が住んでいるこの世界。@ 桃源郷とは、理想郷……ユー: The earthly realm is the world we live in.@Shangri-La is an ideal land... like a utopia.
LDBI\t「本来、桃源郷とは求めるものに非ず。@ それを探し出そうとする者の前: Properly, Shangri-La is not a thing one seeks.@It never appears to those who search for it.
LDBI\t「だが、この戦乱の世の中では、@ そうも言っていられない。神の庇護の: But in this age of war, we can't afford@that luxury. We need a hermit's haven, under@divine protection, safe from every calamity.
LDBI\t「つまり、シェルターのようなものに@ 人間を導くということか」: So you intend to lead humanity into@something like a shelter.
LDBI\t「どうせ、ただで行けるってわけじゃねえんだろ」: Bet it ain't free to get in, though.
LDBI\t「そう、俗界桃源郷に俗人を招いて、@ 争いや破壊を行われては元も子も: Right. If we invited the unworthy into@Earthly Shangri-La and they brought strife and@destruction, it would all be for nothing.
LDBI\t「話が見えてきたよ。@ あんた達に選ばれた者でなきゃ、@ 行けないっ: Now I see where this is going.@Only people you choose get to go there,@right?
LDBI\t「僕達が選ぶんじゃない。@ 君達が然るべき資質を持ち、その格を上げる: We don't choose. If you possess the right@qualities and can raise your standing, the path@to Earthly Shangri-La will open of itself.
LDBI\t「もしかして、尸解が必要だと言うの？」: Don't tell me... you mean shikai is required?
LDBI\t「簡単に言えば、肉体を捨て、仙人になることよ」: Simply put, shedding your body to become@a sennin, an immortal hermit.
LDBI\t「いっ！？@ 体がなくなっちまったら、幽霊と同じなんじゃ……」: Wha?! Without a body, wouldn't you be@the same as a ghost...?
LDBI\t「心配はいらない。@ 僕達が施す尸解は、本来のそれより遥かに@ 成功: No need to worry. The shikai we perform has@a far higher success rate than the@traditional kind.
LDBI\t「君達のように心身壮健であり、@ 強い魂力を持っていれば、まず大丈夫: Those sound in body and mind like yourselves,@with strong spiritual power, will almost@certainly be fine.
LDBI\t「……そうでない人達は、どうなるんです？」: ...And what happens to people who aren't?
LDBI\t「その三魂は然るべき所へ行くことになる」: Their three souls will go where they belong.
LDBI\t「望む望まないに関わらず、@ 尸解できなかった人は、全員死ぬっていう: So whether they want it or not, everyone who@fails shikai just dies?!
LDBI\t「そう……それが天命ということになるね」: Yes... We'd call that their fate.
LDBI\t「尸解に成功したところで、人ではなくなるのだろう？@ 姿形も元のまま: Even if shikai succeeds, you cease to be human.@Surely your form doesn't remain as it was?
LDBI\t「その点は心配ない。@ 尸解すれば、肉の体は失われるが、@ 仙体は魂: No need to worry about that. Shikai costs you@the flesh, but the immortal body you gain is@shaped by the nature of your soul.
LDBI\t「性別すら超越することが出来るが、@ 望めば尸解前と同じ姿のままでも: You can even transcend gender, or, if you wish,@keep the same form you had before shikai.@...As I have.
LDBI\t「望みのままに姿を変えられるということか」: So you can change your form however you like.
LDBI\t「ああ、失った部位があれば、@ それを元通りにすることも可能だよ」: Yes. If you've lost a body part, it can even@be restored to how it was.
LDBI\t「ただし、元から魂を持っていない者や、@ 魂魄に手が加えられた者は、: However, those born without souls, or whose@souls have been tampered with, can't undergo@shikai. I won't say who, but some of you know.
LDBI\t「いずれにせよ、@ 彼らが言う尸解と桃源郷は、危険な選民思想だな」: Either way, this shikai and Shangri-La of@theirs are a dangerous elitist ideology.
LDBI\t「いや、@ 僕達は全ての人間が尸解できればいいと思っている。@ それ: Not so. We'd prefer that every human could@undergo shikai. That's the aim of the@"Universal Shikai Project."
LDBI\t「成功すれば、君達を苛む俗界の問題が解決する。@ 尸解した者は、心穏: Success would end the worldly woes plaguing you.@Those who undergo shikai will live serene,@healthy lives, no longer eroding this planet.
LDBI\t「こいつぁ、質の悪い勧誘だな。@ 人間やめて、幸せになれってのかよ」: Man, talk about a shady sales pitch.@Quit being human and be happy, huh?
LDBI\t「勘違いしてもらっては困るな。@ 僕達は、ルイーナのように人間を滅ぼ: Don't misunderstand. We're not trying to destroy@humanity like the Ruina are.
LDBI\t「その格を上げ、これからの災厄を逃れるための術を@ 授けようと言うの: We mean to raise your standing and grant you@the means to escape the calamities to come.
LDBI\t「それで多くの人が死ぬのなら、@ お前達の尸解そのものが災厄じゃない: If it kills tons of people, then your@shikai is a calamity in itself!
LDBI\t「まあ、どれだけの人間が尸解に成功するか、@ やってみなければわから: Well, how many humans will succeed at shikai,@we won't know until we try.
LDBI\t「あらら、そこはアバウトなのね」: Oh my, you're pretty loose on that part, huh?
LDBI\t「そんないい加減な計画に、@ 多くの人達を巻き込むつもりだなんて……: You'd drag so many people into such a@half-baked plan...!
LDBI\t「本来は、資質を持った希望者のみを尸解させた方が@ いいんだが……ル: Ideally, only willing people with the right@qualities would undergo shikai... But we must@plan for the worst outcome of the Ruina war.
LDBI\t「バラルの神と“破滅の王”の戦いは、@ 熾烈を極めるだろうからね。@: The battle between the god of Baral and the@"King of Destruction" will be fierce beyond@measure. There's no guarantee humans survive it.
LDBI\t「そこで、僕らは準備が整い次第、人類の尸解を行う。@ 君達はその先駆: So once we're ready, we'll perform shikai on@all of humanity. We'd like you to go first@and set an example for everyone.
LDBI\t「三階だか五階だか知らねえが、@ そんなのはお断りでえ！」: Shikai, sixkai, whatever it is,@I ain't doin' it!
LDBI\t「随分と早い返答だな。@ さらなる力と不老長寿が不要なのかい？@ 君: That was a quick answer. You don't want@greater power and eternal youth? It would make@your goals easier to achieve, too.
LDBI\t「ルイーナと戦おうってんなら、@ 素直に協力すればいいじゃないのさ！: If you wanna fight the Ruina, why not@just team up with us?!
LDBI\t「……そこの君はどうかな？@ 君にとって、尸解は助けとなるんじゃない: ...And what about you there?@Wouldn't shikai be of help to you?
LDBI\t（そういうことを嗅ぎ取るのも、@ 仙人の能力だと言うのか）: (Is sensing that kind of thing@another of a sennin's powers?)
LDBI\t「君の悩みはすぐに解決するよ。@ もっとも、尸解に成功すればの話だが: Your troubles would be solved in no time.@Provided shikai succeeds, that is.
LDBI\t「生憎だが、人間をやめるつもりはない」: Sorry, but I've no intention of giving up@my humanity.
LDBI\t「そうか。@ では、尸解を希望する者がいたら、@ 名乗り出てくれたま: I see. Well then, if anyone wishes to undergo@shikai, step forward.
LDBI\t「ふむ、誰もおらぬか。それも善哉」: Hm, no one? That too is well and good.
BMD\t「ダメよ、そんなのじゃ物足りないの」: No, no. That's not nearly enough for me.
BMD\t「へたくそねぇ……/ そんなのじゃ、私を満足させられないわよ」: How clumsy.../　That'll never satisfy me.
BMD\t「それで全力なの？ ちっとも効いてないわよ」: Is that your best? I barely felt it.
BMD\t「うふ§/ ヤンロンにしては物足りないわ」: Mmm§/　I expected more from you, Yang Long.
BMD\t「あらあら、もっとよく狙って」: Oh my, aim a little better.
BMD\t「フフフ、出直してらっしゃい」: Hehehe, come back when you're ready.
BMD\t「うふふ、そんなのじゃ、/ 私を捕まえられないわ」: Hehe, with moves like that,/　you'll never catch me.
BMD\t「もう、慌てないの§/ 私はここよ§」: Now, now, don't rush§/　I'm right here§
BMD\t「当てるつもりなら、/ もっと真面目にやりなさいな」: If you mean to hit me,/　try a little harder, won't you?
BMD\t「ダメねぇ、そんなんじゃ」: Tsk, that's no good at all.
BMD\t「そんなんじゃ、当たってあげない§」: Like that, I won't let you hit me§
BMD\t「甘いわね。遅過ぎるのよ」: Too naive. And far too slow.
BMD\t「あらあら、ヤンロン、どうしたの？/ 当ててくれないとダメじゃない」: Oh my, Yang Long, what's wrong?/　You're supposed to hit me.
BMD\t「あらら、使える武器がないわ。困ったわねぇ」: Oh dear, no weapons I can use./　What a bother.
BMD\t「あらあら、そんな遠くから……/ もっとこっちへいらっしゃいな」: Oh my, from so far away.../　Come closer, won't you?
BMD\t「ふふふ……いじめ甲斐があるわねぇ」: Hehehe... You're such fun to torment.
BMD\t「もっともっと、/ 可愛い声を聞かせてちょうだい！」: More, more!/　Let me hear those cute little cries!
BMD\t「まだ足りないようね。これならどう？」: Still not enough? Then how about this?
BMD\t「あなたにはもう少し、/ お仕置きが必要みたいね」: Looks like you need/　a bit more punishment.
BMD\t「詰めが甘いわよ、マサキ」: You didn't finish the job, Masaki.
BMD\t「しょうがないわね、手伝ったげるわ、/ ヤンロン」: Oh, fine. I'll lend you a hand,/　Yang Long.
BMD\t「別に、手伝う必要ないんじゃないの？」: Does this really need my help?
BMD\t「ほらほら、頼りないね、あんたも」: Come on, you're pretty useless, huh?
BMD\t「シュウ様、後のことはお任せ下さい！」: Master Shu, leave the rest to me!
BMD\t「はいはい、/ 後始末は私がやってあげるわよ、モニカ」: Yes, yes,/　I'll clean up after you, Monica.
BMD\t「物足りないの！ 私に受けさせて！」: Not enough! Let me take that hit!
BMD\t「なかなか良さそうじゃない。私がもらうわ」: That one looks nice. I'll take it.
BMD\t「私が人をかばうなんてね……/ ま、気持ち良さそうだからいっか」: Me, shielding someone.../　Oh well, it looks like it'll feel good.
BMD\t「感謝しなさいよ、私が受けてあげるんだから」: Be grateful. I'm taking this for you.
BMD\t「情けは人の為ならずっていうけど……/ ホントよね§」: They say kindness comes back around.../　And it's true§
BMD\t「まったく、/ 何で私がマサキをカバーしなきゃなんないワケ？」: Honestly,/　why do I have to cover for Masaki?
BMD\t「また、あんたを助ける事になったね、/ プレシア」: Looks like I'm saving you again,/　Precia.
BMD\t「リューネの盾だなんて……/ こっちが盾にしたいくらいよ」: Being Lüne's shield.../　I'd rather use her as one!
BMD\t「あー、もう！ 危ないでしょ、ザッシュ！」: Ugh, honestly! That was dangerous, Zash!
BMD\t「シュウ様！/ ここは私が責めを……/ じゃない、攻撃を受けます」: Master Shu!/　Let me take the punishment.../　I mean, the attack!
BMD\t「……ホントはあんたのことなんて/ どうでもいいんだけどね」: ...Not that I actually/　care about you at all.
BMD\t「ほーら、これはサービスよ§」: Here, this one's on the house§
BMD\t「そう、私の手にかかって逝きたいのね？」: So you want to die by my hand?
BMD\t「いいわ、その望み……叶えてあげる！」: Very well... I'll grant that wish!
BMD\t「何か撃つのが/ もったいないような気がするけど……！」: It almost feels like a waste/　to fire these, but...!
BMD\t「天空からの一撃！ 受けなさい！！」: A strike from the heavens! Take this!!
BMD\t「見える……敵の動きが……！」: I can see it... the enemy's movements...!
BMD\t「いけるわ、これなら……！」: With this, I can do it...!
BMD\t「ドゥバン・オーグ……ここで止めてみせる！」: Duban Ogg... I'll stop you here!
BMD\t「あの男……/ 前にもどこかで会ったような……？」: That man.../　Have I met him somewhere before...?
BMD\t「カークス将軍、力での解決を図っても……！」: General Kirkus, resorting to force won't...!
BMD\t「こうなることがわかっていたのですか、/ あなたは……！」: You knew this would happen,/　didn't you...!
BMD\t「相手がメリオルエッセでも！」: Even if you are a Meliores Esse!
BMD\t「あなた達が/ 恐怖や絶望をもたらすというのなら！」: If you mean to bring/　fear and despair...!
BMD\t「ペルフェクティオ……/ 抗ってみせるわ、あなたに！」: Perfectio.../　I'll defy you to the end!
BMD\t「あなた達が何度地球に来ようと！」: No matter how many times you come to Earth!
BMD\t「ゲストの好きにはやらせないわ！」: I won't let the Guests have their way!
BMD\t「地球をあなた達に渡すつもりはない！」: I won't hand Earth over to you!
BMD\t「彼らの言葉に惑わされてはいけない……！」: I can't let their words mislead me...!
BMD\t「気をしっかり持たないと、/ 付け込まれる……！」: If I don't stay strong,/　they'll take advantage...!
BMD\t「この圧迫感に飲み込まれるわけには……！」: I can't let this pressure swallow me...!
BMD\t「ガイアセイバーズ、/ あなた達の好きにはやらせない！」: Gaia Saviors,/　I won't let you have your way!
BMD\t「トウマ、あなたを必ず救い出す！」: Touma, I'll save you, I swear it!
BMD\t「ダブルＧと言えど！」: Even if you're the Double G!
BMD\t「魔装機相手でもやってみせるわ！」: Even against a Masouki, I can do this!
BMD\t「魔装機が相手ならば……！」: If I'm up against a Masouki...!
BMD\t「ゴーレムなんかに負けるものですか！」: As if I'd lose to some Golem!
BMD\t「念動力者でもないのに、/ ここまで強烈な念を発するなんて……！」: Not even a telekinetic, and yet/　such powerful psychic energy...!
BMD\t「相手が四神の超機人であっても……！」: Even if it's a Choukijin of the Four Gods...!
BMD\t「四凶の超機人……油断できない相手ね」: A Choukijin of the Four Fiends... Careful.
BMD\t「ガンエデン……/ あの念に打ち勝たなければ、私達に未来はない！」: Gan Eden.../　Unless we overcome that mind,/　we have no future!
BMD\t「ユーゼス・ゴッツォ……/ あなたとの因縁、ここで断ち切る！」: Euzeth Gozzo.../　I'll sever our ties here and now!
BMD\t「ユーゼス！/ イングラム少佐に代わって、あなたを討つ！」: Euzeth!/　I'll strike you down for Major Ingram!
BMD\t「さっきの借りを返すわ！」: Time to pay you back for earlier!
BMD\t「どこを見てるの！？ 行くわよ！！」: Where are you looking!? Here I come!!
BMD\t「弱気になんて……なってられない！」: I can't afford... to lose heart now!
BMD\t「あの程度でひるむわけには……！」: I can't flinch at something like that...!
BMD\t「あううっ！/ ここまで押されるなんて……！」: Aaugh!/　They're pushing me back this far...!
BMD\t「ふふふ……先手は取らせてもらうわよ」: Heh heh... I'll be taking the first move.
BMD\t「捕まえた。もう、逃がさないから」: Got you. And I'm not letting you go.
BMD\t「うふふ、こうなったらもう、こっちのものよ」: Ufufu, now that it's come to this, I've won.
BMD\t「さあ、いい子だから大人しくしてなさい」: Now, be a good child and sit still.
BMD\t「さて、私の番かしらね」: Well, I suppose it's my turn.
BMD\t「お返しさせてもらうわ」: Allow me to return the favor.
BMD\t「ただで帰すと思ってるの！？」: You think I'll let you leave unharmed?!
BMD\t「こっちが反撃する番よ！」: Now it's our turn to strike back!
BMD\t「ふふ、倍返しさせてもらうわ！」: Heh, I'll pay you back double!
BMD\t「あうぅっ！/ こ、このパワー……押されてる！？」: Aaugh!/　Th-This power... It's pushing me back?!
BMD\t「くぅっ！ まずいわ、このままじゃ」: Ngh! This is bad. At this rate...
BMD\t「もう、何するのよ！」: Hey, what do you think you're doing?!
BMD\t「ぐえっ！！/ な、何てこと……追い詰められてる？」: Gweh!!/　Wh-What is this... I'm being cornered?
BMD\t「ぐふぅっ！！/ こ、こんなパワーがあるなんて……」: Guhh!!/　I-I can't believe it has this much power...
BMD\t「ど、どういうこと！？/ こんなの、聞いてないわよ！？」: Wh-What's going on?!/　Nobody told me about this!
BMD\t「あうっ！ ふ……やるじゃないの」: Augh! Heh... Not bad at all.
BMD\t「つっ……さすがね。/ けど、これ以上はやらせないから！」: Ngh... Impressive./　But I won't let you go any further!
BMD\t「あら……/ 今のはそれなりに美しく決まってたわね」: Oh my.../　That was executed rather beautifully.
BMD\t「くっ……やるわね。/ なら、こちらも本気を出さないと」: Ngh... You're good./　Then I'd better get serious, too.
BMD\t「ちっ、避けたつもりだったのに……」: Tch, I thought I'd dodged that...
BMD\t「くっ……このっ！/ いつまでもいい気になってんじゃないよ！」: Ngh... Why you!/　Don't get so full of yourself!
BMD\t「こ、このっ！ やってくれるじゃないの！」: Wh-Why you! You'll pay for that!
BMD\t「何、それ？ 本気でやってそれなの？」: What was that? Is that your best?
BMD\t「ふん、その程度じゃビクともしないわよ」: Hmph, that won't even make me flinch.
BMD\t「こっちの装甲をなめてるみたいね」: Looks like you underestimate my armor.
BMD\t「あら、案外大したことないじゃない」: Oh my, that was less than I expected.
BMD\t「駄目ね。そんな攻撃、美学が感じられない」: No good. That attack has no sense of beauty.
BMD\t「ふーん、意外ね。その程度だったの」: Hmm, how surprising. Is that all you had?
BMD\t「駄目ね……全然駄目。出直してらっしゃい」: No good... No good at all. Come back later.
BMD\t「ふん、そんな攻撃、当たるものですか」: Hmph, as if an attack like that would hit.
BMD\t「何するの！ 当たったら危ないでしょ！」: What are you doing?! That could've hit me!
BMD\t「どう？ この回避機動。美しいでしょ？」: Well? Aren't my evasive maneuvers beautiful?
BMD\t「ああ、無駄無駄。/ そんな攻撃、とっくに解析済みだから」: Oh, it's useless./　I analyzed that attack long ago.
BMD\t「何てこと！/ こんな時に使える武器がないなんて！」: Oh no!/　I've got no weapons I can use right now!
BMD\t「参ったわ。ここからじゃ届かないのよね」: What a bother. I can't reach from here.
BMD\t「あら、まだ足りないの？ それじゃ遠慮なく」: Oh, still not enough? Then I won't hold back.
BMD\t「残念、まだ終わりじゃないの！」: Too bad, it's not over yet!
BMD\t「待ちなさい！ まだ終わってないわ！」: Hold it! It's not over yet!
BMD\t「じゃ、遠慮なく行くわよ！」: Well then, I won't hold back!
BMD\t「さあて、この攻撃ならどうかしらね」: Well now, how about this attack?
BMD\t「見切れやしないわよ、/ このイリュージョンソーサーは！」: You'll never see through/　my Illusion Saucer!
BMD\t「幻惑の舞、たっぷり楽しみなさい！」: Enjoy my dance of illusions to the fullest!
LDBI\t「わかっています……。@ でも、ツェントル・プロジェクトの@ 真実を: I know...@But to learn the truth about the@Tsentr Project, I need you, Doctor.
