LDBI\t「それもめぼしい物はありません。@ また、念のためにＴＰＬテストを行: Nothing notable there either.@I also ran a TPL test, just to be safe,@and the result was negative.
LDBI\t「ごく普通の人間だと言うことか？」: Are you saying he's a completely Normal person?
LDBI\t「その言い方は適切ではないですね。@ 戦闘訓練やパイロット訓練を受け: I wouldn't put it that way.@There were signs he'd received combat training@and Pilot training.
LDBI\t「じゃあ、彼がパイロットだということは@ ほぼ確定なんですね」: Then it's all but certain@that he's a Pilot.
BMD\t「先手さえ取れば、勝率が上がる」: Strike first, and the odds favor you.
BMD\t「少しでも敵の数を減らす、/ それが兵法の常道だ！」: Reduce the enemy's numbers bit by bit./　That is the textbook way of war!
BMD\t「相手が何者であろうと、/ ここで退くわけにはいかん」: Whoever my opponent may be,/　I cannot fall back here.
BMD\t「地上人……相手にとって不足はないわ！」: A surface dweller... A worthy opponent!
BMD\t「ぬおっ！ 私の読みが浅かったか！」: Nuoh! Did I misread the situation?!
BMD\t「わ、私に驕りはなかった……！/ なのに、ここまでの損害を受けるとは！: I-I was not overconfident...!/　And yet I've taken this much damage!
BMD\t「むっ！ 想定したよりもダメージが大きいな」: Hm! More damage than I anticipated.
BMD\t「ぬう、意外とやるではないか」: Nngh, you're better than I expected.
BMD\t「さすがだ、一筋縄ではいかんな」: Impressive. You won't go down easily.
BMD\t「ええい、この程度の攻撃を避けきれんとは！」: Blast! I couldn't dodge an attack this weak?!
BMD\t「いかん、まともに受け過ぎたか！」: No good, I took that one head-on!
BMD\t「くっ！ 地上人の力を侮ったか！」: Tch! I underestimated the surface dweller!
BMD\t「その程度の力で、私に挑むか」: You challenge me with power like that?
BMD\t「ほう、当たったか。だが、それだけだな」: Oh, a hit. But that's all it was.
BMD\t「ふっ……遠慮はいらんぞ、地上人」: Heh... Don't hold back, surface dweller.
BMD\t「そんなものか、魔装機神の力は」: Is that the power of a Masoukishin?
BMD\t「ふむ、こちらの推測が的中したな」: Hm, my prediction was right on the mark.
BMD\t「この好機、逃しはせん！」: I won't let this chance slip by!
BMD\t「好きにはやらせんぞ！」: I won't let you have your way!
LDBI\t「確か、Ｔ‐ＬＩＮＫシステムを@ 応用した物だとか……」: If I remember right, it's an application@of the T-LINK System...
LDBI\t「アルテウルがそこまで先を見て、@ 何か仕組んでたとは思えねえけどな: I just don't see Arteur looking that far ahead@and setting something up, though...
LDBI\t「では、アルテウルがクロスゲートの存在を@ 知っていたとしたら、どう: Then what if Arteur knew about@the Cross Gate's existence?
LDBI\t（私の他にも気になっていた者がいましたか……）: (So I wasn't the only one who had noticed...)
LDBI\t「我が弟の話は、あり得ぬことではないな。@ 我々の方もクロスゲートに: My brother's theory isn't impossible.@Several of our own people have felt@a sense of déjà vu about the Cross Gate.
LDBI\t「じゃあ、アルテウルがシュンパティアの改良策を@ 提供したのは……」: Then the reason Arteur provided the@improvements to the Sympathia was...
LDBI\t「シュンパティアが何らかの形で@ クロスゲートに関わる物と予測し、@: Because he predicted the Sympathia was tied@to the Cross Gate in some way,@and wanted to uncover the truth.
LDBI\t「だったら、いの一番にここへ来ねえか？」: Then wouldn't he have come here first thing?
LDBI\t「事前にある程度の確証があったのなら、@ リ・テクに任せず、自分でフ: If he had some degree of proof in advance,@wouldn't he have investigated Fabula Fores@himself instead of leaving it to Re-Tech...?
LDBI\t「他にもクロスゲートが存在し得る場所があって、@ ギリギリまでそれら: There may have been other potential sites@for a Cross Gate, and he was sizing them up@until the very last minute.
LDBI\t「アルテウルはリ・テクが結果を出すまで、@ 高みの見物で……」: So Arteur just watched from on high@until Re-Tech got results...
LDBI\t「南極の遺跡が怪しいから、@ とりあえず唾を付けとこうって……@ そ: The ruins in Antarctica looked suspicious,@so he figured he'd stake his claim for now...@That's why he gave them the improvements?
LDBI\t「だが、アルテウルが……ガイアセイバーズが@ オペレーション・アイス: But what I don't get is why Arteur...@why the Gaia Savers put fighting us first@instead of Operation Icebreaker.
LDBI\t「いずれにせよ、アルテウルは死んだ。@ 今、ここで追及しても詮なきこ: Regardless, Arteur is dead.@Pursuing it here and now is pointless.
LDBI\t（そうだ……行くしかない。そして……）: (That's right... I have to go. And then...)
LDBI\t「直上より接近する物体多数！@ 友軍ではないようです！」: Multiple objects incoming from straight above!@They don't appear to be friendly!
LDBI\t「いえ、違うようです！@ 熱源反応が大きい物をアルファ、ブラボーと認: No, it doesn't look like it!@Designating the ones with the largest heat@signatures as Alpha and Bravo...
LDBI\t「あっ！ アルファ、ブラボーが急加速を！！」: Ah! Alpha and Bravo are rapidly accelerating!!
LDBI\t「フフフ……また会えたわね」: Heh heh heh... We meet again.
LDBI\t「そうよ。あなた達との戦いを経て、私の子と@ ガルベルスはさらに成長: That's right. Through our battles with you,@my child and the Garberus have grown even more.
LDBI\t「ＴＥアブゾーバーの試作１０号機……ＭＯＤＥＬ‐Ｘ。@ ガルムレイド: TE Absorber Prototype Unit 10... MODEL-X.@A machine with the traits of both@the Garmraid and the Cerberus.
LDBI\t「試作機ではないと言ったでしょう？@ このガルベルスはＴＥアブゾーバ: I told you, didn't I? It's no prototype.@This Garberus is the perfected TE Absorber...@the ultimate maintenance-free humanoid weapon.
LDBI\t「ケッ、無限と混沌の次は究極か。@ どいつもこいつも吹かしやがって」: Tch, first infinity and chaos, now ultimate?@Every last one of 'em is full of hot air.
LDBI\t「エルデ、この期に及んで何を……！」: Erde, what are you doing at this point...!
LDBI\t「それも言ったはず。@ 私は、ＡＩ１が成長進化を経て到達する先を@: I told you that too.@I want to see with my own eyes what AI1@becomes at the end of its growth and evolution.
LDBI\t「そのためには、ターミナス・エナジーだけでなく、@ 強力な力が必要な: And for that, I need more than Terminus Energy.@I need tremendous power.
LDBI\t「まさか、貴様！ クロスゲートを！？」: Don't tell me... You're after the Cross Gate!?
LDBI\t「そう……そして、ドゥバン・オーグの目的もそれ。@ だから、彼と手を: Yes... And that's Duban Oog's goal, too.@So I teamed up with him... and followed you.
LDBI\t「ここが最終収束点だ、アリエイル」: This is the final convergence point, Arieil.
LDBI\t「おれは、クロスゲートのエネルギーを手に入れる」: I will obtain the Cross Gate's energy.
LDBI\t「それこそが、この事態の最終収束点であり……@ プロジェクト・イデア: That alone is where this all converges...@the culmination of Project Idealants.
LDBI\t「おれは、アインストの力と@ クロスゲートのエネルギーを得て、@ 新: With the power of the Einst@and the energy of the Cross Gate,@I will build a new order.
LDBI\t「まだわからないのですか！？@ 私達にそんな力はありません！」: Do you still not understand!?@We don't have that kind of power!
LDBI\t「お前こそ、何故理解しない？@ 人類は人類を超えた者によって統治され: And why do you refuse to understand?@Unless humanity is ruled by those beyond human,@it will walk the path to its own destruction.
LDBI\t「お前がしていることは、お前自身の存在意義の否定だ」: What you're doing is a denial@of your very reason for existing.
LDBI\t「いえ、今の私には別の意義があります！」: No, I have a different purpose now!
LDBI\t「人間と共に生きるとでも？@ 奴らはおれ達によって支配される存在なの: To live alongside humans?@They exist to be ruled by us!
LDBI\t「何度でも言います！@ 私達は、人類を支配することなど出来ないのです: I'll say it as many times as it takes!@We cannot rule over humanity!
LDBI\t「黙れ、アリエイル！@ ならば、お前は座して死を待つと言うのか！」: Silence, Arieil!@Then you'd just sit there and wait to die!?
LDBI\t「長く生きることが、あなたの目的なのですか！？@ 命を操り、支配する: Is living a long life your goal!?@Is controlling and dominating life@your reason for living!?
LDBI\t「知れたこと！@ そのために造られたイデアラント……おれとお前だ！」: Obviously!@We Idealants were made for that... you and I!
LDBI\t「私は人間の中で生きることを知りました！@ 命は、生まれた理由に縛ら: I've learned how to live among humans!@A life mustn't be bound by why it was born!
LDBI\t「命は、生きることに燃やされるべきなのです！」: A life should burn itself out in living!
LDBI\t「共に空を抱かぬのであれば、@ その不完全な機体と共に滅びるがいい！: If you will not embrace the sky with me,@then perish along with that incomplete machine!@Consider it a parting gift to my only kin!
LDBI\t「不完全なフリッケライが、何故ここまで戦えたのか……@ わからないの: Why do you think the incomplete Flickerei@has been able to fight this far...@Don't you understand, Duban!?
LDBI\t「聞く耳は持たん！@ アレス！ おれの最後の賭けに付き合ってもらう！: I'm not listening!@Ares! You'll join me in my final gamble!
LDBI\t「クロスゲートのエネルギーを吸収している……！？」: It's absorbing the Cross Gate's energy...!?
LDBI\t「素晴らしい、素晴らしいぞ、このパワー！@ これならば！」: Magnificent... Magnificent, this power!@With this, I can--!
BMD\t「心を……平穏に……」: Let the heart... be at peace...
BMD\t「あなた達は、/ 自分の過去をそう捉えるのね……」: So that's how you all/　see your own past...
BMD\t「彼らの身体に宿る魂は……」: The souls dwelling in their bodies...
BMD\t「あれは、その存在の一端に過ぎない……？」: That's only a fragment of its being...?
BMD\t「あなた達がいう尸解は、死と同義……！」: Your "shikai" is the same as death...!
BMD\t「あなた達の好きにはさせない……」: I won't let you do as you please...
BMD\t「黒焔の狩人……あれは……」: The Hunter of the Black Flame... That's...
BMD\t「あれは地球の守護神などではないわ……！」: That's no guardian god of the Earth...!
BMD\t「あなたの一存で/ 世界を新生させるなどと……！」: To remake the world/　on your whim alone...!
BMD\t「……心を一点に集中させて……」: ...Focus the mind on a single point...
BMD\t「くうっ……！/ アサナを保ち続けるのは……もう限界なの……？」: Kuh...!/　Can I not hold my asana any longer...?
BMD\t「こ……こんな所で落ちるわけには……！」: I... I can't go down here...!
BMD\t「ま、まだみんなにヨガを教え切れていないもの……！/ ここで落ちるわけ: I-I still haven't taught everyone yoga!/　I can't go down here...
BMD\t「ああっ……！/ 精神を……集中させなければ……！」: Aah...!/　I have to... focus my mind...!
BMD\t「メリオルエッセには、/ 冷静に対処しなければ……！」: I must stay cool/　against the Meliolesse...!
BMD\t「あの邪念に飲み込まれるわけには……！」: I can't let that malice swallow me...!
BMD\t「あなたに地球を/ 封印させるわけにはいかない……！」: I won't let you/　seal away the Earth...!
BMD\t「心を平静に保たなければ……」: I must keep my heart calm...
BMD\t「私の心を乱すほどじゃないわ……」: Not enough to disturb my heart...
BMD\t「こんなことで呼吸を乱すわけには……」: I can't let this disturb my breathing...
BMD\t「フレームは損傷していない。まだいける……」: The frame's undamaged. I can go on...
BMD\t「いけない……！/ アサナを取り直さなきゃ……」: Oh no...!/　I have to regain my asana...
BMD\t「く……！ 向こうの敵意に乱された……！」: Ngh...! Their hostility threw me off...!
BMD\t「闇雲に攻撃をしているわけではないようだな」: So you're not just attacking blindly, then.
BMD\t「ふん、どこへ行こうと無駄だ」: Hmph. Run wherever you like. It's useless.
BMD\t「アルテウル様、後は私が！」: Lord Arteur, leave the rest to me!
BMD\t「虚空の彼方へ消え去れ！」: Vanish into the depths of the void!
BMD\t「若僧…/ 叫んでいれば勝てるというものではないぞ」: Boy.../　Yelling won't win you this fight.
BMD\t「どうした、ゼンガー！ それで終わりか！」: What's wrong, Sänger? Is that all?!
BMD\t「どうした！ 教導隊とは名ばかりか！」: Come on! Are the Instructors all talk?!
BMD\t「ぐっ！ 女子供に後れを取るとは！」: Gah! Outdone by women and children?!
BMD\t「ゼンガー！/ 貴様にも斬れぬものがあると知れい！」: Sänger!/　Even you can't cut through everything!
BMD\t「ほう……/ その威力、さすがだと言っておこう！」: Hoh.../　That power is impressive, I'll admit!
BMD\t「フハハハ！/ 小物相手では味わえぬ高ぶりよ！」: Fwahaha!/　Small fry can't give me this thrill!
BMD\t「凡百の機体とは、一味違うな！」: This unit's a cut above the rest!
BMD\t「ふん、どうにも食い足りん」: Hmph. Hardly enough to satisfy me.
BMD\t「ほう……この“無明”に当てたか」: Hoh... You landed a hit on my Mumyou.
BMD\t「いい踏み込みだ。だが、力が足りん」: A fine step in. But you lack strength.
BMD\t「ふふ…老体に鞭打ったというわけか」: Heh... Pushing your old bones, are you?
BMD\t「老いぼれの力など、そんなものよ」: That's all an old man's strength is worth.
BMD\t「旧教導隊など、解散して当然よ」: The old Instructors deserved to disband.
BMD\t「チッ…女子供と侮ったか！」: Tch... I underrated women and children!
BMD\t「女……/ 逃げずに向かって来た度胸は認めてやろう」: Woman.../　You've got nerve, not running from me.
BMD\t「噂の特機も大したことはないな」: That rumored super robot isn't much.
BMD\t「奴の呼吸に乗せられてしまったか……！」: I got caught up in their rhythm...!
BMD\t「寄せては返す波の如く……というわけか」: Like waves that come and go... is that it?
BMD\t「ロレンツォ中佐、後は任せよ！」: Lieutenant Colonel Lorenzo,/　leave the rest to me!
BMD\t「獅子王の剣がお前の血を欲しておるわ！」: The Shishioh Blade craves your blood!
LDBI\t「ゼゼーナン司令、第一波はほぼ全滅です。@ 地球人は、我が方の奇襲を: Commander Zezenan, the first wave@is nearly wiped out. The Earthlings seem to have@expected our ambush.
LDBI\t「……直前の偵察で、そのような素振りを@ 見せていなかったのではない: ...Scan data from just before the attack@showed no such sign, did it?
LDBI\t「ええ……臨戦態勢ではありましたが、@ 多方面で同時に、しかも敏速に: Yes... They were combat-ready, but to respond@so swiftly on so many fronts at once...
LDBI\t「や～れやれ、一筋縄でい～かないのは@ 鋼龍戦隊だけじゃな～いのね」: Weeell, well. Seems the Steel Dragons aren't the@only ones who are a reeeal hassle, huh?
LDBI\t「猿共全ての練度が、そこまで高いとは思えん。@ いくら連中が闘争心に: I refuse to believe all those apes are that@skilled--no matter how much Resolve those brutes@possess.
LDBI\t「事前に情報が漏れていたのだ。それ以外に考えられん。@ ……まさか、: The information was leaked in advance.@There's no other explanation.@...It wouldn't be you two, would it?
LDBI\t「そ～んなことをして、何の得にもな～らないよ。@ や～っぱ、ヒュッケ: Whyyy would we do that? There's nothing in it@for us. Seems to me, going after the Hückebein@was the reeeal mistake, no?
LDBI\t「あ～れでバレちゃったんだ～よ」: That's what tiiipped them off, see?
LDBI\t「忘れたの？ グランゾンとヒュッケバインの確保は、@ 今回の作戦にお: Have you forgotten? Securing the Granzon and the@Hückebein is a top priority in this operation.
LDBI\t「シャフラワースの言う通りだ。@ 所在不明のグランゾンはともかく、ヒ: Shaflawars is right. The Granzon's whereabouts@are unknown, but the Hückebein had to be seized@at once.
LDBI\t（でも……何故、司令はヒュッケバインと@ グランゾンに拘るのかしら…: (But... why is the Commander so fixated@on the Hückebein and the Granzon...?)
LDBI\t「あと、考えら～れる情報漏れの原因は……@ ウェンドロが使ってい～た: Otherwise, the leak could've come frooom...@the courier Wendolo was using, maaaybe?
LDBI\t「だとしても、ウォルガの者でしょう。@ どうやって、私達の奇襲タイミ: Even if so, that would be someone from Wolga.@How would they know the timing of our ambush?
LDBI\t「だ～よね。じゃあ、ウォルガのスパイが@ ど～こかに紛れ込んでい～る: Riiight. Then maybe a Wolga spy's slipped in@somewhere. Or somebody's been tampering with@the combat bioroids.
LDBI\t「調べてみたけど、その線はないわ」: I looked into that. It's not the case.
LDBI\t「じゃ、ウォルガの誰かが地球に来～ていて、@ 俺達を見～張っていたん: Then someone from Wolga must've come to Earth@and been waaatching us.
LDBI\t「ウェンドロ達が使っていた転移航路は@ 私達が制圧し、封鎖しているの: We've seized and sealed off the transfer route@Wendolo and the others were using, remember?
LDBI\t「当事者達が生きているなら、抜け道を作れるかも@ 知れないけど……そ: If the people involved were alive, they might@open a back door... But no one else can use it@without Commander Zezenan's authorization code.
LDBI\t「情報漏洩の件は、引き続き調査せよ。@ グランゾンの所在についてもな: Continue investigating the leak.@And the Granzon's whereabouts as well.
LDBI\t「以後の作戦内容を変更……月を制圧する。@ 猿共が待ち受けていること: Change of plans from here on... We take the Moon.@Submit an assault plan that takes into account@the apes lying in wait.
LDBI\t「援軍は既に手配済みだ。@ 次こそ、地球の猿共に我らゾヴォークの力を: Reinforcements have already been arranged.@This time, make those Earth apes feel the might@of the Zovorg!
BMD\t「ペルフェクティオ！/ 無に還るのは、てめえの方だ！」: Perfectio!/　You're the one going back to nothing!
BMD\t「恐怖、絶望……/ それを振り払って、てめえを倒す！」: Fear, despair.../　I'll shake 'em off and take you down!
BMD\t「ふざけた喋り方をしやがって！」: Cut out that stupid way of talkin'!
BMD\t「てめえの口調は、イライラすんだよ！」: The way you talk gets on my nerves!
BMD\t「セティ！/ てめえじゃ俺を捉えることは出来ねえ！」: Sety!/　There's no way you can catch me!
BMD\t「ゼゼーナン！/ 過ぎた野心は身を滅ぼすんだよ！」: Zezenan!/　Too much ambition'll be your downfall!
BMD\t「ある意味、シュウの被害者か。/ だが、同情する気なんざ更々ねえ！」: In a way, you're one of Shu's victims./　But I don't feel sorry for you one bit!
BMD\t「いつまでも余裕を見せてられると思うなよ！」: Don't think you can stay cocky forever!
BMD\t「桃源郷なんぞに興味はねえんだよ！」: I don't give a damn about Shangri-La!
BMD\t「孫光龍！ てめえ、何様のつもりだ！」: Koryu Son!/　Who the hell do you think you are?!
BMD\t「光龍！ てめえの態度がまず気に入らねえ！」: Koryu!/　First off, I hate your attitude!
BMD\t「光龍にヤンロン、紛らわしいんだよ！」: Koryu, Yang Long... way too confusing!
BMD\t「あいつの尻尾を切るのは、/ ちょいと面倒だな……！」: Cutting off that tail's/　gonna be a bit of a pain...!
BMD\t「てめえら、/ 地上で色々とやってくれたそうじゃねえか！」: You guys!/　Heard you've been busy up on the surface!
BMD\t「邪魔をするんじゃねえぜ、/ ガイアセイバーズ！」: Stay outta my way,/　Gaia Savers!
BMD\t「フェイル……わからねえ……/ 俺にはわからねえ！ 何でこんなことを！: Feil... I don't get it.../　I just don't get it!/　Why would you do this?!
BMD\t「俺は……あんたとだけは/ 戦いたくなかったぜ、フェイル……！/ けど: You're... the one guy I never/　wanted to fight, Feil...!/　But I've got no choice, huh!
BMD\t「どこだ……/ いったい、どこで道を間違っちまったんだ、/ フェイル！: Where...?/　Where the hell did you go wrong,/　Feil?!
BMD\t「もう……引き返せねえんだな、フェイル……/ だったらせめて、この俺が: No turning back now, huh, Feil.../　Then at least I'll be the one to end it!!
BMD\t「あんな化け物が神だってのかよ！？/ どうかしてやがるぜ！」: That monster's supposed to be a god?!/　That's insane!
BMD\t「神だか何だか知らねえが、/ あんな奴を野放しに出来るか！/ ぶっ倒す: God or whatever, I don't care!/　I can't let that thing run loose!/　I'm takin' it down!
BMD\t「こいつぁマジで、神っていうより/ 幽霊や亡霊の類だな……/ だったら: Man, this thing's less like a god/　and more like a ghost or a phantom.../　Then I'll lay it to rest!
BMD\t「ヘッ、どんな忍法を使うってんだよ！」: Heh, what kinda ninja tricks you got?!
BMD\t「てめえがどう進化しようと！」: I don't care how much you evolve!
BMD\t「速そうな機体だな。/ だが、サイバスターにゃ敵わねえぜ！」: Looks like a fast machine./　But it's no match for Cybuster!
BMD\t「ヒュッケバインもどきなんざ、/ 叩き落としてやる！」: I'll knock this fake Hückebein/　right outta the sky!
BMD\t「その斧で俺を斬れると思うなよ！」: Don't think that axe'll cut me down!
BMD\t「何が究極の機動兵器だ！/ ぶっ壊してやるぜ！」: Ultimate mobile weapon, my ass!/　I'll smash it to pieces!
BMD\t「ＡＩ１！/ てめえがこれ以上進化することはねえ！」: AI1!/　You're not evolving any further!
BMD\t「四神の超機人か。/ 相手にとって不足はねえぜ！」: A Choukijin of the Four Gods, huh?/　You'll make a worthy opponent!
BMD\t「その翼、叩き斬ってやるぜ！」: I'll cut those wings right off!
BMD\t「四凶だか何だか知らねえが！/ 好きにはやらせねえ！」: Four Fiends or whatever, I don't care!/　I won't let you do as you please!
BMD\t「超機人にも色んな奴がいるんだな……！」: Takes all kinds of Choukijin, huh...!
BMD\t「その尻尾も羽根もぶった切ってやる！」: I'll slice off that tail and those wings!
BMD\t「てめえが神だと？/ ふざけんな、ただの機械じゃねえか！」: You, a god?/　Gimme a break, you're just a machine!
BMD\t「ガンエデン……/ 地球の封印なんざやらせるか！」: Gan Eden.../　I won't let you seal off the Earth!
BMD\t「ユーゼス！/ てめえの過去も未来も、ここで抹消してやる！」: Euzeth!/　I'll wipe out your past and future here!
BMD\t「大それた野望は身を滅ぼす……/ ユーゼス、てめえにもそれを教えてやる: Grand ambitions lead to ruin.../　Euzeth, I'll teach you that lesson too!
BMD\t「雑魚の妖機人に用はねえ！」: No time for Yokijin small fry!
BMD\t「ルイーナなんざ、とっちめてやる！」: I'll give the Ruina what for!
BMD\t「ルイーナ！ これ以上はやらせねえ！」: Ruina! This is as far as you go!
BMD\t「ルイーナの雑魚に用はねえ！」: No time for Ruina small fry!
BMD\t「いい加減、地球征服なんざ諦めな！」: Give up on conquering Earth already!
BMD\t「てめえらが何度地球へ来ようと、/ 結果は同じだぜ！」: However many times you come to Earth,/　it'll end the same way!
LDBI\t神聖ラングラン王国 ノーヴァス州 ダンク市: Holy Kingdom of Langran@Novus Province, Dunk City
LDBI\t「この赤い部分がシュテドニアスの勢力下にある地域だ。@ 王都を含め、: The red areas are under Schtedonias's control.@It looks like they've seized a good many@provinces, the capital included, but...
LDBI\t「その実体は線による支配だ。@ 点と点を結んでいるに過ぎない」: In truth, their hold is a matter of lines.@They've merely linked one point to the next.
LDBI\t「カークス軍がその線を切断すれば、@ 状況は一変するはずだ」: If the Kirkus Army cuts those lines,@the situation should change entirely.
LDBI\t「青い部分が侵略されていないラングランの地域で、@ 黄色がカークス軍: So the blue areas are the parts of Langran@that haven't been invaded, and the yellow is@under the Kirkus Army's control...
LDBI\t「じゃあ、今、あたしらは@ 敵勢力の真っ只中にいるんだな」: So right now, we're smack in the middle@of enemy territory, huh?
LDBI\t「カークス軍以外のラングラン軍部隊も各地で抵抗を@ 続けているはずだ: Langran units outside the Kirkus Army should@still be resisting, but with the capital taken,@info is scattered. We don't know the details.
LDBI\t「だが、まもなくカークス軍がトロイア州に向けて@ 進撃を開始する。僕: But the Kirkus Army will soon begin its advance@on Troia Province. Gennacy and I plan to stage@a diversion against the enemy forces in Quait.
LDBI\t「今、クエイト市はシュテドニアス軍の@ 補給線の要になっている。ここ: Right now, Quait City is the linchpin of the@Schtedonias Army's supply lines. Strike there,@and the enemy will be thrown off balance.
LDBI\t「補給線の要ということは……@ それなりの戦力が存在しているんでしょ: If it's the linchpin of their supply lines...@they must have a sizable force there.
LDBI\t「リューネ、君達はどうする？@ 無理に参加してもらう必要はないが……: Lüne, what will you all do?@You don't have to join us if you'd rather not...
LDBI\t「ここで待ってるのも何だし、あたしも行くよ」: No point waiting around here. I'm coming too.
LDBI\t「……どうやら、ラングランの解放が@ 散り散りになってる連中を捜し出: ...Looks like liberating Langran is the fastest@way to find the guys who got scattered@and get back to the surface.
LDBI\t「キョウスケ、あたしはヤンロン達を手伝ってやろうと@ 思ってるが、お: Kyosuke, I'm thinking of giving Yang Long and@the others a hand. What about you?
LDBI\t「では、クエイト市へ向かおう」: Then let's head for Quait City.
LDBI\t神聖ラングラン王国 リストン州 クエイト市: Holy Kingdom of Langran@Riston Province, Quait City
LDBI\t「どんな偵察方法かと思いきや、覗き見なんて……@ 前時代的だねぇ」: Here I wondered what kind of scouting we'd do,@and it's just peeking... Real old-school, huh.
LDBI\t「ま、ここんとこのパターンだね。@ けど、ランシャオは役に立つんだよ: Well, that's how it's been lately.@But Ranshao's really useful, you know.@Always darting around, gathering intel.
LDBI\t「あれで変身が出来りゃ、まるで……」: If it could transform too, it'd be just like...
LDBI\t「ゴリアテ、ナグロッドなどの魔装機の他に@ ソディウム級が１隻おりま: Besides Goliaths, Nagrods and other Masouki,@there is one Sodium-class ship as well.
LDBI\t「<ラ・ギアス>の各国で用いられている地上移動要塞で、@ 魔装機を複: It's a mobile land fortress used by the nations@of <ラ・ギアス>. It can carry multiple Masouki.
LDBI\t「機動兵器の母艦ってわけか」: So it's a mothership for mobile weapons.
LDBI\t「ジガンにゃ、おあつらえ向きの相手だろうが」: Sounds like the perfect opponent for the Jigan.
LDBI\t「では、僕達の戦力で対応できそうだな。@ 仕掛けるぞ」: Then our forces should be able to handle it.@Let's move.
LDBI\t「敵襲やて！？@ ここら辺にラングラン軍のまとまった戦力は@ おらん: We're under attack!?@There ain't s'posed to be any real Langran@forces around here!
LDBI\t「それが……相手は地上の機動兵器と魔装機神でして」: Well... it's mobile weapons from the surface@and a Masoukishin.
LDBI\t「<魔装機神>？@ もしかして、ラディウス中尉から報告があった@ グ: <魔装機神>?@Ya mean that Granveil Lieutenant Radius@reported on?
LDBI\t「あっちゃ～、厄介な奴が来おったで。@ こんなことなら、アレの移送を: Aw, jeez, a real troublemaker's shown up.@Shoulda rushed that thing's transport, then.
LDBI\t「しかも、地上のメカの数が増えとるし……@ あいつらも積極的に地上人: And there's more surface mechs than before...@They're snappin' up surfacers too, huh.
LDBI\t「……魔装機神グランヴェールの操者、@ ホワン・ヤンロンだ。ラングラ: ...I am Huang Yang Long, operator of the@Masoukishin Granveil. Cease your invasion of@Langran and withdraw at once.
LDBI\t「あ、いや……うむ、そんなことはない。@ ワシらの方が正義に決まっと: Ah, I mean... ahem, no such thing.@Justice is on our side, plain and simple.
LDBI\t「正義だと？ 王都のテロ事件に乗じ、侵略戦争を@ 仕掛けて来ておきな: Justice? You exploited the terrorist attack on@the capital to launch a war of invasion.@How dare you say that?
LDBI\t「ラングランが魔装機神などを作り出さなければ、@ 我々とて攻め込んだ: If Langran hadn't built the Masoukishin,@we'd never have attacked!
LDBI\t「あのような兵器は、存在するだけで脅威なのです！@ 我々は自分の国を: Weapons like that are a threat just by existing!@We only did what we must to protect our nation!
LDBI\t「魔装機神は、他国を侵略するための兵器ではない。@ 予言された<ラ・: The Masoukishin aren't weapons of conquest.@They are a power to counter the prophesied@calamity of <ラ・ギアス>.
LDBI\t「もうええわ、グラスノフ大尉。@ どっちに正義があるとか、そんなこと: Enough, Captain Glasnov.@Arguin' over who's got justice on their side@won't get us nowhere. War's war, after all.
LDBI\t「ワシらは自分の国を、家族を守るために戦っとる。@ それで充分やない: We're fightin' to protect our country, our kin.@That's reason enough, ain't it?
LDBI\t「ヘッ……あのおっさん、@ なかなか潔いじゃねえか」: Heh... That old geezer's pretty upfront,@ain't he?
LDBI\t「……ならば、これ以上の問答は無用。@ 戦って、決着を付けるまで！」: ...Then there's nothing more to discuss.@We'll settle this in battle!
LDBI\t「……グラスノフ大尉、他の部隊に連絡しとけ。@ こっちの救援は必要な: ...Captain Glasnov, get word to the other units.@Tell 'em we don't need any help here.
LDBI\t「何故です！？@ クエイトを彼らに明け渡すわけにはいきませんよ！」: Why!?@We can't hand Quait over to them!
LDBI\t「あいつらは陽動部隊やろ。敵の本命は、他の基地や。@ もっとも……も: That bunch is a diversion. Their real target's@another base. Prob'ly too late already, though.
LDBI\t「……ラディウス中尉が言っとった通りやな。@ あいつら、強いわ。しゃ: ...Just like Lieutenant Radius said.@Them folks are strong. Nothin' for it, then.@We got no choice but to retreat.
LDBI\t「魔装機神をなめたらあかん。@ ワシらから出向いて、アレを確実に受け: Don't go underestimatin' a Masoukishin.@Better for us to head out and make sure we get@that thing. It'll pay off down the road.
BMD\t「ガルガードの力、とくと見よ！」: Behold the power of the Galguard!
BMD\t「例え、今は大逆者となろうとも……！」: Even if I'm branded a traitor for now...!
BMD\t「今は、/ 力によって道を示さねばならん時なのだ！」: Now is a time when the path/　must be shown by force!
BMD\t「私は全ラ・ギアスを統一し、/ 平和な世界を作り上げる！」: I will unite all of La Gias/　and build a world of peace!
BMD\t「全ての責任は私にある……/ 私がケリをつけねばならんのだ！」: All the responsibility is mine.../　I must be the one to settle this!
BMD\t「私は、私の信念を持って戦っている！/ 今さら変えることなど出来ん！」: I fight by my own Belief!/　I can't change that now!
BMD\t「ジャオームなど、所詮は旧型。/ 新鋭機の力には耐えられまい！」: The Jaohm is just an old model./　It can't stand up to a new machine!
BMD\t「魔装機神か……/ そもそも地上人に頼ろうという考え自体が/ 間違って: The Masoukishin.../　Relying on surface dwellers at all/　was a mistake from the start!
BMD\t「サイバスター……/ 魔装機神の力がこれほどまでに世界を変えるとはな。: Cybuster... Never did I think one/　Masoukishin could change the world so./　Then I, too, can surely do the same!
BMD\t「テュッティ、/ 君は私情に流されていないとは思いたいが……」: Tytti, I'd like to believe you aren't/　acting on personal feelings...
BMD\t「今のような非常時には、/ 力を以て統治する者が必要なのだ。/ 何故、: In a crisis like this one,/　we need someone who rules with strength./　Why can't you see that?!
BMD\t「セニア王女、ご無礼をば致します。/ ちゃんと脱出して下されよ」: Princess Xenia, forgive my rudeness./　Be sure to eject safely.
BMD\t「セニア王女、ノルスで立ち向かおうなど、/ 無謀というもの」: Princess Xenia, facing me in a Norse/　is simply reckless.
BMD\t「剣皇ゼオルートの娘か……/ いくら素質があろうと、/ 年端もいかぬ小: So, Sword Emperor Zeoroot's daughter.../　Whatever your talent, I can't lose/　to a mere slip of a girl!
BMD\t「子供が戦場に出るものではない！/ 戦いは大人に任せておけばいい！」: A child has no place on the battlefield!/　Leave the fighting to the adults!
BMD\t「地上世界の王女と言えど……/ 戦場に出た以上、覚悟は出来ていよう！」: Princess of the surface or not.../　On the battlefield, you must be ready!
BMD\t「貴公も敵に回るか、ゲンナジー。/ 何故、誰も私の成果を評価せぬ！？」: You too turn against me, Gennacy?/　Why does no one value my achievements?!
BMD\t「どうしても私と戦うというのか、ザッシュ……。/ もう一度言うぞ。容赦: You insist on fighting me, Zash.../　I'll say it again: I won't go easy!
BMD\t「その頑固な所は母親に似たか……/ いや、私かも知れんな。/ だとした: That stubborn streak is your mother's.../　No, perhaps it's mine./　If so, what a twist of fate...!
BMD\t「残念だよ、ヤンロン。/ 君は私の戦いを理解してくれていた。/ だが、: A pity, Yang Long./　You understood what I was fighting for./　But as an enemy... you will fall!
BMD\t「私は最高指揮官だ。/ つまり、全ての責任をとる立場だということだ。/: I am the Supreme Commander./　That means I bear all responsibility./　So I won't give up until the end!
BMD\t「袂を分かったとはいえ、かつての同士だ。/ この手にかけるのは忍びんが: We've parted ways, but we were comrades./　I'm loath to strike you down, but it/　can't be helped!
BMD\t「ここまで……/ ここまでやってきた私の戦果を、/ そう簡単に投げ出す: All this... All that I've achieved/　to get this far.../　I can't simply throw it away!
BMD\t「ザムジードの新しい操者か。/ やはり、魔装機神は/ 私の味方をしては: Zamzeed's new pilot, eh?/　So the Masoukishin truly/　won't side with me...!
BMD\t「もし、ザムジードの操者がリカルドであれば……/ いや、言っても詮無い: If only Ricardo were Zamzeed's pilot.../　No, there's no use saying it.
BMD\t「子供とは言え、魔装機神操者。/ ゆめ見逃すことまかり成らん！」: Child or not, you're a Masoukishin pilot./　I cannot let you slip away!
BMD\t「地上人よ……/ 私の行く手を阻むのならば、容赦はせん！」: Surface dweller.../　If you stand in my way, I'll show no mercy!
BMD\t「地上人よ、/ お前達の理を受け入れるわけにはいかん！」: Surface dweller,/　I can't accept your kind's logic!
BMD\t「地上人と言えど、私の大義を否定するのであれば……/ 討つ！」: Surface dweller or not, if you deny/　my cause... you will fall!
BMD\t「今度はこちらから行くぞ！」: Now it's my turn to attack!
BMD\t「まだだ！ まだ私は倒れん！」: Not yet! I won't fall yet!
BMD\t「うぬうっ！/ エウリードにここまでのダメージを！」: Nnngh!/　This much damage to the Eulid!
BMD\t「くうっ！/ 超魔装機に匹敵する力を持っているのか！？」: Ngh!/　It has power to rival a Super Masouki?!
BMD\t「ぐううっ……/ あくまでも我が前に立ち塞がるか！」: Gnnngh.../　You still stand in my way?!
BMD\t「マサキ……サイバスター！！/ やってくれる！」: Masaki... Cybuster!!/　You've done it now!
BMD\t「ガッデス……/ やはり、魔装機神は強いな……！！」: Gaddess.../　The Masoukishin truly are strong...!!
BMD\t「ま、まさか、/ セニア王女がここまで出来るとはな………！」: I-I never thought/　Princess Xenia could do this much...!
BMD\t「さすがは剣皇の娘……後生畏るべし……！」: As expected of the Sword Emperor's/　daughter... Youth is to be feared...!
BMD\t「さ、さすがだ、ヤンロン……！！」: A-As expected of you, Yang Long...!!
BMD\t「ヴァルシオーネを敵に回すのは/ 厄介だったか……！！」: Making an enemy of the Valsione/　was trouble after all...!!
BMD\t「ぐうっ！/ ザムジードに選ばれただけのことはあるか……！」: Gngh!/　Worthy of being chosen by Zamzeed...!
BMD\t「さて、仕事をさせてもらうぜ」: Well then, time to do my job.
BMD\t「自ら望んで死に急ぐこともねえだろうに……」: No need to rush to your own death...
BMD\t「“破滅の王”か。厄介な奴だぜ」: The "King of Ruin," huh? What a pain.
BMD\t「仕方ねえ……行くぜ、ロフ！」: Can't be helped... Here I come, Rof!
BMD\t「セティ、これが俺の任務なんでな」: Sety, this is my mission, you see.
BMD\t「あくまでも枢密院の決定に/ 逆らうつもりなら……！」: If you insist on defying/　the Privy Council's decision...!
BMD\t「あんなのまで出てくるとはな」: Didn't expect even that to show up.
BMD\t「まったく……/ 地球って星の奥深さにゃ、呆れるぜ」: Honestly.../　There's just no end to this Earth place.
BMD\t「あれもヒュッケバインの最新型か」: Is that the latest Hückebein model too?
BMD\t「ああいうのを造り出すから、/ 地球人は侮れねえ」: Building stuff like that's/　why Earthlings can't be taken lightly.
BMD\t「ガンエデン……/ あれはいずれ、俺達にとっても/ 脅威になる……！」: Gan Eden.../　Sooner or later, that thing'll be/　a threat to us too...!
BMD\t「ユーゼス・ゴッツォ……/ あの連中の意志とは関係ねえようだが……！」: Euzeth Gozzo.../　He's not doing their bidding, but...!
BMD\t「俺達の星にも災いをもたらすなら、/ 見逃すわけにはいかねえ！」: If you'll bring ruin to our world too,/　I can't let you slide!
BMD\t「お前達を地球圏から/ 出すわけにはいかねえ！」: I can't let you guys/　leave the Earth Sphere!
BMD\t「これも任務だからな」: It's all part of the mission.
BMD\t「お前らを止めるのが、俺の仕事でな」: Stopping you guys is my job.
BMD\t「お前らは枢密院の意志に反している」: You're defying the Privy Council's will.
BMD\t「俺を狙うなんざ、いい度胸してるぜ！」: Coming after me? You've got guts!
BMD\t「落とせねえなら引っ込んでな！」: If you can't shoot me down, back off!
BMD\t「さぁて、お手本を見せてやるか！」: Well now, let me show you how it's done!
BMD\t「うう……っ！/ こんなことで、やられるとは……！」: Ugh...!/　To think I'd go down like this...!
BMD\t「やれやれ、ここまでか」: Oh well, guess this is it.
BMD\t「うおっ、いかん！/ ダメージを受けすぎたか！」: Whoa, not good!/　Did I take too much damage!?
BMD\t「うおぉっ！？/ ま、まだだ！ まだやられちゃいねえぞ！！」: Whoa!?/　N-not yet! I'm not done yet!!
BMD\t「ぬうっ！/ こ、こいつ、何てパワーしてやがる！？」: Nngh!/　Wh-what power does this guy have!?
BMD\t「チッ、/ 予想外の展開になってきやがったぜ……！」: Tch,/　things aren't going how I planned...!
BMD\t「よっぽど死にてえみてえだな、お前は……！」: You must really want to die, huh...!
BMD\t「うぐっ！/ グレイターキンが押されるのか！？」: Ugh!/　The Greytarkin's being pushed back!?
BMD\t「……そろそろ潮時だな。離脱準備は、と……」: ...Time to call it. Prep for withdrawal...
BMD\t「ま、あいつはやるときゃやるからな」: Well, he comes through when it counts.
BMD\t「セティ、押しが足りんぜ！」: Sety, you're not pushing hard enough!
BMD\t「ゼゼーナン、いい加減に観念しな！」: Zezenan, just give it up already!
BMD\t「くっ！ 少しはできるようだな！」: Kh! Seems you've got some skill!
BMD\t「やる……！ だが、まだツメが甘いな！」: Not bad...! But you're still sloppy!
BMD\t「なんのっ！ この程度で落ちるかよ！」: No way! Like this would take me down!
BMD\t「おいおい、まともにくらっちまったのかよ！」: Hey, hey, you took that one head-on!?
BMD\t「リム、後は私が引き受ける！」: Rim, leave the rest to me!
BMD\t「そう簡単にはやらせん！」: I won't let that happen so easily!
BMD\t「終わらせるわけにはいかないのでな！」: I can't let it end here!
BMD\t「ヴィレッタ、あの敵は俺に任せろ！」: Viletta, leave that enemy to me!
BMD\t「やはり、そう固まったか。ならば！」: Just as I thought, you bunched up./　In that case!
BMD\t「この機を逃しはしないのさ！」: I won't let this chance slip by!
BMD\t「悪いが、そちらのエネルギーをいただくぞ！」: Sorry, but I'll be taking your energy!
BMD\t「読み通りの所へ来たな……！」: You came right where I expected...!
BMD\t「ターゲットは全て捕捉した……！ 行くぞ！」: All targets acquired...! Here I go!
BMD\t「この武器は飾りではないのさ」: This weapon isn't just for show.
BMD\t「味方機は下がれ！ ＭＡＰＷを発射する！」: Allies, fall back! Firing MAP weapon!
BMD\t「超闘士がお前を凶方へ導く」: The Super Fighter guides you/　toward ill fortune.
BMD\t「大凶方の彼方へ去れ！」: Begone, beyond the darkest of omens!
BMD\t「どのみちお前の運は尽きていた」: Your luck had run out either way.
LDBI\t「結局、親父達は資金繰りに困り、@ 遺跡のオーバー・テクノロジーの軍: In the end, my father's team ran short of funds@and had to turn to people who wanted to use the@ruins' over-technology for military purposes.
LDBI\t「オーバー・テクノロジー……@ もしかして、南極の遺跡には<ＥＯＴ>: Over-technology... Could the ruins in the@Antarctic hold <ＥＯＴ>?
LDBI\t「<エアロゲイター>や<インスペクター>との関連性は@ ないと言われ: Supposedly there's no link to the <エアロゲイター>@or <インスペクター>. Nobody knows yet who built@those ruins, or why.
LDBI\t「エール・シュヴァリアー……@ あれのレース・アルカーナというシステ: The Aile Chevalier... Even the name of its@system, Res Arcana, means mystery or secret.
LDBI\t「とりあえず、ジェネレーター代わりに使えるのは@ わかったから、組み: We at least knew it worked as a generator, so@Cliff said we should install it and see what@happens...
LDBI\t「父の助手であるリ・テクなんですが、@ 彼がそう言ってました」: He's a Re-Tech who assists my father.@That's what he told me.
LDBI\t「……つまり、お前は実験台にされたというわけか」: ...So you were used as a guinea pig.
LDBI\t「ヒューゴ、そういう言い方って……！」: Hugo, that's no way to put it...!
LDBI\t「俺だって、人が乗らなきゃ動かないシステムの@ 実験台にされてたって: Believe me, finding out I was a test subject@for a system that won't run without a pilot@didn't exactly make me happy.
LDBI\t「ですが、それでもエール・シュヴァリアーに@ 乗らなきゃならない理由: But even so, I had my reasons for having to@pilot the Aile Chevalier.
LDBI\t「父親に頼まれたからか？」: Because your father asked you to?
LDBI\t「……あの辺境でも色々あったんです。@ <南極事件>だけでなく、<ア: ...A lot happened even out on the frontier.@Not only the <南極事件>,@but the <アインスト> attacks too.
LDBI\t「連邦軍があの怪物達に対応しきれないのなら、@ 機動兵器でも何でも使: If the Federation Army can't deal with those@monsters, we have to defend ourselves--with@mobile weapons, or whatever it takes.
LDBI\t（生き残るための手段……というわけか）: (A means of survival... is that it?)
LDBI\t（……それに、エール・シュヴァリアーにも積まれてる@ シュンパティア: (...Besides, unless I figure out what the@Sympathia in the Aile Chevalier really is,@Rim will...)
LDBI\t「ともかく、異例なことではあるが、ケネス司令からの@ 命令だ……お前: Anyway, this is unusual, but it's an order@from Commander Kenneth... You'll be helping@gather data on the Aile Chevalier too.
LDBI\t「それと、テスラ研を襲撃した妖機人や@ 新型機狙いの集団、メディウス: There's also the Yokijin that attacked the@Tesla Institute, the group after prototypes,@and the Medius Locus incident. Stay alert.
LDBI\t「あら、ジョッシュさんはスルーなんスね。@ 大概の人はツッコミを入れ: Huh, Josh, you're letting it slide? Most@people call her out on it.
LDBI\t「なお、リ・テクと南極の遺跡は機密事項だ。@ 部外者に口外せぬように: Note that the Re-Techs and the Antarctic ruins@are classified. Don't tell outsiders.
LDBI\t「では、本日は水鳥島の演習場へ向かい、@ 模擬戦を行う。各員はそれぞ: Today we head to the Mizutori Island range@for a mock battle. Everyone, supervise the@loading of your unit onto the transports.
LDBI\t「ああ、あれの調整に時間がかかるのはわかっている。@ お前達のセッテ: Yes, I know that thing takes time to tune.@We'll leave once you've finished your setup.
LDBI\t「……では、すみませんが、よろしくお願いします。@ スポンサーから<: ...Well then, sorry to impose, and thank you.@Our sponsor keeps pressing us for combat data@against <ＰＴ> and <特機>.
LDBI\t「……それで俺達が相手に選ばれたというわけか。@ 気安いな」: ...So that's why we were picked as your@opponents. You've got some nerve.
LDBI\t「ヒューゴ、私達だって立場は同じでしょ。@ ガルムレイドのデータを取: Hugo, we're in the same position. We're here@to collect data on the Garmraid too...
LDBI\t「ヒューゴ・メディオ少尉……でしたね。@ 本職の方からしたら、面白く: Second Lieutenant Hugo Medio, was it? I can@see why a professional wouldn't like this.
LDBI\t「畑違いは俺も似たようなもんさ」: I'm not exactly in my own field either.
LDBI\t「そちらも訳ありということですか」: So you've got your own reasons too.
LDBI\t「ああ、こっちも新型のデータを取らなきゃならない。@ 民間人だからと: Yeah. I need data on a new model too. Don't@expect me to go easy on a civilian.
LDBI\t（ヒューゴ、イラついてる……？@ メディウス・ロクスのことが引っ掛か: (Hugo seems irritated...?@Is the Medius Locus still bothering him?@Or is it...)
LDBI\t「あれがＴＥアブゾーバーの試作７号機、@ ガルムレイド……」: So that's TE Absorber prototype No. 7,@the Garmraid...
LDBI\t「搬入状態じゃ、形がよくわからなかったけど……@ 随分といかついスー: I couldn't really tell its shape in transport,@but... that's one rugged super robot.@Lieutenant Ryusei would love it.
LDBI\t「ううん、大丈夫……。@ リュウセイやマイ、キョウスケ中尉、@ 鋼龍: No, it's okay... I believe Ryusei, Mai,@Lieutenant Kyosuke, and everyone in the@Steel Dragons are safe.
LDBI\t「だから、ガルムレイドと@ エール・シュヴァリアーの写真撮っとく……: So I'll take pictures of the Garmraid@and the Aile Chevalier...
LDBI\t「リュウセイ少尉が戻って来たら、見せるの？」: To show Lieutenant Ryusei when he gets back?
LDBI\t「レース・アルカーナ、@ シュンパティア、ＦＣＳ、チェック。@ ……: Res Arcana, Sympathia, FCS, check.@...All right, looking good.
LDBI\t「アクア、出力が安定していないぞ。@ イエローゾーンの真ん中をフラフ: Aqua, your output's unstable. If you keep@wobbling around the middle of the yellow zone,@we're done before we start.
LDBI\t「サーベラスよりパワーがあるし、振り幅も大きいから、@ 上手く調整で: It's got more power than the Cerberus and a@wider swing, so it's hard to adjust...!
LDBI\t「ミタールにそんなわかり易い言い訳を@ するつもりはない。やってみせ: I won't hand Mitar an excuse that obvious.@Make it work.
LDBI\t「ジョッシュさんの機体……@ 特機相手じゃ、分が悪いかもなあ」: Josh's unit... might be at a disadvantage@against a super robot.
LDBI\t「目的は、様々な状況下でのデータ収集だ。@ 勝ち負けを競うわけではな: The objective is data collection under varied@conditions. This is not about winning or losing.
LDBI\t「では、二人共、ラウンド１だ。状況開始！」: All right, you two, Round 1. Begin!
LDBI\t（相手は特機……！@ だが、分の悪い賭けをするつもりはない……@ こ: (It's a super robot...! But I'm not taking@any long-shot gambles... I'll finish this@for sure!)
LDBI\t「エール・シュヴァリアー……@ やれるはずだ、俺とお前なら！」: Aile Chevalier... We can do this, you and I!
LDBI\t（手と足にしびれが…！@ 馬鹿な、まだそんな時間じゃないはずだ）: (My hands and feet are going numb...!@Impossible, it's not time yet!)
LDBI\t（やはり、@ 薬の効く時間が短くなってきている……！？）: (So the medicine really is wearing off@faster...?!)
LDBI\t（冗談じゃないぞ、@ 戦闘中に手足が動かなくなったら……！）: (This is no joke... If my limbs stop@working in the middle of combat...!)
BMD\t「よし、ダメージは軽微だ！」: All right, the damage is light!
BMD\t「この程度じゃ、/ ガルガードはビクともしないっ！」: A hit like that/　won't even make Galguard flinch!
BMD\t「くっ……かすっただけでもこれか……」: Ngh... All this from just a graze...
BMD\t「当たってたまるもんかっ！！」: No way I'm letting that hit me!!
BMD\t「元がブローウェルなら、限界がある！」: If it started as a Blowell,/　it has its limits!
BMD\t「くっ！ / 当たってないのになんてプレッシャーだ……」: Ngh!/　It didn't even hit, but the pressure...
BMD\t「グランヴェールの攻撃……/ 食らったら終わりだ！」: Granveil's attack.../　If it hits me, it's over!
BMD\t「は、反撃は……/ あ、使える武器がないのか……」: C-Counterattack.../　Oh, I don't have a usable weapon...
BMD\t「くっ、駄目だ！ ここからじゃ届かない！」: Damn, no good! I can't reach from here!
BMD\t「ヤンロンさん！ 僕にも手伝わせて下さい」: Yang Long! Let me help too!
BMD\t「リューネさん、後は任せて下さい！」: Lüne, leave the rest to me!
BMD\t「マサキさん、ここは僕に任せて下さい！」: Masaki, leave this one to me!
BMD\t「ヤンロンさん！ 僕が盾になります！」: Yang Long! I'll be your shield!
BMD\t「修行の成果をお見せします！/ 疾風迅雷！ 轟け、稲妻！」: Behold the fruits of my Training!/　Swift as wind, fierce as thunder!/　Roar, lightning!
BMD\t「パワーなら、こっちも負けないぜ！」: If it's power you want, I've got plenty!
BMD\t「お前にもバニシング・トルーパーの/ 称号を与えてやるぜ」: You can have the Vanishing Trooper/　title too!
BMD\t「気が強い女は好みだけどな……！」: I do like a strong-willed woman, but...!
BMD\t「ラ・ギアスのマシンがいかほどのものか、/ 見せてもらおうか」: Let's see what a La Gias machine/　can really do.
BMD\t「人型との戦闘なら、/ こっちだってキャリアがあるんだぜ」: When it comes to fighting humanoids,/　I've got some experience too!
BMD\t「異世界とは言え、/ あの手の相手とは戦い慣れてるんでな！」: Other world or not,/　I'm used to fighting that kind of thing!
BMD\t「この手の世界に/ ああいう怪物は付きものだよな」: Worlds like this always come with/　monsters like that, huh?
BMD\t「ファンタジー戦記物のノリになってきたねぇ」: This is turning into a fantasy war epic.
BMD\t「ま、アインストよりはわかり易い連中だが」: Well, at least they're easier to read/　than the Einst.
BMD\t「いくら女でも、/ こういうアプローチは御免だな」: Woman or not,/　I'll pass on this kind of approach.
BMD\t「やれやれ、根がまともならいい女だろうに」: Sheesh. If she were decent at heart,/　she'd be quite a catch.
BMD\t「やれやれ、/ やることはインスペクターと同じかよ」: Sheesh, they're doing the same/　thing as the Inspectors?
BMD\t「お前らみたいな客を/ 招いた覚えはないんだよ！」: I don't remember inviting/　visitors like you!
BMD\t「インスペクターにゲスト……/ モテモテだね、地球は」: The Inspectors, the Guests.../　Earth sure is popular.
BMD\t「人を下等生物呼ばわりするくせに、/ 学習能力はないんだな」: You call us lower life-forms,/　but you never learn, do you?
BMD\t「やれやれ、アインストの次は妖怪かよ」: Sheesh. First the Einst, now demons?
BMD\t「ああいうの、誰の趣味なんだよ。まったく」: Whose idea of fun is that thing, anyway?
BMD\t「あの手の怪物に縁があるな、俺達は」: We sure attract monsters like that, huh?
BMD\t「四神の超機人か。油断は禁物だな」: A Choukijin of the Four Gods./　Better not let my guard down.
BMD\t「暴れ牛ならぬ暴れ虎を、何とかしなきゃな！」: Not a raging bull, but a raging tiger.../　Gotta do something about it!
BMD\t「フン、面構えはさすが四凶ってことか！」: Hmph, that mug says Four Fiends,/　all right!
BMD\t「こりゃまた極めつけの化け物だな」: Now that's a monster to end all monsters.
BMD\t「あの面で人界を護るって言われても、/ 説得力ないよな」: Protecting the human realm with a face/　like that? Not very convincing.
BMD\t「さて、いよいよ本格的な怪獣映画に/ なってきたな」: Well, now this is turning into a real/　monster movie.
BMD\t「ああいう女神様は勘弁だね」: I'll pass on goddesses like that.
BMD\t「女性に束縛されるのも悪くはないが……/ あんたは問題外だ！」: Being tied down by a lady isn't bad.../　but you're out of the question!
BMD\t「あんたの前世も来世も、/ 知ったこっちゃないのさ！」: Your past lives, your next life.../　I couldn't care less!
BMD\t「天地創造はあんたの頭の中でやってろ！」: Keep your creation of the world/　inside your own head!
BMD\t「あきらめが悪いのが、玉にキズなんでね！」: Not knowing when to quit is my one flaw!
BMD\t「このまま黙ってるほど気前は良くないぜ！」: I'm not nice enough to just take that!
BMD\t「ま、サービス精神も程々に……っと！」: Well, mustn't overdo the service... Hup!
BMD\t「くうっ！ まいったな、こりゃあ……」: Ngh! Well, this is a fine mess...
BMD\t「ま、/ これぐらいのピンチはお約束ってことで！」: Well,/　a pinch like this is par for the course!
BMD\t「ちょっと予想外だが、/ これで面白くなってきたぜ！」: Didn't see that coming,/　but now things are getting fun!
BMD\t「何だ！？ こんなパワーがあったのかよ！？」: What?! They had this kind of power?!
BMD\t「くっ！ 命があるだけマシだってか！？」: Ngh! Should I be glad I'm alive?!
BMD\t「……さあて、ここから形勢逆転といくか！」: ...Now then, time to turn the tables!
BMD\t「ええい、食らい過ぎちまったぜ！」: Dammit, I took way too many hits!
BMD\t「おいおい、まだ引退する気はないんだよ！」: Hey now, I'm not ready to retire yet!
BMD\t「これじゃ、女の子……/ いやいや、後輩に示しがつかないな」: At this rate, I'll never set an example/　for the girls... er, I mean, my juniors.
BMD\t「何！/ グルンガストの装甲をブチ抜いただと！？」: What?!/　It punched through the Grungust's armor?!
BMD\t「フッ、お前とも長い付き合いだったぜ……/ とか言ってる場合か！」: Heh, we've been through a lot, partner.../　Wait, this is no time for that!
BMD\t「くっ！ これじゃ/ 余計なジンクスを増やしちまうぜ……」: Ngh! At this rate/　I'll add another jinx to my list...
BMD\t「ぐっ！/ ヒュッケバインじゃ、そろそろ限界かよ！」: Gah!/　Is the Hückebein reaching its limit?!
BMD\t「ほう、インスペクターよりはやるようだな」: Heh, you're better than the Inspectors.
BMD\t「口で何を言われても、割と平気なんだけどな」: Words don't really bother me much, though.
BMD\t「好みのタイプだが、これはちょっとなぁ」: She's my type, but this is a bit much.
BMD\t「桃源郷にも天国にも行く気はないんでね！」: Not heading to Shangri-La or heaven yet!
BMD\t「ここでゲストにやられるわけには！」: I can't lose to the Guests here!
BMD\t「まだだ、夏喃！ 俺はまだ！」: Not yet, Kanan! I'm not done yet!
BMD\t「お前を止めるために、/ 俺はここに来た……！ だから！」: I came here to stop you.../　So I won't give up!
BMD\t「破滅の運命など、受け入れる気はない！」: I refuse to accept a fate of ruin!
BMD\t「ぐっ！ ガイアセイバーズ……/ お前達に……！」: Ngh! Gaia Saviors.../　I won't lose to you...!
BMD\t「ここでルイーナを止めなければ……！」: I have to stop Ruina here...!
BMD\t「ジンライ……奴の動きを見切らなければ！」: Jinrai... I have to read its movements!
BMD\t「くっ、何てスピードなんだ、奴は！」: Ngh, how fast is that thing?!
BMD\t「ぐうっ！ これが超機人の力か！」: Guh! So this is a Choukijin's power!
BMD\t「四凶の名は伊達じゃないな……！」: They don't call it one of the Four Evils/　for nothing...!
BMD\t「ぐっ！/ ガンエデン……これ以上やらせるかよ！」: Ngh!/　Gan Eden... I won't let you go any further!
BMD\t「致命傷じゃない！ まだいける！」: It's not fatal! I can still go!
BMD\t「ＡＤＣが上手く作動すれば、何とか……！」: If the ADC works right, I can manage...!
BMD\t「ちいっ！ サーボモーターの一つや二つ！」: Tch! What's a servomotor or two?!
BMD\t「落とせると思うな、この俺を！」: Don't think you can shoot me down!
BMD\t「無傷で、というわけにはいかないか……！」: Guess I can't get out of this unscathed...!
BMD\t「エール・シュヴァリアーでも/ 振り切れないとは……！」: Even the Aile Chevalier/　can't shake it off...!
BMD\t「こいつの装甲に頼るつもりはないが……！」: I don't plan to rely on this armor, but...!
BMD\t「ジェアンならば、まだいけるさ！」: The Geant can still keep going!
BMD\t「フォルテギガスなら、まだもつ！」: The Forte Gigas can still hold out!
BMD\t「アニキ、ＡＤＣで何とかなるわ！」: Big brother, the ADC can handle this!
BMD\t「ああ、ここから巻き返してみせるさ！」: Yeah, I'll turn this around from here!
BMD\t「アニキ、クリスが頑張って、って！」: Big brother, Clis says to hang in there!
BMD\t「やはり、おかしい……！/ 何だ、これは……！？」: Something's definitely wrong...!/　What is this...?!
BMD\t「同調しているのか、やはり……！」: So we really are in sync...!
BMD\t「大丈夫だ、これぐらいなら！」: It's fine, this much is nothing!
BMD\t「直撃は……避けられたか」: I managed to avoid a direct hit...
BMD\t「くっ、かわせたはずだ、今のは……！」: Ngh, I should have dodged that...!
BMD\t「奴は/ エール・シュヴァリアーより速い……！？」: Is it.../　faster than the Aile Chevalier...?!
BMD\t「そんなものでジェアンの装甲は！」: That won't get through the Geant's armor!
BMD\t「これぐらい、ジェアンなら問題ない！」: This much is nothing for the Geant!
BMD\t「くっ、油断したつもりは……！」: Ngh, I didn't think I'd let my guard down...!
BMD\t「あたしの邪魔はさせないよっ！」: You're not getting in my way!
BMD\t「手加減なんてしてらんないよっ！」: I can't afford to hold back!
BMD\t「恋も標的もロックしたら逃がさない！」: Once I lock onto a target or a crush,/　they don't get away!
BMD\t「リズムはつかんだ！/ ８ビートから１６ビート！」: I've got the rhythm!/　From 8-beat to 16-beat!
BMD\t「こう見えても/ 修羅場は踏んで来てるんだから！」: I may not look it, but/　I've been through my share of hell!
BMD\t「こういうのは、先に手を出した方が勝ち！」: In fights like this,/　whoever strikes first wins!
BMD\t「待ってるのは性に合わないからね！」: Waiting around just isn't my style!
BMD\t「ドゥバン、あんたの暴走を止めてやる！」: Duban, I'm gonna stop your rampage!
BMD\t「カークス将軍！/ あんたは急ぎ過ぎなんだよ！」: General Kirkus!/　You're moving way too fast!
BMD\t「火傷するのは、そっちの方だよ！」: You're the one who's gonna get burned!
BMD\t「エリオルメッセだか/ マリハリメッセだか知らないけど！」: Eriol Messe, Marihari Messe,/　whatever you're called!
BMD\t「メリオルエッセ、/ あんた達の好きにはやらせない！」: Meliores Esse,/　I won't let you do as you please!
BMD\t「その顔色をもっと変えてやるよ、/ コンターギオ！」: I'll make you change color even more,/　Contagio!
BMD\t「あいつ、男なの？ 女なの！？」: Is that thing a guy? Or a girl!?
BMD\t「ペルフェ、ペルフォク……/ もう！あんたの名前は言いにくいんだよ！」: Perfe, Perfoc... Ugh!/　Your name is way too hard to say!
BMD\t「よーし、ヘッドハンティングだ！」: All right, time for some headhunting!
BMD\t「そういうノリは、嫌いじゃないけど！」: Not that I mind that kind of vibe!
BMD\t「あんたの趣味には付き合ってられない！」: I'm not playing along with your hobbies!
BMD\t「踊りなら、あたしだって！」: If it's dancing, I can do that too!
BMD\t「あれが超機人のトップエースか！」: So that's the Choukijin's top ace!
BMD\t「孫光龍！/ あんたの好きにはやらせない！」: Sun Koryu!/　I won't let you do as you please!
BMD\t「ガイアセイバーズ！ あんた達は許せない！」: Gaia Saviors! I'll never forgive you!
BMD\t「今度はあんた達に一泡吹かせてやる！」: This time, I'm the one/　who'll catch you off guard!
BMD\t「ガイアセイバーズの好きにはやらせない！」: I won't let the Gaia Saviors/　have their way!
BMD\t「あんなのに狩られてたまるか！」: Like I'd let that thing hunt me down!
BMD\t「ヒュッケバインの仇討ちだよ！」: This is payback for the Hückebein!
BMD\t「ダブルＧ相手でも、やってみせる！」: Even against the Double G,/　I'll pull it off!
BMD\t「ああいうの、苦手じゃないのよね！」: Things like that don't bother me!
BMD\t「さーて、モンスター退治だよ！」: Okay, time to go monster hunting!
BMD\t「モンスター相手だと、血が騒いじゃうな～、/ 何故か！」: Monsters really get my blood pumping,/　for some reason!
BMD\t「キモ可愛いのは、範疇内！」: Creepy-cute is totally in my range!
BMD\t「チャイニーズ・モンスターだって、/ 怖くないよ！」: Even a Chinese monster/　doesn't scare me!

BMD\t「とどめだぁぁぁぁぁ！！」: This is the end for youuuu!!

LDBI\t「そうだとしたら、早急なお礼参りだな。@ しかも、たった１機で」: If so, that's some quick payback.@And with just one unit, too.
LDBI\t「状況は不利だ。退け、セティ」: The situation's against us. Fall back, Sety.
LDBI\t「じゃ、じゃあ、司令が言ってた援軍って、@ あなただったの！？」: Th-Then the reinforcements the commander@mentioned... were you!?
LDBI\t「どうして事前に連絡を……いえ、それより！ @ 何で黙って姿を消しち: Why didn't you contact me first... No, wait!@Why did you just disappear without a word!?
LDBI\t「何だ？@ 加勢か、後詰めか……どっちなんだ？」: What's this?@Backup, or a rearguard... which is it?
LDBI\t「それより、彼ら相手でこの状況を@ 覆すことは困難だ。退路は俺が確保: More importantly, turning this around against@them won't be easy. I'll secure a way out.@Withdraw.
LDBI\t「あたしが出張ってきて、この様じゃ@ ゼゼーナン司令に申し訳が立たな: If I come all this way and end up like this,@how will I face Commander Zezenan...!
LDBI\t「ここで人間の指揮官である君を@ 失うわけにはいかん」: We can't afford to lose you,@our human commander, here.
LDBI\t「そう……わかったわ。退きましょう」: I see... All right. Let's withdraw.
LDBI\t「あの指揮官機、高速戦闘型を迎えに来たのか……」: So the commander unit came to pick up@the high-speed type...
LDBI\t「引き際はいいが、無謀だな」: Knows when to pull back, but reckless.
LDBI\t「隊長、他人のことは@ 言えたり言えなかったりしちゃうのです」: Captain, you're both in and not in a@position to talk about others, you are.
LDBI\t「……どっちだ。@ おかしな口調は相変わらずだな。@ 色々な意味で懐: ...Which is it?@Your odd speech hasn't changed a bit.@Nostalgic in more ways than one.
LDBI\t「いえ、月近海へ進入する前に態勢を立て直します」: No. We'll regroup before entering lunar space.
LDBI\t「全周警戒を厳となせ。各機を帰艦させろ」: Full perimeter alert. Recall all units.
LDBI\t「１機増えたところで、どうだって言うのかしら？」: One more unit--what difference will that make?
LDBI\t「捲土重来……いや、諦めが悪いだけか。@ だが、この世界は新参者には: A comeback in force... no, you just don't know@when to quit. But this world isn't kind to@newcomers!
LDBI\t「あたしのビュードリファーに@ 追いつけるかしら？」: Think you can keep up@with my Beautrifa?
LDBI\t「あの機体……乗っているのは@ アギーハみたいに気の強い女かもな」: That machine... the pilot might be a@strong-willed woman like Aguija.
LDBI\t「利害が一致しただけの話だ。@ 過去のことを忘れたわけでもないし、@: Our interests simply align.@I haven't forgotten the past,@and I'm not asking for forgiveness.
LDBI\t「無論、恩を着せる気もない。@ シャドウミラーはお前達によって@ 壊: Nor do I expect you to owe me.@Shadow Mirror was destroyed@by you people, after all.
LDBI\t「あんた……何であのまま逃げなかったんだ？」: Hey... why didn't you just run off back there?
LDBI\t「逃げ場があれば、そうしていたさ」: I would have, if I'd had anywhere to run.
LDBI\t「いや、お前達があがく様を見てやろうと思ってな」: No, I just wanted to watch you people struggle.
LDBI\t「アクセル隊長……@ 私達と共に戦って下さるのですか？」: Captain Axel...@Will you fight alongside us?
LDBI\t「地球にあるソウルゲインを取り戻すためだ。@ お前達と馴れ合うつもり: It's to get back the Soulgain on Earth.@I've no intention of getting chummy with you.
LDBI\t「……給料は出んぞ。@ それに、艦内での行動には制限が付くと思え」: ...You won't get paid.@And expect limits on what you can do aboard.
LDBI\t「好きにしろ。@ 用が済めば、こちらから出て行くさ」: Suit yourself.@Once I'm done, I'll leave on my own.
LDBI\t「……いいんですか、カイ少佐？」: ...Are you sure about this, Major Kai?
LDBI\t「今は少しでも戦力が欲しい。@ 艦長には俺から話しておく」: Right now we need all the firepower we can get.@I'll talk to the captain myself.
LDBI\t「しかも、ヘブンゲートの占拠に失敗するとは……」: And you failed to take Heaven Gate, no less...
LDBI\t「司令、ア～ンノウンの動きが速かったんだ～から、@ しょ～がないよ」: Commander, the Unknoooowns moved too fast,@so it couldn't be heeelped.
LDBI\t「鋼龍戦隊と戦うため、@ 故意に転移出現点を変更したという@ 報告を: I've received a report that you deliberately@changed your warp-in point to fight@the Steel Dragons?
LDBI\t「ど～のみち、足止めは必要だ～ったでしょ」: We'd have neeeeded to stall them aaanyway.
LDBI\t「それに、ロフが来てくれなければ、私は……」: Besides, if Rof hadn't come, I would have...
LDBI\t「まあいい。@ シャフラワース、お前は引き続き月面制圧作戦を@ 続行: Enough.@Shaflawas, continue with the lunar campaign.@Make sure you secure Moon Cradle.
LDBI\t「ラクレイン、お前にもう一度チャンスをやる。@ フルシュワと共にヘブ: Lacrain, I'll give you one more chance.@Retake Heaven Gate together with Fulshwa.@That is all.
LDBI\t「……司令、援軍はて～っきり正規軍だと@ 思ってい～たけど、何でロフ: ...Commander, I tooootally figured the backup@would be regulars, so why Rof? Aaand this is@the fiiirst I've heard he's a mercenary.
LDBI\t「奴が傭兵になった経緯など知らん。@ ゴライクンルの紹介だ」: I don't know how he became a mercenary.@Golaiknl introduced him.
LDBI\t（ゴライクンル……司令が懇意にしてる戦争商人ね。@ ロフちゃん、そ～: (Golaiknl... the commander's pet war merchant.@So little Rof went dooown that road...)
LDBI\t（そ～れに、正規軍が来なかった理由……@ も～しかして、枢密院絡みな: (And the reason the regulars didn't come...@maaaybe it's tied to the Privy Council.)
