LDBI\t「……トロイアへ派遣された部隊の目的は、@ グリモルド山のヴォルクル: ...The force sent to Troia wasn't there@to seal off the Temple of Volkruss@on Mt. Grimold.
LDBI\t「なら、そのままシュテドニアスへ@ 侵攻するために……？」: Then they're going to push on@and invade Schtedonias...?
LDBI\t「ええ。@ それに、兄さんは直属の部隊を引き連れ、@ バルディアのナ: Yes.@And my brother intends to lead his personal@forces to Nagor Bay in Baldia.
LDBI\t「今のラングランに、シュテドニアスとの@ 全面戦争をやる余裕があるよ: Langran doesn't look like it can afford@an all-out war with Schtedonias right now...
LDBI\t「……その通りです。@ いまだに投降していないカークス軍残党もいます: ...That's right. There are still remnants of@Kirkus's army who haven't surrendered, and@turmoil continues all over Langran.
LDBI\t「当然、シュテドニアス側も報復に出るでしょうし……@ 混乱に乗じて、: Schtedonias is bound to retaliate, too...@And Kirkus himself, still on the run, might@make a move in the confusion.
LDBI\t「それにルオゾール達が絡みでもしたら、@ 足をすくわれかねないわ」: And if Luozorl and his lot get involved,@we could have the rug pulled out from under us.
LDBI\t「何があったか知らねえが、焦り過ぎなんだ、殿下は。@ ここでシュテド: Dunno what got into him, but the Prince is@way too impatient. Picking a fight with@Schtedonias now won't do anybody any good.
LDBI\t「ラングラン軍が一つにまとまってるなら、ともかく……@ 下手すりゃ、: If the Langran army were united, maybe...@But as it is, the enemy could hit the cracks@and the whole thing could come apart.
LDBI\t「勝算とか今後の展望とか、どうなってるのかしらん」: What about his odds of winning and his plans@for afterward, hmm? I wonder...
LDBI\t「もしや、フェイル殿下はデュラクシールや@ 魔装機神による特化戦力で: Could Prince Feil be planning a short, decisive@war with Schtedonias, using specialized forces@like the Duraxyll and the Masoukishin?
LDBI\t「そして、我々の戦力も@ その中に含まれているとしたら……」: And if he's counting our forces@among them...
LDBI\t「マサキ、フェイル殿下は私達の処遇について@ 何か言っていたの？」: Masaki, did Prince Feil say anything@about what's going to happen to us?
LDBI\t「私達の申し入れに対して、@ 後ほど返答するとは言われているけれど…: He said he'd respond to our request@later, but...
LDBI\t「艦長、フェイルロード陛下より通信が入っています。@ 魔装機神操者に: Captain, His Majesty Feilroad is contacting us.@He asks that the Masoukishin pilots@be present as well.
LDBI\t「……マサキ、テュッティ、@ 連絡が遅れてすまなかったな」: ...Masaki, Tytti.@I'm sorry I've been slow to contact you.
LDBI\t「君達の言い分はわかっている。@ だが、これは既に決定されたことなの: I know what you have to say.@But this has already been decided.
LDBI\t「本気でシュテドニアスとの戦争を@ 望んでいらっしゃるのですか？」: Do you truly wish for war@with Schtedonias?
LDBI\t「そう、私はこれまでの戦いを経て、気づいたのだ。@ これ以上の戦乱は: Yes. These battles have made me realize@that the only way to end this strife is@to unite all of <ラ・ギアス>.
LDBI\t「今のラングランはガタガタなんだぞ。@ そんな状態でシュテドニアスと: Langran's falling apart right now!@Fight Schtedonias in this state, and@we'll be the ones who crack first.
LDBI\t「それはわかっているよ、マサキ。@ だが、彼らは我々に対し、不信感を: I understand that, Masaki.@But they grow more distrustful of us.
LDBI\t「そして、力を蓄え、再び我が国に侵攻してくる。@ そうなってからでは: They will build their strength and invade us@again. By then it will be too late. Now, with@Schtedonias in retreat, is our best chance.
LDBI\t「そこで、君達の<魔装機神>や<魔装機>の力を@ 借りたいと思ってい: That is why I wish to borrow the power of@your <魔装機神> and <魔装機>.
LDBI\t（やはり、電撃作戦によって敵中枢を叩く気なのか……）: (So he does intend to strike at the enemy's@core with a lightning offensive...)
LDBI\t「……魔装機神操者として、@ その協力要請は受けられねえな」: ...As a Masoukishin pilot,@I can't accept that request.
LDBI\t「理由は、あんたのやり方が……@ シュテドニアスとの戦争が、ラ・ギア: Because I don't believe your methods...@a war with Schtedonias... will bring@peace to La Gias.
LDBI\t「マサキ、小手先で誤魔化してみた所で@ 真の平和は訪れん。根本的な改: Masaki, superficial fixes won't bring true@peace. What's needed is fundamental reform.
LDBI\t「力でしか問題を解決できないなんてのは、@ 二流の政治家の発言だぜ。: Solving problems only by force is what@second-rate politicians say. You planning to@become a second Kirkus?
LDBI\t「……その通りかも知れん。@ だが、私は自分の信じた道を歩む」: ...Perhaps you're right.@But I will walk the path I believe in.
LDBI\t「後世、この決断が悪行として非難されるかも@ 知れないが……それを恐: Future generations may condemn this decision@as an evil act... but I do not fear that.@I can only do all I can, here and now.
LDBI\t「……兄さん、何をそんなに焦っているの？@ そして、その決断の根拠は: ...Brother, why are you in such a hurry?@What's this decision based on?@Could it be... the Duraxyll?
LDBI\t「たった１機の魔装機で戦局を大きく変えられるとは@ 思っていない。だ: I don't believe a single Masouki can greatly@change the course of the war. But only now,@at this moment, can I achieve something great.
LDBI\t「ラングランだけでなく、ラ・ギアス全土を@ 戦火に巻き込むことになっ: Even if it drags not just Langran but all@of La Gias into the flames of war?
LDBI\t「そうだ。今のラ・ギアスには強大な権力と@ 抑止力が必要……誰かが劇: Yes. La Gias needs overwhelming power and a@deterrent. Unless someone serves as the bitter@medicine, the fighting will never end.
LDBI\t「だから、君達には大局的な物の見方をした上で、@ 私の決断に賛同して: So I want you to look at the bigger picture@and support my decision.
LDBI\t「おかしい……おかしいぜ、フェイル殿下。@ あんた、いつからそんな風: This is wrong... it's just wrong, Prince Feil.@When did you turn into this?@Why do you want power so bad?
LDBI\t「私が最終的に欲しているのは権力ではない……@ ラ・ギアスに平穏をも: What I ultimately seek is not power...@It's order, to bring peace to La Gias.
LDBI\t「そいつを得る方法に問題があると言ってる。@ だから、今のあんたに力: I'm saying how you get it is the problem.@So I'm not gonna help you the way you are now.@I'm out.
LDBI\t「テュッティ、ミオ……君達もそうか？」: Tytti, Mio... Do you feel the same?
LDBI\t「あたしはマサキと同意見……@ ようやく終わりそうな戦争を@ 蒸し返: I'm with Masaki...@Dragging up a war that's finally@about to end...
LDBI\t「わかった……強制はしない。@ ……それと、テツヤ・オノデラ中佐」: Very well... I won't force you.@...And, Commander Tetsuya Onodera.
LDBI\t「明後日、セブ神殿で地上送還の準備が整います。@ あなた方はそちらへ: In two days, Sebu Temple will be ready to send@you back to the surface. Please head there.
LDBI\t「また、今までご協力いただいたことに対し、@ 改めて感謝の意を表明致: Once again, allow me to express my gratitude@for all your cooperation so far.@Farewell.
LDBI\t「くそっ、何でこんなことに……！」: Dammit, how did it come to this...!
LDBI\t「これからどうするの、マサキ？」: What are we going to do now, Masaki?
LDBI\t「そんなこと、俺に言われたってわからねえよ……！」: How the hell should I know...!
LDBI\t「ともかく、ハガネをセブ神殿へ案内しましょう。@ これ以上、みんなを: Anyway, let's guide the Hagane to Sebu Temple.@We can't drag everyone into this any further.
LDBI\t「……ここで帰っちゃうのは、何か気が引けるけどね」: ...Kinda feels wrong to head home now, though.
LDBI\t「そうですね……@ 泥試合になるのがわかってて、見過ごすなんて……」: I know...@Turning a blind eye when we know it's@going to turn into a quagmire...
LDBI\t「だが、ここいらが引き際じゃないか？@ フェイル陛下も、俺達に協力を: But isn't this about the time to pull out?@King Feil didn't ask us to help, after all.
LDBI\t「レフィーナ大佐、カークス軍側から情報が入りました。@ フェイル殿下: Colonel Lefina, word from Kirkus's forces.@Prince Feil has retaken Langran's capital...@and Kirkus seems to be winning on many fronts.
LDBI\t「それで戦争の趨勢が決まりそうなのですか？」: Will that decide the outcome of the war?
LDBI\t「いえ。敵はレドナ峡谷付近で戦力を集結させる@ つもりのようですし、: No. The enemy seems to be gathering its forces@near Redona Gorge, and naturally, General@Kirkus won't just stand by and allow it...
LDBI\t「ラングランの命運を決する戦いは@ これからが本番といった所です」: The battle that will decide Langran's fate@is only just beginning.
LDBI\t「第一王位継承者であるフェイル殿下が@ 王都を奪還したのなら、ラング: If Prince Feil, first in line to the throne,@has retaken the capital, it should boost@the Langran army's morale, but...
LDBI\t「カークス将軍がどう思っておられるかは微妙ですな」: How General Kirkus feels about that@is a delicate question.
LDBI\t「将軍がテリウス殿下の即位を望んでいるのなら、@ フェイル殿下との対: If the general wants Prince Tellius crowned,@a clash with Prince Feil is unavoidable.
LDBI\t「とは言え、テリウス殿下は@ そう簡単に御輿へ乗らなさそうではありま: That said, Prince Tellius hardly seems@the type to be made a puppet so easily.
LDBI\t「シュテドニアスへの反撃の狼煙を上げたのは、@ カークス将軍です。ラ: It was General Kirkus who lit the signal fire@for the counterattack on Schtedonias. He must@take pride in starting Langran's liberation.
LDBI\t「それに、戦力はカークス軍の方が上回っている……@ 彼はテリウス殿下: Moreover, Kirkus's army is the stronger one...@After backing Prince Tellius, he may be aiming@to establish a new regime.
LDBI\t「侵略戦争の次は内乱ですか。@ やれやれ、どこの世界でも人間は@ 似: First a war of invasion, now civil strife.@My, my... People are much the same@in every world, it seems.
LDBI\t「……ヤンロン、@ あなたはどうするつもりなのです？」: ...Yang Long,@what do you intend to do?
LDBI\t「僕はカークス将軍に直接会い、@ 彼の考えを見極めようと思っています: I plan to meet General Kirkus in person@and see for myself what he's thinking.
LDBI\t「そして、彼の行動がラングランのみならず、@ ラ・ギアスを混乱に陥れ: And if his actions threaten to plunge not only@Langran but all of La Gias into chaos...
LDBI\t「魔装機神操者としての義務を@ 果たさなければなりません」: ...then I must fulfill my duty@as a Masoukishin operator.
LDBI\t「かつて、マサキからも少し話を聞いたことが@ ありますが、魔装機神操: Masaki told me a little about it once, but@the duty of a Masoukishin operator is...
LDBI\t「<ラ・ギアス>において、魔装機神操者は@ あらゆる権力に従わなくて: In <ラ・ギアス>, Masoukishin operators need not@obey any authority. Every decision is@theirs alone to make.
LDBI\t「そして、その義務とは……@ 世界存続の危機に際しては、@ 全てを捨: And their duty is this...@when the world's very existence is threatened,@to cast everything aside and face it.
LDBI\t「では、カークス将軍の考え次第では……」: Then, depending on what the general intends...
LDBI\t「ええ……彼を止めるつもりでいます」: Yes... I intend to stop him.
LDBI\t「それは……わかりません。@ しかし、まずはカークス将軍の考えを@: That... I don't know.@But first, I want to hear General Kirkus's@intentions from his own mouth.
LDBI\t「また、彼は鋼龍戦隊の他のメンバーに関する@ 情報を持っている可能性: He's also likely to have information about the@other members of the Steel Dragons. I'll ask@about it, along with our return to the surface.
LDBI\t「仮にハガネがフェイル殿下の下にいたとしても、@ 将軍はそのことを我: Even if the Hagane were with Prince Feil,@I expect the general would hide that from us...
LDBI\t「ともかく、私達の地上送還の鍵を握っているのは、@ カークス将軍とフ: In any case, our return to the surface hinges@on General Kirkus and Prince Feil, doesn't it?
LDBI\t「では、私達も彼らの意志を確かめる必要があります。@ まずは、カーク: Then we need to learn their intentions as well.@Starting with General Kirkus...@Yang Long, this ship will accompany you.
LDBI\t「……艦長、この近くにいるカークス軍部隊が@ 何者かと戦闘を行ってい: ...Captain, a Kirkus army unit nearby@appears to be fighting someone.
LDBI\t「戦闘……？@ もしや、まだこの辺りにシュテドニアス軍が？」: Fighting...?@Are Schtedonias forces still in the area?
LDBI\t「レフィーナ大佐、@ そちらへ向かっていただけませんか？」: Colonel Lefina,@could you head over there?
LDBI\t「わかりました。@ 総員、第一種戦闘配置！」: Understood.@All hands, level one battle stations!
LDBI\t「先に手を出して来たのはあなた達よ。@ さあ、覚悟おし」: You're the ones who struck first, you know.@Now, brace yourselves.
LDBI\t「あ～ら、何がやって来たのかと思ったら」: Well, well, and just what have we here?
LDBI\t「シラカワ博士とグランゾン……@ いえ、ネオ・グランゾンはあの時に…: Dr. Shirakawa and the Granzon...@No, surely the Neo Granzon was destroyed@back then...!
LDBI\t「ともかく、各機は出撃を！」: In any case, all units, launch!
LDBI\t「ここは僕達に任せて、君達は下がれ！」: Leave this to us. You fall back!
LDBI\t「あ、あのグランゾンは本物ですの！？」: Is th-that Granzon the genuine article!?
LDBI\t「エネルギー反応から判断して、@ 間違いないようですが……」: Judging by its energy readings,@there seems to be no mistake, but...
LDBI\t「しかし、彼は<修羅の乱>で戦死したはずです！」: But he's supposed to have died@in the <修羅の乱>!
LDBI\t「直接確かめた方が早いよ！@ シュウ！ グランゾンに乗ってるのは、@: Fastest way's to just ask!@Shu! Are you the one@piloting that Granzon!?
LDBI\t「……どうやら、あなた達も私のことを@ 知っているようですね」: ...It seems you know me as well.
LDBI\t「は！？ 何をとぼけてんのさ！@ あたし達を忘れたとは言わせないよ！: Huh!? Quit playing dumb!@Don't tell me you've forgotten us!
LDBI\t「申し訳ありませんが、@ 私には以前の記憶がないんですよ」: My apologies, but I have no memories@of my past.
LDBI\t「いや、あのシュウがそんな嘘をついて@ 誤魔化すわけないか……」: No... Shu's not the type to tell@a lie like that to cover things up...
LDBI\t「それ以前に……@ あいつ、どうやって生き延びたんだ？」: Before that...@how did he even survive?
LDBI\t「も、もしかして、幽霊とか……」: M-maybe he's a ghost or something...
LDBI\t「失礼な！ 本物のご主人様ですよ！@ 確かに一度死んじゃいましたけど: How rude! That's my real master!@Sure, he died once, but@he's been resurrected, see!
LDBI\t「何でシュウがそんなものを……？@ いや、それより、どうやって復活し: Why would Shu have one of those...?@No, more importantly, how did he come back!?
LDBI\t「いや、まだわからんぞ」: No, we can't be sure of that yet.
LDBI\t「……彼らに狙われ、奪われるようなら、@ 機体は破壊しても構わない…: ...If those people target and seize them,@destroying the units is acceptable...
LDBI\t「それがあの方の命令……」: Such are the orders of that one...
LDBI\t「うぬっ！ 各機、アンノウンを攻撃！@ ただし、工場の上に落とすなよ: Grr! All units, attack the unknown!@Just don't let it fall on the factory!
LDBI\t「まだ……あの中にもあるはずだ」: There should still be more... in there as well.
LDBI\t「おのれ、奴の目的は！！」: Damn it, so its goal was...!!
LDBI\t「ヒュッケバイン・シリーズの@ 破壊……だったのか……！」: Destroying the Hückebein series...@that was its goal...!
LDBI\t「申し訳ありません、常務。@ このような結果になってしまって……」: My apologies, Director.@I'm sorry things turned out like this...
LDBI\t「いえ……社員の中から死者が出なかっただけでも@ 良しとしなければ…: No... We should be grateful that none of@our employees were killed...
LDBI\t「それに、ヒュッケバインは@ 全て失われたわけじゃありませんよ」: Besides, we haven't lost@every last Hückebein.
LDBI\t「確かにな。@ 量産型ヒュッケバインＭｋ－Ⅱがあるし……@ そもそも: True.@There's the Mass Production Hückebein Mk-II...@And if I recall, prototype Unit 3 was...
LDBI\t「それらに加え、エクスバインが残っています」: On top of those, there's still the Exbein.
LDBI\t「ええ……被害を受けましたが、@ フレームの破損までには至っていませ: Yes... It took damage, but@the frame itself wasn't compromised.
LDBI\t「俺達は諦めませんよ。鋼龍戦隊のために@ 残ったパーツを集め、エクス: We won't give up. For the Steel Dragons'@sake, we'll gather the remaining parts@and finish the Exbein.
LDBI\t「元々、あれには大幅な強化改造を施すつもりで@ 作業を進めていたので: We were already proceeding with plans@to give it a major upgrade anyway.
LDBI\t「当面の間は、応急措置を施して@ 凌ぐしかありませんが、いずれ……」: For the time being, we'll have to make do@with stopgap repairs, but eventually...
LDBI\t「では、作業を頼む。@ 懸念していた事態が起きるのは、もはや確実だか: Then I'll leave the work to you.@What I feared is now all but certain to happen.
LDBI\t「それにしても、あの黒い機体はいったい……」: Even so, what was that black unit...?
LDBI\t「あれは、ヒュッケバイン・シリーズのデータを@ 流用して作られた機体: I believe that unit was built using@data from the Hückebein series...
LDBI\t「単なるコピーではなく、Ｍｋ－Ⅲと同等……@ あるいは、それ以上の性: It's no mere copy. Its performance seems to@equal the Mk-III's... or even surpass it.
LDBI\t「しかも、奴はヒュッケバインから@ ブラックホール・エンジンと<トロ: What's more, it pulled the cores of the@Black Hole Engine and <トロニウム> Engine@out of the Hückebeins.
LDBI\t「ええ……破片を調査した結果、判明しました」: Yes... We confirmed it by examining the debris.
LDBI\t「奴は連中の一味ではなさそうだが……」: It doesn't seem to be one of them, but...
LDBI\t「ああ……最初に現れた者達の目的は、@ ヒュッケバインの破壊ではなく: Yeah... The first group's objective was to@capture the Hückebein, not destroy it.
LDBI\t「あれがマオ・インダストリーの機体じゃないのなら……@ どこで作られ: If that's not a Mao Industries machine...@then where was it made?
LDBI\t「量産型ヒュッケバインＭｋ－Ⅱのデータを@ 持っていて、あれだけの機: Someone with the Mass Production Hückebein@Mk-II's data who could build such a unit...@<イスルギ重工> comes to mind first.
LDBI\t「彼らは、ブラックホール・エンジンや@ トロニウム・エンジンのノウハ: They'd surely want the know-how behind@Black Hole Engines and Tronium Engines.
LDBI\t「必要としていたのは心臓部のみであって、@ 機体そのものは不要……だ: It only needed their cores, not the units@themselves... so it destroyed them?
LDBI\t「しかし、こちらに仕掛けて来なかった点に@ 疑問が残る。その力を以て: But why didn't it attack us? With that much@power, it could have removed any obstacle@and taken everything here.
LDBI\t「……カイ少佐、分析結果が出ちゃいました」: ...Major Kai, the analysis results are, like,@totally done now.
LDBI\t「予想通りです。@ アーマードモジュールに搭乗していたのは、@ バイ: Just as expected.@The pilot of the Armored Module was@a Bioroid...
LDBI\t「<インスペクター>が使用していた物に@ 酷似しています。また、転移: It closely resembles those the <インスペクター>@used. And the ESW pattern when it teleported in@is a match too, so it be.
LDBI\t「ああ……@ インスペクターが地球圏へ舞い戻って来たのだ」: Yes...@The Inspectors have returned to the Earth Sphere.
BMD\t「本艦で仕留めます！」: We'll finish it with this ship!
BMD\t「あの敵は本艦で撃破します！」: This ship will take out that enemy!
BMD\t「各員、鋼龍戦隊の名に恥じぬ戦いを！」: All hands, fight in a manner worthy/　of the Steel Dragons!
BMD\t「本艦で指揮官機を撃破します！」: We'll take down the commander unit!
BMD\t「理不尽な武力干渉に、私達は屈しません！」: We will not yield/　to unjust armed interference!
BMD\t「ガイアセイバーズに屈してはなりません！」: We must not give in to the Gaia Savers!
BMD\t「前方よりガイアセイバーズ機、接近！」: Gaia Savers unit approaching from ahead!
BMD\t「総員、対艦戦闘用意！」: All hands, prepare for anti-ship combat!
BMD\t「ゲストの好きにやらせてはなりません！」: We mustn't let the Guests run rampant!
BMD\t「『超』が付く魔装機ですからな、/ 油断なりませんぞ」: It's a Masouki with 'Super' attached,/　so best not get careless.
BMD\t「ああいうのは苦手です……」: I'm not good with things like that...
BMD\t「何としてもヴォルクルスを撃破するのです！」: We must destroy Volkruss at all costs!
BMD\t「いかにも邪神、といった感じの体ですな」: Every inch the evil god, isn't it?
BMD\t「では、妖怪退治といきましょうか」: Well then, shall we go ghost hunting?
BMD\t「はい、お札の用意をお願いします」: Yes, please get the talismans ready.
BMD\t「そんなもの、ありません！」: We don't have anything like that!
BMD\t「本艦であの超機人を阻止します！」: This ship will stop that Choukijin!
BMD\t「いやはや、こうなると怪獣映画ですな」: My, my. Now it's a kaiju movie.
BMD\t「あれに取り込まれるわけにはいきません！」: We can't let that thing absorb us!
BMD\t「イーグル、シャーク、パンサー/ ……あちらも戦隊ですな」: Eagle, Shark, Panther.../　Looks like they're a sentai team too.
BMD\t「私達の世界に、あのような神は不要です！」: Our world needs no god like that!
BMD\t「ほう、神々しい。/ 拝んだら、御利益がありますかな」: Oh, how divine./　Would praying to it bring us good fortune?
BMD\t「鋼龍戦隊ある限り、/ あなたの計画が成就することはない……！」: As long as the Steel Dragons stand,/　your plan will never come to pass...!
BMD\t「最終攻撃目標、アダマトロン！/ 各員、奮戦せよ！」: Final target: Adamatron!/　All hands, give it everything you've got!
BMD\t「あの姿……/ 天使と悪魔の中道を往くというわけですか」: That form.../　So it walks the middle path between/　angels and demons, does it?
BMD\t「つまり、人間……その新たな祖……！」: In other words, a human.../　A new progenitor of humanity...!
LDBI\t「マイ、ヒリュウへ報告。@ 我々が現場へ先行すると伝えろ」: Mai, report to the Hiryu.@Tell them we're going on ahead to the scene.
LDBI\t「イング、お前は戻れ。@ 機体改装前に何かあったら事だからな」: Ing, you head back.@We can't risk anything before your unit's refit.
LDBI\t「いえ、僕も行きます。@ 輸送機の積荷を失えば、意味がありませんから: No, I'm going too.@None of this matters if we lose that cargo.
LDBI\t「……わかった。@ ただし、トロニウム・エンジンは使うなよ」: ...All right.@But don't use the Tronium Engine.
LDBI\t「ライ、先行許可が出た」: Rai, we're cleared to go on ahead.
LDBI\t「だ、駄目だ！ 脱出します！」: I-It's no use! I'm bailing out!
LDBI\t「ハミル博士、残ったのは我々だけです！」: Dr. Hamill, we're the only ones left!
LDBI\t「あと一歩の所で……！@ 一筋縄でいかんのは、凶鳥の眷属たる所以か」: We were so close...!@Nothing's ever easy with kin of the@bird of ill omen, is it?
LDBI\t「ダブルＥＸのパーツを見捨てるわけにはいかん。@ あれには、我々の意: I can't abandon the Double EX parts.@Our pride is riding on them...!
LDBI\t「この辺りに連邦軍の施設などない。@ やはり、あれは……」: There are no Federation facilities around here.@So that must be...
LDBI\t「この反応は……フフッ、確定だな」: This reading... Heh, that settles it.
LDBI\t「あの機体、ガイアセイバーズの……！」: That unit... it's from the Gaia Savers...!
LDBI\t「フフフ……こうも上手くお前と出会えるとは。@ 嬉しいよ、イング。い: Heh heh heh... To run into you so easily.@I'm delighted, Ing. Or rather... Egret Ing.
LDBI\t「そこの裏切り者も知らぬことだが……@ マシンナリー・チルドレン、そ: Not even that traitor there knows this...@He's the 22nd of the Machinery Children.
LDBI\t「僕のパパ、イーグレット・フェフによって@ 作り出された、新たな世界: Beings created by my papa, Egret Fehu,@to become the masters of a new world.
LDBI\t「ああ。@ 本来なら、お前はアルファ・セイバーの一員として@ 僕の下: That's right.@By rights, you should be serving under me@as one of the Alpha Sabers. Without a self.
LDBI\t「現行のマシンナリー・チルドレンは、@ オリジネイターである僕を除い: Because the current Machinery Children,@except for me, the Originator, have no@self and never speak.
LDBI\t「人の形をした、機体制御装置だとでも……！？」: So they're just control systems@shaped like people...!?
LDBI\t「君達に倒されたアンサズやスリサズは、@ 人格設定に問題があったから: Ansuz and Thurisaz, who you defeated,@had flawed personality settings.@My current siblings are easier to control, too.
LDBI\t「なら、何故、僕には自我があるんだ！？」: Then why do I have a self!?
LDBI\t「さあね。@ お前がグランド・クリスマスから脱走した理由も含め、@: Who knows?@Apparently nobody really understands it,@including why you fled Grand Christmas.
LDBI\t「パパにとっても不測の事態だったみたいだけど……@ まあ、自分で思い: It seems even Papa didn't see it coming...@Well, you'll just have to remember on your own.
LDBI\t（奴のみならず、イーグレット・フェフも生きていて、@ ガイアセイバー: (Not only him, but Egret Fehu is alive too,@and with the Gaia Savers...!)
LDBI\t「イング、お前が単なる欠陥品なら、@ どうでも良かったんだが……@: Ing, if you were just a defective product,@I wouldn't have cared... But there's@something I don't like.
LDBI\t「念動力さ。@ コピーが僕にない力を持っているなんて、@ ちょっと腹: Telekinesis.@A copy having a power I lack...@It's a little irritating.
LDBI\t「だから、僕はイレギュラーである@ お前の存在を消す」: So I'm going to erase you,@the irregular.
LDBI\t「そんな理由で殺されてたまるか……！@ 念動力だって、何故それを持っ: Like I'll let you kill me for that...!@I don't even know why@I have telekinesis.
LDBI\t「知る必要はないよ。お前はここで死ぬんだから」: You don't need to. You're going to die here.
LDBI\t「いや、僕がフェフという男に造り出された存在なら、@ その理由を直接: No. If I was created by this man Fehu,@I'll ask him why, face to face.
LDBI\t「パパの所まで行けると思っているのか？」: You think you can make it all the way to Papa?
LDBI\t「出自が判明した以上、自分の行動で証を立てます。@ 僕がマシンナリー: Now that I know where I came from,@I'll prove with my actions that even as one@of the Machinery Children, I'm no Egretta...!
LDBI\t「その言葉、今は信用しておく。@ ……ラウル、エクサランスは真っ直ぐ: I'll trust those words for now.@...Raul, get the Excellence to the transport.
LDBI\t「了解。@ それで、ガードに専念すればいいんですね？」: Roger.@So we just focus on guarding it, right?
LDBI\t「ああ、俺達は敵を牽制する」: Right. We'll keep the enemy in check.
LDBI\t「各機、輸送機に接近する敵機を優先して狙え！」: All units, prioritize enemies@closing on the transport!
LDBI\t「エグレッタの狙いは僕です。@ 彼に対して壁になることが出来ます」: Egretta's after me.@I can act as a wall against him.
LDBI\t「いえ、あなたは輸送機の方をお願いします」: No, please protect the transport instead.
LDBI\t「もしや、イング、お前は……」: Ing, could it be that you...
LDBI\t「死ぬつもりはないよ、マイ。@ 僕の記億と存在理由を探る糸口が@ は: I'm not planning to die, Mai.@I can clearly see a lead now on my memories@and my reason for existing.
LDBI\t「だけど、過去の記憶を取り戻しても……」: But even if you get your memories back...
LDBI\t「僕は答えが欲しいんだ。@ それが……今、僕が生きている理由の一つだ: I want answers.@That's... one of the reasons I'm alive now.
LDBI\t「……わかった。エグレッタの牽制はお前に任せる」: ...All right. Keeping Egretta busy is your job.
LDBI\t「状況はこちらが不利だ。@ 敵の狙いを散らさねば、輸送機が墜とされる: We're at a disadvantage.@Unless we split their aim, the transport falls.
LDBI\t「ただし、イング。お前とアッシュが倒されたら、@ 凶鳥の系譜が途切れ: But Ing. If you and the Ash go down,@the bird of ill omen's line will end.@Don't forget that.
LDBI\t「ヒュッケバインとは因縁があってな。@ 左手と引き替えにした機体……: I have history with the Hückebein.@The machine I traded my left hand for...@I can't bear to watch its descendants perish.
LDBI\t「精霊波の干渉が大き過ぎるのです。@ 『<調和の結界>』が破れてから: The spirit wave interference is too great.@Ever since the <調和の結界> was broken,@the power of the spirits has grown unstable.
LDBI\t「こっちに突っ込んで来るニャ！」: It's charging straight at us, meow!
LDBI\t「<アーマードモジュール>だと！？」: An <アーマードモジュール>!?
LDBI\t「申し遅れましたが、召喚された地上人は@ あのような魔装機モドキに乗: I neglected to mention it, but summoned surface@dwellers are often found piloting imitation@Masouki like that one.
LDBI\t「でも、あれ……連邦軍の機体じゃないわよ」: But that... isn't a Federation unit.
LDBI\t「もしかして、<ノイエＤＣ>の残党か……！？」: Could they be remnants of the <ノイエＤＣ>...!?
LDBI\t「シュテドニアス軍がああいう輩を@ 傭兵として徴用しているのです」: The Schtedonias army has been conscripting@that sort as mercenaries.
LDBI\t「ちっ……！ あいつらは俺が片づける！@ トールス、あんたは引き揚げ: Tch...! I'll take care of them!@Torres, you pull back!
LDBI\t「いえ、我々もお手伝いします、マサキ殿」: No, we shall assist you, Masaki.
LDBI\t「ん？ ヴァイスちゃんを見てるのかしら？」: Hm? Is he looking at my Weiss?
LDBI\t「<アインスト>！ 奴もこの地に来ていたか！」: The <アインスト>! So it's come to this land as well!
LDBI\t「この傷の痛み、貴様にも味わってもらう！」: Now you'll taste the pain of this wound!
LDBI\t「何だ、あいつ……！？@ ライン・ヴァイスリッターを@ アインストと: What's with that guy...!?@Does he think the Rein Weissritter@is an Einst!?
LDBI\t「まあ、見た目は確かにアインストっぽいけどね」: Well, it does kinda look like an Einst.
LDBI\t「前にあいつとやり合ったことがあるのかよ？」: You tangle with him before or something?
LDBI\t「ううん、初対面だと思うけど……@ 本物のアインストに怨みを持ってて: Nope, I don't think we've met...@Maybe he's got a grudge against the real Einst@and he's taking it out on me.
LDBI\t「アインストは俺が仕留める！ 攻撃開始！」: The Einst is mine! Commence attack!
LDBI\t「くっ、これ以上は！ 後退する！」: Ngh, I can't take any more! Falling back!
LDBI\t「おのれ、アインスト……！@ ラングレーでの怨み、必ず晴らすぞ！」: Damn you, Einst...!@I swear I'll avenge what happened at Langley!
LDBI\t「さっきのゲートを通って来た@ 地上人じゃニャいか？」: Could it be a surface dweller who came@through that gate just meow?
LDBI\t「だとしたら、放っておくわけにはいかねえか」: If so, guess we can't just leave 'em.
LDBI\t「おい、しっかりしろ！ 大丈夫か？」: Hey, pull yourself together! You okay?
LDBI\t「……何だ、こいつ？ @ 気持ち良さそうに眠ってやがる」: ...What's with this kid?@She's sleeping all nice and comfy.
LDBI\t「マサキ殿、ひとまず我らの基地でご休息を」: Masaki, please rest at our base@for the time being.
LDBI\t「ああ、そうさせてもらうか」: Yeah, guess I'll take you up on that.
LDBI\t「魔装機神を手に入れりゃ、@ 昨日の赤っ恥も帳消しだ！」: If I get my hands on a Masoukishin,@yesterday's humiliation'll be wiped clean!
LDBI\t「何をわけのわからねえことを！@ サイバスターに勝てると思うなよ！」: What the hell are you babbling about!?@Don't think you can beat Cybuster!
LDBI\t「俺達がどこに属していようが、@ 貴様が敵であることに変わりはない！: No matter who we're affiliated with,@you're still our enemy!
LDBI\t「アインストは残らず駆逐する！」: I will exterminate every last Einst!
LDBI\t「もう大元はいなくなっちゃってるんだけど……@ 言っても無駄な感じね: Their big boss is already gone, though...@Seems like telling him won't do any good.
LDBI\t「その機体と貴様がいる限り、@ アインストは滅びたことにはならん！」: As long as you and that machine exist,@the Einst cannot be considered destroyed!
LDBI\t神聖ラングラン王国 ルザック州: Holy Kingdom of Langran, Ruzak Province
LDBI\t「お、気がついたな。@ いや、目が覚めたって方が正しいか」: Oh, you came to.@Or I guess 'woke up' is more like it.
LDBI\t「……え？ きゃあーっ！！ な、何よ、何よっ！@ あなた、誰っ！？: ...Huh? Eeeek!! Wh-What, what is this!?@Who are you!? Why are you in my room!?
LDBI\t「わっ！？ こ、こら、落ち着けっ！ @ よく見ろ、ここがお前の部屋か: Whoa!? H-Hey, calm down!@Look around, does this look like your room!?@Ow ow! Quit scratching!
LDBI\t「うわ～、クロちゃんシロちゃんも@ 真っ青なキャットクローねぇ」: Whoa, those cat claws would put@even Kuro and Shiro to shame.
LDBI\t「あ、あなた達、誰！？ あたしをこんなとこに@ 連れて来て、どうする: Wh-Who are you people!? What are you gonna@do to me, bringing me to a place like this!?
LDBI\t「言っとくけど、あたしん家は貧乏だからねっ！@ 誘拐してもお金なんて: Just so you know, my family's poor!@Kidnapping me won't get you any money!
LDBI\t「あのなぁ……@ お前、もしかして何も覚えてねえのか？」: Look... Don't tell me you@don't remember anything?
LDBI\t「きゃあーっ！ 誘拐犯！ 近寄らないでっ！！」: Eeeek! Kidnapper! Stay away from me!!
LDBI\t「やかましいっ！ @ 黙って俺の話を聞けっ！ わかったなっ！！」: Shut up!@Just be quiet and listen to me! Got it!!
LDBI\t「いいか、俺は誘拐犯じゃない。@ ここはラ・ギアス……簡単に言えば、: Listen, I'm not a kidnapper.@This is La Gias... Simply put, it's a world@inside a hollow space within the Earth.
LDBI\t「そして、お前は何故かここに召喚された」: And for some reason, you got summoned here.
BMD\t「殿下に抗うのであれば！」: If you would defy His Highness...!
BMD\t「地上人の好きにはやらせん！」: Surface dwellers won't have their way here!
BMD\t「我らに与せぬのであれば、/ 地上人とて容赦はせん！」: If you won't side with us,/　surface dwellers or not, no mercy!
BMD\t「サイバスター相手でも怯むわけには！」: Even against Cybuster, I can't falter!
BMD\t「グランヴェールの足を止める！」: I'll stop Granveil in its tracks!
BMD\t「殿下のために、ここで退くわけにはいかん！」: For His Highness, I can't retreat here!
BMD\t「わ、我らには大義が！ 意地があるのだ！！」: W-We have a cause! We have our pride!!
BMD\t「ふ、ふふふ……覚悟はもう出来ている……！」: Heh, heh heh... I'm already prepared...!
BMD\t「わ、我らの義を世に示すために……/ そのためには！」: T-To show the world our righteousness.../　For that...!
BMD\t「くっ！ まだ任務は続行可能だ！」: Kh! I can still carry out the mission!
BMD\t「チッ、いい目をしている！」: Tch, you've got a good eye!
BMD\t「くっ！ あくまでも抗うか！」: Kh! You'll resist to the end?!
BMD\t「何としてもサイバスターを止めねば！」: We must stop Cybuster at all costs!
BMD\t「その力、殿下のために使えば……！」: If only you'd use that power/　for His Highness...!
BMD\t「そう簡単にやられるか！」: I won't go down that easily!
BMD\t「これならば、魔装機神と戦えるぞ！」: With this, we can fight a Masoukishin!
BMD\t「グランヴェールの力は、/ こんなものではないはずだ」: This can't be all/　Granveil's power amounts to.
BMD\t「こんな時に弾切れか！」: Out of ammo at a time like this?!
BMD\t「あなた達と私の願いは同じはず……」: Your wish and mine should be the same...
BMD\t「あなたの翼で、/ 私の結界を越えることは出来ない……」: Your wings cannot carry you/　past my barrier...
BMD\t「アイビス……あくまでも私と戦うのですね」: Ibis... So you insist on fighting me.
BMD\t「四神の力は通用しません」: The power of the Four Gods will not work.
BMD\t「神より人を選ぶのですか、龍虎王……」: You choose humans over a god, RyuKoOh...?
BMD\t「私に剣を向けるのですか、ゼンガー……」: You turn your sword on me, Sänger...?
BMD\t「ゼンガー……やはり、あなたは……」: Sänger... As I thought, you are...
BMD\t「アラド……/ それがあなたの意志なのですか……」: Arado.../　Is that truly your will...?
BMD\t「念の力をそのように使ってはいけない……」: You must not use psychic power that way...
BMD\t「念の力は、/ ガンエデンの下で行使されるべきなのです」: Psychic power must be wielded/　under Gan Eden.
BMD\t「あなた達の念が束になったとしても……」: Even if you bind all your minds together...
BMD\t「今は敢えて受け止めましょう、その念を……」: For now, I shall accept that power...
BMD\t「アウグストスの意志を否定するのですか……」: You would deny the will of Augustus...?
BMD\t「あなた達の念で、/ 私を揺るがすことは出来ません」: Your psychic power/　cannot shake me.
BMD\t「そのようなことをしても、救いはありません」: There is no salvation in doing that.
BMD\t「あくまでも神に逆らうと言うのですか……？」: So you insist on defying God...?
BMD\t「ガンエデンの結界を破ることは出来ません」: You cannot break Gan Eden's barrier.
BMD\t「あなたにしばしの時を……」: I grant you a moment's respite...
BMD\t「考える時間を与えましょう」: I will give you time to reflect.
BMD\t「省みるのです……これまでの行いを」: Reflect... upon all you have done.
BMD\t「力添えを……」: Let me lend you my aid...
BMD\t「災いの源を断ちます」: I will sever the source of calamity.
BMD\t「バラルの園に永久の安息を」: Eternal rest in the Garden of Baral.
BMD\t「大いなる神の福音……」: The gospel of the great God...
BMD\t「心安らかに受け入れるのです」: Accept it with a peaceful heart.
BMD\t「守護の光をあなた達に」: The light of protection upon you.
BMD\t「そして、世界に幸福と安らぎを」: And happiness and peace upon the world.
BMD\t「いでよ、ガンエデンの聖霊よ……」: Come forth, holy spirit of Gan Eden...
BMD\t「約束の地……人々をそこへ導くために」: The Promised Land... I will lead them there.
BMD\t「今、成すべきことを成します！」: I shall do what must be done now!
BMD\t「ライディ様、見ていて下さいませ！」: Please watch over me, Lord Raidy!
BMD\t「フェアリオンの力、お見せ致しますわ！」: Behold the power of the Fairlion!
BMD\t「先手はいただきますわ！」: I'll be taking the first move!
BMD\t「ここで負けるわけにはいきません！」: I cannot afford to lose here!
BMD\t「邪魔をなさるのなら、遠慮は致しません！」: Interfere, and I shan't hold back!
BMD\t「根性……あ、いえ、/ 気合を入れて行きますわ！」: Time for some Vigor... er, I mean,/　let's go with some Spirit!
BMD\t「ヤキを……あ、いえ、/ お灸をすえてやりますわ！」: I'll beat you senseless... er, I mean,/　I shall teach you a lesson!
BMD\t「ブッ飛ば……いえ、突貫致しますわ！」: I'll kick your... er, I shall charge!
BMD\t「ガチンコ……いえ、真っ向勝負ですわ！」: Let's throw down... er, a fair duel!
BMD\t「好きにはやらせませんわよ、シエンヌ！」: I won't let you have your way, Sienne!
BMD\t「ラトゥーニ達を誹ることは許しません！」: I won't allow you to slander Latune/　and the others!
BMD\t「彼らもスクールの出身者だなんて……！」: To think they're from The School too...!
BMD\t「あの胸の宝玉……あれは……！」: That jewel on its chest... That's...!
BMD\t「私には見えます。/ 力を得たとしても、あなたは……！」: I can see it. Even with that power,/　you will still...!
BMD\t「アルテウル、あなたの真意は何ですの！？」: Arteur, what are your true intentions!?
BMD\t「止めてみせますわ、あなたと……/ この戦いを！」: I shall stop you.../　and this battle!
BMD\t「ここで新たな戦を起こすことが、/ 民のためになるとは思えません……！: Starting a new war here can't possibly/　be good for the people...!
BMD\t「彼らは民に仇なす存在……/ 放っておけませんわ！」: They're a threat to the people.../　I can't leave them be!
BMD\t「メリオルエッセ……私は挫けませんわよ！」: Meliores Esse... I won't be broken!
BMD\t「まず、私自身の恐怖を/ 打ち消さなければ……！」: First, I must overcome/　my own fear...!
BMD\t「私達は、あなた達の糧にはなりません！」: We will not become your sustenance!
BMD\t「コンターギオ！/ 狼藉を働くことは許しませんわよ！」: Contagio!/　I won't allow your outrages!
BMD\t「闇を振り払ってみせますわ！」: I shall drive away the darkness!
BMD\t「ペルフェクティオ！/ 私達の世界から立ち去りなさい！」: Perfectio!/　Leave our world at once!
BMD\t「俗界桃源郷などに興味はありませんわ！」: Your worldly paradise holds/　no interest for me!
BMD\t「あなた達の計画は、/ 人のためになりませんわ！」: Your plan does nothing/　for the people!
BMD\t「あなた達の導きなど不要ですわ！」: We have no need of your guidance!
BMD\t「孫光龍！ あなた、何様のつもりですの！？」: Son Koryu!/　Just who do you think you are!?
BMD\t「あなた達が護るべきものは、何ですの！？」: What is it you're meant to protect!?
BMD\t「汚名は必ず挽回……いえ、返上しますわ！」: I'll redeem my disgrace... no,/　I'll clear my name!
BMD\t「お助け致します！ 待っていて下さいませ！」: I'll save you! Please wait for me!
BMD\t「あの機体、不吉ですわ……！」: That unit is an ill omen...!
BMD\t「あの黒い機体、嫌な予感がします……！」: That black unit... I have a bad feeling...!
LDBI\t「……南極より出現した敵性体集団ですが、@ 本日より『ルイーナ』と呼: ...As of today, the hostile group that emerged@from Antarctica has been officially designated@Ruina.
LDBI\t「なお、ルイーナは北極海に戦力を集結させて@ いましたが、ガイアセイ: Also, the Ruina had massed forces in the Arctic@Ocean, but the Gaia Saviors and Earth Federation@Army jointly moved to encircle them...
LDBI\t「ガイアセイバーズ旗艦エア・クリスマスが@ 敵主力を撃破。また、先日: The Gaia Saviors' flagship, the Air Christmas,@destroyed the enemy's main force. In addition,@the barrier recently shrouding the planet...
LDBI\t「ゲストではなく、ルイーナのものと判明しましたが……@ その消去に成: ...proved to be the Ruina's, not the Guest's...@and we have successfully eliminated it.
LDBI\t「今後、南極圏を占拠しているルイーナ、@ そしてゲストに対しても、早: Going forward, against the Ruina occupying the@Antarctic, and against the Guest as well, swift@and effective countermeasures...
LDBI\t「……ここぞとばかり、ガイアセイバーズの功績を@ 喧伝しておりますな: ...They're making the most of this to trumpet@the Gaia Saviors' accomplishments. Presumably to@deflect blame over President Grassman's death.
LDBI\t「仕方あるまい。@ 我々としても、次元断層を消滅させた者が@ 反逆者: It can't be helped.@We can hardly call the ones who erased the@dimensional fault traitors, either.
LDBI\t「ところで、ルイーナという呼称を@ 政府筋にも伝えたのですな？」: By the way, you passed the name Ruina along@to the government as well?
LDBI\t「『アンタークティック・アンノウン』という@ コードネームはセンスが: The code name "Antarctic Unknown" lacks flair,@don't you think? And it's long, too.
LDBI\t「確かに。情報の出所については？」: Indeed. And regarding the source of the intel?
LDBI\t「言っておらんよ。@ こちらの手の内を知られるからな」: I didn't tell them.@That would reveal our hand.
LDBI\t「なお、彼らからの情報提供により、@ 素性が明らかになったガイアセイ: Also, thanks to information they provided, we've@identified several members of the Gaia Saviors.@Here is the relevant material.
LDBI\t「ほう……意外な人選だな」: Oh... An unexpected choice of personnel.
LDBI\t「反体制勢力に所属していた者を起用するとは……@ 反対派にとって、恰: Recruiting those who belonged to anti-government@forces... That gives the opposition ideal@ammunition.
LDBI\t「過去の経歴より実力を重視してのことだと@ 思われますが……追及して: They presumably valued ability over past@records... If pressed, they'll just play dumb.
LDBI\t「それ以前に、グライエン大統領は@ そのことを知っていたかどうか、怪: Before that, it's doubtful whether President@Graien even knew about it.
LDBI\t「まさか、知らずに許可するとは……」: Surely he wouldn't approve it without knowing...
LDBI\t「アルテウル・シュタインベックが@ 真実を伝えていなかったということ: It's possible Arteur Steinbeck never told@him the truth.
LDBI\t「しかし、大統領の件と言い、今回判明した件と言い……@ 反対派が確固: But with the President's death and now this...@if the opposition gets hard proof, it won't stop@at the Gaia Saviors--the government will fall.
LDBI\t「だからこそ、アルテウルの魂胆が解せん。@ あの男は今後のことを深く: Which is why I can't fathom Arteur's motives.@He's not thinking ahead at all... If anything,@he seems to be kindling fires on purpose.
LDBI\t「現時点ではわからんが、答えを導き出す方法はある」: I can't say yet, but there's a way to find out.
LDBI\t「ああ。ガイアセイバーズは彼らを利用し、@ 何かを目論んでいると見て: Yes. There's no doubt the Gaia Saviors are using@them to scheme something.
LDBI\t「今しばらく泳がせ、接触させれば、@ アルテウルの魂胆が見えてくるか: If we let them roam a while and make contact,@Arteur's scheme may come to light.
LDBI\t「しかし、鋼龍戦隊を表立って支援することは@ 出来ませんぞ」: But we can't openly support the Steel Dragons.
LDBI\t「もちろん、追撃命令を取り下げるつもりはない。@ ただし、ジェイコブ: Of course, I have no intention of withdrawing@the pursuit order. However, Jacob... see that@they have a way out.
LDBI\t「ガイアセイバーズへの対処は、@ それだけでよろしいのですか？」: Is that all you intend to do about@the Gaia Saviors?
LDBI\t「民衆の大半は、ガイアセイバーズが@ 次元断層を消滅させたと思い込み: Most of the public believe the Gaia Saviors@erased the dimensional fault, and are coming to@see them as heroes.
LDBI\t「今はやむを得まい。@ あれほどわかり易く、そして全世界の人間に対し: It can't be helped for now.@No feat could be clearer, or easier to show to@the whole world.
LDBI\t「だが、英雄は結果を出すことを常に要求される。@ そして、そこに偽り: But heroes are always expected to deliver.@And if there's any falsehood in it, public@sentiment will turn against them in an instant.
LDBI\t「ですが、それでは我々の面目が……」: But then what of our honor...?
LDBI\t「何もしておらぬわけではない。@ 情報と証拠はジェイコブに集めさせて: It's not as though we're doing nothing.@I have Jacob gathering information and evidence.
LDBI\t「それに、ガイアセイバーズがいかに戦果を挙げようと、@ 数では圧倒的: Besides, however many victories the Gaia Saviors@win, we hold an overwhelming edge in numbers.
LDBI\t「肝要なのは、力の持久だよ。@ 一握りの独立特化戦力では、敵中枢を@: What matters is staying power.@A handful of specialized independent forces may@be able to destroy the enemy's core...
LDBI\t「世界規模での治安維持など不可能だからな」: ...but they could never keep order across the globe.
LDBI\t「連邦軍の面目躍如を期するなら、ゲストへの反攻作戦を@ 急ぎ構築した: To restore the army's honor, hurry and plan a@counterattack on the Guest. With Moon Cradle and@Heaven Gate taken, the Space Force won't hold.
LDBI\t「わかっております。@ 一両日中に作戦概要をまとめる予定です」: I'm aware.@We'll have an outline ready within a day or two.
LDBI\t「作戦名については、いいアイデアがある。@ そちらで勝手に決めぬよう: I have a good idea for the operation name.@Don't go deciding it on your own.
LDBI\t「高名なロボット工学研究者ですな。@ ビアン・ゾルダークの知己で、<: A renowned robotics researcher.@A friend of Bian Zoldark, he was formerly a@member of the <ＥＯＴＩ機関>.

LDBI\t「だから、それが何だってんだ？」: So what's that supposed to mean?

LDBI\t「ええ。グランゾンが存在する限り、地球では@ 通常起こり得ない事件が: Yes. As long as Granzon exists, incidents that@should never occur keep happening on Earth,@and chaos reigns... That is how it was designed.

LDBI\t「言っておきますが、私が望み、仕組んだことでは@ ありませんよ。中に: I should make clear that I neither wished for@nor arranged this. And some of these incidents@surely occurred without any link to Granzon.

LDBI\t「君もそれを目指しているのであれば、@ 君の力を借りることにしよう」: If that is your aim as well,@then I'll gladly accept your help.
LDBI\t「父の搭乗機であったガルガードは、後方の基地で@ オーバーホールを受: My father's machine, the Galguard, was due for@an overhaul at a base behind the lines.
LDBI\t「だからこそ、僕はその直前に@ あの機体を奪取することが出来たんです: That's why I was able to steal it@right before that happened...
LDBI\t「父があれを手放したことに疑問を感じるんです。@ ガルガードは、<魔: I find it odd that my father let it go.@The Galguard is a <魔装機> with the potential@to rival a <魔装機神>.
LDBI\t「後々のことを考えて、@ 温存しておく気だったのではないか？」: Perhaps he meant to keep it in reserve@for later?
LDBI\t「もちろん、そうでしょうが……@ 他にも理由があるような気がするんで: I'm sure that's true, but...@I feel like there's another reason as well.
LDBI\t「例えば、ガルガードを上回る@ 強力な機体が用意されているとか……」: Like, say, a machine even more powerful@than the Galguard being prepared for him...
LDBI\t「！ 超魔装機計画か？@ だが、あれは中止になったはず……」: The Super Masouki Project?!@But that was supposed to have been canceled...
LDBI\t「ヤンロン、ザッシュ！ 何やってんの！@ 早く機乗しなよ！」: Yang Long, Zash! What're you doing?!@Get in your machines already!
LDBI\t「ああ、わかった。@ ……ザッシュ、命を粗末にするなよ」: Right, understood.@...Zash, don't throw your life away.
LDBI\t「前部全主砲、攻撃用意！@ 各機は直ちに出撃！」: All forward Main Cannons, prepare to fire!@All units, launch immediately!
LDBI\t「ついにここまで来たか」: So you've finally come this far.
LDBI\t「邪神の力を利用し、ラ・ギアスを統一した所で、@ 人心を掴むことは出: Unite La Gias with a dark god's power, and you@still won't win the hearts of the people.
LDBI\t「あなたが蛮行を続けると言うのなら、@ 僕達のような存在が現れ、阻止: If you insist on continuing this savagery,@people like us will appear to stop you.
LDBI\t「フッ、マサキ達もそうだったが……@ やはり、魔装機神は私の味方をし: Heh. Masaki and the others were the same...@The Masoukishin won't side with me after all.
LDBI\t「だから、ルオゾールの協力を仰いだのですか。@ フェイル軍に仕掛けた: Is that why you sought Luozorl's help?@And the timing of your attack on Feil's army...@Why would you do such a thing...?
LDBI\t「戴冠式の直前にテリウス殿下が出奔し、@ クリストフ……シュウ・シラ: Because Prince Tellius fled just before his@coronation and was taken away by Christoph...@Shu Shirakawa.
LDBI\t「シュウはいったい何のために@ そんなことを……！？」: Why would Shu do something@like that...?!
LDBI\t「さてな。@ ルオゾールにそのことを問い質したが、@ 与り知らぬと答: Who knows.@I pressed Luozorl on the matter, but he@claimed to know nothing of it.
LDBI\t「なるほど……@ それで、テリウスっていう大看板を失ったてめえは@: I get it...@So after losing Tellius, your big poster boy,@you panicked and jumped Feil's army, huh?
LDBI\t「あの後、姿を消したままだ。@ だが、奴が時間を稼いでくれたおかげで: He's been missing ever since.@But thanks to the time he bought me,@I was able to take delivery of this machine.
LDBI\t「超魔装機エウリード……@ お前もその名を聞いたことがあろう？」: The Super Masouki Eulid...@Surely you've heard that name before?
LDBI\t「かつて、@ カークス将軍が提案し、計画が進められていた……@ 魔装: Once, General Kirkus proposed it and the project@was set in motion... a Masouki meant to surpass@the Masoukishin.
LDBI\t「つまり、<特機>みてえな<魔装機>ってことか」: So it's a <特機> kind of <魔装機>, huh?
LDBI\t「密かに開発を続行させていたとは……！」: So you secretly kept development going...!
LDBI\t「マサキ達との戦いや王都制圧作戦で@ エウリードが間に合っていれば、: If the Eulid had been ready for the fights with@Masaki's group or the assault on the capital,@I would never have been outdone...
LDBI\t「そして、この機体が量産された暁には、@ ヴォルクルスの力を頼らずと: And once this machine is mass-produced,@Langran will wield tremendous power without@needing to rely on Volkruss.
LDBI\t「そういうのを、取らぬ狸の皮算用って@ いうんだよ！」: That's called counting your chickens@before they hatch!
LDBI\t「フン……他にも戦力はある。@ これを見るがいい」: Hmph... I have other forces as well.@Behold.
LDBI\t「あ、あんな物も召喚されていたの……！？」: Th-They summoned something like that too...?!
LDBI\t「そう、手に入れた時は破損していたが……@ こちらで修理を行い、使え: Indeed. It was damaged when I acquired it...@but we repaired it and made it operational,@with future mass production in mind.
LDBI\t「あれは、あたしの親父が開発した@ 究極ロボ・ヴァルシオン……そのコ: My old man developed the ultimate robot,@Valsion... and that thing's a copy of it.
LDBI\t「そんなものを使おうだなんて……@ カークス、あんた、やっぱり親父に: Using something like that...@Kirkus, you really are like my old man.
LDBI\t「ほう、不思議な因縁だな。@ だが、エウリードやヴァルシオンの力があ: Heh, a curious twist of fate.@But with the power of the Eulid and Valsion,@I have nothing to fear.
LDBI\t「どんな悪にも屈することなく、@ 正義を貫くことが出来る……」: I can uphold justice and never bow@to any evil...
BMD\t「ダブルＧ……相手にとって不足はなくてよ」: Double G... a worthy opponent indeed.
BMD\t「ダブルＧの３号機と言えど……！」: Even if it's Double G Unit 3...!
BMD\t「超魔装機……/ その力が如何ほどのものであっても！」: A Super Masouki.../　However great its power may be!
BMD\t「ラ・ギアスの機動兵器……/ その力、見せてもらうわ」: A La Gias war machine.../　Show me what it can do.
BMD\t「邪神ヴォルクルス……/ ここで食い止めなければ！」: The evil god Volkruss.../　I have to stop it here!
BMD\t「ルイーナ……これ以上、先には進ませないわ」: Ruina... I won't let you go any further.
BMD\t「エルデ・ミッテ……/ その妄念、断ち切ってあげるわ！」: Erde Mitte.../　I'll sever that obsession of yours!
BMD\t「エルデ！ その欲望と共に潰えなさい！」: Erde! Perish along with your greed!
BMD\t「あなた達、地球圏から去りなさい！」: All of you, leave the Earth Sphere!
BMD\t「あなた達が何度干渉してこようと……！」: No matter how many times you interfere...!
BMD\t「ゲスト……阻止してみせるわ」: The Guest... I will stop them.
BMD\t「四神の超機人……私が相手よ」: Choukijin of the Four Gods.../　I'll be your opponent.
BMD\t「その翼で私に追いつけて？」: Can those wings of yours keep up with me?
BMD\t「四凶の名に相応しい化け物ね……！」: A monster worthy of the name Shikyo...!
BMD\t「偽りの神には惑わされなくてよ！」: A false god won't lead me astray!
BMD\t「ガンエデン……/ あなたの結界は、人類の進歩を妨げることになる！」: Gan Eden.../　Your barrier will only hinder/　humanity's progress!
BMD\t「ユーゼス・ゴッツォ……/ あなたの悪しき声を砕く！」: Euzeth Gozzo.../　I'll shatter that wicked voice of yours!
BMD\t「どんな漆黒い闇が嘲笑おうと……/ 私が望む結果は一つ！」: Let the jet-black darkness sneer.../　I seek only one outcome!
BMD\t「私を狙ったのが運の尽きよ」: Targeting me was your last mistake.
BMD\t「私に手出ししたことを……/ 後悔させてあげる！」: I'll make you regret.../　ever laying a hand on me!
BMD\t「気を抜くのはまだ早くてよ」: It's too early to let your guard down.
BMD\t「油断は命取りになるわ」: Carelessness will be the death of you.
BMD\t「……くっ！/ 私をここまで追いつめるなんて……！」: ...Ngh!/　To think they'd push me this far...!
BMD\t「惜しかったわね、/ あともう一息だったのに……！」: Too bad. You were/　so close, too...!
BMD\t「機体大破……！ でも、まだ戦える！」: Heavy damage...! But I can still fight!
BMD\t「私のプライドに/ 傷をつけた代償は高いわよ！」: Wounding my pride/　will cost you dearly!
BMD\t「くっ……！/ ここは私が死ぬべき場所ではなくてよ……！」: Ngh...!/　This is not where I'm meant to die...!
BMD\t「彗星の名は伊達ではないわね……！」: The Comet's name isn't just for show...!
BMD\t「マシンナリー・チルドレンを/ 甘く見たつもりはないけど……！」: I didn't mean to underestimate/　the Machinery Children, but...!
BMD\t「アレス・ガイストに捕捉されるなんて……！」: To think Ares Geist could catch me...!
BMD\t「くうっ！ ロフ……油断ならないわね」: Ngh! Rof... I can't let my guard down.
BMD\t「口調と裏腹に攻撃は速い……！」: Despite that tone, he strikes fast...!
BMD\t「くうっ！/ ゲストとの戦いに終止符を打つまでは……！」: Ngh!/　Not until I put an end/　to the war with the Guest...!
BMD\t「こんなことで恐怖する私ではなくてよ！」: This is hardly enough to frighten me!
BMD\t「くっ！/ 油断ならないわね、メリオルエッセは」: Ngh!/　The Meliores Esse are dangerous foes.
BMD\t「コンターギオ……/ 笑っていられるのは、今の内よ！」: Contagio.../　Laugh while you still can!
BMD\t「アクイラ……言うだけのことはあるようね」: Aquila... you live up to your words.
BMD\t「夏喃……私の心はまだ折れていなくてよ！」: Kanan... my heart isn't broken yet!
BMD\t「孫光龍、あなたには屈しない……！」: Sun Koryu, I will not bow to you...!
BMD\t「どいつもこいつもバッサリだぜ！」: Every last one of you gets cut down!
BMD\t「タイマン勝負、どんなもんだ！」: One-on-one! How do you like that!
BMD\t「締めはドリル・アタッカー！！」: And to finish, the Drill Attacker!!
BMD\t「こいつが参式の必殺剣だ！」: This is the Type-3's ultimate sword!
BMD\t「このミサイルは外すわけにはいかねえ！」: I can't afford to miss with this Missile!
BMD\t「頼むから、当たってくれよ！ マジで！！」: Please, just hit! I mean it!!
BMD\t「こいつに気づいた時は、もう手遅れだ！」: By the time you notice this, it's too late!
LDBI\t「私は……ルイーナは、@ あれを破滅させようとしていたのか」: So I... So Ruina was trying to destroy that?
LDBI\t「あの青い輝きを見て、@ 胸に湧き起こるもの……何とも言えない……@: Looking at that blue radiance, something wells@up in my chest... I can't describe it...@What is this...?
LDBI\t「それは……美しいものを見て、@ 感動したんじゃないかしら？」: I think... you were moved by seeing@something beautiful, weren't you?
LDBI\t「グラキエースさんだって、そうよ。@ ショウコが男の子だったら、ほっ: You're beautiful too, Glacies.@If I were a boy, I wouldn't leave you alone.
LDBI\t「うん。女の子でも憧れちゃうわ」: Yeah. Even a girl like me admires you.
LDBI\t「文字通りのクール・ビューティだものね」: You're a cool beauty in the literal sense.
LDBI\t「先程の……ほっとかないな、とはどういう意味だ？」: Earlier... What did you mean by@"wouldn't leave you alone"?
LDBI\t「それはね、イルムさんみたいな男の人が@ グラキエースさんを口説くっ: It means a guy like Irm would@try to hit on you, Glacies.
LDBI\t「悪いが、見込みのない所に突っ込むほど@ 暇じゃないさ」: Sorry, but I don't have time to chase@a lost cause.
LDBI\t「見込みがないって……ああ、なるほど」: A lost cause...? Oh, I see.
LDBI\t「さあ、よもやま話はそこまでだ。@ 第一種戦闘配置だからな、みんな機: All right, enough chitchat. We're at Level 1@battle stations, so everybody get in your@machines. Move it, move it!
LDBI\t「本艦を中心とした半径２０キロメートルの空域に、@ 異常重力反応発生: Abnormal gravity readings within a 20-kilometer@radius of the ship!
LDBI\t「来たか！ 全砲門開け！ 攻撃用意！」: Here they come! Open all gun ports!@Prepare to attack!
LDBI\t「あっ！ ０時方向に高エネルギー反応！@ か、拡散します！！」: Ah! High energy reading at 12 o'clock!@I-It's spreading!!
LDBI\t「ま、間に合いません！ 呑み込まれます！！」: W-We won't make it! It's swallowing us!!
LDBI\t「あの時と同じ……限仙境か！」: Just like that time... It's Gensenkyo!
LDBI\t「その通り。直接会うのは初めてだね。@ まずは、“破滅の王”を封じて: That's right. This is our first time meeting@in person. First, allow me to thank you again@for sealing away the "King of Destruction."
LDBI\t「彼らは僕らにとっても厄介な敵だったからね。@ おかげで大変助かった: They were troublesome enemies for us as well.@You were a great help.
LDBI\t「よく言うぜ！ @ 高みの見物を決め込むつもりだったくせによ！」: Big talk! You were planning to sit back and@watch the whole thing!
LDBI\t「そうでもないさ。@ 君達が“破滅の王”に敗れるようだったら、@ 南: Not quite. If you'd lost to the@"King of Destruction," we'd have marched on@the Antarctic ourselves.
LDBI\t「それに、ルイーナの残党を始末したのは、@ 僕達なんだよ。感謝して欲: Besides, we're the ones who wiped out what was@left of Ruina. You should be grateful, really.
LDBI\t「だが、我々に時間稼ぎをさせていたことに@ 違いはあるまい？」: But there's no denying you had us@buying time for you, is there?
LDBI\t「御明察。俗界桃源郷の枠組みが出来たとは言え、@ 総人尸解計画を実行: Very perceptive. The framework of the Earthly@Paradise is in place, but putting the Total@Human Shikai Plan into action will take a while.
LDBI\t「いや、あと５時間、それとも５日かな？@ まあ、５年ってことはないけ: No, five hours... or was it five days?@Well, it won't be five years, anyway.@Ahahahaha!
LDBI\t「ああ、そうそう。もう一つお礼を@ 言っておかなきゃならないことがあ: Oh, right. There's one more thing@I need to thank you for.
LDBI\t「我らの巫女を丁重に扱ってくれて、ありがとう」: Thank you for treating our priestess so kindly.
LDBI\t「ま、まさか、イルイのことか！？」: D-Don't tell me you mean Irui!?
LDBI\t「あの子をかどわかしたのは、やっぱりお前達か！！」: So it was you who abducted her after all!!
LDBI\t「かどわかすなんて失敬な。@ 彼女はバラルの神の巫女……総人尸解計画: Abducted? How rude. She's the priestess of@Baral's god... the key to the Total Human@Shikai Plan.
LDBI\t「嘘じゃないよ。@ 彼女に“力”があることは、@ 君達も知っているだ: It's no lie. You already know@she has a "power," don't you?
LDBI\t「ならば、イルイはクストースと関係が……！」: Then Irui is connected to the Custos...!
LDBI\t「あの子がバラルの一員だなんて、@ そんなことあるもんか！ あの優し: There's no way she's one of Baral!@Not that sweet kid!
LDBI\t「だったら、どうしてイルイは私達と……！？」: Then why did Irui stay with us...!?
LDBI\t「あの子が私達に接触したのは、作為的な……？」: Was her contact with us deliberate...?
LDBI\t「あ、あたしは信じない……！@ 例え事実だったとしても、あいつらが@: I-I don't believe it...!@Even if it's true, they're the ones@twisting Irui's will!
LDBI\t「どうしても真実が知りたければ、方法は二つある。@ 君達がバラルの名: If you must know the truth, there are two ways.@Undergo shikai in Baral's name and become@immortals...
LDBI\t「お前達を打ち倒し、バラルの園へ行くか……だな？」: Or strike you down and reach the Garden@of Baral... correct?
LDBI\t「そう。@ 夏喃や泰北が何度か君達を説伏しようとしたが、@ どうも聞: Exactly. Kanan and Taihoku tried several times@to win you over, but you don't seem to listen.
LDBI\t「まあ、そういう強い意思を持っているからこそ@ “破滅の王”を退けた: Then again, it's that strong will that let you@drive back the "King of Destruction"...
LDBI\t「俗界桃源郷の護りを固め、大羅天へ至る道を求めて@ 現れる万魔百邪と: Help us fortify the Earthly Paradise and fight@the myriad demons that will appear seeking the@road to Dairaten. We need your strength.
LDBI\t「だが、危険もなかろう。@ 先程も言った通り、私自身も１号機から３号: But it shouldn't be dangerous, either.@As I said earlier, I tested Units 1 through 3@myself.
LDBI\t「しかし、あれが本格的に動いた場合は……！」: But if that thing really starts working...!
LDBI\t「結果を出さねば、前に進めん。@ この遺跡は人類にとって、テスラ・ド: We can't move forward without results.@These ruins could bring humanity benefits@surpassing even the Tesla Drive.
LDBI\t「ここまで来て、ＬＴＲ機構に遺跡を明け渡すわけには@ いかん。それに: We've come too far to hand the ruins over@to the LTR Organization. And this is Ri-Tech's@chance to outdo the Tesla Leicht Institute.
LDBI\t「上手くいけば、この南極からも出られる。@ 機密保持のため、ここへ閉: If it works, we can even leave Antarctica.@We won't be locked away here for secrecy's sake.
LDBI\t「だからと言って……@ 身寄りのない、年端の行かぬ子を@ 被験体にす: Even so...@using a young child with no family@as a test subject...
LDBI\t「日本の特脳研への申し出は断られた。@ いや、上の方で握り潰されたか: Japan's SBRI turned down our request.@Or maybe someone higher up buried it.@This is the only way left...
LDBI\t「クリアーナ・リムスカヤ……@ 高感応力と純真な心を併せ持った彼女に: Cliana Rimskaya...@With her high sensitivity and pure heart,@she is my last thread of hope...
LDBI\t「……まさか、こんなことになるとは……」: ...I never imagined it would come to this...
LDBI\t「クリアーナは昏睡状態に陥っています。@ 海馬に異常が見受けられるた: Cliana has fallen into a coma.@There are abnormalities in her hippocampus,@so she may have memory problems if she wakes...
LDBI\t「だが、間違いなく、あれは動いたのだ……@ 彼女に応えたのだ。そして: But it moved, without a doubt...@It responded to her. And that device showed@a linked reaction as well...!
LDBI\t「え、ええ……教授の予測通り、@ あれはセットで運用する物のようです: Y-Yes... Just as you predicted, Professor,@they seem meant to be operated as a set...@But if our only success is in that state...
LDBI\t「私は諦めん……諦めんぞ……。@ 何としてもクリアーナを目覚めさせて: I won't give up... I won't...@Do whatever it takes to wake Cliana up...
LDBI\t「ようやく新たな一歩を踏み出せたのだ……@ 彼女が我々の希望なのだ…: We've finally taken a new step forward...@She is our hope...!
LDBI\t「ええ……お気づきになりませんでしたか？@ 最近、彼女が独り言を……: Yes... Haven't you noticed?@Lately she's been talking to herself... No,@talking with someone while she's alone.
LDBI\t「シュンパティア０１でのリンク・テストを@ 重ねる度に、その兆候が顕: The symptoms seem to grow more pronounced@with each link test on Sympathia 01.
LDBI\t「君は、０１との接触が原因だと考えるのか？」: You think contact with 01 is the cause?
LDBI\t「その点も踏まえて、精神科医による検査を。@ あの歳の少女をこんな所: Have a psychiatrist examine her for that, too.@We're keeping a girl her age locked up in here.@Of course she's under stress.
LDBI\t「親兄弟、いえ、近い歳の子が側にいるのならともかく、@ この環境では: If she had family or kids her age nearby,@it'd be different, but in this environment...
LDBI\t「危険な兆候です。@ これ以上のリンク・テストは避けるべきかと」: It's a dangerous sign.@We should avoid any further link tests.
LDBI\t「シュンパティアとレース・アルカーナの関連性が@ ようやくわかってき: Just as we're finally starting to understand@the link between Sympathia and Res Arcana...
LDBI\t「彼女のＤＩＤは、重くなる一方です。@ メンタル的な問題の範疇を越え: Her DID only keeps getting worse.@It's moving beyond the realm of a mental issue.
LDBI\t「もう一つの人格……クリスはリアナと呼んでいますが、@ 彼女らは明確: The other personality... Chris calls her Riana,@but they clearly recognize each other, and even@talk the way they would with another person.
LDBI\t「……養子とは言え、娘のことだ。わかっている」: ...Adopted or not, she's my daughter.@I'm aware.
LDBI\t「交代人格のように見えますが、@ 真の意味での多重人格かも知れないの: They may look like alter personalities,@but they could be multiple personalities@in the truest sense, you know.
LDBI\t「しかも、海馬に生じた異常によって、@ 彼女らは初めから自分達がそう: And because of the anomaly in her hippocampus,@they believe they've always been this way.@Their memories have been rewritten.
LDBI\t「クリスは、ほぼ以前のクリアーナと同じです。@ しかし、リアナは好戦: Chris is almost the same as the old Cliana.@But Riana has an aggressive personality...
LDBI\t「第１８次リンク・テストにおいて、@ リアナがクリスを圧倒し、凶暴性: Have you forgotten how, in the 18th link test,@Riana overwhelmed Chris and turned violent?
LDBI\t「いや……。@ 確かに、あの時のリアナは……別人のようだった」: No...@You're right. Riana back then was... like@someone else entirely.
LDBI\t「原因は明らかにシュンパティア０１です。@ あれとリンクする度、彼女: The cause is clearly Sympathia 01.@Every time she links with it, I feel like@she's becoming less and less herself.

LDBI\t「ま……差し引きトントンって所だよ。@ それより、後はあたしに任せな: Well... I about broke even.@Anyway, leave the rest to me.@Dying in a place like this would be lame.
LDBI\t「とか言って、自分だけで儲ける気だろうが」: You just want all the money for yourself.
LDBI\t「あんたを心配してやってんだよ。@ さあ、行きな。三人揃って地上に戻: I'm worried about you, okay?@Now go. What's the point if all three of us@don't make it back to the surface?

LDBI\t「ふふん……@ あいつら、まだ数は揃ってないみたいだね」: Heh...@Looks like they're still not at full strength.

LDBI\t「でも、微妙に形が違うような……」: But the shape seems a little different...
LDBI\t「あたしはシエンヌ・アルジャン。@ シアンと同じ、<ブーステッド・チ: I'm Sienne Argent.@Same as Cyan, one of the <ブーステッド・チルドレン>.
LDBI\t「三人の中じゃ、あたしが一番年上だからね。@ リーダーみたいなもんさ: I'm the oldest of the three of us.@So I'm the Leader, more or less.
LDBI\t「ブロンゾ２７……今はゼオラだっけか。@ あいつらは一緒じゃないのか: Bronzo 27... Or is it Seolla now?@They're not with you?

LDBI\t「アラド達がいたら、どうする気なのよ？」: And if Arado and the others were here,@what would you do?
LDBI\t「ハッ、仲間！？ 馬鹿言うな、あいつらとは@ たまたま同じ所にいただ: Ha! Comrades!? Don't be stupid! We just@happened to be in the same place!
LDBI\t「それに、ブーステッド・チルドレンという@ ブランドを持つのは、あた: Besides, the Boosted Children brand@belongs to us alone!@Those washouts are bad for business!
LDBI\t「アラド達とは訳が違うようだな」: She's nothing like Arado and the others.
LDBI\t「む、むしろブーステッド・チルドレンであることに@ 誇りを持って……: S-She's actually proud of being one@of the Boosted Children...!?
LDBI\t「ま、<スクール>じゃ、@ 色々と酷い目には遭ったけどね……@ 食っ: Sure, I went through all kinds of hell at@<スクール>... but I got the power and skills@to make a living.
LDBI\t「だから、これからは面白可笑しく生きるんだよ！@ 名を上げて、出世し: So from now on, I'm gonna live it up!@Make a name, move up, and rake in the cash!

LDBI\t「カークス将軍……ゴドル・ノーランド少佐です。@ 以前、ラングランに: General Kirkus... I am Major Godol Norland.@I saw you once, back when I was@stationed in Langran.
LDBI\t「私も祖国のため、ここを退くわけには参りません！@ 一命を賭し、あな: For my country's sake, I cannot retreat either!@I will face you, even at the cost of my life!

LDBI\t「ここでの勝敗は決した。貴公にも家族……@ そして、ラングランでの知: This battle is decided. You too have family...@and acquaintances in Langran, I presume.

LDBI\t「ラングランとシュテドニアスだけでなく……@ <ラ・ギアス>全土に秩: Not only for Langran and Schtedonias...@but to bring order and peace to all of <ラ・ギアス>.
LDBI\t（……カークス・ザン・ヴァルハレヴィア……@ 単なる戦争屋というわけ: (...Kirkus Zan Valhalevia...@It seems he is no mere warmonger.)

BMD\t「あまり気は進まんが……/ 戦うとなった以上、躊躇はしない！」: I'm not keen on this.../　but in a fight, I won't hesitate!
BMD\t「悪いな、地上人。落とさせてもらうぞ！」: Sorry, surface dweller./　I'm shooting you down!
BMD\t「おっと、ただでは帰さないぞ。悪いな」: Whoa, you're not getting off free./　Sorry.

BMD\t「ぐうっ！！/ ま、まずい、完全に押されている！」: Guh!!/　Th-this is bad, I'm totally outmatched!

BMD\t「うおっ！？/ ま、まずいぞ……まさかこれほどとは」: Whoa?!/　Th-this is bad.../　I never expected it to be this strong.

BMD\t「やるっ！/ やはりそうでなくてはな！」: Not bad!/　That's more like it!
BMD\t「くっ！ さすがにいい腕してるな」: Ngh! You're good, I'll give you that.

LDBI\t「くっ！@ ヒリュウへ！ こちらジョッシュ！@ 基地が自爆する！ 直: Ngh!@Hiryu, this is Josh!@The base is going to self-destruct! Get out now!

LDBI\t「……お前にはわかっているはずだ。@ 我らに死を、存在の消滅を恐れる: ...You must know already.@We have no fear of death, of ceasing to exist.@Sorrow, anger, hatred--we have none of them.

LDBI\t「お前をここから連れ出す！」: I'm getting you out of here!

LDBI\t「俺を動かしたのは、それを望んだお前の心だ！@ だから、俺は！」: What moved me was your heart wishing for that!@That's why I...!

LDBI\t「……“破滅の王”の力が、僕に流れ込んでくる……@ 僕を殺してくれ、: ...The King of Ruin's power is flooding me...@Kill me, girl with two souls.
LDBI\t「今、僕を殺せば、@ 爆発の規模を抑えられるかも知れない」: If you kill me now,@you may be able to limit the size of the blast.
LDBI\t「何をためらうことがある？@ 君達は、そのためにここへ来た。@ さあ: Why do you hesitate?@This is what you came here for.@Come, quickly. Erase my existence.

LDBI\t「共有する僕の部分が生んだんだ。本物じゃない。@ さあ、早く僕を殺し: The part of me we share made them. They're fake.@Now, quickly, kill me.@Before you both disappear...
LDBI\t「呪縛を解くって……言ったでしょうっ！！」: I said... I'd break your chains!!

LDBI\t「よせ！ やめるんだ！ 君が消えてしまう！」: Stop! Don't do it! You'll disappear!

LDBI\t「……大丈夫だ……身体に問題はない……」: ...You're okay... Nothing's wrong with your body...
LDBI\t「こ、こんなの嫌よ、クリス……！@ ずっと、ずっと一緒だったのに……: N-No, I don't want this, Cliss...!@We were always, always together...!
LDBI\t（もう……隠すことは出来ないか……@ 説明をしなければ……彼らのこと: (I guess I can't hide it anymore...@I'll have to explain... about them...@and about how I feel now...)

LDBI\t「何やねん、それ。@ ジョッシュ、ホンマにこの女は……」: What's that s'posed to mean?@Josh, is this woman really...

LDBI\t「残る奴がいたら、@ 俺達とＧバンカランで何とかする！@ 行くんだ、: If any stay behind,@we'll handle them with the G-Bankaran!@Go, Kota!

LDBI\t「わかった！@ さあ、追って来やがれ！ 忍者共！」: Got it!@C'mon, chase me if you can, you ninjas!

LDBI\t「エレーブ１から各機へ。@ ここは連邦軍の制空圏内だ。時間は掛けられ: Eleve 1 to all units.@This is Federation airspace. We can't dawdle.@Take out the Mass-Production Jinrai fast!

LDBI\t「……連邦軍の哨戒機が頭上を飛び回っておりますが、@ こちらの位置は: ...Federation patrol planes are flying overhead,@but they don't seem to have detected us.
LDBI\t「日本近海で、しかも管轄下だった我々を@ 取り逃がしたとあっては、ケ: If we, formerly under his command, escape him@in waters near Japan of all places, Commander@Kenneth will lose even more face...
LDBI\t「オメガはアルテウル様直属であり、最上位のセイバー。@ そして、私は: Omega reports directly to Lord Arteur. It's the@highest-ranking Saber. And I am Amala Burton.@Remember that.

LDBI\t「アルテウル司令からの命令で、月へ向かう途中だった」: I was on my way to the moon,@under orders from Commander Arteur.
LDBI\t「答える必要はない。@ それより……しばらくの間、ベータ・セイバーは: You don't need to know.@More importantly... for the time being,@Beta Saber falls under my command.
LDBI\t「オメガは最上位のセイバーだと言った。@ アルファ以下に対し、命令権: I told you, Omega is the highest-ranking Saber.@It has command authority over Alpha and below.

LDBI\t「では、命令を伝える。ハガネを追撃しろ」: Now, your orders. Pursue the Hagane.

LDBI\t（こいつ……見透かしたようなことを……）: (Damn her...@Acting like she can see right through me...)
BMD\t「チッ、いい攻撃をする！！」: Tch, that was a good hit!!

BMD\t「や、やはり、隊長の方が/ 一枚上手か！」: I-I knew it... the Captain/　is a cut above me!
BMD\t「くっ！/ このままでは隊長のいいようにやられる！」: Ngh!/　At this rate, the Captain'll toy with me!
BMD\t「ガルベルスもＡＩ１も……超えてやる！」: I'll surpass Garberus and AI1 both!
BMD\t「この程度、牽制にもならない！」: That's not even enough to hold me back!
BMD\t「その程度で、俺を止められると思うな！」: Don't think that'll be enough to stop me!
BMD\t「チッ、サーベラスに食いついてきたか！」: Tch, it's latched onto the Cerberus!
BMD\t「この程度、気にするまでもない！」: This isn't even worth worrying about!

BMD\t「くっ！ よく俺達に当てた！」: Ngh! Well done landing a hit on us!
BMD\t「ホント、後が怖いわよ？」: You'll pay for this later, you know?
BMD\t「さすが、ガルムレイド……頑丈だな」: As expected of the Garmraid... It's tough.
BMD\t「押しが弱いな、ロフ！」: You're not pushing hard enough, Rof!
BMD\t「ゼブ、そんな攻撃で俺を倒せると思うな！」: Zeb, don't think that attack/　can take me down!
BMD\t「ペルフェクティオ！ それで終わりか！」: Perfectio! Is that all you've got!?
BMD\t「メディウス・ロクス……！/ こっちの出方を窺っているのか！？」: Medius Locus...!/　Is it feeling out our moves!?
BMD\t「どうも調子が合わないんだよな、/ あいつは……！」: I just can't get in step/　with that guy...!
BMD\t「そう易々と破滅する気はない！」: I'm not about to be ruined that easily!
BMD\t「こっちは/ バニシングするつもりなんてないぜ！」: I've got no plans/　to go vanishing on you!

BMD\t「あの見た目に/ 気圧されたつもりはないんだが……！」: I don't think I let/　those looks get to me, but...!
BMD\t「ぐっ！/ 怪獣映画のやられ役なんて、御免だぜ！」: Ugh!/　No way I'm a monster movie victim!
BMD\t「あんなのと一緒になるのは嫌だね……！」: I'd hate to end up like that thing...!
BMD\t「ユーゼスめ……/ 色々とほざくだけのことはあるか！」: Euzeth.../　Guess all that talk wasn't just hot air!
BMD\t「チッ……俺の動きが読まれてるのか？」: Tch... Are my moves being read?
BMD\t「うっ！ なんの、まだまだこれからってね！」: Ugh! Nah, I'm just getting started!
BMD\t「ここまでは予測通り。/ じゃ、そろそろ本気を出すか！」: All as predicted so far./　Guess it's time I got serious!
BMD\t「うおっ！ こうでなくっちゃな！」: Whoa! Now that's more like it!

BMD\t「そこは強化してないっつーの！」: I didn't upgrade that part, dammit!

BMD\t「ま……/ こいつにゃ、この程度のヤバさは付き物だからな」: Well.../　This kind of danger comes with this machine.

BMD\t「ハッ！ やっぱりな。/ そんなもんだと思ったぜ」: Hah! Just as I thought./　That's all you've got.
BMD\t「やれやれ、/ 俺もあんまり進歩がねえってことか」: Geez.../　Guess I haven't improved much myself.

BMD\t「ほ～う……/ ヒュッケバインに当てるたあ、やるじゃないの」: Well, well.../　Landing a hit on a Hückebein? Not bad.

BMD\t「こいつの扱いにゃ、慣れてるんでね」: I know how to handle this thing.

LDBI\t「対空対地警戒を厳となせ。@ 敵の本陣だ、何が起きてもおかしくはない: Maintain full anti-air and anti-ground alert.@We're at the enemy's HQ. Anything can happen.

LDBI\t「さあて、いよいよ大詰めか」: Well now, here comes the finale.

LDBI\t「何故、私にそのようなことを？」: Why are you saying that to me?
LDBI\t「無駄口を叩くな、ミオ。@ 相手は曲がりなりにも神を自称しているんだ: Quit the chatter, Mio.@Whatever else it is, it calls itself a god.@This won't be easy.
LDBI\t「あら、あたしは楽しみよ。@ いったい、どんなのが出てくるか」: Oh, I'm looking forward to it.@I wonder just what'll come out.
LDBI\t「そのようなことを仰っておられる場合では@ ございませんでしょう？」: Is this truly the time for you to be saying@such things, would it not be?
LDBI\t「まったくでございませんでしょうのことよ」: Most indeed, would it not be being so.
LDBI\t「ラミアちゃん、うつってるうつってる」: Lamia, it's rubbing off on you, rubbing off!

LDBI\t「ああ、様子を見る。各機、警戒を怠るなよ」: Yeah, we'll wait and see. All units, stay alert.

LDBI\t「つまり、ガンエデン麾下の機動兵器ね」: So they're Gan Eden's own mobile weapons.
LDBI\t「ククル、お前はガンエデンを見たことがあるのか？」: Kukuru, have you ever seen Gan Eden?
LDBI\t「ない。@ 神殿の奥への立ち入りを許されておったのは@ 光龍と、おそ: No.@The only ones permitted into the inner temple@were Koryu and, most likely...

LDBI\t「……妾は、バラルの園で巫女の姿を見ておらぬ」: ...I saw no sign of the priestess@in the Garden of Baral.

LDBI\t「攻撃的ではなく……@ こちらを包み込むような……」: It's not aggressive...@It's like it's wrapping itself around us...
LDBI\t「でも、気を許したら、取り込まれる……」: But let your guard down and it'll absorb you...
LDBI\t（この念の持ち主は……まるで……）: (Whoever this presence belongs to... it's like...)
LDBI\t（何だろう……懐かしさすら感じる……）: (What is this... I even feel nostalgic...)
LDBI\t（ぼ、僕は違う……！ 蝕まれる……！？）: (N-No, I'm different...! It's eating at me...!?)

LDBI\t「動いたか！ 各砲、攻撃用意！」: It's moving! All batteries, ready to fire!

BMD\t「私が後始末をして差し上げます」: I shall graciously tidy up for you.

BMD\t「お姉様、お手伝いさせていただきます」: Sister, allow me to help you.
BMD\t「シュウ様、私にお任せ下さい！」: Master Shu, leave this to me!

BMD\t「お下がりください、私がサポートします！」: Please fall back, I'll support you!
BMD\t「お任せ下さい、私がお護りします！」: Leave it to me, I'll protect you!

BMD\t「では、マサキ。/ 私に助けていただかせ……/ いただき……えーと……: Now then, Masaki./　Please let yourself be helped by me.../　let me be helping... um...
BMD\t「ヤンロン、お助けいただきます」: Yang Long, I humbly receive your help.
BMD\t「……どうして私がサフィーネなんかを/ 護らなくてはなりませんの？」: ...Why must I be the one/　protecting someone like Saphine?
BMD\t「その目に魅入られし者は、/ 断末魔の声を上げる！！」: Those entranced by this eye/　shall let out their death cry!!
BMD\t「では、攻撃させていただきます」: Now then, I shall humbly attack.

LDBI\t「それでも……@ 知った顔が……身近な人がいなくなるのは……」: Even so... when someone you know...@someone close to you... is gone...
LDBI\t「いつまでこんなことが続くのかな……」: How long is this going to go on...
LDBI\t「苦しい状況でも、前に進まなければ……@ 生き残らなければ、死んでい: Even when it's hard, we have to move forward...@we have to survive, or the feelings of those who@died, and all they did, will be buried.
LDBI\t「気休めかも知れないけど、@ 今の私に言えるのはこれぐらいよ」: It may not be much comfort, but@that's all I can say right now.
LDBI\t（そうだ……あたし達は飛ばなくちゃいけない……@ フィリオのためにも: (That's right... We have to fly...@for Filio's sake, and for our own.)
LDBI\t「ここでアルテリオンと遭遇するとは……！@ 運命の巡り合わせとでも言: To run into the Alterion here...!@Is this what they call fate?
LDBI\t「もしかして、@ 今度こそスレイはあたし達の所へ……？」: Could it be...@Sleigh's finally coming over to our side...?
LDBI\t「前回、ＧＲａＭＸｓに敗れたから？@ それで何もせずに……スレイのプ: Because she lost to the GRaMXs last time?@And she'd just give up? You think Sleigh's pride@would allow that?
LDBI\t（でも、単機で来たということは……@ 何か他の理由があるのかも知れな: (But coming alone like this...@maybe she has some other reason.)
LDBI\t「ここで、私達だけで出会うとは……これも運命か。@ あの女の依頼より: Meeting them here, just us... Is this fate too?@Telling me to do what must be done,@rather than that woman's request...
LDBI\t「こちらへ向かって来る敵は、@ 私と鋼龍戦隊が引き受ける」: The Steel Dragons and I will take on@the enemies heading our way.
LDBI\t「大将自ら出撃かよ。いい度胸じゃねえか」: The big boss is heading out himself? Gutsy.
LDBI\t「あの魔装機、カッコいいッスね。@ 腕が４本もあるし」: That Masoukin's pretty cool, huh?@It's got four whole arms!
LDBI\t「見た目はグランヴェールに似ているな」: It looks a lot like the Granveil.
LDBI\t「ガルガードの性能は、魔装機神に迫るものがあるが……@ 設計思想は僕: The Galguard nearly matches a Masoukishin...@but its design is closer to the Cybuster's@than to my own unit's.
LDBI\t「来やがったな！ 行くぜ、野郎共！」: Here they come! Let's go, boys!
LDBI\t「ちょっと！ 野郎で一括りにしないでよ！」: Hey! Don't lump us all in as boys!
LDBI\t（鋼龍戦隊……その力、直に見せてもらおうか）: (Steel Dragons... Let me see your power firsthand.)
LDBI\t「敵機接近！ １時方向より真っ直ぐ！@ 数は４！」: Enemy units approaching! Straight in from@1 o'clock! Four of them!
LDBI\t「ヘッ、出遅れちまったぜ。@ だが、そのおかげでいい獲物にありつけた: Heh, guess I'm late to the party.@But thanks to that, I've landed some nice prey.
LDBI\t「何だ、あいつ……魔装機にゃ見えねえな。@ 地上の機体か？」: What's that thing... Doesn't look like a@Masoukin. Is it from the surface?
LDBI\t「ですが、該当するデータはありませんよ！」: But there's no matching data on it!
LDBI\t「いよう。@ てめえら、鋼龍戦隊だろ。噂は聞いてるぜ」: Yo.@You're the Steel Dragons, huh?@I've heard all about you.
LDBI\t「あんた、地上人だね！？」: You're from the surface world, aren't you!?
LDBI\t「ああ、俺はシアン・アルジャン。@ <ブーステッド・チルドレン>さ」: Yeah. Name's Cyan Argent.@I'm one of the <ブーステッド・チルドレン>.
LDBI\t「ああ。だが、俺をブロンゾ２８や２７みたいな@ 格下と一緒にすんなよ: Yeah. But don't lump me in with small fry@like Bronzo 28 and 27.
LDBI\t「俺はアルジャン・クラス……@ アウルム１が死んだ今となっちゃ、@: I'm Argent class... and now that Aurum 1's@dead, that makes me the number one@Boosted Child.
LDBI\t「アラド達から他に生き残りがいると@ 聞いていたが……」: Arado and the others said there were other@survivors, but...
LDBI\t「もしや、彼らも<リマコン>を受けて……！？」: Could they be under <リマコン> as well...!?
LDBI\t「おいおい、薬漬けだった連中と一緒にすんなよ。@ 俺はこの稼業が性に: Hey, hey, don't lump me in with those junkies.@This line of work just suits me.
LDBI\t「それに、この世界にいた方が稼げそうだしな。@ しかも、相手がてめえ: Besides, I'll probably make more money here.@And if you're my opponents, even better.
LDBI\t「お前はどこの所属だ？ @ 連邦軍には見えん……<ノイエＤＣ>の残党: Who do you belong to? You're not Federation...@Are you a <ノイエＤＣ> remnant?
LDBI\t「今はシュテドニアス軍に雇われてる。@ 地上での所属を教えるつもりは: Right now, I'm on Schtedonias's payroll.@Not telling you who I'm with up top, though.
LDBI\t「じゃ、ノイエＤＣの残党で構わんぜ？@ がっぽり稼げりゃ、どこでも構: Then call me a Neue DC remnant, fine by me.@As long as the money's good, I don't care who.
LDBI\t「アラド達とは随分感じが違うな……」: He's a lot different from Arado and the others...
LDBI\t「所詮、あいつらは欠陥品さ。@ ブーステッド・チルドレンとして@ 本: In the end, they're just defective goods.@I'm what a Boosted Child is supposed@to be.
LDBI\t「知ったことか！@ あたしらに喧嘩を売るってんなら、@ 買ってやるぜ: Like I care!@If you wanna pick a fight with us,@we'll take you on!
LDBI\t「ヘッ……鋼龍戦隊を仕留めたとなりゃ、@ 地上に戻っても俺達は勝ち組: Heh... If we take down the Steel Dragons,@we'll be winners even back on the surface.
LDBI\t「他の連中には悪いが、手柄をいただく。@ てめえらには負け組になって: Sorry to the others, but the glory's mine.@You lot get to be the losers.@Brace yourselves!
LDBI\t「戦域内の敵機反応、消えました。@ 他の敵部隊も撤退を開始したようで: Enemy signals in the combat area are gone.@The other enemy units appear to be withdrawing.
LDBI\t「敵の本当の目的は、陽動……？」: Was the enemy's real objective a diversion...?
LDBI\t「さっきのガキ……@ 色々ほざいた割にゃ、あっさり引き揚げやがったな: That brat from before...@Mouthed off plenty, then bailed without a fight.
LDBI\t「連邦軍でもノイエＤＣの残党でも@ なさそうな感じでしたね……」: He didn't seem to be Federation or@Neue DC remnants either...
LDBI\t「奴の機体は新型のリオン・シリーズだった。@ イスルギ絡みか、あるい: His unit was a new Lion series model.@Isurugi's involved, or else...
LDBI\t「それ、小耳に挟んだことあるけど……何なの？」: I've heard that name in passing... What is it?
LDBI\t「連邦政府大統領の直轄組織で、@ 新型兵器の開発やテストを行っている: It's an organization under the Federation@President's direct command. Apparently they@develop and test new weapons.
LDBI\t「そして、その本拠地はグランド・クリスマス……@ かつて、アイドネウ: And its headquarters is Grand Christmas...@the place once called Aidoneus Island.
LDBI\t「そこは周辺海域が封鎖されている上、@ 島一帯が特殊シェードで覆われ: The surrounding waters are sealed off, and the@whole island is covered by a special shade,@so even Satellite Seekers can't see it.
LDBI\t「……色々とキナ臭い噂を聞くな」: ...I've heard a lot of shady rumors about it.
LDBI\t（親父の……かつての<ディバイン・クルセイダーズ>の@ 本拠地がそん: (Dad's base... the old <ディバイン・クルセイダーズ> HQ...@It's turned into something like that...)
LDBI\t「何にせよ、ラ・ギアスにいたんじゃ、@ 調べようがねえぜ」: Either way, we can't look into it@from down here in La Gias.
LDBI\t「……カークス将軍、よろしいですか？」: ...General Kirkus, may I have a moment?
LDBI\t「話があるのなら、後にしてもらおう。@ 我々はこのまま撤退した敵部隊: If you've something to say, it can wait.@We're pursuing the retreating enemy now.
LDBI\t「このトロイアからシュテドニアス軍を一掃し、@ 我らの力を示さねばな: We must purge Schtedonias's forces from Troia@and show our strength. All to end this war@with them as quickly as possible.
LDBI\t「レフィーナ大佐、引き続き協力を頼みたい」: Colonel Lefina, I'd ask for your continued help.
LDBI\t「あたしらに喧嘩を吹っ掛けて、@ ただで済むと思うなよ！」: You think you can pick a fight with us@and get away with it!?
LDBI\t「おーおー、年増は怖いな」: Ooh, scary. Old hags are the worst.
LDBI\t「誰が年増だっ！@ ガキが生意気なことを言ってんじゃねえ！！」: Who're you calling old!?@Don't get smart with me, you brat!!
LDBI\t「てめえの機体、もしかしてリオン・シリーズか！？」: Is your unit one of the Lion series!?
LDBI\t「そうだ！@ こいつはケルベリオンってんだ、覚えときな！」: That's right!@This baby's called the Kerberion. Remember it!
LDBI\t「と言っても、ここで死んだら意味ねえけどなぁ！」: Not that it'll matter if you die here!
LDBI\t「てめえ、あのＡＴＸチームの隊長だろ？@ キョウスケ・ナンブだな？」: You're the leader of that ATX Team, right?@Kyosuke Nanbu?
LDBI\t「ＡＴＸチームは極上の獲物だからな！@ 仕留めりゃ、儲かるんだよ！」: The ATX Team is prime prey!@Bag you, and I hit the jackpot!
BMD\t「ルイーナ……破滅の軍勢か」: Ruina... The legions of ruin, then.
BMD\t「ルイーナの好きにはやらせん」: I won't let Ruina have their way.
BMD\t「エルデ・ミッテ……/ お前一人で自滅への道を歩むがいい」: Erde Mitte... You may walk the road/　to self-destruction alone.
BMD\t「オール・イン・ワン……/ そのような結果を招くわけにはいかん！」: All-in-One.../　I cannot allow such an outcome!
BMD\t「忌むべき来訪者よ、地球圏より去れ！」: Accursed visitors, begone from/　the Earth Sphere!
BMD\t「インスペクターと同じ運命を辿っていただく」: You will share the Inspectors' fate.
BMD\t「結局、お前達は力に訴えるのか……！」: In the end, you resort to force...!
BMD\t「いかに強固な盾を持っていようと……！」: No matter how sturdy your shield...!
BMD\t「四神の超機人……我らに仇なすのであれば！」: Four Gods Choukijin... if you stand/　against us, then so be it!
BMD\t「四凶の超機人……手合わせ願おうか」: Four Fiends Choukijin.../　I would ask for a bout.
BMD\t「お前達がもたらす凶事、/ 払拭させていただく！」: The calamity you bring,/　I shall sweep away!
BMD\t「疾れ、トロンベ！ 凶風より速く！」: Fly, Trombe! Faster than the evil wind!
BMD\t「その黒き衣を振り払う！」: I shall tear away that black mantle!
BMD\t「トロンベよ、デモンを蹴散らすぞ」: Trombe, let us scatter the Demons!
BMD\t「行く手を阻むか、デモン！」: You would bar my way, Demon?
BMD\t「人類は、/ お前のような神など必要としていない！」: Humanity has no need/　of a god like you!
BMD\t「お前のような神にすがらねばならぬほど、/ 我らは脆弱な存在ではない！: We are not so frail that we must/　cling to a god such as you!
BMD\t「ユーゼスよ、迷妄の世界へと消えるがいい！」: Euzeth, vanish into/　the realm of delusion!
BMD\t「ユーゼス……/ お前の呪われた輪廻、ここで断ち切る！」: Euzeth.../　I will sever your cursed cycle here!
BMD\t「相応の返礼をさせてもらおう！」: Let me repay you in kind!
BMD\t「トロンベよ、勝負はここからだ！」: Trombe, the real fight begins now!
BMD\t「お前に我がトロンベを/ 止めることが出来るか……？」: Do you have what it takes/　to stop my Trombe...?
BMD\t「調子に乗るのは遠慮してもらおうか！」: I'll have to ask you not to get cocky!
BMD\t「くうっ……！/ トロンベが落とされるとは……！」: Ngh...!/　To think Trombe would be downed...!
BMD\t「面白い……！/ 私をここまで追い詰めるとはな」: Interesting...!/　To think you'd push me this far.
BMD\t「ぐうっ……！/ 私が死すべき場所は、ここではない……！」: Gah...!/　This is not where I am meant to die...!
BMD\t「フッ……まだ我が妻の下へ/ 逝くわけにはいかんのでな」: Heh... I can't join my wife/　in the beyond just yet.
BMD\t「まだだ……！ まだクロガネは沈まん！」: Not yet...! The Kurogane won't sink yet!
BMD\t「ひるむな！ 各砲座、各個に敵を狙い撃て！」: Don't falter! All batteries,/　engage targets independently!
BMD\t「ぐっ……！/ 艦首回転衝角、起動準備！/ いざとなれば、本艦をぶつけ: Ngh...!/　Prepare the bow drill ram!/　If need be, we ram them with the ship!
BMD\t「やるな。/ だが、我がトロンベを落とすには力が足りん」: Well done./　But you lack the power to down my Trombe.
BMD\t「くっ……！/ 相手の力を読み違えるとは……/ 私も未熟ということか」: Ngh...!/　To misjudge my opponent's strength.../　I am still inexperienced, it seems.
BMD\t「どうやら、/ こちらも本気を出さねばならないようだな」: It seems/　I must get serious as well.
BMD\t「フッ……お互い、退路はないようだな」: Heh... Neither of us can turn back now.
BMD\t「左舷、弾幕を張れ！/ 敵機を本艦に接近させるな！」: Port side, lay down a barrage!/　Keep enemy units away from the ship!
BMD\t「フッ……このクロガネに/ 挑んでくるだけのことはあるな」: Heh... Bold enough to challenge/　the Kurogane, and with reason.
BMD\t「被弾箇所をチェック！/ 補助エンジンを使用し、艦体を保て！」: Check the damaged sections!/　Keep us steady on the auxiliary engines!
BMD\t「イグニス、まだ勝負はついていない！」: Ignis, the fight is not over yet!
BMD\t「私を絶望させるには、程遠い！」: It will take far more to make me despair!
BMD\t「パワーもスピードも/ ヒュッケバイン以上か……！」: More power and speed/　than the Hückebein...!
BMD\t「ダブルＧを破壊するために/ 作られただけのことはある……！」: It was built to destroy the Double G,/　and it shows...!
BMD\t「これが四凶の実力か……！」: So this is the might/　of the Four Fiends...!
BMD\t「どうした？ 力を出し惜しむ必要はないぞ」: What is it? No need to hold back.
BMD\t「我がトロンベに命中させたことは/ 評価に値するが……」: Landing a hit on my Trombe/　is commendable, but...
BMD\t「勢いだけで、この私を倒せると思うな」: Don't think momentum alone can defeat me.
BMD\t「この程度の損傷なら、/ 戦闘行動に支障はない」: Damage at this level/　won't hinder combat.
BMD\t「この程度の損傷なら問題ない。/ 直ちに反撃態勢へ移れ！」: This damage is no problem./　Prepare to counterattack immediately!
BMD\t「参番艦の実力、甘く見ないでいただこう」: I'll ask you not to underestimate/　the third ship of the line.
LDBI\t「……なるほど。地上への送還準備が整うまで@ まだ時間が掛かるのなら: ...I see. If it'll still be a while before@they're ready to send us back to the surface,@we can squeeze in one more job.
LDBI\t「それに近いが……@ 我々の仕事は雇い主から預かった機体を運用し、@: Close to it, but...@our job is to operate units entrusted to us@by our employer and gather data on them.
LDBI\t「特に実戦データは高く売れる。@ だから、この世界での戦闘は大きなメ: Combat data sells especially high.@So fighting in this world is a big plus for us.@Not that it means anything unless we get back.
LDBI\t「仕事を引き受けるに当たって、条件が一つある」: I have one condition for taking the job.
LDBI\t「鋼龍戦隊との接触は避けたい。@ 敵味方として鉢合わせをした場合は@: I want to avoid contact with the Steel Dragons.@If we run into them as enemies,@that can't be helped, but...
LDBI\t「同一の作戦に参加するなどして、@ こちらの素性を知られたくはない」: I don't want our identities exposed by, say,@joining them in the same operation.
LDBI\t「……なるほど、貴公らの存在や行動は@ 地上では非合法ということか」: ...I see. So your existence and activities@are illegal on the surface.
LDBI\t「そうだ。@ それと、忠告をしておくが……」: That's right.@And a word of warning...
LDBI\t「ここへ来る途中で見かけたノイエＤＣの連中……@ オレグとか言ったか: Those Neo DC people we saw on the way here...@Oleg, was it? If you intend to use them too,@don't tell them about the Steel Dragons.
LDBI\t「シュテドニアス軍より先に@ そちらへ襲い掛かりかねんからな」: They're liable to attack them before@they even go after the Schtedonias Army.
LDBI\t「……覚えておこう。貴公の条件も了解した。@ こちらから指示するポイ: ...I'll keep that in mind. I accept your terms.@Stand by at the point we designate.
LDBI\t（アラセリ、オレグ……@ はたして、ヤンロン達の代わりになるかどうか: (Araceli and Oleg...@I wonder if they can really replace@Yang Long and the others...)
LDBI\t「ええ。この辺りはカークス軍の勢力圏内ですが……@ シュウやサフィー: Yes. We're in Kirkus Army territory, but...@people like Shu and Saphine are known@to roam about, so caution seems wise.
LDBI\t「ふむ……レーダーで探知しにくい敵がいるかも@ 知れないと言うのです: Hmm... You're saying there may be enemies@that are difficult to detect on radar.
LDBI\t「例えば、ルオゾールなどは隠形の術を使いますので、@ 僅かな手掛かり: Luozorl, for instance, uses a concealment spell,@so the only way to sense his presence@is from the slightest of clues.
LDBI\t「周辺環境の異変や、邪念の気配などです」: Anomalies in the surroundings, or a sense of malice.
LDBI\t「では、<Ｔ‐ＬＩＮＫシステム>を搭載した機体……@ それでいて高機: Then a unit equipped with the <Ｔ‐ＬＩＮＫシステム>...@and with high mobility to boot...@Lieutenant Ryusei's ART-1 is the best fit.
LDBI\t「こちらからはゲンナジーを出しましょう。@ 彼のジャオームも機動性に: We'll send Gennacy from our side.@His Jaohm is also highly mobile.
LDBI\t「了解。@ それにしても、そのジャオームはカッコいいな。@ サイバス: Roger.@Man, that Jaohm of yours looks awesome.@It kinda looks like Cybuster, too.
LDBI\t「こいつはラングランの正魔装機第一号機で……@ マサキが初めて搭乗し: This was Langran's first official Masouki...@and the first unit Masaki ever piloted.
LDBI\t「Ｔ‐ＬＩＮＫセンサーに反応が……！@ この先だ！」: Something's on my T-LINK Sensor...!@Up ahead!
LDBI\t「敵だとでも言うのか？@ 精霊レーダーに反応はないぞ」: Are you saying it's an enemy?@There's nothing on the spirit radar.
LDBI\t「だが、覚えのある感じだ……！@ ＡＲＴ‐１からドラゴン２！@ いき: But it feels familiar...!@ART-1 to Dragon 2!@We might've hit the jackpot right off the bat!
LDBI\t「念のため、確認しましょう。@ 総員第一種戦闘配置。両舷前進強速」: Let's confirm it, just in case.@All hands to battle stations. Ahead full.
LDBI\t「この辺りですか……レーダーに反応は？」: Around here, then... Anything on radar?
LDBI\t「ありませんが……@ 妙な地面振動を感知しております。@ 地震ではな: Nothing, but...@we're detecting strange ground tremors.@They don't seem to be an earthquake.
LDBI\t「振動地帯に威嚇砲撃を試みます。@ ６番主砲、攻撃用意」: We'll fire a warning shot at the tremor zone.@Main Cannon 6, prepare to fire.
LDBI\t「了解。６番主砲、攻撃用意」: Roger. Main Cannon 6, prepare to fire.
LDBI\t「……こちらに気づくとは……@ さすがだと言っておきましょう」: ...To have noticed us...@I must commend you.
LDBI\t「さて、これ以上は隠し切れませんな。@ 術を解きますぞ」: Well, we can't stay hidden any longer.@I shall lift the spell.
LDBI\t「チッ、針路変更が間に合わなかったとはな」: Tch, we didn't change course in time.
LDBI\t「では、カンツォート・ジョグ少佐……@ 私はこれにて」: Well then, Major Kanzort Jorg...@I shall take my leave.
LDBI\t「待て、ルオゾール！@ ……チッ、あの野郎……しかも、@ 俺をフルネ: Wait, Luozorl!@...Tch, that bastard... And he had the nerve@to call me by my full name, too.
LDBI\t「貴様、ルオゾールと手を組んでいたとは……！」: You were in league with Luozorl...!
LDBI\t「それがどうした？@ 勝利を得るためなら、手段は選ばねえぜ」: So what?@I'll use any means necessary to win.
LDBI\t「隠形の術で@ こんな所まで侵攻しているということは……@ もしや、: If you've advanced this far@under a concealment spell...@could you be after the Kirkus main force?
LDBI\t「バレちまった以上は仕方がねえ。@ どのみち、お前らも倒さなきゃなら: Now that we're found out, there's no helping it.@We gotta take you out sooner or later anyway.@So let's settle this here and now!
LDBI\t「各機、直ちに出撃！ 応戦せよ！」: All units, launch now! Engage the enemy!
LDBI\t「奴らを突破し、カークスの下まで行くぞ！@ 心して掛かれ！」: Break through them and get to Kirkus!@Stay sharp!
