BMD\t「グランゾン相手とは少々頭が痛いな。/ だが、先に叩いてしまえば！」: Facing Granzon is a bit of a headache./　But if I strike first...!
BMD\t「グランゾンか。/ 出来れば関わり合いたくない相手だが……」: Granzon, huh./　I'd rather not tangle with it, but...
BMD\t「お尋ね者とはいえ、/ まともに戦うのは危険な相手だ。/ 何か他に策は: He may be a wanted man, but/　he's too dangerous to fight head-on./　Isn't there some other way...!?
BMD\t「紅蓮のサフィーネか。/ ふん、また色々と悪さをしているようだな。/: Saphine the Crimson, huh./　Hmph, still up to no good, I see./　I'll bring you to justice!
BMD\t「お尋ね者のサフィーネが！/ 貴様を倒して、その賞金で遊び倒してやる！: It's the wanted Saphine!/　I'll beat you and party on the bounty!
BMD\t「我がシュテドニアスでも、/ 貴様の悪名は届いているぞ。/ 神妙にお縄: Word of your infamy has reached/　even our Schtedonias!/　Surrender quietly!
BMD\t「ラングランに与する地上人め！/ 容赦はせんぞ！」: Surface dweller in league with Langran!/　I'll show you no mercy!
BMD\t「そこをどけ、地上人！」: Out of my way, surface dweller!
BMD\t「地上のメカに後れは取らん！」: I won't lose to surface machines!
BMD\t「地上のメカがいかほどのものか、/ 見せてもらおうか！」: Let's see what a surface machine/　is capable of!
BMD\t「ふん、壊し甲斐のある奴だな！」: Hmph, this one'll be fun to break!
BMD\t「魔装機神だか何だか知らんが、/ 先に落としてしまえば、恐るるに足りん: I don't care about any Masoukishin!/　If I shoot it down first,/　there's nothing to fear!
BMD\t「サイバスターか……/ あのような力を造り上げるとは/ ラングランめ！: Cybuster, huh.../　To think Langran could create/　such power! Damn them!
BMD\t「魔装機神といえども、先に潰してしまえば、/ 恐れることもあるまい！」: Masoukishin or not, if I crush it first,/　there's nothing to fear!
BMD\t「ガッデスか……相手にとって不足はない！/ 思い切りやらせてもらうぞ！: Gaddess, huh... A worthy opponent!/　I'll go all out!
BMD\t「確か、ガッデスは女が操者だったな。/ だが、手加減はせんぞ！」: If I recall, Gaddess's pilot is a woman./　But I won't hold back!
BMD\t「ガッデスとて万能ではあるまい。/ 先に落としてしまえば、/ どうとい: Even Gaddess can't be invincible./　If I shoot it down first,/　it's nothing to worry about!
BMD\t「グランヴェールか……面白い！/ 力比べといこうか！」: Granveil, huh... Interesting!/　Let's have a contest of strength!
BMD\t「グランヴェールのパワーは脅威だが、/ 先手を取れば勝機はある！」: Granveil's power is a threat, but/　if I strike first, I can win!
BMD\t「攻撃力が売り物の魔装機神なら、/ そいつを使えなくしちまえば/ いい: A Masoukishin built on firepower?/　Then I just gotta take that away,/　simple as that!
BMD\t「お返しさせてもらうぞ！」: I'll pay you back for that!
BMD\t「受けた分はきっちり返す！」: I'll return every bit of what I took!
BMD\t「ただで済むと思ったかよ！」: Think you'd get away with that!?
BMD\t「まだだ！/ 今度はこっちから行くぞ！」: Not yet!/　Now it's my turn!
BMD\t「今ので倒せなかった、てめえの負けだ！」: You couldn't finish me--now you lose!
BMD\t「ぐはぁっ！？/ な、なんの……やらせん！！」: Gahh!?/　N-Not yet... I won't let you!!
BMD\t「ぐへぇっ！？ お、おい、嘘だろ！？/ あんな小娘に/ 好き勝手やられ: Gueh!? H-Hey, you're kidding!?/　Being pushed around/　by some little girl...!
BMD\t「ぎへぇっ！！ マ、マジか……/ あの細身の機体の/ どこにそんなパワ: Gyeh!! S-Seriously.../　Where does that slender unit/　get all that power...
BMD\t「ぐあぁぁっ！！ ま、まずい……/ まともにやり合っちゃ、/ グランゾ: Guaahh!! Th-This is bad.../　Fighting Granzon head-on/　puts me at a disadvantage.
BMD\t「ぬわにぃぃぃ！？/ サフィーネ、てめえ……やりやがったなっ！」: Whaaat!?/　Saphine, you... You've done it now!
BMD\t「ち、地上人の好きにさせるわけには……！」: I-I can't let surface dwellers/　have their way...!
BMD\t「ええい、やはり地上人は厄介だな！！」: Blast it, surface dwellers are trouble!!
BMD\t「がああっ！？/ や、やべぇ……サイバスターってのは/ ここまでパワー: Gaahh!?/　Cr-Crap... I didn't know Cybuster/　had this kind of power...
BMD\t「ぎええっ！！ く、くそっ！/ ガッデスがここまでやるたぁな……/ 見: Gyeehh!! D-Damn it!/　Never thought Gaddess was this good.../　I underestimated it.
BMD\t「ぐはああっ！！/ う、噂に違わぬ、とんでもねえパワーだな、/ グラン: Gwahh!!/　Y-You're as insanely strong as they say,/　Granveil!
BMD\t「み、見かけ以上の/ パワーじゃねえかっ！！」: Th-There's more power/　than it looks!!
BMD\t「何て速さだ、動きが見えん！」: So fast... I can't see it move!
LDBI\t「ゼイドラムでバラン＝シュナイルを@ 倒すことなど出来ん。私に刃向か: A Zeidram can't defeat the Baran-Schneil.@Die regretting that you ever defied me.
LDBI\t「後悔するのは、今までお前に荷担していたことだ。@ この戦いで全てが: What I regret is ever having sided with you.@This fight won't settle everything, but...
LDBI\t「全力を尽くし、お前を討ち取る！@ でなければ、俺は先へ進めん！」: I'll give it my all and strike you down!@If I don't, I can never move forward!
LDBI\t「部下の不始末は、上官である私が処理せねばな」: As their superior, it falls to me@to clean up after my subordinates.
LDBI\t「それはこっちの台詞よ！@ 地球人じゃなく、ゾヴォーク人の手で@ あ: That's my line!@Not an Earthling, but a Zovorg@will be the one to bring you down!
LDBI\t「や～れやれ、@ バラン＝シュナイルと戦うことになるとはね」: Well, well...@Never thought I'd be fighting the Baran-Schneil.
LDBI\t「今更悔いても遅い。死の制裁を下してやる」: Your regrets come too late.@I sentence you to death.
LDBI\t「後悔しているのは、そっちじゃないか？@ この情勢、もう覆せないぜ」: Aren't you the one with regrets?@The tide's turned. You can't reverse it now.
LDBI\t「グランゾンと言えど、@ このバラン＝シュナイルには歯が立たんぞ」: Not even the Granzon@can stand up to the Baran-Schneil.
LDBI\t「ゲストから提供された技術だけを@ 用いていれば、そうかも知れません: That might be true if I had used only@the technology the Guests provided...
LDBI\t「私のグランゾンは、あなたが想像もつかない力を@ 秘めているのです」: My Granzon harbors power beyond anything@you could imagine.
LDBI\t「もっとも、@ それをお見せする必要はなさそうですがね、ククク」: Though it seems I won't need@to show it to you. Heh heh heh...
LDBI\t「さて、いよいよ大詰めだな、ゼゼーナン。@ そんな物を持ち出したとこ: Well, this is the finale, Zezenan.@Breaking that thing out won't give you a chance.
LDBI\t「フン……己の力を知らぬ者は哀れだな」: Hmph... How pitiful, those who don't@know the limits of their own strength.
LDBI\t「その台詞もそっくり返してやるよ！」: I'll throw that line right back at you!
LDBI\t「その機体に使われている技術は、@ 我ら由来の物ではない」: The technology used in that machine@did not originate with us.
LDBI\t「エアロゲイターがてめえらと違うってことぐらい、@ 知ってるぜ！」: I already know the Aerogators@aren't the same as you bastards!
LDBI\t「では、彼らの正体がどのようなものか、@ わかっているのか？」: Then do you understand@what they truly are?
LDBI\t「私はまだ諦めていない。@ サイバスター……その技術を我が物とする」: I have not given up yet.@Cybuster... I will make its technology my own.
LDBI\t「てめえは魔装機神の何たるかをわかっちゃいねえ。@ 似たような物は作: You don't get what a Masoukishin really is.@You might copy something like it,@but you'll never make the real thing!
LDBI\t「そのメカが大口を叩くほどの力を持ってるか、@ 俺に見せてみやがれ！: Let's see if that machine's got the power@to back up all that big talk!
LDBI\t「フン、小猿が……後悔するだけでは済まんぞ」: Hmph, you little monkey... Regret will be@the least of your worries.
LDBI\t「あたしは銀河を飛んでみせる！@ あんたを……全てを乗り越えて！」: I'm going to fly across the galaxy!@Past you... past everything!
LDBI\t「貴様ら猿共の進出を誰が許すか！@ 災いの芽はここで摘んでおく！」: As if we'd let you monkeys spread!@I'll nip this menace in the bud here and now!
LDBI\t「お前のような偏見の権化に@ 兄様と我々の夢を妨げることは出来ない！: A paragon of bigotry like you will never@stand in the way of my brother's dream and ours!
LDBI\t「猿が夢を語るか！ 笑わせるな！」: Monkeys talking about dreams!?@Don't make me laugh!
LDBI\t「さんざん猿呼ばわりしてるけどさ、@ 惑星とか軍団とかが付いたら、侮: You keep calling us monkeys and all, but@once it's Planet of the Apes or an ape army,@they're nothing to sneeze at, y'know?
LDBI\t「ちなみに、あたしはチンパンジーの方でよろしく！」: By the way, put me down as the chimpanzee!
LDBI\t「だから、何の話なのだ！」: Just what are you talking about!?
LDBI\t「ば、馬鹿な！ あんな下等生物共に！@ 猿ごときに！ 何故だ！？」: Im-Impossible! Beaten by those lower lifeforms!@By mere monkeys! How!?
LDBI\t「バラン＝シュナイルに取り付く！@ 道を空けてくれ！」: I'm going to latch onto the Baran-Schneil!@Clear a path for me!
LDBI\t「実は、戦闘になっても@ 可能な限りゼゼーナンを生かして@ 連行しろ: Truth is, I was told to take Zezenan@alive if at all possible,@even if it came to a fight.
LDBI\t「余罪を追及し、真相を明らかにするためさ。@ それに、ここで奴が死ん: To probe his other crimes and get the truth.@Besides, if he dies here, even more facts@will be buried in the dark.
LDBI\t「さ、猿共の情けを受け……@ 貴様のように生き恥を晒す気などない……: I-I will not accept mercy from monkeys...@and live on in disgrace like you...!!
LDBI\t「ふざけるな！@ お前には諸々の責任をきっちり取ってもらう！」: Like hell!@You'll answer for everything you've done!
LDBI\t「こ、こいつ！ 自爆装置を！？@ みんな、奴から離れろ！」: Th-This guy! A self-destruct device!?@Everyone, get away from him!
LDBI\t「お、覚えておくがいい、メキボス！@ 貴様も枢密院も、私の計画を阻止: R-Remember this, Mekibos!@You and the Privy Council will surely live to@regret thwarting my plans!!
LDBI\t「いいか、地球は間違いなく銀河の病巣だ！@ 今のあの星を見ろ！ 人外: Mark my words, Earth is a cancer on the galaxy!@Look at that planet now!@It's being eaten away by inhuman things!
LDBI\t「猿共だけではない！@ 地球から発せられた災いは、@ 必ずや銀河を覆: And not just the monkeys!@The calamities that spring from Earth@will surely engulf the entire galaxy!!
LDBI\t「あの星は呪われているのだ！ 災厄の源なのだ！@ 必ず、必ず後悔する: That planet is cursed! It is the source of ruin!@You will regret it! You will! Mark my words!!
LDBI\t「いずれ、貴様らも私と同じ運命を辿る！！@ 悔いろ！ 悔いろ！！ 悔: In time, you'll all share my fate!!@Regret it! Regret it!! Regret it allllll...!!
LDBI\t（くそっ、計画の暗部を@ あの世へ持って行きやがったか……）: (Damn, he took the dark side of the plan@to the grave with him...)
LDBI\t（プライドを守ったか、あるいはこの期に及んで@ ゾガルの行き先を案じ: (Was it to protect his pride, or was he worried@about where Zogal would end up, even now...?)
LDBI\t（いずれにせよ、@ 散り際だけは潔かったと言っておいてやるぜ……）: (Either way, I'll give him this much--@he went out with dignity...)
LDBI\t「望まぬ結果だったが……@ 地球軍との戦いが終結しただけでも@ 良し: Not the outcome I wanted, but...@at least the war with the Earth forces is over.@I'll call that good enough.
LDBI\t「いや、まだ俺達がいる。@ 指揮官として参戦していたからには@ 責任: No, there's still us.@Having fought as Commanders,@we have a duty to take responsibility.
LDBI\t「ゼゼーナンが死んだ今、@ これまでの責任は全て俺が負う」: With Zezenan dead,@I'll take full responsibility for everything.
LDBI\t「だから、後の者の罪は問わないで欲しい。@ それを約束してくれれば、: So please don't charge the others.@Promise me that, and my head is yours.
LDBI\t「では、その錘としてデルタはいかがでしょう？@ トオミネ博士からも出: Then why not put Delta on the scale as a weight?@Dr. Toomine has requested a sortie as well.
LDBI\t「しかも、今回は本人も赴くそうです。@ 改修されたジンライに対し、@: What's more, he intends to come in person.@He says he has an effective strategy@against the modified Jinrai.
LDBI\t「よかろう、許可してやれ。それも……試練だ」: Very well, grant it. That, too... is a trial.
LDBI\t「ふん……まだ浅い。@ 相手をただ蹴るのではなく、蹴り抜け。@ 地面: Hmph... Still too shallow.@Don't just kick your foe. Kick right through.@Hard enough to bore into the ground.
LDBI\t「よし……次はシミュレーター訓練だ。@ お前のスタイルに合わせたあの: Good... Next is simulator training.@Today, you'll master that technique@tailored to your style.
LDBI\t「休んでいる暇はない。行くぞ」: There's no time to rest. Let's go.
LDBI\t「……アクセルはああ言っておったが、@ 飲み込みは早いのう」: ...Axel may have said otherwise,@but the boy's a quick study.
LDBI\t「ええ……@ しかも、奴はリューネのパワーリストとアンクルを@ 装着: Yes...@And he's piloting the RaiOh while still wearing@Lüne's wrist and ankle power weights.
LDBI\t「下手をすれば、命に関わりかねない……@ よくやっていると思いますよ: One slip, and it could cost him his life...@I'd say he's doing well.
LDBI\t「ホント、驚き……アクセルの面倒見の良さにもね」: Really, it's amazing...@And so is how Axel's taking care of him.
LDBI\t「後は一意専心、一点集中の極撃を体得できれば……@ 奴は新たな段階へ: Now, if he can master the ultimate strike of@total, single-minded focus...@he'll be able to advance to a new level.
LDBI\t「アヅキ、こちらからの警告に対する応答は？」: Azuki, any response to our warnings?
LDBI\t「ならば、迎撃する。@ 前部全主砲、ＶＬＳＭ、攻撃用意！」: Then we intercept.@All forward Main Cannons, VLSM, ready to fire!
LDBI\t「アルファより降下する物体多数！@ 量産型ジンライです！」: Multiple objects descending from Alpha!@They're Mass-Production Jinrai!
LDBI\t「一度ならず二度までも……@ ガイアセイバーズは本格的に@ 僕達とや: Not once, but twice...@Are the Gaia Savers really set on@taking us on in earnest?
LDBI\t「なら、受けて立つ……！@ ジンライを何度送り込んで来ても、@ 無駄: Then bring it on...!@No matter how many Jinrai they send,@I'll show them it's useless!
LDBI\t（フン、出て来たか。これで手間が省けた。@ 後は奴をレンジ内に誘い込: (Hmph, so it's come out. That saves me trouble.@Now I just need to lure it into range.)
LDBI\t（事を確実に成すため、一つ手を打っておくか……）: (To ensure this goes off without fail,@I'll make one more move...)
LDBI\t「……聞こえるか、鋼龍戦隊。@ 私はカオル・トオミネだ」: ...Can you hear me, Steel Dragons?@I am Kaoru Toomine.
LDBI\t「トオミネ博士があの艦に……！？」: Dr. Toomine is on that ship...!?
LDBI\t「ついに本人が出向いて来たか」: So the man himself has finally come out.
LDBI\t「しばしの猶予をやる。@ 私のジンライと娘を返してもらおうか。@ そ: I'll grant you a short reprieve.@Return my Jinrai and my daughter.@Do that, and I may withdraw from here.
LDBI\t「ミナキ……やはり、鋼龍戦隊にいたか。@ 残念だよ。身寄りのないお前: Minaki... So you're with the Steel Dragons.@It's a shame. You had no one, yet I took you in@and cherished you so dearly.
LDBI\t「私の想いを最も良く知っておるのは、お前だろう？@ ビアン・ゾルダー: Surely you know my heart better than anyone.@Ever since Bian Zoldark judged me unfairly@and crushed my ambitions...
LDBI\t「私がどのような想いでジンライを作り上げたか。@ 再起を期し、どれほ: How I felt as I built the Jinrai.@How much I struggled to rise again.@Have you forgotten all of that?
LDBI\t「お前をラボに残したのは、私の誤りだった。@ 私の導きなしでは、道を: Leaving you at the lab was my mistake.@Without my guidance, you'll stray from the path.
LDBI\t「ミナキ、今ならまだ間に合う。私の下に戻れ。@ お前には私という存在: Minaki, it's not too late. Come back to me.@You need me in your life.@You cannot live on your own.
LDBI\t「そして、ジンライは@ 私達の下で運用されるべきなのだ。@ わかるな: And the Jinrai should be@operated under our command.@You understand, don't you?
LDBI\t「で、ですが、ＢＳＫモードは……@ 何故、あのような物を……！？」: B-But, the BSK Mode...@Why would you build something like that...!?
LDBI\t「必要悪なのだよ。ジンライを正しく使うためのな」: It's a necessary evil.@One needed to use the Jinrai properly.
LDBI\t「正しく使うだと！？@ あんたに、そんな台詞は言わせない！」: Used properly!?@I won't let you say something like that!
LDBI\t「あんたは、自分の怨みを晴らしたいだけだろうが！@ ミナキは……この: You just want to get your revenge!@Minaki... and this RaiOh aren't tools for that!@They're not yours anymore!
LDBI\t「ほう、貴様がパイロットか。@ 見た所、軍人には見えん……」: Oh, so you're the pilot.@From the look of you, you're no soldier...
LDBI\t「フッ、やはりシステムＬＩＯＨは良く出来ている。@ 貴様のような者が: Heh, System LIOH is well made after all.@Even the likes of you can@control the Jinrai with it.
LDBI\t「ああ、あのシステムのおかげで@ とんでもない目に遭ったぜ……！」: Yeah, and thanks to that system,@I went through hell...!
LDBI\t「だが、そっちはもう対処済みだ！@ ジンライは雷鳳として生まれ変わっ: But we've already dealt with that!@The Jinrai's been reborn as the RaiOh!@I won't hand it over to you!
LDBI\t「トウマの言う通りです、父様……@ 今という状況で、雷鳳は地球圏を脅: Touma's right, Father...@In this situation, the RaiOh should be used@to save the Earth Sphere from its threats.
LDBI\t「そう思うのなら、ジンライを返せ。@ あれは私の物だ。ガイアセイバー: If you believe that, then return the Jinrai.@It's mine. The Gaia Savers will use it@to strike down the Ruina and the Baral.
LDBI\t「ああ、今までの行動が証明している。@ お前は己の私怨を晴らすために: Indeed, your actions so far prove it.@You'd use the Jinrai to settle your own grudge.@Yes--to defeat our Double G.
LDBI\t「って言うか、そのためにここまで来たんでしょ？」: I mean, you came all this way for that, right?
LDBI\t「ま、待って下さい、父様！@ ジンライを退かせて下さい！@ 今、ここ: P-Please wait, Father!@Please pull back the Jinrai!@Fighting here now won't...
LDBI\t「ミナキ、俺は君の親父さんを止める」: Minaki, I'm going to stop your old man.
LDBI\t「俺のこの手で、親父さんの性根を入れ替えてやる！」: With my own hands, I'll knock some sense@into your old man!
LDBI\t「私の所まで来られるものなら、来るがいい」: If you can reach me, then come.
LDBI\t「ま、実際に行って、確かめるしかないんじゃない？」: Well, guess we'll just have to go and see, huh?
LDBI\t「ああ、奇襲作戦は望む所だぜ」: Yeah, I'm all for a surprise attack.
LDBI\t「ところでさ、ブランシュネージュの@ アルスノーヴァもウェポン・ボッ: By the way, Blanche Neige's Ars Nova was a@Weapon Box Hanger too, right?@What's this new one like?
LDBI\t「アルスノーヴァよりも大きくて……@ 空飛ぶ武器庫だって、クリフが言: It's bigger than the Ars Nova...@Cliff called it a flying armory.
LDBI\t「へ～え……そりゃ、凄そうだな。@ 戦力が増強されるのなら、ありがて: Huh... Sounds impressive.@If it'll beef up our forces, I'm all for it.@And that Exe... Exeg...
LDBI\t「う～ん……そんなに言いにくいかな、@ エグゼクスバインって」: Hmm... Is Exexbein really@that hard to say?
LDBI\t「ああ、それそれ。@ さすが、特盛りバインって感じッスよね」: Yeah, that.@It really does sound like an extra-large Bein.
LDBI\t「いやいや、ブラックホール・エンジン以外にも@ まだ盛る物はあるのさ: Oh no, there's more to pile on@besides the Black Hole Engine.
LDBI\t「まだ秘密。@ 切り札は最後まで取っておくものだからな」: That's still a secret.@You always save your trump card for last.
LDBI\t「単に調整が遅れているだけでしょう。@ 早く仕上げないと、間に合いま: You're just behind on the tuning, aren't you?@Finish it soon, or it won't be ready in time.
LDBI\t「そうなんですが、ジンライの改修を行っている@ ミナキから応援要請が: Well, yes, but Minaki asked me to help@with the Jinrai refit...
LDBI\t「……これでウェポン・ボックス・ハンガーが@ 実在していたら、人手が: ...And if the Weapon Box Hanger really exists,@we'll be short-handed...
LDBI\t「はい……ご心配をお掛けして、すみません。@ でも、僕がマシンナリー: Yes... I'm sorry to have worried you.@But as long as I'm one of the@Machinery Children...
LDBI\t「記憶を取り戻したら……いえ、そうでなくても@ ここにいるわけには…: Once I get my memories back... No, even if I@don't, I can't stay here...
LDBI\t「それは違う……@ 大事なのは、今……過去じゃない……」: That's not true...@What matters is now... not the past...
LDBI\t「私はかつて、みんなの敵だった……。@ でも、そんな私をアヤやリュウ: I was everyone's enemy once...@But Aya, Ryu, and the others@accepted me anyway...
LDBI\t「みんな、私を仲間だと認めてくれた……。@ だから、イングも……」: Everyone accepted me as one of them...@So you can be, too, Ing...
LDBI\t「それは、あなた自身が決めなさい。@ かつてのマイも……そうしたわ」: That's for you to decide.@Just like Mai did, back then.
LDBI\t「イング……お前の素直な気持ちを聞かせろ」: Ing... Tell us how you really feel.
LDBI\t「今まで、僕は……失った過去を取り戻すために……@ 自分の素性を知る: Until now, I've lived to regain my lost past...@to find out who I really am.
LDBI\t「その中で、助けていただいた恩を返すためにも……@ 僕に出来ることを: Along the way, I wanted to do what I could...@to repay you all for helping me...@But I didn't want to die knowing nothing...
LDBI\t「そんな僕でも、居場所があって……@ ガイアセイバーズの一員だったこ: Even someone like me had a place here...@Even knowing I'd been one of the Gaia Savers...@even when I lost control of my psychic power...
LDBI\t「君がマシンナリー・チルドレンであっても、@ それは変わらないよ」: Even if you're one of the Machinery Children,@that doesn't change anything.
LDBI\t「そう……あなたはアーマラやエグレッタと戦って、@ ここにいるんだも: That's right... You fought Amala and Egretta,@and you're here with us.
LDBI\t「ありがとうございます。@ 僕は自分の素性を知って、次に何をすべきか: Thank you.@Now that I know who I am, I think I understand@what I should do next...
LDBI\t「僕が何のために作られたのか、@ その答えを知るためだけじゃなく……: Not just to learn the answer@to why I was created...
LDBI\t「僕を受け入れてくれた皆さんと共に、@ 戦うべき相手と戦いたいと思っ: I want to stand with all of you who accepted me@and fight the enemies we must face.
LDBI\t「でも、もし、僕が全てを思い出して……@ 皆さんの敵になるようなこと: But if I remember everything...@and end up becoming your enemy...
LDBI\t「うん……その時は君を止めるよ。@ 君の命を奪うんじゃなく……助ける: Yeah... Then we'll stop you.@Not to take your life... but to save you.
LDBI\t「では、クルト……イティイティ島を頼むぞ」: Kurt... I leave Itiiti Island to you.
LDBI\t「それじゃ、トウマ……イルイをよろしくね」: Okay, Touma... Take care of Irui for me.
LDBI\t「ああ、留守番は任せてくれ」: Sure, leave things here to me.
LDBI\t「イング、現状ではブラックホール・エンジンと@ トロニウム・エンジン: Ing, for now, using the Black Hole Engine and@Tronium Engine together is prohibited.@Run on the latter as your main power.
LDBI\t「スピードと機動性に優れた機体ですから、@ この手の任務に向いていま: That unit excels in speed and mobility, so it's@well suited to this sort of mission. He has a@navigator with him, so he'll make it back.
LDBI\t「るせえなぁ。@ ちょっとぐらい、いいじゃねえか」: Shut up.@What's the harm in a little fun?
LDBI\t「……ニャんかあっちは楽しそうだニャ」: ...They sure look like they're having fun, meow.
LDBI\t「まだ出て来たばかりだし、敵はいねえだろ。@ やらせときな」: We only just set out. No enemies around yet.@Let him be.
LDBI\t「レーダー・ブリップから判断して、@ 戦闘中みたいだけど……」: Judging from the radar blips,@looks like there's a battle going on...
LDBI\t「くっ、こんなことになるなんて！」: Ugh, I never thought it'd come to this!
LDBI\t「わからない、あたしも初めて見る連中だよ！」: No idea! I've never seen them before either!
BMD\t「いけない、回避できなかった……！？」: Oh no, I couldn't dodge it...?!
BMD\t「各部チェック……/ 問題はないみたいね」: Checking all systems.../　Looks like everything's fine.
BMD\t「雷神よ、来たりて我の敵を討て！」: God of thunder, come forth/　and smite my foe!
BMD\t「百邪斬断、万精駆滅、急々如律令！！」: Sever a hundred evils,/　banish ten thousand spirits!/　Swiftly, as the law commands!!
BMD\t「クスハです！/ 重力衝撃砲を使いますっ！」: This is Kusuha!/　Using the Gravity Shock Cannon!
BMD\t「天に凶星、地に精星……！」: An evil star in the heavens,/　a pure star on the earth...!
BMD\t「慎重にいかなきゃ…！」: Cautious now... I need to be careful...!
BMD\t「出来れば、これで落ちてくれ！」: Please, let this take you down!
BMD\t「カチーナ中尉の足を引っ張るわけには！」: I can't drag Lieutenant Katina down!
BMD\t「生まれ変わったゲシュペンストＭｋ‐Ⅱの力、/ 見せてやる！」: I'll show you the power of the reborn/　Gespenst Mk-II!
BMD\t「このタイプＣなら、いけるはずだ！」: This Type C should be able to do it!
BMD\t「このタイプＣでやってみせる！」: I'll pull this off with the Type C!
BMD\t「何となくカチーナ中尉に似ているような……」: Somehow, it kind of reminds me of/　Lieutenant Katina...
BMD\t「子供だからって、油断は出来ない……！」: Child or not, I can't get careless...!
BMD\t「ブーステッド・チルドレンを/ 甘く見るわけには……！」: I can't underestimate/　the Boosted Children...!
BMD\t「あの男が、/ ガイアセイバーズの総司令官……！」: That man is the Gaia Savers'/　Commander-in-Chief...!
BMD\t「これ以上、戦乱を広げるわけには……！」: Can't let this war spread any further...!
BMD\t「メリオルエッセ……油断は出来ない！」: Meliores Esse... Can't let my guard down!
BMD\t「相手がメリオルエッセでも、やってみせる！」: Even against Meliores Esse,/　I'll show you what I can do!
BMD\t「本当に怖いのは、/ カチーナ中尉のお仕置きだ！」: What's really scary is/　Lieutenant Katina's punishments!
BMD\t「中尉に日夜鍛えられてるんだ……/ そう簡単には怖がらないぞ！」: The Lieutenant trains me day and night.../　I don't scare that easily!
BMD\t「あれが“破滅の王”……/ ここで食い止めてみせる！」: So that's the "King of Ruin".../　I'll stop it right here!
BMD\t「指揮官機相手でも怯むものか！」: Commander unit or not, I won't flinch!
BMD\t「まだ戦う気なのか、ゼゼーナン！」: You still want to fight, Zezenan!?
BMD\t「孫光龍……一筋縄ではいかない相手だ……！」: Sun Koryu... He won't go down easily...!
BMD\t「ガイアセイバーズ、/ お前達の好きにはやらせない！」: Gaia Savers,/　I won't let you do as you please!
BMD\t「反逆者の汚名を着せられたまま、/ 終わってたまるものか！」: I'm not going down/　still branded a traitor!
BMD\t「コックピットを狙うわけにはいかない…！」: I can't aim for the cockpit...!
BMD\t「何とかして助け出さなければ！」: I have to rescue them somehow!
BMD\t「マシンナリー・チルドレンの/ 生き残りがいたなんて……！」: I never thought any Machinery Children/　survived...!
BMD\t「強敵でも一度は戦った相手なんだ……/ 何とかしてみせる！」: It's tough, but I've fought it before.../　I'll find a way!
BMD\t「捕捉できるのか、あれを……！？」: Can I even lock onto that...!?
BMD\t「魔装機とだって、互角に戦ってみせる！」: I'll fight even a Masouki on equal terms!
BMD\t「岩の怪物なんかに負けるものか！」: I won't lose to some rock monster!
BMD\t「何としてもルイーナを退けなければ！」: I must repel the Ruina at all costs!
BMD\t「ゲスト、お前達の好きにはやらせないぞ！」: Guest, I won't let you do as you please!
BMD\t「中尉の代わりに倒さなきゃ……！」: I'll take it down for the Lieutenant...!
BMD\t「カチーナ中尉にも苦手な物があるんだな……」: Even Lieutenant Katina has weak spots...
BMD\t「四神の超機人と言えど、怯みはしないぞ！」: Choukijin of the Four Gods or not,/　I won't back down!
BMD\t「仙人になるつもりなんてない……！」: I don't plan on becoming an immortal...!
BMD\t「強制的な尸解なんて、やらせるものか！」: I won't let you force shikai on me!
BMD\t「そのガード、何としても突き崩す！」: I'll break through that Guard somehow!
BMD\t「虎王機……何とかして止めなければ！」: KoOhKi... I have to stop it somehow!
BMD\t「あれも超機人……！？/ 怪物にしか見えないぞ！」: That's a Choukijin too...!?/　It looks like a monster!
BMD\t「フッ……それで/ このクロガネを沈めるつもりか？」: Heh... You intend to sink/　the Kurogane with that?
BMD\t「厭客に構っている暇はないのだがな」: I've no time to waste/　on unwelcome guests.
BMD\t「口調とは裏腹に、狙いは正確だな」: Your words are crude,/　but your aim is true.
BMD\t「メリオルエッセの力はその程度か」: Is that all the power/　of the Meliores Esse?
BMD\t「それで終わりか、ペルフェクティオ！」: Is that all you have, Perfectio!
BMD\t「ジンライという名は伊達ではないようだな」: Jinrai is no empty name, it seems.
BMD\t「我がトロンベと同レベルの運動性か」: Mobility on par with my Trombe, eh?
BMD\t「エルデ・ミッテ…妄念が増しているな」: Erde Mitte... Your delusion is growing.
BMD\t「ユーゼス……この力、やはり危険だな」: Euzeth... This power/　is truly dangerous.
BMD\t「ほう……私とこのトロンベを狙ってきたか」: Oh? You've set your sights/　on me and my Trombe?
BMD\t「見切るまでもない……」: No need to even read it...
BMD\t「その動き……読むのは一瞬で充分！」: Those moves... An instant/　is all I need to read them!
BMD\t「我がトロンベが、そのような攻撃などに！」: My Trombe won't fall/　to an attack like that!
BMD\t「クロガネでも、これぐらいの芸当は出来る」: Even the Kurogane can/　pull off a trick like this.
BMD\t「その程度の腕で/ 我がトロンベを捉えることは出来ん」: With skills like that,/　you'll never catch my Trombe.
BMD\t「私を甘く見るのは遠慮していただこう」: I'll thank you not to underestimate me.
BMD\t「悪いことは言わん。出直してきたまえ」: Take my advice./　Come back when you're ready.
BMD\t「己の力を生かしきれていないようだな」: You're failing to make/　full use of your power.
BMD\t「相手が悪かったと言うことだ」: You simply picked the wrong opponent.
BMD\t「我が友の真意に気づけ、スレイ……！」: Realize my friend's/　true intent, Sleigh...!
BMD\t「フッ、その口調には釣られんぞ」: Heh. I won't be baited by that tone.
BMD\t「ゼゼーナン、/ お前の野望が成就することはない！」: Zezenan,/　your ambitions will never be realized!
BMD\t「その炎でトロンベを捉えることは出来ん！」: Those flames can't catch the Trombe!
BMD\t「それで私に恐怖を与えようなどと……」: You think that will frighten me...?
BMD\t「ウンブラ、お前が我が血を見ることはない」: Umbra, you will never see my blood.
BMD\t「ペルフェクティオ、破滅するのはお前だ！」: Perfectio, it is you/　who will meet ruin!
BMD\t「ガイアセイバーズ、/ それで私を阻止しようなどと……！」: Gaia Saviors,/　you think that will stop me...!
BMD\t「その翼を以てしても/ トロンベを捉えることは不可能だ」: Not even those wings/　can catch the Trombe.
BMD\t「その翼は見かけ倒しか？」: Are those wings just for show?
BMD\t「四神の超機人は、/ その程度のものではあるまい？」: The Choukijin of the Four Gods/　are capable of more than that, surely?
BMD\t「疾風迅雷、というわけではないようだな」: Hardly swift as wind and/　thunder, it seems.
BMD\t「それでは、インスペクター以下だな」: Then you're beneath even the Inspectors.
BMD\t「ルイーナに手間取るわけにはいかん」: I won't be held up by the Ruina.
BMD\t「破滅など受け入れるつもりはない」: I have no intention of accepting ruin.
BMD\t「お前と一つになる気などない」: I have no desire to become one with you.
BMD\t「ガンエデン……/ お前の呪縛を断ち切ってみせる」: Gan Eden.../　I will sever your hold!
BMD\t「お前が新たな世界の規範になることはない！」: You will never become/　the law of a new world!
LDBI\t「艦周辺に異常重力場発生！@ 拡大していきます！！」: Abnormal gravity field forming around the ship!@It's expanding!!
LDBI\t「龍人機、虎王機の分まで私が頑張るから！」: RyuJinKi, I'll work hard enough@to make up for KoOhKi too!
LDBI\t「合体した四神の超機人の強さは、@ 君が最もよく知っているだろう？@: You know better than anyone how strong@the combined Four Gods Choukijin are, don't you?@Can you still face JakuBuOh without breaking?
LDBI\t「心は折れない、折らせない……そう誓ったんです！」: My heart won't break. I won't let it...@That's what I swore!
LDBI\t「フフッ、そういう心こそ、手折り甲斐があるよ」: Heh. It's hearts like that which are most@worth plucking.
LDBI\t「彼女の気性の激しさは、虎龍王以上だよ。@ 迂闊に触れれば、その炎で: Her temper is even fiercer than KoRyuOh's.@Get careless, and her flames will burn you away.@Now, will you come through unscathed?
LDBI\t「虎龍王や雀武王ほどの速さじゃない……@ 龍人機なら捉えられる！」: It's not as fast as KoRyuOh or JakuBuOh...@RyuJinKi can catch it!
LDBI\t「じゃが、堅牢さは超機人の中でも出色卓抜しておる。@ 龍王が秘器、神: But it's the sturdiest of all the Choukijin.@Not even the Dragon King's secret weapon,@the Shinchintetsu Kinkobo, can shatter it.
LDBI\t「超機人なくして、@ 武雀王の神獣盾を破れるかのう？」: Without a Choukijin of your own, can you@break BuJakuOh's Divine Beast Shield, eh?
LDBI\t「やってみせるさ！@ そして、お前達の計画を阻止する！」: Watch me!@And then I'll stop your plan!
LDBI\t「艦長、現在位置は限仙境へ引きずり込まれる前と@ ほぼ一致しておりま: Captain, our current position matches almost@exactly where we were before being dragged into@Gensenkyo.
LDBI\t「バラルの超機人や妖機人達は？」: What about Baral's Choukijin and the Yokijin?
LDBI\t「見当たりません。@ どうやら、あの鮫に助けられたようですな」: No sign of them.@It would seem that shark came to our rescue.
LDBI\t「あれはいったい何者なのか……。@ そして、何故、私達を助けたのか…: What in the world is it...?@And why did it help us...?
LDBI\t「バラルの超機人に仕掛けたことから判断して、@ 彼らの身内ではないと: Judging from how it attacked Baral's Choukijin,@I doubt it's one of their own, but...
LDBI\t「バラルやルイーナと敵対する新たな勢力……@ ゲストでもガイアセイバ: A new force opposed to both Baral and Ruina...@one that isn't the Guest or the Gaia Saviors...@Could such a thing exist?
LDBI\t「現状では何とも言えませんが……@ 今回の件で、バラルの仙人達が総人: Hard to say at present, but this incident@revealed that Baral's sennin intend to purge@humanity with the so-called Mass Shikai Plan.
LDBI\t「もっとも、それを実行に移すには@ まだ時間が掛かるようですが……」: Though it appears they'll need more time@before they can put it into action...
LDBI\t「彼らはゲストやルイーナ、ガイアセイバーズと違い、@ 何らかの方法で: Unlike the Guest, Ruina, or the Gaia Saviors,@they seem to have some way of tracking@our movements.
LDBI\t「そうですね……@ でなければ、限仙境に引き込むことなど出来ません」: Indeed...@Otherwise, they couldn't have dragged us@into Gensenkyo.
LDBI\t「神出鬼没の上、本拠地も不明……@ 我々にとって、かなり厄介な敵です: They appear without warning, and their base@is unknown... A most troublesome enemy for us.
LDBI\t「しかし、バラルの仙人達は@ 私達を戦力として取り込もうとしています: However, Baral's sennin are trying@to bring us over to their side.
LDBI\t「まあ、あの夏喃という仙人は@ クスハ少尉をかなり気に入っているよう: Well, that sennin Kanan seems quite taken@with Lieutenant Kusuha... I expect he'll show@up again to recruit us.
LDBI\t「ええ……それを逆手に取ることで、@ 何らかの打開策が見出せるかも知: Yes... If we turn that against them,@we may find a way to turn things around.
LDBI\t「ですが、バラルに対しては@ 受け身一方にならざるを得ませんぞ」: Even so, against Baral we'll have no choice@but to stay on the defensive.
LDBI\t「アインストの時もそうでした。@ 私は、私の部下達を……このような状: It was the same with the Einst.@I trust my crew... people who never lose@their Mettle, even in a situation like this.
LDBI\t「しかし、まあ……クスハちゃんも@ えらいのに見込まれちゃったわね。: Still... Kusuha's sure caught the eye of@a real piece of work. Looks like Bullet's got@himself a rival, huh?
LDBI\t「そんな生易しい相手じゃありませんよ。@ 雀武王に武雀王……そして、: He's not someone to take that lightly.@JakuBuOh, BuJakuOh... and KoOhKi.@Three of the Four Gods have turned against us.
LDBI\t「でも、イーブンにするつもりでしょ」: But you plan to even the score, right?
LDBI\t「ええ、必ず虎王機を取り戻してみせます」: Yes. I'll get KoOhKi back, no matter what.
LDBI\t「龍虎王と虎龍王と一緒に戦ってて、四神の超機人の@ 強さはわかってる: Fighting alongside RyuKoOh and KoRyuOh,@I figured I knew how tough the Four Gods were...@but as enemies, they're something else!
LDBI\t「しかも、本物の仙人が乗ってるなんて……」: And real sennin are piloting them...
LDBI\t「我ら全てを異界へ転移させた力は侮り難い。@ もっとも、ルイーナのよ: The power that sent us all to another realm@is formidable. Though unlike Ruina, they don't@seem to intend large-scale destruction...
LDBI\t「彼らの口振りから判断して、@ 総人尸解計画が実行された場合、@ そ: Judging by the way they spoke,@if the Mass Shikai Plan is carried out,@there may be no escaping it.
LDBI\t「全人類に対し、同時に尸解が行われると？」: You mean shikai would be performed on all@of humanity at once?
LDBI\t「ああ。そのため、準備に手間と時間を@ 要するのでないかと見ているが: Yes. That's why I suspect the preparations@will take considerable time and effort...
LDBI\t「しかし……いったいどのようにして@ 全人類の尸解を行うのでしょう？: But... how exactly would they perform@shikai on all of humanity?
LDBI\t「それはわからんが……@ 鍵を握る存在の見当は付く」: That I don't know... but I have an idea@of what holds the key.
LDBI\t「そうだ。@ 夏喃はまもなく目覚めると言っていたがな」: Exactly.@Kanan did say it would awaken soon.
LDBI\t「“破滅の王”は負の波動を糧とする……@ では、バラルの神は何を？: The "King of Destruction" feeds on negative@energy... Then what about Baral's god?@What does it need in order to awaken?
LDBI\t「その答えは、我らの中にあるかも知れない」: The answer may lie within us.
LDBI\t「もしや、クスハとブリット……@ そして、龍人機ですか？」: You don't mean Kusuha and Bullet...@and RyuJinKi?
LDBI\t「それだけではないだろう。@ テスラ研での事件以降、バラルと接触した: Not only them. Since the Tesla Institute@incident, nearly everyone who's met Baral@is in the Steel Dragons or connected to them.
LDBI\t「夏喃の言葉から判断して、@ 彼らは我々の資質を調べていたと思える」: Judging from Kanan's words,@it seems they've been studying our potential.
LDBI\t「それで、私達を真っ先に@ 尸解させようというのなら……」: So if they want us to be the first@ones to undergo shikai...
LDBI\t「ああ。我らは、バラルの目的成就の成否に@ 大きく関わっているのかも: Yes. We may have a major bearing on whether@Baral achieves its goal or not...
LDBI\t「ねえ、イルイちゃん……@ 聞きたいことがあるんだけど、いい？」: Hey, Irui...@Can I ask you something?
LDBI\t「出撃前に、嫌な予感がするって言ってたよね？@ あれって……バラルの: You said you had a bad feeling before we@sortied, right? Was that... about Baral?
LDBI\t「でも……結局、バラルが出て来たから、@ イルイの予感は当たったのよ: But... Baral did show up in the end,@so Irui's hunch turned out to be right...

LDBI\t「だ、駄目だ……！@ このままじゃ、やられる……！！」: N-No...!@At this rate, I'll be killed...!!
LDBI\t「殺される……！@ このまま……過去を思い出せないまま……！」: I'll be killed...!@Like this... never remembering my past...!
LDBI\t（……機体……僕が……使える機体……@ ここにある機体……）: (...A machine... One I can use...@A machine here...)
LDBI\t（グルンガスト参式……龍人機……@ 駄目だ……もう念が定着している…: (Grungust Type 3... RyuJinKi...@No... they're already attuned to others...)
LDBI\t「リシュウ、ゼンガー、貴様らが相手なら尚更のこと。@ 故に、俺は地上: Rishu, Sänger, all the more so against you two.@That is why I returned to the surface world.
LDBI\t「笑止。悪逆魔道の剣で、この俺は斬れん」: Absurd. A blade of wicked sorcery cannot cut me.
LDBI\t「どうあっても退けぬか？」: Will you not stand down, no matter what?
LDBI\t「かつて言ったはず。無意味な題目など、馬耳東風。@ 人血と機油にて己: I told you once: hollow creeds mean nothing.@I slake my thirst with blood and machine oil.
LDBI\t「心配すんな。お前らを始末した後で、@ ルイーナもバラルも片づけてや: Don't worry. Once we've finished you off,@we'll take care of Ruina and Baral too!
LDBI\t「どうしてもおれ達とやるってんなら、@ あいつらを倒した後で相手をし: If you're that set on fighting us,@we'll take you on after we beat those guys!
LDBI\t「命乞いが下手だねぇ、アラド！@ こっちは見逃す気なんて、さらさらな: You're lousy at begging for your life, Arado!@We've got no intention of letting you go!
LDBI\t「誰が命乞いなんかするか！」: Like I'd ever beg for my life!
LDBI\t「……テツヤ中佐、降りかかる火の粉は@ 払わねばなるまい」: ...Commander Tetsuya, when sparks fly our way,@we have no choice but to brush them off.
LDBI\t「やむを得ん……！@ 各機、ガイアセイバーズを迎撃せよ！」: It can't be helped...!@All units, intercept the Gaia Saviors!
LDBI\t「チッ、こんな所で死ねるか！@ この借りは必ず返してやる！」: Tch, like I'm gonna die in a place like this!@I'll pay you back for this, count on it!
LDBI\t「くうっ、やってくれるじゃねえか！@ だが、ここでくたばる気なんざね: Ngh, you've got some nerve!@But I've got no plans to kick the bucket here!
LDBI\t「……連戦だから、この結果は仕方ないし。@ でも、死ぬつもりもないし: ...Back-to-back fights, so this can't be helped.@But I'm not planning to die, either.
LDBI\t「うぬっ！ この“無明”をよくも！」: Ngh! How dare you do this to the Mumyou!
LDBI\t「リシュウ、ゼンガー！ この勝負、預けるぞ！」: Rishu, Sänger! We'll settle this another time!
LDBI\t「次に相見える時は、その首を貰い受ける！」: Next time we meet, your head is mine!
LDBI\t「あらら……剣も速いけど、逃げ足はそれ以上ねぇ」: Oh my... Quick with a blade, but even quicker@at running away.
LDBI\t「ゼンガー！ @ 貴様との死合、心待ちにしていたぞ！」: Sänger!@I've been longing for our duel to the death!
LDBI\t「私欲の剣など、俺には通用せん！@ それほどに剣を振るいたくば、@: A blade of selfish desire won't work on me!@If you crave swinging your sword that badly,@go take on the demons of the underworld!
LDBI\t「ムラタ！@ いまだ人斬りの快楽から逃れられぬか！」: Murata!@Can you still not escape the thrill of killing?!
LDBI\t「剣は人を斬るための物！@ 今、俺の獅子王は貴様の命を絶つために奔る: A sword exists to cut down men!@Now my Shishioh races to end your life!
LDBI\t「リシュウの弟子、そして超機人！@ 斬り甲斐のある相手だ！ 一太刀で: Rishu's disciple, and a Choukijin!@Worthy prey for my blade!@Don't you dare die on the first stroke!
LDBI\t「濁ったその切っ先で、@ 俺と虎龍王を斬れるものかよ！」: You think that tainted blade can cut down@me and KoRyuOh?!
LDBI\t「……おそらく、アルテウルが追撃中止命令を@ 握り潰したのだと思うが: ...I suspect Arteur quashed the order to halt@the pursuit, but I also glimpse the hand of@Marshal Gaspar in this.
LDBI\t「向こうの出方を窺ったのだ。我らを餌にしてな」: They were testing the other side's response.@Using us as bait.
LDBI\t「艦長、覚悟を決めておいた方がいい。@ 我々は南極より先にグランド・: Captain, you'd best steel yourself.@We may be sent to Grand Christmas@before we ever reach Antarctica.
LDBI\t「しかし……今、我々が戦うべき相手は……」: But... right now, the ones we should@be fighting are...
LDBI\t「向こうはそう思っていない。@ 疑問を感じることなく、むしろ嬉々とし: They don't see it that way.@Without a second thought, they'll gladly come@at us with their blades drawn.
LDBI\t「うむ。ガイアセイバーズには@ 我らと因縁を持つ者が多いからのう」: Indeed. Many in the Gaia Saviors@have old scores to settle with us.
LDBI\t「しかし、連邦軍との取り決めを無視して行動すれば、@ 自分達に対する: But acting against our deal with the Federation@will only deepen the suspicion against us.
LDBI\t「そんなことは、もはやどうでもいいのかも知れんな」: Perhaps that no longer matters to them.
LDBI\t「我らとの因縁の精算……@ それがあやつらの本懐だとしたら……」: Settling their scores with us...@If that is their true aim...
LDBI\t「ですが、今という状況で避けられる戦いは@ 避けるべきだと判断します: Even so, given the current situation, I judge@that we should avoid any fight we can.
LDBI\t「それでよい。あやつらの理不尽に対しては、@ そのような心根が必要じ: That is well. Against their unreason,@such a spirit is needed.
LDBI\t「これから先、いかなる敵と戦おうと……@ 星難を救うという大義を忘れ: Whatever foes we face from here on...@we must never forget our duty to save the world.
LDBI\t「さすれば、艱難辛苦の中で@ 必ずや生道、そして正道を見出せようぞ…: Then, amid every trial and tribulation,@you will surely find the way to survive...@and the way that is just.
LDBI\t「クククッ、消滅を逃れただけでなく、@ 我らに楯突くとは。どのような: Kukuku... Not only escaping annihilation, but@defying us as well. How broken must one be@to end up like that?
LDBI\t「だが、これで人間達は@ メリデンプルムの中へ入る術を手に入れた」: But now the humans have obtained@a way into Meridemplum.
LDBI\t「ここへ来ようが来まいが、結果は同じだ」: Whether they come here or not,@the result is the same.
LDBI\t「だが、バラルのこともある……@ しばらくは、守りを固めた方がよかろ: Still, there is Baral to consider...@For a time, we'd best bolster our defenses.
LDBI\t「奴らの結界は、このメリデンプルムを侵蝕できぬ。@ そして、バラルの: Their barrier cannot encroach upon Meridemplum.@And even Baral's god cannot escape@the fate of ruin, kukuku...
LDBI\t「我らと同じく、星を封じた者達だ。@ 侮るわけにはいかぬよ」: Like us, they sealed away a star.@We cannot afford to underestimate them.
LDBI\t（ラキ……俺は壊れたお前を見たくないぜ……）: (Lakhi... I don't want to see you broken...)
LDBI\t（もう元に戻らないのなら、この手でお前を……）: (If there's no bringing you back,@then with my own hands, I'll...)
LDBI\t「……鋼龍戦隊がトーチカ８を襲撃し、@ ＮＶユニットを奪取しました」: ...The Steel Dragons attacked Tochka 8@and stole the NV Unit.
LDBI\t「ふん……まさか、向こうから仕掛けてくるとはな。@ 兵器開発の分散化: Hmph... I never thought they'd strike first.@Spreading out weapons development backfired...
LDBI\t「彼らが現状でそのような決断を下すとは……」: For them to make such a decision@in their current situation...
LDBI\t「後押しがあったかも知れんな。@ だいたいの見当はつくが」: Someone may have pushed them.@I have a fair idea who.
LDBI\t「なお、エリック・ワン博士が@ 行方不明になっていることが判明しまし: Also, we've learned that Dr. Eric Wang@has gone missing. The Steel Dragons may have@taken him, but...
LDBI\t「もし、自ら望んで同行したのなら、@ ＮＶユニットの情報を外部に漏ら: If he went with them willingly,@he may be the one who leaked@the NV Unit's data.
LDBI\t「腹の底が今ひとつ見えぬ男だったが……まあいい。@ 鋼龍戦隊があれを: I never could tell what he was really after...@Well, no matter. If the Steel Dragons use it,@they can serve as a decoy for the Ruina.
LDBI\t「はっ……@ トーチカ８にはメリオルエッセの機体が@ ３機現れたとい: Yes, sir...@We've also received reports that three@Meliores Esse units appeared at Tochka 8.
LDBI\t「早速、引き付けたか。@ それで……鋼龍戦隊がルイーナを撃退したのか: They've drawn them in already.@So, did the Steel Dragons repel the Ruina?
LDBI\t「ええ。その後、我が方の追撃を振り切り、@ 行方をくらませました。し: Yes. Then they shook off our pursuit@and vanished. However, we have a fair idea@of where they're currently based.
LDBI\t「そうか。@ では、どのセイバーを送り込むか……」: I see.@Then, which Saber shall we send...
LDBI\t「ドゥバンとトオミネ博士から、@ 何度か出撃要請がありました」: Duban and Dr. Tohmine have both@requested to sortie several times.
LDBI\t「トオミネ博士はわかるが……何故、ドゥバンが？」: Dr. Tohmine I understand... But why Duban?
LDBI\t「彼はアインストのコアを欲しています。@ レッド・オーガが鋼龍戦隊と: He wants an Einst core. The Red Ogre has been@in contact with the Steel Dragons, so he thinks@they may lead him to it.
LDBI\t「ああ……アーマラからそのような報告を受けたな。@ それで宿命から逃: Ah... Amala did report something of the sort.@Does he hope to escape his fate that way?
LDBI\t「本人はそのことを知らぬはずですが……」: He shouldn't be aware of that himself...
LDBI\t「本命がレッド・オーガだというなら、@ 気が逸れるかも知れん。デルタ: If his real target is the Red Ogre, he may get@distracted. Delta might be the better choice.
LDBI\t「しかし、ジンライを奪取されるという@ 大失態を演じていますし、量産: But they committed the grave blunder of@letting the Jinrai be stolen, and with only@mass-production units...
LDBI\t「構わん、噛ませ犬を送り込むのもいいだろう」: That's fine.@It won't hurt to send in a fall guy.
LDBI\t「ええ、アルテウル司令のご命令です」: Yes. Those are Commander Arteur's orders.
LDBI\t「汚名返上の機会を与えていただき、感謝します」: I'm grateful for this chance to clear our name.
LDBI\t「ジンライを取り戻すつもりか？@ 今頃、奴らが自分達の戦力とすべく、: You mean to take back the Jinrai?@By now they may be modifying it@to add to their own forces.
LDBI\t「その可能性はあり得るが……@ そう簡単にはいかぬのだよ」: That may be so... but it is not@so easily done.
LDBI\t「ふん……あてにならんな。@ 司令に直接掛け合う」: Hmph... You're unreliable.@I'll take this up with the Commander directly.
LDBI\t「アルテウル様はお忙しい。@ お前のわがままを聞いている暇などない」: Lord Arteur is busy.@He has no time to indulge your selfishness.
LDBI\t「わがまま……？@ 違うな、デルタなどより確実な作戦の具申だ」: Selfishness...?@Hardly. I'm proposing a surer plan than Delta's.
LDBI\t「レッド・オーガが見つからず、焦っているだけだろう？@ それとも、ア: You're just impatient since the Red Ogre@hasn't turned up, aren't you? Or do you still@have feelings for Arieil?
LDBI\t「下がれと命令しているのだ。@ オメガは最上位のセイバー……アルファ: I'm ordering you to stand down. Omega is the@highest Saber... I told you it has command@over Alpha and below, didn't I?
LDBI\t「ふん……そのオメガも生まれ変わった凶鳥に@ 後れを取ったと聞く。エ: Hmph... I hear that same Omega lost out to the@reborn Bird of Ill Omen. Along with Egretta.
LDBI\t「おれのアレスがアインストのコアを得さえすれば、@ 鋼龍戦隊のどんな: Once my Ares gets an Einst core, I can defeat@any unit the Steel Dragons have.
LDBI\t（ふん、本懐を遂げた所で、@ お前の宿命が変わるかどうかは……）: (Hmph. Even if you achieve your goal,@whether it will change your fate...)
LDBI\t「……ＡＩ１が拒絶反応を示した理由は何だ？@ ラズムナニウムにも異常: ...Why did AI1 show a rejection response?@The Lazmnanium also seemed to stir abnormally.
LDBI\t「今、メディウスからＡＩ１を取り外し、@ 調査を行っている所です」: We're removing AI1 from the Medius now@to investigate.
LDBI\t「ＴＥアブゾーバーのパーツや@ ターミナス・エンジンを取り込んだこと: If absorbing the TE Absorber parts and the@Terminus Engine is the cause, that's a@serious problem.
LDBI\t「以前述べた通り、@ ＭＯＤＥＬ‐Ｘにはパイロットを搭乗させ、@ 私: As I said before, the MODEL-X will carry a@pilot and the AI0 I've adjusted.@This is final.
LDBI\t「アルテウル司令の承認も得ている」: Commander Arteur has approved it as well.
LDBI\t「……ＡＩ０では、ラズムナニウムの性能を@ 最大限に引き出すことが出: ...AI0 can't draw out the Lazmnanium's@full potential.
LDBI\t「確かに、自己修復能力は落ちることになるが、@ ＭＯＤＥＬ‐Ｘはそれ: True, its self-repair ability will suffer, but@the MODEL-X has more than enough combat power@to make up for it.
LDBI\t「ＡＩ１がなくとも、最強のＴＥアブゾーバーに@ なるだろう。そもそも: Even without AI1, it'll be the strongest TE@Absorber. Besides, AI1 isn't interactive,@so pilots find it hard to work with.
LDBI\t「うるさい子供など、私は欲しくありませんもの」: I have no desire for a noisy child.
LDBI\t「君のそういう観点は、どうも歪んでいるな」: That view of yours is rather twisted.
LDBI\t「……８号機と９号機、１０号機のパイロットは@ どうするのです？」: ...And what about the pilots for Units 8, 9,@and 10?
LDBI\t「８号機と９号機は、適任者が見つかるまで@ ＡＩ０でテスト運用するこ: Units 8 and 9 will undergo test operation with@AI0 until suitable pilots are found. That's in@light of your position and past achievements.
LDBI\t「また、ＭＯＤＥＬ‐Ｘのパイロットは@ ドゥバン・オーグにしようと考: Also, I'm thinking of making Duban Ogg@the MODEL-X's pilot.
LDBI\t「オヅヌ博士が死亡した今、@ プロジェクト・イデアランツは頭打ちとな: With Dr. Ozunu dead, Project Idealants has@hit a wall, and the Ares Geist has plenty@of problems too.
LDBI\t「彼はアレスに拘りを持っているようですが……」: He seems quite attached to the Ares, though...
LDBI\t「別にあれを廃するわけではない。@ それに、ＭＯＤＥＬ‐Ｘの性能を知: We're not scrapping it.@And once he sees what the MODEL-X can do,@he'll take an interest.
LDBI\t（……このままでは、私の子が……@ 何とかしなければ……）: (...At this rate, my child will...@I have to do something...)
LDBI\t「……では、以上だ。@ ＡＩ１の調査、調整作業に戻りたまえ」: ...That's all, then.@Return to examining and adjusting AI1.
LDBI\t（あの時、ＡＩ１は彼女と戦うことを@ ためらったように見えた……）: (Back then, AI1 seemed to hesitate@to fight her...)
LDBI\t（まさか……。@ いえ、そんなことはあり得ない……@ あの後、スキャ: (No way...@No, that can't be...@I scanned and checked it afterward.)
LDBI\t（ＡＩ１、あなたは何を感じたの……？@ それもさらなる進化を遂げるた: (AI1, what did you feel...?@Is that, too, part of evolving further...?)
LDBI\t「はあっ、はあ……腹筋３００回、達成！@ だいぶトレーニングの成果が: Huff, huff... 300 sit-ups, done!@Looks like my training's really paying off.
LDBI\t「観念せい、ムラタ。@ お主は修羅道を極めるどころか、@ 剣の道の悟: Give it up, Murata.@Far from mastering the way of the Shura,@you'll never even grasp the way of the sword.
LDBI\t「お主は煩悩に囚われ、邪道に堕ち、真理を見失った。@ それはまさに、: Desire bound you. You fell to a wicked path and@lost sight of the truth. As your machine's name@says... you are "Mumyou." Ignorance itself.
LDBI\t「お、おのれぇ！ 老いぼれがぁぁぁぁぁ！！」: Why, you...! You senile old fooool!!
LDBI\t「……言ったはずじゃ。@ 我は悪を断つ剣なり……とな」: ...As I told you.@I am the sword that cleaves evil.
LDBI\t「外道の剣で俺を断つことは出来ん」: A heretic's blade cannot cleave me.
LDBI\t「そう……冥府への案内、我が斬艦刀が仕った」: Indeed... my Zankantou has served as your@guide to the underworld.
LDBI\t「お、おのれ、ゼンガー！！@ 誰が冥府などに！ 俺が、俺が往く道は…: D-Damn you, Sänger!!@Like hell I'm going to the underworld!@The path I walk leads to...!!
LDBI\t「……言ったはずだ。@ 我に断てぬものなし……とな」: ...As I told you.@There is nothing I cannot cut.
LDBI\t「そ、その先に俺の求めるものが！@ 阿修羅の悟りがぁぁぁぁぁ……！！: B-Beyond it lies what I seek!@The enlightenment of the Ashuraaaaa...!!
LDBI\t「戦域内の敵機、反応なし！@ 針路を確保しました！」: No enemy readings in the combat zone!@Our course is clear!
LDBI\t「よし、このままグランド・クリスマスへ突入する！」: Good. We'll proceed straight into Grand Christmas!
BMD\t「さ～て、仕事、仕事」: Welll, time to get to work.
BMD\t「そ～んじゃま、ちょいと行きますか」: Alrighty then, guess I'll head on out.
BMD\t「こ～っちも仕事なんでね」: Gotta make a livin' too, y'know.
BMD\t「い～っちょ、やりますか」: Let's gooo do this, shall we?
BMD\t「ちょ～っくら、ちょいと！」: Gimme just a liiittle sec here!
BMD\t「シュウ・シラカワ……目～障りな男だよ」: Shu Shirakawa... a real eyesore of a guy.
BMD\t「グランゾン……早く始末しないと」: Granzon... Better get rid of it fast.
BMD\t「ま～ったく、と～んだ食わせ者だよ、シュウ」: Maaan, you're one slippery customer, Shu.
BMD\t「もう、あんたにはついてけないね」: I just can't keep up with you anymore.
BMD\t「お互い覚悟を決める時が来たな」: Time for both of us to brace ourselves.
BMD\t「風の魔装機神って奴ね」: So that's the Masoukishin of wind, huh?
BMD\t「色んな魔装機神がいるもんだ～ね」: Suuure are all kinds of Masoukishin, huh.
BMD\t「魔装機神み～たいなメカがいるから、/ 地球は厄介な～んだな」: It's mechs like the Masoukishin/　that make Earth such a paaain.
BMD\t「そ～んじゃま、ガ～ルハントと洒落こもうか」: Welll then, time for some girl-huntin'.
BMD\t「ヒュッケバインって、/ 消～えたはずじゃなかったか？」: Hückebein? Wasn't that thing/　suppooosed to be gone?
BMD\t「あれ、問題が多いからね。消してやるよ」: That thing's trouble. I'll wipe it out.
BMD\t「そ～の眼鏡、割ってやるよ」: I'll craaack those glasses of yours.
BMD\t「別の星の技術を使ってる奴も、厄介だ～ね」: Guys usin' alien tech are a paaain too.
BMD\t「ダブルＧは始末しないとな」: Gotta get rid of the Double G.
BMD\t「ダブルＧを倒せば、/ あいつらも意気消沈す～るだろ」: Beat the Double G, and that'll/　take the wind outta their sails, I bet.
BMD\t「さ～て、グルンガストをさく～っと倒すか」: Welll, let's zip through this Grungust.
BMD\t「グ～ルンと回って、ガスッと変形する奴ね」: The one that spins with a grrrun and/　transforms with a gust, huh?
BMD\t「あ～んなのが量産されたら、あいつらは/ 攻め込んでくる。今の内に始末: If they mass-produce stuff like thaaat,/　they'll invade. Gotta take it out now.
BMD\t「派手なメカだね。誰が作ったんだか」: Flashy mech. Who built that thing?
BMD\t「バリってるねぇ、色々」: Lookin' real slick, in a lotta ways.
BMD\t「昔からあ～ゆ～のを作ってるから、/ 地球人は危険なんだな」: Earthlings are dangerous 'cause they've/　been buildin' stuff like thaaat forever.
BMD\t「こ～っちのも見てってちょうだいよ」: Have a looook at mine too, won'tcha?
BMD\t「こ～こからが本番、ってねぇ」: Here's where the real show staaarts.
BMD\t「な、何とまあ！」: W-well, would ya look at that!
BMD\t「まぁいった、まいった。出直してくるわ」: Weeell, I give. I'll come back later.
BMD\t「こ～のまま終わるつもりはな～いんだよね」: Don't plan on endin' it like thiiis, though.
BMD\t「くうっ！ さぁすが、やるやる」: Ngh! Not bad, not bad at all.
BMD\t「おおっ？ ちょ～いとまずいかもね」: Whoa? Might be a liiittle trouble.
BMD\t「おおっとお！ 洒落になんなくなってきたかな」: Whoa there! This ain't funny anymore.
BMD\t「おっとっと、オーグバリューでも危ないな」: Whoops, even the Org-Valu's at risk.
BMD\t「くうう……/ ヒュッケバインを超えるって～の？」: Ngh.../　You sayin' it beats a Hückebein?
BMD\t「いてて……ガスッとやられちまったい」: Ow ow... That one hit with a gust.
BMD\t「おおっ！ バリバリだ～ね、そのマシン」: Whoa! That machine's got some kick!
BMD\t「グランゾン……や～っぱ始末に悪いわ」: Granzon... a reeeal pain to deal with.
BMD\t「お～嬢ちゃん相手に、/ ボケてる場合じゃないかもね」: No time to be goofin' around/　with a little missy, maybe.
LDBI\t「<ＲＥＢ>本体はフィールドで保護してある故、@ 遠慮はいらん。存分: The <ＲＥＢ> core is protected by a field,@so hold nothing back. Go at it all you like.
LDBI\t「言われなくても、そのつもりだぜ！」: You don't have to tell me twice!
LDBI\t「各機、デモンゴーレムを掃討しろ！」: All units, wipe out the Demon Golems!
LDBI\t「むうっ……あやつめ、予想以上に抵抗を……！」: Hrmm... That thing's resisting more than I expected...!
LDBI\t「頼りねえこと言うなよ、婆さん！@ ＲＥＢの疑似人格をしっかり抑え込: Don't go soft on me now, Granny!@Keep a tight lid on REB's pseudo-personality!
LDBI\t「むうっ、いかん……疑似人格が目を覚ますぞ」: Hrm, this is bad... The pseudo-personality@is waking up.
LDBI\t「何だと！？ 話が違うじゃねえか！」: What!? That's not what you told us!
LDBI\t「イブンめ……@ この高貴にして優雅、全世界の覇王たる我、@ 全知全: Ibn, you wretch... To think you'd try to seal@me, the noble and elegant overlord of the world,@the omniscient, omnipotent Gatezeruku...
LDBI\t「低級な疑似人格めが。@ この場で消去されたくなければ、疾く立ち去れ: You lowly pseudo-personality.@If you don't wish to be erased here and now,@begone.
LDBI\t「ククク……その様な口を利いて、@ 我を貶めようとしても無駄なこと。: Heh heh heh... Speaking to me that way@won't diminish me. I can hear it--your hearts'@anguish, your cries of despair.
LDBI\t「動くでない。@ 我に傷をつければ、送還魔法が使えなくなるぞ？」: Do not move.@Wound me, and your return spell will be useless.
LDBI\t「チッ、こっちの目的を知ってやがったか……！」: Tch, so it knew what we were after...!
LDBI\t「我は全知全能の神であり、@ ラ・ギアスに災厄をもたらす魔神なるぞ」: I am an all-knowing, all-powerful god,@the demon lord who brings calamity to La Gias!
LDBI\t「何が魔神だ！ 低級妖魔のくせによ！」: Demon lord, nothing! You're just a lowly demon!
LDBI\t「こちらの弱みに付け込んでくる所など、@ まさにそうですな」: Exploiting our weakness like that@certainly fits the description.
LDBI\t「でも、ガテゼルクがソラティス神殿を@ 完全に乗っ取ってしまったら、: But if Gatezeruku completely takes over@the Soratis Temple, won't something bad@happen to Langran...!?
LDBI\t「イブンさん、@ あのコンピューターは絶対に必要な物なのかしらん？@: Ibn, is that computer something you@absolutely need? Other than for sending us@back to our world, I mean?
LDBI\t「……いや、必要なデータのバックアップはあるし、@ 送還魔法のような: ...No. I have backups of the data I need,@and I seldom use it for anything but@grand spells like the return spell.
LDBI\t「じゃあ、壊しちゃってもＯＫだったりして」: So maybe it's A-OK if we just smash it?
LDBI\t「待て！@ それじゃ、地上へ帰れなくなっちまうぜ！」: Hold on!@Then we'd never get back to the surface!
LDBI\t「どのみち、今すぐ戻るわけじゃないし……@ 後で修理することだって出: We're not going back right away anyway...@And you could always repair it later, right?
LDBI\t「それに、帰る方法は他にもあるんだろう？@ 現に、お前のサイバスター: Besides, there's another way home, right?@After all, your Cybuster can travel between@the surface and La Gias all on its own.
LDBI\t「……何だ？ 貴様ら、何を話している？」: ...What? What are you people talking about?
LDBI\t「なら、優先すべきはこの事態の収拾だな。@ 艦長、どうです？」: Then our priority is getting this under control.@Captain, what do you say?
LDBI\t「異論はない。現時点で、我々だけ地上へ@ 帰還するわけにはいかんから: No objection. We can't very well head back@to the surface by ourselves right now.
LDBI\t「こないだ、リオちゃんも言ってたでしょ。@ 今度は私達があなたに協力: Rio said it the other day, didn't she?@Now it's our turn to help you out.
LDBI\t「よかろう、ガテゼルクなんぞに好き勝手されては@ 迷惑じゃしの、ＲＥ: Very well. Letting Gatezeruku run amok would@be a nuisance, so I'll give up on REB.@Don't hold back.
LDBI\t「そうじゃ。お前さんなんぞに乗っ取られたままでは、@ 何をされるかわ: Indeed. While you possess it, there's no telling@what you might do.
LDBI\t「待て、話し合おう、話せばわかる」: Wait! Let us talk this over.@I'm sure we can reach an understanding.
LDBI\t「え？ 態度が変わった……！？」: Huh? Now it's changing its tune...!?
LDBI\t「我の話を聞け。@ 全能なる我、世界の覇者たる我が@ 本気になれば、: Hear me out.@Should I, the almighty conqueror of the world,@get serious, you would all...
LDBI\t「低級妖魔なんぞと話すことなどないわ」: I've nothing to discuss with a lowly demon.
LDBI\t「ああ！ @ ＲＥＢごとてめえを叩き潰してやるぜ！」: Yeah!@We'll smash you to pieces, REB and all!
LDBI\t「ぬうう……！@ かくなる上は、我自らが……！」: Grrr...!@Then I shall deal with you myself...!
LDBI\t「もっと凄い怪物が出て来ると思った……」: I thought some huge monster would show up...
LDBI\t「所詮は低級妖魔だってこった！@ 婆さん、頼むぜ！」: It's just a lowly demon after all!@Granny, you're up!
LDBI\t「ヘッ、引っ掛かりやがったな！@ 結界を張られちゃ、もうＲＥＢに取り: Heh, you fell for it!@With that barrier up, you can't possess REB@anymore!
LDBI\t「お、おのれ！ 貴様、我を謀りおったな！」: D-Damn you! You have deceived me!
LDBI\t「ふふっ、思ってたより素直だったわねぇ」: Ooh, that was easier to fool than I expected.
LDBI\t「矮小な人間の分際で我に挑むとは！@ 身の程知らずが！」: Puny humans daring to challenge me!@Know your place!
LDBI\t「ああ、行って、教えてやる！ @ ミナキが雷鳳に込めた想いを！！」: Yeah, I'm coming, and I'll show you!@Everything Minaki put into the RaiOh!!
LDBI\t「トオミネ博士！@ このまま一気にあんたの所へ行ってやる！！」: Dr. Tohmine!@I'm coming straight for you, right now!!
LDBI\t「フッ、レンジ内に入ったな。@ これならば、強制起動コードを@ 確実: Heh, you're within range.@Now I can be certain of transmitting@the forced activation code.
LDBI\t「さあ、ジンライよ！@ システムＬＩＯＨの神髄を見せろ！@ お前に与: Now, Jinrai!@Show me the true essence of System LIOH!@Carry out the true purpose you were built for!
LDBI\t「でも、システムＬＩＯＨは機能に@ 制限をかけてるんでしょう！？」: But I thought System LIOH had limits@placed on its functions!?
LDBI\t「ミナキ……お前のやることなど看破している。@ システムＺＬＡＩを排: Minaki... I saw through what you were doing.@You removed System ZLAI and put System LIOH@into a dormant state.
LDBI\t「だが、人間がジンライを運用するに当たって、@ システムＬＩＯＨを排: But for a human to operate the Jinrai,@System LIOH can't be removed, nor can all@of its functions be cut.
LDBI\t「五体駆動によるフィードバックに耐えるには、@ システムのレジスター: To endure the feedback of full-body drive,@the system's registers must be used.
LDBI\t「そう設計したのはお前であり、@ そうするよう仕向けたのは私なのだか: For you are the one who designed it that way,@and I am the one who led you to do so.
LDBI\t「と、父様は……システムＬＩＯＨに@ 外部からの強制起動装置を……！: F-Father... you put an external forced@activation device in System LIOH...!?
LDBI\t「そうだ、お前の与り知らぬ所でな。@ 言わば、保険だよ。私の研究成果: Yes, without your knowledge.@Insurance, you might say. Against anyone who@would misuse the fruits of my research.
LDBI\t「確実に強制起動させ、制御するには@ いくつか条件があるが……それら: There are several conditions for reliably@forcing activation and taking control...@and just now, every one of them was met.
LDBI\t「お前がシステムＺＬＡＩを排除しようと、@ システムＬＩＯＨがある限: Even if you remove System ZLAI, as long as@System LIOH remains, the Jinrai will@go on being the Jinrai.
LDBI\t「中に訓練された人間が乗っていれば、@ その判断力や直感までも戦闘に: With a trained human aboard, it will put even@their judgment and Sense to use in combat.
LDBI\t「人機一体などではない、ジンライにとって@ 人間など一部品に過ぎぬの: This is no union of man and machine. To the@Jinrai, a human is nothing more than a part.
LDBI\t「人という部品……バルトールと同じか」: Humans as parts... Just like the Bartoll.
LDBI\t「フン、真価を発揮したシステムＬＩＯＨは@ ユルゲンのＯＤＥシステム: Hmph. At full power, System LIOH surpasses@Jurgen's ODE System, the <ゲイム・システム>,@and even Bian's JINKI-1.
LDBI\t「さあ、ジンライよ！ 与えられた役目を果たせ！@ 私に屈辱を与えたビ: Now, Jinrai! Fulfill the role you were given!@Before my very eyes, destroy the Double G@of Bian Zoldark, the man who humiliated me!
LDBI\t「そして、あの男より私が優れていたことを@ 世に証明するのだ！！」: And prove to the world that I was@superior to that man!!
LDBI\t「この間の二の舞とはな……！」: A repeat of last time, huh...!
LDBI\t「止めるしかないでしょう、俺達の手で！」: We've got no choice but to stop it ourselves!
LDBI\t「無駄だ！ @ Ｓ‐ＢＳＫモードは、例えパイロットが@ 排除されても: It's useless!@S-BSK mode will not stop, even if@the pilot is eliminated!
LDBI\t「そう、中の人間が死んでも動き続けるのだよ！」: Yes, it will keep moving even if the one@inside is dead!
LDBI\t「父様……父様は、@ 私の行動を看破していると言いましたね……」: Father... You said you had@seen through my actions...
LDBI\t「……万が一に備えて、システムＬＩＯＨに@ 爆破装置を備え付けておい: ...Just in case, I installed an explosive@device in System LIOH. To force it to@shut down if it ever went berserk.
LDBI\t「く、うう……た、助かったぜ、ミナキ……」: Ngh... Th-Thanks, Minaki... You saved me...
LDBI\t「あ、ああ、何とか……おかげで目が覚めた……」: Y-Yeah, somehow... That woke me right up...
LDBI\t「ミ、ミナキ！ システムを破壊したのか！@ 私とお前で作り上げた、シ: M-Minaki! You destroyed the system!@System LIOH, which you and I built together!
LDBI\t「ええ、そうです、父様……@ ＢＳＫモードの存在を知って、私は……」: Yes, I did, Father...@Once I learned BSK mode existed, I...
LDBI\t「お、愚かな真似を！！」: Wh-What a foolish thing to do!!
LDBI\t「あ、あんた……ミナキが一人で生きていけないと@ 言ったな……」: Y-You... said Minaki couldn't@make it on her own...
LDBI\t「ミナキは悲しんだんだ……@ あんたがシステムＬＩＯＨに@ あんな物: Minaki was heartbroken... when she found@out you'd planted something like that@in System LIOH...
LDBI\t「だけど……@ そこで悲しみに呑み込まれはしなかった……」: But... she didn't let that@sadness swallow her...
LDBI\t「そして、自分の手でシステムＬＩＯＨを壊して、@ 俺と雷鳳を助けてく: And she destroyed System LIOH with her own@hands to save me and the RaiOh...
LDBI\t「それは……ミナキがあんたから離れて@ 生きていけるって証だ……！」: That's proof... that Minaki can live@her life apart from you...!
LDBI\t「若造が知ったようなことを！@ システムＬＩＯＨの補助なしでは、@: Don't talk as if you understand, boy!@Without System LIOH's assistance, you@can't hope to operate the Jinrai properly!
LDBI\t「作戦変更だ！ このままジンライを持ち帰る！」: Change of plans! We're taking the Jinrai back!
LDBI\t「か、身体が……重い……！ 機体が……！」: M-My body... so heavy...! The machine...!
LDBI\t「そうだろう！@ ＤＭＬシステムは、今のお前にとって重き枷よ！」: Of course it is!@The DML System is a heavy shackle to you now!
LDBI\t「重いぜ……確かに雷鳳は……@ こいつで戦うってことは……」: Yeah, it's heavy... The RaiOh really is...@Fighting with this thing means...
LDBI\t「トウマ！ 機体を捨てて、逃げて！！」: Touma! Abandon the machine and get out!!
LDBI\t「だが、俺は自分で決めたんだ……@ 俺は、自分の意思で戦うことを選ん: But I decided this myself...@I chose to fight of my own free will...!
LDBI\t「トウマ、岩を穿つ涓滴の落下点を見極めよ。@ その一点に己が力を傾注: Touma, discern where the droplet that bores@through stone will fall. Focus all your@strength on that single point.
LDBI\t「人機は己、己は人機！@ 抗わず、従えず、一心同体となれ！@ これぞ: The machine is you, and you are the machine!@Neither resist nor subjugate--become one!@This is the secret of man-machine unity!
LDBI\t「一意専心！ お前の打と意地を見せよ！」: Single-minded resolve! Show me your blows@and your guts!
LDBI\t「そう……信じたことのない神に祈っていた」: Yeah... I was praying to a god I've never@believed in.
LDBI\t「いや……役に立たない幻の全能者のことさ」: No... a useless, illusory almighty being.
LDBI\t「幻に祈って、意味があるのか？」: Is there any point in praying to an illusion?
LDBI\t「少なくとも、多少の気休めにはなる」: If nothing else, it's a little comfort.
LDBI\t「まさか……これが恐怖……@ 恐れるということなのか。だが、何故……: Could this be... fear...?@Is this what it means to be afraid? But why...?
LDBI\t「私は……恐れているのか。@ ペルフェクティオと……私を作り出した者: I'm... afraid. Afraid of fighting@Perfectio... the one who created me...
LDBI\t「戦いの中で死ぬことを……@ 存在の消滅を恐れている……」: Afraid of dying in battle...@Afraid of ceasing to exist...
LDBI\t「私が消えて……お前と……@ 共に生きることが出来なくなるのが怖い…: I'm scared of vanishing... of no longer@being able to live... with you...@Ridiculous. I'm...
LDBI\t「ラキ……偽りでも仮初めでもない、@ それは本物の命と心だ」: Raki... that's no fake or temporary thing.@That's a real life and a real heart.
LDBI\t「お前が、確かに俺と同じように生きている……@ その証だ」: It's proof that you're truly alive...@just like me.
LDBI\t「怖いよ……戦うのはいつだって。前にも言った。@ 誰だって死にたくな: I'm scared... every time I fight. I told you@before. Nobody wants to die. But...@it's something I have to do.
LDBI\t「人間は……強いのだな。@ 恐怖に抗い、なおも戦いに向かうことが@: Humans are... strong, aren't they?@They can defy their fear and still go@into battle.
LDBI\t「だけど……もし……生き残っても……@ この世界に私の居場所はない…: But... even if... I survive...@there's no place for me in this world...
LDBI\t「私はペルフェクティオと共に@ 滅びるべきなのかも知れない……」: Maybe I should perish@along with Perfectio...
LDBI\t「俺が……作る。お前の……」: I'll... make one. A place for you...
LDBI\t「そろそろ機乗する時間よ」: It's almost time to board our units.
LDBI\t（親父……これから戻るぞ、ファブラ・フォレースへ。@ あんたがしでか: (Dad... I'm going back to Fabula Fores.@To settle everything... everything@you set in motion...)
LDBI\t「艦長、@ 本艦はまもなくＤ５ラインに差し掛かります！」: Captain,@we're about to reach Line D5!
LDBI\t「さあ、いよいよだ！ ヒリュウに遅れるなよ！」: All right, this is it! Don't fall behind the Hiryu!
LDBI\t「０時方向、レンジ６！@ ルイーナとクストースらしき物が@ 戦闘を行: Twelve o'clock, range 6!@Ruina and what appear to be Custos@are engaged in combat!
LDBI\t「ぬうっ、バラルめ……！@ 一度、メリデンプルムの中に戻るしかないか: Nngh, damn you, Balar...!@We have no choice but to fall back into@Meridenplum for now.
LDBI\t「ルイーナ残存機、メリデンプルムの方向へ後退！@ クストースに動きな: Remaining Ruina units withdrawing toward@Meridenplum! No movement from the Custos!
LDBI\t「こちらには仕掛けて来ないのか……」: They're not going to attack us...?
LDBI\t「クストース及び機動兵器群が@ 現戦域より離脱！」: The Custos and their mobile weapons@are leaving the combat area!
LDBI\t「ああ。メリデンプルムの中に入れないのか、@ それとも入る気がないの: Yeah. Either they can't get into Meridenplum,@or they don't intend to...
LDBI\t「いずれにせよ、バラルは俺達にルイーナとの@ 決着を付けさせようとし: Either way, Balar wants us to be the ones@to settle things with Ruina.
LDBI\t「自分達の戦力を温存するため？」: So they can conserve their own forces?
LDBI\t「それだけじゃないだろう」: That can't be all of it.
LDBI\t「……バラルがあえてメリデンプルムの中に@ 侵入しないのでしたら、前: ...If Balar is deliberately holding back from@Meridenplum, then caught between a tiger and a@wolf hardly covers it, I'd say.
LDBI\t「例え、後でバラルが待ち受けていたとしても……@ ここで私達がルイー: Even if Balar is lying in wait for us after...@we must defeat Ruina here. Once the "King of@Destruction" revives, it will be too late.
LDBI\t「……ここからは僕とグラキエースが@ 水先案内人になろう。僕達でメリ: ...From here on, Glacies and I will be@your guides. We'll neutralize Meridenplum@between the two of us.
LDBI\t「両舷前進第三戦速！@ これよりファブラ・フォレースへ突入します！」: Both engines ahead, third battle speed!@We are now entering Fabula Fores!
LDBI\t「コンターギオ、@ ストゥディウムとファービュラリスが@ メリデンプ: Contagio,@Studium and Fabularis have broken@through Meridenplum.
LDBI\t「クククッ、来たか」: Heh heh heh... So, they've come.
LDBI\t「バラルはメリデンプルムの中に入れぬようだ」: It seems Balar cannot enter Meridenplum.
LDBI\t「あの連中が何をしようと、@ 直に“破滅の王”が目覚める。@ それで: No matter what those fools do,@the "King of Destruction" will soon awaken.@With that, all will begin, and all will end.
LDBI\t「ついに戻って来たぞ。ルイーナとの戦いは、@ ここから始まった……」: We're finally back. The fight with Ruina@started right here...
LDBI\t「表層部分は、あの時と@ ほとんど変わりがないようだな」: The surface looks like it's@hardly changed since then.
LDBI\t「でも、地下のファブラ・フォレースが@ どうなっているか……」: But who knows what's become of@Fabula Fores underground...
LDBI\t「センサーはあまり役に立たないわ。@ ＥＳウェーブみたいな波動が、氷: The sensors aren't much help. Waves like the@ES Wave keep pouring out from under the ice@nonstop.
LDBI\t「下で何が起きているか、@ 自分の目で確かめるしかないということか」: So we'll have to see what's going on down@there with our own eyes.
LDBI\t「負の波動が集中している……@ “破滅の王”の目覚めはもうすぐだ。@: The negative waves are focusing here...@The "King of Destruction" will wake soon.@Of that, I'm certain.
LDBI\t「クククッ、人間共よ、よくここまで来た」: Heh heh heh... Well done making it this far,@humans.
LDBI\t「まもなく、“破滅の王”が現れる」: The "King of Destruction" will soon appear.
BMD\t「ハハッ！ どこ見てんのさ！！」: Haha! Where are you even looking!!
BMD\t「ここから先には行かせんぞ！」: You won't get past this point!
BMD\t「すみません、ここまでです！」: Sorry, this is as far as I go!
BMD\t「機体はまだ動く……！ やれるぞ！！」: My unit still moves...! I can do this!!
BMD\t「ぐあっ！ き、機体の維持を……！！」: Gahh! M-must keep the unit together...!!
BMD\t「うぐっ！ まだ引き下がれん！！」: Ugh! I can't back down yet!!
BMD\t「致命傷は免れたが、次は……！」: That wasn't fatal, but the next one...!
BMD\t「そう簡単にやられはしないぞ！」: I won't go down that easily!
BMD\t「これぐらいでひるんでなるものか！」: I won't flinch at something like this!
BMD\t「しまった、見失った！」: Damn, I lost sight of them!
BMD\t「少しでも手助けを！」: Let me help, even a little!
BMD\t「生き残るのは俺の方だ！」: I'm the one who's going to survive!
BMD\t「よし、捕捉できる！」: All right, I can lock on!
BMD\t「多少の無茶は、承知の上だ！」: I knew going in this would be reckless!
BMD\t「イエローゾーン……ギリギリか……！/ だが、やってやる！」: Yellow zone... cutting it close...!/　But I'll do it anyway!
BMD\t「いちいち言われなくても！」: You don't have to tell me every time!
BMD\t「ここで倒せば済むことだ！」: Beat it here, and that settles it!
BMD\t「待って！ イエローゾーンなのよ！」: Wait! We're in the yellow zone!
BMD\t「これでもマシな方なのよ！」: Believe me, this is an improvement!
BMD\t「出力、イエローゾーン！/ もうすぐブルーに……」: Output, yellow zone!/　It'll hit blue soon...
BMD\t「来たわ！ 頼むわよ、ヒューゴ！」: Here it comes! It's up to you, Hugo!
BMD\t「敵のパターンデータ、送ったわよ！」: I've sent you the enemy's pattern data!
BMD\t「言われなくても、わかっている！」: I know, you don't have to tell me!
BMD\t「くっ、デモンのパターンは予測が……！」: Ugh, I can't predict the Demon...!
BMD\t「お前は出力調整に専念していればいい！」: You just concentrate on the output!
BMD\t「妖機人の動きに惑わされないでね！」: Don't let the Yokijin's moves fool you!
BMD\t「奴のコアを組み込んだ兵器など！」: A weapon with its core built in...!
BMD\t「イェッツトの力を発揮する前に倒す！」: I'll beat it before Jetzt can cut loose!
BMD\t「イェッツトとの因縁、ここで断ち切る！」: I'll sever my ties to Jetzt here!
BMD\t「ある意味、/ お前もイェッツトの犠牲者か……！」: In a way,/　you're a victim of Jetzt, too...!
BMD\t「奴が黒幕……！ ならば！」: So he's behind it all...! Then!
BMD\t「アルテウル、/ お前の思い通りにいくと思うなよ！」: Arteur,/　don't think this'll go your way!
BMD\t「絶望なら、過去に充分味わったんでな……！」: I've had my fill of despair already...!
BMD\t「お前達が言う恐怖や絶望など……！」: The fear and despair you talk about...!
BMD\t「コンターギオ、お前などに！」: Contagio, I won't lose to you!
BMD\t「破滅するのは俺達じゃない……お前の方だ！」: We're not the ones headed for ruin.../　You are!
BMD\t「乗り越えてやる……/ お前が示す恐怖や絶望を！」: I'll overcome them.../　the fear and despair you show me!
BMD\t「ゲストの指揮官機と言えど！」: Even if it's a Guest Commander's unit!
BMD\t「お前達が何度地球圏へ現れようと！」: Come to the Earth Sphere all you want!
BMD\t「ゼゼーナン、お前はここで終わりだ！」: Zezenan, this is where you end!
BMD\t「俺は人間をやめるつもりなどない！」: I'm not about to stop being human!
BMD\t「お前達が言う尸解は、/ 死と同義じゃないのか！」: The shikai you talk about.../　is just another word for death!
BMD\t「お前に見せてやる……/ 限りある命、人間の力をな！」: I'll show you.../　the power of finite human life!
BMD\t「光龍！ そこから引きずり下ろしてやる！」: Koryu! I'll drag you down from there!
LDBI\t「こちらの指示に従わない場合、@ 当方には先制攻撃の権利が与えられる: If you fail to comply, understand that we@have been granted the right to strike first.
LDBI\t「待って下さい、大佐！@ 大統領の件は濡れ衣です。@ 我々の意志では: Wait, Colonel! The President's death was a@frame-up. It was never our intention.
LDBI\t「いえ、そんなことを議論している場合では@ ありません。地球が消失し: No, this is no time to argue about that. With@Earth gone, finding the cause and a@countermeasure must come first...
LDBI\t「軍籍なき者が憂えることではない」: That's no concern for those with no commission.
LDBI\t「武装解除を受け入れるか否か、即答せよ」: Answer now: will you accept disarmament or not?
LDBI\t（今そこにある危機より、@ 与えられた命令の遂行が重要だというのか。: (Carrying out orders matters more than the@crisis right in front of us? No, as soldiers,@that's how it should be, but...)
LDBI\t「よろしい、これより接収要員を出す。@ 以後はその指示に従ってもらお: Very well. We'll send a team to seize the ship.@From then on, follow their orders, Commander.
LDBI\t「この状況下で、友軍と交戦するわけにはいかん」: We can't fight friendly forces@in this situation.
LDBI\t「こっちは規格外の機体揃いだ。@ 艦内でシーリングを行うとしても、@: Our machines are all nonstandard.@Even if they seal them inside the ship,@it'll take a good while.
LDBI\t「各員は戦闘配置のまま待機。全周警戒を厳となせ。 @ 有事の際は、即: All hands, stay at battle stations. Maintain@full-perimeter vigilance. Be ready to@respond immediately if anything happens.
LDBI\t「状況が動く、と？」: You think the situation will shift?
LDBI\t「ああ……嫌な空気だ。@ しかも、我々は動きを止めている。@ 敵にと: Yes... I don't like the feel of this.@And we're dead in the water.@We're a perfect target for the enemy.
LDBI\t「わかりました。@ 甲板長には丁寧に応対するよう申し伝えます。@ 時: Understood. I'll tell the boatswain to treat@them courteously. That'll buy us time, too.
LDBI\t「……抵抗する素振りはないか。@ あのダイテツ・ミナセの教え子にして: ...No sign of resistance, then.@Rather docile for a pupil of Daitetsu Minase.
LDBI\t「自分は、オペレーションＳＲＷで鋼龍戦隊の@ 勇戦ぶりを目の当たりに: During Operation SRW, I saw the Steel Dragons'@valor with my own eyes.
LDBI\t「彼らと交戦することになったら、@ 無事で済むとは思えません。@ そ: If we ended up fighting them, I doubt we'd@come out unscathed. Especially in a situation@as abnormal as this...
LDBI\t「貴様も喧伝の片棒を担ぐか。@ <Ｌ５戦役>の勝利は、彼らの力だけで: So you'd help spread their propaganda too?@Victory in the <Ｌ５戦役> wasn't@achieved through their strength alone.
LDBI\t「特定の部隊に優秀な兵器を集中させるという@ 歪な運用思想の結果、目: It's merely the result of a warped doctrine that@concentrates top weapons in a single unit. A few@stood out, nothing more.
LDBI\t「もっと作戦全体のバランスを考え、戦力を@ 配置しておけば、グレート: Had our forces been balanced across the whole@operation, the Great Ark wouldn't have sunk...@Admiral Norman Slay wouldn't have fallen.
LDBI\t「鋼龍戦隊もガイアセイバーズも、@ ＩＳＡ戦術の一面を極端に押し出し: The Steel Dragons and the Gaia Saviors are just@extreme products of one facet of ISA tactics.@And the latter, outside military control...
LDBI\t「高熱源体多数接近！ ３時方向、仰角０５より@ まっすぐ！ レンジ３: Multiple heat sources approaching! Bearing 3@o'clock, elevation 05, straight in! Range 3...@no, entering Range 2!
LDBI\t「真横から！？ 速過ぎるぞ！」: From the flank!? They're too fast!
LDBI\t「高速ミサイルと目されます！@ 本艦への直撃コース！」: They appear to be high-speed missiles!@On a direct collision course with us!
LDBI\t「艦尾右舷フレーム４７６上部に被弾！@ 右舷主機、出力低下！」: Hit on the upper aft starboard, frame 476!@Starboard main engine losing output!
LDBI\t「レパルス、被弾！@ 敵集団の識別終了！ ルイーナです！」: The Repulse has been hit!@Enemy group identified! It's the Ruina!
LDBI\t「何！？@ 地球が消失したのに……奴ら、どこから！？」: What!? Earth has vanished... so where did they@come from!?
LDBI\t「宇宙にもルイーナが@ 存在していたんでしょうか……！？」: Were there Ruina in space, too...!?
LDBI\t「そんな報告は聞いていない……！@ アヅキ、レパルスとの回線を開け！: I've received no such report...!@Azuki, open a channel to the Repulse!
LDBI\t「ハンフリー司令、敵はルイーナです！@ 当方が迎撃しますので、そちら: Colonel Humphrey, the enemy is the Ruina!@We'll intercept them, so please withdraw!
LDBI\t「指図は受けん。@ 混乱に乗じて逃亡する意図であろうが」: I'll take no orders from you.@You intend to escape in the confusion.
LDBI\t「我々にはルイーナとの交戦経験があります！@ せめて、迎撃の許可を！: We have combat experience against the Ruina!@At least allow us to intercept!
LDBI\t「出せん。@ 貴艦の戦力は、全て我が隊の管轄下にある。@ 勝手に運用: Denied. All of your ship's forces fall under@my unit's jurisdiction. You may not deploy them@at will.
LDBI\t「ミサイル第２波、本艦へ接近！ 直撃コース！」: Second missile wave inbound!@They're on a collision course!
LDBI\t「！ こちらの回避運動を読んでいるのか！？」: Wha-- Are they reading our evasive maneuvers!?
LDBI\t「艦長、敵はレパルスに狙いを定めています！」: Captain, the enemy's targeting the Repulse!
LDBI\t「こちらのＰＴ隊を出せ！@ 敵の目を引き付けさせるんだ！」: Launch our PT squad!@Have them draw the enemy's attention!
LDBI\t「連邦軍からも@ 反逆者の汚名を着せられることになる、か？」: We'll be branded traitors by the Federation@Forces as well?
LDBI\t「ここは……敢えて着る！」: If it comes to that... I'll bear it!
LDBI\t「反逆者であろうとも、@ 地球消失の謎を追うことは出来るし、@ ルイ: Even as traitors, we can pursue the mystery@of Earth's disappearance, and fight the Ruina@and the Guests.
LDBI\t「ならば、迷う必要はない……@ そして、ここで終わるわけにはいかん。: Then there's no need to hesitate...@And we can't let it end here.@Launch all units at once!
LDBI\t「腹をくくったな、艦長。@ 思い切りの良さは、ダイテツ艦長に似てきた: So you've made up your mind, Captain.@You're getting as bold as Captain Daitetsu.
LDBI\t「同士討ちよりはマシですからね。@ 後々でモメそうだけど」: Beats fighting our own side.@Though it'll probably cause trouble later.
LDBI\t「双方とも無事だったらな。@ ……アリエイル、イング。状況が状況だ。: If both sides make it through.@...Arieil, Ing. Given the situation,@we'll need your strength.
LDBI\t「イング、お前にとって初の宙間戦闘だ。@ 慣れるまでは前線に出ず、ハ: Ing, this is your first battle in space.@Stay off the front line until you adapt, and@fly direct cover for the Hagane.
LDBI\t「いえ、お気遣いなく。もう馴染みました」: No need to worry. I've already adapted.
LDBI\t（馴染んだ……？ 適応能力の高さ故、か。@ それに、この状況下でも冷: (Adapted...? Because of his high adaptability?@And he's staying cool even in this situation.)
LDBI\t（この感覚……身体が覚えている。@ 実践するのは初めてだが……いける: (This feeling... my body remembers it.@First time for real, but... I can do this.)
LDBI\t「エレーブ１より各機。@ 地球可視宙間での戦闘だが、見ての通りの状況: Eleve 1 to all units.@This is combat in Earth-visible space, but@you can see the situation for yourselves.
LDBI\t「ノイズが走るな……@ だが、貴様ごときを相手に、この程度の異常など: Noise... But against the likes of you,@an anomaly this minor is of no consequence.
LDBI\t「また奴の声が……！@ 通信機じゃない、これはシュンパティアを@ 通: His voice again...!@That's not the comm. Is it coming@through the Sympathia?!
LDBI\t「む、この声……そうか、お前がそうなのか」: Hm, this voice... I see. So you are the one.
LDBI\t「聞こえてるなら、答えろ！@ 親父達はどうなったんだ！？」: If you can hear me, answer!@What happened to my dad and the others?!
LDBI\t「知らぬな。@ だが、あの氷の地は、既に我らルイーナの手に落ちた」: I know nothing of that. But that frozen land@has already fallen to us, the Ruina.
LDBI\t「もう手遅れだとでも言うのかよ！」: You saying it's already too late?!
LDBI\t「あいつに近づけば近づくほど、@ シュンパティアの調子がおかしくなる: The closer we get to that guy,@the more the Sympathia acts up!
LDBI\t「このノイズ……なるほど、そうか」: This noise... I see. So that's it.
LDBI\t「シュンパティアを通してのものなの……！？」: Is it coming through the Sympathia...?!
LDBI\t「人間……お前は違うな。@ そのマシーンも他とは違う……波動も重なっ: Human... You are different. And that machine@is unlike the others... its waves overlap.@Interesting...!
LDBI\t「あ、ああいう敵に適合したＭＰデータは……！」: Th-the MP data for fighting enemies like that...!
LDBI\t「闘志よりも怯えや恐怖が強まっているな。@ いい傾向だ」: Fear and dread are outweighing your mettle.@A promising sign.
LDBI\t「生憎だが、この機体を操ってるのは俺の方だ！」: Sorry, but I'm the one piloting this machine!
LDBI\t「む……こやつからは波動が感じられん。@ 人ではないのか？」: Hm... I sense no waves from this one.@Is it not human?
LDBI\t「人が人たる定義……お前に理解できるのか？」: What makes a human human...@Can you even understand that?
LDBI\t「我らの意志や力！ その身で受け止めよ！」: Our will and our might! Take them head-on!
LDBI\t「強靱な意志……@ それが絶望で彩られた時、我らにとって@ この上な: Strong will... When it is painted with despair,@it will become the finest sustenance@for us!
LDBI\t「単に我々を倒すだけでなく、@ 絶望させることに意味があるというのか: So it's not enough just to defeat us...@they need us to despair?!
LDBI\t「そうだ……力と意志を俺に示せ。@ 我らが欲するものは、その先にある: Yes... Show me your strength and will.@What we desire lies beyond them.
LDBI\t「このあたしが、@ そう簡単にビビると思うんじゃねえぞ！」: Don't you think for a second@I'm gonna get scared that easy!
LDBI\t「だが、いずれお前達は絶望の淵に落ちる……@ もうまもなくだ」: But you will all sink into despair in time...@Very soon now.
LDBI\t「るせえんだよ、ハゲ！@ その前にてめえが地獄へ堕ちやがれ！」: Shaddup, baldy!@You're the one who's going to hell first!
LDBI\t「メリオルエッセ、“破滅の王”……@ ルイーナに関する情報が断片的に: Meliores Esse, the "King of Destruction"...@We've gathered bits of intel on the Ruina.
LDBI\t「ええ。インスペクターやゲストとは違い、@ 制圧を主目的とする集団で: Yes. Unlike the Inspectors or the Guests,@conquest doesn't seem to be their main goal.
LDBI\t「あのアクイラという男は@ 破滅という言葉を何回も口にしていた……@: That Aquila mentioned destruction@several times... Could that@be the goal itself?
LDBI\t「だとしたら、こちらが浮き足立つこの時点で@ 最も効果的な手を打って: If so, they'll make their most effective move@now, while we're rattled.
LDBI\t「そうだな……あたしだったら、地球を一発で@ ぶっ壊しちまうような爆: Let's see... If it were me, I'd drop in@a bomb that'd blow the Earth apart in one go.
LDBI\t「言うことが極端でありますことね」: What an extreme thing you are saying, it is.
LDBI\t「手段はともかく、決定打を打たないのなら……@ かつてのエアロゲイタ: Means aside, without a decisive blow...@it seems that, like the Aerogators before,@they don't intend to end it all in one move.
LDBI\t「目的に至るまでの経緯も@ あいつらにとっては重要で……@ それもま: The process of getting to their goal@matters to them too... So that's also@one of their goals, huh?
LDBI\t「アクイラは、負の波動が糧になると言った。@ そこにも謎を解く鍵があ: Aquila said negative waves are sustenance.@There must be a key to the mystery there too.
LDBI\t（鍵……エール・シュヴァリアーや@ ブランシュネージュもそうなのか…: (A key... Could the Aile Chevalier and@the Blanche Neige be one too...?)
LDBI\t「ジョッシュ、リ・テク達は輸送機で@ 最寄りの連邦軍基地に向かうこと: Josh, the Re-Techs will be heading to@the nearest Federation base by transport.
LDBI\t「ああ、君達の機体のこともあるし……@ ファブラ・フォレースの教授達: Yes, there's the matter of your machines...@and I'm worried about the professor and@the others at Fabula Fores.
LDBI\t「リ・テクの一人で、@ エール・シュヴァリアーの開発にも携わっていた: He's one of the Re-Techs, and he also@worked on developing the Aile Chevalier.@This is Clifford Gygax.
LDBI\t「よろしく。@ ドクトル・クリフ……または、クリフで結構」: A pleasure.@Doktor Cliff... or simply Cliff will do.
LDBI\t「では、ドクトル・クリフ……ジョッシュとリムは@ 我々とは違った方法: Then, Doktor Cliff... Josh and Rim apparently@heard the Meliores Esse in a way we didn't...@What can you tell us about that?
LDBI\t「おそらく、シュンパティアに@ 何らかの原因があると考えています」: I believe the Sympathia@is likely the cause, in some way.
LDBI\t「何だ、随分と曖昧な答えだな」: Huh? That's a pretty vague answer.
LDBI\t「あれにそういう性質があると知ったのは、@ つい先程なのでね」: I only learned it had that property@a short while ago, you see.
LDBI\t「エール・シュヴァリアーとブランシュネージュは、@ ジョッシュとリム: I'm told only Josh and Rim can handle@the Aile Chevalier and Blanche Neige.@Could the cause lie with them?
LDBI\t「限りなく低いでしょう。@ ジョッシュとリムはシュンパティアを通じて: Extremely unlikely.@Josh and Rim sensed their will@only through the Sympathia.
LDBI\t「そして、あのシステムには@ ファースト・コンタクトを行った者にしか: Moreover, that system has the trait@of responding only to the person who@made first contact with it.
LDBI\t「ふむ……アヤ、<Ｔ‐ＬＩＮＫシステム>を通じて@ 何か感じたことは: Hmm... Aya, did you sense anything@through the <Ｔ‐ＬＩＮＫシステム>?
LDBI\t「アクイラは強い負の念を持ってましたが、@ ダイレクトに声を聞くまで: I felt strong negative emotion from Aquila,@but until I heard his voice directly...
LDBI\t「これは私の推測ですが、@ メリオルエッセの機体にもシュンパティアと: This is just my guess, but might the@Meliores Esse machines have a device@similar to the Sympathia?
LDBI\t「その可能性はあり得る。@ ファブラ・フォレースのテクノロジーは、@: That's possible.@Fabula Fores technology may be@similar to that of the Ruina.
LDBI\t「なら、そのファブ何とかを造ったのは、@ ルイーナなのかよ？」: So then, was that Fab-whatever thing@built by the Ruina?
LDBI\t「……今の所は何とも言えんな」: ...I can't say anything at this point.
LDBI\t「では、リ・テクはルイーナの存在を……@ あのような敵性体が現れるこ: Then, did the Re-Techs damn well know@about the Ruina... that hostiles like those@would appear, in advance, if you please?
LDBI\t「教授はある程度予測していたようだが……@ あんな連中だとわかってい: The professor had some clarity on it...@but had we known what they were, we'd have@requested a Federation sortie via the sponsor.
LDBI\t「口外できません。そういう契約なので」: I can't disclose that. It's in the contract.
LDBI\t「もしや、ジョッシュも知らぬことなのか？」: Could it be that even Josh doesn't know?
LDBI\t「ええ……スポンサーと直接やりとりをしていたのは、@ 父だったので」: Right... The one who dealt directly with@the sponsor was my father.
LDBI\t「ドクトル……非常事態なのだ。@ 少しでも手掛かりとなる情報が欲しい: Doktor... this is an emergency.@We need any clue we can get.@I'd like you to tell us who the sponsor is.
LDBI\t神聖ラングラン王国 ラングラン州: Holy Kingdom of Langran, Langran Province
LDBI\t「……ザムジードの応急処置が終わったわ。@ ここのスタッフって、優秀: ...Zamzeed's emergency repairs are done.@The staff here are really top-notch.
LDBI\t「マサキが地上にいた時は、サイバスターを@ 扱ってたからね。それに、: They handled Cybuster while Masaki was on the@surface. Plus, the Steel Dragons field all kinds@of units, so everyone's got lots of experience.
LDBI\t「それがしの機体も整備をしていただき、@ 助かっております」: I am most grateful that they have seen to@my machine as well.
LDBI\t「ええ。ラングラン軍の整備員と比べても、@ 遜色のない仕上がり具合で: Indeed. Their work is every bit as good as@that of the Langran Army's mechanics.
LDBI\t「……ねえねえ、一つ聞いていいかな。@ そもそも、<魔装機神>や<魔: ...Hey, hey, can I ask one thing?@Why were the <魔装機神> and the <魔装機>@built in the first place?
LDBI\t「マサキ、説明してなかったの？」: Masaki, you didn't explain it to her?
LDBI\t「……そう言や、ちゃんとは話してなかったな」: ...Come to think of it, I never really did.
LDBI\t「じゃあ、私が教えてあげるわ。@ 魔装機が開発されるきっかけとなった: Then I'll tell you. Development of the Masouki@was triggered by a prophecy from the seers@of the Langran Royal Academy.
LDBI\t「それは、『巨大な魔神がラングランを滅ぼす。@ そして、それはラ・ギ: It said: "A giant demon god will destroy@Langran, and bring calamity upon all who@live in La Gias."
LDBI\t「ええ。だから、それに対抗するための力として、@ <魔装機>や<魔装: Right. So the decision was made to develop@the <魔装機> and <魔装機神>@as a power to counter it.
LDBI\t「それまで、このラ・ギアスではそんなに強力な兵器は@ 存在していなか: Until then, there had been no weapons that@powerful here in La Gias.
LDBI\t「ふ～ん……予言なんていう随分とあやふやな@ きっかけで魔装機を作っ: Hmm... So you built the Masouki on something@as flimsy as a prophecy.
LDBI\t「あやふやって……@ ああ、地上での予言的中率は凄く低いんだっけ」: Flimsy...? Oh, right, prophecies on the@surface are hardly ever accurate, aren't they?
LDBI\t「ラングランみたいに@ ラプラス変換理論が完成されていないから、@: Laplace transform theory isn't perfected@there like it is in Langran, so people mostly@rely on individual psychic intuition, right?
LDBI\t「信頼性が高いわ。@ ただ、予言はあくまでも可能性だから、@ 人の力: Highly reliable. But a prophecy is only a@possibility, so it can be changed by human@effort.
LDBI\t「だからこそ、ラングランで<魔装機>と<魔装機神>の@ 開発が決定さ: That's exactly why Langran decided to@develop the <魔装機> and <魔装機神>.
LDBI\t「でも、どうしてラングランを救うマシンの@ パイロットが地上人なの？: But why are the pilots of the machines that@will save Langran from the surface? Why not@just have people from this world ride them?
LDBI\t「魔装機を動かすには<プラーナ>……“気”が必要なの。@ それも、激: To move a Masouki, you need <プラーナ>--ki.@And specifically, the kind that comes with@intense swings of emotion.
LDBI\t「激しい感情の起伏、ねぇ。@ マサキはそうだと思うけど……」: Intense swings of emotion, huh?@I can see that with Masaki, but...
LDBI\t「ミオも心の奥には大きな感情のうねりがあるはずよ。@ そうでしょ？」: You must have powerful waves of emotion deep@in your heart too, Mio. Isn't that right?
LDBI\t「もしかして、そういった人……魔装機神の@ パイロットになれるほどの: Could it be that people like that... people@with enough prana to pilot an Elemental Lord@are rare in Langran?
LDBI\t「そう……だから、<魔装機神>や<魔装機>の操者候補として@ 私やマ: Yes... That's why surface dwellers like@Masaki and me were summoned as candidate@pilots for the <魔装機神> and <魔装機>.
LDBI\t「グランヴェールには、@ ホワン・ヤンロンっていう地上人が乗ってるよ: Granveil's piloted by another surface@dweller, a guy named Yanlong Huang.
LDBI\t「ミオ、念のためにもう一度確認しておくが……@ いいんだな？」: Mio, just to make sure, I'll ask again...@You're okay with this?
LDBI\t「ええ。ザムージュが彼女を選んだんなら、@ あたしがとやかく言う筋合: Yeah. If Zamuuju chose her, it's not my@place to say anything.
LDBI\t「私も同意見よ。@ ミオ、ザムジードをよろしくお願いね」: I agree. Mio, please take good care@of Zamzeed.
LDBI\t「ねえ、お兄ちゃん……@ あたしがディアブロに乗ってもいい？」: Hey, big brother...@Can I pilot Diablo?
LDBI\t「止めたって駄目だよ、お兄ちゃん。@ あたしだって戦えるもの、手伝い: It's no use trying to stop me, big brother.@I can fight too, and I want to help.
LDBI\t「それに、ディアブロにはマドックお爺ちゃんに@ 何度か乗せてもらった: Besides, Grandpa Maddock let me ride@in Diablo a few times.
LDBI\t「いや、だからと言って……」: No, but just because of that...
LDBI\t「今は大変な時なんでしょ。@ 早く王都を取り戻さなきゃ、ラングランは: Things are really bad right now, aren't they?@If we don't take back the capital soon,@Langran will...
LDBI\t「しかしだな……@ テュッティ、お前からも言ってやってくれ」: But still...@Tytti, back me up here.
LDBI\t「いいわ、プレシア。ディアブロに乗りなさい」: All right, Precia. You may pilot Diablo.
LDBI\t「さすが、テュッティお姉ちゃん！ 話がわかる！」: You're the best, Tytti! You understand!
LDBI\t「マサキ、プレシアはあのゼオルートの娘よ。@ 大丈夫、信じてあげなさ: Masaki, Precia is the daughter of Zeoroot.@She'll be fine. Have faith in her.
LDBI\t「……あなたの気持ちは理解できるわ。@ でも、いずれは……」: ...I understand how you feel.@But sooner or later...
LDBI\t「……わかったよ。@ ただし、くれぐれも無理をするなよ、プレシア」: ...Fine.@But don't you dare push yourself, Precia.
LDBI\t「じゃあ、ディアブロの調整をしなきゃね。@ おいで、プレシア」: Well then, we'd better tune up Diablo.@Come on, Precia.
LDBI\t「プレシアの実の父親で……@ ラングラン王宮の剣術師範や武術指南役を: Precia's biological father... He was the@sword master and martial arts instructor@at the Langran palace. He was my mentor too.
LDBI\t「そう、“剣皇”と称される神祇無窮流の達人……@ 皆から慕われる、素: Yes, the "Sword Emperor," a master of the@Shingi Mukyu style... A wonderful man,@loved by everyone.

BMD\t「では、/ この艦がただの改造艦ではないことを/ 教えてやりましょう」: Then,/　let's show them this ship is more/　than a simple refit.

BMD\t「アプローチは大胆に。/ でないと、艦長は口説けませんぞ」: Be bold in your approach./　Or you'll never win over the Captain.
BMD\t「確かに、積極的な方がいいかも……」: True, being aggressive might be better...
BMD\t「何の話ですか！」: What are you two talking about!
BMD\t「ルイーナを接近させてはなりません！」: Don't let the Ruina get close!

BMD\t「あの、モザイク処理をお願いしますね」: Um, please add a mosaic to it, okay?
