BMD\t「ブーステッド・チルドレンが……/ 調子に乗るな！」: You Boosted Children.../　Don't get cocky!
BMD\t「ほう、僕のアルタルフに食いついたか」: Oh? You managed to keep up with my Altarf.
BMD\t「もう少しやると思っていたけどね」: I thought you'd put up more of a fight.
BMD\t「ある意味懐かしいね、この感覚は」: In a way, this feeling is nostalgic.
BMD\t「しばらくの間、付き合ってやるか……」: I suppose I'll play along for a while...
BMD\t「オリジナルである僕に楯突くか……！」: You dare defy me, the original...!
BMD\t「イング……お前が僕を上回るなどと……！」: Ing... How could you surpass me...!
BMD\t「アリエイル……それで終わりかい？」: Arieil... Is that all you've got?
BMD\t「イング……やはり、お前はその程度だ」: Ing... Just as I thought, that's your limit.
BMD\t「君達の能力は、そんなものだったかな？」: Is that really the extent of your abilities?
BMD\t「お前にも断てぬものがあるんだよ」: There are things even you can't cut.
BMD\t「所詮、イデアラントはそんなものか」: So that's all an Idealant amounts to.
BMD\t「成長していないね、ブロンゾ２８」: You haven't grown at all, Bronzo-28.
BMD\t「しばしの生を楽しむんだね」: Enjoy what little life you have left.
BMD\t「逃げ足が早いね」: Quick to run away, aren't you?
BMD\t「見逃すわけにはいかないな」: I can't let you get away.
BMD\t「詰めが甘いな、アーマラ」: You're sloppy at the finish, Amala.
BMD\t「手伝ってやるよ、ドゥバン・オーグ」: I'll lend you a hand, Duvan Ogue.
BMD\t「手加減でもしているのか、アルベロ？」: Are you going easy on them, Albero?
BMD\t「駒が減るのはあまり良くないからね」: Losing pieces isn't good for us, after all.
BMD\t「フッ……僕を待っていたのかい？」: Heh... Were you waiting for me?
LDBI\t「じゃあ、お主にサーベラス・イグナイトと@ ガルムレイド・ブレイズの: Now then, let me explain the Cerberus Ignite@and Garmraid Blaze to you.
LDBI\t「まず、イグナイトの素体はサーベラスの強化型での。@ しかも、リバー: First, the Ignite's base frame is an upgraded@Cerberus. And it's capable of Reversible@Transformation.
LDBI\t「それと、イグナイト・パーツという@ 武装ユニットの装着位置が変わる: And by changing the mounting positions of its@weapon units, called Ignite Parts...
LDBI\t「近距離・格闘戦用のフォームＧと@ 遠距離・砲撃専用のフォームＳとい: it can take two forms: Form G, for close-range@melee, and Form S, for long-range bombardment.
LDBI\t「また、ＴＥエンジンも改良型になっておっての、@ 出力調整の問題が軽: Its TE Engine's been improved too, so the@output regulation problem is reduced.@DFC's relatively easy as well.
LDBI\t「での、フォームに応じてパイロットが変わるように@ なっておるがの…: Now, it's set up so the pilot changes with the@form... but I can make it work the same as the@Cerberus and Garmraid. What'll it be?
LDBI\t「あなたの身体の負担を減らすためにも、@ パイロットが変わる仕様にし: To reduce the strain on your body, I think@switching pilots is the better setup.
LDBI\t「私、ここしばらくは@ 一人でＴＥアブゾーバーに乗っていたし……@: I've been flying the TE Absorber alone for a@while now... I can do it.
LDBI\t「じゃあ、次はブレイズの説明をするでの。@ あれの素体はガルムレイド: Now, let me explain the Blaze. Its base frame@is an upgraded Garmraid. Its TE Engine has@been improved as well.
LDBI\t「さらに、マシン・アニマリートという@ サポート・メカ……狼型のロウ: On top of that, it has support mechs called@Machine Animalitos... the wolf-type Rouga and@the bird-type Hiou.
LDBI\t「ロウガとヒオウは単体でも戦闘可能じゃがの、@ 通常は分離状態で素体: Rouga and Hiou can fight on their own, but@they're normally separated and mounted all@over the frame. Shift their positions, and...
LDBI\t「ブレイズもフォームＧとフォームＳになれるでの」: the Blaze can also become Form G or Form S.
LDBI\t「そちらも近距離戦用と遠距離戦用の……？」: Close-range and long-range forms for it too...?
LDBI\t「んむ。サーベラス・イグナイトと@ ガルムレイド・ブレイズ、それぞれ: Mm-hmm. Switch between the Cerberus Ignite's@and Garmraid Blaze's forms to suit the@situation, and you'll do fine.
LDBI\t「了解です。@ ……アクア、俺はミタールとエルデを……」: Understood.@...Aqua, I'm going after Mitar and Erde...
LDBI\t「ええ……わかっているわ。@ もうＡＩ１を破壊するだけじゃ済まない…: Yes... I know.@Just destroying AI1 won't be enough anymore...
LDBI\t「エルデと決着を付けるしかない……！」: I have to settle things with Erde...!
LDBI\t「えっ！？ 俺を雷鳳に！？」: Huh?! You want me in the RaiOh?!
LDBI\t「そうだ。レフィーナ大佐は、@ あれが今後も戦力として必要だと判断さ: That's right. Colonel Lefina has decided@we'll still need it as a fighting asset.
LDBI\t「そして、俺やゼンガーは@ 雷鳳に初めて乗ったにも関わらず、量産型ジ: And Sänger and I took note of your talent--@you fought the Mass-Production Jinrai the very@first time you piloted the RaiOh.
LDBI\t「カイ少佐だけでなく、ゼンガー少佐も……？」: Major Kai, and Major Sänger too...?
LDBI\t「ああ。荒削りだが、いい素質を持っている」: Yes. You're rough around the edges, but you@have real potential.
LDBI\t「無論、断っても構わん。よく考えろ」: Of course, you may refuse. Think it over.
LDBI\t「……その必要はありません。やらせて下さい」: ...There's no need. Let me do it.
LDBI\t「ミナキ……俺はやるよ。君の手で改修された雷鳳が、@ この世界を護る: Minaki... I'll do it. I'll prove that the RaiOh@you rebuilt is a power to protect this world.
LDBI\t「父の……私のせいで、あのような目に遭ったのに……@ そう言ってくれ: After all my father... all I put you through...@you'd still say that?
LDBI\t「ならば、この件は決定だ。@ ミナキ、再改修部分についての説明を」: Then it's settled.@Minaki, explain the refit modifications.
LDBI\t「はい。@ 人間が雷鳳を運用するに当たって、@ システムＬＩＯＨを排: Yes.@For a human to operate the RaiOh,@System LIOH can't be removed.
LDBI\t「その理由は……五体駆動によるフィードバックに@ 耐えるために、ＬＩ: The reason is that LIOH's register must be used@to withstand the feedback from full-body@motion control.
LDBI\t「システムＬＩＯＨが残ったままなら、@ また暴走する危険性が……」: If System LIOH is still in there, there's a@risk it'll go berserk again...
LDBI\t「いえ、使う機能は先程述べたレジスターだけ……@ 他は休眠させます。: No, we'll use only the register I mentioned...@the rest stays dormant. In exchange, LIOH will@provide almost no support...
LDBI\t「あなた自身の格闘スキルを上げることが@ 必要となります」: so you'll need to raise your own@fighting skills.
LDBI\t「つまり、特訓しろと……」: So you're saying I need to train hard...
LDBI\t「そこで、俺とゼンガー……そして、アクセルで@ お前を鍛え上げること: So Sänger and I... along with Axel... will@whip you into shape.
LDBI\t「……なるほど、おれがここに呼ばれた理由はそれか」: ...I see. So that's why I was called here.
LDBI\t「ああ……ソウルゲインには@ ＤＭＬシステムに似た物が搭載されている: Yes... The Soulgain carries something similar@to the DML System, and your own fighting skills@are top-notch.
LDBI\t「そんな頼みを聞く義理はないが……@ 今の状況ではそんなことを言って: I'm under no obligation to grant that favor...@but in this situation, I can't exactly refuse.
LDBI\t「引き受けてやろう。@ ただし、生半可ではないぞ。覚悟しておけ」: Fine, I'll take it on.@But it won't be half-hearted. Be ready.
LDBI\t「は、はい！ よろしくお願いします！」: Y-Yes, sir! I'm in your hands!
LDBI\t「命令に違反しただけでなく、@ 試作８号機と９号機までも失うとは！@: Not only did you disobey orders, you lost@Prototypes No. 8 and No. 9 as well!@What on earth were you doing?!
LDBI\t「先程申し上げた通り、@ その原因を作ったのはアルベロです。@ ……: As I told you earlier,@Albero was the cause.@...Though he's dead now.
LDBI\t「あ、あの男……何故、そのような真似を……！」: Th-That man... Why would he do such a thing...!
LDBI\t「手柄を焦っていたようですわね、@ 偽物の息子のために」: It seems he was eager for results,@for the sake of his fake son.
LDBI\t「馬鹿な……！ 私の命令に逆らった時点で@ 息子がどうなるか、わから: Absurd...! The moment he defied my orders, he@had to know what would become of his son!
LDBI\t「こ、このような失態……それに、損失を……！@ これでは、私の立場が: S-Such a blunder... and such losses...!@This will ruin my position... the project...!
LDBI\t「まだＡＩ１とメディウス、ＭＯＤＥＬ‐Ｘがあります。@ それらで結果: We still have AI1, Medius, and MODEL-X.@Why not produce results with those?
LDBI\t「そういう問題ではないのだよ！@ 私の名誉に大きな傷が付けられたのだ: That's not the point!@My honor has been badly tarnished!
LDBI\t「ＡＩ１がさらなる進化を遂げれば、@ 私の子をＭＯＤＥＬ‐Ｘに搭載す: If AI1 evolves further, and if my child is@installed in MODEL-X... we'll gain more than@enough to make up for it.
LDBI\t「冗談ではない！ あれは危険だ！@ 君にも責任を取ってもらうぞ！ 覚: Don't be absurd! That thing is dangerous!@You'll take responsibility too! Be ready!
LDBI\t（後はドゥバン・オーグを……。@ それで、この男には選択肢がなくなる: (Now for the Duvan Ogue... Then this man@will have no choice left.)
LDBI\t「アイビス、向こうは戦闘態勢に入ったわ！」: Ibis, she's switched to combat mode!
LDBI\t「ならば……やることは一つだ！」: Then... there's only one thing to do!
LDBI\t「フ……こちらの意図を理解してくれたか。@ ……認めたくはないが、根: Heh... So you understand my intent.@...I hate to admit it, but deep down,@it seems we're cut from the same cloth...
LDBI\t「全ての決着を付ける前に聞きたいことがある。@ アイビス、お前はその: Before we settle everything, I have a question.@Ibis, what do you intend to do@with that Altairion...?
LDBI\t「銀河を飛ぶこと……@ そして、その前にあたし達の星を守ることだよ」: Fly through the galaxy...@And before that, protect our world.
LDBI\t「逆に聞く。@ スレイ、あんたはそのベガリオンで@ 何をするつもりな: Now let me ask you.@Sleigh, what do you intend to do@with that Vegalion?
LDBI\t「気づいていたさ。今の私には何もない……」: I've known all along. I have nothing now...
LDBI\t「<ＤＣ>、そして<プロジェクトＴＤ>にいた頃は@ 兄様のために……: Back in the <ＤＣ>, and then <プロジェクトＴＤ>...@I flew for Brother... to see him smile...@just for that, and nothing else...
LDBI\t「兄様を失った後、@ 私に残されたのはシリーズ７７を@ 求めることだ: After I lost Brother,@all I had left was my pursuit@of Series 77...
LDBI\t「だから、アルテリオンを取り戻すため、@ 兄様の手が直接加えられてい: So, to take back the Altairion,@I boarded this Vegalion, which Brother@never touched with his own hands...
LDBI\t「兄様が設計したとは言え、@ この機体に兄様の魂は込められていない…: Brother may have designed it,@but his soul isn't in this machine...@Like me. Hollow, even with me aboard...
LDBI\t「ベガリオンとアルテリオンを手に入れても、@ そこから先が私にはない: Even if I had both the Vegalion and Altairion,@there's nothing beyond that for me...
LDBI\t「情けない話だ……@ 私は、アステリオンやアルテリオンを得て、@ 兄: It's pathetic...@I was jealous of you for getting the Astelion@and Altairion and carrying on Brother's dream.
LDBI\t「私の兄様を……@ 兄様の全てを取られたような気がしてな」: It felt like you'd taken my brother...@taken everything of his from me.
LDBI\t「だが、たった一つだけ残されていたものが@ あることに気づいた。それ: But I realized there was one thing@I still had left. And that is...

LDBI\t「なお、繰り返しになるが……@ 建前上、連邦軍は君達の行動に関与せず: Again, I must stress this...@Officially, the Federation Forces are not@involved in your actions and bear no liability.
LDBI\t「また、ガイアセイバーズの今後の動向次第では、@ 威力偵察や能動的な: Also, depending on what the Gaia Saviors do@next, we may have you carry out reconnaissance@in force or other proactive operations.
LDBI\t「現時点では、いくら彼らが怪しいと言えど、@ 連邦軍から仕掛けるわけ: Since, however suspicious they may be, the@Federation Forces can't strike first at present.
LDBI\t「ああ。今の君達の立場を利用する形となるのが@ 心苦しいが……」: Yes. It pains me to take advantage of the@position you're in now, but...
LDBI\t「アルテウルの陰謀を暴くため、@ 強硬手段を取る必要があると判断され: If we judge that forceful measures are needed@to expose Arteur's conspiracy, you'll be the@ones to act.
LDBI\t「また、ギャスパル元帥は@ 後々のルイーナやゲストへの反攻作戦に@: Also, Marshal Gaspar apparently intends to have@you take part in future counteroffensives@against the Ruina and the Guests.
LDBI\t「特にルイーナに対しては、リ・テクの機体と@ そのパイロットが鍵とな: Against the Ruina in particular, the Re-Tech@machines and their pilots could be the key...
LDBI\t「場合によっては、かつての@ ホワイトスターやソーディアン攻略作戦の: If it comes to it, you may have to storm the@enemy's core, as in the White Star and Sodium@assault operations of the past.
LDBI\t「その場合も支援なしということですかな？」: And would that be without support as well?
LDBI\t「さすがにそれはない。根回しはしておくさ」: Of course not. I'll pull some strings.
LDBI\t「あと、ある民間企業が@ 鋼龍戦隊へ物資提供を申し出ていてね。@ 偽: Also, a private company has offered supplies@to the Steel Dragons. A disguised transport@will deliver them to Iti Iti Island.
LDBI\t「ケントルム・エクスプレス……@ 経営者はアクア・ケントルム少尉の叔: Centrum Express... Its owner is the uncle of@Lieutenant Aqua Centrum...
LDBI\t「彼女の父であるテイラー・ケントルム上院議員を通じ、@ 鋼龍戦隊への: Through her father, Senator Taylor Centrum, he@offered material support to the Steel Dragons.
LDBI\t「大変ありがたい話ですが……問題はないのですか？」: We're very grateful, but... is that all right?
LDBI\t「表向きには戦災地への救援物資という扱いだ。@ しかも、そちら以外の: Officially, it's relief aid for war-torn areas.@We've also received supplies bound elsewhere.
LDBI\t「なお、ケントルム上院議員から要望があってね……@ アクア少尉には、: Also, Senator Centrum made one request... He@asks that Lieutenant Aqua not be told who@provided the supplies.
LDBI\t「彼女に過保護だと受け取られたくないそうだ」: He doesn't want her to think he's overprotective.
LDBI\t「なるほど……そういう事情ですか」: I see... So that's how it is.
LDBI\t「では、以上だ。また連絡する」: That's all, then. I'll be in touch.
LDBI\t「……ジェイコブ中将やアクア少尉の親族だけでなく、@ ミツコ・イスル: ...Not just Lieutenant General Jacob and@Lieutenant Aqua's family, but President Mitsuko@Isurugi and Dr. Shu Shirakawa as well...
LDBI\t「結果的には、我々の手助けをしてくれたことに@ なりますかな」: In the end, it seems they've all lent us a hand.
LDBI\t「彼女は、シラカワ博士の情報と共に、@ ベガリオンとスレイ・プレステ: Along with Dr. Shirakawa's information, she may@have entrusted the Vegalion and Sleigh Presty@to us as well.
LDBI\t「向こうはともかく、アイビス達は彼女の帰還を@ 望んでいたわけですか: Whatever Sleigh herself thought, Ibis and the@others wanted her back, after all.
LDBI\t「それに……こちらの口を封じるためでもありますね」: And... it's also to keep us quiet, isn't it?
LDBI\t「左様……@ スレイ・プレスティが所属していた傭兵集団の@ 雇い主は: Indeed... The employer of the mercenary group@Sleigh Presty belonged to was Isurugi Heavy@Industries.
LDBI\t「しかし、そのことを公にし、追及すると@ 彼女自身のみならず、プロジ: But if we exposed that and pressed the matter,@she, Project TD, and we who took her in would@all suffer for it.
LDBI\t「まあ、有耶無耶にしておけということでしょうなぁ」: Well, I suppose we're meant to let it slide.
LDBI\t「現状ではやむを得ませんが……@ ミツコ・イスルギ社長とシュウ・シラ: It can't be helped for now... But President@Mitsuko Isurugi and Dr. Shu Shirakawa, too...
LDBI\t「ガイアセイバーズを……アルテウルを@ 危険視していることに違いはな: ...clearly both see the Gaia Saviors... and@Arteur as a threat.
LDBI\t「グランゾンにそのような秘密が隠されていたとは……」: To think the Granzon held such a secret...
LDBI\t「それに、ゲストのゼゼーナンって奴は@ かなり前から良からぬことを企: Plus, that Guest guy Zezenan's been schemin'@for ages, messin' with Earth from way back.
LDBI\t「なら、<ＤＣ戦争>以前から<ＥＯＴ特別審議会>と@ 接触していた…: Then he'd been in contact with the@<ＥＯＴ特別審議会> since before the <ＤＣ戦争>...
LDBI\t「スカルヘッド……今のヘブンゲートは@ ゼゼーナンの目論見によって@: Skullhead... The current Heaven's Gate may@have been built according to Zezenan's@designs.
LDBI\t「グランゾンのせいでトンデモ事件が多発してたなんて、@ にわかには信: Hard to swallow that all those wild incidents@were the Granzon's fault, but...
LDBI\t「そのゼゼーナンって人、色々企んでた割には@ 事態を収拾できてないん: For all his scheming, this Zezenan guy doesn't@seem to have things under control, huh?
LDBI\t「本人もここまでの大事になるとは@ 思っていなかったんだろうさ」: I bet even he didn't think it'd blow up@this big.
LDBI\t「まあ、ゲストがアインストやルイーナを@ 意図的に呼び出したとは思え: Still, I doubt the Guests summoned the Einst@or the Ruina on purpose.
LDBI\t「別の世界との境界線が不安定になってる原因は@ 地球そのものにあるん: Shu said the reason the boundaries with other@worlds are getting unstable might lie with@Earth itself.
LDBI\t（地球そのものに……@ もしや、南極のファブラ・フォレースか？）: (With Earth itself... Could it be the Fabula@Fores in Antarctica?)
LDBI\t「それにしても、どうしてシュウは私達だけじゃなく、@ マサキ君達まで: But why did Shu call out Masaki and the others@too, not just us?
LDBI\t「ま、言い方は悪いが……@ 鋼龍戦隊が出向かなかった場合の保険じゃな: Not to put it too bluntly, but... as insurance@in case the Steel Dragons didn't show?
LDBI\t「実際、こっちは疑って掛かって、@ 俺達で様子を見に行っただけだが…: Truth is, we were suspicious and just came to@check it out ourselves... but if Shu's involved,@Masaki's guaranteed to take the bait.
LDBI\t「人を釣り堀の魚みてえに言うんじゃねえよ」: Quit makin' me sound like a fish in a stocked@pond!
LDBI\t「……つまり、シュウは鋼龍戦隊やマサキ達を@ 証人とするべく呼び出し: ...So Shu called the Steel Dragons and Masaki's@group here to serve as witnesses...
LDBI\t「俺達の前でゼゼーナンの目論見を暴いて、@ 奴が慌てる所を見たかった: He wanted to expose Zezenan's scheme in front@of us and watch him squirm. Damn, what a@sneaky bastard.
LDBI\t「でも、あの人は世間に向けて@ アルテウル・シュタインベックの陰謀を: But he did hint to the world about Arteur@Steinbeck's conspiracy...
LDBI\t「あんなの、後で何とでも言い訳できるだろ。@ やり方がセコいんだよ」: He can explain that away later however he wants.@It's a cheap way to play it.
LDBI\t「でも、騒ぎにはなってるし、@ 後々で効いてくるってこともあり得るわ: But it's stirred things up, and it might pay@off down the line.
LDBI\t「全く根拠がないってわけじゃないですからね……」: It's not like it's completely baseless...
LDBI\t「それに……シュウは私達に@ 今、戦うべき相手を示したのかも知れない: Besides... Shu may have shown us who we@should be fighting right now...
LDBI\t「あいつのことだ、俺達や鋼龍戦隊を利用して@ ゲストやガイアセイバー: Knowin' him, he's just usin' us and the Steel@Dragons to pound the Guests and the Gaia@Saviors.
BMD\t「ぐっ！ 意外にダメージでかいな……！」: Gah! That did more damage than I thought...!
BMD\t「さぁて……どうしたもんかな、こいつは」: Well now... What to do about this one?
BMD\t「まあ、ここまではな」: Well, I'll give you that much.
BMD\t「結構食い込んできやがったな」: You dug in pretty deep there.
BMD\t「どうもな……本気でやってるのか？」: I dunno... Are you even trying?
BMD\t「おい！ 本気を出さねえと……死ぬぜ？」: Hey! If you don't get serious... you'll die.
BMD\t「力もねぇくせに……引っ込んでろ！！」: You're weak... so stay out of this!!
BMD\t「そんな腕で戦いに出るな！」: Don't come to a fight with skills like that!
BMD\t「こっちは冗談でやってるんじゃねえんだぜ？」: I'm not doing this for laughs, you know?
BMD\t「ほう……当ててきやがったか」: Oh... So you landed a hit.
BMD\t「これぐらいのことはしてもらわねえとな」: I'd expect at least that much from you.
BMD\t「ふん、/ グレイターキンに食いついてくるとはな」: Hmph./　Keeping up with the Greytarkin, huh?
BMD\t「遠慮はいらねえぜ、ロフ」: No need to hold back, Rof.
BMD\t「そう簡単には当たらんもんよ！」: It's not that easy to hit me!
BMD\t「おっと、その手は食わねえ」: Whoa, I'm not falling for that.
BMD\t「遊びでやってるんじゃねえんだぜ？」: I'm not playing games here, you know?
BMD\t「まあ、お前らじゃそんなもんだろう」: Well, that's about what I'd expect from you.
BMD\t「何だ、つまらねえ奴だな」: What, you're no fun at all.
BMD\t「ゼゼーナン、あんたじゃ無理だ」: Zezenan, you're not up to this.
BMD\t「直撃だと思ったか？ 残念だったな」: Thought Pierce would do it? Too bad.
BMD\t「無駄な攻撃だというのがわからんようだな」: /　You don't get that your attacks are useless?
BMD\t「これが技術力の差、って奴だ」: That's what you call a technology gap.
BMD\t「理解に苦しむな。何がしたいんだ？」: I don't get it. What are you trying to do?
BMD\t「こっちも色々考えてるんでね」: I've got a few ideas of my own, you know.
BMD\t「次は直接攻撃してこい！」: Next time, come at me directly!
BMD\t「次はちゃんと撃ってこいよ」: Next time, actually shoot at me.
BMD\t「弾切れか……！ まあ、しょうがねえ……」: Out of ammo...! Well, can't be helped...
BMD\t「良かったな。命拾いしたぜ」: Lucky you. You live to see another day.
BMD\t「ちいっ……！/ この距離では、どうにもならんな……！」: Tch...!/　Not much I can do at this range...!
BMD\t「少しは頭を使ってきたようだな」: Looks like you're finally using your head.
BMD\t「フン、見逃してやるか」: Hmph, I'll let you off this time.
BMD\t「こっちのレンジから逃げやがったか」: Slipped out of my range, huh?
BMD\t「あいつ、どこへ消えやがった？」: Where the hell did they go?
BMD\t「おっと、続きがあるんだぜ？」: Whoa, there's more where that came from!
BMD\t「やれやれ、しょうがねえ」: Sheesh, guess I've got no choice.
BMD\t「効率重視で行かせてもらうぜ！」: I'll keep this nice and efficient!
BMD\t「仕方がない、相手をしてやるか」: Can't be helped. I'll play with you.
LDBI\t「行ってやるわよ、この子と一緒にね！」: Fine, I'll go--with this little one at my side!
LDBI\t「お前はウェントスの機能を乱す。@ その原因を取り除く。消えてもらう: You disrupt Ventus's functions.@I will remove the cause. You must vanish.
LDBI\t「ぬううっ、馬鹿な！@ この俺が、人間共に押し負けるなどと！」: Nngh, impossible!@Me, overpowered by a bunch of humans!?
LDBI\t「そんなことが出来るか！@ 俺はあの人間を抹殺するんだよ！@ でなき: Like hell I will!@I'm going to wipe out that human!@Otherwise, Laki will...!
LDBI\t「そのことも含め、考えがある。@ ここは私に任せ、お前は退くのだ」: I have a plan that covers that as well.@Leave this to me and fall back.
LDBI\t「あれだけのことを言っておきながら、@ グラキエースに拘っておきなが: After everything he said, after obsessing@over Glacies, he's pulling out?@Why...?
LDBI\t（この私を退けるか……！@ ならば、あの策を使うしかあるまい）: (They drive even me back...!@Then there's nothing for it but that plan.)
LDBI\t「そのことも含め、私に考えがある」: I have a plan that covers that as well.
LDBI\t「オフィチナスはどうする！？@ みすみす奴らにここを明け渡すのか！？: What about Officinas!?@You're just going to hand this place to them!?
LDBI\t「確かに、我らにとって手痛い損失だが、@ それは一時のこと。後々に利: It's a painful loss for us, true,@but only a temporary one. It'll pay off later.
LDBI\t「考えがあると言っただろう？ @ 私に任せるのだ」: I told you I have a plan, didn't I?@Leave it to me.
LDBI\t（さらばだ、人間共。@ ここがお前達の墓場となる。クククッ）: (Farewell, humans.@This place will become your grave. Heh heh heh.)
LDBI\t「メリオルエッセ機、基地から離脱していきます！」: The Meliores Esse units are leaving the base!
LDBI\t「見切りを付けたのか……！？」: Have they given up on it...!?
LDBI\t「チャンスだ……！@ リム、ウェポン・ボックス・ハンガーを@ パージ: This is our chance...!@Rim, purge the Weapon Box Hanger@and we'll head underground!
LDBI\t「わかってます、無茶はしませんよ！」: I know, I won't do anything reckless!
LDBI\t「案ずるな。私があの人間達を葬る。@ そのために私はここにいる」: Do not worry. I will bury those humans.@That is why I am here.
LDBI\t「私の中からも、この世界からもお前の存在を消す。@ 滅びを定められし: I will erase you from within me, and from@this world. You who are destined for ruin,@leave your corpses to rot amid hatred.
LDBI\t（くっ……そうだ、グラキエース……お前のその心）: (Ngh... That's right, Glacies...@That heart of yours.)
LDBI\t（憎悪させ、恐怖させ、死をもたらすという意思は@ 純粋で明確なのに、: (Your will to spread hatred and fear and bring@death is pure and clear, yet there's no malice,@no clinging to your own life--that heart.)
LDBI\t（うっ……やめろ！ 貴様の意識が私を圧迫する。@ その戯れ言が私の機: (Ngh... Stop! Your consciousness presses on me.@Your drivel impairs my functions. I was made@that way--I exist to embody destruction.)
LDBI\t（不都合なのは、貴様の存在だ。@ おかしいのは、貴様が私の中にいるこ: (What is inconvenient is your existence.@What is wrong is that you are inside me.)
LDBI\t（その、お前の中の俺を見ろ、グラキエース。@ 自分の心の歪さを見ろ）: (Look at the me inside you, Glacies.@See how warped your own heart is.)
LDBI\t（俺と共感したお前の一部、@ 共有してしまったその意識の中で、@ お: (The part of you that resonated with me,@within the consciousness we came to share...@you long to be set free.)
LDBI\t（それが俺の意思となって、@ 俺を動かしているんだ。それを見ろ）: (That has become my will,@and it's what drives me. Look at it.)
LDBI\t（黙るがいい……人間。@ 私が完全に壊れる前に、お前を殺してみせる）: (Be silent... human.@Before I break completely, I will kill you.)
LDBI\t（ぐ……う……！@ ならば、滅びろ……死して、破滅の、王の……@ く: (Ngh... ugh...!@Then perish... In death... the King... of Ruin...@Gaaah...!)
LDBI\t「アニキ、どうしたの！？ しっかりして！！」: Bro, what's wrong!? Pull yourself together!!
LDBI\t（くそ……あいつの意識が、俺を壊すのか……！@ 違う、そうじゃない！: (Damn... Is her mind going to break me...!?@No, that's not it! Ngh, the resonance...@the sync is still getting stronger...!)
LDBI\t（駄目だ、“破滅の王”が、ルイーナが@ いったい何なのか知るまで@: (No... until I know what the "King of Ruin"@and the Ruina really are, I can't cut off@the Sympathia...!)
LDBI\t（機能不全が強まっている……私は……私は……？）: (My malfunction is worsening... I... I am...?)
LDBI\t「やはり、駄目か……グラキエース」: So it's no use after all... Glacies.
LDBI\t「ならば、今からそこを自爆させる。@ お前達の死を以て、オフィチナス: Then I will self-destruct that place now.@With your deaths, the energy of Officinas will@be unleashed. Be of use by perishing.
LDBI\t「お前もだ、ウェントス。@ “破滅の王”から授かった力で、@ そこに: You too, Ventus.@With the power granted by the "King of Ruin,"@bring death to the humans there.
LDBI\t「では、さらばだ。@ お前達に良き滅びがもたらされんことを」: Farewell, then.@May a fine ruin be granted to you all.
LDBI\t「……コンターギオ達は私が使えなくなったと判断した。@ 私達の死の波: ...Contagio has judged me no longer usable.@With the waves of our deaths, we will turn the@energy of Officinas into destructive power.
LDBI\t「貴様達もろとも、私達は消えるのだ」: We will vanish, and take you with us.
LDBI\t「もう僕にはどうすることも出来ない……@ 僕はシステムに囚われている: There's nothing I can do anymore...@I'm trapped by the system.
LDBI\t「ユーゼス・ゴッツォ、お前の過去生に@ 僕は存在していたか？」: Euzeth Gozzo, in your past lives...@did I exist?
LDBI\t「存在していなければ、@ 僕こそがお前の新たな運命変動因子だ！」: If I didn't, then I'm the new@fate-altering factor in your destiny!
LDBI\t「お前の運命を決めるのは、お前じゃない！@ 僕達なんだ！！」: You're not the one who decides your fate!@We are!!
LDBI\t「お、同じか……同じ結末なのか……！」: Th-The same... Is it the same ending...?!
LDBI\t「な、何故だ……何故だ……！？@ 因子が決定的に違うのだぞ……ガンエ: Wh-Why... Why?!@The factors are completely different... I took@Gan Eden... I took the Cross Gate...!
LDBI\t「私の邪魔をする者など……いないはず……！」: There should be no one left to stand in my way...!
LDBI\t「フッ……目の前にいるでしょう？」: Heh... We're right in front of you, are we not?
LDBI\t「結末は見えていたはずだ、これがな」: You should've seen this ending coming.
LDBI\t「わ、私がこんな所で……終わるはずがない……！」: I-I can't possibly end in a place like this...!
LDBI\t「最期に教えていただきましょうか。@ クロスゲートは、誰が何のために: Before you go, perhaps you'll tell me this.@Who built the Cross Gate, and for what purpose?
LDBI\t「終わるはずが……ない……！@ そうだ、新人祖たる私が死ぬなどと……: It can't... end like this...!@Yes, for I, the New Progenitor, to die...!
LDBI\t「くっ、ふふふ……ふふふ……@ 輪廻を解脱した私が……死ぬわけがない: Kuh, heh heh heh... heh heh...@I have broken free of the cycle of rebirth...@I cannot die... Kuh, heh heh heh heh...
LDBI\t「そうだ……私は世界を……全てを創る……@ ふふふっ……そう、全て…: Yes... I will create the world... everything...@Heh heh... Yes, all of it... all of it... heh
LDBI\t「もう一度聞きます。@ クロスゲートを造ったのは、何者です？@ 何が: I'll ask again.@Who built the Cross Gate?@What is its purpose?
LDBI\t「私だ！ 私が造ったのだ！@ そう、あれは！ 私が造るはずだったのだ: Me! I built it!@Yes, that thing! I was supposed to build it!!
LDBI\t「クロスゲートもガンエデンも！@ 新しい世界も、人類も！ ははははは: The Cross Gate, Gan Eden!@A new world, mankind! Hahahaha!!@Yes! I was supposed to create it all!!
LDBI\t「なのに、何を間違った！？ @ 何が原因なのだ！？ イルイか！？@: So what went wrong?!@What was the cause?! Was it Irui?!@Hahaha! Of course! It was Irui!!
LDBI\t「……そのイルイを取り込んでしまったのは誰だ？」: ...And who was it that absorbed that Irui?
LDBI\t「僕という運命変動因子を@ 作ってしまったのは……誰だ？」: And who was it that created@me, the fate-altering factor?
BMD\t「お礼はさせていただかなくてはいけませんね」: I really must repay you for that.
BMD\t「私に刃向かった報いです」: This is your reward for defying me.
BMD\t「先に手を出したのはあなたですからね/ ……ククク」: You did strike first, after all./　...Heh heh heh.
BMD\t「そのまま逃げれば良かったものを……」: You should have just kept running...
BMD\t「ククク……これならどうです？」: Heh heh heh... How about this?
BMD\t「では、/ 私も遠慮なく攻撃させてもらいましょうか」: Well then,/　I'll attack without reservation too.
BMD\t「報いを受けていただきましょうか」: Time for you to pay the price.
BMD\t「では、意趣返しといきましょうか」: Well then, let's return the favor.
BMD\t「どうやらここまでのようですね……」: It seems this is as far as I go...
BMD\t「！？/ ここまでやるとは……/ 私の予測が甘かったようですね」: !?/　To think you'd go this far.../　It seems my calculations were naive.
BMD\t「むぅっ！ このパワー……/ 私の予想を上回っていますね」: Mmh! This power.../　It exceeds my expectations.
BMD\t「くっ……なるほど、/ そちらも必死というわけですね」: Ngh... I see,/　so you're desperate as well.
BMD\t「くっ……なるほど、上手い手です」: Ngh... I see. A clever move.

BMD\t「うぎゃあぁぁっ！！/ 死ぬ、死む、死め、死もう！」: Gyaaaaah!!/　I die, I dies, I dying, I'm gonna die!

BMD\t「むうっ……/ グランヴェールの力……さすがです」: Mmh.../　The power of Granveil... Impressive.
BMD\t「何と……/ これほどのパワーとは、少々予想外でした」: What.../　This much power is rather unexpected.
BMD\t「む……意外でしたよ、アハマド。/ あなたを侮っていました」: Hm... You surprised me, Ahmad./　I underestimated you.
BMD\t「あがけばあがくほど、/ 鎖は絡まるものですよ、ユーゼス」: The more you struggle,/　the tighter the chains grow, Euzeth.
BMD\t「つっ！/ ……しかし、この程度では、私は倒せませんよ」: Tch!/　...But this much won't defeat me.
BMD\t「ぬっ……！/ だが、まだまだ大した事はありませんよ……」: Ngh...!/　But it's still nothing to speak of...
BMD\t「むっ……その程度で私と戦おうと？/ ……フッ、愚かな……」: Hm... You'd fight me with only that?/　...Heh, how foolish...
BMD\t「なかなか……/ しかし、本当の勝負はこれからですよ」: Not bad.../　But the real contest starts now.
BMD\t「ほう、直撃させてきましたか」: Oh? So you landed a direct hit.
BMD\t「つっ！/ ……しかし、まだこの程度では、/ 私は倒せませんよ」: Tch!/　...But this much still isn't/　enough to defeat me.
BMD\t「ぬ……だが、/ まだまだ大したことはありませんよ……」: Ngh... But,/　it's still nothing to speak of...
BMD\t「ほう……なかなかいい攻撃です。/ ですが、決定力に欠けていますね」: Oh... A fine attack./　But it lacks decisive force.
BMD\t「なるほど、そう来ましたか。/ 悪くない攻撃です」: I see, so that's your approach./　Not a bad attack.
BMD\t「ふむ、いい所を突いてきましたね。/ なかなかの腕前です」: Hm, you've found a good opening./　Quite skillful.
BMD\t「ほう……/ どうやらあなたに対する認識を/ 少し改める必要がありそう: Oh.../　It seems I'll need to revise/　my opinion of you somewhat.
BMD\t「けど、こんなのでやられるご主人様じゃ/ ありませんよっ！ ええ、そう: But Master's not gonna go down/　to something like that! No way, no how!/　Master is invincible, after all!
BMD\t「い、言っときますけどね！/ 今のはただのまぐれですからね！/ ご主人: J-Just so you know!/　That was a total fluke!/　Once Master gets serious, it's nothing!
BMD\t「ほう……/ 炎の魔装機神は伊達ではないようですね」: Oh.../　The Elemental Lord of Fire is no sham.
BMD\t「む……外見に似合わぬこのパワー……/ なるほど、ヴァルシオンの発展系: Hm... Such power despite its looks.../　I see. So it really is/　a development of the Valsion.
BMD\t「……見直しましたよ、アハマド。/ あなたの力がこれほどとは……」: ...I misjudged you, Ahmad./　I never knew you had such power...
BMD\t「……量産機とはわけが違うようですね」: ...This is no mass-produced unit, it seems.
BMD\t「……そろそろ/ あなた達との因縁を終わりにしたいですね」: ...It's about time I ended/　this long feud between us.
BMD\t「あなた達が思っているほど、/ グランゾンは脆くないのですよ」: Granzon is not as fragile/　as you seem to think.
BMD\t「最後の悪あがきですね、ゼゼーナン卿」: One last futile struggle, Lord Zezenan?
BMD\t「光龍、/ あなたの出し物はそれで終わりですか？」: Koryu,/　is that the end of your little show?
BMD\t「む……人外の力を侮っていましたよ」: Hm... I underestimated this inhuman power.
BMD\t「私は、あなた達の贄になる気はありませんよ」: I have no intention/　of becoming your sacrifice.

LDBI\t「ええ、ゲストの侵攻が判明した直後、@ 開発中の物をまとめて地球へ移: Yes. Right after the Guests invaded,@we were told to gather everything in development@and ship it to Earth.
LDBI\t「<インスペクター事件>では新型機が狙われましたので……@ そこから: During the <インスペクター事件>, new models were@targeted... This measure draws on that lesson.
LDBI\t「もっとも、行き先が消えるなどとは@ 思いもしませんでしたが」: Though I never imagined our destination@would simply vanish.
LDBI\t「それで、目的地をＬ４宙域のコロニー群へ変更し……@ そちらへ向かっ: So we changed course for the colonies in L4...@and on the way there, we managed to make@contact with the Hagane.
LDBI\t「エクスバイン用のパーツは、全て持ち出したのか？」: Did you bring all the parts for the Ex-Bein?
LDBI\t「その通りですが……@ 一連の事件が原因で、作業は遅れていましてよ」: We did, but... that whole string of incidents@has put the work behind schedule.
LDBI\t「だが、これで機体とパーツが揃った。@ 後は、いかにして効率良く仕上: Still, now we have both the unit and the parts.@All that remains is finishing it efficiently.
LDBI\t「私も手伝いますわよ。ＰＴ開発に関わった者として、@ ハイ・パーソナ: I'll help as well. Having worked on PTs myself,@I can't let High Personal Troopers steal our@thunder. Let's get to work right away.
LDBI\t「うむ。@ まずはアッシュのエンジン・モジュール換装だ」: Right.@First, we'll swap out the Ash's engine module.
LDBI\t「ああ、そこは早めに手を付けて、@ 上体バランスとバイパス周りの再調: Yeah, we need to get on that early and readjust@the upper-body balance and the bypass systems...
LDBI\t「どうやら、本格的に火が付いたみたいだな。@ 仕上がりが楽しみだぜ」: Looks like they're really fired up now.@Can't wait to see how it turns out.
LDBI\t「わかってるよ、会社に残ったんだろ？」: I know. He stayed behind at the company, right?
LDBI\t「ま、前回のこともあるからな……@ あいつらしい判断だぜ」: Well, after what happened last time...@That's just like him.
LDBI\t「ラーダ……補給物資を分けてもらったのは@ 助かったが、大丈夫なのか: Radha... Sharing their supplies helped us out,@but will they be all right?
LDBI\t「モドネル艦長はインスペクター事件の時、@ 鋼龍戦隊に命を救われたこ: Captain Modonel says the Steel Dragons saved his@life during the Inspector Incident. He wanted to@repay that, in some small way...
LDBI\t「何？ そんなこと、俺には一言も……」: What? He never said a word to me...
LDBI\t「男気のある人物だったようだな。@ ……それで、艦長。以後の行動だが: Sounds like a man with real grit.@...Now then, Captain. As for our next move,@do we head straight for the Moon?
LDBI\t「それなのですが……宇宙軍が月でゲストと交戦中なら、@ 我々はヘブン: About that... If the Space Force is fighting the@Guests on the Moon, I think we'd be better off@heading to Heaven's Gate instead.
LDBI\t「ええ。語弊はありますが、@ 作戦行動中の友軍部隊が少なければ少ない: Yes. It may sound wrong, but I figured the@fewer friendly units in active operations,@the easier it'd be for us to move.
LDBI\t「宇宙軍が健在なら、追っ手にも変わり得るか……。@ だが、ムーンクレ: With the Space Force intact, they could turn@into pursuers too... But what about Moon Cradle?@It's likely fallen.
LDBI\t「友軍のバックアップがあるならともかく、@ 現状、単艦で向かうのは危: With friendly backup it'd be another matter,@but heading there alone right now is risky.
LDBI\t「確かに……ヘブンゲートの方が攻め易いがな」: True... though Heaven's Gate is easier to hit.
LDBI\t「月やコロニーは宇宙軍に任せ、メリオルエッセと@ 交戦経験のある我々: The Moon and colonies are the Space Force's job.@We've fought the Meliores Esse; shouldn't we go@to Heaven's Gate and solve the rift mystery?
LDBI\t「ねえ、イング。@ あなた、本当にあのアーマラって子に@ 覚えがない: Hey, Ing.@Do you really not remember@that girl Amala?
LDBI\t「前回もそうだったけど、彼女はわざとイングを@ 追い詰めていたような: It was the same last time... I get the feeling@she was backing Ing into a corner on purpose...
LDBI\t「何故、そのような……」: Why would she do such a thing...?
LDBI\t「イングに力を発揮させるため……@ 彼を成長させるためかも知れません: To make Ing draw out his power...@Maybe to make him grow stronger.
LDBI\t「念動力者は危機に陥った時、@ 力を発揮させる傾向があるけど……」: Telekinetics do tend to unleash their@power when they're in danger, but...
LDBI\t「わざと痛めつけて、成長を促す……@ そのやり方、覚えがあるぜ」: Roughing someone up on purpose so they grow...@I've seen that trick before.
LDBI\t「ああ。@ 俺達を強力な手駒に仕立て上げるため、@ 自分自身が敵とな: Yeah.@He made himself our enemy@to turn us into powerful pawns...
LDBI\t「では、アーマラの目的もそうだと？」: Then you think that's Amala's goal too?
LDBI\t「いずれガイアセイバーズの戦力とするために@ イングを放逐し、アーマ: If they cast Ing out so he'd eventually join the@Gaia Savers' forces, and Amala's playing the@enemy to make him grow...
BMD\t「お兄ちゃん、後は任せて！」: Big brother, leave the rest to me!
BMD\t「ちょっと！/ まだ終わってないわよ、お兄ちゃん！」: Hey!/　We're not done yet, big brother!
BMD\t「ミオ、後は任せて！」: Mio, leave the rest to me!
BMD\t「間に入ればっ！」: If I can just get in between...!
BMD\t「リムさん、後は任せて！」: Rim, leave the rest to me!
BMD\t「ミチルさん、やせ我慢しちゃ駄目！」: Michiru, don't just tough it out!
BMD\t「サンダー・スマッシャー！/ 撃つんだからっ！」: Thunder Smasher!/　I'm firing it, so there!
BMD\t「これで決めてみせるんだから！」: I'll finish this, just watch me!
BMD\t「いつまでも笑ってられると思わないで！」: Don't think you can keep laughing forever!
BMD\t「ウンブラ！/ あんたの思い通りにはいかないわ！」: Umbra!/　Things won't go the way you want!
BMD\t「ウンブラ、そこをどいてもらうわよ！」: Umbra, you're getting out of my way!
BMD\t「セプテンプルムを何とかしなきゃ……！」: I have to do something about Septemptrum...!
BMD\t（あの人、男なの？ 女なの？）: (Is that person a man? Or a woman?)
BMD\t「あたしが何者であっても、/ クリスが戻って来るまで/ 消えるわけには: No matter what I am,/　I can't disappear/　until Chris comes back!
BMD\t「ペルフェクティオ……！/ あたしとこの子の力で、あんたを倒す！」: Perfectio...!/　With my strength and this one's,/　I'll take you down!
BMD\t「地球をあんた達に渡しはしないわ！」: We won't hand Earth over to you!
BMD\t「何の権利があって、あたし達の地球を……！」: What right do you have to our Earth...!
BMD\t「指揮官機ね……でも、やってみせる！」: A Commander unit... But I'll do it anyway!
BMD\t「夏喃、あんたの思い通りにはならない！」: Kanan, things won't go your way!
BMD\t「仙人なんかになるつもりはないわ！」: I'm not about to become some immortal!
BMD\t「孫光龍！ あんたの言うことなんて！」: Sun Koryu! I won't listen to you!
BMD\t「四霊相手でも……負けられない！」: Even against the Four Spirits... I can't lose!
BMD\t「ジンライの動きには気をつけなきゃ……！」: I've got to watch out for Jinrai's moves...!
BMD\t「ジンライ……これ以上、暴れさせないから！」: Jinrai... I won't let you rampage anymore!
BMD\t「スピードだけで勝負が決まるわけじゃない！」: Speed alone doesn't decide a fight!
BMD\t「いくら速くても、捕捉してみせる！」: However fast you are, I'll lock on!
BMD\t（あれに殴られたら、きっと痛いよぉ！）: (Getting hit by that would really hurt!)
BMD\t「ルイーナ、あんた達の好きにはやらせないわ！」: Ruina, I won't let you do as you please!
BMD\t「クリス……見ていて。ルイーナはあたし達が！」: Chris... Watch me. We'll handle Ruina!
BMD\t「クリス……あたしは挫けない。/ 戻って来てくれると信じてる！」: Chris... I won't give up./　I believe you'll come back!
BMD\t（遺跡からあんなのが出てくるなんて……！）: (To think that came out of the ruins...!)
BMD\t「早く父さんの所へ行かなきゃ！」: I have to get to Dad, fast!
BMD\t「これ以上はやらせない！」: I won't let you go any further!
BMD\t「一気にダメージを与えれば、倒せるはず！」: If I hit it hard all at once, it'll go down!
BMD\t「エルデ・ミッテ！/ あんたの好きにはやらせない！」: Erde Mitte!/　I won't let you do as you please!
BMD\t「エルデ！/ あんたの妄想に興味なんてないわ！」: Erde!/　I'm not interested in your delusions!
BMD\t「ＡＩ１！ これ以上進化なんてさせない！」: AI1! I won't let you evolve any further!
BMD\t「やっつければ大丈夫！」: We'll be fine once we beat it!
BMD\t（あ、あんまり近くで見たくない……）: (I-I don't wanna see it up close...)
BMD\t「妹に手を出す奴は俺が許さねえ！」: Nobody lays a hand on my sister!
BMD\t「ショウコ、早く逃げろ！」: Shoko, get out of here, now!
BMD\t「ミチル！ てめえ、何やってんだ！」: Michiru! What the hell are you doing?
BMD\t「しょうがねえ！ 助けてやるぜ、ミチル！」: Fine, whatever! I'll bail you out, Michiru!
BMD\t「サイバスターでも避けられねえのなら！」: If even Cybuster can't dodge it, then...!
BMD\t「まとめて相手をしてやるぜ！！」: I'll take you all on at once!!
BMD\t「江戸っ子は、宵越しの銭を持たねえんだよ！」: A true son of Edo never hoards his cash!
BMD\t「出し惜しみはしないということか」: So you're not holding anything back.
BMD\t「お兄ちゃん、まだ行けるわ！」: You can still do it, big brother!
BMD\t「この距離なら、こいつだ！」: At this range, it's gotta be this!
BMD\t「雷鳳！ お前に全てを懸ける！」: RaiOh! I'm staking everything on you!
BMD\t「バイトで鍛えた根性を見せてやる……！」: I'll show you the guts I built/　working part-time jobs...!
BMD\t「俺の売り物は気合と根性だ……！」: All I've got to sell is spirit and guts!
BMD\t「俺にも出来ることがあるはずだ……！」: There's gotta be something I can do...!
BMD\t「やってみせると決めたんだ……！」: I decided I'd pull this off...!
BMD\t「集中しろ！ 敵は目の前だ！」: Focus! The enemy's right in front of you!
BMD\t「待ちの戦法はガラじゃない……！」: Waiting it out isn't my style...!
BMD\t「迷うな……！ 迷いは動きを鈍らせる！」: Don't hesitate...!/　Hesitation slows you down!
BMD\t「先手必勝……仕掛けるっ！」: Strike first to win... Here I go!
BMD\t「決める……！ 奴より速く！」: I'll end this...! Faster than my foe!
BMD\t「行くぞ、雷鳳！ 俺達の戦いの時だ！」: Let's go, RaiOh! It's time for our fight!
BMD\t「ミナキも見てるんだ……！ 負けられない！」: Minaki's watching too...! I can't lose!
BMD\t「疾風迅雷！ スピードで勝負だ！」: Swift as lightning! Speed is my game!
BMD\t「ウェイト無視の無差別級でも、/ 勝ってみせる！」: Even in an open-weight bout,/　I'll come out on top!
BMD\t「ドゥバン・オーグ！ 全力で行くぞ！」: Duvan Oog! I'm going all out!
BMD\t「アルテウル！ 悪の黒幕は俺が討つ！」: Arteur! I'll take down/　the villain behind it all!
BMD\t「外道！/ 真面目に生きてる人達の怒りを思い知れ！」: You scum!/　Feel the rage of everyone/　who lives an honest life!
BMD\t「イグニス！ その鼻っ柱をへし折ってやる！」: Ignis! I'll knock you down a peg!
BMD\t「ルイーナのボスか！/ 相手にとって不足なしだ！」: The boss of the Ruina!/　You'll make a worthy opponent!
BMD\t「メリオルエッセ！/ 手下を連れて、とっとと帰ってもらう！」: Meliorquesse!/　Take your lackeys and get lost!
BMD\t「恐怖は雷鳳の翼で越えてみせる！」: I'll soar past my fear on RaiOh's wings!
BMD\t「ペルフェクティオ！/ お前の邪気を封印する！」: Perfectio!/　I'll seal away your evil!
BMD\t「お前の生み出す破滅は、俺が蹴り砕く！」: The destruction you bring.../　I'll kick it to pieces!
BMD\t「あの男からは武人の風格を感じる……！」: That man carries himself/　like a true warrior...!
BMD\t「俺の相手をしてもらうぞ、ゲストの指揮官！」: You'll be facing me, Guest Commander!
BMD\t「指揮官を叩いて、勝負をつける！」: I'll take out the Commander and end this!
BMD\t「あの男の言葉を聞くと力が抜ける……！」: That guy's talk saps my strength...!
BMD\t「女が相手でも、/ 敵ならば、情けはかけない……！」: Woman or not,/　if you're an enemy, I won't hold back!
BMD\t「外道ゼゼーナン！/ お前の悪巧みは、今日ここで潰える！」: Zezenan, you scum!/　Your schemes end here, today!
BMD\t「俺達がいる限り、/ 地球をお前の好きにはさせない！」: As long as we're around,/　you won't do as you please with Earth!
BMD\t「やっと出てきたな、黒幕！/ だが、ここまでだ！」: So the mastermind finally shows!/　But this is where it ends!
BMD\t「孫光龍！ これが人間の底力だ！」: Koryu Son! This is humanity's potential!
BMD\t「その上から目線……！/ 俺と雷鳳が飛び越えてやる！」: That condescending attitude...!/　RaiOh and I will leap right over it!
BMD\t「長いものに巻かれて生きる程、/ 大人じゃないんでな！」: I'm not grown-up enough/　to just go with the flow!
BMD\t「卑怯な手を使う奴らに容赦はしない！」: No mercy for cowards who fight dirty!
BMD\t「ガイアセイバーズ……/ 自業自得って言葉を教えてやる！」: Gaia Savers.../　I'll teach you the meaning of karma!
BMD\t「お前達に見せてやる！ 俺と雷鳳の力を！」: I'll show you! The power of RaiOh and me!
BMD\t「兄弟対決だからこそ、負けられない！」: Brother against brother... I can't lose!
BMD\t「見ててくれ、ミナキ！/ ジンライは俺が倒す！」: Watch me, Minaki!/　I'll take down Jinrai!
BMD\t「恐怖は気合で乗り越える！」: I'll overcome fear with sheer spirit!
BMD\t「心を研ぎ澄ませ……！/ 焦りは奴らの思う壺だ！」: Sharpen your mind...!/　Getting rattled is just what they want!
BMD\t「その化け物は俺が地獄へ蹴り落とす！」: I'll kick that monster straight to hell!
BMD\t「外道エルデ・ミッテ！ 終わらせるぞ！」: Erde Mitte, you scum! This ends now!
BMD\t「ゲスト！ お前達に地球は渡さない！」: Guest! We won't hand Earth over to you!
BMD\t「見せてやるぞ、地球人のド根性を！」: Get a load of Earthling guts!
BMD\t「こっちにも客を選ぶ権利ってのがある！」: We get to choose our customers, too!
BMD\t「お客様は神様じゃない！ 叩き出してやる！」: The customer isn't always right! Get out!
LDBI\t「では、本物のテリウス殿下の行方を探りましょう。@ ザボド卿の体調不: Then we should look for the real Prince Tellius.@Blaming it on Lord Zabod's poor health is a@tired excuse. Their side must be in disarray.
LDBI\t「うむ……事によっては、カークス軍と@ 一戦交えねばならんかも知れん: Yes... Depending on how things go, we may have@to cross swords with Kirkus's army...
LDBI\t「なるほど、事情はわかりました。@ それで、テリウス殿下の行方につい: I see. I understand the situation.@Do you have any idea where Prince Tellius is?
LDBI\t「セニアに調べさせようと思っているのですが……」: I was thinking of having Xenia look into it...
LDBI\t「艦長、お話中、申し訳ありませんが……@ よろしいですか？」: Captain, sorry to interrupt, but...@may I have a moment?
LDBI\t「０時方向、１０キロメートルほど先で@ 魔装機らしき機体の反応が複数: I'm reading multiple units, likely Masouki,@about 10 km out at twelve o'clock.
LDBI\t「どうも動きが妙で……@ 複数の機体が１機を追跡しているようなんです: Their movements are odd...@It looks like several units are chasing one.
LDBI\t「この辺りで展開している部隊となると、カークス軍……@ 演習でもやっ: Any unit deployed around here would be Kirkus's@army... Are they running an exercise?
LDBI\t「もしかしたら……！@ 中佐、そちらへ向かってもらえませんか？」: Could it be...!@Commander, could you head over there?
LDBI\t「了解しました。@ 念のため、総員に第一種戦闘配置命令を出します」: Understood.@Just in case, I'm ordering all hands to@level-one battle stations.
LDBI\t「お止めなさい、テリウス殿下。@ それ以上抵抗されるのなら、我々は強: Stop this, Prince Tellius.@If you resist any further, we'll have no choice@but to take drastic measures.
LDBI\t「やれやれ……@ レスリー、影縛りの用意は出来たか？」: Good grief...@Leslie, is the Shadow Bind ready?
LDBI\t「あと１分いただけますか」: Give me one more minute, please.
LDBI\t「ち、近づくなっ！ ぼ、僕は本気だぞ！！」: D-Don't come any closer! I-I mean it!!
LDBI\t「よろしいですか、殿下。命令では、生死を問わぬと@ 言われております: Listen, Your Highness. Our orders say dead or@alive... but we intend to bring you back@safe and sound.
LDBI\t「しかし、駄々をこねられるようでしたら、@ 御身の保証は……」: However, if you insist on throwing a tantrum,@I can't guarantee your safety...
LDBI\t「アクロス少佐、@ こちらへ地上人の戦艦が接近中です！」: Major Across,@a surface-world battleship is approaching!
LDBI\t「ちっ、気づかれたか。@ ライオネス少尉、アハマド殿に連絡を」: Tch, they've noticed us.@Lieutenant Lioness, contact Lord Ahmad.
LDBI\t「無駄ですよ、テリウス殿下。王族と言えど、@ この影縛りから逃れるこ: It's useless, Prince Tellius. Not even royalty@can escape this Shadow Bind.@Please be still.
LDBI\t「あのガディフォールに乗っているのは、@ テリウスか！」: The one piloting that Gadifor...@it's Tellius!
LDBI\t「テリウス殿下はカークスの下から脱走を……！」: Prince Tellius has escaped from Kirkus...!
LDBI\t「しかも、魔装機を奪って……あの子が……」: And he stole a Masouki to do it... That boy...
LDBI\t「マサキ、テュッティ、テリウスを助けてやってくれ。@ それで、カーク: Masaki, Tytti, please go help Tellius.@That will shatter Kirkus's scheme.
LDBI\t（援軍が来るまで時間を稼ぐしかないか）: (Guess I'll have to stall until@reinforcements arrive.)
LDBI\t「……あなた方はカークス軍の部隊ですね。@ 私は魔装機神ガッデスの操: ...You're a unit of Kirkus's army, aren't you?@I am Tytti Noorbuck, operator of the@Masoukishin Gaddess.
LDBI\t「よく存じ上げていますよ。@ 私はラテル・アクロス。階級は少佐です」: I know you well.@I am Major Ratel Across.
LDBI\t「で、このような所へわざわざいらっしゃるとは……@ どういうご用件で: So, what brings you all the way out@to a place like this?
LDBI\t「あらら、堂々としらばっくれたわねぇ」: Oh my, playing dumb right to our faces, huh?
LDBI\t「時間稼ぎが目的なのかも知れないわ」: Maybe they're trying to buy time.
LDBI\t「……アクロス少佐、私達はそこにいらっしゃる@ テリウス殿下を取り戻: ...Major Across, we've come to take back@Prince Tellius, who is right there.
LDBI\t「お待ち下さい、テュッティ殿。@ テリウス殿下は我々にとっても重要な: Please wait, Lady Tytti.@Prince Tellius is important to us as well.@We cannot hand him over. Even if...
LDBI\t「例え、殺してでも……か？」: Even if you have to kill him...?
LDBI\t「馬鹿な、影縛りを破るなど……！@ いくら王族の魔力が高いとは言え、: Impossible, breaking the Shadow Bind...!@Royals may have high prana, but that's beyond@any human!
LDBI\t「はあ、はあ……僕は……僕は、もう嫌だ！！@ 人の言いなりに動くのは: Hah, hah... I... I can't take it anymore!!@Doing whatever other people tell me...
LDBI\t「その力……私が預かりましょう」: That power... allow me to take charge of it.
LDBI\t「テリウス、あなたの力を見せていただきましたよ。@ それだけの力があ: Tellius, I have seen your power.@With power like that, you have nothing to fear.@Now, come to me.
LDBI\t「ぼ……僕が？ 僕なんかの力が……？」: M... Me? Someone like me has power...?
LDBI\t「ええ、あなたの力が必要なのです。@ しかし、無理強いはしません。@: Yes, I need your power.@But I won't force you.@What matters is your own will.
LDBI\t「……ぼ、僕は今まで……いつも誰かの陰に@ 隠れていたような気がする: ...I-I've always felt... like I was hiding@in someone else's shadow...
LDBI\t「でも……クリストフ……僕の力が必要なら……@ 僕という存在が必要な: But... Christoph... if you need my power...@if you need someone like me...
LDBI\t「僕を……僕を連れて行ってくれ……！」: Take me... take me with you...!
LDBI\t「奴は感じたのだろう、実戦の恐怖を」: He must have felt it... the terror of real combat.
LDBI\t「まあいい、今日はここまでにしておこう。@ 詰め込み過ぎは、良くない: Well, that'll do for today.@Pushing too much at once is never good.

LDBI\t（わ、若い……話には聞いてたけど……。@ カイ少佐はともかく、ヒュー: (W-Wow, they're young... I'd heard, but still...@Major Kai aside, Hugo's younger than me too...@I'm raising the average age, aren't I?)

LDBI\t「も、もしかして、ヒューゴ少尉も……！？」: D-Don't tell me... Lieutenant Hugo,@you too...!?
LDBI\t「いや、俺は操縦と戦闘担当だ。@ サンバカーニバルじゃあるまいし、男: No, I handle piloting and combat.@This isn't Carnival. If a man and a woman both@wore outfits like that, we'd be a laughingstock.

LDBI\t「だが、多少は慣れてきただろう？」: But you've gotten somewhat used to it, right?
LDBI\t「そうそう、このままお風呂に入れるし……」: Yeah, and I can even take a bath in it...
LDBI\t（まさか、ラミア少尉以上に露出度の高い服を@ 着ることになるなんて、: (I never imagined I'd end up wearing something@even more revealing than Lieutenant Lamia's...)

LDBI\t「了解した。ゼオラ、少尉を更衣室へ」: Understood. Seolla, show her to the locker room.

LDBI\t「わかりました。まず、ターミナス・エナジーとは、@ ツェントル・プロ: Understood. First, Terminus Energy is an energy@discovered by Dr. Mitar Zapad of the@Tsentr Project...
LDBI\t「重力、電磁力、強い相互作用、弱い相互作用という@ ４つの力の他に、: It was predicted to exist alongside the four@forces: gravity, electromagnetism, and the@strong and weak interactions.
LDBI\t「理論上、どこにでも存在しているのですが……@ その収集と応用は非常: In theory, it exists everywhere...@but collecting and applying it was said to be@extremely difficult.
LDBI\t「そこで、それを可能にしたのが@ サーベラスに搭載されているＴＥエン: And what made that possible is Cerberus's@TE Engine... the Terminus Energy Engine.@However...

LDBI\t「そのため、出力が不安定で……@ 電力を併用し、私がエンジン出力の調: As a result, its output is unstable...@It runs on electric power as well, and I have to@board in a DFC suit to regulate engine output.
LDBI\t「そのＴＥエンジンが完全な物になれば……@ 理論上、ＴＥアブゾーバー: And if that TE Engine were perfected...@in theory, a TE Absorber could operate@indefinitely?

LDBI\t「あれは、サーベラスと共に開発されていた@ ＴＥアブゾーバーの試作５: That's the fifth TE Absorber prototype,@developed alongside Cerberus, but it doesn't@have a TE Engine.
LDBI\t「その代わり、機体フレームや装甲に@ ラズムナニウムが使用されていま: Instead, its frame and armor@use Razmnanium.
BMD\t「効かん、効かんぞっ！！」: Useless! That won't work on me!!

BMD\t「念のため、もう一発くれてやるぜ！」: Here's one more, just to be sure!
BMD\t「覚悟しとけよ、こいつは痛いぜっ！」: Brace yourself, this one's gonna hurt!
LDBI\t「だが、その前に敵拠点の一つを攻略してもらいたい。@ そこに地上人が: But first, I want you to capture an enemy base.@We also have intel that surface dwellers are@being held there.
LDBI\t「ああ、信憑性は高い。@ また、我が方の諜報員が敵拠点付近で@ 巨大: Yes, and it's quite reliable.@Our agents also spotted a surface machine@wielding a giant sword near the enemy base.
LDBI\t「巨大な剣……もしかして！？」: A giant sword... Could it be!?
LDBI\t「グルンガスト零式か参式、@ あるいはダイゼンガーかも知れませんな」: Perhaps the Grungust Type 0 or Type 3,@or even the Dygenguar.
LDBI\t「気になるのであれば、@ 自らの目で確かめてもらいたい。以上だ」: If it concerns you,@see for yourselves. That is all.
LDBI\t「口が達者……権謀術策に長けたお方ですな。@ 政治家にも向いておられ: A smooth talker... and a master of intrigue.@He seems well suited to politics as well.
LDBI\t（シュテドニアス軍との戦いが終わった後で、@ フェイル殿下とカークス: (So once the war with Schtedonias is over,@Prince Feil and General Kirkus@may well come to blows...)
LDBI\t「ヤンロン、カークス将軍の言ってたことが@ 本当なら、あたし達は……: Yang Long, if what General Kirkus said is@true, then we're...

LDBI\t「そうかの……お主は、他の者に話したのかの？」: I see... Have you told anyone else?
LDBI\t「それは……余計な心配を掛けるわけには@ いかないと思って……」: Well... I didn't want to burden them@with needless worry...
LDBI\t「お主自身の……お主の身体は大丈夫なのかの？」: What about you... Is your body@holding up all right?
LDBI\t「今の所は何とか……。@ ですから、この件は秘密にしておいて@ 下さ: I'm managing for now...@So please, could you keep this@between us?
LDBI\t「ふむ……まあ、お主がそう言うならの」: Hmm... Well, if that's what you want.
LDBI\t「お主とまた会うことになるとはの。@ 不思議な縁があるようじゃの」: Fancy meeting you again.@Seems we're tied by some strange fate.
LDBI\t「お主がおるということは、@ アルフィミィも一緒なのかの？」: If you're here, does that mean@Alchemie is with you too?
LDBI\t「ホッホッホ、@ 眠り王子ならぬ眠り幼女というわけかの」: Ho ho ho!@Not a sleeping prince, but a sleeping little@girl, eh?
LDBI\t「何がおかしいのかわからんが……アルフィミィは@ その内に戻って来る: I don't see what's so funny... but Alchemie@may come back sooner or later.

LDBI\t「ああ見えて、一筋縄ではいかん奴だ。@ さほど心配はしていない」: She may not look it, but she's no pushover.@I'm not too worried.
LDBI\t「気にはなっておるんじゃの。素直じゃないの」: So you are worried. Not very honest, are you?
LDBI\t「おお、お主が」: Oh ho, so you're the one.

LDBI\t「それがフェリオの頼みじゃったからの」: Well, Ferio asked me to, you see.
LDBI\t「あの、博士と父はどのような……」: Um, how do you know my father...?

LDBI\t「多分、フェリオはお主らのことを心配しておったでの。@ じゃから、あ: I suspect Ferio was worried about you two.@That's why he prepared that recording.@You ought to read between the lines.

LDBI\t「ええ、覚えておきます」: Right, I'll keep that in mind.

LDBI\t「そして、このままでは@ 自分を作った存在に消されると思っている……: And she believes that, at this rate, she'll@be erased by the one who created her...@But that's not to say she's afraid of it.
BMD\t「レオナ、奴は俺が引き受ける！」: Leona, I'll take care of this one!

BMD\t「いい位置だ……！ いける！」: Good position... I can do this!
BMD\t「この距離……直撃させる！」: At this range... a direct hit!

BMD\t「ツイン・ソリッドカノン……/ 撃ち抜いてやる！」: Twin Solid Cannons.../　I'll blast right through you!
BMD\t「まとめて片付けてやる！」: I'll take you all out at once!
BMD\t「この距離、直撃させる！」: At this range, a direct hit!
BMD\t「このスピードが見切れるか！」: Can you keep up with this speed?!
BMD\t「連続射撃だ、逃がしはしない！」: Rapid fire! You won't get away!
BMD\t「ジガンのパワーで押し切る！」: I'll push through with the Jigan's power!
BMD\t「同じ過ちは繰り返さぬ……/ 今度こそ、我は宿命を変える」: I will not repeat the same mistake.../　This time, I will change my destiny.
BMD\t「お前達は目障りだ……今も昔も」: You are an eyesore... now as ever.
BMD\t「これ以上、我が運命に絡むことは許さぬ」: I will not let you entangle my fate any further.
BMD\t「あの時の決戦……お前には、/ さらに多種多様の同胞がいたのだがな」: In that final battle... you had/　far more varied brethren beside you.
BMD\t「力の差がわからぬか、レビよ」: Can you not grasp the gulf/　between our power, Levi?
BMD\t「アウレフめ、上手く調教したものだ」: Aureph tamed you well, I see.
BMD\t「まだ諦めぬのか、イング」: Still you will not give up, Ing?
BMD\t「あの男……滅ぼさず、取り込むべきか……？」: That man... should I absorb him/　rather than destroy him...?
BMD\t「その機体の礎は、/ 我がアウレフに与えたものなのだぞ」: That machine's foundation is something/　I gave to Aureph.
BMD\t「お前達に我が運命は変えられぬ。/ そして、己の宿命もな」: You cannot change my fate./　Nor your own destiny.
BMD\t「クラス・ギボルなど、もはや不要」: I have no further need of Class Gibbor.
BMD\t「弱者が群れをなしても、結果は見えている」: The weak may flock together, but the/　outcome is already clear.
BMD\t「人を創りし者は神、神を創りし者は人……」: He who creates man is god; he who/　creates god is man...
BMD\t「我は超越する……/ 愚帝のみならず、創世神をも」: I shall transcend.../　not just the foolish emperor,/　but the god of creation as well.
BMD\t「手を止め、新人祖の誕生を祝福せよ」: Stay your hand and bless the birth/　of the Neo-Progenitor.
BMD\t「大人しく滅びの時を待つ気はないようだな」: It seems you have no intention of/　quietly awaiting your destruction.
BMD\t「殊勝だな、アウレフの遺志を継ぐとはな」: How admirable, to carry on/　Aureph's will.
BMD\t「そう、あの時もお前達は我に刃向かった」: Yes... you defied me back then, too.
BMD\t「その力……この世界でも/ さほど変わりはないようだな」: That power... it seems little/　changed even in this world.
BMD\t「我はお前を知っている……遠い昔からな」: I know you... from long, long ago.
BMD\t「お前達との戦い……懐かしさすら感じるぞ」: Fighting you... it even feels nostalgic.
BMD\t「たとえお前がジュデッカに乗ろうと、/ 我は倒せぬ」: Even if you pilot the Judecca,/　you cannot defeat me.
BMD\t「フン……創造主に楯突くとはな」: Hmph... defying your creator, are you?
BMD\t「イング、/ これ以上お前との因縁を深める気はない」: Ing, I have no wish to deepen/　our karmic ties any further.
BMD\t「イング、お前の力で我は屠れぬ」: Ing, your power cannot slay me.
BMD\t「真髄に達していないＳＲＸで我は倒せぬ」: An SRX that has not reached its true/　essence cannot defeat me.
BMD\t「不完全な機体で、我を倒せると思うな」: Do not think an incomplete machine/　can defeat me.
BMD\t「我には通用せん」: That will not work on me.
BMD\t「しばしの時が必要か……」: I need a moment, it seems...
BMD\t「多少の運が残っていたようだな」: It seems some luck remained to you.
BMD\t「我に畏怖の念を抱くのは当然だ」: It is only natural to hold me in awe.
BMD\t「お前に逃げ場はない」: There is nowhere for you to run.
BMD\t「そう上手く事は運ばぬ」: Things will not go so smoothly.
BMD\t「我が掌中で踊れ」: Dance in the palm of my hand.
BMD\t「新しき楽園の主として相応しい存在は、/ 新人祖たる我……」: The one fit to rule the new paradise/　is I, the Neo-Progenitor...
BMD\t「我が永久の楽園に古き血脈はいらぬ……」: My eternal paradise has no need/　for the old bloodlines...
BMD\t「冥底へ堕ちよ！」: Fall into the depths of the netherworld!
BMD\t「かつてのアダムは/ エデンの園より追放された……」: Adam of old was cast out/　of the Garden of Eden...
BMD\t「輪廻転生しようとも、/ お前達の居場所はない……」: Even through reincarnation,/　there is no place for you...
BMD\t「行け、因果地平の彼方へ！」: Go, beyond the horizon of causality!
BMD\t「生まれよ、出でよ、我が下僕達……」: Be born, come forth, my servants...
BMD\t「死者の霊魂……その呪いを享受せよ」: Spirits of the dead... receive their curse.
BMD\t「冥底より……、来たれ、集まれ、亡者達……」: From the netherworld... come, gather,/　O souls of the dead...
BMD\t「彼奴らの怨嗟……その身で受けよ！」: Their hatred... take it upon yourself!
BMD\t「時間と空間が交差し、/ お前は古の忌憶を垣間見る」: Time and space intersect, and/　you glimpse forbidden memories of old.

LDBI\t「それでルイーナだけを攻撃した……？」: So they only attacked the Ruina...?
LDBI\t「ここへ来る前にも一仕事したから、@ 早く帰りたいし」: We already did a job before coming here,@so I wanna get home soon.
LDBI\t「奴らはルイーナより食いでがある。@ 仕掛けるぞ」: They'll make a better meal than the Ruina.@We attack.
LDBI\t「ふふん、そうこなくちゃね」: Heh, now that's more like it.
LDBI\t「ヘッ、今度の隊長はアルベロと違って話がわかるぜ」: Heh, this leader's way more reasonable than Albero.
LDBI\t「存分に血を吸うがいい。@ 斬り甲斐のある強者は、俺に回しても構わん: Drink your fill of blood.@Any strong ones worth cutting down,@you may leave to me.
LDBI\t「じゃ、そうする。@ さっきの戦闘で、弾もあんまりないし」: Okay, I will.@I'm low on ammo after that last fight anyway.
LDBI\t「誰がそんな勿体ねえことするかよ。@ ムラタ、あんたより稼いでみせる: Like I'd waste 'em like that.@Murata, I'll outscore you, just watch.
LDBI\t「艦長！ ガイアセイバーズは@ こちらに仕掛けてくる気のようです！」: Captain! The Gaia Saviors@look like they're going to attack us!
LDBI\t「こちらは鋼龍戦隊ハガネ艦長、@ テツヤ・オノデラ中佐だ！ そちらは: This is Commander Tetsuya Onodera, captain of@the Steel Dragons' Hagane! Didn't you call off@your pursuit of us?!
LDBI\t「寝言は寝てから言うもんだよ」: Save the dreaming for when you're asleep.
LDBI\t「大統領を殺した罪は重いからな、お前らの上も@ さすがに庇い切れなく: Killing the president's no small crime.@Guess even your bosses couldn't cover for you.
LDBI\t「だから、それは濡れ衣だって言ってんだろうが！」: I keep telling you, we were framed!
LDBI\t「それをわかってくれる人もいるのよ！」: And there are people who understand that!
LDBI\t「へえ、どこの誰だい？ ここに連れて来なよ」: Oh yeah? Who and where? Bring 'em here.
LDBI\t「……あなた達、地球圏の状況を把握していないの？@ 今、私達が戦うべ: ...Don't you know what's going on in the@Earth Sphere? Right now, the enemy we should@be fighting is...
LDBI\t「ルイーナとバラルかい？@ でも、ここでお前達を見逃す理由にはならな: The Ruina and the Baral?@That's still no reason to let you go here.
LDBI\t「ああ。@ そもそも、鋼龍戦隊の追撃中止命令なんざ出てねえよ」: Yeah.@Besides, nobody ever ordered us to stop@chasing the Steel Dragons.
LDBI\t「……嘘を言ってるようにも、@ 言ってないようにも見えるわね」: ...I can't tell whether they're lying@or not.
LDBI\t「そうねぇ、@ 武者ガーリオンと子犬ちゃん達相手じゃね」: Guess so, when it's the samurai Guarlion@and his little puppies.
LDBI\t「あの男がガンマ・セイバーの指揮を執っているのなら、@ エルデは今、: If that man's in command of the Gamma Saber,@then what's Erde doing now...?
LDBI\t「……ムラタ、お主がガイアセイバーズにおるとはの。@ <ノイエＤＣ>: ...So, Murata, you've joined the Gaia Saviors.@Weren't you aiding the <ノイエＤＣ> remnants?
LDBI\t「こちらへ戻って来てから、連中の所在は知れん。@ 異星人や妖魔共に喰: I've lost track of them since returning here.@Perhaps the aliens or demons devoured them...@Either way, the Gaia Saviors employ me now.
LDBI\t「テツヤ・オノデラ中佐の言葉に思う所はないのか？@ 今は我らで剣を交: Do Commander Tetsuya Onodera's words@give you no pause? This is no time for us@to be crossing swords.
LDBI\t「修羅の悟りは人機の骸、その堆山の彼方にある。@ 眼前に強者あらば、: A Shura's enlightenment lies beyond a mountain@of fallen men and machines. When a strong foe@stands before me, I simply cut them down.
LDBI\t「ゼゼーナン司令、@ ムーンクレイドルの内部調査が終了しました」: Commander Zezenan, we've finished our internal@survey of Moon Cradle.
LDBI\t「セキュリティ類の完全解除には@ まだ時間がかかりますが、機能の５５: Fully disabling security will take more time,@but we control 55% of its functions. It will@serve as our base without issue.
LDBI\t「猿共め、案外素直に明け渡したな」: The apes surrendered it rather meekly.
LDBI\t「月面都市の頭上を抑えられ、生殺与奪権を握られて、@ 小細工をするほ: With us above their lunar cities, holding their@lives in our hands, they aren't foolish enough@to try any tricks.
LDBI\t「ふん、それはどうかな。@ 彼らはウェンドロに勝利しているのだ。@: Hmph, I wonder.@They defeated Wendolo, after all.@I doubt they'll submit so easily.
LDBI\t「隙あらば、武器を手にし、挑んでくるだろう。@ それが野蛮人たる所以: Given an opening, they'll arm themselves and@challenge us. That's what makes them savages.
LDBI\t「だが、今はまだ反抗的な者を粛清するだけでいい。@ 猿共の使い道は色: But for now, just purge the defiant ones.@The apes have many uses. Don't needlessly thin@their numbers.
LDBI\t「それと、前回にシュウ・シラカワが仕掛けた@ ＮＮＣネットワークのワ: Also, what countermeasures have we taken@against the worm Shu Shirakawa planted in the@NNC network last time?
LDBI\t「全バイオロイドに改良型の自閉モードを@ 設定しています。シミュレー: Every Bioroid has been given an improved@isolation mode. In simulations, we held the@first-strike infection rate to 0.01% or less.
LDBI\t「では、地球軍の月面基地については？」: Then, what of the Earth forces' lunar bases?
LDBI\t「半数を制圧しました。@ 残りはここへ降下した本隊戦力を以て@ 抑え: We've taken half of them.@The main force that descended here@will move to suppress the rest.
LDBI\t「まもなく、ゼブとロフが攻撃を開始します」: Zeb and Rof will begin their attack shortly.
LDBI\t（さて、ここからだ。@ この混乱した状況を利用し、巻き返す。@ 地球: (Now then, this is where it begins.@I'll exploit this chaos to turn the tables...@and make the Earth Sphere my own power base...)
LDBI\t「そうか、イングがそんなことを……」: I see. So Ing said that...
LDBI\t「ガリルナガンとアーマラ・バートンの件で@ 一番戸惑っているのは、彼: I'd say he's the one most confused about@Galilnagant and Amala Burton, though...
LDBI\t「……ヴィレッタ、ラミア。お前達はどう考える？@ かつての立場を踏ま: ...Viletta, Lamia. What do you two think?@Given your former positions, I want your views.
LDBI\t「イングがガイアセイバーズから送り込まれた@ 工作員だという可能性は: It's possible Ing is an operative sent in@by the Gaia Saviors.
LDBI\t「彼の過去は彼自身……@ そして、ガイアセイバーズに所属していた@: Since his past is unknown even to him...@and to Arieil, who was with the Gaia Saviors.
LDBI\t「でも、イングはラウル達が偶然発見し、@ ハガネに運び込まれたんです: But Raul and the others found Ing by chance@and brought him aboard the Hagane.
LDBI\t「それも、たまたまあの人達が鋼龍戦隊の@ 演習区域の近くにいたからで: And that only happened because they were@near the Steel Dragons' exercise area...@It doesn't feel intentional to me.
LDBI\t「その点はもっともだ。@ 鋼龍戦隊と確実に接触するのなら、@ アリエ: That's a fair point.@To be certain of contacting the Steel Dragons,@one would use a method like Arieil's.
LDBI\t「もっとも、彼女が工作員だとしたら、@ 俺達に手の内を明かし過ぎだが: Then again, if she's an operative, she's shown@us far too much of her hand.
LDBI\t「ええ……ドゥバン・オーグの態度から判断しても、@ アリエイルの行動: Yes... Judging by Duvan Ogg's attitude, too,@I don't believe Arieil's actions hide anything.
LDBI\t「だったら、イングも……」: Then maybe Ing is the same...
LDBI\t「だが、記憶を失う前の彼が@ どのような任務を与えられていたか、@: But what mission he was given@before losing his memory...@that we don't know.
LDBI\t「本来は別の手段で鋼龍戦隊と接触する予定だったが、@ 何らかの事故が: Perhaps he was meant to contact the Steel@Dragons another way, but some accident wiped@his memory...
LDBI\t「偶然が重なった結果、@ ハガネへの潜入に成功したとも考えられる」: It's conceivable that a string of coincidences@then let him infiltrate the Hagane.
LDBI\t「そ、そんな……余程の強運の持ち主でない限り、@ 無理な話です」: B-But... that's impossible, unless he had@Fortune itself on his side.
LDBI\t「同感だが、可能性がゼロだとは言い切れないわ」: I agree, but we can't say the chance is zero.
LDBI\t「かつての私は、偶然に近い形でシロガネと@ 接触しましたが……予めそ: Back then, I made contact with the Shirogane@almost by chance... but preparations had been@made with that very scenario in mind.
LDBI\t「そうだったな。@ お前は、イスルギ重工から派遣された@ テストパイ: That's right.@You were posing as a test pilot sent@from Isurugi Heavy Industries.
LDBI\t「さらに私の場合、<シャドウミラー>本隊との@ 連絡手段に問題があっ: In my case, I also had trouble contacting@the main <シャドウミラー> force... As a solution,@W16 was sent to make contact in secret.
LDBI\t「仮に、イングがガイアセイバーズの工作員であり、@ 記憶喪失という問: Suppose Ing is a Gaia Saviors operative,@and his memory loss became a problem...
LDBI\t「その対策、または軌道修正が@ アーマラとガリルナガンだとしたら、@: If their countermeasure, or course correction,@was Amala and Galilnagant, it'd be a most@slipshod move, it would so be.
LDBI\t「そうね……あれではイング自身が疑われるだけ。@ その結果、鋼龍戦隊: True... All that does is cast suspicion on Ing.@It doesn't account for the risk that he'd be@removed from the Steel Dragons as a result.
LDBI\t「ですが、イングの力を引き出そうとしたことで、@ アーマラ……いえ、: But since they tried to draw out Ing's power,@the chance has gone and popped up that Amala...@no, Arteur is using him for some scheme.
LDBI\t「カイ少佐……この後、イングは……」: Major Kai... What happens to Ing now...?
LDBI\t「戦力が半減している現状で、@ アッシュを扱える彼を外すのは得策では: With our strength halved, removing the one@person who can pilot the Ash wouldn't be wise.
LDBI\t「だが、監視を怠るな。@ そして、本人も自覚している通り……@ 最悪: But keep him under watch.@And as he himself is aware...@in the worst case, we'll have to be merciless.
LDBI\t「では、以上だ。@ １０分後に次の作戦のブリーフィングを行う。@ 遅: That's all, then.@Briefing for the next operation in 10 minutes.@Don't be late.
LDBI\t「ねえ、リョウト君……@ イングの記憶はこのまま戻らない方が@ いい: Hey, Ryoto...@maybe it'd be better if Ing's memories@never came back...
LDBI\t「だけど……@ もし、あの子が記憶を取り戻して、@ 私達の敵になって: But...@if that kid gets his memories back@and becomes our enemy...
LDBI\t「イングも覚悟をしているけど……@ その時は、彼を助けよう」: Ing is prepared for that too, but...@if it happens, let's save him.
LDBI\t「念の力を持っているのは、僕達だけじゃない……@ みんなで力を合わせ: We're not the only ones with psychic power...@If we all work together, we'll manage.
LDBI\t「では、ブリーフィングを始める。@ まず、この映像を見てもらおう」: Now, let's begin the briefing.@First, take a look at this footage.
LDBI\t「アリエイルから提供された@ ヘブンゲートの画像データだ」: This is image data of Heaven's Gate@provided by Arieil.
LDBI\t「破損した部分は補強され、@ 以前とほぼ変わりない耐久性を@ 持って: The damaged sections have been reinforced,@and it's likely about as durable@as it was before.
LDBI\t「だが、作戦目的は@ ヘブンゲートの破壊や奪還ではない」: However, the objective isn't to destroy@or recapture Heaven's Gate.
LDBI\t「最優先目標はメリオルエッセ……@ イグニスを捕らえることだ」: Our top priority is a Meliores Esse...@capturing Ignis.
LDBI\t「何……？ 何故、そんなことを？」: What...? Why would we do that?
LDBI\t「彼から地球消失に関する情報を@ 聞き出すのでございますです」: We're going to wring info about Earth's@disappearance out of him, we are, so we be.
LDBI\t「素直に答えるような奴なのか？」: Is he the type to answer honestly?
LDBI\t「そんな感じじゃなかったッスけど……」: He didn't seem like it, though...
LDBI\t「まあ、望みは薄いね」: Well, I wouldn't get my hopes up.
LDBI\t「捕獲が困難であれば、追い詰め、撤退させろ。@ それで地球方面へ向か: If capture proves difficult, corner him and@force him to withdraw. If he heads toward@Earth after that, all the better.
BMD\t「ルイーナを食い止めなきゃ！」: We have to stop the Ruina!
BMD\t「ルイーナ……これ以上やらせはしないわ！」: Ruina... I won't let you go any further!
BMD\t「ここでＡＩ１を食い止めなきゃ……！」: We have to stop AI1 here...!
BMD\t「あの状態からどう進化するって言うの……！」: How could it evolve any further from that?!
BMD\t「あなた達、地球圏から出て行きなさいよ！」: Get out of the Earth Sphere, all of you!
BMD\t「何度地球圏へ来たって、結果は同じよ！」: Come to the Earth Sphere all you want--/　you'll get the same result!
BMD\t「妖機人の好きにはやらせないわ！」: I won't let the Yokijin do as they please!
BMD\t「四神の超機人……油断は出来ないわ！」: A Choukijin of the Four Gods.../　I can't let my guard down!
BMD\t「雀武王……あれも四神の超機人……！」: JakuBuOh... Another Choukijin/　of the Four Gods...!
BMD\t「武雀王のガードを崩さなきゃ……！」: I have to break BuJakuOh's Guard...!
BMD\t「虎王機、正気に戻って！」: KoOhKi, come back to your senses!
BMD\t「四凶の超機人……何とかして止めなきゃ！」: A Choukijin of the Four Fiends.../　I have to stop it somehow!
BMD\t「相手が四凶でも、やるしかない！」: Four Fiends or not, I have to do this!
BMD\t「クストースを止めなきゃ……！」: I have to stop the Custos...!
BMD\t「イルイ……必ず助けてあげる！」: Irui... I'll save you, I promise!
BMD\t「ユーゼス……/ あなたの思い通りにさせるもんですか！」: Euzeth.../　I won't let things go your way!
BMD\t「ユーゼス……/ あなたが何者だろうと、何をしようと、/ 私達は負けな: Euzeth.../　Whoever you are, whatever you do,/　we won't lose!
BMD\t「あの黒い特機はいったい……！」: What is that black Super Robot...?!
BMD\t「ダブルＧが敵になるなんて……！」: I can't believe Double G is our enemy...!
BMD\t「私を倒せなかったことを、後悔なさいっ！」: You'll regret not finishing me off!
BMD\t「これ以上私を怒らせると……/ 後悔するわよっ！！」: Make me any angrier.../　and you'll regret it!!
BMD\t「さ、さすがに……強い！！」: Y-You're strong... I'll give you that!!
BMD\t「きゃああっ！/ これ以上は、やらせない！！」: Kyaaah!/　I won't let you do any more!!
BMD\t「あの子を残して、/ こんな所で死ねないのよ！！」: I can't die in a place like this/　and leave that girl behind!!
BMD\t「次を食らったら……落とされる……？」: If I take another hit... I'll go down...?
BMD\t「や、やられてたまるもんですかっ！！」: L-Like I'd let you beat me!!
BMD\t「くっ！/ 隼の翼は、まだ飛べるわよっ！！」: Ngh!/　The falcon's wings can still fly!!
BMD\t「これがアルジャン・クラスの実力……！」: So this is the power of the Argent class...!
BMD\t「シアン……まだ勝負はついてないわ！」: Cyan... This fight isn't over yet!
BMD\t「あの喋り方で攻撃されると、/ 余計にイライラする～！」: Getting attacked by someone who talks/　like that makes it even more annoying!
BMD\t「ぬっ！ おのれ、よくもっ！」: Ngh! Damn you, how dare you!
BMD\t「ガキが……いつまでもつけあがるなっ！」: Brat... Don't get too full of yourself!
BMD\t「ちっ、/ 見た目の割にゃパワーがあるじゃねえか」: Tch,/　you've got more power than you look!
BMD\t「おっと！ まあ、グランゾン相手なら/ この程度のダメージは織り込み済: Whoa! Well, against the Granzon,/　I figured on taking this much damage.
BMD\t「ちっ、結構厄介じゃねえかよ、/ サフィーネっての！」: Tch, you're a real pain,/　aren't ya, Saphine!
BMD\t「ちっ、なかなかやるな、地上人！」: Tch, you're pretty good, surface dweller!
BMD\t「ちっ、なるほどな。/ これがサイバスターの力か……！」: Tch, I see./　So this is the Cybuster's power...!
BMD\t「やるな……ガッデスめ。/ 正直甘く見ていたわ」: Not bad... Gaddess./　Truth is, I underestimated you.
BMD\t「ほほう、確かに強力だな、グランヴェール。/ だが、まだこっちには余力: Oho, you're strong all right, Granveil./　But I've still got plenty left in me!
BMD\t「そこそこ重い攻撃だったがな……！」: That was a fairly heavy hit...!
BMD\t「ほう、/ 図体に見合ったパワーはあるようだな！」: Oh, looks like you've got power/　to match your size!
BMD\t「馬鹿め！/ そんなもの、蚊に刺されたほどにも感じんわい！」: Fool!/　I didn't feel that any more/　than a mosquito bite!
BMD\t「それで精一杯か？/ だとしたら、情けないにも程がある」: Is that your best?/　If so, that's beyond pathetic.
BMD\t「見かけと一緒でヤワな攻撃だな！」: Your attacks are as flimsy as you look!
BMD\t「はっ、グランゾンつっても、/ 噂ほどじゃねえってことか！」: Hah, so the Granzon's/　not as tough as they say!
BMD\t「ああん？/ 痛くもかゆくもねぇぞ、サフィーネ！」: Huh?/　That didn't hurt one bit, Saphine!
BMD\t「あん？ 何の真似だ、地上人？」: Huh? What's that supposed to be,/　surface dweller?
BMD\t「ハッ、地上人を買い被り過ぎたか」: Hah, guess I overrated surface dwellers.
BMD\t「がははは！/ サイバスターってのはこの程度かよ！」: Gahahaha!/　Is that all the Cybuster's got?
BMD\t「速さだけで勝負が決まるか！」: Speed alone won't decide this fight!
BMD\t「ああん？/ それで終わりかい、ガッデスさんよ」: Huh?/　That all you got, Gaddess?
BMD\t「何だ、そりゃ。/ グランヴェールってのは、/ パワーが売りじゃなかっ: What the hell was that?/　Isn't the Granveil supposed to be/　all about power?
BMD\t「はっ！ その得物は飾りか！」: Hah! Is that weapon just for show?
BMD\t「ふん、やはり見かけ倒しか」: Hmph, all bark and no bite after all.
BMD\t「甘いわ！/ そんなもの、当たりはせん！」: Too soft!/　That'll never hit me!
BMD\t「子供と遊んでいる暇はない！」: I've no time to play with you, Child!
BMD\t「いくらグランゾンでも、/ 当てることが出来ねば！」: Even the Granzon's no threat/　if it can't land a hit!
BMD\t「ふん、サイバスターの名が泣くぞ！」: Hmph, you shame the Cybuster name!
BMD\t「ガッデス、噂ほどではないな！」: Gaddess, you're not all they say!
BMD\t「グランヴェールといえど、当たらねばな！」: Granveil or not, it has to hit!
BMD\t「下手くそめが。どこを狙っとるか！」: Clumsy fool. What are you aiming at?
BMD\t「ふん、そう来ると思っとったわい！」: Hmph, I knew you'd try that!
BMD\t「くそっ！/ 弾切れとは、ついておらん！」: Damn!/　Out of ammo? Just my luck!
LDBI\t「よし、ヴォルクルスの片割れを倒したぞ！」: All right, we took down one half of Volkruss!
LDBI\t「この勢いで、もう片方も！」: Let's ride this momentum and take out the other one!
LDBI\t「ま、まさか、復活するんじゃねえだろうな！？」: D-Don't tell me it's coming back to life!?
LDBI\t「なら、さっきよりも強くなって……！？」: Then it's even stronger than before...!?
LDBI\t「ここまで来て、後に退けるか！@ やるしかねえ！」: We've come this far, we can't back down now!@We've got no choice but to fight!
LDBI\t「ああ。ユーゼス同様、捨て置くわけにはいかん」: Right. Like Euzeth, we can't leave it be.
LDBI\t（あのヴォルクルスがどこまでの力を持っているか……@ それでユーゼス: (How much power does that Volkruss have...@From that, I can gauge how Euzeth is tied@to the power of the Cross Gate.)
LDBI\t「……彼奴らがいまだ存在するのは、@ 我が因縁、我が業の深さ故か」: ...Do those wretches still exist because@of my fated ties, the depth of my karma?
LDBI\t「あなたの過去がどうであったか知りませんが……@ そういう運命なので: I don't know what your past was like...@but perhaps that is simply your fate, no?
LDBI\t「もはや運命は与えられるものでも、@ 切り開くものでもない。我が規範: Fate is no longer something bestowed,@nor something to be carved out. It shall be@my law, which I create and control.
LDBI\t「成住壊空の運命は何人たりとも逃れられぬと聞く。@ 例え、神であって: I hear none can escape the cycle of formation,@existence, decay, and void. Is that not true@even of gods?
LDBI\t「その理を知るのは、我一人で良い。@ お前達は時空が交差する“門”を: Only I need know that truth. Pass through@the "Gate" where time and space intersect,@and vanish beyond the horizon of causality.
LDBI\t「ア、アダマトロンの損傷部が@ 修復されていきます！」: Th-The Adamatron's damaged sections@are being repaired!
