BMD\t「ただのお洋服じゃありませんもの」: This is no ordinary dress, after all.
BMD\t「ザマぁ見……いえ、残念でしたわね」: Serves you ri-- I mean, what a pity.
BMD\t「そのようなもの、撃つだけ無駄ですわよ」: Firing that at me is a waste of effort.
BMD\t「さっさとお帰り下さいませ！」: Kindly see yourself out at once!
BMD\t「無駄遣いし過ぎました……」: I've used up far too much...
BMD\t「もう一発ぶちか……/ いえ、もう一撃いきますわ！」: Let me smash 'em once mo--/　I mean, here's another strike!
BMD\t「援護しちゃったりしますわ！」: I'll just go ahead and back you up!
BMD\t「協力しちゃったりしますわ、ラトゥーニ！」: I'll just go ahead and join in, Latune!
BMD\t「ライディ様には/ 余計なお世話かも知れませんけど……！」: Raidi may not need my help,/　but still...!
BMD\t「ライディ様のお兄様、/ お手伝い致しますわ！」: Raidi's brother,/　allow me to assist!
BMD\t「アラド、後はお任せ下さいませ！」: Arado, leave the rest to me!
BMD\t「マイも頑張っていますのね。なら、私も！」: Mai is doing her best. Then so will I!
BMD\t「アルフィミィ、後はお任せ下さいませ！」: Alchemie, leave the rest to me!
BMD\t「フィオナ、後はお任せ下さいませ！」: Fiona, leave the rest to me!
BMD\t「女だからって甘く見ないことねっ！！」: Don't take me lightly/　just because I'm a woman!!
BMD\t「一気に片を付けるよ！」: Let's finish this in one go!
BMD\t「逃げるんなら今の内だよ！」: If you're running, now's your chance!
BMD\t「なるほど、戦い甲斐がありそうだ」: I see... This one's worth fighting.
BMD\t「面白い……/ やはり強敵が相手でなくてはな」: Interesting.../　It has to be a strong foe, after all.
BMD\t「地上人か……/ 存分に腕を振るえそうだな！」: A surface dweller.../　I can really cut loose on this one!
BMD\t「女だからといって、侮るな！/ グランヴェールといえど、先手を取れば！: Don't take me lightly for being a woman!/　Granveil or not, if I strike first...!
BMD\t「傲岸不遜を絵に描いたような男！/ 貴様には負けないっ！」: You're arrogance in human form!/　I won't lose to you!
BMD\t「魔装機神グランヴェール……/ 確かに厄介な相手だが、/ 先に落としさ: The Masoukishin Granveil.../　A troublesome foe, to be sure,/　but if I take it down first...!
BMD\t「地上のメカか？/ 何というか……変わったデザインだな」: A surface mech?/　It's... an odd design, to say the least.
BMD\t「確か……ヴァルシオーネとか言ったか？/ 必要以上に人に似せるのに、/: Valsione, I think it was called...?/　Why bother making it resemble/　a person more than it needs to?
BMD\t「くっ……何なんだ、あの化け物は！/ あんなもの、野放しに出来ん！」: Ngh... What is that monster?!/　I can't let that thing run wild!
BMD\t「ルオゾールめ、/ 厄介なものを復活させてくれたものだ！」: Damn you, Luozorl,/　for reviving something so troublesome!
BMD\t「悪いが、こちらも手は抜けなくてな！」: Sorry, but I can't hold back either!
BMD\t「そのまま帰すと思ったか！？」: You thought I'd let you leave like that?!
BMD\t「ただで済むと思うなっ！」: Don't think you'll get away with this!
BMD\t「ちっ、ここまでか……撤退する！」: Tch, that's it for me... Withdrawing!
BMD\t「い、いかん……これ以上は危険だ」: N-No good... Any more is too dangerous.
BMD\t「くっ……/ こんなことでやられては、立つ瀬がない！」: Ngh.../　I'd never live it down if I fell to this!
BMD\t「まだまだ、/ やられるわけにはいかない！」: Not yet!/　I can't go down yet!
BMD\t「うぅっ！！/ こ、こうも好き勝手やられるとは……」: Ugh!!/　T-To let them run rampant like this...
BMD\t「何っ！？ あのボディのどこから、/ これほどのパワーが……」: What?! Where does that body/　get this kind of power...?
BMD\t「ええい！/ 地上人め、侮り難い！」: Blast it!/　These surface dwellers are no pushovers!
BMD\t「くっ、/ 地上のメカにここまで押されるとは！」: Ngh,/　pushed this far by a surface mech!
BMD\t「ぐうっ！/ こ、これが魔装機神の力か……！」: Gugh!/　S-So this is a Masoukishin's power...!
BMD\t「くっ、さすがだ。/ だが、こっちも退けん！」: Ngh, impressive./　But I can't back down either!
BMD\t「やるっ！/ だが、まだこれからが勝負！」: Good!/　But the real fight starts now!
BMD\t「つっ、思ったよりもパワーがある！」: Tch, more power than I expected!
BMD\t「くっ！/ さすがはグランヴェール、ということか」: Ngh!/　I suppose that's the Granveil for you.
BMD\t「ちっ、図体がデカいのは/ 伊達ではないということか！」: Tch, so that size isn't/　just for show!
BMD\t「手を抜いているのか？ 今は戦闘中だぞ！」: Are you holding back? This is a battle!
BMD\t「どうした！/ それで精一杯だと言うつもりか！」: What's wrong?!/　Is that really the best you can do?!
BMD\t「大口を叩く割に、大したことはないな！」: All talk and nothing to back it up!
BMD\t「ふっ、地上のメカといえど、/ その程度の力では！」: Heh, surface mech or not,/　that little power won't cut it!
BMD\t「そう簡単に当たるものかっ！！」: As if it'd hit that easily!!
LDBI\t「あれが……もう一つのルーツですの」: That is... another of the roots.
LDBI\t「え？@ アルフィミィちゃん、前にも@ そんなこと言ってなかった？」: Huh? Alchemie, didn't you say@something like that before?
LDBI\t「艦長、戦域内に重力震反応！@ 何者かが転移出現します！！」: Captain, gravity quake reading in the combat zone!@Someone's transferring in!!
LDBI\t「フッ……自分が成すべきことを@ ようやく見つけたようね、スレイ」: Heh... So you've finally found@what you need to do, Sleigh.
LDBI\t「アイビスさんとスレイさんが一緒に……@ プロジェクトＴＤがあるべき: Ibis and Sleigh together...@Project TD is back the way it should be.
LDBI\t（我が友よ……@ 星への翼、お前が託した輝き……@ それが今、一つと: (My friend...@Your wings to the stars, your shining legacy...@They have now become one.)
LDBI\t（ならば、私はお前の夢を受け継ぐ者達……@ その眼前に立ちはだかる者: (Then I shall strike down any who stand@before those who inherit your dream.)
LDBI\t（鋼龍戦隊が来たか。乱戦になれば、勝機も見える。@ それに、いざとな: (The Steel Dragons are here. In a melee, I may@find a chance to win. And if it comes to it,@the Cylion can get me out of here.)
LDBI\t「サイリオンの慣熟は終えた……@ 機体性能に差があろうとも、結果的に: I've mastered the Cylion... Even if our@machines differ in performance, in the end,@it's the pilot's skill that counts.
LDBI\t「あたしだって、プロジェクトＴＤで@ 訓練を積んできた！ シリーズ７: I trained in Project TD too! When it comes@to handling the Series 77, I won't lose@to anybody!
LDBI\t「私はプロフェッショナルだ！@ テストパイロット上がりの小娘に@ 後: I'm a professional!@I won't fall behind some little girl@who used to be a test pilot!
LDBI\t「……だから、言ったんだ……ここから去れって」: ...That's why I told you... to get out of here.
LDBI\t（アラセリ・ガルシア……@ 同じ空を飛ぶパイロットでも、お前とアイビ: (Araceli Garcia...@You and Ibis may fly the same skies as pilots,@but your eyes were set on different places...)
LDBI\t（その差が、この結果を招いた……@ 今の私には、それがわかる）: (That difference led to this outcome...@Now I can understand that.)
LDBI\t「り、離脱できん！ このサイリオンがっ！！」: C-can't break away! This damn Cylion!!
LDBI\t（アラセリ・ガルシア……@ お前と鋼龍戦隊では、見据えていた先が違う: (Araceli Garcia...@You and the Steel Dragons had your eyes set@on different places...)
LDBI\t「敵機、全機撃墜。後続の反応、ありません」: All enemy units destroyed.@No sign of reinforcements.
LDBI\t「アイビス達は？」: What about Ibis and the others?
LDBI\t（兄様……@ 今日からスレイは自分の意志で歩きます……）: (Brother...@From today, I will walk by my own will...)
LDBI\t（そして、いつの日か……@ このハイペリオンで兄様が夢見たものを@: (And someday...@in this Hyperlion, I'll get to see@what you dreamed of, Brother...)
LDBI\t「ハイペリオン……@ この機体なら、本当に銀河の果てまでも@ 飛んで: Hyperlion...@With this machine, I really feel like we could@fly all the way to the edge of the galaxy...
LDBI\t「そのためには、これからも@ 私達の力を一つにする必要があるわ」: To do that, we'll need to keep@combining our strengths into one.
LDBI\t「わかってる。@ ……ＴＤ４よりスティール２。ベガリオンと@ スレイ: I know.@...TD4 to Steel 2. Requesting landing clearance@for Vegalion and Sleigh Presty.
LDBI\t「今日からまた、スレイはあたし達の仲間だからね」: From today, Sleigh's one of us again, okay?
LDBI\t「星の軌道に回り道などない。遠回りに見えようと、@ いずれは目指すべ: There are no detours in a star's orbit.@However roundabout it may seem, it always@returns to the path it was meant to take.
LDBI\t「そして、今日までの旅路も@ きっと君の糧となっているはずだ」: And the journey that brought you here@will surely have made you stronger.
LDBI\t「レフィーナ司令には、@ 私からも口添えをしよう。@ だから、我らの: I'll put in a word for you@with Commander Lefina as well.@So come with us.
LDBI\t「我が友、フィリオもそれを望んでいるだろう」: My friend Filio would surely want that too.
LDBI\t「それに、あなた……他にも目的があって、@ 単機で私達に接触して来た: Besides... didn't you have some other reason@for approaching us alone?
LDBI\t「イスルギ重工社長、ミツコ・イスルギから@ レフィーナ・エンフィール: I carry a message from Mitsuko Isurugi,@president of Isurugi Heavy Industries,@for Commander Lefina Enfield.
LDBI\t「ミツコ・イスルギは、@ あなた達がそういう反応を@ 示すだろうと予: Mitsuko Isurugi predicted@you would react that way.
LDBI\t「だから、私がメッセンジャーとして選ばれたと@ 推測されます」: I assume that's why I was chosen@as the messenger.
LDBI\t「とは言え、罠である可能性は否めん。@ そもそも、その両者が誘いに応: Even so, we can't rule out a trap.@And I doubt both sides would even accept@the invitation.
LDBI\t「ですが、彼は勝算なしに動く人物ではありませんよ」: But he's not a man who moves@without a chance of success.
LDBI\t「俺もそう思う。@ 両者を動かし得る何かを掴んでいるのだろう」: I agree.@He must have a hold on something@that could move both sides.
LDBI\t「それなら、ミツコ・イスルギとスレイを介さず、@ 直接私達に伝えても: Then couldn't he have told us directly,@rather than through Mitsuko Isurugi and Sleigh?
LDBI\t「こちらに手の内を読まれたくなかったのだろう。@ そして、イスルギを: He likely didn't want us reading his hand.@As for why he involved Isurugi...@perhaps there's some bad blood between them?
LDBI\t「だとすれば、先程のサイリオンはいったい……」: Then what was that Cylion earlier...?
LDBI\t「要は、大統領の件のように@ 情報が操作される前に自分の目で確かめろ: The point is, he wants us to see it with our@own eyes before the information is manipulated,@as with the President.
LDBI\t「自分は罠の可能性が高いと思います。@ それに、最優先すべきはイティ: I think the odds of a trap are high.@And resupplying at Itiiti Island comes first...@We can't afford to go up into space.
LDBI\t「同感です。@ 二度も術中にはまるわけにはいきませんぞ」: Agreed.@We can't afford to fall into their trap twice.
LDBI\t「ですが、シラカワ博士がやろうとしていることは、@ 我々の現状を打破: However, what Dr. Shirakawa is attempting could@be what breaks us out of our current situation.
LDBI\t「そこで……単機で宇宙へ上がれる機体を@ 何機か派遣します。それでど: So... we'll send a few units that can reach@space on their own. How does that sound?
LDBI\t「スレイ……あなた達のハイペリオンが@ この任務に最も適した機体であ: Sleigh... your Hyperlion is the unit@best suited for this mission.
LDBI\t「アイビス達と共に宇宙へ上がってもらうことに@ なりますが、よろしい: You'd be going up into space with Ibis and@the others. Is that all right?
LDBI\t「私は……この身を受け入れてくれたそちらの@ 寛大な処置に感謝してい: I... am grateful for the generous treatment@you've shown in accepting me.
LDBI\t「そして、今はアイビス達に協力したいというのが@ 偽らざる想いです」: And right now, I honestly want@to help Ibis and the others.
LDBI\t「アルテリオンとベガリオンが@ 合体するとはな……」: I can't believe Alterion and@Vegalion can combine...
LDBI\t「アルテリオンの名前の由来はアルタイル……彦星。@ ベガリオンはベガ: Alterion comes from Altair... the Cowherd.@Vegalion from Vega... the Weaver. Combined,@the two bring Series 77 to its culmination.
LDBI\t「もしかして……７７は七夕を意味しているのですか？」: Could it be... that 77 stands for Tanabata?
LDBI\t「ええ。それも７７の名前の由来の一つよ」: Yes. That's another origin of the name 77.
LDBI\t「じゃあ、ハイペリオンじゃなくて、@ タナバタリオンって名前の方が良: Then shouldn't it be called Tanabatalion@instead of Hyperlion?
LDBI\t「語呂わりぃな、そいつぁよ」: Doesn't exactly roll off the tongue, pal.
BMD\t「さあて、種も仕掛けもありまくり！」: Now then, this trick's got plenty up its sleeve!
BMD\t「気づいた時にゃ、もう遅いぜ！」: By the time you notice, it's too late!
LDBI\t「事故とは言え、責任は感じているのだよ。@ だからこそ、軍医が見放し: Accident or not, I do feel responsible.@That's why I saved you by special measures when@the army doctors gave up on you--at great cost.
LDBI\t「それでこのザマか。@ 要は俺に首輪をつけ、口を封じようとしたんだろ: And this is the result?@You just wanted to collar me and shut me up.@If you'd cured me completely, I'd...
LDBI\t「君が疑いを持つのはやむを得ないが……@ あの短期間で君をそこまで回: I understand your suspicions, but...@you could at least credit us for restoring you@that far in so short a time.
LDBI\t「我々でなければ、君は救えなかった。@ 不服があるなら、他の医者の所: No one but us could have saved you.@If you're dissatisfied, go see another doctor.
LDBI\t「いや……@ 君をこれ以上回復させられる医者がいるなら、@ 逆に紹介: No...@If there's a doctor who can heal you further,@I'd like you to introduce me to them.
LDBI\t「いいかね？@ 君はツェントル・プロジェクトの成果によって@ 命を救: Understand?@Your life was saved by the fruits@of the Tsentr Project.
LDBI\t「ならば、プロジェクトのために働いてもらうのは@ 当然のことだ」: So naturally, you'll work for the project@in return.
LDBI\t「それは、あんたの勝手な理屈だ」: That's just your own self-serving logic.
LDBI\t「……どうも君はツェントル・プロジェクトを@ 誤解しているようだな。: ...You seem to misunderstand the Tsentr@Project. We're seeking a means to defend the@Earth Sphere from outside enemies.
LDBI\t「その中の一つが、@ 君達に与えたＴＥアブゾーバー試作６号機……@: One of those is what we gave you:@TE Absorber Prototype Unit 6...@Cerberus.
LDBI\t「……なら、イェッツトは？@ あの疑似アインストは何だったんだ？」: ...Then what about Jetzt?@What was that pseudo-Einst?
LDBI\t「言わば、必要悪……@ <アインスト>のような存在を打ち倒すためのな: A necessary evil, you might say...@to defeat beings like the <アインスト>.
LDBI\t「研究には試行錯誤が付き物だ。@ 君達クライウルブズをそれに巻き込ん: Trial and error is part of research.@I do regret that you and the Cry Wolves@got caught up in it.
LDBI\t「それに加え、@ ツェントル・プロジェクトの全てを@ 君に明かせぬこ: As well as the fact that I can't reveal@everything about the Tsentr Project to you.
LDBI\t「知られるとまずいことがあるからだろうが」: Because there are things you don't want known.
LDBI\t「ヒューゴ……君もアクア少尉のように、@ 素直に協力してもらえないも: Hugo... Why can't you just cooperate@willingly, like Lieutenant Aqua?
LDBI\t「今のツェントル・プロジェクトは、@ ある止ん事無き御方の意志によっ: The Tsentr Project now operates by the will@of a certain most distinguished individual.
LDBI\t「いずれ時が来れば、君は私達に協力していることを@ 誇りに思うだろう: When the time comes, you'll be proud@to have worked with us.
LDBI\t「悪いが、そんなにめでたい頭じゃない。@ 俺の目的は一つ……」: Sorry, but I'm not that gullible.@I have only one goal...
LDBI\t「好きにすればいいと言ったはずだ。@ ただし、君が何をやろうと、何を: I told you you're free to do as you please.@But whatever you do, whatever you say,@it will all be in vain.
LDBI\t「それだけの権力を持った人物が、我々の上にいる。@ そして、彼は地球: Above us is someone with that much power.@And he wishes for the Earth Sphere to endure@by Earthlings' hands... The just cause is ours.
LDBI\t「今は耐えるべき時なのだ、ヒューゴ。@ 共に恩讐を乗り越え、忌まわし: Now is the time to endure, Hugo.@Let us overcome our grudges together, dispel@the cursed past, and seize glory.
LDBI\t「そんなことに興味はない」: I have no interest in that.
LDBI\t「なら……私を殺せば、君の気は晴れるのか？」: Then... would killing me make you feel better?
LDBI\t「……それが出来るのなら、とっくの昔にやっている」: ...If I could do that,@I'd have done it long ago.
LDBI\t「そう、君は愚かな人間ではない。@ だからこそ、私に文句を言うものの: Yes, you're not a foolish man.@That's why you complain but never act on it.@Nor do you choose to take your own life.
LDBI\t（……その通りだ。@ 己の死から学び得ることは何もない……）: (...He's right.@Nothing can be learned from one's own death...)
LDBI\t（任務を成し遂げ、必ず生きて還る……）: (Complete the mission,@and always come back alive...)
LDBI\t（それがアルベロ隊長の教えだった……@ 俺が生き延びなければ、フォリ: (That was Commander Albero's lesson...@If I don't survive, then Foglia's and the@others' deaths will have been...)
LDBI\t「我々の関係は、ギブ・アンド・テイクなのだ。@ 君はＴＥアブゾーバー: Ours is a give-and-take relationship.@You provide us with TE Absorber data...@and I give you the means to live.
LDBI\t「うむ。@ しばらくの間、伊豆基地の<特殊戦技教導隊>へ出向し、@: Indeed. For a while, you'll be assigned to@the <特殊戦技教導隊> at Izu Base@to collect field data on Cerberus.
LDBI\t（伊豆の<教導隊>……カイ・キタムラ少佐の部隊か）: (The <教導隊> at Izu...@Major Kai Kitamura's unit, huh?)
LDBI\t「それと、７号機がロールアウトし次第、伊豆へ送る。@ そちらのテスト: Also, once Unit 7 rolls out, we'll send it@to Izu. You'll test that one as well.
LDBI\t「サーベラスとは違い、@ <特機>タイプのＴＥアブゾーバーだ。@ 君: Unlike Cerberus,@it's a <特機>-type TE Absorber.@We're tuning it for the two of you.
LDBI\t「名前はガルムレイド。@ スペックデータは、機体と共に送る」: Its name is Garmraid.@The spec data will be sent along with the unit.
LDBI\t「……５号機がメディウス・ロクス、@ ６号機がサーベラス、そして７号: ...Unit 5 is Medius Locus,@Unit 6 is Cerberus, and now Unit 7, Garmraid...
LDBI\t「メディウスのデータは参考用としてもらっているが、@ ＴＥアブゾーバ: We've been given Medius's data for reference,@but how many TE Absorbers are there in total?
LDBI\t「それを知る必要はない。@ また、他の者にサーベラスとガルムレイドを: You don't need to know that.@Also, you are not to let anyone else pilot@Cerberus or Garmraid.
LDBI\t「もっとも、その２機は@ 君達の専用機としてアジャストされているから: Not that anyone else could operate them,@since both units have been adjusted@exclusively for the two of you.
LDBI\t「サーベラスとガルムレイドの情報は@ 先方に知られても問題ないんだな: So it's no problem if the people there@learn about Cerberus and Garmraid?
LDBI\t「機体整備のこともある。構わんよ」: They'll have to maintain the units. That's fine.
LDBI\t「ただし、君がプロジェクトにとって@ 不利になる行動を取れば……」: However, should you act in a way that@harms the project...
LDBI\t「薬の手配は保証できない、だろう？」: You can't guarantee my medicine, right?
LDBI\t（……今は耐えるべき時、か。@ その言葉には賛同できる）: (...Now is the time to endure, huh?@I can agree with that much.)
LDBI\t「そう……夢が叶ったのね、アクア」: I see... So your dream came true, Aqua.
LDBI\t「どんな機体……と尋ねても、@ 機密事項なんでしょう？」: And if I asked what kind of machine...@it'd be classified, wouldn't it?
LDBI\t「そうなんです。@ ミッテ先生が連邦軍絡みの仕事をなさっていれば、@: That's right. Though if you were doing work@for the Federation Forces, Professor Mitte,@you might hear about it...
LDBI\t「ところで、先生はアビアノ基地を出られた後……@ どこで、何をしてお: By the way, Professor, since you left Aviano@Base... where are you, and what are you doing?

LDBI\t「モヤモヤした感じ……共鳴しておりますの……？」: This murky feeling... Is it resonating...?

LDBI\t「間違いない、ファウ・ケルンが活性化している！」: No doubt about it, the Fau Kern is activating!
LDBI\t「あれはイェッツト……レジセイアの……？@ まだ残っていましたの……: Is that Jetzt... Regisseur's...?@Is it still around...?
BMD\t「ラウルさん、ロック継続中です」: Raul, the lock is still holding.
BMD\t「突撃するぞ！/ みんな、しっかり掴まっていろ！」: Commencing assault!/　Everyone, hold on tight!
BMD\t「フィールド展開！ いいわよ！」: Field deployed! You're good to go!
BMD\t「すぐに終わらせる、これがな」: I'll end this quickly, that's how it is.
BMD\t「時間をかける気はない……！」: I don't intend to drag this out...!
BMD\t「当たり負けはせん、これがな」: I won't be outmatched, that's how it is.
BMD\t「ドゥバン……/ 紛い物では、所詮無理な話だ」: Duban.../　A fake was never going to cut it.
BMD\t「知らぬ間に/ 地球は異星人に支配されるということか。/ 巧妙だが、気: So aliens would rule Earth/　before anyone even noticed./　Clever, but quite the long game.
BMD\t「恐怖を味わうことになるのは、お前達の方だ」: You're the ones who'll be tasting fear.
BMD\t「お前達が言う絶望は温い、これがな」: Your despair is lukewarm, that's how it is.
BMD\t「ペルフェクティオ……/ 『こちら側』へ来るとただでは済まんぞ。/ …: Perfectio.../　Come to 'this side' and it'll cost you./　...I'd know.
BMD\t「お前達と馴れ合うつもりはない！」: I've no intention of playing nice with you!
BMD\t「お前達はかつての俺達と同じ……/ 招かれざる客だ、これがな」: You're just like we once were.../　Uninvited guests, that's how it is.
BMD\t「どのみち、お前では無理だったということだ、/ ゼゼーナン」: Either way, you were never up to it,/　Zezenan.
BMD\t「桃源郷などという腑抜けた世界に興味はない」: I've no interest in some spineless utopia.
BMD\t「甘言には裏がある……お前達の真意は何だ？」: Sweet words hide a catch... What's your aim?
BMD\t「その物言い、その超機人……/ どこまでもふざけた奴だ」: That attitude, that Choukijin.../　You mock everything, don't you?
BMD\t「鋼龍戦隊を危険視する気持ちは/ わからんでもないがな」: I can't say I don't get why they'd see/　the Steel Dragons as a threat.
BMD\t「ガイアセイバーズ……/ おれの邪魔をするのなら、容赦はせん」: Gaia Saviors.../　Get in my way, and I'll show no mercy.
BMD\t「あの黒い翼……気に入らんな」: Those black wings... I don't like them.
BMD\t「目障りな雑魚から片付けてやる！」: I'll clear out the annoying small fry first!
BMD\t「ＡＩ１……お前の行く末などに興味はない」: AI1... I don't care what becomes of you.
BMD\t「なかなかいい面構えだ、これがな」: Quite the face on that one, that's how it is.
BMD\t「龍虎王や虎龍王とは一味違うようだな」: Not quite like RyuKoOh or KoRyuOh, is it?
BMD\t「ガンエデン……/ おれは、籠中の鳥になる気はない」: Gan Eden.../　I won't become a caged bird.
BMD\t「檻の中でおれ達のような存在を/ 朽ち果てさせる……/ それが真意じゃ: Locking beings like us in a cage/　to rot away.../　Isn't that your real aim, Gan Eden?
BMD\t「皮肉だな。/ 世界の有り様を変えようとしたおれが、/ 貴様を止める側: Ironic./　I tried to remake the world's order,/　and now I'm the one stopping you.
BMD\t「起死回生……そう簡単には成し遂げられんぞ、/ これがな！」: A last-ditch comeback... won't come easy,/　that's how it is!
BMD\t「やり返さねば気が済まない質でな」: I'm the type who has to hit back.
BMD\t「ええい、ここまでか！」: Damn it, is this the end?!
BMD\t「まだ逆転するチャンスはある……！」: There's still a chance to turn this around...!
BMD\t「限界が来たわけではない……/ 動ける限り戦い抜く！」: I haven't hit my limit yet.../　I'll fight as long as I can move!
BMD\t「うぐっ！ ここで引き下がれるか！」: Ugh! I can't back down here!
BMD\t「まだ動ける。残念だったな」: I can still move. Too bad for you.
BMD\t「なるほど、そう来たか……！」: I see, so that's your move...!
BMD\t「装甲は抜けていない……。問題はないな」: It didn't pierce the armor... No problem.
LDBI\t「いい加減なことを言うんじゃねえ！@ ラングランを混乱させてんのは、: Don't give me that crap!@You're the one throwing Langran into chaos!
LDBI\t「理解してもらえぬのは残念だ。@ では、我々はシュテドニアス軍を追撃: It's a pity you cannot understand.@Now, we will be pursuing the Schtedonias army,@so I shall take my leave.
LDBI\t「諸君、よくやってくれた。@ 我が方も敵の撃退に成功した」: Well done, everyone.@Our forces have also repelled the enemy.
LDBI\t「現在、シュテドニアス軍はヌエット海を渡って@ 撤退しつつあり、カー: The Schtedonias army is now retreating across@the Nuett Sea, with Kirkus's forces in pursuit.
LDBI\t「奴は、殿下が混乱の源だとぬかしやがった」: That jerk had the gall to say@you're the source of the chaos.
LDBI\t「テリウス殿下の戴冠式のことも話してやがったが……@ あいつの好きに: He talked about Prince Tellius's@coronation, too... Are you really gonna@let him do whatever he wants?
LDBI\t「今、最優先すべきはシュテドニアス軍の撃退だ。@ カークス軍の力を借: Right now, our top priority is driving out@the Schtedonias army. Without Kirkus's forces,@we cannot purge the enemy from this continent.
LDBI\t「マサキ、控えなさい。@ カークス将軍の件で最も頭を悩ませているのは: Masaki, that's enough.@No one is more troubled over General Kirkus@than Prince Feil.
LDBI\t「ともかく、君達は王都まで戻って来てくれ。@ その後、改めて要請を出: In any case, please return to the capital.@I will issue a new request after that.
LDBI\t「殿下、カークス軍にも地上人部隊がいるようです。@ もしかして、我が: Your Highness, Kirkus's army seems to have@surface dweller units too. Perhaps our@flagship, the Hiryu Custom, was also...
LDBI\t「彼は、麾下戦力の全てを@ こちら側に明かしていないのです。@ 我々: He has not disclosed all the forces@under his command to us.@We are investigating on our end, but...
LDBI\t「何か判明しましたら、ご連絡をお願いします」: Please let us know if you find anything.
LDBI\t「それと、ヤンロン達の消息もな。@ あいつら、こんな時にどこを@ う: Find out what's up with Yang Long's bunch too.@Where the hell are they wandering off to@at a time like this...?
LDBI\t「では、殿下……我々は王都へ帰還します」: Then, Your Highness... we'll return to the capital.
BMD\t「あの敵は本艦で仕留める」: This ship will finish that enemy off.
BMD\t「総員、レーツェル様の期待に応えるのだ」: All hands, live up to Rätsel's hopes!
BMD\t「前方のガイアセイバーズ機に仕掛ける！」: Engaging the Gaia Savers unit ahead!
BMD\t「ガイアセイバーズの横暴を許すな！」: Don't let the Gaia Savers run roughshod!
BMD\t「マイヤー総司令や、/ ビアン総帥のご遺志に従わぬのであれば……！」: If you refuse to honor the wishes of/　Supreme Commander Maier and Dr. Bian...!
BMD\t「あの黒い特機を近づけるな！」: Keep that black super robot away!
BMD\t「本艦でデモンを駆逐する！」: This ship will wipe out the Demons!
BMD\t「本艦であの超機人を阻止する！」: This ship will stop that Choukijin!
BMD\t「本艦でゲスト機を仕留めるぞ！」: This ship will finish off the Guest unit!
BMD\t「被弾箇所、報告！ ダメコンを急げ！」: Report the damage! Hurry with damage control!
BMD\t「ここで沈めば、/ レーツェル様に申し訳が立たんぞ！」: If we sink here,/　how will we ever face Rätsel?!
BMD\t「弾幕を厚くしろ！ 敵を近づけるな！」: Thicken the barrage! Keep them back!
BMD\t「終わるわけにはいかん！/ 役目を果たすまでは！」: We can't end here!/　Not until our duty is done!
BMD\t「ゲストに後れを取るな！ 反撃を！」: Don't fall behind the Guests! Counterattack!
BMD\t「ルイーナ機の撃破を急げ！」: Take out the Ruina unit, quickly!
BMD\t「デモンをこれ以上近づけるな！」: Don't let the Demons get any closer!
BMD\t「確実にゲスト機を撃破せよ！」: Make sure that Guest unit goes down!
BMD\t「その程度で、クロガネは沈まんよ」: That won't be enough to sink the Kurogane.
BMD\t「本艦を集中的に狙ってきたか……！」: So they're concentrating on this ship...!
BMD\t「こちらは修羅場を/ 何度もくぐり抜けてきているのでな」: We've been through hell/　more times than we can count.
BMD\t「各砲座、敵機の接近を許すな」: All turrets, keep the enemy at bay.
BMD\t「抵抗が弱いが、油断してはならん」: Resistance is light, but stay alert.
BMD\t「ふん、インスペクターと同レベルだな」: Hmph, no better than the Inspectors.
BMD\t「ルイーナを接近させるな！」: Keep the Ruina from closing in!
BMD\t「デモンに食いつかれるとはな……！」: To think the Demons got their teeth in us...!
BMD\t「デモンめ、本艦を狙ってきたか」: So the Demons are after this ship.
BMD\t「レーツェル様から預かった艦を/ 傷つけるわけにはいかん」: I won't let a ship entrusted to us/　by Rätsel come to harm.
BMD\t「エア・クリスマス相手に油断は禁物だぞ」: Don't let your guard down/　against Air Christmas.
BMD\t「この調子でデモンを近づけるな！」: Keep those Demons back, just like that!
BMD\t「フィールドの展開が間に合ったか」: The field went up just in time.
BMD\t「打つ手を考えるのだな」: You'd better think of another move.
BMD\t「本艦を盾にするのだ！」: Use this ship as a shield!
BMD\t「ユルサン……ユルサンゾ！」: Unforgivable... I will not forgive you!
BMD\t「ワカラヌカ……ムダダト……」: Do you not see... It is futile...
BMD\t「ぐうっ！/ こ、こんな所で……終わってたまるか！！」: Gah!/　I-I'm not going down... not here!!
BMD\t「うぐっ！ まだいける！ まだ戦えるっ！！」: Ugh! I can still go! I can still fight!!
BMD\t「こ、これぐらいのピンチなんか……/ 切り抜けてやらあ！！」: A-A pinch like this.../　I'll bust right through it!!
BMD\t「何っ！？/ だがな……ここから巻き返すのが/ スーパーロボットのお約: What?!/　But hey... a comeback from here/　is the classic super robot move!!
BMD\t「アヤ、俺を信じろ！ 俺は負けやしねえ！！」: Aya, trust me! I'm not gonna lose!!
BMD\t「へ、へへへ……来たぜ……/ お約束の大ピンチって奴がよ……！」: Heh, heh heh... Here it comes.../　the classic big pinch...!
BMD\t「こ、こうなったら、/ 俺達の底力を見せてやろうぜ、Ｒ‐１！」: I-In that case,/　let's show 'em our true Potential, R-1!
BMD\t「うああっ！/ ゲシュペンストがここまで追い込まれるなんて！」: Waaah!/　The Gespenst's been pushed this far?!
BMD\t「どうした、ゲシュペンスト！/ まだいけるだろ！？」: What's wrong, Gespenst?!/　You can still go, right?!
BMD\t「グルンガストが/ この程度だと思うんじゃねえぞ！」: Don't think this is all/　the Grungust's got!
BMD\t「く、くそっ！/ グルンガストでも無理だってのかよ！？」: D-Damn it!/　Even the Grungust can't cut it?!
BMD\t「ヒュッケバインが、/ ここまでのダメージを受けるなんて……！」: I can't believe the Hückebein's/　taken this much damage...!
BMD\t「ダ、ダメだ……/ ヒュッケバインの装甲が、もうもたねえ……！」: N-No good.../　The Hückebein's armor won't hold...!
BMD\t「ゲストめ、やってくれるぜ！」: Damn Guests, they got me good!
BMD\t「インスペクターより一枚上手か！」: A cut above the Inspectors, huh?!
BMD\t「うぐっ！ ルイーナなんぞに！」: Ugh! Like I'd lose to the Ruina!
BMD\t「あ、あの念に取り込まれたら……！！」: I-If that will drags me in...!!
BMD\t「こ、こんな所で/ 破滅するわけにはいかねえんだよ！」: I-I'm not gonna meet my doom/　in a place like this!
BMD\t「ぐうっ！ 奴に狩られてたまるか！」: Gah! Like I'd let him hunt me down!
BMD\t「くそっ、魔装機のパワーを侮ったか！」: Damn, I underrated a Masouki's power!
BMD\t「何てもんを撃ち込んできやがるんだ、/ あの亀ロボは！」: What the hell is that turtle robot/　firing at me?!
BMD\t「四凶の超機人は、/ 伊達じゃねえってことか！」: So the Four Evils' Choukijin/　aren't just for show!
BMD\t「や、奴に食われてたまるか！」: L-Like I'd let it eat me!
BMD\t「あんなのと一つになってたまるか！」: Like I'd become one with that thing!
BMD\t「ユーゼス……てめえだけはっ！！」: Euzeth... you're the one I'll take down!!
BMD\t「て、てめえとの因縁なんざ……/ 願い下げなんだよ！」: M-My fate tied to yours.../　I want no part of it!
BMD\t「ちっ！ 俺の邪魔をするんじゃねえ！！」: Tch! Stay out of my way!!
BMD\t「くっ、なかなかいい攻撃だ……/ 参考にさせてもらうぜ！」: Ngh, nice attack.../　I'll be taking notes!
BMD\t「ぐあっ！/ てめえの面、ちゃんと覚えたからな！」: Gah!/　I won't forget your face!
BMD\t「うわあっ、やられた！！/ ……って、慌てるほどでもねえか」: Waaah, I'm hit!!/　...Eh, it's nothing to panic over.
BMD\t「こいつ……/ どうあっても俺を止める気か……！ だがな！」: This guy... he's dead set/　on stopping me...! Well, guess what!
BMD\t「ヤ、ヤベえ……/ これじゃ、ヴィレッタ隊長に怒られちまうぜ！」: Th-This is bad.../　Captain Viletta's gonna chew me out!
BMD\t「その程度じゃ、ＳＲＸは止められない！！」: That's not enough to stop the SRX!!
BMD\t「くっ！ プラスパーツに被弾したぞ！」: Ngh! The Plus Parts took a hit!
BMD\t「わかってる！ ちょっと油断しただけだ！」: I know! I just got careless for a sec!
BMD\t「手ぇ抜いてるように見えるか！？/ え、見えるって？」: Do I look like I'm slacking off?!/　Huh, I do?
BMD\t「うぐっ！/ アヤ、脚部のフィールド・サポートを！」: Ugh!/　Aya, field support for the legs!
BMD\t「この程度でＲ‐１が落ちるかってんだ！！」: Like the R-1's gonna go down to this!!
BMD\t「Ｒ‐１がそんなもんで落ちると思うな！」: Don't think the R-1 goes down that easy!
BMD\t「ダメージチェック！/ よし、Ｒ‐１……まだいけるぜ！」: Damage check!/　Okay, R-1... we can still go!
BMD\t「ヘッ、/ ゲシュペンストを見くびってたようだな！」: Heh,/　looks like you underestimated the Gespenst!
BMD\t「イングめ、よくも！」: Damn you, Ing! How dare you!
BMD\t「許さん、許さんぞ！ イング！！」: I won't forgive you... Never, Ing!!
BMD\t「ぐうっ！ イングめ、予想外の力を……！！」: Ngh! Ing, I didn't expect such power...!!
BMD\t「馬鹿な、あの機体にあんな力が……！！」: Impossible! That machine has such power...!?
BMD\t「うぐっ！/ 消え去るべきはその機体だ、私ではない！」: Ugh!/　That machine is what should vanish, not me!
BMD\t「くっ！/ 凶鳥に狩られるなど、あってはならない！」: Ngh!/　No bird of ill omen will hunt me down!
BMD\t「くうっ！ 欠陥機にここまで押されるとは！」: Ngh! Pushed this far by a defective unit!
BMD\t「中途半端な攻撃など、するだけ無駄だ！」: Half-hearted attacks are a waste of effort!
BMD\t「少しはやるようだが、詰めが甘いな」: Not bad, but you can't finish the job.
BMD\t「ふん、奴を甘く見過ぎたか」: Hmph. Seems I took them too lightly.
BMD\t「フフフ……狩り甲斐のある獲物だ」: Heh heh heh... Prey worth hunting.
BMD\t「ハッ、勢いだけではな！」: Ha! Momentum alone won't cut it!
BMD\t「くらったか。/ だが、トロニウム・レヴに異常はない」: A hit, then./　But the Tronium Rev is unaffected.
BMD\t「以前ほどの力はないようだな」: You're not as strong as you once were.
BMD\t「ヴィレッタ、/ お前は己の過ちに気づいていない」: Viletta,/　you haven't realized your own mistake.
BMD\t「寄せ集めで作った機体と言えど、/ そこそこのパワーはあるようだな」: For a patchwork machine,/　it has a fair amount of power.
BMD\t「トロニウムから得た力を/ 完全に引き出せていないようだな」: Seems you can't fully draw out/　the power you got from the Tronium.
BMD\t「この程度、いちいちかわすまでもない」: Attacks like this aren't worth dodging.
BMD\t「どうした？ 当てるだけで精一杯か？」: What's wrong? Is just hitting me your limit?
BMD\t「ふん、アルテウル様が/ 目を付けられただけのことはあるな」: Hmph. No wonder/　Lord Arteur took an interest in you.
BMD\t「ガリルナガンを捉えるとは……/ 褒めておいてやる」: Landing a hit on the Galilnagant.../　I'll give you some credit.
BMD\t「パターンを読んだか、ヴィレッタ」: So you read my pattern, Viletta.
BMD\t「所詮は寄せ集めの機体か」: Just a patchwork machine after all.
BMD\t「全身に付けたそのパーツは、ただの飾りか？」: Are all those parts on you just for show?
BMD\t「不完全なトロニウム・エンジンでは、/ その程度か」: So that's the limit of an/　incomplete Tronium Engine.
BMD\t「お前の動きは、手に取るようにわかる」: I can see your every move.
BMD\t「ガリルナガンには追いつけん！」: You can't keep up with the Galilnagant!
BMD\t「そんなガラクタで何が出来る？」: What can you do with that junk?
BMD\t「そうだ、イング……/ 所詮、お前はその程度だよ！」: That's right, Ing.../　In the end, that's all you are!
BMD\t「相手にならんな、ＳＲＸチーム」: You're no match for me, SRX Team.
BMD\t「ヴィレッタ、お前では無理だ」: Viletta, you're not up to it.
BMD\t「ハッ！ それがお前の力か、イング！」: Ha! Is that your power, Ing!?
BMD\t「そんなものか、凶鳥の末裔は」: Is that all the bird of ill omen's heir has?
BMD\t「まあいい、ここは見逃してやる」: Fine. I'll let you go this time.
BMD\t「恐ろしいのか、この私が」: So you fear me, do you?
BMD\t「おれこそが優れた支配種！ 支配者！/ 孤高の存在となる！！」: I am the superior species! The ruler!/　I will stand alone, above all!!
BMD\t「変える！/ 変えてやるぞ、この呪われた宿命を！！」: I'll change it!/　I'll change this cursed destiny!!
BMD\t「超越！ 超越するぞ、全ての存在を！！」: Transcend! I'll transcend all that exists!!
BMD\t「アリエイル！ おれは運命を変える！！」: Arieil! I will change my fate!!
BMD\t「お前がイデアラントであることをやめるなら！/ おれはイデアラントを超: If you're giving up being an Idealant.../　then I'll surpass the Idealants!!
BMD\t「貴様だ！ 貴様の力を物にすれば！！」: You! If I make your power mine...!!
BMD\t「貴様を得て、おれは進化を遂げる！！」: With you, I'll complete my evolution!!
BMD\t「追う！ 追い詰めてやる！！」: I'll chase you! I'll run you down!!
BMD\t「逃がさん！ 逃がしはせん！！」: You won't escape! I won't let you!!
BMD\t「まだ！ まだ終わらんぞ！！」: Not yet! It's not over yet!!
BMD\t「ここから！ 俺はここからだ！！」: From here! This is where I begin!!
BMD\t「届かん！ 届かんぞ、おれの命には！！」: Not enough! You'll never take my life!!
BMD\t「死なん！ おれは死なんぞ！！」: I won't die! I will not die!!
BMD\t「よくも！ よくもこのおれに！！」: How dare you! You dare do this to me!!
BMD\t「止まらん！/ 止まらんぞ、おれもアレスも！！」: Nothing stops us!/　Not me, and not Ares!!
BMD\t「ええい、邪魔をするな！！」: Damn it, stay out of my way!!
BMD\t「当たらん！ 当たらんぞ！！」: You can't hit me! You can't!!
BMD\t「おれの障害となるもの全てを！！」: Everything that stands in my way!!

BMD\t「今度は君達が地の底へ墜ちる番だ」: Now it's your turn to fall into the abyss.
BMD\t「大統領を殺害した罪……その命で贖え」: You killed the President... Pay with your lives.
BMD\t「罪人は罰を受けなきゃならないのさ」: Sinners have to be punished, you know.
BMD\t「鋼龍戦隊……君達の役目は終わったのさ」: Steel Dragons... Your role is over.
BMD\t「真実を知るのが先か、死ぬのが先か……」: Will you learn the truth first, or die first...?
BMD\t「どこまで耐えられるかな、イング？」: How long can you hold out, Ing?
BMD\t「コピーが、/ オリジネイターである僕を超えるなどと……！」: A mere copy, surpassing/　me, the Originator...!
BMD\t「殺してやるよ、イーグレット・イング……！」: I'm going to kill you, Ing Egret...!
BMD\t「イング、お前のナンバーは欠番だ……！」: Ing, your number is being retired...!
BMD\t「僕は許さない、お前の存在を……！」: I won't forgive your very existence...!
BMD\t「ゼンガー……今度はお前が死ぬ番だ」: Sänger... Now it's your turn to die.
BMD\t「僕と違って、/ お前は生き返ることが出来ないだろう？」: Unlike me,/　you can't come back to life, can you?
BMD\t「ドゥバンの代わりに君を始末してやる」: I'll take care of you in Duban's place.
BMD\t「限りある命をそういう風に使うとはね」: So that's how you use your limited life.
BMD\t「裏切り者には死を。/ ありきたりな言葉だけどね」: Death to traitors./　A tired old phrase, I know.
BMD\t「ブロンゾ２８……/ スリサズやアンサズが/ 地の底で君を待っているよ: Bronzo 28.../　Thurisaz and Ansuz are waiting/　for you down in the abyss.
BMD\t「今度こそ汚点を消す」: This time, I'll erase the stain.
BMD\t「君はもう放っておけないね、色々な意味で」: I can't leave you alone anymore. In many ways.
BMD\t「君達も目障りだ、ブロンゾ２８と同じくね」: You're an eyesore too, just like Bronzo 28.
BMD\t「御し難いね、ブーステッド・チルドレンは」: Boosted Children are so hard to control.
BMD\t「消えてもらうよ、Ｗ１７」: Time for you to disappear, W17.
BMD\t「このまま帰すわけにはいかない！」: I can't just let you go home like this!
BMD\t「チッ、ここまでか！」: Tch, this is as far as I go!
BMD\t「ぼ、僕は何度でも甦る！/ 甦るはずなんだぁぁ！！」: I-I'll come back again and again!/　I'm supposed to come back!!
BMD\t「目障りだな、どこまでも……！」: You're an eyesore to the very end...!
BMD\t「抹消してやる……その存在を必ず……！」: I'll erase you... I'll erase your existence...!
BMD\t「アルタルフをここまで押し込むとはね……！」: To push Altarf back this far...!
BMD\t「許してやるさ、イング。ここまではね……！」: I'll let it slide, Ing. Up to this point...!
BMD\t「くっ！/ コピーがオリジナルを上回るなどと……！」: Ngh!/　A copy surpassing the original...!
BMD\t「ゼンガー……/ あの時と同じようにいくと思うな……！」: Sänger.../　Don't think it'll go like last time...!
BMD\t「イデアラントが/ マシンナリー・チルドレンを/ 超えるなどと……！」: An Idealand/　surpassing the/　Machinery Children...!
BMD\t「ブロンゾ２８……君ごときに！」: Bronzo 28... By the likes of you!
BMD\t「チッ、壊れた人形の分際で！」: Tch, you're just a broken doll!
BMD\t「フフフ、面白くなってきたよ」: Heh heh heh, this is getting interesting.
BMD\t「そんなもので、このアルタルフは倒せない」: That won't be enough to bring down Altarf.
BMD\t「次はどうするつもりだ、イング？」: What will you do next, Ing?
LDBI\t「……あなたに直接連絡を入れましたのは、@ 折り入ってお願いしたいこ: ...I contacted you directly because@I have a rather special favor to ask of you.
LDBI\t「それで私はアラセリ・ガルシアのチームから@ 外されたのか……」: So that's why I was taken off@Araceli Garcia's team...
LDBI\t「もっとも、今回の件がなくても、@ ベガリオンをガイアセイバーズへ@: Even without this business, I had no@intention of providing the Vegalion@to the Gaia Saviors.
LDBI\t「<プロジェクトＴＤ>は、@ 表も裏も我が社にとって有益ですから」: <プロジェクトＴＤ> benefits our company, after all,@both on the books and off.
LDBI\t「……で、私に何をさせる気だ？」: ...So what do you want me to do?
LDBI\t「私の特使として、@ 鋼龍戦隊に合流していただきたいんですの」: I'd like you to join the Steel Dragons@as my special envoy.
LDBI\t「本来なら直接か、人を介して@ あの方達へ連絡を入れる所なのですが…: Normally, I'd contact them directly,@or through an intermediary, but...
LDBI\t「裏のプロジェクトＴＤのこともあって、@ そう簡単には信用してもらえ: Given the secret side of Project TD,@they're unlikely to trust me so easily, no?
LDBI\t「そこで、当事者の一人であり、鋼龍戦隊とも縁がある@ あなたに出向い: So I thought I'd send you, since you're@personally involved and have ties to@the Steel Dragons.
LDBI\t「……私の本当の目的が何か知っているのか？」: ...Do you know what my true purpose is?
LDBI\t「ええ。@ でも、織姫と彦星の逢瀬にも期待しておりますのよ？」: Yes.@But I'm also hoping for a tryst between@Orihime and Hikoboshi, you know?
LDBI\t「ともかく、@ この依頼はプロジェクトＴＤや鋼龍戦隊だけでなく、@: In any case, this request affects not just@Project TD and the Steel Dragons, but our@own fate as well.
LDBI\t「大げさに言えば、地球の未来が懸かっていますのよ」: To exaggerate a little,@the future of Earth hangs on it.
LDBI\t「あら、あなたには断る理由などありませんでしょう？@ “ＨＹＰＥＲ７: Oh, but you have no reason to refuse, do you?@"HYPER77"... It's indispensable for making@your brother's dream come true.
LDBI\t「それをあなた一人で手にするか、あるいは……。@ 私の依頼を確実に果: You could seize it on your own, or...@If you reliably carry out my request,@I promise you even greater support.
LDBI\t（……私が兄様の夢を実現させるには……）: (For me to make Brother's dream a reality...)
LDBI\t「では、よしなに」: Then I leave it in your hands.
BMD\t「ガイアセイバーズの力を知らしめよ」: Show them the might of the Gaia Savers.
BMD\t「大義は我らにある。そう、我らにな……」: Justice is on our side. Yes, ours...
BMD\t「我らこそが地球圏の守護者だ。奮戦せよ」: We are the Earth Sphere's guardians. Fight!
BMD\t「イング、お前の力を試してやる」: Ing, let me test your power.
BMD\t「イング、お前は終極点へ辿りつけるか？」: Ing, can you reach the Terminus Point?
BMD\t「イング……これで死ぬようなら、お前は……」: Ing... If this kills you, then you're...
BMD\t「アリエイル、お前の宿命の時を早めてやろう」: Arieil, I'll hasten your hour of destiny.
BMD\t「お前達のＴＥアブゾーバーは捨て石なのだよ」: Your TE Absorbers are mere sacrificial pawns.
BMD\t「ツェントル・プロジェクトの成果を/ 見せてもらおうか」: Let me see what the Tsentr Project/　has accomplished.
BMD\t「ターミナス・エナジーは、私の道を開く……」: Terminus Energy will open my path...
BMD\t「鋼龍戦隊……お前達はもう不要な存在だ」: Steel Dragons... You're no longer needed.
BMD\t「反乱分子は処分せねばな」: Rebel elements must be disposed of.
BMD\t「お前達の役目は、我らが引き継いでやる……」: We'll take over your role from here...
BMD\t「お前達は我らに敗れ去る宿命なのだ」: You're destined to fall before us.
BMD\t「フフ……お前達ではなく、/ 我がガイアセイバーズこそが/ 地球圏の守: Heh... Not you, but my Gaia Savers/　are the ones fit to be/　the guardians of the Earth Sphere.
BMD\t「フッ……クリスマス級は、/ スペースノア級を凌駕する」: Heh... The Christmas class surpasses/　the Space Noah class.
BMD\t「ヒリュウ……あの艦の役目は、/ 冥王星宙域戦で終わっていたのだがな」: The Hiryu... Its role should have/　ended with the Battle of Pluto.
BMD\t「まだＳＲＸ計画の/ 真髄に到達出来ていないようだな」: It seems you've yet to reach/　the true essence of the SRX Project.
BMD\t「ＳＲＸ計画……/ 今のままでは頓挫したも同然か」: The SRX Project... As it stands,/　it's as good as dead.
BMD\t「彼らこそが、我らの本命……真の敵だ」: They're our real target... the true enemy.
BMD\t「ガイアセイバーズ……その名に恥じぬ戦いを」: Gaia Savers... Fight worthy of your name.
BMD\t「我が計画の邪魔はさせんぞ」: I won't let you interfere with my plans.
BMD\t「……ここまでのようだな」: ...It seems this is as far as I go.
BMD\t「どう抗おうと/ お前達の行く末は決まっている……」: No matter how you resist,/　your fate is already sealed...
BMD\t「ほう……ここまでやるとはな」: Oh... I didn't expect you to go this far.
BMD\t「フッ、いずれお前達も……」: Heh, sooner or later, you too will...
BMD\t「エア・クリスマスに/ ここまでのダメージを与えるとはな」: To deal this much damage/　to the Air Christmas...
BMD\t「アリエイル、/ あがいたところでお前の宿命は変わらんぞ」: Arieil, struggle all you like,/　your fate won't change.
BMD\t「フフ……惜しいな、アリエイル」: Heh heh... Such a pity, Arieil.
BMD\t「それなりの成果は挙がっているようだな」: It seems you've made some progress.
BMD\t「そのＴＥアブゾーバーで/ 私を倒すことは出来ん」: That TE Absorber/　won't be enough to defeat me.
BMD\t「そうだ、イング……/ お前に秘められた力を解き放て」: Yes, Ing.../　Unleash the power hidden within you.
BMD\t「ＳＲＸ計画…………/ 予備策としての使い道はある」: The SRX Project....../　It still has use as a backup plan.
BMD\t「お前達のＳＲＸ計画は、歪められている」: Your SRX Project has been twisted.
BMD\t「今のはなかなかの手だった」: That was a rather good move.
BMD\t「所詮、あの機体は予備策の一つに過ぎん……」: That unit is just one backup plan of many...
LDBI\t「あなた達は人界を護る存在じゃない、@ 脅かす存在です！」: You're not protectors of the human world.@You're a threat to it!
LDBI\t「ま、言うよね。@ じゃあ、再度頭から丁寧に説明しようか。@ 今の内: Of course you'd say that.@Then let me carefully explain it from the top.@Feel free to repair, resupply or rest meanwhile.
LDBI\t「あ、トイレに行っても、@ チャンネルはそのままでね。はははっ」: Oh, and if you go to the bathroom,@don't change the channel. Hahaha!
LDBI\t「あいつ、どこまでも人を舐めた態度を……！」: That guy... He's mocking us at every turn...!
LDBI\t「さて……夏喃や泰北も言っていたと思うけど、@ かつてこの地球を滅亡: So... Kanan and Taihoku probably told you this,@but the ones who once saved Earth from ruin@were none other than us and the god of Baral.
LDBI\t「遙かな昔、この星には魔神や妖怪共が@ 跋扈した時代があってね……百: Long ago, there was an age when demon gods and@monsters ran rampant here... These Hundred Evils@threatened humanity and ravaged nature.
LDBI\t「で、百邪に対抗するため、@ 古代人が造り出したのが超機人……」: And to fight the Hundred Evils,@the ancients created the Choukijin...
LDBI\t「そして、それらを束ねていたのが、僕らの主であり、@ 地球の守護神た: And the one who led them was our master,@Earth's guardian deity, "Gan Eden."
LDBI\t「それがバラルの神の名か……！」: So that's the name of Baral's god...!
LDBI\t（同じだ……クロスゲートと……@ ガンエデンという言葉にも……僕は…: (It's the same... as with the Cross Gate...@And the words "Gan Eden" too... Am I...?)
LDBI\t「そして、僕は長き眠りにつくガンエデンに代わって、@ この星を護る役: And with Gan Eden in a long slumber, I was@chosen to protect this planet in its stead.
LDBI\t「今でも鮮明に覚えているよ。@ 四霊、四神を始めとする多くの超機人が: I still remember it vividly. Many Choukijin,@led by the Four Spirits and Four Gods,@gathered under the god of Baral, but...
LDBI\t「少々予想外のことに暴虐の超機人である@ 四罪や四凶、それに付き従う: Rather unexpectedly, the tyrannical Choukijin,@the Four Sinners and Four Fiends, and their@followers went over to the Hundred Evils.
LDBI\t「その成れの果てが、妖機人……@ つまり、超機人達は敵味方に分かれて: What they became were the Yokijin...@In other words, the Choukijin split into@two sides and fought each other.
LDBI\t「おかげで戦いは激化……大地を砕き、海を割り、@ 天をも焦がすバラル: It raged on... Baral versus the Hundred Evils,@a struggle that broke earth, split the seas and@scorched heaven. History named it the Kijin War.
LDBI\t「そのせいで、超機人が世界に災厄をもたらす@ 魔神だなんていう伝説が: Thanks to that, a legend arose that Choukijin@were demon gods bringing disaster to the world.
LDBI\t「クスハ君、ブリット君……君達の超機人も@ そう思われていたんだよ？: Kusuha, Bullet... people thought that about@your Choukijin too, you know?
LDBI\t「ああ。龍虎王と虎龍王はね、機人大戦の最中に@ ガンエデンを裏切り、: Yes. RyuKoOh and KoRyuOh betrayed Gan Eden@in the middle of the Kijin War and sided with@the Hundred Evils.
LDBI\t「そして、彼らを誅するため、@ 同じ四神である雀武王が追った。@ そ: And JakuBuOh, one of the same Four Gods,@went after them to punish them. That's where@their feud began.
LDBI\t「だけど、義は雀武王の方にあるのさ。@ 龍虎王と虎龍王は、愚かにも己: But righteousness lies with JakuBuOh.@RyuKoOh and KoRyuOh foolishly forgot their duty@and were drawn to the Hundred Evils.
LDBI\t「嘘を言うな！@ 虎龍王と龍虎王はアインストと戦ったんだぞ！」: Liar!@KoRyuOh and RyuKoOh fought the Einst!
LDBI\t「だが、今はガンエデンとその下僕である僕達に@ 刃を向けている……」: Yet now they turn their blades on Gan Eden@and on us, its servants...
LDBI\t「神に逆らう者は、悪魔に決まっているじゃあないか」: Those who defy god are devils, obviously.
LDBI\t「そんなことはありません！@ 龍虎王は、人界を守護する超機人だと……: That's not true!@RyuKoOh is a Choukijin guarding the human world...
LDBI\t「だから、君達は騙されたのさ。@ それが人の魂力と強念を以て、最大の: That's how they fooled you.@It's their standard trick: using human soul@power and strong will to unleash their full strength.
LDBI\t「超機人の宿命とは、人界の救済だけでなく、@ 万魔百邪の駆滅……つま: The Choukijin's destiny isn't just to save the@human world, but to eradicate all evils... to@destroy whatever threatens this planet.
LDBI\t「そして、それを邪魔しようとする君達と@ 龍虎王、虎龍王は百邪そのも: And you, who try to interfere with that, along@with RyuKoOh and KoRyuOh, are the Hundred Evils@themselves.
LDBI\t「そんな……そんな言葉で、俺達の心は折れない。@ 虎龍王と龍虎王は、: Talk like that... won't break our spirit.@KoRyuOh and RyuKoOh have fought alongside us@time and again against threats to this planet...
LDBI\t「そう、虎龍王と龍虎王は、今も俺達と共にある！@ お前達に義があり、: Yes, KoRyuOh and RyuKoOh are still with us!@If you were just and truly Earth's guardians,@they wouldn't be here!!
LDBI\t「なるほど、白虎の操者に一理あり。それも善哉」: I see, the White Tiger's pilot has a point.@How splendid.
LDBI\t「おいおい、ご老体……水を差さないでくれるかな」: Come on, old man... don't spoil the mood.
LDBI\t「光龍、これ以上の説伏は無駄だ。@ 幼子は叱咤を以て導かねばなるまい: Koryu, further persuasion is pointless.@Children must be guided with a firm scolding.
LDBI\t「まあ、だいたい同じ展開になるからねぇ」: Well, it usually goes the same way anyhow.
LDBI\t「だが、今回は違う。@ ガンエデンの下には、マシアフがいる」: But this time is different.@Gan Eden has the Mashiah.
LDBI\t「ああ、そうさ。ガンエデンはマシアフを得て、@ 真の力を発揮する。そ: Yes, indeed. With the Mashiah, Gan Eden can@unleash its true power. The proof? The Garden@of Baral's revival and the shield around Earth.
LDBI\t「あ、あれが、イルイのやったことだってのかよ！？」: You're saying Irui did all that?!
LDBI\t「真実を知りたければ、彼女に直接聞けばいい。@ ただし……尸解を終え: If you want the truth, ask her yourself.@But only once you've shed your mortal coils.
LDBI\t「じゃあ、そろそろ始めようか。@ 古の機人大戦の再来だ！」: Now then, shall we begin?@The ancient Kijin War, reborn!
LDBI\t「ああ、俺は虎龍王と龍虎王を信じる！@ これまで、そうして来たように: Right, I believe in KoRyuOh and RyuKoOh!@Just like I always have!
LDBI\t「信じるべきはバラルの神さ。@ 信じる者は救われるって言うだろ？」: It's the god of Baral you should believe in.@They say believers will be saved, right?
LDBI\t「おれに信じる神などいない、これがな」: I don't believe in any god. That's just how it is.
LDBI\t「我がトウゴウ家とお主らとの因縁、@ ここで断ち切ってくれようぞ」: This feud between my Tougou clan and your lot,@I shall sever it here and now!
LDBI\t「そこまで言うなら、僕も本気で行こうかな？@ もし死んでしまっても、: If you insist, maybe I'll get serious too?@And if you end up dead, don't worry.
LDBI\t「僕らが君達の代わりに地球を護るからね！@ あははははははは！！」: We'll protect Earth in your place!@Ahahahahahaha!!
LDBI\t「我は！ 我らは百邪を断つ剣なり！！@ 立ち塞がる者は例え神であろう: I am! We are the sword that cleaves@the Hundred Evils!! Any who stand in our way,@even gods, will be cut down!!
LDBI\t「はははっ、僕達を百邪と言ったな！@ ならば、応龍皇！ 愚者に裁きの: Hahaha, you called us the Hundred Evils!@OryuOh! Bring judgment's thunder on these fools!
LDBI\t「そして、彼らの魂魄を@ 大いなるバラルの神の下へ！ ははははは！」: And send their souls@to the great god of Baral! Hahahaha!
LDBI\t「ふむ、今回は激戦になりそうじゃ。@ 早めに装符を修復しておこうかの: Hmm, this looks to be a fierce battle.@I'd best repair my talismans early.
BMD\t「その程度でフリッケライは止められません」: That won't be enough to stop Flickerei.
BMD\t「さすが、アルト……頑丈ですね」: As expected of Alt... It's sturdy.
BMD\t「それでアルトを止めることは出来ません」: That won't be enough to stop Alt.
BMD\t「時間がない……あなたも、私も……！」: There's no time... for you, or for me...!
BMD\t「ドゥバン、あなたも気づいているはずです！」: Duban, you must have noticed it too!
BMD\t「アルファ・セイバーが/ この程度だとは思えない……」: I can't believe this is/　all an Alpha Saber has...
BMD\t「彼の攻撃は、上手く受け流さねば……！」: I must deflect his attacks well...!
BMD\t「遠慮は無用です、ガイアセイバーズ」: No need to hold back, Gaia Savers.
BMD\t「ダブルＧ……/ サイズに似合わず俊敏な動きですね」: Double G.../　Agile movements, for its Size.
BMD\t「メディウス……/ 動作に奇妙な揺らぎがある……？」: Medius.../　Strange fluctuations in its movements...?
BMD\t「ツェントル・プロジェクトの最終機が、/ この程度だとは……」: The Tsentr Project's final unit,/　and this is all it can do...
BMD\t「こちらのことをよく研究しているようですね」: You seem to have studied us well.
BMD\t「あれがこのまま暴走し続ければ……！」: If it keeps running out of control...!
BMD\t「ガンエデン……あなたの慈悲は歪んでいます」: Gan Eden... Your mercy is twisted.
BMD\t「あなたに命を操り、/ 支配することは出来ない……！」: You cannot manipulate/　and control life...!
BMD\t「的になるつもりはありません」: I don't intend to be a target.
BMD\t「アルファ・セイバーと言えど……！」: Even if it's an Alpha Saber...!
BMD\t「次もかわします」: I'll dodge the next one too.
BMD\t「その動きで、私を捕捉することは不可能です」: Those movements can't lock onto me.
BMD\t「それで攻撃終了ですか？」: Is that the end of your attack?
BMD\t「どのような攻撃にも、/ 見切るポイントがあるものです」: Every attack has a point/　where it can be read.
BMD\t「瞬発力はアルトアイゼン譲りなのです」: Its burst speed comes from Alteisen.
BMD\t「クロガネに手出しはさせん！」: I won't let you lay a hand on the Kurogane!
BMD\t「油断するな、カーラ！」: Don't let your guard down, Carla!
BMD\t「ハガネのカバーに入れ！」: Move in and cover the Hagane!
BMD\t「その陣形なら、単騎で充分！」: In that formation, I need no one else!
BMD\t「一所に固まっていたのが、/ 運の尽きだったな！」: Bunching together like that/　was your undoing!
BMD\t「我が照星は、お前を捉え続けている！」: My sights remain fixed on you!
BMD\t「総員、雷撃戦用意！」: All hands, prepare for torpedo combat!
BMD\t「１番から３番副砲、撃て！」: Secondary guns one through three, fire!
BMD\t「クロガネの実力……思い知っていただく！」: I'll show you the Kurogane's true power!
BMD\t「両舷副砲、砲撃始め！」: Port and starboard guns, open fire!
BMD\t「副砲、１番から４番、砲撃始め！」: Secondary guns one through four, fire!
BMD\t「クロガネより各機へ！/ これより主砲を発射する！」: Kurogane to all units!/　Firing the Main Cannon!
BMD\t「了解！ 前部各砲塔、発射準備！」: Roger! All forward turrets, ready to fire!
BMD\t「トロンベよ、阻むもの全てを撃ち抜け！」: Trombe, pierce all that stands in our way!
BMD\t「これで終わりにさせていただく！」: Allow me to end this now!
LDBI\t「おっと、そこにその端くれがいるみたいだね」: Oh my, looks like a lowly one of them@is right there.
LDBI\t神聖ラングラン王国 リストン州: Holy Kingdom of Langran, Liston Province
LDBI\t「……山の上から敵陣を覗くなんて、@ 随分とアナログな偵察ねぇ」: ...Peeking at the enemy from a mountaintop?@What a low-tech way to Scan them.
LDBI\t「頭を下げろ、リューネ。敵に見つかるぞ」: Keep your head down, Lüne. They'll spot us.
LDBI\t「はい。周辺に伏兵はおりません。@ 敵機を基地外へ誘導すれば、確実か: Yes. There are no ambushers in the area.@If we lure the enemy units out of the base,@success should be assured.
LDBI\t「な、何なの、そいつ！？ 黒ヒョウ！？」: Wh-What is that thing!? A black panther!?
LDBI\t「ただの風生獣だ。気にするな」: Just a fengshengshou. Don't worry about it.
LDBI\t「気になるわよ！ しかも、喋ってるし！」: Of course I'm gonna worry! And it talks!
LDBI\t「まあ、クロやシロを見てるしね」: Well, I've seen Kuro and Shiro, so...
LDBI\t「私はランシャオ。ヤンロン様の使い魔です。@ 以後、お見知りおきを」: I am Ranshao, Master Yang Long's familiar.@A pleasure to make your acquaintance.
LDBI\t「こっちこそよろしく。@ あんたみたいなファミリアもいるんだね」: Likewise.@Didn't know there were familiars like you.
LDBI\t「はい。@ 風生獣は、古代中国の幻獣です。@ 私はその姿を基にして作: Yes. Fengshengshou are mythical beasts@of ancient China. I was made in the image@of one.
LDBI\t「……基地の戦力があれだけなら、@ 一気に突入して片づけよう。@ 行: ...If that's all the base has,@we'll charge in and finish them in one go.@Let's go, Lüne.
LDBI\t「<魔装機神>グランヴェール……@ 堂々と乗り込んでくるとは、いい度: The <魔装機神> Granveil...@You've got nerve, marching right in here.
LDBI\t「命が惜しければ、直ちに国外へ去れ。@ 生半な覚悟とそのような<魔装: If you value your life, leave this country now.@With such half-hearted resolve and a <魔装機>@like that, you'll never defeat me.
LDBI\t「敗軍の兵が何を言う！@ お前達がどうあがいた所で、@ 我が軍は圧倒: Big words from a beaten army!@No matter how you struggle,@our forces hold the overwhelming advantage!
LDBI\t「ふん……そう感情的になっては、@ 魔装機の扱いはおぼつかんぞ」: Hmph... Let your emotions run wild like that,@and you'll never handle a Masouki properly.
LDBI\t「傲岸不遜なその物言い、許せん！@ お前の魔装機神をろ獲し、ジェスハ: Such arrogant insolence! I won't stand for it!@I'll capture your Masoukishin and present it@to General Jesuha!
LDBI\t「不相応の欲は、己の目を曇らせると知れ」: Know that undeserved greed clouds one's eyes.
LDBI\t「減らず口を叩くな！ 各機、攻撃開始！@ 奴らを基地へ行かせるな！」: Enough of your lip! All units, attack!@Don't let them reach the base!
LDBI\t「リューネ、敵陣へ突入するぞ。遅れるな！」: Lüne, we're charging the enemy lines. Keep up!
LDBI\t「ご主人様、こちらへ接近してくる機体が……@ 数は１、魔装機ではない: Master, a unit is approaching us...@Just one. It doesn't appear to be a Masouki.
LDBI\t「なら、地上の機動兵器か？」: Then a mobile weapon from the surface?
LDBI\t「やはり、ヴァルシオーネか。@ もう１機は……何だ？」: The Valsione, as I thought.@And the other one... what is that?
LDBI\t「キョウスケ！@ あんたもラ・ギアスへ召喚されてたの？」: Kyosuke!@Were you summoned to La Gias too?
LDBI\t「<ラ・ギアス>……？@ マサキが言っていた地底世界か？」: <ラ・ギアス>...?@The underground world Masaki talked about?
LDBI\t「……ダイレクトに転移したわけではなかったか。@ ならば、あの二人も: ...So it wasn't a direct transfer after all.@Then those two may also be...
LDBI\t「いや、気にするな。@ ……こちらは状況がよくわかっていない。@ お: Never mind.@...I don't fully understand the situation here.@What's that unit fighting alongside you?
LDBI\t「あれは魔装機神グランヴェール……@ 乗ってるのは、ホワン・ヤンロン: That's the Masoukishin Granveil...@Its pilot's Huang Yang Long.@He's Masaki's comrade down here.
LDBI\t「地球連邦軍のキョウスケ・ナンブ中尉……@ 地上での仲間だよ。マサキ: Lieutenant Kyosuke Nanbu of the Earth@Federation Army... A friend from the surface.@He knows Masaki, too.
LDBI\t「詳しい事情を聞くためには、@ ここでの戦闘を終わらせる必要がありそ: Looks like I'll need to end this battle@before I can hear the details.
LDBI\t「そういうこと。悪いけど、手伝ってくんない？」: Exactly. Sorry, but could you give us a hand?
LDBI\t「くうっ、よくも！ この屈辱、忘れんぞ！！」: Ngh, damn you! I won't forget this humiliation!!
LDBI\t「ご主人様、敵機の反応が全て消えました」: Master, all enemy signals have vanished.
LDBI\t「これでひとまずの任務は果たせた。@ リューネ、キョウスケ中尉、礼を: That fulfills our mission for now.@Lüne, Lieutenant Kyosuke, you have my thanks.
LDBI\t「そうだね……あんたの話も聞きたいし」: Sure... I want to hear your side, too.
LDBI\t「じゃあ、鋼龍戦隊とは別行動だったんだ……」: So you were separate from the Steel Dragons...
LDBI\t「詳しくは話せんが、おれとマサキ、@ リュウセイで行動していて、その: I can't go into detail, but I was working with@Masaki and Ryusei. Then we were transferred...@no, it seems we were summoned.
LDBI\t「珍しいね、その三人で動いてたなんて。@ じゃ、リュウセイもラ・ギア: That's rare, you three working together.@Then maybe Ryusei's in La Gias too.
LDBI\t「奴だけじゃない。@ ゲートがそこかしこで開かれているなら……@ 鋼: Not just him.@If gates are opening all over the place...@the Steel Dragons may have been summoned too.
LDBI\t「実は……あたしもそんな気がしてたんだ」: Actually... I kinda had that feeling too.
LDBI\t「ともかく、情報を集めんとな」: Either way, we need to gather information.
LDBI\t「うん……いきなりラ・ギアスへ呼び込まれて、@ 困ってる仲間がいるか: Yeah... Some of our friends might've been@dragged into La Gias out of nowhere@and could be in trouble.
LDBI\t「……僕達の陣営につくことを勧めるが、@ 強制をするつもりはない。リ: ...I'd recommend joining our side,@but I won't force you. There are risks.
LDBI\t「って言われても、行く当てがないしねえ……」: Not like I've got anywhere else to go, though...
LDBI\t「ホワン・ヤンロン……だったな。@ 召喚された地上人の情報が集まるま: Huang Yang Long, was it?@Until I learn more about the summoned surfacers,@I'll travel with you.
LDBI\t「僕と行動を共にする以上、@ シュテドニアス軍との戦闘は避けられんぞ: As long as you're with me,@fighting the Schtedonias Army is unavoidable.
LDBI\t「わかっている。@ おれもこの地で果てるつもりはないからな」: I know.@I have no intention of dying here, either.
LDBI\t「聞こえなかったのか？@ お前達が所有する兵器全てを、@ 我らガイア: Did you not hear me?@We, the Gaia Sabers, are seizing every@weapon in your possession.
LDBI\t「なお、レフィーナ・エンフィールド大佐以下の士官は、@ 艦船及び機動: In addition, to ensure a smooth seizure of your@ships and mobile weapons, Colonel Lefina Enfield@and her officers will be temporarily detained.
LDBI\t「その理由を……理由を聞かせて下さい！」: On what grounds... Tell me on what grounds!
LDBI\t「鋼龍戦隊は、連邦軍の指揮下から離れ、@ 所在不明となった。その間、: The Steel Dragons left Federation command and@went missing. During that time, you are@suspected of contact with hostile forces.
LDBI\t「大統領はそれを懸念され、@ 厳密な査問を行う必要があると判断された: The President is concerned by this, and has@judged that a rigorous inquiry is necessary.
LDBI\t「ラ・ギアスの件については、統合参謀本部や@ 伊豆基地司令部に報告を: We reported the La Gias matter to the Joint@Chiefs of Staff and to Izu Base Command!
LDBI\t「我々はケネス・ギャレット司令の命令に従い、@ 査問を受けるべく伊豆: Under Commander Kenneth Garret's orders, we@were headed to Izu to submit to an inquiry...!
LDBI\t「大統領のご意志により、我らガイアセイバーズが@ 鋼龍戦隊の査問を行: By the President's will, we of the Gaia Sabers@will conduct the Steel Dragons' inquiry.
LDBI\t「それで、この状況下において武装解除などと……！」: And so you demand we disarm, in a situation@like this...!
LDBI\t「現時点で我々がなすべきことは、@ ルイーナやゲストの侵攻阻止ではあ: Right now, shouldn't our priority be stopping@the Ruina and Guest invasions?!
LDBI\t「問題をすり替えるな。@ このような状況下だからこそ、戦局を左右し得: Don't change the subject. It's precisely in@times like these that specialized forces able@to sway the war must be strictly controlled.
LDBI\t（言い掛かりも甚だしい。@ まるで、こちら側を煽っているような……）: (This accusation is outrageous. It's as if@they're trying to provoke us...)
LDBI\t「大統領のお考えは、こうだ。@ 鋼龍戦隊のような戦力は、軍ではなく、: The President's view is this: a force such@as the Steel Dragons belongs not to the@military, but under the highest authority...
LDBI\t「ＰＧＳを行使し、@ 大統領の意のままに、迅速に動くべきなのだと」: That it should exercise the PGS and act@swiftly, as the President wills.
LDBI\t「^The privilege of the GAIA SABERS: ^The privilege of the GAIA SABERS^...@Commonly called the GS Privilege.
LDBI\t「軍事問題における大統領特命を@ 速やかに遂行するために与えられた特: A special right granted for the swift execution@of presidential orders in military matters...
LDBI\t「連邦軍とは異なる武装組織を成立させるための@ ものであり、軍からの: It exists to establish an armed organization@separate from the Federation Army, and grants@the right to refuse any order from the military.
LDBI\t「それならば、我々連邦軍に対する命令権を@ 保証するものではないでし: Then it doesn't guarantee you any authority@to command us in the Federation Army...!
LDBI\t「そもそも、そのＧＳ特権は@ 連邦議会の承認を受けているのですか？」: To begin with, has this GS Privilege@been approved by the Federal Assembly?
LDBI\t「では、あなた方の接収命令には、@ 法的根拠がないことになります」: Then your seizure order has@no legal basis.
LDBI\t「現時点、この場での武装解除には応じられません。@ 全ての責に対する: We cannot agree to disarm here and now. We will@answer for everything at the Far East Command's@Izu Base once our current mission is complete.
LDBI\t「その後、然るべき筋を通していただければ、@ そちらの意向にも従いま: After that, if you go through the proper@channels, we will comply with your wishes.
LDBI\t（愚かな選択だ。@ この状況を切り抜けられると思っているのか）: (A foolish choice. Does she think she can@get out of this situation?)
LDBI\t「あくまでも、我らガイアセイバーズの指示……@ 武装解除には応じない: So you persist in refusing the instructions of@the Gaia Sabers... refusing to disarm?
LDBI\t「先程も述べた通り……今、ここでは。@ 統合参謀本部、並びに極東方面: As I said before... not here, not now. Not@unless formal orders come down through the Joint@Chiefs of Staff and Far East Command HQ.
LDBI\t（これで少しでも時間が稼げれば……）: (If this buys us even a little time...)
LDBI\t「大統領こそが連邦軍の最高司令官であることを@ 知らぬわけではあるま: Surely you are aware that the President is@the supreme commander of the Federation Army?
LDBI\t「……では、大統領の戦争権限法は？@ 連邦議会への説明、報告の義務に: ...Then what about the President's War Powers@Act? His duty to explain and report to the@Federal Assembly?
LDBI\t「非常時の特例だ。@ それに、我々は大統領の特別命令書も持っている。: This is an emergency exception. Besides, we@hold a special order from the President. The@Assembly will be informed after the fact.
LDBI\t「ならば、大統領に直接説明をさせて下さい」: Then let the President explain this@to us directly.
LDBI\t（……司令は、@ 大統領をこの場に出さないつもりなのか？）: (...Does the commander not intend to@let the President appear here?)
LDBI\t「埒が明かんな。@ ならば、今回の件に関し、大統領から@ 全権を委譲: This is getting us nowhere. Then I, entrusted@by the President with full authority in this@matter...
LDBI\t「鋼龍戦隊に対する強制接収を執行する」: ...will carry out the forced seizure of the@Steel Dragons.
LDBI\t「全軍へ。彼らがこれに抵抗した場合は、@ 連邦政府大統領への叛乱行為: All forces: should they resist, it will be@deemed rebellion against the Federation@President. Preemptive attacks are authorized.
LDBI\t「い、一方的過ぎますよ！@ こんなの無茶苦茶じゃないですか！」: Th-That's way too one-sided!@This is completely insane!
LDBI\t「まさか、彼らは最初から……！」: Don't tell me they planned this@from the start...!
LDBI\t「ええ、我々を潰す気だったのでしょうな。@ 本来は然るべき手順を踏み: Yes, they meant to crush us, I'd wager. They may@originally have intended to follow proper@procedure and handle this quietly, but...
LDBI\t「この様子では武装解除に応じても、我々士官は@ おそらく無事では済み: At this rate, even if we disarm, we officers@likely won't come out of this unscathed.
LDBI\t「それを命令として受け入れるか、抗うか。@ いかがしますか、艦長」: Accept it as an order, or resist?@What will it be, Captain?
LDBI\t「アルファ１からセイバー１、アルテウル司令へ。@ 配備完了……いつで: Alpha 1 to Saber 1, Commander Arteur.@Deployment complete... Ready to launch anytime.
LDBI\t「司令、大統領閣下からです」: Commander, it's His Excellency the President.
LDBI\t「状況は、“正確に”大統領へ伝わっているな？」: The President has been informed of the@situation "accurately," yes?
LDBI\t（そう、こちらで予め用意した映像を……）: (Yes... with the footage we@prepared in advance...)
LDBI\t「……アルテウル、@ 鋼龍戦隊が反乱を起こしたようだな」: ...Arteur, it seems the Steel Dragons@have rebelled.
LDBI\t「ええ。@ やはり、後ろめたいことがあったようで」: Yes. It seems they had something@to hide after all.
LDBI\t「あそこまで短絡的だとは思っていなかった。@ アルテウル、お前が危惧: I didn't think they'd be so rash. Arteur, it's@just as you feared.
LDBI\t（大統領は何を言っているのだ……？@ 鋼龍戦隊は、接見を申し出たのだ: (What is the President talking about...?@The Steel Dragons asked for an audience!)
LDBI\t「やむを得ん、強制接収を行え。ただし、鋼龍戦隊は@ 一般大衆にとって: Very well, carry out the forced seizure. But@to the public, the Steel Dragons are heroes of@many wars. Avoid annihilating them.
LDBI\t「彼我の損耗を最小限に抑えつつ、彼らを投降させ、@ その言い分を直接: Keep losses on both sides to a minimum and@make them surrender. I want to hear their side@directly. Can you do it?
LDBI\t「ともかく、今日からスレイもあたし達と一緒に@ 戦うことになったの」: Anyway, starting today, Sleigh's going to be@fighting alongside us.
LDBI\t「改めてよろしくお願いするわね」: Once again, we're glad to have you with us.
LDBI\t「ええ……@ スレイさんが戻って来てくれて、私も嬉しいです」: Yes...@I'm glad you came back to us, Sleigh.
LDBI\t「彗星と流星の活躍に期待させてもらうわ」: I have high hopes for the Comet@and the Shooting Star.
LDBI\t「出来る限りの事はするつもりだ」: I intend to do everything I can.
LDBI\t「スレイ、あんたに紹介したい子がいるの。@ ……イルイ、こっちに来て: Sleigh, there's someone I want you to meet.@...Irui, could you come over here?
LDBI\t「こんな子供が軍艦に……」: A child like this, on a warship...
LDBI\t「色々あって、私達で面倒を見ることになったの」: A lot happened, and now@we're looking after her.
LDBI\t「イルイ、あたしの仲間を紹介するね。@ スレイ・プレスティ……<プロ: Irui, let me introduce my teammate.@Sleigh Presty... Number 01 of <プロジェクトＴＤ>,@and the pilot of the Vegalion.
LDBI\t「いずれ、あたしやツグミと一緒に@ 星の海を目指すことになるの」: Someday, she'll be heading for the sea of stars@with Tsugumi and me.
LDBI\t「スレイ、イルイと仲良くしてやってね」: Sleigh, be nice to Irui, okay?
LDBI\t「ウンブラの相手は我らに任せ、@ 君達はセプテンプルムへ向かいたまえ: Leave Umbra to us.@You make for Septemplum.
LDBI\t「わかりました。@ ……リム、あのメリオルエッセと接触するまで@ 慎: Understood. ...Rim, stay cautious until we@reach that Meliores Esse. Avoid combat as much@as you can, and don't waste ammo.
LDBI\t（リアナ、私達が目指す場所、わかってるよね？）: (Riana, you know where we're headed, right?)
LDBI\t「破滅を定められし者達よ……@ 憎しみと苦しみの闇に包まれ、滅びを迎: You who are fated for ruin...@Be shrouded in the darkness of hate and agony,@and meet your destruction.
LDBI\t「ウンブラ……避けては通れないか！」: Umbra... No way around you, huh!
LDBI\t（ノイズが生じる……@ だが、私の機構にさしたる異常はない）: (Noise is occurring...@Yet my mechanisms show no significant anomaly.)
LDBI\t（他のメリオルエッセと同じだ……@ シュンパティアの調子がおかしくな: (It's the same as with the other Meliores Esse...@It just makes the Sympathia act up...)
LDBI\t（接触して理解した……この人間、もしや……）: (Through contact, I understand...@This human... could it be...)
LDBI\t「リム、迂闊に戦うんじゃない！@ 後で何が起きるかわからないんだぞ！: Rim, don't go fighting carelessly!@There's no telling what'll happen afterward!
LDBI\t（リ、リアナ……@ もし、この子が動かなくなっちゃったら……）: (R-Riana...@What if this one stops moving on us...?)
LDBI\t「人間よ、あくまでも抗うか……」: Human, you resist to the very end...
LDBI\t「これでどうなる……何が起きるの……！？」: Now what? What's going to happen...!?
LDBI\t（き、来た！ また入ってくるぅ！）: (H-Here it comes! It's getting inside again!)
LDBI\t（君のマシーンと……システムだ……@ それが僕達をつないでいる……）: (Your machine... and the system...@That's what's connecting us...)
LDBI\t（僕達の意識が……想いが……@ 強制的に共振し……互いを引き寄せて…: (Our minds... our feelings...@are being forced to resonate...@drawing each other in...!)
LDBI\t（ううっ、止められない……乱れる……！）: (Ngh, I can't stop it... It's going wild...!)
LDBI\t（す、吸い込まれる！！ 逃げられない！！）: (I-I'm being sucked in!! I can't get away!!)
LDBI\t（う、宇宙……！？@ お兄ちゃんやみんなはどこへ行ったの！？）: (S-Space...!?@Where did Big Brother and everyone go!?)
LDBI\t（僕達はセプテンプルムから弾き飛ばされ……@ 次元の狭間へ落ちたのか: (Were we flung out of Septemplum...@and dropped into a rift between dimensions...?)

BMD\t「さあ、滅びて我らの糧となれ！！」: Now, perish and become our sustenance!!
BMD\t「さあ、戦慄と恐怖の宴を始めよう！/ 全てを破滅へ導くために！」: Let the feast of dread and terror begin!/　To lead all things to ruin!
BMD\t「さあ、恐怖にその身をよじれ！/ 逃れられぬ破滅の力を前にして！」: Now, writhe in terror!/　Before a power of ruin you cannot escape!
BMD\t「混沌へ堕ち、溶け果てよ！/ クハハハハァ！！」: Fall into chaos and melt away!/　Kuhahahahaa!!
LDBI\t（これは……行くなということなのか？）: (Is this... telling me not to go?)
LDBI\t「フフフ……出て来たな」: Heh heh... So you've come out.
LDBI\t（イング……@ それに、ブロンゾ２８達はいないようだが……）: (Ing...@And it seems Bronzo 28 and the others aren't here...)
LDBI\t（ゼンガー・ゾンボルト……@ お前と再び出会える日を待っていたよ）: (Sänger Sombold...@I've been waiting for the day we'd meet again.)
LDBI\t「もし、と司令には言ったが、@ こうもあっさりと接触するとはな……」: I told the commander it was only a maybe,@but to run into them this easily...
LDBI\t「アルファ１、私がヒリュウへ呼びかける。@ 指示あるまで攻撃を禁止す: Alpha 1, I'll hail the Hiryu.@You are not to attack until ordered.
LDBI\t「戦力温存のためかい？@ 無駄だよ、僕とお前がいる以上は」: To preserve our forces?@It's pointless, as long as you and I are here.
LDBI\t「繰り返す。指示あるまで攻撃を禁止する」: I repeat. You are not to attack until ordered.
LDBI\t「ふん……もう彼ら相手に正体を隠しても@ 意味はないのに」: Hmph... There's no point hiding who we are@from them anymore.
LDBI\t「艦長、エア・クリスマスから入電！」: Captain, transmission from the Air Christmas!
LDBI\t「……鋼龍戦隊旗艦ヒリュウ改に告げる。@ 私は、ガイアセイバーズ旗艦: ...To the Steel Dragons flagship, Hiryu Custom.@This is Colonel Curly Naumann, captain of the@Gaia Saviors flagship, Air Christmas.
LDBI\t「あ、あれ、リー・リンジュン中佐よね！？」: H-Hey, isn't that Commander Lee Linjun!?
LDBI\t「そのリーってのは、誰なんでえ？」: Who the heck's this Lee guy?
LDBI\t「シロガネの艦長だった人物だが……連邦軍から離反し、@ シャドウミラ: He used to captain the Shirogane... but he@defected from the Federation Army and sided@with Shadow Mirror and the Inspectors.
LDBI\t「な、何でそんな奴が@ ガイアセイバーズにいるんだよ！？」: Wh-Why's a guy like that@with the Gaia Saviors!?
LDBI\t「そこら辺は、@ レフィーナ艦長が問い質してくれるでしょ」: I'm sure Captain Lefina will@grill him on that.
LDBI\t「……貴様らは<地球連邦政府>に対する反乱者として@ 指定され、攻撃: ...You have been branded rebels against@the <地球連邦政府>,@and we have been authorized to attack you.
LDBI\t「速やかに武装解除の上、投降せよ。@ これに従わぬ場合は、攻撃を開始: Disarm immediately and surrender.@If you do not comply, we will open fire.
LDBI\t「現在、最優先で対処しなければならないのは、@ 地球を包み込んだ次元: Shouldn't our top priority be the dimensional@rift enveloping the Earth, and the Ruina, who@keep slaughtering people indiscriminately?
LDBI\t「問題をすり替えるな。@ 貴様らは大統領を殺害した罪人なのだぞ」: Don't change the subject.@You're criminals who murdered the President.
LDBI\t「では、お聞きします。@ 何故、あの時、大統領機を発進させたのです？: Then let me ask you this.@Why did you launch the President's craft then?
LDBI\t「ハガネの針路上には、アーチンが出現しました。@ いえ、それ以前に…: An Urchin appeared in the Hagane's path.@No--even before that, if you meant to get the@President out, why didn't you do it sooner?
LDBI\t「貴様らが素直にアルテウル司令の命令を@ 受け入れていれば、あのよう: If you had simply accepted Commander Arteur's@orders, it would never have come to that.
LDBI\t「現状のＧＳ特権は、連邦軍への命令を@ 保証するものではありません」: The GS privileges as they stand don't give you@the authority to command the Federation Army.
LDBI\t「故に我々は、然るべき筋を通し、@ 然るべき場所にて、責に対する申し: Therefore, we said we would answer for our@actions through proper channels, in the proper@venue, and asked to explain to the President.
LDBI\t「しかし、大統領があの場にいたにも関わらず、@ アルテウル司令はそれ: Yet even though the President was right there,@Commander Arteur refused.
LDBI\t「……逆に問うが、大統領が直接命令を下してれば、@ 貴様らは従ったの: ...Then let me ask you. Had the President@ordered you directly, would you have complied?
LDBI\t「それが正統なものであれば。@ しかし、あなた方は一方的に戦端を開き: Yes, if it were legitimate.@But you opened hostilities unilaterally.@Even with an emergency unfolding in Antarctica.
LDBI\t「アルテウル司令の真の目的は、大統領暗殺……@ そして、我々をその犯: Commander Arteur's true goal was to assassinate@the President... and to frame us for it,@was it not?
LDBI\t「……あれが我々側の陰謀だとでも？ @ 言い掛かりも甚だしい」: ...You're claiming that was our conspiracy?@What an outrageous accusation.
LDBI\t「そうでしょうか。@ あの時の艦隊陣形は、意図的に我々をある方向へ@: Is it? The fleet's formation at the time could@be seen as deliberately arranged to drive us@off in a particular direction.
LDBI\t「そして、その先へ都合良く現れたアーチン……@ ゲストの決定打だとし: And then an Urchin conveniently showed up...@If it was the Guest's decisive move, why send@only a unit meant for reconnaissance in force?
LDBI\t「あれも我々が仕組んだことだと言いたいのか？」: Are you saying we staged that as well?
LDBI\t「アーチンは、<ＤＣ戦争>前後から現れていました。@ ろ獲し、運用す: Urchins have been seen since around the time@of the <ＤＣ戦争>. One could be captured@and put to use.
LDBI\t「貴様が言っていることは、状況証拠にもならん。@ 単なる推測だ。どう: What you're saying doesn't even count as@circumstantial evidence. It's mere speculation.@You can spin any story you like that way.
LDBI\t「では、人々はあなた方が作り上げ、公表した話を@ 信じているとも言え: Then one could also say people believe the@story you fabricated and made public.
LDBI\t「屁理屈を。@ 貴様らが大統領を殺害したのは、@ 紛れもない事実なの: Spare me your sophistry.@It is an indisputable fact@that you killed the President.
LDBI\t「……ええ、我々は踊らされました。@ ですが、ガイアセイバーズは@: ...Yes, we were manipulated.@But there is much about the Gaia Saviors@that is suspicious...
LDBI\t「あなた方は、本当に地球圏を守護する剣たり得るのか。@ それとも、守: Are you truly a sword worthy of guarding the@Earth Sphere? Or usurpers of power wearing@the mask of protectors?
LDBI\t「我々は、然るべき場所で真実を明らかにしてみせます。@ 今は、反乱者: We will bring the truth to light in the proper@venue--even if, for now, we are branded rebels.
LDBI\t「その後で、@ 我々が犯した罪に対する裁きを受けましょう」: After that,@we will accept judgment for our crimes.
LDBI\t「大した自信だな。こちらは損耗を抑えるべく、@ 降伏勧告をしているの: Quite confident, aren't you? I'm urging you to@surrender so as to minimize losses...
LDBI\t「やっぱり、向こうはやる気なんだ！」: I knew it, they're itching for a fight!
LDBI\t「お前もそうだろうが、僕も彼らに借りがあってね。@ こういう機会を待: I'm sure you do too, but I owe them one myself.@I've been waiting for a chance like this.
LDBI\t「鋼龍戦隊とは、いずれ決着を付けることになるんだ。@ ここで戦力を削: We're bound to settle things with the Steel@Dragons eventually. Arteur won't complain if@we whittle down their forces here.
LDBI\t「リ・テクのマシンを手に入れれば、尚更ね」: Especially if we get our hands on Re-Tech machines.
LDBI\t「なら、お前は何故、連中を看過しなかった？@ さっさと北極へ向かえば: Then why didn't you let them be?@You could've just gone on to the North Pole.
LDBI\t「ま、気持ちはわかるよ。@ 僕が勝手にやったことだと言い訳すればいい: Well, I get how you feel.@Just say I acted on my own.
LDBI\t「何だ、てめえ……何者だ！？」: What the hell...? Who are you!?
LDBI\t「僕はエグレッタ・ウーノ。@ 君達にはイーグレット・ウルズと名乗った: I'm Egretta Uno.@Or perhaps you'd know me better@as Egret Uruz.
LDBI\t「茶番だな、シュウ・シラカワ。@ 異星人の証言など、何の証拠にもなら: This is a farce, Shu Shirakawa.@The testimony of an alien proves nothing.
LDBI\t「仰る通り……言い掛かりですよ、ククク」: Just as you say... It's a baseless accusation.@Heh heh heh...
LDBI\t「では、そろそろ本題に移りましょうか。@ 先だって、私はゼゼーナン卿: Now then, shall we get to the matter at hand?@Some time ago, I sent Lord Zezenan@a certain item.
LDBI\t「そして、アルテウル司令……@ それこそが、先日あなたにお伝えした@: And, Commander Arteur...@that item is the secret about the Guests@I mentioned to you the other day.
LDBI\t（……見当は付いているが、@ この目で確かめんことにはな）: (...I have an idea what it is,@but I must see it with my own eyes.)
LDBI\t「さて……ご自身で推理されてはいかがです？」: Well... why not deduce that for yourself?
LDBI\t「ふん、私を試そうと言うのか？@ あれは、特異点のフェイズシフト理論: Hmph, you would test me?@That is a diagram explaining the singularity@phase-shift theory...
LDBI\t「つまり、グランゾンの心臓部の理論を説明したものだ。@ 貴様はあれを: In other words, it explains the theory behind@Granzon's core. Where did you obtain it?
LDBI\t「あの部分は完全にブラックボックス化していて、@ 内部の調査は不可能: That section is a complete black box.@Investigating its interior is impossible...@especially for Earth's apes.
LDBI\t「まさか、独自であの理論に到達できたわけでは@ あるまい。猿共の科学: Surely you didn't arrive at that theory@on your own. With the science of apes,@unraveling it would take decades.
LDBI\t「どうもあなた方は、自分達以外の存在が@ 無知だと思っているようです: You people seem to think that everyone@but yourselves is ignorant.
LDBI\t「地球圏には、あなたが想像している以上の@ 異文明が接触し、その技術: Far more alien civilizations than you imagine@have made contact with the Earth Sphere,@and their technology has flowed in.
LDBI\t「仮に貴様らが帝国の技術を理解していたとしても、@ あれを解明するに: Even if you understood the Empire's technology,@deciphering that would take...
LDBI\t「大した時間は必要ありませんでしたよ」: It didn't take very long at all.
LDBI\t「ハッ、馬鹿なことを。@ 地球の猿ごときにあれが理解できるものか」: Ha! Nonsense.@As if Earth apes could ever understand it.
LDBI\t「やれやれ、頑固なお方ですね。@ まあ、いいでしょう。それより、招い: My, how stubborn you are.@Well, no matter. More importantly, it seems@another group of guests I invited has arrived.
LDBI\t「来てやったぜ、シュウ！ 時間通りだ！」: I'm here, Shu! Right on time!
LDBI\t「今回は迷わなかったようですね、マサキ」: So you didn't get lost this time, Masaki.
LDBI\t「先に飛び出したのはいいけど、迷っちゃって……@ 途中で変ニャ化け物: We shot out ahead, but then we got lost...@and ran into a weird-meow monster on the way...
LDBI\t「その後、ようやくここに辿り着いたニャ」: After that, we finally made it here, meow.
LDBI\t「る、るせえ！ 結果オーライだっつーの！」: Sh-Shut up! It all worked out, didn't it!
LDBI\t「なるほど……それであなただけなのですか」: I see... So that's why you're alone.
LDBI\t「ふん……記憶は戻ったみてえだな、シュウ」: Hmph... Looks like you got your memory back, Shu.
LDBI\t「あ、ご主人様。他のも来ましたよ」: Oh, Master. The others are here too.
LDBI\t「マサキ、先に着いてたのね！@ 心配してたのよ、どこかへ迷い込んで@: Masaki, you got here first!@I was worried you'd wandered off@somewhere and gotten lost...
LDBI\t「いちいち説明しなくていいっつーの！」: You don't have to explain every little thing!
LDBI\t「わ～、ホントに宇宙へ出て来ちゃった。@ マサキに言われてたけど、魔: Wow, we really made it out into space.@Masaki told me, but I guess the Masoukishin@can move in space too.
LDBI\t「ところでお師匠、下に見えるのが……」: By the way, Master, that thing down below...
LDBI\t「そう、地球は青かった……@ もとい、優しく光る淡い水色だった、って: That's right. The Earth was blue...@er, I mean, a pale aqua, softly glowing, y'know.
LDBI\t「お前が僕達を呼び出したんだろうが。@ しかも、グランゾンどころか、: You're the one who summoned us.@And not only is Granzon here, so are forces@from the surface. What's going on?
LDBI\t「さあ？@ シュウ様のご命令でやっただけのことよ」: Who knows?@I only did as Master Shu ordered.
LDBI\t「事前に情報を仕入れてたから、わかるぜ。@ あっちはゲストっていう異: I got the info beforehand, so I know.@Those are the aliens called the Guests,@and the others are the Gaia Saviors.
LDBI\t「ガイアセイバー？@ ヒーロー戦記最大の作戦って奴ね」: Gaia Saver?@You mean the biggest operation in Hero Senki?
LDBI\t「おっしょさん、別のが混ざってます～」: Mastah, you've got a different one mixed in~
LDBI\t「何だ？ ミオ、誰と喋ってんだ？」: What? Mio, who're you talking to?
LDBI\t「その話は後、後。@ 取り込み中みたいだしね」: Later, later.@Looks like they're busy right now.
LDBI\t「ようこそ、皆さん。@ まずは紹介させていただきましょうか」: Welcome, everyone.@Allow me to make the introductions.
LDBI\t「あちらがガイアセイバーズの@ アルテウル・シュタインベック司令……: Over there is Commander Arteur Steinbeck@of the Gaia Saviors...
LDBI\t「そして、ゲストの司令官である@ テイニクェット・ゼゼーナン卿です」: And this is the commander of the Guests,@Lord Teinikuet Zezenan.
LDBI\t「ほう、あれが魔装機神か。@ このエネルギー反応……確かに、地球の軍: Hoh, so that is a Masoukishin.@This energy reading... Earth's military@technology truly is superior, it seems.
LDBI\t「フッ、魔装機神は氷山の一角に過ぎませんよ」: Heh. The Masoukishin are merely@the tip of the iceberg.
LDBI\t「ふん……この目で見て、理解が深まった。@ 帝国の連中も地球に目を付: Hmph... Seeing it myself has deepened my grasp.@No wonder the Empire has its eyes on Earth.
LDBI\t「だが、ここまで軍事技術のみに偏った文明は@ やはり危険だ。我々の管: Still, a civilization so fixated on war tech@is dangerous. If we don't guide it rightly under@our control, it will destroy even the galaxy.
LDBI\t「悪いことは言わん。今すぐ武器を捨て、投降したまえ。@ 所詮、貴様ら: Heed me. Drop your weapons and surrender now.@You're merely apes with high-end weapons.@You cannot defeat our forces.
LDBI\t「何なの、あのチョー上から目線の物言いは。@ あったまくんなぁ」: What's with that super condescending attitude?@It totally ticks me off!
LDBI\t「ゼゼーナン、だったな。@ てめえの前任者も、似たようなことを言って: Zezenan, was it?@Your predecessor said the same kind of thing@right before we beat him!
LDBI\t「ウェンドロごとき小者と私を一緒にするな。@ 我らは奴と違い、現地調: Do not lump me in with a small fry like Wendolo.@Unlike him, we don't procure weapons locally.@Our forces are made up of our own arms.
LDBI\t「緒戦で我らに敗れておいて、よく言う」: Big talk, considering we beat you@in the opening battle.
LDBI\t「言葉に気をつけるがいい、アルテウル。@ 月都市の一つや二つ、見せし: Mind your tongue, Arteur.@I could wipe out a lunar city or two@as an example.
LDBI\t「いいだろう、貴様らのような野蛮人には@ 力を示すのが一番だ。我らの: Very well. For savages such as you,@a show of force works best. Witness our power!
BMD\t「スピードならこっちが上よ！」: We've got the edge in speed!
BMD\t「スピードなら、こっちが上よ！」: When it comes to speed, we're faster!
BMD\t「その攻撃パターンへの対処は練習でやった！」: I trained for that attack pattern!
BMD\t「その調子よ！/ 今のタイミングを忘れないで！」: That's it!/　Don't forget that timing!
BMD\t「油断しないで！ 次が来るわよ！」: Stay sharp! Here comes the next one!
BMD\t「あたし達の夢の結晶をやらせるものか！」: I won't let you wreck our dream machine!
BMD\t「ハイペリオンとあたし達ならやれる！」: With the Hyperlion, we can do this!
BMD\t「敵の動きは私より遅いぞ」: The enemy's slower than I am.
BMD\t「いける……！ メリオルエッセが相手でも！」: I can do this...!/　Even against a Meliores Esse!
BMD\t「スピードだったら、あたしだって負けない！」: I won't lose on speed either!
BMD\t「いける！ あいつの動きが読める！！」: Yes! I can read its movements!!
BMD\t「あいつらに勝てなきゃ、/ あたし達の夢は……！」: If we can't beat them,/　our dream will...!
BMD\t「インスペクター戦のデータを応用すれば！」: If I apply the data from/　our fights with the Inspectors!
BMD\t「いくら相手の攻撃力が高くても、/ かわしていけば……！」: No matter how hard they hit,/　if I just keep dodging...!
BMD\t「当てられる前に、勝負を決める……！」: I'll end this before they land a hit...!
BMD\t「スレイ！ あんたには負けられない！！」: Sleigh! I can't lose to you!!
BMD\t「あんたなんかに……/ あんたにだけは負けてなるものか！！」: Not to you.../　I refuse to lose to you of all people!!
BMD\t「スレイ！ もう昔のあたしじゃないよ！」: Sleigh! I'm not who I used to be!
BMD\t「あんた達には負けられないよ！」: I can't lose to you guys!
BMD\t「相手がガイアセイバーズだろうと……！」: Even if they're the Gaia Savers...!
BMD\t「力であたしを止められると思うな！」: Don't think brute force can stop me!
BMD\t「リオンの発展型だろうと、/ 振り切ってみせる！」: Advanced Lion model or not,/　I'll outrun you!
BMD\t「新型だろうとやられるもんか！」: New model or not, I won't go down!
BMD\t「重装甲が仇になったみたいだね！」: Looks like that heavy armor backfired!
BMD\t「高速戦闘で/ 負けるわけにはいかないんだ……！」: I can't afford to lose/　a high-speed battle...!
BMD\t「カリオンを超えても、/ あたしの機体は超えられない！」: You may have surpassed the Calion,/　but you can't surpass my machine!
BMD\t「その魔装機じゃ、追いつけないよ！」: That Masouki can't keep up with me!
BMD\t「サイバスターほどのスピードでなければ！」: Unless you're as fast as the Cybuster!
BMD\t「あたし達は元の世界に帰るんだ！」: We're going back to our own world!
BMD\t「この手の相手は、/ アギーハ戦で経験済みだよ！」: I already dealt with this kind/　of enemy fighting Aguija!
BMD\t「化け物なんかにやられはしない！」: I won't lose to some monster!
BMD\t「そんなわけのわからない攻撃に/ 当たるものか！」: As if I'd get hit/　by some weird attack like that!
BMD\t「悪の超機人の攻撃なんかに！」: Not by some evil Chokijin's attack!
BMD\t「こっちはスピードで/ かく乱するしかないんだ……！」: All we can do is use our speed/　to disrupt them...!
BMD\t「超機人だろうと、スピード勝負なら！」: Chokijin or not, in a speed contest...!
BMD\t「邪神だろうと、軌道を見切れば！」: Evil god or not, if I read its path!
BMD\t「あんなのに飲み込まれてたまるものか！」: Like I'd let that thing swallow me up!
BMD\t「イルイを取り戻すまで、/ やられてなるものか！」: I can't go down/　until I get Irui back!
BMD\t「あたしはイルイを助け出す！ 絶対に！」: I'll rescue Irui! No matter what!
BMD\t「相手は無人機なんだ。軌道は読みやすい！」: It's unmanned. Its path is easy to read!
BMD\t「よし！ この調子ならいける！！」: Okay! At this rate, we can do this!!
BMD\t「これくらいで浮かれてはいられない！！」: I can't get carried away over this!!
BMD\t「軌道を見切れば、回避は出来る！」: If I read its path, I can dodge it!
BMD\t「やるぅ！/ 回避プログラムよりも早い反応よ！」: Nice!/　That's faster than the evasion program!
LDBI\t「リム、お前の方で何かわかるか！？」: Rim, can you tell anything on your end!?
LDBI\t（……穏やかに……そして、強く共振しているね。@ 僕が君達を知りたい: (...We resonate gently... and yet strongly.@Because I wanted to know you...@and you wanted to know me...)
LDBI\t（あたしは違う……そう思ったのは、クリスよ）: (Not me... It was Kris who wanted that.)
LDBI\t（だが、リアナ……君もわかっているはずだ。@ 僕の中に君達がいる。君: (But Riana... you must know it too.@I am within you. You are within me...@We are alike...)
LDBI\t（何故……ウェントス、あんたは@ メリオルエッセなんでしょ。なのに、: (Why...? Ventus, you're a Meliores Esse,@aren't you? So why is your will to destroy@so weak?)
LDBI\t（しかも、あんたは自分が消え去ることを@ 望んでる……）: (And what's more, you actually want to@vanish...)
