LDBI\t「ああ。相手は異星人やＤＣ残党じゃない、@ 君達と同じ体制側の組織だ: Yes. They're not aliens or DC remnants. They're@part of the establishment, same as you. Here,@reason is on their side.
LDBI\t「皆さん、お気遣いは結構です。@ これは私の戦い……ここは自力で切り: Everyone, there's no need to worry about me.@This is my fight. I'll break through on my own.
LDBI\t「切り抜けるだと？ @ おれを倒す気か、失敗作のガイストで」: Break through?@You mean to beat me with that failed Geist?
LDBI\t「ドゥバン・オーグ……僕もあなたには従わない」: Duban Oog... I won't obey you either.
LDBI\t「ガイアセイバーズが、僕の記憶を呼び戻す@ きっかけになるとしても…: Even if the Gaia Saviors could be the key@to bringing my memories back... I just feel@like I shouldn't go there.
LDBI\t「だったら、なおさら！」: Then all the more reason to go!
LDBI\t「僕は失った過去を知りたい……。@ でも、そのことで、これ以上皆さん: I want to know the past I've lost...@But I can't let that cause you all@any more trouble.
LDBI\t「フィオナ、@ ブリット達が動けなくても、俺達なら！」: Fiona,@even if Bullet's team can't act, we can!
LDBI\t「駄目よ。テスラ研が無事では済まなくなるわ」: No. Tesla Labs wouldn't get off unscathed.
LDBI\t「落ち着いて、モニターを見て。@ 所長からのメッセージが入ってるわ」: Calm down and look at the monitor.@There's a message from the Director.
LDBI\t「そうか、レーツェルさん達が戻ってくれば……！」: Right, if Rätsel and the others come back...!
LDBI\t「……彼らは、ガイアセイバーズ側から見れば、@ 追うべき相手になるか: ...From the Gaia Saviors' view, they're targets@to be pursued. I hate to push the trouble@onto them, but...
LDBI\t「後はいかに時間を稼ぐか。@ ロブ、もう一つの策は？」: Now it's a matter of buying time.@Rob, what about the other plan?
LDBI\t「火は入れました。コーティング・クロークの装着と@ 遠隔操作のセッテ: It's powered up. The Coating Cloak and remote@control setup will be finished shortly.
LDBI\t「しかし、パッチ・アーマーをＡＤテープで@ 固定しているような状態で: But with the patch armor just held on@by AD tape...
LDBI\t「万が一の場合、リモート・コントロールで出す。@ それで少しでも時間: If it comes to it, we'll launch it by remote.@That should buy us a little time. Hurry it up.
LDBI\t「……アリエイルさん、@ あなたは僕の過去を知っているんですね？」: ...Arieil,@you know about my past, don't you?
LDBI\t「ほんの一部ですが……」: Only a small part of it...
LDBI\t「それでも結構です。後で話を聞かせて下さい」: That's enough. Please tell me about it later.
LDBI\t「アリエイル、イング……手間取らせるなよ」: Arieil, Ing... Don't make this difficult.
LDBI\t「そんな欠陥品でおれのアレスに挑むか」: You'd challenge my Ares with that defective unit?
LDBI\t「だからこそ、制御が可能なのです。@ しかし、アレスのファウ・ケルン: That's exactly why it's controllable.@But the Fau Kern in the Ares...!
LDBI\t「言ったはずだ、このおれに相応しい力だとな！」: I told you--it's a power worthy of me!
LDBI\t「自分の過去が知りたければ、大人しくおれに従え」: If you want to know your past, just obey me.
LDBI\t「僕はガイアセイバーズへ……@ 記憶にない所へ戻るつもりはない！」: I have no intention of going back to the@Gaia Saviors... to a place I don't remember!
LDBI\t「おのれ、脱走者風情がよくも！@ こうなったら……！」: Damn you, deserter scum! How dare you!@If it's come to this...!
LDBI\t「ふん、やるな。@ だが、これ以上時間を掛けるつもりはない」: Hmph, not bad.@But I won't waste any more time on this.
LDBI\t「う、うう……いったい、どうなって……」: Ugh... What the heck just happened...?
LDBI\t「って言うか、ここはどこ！？@ あたし、宇宙にいたのに！ 何で地上へ: Wait, where am I?!@I was in space! Why am I on the ground?!
LDBI\t「混乱するのは当然だ。@ 不測の事態だろうからな」: It's natural to be confused.@You couldn't have seen this coming.
LDBI\t「あんた、誰……！？ ここはどこなのさ？」: Who are you...?! And where is this place?
LDBI\t「僕の名はホワン・ヤンロン。@ そして、ここはラ・ギアスだ」: My name is Huang Yang Long.@And this is La Gias.
LDBI\t「そう、@ 地球内部の異なる位相空間にある地底世界……@ 君は地上か: Yes. A subterranean world existing in a@different phase space within the Earth...@You were summoned here from the surface.
LDBI\t「そ、それじゃ、マサキと同じ……！」: Th-Then you mean, just like Masaki...!
LDBI\t「マサキ？ もしや、マサキ・アンドーのことか？@ 君はあいつと知り合: Masaki? You mean Masaki Andoh?@You know him?
LDBI\t「そうだよ。@ <Ｌ５戦役>や<インスペクター事件>、<修羅の乱>で: Yeah. We fought together in the <Ｌ５戦役>,@the <インスペクター事件>, and the <修羅の乱>.
LDBI\t「ああ。@ 僕のグランヴェールも彼のサイバスターと同じ、@ この世界: Yes. My Granveil, like his Cybuster,@is one of the only four <魔装機神>@that exist in this world.
LDBI\t「ふ～ん……。@ ホワン・ヤンロンって言ったね。@ もしかして、中国: Hmm... Huang Yang Long, you said?@Are you Chinese, by any chance?
LDBI\t「そう、僕はこの<ラ・ギアス>出身の人間じゃない。@ 君と同じく、地: That's right. I'm not originally from <ラ・ギアス>.@Like you, I'm from the surface.
LDBI\t「連中もゲートに気づいたか」: So they noticed the gate too.
LDBI\t「<アーマードモジュール>……！@ でも、連邦軍の機体じゃない……<: <アーマードモジュール>...!@But not Federation ones... <ＤＣ> remnants, maybe?
LDBI\t「彼らも君と同じように@ ラ・ギアスへ召喚されたのだ」: They were summoned to La Gias@just like you.
LDBI\t「誰が、何のためにそんなことを……」: Who would do that, and why...?
LDBI\t「君達を呼び寄せたのが何者か知らないが……@ 地上から召喚した者達を: I don't know who called you all here...@but there are those who use people@summoned from the surface as mercenaries.
LDBI\t「で、そいつらはあんたと敵対してるってわけ？」: And those guys are your enemies, I take it?
LDBI\t「どうする？ @ 君は後退してもらっても構わんが……」: What will you do?@I won't object if you choose to fall back...
LDBI\t「冗談！ 売られた喧嘩は買わなきゃ、@ リューネ・ゾルダークの名が泣: As if! If I backed down from a fight,@I'd be a disgrace to the name Lüne Zoldak!
LDBI\t「それに、あたしのヴァルシオーネを見て@ 向かってくるＤＣ残党なら、: Besides, if DC remnants still come at me@after seeing my Valsione, I won't hold back!
LDBI\t「リューネ……それに、ヴァルシオーネか。@ いい度胸だ。やられるなよ: Lüne... and the Valsione, was it?@You've got nerve. Don't get shot down.
LDBI\t「後続はなしか……偵察部隊だったらしいな」: No reinforcements... Seems it was a recon unit.
LDBI\t「ヤンロン、何であんたはさっきの連中に@ 狙われてたの？」: Yang Long, why were those guys@after you?
LDBI\t「どちらかと言えば、狙いは君だった。@ 何が召喚されたか、様子を見に: If anything, they were after you.@They came to see what had been summoned.@Same as me.
LDBI\t「様子を見に来たって……」: To see what had been summoned...?
LDBI\t「ここ最近、原因不明のゲートが@ 開かれるという騒ぎが多発していてな: Lately, there's been a rash of incidents@where gates open for no known reason...
LDBI\t「多くの地上人が突発的に@ 召喚されてしまっているんだ」: Many surface dwellers have been@suddenly summoned here.
LDBI\t「ああ、君もこの地へ来てしまった以上、@ 事情を知っておく必要がある: Yes. Now that you've come here,@you need to know what's going on.@It's a bit of a long story, though...
LDBI\t神聖ラングラン王国 マラカ州 セミール湾: Holy Kingdom of Langran@Malaka Province, Semir Bay
LDBI\t「……以上が、現在の神聖ラングラン王国の状況だ」: ...That is the current situation@in the Holy Kingdom of Langran.
LDBI\t「要するに、このラングランって国が、@ 王都で起きたテロのせいで無政: So basically, this country Langran fell into@anarchy because of a terrorist attack@in the royal capital.
LDBI\t「で、隣のシュテドニアス連合が攻め込んで来て……@ カークス将軍って: Then the Schtedonias Union next door invaded...@and this General Kirkus guy rose up, right?
LDBI\t「ああ。@ 現状のラングランにおいてまとまった勢力と@ 呼べるのは、: Yes. Right now, General Kirkus's forces are@the only organized power left in Langran.
LDBI\t「僕は、将軍とは意見を異にするが……@ ラングランを解放するため、共: I don't share the General's views...@but I'm fighting alongside him against@Schtedonias to liberate Langran.
LDBI\t「さて、リューネ……君はどうする？」: Now then, Lüne... What will you do?
LDBI\t「地上に帰る方法はあるの？」: Is there a way back to the surface?
LDBI\t「召喚系の魔法は、かなりの魔力を@ 必要とするからな……使える人間は: Summoning magic requires a great deal@of magical power... Few people can use it.
LDBI\t「有名な所では、@ 大神官イブンに銀の魔法師カテキス……@ 他には、: Well-known ones include High Priest Ibn@and Catekis the Silver Sorcerer...@as well as the late Prince Feyroad.
LDBI\t「じゃ、魔法が使える人間がいれば、@ 割と簡単に戻れるの？」: So if I find someone who can use magic,@getting back would be pretty easy?
LDBI\t「この混乱した状況下で、そうはいかんだろうな。@ 神殿が敵に制圧され: Not in this chaos, I'm afraid.@The temples may be under enemy control,@or the priests may have evacuated.
LDBI\t「なら、すぐに帰れるってわけじゃないんだ。@ ところで……マサキは今: So I can't go home right away, huh?@By the way... where's Masaki now?@He said he was heading to La Gias.
LDBI\t「彼の行方はわからない。カークス将軍の部隊は@ ともかく、散り散りに: I don't know where he is. Aside from General@Kirkus's forces, we can't even contact the@other comrades who were scattered.
LDBI\t「そう……マサキのことだから、@ どこかで迷子になってるかも知れない: I see... Knowing Masaki, he's probably@gotten himself lost somewhere...
LDBI\t「あいつとの合流を望むのなら、@ 今の僕では力になれそうにない。@: If you want to reunite with him,@I'm afraid I can't help you right now.@I have a mission.
LDBI\t「遊軍として敵を混乱させることだ。@ まず北に向かい、シュテドニアス: To sow confusion among the enemy as a@roving unit. First, I'll head north and hit@one of Schtedonias's relay bases.
LDBI\t「ああ。@ 炎の魔装機神グランヴェールならば、可能だ」: Yes. With Granveil, the Masoukishin of Fire,@it's possible.
LDBI\t「ふ～ん……じゃ、あたしもついてくよ」: Hmm... Then I'm coming with you.
LDBI\t（もしかして、素性を隠すために……？@ でも、ガイアセイバーズ側でそ: (Could he have been hiding his origins...?@But why would the Gaia Savers do that...?)
LDBI\t「ですが、あの子はマシンナリー・チルドレンと言っても@ エグレッタや: But even if he's one of the Machinery Children,@he's not like Egretta, or Thurisaz and Ansuz@back then. He just feels different...
LDBI\t「おれ達みたいな@ <ブーステッド・チルドレン>でもなかった……」: He wasn't one of the@<ブーステッド・チルドレン> like us, either...
LDBI\t「しかし、@ イーグレット・フェフに造り出された存在なら、@ 普通の: Still... if he was made by Egret Fehu,@he can hardly be a normal human.
LDBI\t「イングの念動力は、@ 奴によって与えられたものなのではないか？」: Could Ing's Telekinesis have been@given to him by that man?
LDBI\t「あそこまでの力を発揮させるとなると、@ <ホワイトスター>にあった: To draw out that much power...@I'm not sure even the facilities on@<ホワイトスター> could do it...
LDBI\t「でも、それらはＬ５戦役のオペレーションＳＲＷで、@ 全て破壊されて: But those were all destroyed@during Operation SRW in the L5 Campaign.
LDBI\t「ならば、<エアロゲイター>の@ 技術によるものではないのか……」: Then it wasn't done by the@<エアロゲイター> and their technology...
LDBI\t「仮に私の父が何らかの形で関与していたとしても……@ 意図的にあのよ: Even if my father was involved somehow...@I doubt he could grant power like that@on purpose...
LDBI\t「エアロゲイターの技術と言えば、@ ガリルナガンに疑わしい点がありま: Speaking of the Aerogators' technology,@there's something suspicious about Galilnagant.
LDBI\t「あの機体にはトロニウム・エンジンが搭載されており、@ Ｒ‐ＧＵＮリ: That machine carries a Tronium Engine,@and its attacks resembled the R-GUN Rivale's.
LDBI\t「映像記録で見たが、@ あの機体も失われてしまっている……@ イング: I saw it in the video records,@but that machine was lost too...@along with Ingram.
LDBI\t「<トロニウム>に関しては、@ ガリルナガンが奪取したことで説明でき: The <トロニウム> could be explained@by Galilnagant having stolen it, but...
LDBI\t「あの機体には、@ Ｒ‐ＧＵＮリヴァーレと同レベルの技術が@ 用いら: Couldn't that machine be using@technology on the same level@as the R-GUN Rivale?
LDBI\t「だけど、どうやって、それを手に入れるんだよ？ @ リヴァーレだけじ: But how would they get their hands on that?@It's not just the Rivale--the White Star's@gone too, y'know!
LDBI\t「事前に何らかの手段で入手したか……@ あるいは、何者かによってもた: Either they obtained it beforehand somehow...@or someone gave it to them.
LDBI\t「ヴィレッタ隊長、ホワイトスターを送り込んだ者が@ ガイアセイバーズ: Captain Viletta, couldn't whoever sent@the White Star be lending the Gaia Savers@a hand?
LDBI\t「じゃあ、第二のエアロゲイターが@ 動いてるってのかよ……！？」: So you're saying a second set of@Aerogators is on the move...!?
LDBI\t「ただし、疑問もある」: But there's a problem with that.
LDBI\t「<エアロゲイター>の目的は、@ 戦士として優れた資質や旺盛な闘争心: The <エアロゲイター>' goal was to hand <ＥＯＴ>@to Earthlings with superior warrior aptitude@and strong Resolve... and then...
LDBI\t「幾多の戦いを勝ち抜き、戦闘能力を昇華させた者達を@ 自軍の戦力とし: ...to take those who won battle after battle@and refined their combat skills, and make@them part of their own forces.
LDBI\t「結果的にそれは失敗したが……@ Ｌ５戦役のオペレーションＳＲＷの時: It ultimately failed... but by the time@of Operation SRW in the L5 Campaign, the people@they'd chosen had finished their training.
LDBI\t「次なる手として妥当なのは、@ 再びホワイトスターを送り込み、さらな: The logical next step would be to send in@another White Star, and capture the warriors@who've grown further, along with their weapons.
LDBI\t「その前段階だってことは？@ イングラム少佐だって、事前に潜伏して@: What if this is the setup for that?@Major Ingram infiltrated us ahead of time@to get things ready, after all...
LDBI\t「エアロゲイターがガイアセイバーズ……@ いえ、アルテウルと結託して: If the Aerogators were allied with the Gaia@Savers... No, with Arteur, they could reach@their goal far more easily.
LDBI\t「彼はイングラムとは違い、連邦政府の……@ それも中央に近い立場の人: Unlike Ingram, he's part of the Federation@government... and close to its very center.
LDBI\t「そうですね……私達を捕らえるつもりなら、@ 今までにいくらでもチャ: True... If they meant to capture us,@they've had plenty of chances by now.
LDBI\t「あの時、完全に我々を包囲し……実力行使で@ ねじ伏せていれば、事は: Had they fully surrounded us that time...@and forced us down, it would have been over.
LDBI\t「つまり、第二のエアロゲイターが動いている@ 可能性は低いということ: So the chances of a second set of Aerogators@being on the move are low...
LDBI\t「しかし、ガリルナガンという機体が存在し、@ あのような力を見せた以: But given that a machine called Galilnagant@exists, and showed that kind of power...
LDBI\t「ガイアセイバーズがエアロゲイターか、@ それに近しい何かと関係を持: shouldn't we suspect the Gaia Savers are tied@to the Aerogators, or something close to them,@and possess their technology?
LDBI\t「そうね。@ イングの件も踏まえ、事実を調べる必要がある」: Yes. Taking Ing into account as well,@we need to find out the truth.
LDBI\t「……ギリアム少佐、@ この件をジェイコブ中将に報告して下さい」: ...Major Gilliam, please report@this matter to Lieutenant General Jacob.
LDBI\t「レフィーナ大佐、今後のイングの扱いですが……@ どうすればよろしい: Captain Lefina, regarding Ing from here on...@how would you like us to handle him?
LDBI\t「あいつ、記憶が戻ったら@ エグレッタみたいになっちまうのかな……」: If he gets his memory back, will he@turn into someone like Egretta...?
LDBI\t「イングは、身の証を立てると言って、@ 自分の意志でエグレッタやアー: Ing said he'd prove himself, and fought Egretta@and Amala of his own will. Even if he gets his@memories back, I just know he'll...
LDBI\t「それに……彼はもうアルファ・セイバーに帰れない。@ 帰っても、エグ: Besides... he can't go back to Alpha Saber now.@Even if he did, Egretta would...
LDBI\t「ええ……あの子の居場所は、@ もうここにしかないのかも知れない……: Yeah... This might be the only place@left for him now...
LDBI\t「だが、あいつに何らかの暗示がかけられていて……@ 記憶を取り戻した: But he might be under some sort of suggestion...@Once his memory returns, or other conditions@are met, he could become our enemy.
LDBI\t「……その時は、その時でしょう」: ...We'll deal with that when it comes.
LDBI\t「エグゼクスバインは、我々にとって貴重な戦力です。@ そして、それを: The Exexbein is a valuable asset to us.@And Ing is the only one who can pilot it...
LDBI\t「引き続き、彼が我々と行動を共にすることを望むなら、@ そうさせまし: If he wishes to keep fighting alongside us,@we'll let him.
LDBI\t「ただし、最悪の事態が発生した場合は……」: However, should the worst come to pass...
LDBI\t「その時は……僕達が彼を止めます」: If it comes to that... we'll stop him.
LDBI\t「アルテウル様、@ イングのあの力はいったい何なのです？」: Lord Arteur,@what exactly is that power of Ing's?
LDBI\t「私の計画を成就させるために必要なものだよ」: Something necessary for my plan to come to fruition.
LDBI\t「危ぶむことはない。@ お前とガリルナガンは最高の仕事をしてくれた。: There's no need to worry.@You and Galilnagant did superb work.@I'm truly, deeply glad that I brought you.
LDBI\t「イングは、私の願いを叶えるための道具に過ぎん。@ だが、アーマラ…: Ing is merely a tool to realize my wishes.@But you, Amala... you are different.
LDBI\t「私が最も信頼しているのは、お前なのだ。@ 以後も私を信じ、任務を遂: You are the one I trust above all.@Keep faith in me, and carry out your mission.
LDBI\t「はい……どこまでもお供致します、アルテウル様」: Yes... I'll follow you anywhere, Lord Arteur.
LDBI\t「……イングを殺すつもりだったようだな」: ...It seems you meant to kill Ing.
LDBI\t「だけど、パパが望む結果が出たんだろう？」: But you got the result you wanted, didn't you, Papa?
LDBI\t「いや……命令に従うよ。@ パパの望みは……僕の望みでもあるからね」: No... I'll follow orders.@What Papa wants... is what I want too.
BMD\t「……確実な攻撃をしなきゃ……！」: ...I have to make this attack count...!
BMD\t「音速の妖精からは逃げられない……！」: No one escapes the supersonic fairy...!
BMD\t「このラプターは一味違う……」: This Raptor is a cut above...
BMD\t「シエンヌ……私は、もう昔の私じゃない」: Sienne... I'm not who I used to be.
BMD\t「シエンヌ……あなたが退かないのなら……！」: Sienne... If you won't back down...!
BMD\t「私は……あなた達とは違う道を選んだの」: I... chose a different path from you.
BMD\t「私にも戦う理由が……退けない理由がある」: I have reasons to fight... and not retreat.
BMD\t「シオ……動きは読ませない……！」: Shio... I won't let you read my moves...!
BMD\t「アレス・ガイスト……/ スピードでかく乱すれば……！」: Ares Geist.../　If I Disrupt it with my speed...!
BMD\t「ドゥバン・オーグ……/ あなたの選択を認めるわけにはいかない」: Duvan Ogg.../　I can't accept the choice you made.
BMD\t「アルテウル・シュタインベック……/ 私達は、あなたには屈しない」: Arteul Steinbeck.../　We won't bow to you.
BMD\t「イグニス……/ あなた達が与える恐怖には屈しない」: Ignis.../　We won't give in to the fear you spread.
BMD\t「たとえ絶望しても、それを乗り越える……/ 私はそうしてきたもの……！: Even in despair, I'll overcome it.../　That's what I've always done...!
BMD\t「コンターギオ……/ あなたを楽しませるつもりなんてない」: Contagio.../　I have no intention of amusing you.
BMD\t「ウンブラ……私達は、そう簡単に絶望しない」: Umbra... We don't fall into despair so easily.
BMD\t「ペルフェクティオ……/ この世界にあなたの居場所はないわ」: Perfectio.../　There's no place for you in this world.
BMD\t「ここで“破滅の王”を退け、/ 門を封印しなければ……！」: We have to drive back the King of Ruin/　and seal the gate...!
BMD\t「やり方は/ インスペクターと変わっていないのね」: Your methods are no different/　from the Inspectors'.

LDBI\t「ああ、確か……マサキの義理の妹なんだよね」: Oh, right... you're Masaki's adopted sister.
LDBI\t「……たは～、そっちは女子率が高かったんだな。@ 俺もハガネに乗って: ...Man, your side had way more girls.@I should've been on the Hagane.
LDBI\t「何言ってんだ、お前？」: What are you going on about?
LDBI\t「あそこの……ＡＲＴ‐１に張り付いてる子も@ お前の知り合い？」: That girl over there... clinging to the ART-1,@is she a friend of yours too?
LDBI\t「……これがＡＲＴ‐１……@ Ｒシリーズとヒュッケバイン・シリーズの: ...So this is the ART-1...@The way the R-Series and Hückebein Series@lines blend together is just exquisite.
LDBI\t「わかるわかる。@ フレームの剛性が上がって、屈伸時の@ 重心移動が: Totally. The frame's more rigid, so it@looks like it'd shift its weight more@easily when it crouches and extends.
LDBI\t「彼女は<魔装機>の設計をやってるからね。@ それに、<パーソナルト: She designs <魔装機>, after all.@And she's also done research on@<パーソナルトルーパー> and <特機>...
LDBI\t「つまり、相当なメカ好きってこと？」: So basically, she's a huge mecha nut?
LDBI\t「リュウセイ君とはちょっと方向性が違うわよ。@ ヒュッケバインを参考: She's not quite the same type as you, Ryusei.@She even built a Masouki modeled on@the Hückebein.

BMD\t「ほう……やはりな。/ 魔装機神に匹敵するそのパワー……/ きちんと使: Hmm... Just as I thought./　Power that rivals the Masoukishin.../　Use it properly, Lüne.

BMD\t「勇敢な姫君だ……/ 国では民に慕われているのだろうな」: A brave princess.../　Your people must adore you back home.
BMD\t「そうだ……遠慮はいらんぞ、ライディース」: That's it... Don't hold back, Raidiese.

BMD\t「そんな攻撃など、物の数ではない！」: An attack like that is nothing!
BMD\t「どうした、それで精一杯か？」: What's wrong? Is that your best?
BMD\t「無駄だよ……/ このデュラクシールを/ 止められるものなどいない……: It's useless.../　Nothing can stop/　this Duraxyll...
BMD\t「わかるか？ マサキ……/ サイバスターをも超える、/ このデュラクシ: Do you see it, Masaki?/　The power of this Duraxyll.../　a power beyond even the Cybuster...
BMD\t「迷いがあるな、テュッティ……/ 戦場での迷いは、命に関わるぞ！/ 迷: You're hesitating, Tytti.../　Hesitation in battle can get you killed!/　Cast your doubts aside!
BMD\t「もうよせ、セニア。/ ノルスでは太刀打ちできん」: Enough, Xenia./　The Norse is no match for this.
BMD\t「素質はあるが……/ まだまだ父上には遠く及ばんぞ、プレシア！」: You have potential.../　but you're far from your father's level,/　Precia!
BMD\t「君のジャオームでは、/ このデュラクシールには勝てんよ」: Your Jaohm/　can't defeat this Duraxyll.
BMD\t「ガルガードはいい機体だが……/ 宝の持ち腐れだな」: The Galguard is a fine machine.../　but it's wasted on you.
BMD\t「見よ、ヤンロン。/ グランヴェールの力を以てしても、/ デュラクシー: See, Yang Long./　Even the Granveil's power amounts to/　only this before the Duraxyll!
BMD\t「その程度では効かんよ、リューネ」: That won't work on me, Lüne.
BMD\t「まだまだ力不足だな、ミオ」: You're still not strong enough, Mio.
BMD\t「ライディース……/ そんなもので私を止めることは出来ん」: Raidiese.../　That won't be enough to stop me.
BMD\t「地上の技術を取り入れたこのデュラクシールは、/ 君達の機体をも凌駕す: This Duraxyll, built with surface tech,/　outclasses even your machines.../　You cannot stop it!
BMD\t「そう簡単に当たるものか」: It won't be that easy to hit me.
BMD\t「テュッティ、手心は無用だ！」: Don't go easy on me, Tytti!
BMD\t「セニア、やめておけ。お前の腕では無理だ」: Stop, Xenia. You lack the skill for this.
BMD\t「プレシア……君にはまだ早い」: Precia... You're not ready for this yet.
BMD\t「ミオ……君にはまだ無理だ」: Mio... This is still beyond you.
BMD\t「速いな、ヴァルシオーネ。/ だが、狙いは甘い！」: You're fast, Valsione./　But your aim is sloppy!
BMD\t「弾切れとはな……仕方がないか」: Out of ammo... It can't be helped.
BMD\t「君達に/ このデュラクシールを止められるか……！？」: Can any of you/　stop this Duraxyll...?!
BMD\t「行くぞ……このラ・ギアスの命運を懸けて！」: Here I come.../　The fate of La Gias is at stake!
BMD\t「私の全てを出し尽くす！」: I'll give it everything I have!
LDBI\t「何故、ああなったか……彼女達と共振したか……@ 僕にもよくわからな: Why it happened... why I resonated with them...@I don't really understand it myself...
LDBI\t「私にもわからぬことよ……@ ウェントスを責めるでない」: Even I do not understand it...@Do not blame Ventus.
LDBI\t「なら、さっさとアートルム・エクステリオルを……」: Then hurry up and deploy the Atrum Exterior...
LDBI\t「あれは大きな力を必要とする。@ 再度展開すれば、“破滅の王”の目覚: That requires great power.@Deploying it again would delay the awakening@of the "King of Ruin."
LDBI\t「それに、あの人間達によって、@ また同じようなことが起きるかも知れ: Besides, those humans may well cause@the same thing to happen again.
LDBI\t「地上にオフィチナスを建造し、@ 軍勢を増やした方が良かろうな」: We would do better to build an Officinas on@the surface and increase our forces.
LDBI\t「俺とコンターギオは、@ 宇宙でオフィチナスの候補地を見つけたんだ。: Contagio and I found a candidate site@for an Officinas in Space.@If Ventus hadn't screwed up, by now...
LDBI\t「この際、宇宙のことはよい。@ それより、あの人間達とシステムを破壊: Forget about Space for now.@Instead, destroy those humans and their system,@before they hinder us any further.
LDBI\t「わかったぜ。@ ラキ、あいつらは俺に任せろ」: Got it.@Raki, leave those guys to me.
LDBI\t「フン……なら、いいがよ」: Hmph... Fine, if you say so.
BMD\t「何故、僕を呼ぶ？/ 何故、意識の中に入ってくる？」: Why do you call to me?/　Why do you enter my mind?
BMD\t「僕達の意識が、想いが共振している……」: Our minds, our feelings... they're resonating...
BMD\t「リム……二つの魂を持つ娘……」: Rim... the girl with two souls...
BMD\t「君の意識も感じる……」: I can sense your mind too...
BMD\t「意識は感じるが、共振はしない……」: I sense a mind, but there's no resonance...
BMD\t「僕を倒す気なら……」: If you mean to defeat me...
BMD\t「これも共振が成せる業なのか……！」: Is this, too, the work of the resonance...?!
BMD\t「強く感じる……その存在を……！」: I feel it so strongly... that presence...!
BMD\t「意識が……引き寄せられているのか」: Is my mind... being drawn in?
BMD\t「その存在を強く感じる……」: I feel that presence so strongly...
BMD\t「駄目だ……それじゃ、僕を……」: No... that won't be enough to...
BMD\t「グラキエース、後は僕が」: Glacies, leave the rest to me.
BMD\t「グラキエース、ここは僕が引き受ける」: Glacies, I'll take care of this.
LDBI\t「『個別コマンド』の『合流』を使用すれば、@ 周囲８マスで接続する２: Use the Join unit command to combine two@Single Units within the surrounding 8 squares@into a Twin Unit.
LDBI\t「『気力』などの特別な制限はないが、@ 例外として戦艦は『ツインユニ: There are no special requirements, like Will,@but battleships are the exception--they can't@form a Twin Unit.
LDBI\t「合流時に表示されるウィンドウは、@ 部隊の『アビリティ』とその効果: The window shown when joining displays the@squad's Abilities and their effects.
LDBI\t「『アビリティ』とは機体とパイロットに装備するもので、@ 戦いを有: Abilities are equipped to units and pilots,@granting special effects that give you an edge@in battle.
LDBI\t「それは機体とパイロットにある@ 『スロット』にそれぞれ３個ずつ装備: Units and pilots each have Slots that can@hold three Abilities apiece.
LDBI\t「そして、同じ『アビリティ』が３個以上揃っていると、@ 『アビリティ: And when three or more of the same Ability@are equipped, an Ability Effect activates.
LDBI\t「『アビリティ効果』は、部隊に対して@ 武器のダメージや回避率がアッ: Ability Effects give a squad various bonuses,@such as increased weapon damage or evasion.
LDBI\t「『シングルユニット』は機体とメインパイロット@ 計６個の『スロット: A Single Unit counts six Slots in total, from@its unit and main pilot, while a Twin Unit@counts twelve.
LDBI\t「つまり、『シングルユニット』の@ 『アビリティ効果』は２つまでだけ: So a Single Unit can have up to two@Ability Effects, but...
LDBI\t「『ツインユニット』なら、それぞれの機体に@ 『アビリティ効果』が４: A Twin Unit can activate up to four Ability@Effects for each unit, so it's a better deal!
LDBI\t「なお、『アビリティ』の装備は@ インターミッションの『アビリティ』: You equip Abilities with the Ability command@during the intermission.
LDBI\t「では、『ツイン精神コマンド』を使ってみるぞ」: Now, let's try using a Twin Spirit Command.
LDBI\t「『ツインユニット』が攻撃する場合、@ サブ側の機体は攻撃しなくても: When a Twin Unit attacks, the sub unit doesn't@have to attack, but it can still be targeted@by enemy counterattacks.
LDBI\t「また、先程も言った通り、@ ユニットの行動は１フェイズに１回きりな: And as I said earlier, each unit can only act@once per phase, so the sub unit will also@finish its action.
LDBI\t「何もしてないのに行動終了になるのか……@ もったいないッスね」: It finishes its action without doing anything?@What a waste.
LDBI\t「そういう時は『ツインユニット』を@ 『シングルユニット』にすればい: In that case, just split the Twin Unit@back into Single Units.
LDBI\t「『ツインユニット』を@ 『シングルユニット』にするには、@ 個別コ: To turn a Twin Unit into Single Units,@use the Separate unit command.
LDBI\t「ただし、解散した場合は@ 使用中の『ツイン精神コマンド』の効果は@: But be careful: separating will cancel@the effects of any active Twin Spirit@Commands.
LDBI\t「では、敵ユニットを登場させるぞ」: Now, I'll bring out some enemy units.
LDBI\t「戦闘へ入る前に武器の説明をする」: Before we get into combat, I'll explain weapons.
LDBI\t「武器には『通常』、『全体』、『マップ』の@ ３つの種類がある」: There are three types of weapons:@Normal, ALL, and MAP.
LDBI\t「え～っと………『全体』ってのは『ＡＬＬ』マークが@ ついている武器: Um... ALL weapons are the ones marked@with ALL...
LDBI\t「『マップ』ってのは『ＭＡＰ』マークが@ ついている武器で……何もな: And MAP weapons are marked with MAP...@and the ones with no mark are Normal, right?
LDBI\t「そうだ。種別が『通常』の武器を使った@ 攻撃のことを『通常攻撃』…: Correct. An attack with a Normal weapon@is called a Normal Attack...
LDBI\t「『全体』の武器を使った攻撃のことを『全体攻撃』、@ 『マップ』の武: An attack with an ALL weapon is an ALL Attack,@and an attack with a MAP weapon is called@a MAP Weapon.
LDBI\t「『通常攻撃』武器が１機にダメージを与えるのに対し、@ 『全体攻撃』: A Normal Attack weapon damages one unit,@while an ALL Attack weapon damages a whole@squad...
LDBI\t「『マップ兵器』は、攻撃範囲内にいる全ての部隊に@ ダメージを与える: And a MAP Weapon damages every squad@within its area of effect.
LDBI\t「なお、戦闘にはポジションによる相性があるから@ 注意が必要だ」: Also, keep in mind that position matchups@matter in combat.
LDBI\t「同じポジション……メイン側の機体が@ 敵のメイン側の機体を攻撃した: Same positions--your main unit attacking the@enemy's main unit, or sub attacking sub--@are fine, but...
LDBI\t「逆のポジション……メイン側の機体が@ サブ側の機体を攻撃する場合な: Opposite positions--such as a main unit@attacking a sub unit--deal less damage@than normal.
LDBI\t「メイン側の機体による攻撃で@ 敵に与えられるダメージはメイン側に１: Attacks from the main unit deal 100% damage@to the enemy's main unit and 65% to its sub.
LDBI\t「また、武器の中には、@ パイロットの『気力』が一定値以上でないと@: Also, some weapons can only be used when@the pilot's Will is at a certain level@or higher.
LDBI\t「『気力』は戦闘で与えるダメージにも影響する。@ 戦闘に参加したり、: Will also affects the damage you deal.@It rises and falls as you fight in battles@and as enemy or allied units are shot down.
LDBI\t「では、実際に『全体攻撃』をやってみせよう」: Now, I'll demonstrate an ALL Attack.
LDBI\t「『全体攻撃』武器の中には、@ 隣接する敵部隊にも同時にダメージを与: Some ALL Attack weapons can also perform@a Double Attack, damaging an adjacent enemy@squad at the same time.
LDBI\t「先程も言った通り、『マップ兵器』は@ 攻撃範囲内にいる全ての部隊に: As I said earlier, MAP Weapons damage every@squad within their area of effect.
LDBI\t「そして、ポジションによって@ ダメージが減ることはなく、敵の反撃も: Their damage isn't reduced by position,@and the enemy can't counterattack.
LDBI\t「ただし、攻撃範囲内に味方がいれば、@ 敵と一緒にダメージを受けるこ: However, if allies are within the area,@they'll take damage along with the enemy.
LDBI\t「『マップ兵器』を使う時は、充分に気をつけろ」: Be very careful when using MAP Weapons.
LDBI\t「では、実際に『マップ兵器』を使用してみるぞ」: Now, I'll use a MAP Weapon for real.
LDBI\t「す、すげえ……一網打尽だ」: Wh-whoa... wiped 'em all out in one go.
LDBI\t「『マップ兵器』の特徴として、種類ごとに@ 様々な射程範囲を持ってい: One feature of MAP Weapons is that each type@has its own unique area of effect.
LDBI\t「ありゃ？ 『通常攻撃』って、一つじゃないんスね」: Huh? There's more than one kind of@Normal Attack?
LDBI\t「そうだ。『ツインユニット』同士の戦闘では、@ 『個別攻撃』と『集中: That's right. In battles between Twin Units,@you can choose Split Attack or Focus Attack.@I'll explain each one briefly.
LDBI\t「まず、『個別攻撃』。@ これは、『ツインユニット』の２機が攻撃目標: First, Split Attack. With this, each of the@Twin Unit's two units attacks its target...@the enemy in the same position.
LDBI\t「『個別攻撃』は、敵の部隊に平均してダメージを@ 与えたい場合に使え: Use Split Attack when you want to spread@damage evenly across an enemy squad.
LDBI\t「『個別攻撃』は同じポジションの敵を@ 攻撃するのに対し、『集中攻撃: Split Attack hits the enemy in the same@position, while Focus Attack lets you pick@any one unit in the enemy squad to attack.
LDBI\t「つまり、邪魔な奴を集中的に狙えるんスね」: So I can gang up on whoever's in the way!
LDBI\t「そういうことだ。@ では、実際に『集中攻撃』をやってみせよう」: Exactly. Now, I'll demonstrate@a Focus Attack.
LDBI\t「今のが『集中攻撃』だ。@ 『通常攻撃』には、『個別攻撃』と『集中攻: That was a Focus Attack. Remember that@Normal Attacks come in two kinds:@Split Attack and Focus Attack.
LDBI\t「なお、『通常攻撃』には隣接する部隊からの@ 『援護攻撃』や『援護防: Also, Normal Attacks can trigger Support@Attack or Support Defense from adjacent squads.
LDBI\t「『援護攻撃』は、こちらの『通常攻撃』の後に@ 隣接する部隊が追加攻: With Support Attack, an adjacent squad makes@a follow-up attack after your Normal Attack.
LDBI\t「逆に『援護防御』は、@ 敵から『通常攻撃』を受けた場合に@ 隣接す: Conversely, with Support Defense, when the@enemy hits you with a Normal Attack,@an adjacent squad takes the damage instead.
BMD\t「向こうは何のためらいもない……！」: They don't hesitate for a second...!

BMD\t「そんな攻撃、もらうわけないでしょ！」: As if I'd take a hit like that!
BMD\t「確かに、ガードは堅いからな……」: Well, the guard on this thing is solid...
BMD\t「こういう手もあるのよ！」: There's more than one way to do this!
BMD\t「私としたことが……/ 相対距離を見誤るなんて！」: How careless of me.../　Misjudging the relative distance!
BMD\t「くっ、速い……！ どこへ消えたの！？」: Ngh, so fast...! Where did it go?!
BMD\t「まだいける……！ 援護します！」: I can still go...! Moving to support!
BMD\t「離脱しそこなったわね……！/ 悪いけど！」: You failed to pull away...!/　Sorry, but here I come!
BMD\t「読み通り！ まだ攻撃できるわ！」: Just as planned! I can still attack!
BMD\t「少佐、見ていて下さい！ 私も行きます！」: Watch me, Major! I'm going too!
BMD\t「少佐、後は私が！」: Major, leave the rest to me!
BMD\t「あの伝説の教導隊メンバーと/ 連係を組めるなんて、名誉だわ……！」: Teaming up with a member of the/　legendary Instruction Team... An honor!
BMD\t「ラーダさん、後は任せて下さい！」: Radha, leave the rest to me!
BMD\t「アラド、後は任せて！」: Arado, leave the rest to me!
BMD\t「キョウスケ中尉、後は私が！」: Lieutenant Kyosuke, leave the rest to me!
BMD\t「ＡＴＸチーム！ 援護します！」: Team ATX! I'll back you up!
BMD\t「ＡＴＸチームと連係を組めるなんて、/ 光栄だわ……！」: Teaming up with Team ATX.../　What an honor...!
BMD\t「ＳＲＸチーム！ 援護します！」: Team SRX! I'll back you up!
BMD\t「ＳＲＸチームと/ 連係を組める日が来るなんて……！」: I never thought I'd get to/　team up with Team SRX...!
BMD\t「そう上手くいくと思わないで！」: Don't think it'll be that easy!
BMD\t「私の憧れの人をやらせるもんですか！」: I won't let you hurt the man I admire!
BMD\t「古鉄奥義！/ ファイナル・ジョーカー・カード！」: Old Iron's ultimate!/　Final Joker Card!
BMD\t「オラオラオラーッ！！」: Take this! And this! And this!!
BMD\t「オラオラオラオラァッ！！」: Take this, and this, and this, and THIS!!
BMD\t「土壇場でよけるなよ！！」: Don't dodge at the last second!!
BMD\t「細かいことは、後で考えるっ！！」: I'll figure out the details later!!
BMD\t「おれのド根性、見せてやるぜぇっ！」: Time to show you my Super Guts!
BMD\t「お互い、覚悟を決めようぜっ！！」: Let's both get ready for this!!
BMD\t「おれだって教導隊の一員なんだ！/ やってやる！」: I'm part of the Instructor Corps too!/　I can do this!
BMD\t「教導隊の黒一点！/ アラド・バランガ参上！」: The only guy in the Instructor Corps!/　Arado Balanga is here!
BMD\t「必ず中てると書いて、必中と読むっ！」: Bullseye means you hit the bull's-eye!
BMD\t「ちゃんと使いこなしゃ、こいつだって！」: Handle it right, and even this thing can!
BMD\t「ただの量産機だと思うなよ！」: Don't take this for some mass-produced unit!
BMD\t「ヒュッと飛んで、/ バインとブッ飛ばしてやる！」: Zip in quick,/　and send 'em flying with a WHAM!
BMD\t「アルトだって使いこなしてみせる！」: I can handle even the Alt!
BMD\t「頼むぜ、ビルガーの兄ちゃん！」: Counting on you, Bilgar's big bro!
BMD\t「ズガーンと突っ込め、ジガン！」: Charge in with a KABOOM, Jigan!
BMD\t「余りモンなんて言わせねえぞ！」: Don't you dare call this a leftover!
BMD\t「ガイアセイバーズ！/ お前らの好きにはやらせねえ！」: Gaia Saviors!/　We won't let you do as you please!
BMD\t「ガイアセイバーズ……/ よくもおれ達を嵌めてくれたな！」: Gaia Saviors.../　How dare you set us up!
BMD\t「ガイアセイバーズに負けてたまるかよ！」: No way I'm losing to the Gaia Saviors!
BMD\t「マシンナリー・チルドレンが何だってんだ！」: So what if you're Machinery Children?!
BMD\t「何度でも見せてやるぜ、/ 落ちこぼれの意地って奴を！」: I'll show you as many times as it takes/　what a washout's pride looks like!
BMD\t「エグレッタ！ 今度こそ決着をつけてやる！」: Egretta! This time we settle this!
BMD\t「そっちがその気なら、こっちだって！」: If that's how you want it, fine by me!
BMD\t「昔とは違うってことを教えてやる！」: I'll show you I'm not who I used to be!
BMD\t「お前らがガイアセイバーズだってんなら、/ こっちも退けねえ！」: If you're the Gaia Saviors,/　then we can't back down either!
BMD\t「おれを落ちこぼれ呼ばわりして、/ 負けた奴は多いぜ！」: Plenty of guys called me a washout/　and lost!
BMD\t「シエンヌ、お前達の踏み台にはならねえぞ！」: Sienne, we won't be your stepping stone!
BMD\t「シアン！/ クラスが上だからって、どうだってんだよ！」: Cyan!/　So what if you outrank me?!
BMD\t「出世とか勝ち組とか、それが何だってんだ！」: Promotions, being a winner... who cares?!
BMD\t「何セイバーだか知らねえが、負けねえぞ！」: Whatever-Saviors, I ain't losing to you!
BMD\t「そのぶっとい腕をぶった斬ってやる！」: I'll slice off those big fat arms!
BMD\t「お前一人で/ この世界を支配できるわけねえだろうが！」: There's no way you could/　rule this world all by yourself!
BMD\t「アーマラ！ お前の好きにはやらせねえ！」: Amala! We won't let you do as you please!
BMD\t「アルテウル！/ てめえの思い通りにはいかねえぜ！」: Arteur!/　Things won't go the way you want!
BMD\t「おれは、そう簡単にはビビらねえぜ！」: It takes more than that to scare me!
BMD\t「メリオルエッセなんざ怖かねえ！」: I'm not scared of the Meliores Esse!
BMD\t「イグニス！ 火傷すんのはお前の方だ！」: Ignis! You're the one getting burned!
BMD\t「コンターギオ、てめえの顔は何色だってんだ！」: Contagio, what color's your face anyway?!
BMD\t「ガチ勝負で行くぜ、アクイラ！」: Let's settle this for real, Aquila!
BMD\t「筋肉じゃなく、腕で勝負だ！」: It's skill that wins, not muscle!
BMD\t「破滅するのはてめえの方だ！」: You're the one headed for ruin!
BMD\t「こいつの切れ味、試してみるか！？」: Wanna see how sharp this baby is!?
BMD\t「脱いだら凄いんです！」: I look amazing with my clothes off!
BMD\t「てめえら全員から巻き上げてやらぁ！！」: I'll fleece every last one of you!!
BMD\t「種も仕掛けもございません！/ 変幻自在のオクスタン！」: No tricks, nothing up my sleeve!/　The ever-shifting Oxtongue!
BMD\t「さあて……何が飛び出すかは、/ 見てのお楽しみっ！！」: Now then... what'll pop out?/　That's the fun part!!
BMD\t「よぉし、こっちの弾に決めた！」: All right, I'll go with this round!
BMD\t「あんたの運命決まったぜ！/ こいつで消し飛べ、ブラスター！！」: Your fate's sealed!/　Vanish with this--Blaster!!
BMD\t「勝つか負けるか二つに一つ！/ 必殺！ ワイドブラスター！！」: Win or lose, one or the other!/　Ultimate! Wide Blaster!!
BMD\t「ガンドロの最大パワー！/ ぶつけてやらあ！！」: Gandoro's full power!/　I'll slam it right into ya!!
BMD\t「俺のチップは全部ガンドロに賭けるぜ！！」: I'm betting all my chips on Gandoro!!
BMD\t「ガンドロ自体がでけえハンマーだ！」: Gandoro itself is one giant hammer!
BMD\t「そうら、持ってけ！/ 超特大のシーズアンカーだ！」: There ya go, take it!/　An extra-large Seize Anchor!
BMD\t「こいつを食らったら、/ 悲鳴を上げるのがお約束だぜ！」: When this hits you,/　screaming is mandatory!
BMD\t「さあ、お星様になっちまいな！！」: Go on, become a star in the sky!!
BMD\t「ブーストハンマー！/ いつもより回っております！」: Boost Hammer!/　Spinning extra today, folks!
BMD\t「種明かしはしねえぜ！/ くらえ、リープ・スラッシャー！」: I'm not revealing the trick!/　Take this, Leap Slasher!
BMD\t「と言いつつ、メッタ斬りぃぃぃぃっ！！」: Or so I said--slice and diiiice!!
BMD\t「試してみるかい、ロシアン・ルーレット！」: Feel like a round of Russian roulette?
BMD\t「ここ一番の大勝負、大博打！！」: The big gamble! All or nothing!!
BMD\t「もってけドロボー！ コンチキショー！！」: Take it all, you crook! Dang it!!
BMD\t「こいつは本物のクレイモアだぜ。/ え～、リアルなクレイモア、ってね！: This here's the real Claymore./　Uhh, a really real Claymore, get it?
BMD\t「本艦で仕留める！」: We'll finish it with this ship!
BMD\t「あの敵は本艦で撃破する！」: This ship will take down that enemy!
BMD\t「あなたが力を以て、/ この世界を制するというのであれば……！」: If you intend to rule this world/　by force...!
BMD\t「本艦で指揮官機を撃破する！」: This ship will destroy the commander unit!
BMD\t「これ以上、シュテドニアス軍の/ 好きにはさせん……！」: I won't let the Schtedonias Army/　have its way any longer...!
BMD\t「ゼゼーナン……もはやお前に逃げ場はない！」: Zezenan... You have nowhere left to run!
BMD\t「ガイアセイバーズの横暴を/ 許す気はない……！」: I won't stand for/　the Gaia Savers' tyranny...!
BMD\t「鋼龍戦隊の意地を見せてやる……！」: I'll show them the Steel Dragons' resolve!
BMD\t「ガイアセイバーズ……/ お前達の好きにさせるものか！」: Gaia Savers.../　I won't let you have your way!
BMD\t「どこの世界でも/ やることは同じというわけか……！」: So it's the same/　in every world, is it...!
BMD\t「この世界で/ 再起を図るつもりだとでも言うのか……！」: Are you saying you intend to/　make a comeback in this world...?!
BMD\t「あの艦を撃破し、汚名を返上する！」: We'll destroy that ship and clear our name!
BMD\t「対艦戦だ！ 総員、気を引き締めてかかれ！」: Ship-to-ship combat!/　All hands, stay sharp!
BMD\t「各機の道を開ける！ 対艦戦闘用意！」: Clear a path for our units!/　Prepare for anti-ship combat!
BMD\t「あの艦は本艦で沈める！」: This ship will sink that vessel!
BMD\t「本艦でデモンゴーレムを駆逐する！」: This ship will wipe out the Demon Golems!
BMD\t「本艦で妖機人を駆逐する！」: This ship will wipe out the Yokijin!
BMD\t「何としてもルイーナを食い止めるんだ！」: We must stop the Ruina at all costs!
BMD\t「地球圏への干渉は許さん！」: I won't let you meddle/　in the Earth Sphere!
BMD\t「地球には/ ゲストもインスペクターも必要ない！」: Earth has no need/　for the Guests or the Inspectors!
BMD\t「お前達が何度地球圏へ現れようと……！」: No matter how many times/　you come to the Earth Sphere...!
BMD\t「応龍は、我ら鋼龍が打ち倒す！」: The Steel Dragons will bring down Ouryu!
BMD\t「何としても奴の暴走を食い止めるんだ！」: We must stop its rampage at all costs!
BMD\t「ここで何としてもガンエデンを阻止する！」: We must stop Gan Eden here at all costs!
BMD\t「奴が新人祖などと……誰が認めるものか！」: Him, a new progenitor...?/　As if anyone would accept that!
BMD\t「今度はこちらから仕掛ける！」: Now we take the fight to them!
BMD\t「ぐあああっ！！/ くっ……！ 本艦が沈めば……！！」: Gwaaah!!/　Ngh...! If this ship goes down...!!
BMD\t「くっ！ 総員、直ちに退艦しろ！！」: Ngh! All hands, abandon ship at once!!
BMD\t「くっ！ これ以上、直撃を受ければ……！」: Ngh! If we take any more direct hits...!
BMD\t「艦尾テスラ・ドライブ・パイルに直撃！/ 出力落ちます！」: Direct hit to the aft Tesla Drive pile!/　Output dropping!
BMD\t「メインロケット、３番から５番！/ 噴射３秒！」: Main rockets, 3 through 5!/　Fire for 3 seconds!
BMD\t「ぐうっ！ レンジ３の味方機を直掩に！」: Ngh! Units within range 3,/　cover the ship!
LDBI\t「王都の喉元に刃を突き付けられた状態で@ そのようなことを仰いますか: You say such a thing while our blade is@pressed to the royal capital's throat?
LDBI\t「ラングランの混乱が望みではあるまい。@ 将軍と同じく、私もこの戦い: Surely you don't want chaos in Langran.@Like you, General, I wish to end this@battle as quickly as possible.
LDBI\t「では、そちらこそ兵を退き、@ 王都を我らに明け渡していただきたい。: Then it's you who should withdraw your troops@and yield the capital to us. And, Your Highness,@I must ask you to renounce the succession.
LDBI\t「てめえ、何様のつもりだ！？」: Who the hell do you think you are!?
LDBI\t「カークス将軍……戴冠式の真相は知っている。@ それが明らかになるの: General Kirkus... I know the truth about the@coronation. It is only a matter of time before@it comes to light.
LDBI\t「こりゃまた、豪快にしらばっくれたわねぇ。@ カークス軍の得意技なの: Wow, now that's one bold-faced denial.@Is playing dumb the Kirkus Army's specialty?
LDBI\t「あの戴冠式に出席していたテリウス殿下が@ 偽者だということは、わか: We know that the Prince Tellius who attended@the coronation was an impostor.
LDBI\t「何の証拠があって、そのようなことを言う？」: And what proof have you for such a claim?
LDBI\t「……将軍も知っているはずだ。@ 我々が本物のテリウスと接触したこと: ...You must know it as well, General.@We have made contact with the real Tellius.
LDBI\t「さて……記憶にございませんな」: Hmm... I have no recollection of any such thing.
LDBI\t「政治家みたいな言い訳しやがって……」: That's a politician's excuse if I ever heard one...
LDBI\t「どうあっても退く気がないと言うのだな？」: Then you refuse to withdraw, no matter what?
LDBI\t「然様。ここで雌雄を決する他ありませぬ」: Indeed. We have no choice but to settle this here.
LDBI\t「ふん……いい度胸だ、カークス。@ 以前のてめえとは大違いだな」: Hmph... You've got guts, Kirkus.@You're nothing like you used to be.
LDBI\t「私も驚いているよ、これほどの才能があったことに。@ まさに、治世の: I too am surprised I had such talent in me.@Truly, an able minister in times of peace,@and a crafty schemer in times of chaos.
LDBI\t「何が治世の能臣だ。昼行灯だったくせに」: Able minister, my ass. You were a do-nothing!
LDBI\t「今は力によって道を示さねばならぬ時なのだ。@ 大逆者の汚名を着よう: Now is a time when force must show the way.@Though I be branded a traitor, I will unite@Langran by force... nay, all of <ラ・ギアス>!
LDBI\t「それこそが、この世界に平和をもたらす@ 最善の方法なのだ」: That is the best way to bring@peace to this world.
LDBI\t「てめえにゃ過ぎた野心だぜ、そいつは！@ それを成し遂げるために何人: That ambition's too big for the likes of you!@How many people are you willing to sacrifice@to make it happen!?
LDBI\t「犠牲なき平和など、あり得ぬよ」: There is no such thing as peace without sacrifice.
LDBI\t「お前達に志あらば、我が下へ来るがいい。@ そして、共にラ・ギアス全: If you have any convictions, come to my side.@Together, let us fight for peace across@all of La Gias.
LDBI\t「あなたと同じようなことを言った人間が、@ 地上にもいたのよね。目指: Someone up on the surface said the same kind@of thing as you. Same goal, but the way they@went about it was the problem, y'know?
LDBI\t「我が大義を理解せぬか」: So you cannot grasp my great cause.
LDBI\t「まあ、あんたの大義とやらはわかり易いがな。@ だが、それ故にその危: Sure, your so-called cause is easy to grasp.@But that's exactly what makes it dangerous.
LDBI\t「そう……お前の大義は、野望と紙一重だ」: Exactly... There's a fine line between your@cause and mere ambition.
LDBI\t「やはり、これ以上話しても無駄なようだな。@ 各機、攻撃を開始せよ」: It seems further talk is indeed futile.@All units, commence attack.
LDBI\t「<アインスト>……ここで決着を付けるぞ」: <アインスト>... We settle this here.
LDBI\t「あなた……カークス軍にいたのね」: So you... were with the Kirkus Army.
LDBI\t「もしや、あれは……オレグ・ナザロフ大尉か？」: Could that be... Captain Oleg Nazarov?
LDBI\t「え？ 知り合いなの？」: Huh? You two know each other?
LDBI\t「彼は、ノイエＤＣの総帥だったバン大佐直属部隊の@ 隊長……ラングレ: He commanded the unit directly under Colonel@Bhan, leader of the Neue DC... He also fought@in the battle against the Einst at Langley.
LDBI\t「なるほど、それでアインストに怨みを……」: I see, so that's why he hates the Einst...
LDBI\t「ユウキ……この裏切り者めが。@ バン大佐の恩義を忘れ、鋼龍戦隊に@: Yuuki... you traitor.@Forgetting your debt to Colonel Bhan, and@throwing in with the Steel Dragons...!
LDBI\t「オレグ大尉……@ バン大佐亡き後のノイエＤＣに大義はない」: Captain Oleg...@With Colonel Bhan gone, the Neue DC has no cause.
LDBI\t「それに、地上での争いを@ ラ・ギアスに持ち込んでどうなるってのよ！: Besides, what's the point of dragging the war@on the surface into La Gias!?
LDBI\t「ここがどこであろうと、@ アインストと連邦に与する者は死ぬべきなの: It doesn't matter where we are!@Anyone siding with the Einst and the Federation@must die!
LDBI\t「悪いけど、あなたの恨み辛みに@ 付き合ってる暇はないのよね……！」: Sorry, but we don't have time to indulge@your grudges...!
LDBI\t「カークス……てめえはやり過ぎた。@ その野心の代償をここで払っても: Kirkus... you went too far.@Time to pay for that ambition of yours!
LDBI\t「来るがいい！@ お前達の死を以て、我が大義を世に示してくれよう！」: Come, then!@Your deaths shall prove my cause to the world!
LDBI\t「戦力の出し惜しみをしている場合ではない……！@ 残りの機体を全て出: This is no time to hold back our forces...!@Deploy all remaining units!
LDBI\t「それで打ち止めってわけか！@ 勝負が見えたぜ、カークス！」: So that's all you've got, huh!?@I can see how this ends, Kirkus!
LDBI\t「笑止！@ 戦いは終わってみなければわからぬものよ！」: Absurd!@No battle is decided until it is over!
LDBI\t「なら、さっさと幕を引いてやるぜ！」: Then I'll bring the curtain down right now!
LDBI\t「お、おのれ、アインスト！ 連邦の犬共めぇぇ！！」: D-Damn you, Einst! You Federation dogs!!
LDBI\t「……あの人、現実が見えてなかったわよね、@ 色んな意味で……」: ...That guy really couldn't see reality,@in more ways than one...
LDBI\t「だが、私は諦めん！ 理想を実現するまではな！@ 諸君、また会おう！: But I shall not give up! Not until I realize@my ideals! Until we meet again, gentlemen!
LDBI\t「カークス将軍は力と大義名分を失ったのよ。@ だから、彼に従う者達は: General Kirkus has lost his power and his@justification. So those who follow him will@most likely...
LDBI\t「チッ、カークス軍はもう終わりか……！」: Tch, so the Kirkus Army's finished...!
LDBI\t「覚えておくがいい、ユウキ！ そして、アインスト！@ 俺は貴様らの存: Remember this, Yuuki! And you too, Einst!@I will never accept that you exist!
LDBI\t「ただし、ザムジードは自らの意思に反して@ 操られているわけですから: However, Zamzeed is being controlled against@its own will, so it must be suffering@terrible agony...
LDBI\t「ああ、魔装機神は自分で操者を選ぶからな。@ それを無理矢理ねじ伏せ: Yeah, a Masou Kishin picks its own pilot.@Forcing it into submission like that...!
LDBI\t「ミ、ミオ、あなた……ザムジードの心がわかるの！？」: M-Mio, you... you can understand@Zamzeed's heart!?
LDBI\t「これは……間違いなさそうだな。@ ディアブロを乗りこなしたことと言: This... there's no doubt about it.@First she handled the Diablo, and now@she's reading Zamzeed's heart...
LDBI\t「そんな！ 駄目よ！ あの子には無理だわ！」: No! That's no good! She's not up to it!
LDBI\t「テュッティ、気持ちはわかるけどよ」: Tytti, I know how you feel, but...
LDBI\t「マサキ、私は昔のことに拘ってるわけじゃないのよ。@ ただ、ミオの実: Masaki, it's not that I'm hung up on the past.@It's just, with Mio's skills...
LDBI\t「……とりあえず、あれが魔装機神の１体なら、@ 取り返した方がいいん: ...Anyway, if that's one of the Masou Kishin,@shouldn't we get it back?
LDBI\t「ああ、そうだ。@ テュッティ、話は後だ。まずはザムジードを！」: Yeah, you're right.@Tytti, we'll talk later. Zamzeed comes first!
LDBI\t「ザムジードには悪いが、力ずくで取り押さえる。@ あいつは結構頑丈だ: Sorry, Zamzeed, but we'll pin it down by force.@It's pretty tough. Just don't go overboard@and shoot it down.
LDBI\t「あちゃあ、無茶が祟ったか。もう動かんわ。@ このままやったら、あい: Aw, shoot, pushed it too hard. She won't budge.@If I stick around, they'll nab me...@Guess I gotta run fer it and eat the demotion.
LDBI\t「マサキ、コックピットから人が！」: Masaki, someone's coming out of the cockpit!
LDBI\t「野郎、捕まえてやるぜ！」: Hold it, you! I'm gonna catch you!
LDBI\t「兄ちゃん、ワシはそんなノロマやないで。@ 縁があったら、また会おか: Sorry, kid, I ain't that slow.@See ya around, maybe. I'm outta here!
LDBI\t「でも、敵本隊は後退したし、@ ザムジードも取り戻せたわ」: But the main enemy force has pulled back,@and we got Zamzeed back.
LDBI\t「ああ……フェイル殿下の方も何とかなるだろう。@ みんな、すまねえが: Yeah... Prince Feil should be fine too.@Sorry, everyone, but help me recover Zamzeed.
LDBI\t「てめえなんぞにザムジードが扱えるのかよ！？」: You really think you can handle Zamzeed!?

LDBI\t「何だ、こいつ？ すげえトロイア訛りだな」: What's with this guy?@That's one thick Troia accent.
LDBI\t「あなた、ザムジードから降りて投降しなさい！」: You! Get out of Zamzeed and surrender!
LDBI\t「アホ言え！ んなこと出来るかいな！」: Don't be stupid! Like I'd do that!
LDBI\t「なら、気は進まないけど、@ 力ずくで行くしかないわね……！」: Then I don't like it, but@we'll have to use force...!
LDBI\t「上等や、かかってこんかい！」: Bring it on, then! Come at me!
LDBI\t「ザムジードが痛がって、泣いてるじゃない！@ さっさと降りなさいよ！: Zamzeed's in pain, it's crying!@Get out of there already!
LDBI\t「ほう……お嬢ちゃん、地上人みたいやな。@ こないなトコに首突っ込ん: Oho... missy, you're from the surface, huh?@Stick your nose in a place like this,@and you'll get more'n just hurt.
LDBI\t「覚悟の上だよ！@ ザムジードは返してもらうからね！」: I know what I'm getting into!@We're taking Zamzeed back!
LDBI\t「うわっちゃあ！ やられてもうたわ！」: Whoa there! They got me good!
LDBI\t神聖ラングラン王国 サイツェット州 バナン市: Holy Kingdom of Langran@Saizet Province, Banan City
LDBI\t「ザムジード……@ さすがに無傷で取り戻すわけにはいかなかったな」: Zamzeed...@Figures we couldn't get it back unscathed.
LDBI\t「壊れちゃってるよね……直せるの？」: It's busted, isn't it... Can it be fixed?
LDBI\t「フェイル殿下の所へ行けば、何とかなるだろ」: If we take it to Prince Feil, it'll work out.
LDBI\t「……ねえ、マサキ。@ 魔装機神に乗るって、どんな気分なの？」: ...Hey, Masaki.@What's it like piloting a Masou Kishin?
LDBI\t「ザムジードを初めて見た時、泣いてると思ったの。@ まるで兄弟か親友: The first time I saw Zamzeed, I felt it crying.@Like a brother or best friend was being hurt...@So I felt like I had to help it...
LDBI\t「魔装機神は、それぞれが高位の精霊と契約を結んで、@ その能力を宿ら: Each Masou Kishin has a pact with a high spirit,@which grants it its power.
LDBI\t「言わば、一人の人間みたいなもんだ。@ それ故に魔装機神は操者を選ぶ: You could say each one's like a person.@That's why a Masou Kishin chooses its pilot--@someone whose mind it can sync with.
LDBI\t「だから、ミオ……ザムジードの心を理解した@ お前は、あいつに選ばれ: So, Mio... you understood Zamzeed's heart,@which means it chose you.
LDBI\t「魔装機神操者には権利と義務が伴うんだ。@ いずれ、フェイル殿下が教: Masou Kishin pilots have rights and duties.@Prince Feil will fill you in eventually, but...
LDBI\t「まず、魔装機神操者は@ あらゆる権力に従わなくていい。@ その意思: First, a Masou Kishin pilot doesn't have to@obey any authority. Their will takes@precedence over the decisions of nations.
LDBI\t「そして、義務とは世界存続の危機に際した時……@ 何らかの脅威と出会: As for the duty: when the world is in peril...@when you meet some threat and judge that it@could become a catastrophe for La Gias...
LDBI\t「俺も最初に聞いた時はそう思ったさ。@ だが、魔装機神操者としての義: I thought the same when I first heard it.@But fulfilling the duty of a Masou Kishin pilot@is pretty tough.
LDBI\t「責任重大……ってことよね」: So it's a heavy responsibility, huh.
LDBI\t「ああ。それを果たせるだけの力をつけることだ。@ そして、心の強さも: Yeah. You need the strength to carry it out.@Strength of heart, too. If a pilot turns wicked,@the guardian spirit will reject them.
LDBI\t「おっ、珍しく素直だな。普段もそうだといいんだけど」: Oh, being honest for a change?@Wish you were like this all the time.
LDBI\t「では、空間転移による移動は……？」: Then what about travel via spatial transfer...?
LDBI\t「その内、ゲストによって証明されるだろうが……@ 不可能だと考えてい: The Guests will probably prove it for us soon...@but I believe it's impossible.
LDBI\t「じゃあ、Ｈ‐ＭＡＰＷ以上のパワーを@ ぶつけりゃいいんじゃねえか？: Then can't we just hit it with something@stronger than an H-MAPW?
LDBI\t「試す価値はあると思うが……@ バラルの園に住まう孫光龍という人物は: It may be worth a try... But the man who@dwells in the Garden of Baral, Son Koryu,@reportedly declared it would be futile.
LDBI\t「だとしても、バラルの園を浮上させ、@ あのようなバリアを展開した力: Even so, we shouldn't underestimate the power@that raised the Garden of Baral and deployed@a barrier like that.
LDBI\t「ああ……地球は人知を超えた術で@ 再び封印されてしまったと考えられ: Yes... We can assume Earth has been sealed@again by arts beyond human understanding.@After all, we can't contact the surface at all.
LDBI\t「おそらく、孫光龍は地球に住まう人々の逃げ場を@ なくした上で、総人: Son Koryu likely intends to carry out the@Total Human Shikai Project after leaving the@people of Earth with nowhere to run.

LDBI\t「ロア・アーマーのクリスタルの中さ。@ でも、こうやって会話すること: Inside the Roa Armor's crystal.@But he can talk with us like this, too.

LDBI\t「その可能性もあるが……@ まるで画像を加工したかのように@ いくつ: That's possible, but... several cities and@bases had vanished cleanly, as if someone@had edited an image.
LDBI\t「理由はわからんが……@ 俺達の目には、本来あるべき姿の地球が@ 映: I don't know why... but it's highly likely@that what we're seeing isn't Earth as it@truly is.
LDBI\t「……消えた都市や基地に何か共通点はあるのか？」: ...Do the vanished cities and bases have@anything in common?

LDBI\t「しかし、そこにはバラルの意図が介在しているはずだ」: Still, Baral's intent must be at work there.
LDBI\t「確証はないが、俺達に対する何らかのメッセージ……@ 警告ではないか: I have no proof, but I believe it's some kind@of message to us... a warning.

LDBI\t「ミチルの考えは的外れではない。@ そういう類のメッセージだろう」: Michiru's idea isn't off the mark.@It's likely a message of that sort.
LDBI\t「何だかよくわからねえが、@ バラルが思ってた以上にとんでもねえ連中: I don't really get it, but one thing's for@sure: Baral's way crazier than we figured.
LDBI\t「これから俺達はどうするんだよ？」: So what're we gonna do now?
LDBI\t「それについては、レフィーナ大佐達が協議中だ。@ では……各員、持ち: Colonel Lefina and the others are discussing@that now. All right... everyone, return to@your posts.

LDBI\t「ショウコ達も捜したんですけど……」: Shoko and everyone searched too, but...
LDBI\t「艦内映像もチェックしましたが、@ それらしい姿は見当たらず……」: We checked the ship's camera footage too,@but saw no sign of her...
LDBI\t「部屋の中で突然消えてしまったとしか……」: All I can think is she suddenly vanished@from inside the room...
LDBI\t「……では、我々はヘブンゲートへ向かうが、@ そちらはどうするつもり: ...We'll be heading for Heaven's Gate,@then. What do you plan to do?
LDBI\t「今の所、クストースや超機人はバラルの園に@ 接近しない限り、動きを: At present, the Custos and Choukijin don't@move unless we approach the Garden of Baral.@And if we have no way to return to Earth...
LDBI\t「我々もオペレーション・レコンキスタに@ 参加させていただきたいと思: We would like to take part in@Operation Reconquista.

LDBI\t「司令さえよろしければ、@ 我々を補充戦力としてお使い下さい」: If it's acceptable to you, sir, please use@us as reinforcements.
LDBI\t「しかし、統合参謀本部の許可を得ねば……」: But without authorization from the Joint@Chiefs of Staff...
LDBI\t「地上との交信は不可能ですし、@ 我々は軍籍を剥奪されている身ですが: Contact with the surface is impossible,@and we've been stripped of our commissions,@but...
LDBI\t「……そうだな。では、貴官の申し出を受け入れよう。@ ただし、地球に: ...True. Then I'll accept your offer.@However, should anything happen on Earth,@you'll return to your original mission.

LDBI\t「今更、体面などと……@ 鋼龍戦隊の追撃を取りやめろと言うのか？」: Saving face, now of all times...?@Are you telling me to call off our pursuit@of the Steel Dragons?

LDBI\t「ただし、この国にのさばっている@ シュテドニアス軍を全て撃退した後: However, only after we've driven off all the@Schtedonias forces running rampant here.@Is that clear, Kirkus?

LDBI\t「どういうおつもりなのです？@ カークスはテリウス殿下を傀儡として、: What are you thinking?@Kirkus means to make Prince Tellius his puppet@and seize control of the nation!

LDBI\t「そうね、地上の大都市みたいに高層建築物が@ 立ち並んでいるわけじゃ: True, there aren't rows of skyscrapers here@like in the big cities on the surface...

LDBI\t「……あまりくっつくな。@ 遊びに来たわけじゃないんだぞ」: ...Stop clinging to me.@We're not here to have fun.

LDBI\t「そりゃもう……@ ティーバッグで適当に紅茶を飲もうものなら、@ 荷: Oh, big time...@Make tea with a tea bag in front of him, and@his charged particle cannon would open fire.
LDBI\t「あらあらあら、大変ね」: My, my, my. That sounds serious.

LDBI\t「もちろんだ。今日はヌワラエリヤ、それも@ ラバーズリープ産を用意し: Of course. Today it's Nuwara Eliya, and from@the Lover's Leap estate. I took great care with@the water temperature so it won't be bitter.

LDBI\t「じゃあ、いただくわね。@ えっと、お砂糖は……」: Well then, I'll have some.@Um, where's the sugar...

LDBI\t「サイバスターより強いのか、弱いのか……@ 何にせよ、魔装機神は<ラ: Is it stronger than the Cybuster, or weaker...@Either way, it pays to finish off a Masoukishin@while we're in <ラ・ギアス>!

LDBI\t「ハッ！@ あんただって、昔はそうじゃなかったのかい！？」: Hah!@Weren't you just the same back in the day!?
LDBI\t「気の強い女にガタイがいい男……@ 残る一人はあれか、美少女だったり: A tough-talking woman and a beefy guy...@So is the last one some cute girl, or what!?
LDBI\t「ハッ！ もう一人に会えるかどうか、@ わかんないよ！」: Hah! Who knows if you'll@ever get to meet the third!
LDBI\t「鋼龍戦隊のエースを落とせば、@ あたしの名に箔が付くってもんさね！: If I take down the Steel Dragons' ace,@it'll put some real gilding on my name!

BMD\t「ラプターなら、あれが出来る……！」: With the Raptor, I can pull that off...!
BMD\t「まずは足を止める！」: First, I'll stop you in your tracks!
BMD\t「行くよ、マニューバーＲａＭＶｓ！/ ＲＴアレンジ！」: Here goes, Maneuver RaMVs!/　RT Arrange!
BMD\t「３番目のダブルＧ……/ 相手にとって不足はない」: The third Double G.../　A worthy opponent.
BMD\t「ダブルＧと言えど、/ 近距離戦では負けん……！」: Double G or not,/　I won't lose at close range...!
BMD\t「下忍相手に後れは取らん……！」: I won't fall behind mere genin...!
BMD\t「今度はお前が狩られる番だ……！」: Now it's your turn to be hunted...!
BMD\t「おれ達まで狩れると思うなよ……！」: Don't think you can hunt us too...!
BMD\t「魔装機神と同等か、それとも……！」: On par with a Masoukishin, or...!
BMD\t「サイバスターほどのスピードが/ ないのであれば……！」: If you don't have/　Cybuster's speed...!
BMD\t「魔装機か。/ 対ＰＴ戦と同じ要領でいけるはずだ……！」: A Masouki./　Fight it like a PT and it should work...!
BMD\t「魔装機だろうと、懐に飛び込めば……！」: Masouki or not, if I get in close...!
BMD\t「こちらもその手の機体とは/ 戦い慣れているんでな……！」: We're used to fighting/　machines like that ourselves...!
BMD\t「化け物共の相手は慣れている……！」: I'm used to dealing with monsters...!
BMD\t「人に仇なす邪神か。/ ある意味、能書きをたれる人間よりわかり易い」: An evil god that harms mankind./　In a way, you're easier to read/　than people who preach.
BMD\t「全てを取り込む、か。/ やれるものなら、やってみせろ……！」: Absorb everything, huh?/　Go ahead and try...!
BMD\t「お前が求める結果など……興味はない！」: I don't care what result you're after!
BMD\t「四神の超機人か……！」: The Choukijin of the Four Gods...!
BMD\t「どんな化け物であろうとも……！」: No matter what kind of monster...!
BMD\t「アインストよりはわかり易い連中だ……！」: Easier to read than the Einst...!
BMD\t「ガンエデン……お前の結界を貫く！」: Gan Eden... I'll pierce your barrier!
BMD\t「悪いが、元から信心深い質じゃない……！」: Sorry, I was never the devout type...!
BMD\t「因果応報……/ その言葉の意味を教えてやる！」: What goes around comes around.../　I'll teach you what that means!
BMD\t「ユーゼス、貴様も全賭けというわけか。/ だが、こちらはそれ以上だ！」: Euzeth, so you're going all in too./　But I'm betting even more!
BMD\t「ユーゼス、/ おれの賭けに付き合ってもらうぞ！」: Euzeth,/　you're going to play along with my bet!
BMD\t「つくづく化け物とは縁があるらしいな……！」: Seems I'm fated to keep meeting monsters...!
BMD\t「ルイーナの雑魚に用はない……！」: I have no business with Ruina small fry...!
BMD\t「お前達がいくら湧いて出ようと……！」: No matter how many of you crawl out...!
BMD\t「ルイーナ……/ この世界にお前達の居場所はない」: Ruina.../　There's no place for you in this world.
BMD\t「お前達がまき散らす恐怖ごと/ 排除あるのみ……！」: You and the fear you spread/　will be wiped out...!
BMD\t「ゲストだろうがインスペクターだろうが……/ やることは決まっている」: Guests or Inspectors.../　I know what I have to do.
BMD\t「その諦めの悪さが命取りになる……！」: That stubbornness will be your undoing...!
BMD\t「お前達のような客を招いた覚えはない……！」: I don't recall inviting guests like you...!
BMD\t「こちらの番か……。いくぞ……！」: My turn, then... Here I go...!
BMD\t「おれを落とせなかったのは命取りだ……！」: Failing to take me down will cost you...!
BMD\t「お前が考えているほど……/ 距離は開いてないぞ……！」: The gap isn't as wide.../　as you think...!
BMD\t「ここまで……よくもったほうか……くっ！」: I suppose I held out this long... Ngh!
BMD\t「しくじった！ ……まだ落ちるなっ！」: I blew it! ...Don't go down yet!
BMD\t「完全に破壊するまで、安心するなよ……！」: Don't relax till it's fully destroyed...!
BMD\t「いい手札だ……/ だが、こちらの手は知るまい……！」: A good hand.../　But you don't know mine...!
BMD\t「ぐ……アルト、あと少しもたせろ……！」: Ngh... Alt, hold out a little longer...!
BMD\t「もろい……！/ くっ……機動性があったところで！」: Fragile...!/　Ngh... What good is mobility...!
BMD\t「速い機体はすぐこうなるか……！/ ちっ……！」: Fast machines always end up like this...!/　Tch...!
BMD\t「このままでは、本当に幽霊になるな……。/ 笑い話にもならん……！」: At this rate, I'll really be a ghost.../　That's not even funny...!
BMD\t「さすがにもらいすぎか！/ だが、ジガン……まだ動けよ……！」: Took too many hits after all!/　But Jigan... keep moving...!
LDBI\t「わ、私の……私のせいなんです……@ 私がミッテ先生のことで、動揺し: I-It's my... It's my fault...@I got shaken up over Professor Mitte, and...
LDBI\t「エルデ・ミッテ……@ 私が士官学校にいた頃の……講師で……@ <Ｔ: Erde Mitte... She was a lecturer...@back when I was at the officer academy...@She arranged the architecture of the <ＴＣ‐ＯＳ>...
LDBI\t「あ、あの人が……@ ツェントル・プロジェクトに参加していて……@: F-For her to be...@part of the Tsentr Project...@and piloting the Medius, no less...
LDBI\t「せ、先生は……知っていて……@ 今まで私達を……う、うう……」: Sh-She knew... all along...@and all this time she was... Uuh...
LDBI\t「それなのに……私は……@ 私のせいでヒューゴが……ヒューゴが……！: And yet... I...@Because of me, Hugo... Hugo...!!
LDBI\t「だけど……だけど……@ ヒューゴは身体が……限界が近いって……」: But... but...@Hugo said his body... was close to its limit...
LDBI\t「ヒューゴ少尉の身体に何が……？」: What's wrong with Lieutenant Hugo's body...?
LDBI\t「……イェッツトとの戦いで彼は瀕死の重傷を負った。@ そして、彼の身: ...He was mortally wounded fighting the Jetzt.@He was then handed over to the Tsentr Project,@which had ties to that monster...
LDBI\t「失った部分は、ミタール・ザパトによって補われた」: What he'd lost was replaced by Mitar Zapad.
LDBI\t「しかも、人工骨にはラズムナニウムと思しき物が@ 投入されていたの」: What's more, his artificial bones had been@infused with what appeared to be Lazmnanium.
LDBI\t「少尉がいつも服用していた薬は、拒絶反応を抑え、@ ラズムナニウムの: The pills he always took suppressed rejection@and slowed the Lazmnanium's activity...@And only Dr. Zapad could formulate them.
LDBI\t「おそらく、彼はヒューゴ少尉を@ ラズムナニウムの実験台にしていたの: I believe he was using Lieutenant Hugo@as a test subject for Lazmnanium...
LDBI\t「で、でも、薬がなくなったら……？」: B-But what happens if the medicine runs out...?
LDBI\t「全身がラズムナニウムに侵蝕されて、死に至る……@ ヒューゴ少尉の身: The Lazmnanium would consume his whole body,@and he would die... His very body was@the shackle binding him.
LDBI\t「そ、そんなこと……私には一言も……」: H-He never said a word about that to me...
LDBI\t「お前に余計な気を遣わせたり、@ 心配を掛けたくなかったからだろう…: He probably didn't want you fussing over him@or worrying about him...
LDBI\t「だ、だからって……そんな重要なことを……」: B-But even so... something that important...
LDBI\t「……ガイアセイバーズとの一件で薬の入手が@ ままならなくなり……あ: ...After the incident with the Gaia Savers, he@couldn't get any more medicine... He only had@about 10 days' worth left.
LDBI\t「イティイティ島に着いたら、@ 俺は奴をＴＥアブゾーバーから降ろすつ: Once we reached Iti Iti Island, I intended to@take him off the TE Absorber. I also urged him@to tell Aqua the truth, but...
LDBI\t「ヒューゴは……島に到着したら、@ 本当の事情を話すと言っていました: Hugo... said he'd tell me everything@once we reached the island...
LDBI\t「あの人が、私にシミュレーター訓練をやらせたり、@ ＴＥリミッター解: Making me do simulator training, talking about@releasing the TE Limiter... He did all that@because he didn't have much time left...
LDBI\t「いや……無理にでも奴を降ろすべきだった……。@ これは俺の責任だ…: No... I should've grounded him, even by force...@This is on me...
LDBI\t「少し……一人にさせてもらえませんか……」: Could you... leave me alone for a while...
LDBI\t（どうして……どうして、ミッテ先生が……@ 何故、あの人は私を……？: (Why... Why Professor Mitte...@Why did she... do that to me...?)
LDBI\t（わからない……色んなことがあり過ぎて……）: (I don't understand... So much has happened...)
LDBI\t「……このＴＥアブゾーバーは、@ もう使い物になりませんわね」: ...This TE Absorber is@beyond salvaging, I'm afraid.
LDBI\t「やはり……妙ですわね」: Just as I thought... Something is odd.
LDBI\t「損傷部分……特に胴体部をご覧なさい。@ 四肢は相当の衝撃を受け、ひ: Look at the damage... the torso in particular.@The limbs took heavy impacts and are mangled,@yet these wounds look as if cut clean away...
LDBI\t「さらに、ＴＥエンジンも@ モジュールごと持って行かれています」: What's more, the TE Engine has been taken@along with its entire module.
LDBI\t「もしや、それが目的で……」: Could that have been their goal...?
LDBI\t「ＴＥエンジンはツェントル・プロジェクト側にも@ 存在しているでしょ: The Tsentr Project side surely has TE Engines@of its own. If they meant to capture the unit,@that would be one thing, but...
LDBI\t「何故、あの場でエンジンを取り込んだか。@ しかも、ヒューゴ少尉ごと: Why absorb the engine then and there?@And Lieutenant Hugo along with it...
LDBI\t「この結果は、向こう側でも@ 予期していなかったのではないか……@: I suspect this outcome was something@even the other side didn't anticipate...@That is my view.
LDBI\t「メディウス・ロクスが進化を成し遂げたにも@ 関わらず、ろ獲も撃墜も: Medius Locus evolved, and yet it could neither@capture nor shoot down the unit... So you mean@the result was a half-measure?
LDBI\t「それに、ここまで追い詰めておきながら、@ 撤退した理由が解せん。何: And after pushing us this far, why pull out?@Doesn't add up. Was something malfunctioning?
LDBI\t「アクア少尉だけが生き残ったのも、@ ＴＥエンジンを奪取したのも、向: Lieutenant Aqua surviving alone, and the theft@of the TE Engine... Both may well have been@unexpected for them.
LDBI\t「意外も何も、メディウスを操縦していたのは@ アルベロ少佐ですよ。ア: Unexpected? Major Albero was the one piloting@the Medius. Lieutenant Aqua aside, he wouldn't@take the TE Engine without meaning to...
LDBI\t「ラズムナニウムというファクターを踏まえて@ 考えてみなさい」: Think about it with Lazmnanium@factored in.
LDBI\t「あれはダメージを修復するだけでなく、@ メディウス・ロクスの形状、: It did more than repair damage. It drastically@altered Medius Locus's form, size, and even@its characteristics.
LDBI\t「つまり、<マシンセル>と同等の力を……@ 侵蝕支配機能までも有して: What if it rivals the <マシンセル>...@even down to the ability to infest and control?
LDBI\t「あ、ああ……@ ヒューゴ少尉の身体から検出された@ ラズムナニウム: Y-Yeah...@The Lazmnanium detected in Lieutenant Hugo's@body showed signs of that...
BMD\t「汚名は我が剣で振り払う！」: I'll clear my name with my sword!
BMD\t「貴様らに万悪を断つ気概はあるか！」: Do you have the resolve to cleave all evil?!
BMD\t「己の快楽のために剣を振るうとは！」: You wield a sword for your own pleasure?!
BMD\t「悪逆無道の剣、許すまじ！」: I will not forgive so villainous a sword!
BMD\t「師に代わり、俺が制裁を下す！」: In my master's stead, I will punish you!
BMD\t「怒濤の剣にて迅雷を制す！」: My surging sword will tame the thunder!
BMD\t「魂宿らぬ機忍など！」: A soulless machine ninja is nothing!
BMD\t「何度俺に挑もうが、結果は同じだ！」: No matter how often you challenge me,/　the result will be the same!
BMD\t「エグレッタ！ 地の底へ還れ！」: Egretta! Return to the depths below!
BMD\t「エグレッタ……/ 今一度、引導を渡してくれる！」: Egretta.../　I'll send you to your end once more!
BMD\t「如何に空を駆けようと！」: No matter how you soar through the sky!
BMD\t「メディウス・ロクス……いざ尋常に勝負！」: Medius Locus.../　Face me in a fair duel!
BMD\t「メディウス・ロクス……/ 如何に変化を遂げようと！」: Medius Locus.../　No matter how you transform!
BMD\t「その銃斧ごと打ち砕く！」: I'll smash you along with that gun-axe!
BMD\t「黒き凶鳥よ、いざ尋常に勝負！」: Black bird of ill omen, face me fairly!
BMD\t「超魔装機……相手にとって不足なし！」: A Super Masouki... A worthy opponent!
BMD\t「ラ・ギアスの人機よ、いざ！」: War machine of La Gias, have at you!
BMD\t「魔装機に後れは取らん！」: I won't fall behind a Masouki!
BMD\t「俺もこの地で果てるわけにはいかぬ……！」: Nor can I meet my end in this land...!
BMD\t「土塊の魔物など蹴散らしてくれる！」: I'll scatter these monsters of clay!
BMD\t「ヴォルクルス……破邪の剣にて貴様を断つ！」: Volkruss.../　My demon-slaying sword will cleave you!
BMD\t「行く手を阻むか、破滅の軍勢……！」: You'd bar my path, army of ruin...!
BMD\t「ルイーナ……/ 貴様らなどに臆する俺ではない！」: Ruina.../　I won't cower before the likes of you!
BMD\t「ガルベルス……/ その居場所は、冥府こそが相応しい！」: Garberus.../　The underworld is where you belong!
BMD\t「ツェントル・プロジェクトの真髄……/ この俺に示してみよ！」: The essence of the Tsentr Project.../　Show it to me!
BMD\t「エルデ・ミッテ！/ その妄執、我が剣で断つ！」: Erde Mitte!/　My sword will sever your obsession!
BMD\t「邪念に染まりし羊水は、消散すべし！」: Amniotic fluid stained with malice/　must be dispersed!
BMD\t「厭客は立ち所に去るべし！」: Unwelcome guests should leave at once!
BMD\t「妖怪変化は散滅すべし！」: Ghouls and specters shall be destroyed!
BMD\t「物の怪など、立ち所に屠ってくれる！」: I'll slay these demons on the spot!
BMD\t「四神の超機人、相手にとって不足なし！」: A Choukijin of the Four Gods!/　A worthy opponent!
BMD\t「四神と言えど、人界に仇なすのならば！」: Four Gods or not,/　if you threaten the human world...!
BMD\t「朱雀の超機人よ、いざ参る！」: Choukijin of Suzaku, here I come!
BMD\t「行くぞ、玄武の超機人！」: Here I come, Choukijin of Genbu!
BMD\t「己を取り戻せ、虎王機よ！」: Come back to your senses, KoOhKi!
BMD\t「お前は我らと共に人界の敵と戦ってきた。/ そのことを思い出すのだ！」: You fought beside us against/　the enemies of mankind./　Remember that!
BMD\t「我が剣にて、四凶を討つ！」: My sword shall slay the Four Fiends!
BMD\t「寇を斬り、凶を滅す！」: Slay the invader, destroy the fiend!
BMD\t「饕餮王、/ お前にも食らえぬ物があることを知れ！」: TotetsuOh,/　learn some things even you can't devour!
BMD\t「クストース……/ 我が眼前に立ち塞がるのであれば！」: Custos.../　If you would stand in my way!
BMD\t「我が前に立ち塞がる者は、/ たとえ神であっても斬り捨てる！」: Whoever stands in my way,/　even a god, I will cut down!
BMD\t「我はゼンガー！ ゼンガー・ゾンボルト！/ 魔人祖を断つ剣なり！」: I am Sänger! Sänger Sombold!/　The sword that cleaves/　the Demon Progenitor!
BMD\t「ユーゼス！ 貴様の輪廻は閉塞し、/ ここに潰えることになる！」: Euzeth! Your cycle of rebirth is closed,/　and here it shall end!
BMD\t「よかろう！ この勝負、受けて立つ！！」: Very well! I accept this challenge!!
BMD\t「妖機人に食いつかれるとはな」: Getting caught by a Yokijin, huh.
BMD\t「光龍、貴様などに！」: Koryu, I won't fall to the likes of you!
BMD\t「見え透いたモーションだったな」: That motion was far too obvious.
BMD\t「あいにくだが、俺には通じん！」: Sorry, but that won't work on me!
BMD\t「お前が仕掛けた時から、/ この結果は決まっていた」: The moment you made your move,/　this outcome was decided.
BMD\t「心を平静に保てば、造作もないことだ」: Keep your mind calm,/　and it's child's play.
BMD\t「この運動性、反応速度……/ 名機と言われるだけある」: This mobility, this response time.../　It lives up to its reputation.
BMD\t「以前より運動性が向上しているのでな」: Its mobility's improved since last time.
BMD\t「伊達に空を飛んでいるわけじゃない」: I don't fly just for show.
BMD\t「お前に狩られるつもりはない」: I've no intention of becoming your prey.
BMD\t「ゼゼーナン、お前では無理だ！」: Zezenan, you're not up to this!
BMD\t「ルイーナなどにやられるか！」: As if I'd fall to the Ruina!
BMD\t「ふん、見かけ倒しだな」: Hmph. All show and no substance.
BMD\t「超機人にやられるわけにはいかん」: I can't afford to fall to a Choukijin.
BMD\t「四凶などと……名ばかりか」: The Four Fiends... in name only?
BMD\t「俺を取り込めると思うな！」: Don't think you can absorb me!
BMD\t「ユーゼス、それがお前の力か！」: Euzeth, so this is your power!
BMD\t「悪いが、こういう備えがあるのでな」: Sorry, but I came prepared for this.
BMD\t「ジャマーの力だ。惜しかったな」: That's the Jammer's power. Nice try.
BMD\t「平静を失った結果がこれか……」: So this is what comes/　of losing your composure...
BMD\t「回避し損なったようだな」: Looks like you failed to dodge.
BMD\t「カーラ、後は任せろ！」: Carla, leave the rest to me!
BMD\t「よくやった、カーラ。充分な牽制だ」: Well done, Carla. That kept them pinned.
BMD\t「ブリット、後は俺に任せろ！」: Bullet, leave the rest to me!
BMD\t「下がれ、タスク。後は俺の仕事だ！」: Fall back, Tasuku. The rest is my job!
BMD\t「俺に後始末をさせるとはな……」: Leaving me to clean up the mess...
BMD\t「リム、後は俺が！」: Rim, leave the rest to me!
BMD\t「まだこちらには余裕があるのでな！」: I've still got room to spare!
BMD\t「目に物見せてやるぜ！」: I'll show you what I've got!
BMD\t「誰にも手は出させねえ……/ てめえは俺の獲物だ！」: Nobody else lays a hand on you.../　You're my prey!
BMD\t「何だ、あいつ……子供じゃねえか！」: What the... That's just a kid!
BMD\t「小娘が……調子に乗るなよ！/ 痛い目見せてやるぜ！」: Don't get cocky, little girl.../　I'll teach you a painful lesson!
BMD\t「子供が……戦場を遊びとはき違えんな！/ 尻尾巻いて逃げ帰んな！」: Kid... A battlefield's no playground!/　Tuck your tail and run on home!
BMD\t「地上のメカかよ……/ まったく、風変わりな。妙な趣味してやがるぜ」: A surface machine?/　Weird. Talk about strange taste.
BMD\t「何なんだろうな、あいつは。/ そこまで人型にこだわる理由がわかんねぇ: What's with that thing?/　Why's it so hung up on being humanoid?
BMD\t「てめえ、戦場を遊び場と勘違いしてねえか！？/ 思い知らせてやるぜ！」: Think a battlefield's a playground!?/　I'll set you straight!
BMD\t「シュウ・シラカワ……油断ならねえ相手だぜ。/ 気を引き締めてかからね: Shu Shirakawa... Can't let my guard down./　Gotta stay sharp for this one.
BMD\t「ちっ、噂のグランゾンかよ。/ 相手にとって不足はねぇ、行くぜっ！」: Tch, the infamous Granzon, huh?/　A worthy opponent! Here I come!
BMD\t「てめえら、色々と画策してるみてぇだがな、/ 世の中そう簡単にいくと思: You lot are scheming plenty, but if you/　think the world works that easy,/　you're dead wrong!
BMD\t「紅蓮のサフィーネかよ。/ いい女らしいが、性格に難あり、だな」: Saphine the Crimson, huh?/　Hot, but her personality needs work.
BMD\t「確か、あいつにゃ賞金がかかってたよな？/ いいボーナスじゃねえか、い: Didn't she have a bounty on her head?/　Nice bonus! I'll take it!
BMD\t「サフィーネ、/ てめえなんぞと遊んでる暇はねえんだ！/ さっさと終わ: Saphine,/　I don't have time to play with you!/　Let's wrap this up!
BMD\t「地上人め、一泡吹かせてやるぜ！」: You're in for a shock, surface dweller!
BMD\t「お前らは手を貸す陣営を間違えたんだよ！」: You picked the wrong side to help!
BMD\t「しゃしゃり出てくるんじゃねえよ、/ 地上人が！」: Don't go butting in,/　surface dweller!
BMD\t「地上の奴らに、/ これ以上好きにはやらせねえぜ！」: No more letting the surface dwellers/　do as they please!
BMD\t「なるほどな、こいつぁ確かに上物だ！」: I see. This one's top-grade, all right!
BMD\t「サイバスター！ 目に物見せてやるぜ！」: Cybuster! I'll show you what I've got!
BMD\t「魔装機神サイバスター……/ ぶっ潰してやるぜ！」: The Masoukishin Cybuster.../　I'll smash it to pieces!
BMD\t「サイバスターをやったとなりゃ、/ 俺の株も急上昇ってもんよ！/ さあ: Take down Cybuster, and my stock/　goes through the roof!/　Here I go!
BMD\t「魔装機神、魔装機神って、うるせえんだよ！/ 機体の性能だけで勝てると: Enough with the Masoukishin crap!/　Specs alone won't win you this fight!
BMD\t「魔装機神なんつっても、無敵じゃねえんだ！/ 攻撃し続けりゃ、こっちの: Masoukishin or not, it ain't invincible!/　Keep hitting it and I'll get my chance!
BMD\t「ガッデスか……魔装機神の中じゃ、格下だな」: Gaddess, huh.../　Bottom of the Masoukishin ladder.
BMD\t「魔装機神ガッデスね……/ ま、悪くねぇ機体だが！」: The Masoukishin Gaddess, huh.../　Well, it's not a bad machine, but!
BMD\t「おっと、グランヴェールか。/ あいつの攻撃力は厄介だからな。/ 早め: Whoa, it's Granveil./　Its firepower's a real pain./　Better finish this fast.
BMD\t「いくら攻撃力の高いグランヴェールでも、/ 先に倒しちまえば怖くねえの: Granveil may hit hard, but if I take it/　down first, there's nothing to fear!
BMD\t「グランヴェールの弱点は、その装甲の低さ……/ なら、先制攻撃が一番だ: Granveil's weak spot is its thin armor.../　So striking first is the way to go!
BMD\t「そんな杭打ち機で何しようってんだ？」: What's that pile driver gonna do, huh?
BMD\t「ご大層なマシンに乗りやがって！」: Riding around in such a fancy machine!
BMD\t「地上の戦艦か！ いい的だぜ！」: A surface battleship! Nice big target!
BMD\t「色んなものが混ざってやがんな、あいつは！」: That thing's a hodgepodge of all sorts!
BMD\t「さあて、俺の番だな。覚悟しろよ」: Well now, my turn. Get ready.
BMD\t「じゃ、俺の番だな。行くぜっ！」: Then it's my turn. Here I go!
BMD\t「俺とやり合おうってんなら、覚悟を決めな！」: If you wanna tangle with me, be ready!
BMD\t「まだ俺の番が残ってんだぜ！」: I've still got my turn left!
BMD\t「なっ！？ 嘘だろ！？ この俺が……」: Wha!? No way!? Me, of all people...
BMD\t「馬鹿な、やられた！？」: No way... I got taken down!?
BMD\t「うおっ！？/ こ、この……こいつは予想外だったぜ」: Whoa!?/　Wh-Why you... Didn't see that coming.
BMD\t「やべぇ……調子に乗りすぎたか？」: Crap... Did I get too cocky?
BMD\t「ぐあっ！！/ や、やりやがったな……/ だが、まだ負けてねぇ！」: Gah!!/　Y-You'll pay for that.../　But I ain't beat yet!
BMD\t「ぐううっ……！/ グランゾン相手に、/ まともにやり合うのは不利か…: Guhhh...!/　Going toe-to-toe with the Granzon/　is a losing game...!
BMD\t「うああっ！！ くそっ！/ サ、サフィーネなんぞにいいようにされて……: Uwaah!! Damn it!/　Getting pushed around by S-Saphine...!
BMD\t「地上人なんぞに/ やられるわけにはいかねえんだよ！！」: I can't lose to some/　surface dweller!!
BMD\t「ち、地上人め……侮り過ぎたぜ……！」: D-Damn surface dweller.../　I underestimated you...!
BMD\t「地上でそれなりの/ 修羅場をくぐってきたみてぇだな……！」: Looks like you've been through/　some real hell up on the surface...!
LDBI\t「ありがとう、イルイ。@ ……悪かったな、付き合ってもらって」: Thanks, Irui.@...Sorry for making you stick around.
LDBI\t「ううん……。@ でも、どうして、こんなに大変なトレーニングを？」: It's okay...@But why are you doing such hard training?
LDBI\t「まあ……ちょっとね。@ さて、もう時間だな。格納庫に行くか」: Well... I've got my reasons.@Anyway, it's about time. Let's head to the hangar.
LDBI\t「外装の作業は、ほぼ終わりました。@ 後はシステムＬＩＯＨの最終調整: The exterior work is nearly finished.@All that's left is the final tuning@of System LIOH.
LDBI\t「いよいよ完成か……@ 機体の色を白くしたのは、やっぱりいいな。@: So it's finally done...@Going with white for the paint job was smart.@It really shakes off that Jinrai image.
LDBI\t「とは言え、あいつのちぎれたＲＡＭマントを@ 流用しているけどな」: Mind you, we're still reusing that thing's@torn RAM mantle.
LDBI\t「マフラーみたいで格好いいですよ。@ それで、もう動かせるんですか？: It looks cool, like a scarf.@So, can it move yet?
LDBI\t「ああ。ゼンガー少佐が戻り次第、@ 起動テストを行う予定だ。ダブルＧ: Yeah. Once Major Sänger gets back, we'll run@a startup test. Nobody's more used to pairing@Double G with the DML system than him...
LDBI\t「初期段階のデータ取りに協力してもらう」: He'll help us gather the early-stage data.
LDBI\t「そうですか……。@ ところで、ミナキ。こいつの新しい名前は@ もう: I see...@By the way, Minaki. Have you decided on@a new name for this thing yet?
LDBI\t「俺に案がある。ライジンってのはどうかな？」: I've got an idea. How about Raijin?
LDBI\t「敵だったジンライが、味方になったから……という@ 意味も込められて: It's also meant to say Jinrai went from enemy@to ally, you know. Plus, its attacks now use@the Plasma Converter...
LDBI\t「あの……実は、俺もこいつの新しい名前を@ 考えてたんですけど……」: Um... Actually, I've been thinking@of a new name for it too...
LDBI\t「ああ。@ システムＬＩＯＨで動くから、ライオウ……@ “雷”に鳳凰: Sure.@It runs on System LIOH, so... RaiOh.@'Rai' for thunder, and 'Oh' for phoenix.
LDBI\t「ライオウ……そのまんまだねぇ」: RaiOh... That's pretty on the nose.
LDBI\t「あの……全然、捻ってないですけど」: Um... That doesn't have any twist at all.
LDBI\t「トウマ、鳳凰の“凰”は雌を意味しますが……」: Touma, the 'Oh' kanji for phoenix means@the female bird...
LDBI\t「ええ、“鳳”の方が雄です」: Yes. The male one is written as 'Ho.'
LDBI\t「なら、“鳳”で……それじゃ、ライホウか。@ まあ、そこはライオウと: Then we'll use 'Ho'... which makes it RaiHo.@Well, we'll just say it's read 'RaiOh.'
LDBI\t「じゃあ、決まりだな。@ 今日からこいつはジンライじゃなく、雷鳳だ」: Then it's settled.@As of today, this guy's not Jinrai. It's RaiOh.
LDBI\t「問い合わせてみましょう」: Let's find out what's going on.
LDBI\t（鋼龍戦隊が@ まだ戻って来ていないってのに……！）: (And the Steel Dragons@aren't even back yet...!)
LDBI\t「この基地のことが知られたんでしょうか……？」: Could they have found out about this base...?
LDBI\t「いや、そう簡単には……」: No, it wouldn't be that easy...
LDBI\t「いえ、今のところは。ここも外れでは？」: None so far. Is this another miss?
LDBI\t「フン……@ 最初から<ＭＡＰＷ>を使えれば、楽なのだがな」: Hmph...@If we could use the <ＭＡＰＷ> from the start,@this would be easy.
LDBI\t「ええ、まったく。何であれを先に降ろすんです？」: Tell me about it. Why drop those first?
LDBI\t「デルタ・セイバーは失態続きだからな。@ ここで大きな成果が欲しいん: Delta Saber's had one blunder after another.@They want a big win here.
LDBI\t「それに付き合って、@ 貧乏くじを引かされるのは御免ですよ」: I'd rather not get stuck with the short@straw for their sake.
LDBI\t「なら、さっさと荷物を降ろせ。@ どんな扱いをしようが、文句を言わん: Then hurry up and drop the cargo.@However you treat them, they never complain.@That's their selling point.
LDBI\t「せいぜい当たりを引いてくれよ。@ ……我々は現空域より離脱する」: Let's hope they hit the jackpot.@...We're withdrawing from this airspace.
LDBI\t「目標アルファより、量産型ジンライが降下！@ 数は９！」: Mass-Production Jinrai dropping from Target@Alpha! Count: 9!
LDBI\t「目標アルファより、量産型ジンライが降下！@ 数は１２！」: Mass-Production Jinrai dropping from Target@Alpha! Count: 12!
LDBI\t「厄介な連中が……しかも、偽装滑走路の上に……！」: Those pests... And right on top of@the camouflaged runway...!
LDBI\t「このままでは、@ 基地の存在が知られかねません……！」: At this rate, they could discover@the base...!
LDBI\t「何とかやり過ごせればいいが……」: If only we could just wait them out...
LDBI\t「目標群が地表部を攻撃！@ か、滑走路の昇降装置が露出しました！」: Targets attacking the surface!@Th-The runway elevator's been exposed!
LDBI\t「くっ！ やむを得ん、迎撃機を出せ！@ 鋼龍戦隊は、あとどれぐらいで: Damn! No choice. Launch interceptors!@How long until the Steel Dragons get back!?
LDBI\t「直行コースならば、約２０分です！」: About 20 minutes on a direct course!
LDBI\t「それまで、何としても持ち堪えねば……」: We have to hold out until then, no matter what...
LDBI\t「クルト艦長、トウマ・カノウから通信です！@ 彼は、改修されたジンラ: Captain Kurt, transmission from Touma Kanou!@He's aboard the modified Jinrai!
LDBI\t「トウマ・カノウです！@ 俺を雷鳳で出させて下さい！」: This is Touma Kanou!@Let me sortie in RaiOh!
LDBI\t「生まれ変わったジンライの名です！@ こいつなら、量産型ジンライを上: It's the name of the reborn Jinrai!@With this, I might be able to draw@the Mass-Production Jinrai away!
LDBI\t「僕達はエネルギーの補給にこんな手間は@ 掛けていなかったが……悪く: We never went to this much trouble just to@resupply our energy... but it's not bad.@I like this liquid.
LDBI\t「必殺のクスハ汁じゃねえか！？」: Isn't that the lethal Kusuha Juice!?
LDBI\t「……僕がクスハ少尉にお願いして、@ 作ってもらったんです。スーパー: ...I asked Lieutenant Kusuha to make it for me.@She said it was the super-mild version, but...
LDBI\t「お前……結局、挑戦したのか」: You... You actually went and tried it?
LDBI\t「ええ……噂とは違い、美味でした」: Yes... Unlike the rumors, it was delicious.
LDBI\t「誰かが飲んで確かめたらええねん」: Somebody just has to drink it and find out.
LDBI\t「じゃあ、言い出しっぺのてめえがやれよ」: Then you do it. You're the one who said it.
LDBI\t「お？ もしかして、ビビってんのか？」: Huh? Don't tell me you're scared?
LDBI\t「言うたな！ ほな、飲んだるわい！」: You asked for it! Fine, I'll drink it!
LDBI\t「てっきり、ぶっ倒れるものかと……」: I figured you'd keel right over...
LDBI\t「めっちゃ苦いけど、倒れる程やないな」: It's crazy bitter, but not enough@to knock me out.
LDBI\t「じゃあ、@ ホントにスーパーマイルド・バージョンか……」: So it really is@the super-mild version...
LDBI\t「で、でも、それを美味しいっていう@ イングとウェントスさんって……: B-But if Ing and Ventus think that's@delicious, then...
LDBI\t「……味覚は変ね、間違いなく」: ...Their taste buds are off,@no doubt about it.
LDBI\t「あっ、グラキエースさん、また……」: Ah, Glacies, you did it again...
LDBI\t「……ああしてると、まるで子供みたい……」: ...Seeing her like that, she's like a child...
LDBI\t「見た目はプレシアの方がずっと幼いのにね。@ そういうプレイ？」: Even though Precia looks way younger.@Is it some kind of role-play?
LDBI\t「プレイって……どういう意味でございますの？」: Role-play... Whatever do you mean by that?
LDBI\t「やめなさい、サフィーネ。@ シャイン王女に変なことを教えないで」: Stop it, Saphine.@Don't teach Princess Shine weird things.
LDBI\t「プレシアちゃん、お母さんみたいね」: Precia, you're just like her mom.
LDBI\t「私と彼女がどう見えるのかわからないが……@ 私は作られてから、わず: I don't know how she and I look to you...@but I was created only a short time ago.
LDBI\t「生まれた日のことだ。@ 人間は毎年、その日が来る度にお祝いをする」: The day you were born.@People celebrate it every year when it comes.
LDBI\t「生まれた日……わからないな」: The day I was born... I don't know.
LDBI\t「まあ、人によると思うけど……」: Well, I guess it depends on the person...
LDBI\t「大切と言うか、@ みんなが祝ってくれるのが嬉しいんです」: It's not so much that it's important...@it's just nice when everyone celebrates you.
LDBI\t「誕生日がわからないなら、決めちゃえば？@ デスピニスもそうだったし: If you don't know your birthday, just pick one!@That's what Despinis did.
LDBI\t「私は……フィオナさん達に引き取られた日が@ 誕生日になったんです…: Mine... became the day Fiona and the others@took me in...
LDBI\t「だったら、アニキ……あの日にしようよ。@ ウェンとラキがあたし達の: Then, Bro... let's make it that day.@The day Wen and Raki came to us.
LDBI\t「うん、わかってる……。@ でも、クリスもそうすると思うから……」: Yeah, I know...@But I think Chris would do the same...
LDBI\t「オペレーション・アイスブレイカーの@ 発動時刻が変更されました。２: The start time for Operation Icebreaker@has been changed. It's moved up two hours...@to 0800 today.
LDBI\t「結界……メリデンプルムの外に@ 機動兵器が多数出現したそうです」: The barrier... Apparently many mobile weapons@have appeared outside Meridemplum.
LDBI\t「出迎えの準備は万端ということか……」: So they're all set to welcome us...
LDBI\t「連邦軍部隊の動きは予定通りで？」: Are Federation forces moving as planned?
LDBI\t「それにしても……@ 我々の動きを知っていながら、先制攻撃を@ 仕掛: Still... It's unsettling that they haven't@struck first, even though they know@what we're doing.
LDBI\t「バラルを警戒しておるのかの」: Could they be wary of the Baral?
LDBI\t「故意に我々を引き入れるつもりかも知れません」: They may intend to draw us in deliberately.
LDBI\t「オペレーション・アイスブレイカーに@ 参加する者達を糧とし、それに: They'd feed on those taking part in@Operation Icebreaker, and use that to awaken@the "King of Ruin"...
LDBI\t「メリオルエッセの言葉によれば、@ 強者が絶望した時、彼らにとって@: According to the Meliores Esse,@when the strong fall into despair, they give off@waves of a quality their kind finds ideal.
LDBI\t「つまり、おれ達は最適な餌だというわけか。@ それに、メリオルエッセ: So we're the perfect bait, then.@And if even the Meliores Esse can be fed on,@that makes it all the worse.
LDBI\t「どちらに転んでも、“破滅の王”が@ 目覚める可能性があるということ: Either way, the "King of Ruin"@could still awaken...
LDBI\t「ともかく……作戦開始２時間前までに@ 配置に付くよう、各員に伝達し: In any case... please inform all personnel@to take position two hours before it begins.
LDBI\t（オペレーション・アイスブレイカー……@ 打ち砕かなければならないの: (Operation Icebreaker...@What we must shatter isn't just the ice...)
LDBI\t「そう言や、あんた……@ ゼオルートのおっさんの後輩だったっけ。@: Come to think of it, you were...@one of old man Zeoroot's juniors,@back at the officers' academy, right?
LDBI\t「シュウと戦って……逝っちまったよ」: He fought Shu... and he died.
LDBI\t「俺がお前らと地上で出会う前の話だけどな」: That was before I met you guys@on the surface, though.
LDBI\t（そういう事情もあって、@ マサキはシラカワ博士を……）: (So that's why Masaki feels that way@about Dr. Shirakawa...)
LDBI\t「シュテドニアスの連中を見つけたようだな！@ 出撃しようぜ！」: Looks like they found the Schtedonias forces!@Let's sortie!
LDBI\t「ここでの勝敗は決しつつあるな。@ 奴らを仕留めれば、昇進も夢ではな: The outcome here is nearly decided.@Take them out, and promotion is within reach.
LDBI\t「これでは多勢に無勢……@ だが、ここで我らが敵を食い止めねば、@: We're hopelessly outnumbered...@But if we don't hold the enemy here,@Prince Feil's operation will...!
LDBI\t「ちっ、奴らがここまで！@ ジェスハ将軍の敗走が響いたか！」: Tch, they've made it this far!@General Jesuha's rout is costing us!
LDBI\t「あれは地上人の戦艦ハガネ……@ それに、ザムジードも」: That's the surfacers' battleship Hagane...@And Zamzeed, too.
LDBI\t「オールト将軍ですね？@ 後は私達が何とかします。@ そちらはいった: General Oort, I presume?@We'll handle the rest.@Please fall back for now.
LDBI\t「いえ、我らも戦いますぞ」: No, we will fight as well.
LDBI\t「気持ちだけもらっとくぜ。@ こっちは魔装機神が３機いるからな」: Appreciate the thought.@We've got three Masouki Shin over here.
LDBI\t「だから、将軍はフェイル殿下に加勢してくれ。@ あんたもその方がいい: So go back up Prince Feil, General.@You'd rather do that anyway, right?
LDBI\t「……プレシア、ミオ、@ お前達はまだ機体に慣れちゃいねえ。@ 後ろ: ...Precia, Mio,@you two still aren't used to your units.@Stay back and focus on support.
LDBI\t「こっちも了解！@ 行くよ、ザムジード！」: Roger that here too!@Let's go, Zamzeed!
LDBI\t「魔装機神ザムジード……@ あの機体を我が方で運用できていれば……！: The Masouki Shin Zamzeed...@If only we could have put that unit to use...!
LDBI\t「ジェスハ将軍のツケがこちらに回って来たか」: So we're paying for General Jesuha's failure.
LDBI\t「各機へ！ 魔装機神が相手と言えど、@ 機先を制すれば勝機が見える！: All units! Even against a Masouki Shin,@if we seize the initiative, we can win!
LDBI\t「ここであの連中を退ければ、@ 戦局が優勢になるだけでなく、ラングラ: Drive them back here, and not only will we@gain the upper hand, we'll break the morale@of the entire Langran army! Fight hard!
LDBI\t「あともうちょっとで王都を取り戻せるんだ！@ これ以上、てめえらの好: We're this close to taking back the capital!@I'm not letting you bastards run wild anymore!
LDBI\t「……こちら側の援軍はどうした？@ 地上人の傭兵共は何をしている？」: ...What happened to our reinforcements?@What are those surfacer mercenaries doing?
LDBI\t「これで三人兄弟が全員顔見せしたってわけね」: So now all three brothers have shown up, huh?
LDBI\t「シオ・アルジャンだったな。援軍はお前だけか？」: Shio Argent, wasn't it?@Are you the only reinforcement?
LDBI\t「そうだよ。@ 本当は来たくなかったけど、シエンヌに@ 言われたから: Yep.@I didn't really want to come, but Sienne@told me to, so I had no choice.
LDBI\t「おじさん達の軍、何か大変みたいだし。@ シアンも適当な所で切り上げ: Your army seems to be in some kind of trouble.@Cyan said he'd bail at a good point, too,@and I'm planning to do the same.
LDBI\t「さっさと仕事をして、地上へ帰してもらいたいし。@ 僕はシエンヌ達と: I want to get the job done and get sent home.@Unlike Sienne and the others, I don't want to@stick around a place like this.
LDBI\t「あいつ、他の二人とは感じが違う……？」: That one feels different from the other two...?
LDBI\t「ギラついた所がないって言うか……@ 別の意味でひねてるわねぇ」: He's not all fired up, but...@he's twisted in a whole different way, huh?
LDBI\t「相手が誰でも、別に興味ないし。@ 面倒だから、さっさとやられちゃっ: I don't care who I'm fighting.@This is a pain, so just hurry up and lose.
LDBI\t「だったら、こんな所に@ 首を突っ込まなきゃいいじゃないのさ！」: Then you shouldn't have stuck your nose@into this in the first place!
LDBI\t「シュテドニアス軍に協力すれば、@ 地上へ戻れるって話だし」: They said if we help the Schtedonias army,@we can go back to the surface.
LDBI\t「やっぱり、そういう事情か」: Figured it was something like that.
LDBI\t「だけど、シエンヌ達は@ ここでも稼ぐつもりみたいだから、@ 僕はそ: But Sienne and the others seem to want@to make money here too,@so I'm just going along with them.
LDBI\t「ここでも……？ 地上でも傭兵をやってるのか？」: Here too...?@You work as mercenaries on the surface, too?
LDBI\t「そうじゃないけど、@ 本当のことを教える必要なんてないし。@ そも: Not really, but@I don't have to tell you the truth.@I don't want to get involved with you anyway.
LDBI\t「じゃ、坊やにはさっさとご退場願いましょっか。@ こっちは取り込み中: Then let's have the little boy make his exit.@We're kind of busy over here, okay?
LDBI\t（ああ、面倒くさいな……早く終わらせよう）: (Ugh, this is such a pain... Let's wrap it up.)
LDBI\t「くっ、奴らを食い止められんとは！@ 遺憾ながら、撤退する！」: Damn, we couldn't stop them!@Regrettably, we must retreat!

LDBI\t「良かったら、他の機体も見せてくれない？@ <パーソナルトルーパー>: Mind showing me the other units too?@Not just <パーソナルトルーパー>--I'm interested in@<アーマードモジュール> and <特機>, too.

LDBI\t「あの男の背後にガイアセイバーズがいるなら、@ 尚更です。それに、上: Especially if the Gaia Savers are behind him.@And if things go well, I may find a lead@to the truth.

LDBI\t「今、私達が置かれている状況で@ あなたという戦力が抜けてしまうのは: In our current situation, losing someone@of your strength isn't something we want,@but...
