BMD\t「そちらの動きは、既に見切っているのでな」: I've already read your every move.

BMD\t「姑息な手を使わなければ、この程度か！」: Without your dirty tricks,/　this is all you've got?!

BMD\t「く……！/ かわしているだけでは勝てん……！」: Ngh...!/　Just dodging won't win this...!
BMD\t「その図体では、/ こちらの動きについてこられまい！」: With a bulk like that,/　you can't keep up with me!

BMD\t「ちい……！ 距離を置き過ぎたか！」: Tch...! I let the distance get too wide!
BMD\t「相対速度差がありすぎるか……！」: The relative speed gap's too great...!
BMD\t「レンジ外か……ならば、距離を詰める！」: Out of range... Then I'll close in!
BMD\t「このままではベガリオンでも……！」: At this rate, even the Vegalion...!

LDBI\t「フッ……勝算があるからこそ、私はここにいる」: Heh... I am here precisely because I can win.
LDBI\t「何や、あのおっさん……ここまで追い込まれといて、@ えろう自信を持: What's with that geezer? Backed into a corner@like this, and he's still actin' all cocky.
LDBI\t「特化した戦力、つまりあなた達のような存在との@ 戦闘を想定して開発: A massive mobile weapon built to fight@specialized forces--beings like you...
LDBI\t「かつてウェンドロが乗っていた@ ディカステスを凌駕する性能を持ち、: It surpasses the Dikastes that Wendolo@once piloted, and a single unit can@suppress an entire wide-area battlefield.
LDBI\t「そ～う、ゼゼーナンの切～り札さ。@ こ～こから地球の都市を狙撃する: Tha~t's right, Zezenan's trump ca~rd.@It could even snipe Earth's cities@from ri~ght here.
LDBI\t「超大型兵器と言うからには、@ 全長５０キロメートルぐらいはあるんだ: If it's a super-large weapon, it's gotta be@about 50 kilometers long, right?
LDBI\t「ズラだかボラだか知らねえが、@ ダークブレイン以上の強さだったら@: Bran, Bonan, whatever it's called--@if it's tougher than Dark Brain,@I'll be damn surprised.
LDBI\t「こっちはここに来るまで、@ 異世界から来た連中や、仙人に妖怪共と戦: To get here, we've fought guys from another@world, hermit sages, and demons.@Some half-baked mech won't faze us.
LDBI\t「カッコいいメカだったら、写真撮るんでしょ？」: You'll snap pictures if it looks cool, right?
LDBI\t（余裕あるわね……あたし達は思っていた以上に@ とんでもない連中を相: (They're so relaxed... Maybe we were up against@far more incredible people than we thought...)
LDBI\t「その蛮勇とも言える闘争心……@ やはり、貴様ら地球の猿は危険な存在: Such resolve, bordering on reckless bravado...@As I thought, you Earth monkeys are dangerous.
LDBI\t「出たな、お前らの定番のお題目が」: Here comes your guys' usual sermon.
LDBI\t「猿と言うが、見た目は同じだ。@ さらに、地球の政治体制を批判するが: You call us monkeys, but we look just the same.@And you criticize Earth's politics, but what@you do back home isn't all that different.
LDBI\t「私は、かつて地球へ赴いた時、@ その歴史を調査した……」: When I once went to Earth,@I investigated its history...
LDBI\t「驚いたよ、ここまで愚かな種族が@ この銀河系に生存しているとはな」: I was astonished that so foolish a species@could exist in this galaxy.
LDBI\t「知っているか？@ 貴様らは何千、何万という種を@ わずかな期間で絶: Do you know?@You have driven thousands, tens of thousands of@species to extinction in a very short time.
LDBI\t「星間連合種保存法に照らし合わせれば、@ 無期刑に値する。そのような: Under the Interstellar Union's Species@Preservation Act, it merits life in prison.@We cannot grant autonomy to such lesser beings.
LDBI\t「俺達も偉そうには言えねえぜ。@ 星間連合を作り上げるまでの課程で、: We're not ones to talk.@In building the Interstellar Union, we drove@countless species to extinction.
LDBI\t「時間の問題なのだよ。@ 我らと比較にならぬ速さで他種を@ 滅亡へ追: It is only a matter of time.@They are driving other species to ruin far@faster than we ever did.
LDBI\t「そして、同族での殺し合いも続けている。@ 我らのように戦闘用バイオ: And they continue killing their own kind.@Instead of combat bioroids like ours, they wage@wars that answer blood with blood.
LDBI\t「俺達の世界でも、そのような時代はあった。@ それに、今は人間以外の: We had an era like that too. Besides, now we@just send non-human soldiers out to fight.@War itself never went away.
LDBI\t「だが、我らに比べて地球の猿共の闘争本能が@ 旺盛であることは、貴様: But surely you know the Earth monkeys'@fighting instinct is far fiercer than ours.
LDBI\t「そして、奴らの軍事技術に関する応用力は、@ 我らの予想を超えていた: And their talent for adapting military@technology exceeded our expectations.
LDBI\t「地球の猿共は、知性と力のバランスが取れていない。@ そのような連中: The Earth monkeys' intellect and power are out@of balance. If such creatures expand into our@world, they will surely disrupt its order.
LDBI\t「あたし達は、戦争をするために@ 星の海を目指してるんじゃない！」: We aren't reaching for the sea of stars@to wage war!
LDBI\t「全ての猿共がそうだと言い切れるか？@ 現に貴様らは武器を持ち、@: Can you say that of every monkey?@Even now, you have taken up arms@and gathered here, have you not?
LDBI\t「何言ってんのさ！ @ そもそも、あんた達が一方的に攻めて来たから、: What are you talking about?!@This all happened because you attacked us@out of nowhere!
LDBI\t「私は、最初から侵略戦争を意図していたわけではない。@ 交渉という手: I did not intend a war of invasion at first.@I meant to proceed through negotiation. But the@one who obstructed it... was you, Shu Shirakawa.
LDBI\t「……対等な立場での話し合いでしたら、@ 南極であのようなことをせず: ...Had you meant to talk as equals, you could@have chosen another way than what you did@in Antarctica.
LDBI\t「貴様らのような蛮族と同じ目線で@ 交渉を行うなど、あり得ん」: Negotiate on equal footing with barbarians@like you? Unthinkable.
LDBI\t「それはお前の偏見だ、ゼゼーナン。@ 地球人は、俺達と対等に話し合え: That's your prejudice talking, Zezenan.@Earthlings can talk with us as equals.@After all these battles, I've come to see that.
LDBI\t「愚かな……下等種族に感化されおったか。@ ならば、貴様も同罪だ」: Fool... You've been swayed by a lesser race.@Then you are equally guilty.
LDBI\t「あんたに言えることか、それが？」: Are you in any position to say that?
LDBI\t「色々と大義名分を並べちゃいるが、@ 本心は地球の利権を独占すること: You spout all these noble pretexts, but what@you really want is Earth all to yourself.
LDBI\t「そして、俺達を欺き、利用し、@ 挙げ句の果てに切り捨てようとした」: And you deceived us, used us,@and in the end tried to throw us away.
LDBI\t「今までは命令だから従ってきたが……@ もうあんたの言うことを聞く理: Till now I followed because they were orders...@but I've no reason or duty to listen to you now.
LDBI\t「そうよ……あなたの欲のために戦うのは@ もう止めたわ」: That's right... I'm done fighting@for your greed.
LDBI\t「セティ、ゼブ……目を掛けてやった恩を忘れおって！」: Sety, Zeb... You forget the favor I showed you!
LDBI\t「よく言うわね。都合が悪くなると@ あたし達も切り捨てるつもりだった: Look who's talking. You'd have cut us loose@too the moment we became inconvenient.@I don't feel I owe you anything.
LDBI\t「ゼブは本気で怒ると、ああなる時があるのさ」: Zeb gets like that sometimes@when he's really angry.
LDBI\t「なら、普段の喋り方は何なんですかね。@ 演技？ いわゆるキャラ立ち: Then what's with his usual way of talking?@An act? A character gimmick? Or a bit?@Is that kind of thing normal for aliens?
LDBI\t「あなたも普段のあの方を見習って、@ ゆっくり喋ってみてはどうでしょ: Perhaps you should follow his usual example@and try speaking slowly...?
LDBI\t「嫌ですよ。誰かさんとキャラが被っちゃいます。@ それにのんびり喋る: No way. I'd overlap with somebody's character.@Besides, talking all leisurely is totally@impossible for me. Right, Master?
LDBI\t「……期待はしていなかったが……@ ゼゼーナンとの戦闘は、やっぱり避: ...I didn't hold out much hope... but a fight@with Zezenan really can't be avoided, huh.@Sorry about this, Commander Lefina.
LDBI\t「貴様さえいなければ、俺とラキは同じものでいられた！@ 俺は、俺は貴: If it weren't for you, Raki and I could've@stayed the same! I... I, you... Damn it,@what is this awful feeling?!
LDBI\t「……ああ、そうだ。@ イグニス、それがお前の……お前自身の憎しみだ: ...Yes, that's right.@Ignis, that's your... your very own hatred.
LDBI\t「誰かから与えられたものでも、@ 誰かの想いを感じ取ったものでもない: Not something given to you by someone else,@nor someone else's feelings you picked up...
LDBI\t「消えたくないという想いは、@ お前の悔恨、そして死への恐怖だ」: That wish not to disappear is your regret...@and your fear of death.
LDBI\t「何だと……？ これが……これがそうなのか。@ これが……俺達が求め: What...? This... this is it?@This is what we sought... what the King of@Destruction has drawn its power from...
LDBI\t「そうか……クッ、ハ、ハハッ、俺は貴様が憎いのか。@ これが、憎悪す: I see... Heh, ha, haha! So I hate you, do I?@So this is what it means to hate.
LDBI\t「駄目だ、それでは“破滅の王”に……！」: No! Then the King of Destruction will...!
LDBI\t「変だな……ラキ……@ お前から悲しみの波動を感じるぜ……」: Strange... Raki...@I can sense waves of sorrow from you...
LDBI\t「ああ……ああ、そうだ。私は悲しい。@ お前が消えてしまう、お前が死: Yes... yes, that's right. I'm sad.@Sad that you'll disappear... that you'll die...
LDBI\t「確かに、私とお前は同じものだったのだから……」: After all, you and I truly were the same...
LDBI\t（ラキとウェンだけじゃない……@ イグニスも……人の感情を……）: (It's not just Raki and Wen...@Even Ignis... has human emotions...)
LDBI\t「……アクイラ、コンターギオ、そしてイグニス……@ お前達の滅びに、: ...Aquila, Contagio, and now Ignis...@May the King bless your destruction.
LDBI\t「悲しみの涙と赤き血は、素晴らしき美酒となり、@ 呻きと轟く絶叫は、: Tears of sorrow and crimson blood become the@finest wine; groans and thundering screams@become a splendid melody.
LDBI\t「絶望に打ちひしがれる心は、我らルイーナの糧。@ そして、幾千万の魂: Hearts broken by despair feed us, the Ruina.@Fed the hatred, fear, and death of countless@souls, the King of Destruction shall arise here.
LDBI\t「生きとし生けるもの全てを……滅びへ導くために。@ この星の破滅を以: To lead all living things to ruin...@This planet's destruction will open the path@for my King's arrival.
LDBI\t「その道とやらが、あのクロスゲートか」: And that path would be the Cross Gate?
LDBI\t「なら、クロスゲートを作ったのも@ てめえらなのかよ！？」: So you bastards made the Cross Gate@too?!
LDBI\t「あれは古から存在し、@ 大いなる破壊、破滅、滅亡を司る存在を招く門: It has existed since ancient times, a gate@that summons the being who governs great@destruction, ruin, and annihilation...
LDBI\t「我らにこの世界の知識を与えた者は、@ それをファブラ・フォレースと: The one who gave us knowledge of this world@called it Fabula Fores.
LDBI\t「そいつは俺の親父……フェリオ・ラドクリフか！？」: Was that my father... Felio Radcliffe?!
LDBI\t「真実を知ったところで、何も変わらぬよ」: Knowing the truth will change nothing.
LDBI\t（否定しなかったな……やはり……！）: (He didn't deny it... So it's true...!)
LDBI\t「クロスゲートを作ったのは、@ ルイーナじゃねえってことなのか……！: So the Ruina weren't the ones@who made the Cross Gate...?!
LDBI\t「多分……。@ 彼らは、元々存在していたものを@ 利用しただけなのか: Probably...@They might have just been using something@that already existed...
LDBI\t「じゃあ、いったい誰がクロスゲートを作って、@ こんな所に設置したん: Then who built the Cross Gate@and put it in a place like this...?!
LDBI\t「今はそんなことをとやかく言ってる場合じゃねえ！@ とっととウンブラ: This ain't the time to be arguing about that!@Let's take out Umbra quick and smash@that Cross Gate to pieces!
LDBI\t「こりゃあ、あれッスよ。@ あいつを倒したら、それがきっかけになって: You know how this goes, right?@We beat that guy, and that's the cue@for the final boss to show up...
LDBI\t「倒さずとも、“破滅の王”は現れる。@ やるなら、さっさとやった方が: The King of Destruction will come either way.@If we're doing this, better do it fast.@...Whoever plays his trump card first loses.
LDBI\t「とか言って、今までも結構切ってるような気が～」: Says the guy who's played his trump cards@plenty of times already~
LDBI\t「ここで手をこまねいている場合ではない！@ 各機、攻撃を開始しろ！」: This is no time to sit on our hands!@All units, commence attack!
LDBI\t「人よ、その短き旅路もここで終わる。@ 耐え難き絶望と恐怖の中で。@: Humans, your brief journey ends here,@amid unbearable despair and terror.@Now, offer up your blood...
LDBI\t「魂が凍り付く程の憎悪の叫びを。@ そして、その死を“破滅の王”と私: Screams of hatred that freeze the very soul.@And offer your deaths to the King of@Destruction and to me...
LDBI\t「もはや、お前とそのマシーンとて@ “破滅の王”の目覚めを止められぬ: Not even you and that machine can stop@the King of Destruction's awakening now.
LDBI\t「まだ奴はその姿を現していない！@ なら、止められるチャンスがあるっ: It hasn't shown itself yet!@That means there's still a chance to stop it!
LDBI\t「“鍵”を開けた者がお前であったなら、@ 我らの姿形は今とは違う物に: Had it been you who turned the "key,"@our forms might differ from what they are now.
LDBI\t「知る必要はない。結果は同じことよ」: You need not know. The outcome is the same.
LDBI\t「運命に抗おうと、行き着く先は虚無……@ 定められた時は、すぐそこに: Defy fate if you will; it ends in nothingness...@The appointed hour is close at hand.
LDBI\t「滅びの宿命は変えられずとも、@ そこへ至る過程は変えられる……！」: Even if our fate of ruin can't be changed,@we can change the path that leads there...!
LDBI\t「お前とて“破滅の王”を止めることは出来ぬぞ」: Not even you can stop the King of Destruction.
LDBI\t「いや、方法は一つだけある……@ ウンブラ、お前はそれを知っているは: No, there is one way...@Umbra, you should know it well.
LDBI\t「無駄だ、ウェントス。@ お前達はここに至るまで、時間を掛け過ぎた。: It's futile, Ventus.@You took far too long to get here.@It is impossible now.
LDBI\t「ならば、我が血、我が身体、我が命、我が死を@ 我が主に……！」: Then my blood, my body, my life, my death...@I offer to my master...!
LDBI\t「来たれ、我が王、“破滅の王”……！」: Come forth, my King... King of Destruction...!
LDBI\t「ヒューゴ！@ クロスゲートから物凄いエネルギー反応が！！」: Hugo!@Massive energy readings from the Cross Gate!!
LDBI\t「計測は！？ 何のエネルギーだ！？」: Readings?! What kind of energy is it?!
LDBI\t「各機、直ちにクロスゲートを破壊せよ！」: All units, destroy the Cross Gate at once!
LDBI\t「いけませんぞ、艦長！@ あの状態で破壊すれば、ファブラ・フォレース: You mustn't, Captain!@If we destroy it in that state, Fabula Fores@itself might be blown to pieces!
BMD\t「わけのわからねえことを言いやがって……！/ てめえの世界なんぞに興味: Spouting nonsense...!/　I don't care about your world!
BMD\t「終わってみなきゃ、/ 結果はわからねえぜっ！」: It ain't over till it's over,/　so don't count me out!
BMD\t「ここから巻き戻して……/ もとい、巻き返してやる！」: Time to rewind this.../　Er, I mean, turn this around!
BMD\t「後手に回るかよっ！/ ……って、回ってるか」: Like I'd fall behind!/　...Oh wait, I already have.
BMD\t「これぐらいの修羅場なら、/ 毎度のことだぜ！！」: A brawl like this/　is just business as usual!!
BMD\t「くそっ！ 絶対に生き残ってやる！」: Dammit! I'm gonna survive no matter what!
BMD\t「タンマ！ ちょっとタンマ！！」: Time out! Hold on, time out!!
BMD\t「ここで死ねるか！/ おれはあいつとの約束を守るんだっ！！」: I can't die here!/　I'm keeping my promise to her!!
BMD\t「な、何！？ フレームまで食い込んだ！？」: Wh-What!? It cut into the frame!?
BMD\t「くそっ！ リオンじゃ/ これ以上は無理か！？」: Dammit! Is this all/　the Lion can take!?
BMD\t「うわっ、ビックリオン！/ ……なんて冗談言ってる場合じゃねえ！」: Whoa, a Lion-heart attack!/　...This is no time for jokes!
BMD\t「ううっ、本当は量産機の方が強いんだぞ！/ ……え？ 乗ってる奴が悪い: Ugh, the mass-production model/　is actually stronger, you know!/　...What? The pilot's the problem?
BMD\t「ビルガー、最後まで/ 付き合ってやるからな……！！」: Bilgar, I'm sticking with you/　till the very end...!!
BMD\t「こうなったら……装甲を捨ててでもっ！！」: If it comes to it... I'll ditch the armor!!
BMD\t「ア、アルトの装甲をブチ抜くなんて……！！」: I-It punched through the Alt's armor...!!
BMD\t「ジ、ジンクス通りになってたまるかよ！！」: N-No way I'm living up to that jinx!!
BMD\t「ぐっ！ ドゥバンめ、よくも！」: Ngh! Duban, you'll pay for that!
BMD\t「さ、さすが/ アルジャン・クラスってわけかよ……！」: G-Guess that's/　the Argent Class for you...!
BMD\t「力比べじゃ、あいつに敵わねえのか……！？」: Can't I beat him in a test of strength...!?
BMD\t「ロフ！ まだ勝負は付いてねえ！」: Rof! This fight isn't over yet!
BMD\t「だ、伊達に/ “破滅の王”なんて名乗ってねえな……！」: Th-There's a reason he calls himself/　the "King of Destruction"...!
BMD\t「くっ！ ジンライの動きが見えねえ！」: Ngh! I can't see Jinrai's moves!
BMD\t「さ、さすがダブルＧってことか……！」: G-Guess that's Double G for you...!
BMD\t「こ、このままじゃ、/ あいつに喰われちまう……！」: A-At this rate,/　it's gonna eat me alive...!
BMD\t「あ、あんなのに取り込まれたら、/ ただじゃ済まねえ！」: I-If that thing absorbs me,/　I'm done for!
BMD\t「ガンエデン……おれはまだ諦めねえ！」: Gan Eden... I'm not giving up yet!
BMD\t「あ、あれ？ 思ったよりダメージが……」: Huh? That did more damage than I thought...
BMD\t「くっ！/ 落ちこぼれにだってなあ、意地はあるんだよっ！」: Ngh!/　Even a washout has his pride, you know!
BMD\t「ううっ！/ 向こうの手に乗せられちまったのか……！？」: Ugh!/　Did I fall right into their trap...!?
BMD\t「こ、これじゃ、おれの見せ場ってもんが！！」: A-At this rate, I'll never get my big moment!!
BMD\t「こ、こういう時の呪文は……/ バランガバラン……おっとっと」: Th-The magic words at a time like this.../　Balanga Balan... whoa, whoa.
BMD\t「やべえ！ これじゃいつもの展開だ！」: Crap! This is how it always goes!
BMD\t「ここまで来たんだ！ やられてたまるか！」: I've come this far! I won't go down now!
BMD\t「まだまだ！/ この程度でくたばりゃしねえぜ！」: Not yet!/　It'll take more than this to finish me!
BMD\t「くっ！ ガワが薄いからなあ、リオンは……」: Ngh! The Lion's armor is just too thin...
BMD\t「くっ！ こんなもんでビビルガー！」: Ngh! Like this'll scare the Bilgar outta me!
BMD\t「くそっ！/ ファルケンじゃ耐え切れねえか！？」: Dammit!/　Can't the Falken take it!?
BMD\t「や、やばい！/ これじゃキョウスケ中尉にどやされちまう！」: Uh-oh!/　Lieutenant Kyosuke's gonna chew me out!
BMD\t「ぐっ！ バインと当たっちまった！」: Ugh! That hit with a Hucke-BANG!
BMD\t「当たるも八卦、当たらぬもヒュッケ……/ いや、当たったって！」: Hit or miss, it's all Hucke-luck.../　No wait, that was a hit!
BMD\t「ううっ！ ガスッと当たっちまったぜ！」: Ugh! That one hit with a big thunk!
BMD\t「エグレッタ！ おれの打たれ強さを忘れたか！」: Egretta! Forgot how tough I am!?
LDBI\t「もしや、アルテウルからもたらされた@ シュンパティアの改良策か……: Could it be the Sympathia upgrade@that Arteur provided...!?
LDBI\t「フェリオ・ラドクリフが触れた@ シュンパティアの別因子は、@ “鍵: The other factor within the Sympathia@that Felio Radcliffe touched awakened@its function as the "key."
LDBI\t「“門”を開き、我の一部に直接触れたからだ」: Because he opened the "gate" and directly@touched a part of me.
LDBI\t「そして、この肉の器が所有していた知識によって、@ 我が眷属が新たな: And from the knowledge this flesh vessel held,@my kin were born anew in a new form.
LDBI\t「では、メリオルエッセは@ フェリオ・ラドクリフ教授の知識や記憶を@: Then the Meliores were created based on@Professor Felio Radcliffe's knowledge@and memories...!
LDBI\t「然り。“鍵”によって人間の心の仕組みを調べ、@ そこから効率良く負: Indeed. Using the "key," they studied the human@mind, and gained the form and power to draw out@and gather its negative waves efficiently.
LDBI\t「貴様も同じか、それは？」: And is that thing the same for you?
LDBI\t「あ、あれが“破滅の王”の本体ですの……！？」: Is th-that the true form of the "King of Ruin"...!?
LDBI\t「ああ、妖機人も真っ青だぜ……！」: Yeah, that'd make even a Yokijin turn pale...!
LDBI\t「“破滅の王”の名に相応しい、@ 醜悪な機体ね……！」: A hideous machine, worthy of the name@"King of Ruin"...!
LDBI\t「あらん、なかなか素敵だと思うけど？」: Oh my, I think it's rather lovely, don't you?
LDBI\t「んなこと言ってる場合かよ！」: Is this really the time for that!?
LDBI\t「コウタ、ＯＧセンサーを使うぞ」: Kota, I'm using the OG Sensor.
LDBI\t「やはり、そうか。ペルフェクティオの本体は、@ まだクロスゲートの向: As I thought. Perfectio's true form is@still on the other side of the Cross Gate.@So that thing is essentially its Afterimage.
LDBI\t「Ｒゲージが真っ赤っかだぜ！ 分身でこれかよ！？」: The R Gauge is totally red! And this is just@its Afterimage!?
LDBI\t「本体が出て来たら、終わりだ。@ 今の内に何としてもあれを倒し、@: If the true form emerges, it's over.@We must destroy that thing now at all costs@and seal the Cross Gate.
LDBI\t「可能性はある。@ ペルフェクティオは、過去に少なくとも@ 一度封印: It's possible. Perfectio has been sealed@at least once in the past, after all.
LDBI\t「そ、そっか！@ だから、このファブラ・フォレースが@ あるんだもん: R-Right! That's why this Fabula Fores@exists in the first place!
LDBI\t「待って下さい。@ ファブラ・フォレースを作った者達は、命と引き替え: Hold on. Didn't the builders of Fabula Fores@seal Perfectio away at the cost of@their own lives?
LDBI\t「だからって、俺達もそうなるとは限らねえ！」: That doesn't mean the same'll happen to us!
LDBI\t「ああ、この勝負……賭け甲斐がある」: Yeah. This is a bet worth making.
LDBI\t「俺が親父を……いや、ペルフェクティオを@ 止めなければ……！」: I have to stop my father... no,@Perfectio...!
LDBI\t「……ジョッシュ、命を粗末にするなよ。@ お前一人だけで何とかなる問: ...Josh, don't throw your life away.@This isn't a problem you can solve alone.
LDBI\t「そうよ、ジョッシー。@ 前にも言ったけど、一人で抱え込まないでね」: That's right, Joshy. Like I said before,@don't carry it all by yourself, 'kay?
LDBI\t「ペルフェクティオに言った通り、@ 俺もお前も、まだ人間だ。@ 人間: Like I told Perfectio, we're both@still human. We can fight him as humans.
LDBI\t「だけど、@ あたしはクリアーナ・リムスカヤじゃない……@ それに、: But...@I'm not Cliana Rimskaya...@And Chris, she...
LDBI\t「馬鹿なことを言うな！@ お前もクリスも、両方とも俺の大事な妹だ！！: Don't say such stupid things!@You and Chris are both my precious sisters!!
LDBI\t「そう……君が消えれば、クリスが悲しむ」: Yes... if you vanish, Chris will grieve.
LDBI\t「君は……いや、君達はクリアーナ・リムスカヤだ。@ そして、僕に新た: You are... no, you both are Cliana Rimskaya.@And you gave me a new life.
LDBI\t「僕も、君達にそうしたい。@ “破滅の王”を倒すことによって……」: I want to do the same for you both...@by defeating the "King of Ruin."
LDBI\t「リム……聞いてくれ。おそらく、この戦いじゃ@ 俺達のシュンパティア: Rim... listen. In this fight, our Sympathia@will probably be the key.
LDBI\t「だが、それはペルフェクティオが言う@ “鍵”じゃない……俺達のマシ: But not the "key" Perfectio talks about...@Our machines should have the power to beat him,@or at least the trigger for it.
LDBI\t「どうしようもない親父だったが……@ 俺は、あの時のメッセージを信じ: He was a hopeless father... but@I believe in the message he left back then.
LDBI\t「思い出したか。なら、俺に力を貸してくれ。@ ここが俺達の正念場だ。: You remember. Then lend me your strength.@This is our moment of truth. We have no choice.@For Chris's sake too.
LDBI\t「わかった、アニキ……あたし、やるよ。@ ここで何もしなかったら、そ: Okay, Big Bro... I'll do it.@If I did nothing here, Chris would@really be mad at me...!
LDBI\t「我は全ての宇宙と共に存在するもの。@ この肉体と同じ、自らを人と呼: I exist with all of Space. You beings who,@like this flesh, call yourselves human...@the time has come for your world to meet ruin.
LDBI\t「るせえ！ @ てめえこそ、とっとと元の世界へ戻りやがれ！」: Shut up!@Hurry up and get back to your own world!
LDBI\t「それが出来ねえってんなら、ここでブッ倒す！！」: And if you can't, I'll smash you right here!!
LDBI\t「儚き生命は寂滅すべし。@ 抗拒せず、摂理を受け入れよ」: Fleeting life must perish into stillness.@Do not resist. Accept the natural order.
LDBI\t「行くぞ、ペルフェクティオ……！@ このファブラ・フォレースから始ま: Here I come, Perfectio...!@Every calamity that began with Fabula Fores...@we'll end it here, with our own hands!
LDBI\t「“鍵”に近しい物を得てもなお、@ 我に抗うか……人間よ」: Though you hold something close to the "key,"@you still defy me... human?
LDBI\t「俺のシュンパティアは、お前を倒すための鍵だ！@ 俺はそう信じる！」: My Sympathia is the key to defeating you!@That's what I believe!
LDBI\t「ならば、その器ごと@ 恐怖と絶望の奈落へ堕ちるがいい」: Then fall, vessel and all, into the abyss@of terror and despair.
LDBI\t「お前は本来、存在し得ないもの……@ 我が生み出したも同然の虚ろな魂: You were never meant to exist...@a hollow soul all but born of me...
LDBI\t「で、でも、あたしは生きてる！@ ここに、こうやって！」: B-But I'm alive!@Right here, like this!
LDBI\t「シュンパティアは偽りの“鍵”……@ お前もまた、偽りの存在……消え: The Sympathia is a false "key"...@You too are a false being... destined to fade.
LDBI\t「あたしが何者であっても、@ クリスが戻って来るまで消えるわけには@: No matter what I am,@I can't disappear until@Chris comes back!
LDBI\t「お前も他のメリオルエッセと同じく、@ 我が糧となって滅びるがいい」: Like the other Meliores, you too shall@become my sustenance and perish.
LDBI\t「それは、かつての私の宿命……だが、今は違う。@ 私は、ジョッシュ達: That was once my fate... but not anymore.@I stand with Josh and the others...!
LDBI\t「我へ注がれる負の波動の流れ……@ そこに介在していたお前が抗うとは: The flow of negative waves pouring into me...@And you, who once mediated it, defy me now.
LDBI\t「まもなく、艦が進発する。@ ルイーナはこちらの動きに呼応するだろう: The ship will be departing shortly.@The Ruina will likely respond to our movements.@We could get sortie orders at any time.
LDBI\t「これから南極圏へ到達するまでの間、@ 各員はそれぞれの格納庫待機室: Until we reach the Antarctic Circle,@all personnel will wait in the ready rooms@of their respective hangars.
LDBI\t「……南極かぁ。いい思い出がねえんだよな」: ...Antarctica, huh? Got no good memories there.
LDBI\t「まだ新人だった頃、<南極事件>の現場にいてさ。@ グランゾンにコテ: Back when I was a rookie, I was there@for the <南極事件>.@The Granzon beat us to a pulp.
LDBI\t「あの時、サイバスターが来てくれなかったら、@ お陀仏だったぜ……」: If Cybuster hadn't shown up back then,@we'd have been goners...
LDBI\t「あの機体……フリッケライ・ガイストが@ 気になってるみたいね」: That unit... Looks like the Flickerei Geist@has caught your interest.
LDBI\t「アルトちゃんのパーツが、巡り巡って@ あの機体にくっついてるなんて: Who'd have thought some of Alt's parts would@find their way onto that unit...
LDBI\t「アクセルのソウルゲインにもぎ取られて、@ そのままだと思っていたが: I thought it was gone after Axel's Soulgain@ripped it off... I didn't know <シャドウミラー>@had recovered it.
LDBI\t「戦利品だったのかしらん。@ しかも、フリッケライ・ガイストのコアは: Maybe it was a war trophy?@And they say the Flickerei Geist's core is a@twice-recycled <アインスト> part, too...
LDBI\t「ある意味、ライン・ヴァイスちゃんや@ アルトちゃんの遠い親戚って感: So in a way, it's like a distant relative@of Rein Weiss and Alt?
LDBI\t「ライン・ヴァイスリッターと同じ所に置いて、@ 反応はないのか？」: You've kept it next to the Rein Weissritter,@and there's no reaction?
LDBI\t「ええ……龍人機も。@ 色々混ざってて、別物になっちゃってるのかもね: Nope... Not with the RyuJinKi either.@It's such a mix, maybe it's something else now.@By the way, where's its cute little pilot?
LDBI\t「イングと共に監視下にあると聞いている。@ ギリアム少佐がこちらに合: I'm told she's under guard along with Ing.@They'll be handed over once Major Gilliam@rejoins us, apparently...
LDBI\t（……あの二人、@ ＡＴＸチームのキョウスケ・ナンブ中尉と@ エクセ: (...Those two must be the ATX Team's@First Lieutenant Kyosuke Nanbu and@Second Lieutenant Excellen Browning.)
LDBI\t（鋼龍戦隊トップエースのコンビ……@ さすがの貫禄だわ）: (The Steel Dragons' top ace duo...@They really do have presence.)
LDBI\t「あらん、あなた……アクア・ケントルム少尉ね？」: Oh my... You're Lieutenant Aqua Centrum, right?
LDBI\t「えっ！？ わ、私を御存知なんですか？」: Huh!? Y-You know who I am?
LDBI\t「そりゃ、もう。@ グラビア・クイーンばりの新人さんが来たって、@: Oh, of course.@Everyone's talking about the new girl who@looks like a pinup queen.
LDBI\t（や、やっぱり、そっち系の話で……なのね）: (S-So it IS about that after all...)
LDBI\t「私はああいうパイロット・スーツ、好きよん。@ カッコいいじゃなぁい: I'm a fan of pilot suits like yours.@Don't you think they look cool?
LDBI\t「私のもリニューアルしようかしらん。@ シースルー素材をいっぱい使っ: Maybe I'll get mine redesigned.@With loads of see-through material, hmm?
LDBI\t「予算の無駄遣いだ。サインはしないぞ」: Waste of budget. I won't sign off on it.
LDBI\t（か、格好いい……憧れちゃうな、あの二人）: (S-So cool... I really look up to those two.)
LDBI\t「こちらと接触を？ @ ガイアセイバーズの旗艦が？」: They want to make contact?@The Gaia Savers' flagship?
LDBI\t「ええ。グライエン・グラスマン大統領、及び@ アルテウル・シュタイン: Yes. These are direct orders from@President Graien Grassman and Special@Vice President Arteur Steinbeck.
LDBI\t「アリエイル・オーグ少尉絡みの件なのか……@ あるいは、南極で我が隊: Could this concern Lieutenant Ariel Org...@Or do they intend to run a joint operation@with us in Antarctica?
LDBI\t「それならば、通信だけで事足りるはずです」: If so, a simple transmission would suffice.
LDBI\t「いかが致します？@ 統合参謀本部や伊豆に問い合わせますか？」: What shall we do?@Should we contact the Joint Chiefs or Izu?
LDBI\t「大統領命令であるならば、@ 無視するわけにはいきません。@ 直ちに: If it's a presidential order,@we can't ignore it.@Change course at once... and inform the Hagane.
LDBI\t「ガイアセイバーズ艦隊、現空域へ進入してきます」: Gaia Savers fleet entering our airspace.
LDBI\t「艦隊が展開……輪形陣を組むようです。@ 水平面でなく、上空にも……: The fleet is deploying... in a ring formation.@Not just on the horizontal plane, but above us@too... This is odd.
LDBI\t「こちらを包囲する気か……！？」: Are they trying to surround us...!?
LDBI\t「司令、各艦の配置が完了しました」: Commander, all ships are in position.
LDBI\t「ご苦労。大統領機の方は？」: Good work. And the President's craft?
LDBI\t「いつでも発艦可能です」: It can launch at any time.
LDBI\t「ええ。@ ……例の物はご確認いただけましたでしょうか？」: Yes.@...Have you had a chance to review that item?
LDBI\t「ああ、ピューリッツァー賞……@ いや、パルム・ドールが狙えるかも知: Yes. It could win a Pulitzer...@No, perhaps even the Palme d'Or.
LDBI\t「では、万一の事態が起きた場合、@ 大統領には現空域から退避していた: Then, should anything unexpected happen,@the President will withdraw from this airspace.
LDBI\t「具申します。やはり、今すぐ護衛を付け、@ そうすべきかと。ゲストや: If I may, sir... I think he should do so now,@under escort. We can't rule out the Guests or@the Antarctic unknowns appearing here.
LDBI\t「大統領がこの場におられることが肝要なのだよ。@ お前も、鋼龍戦隊が: It is vital that the President be present here.@You don't think the Steel Dragons will simply@obey, do you?
LDBI\t「はっ……ミッション・ハルパーの時もそうでした。@ 彼らは軍人である: Yes, sir... It was the same in Mission Harpe.@Though they're soldiers, they tend to act@on their own judgment.
LDBI\t「もっとも……自分にもそういう時期がありましたが」: Though I once had a time like that myself.
LDBI\t「だが、お前は己の過ちを悔い、ここにいる。@ ガイアセイバーズに貢献: But you regretted your errors, and you're here.@Serve the Gaia Savers and your slate is clean.@Then you can reclaim your name.
LDBI\t（鋼龍戦隊……テツヤ・オノデラ……@ お前達は、どう出る……？）: (The Steel Dragons... Tetsuya Onodera...@What will you do...?)
LDBI\t「では、鋼龍戦隊との回線を開け」: Now, open a channel to the Steel Dragons.
LDBI\t「艦長、ガイアセイバーズ旗艦、@ エア・クリスマスより入電です」: Captain, incoming transmission from@the Gaia Savers' flagship, Air Christmas.
LDBI\t「鋼龍戦隊に告ぐ。@ 私はガイアセイバーズ司令、@ アルテウル・シュ: Attention, Steel Dragons.@I am the commander of the Gaia Savers,@Arteur Steinbeck.
LDBI\t「地球連邦軍極東方面軍第１独立特殊戦隊司令、@ レフィーナ・エンフィ: Commander of the Earth Federation Army Far East@1st Independent Special Combat Squadron,@Colonel Lefina Enfield.
LDBI\t「アルテウル司令、@ 我々との合流を希望された理由をお教え下さい」: Commander Arteur, may I ask@why you wished to rendezvous with us?
LDBI\t「よかろう。@ グライエン・グラスマン連邦政府大統領閣下の@ 命令を: Very well.@I shall relay the orders of His Excellency@Graien Grassman, President of the Federation.
LDBI\t「鋼龍戦隊は現時刻を以て、その任を解く。@ 直ちに武装解除し、所有す: The Steel Dragons are hereby relieved of duty.@Disarm at once and surrender all your ships@and mobile weapons to us.
BMD\t「エルデ・ミッテ……/ 結果がどうなるか、あなたにはわかっているはず」: Erde Mitte.../　You must know how this will end.
BMD\t「急激な進化は自滅を招く……/ でも、それを待つわけにはいかない」: Rapid evolution invites ruin.../　But I can't wait for that to happen.
BMD\t「妖機人がどんな動きをしても、/ 対応してみせる」: Whatever the Yokijin do,/　I'll be ready for it.
BMD\t「四神の超機人と言えど……」: Even a Choukijin of the Four Gods...
BMD\t「四凶の超機人……迂闊に飛び込むのは危険」: A Choukijin of the Four Fiends.../　Charging in carelessly is dangerous.
BMD\t「ガンエデン……あなたの庇護はいらない」: Gan Eden... I don't need your protection.
BMD\t「人造神……/ 人が造ったものならば、人の手で……！」: A man-made god.../　If humans made it, humans can stop it...!
BMD\t「ユーゼス、/ あなたの妄想に付き合う気はない……！」: Euzeth,/　I won't indulge your delusions...!

BMD\t「そう簡単にはやらせないもの……！」: I won't make it that easy...!
BMD\t「あなたのクセは、だいたいわかったわ」: I've mostly figured out your habits.
BMD\t「同じ手はもう通用しない」: The same trick won't work again.
BMD\t「う……！/ ジャーダやガーネットを残して、死ねないもの……！」: Ugh...!/　I can't die and leave/　Giada and Garnet behind...!
BMD\t「これぐらい……！/ スクールにいた時と比べれば……！」: This is nothing...!/　Compared to when I was at The School...!
BMD\t「被弾箇所チェック……/ ダメージチェック……まだ戦えるわ……！」: Checking hit locations.../　Damage check... I can still fight...!
BMD\t「く……！ まだ落ちない……！」: Ngh...! I'm not going down yet...!

BMD\t「終わったわけじゃない……/ まだ立て直せる……！」: It's not over yet.../　I can still recover...!
BMD\t「大事な機体だもの……！/ 失うわけには……！」: This unit is precious to me...!/　I can't lose it...!
BMD\t「くっ、シアン……/ ここまで押してくるとは……！」: Ngh, Cyan.../　I didn't think you'd push me this far...!
BMD\t「シオの読みを上回らなければ……！」: I have to outthink Shio's predictions...!
BMD\t「さすが指揮官機……！」: As expected of a Commander's unit...!
BMD\t「あの口調に/ 乗せられたつもりはないけど……！」: Not that I'm letting/　that tone get to me...!
BMD\t「ゼゼーナン……これ以上はやらせない」: Zezenan... I won't let you go any further.
BMD\t「これが“破滅の王”の力……！」: So this is the power/　of the "King of Destruction"...!
BMD\t「妖機人に後れを取るわけには……！」: I can't fall behind the Yokijin...!
BMD\t「武雀王の直撃は避けなければ……！」: Can't take a direct hit from BuJakuOh...!
BMD\t「四凶のデータを再検証しなければ……！」: I need to reverify/　the data on the Four Fiends...!
BMD\t「ＡＩ１の暴走を止めなければ……！」: I have to stop AI1's rampage...!
BMD\t「あんなものが神であるわけがない……！」: That thing can't possibly be a god...!
BMD\t「ユーゼス……勝負はまだついていない……！」: Euzeth... This fight isn't over yet...!
BMD\t「くっ、/ ジンライのデータを再検証しなければ……！」: Ngh,/　I need to reverify the Jinrai's data...!
BMD\t「！？ 直撃……！ 油断した……」: !? A direct hit...! I got careless...
BMD\t「これぐらいのダメージは、許容範囲内……」: This much damage is within tolerance...
BMD\t「……構わない……/ 見返りにあなたのデータを取ったもの」: ...It doesn't matter.../　I got your data in exchange.
BMD\t「あうっ……！/ データを生かしきれなかった……？」: Ah...!/　I couldn't make full use of the data...?
BMD\t「く……！/ パターン解析が間に合わなかった……」: Ngh...!/　My pattern analysis wasn't fast enough...
BMD\t「超闘士の必殺剣、見せてやるぜ！」: Here's the Super Fighter's killer sword!
BMD\t「決めてやるぜ！ 超闘士超必殺！」: Let's end this!/　Super Fighter Ultimate Move!
LDBI\t「……僕がここへ来る前に得た情報なのですが、@ カークス軍とフェイル: ...According to what I learned before coming,@the Kirkus and Feil armies dealt Schtedonias@a major blow in the battle at Redna Gorge.
LDBI\t「現在、敵はラングランから撤退を始めており、@ カークス軍がそれを追: The enemy has now begun withdrawing from@Langran, with Kirkus's army in pursuit.
LDBI\t「なお、これが予測されている敵の撤退コースです」: Here is the enemy's projected retreat route.
LDBI\t「彼らは海へ向かっているようですね」: They seem to be heading for the sea.
LDBI\t「ええ、ヌエット海です。@ その向こう側にシュテドニアスの領土があり: Yes, the Nuet Sea.@Schtedonias territory lies beyond it.
LDBI\t「ここで追い討ちをかければ、@ シュテドニアスの連中をラングランから: So if we hit 'em now, we can drive@those Schtedonias bastards right out@of Langran, huh?
LDBI\t「大佐、僕とゲンナジーはヌエット海へ向かいます。@ あなた方はセブ神: Colonel, Gennacy and I will go to the Nuet Sea.@I ask that you guard Sebu Temple.
LDBI\t「君は駄目だ。@ ガルガードを持ち出して脱走したことが@ 問題になっ: Out of the question.@Do you think deserting with the Galguard@hasn't caused a problem?
LDBI\t「君の身柄は僕が預かる。@ シュテドニアス軍との戦いが終わった後、@: You'll be in my custody.@Once the fight with Schtedonias is over,@I intend to go to the capital.
LDBI\t「その後、フェイル殿下にお目通りして……@ 君の処遇についても相談す: Then I'll seek an audience with Prince Feil...@and discuss what's to be done with you.
LDBI\t「ヤンロン……あたし、あんたについてくよ」: Yang Long... I'm coming with you.
LDBI\t「この世界じゃ、あたしは部外者だけどね。@ 何だかんだで色々と絡んじ: Sure, I'm an outsider in this world.@But one way or another, I got tangled up in@all this, and I know what's going on...
LDBI\t「だから、この戦いを早く終わらせたいんだ。@ それに、カークス将軍も: So I want this war over fast. Besides,@I think somebody has to stop General Kirkus.@That's honestly how I feel.
LDBI\t「……ありがとう、リューネ。@ では、君の力を借りよう」: ...Thank you, Lüne.@Then I'll gladly accept your help.
LDBI\t「あんたからそうストレートに言われると、@ 何か照れ臭いね」: Hearing it so straight from you@is kinda embarrassing.
LDBI\t「あ、あの、私も……@ もし、お力になれることがございましたら……」: U-Um, I, too... if there is any way@I might be of help to you...
LDBI\t「所縁はございませんが、ラングラン王家のお話が@ 他人事とは思えなく: I have no ties to it, but Langran's royal@family's plight touches me... Our countries@differ, yet for a people who long for peace...

FIXH\t ファイター・ロアことコウタ・アズマが搭乗するスーパーロ\nボットで:
A super robot piloted by Kota Azuma, a.k.a. Fighter
Roar. Kota's grandfather Kisaburo modified it from a
humanoid mobile weapon entrusted to him by Roa, a
warrior from another world. Its main engine, the OG
(Over Gate) Engine, was built with otherworldly
overtechnology. It opens a limited hyperdimensional
aperture and uses special energy particles found in
a weakly-correlated proximal subspace to power the
unit and its attacks. However, the OG Engine has not
been fully repaired, so the unit cannot yet unleash
its true power. It also carries systems similar to
the ABMD (Artificial Bone Muscle Drive) and DML
(Direct Motion Link) systems, allowing it to move as
one with its pilot. It is also known as the
"Compati Kaiser" or the "Battle Force Robo."
FIXH\t コンパチブルカイザーと大型戦闘機Ｇサンダーゲートが合体\nした状態:
The combined form of the Compatible Kaiser and the
large fighter G-Thundergate. Its main engine, the OG
(Over Gate) Engine, was built with otherworldly
overtechnology. It opens a limited hyperdimensional
aperture and uses special energy particles found in
a weakly-correlated proximal subspace to power the
unit and its attacks. It carries systems similar to
the ABMD (Artificial Bone Muscle Drive) and DML
(Direct Motion Link) systems, allowing it to move as
one with its pilot. The G-Thundergate transforms
into a large wing booster and docks on the back of
the Compatible Kaiser, boosting agility and mobility
and adding weapons such as shoulder cannons. The OG
Engines of the Compatible Kaiser and G-Thundergate
work in tandem to amplify output, enabling use of
its ultimate weapon, the Over Kaiser Sword. Commonly
called the "G-Compati Kaiser."
FIXH\t コンパチブルカイザーのサポートメカとなる大型戦闘機。\n カイザー:
A large fighter that serves as the Compatible
Kaiser's support mech. Like the Kaiser, it carries
an OG (Over Gate) Engine and has high mobility and
firepower. Only someone wearing the Emmy Armor can
pilot it; no one else can operate it.
It was believed destroyed in the past battle with
the Dark Brain, but was recovered along with the
Emmy Armor and repaired as a weapon against the
Compatible Kaiser. Originally black, it returned
to its original color, red, upon combining with
the Compatible Kaiser.
FIXH\t コウタ・アズマがロア・アーマーを着込んだ状態。\n 額のクリスタル:
Kota Azuma wearing the Roa Armor.
Roa's soul dwells in the crystal on its forehead.
Highly airtight, it allows action in space and
underwater. (The hair is a heat-dissipation part,
the nose and mouth are covered by skin-colored
armor, and the eyes by an ultra-thin transparent
shield.) Hardpoints all over the armor can also
mount a variety of optional parts.
The Roa Armor greatly enhances Kota's physical
abilities. With its small back thrusters and his
main weapon, the Fighter Beamgun, he can even take
on humanoid mobile weapons.
FIXH\t キサブロー・アズマ博士が、ある企業からの依頼を受け、コ\nンパチブ:
A super robot that Dr. Kisaburo Azuma had been
developing at a company's request since before he
met the Compatible Kaiser. Its official name is
"Bankaran," but Michiru Hanaten added a "G" to the
front, making it the "G-Bankaran."
A power fighter specializing in melee combat, it has
high durability thanks to its heavy armor and sturdy
frame. Joints improved with know-how gained from the
Compatible Kaiser let it move nimbly despite its
heavyweight build. Its look is modeled on Kisaburo
in his youth, and he reportedly intended to pilot
the Bankaran into battle himself if need be.
FIXH\t 剣撃戦闘用の特殊人型機動兵器。\n パイロットの思考を直接機体に伝:
A special humanoid mobile weapon for sword combat.
It carries the Direct Feedback System, which relays
the pilot's thoughts directly to the unit, and is
armed with slashing weapons such as the "Godaiken."
Its cape is a kind of shield that can even deflect
beams.
It seems to have been developed alongside the
Soulgain, as their parts share common features.
However, it lacks the Direct Action Link System that
lets pilot and machine move as one. Its tracking and
reaction speed are a step behind the Soulgain's, but
its enhanced thrusters give it a higher top speed.
BMD\t「多少なりとも戦力を削る。戦いの初歩だな」: Wear down their forces, even a little./　That's the basics of war.
BMD\t「こんなもん、蛇口……もとい、序の口だぜ！」: This is just the tip of the ice cube.../　I mean, the iceberg!
FIXH\t 旧西暦２０１２年の隕石災害（ダブル・インパクト）以降\nの世界的混:
A planetwide political body that grew out of a
provisional UN organization after the global
turmoil that followed the meteor disasters of
Old Calendar 2012 (the Double Impact).
Although it is an international governing body
set atop the old nations, now autonomous regions,
it does not unite all of humanity's political
functions into one. International problems, such
as the small- and mid-scale conflicts predating
its founding, were simply inherited by the
regions themselves.
FIXH\t 「百邪」と呼ばれる悪魔や妖怪と戦うために古代中国人が\n作り出した:
A title for semi-organic weapons built by the
ancient Chinese to battle the demons and monsters
called the Hyakuja. They have autonomous thought
circuits and can act on their own, but cannot
unleash their true power unless a Telekinesis
user (a Kyonenja) they have accepted as pilot
rides within. A normal human can sometimes board
and pilot one, but at the price of having their
soul power (life force) absorbed by it. In the
worst case, they die.
Choukijin are ranked as the Four Spirits, Four
Gods, Four Fiends, and so on. Units other than
RyuKoOh and KoRyuOh are thought to exist, but
details remain unclear.
FIXH\t 『調和の塔』と呼ばれる塔から、<ラ・ギアス>全土を覆って\nいる特:
A special barrier covering all of <ラ・ギアス>,
projected from the so-called Tower of Harmony.
It supplies magical power to the whole world and
also restricts the use of large-scale magic.
FIXH\t 新西暦１８４年、１０基のスペースコロニーが統合されて\n独立国家と:
In New Century 184, ten space colonies merged to
form an independent nation. The United Colony
Corps is the military formed by reorganizing the
Earth Federation Space Army forces that had been
stationed in the colonies.
Though nominally a separate organization, it is
effectively under Federation Army jurisdiction
(some United Colony Corps officers resent this).
Since it must carry out advanced operations and
combat in space, its personnel are highly capable.
At the end of New Century 186, it declared war on
the Federation government and Federation Army
alongside the DC. As the United Colony Corps made
up nearly all the forces in space at the time, it
quickly seized control of space.
It then supported DC operations on the ground, but
surrendered to the Federation Army after Supreme
Commander Maier V. Branstein died in battle.
However, this was in preparation for the coming
decisive battle with the aliens, and indeed many
United Colony Corps units took part in Operation
SRW, the final operation of the L5 War.
After the war, it came under Federation Army
jurisdiction and its leadership was replaced.
Though its name became an empty shell, it still
makes up the majority of the forces in space.
FIXH\t 空間・次元転移装置「システムＸＮ」によって並行世界\nからやってき:
A group that came from a parallel world by way of
the space-dimension transfer device System XN.
Originally, they were the Earth Federation Army's
special operations unit in that parallel world.
Active behind the scenes since the <Ｌ５戦役>, they
aided the DC remnants in their armed uprising.
They sought to perfect System XN and keep the
world in a state of war using mobile weapons
carrying mass-produced versions of it, as well as
artificial humans called the W Series, but they
were defeated by the Hagane and Hiryu Custom.
FIXH\t 修羅神とは修羅が使用する兵器であり、繰者の生体エネル\nギーによっ:
Shura Gods are the weapons used by the Shura, and
they run on the bio-energy of their masters.
They are ranked in classes such as Retsu, Goh, and
Choh. The lowest rank, Retsu-class, can be piloted
by any Shura with a certain level of fighting spirit
(life energy) and skill.
However, Goh- and Choh-class Shura Gods are even
more selective about their pilots. Becoming their
master requires matching strength, trials, and a
ritual. Once a master has been chosen, it is
basically impossible for anyone else to board and
operate it until that master dies. One theory holds
that Goh- and Choh-class Shura Gods have a will of
sorts, and will only allow those they accept as
their master to board (if an unfit pilot boards,
the Shura God drains their fighting spirit until
they die).
Shura Gods of Goh class and above were built with
lost technology, and today's Shura are unable to
develop new machines. As a result, Goh- and
Choh-class Shura Gods are limited in number, and
some have remained in use for several hundred years.
Several Shura Gods are also said to remain sealed
away, still awaiting a master.
Masters of Goh-class Shura Gods are held in high
regard among the Shura and wield a degree of
authority. To become a Shura general, one must be
the master of a Choh-class Shura God.
Retsu-class Shura Gods were built using surviving
Goh-class Shura Gods as reference. While their
performance is greatly reduced, they can be
mass-produced.

FIXH\t <地球連邦軍><特殊戦技教導隊>所属のパイロット。\n 高い戦闘能:
A pilot in the <地球連邦軍>
<特殊戦技教導隊>.
Possesses exceptional combat and piloting skills,
and is calm and composed to the point of seeming
mechanical. An intelligent, quiet beauty, yet she
has an air about her that is somehow inhuman.
In truth, she is an artificial human of the type
known as the "W Series." Once a spy for the
<シャドウミラー> unit, she awakened to her own sense
of self after meeting Kyosuke and the others.
She now serves as Kai's de facto adjutant in the
<教導隊>.
FIXH\t <地球連邦軍><特殊戦技教導隊>所属のパイロット。\n 前向きで明:
A pilot in the <地球連邦軍>
<特殊戦技教導隊>.
Cheerful and upbeat, and easygoing in appearance,
but serious at heart. A product of <スクール>.
After the <Ｌ５戦役>, he joined the remnants of
the <ＤＣ> and opposed Kyosuke's group.
Later, after meeting Latune and the others, he
came to fight alongside them.
FIXH\t <地球連邦軍><特殊戦技教導隊>所属のパイロット。\n <スクール:
A pilot in the <地球連邦軍>
<特殊戦技教導隊>.
A product of <スクール> and Arado's partner.
A serious honor-student type who is strong-willed
and short-tempered. She jumps to conclusions and is
scary when angry. Underneath, though, she is caring
and always worries about her partner, Arado.

A pilot in the <地球連邦軍>
<特殊戦技教導隊>.
A product of <スクール>, she displays outstanding
talent in combat and piloting <パーソナルトルーパー>s.
She had closed off her heart due to the harsh
experiments and training at <スクール>, but
regained her humanity after meeting Ryusei and
the others.
FIXH\t かつて<ＤＣ>で進められ、現在は連邦軍管轄下に置かれて\nいる<プ:
A test pilot for <プロジェクトＴＤ>, which was once
run by the <ＤＣ> and is now under the
jurisdiction of the Federation Army.
Single-minded and strong-willed. She dreams of
setting out into space as an astronaut, and is a
hard worker who has endured grueling training to
get there. Her skill falls far short of her
<プロジェクトＴＤ> colleague Sleigh's, and she is ranked
only Number 04, but no one can match her passion.
FIXH\t <プロジェクトＴＤ>のシステム開発チームのチーフ。\n <イスルギ:
Chief of <プロジェクトＴＤ>'s system development team.
She keeps <プロジェクトＴＤ> going with support from
<イスルギ重工>. Generally caring, personable, and
dependable, but at times she makes coldly rational
judgments to the point of ruthlessness.
BMD\t「性格もやることもきっついね、割と」: That attitude and those moves/　are both pretty harsh, huh?
BMD\t「五大剣には、こういう使い方もある！」: The Five Great Swords can/　be used like this, too!
LDBI\t「目標、さらに減速。まもなく視界に入ります」: The target is slowing down further.@It'll be in visual range shortly.
FIXH\t 遥か昔、地球に飛来した人造神。その正体は何者かによって\n造られた:
A man-made god that came to Earth in ancient
times. In truth, it is the central control unit of
"Baral," a planetary defense system built by an
unknown party. By linking with a strong psychic
known as a priestess or Masiaf, it encloses the
planet under its protection in a powerful barrier,
sealing it off completely from the outside world.
Since it lets no one inside the barrier leave and
attacks anyone outside, it could be said to be a
system not for protecting a planet, but for sealing
it away.
FIXH\t <マオ・インダストリー>が開発した<パーソナルトルーパー>。\n:
A <パーソナルトルーパー> developed by <マオ・インダストリー>.
　Carrying on Alteisen's concept, it is designed for
close-range melee combat and normally operates
alongside the Wildfalken, a long-range artillery
unit.
　No <ＥＯＴ> is used; it carries live-ammo weapons for
short- to mid-range combat. Its frame is also not
the H Frame of the R-1 and Hückebein series, but
the GII Frame.
A high-performance <テスラ・ドライブ> on its back allows
it to fly unaided under gravity.
　Furthermore, by purging its outer armor, called
Jacket Armor, it shifts into a high-mobility mode.
Design and development were handled by Dr. Marion
Radom. One other unit of the same type exists.

A <パーソナルトルーパー> developed by <マオ・インダストリー>.
　Carrying on Weissritter's concept, it is built for
long-range artillery combat and has a powerful
<テスラ・ドライブ>, giving it mobility that ranks among
the very best of any <パーソナ
ルトルーパー>.
　It normally operates alongside the close-combat
Wildwürger, and their combination attack, "Twin
Bird Strike," performed with the Wildwürger in
high-mobility mode, is especially powerful.
　Its main weapon is the Oxtongue Rifle, which can
fire either solid rounds or energy shots. Unlike
the Wildwürger, it uses the Hückebein-line H Frame,
improving frame rigidity and reducing weight.
Development was handled by Dr. Kirk Hamill.
　The name Wildfalken derives from the German words
"WILD" and "WANDERFALKE" (peregrine falcon). One
other unit of the same type exists.
FIXH\t 可変型<パーソナルトルーパー>、ビルトラプターの強化改造\n型。<:
An upgraded version of the Wildraubtier, a
transformable <パーソナルトルーパー>. Fitted with a
<テスラ・ドライブ>, it has improved mobility and speed. It
also gains firepower through a powerful built-in
weapon (rail cannon) and the Blade Rhinoceros for
melee, neither of which the original had.
FIXH\t ビルトラプター・シュナーベルの飛行形態（フライヤー・\nモード）。:
The flight form (Flyer Mode) of the Wildraubtier
Schnabel. With the rail cannon now positioned at
the front, its balance is better than before the
upgrade.
FIXH\t アルブレードは<マオ・インダストリー>社が開発したＲ‐１の\n簡易:
The R-Blade is a simplified mass-production
prototype <パーソナルトルーパー> of the R-1 developed by
<マオ・インダストリー>. It lacks the R-1's mechanism for
transforming into flight mode and its <Ｔ‐ＬＩＮＫシステム>
(a telekinesis sensing and amplifying device), but
its basic performance is high.
　The R-Blade Custom is a special-spec machine
based on Prototype No. 3, which was tuned for
close-range combat, now fitted with a <テスラ・ドライブ>,
a Split Beam Cannon, and the same Jacket Armor
used on the Wildwürger.

The general name for high-end
portable handheld devices.

Short for
<ディバイン・クルセイダーズ>.
FIXH\t タクティカル・サイバネティクス・オペレーティング・\nシステム（戦:
Tactical Cybernetics Operating System
(a tactical, motion-reasoning OS).
　The OS used by <パーソナルトルーパー>s and other
humanoid mobile weapons. For example, if a pilot
chooses to "punch the enemy," the AI calculates
the current positions of its own unit and the
enemy, then selects the most efficient and
appropriate motion from the multiple motion
pattern data sets stored in the unit.
　This frees the pilot from the complex controls
of a humanoid mobile weapon. The pilot can focus
on reading the situation and give only minimal
input, while the unit automatically chooses the
right motions and carries out the action the
pilot intended.
　Furthermore, pilots can freely set the types of
motion pattern data and their execution priority,
allowing them to optimize the unit's movements to
suit their own preferences and piloting habits.

　Of the three option part sets, Type N is the most

FIXH\t ＰＴＸ‐００１ゲシュペンストに大幅な強化改造を施した\n<パーソナ:
A <パーソナルトルーパー> created by heavily upgrading
the PTX-001 Gespenst.
　The first unit born of the Halloween Plan, a
proposal for upgrading the Gespenst series devised
by Gilliam Jaeger, Kai Kitamura, and others. Using
<マオ・インダストリー>' latest technology, it was modified
from the frame up, and nearly all of its armor was
replaced. On its back is a large Flight Unit with a
<テスラ・ドライブ>, giving it mobility on par with the
latest units. It also carries a powerful beam weapon
called the Mega Buster Cannon.
FIXH\t <ＤＣ>の量産型<アーマードモジュール>であるリオンをろ獲し、\n:
A captured Lion, the <ＤＣ>'s mass-produced
<アーマードモジュール>, refitted with upgraded weapons
and armor.
　Spare <パーソナルトルーパー> parts, such as those of the
Hückebein, Gespenst, and Alteisen, are used
throughout the unit. Notably, the arms were replaced
wholesale with <パーソナルトルーパー> arms, and folding
slashing blades were fitted to the legs, so it can
handle the close-range melee combat the Lion was
weak at. A stopgap modification halfway between a
<パーソナルトルーパー> and an <アーマードモジュール>, it
nonetheless has high potential.
BMD\t「凶星の剣にて、お前を討つ！」: With the sword of the ill star,/　I'll strike you down!
FIXH\t <地球連邦軍>が使用する大型戦略戦術輸送機。\n 最大５機の<パー:
A large strategic/tactical transport aircraft used
by the <地球連邦軍>.
It can carry up to five <パーソナルトルーパー>s to
the battlefield. Its onboard launch catapult allows
<パーソナルトルーパー>s to sortie in mid-flight,
enabling rapid unit deployment.
FIXH\t <ＤＣ>（<ディバイン・クルセイダーズ>）総帥であるビアン・ゾ\n:
The first of the "Dynamic General Guardian" series,
or "Double G," special humanoid mobile weapons
built to defend <アースクレイドル>. Their basic design
is the work of Dr. Bian Zoldark, supreme commander
of the <ＤＣ> (<ディバイン・クルセイダーズ>).
Built for sword and close combat, it uses the "DML
System" and the dedicated OS "JINKI-1" for its
controls, letting pilot and machine move as one.
Power is transmitted through its frame by the "ABMD
(Artificial Bone Muscle Drive) System," giving it
far more flexible, dynamic movement than other
humanoid mobile weapons of the same size.

The second of the "Dynamic General Guardian"
series, or "Double G," designed by Bian Zoldark,
supreme commander of the <ＤＣ> (<ディバイン・クルセイダーズ>).
Tailored to Rätsel's hit-and-run fighting style, it
carries a long-barreled beam cannon, high-output
vernier thrusters, and wheels for high-speed ground
travel (Felse Rad). It can also transform into
Pferd Mode and carry Dygenguar on its back. Together,
the two resemble a mounted samurai, a sight that
overwhelms all who behold it.
FIXH\t ビアン・ゾルダーク博士の設計図を基にし、カオル・トオミ\nネ博士が:
The third Dynamic General Guardian, built by Dr.
Kaoru Toomine from Dr. Bian Zoldark's blueprints.
A high-speed close-combat unit, it carries no pilot
and is controlled by an AI called "System ZLAI."
Its purpose is to destroy Unit 1, Dygenguar, and
Unit 2, Aussenseiter. Modeled on a ninja, it wields
shuriken (Multiply Blade), a ninja sword (Anchor
Secret Sword), and other weapons. It incorporates
an improved "ABMD (Artificial Bone Muscle Drive)
System," making it more agile than Dygenguar or
Aussenseiter. It also has EA (Electronic Attack)
and EP (Electronic Protection) capabilities.
FIXH\t ジンライの簡易量産型。外見は良く似ているが、生産コスト\nを下げる:
A simplified mass-production version of Jinrai.
It looks much the same, but several features were
omitted to cut production costs, and its ABMD
(Artificial Bone Muscle Drive) System is built into
the legs only. If Jinrai is a mid-rank ninja, this
mass-produced model is a low-rank one.
FIXH\t ろ獲したジンライを改修した機体。システムＺＬＡＩを排除\nし、ダイ:
A captured Jinrai that has been modified. System
ZLAI was removed, and like Dygenguar it is now a
manned unit with a DML (Direct Motion Link) System.
It also incorporates "System LIOH," an innovative
man-machine interface. The system learns a pilot's
traits to draw out their latent potential, serving
as both the unit's control OS and a system for
training soldiers. Boosters developed as add-on
equipment for Dygenguar and Aussenseiter are fitted
to its legs, and since its pilot Touma excels at
martial arts, it relies mainly on kicks rather than
the handheld weapons the original Jinrai used.
FIXH\t 人型機動兵器の戦技研究・構築やモーションデータの作成\nのため、結:
A unit formed to research and develop combat
tactics for humanoid mobile weapons and to create
motion data for them.
  The basic motion data in the <ＴＣ‐ＯＳ> installed
in today's Personal Troopers was created by this
unit through repeated test operations.
  The unit consisted of six elite members: its
commander Kar-wai Lau, along with Kai Kitamura,
Tempest Hawker, Sänger Sombold, Elzam V.
Branstein, and Gilliam Jaeger.
  Though the unit disbanded after an incident in
S.C. 184, its colorful members and their
achievements have made it a near-legend both
inside and outside the Federation Army.
  After the <Ｌ５戦役>, it was re-formed with Kai
Kitamura as its commander.
FIXH\t 特殊人型機動兵器、俗に言うスーパーロボットのこと。\n主に全長４０:
Special humanoid mobile weapons, commonly called
super robots. The term mainly refers to units over
40 meters tall that carry special power sources or
systems.
FIXH\t メテオ３から発見された物質。\n 少なくとも太陽系内では産出される:
A substance discovered in Meteor 3.
  It is not found anywhere in the solar system, at
least, and when discovered it was sealed inside
containers that were clearly artificial.
  Tronium is a metallic substance the size of a
grain of rice that holds an immense amount of
energy. Meteor 3 contained six pieces of Tronium,
which were analyzed and studied by the <ＥＯＴＩ機関>.
Several of them were later provided to the
Federation Army through various deals (in which
Major Ingram Prisken of the SRX Project was
involved).
  The Tronium Engine extracts Tronium's virtually
limitless energy and converts it into power. Its
energy conversion per unit of time is too great to
measure. Because engine materials built with
humanity's current technology cannot withstand the
intense energy it generates, a limiter is fitted.
In addition, since energy output increases at an
accelerating rate as power is raised, the engine
is extremely difficult to regulate.
FIXH\t <テスラ・ライヒ研究所>で開発された高効率反動推進装置。\n 重力:
A high-efficiency reaction thruster developed at
the <テスラ・ライヒ研究所>. It can alter
gravitational mass (weight) and inertial mass
(resistance to motion) independently, using this
to accelerate conventional propellant and propel
objects efficiently. It could be called a kind of
gravity control device.
It made atmospheric flight and space travel easy,
but early units were so large that only
warship-class vessels could carry them. However,
<ＥＯＴ> analysis data from Meteor 3 led to major
advances in gravity-control physics, making the
Tesla Drive itself far more powerful and compact.
Starting with the Armored Modules developed by
the <ＤＣ>, it could then be mounted even on
20-meter-class humanoid mobile weapons.
FIXH\t 北米コロラドに存在するオーバーテクノロジーの総合研究\n機関。新西:
A comprehensive overtechnology research facility
in Colorado, North America, founded by Bian
Zoldark in S.C. 171.
It has produced many geniuses, among them
robotics authority Jonathan Kazahara and Eric
Wong.
Although most of its members transferred to the
<ＥＯＴＩ機関> upon its founding, it continues its own
<ＥＯＴ> research, improvement of the <テスラ・ドライブ>,
and development of the Grungust series.
Its name comes from inventor Nikola Tesla and
scientist Wilhelm Reich.
Its current director is Jonathan Kazahara.
FIXH\t 特殊脳医学の権威、ケンゾウ・コバヤシ博士が提唱した、\n人の思念作:
A type of deep brain wave that governs the action
of human thought, proposed by Dr. Kenzou
Kobayashi, an authority in special brain medicine.
It is used to assess telekinetic aptitude.

FIXH\t サイバスターの巡航形態。\n 神聖ラングラン王国の神鳥ディシュナス:
Cybuster's cruising form.
　Its form is modeled after Dishnas, the sacred
bird of the Holy Kingdom of Langran.
FIXH\t <ＤＣ>総帥ビアン・ゾルダークが娘であるリューネのため\nに開発し:
The second unit of the Valsion series, built by
<ＤＣ> leader Bian Zoldark for his daughter Lüne.
　Because it uses artificial muscles to transmit
power throughout its frame, it moves with a
flexibility and humanlike quality far beyond
<パーソナルトルーパー> or <アーマードモジュール>.
Even its facial expression can change.
　It also carries a smaller, improved <テスラ・ドライブ>,
allowing it to fly on its own. Armed with the
wide-area Psychoblaster, plus the Cross Smasher
and Divine Arm also carried by the Valsion, it
boasts exceptionally high combat capability.
　Its control system incorporates a DML (Direct
Motion Link) system, enabling the machine to move
as one with its pilot.
FIXH\t ヴァルシオン・シリーズの２号機ヴァルシオーネを、<ラ・ギ\nアス>:
The second Valsion series unit, the Valsione,
enhanced with the alchemy of <ラ・ギ
アス>. It uses the ABMD system to
transmit power throughout the frame, and a DML
system that traces the pilot's movements for its
controls, giving it flexible, humanlike motion far
beyond that of other humanoid mobile weapons.
FIXH\t <シャドウミラー>が使用していた万能戦闘母艦。\n <テスラ・ドラ:
An all-purpose combat carrier used by
<シャドウミラー>.
　A large ship equipped with a <テスラ・ドライブ>, it
boasts high carrying capacity and stealth, and
can operate in space, in the air and underwater.
It is said to have been built to counter
Space Noah-class carriers such as the Hagane,
but this is unconfirmed.
FIXH\t 対異星人戦闘用に建造されたスペースノア級万能戦闘母艦の\n弐番艦。:
The second ship of the Space Noah-class
multipurpose combat carriers, built for combat
against aliens. It floats via a <テスラ・ドライブ> and
is propelled by eight main rocket engines, among
other systems.
　Its hull is made of ultra-resistant metal,
allowing not only space travel but also flight
within the atmosphere and underwater operation.
It also excels in ship-to-ship gunnery and in
carrying <パーソナルトルーパー> and various fighters.
It was the ship that made the Federation's ISA
tactic a reality (Integrated Synchronizing
Attack: a blitzkrieg by a mobile battleship
serving as a carrier and the humanoid mobile
weapons it carries).
　Plans for the Space Noah class were split
between two opposing visions: escorts for the
Earth exodus fleet, and <ＰＴ>-carrying combat
carriers for fighting aliens. In a way that
undermined the overarching Earth exodus plan,
they were given the combat capabilities called
for by the Earth Sphere defense initiative.
　To conceal this dual purpose, they adopted a
flexible structure unheard of in a warship.
Modularizing the ship around a common core of
hull and main engines lets mission-specific
combat modules be replaced in a relatively
short time.
　The replaceable part is the bow, and the first,
second and third ships each carry a different
module.
　The bow module of the second ship, the Hagane,
is the Tronium Buster Cannon, a high-output
heavy metal particle cannon that gives it one of
the highest attack powers of any Federation
warship. Its code name is "Steel 2."
FIXH\t 対異星人戦闘用に建造されたスペースノア級万能戦闘母艦\nの参番艦。:
The third ship of the Space Noah-class
multipurpose combat carriers, built for combat
against aliens. It floats via a <テスラ・ドライブ> and
is propelled by eight main rocket engines, among
other systems.
　The Kurogane's bow module is a Giant Rotating
Ram for crushing bedrock (the anti-ship,
anti-bedrock Excalibur Drill Ram), allowing it
to engage ships in close combat and clear
obstacles such as rock or ice from its path.
When the <テスラ・ドライブ>'s output exceeds a certain
level, a T-Dot Array force field called the
"Break Field" envelops the whole ship. Using it
with the Giant Rotating Ram, the ship can even
breach the wide-area <エネルギーフィールド> of enemy
fortresses and the like. Its code name is
"Iron 3."
FIXH\t 人類初の外宇宙探査航行艦「ヒリュウ」を改造した汎用戦闘\n母艦。\:
A general-purpose combat carrier converted
from the Hiryu, humanity's first deep space
exploration vessel.
　It was also the first ship equipped with a
<テスラ・ドライブ>. In S.C. 179, it was attacked by
<エアロゲイター> mobile weapons beyond Pluto's orbit
and moderately damaged. After heavy losses, it
returned to Icarus Base in the asteroid belt.
　It was later extensively refitted around the
ISA tactic (Integrated Synchronizing Attack: a
blitzkrieg by a mobile battleship serving as a
carrier and the humanoid mobile weapons it
carries), and reborn as the general-purpose
combat carrier Hiryu Custom.
　Its bow mounts a Super Gravity Shock Cannon
based on <ＥＯＴ> technology, giving it combat
power second only to the Hagane and Kurogane.
Its code name is "Dragon 2."
FIXH\t <イスルギ重工>が建造したガイアセイバーズの旗艦。高性能<テ\nス:
The flagship of the Gaia Saviors, built by
<イスルギ重工>. This multipurpose combat carrier has
several high-performance <テ
スラ・ドライブ>s, allowing space travel, atmospheric
flight, surface navigation and underwater
operation. It also surpasses Space Noah-class
carriers in speed and humanoid weapon capacity,
and by retracting its bridge, main cannon,
secondary guns and anti-air weapons, it can
switch to a high-speed cruise mode. By combining
the "Break Field," a T-Dot Array force field
enveloping the ship, with the "Field Blade"
generated from its bow, it can break through
enemy lines, storm fortresses and fight ships
in close combat. It is also said to carry
special functions unseen in past warships, but
the details are unknown.
FIXH\t <地球連邦軍>などで用いられる空中戦闘母艦。\n 戦闘機や<アーマ:
An aerial combat carrier used by the
<地球連邦軍> and others.
　It can launch and recover fighters and
<アーマードモジュール>s in midair, with high carrying
capacity. With excellent wide-area air defense
and powerful fixed armament, it is practically
a flying fortress.
BMD\t「フフフ……意地を見せたか、鋼龍戦隊」: Heh heh heh... You've shown your grit,/　Steel Dragons.
BMD\t「さすがは鋼龍戦隊……と言っておこう」: As expected of the Steel Dragons.../　I'll grant you that much.
FIXH\t マリオン・ラドム博士のプランの下、レオナ・ガーシュタイ\nンの搭乗:
Following a plan by Dr. Marion Radom, Tasuku
Shinguji lovingly upgraded the Guarlion Custom
flown by his girlfriend, Leona Garstein.
　It is fitted with the latest <パーソナルトルーパー>
technology and a <テスラ・ドライブ>, improving its
mobility and firepower. A <Ｔ‐ＬＩＮＫシステム> is
also installed.
　Like the Guarlion, it has dedicated field
inductors added to both shoulders, letting it fix
induction-heated metal particles at a point in
front of the unit, wrap them in a TK Field, and
extend them to strike the enemy.
FIXH\t ジガンスクードの強化改造型。\n グルンガストシリーズに使われてい:
An upgraded and modified Giganscudo.
　TGC Joints, as used in the Grungust series, are
employed in every joint, and the Giganscudo's Siege
Shield Units have been replaced with Siege Anchor
Units, improving its close-combat ability. An
improved Gravicon System also lets it deploy a
G-Territory, further raising its defense. The plan
to modify it into the Duro (Italian for "hard") was
drawn up by Dr. Marion Radom. Nicknamed "Gandoro."
FIXH\t 恒星間航行計画「<プロジェクトＴＤ>」で開発された宙間航行\n・宇:
Developed under the interstellar travel plan
"<プロジェクトＴＤ>" as an <アーマードモジュール> for space
travel and work in space. The newest model of
Series 77, it was designed using data from its
predecessor, the Astelion AX. Its two
high-performance <テスラ・ドライブ>s, one on each side,
give it mobility and maneuverability unmatched by
any other <アーマードモジュール>. It can transform into
a Cruise Figure (CF) for travel and a Doll Figure
(DF) for work, letting it handle all kinds of
situations. Anticipating contact with hostile
intelligent life in deep space, it is armed with
the "G-Axel Driver" gravity-controlled accelerator
cannon as its main weapon and the "CTM" series of
Combined Tactical Missiles as secondary armament.
FIXH\t 恒星間航行計画「<プロジェクトＴＤ>」で開発された高機動<ア\nー:
A high-mobility <アーマードモジュール> developed under
the interstellar travel plan "<プロジェクトＴＤ>." The
newest model of Series 77, it was designed using
data from its predecessor, the Karion. Equipped
with two compact, high-performance <テスラ・ドライブ>s,
it boasts even greater mobility and acceleration
than its sister unit, the Alterion.
FIXH\t 恒星間航行計画「<プロジェクトＴＤ>」で開発されたシリーズ\n７７:
The combined form of the Alterion and Vegalion,
the newest models of Series 77, developed under
the interstellar travel plan "<プロジェクトＴＤ>." Its
mobility and maneuverability are the pinnacle
among all <アーマードモジュール>s, and it wields
tremendous firepower.
FIXH\t リクセント公国からの依頼と資金援助を受け、<テスラ・ライ\nヒ研究:
Built by the <テスラ・ライ
ヒ研究所> at the request of and with
funding from the Principality of Riksent, this
<アーマードモジュール> is Shine Hausen's personal unit.
　It uses a modified, miniaturized version of the
Astelion's test frame and <テスラ・ドライブ>, and was
lightened to the absolute limit. As a result, its
mobility and maneuverability rival the Astelion's.
To make up for its now-fragile armor, it carries an
<エネルギーフィールド> generator and a special man-machine
interface called the "W-LINK System."
　Type G's cockpit is specially built for Shine,
who has the power of foresight. It is fitted with
the brainwave control device also used in the
Grungust and a high-performance G-Canceller.
　The "W-LINK System" synchronizes the movements of
the two Fairions, compensating for the difference
in piloting skill between Latune and Shine. Using
this system, Latune, who pilots Type S, can
control Type G to a degree and perform combination
attacks with it.
FIXH\t 「ツェントル・プロジェクト」で開発されたＴＥアブゾー\nバーの試作:
The fifth TE Absorber prototype developed by the
Tsentr Project. Dr. Mitar Zapato, the project's
central figure, created the TE Engine, which
harnesses Terminus Energy, as the prototypes'
power source. He also succeeded in developing
Lazmanium, a self-repairing armor material.
However, both proved difficult to control, and
after much trial and error with TE Absorber
prototypes 1 through 4, Mitar temporarily gave up
on a unit carrying both the TE Engine and
Lazmanium. Instead, it was decided to split them
up, giving Lazmanium to prototype 5, the Medius
Locus, and the TE Engine to prototype 6, the
Cerberus, and prototype 7, the Garmraid, so that
each technology could be developed on its own.
The Medius Locus was built using <パーソナルトルーパー>
data. Though its output falls short of the TE
Engine units, it boasts high mobility and
responsiveness.
FIXH\t メディウス・ロクスが変貌した姿。ＡＩ１が得た様々な機体\nデータや:
The transformed form of the Medius Locus. Using
the various unit and combat data acquired by AI1,
it changed shape through Lazmanium's
self-evolution ability, gaining a dramatic boost
in power. The unit has grown larger than before,
and its form and weapons now lean toward those of
a <特機>. This is thought to be because Erde,
conscious of TE Absorber prototype 10, drove AI1
to evolve so it could rival that unit.
FIXH\t ＴＥアブゾーバーの試作１０号機であり、最終型とも言える\n機体。「:
TE Absorber prototype 10, effectively the final
model. The name "Garberus" combines "Garmraid"
and "Cerberus" (Kerberos), and it is also known
as "MODEL-X." It carries all of the Tsentr
Project's creations--the TE Engine, Lazmanium and
AI1--making it a maintenance-free mobile weapon
that can, in theory, run semi-permanently. It
combines the traits of the Cerberus Ignite and
Garmraid Blaze, and can transform into forms
resembling each. Form G (Garmraid) excels at
melee combat, while Form C (Cerberus) excels at
ranged combat. The unit is fully controlled by
AI1 and carries out its missions without fail
(it is unaffected by emotions or physical
condition, and can operate in conditions no
human could endure).
FIXH\t ガイアセイバーズのアルファ・セイバーで用いられる人型機\n動兵器。:
A humanoid mobile weapon used by the Gaia Savers'
Alpha Saver team. It was developed from data on a
captured Rest Gemira (Earth codename: Geminira),
an unmanned general-purpose transformable mobile
weapon used by the <インスペクター>. The Rest Gemira's
flexible frame and wide-ranging joints were
retained as much as possible, giving it high
mobility and responsiveness. It also carries a
high-performance <テスラ・ドライブ>. To keep production
costs down, its transformation mechanism was
omitted.
The time between the Rest Gemira's first sighting
on Earth and the Canis's mass production was short,
and much about its development remains a mystery.

A humanoid mobile weapon used by the Gaia Savers'
Alpha Saver team. It was developed from data on a
captured Rest Gemira (Earth codename: Geminira),
an unmanned general-purpose transformable mobile
weapon used by the <インスペクター>. The Rest Gemira's
flexible frame and wide-ranging joints were
retained as much as possible, giving it high
mobility and responsiveness. To keep production
costs down, its transformation mechanism was
omitted.
The Altarf's large wings house command and control
systems and a high-performance <テスラ・ドライブ>,
further improving its mobility. Its Double
Gunnery, which can fire both live rounds and beams,
has been upgraded to a long-barrel version fitted
with a large bayonet.
FIXH\t クロスゲートからのエネルギーによって、ラズムナニウムが\n暴走し、:
Energy from the Cross Gate has driven the
Lazmanium out of control, causing the core housing
AI1 to grow enormous and fuse with the TE Engine.
True to the name "ALL In 1," it seeks to absorb
everything into its own body.
BMD\t「相対速度、距離算出！ データ・ロード！」: Relative speed and distance calculated!/　Loading data!
FIXH\t 鋼龍戦隊オクトパス隊（オクト小隊）の隊長。\n 熱血系で我が強く、:
Leader of the Steel Dragons' Octopus Team
(Octo Squad). A hot-blooded, headstrong, and
belligerent woman. The type to act before she
thinks, she has a harsh tongue and a long record
of disobeying orders. Still, her piloting skills
are solid, and she's surprisingly good at looking
after her subordinates. Rank: Lieutenant.
FIXH\t 鋼龍戦隊オクトパス隊所属のパイロット。\n 気が優しく、大人しい性:
A pilot in the Steel Dragons' Octopus Team.
Kind-hearted and mild-mannered. He worries about
the reckless Katina and works to keep her in
check. Whether in daily life or on missions, he
tends to support others--an unsung hero who
works behind the scenes.
FIXH\t 鋼龍戦隊の司令で、ヒリュウ級汎用戦闘母艦ヒリュウ改の\n艦長。\n:
Commander of the Steel Dragons and captain of the
Hiryu-class multipurpose battleship Hiryu Custom.
A gifted young woman who graduated top of her class
from the space officer academy at Icarus Base in
the asteroid belt. Demure, a worrier, and quick to
tears, but with a strong core. Her earnest nature
and dedication to her duties have earned her the
trust of the Hiryu Custom's crew despite being a
rookie captain. Chosen as the Hiryu Custom's
captain on Sean's recommendation, she grows into
a capable captain with his support. Promoted to
Colonel after the <修羅の乱>.
FIXH\t ヒリュウ級汎用戦闘母艦ヒリュウ改の副長。\n 物腰柔らかな英国紳士:
Executive officer of the Hiryu-class multipurpose
battleship Hiryu Custom. A soft-spoken English
gentleman with a wealth of knowledge, experience,
and a sense of humor, he provides Lefina with
precise support. He previously served as XO of the
deep space exploration ship Hiryu, under Captain
Daitetsu. He was meant to succeed Daitetsu, who was
relieved of command over the damage to the Hiryu,
but he declined and recommended Lefina for captain.
A heavy drinker and connoisseur of Western liquor.
Promoted to Lieutenant Colonel after the
<修羅の乱>.
FIXH\t ヒリュウ級汎用戦闘母艦ヒリュウ改のブリッジオペレー\nター。\n:
Bridge operator of the Hiryu-class multipurpose
battleship Hiryu Custom.
Serious and something of a neat freak, but
personable. She and Lefina were classmates at the
space officer academy, and she always watches
over her. Promoted to Second Lieutenant.
FIXH\t <地球連邦軍><特殊戦技教導隊>の隊長。\n 叩き上げの軍人で、現:
Leader of the <地球連邦軍>'s
<特殊戦技教導隊>.
A career soldier who rose through the ranks, he
believes in a hands-on approach. Once feared as a
demon of a commander, he's mellowed somewhat since
the <Ｌ５戦役>. With Latune and others, he creates
motion data for mainline units and tests new
models. Rank: Major.
FIXH\t 傭兵ムラタの搭乗機。\n ベースとなった機体はガーリオン・カスタム:
The unit piloted by the mercenary Murata.
　Based on the Guarlion Custom, it adds a large
Booster to each shoulder for better acceleration
and charging power. Its armor has been reinforced
throughout, and it is armed with the Shishioh
Blade, making it a machine specialized for
swordplay.
FIXH\t 宙間戦闘仕様の量産型ヴァルシオン（ヴァルシオン改）。\n 量産先行:
A mass-produced Valsion (Valsion Custom) built
for space combat.
　The flexible arms of the early production model
have been replaced with Booster units, and its
armor has been reinforced.
　Extra vernier thrusters for attitude control
have also been fitted. Though specialized for
space combat, it can also fight under gravity.
FIXH\t <イスルギ重工>が開発した汎航空戦闘機のアップデート型。\n 戦場:
An updated version of the general-purpose
fighter developed by <イスルギ重工>.
　A next-generation craft for any battlefield, it
offers seamless air combat from low to high
altitude and a large payload. Flexible wings of
special materials, a fully enclosed cockpit, and
modular construction with an extremely long TBO
set it apart from current aircraft.
FIXH\t <地球連邦軍>の主力戦車。大口径のレールガンを装備してい\nる。:
The main battle tank of the
<地球連邦軍>. It is armed with a
large-caliber Railgun.
FIXH\t <地球連邦軍>などで使用される宇宙航行艦。\n フレーム状の本体に:
A space vessel used by forces including the
<地球連邦軍>.
　Its frame-like hull can mount multipurpose weapon
units armed with missiles and lasers, containers
with launch catapults for <アーマードモジュール>s and
<パーソナル
トルーパー>s, supply transport containers,
and more. This lets it serve as a battleship,
carrier, transport, or multipurpose support ship.
FIXH\t <地球連邦軍>などで使用される大型宇宙戦艦。\n 司令部機能を持っ:
A large space battleship used by forces
including the <地球連邦軍>.
　With its command functions, it often serves as a
fleet flagship. It also has excellent search
capability and spacecraft control functions. It
consists of a battle carrier, which carries space
fighters and <アーマードモジュール>s, and five beam
gunships. The beam gunships can operate alone,
and can even be evacuated and used as missiles
themselves.
LDBI\t「陛下だと！？ 戴冠式はまだだろうが！」: "His Majesty"?! The coronation@hasn't even happened yet!
BMD\t「意外に保つな……と言っても状況は不利か」: Holding up better than I expected.../　Still, the odds are against me.
BMD\t「ルイーナ……ここであんた達を食い止める！」: Ruina.../　I'll stop you all right here!
BMD\t「四神の超機人……でも、負けない！」: A Choukijin of the Four Gods.../　But I won't lose!
BMD\t「四凶の超機人……何としても！」: A Choukijin of the Four Fiends.../　No matter what!
FIXH\t 「ツェントル・プロジェクト」で開発されたＴＥアブゾー\nバーの試作:
The seventh TE Absorber prototype developed by the
Tsentr Project. A <特機>-type machine, it
excels at close combat. However, the TE Engine,
which harnesses Terminus Energy, has many problems
with output regulation and the like, so battery
power supplements the drive of its joints and other
parts. To allow finer TE Engine output control and
to assist with unit control, the DFC (Direct
Feeling Control) system was introduced, and an
Operator wearing a dedicated suit rides along in
the machine. A second unit of the same model
exists, but as it serves mainly as a source of
spare parts, it has not been used in testing or
combat.

The ninth TE Absorber prototype developed by the
Tsentr Project. It consists of a main body built
using data gathered from the seventh prototype,
Garmraid, and the unmanned mobile weapons known as
the "Machine Animalito." It also carries a
new-model TE Engine with improved output and
stability over Garmraid's. In addition, it can
deploy an energy field called the "TE Sphere,"
raising its defense.
The Machine Animalito are of two types: Hiou, an
unmanned bird-type fighter, and Rouga, an unmanned
wolf-type mobile weapon. Each can operate on its
own, but normally they are split into parts and
mounted on Garmraid Blaze's arms, legs, shoulders,
back and so on.
In Form G, Rouga's head transforms into a striking
weapon mounted on the right arm, and Hiou
transforms into a wing booster mounted on the back.
Like Garmraid, this form excels in close combat.

The ninth TE Absorber prototype developed by the
Tsentr Project. It consists of a main body built
using data gathered from the seventh prototype,
Garmraid, and the unmanned mobile weapons known as
the "Machine Animalito." It also carries a
new-model TE Engine with improved output and
stability over Garmraid's. In addition, it can
deploy an energy field called the "TE Sphere,"
raising its defense.
The Machine Animalito are of two types: Hiou, an

In Form S, Rouga's head transforms into a shield
mounted on the left arm, and Hiou transforms into a
cannon mounted on the back, giving it excellent
mid- to long-range combat ability. Using the shield
together with the TE Sphere also makes its defense
slightly higher than Form G's.

The sixth TE Absorber prototype developed by the
Tsentr Project. It is highly mobile and excels at
mid- to long-range combat. However, the TE Engine,
which harnesses Terminus Energy, has many problems
with output regulation and the like, so battery
power supplements the drive of its joints and other
parts. To allow finer TE Engine output control and
to assist with unit control, the DFC (Direct
Feeling Control) system was introduced, and an
Operator wearing a dedicated suit rides along in
the machine. A second unit of the same model
exists, but as it serves mainly as a source of
spare parts, it has not been used in testing or
combat.

The eighth TE Absorber prototype developed by the
Tsentr Project. It consists of a main body built
using data gathered from Cerberus, and an add-on
weapon unit called the "Ignite Parts." It also
carries a new-model TE Engine with improved output
and stability over Cerberus's. In addition, it can
deploy an energy field called the "TE Sphere,"
raising its defense.
The Ignite Parts can operate alone as an unmanned
fighter, but are normally used mounted on the
Cerberus Ignite's main body.
The main body can also transform between "Figure
W," a close-combat mode, and "Figure B," a
bombardment mode (its front and back are reversed),
giving it high versatility. Mounting the Ignite
Parts on Figure W produces "Form G," which delivers
performance specialized for close combat.
