BMD\t「ユーゼス、お前が創造主になるなどと！」: Euzeth, you think you can play Creator!?
BMD\t「フッ、量産型とは一味違うわね」: Heh, a cut above the mass-produced ones.
FIXH\t <パーソナルトルーパー>の略称。:
Short for
<パーソナルトルーパー>.
FIXH\t <テスラ・ライヒ研究所>の顧問。\n 示現流の達人で、グルンガスト:
An advisor at the <テスラ・ライヒ研究所>.
A master of the Jigen-ryu school, he is involved in
developing swords for the Grungust and creating
sword motion data. He is also the teacher of Sänger
and Bullet. Strict when it comes to the way of the
sword, but otherwise a good-natured old man.
FIXH\t <マオ・インダストリー>のスタッフで、現在は<地球連邦軍>\n<特:
A <マオ・インダストリー> staff member, currently seconded
to the <地球連邦軍>'s
<特殊戦技教導隊>, providing support in
many areas. A thoughtful, quiet woman with telepathic
abilities, she worked on man-machine interface
development at <マオ・インダストリー>. Her specialty is
yoga, and she is a little feared for recommending
asanas (yoga poses) that others find hard to do.
FIXH\t 地中海に面する連邦特別自治区・リクセント公国の王女。\n 天真爛漫:
Princess of the Principality of Ricsent, a special
Federation autonomous zone on the Mediterranean.
Innocent and curious, she acts the moment an idea
strikes her. She is close friends with Latooni and
harbors a faint crush on Rydeas. She also possesses
the power of foresight.
FIXH\t <パーソナルトルーパー>の開発メーカー、<マオ・インダスト\nリー:
President of <マオ・インダストリー>, a <パーソナルトルーパー>
manufacturer. A cool-headed pragmatist, she was
influenced by her father, Mao Industries' founder,
to become a <パーソナルトルーパー> pilot, and once served
in Team PTX, a special forces unit of the
<地球連邦軍>'s Far East Branch.
FIXH\t エクサランス・レスキューのパイロット。\n 基本的には責任感が強く:
Pilot of the Excellence Rescue.
Fundamentally a responsible, hot-blooded guy who
doesn't sweat the details. With his twin sister
Fiona, he founded L&E Corporation, a company that
takes on repair and rescue jobs, and serves as its
president.
FIXH\t ラウルの双子の妹。意志が強く、明るい女性。ラウルより\nしっかりし:
Raul's twin sister. A strong-willed, cheerful woman.
More level-headed than Raul, she is often mistaken
for the older twin. She loves a challenge, and once
she makes up her mind, she won't listen to anyone.
At L&E Corporation, which she founded with Raul and
the others, she handles sales, cooking and laundry,
but she is effectively the one running the company.
BMD\t「孫光龍……何て強力な念の力なの……！」: Sun Koryu.../　What tremendous psychic power...!
BMD\t「敵の念を……攻撃の意志を感じ取る……！」: I can sense the enemy's mind.../　their intent to attack...!
FIXH\t デュミナスによって創り出されたテクニティ・パイデス（人\n工生命体:
A Technity Paides (artificial life-form) created by
Duminas. After the <修羅の乱>, she was taken
in by Raul and Fiona and became part of their
family. She works as an assistant at L&E
Corporation, the company Raul and the others
founded. She is reserved and quiet by nature.
BMD\t「わかっているでしょう？/ 人と神、その念、力の差を……」: Surely you understand?/　Man and god... the gulf between/　their will and their power...
FIXH\t リクセント公国からの依頼と資金援助を受け、<テスラ・ライ\nヒ研究:
An <アーマードモジュール> developed by the
<テスラ・ライ
ヒ研究所> at the request of, and
with funding from, the Principality of Riksent. The
personal machine of Latune Subota.
　Built by modifying and miniaturizing an Astelion
test frame and <テスラ・ドライブ>, it is lightened to the
utmost limit. As a result, its mobility and
maneuverability rival the Astelion's. It also carries
an <エネルギーフィールド> generator to compensate for its
fragile armor, and a special man-machine interface
called the "W-LINK System." This system synchronizes
the movements of the two Fairions to correct the
gap in piloting skill between Latune and Shine.
Using this system, Latune in Type S can control
Type G to a degree and perform combination attacks.
FIXH\t <イスルギ重工>が開発した高機動<アーマードモジュール>。恒星\n:
A high-mobility <アーマードモジュール> built by <イスルギ重工>.
Its design is based on data from the Calion and
Vegalion of the interstellar navigation project
"<プロジェクトＴＤ>." Its performance rivals the
Vegalion's, and Flexible Weapon Operators on both
wings let it use firearms built for <アーマードモジュール>s
and <パーソナルトルーパー>s. It also has a large weapon
bay with MTD guided missiles and a folding TDA nose.
FIXH\t ガレリオン（ガーリオンの後継機）の試作機をベースとし、\n<ブース:
Based on a Garelion prototype (the Guarlion's
successor), this <アーマードモジュール> is customized for
the <ブーステッド・チルドレン>. Though heavily armored, its
high-performance <テスラ・ドライブ> and back thrusters
let it engage in high-mobility combat beyond even
the Astelion AX.
　The Plaisant also mounts Turnail Crushers on both
arms and has command-and-control functions.

Based on a Garelion prototype (the Guarlion's
successor), this <アーマードモジュール> is customized for
the <ブーステッド・チルドレン>. Though heavily armored, its
high-performance <テスラ・ドライブ> and back thrusters
let it engage in high-mobility combat beyond even
the Astelion AX.

Based on a Garelion prototype (the Guarlion's
successor), this <アーマードモジュール> is customized for
the <ブーステッド・チルドレン>. Though heavily armored, its
high-performance <テスラ・ドライブ> and back thrusters
let it engage in high-mobility combat beyond even
the Astelion AX.
　The Avenir is an electronic warfare model with EA
(electronic attack), EP (electronic protection), and
ES (electronic support) capabilities.
FIXH\t <イスルギ重工>が開発したリオンの後継機。「レリオン（Ｒｅ\nＬＩ:
The successor to the Lion, developed by <イスルギ重工>.
"Relion (ReLION)" stands for "Refined Lion." Its
human-type arms let it use a variety of weapons like
the Guarlion. With better base performance than the
Lion, it is easy to handle, easy to maintain and
produce, making it a multi-role <アーマードモジュール>.
FIXH\t ベガリオンのパイロット。\n <プロジェクトＴＤ>の責任者であるフ:
Pilot of the Vegalion.
Younger sister of Filio Presty, head of <プロジェクトＴＤ>.
Fierce and merciless toward anyone who opposes her,
she has absolute confidence in her own skill and
enormous pride.
FIXH\t 剛胆な性格で、自分の信念を貫く武人。義を重んじ、常に\n正々堂々と:
A bold-hearted warrior true to his own beliefs.
He values honor and strives always to act fairly
and squarely, but can be inflexible at times.
An expert in melee combat, especially swordplay.
FIXH\t ハガネやヒリュウ改を陰ながら助ける謎の人物。\n 沈着冷静で誇り高:
A mysterious figure who covertly aids the Hagane
and the Hiryu Custom.
Cool, composed, and proud, he values the greater
cause. He is also a flexible thinker and always acts
with the big picture in mind. A genius at piloting
humanoid mobile weapons, he always calls whatever
machine he pilots by his horse's name, "Trombe"
(German for "tornado"). He is a true gourmet and a
first-rate cook.
FIXH\t スペースノア級万能戦闘母艦参番艦クロガネ所属のパイロッ\nト。\n:
A pilot assigned to the Kurogane, third ship of the
Space Noah-class multipurpose battleships.
Cool and composed, always mindful of behaving like a
gentleman. Despises underhanded acts and never
hesitates to help the weak. A lover of black tea,
particular about how it is brewed and drunk.
FIXH\t スペースノア級万能戦闘母艦参番艦クロガネ所属のパイロッ\nト。通称:
A pilot assigned to the Kurogane, third ship of the
Space Noah-class multipurpose battleships. Goes by
Carla.
A passionate, tomboyish girl. An optimist, the type
to forget minor worries after a good night's sleep.
FIXH\t <地球連邦軍>情報部所属の軍人。\n 性格は沈着冷静、頭脳明晰。ど:
A member of <地球連邦軍> Intelligence.
Cool, composed, and brilliant. Somewhat enigmatic,
but with a soft spot for loyalty and compassion.
Formerly of the Federation's
<特殊戦技教導隊>, which created
the base data for <ＴＣ‐ＯＳ>. A superb <パーソナルトル
ーパー> pilot. Rank: Major.
FIXH\t 新西暦１８６年、地球連邦軍南極コーツランド基地で起き\nた反乱事件:
In S.C. 186, a rebellion at the Earth Federation
Army's Coats Land Base in Antarctica.
　At the time, the base was holding an unveiling
ceremony for the Shirogane, first ship of the Space
Noah-class multipurpose battle carriers, and the
Granzon, a humanoid mobile weapon developed by the
<ＥＯＴＩ機関>, but the ceremony was only a cover.
Behind the scenes, peace talks were underway with
extraterrestrial intelligent life code-named the
"Guests."
　However, the terms amounted to Earth's near-total
surrender to the Guests, and many of those who knew
the truth were outraged.
　During the talks, Dr. Shu Shirakawa, one of the
Granzon's developers and also its test pilot,
suddenly attacked the Guests' starship. He then
turned on the Federation Army as well, leaving
Coats Land Base in ruins.
　This incident ended negotiations with the Guests.
Immediately afterward, the <ＤＣ> rose up, sparking
the wars that followed (the <ＤＣ戦争>, the <Ｌ５戦役>, and
the <インスペ
クター事件>).
　Before the talks, the Guests had appeared over
Coats Land Base aboard a starship of the <エアロゲイター>,
and at the time of the incident many equated the
Guests with the Aerogators.
　Since the <インスペクター事件>, however, the prevailing
theory holds that the Guests' ship was a decoy, and
that they are not Aerogators but a faction closely
tied to the <インスペクター>.
FIXH\t <Ｌ５戦役>後、バン・バ・チュンが<シャドウミラー>の協力\nを得:
After the <Ｌ５戦役>, Van Vat Tran, aided by
<シャドウミラー>, united <ＤＣ> remnants and anti-
Federation dissidents into this military force.
　It rose up in S.C. 187, aiming to unify the Earth
Sphere by force. But its true enemy was the aliens
bent on invading the Earth Sphere, and when the
Inspectors attacked, it called a temporary truce
with the Federation Army.
　However, during the operation to retake North
America, Van fell into Shadow Mirror's trap and was
killed, and the organization collapsed. Some
factions remain in hiding, however, and some have
become guerrillas, carrying on the anti-Federation
struggle.
FIXH\t エアロゲイターが保有していると思われる１０メートル\n以上の有関節:
A general term for the humanoid mobile weapons
developed to counter the articulated mobile weapons
over 10 meters tall believed to be held by the
Aerogators.
　The landmark first Personal Trooper was the
PTX-001 "Gespenst" built by <マオ・インダストリー>,
rolled out in S.C. 180.
　Key features include easy weapon replacement via
its manipulators, and the high mobility over rough
terrain provided by bipedal walking and hovering.
　Also, thanks to the <ＴＣ‐ＯＳ>, the pilot need only
assess the situation and make minimal inputs; the
machine then automatically selects the right
motions to carry out the pilot's intended action.
BMD\t「相手の確認を怠るからこうなるんだ！」: That's what you get for/　not checking your target!
CSB\tＡ．精神コマンド、特殊効果１などを利用します。: A. Use Spirit Commands, Special Effect 1, etc.
CSB\t<W=28><H=28>Ａ．<C=FF8000FF>受けるダメージを、:
<W=28><H=28>A. <C=FF8000FF>An ally unit takes the damage in another unit's place.</C></H></W>

　●When a unit is hit by a <LINK=0>Normal Attack</LINK>, an allied unit takes the damage instead.
　　A unit can perform Support Defense if it meets these conditions:

　・It is adjacent to the unit under attack.
　・It has a <LINK=1>Move Type</LINK> that can enter the attacked unit's terrain.
　・Its main pilot has the <LINK=2>Special Skill</LINK> "Support Defense" with uses remaining.
　・It is not part of the attacked unit's <LINK=3>Combination Attack</LINK>.

　<S=8><Y=-3><W=32><H=32><I=156></H></W></Y><S=3>With Support Defense, the damage is taken while defending, so it is
　　　50% of normal. The number of supports per phase equals the
　　　skill level.
CSB\tＡ．精神コマンド「根性」「ド根性」「信頼」「友情」「絆」を使用します。: A. Use Vigor, Super Guts, Trust, Friendship, or Bond.
CSB\t<W=28><H=28>Ａ．<C=FF8000FF>以下の精神コマンド:
<W=28><H=28>A. <C=FF8000FF>Use the following Spirit Commands.</C></H></W>

　<T=30>Vigor</T>
　・Restores 30% of your own max HP.

　<T=30>Super Guts</T>
　・Fully restores your own HP.

　<T=30>Trust</T>
　・Restores 2000 HP to a chosen unit.

　<T=30>Friendship</T>
　・Fully restores a chosen unit's HP.

　<T=30>Bond</T>
　・Restores 50% of max HP to all allied units.
BMD\t「どう抗おうと君達の運命は変わらない……！」: No matter how you resist,/　your fate will not change...!
BMD\t「風の魔装機神の力を見せてやる！」: I'll show you the power/　of the Wind Elemental Lord!
BMD\t「アルテウル、僕も退くつもりはない」: Arteur, I won't back down either.
BMD\t「この国をお前達の好きにはさせん！」: I won't let you have your way/　with this country!
BMD\t「動きをよく見れば、四凶と言えど！」: If I watch its moves closely,/　even one of the Four Fiends...!
BMD\t「中尉の賭けに付き合ってみるか……！」: Guess I'll go along with/　the Lieutenant's gamble...!
BMD\t「今のパターンは駄目だ。次は当てられるぞ」: That pattern was no good./　They'll hit me next time.
BMD\t「オォォォン……カ弱キ者ヨ……ムダナ抵抗ハヨセ」: Ooooohn... Feeble one.../　Cease your futile resistance.
BMD\t「ガッ……神ヲモ畏レヌタワケ者ガ……」: Gah... Insolent wretch.../　who fears not even a god...
BMD\t「我ガ威光ノ前ニハ……蟻ニモ等シイ……」: Before my majesty.../　you are no more than ants...
FIXH\t 異世界「修羅界」より地球圏へ転移した戦闘集団「修羅」\nによる戦乱:
A war waged by the Shura, a band of warriors who
crossed into the Earth Sphere from another world,
the Shura realm. With the Shura realm on the brink
of destruction, Alkaid, king of the realm's nation
of Ra, led the Shura into the Tenku Majo (Earth
codename: Sordian), a colossal sword-shaped
structure capable of dimensional transfer, and
made the jump in search of a new land.
They arrived in the Earth Sphere after the
<インスペクター事件> and invaded regions across
the globe with mobile weapons called <修羅神>.
Several cities fell to the Shura, but the Hagane
and Hiryu Custom forces carried out Operation
Overgate, an assault into the Tenku Majo.
Together with Folka Alberk and others who had come
to question the Shura way of life and sided with
Earth, they succeeded in defeating Alkaid.
　After the war, Folka and the surviving Shura
used the Tenku Majo to make a dimensional jump and
left the Earth Sphere.
FIXH\t かつて連邦軍内に存在していた人型機動兵器パイロットの\n養成機関。:
A training institution for pilots of humanoid
mobile weapons that once existed within the
Federation Army. It was founded at nearly the same
time as the <特殊戦技教導隊>.
　At first, it retrained pilots of existing weapons
to fly humanoid mobile weapons such as the
<パーソナルトルーパー>, but after Adler Koch took charge
of the School, its goals changed completely.
　Instead of converting existing weapon pilots, he
sought to train pilots who would fly humanoid
mobile weapons from the very start.
　To that end, he secretly gathered children with
no family ties and superior reflexes and dynamic
vision. He also brought in Dr. Aguila Setome from
the Japan Institute of Special Brain Medicine and
put her in charge of erasing and manipulating the
children's memories. On top of that, Adler
subjected them to mind control and drugs and put
them through special training. He was trying to
create, in a "short time," humans specialized in
piloting and fighting with humanoid mobile
weapons... the "Boosted Children."
　The children were sorted into classes named for
metals--Aurum (gold), Argent (silver), Bronzo
(bronze), Hierro (iron), Latune (brass), and so
on--and were adjusted for a variety of roles.
　Perhaps because of the heavy-handed methods, only
a tiny handful of the children ever achieved
outstanding results.
　The inhumane training methods, and results that
failed to justify them, became a problem, and the
School was disbanded. However, the training of the
Boosted Children would continue, relocated to the
<ＤＣ>.
FIXH\t 旧西暦の国連特別軍が礎となった地球連邦政府管轄の\n国際軍事組織。:
An international military organization under the
Earth Federation Government, founded on the
U.N. Special Forces of the Old Calendar era.
　Because of how the Federation Government came to
be, economics and administration are still left to
coordination among nations, while the military
alone is clearly unified on a global scale. As it
grew out of Old Calendar national militaries, each
regional army has its own distinct character.
FIXH\t アクセル・アルマーが搭乗する格闘戦用の特殊人型機動兵\n器。パイロ:
A special humanoid mobile weapon for close combat,
piloted by Axel Almer. Its Direct Action Link
System, which links the unit's movements to the
pilot's, works with its Direct Feedback System and
ABMD (Artificial Bone Muscle Drive) System to give
it superb responsiveness and mobility. Combat
blades of a special liquid metal mounted on both
elbows, used in tandem with its fists, make it
formidable in hand-to-hand fighting. Most of
Soulgain's armor is also made of EG Alloy (an Active
Metal specialized for shape recovery), letting it
repair a certain amount of battle damage on its own.
FIXH\t 「アサルトドラグーン」と呼ばれるカテゴリーの強襲用人型\n機動兵器:
A humanoid mobile weapon built for violent assault,
of the class known as "Assault Dragoons."
　Its system analyzes and records the pilot's brain
wave patterns, then uses feedback from the unit to
semi-forcibly bring the pilot into Sync with it.
This lets the pilot's reflexes translate directly
into motion commands for patterned maneuvers.
　It mounts Swordbreakers, remote-controlled flying
gun platforms, on both shoulders, and excels at
mid- to long-range combat. This is a Commander's
unit, and several units of the same type exist.
FIXH\t ラミア・ラヴレスが搭乗する特殊人型機動兵器。\n 有機体に近い背中:
A special humanoid mobile weapon piloted by
Lamia Loveless.
　Its organic-looking wings and design resembling
a woman's suit of armor give it a mystical air.
　Its attacks, which fire materialized energy shaped
into spears and arrows, and its slender rapier evoke
a Western knight. However, much about its materials
and power source remains unknown, and it is highly
likely to be a unit built with <ＥＯＴ>.
　It is said to have been developed by <イスルギ重工> for
the Federation Army's next-generation mainstay unit
trials, but whether that is true is unknown.
　In addition, its registration system prevents
anyone but its dedicated pilot, Lamia, from
operating it.
FIXH\t 陸戦・砲撃戦用の人型機動兵器。Ｔｙｐｅ３４とも呼ばれ\nる。\n:
A humanoid mobile weapon for ground and artillery
combat, also known as the Type 34.
　A custom unit made by taking the mass-produced
RGV-Type 30 "Randgriz" and transplanting into it the
drive system and generator of its successor model,
strengthening its artillery capability and armor. It
is equipped with thick armor, a shield, a Jammer,
and a Beam Coat.
　The Razangriff Raven is a modified Razangriff
fitted with a flight unit that doubles as an armed
base (equipped with a <テスラ・ドラ
イブ> and a plasma generator).
　This allows it to fly under gravity, and added
weapons such as the Charged Particle Beam boost its
firepower.
FIXH\t 陸戦・砲撃戦用の人型機動兵器。Ｔｙｐｅ３０とも呼ばれ\nる。\n:
A humanoid mobile weapon for ground and artillery
combat, also known as the Type 30.
　Though its mobility is low, its armor is thick and
the unit is highly stable and reliable. It can also
hover, giving it excellent cross-country ability.
　The Randgriz Raven is a modified Randgriz fitted
with a booster pod carrying a <テスラ・ドライブ>. Its
linear cannons have also been increased to two,
raising its firepower.
FIXH\t 地底世界<ラ・ギアス>の神聖ラングラン王国で開発された機\n体。\:
A unit developed by the Holy Kingdom of Langran in
the underground world of <ラ・ギアス>.
　Blessed by the wind spirit Cyfis, it is known as
the "<魔装機神> of Wind." Its main power source is a
Fulcanelli-type perpetual motion engine. To raise
its power efficiency, the operator's (pilot's)
<プラーナ> is required. <プラーナ> is basically the same as
what is called "ki" or "aura," and is supplied by
the operator. As a result, the unit's power is
greatly affected by the operator's aptitude.
　The unit is highly airtight and can operate
underwater and in Space. An internal recycling
system protects the operator's bodily functions,
allowing extended operation. It also uses ether (an
energy with no mass, at rest relative to absolute
coordinates) as a magical medium for propulsion.
　Its armor is made of Orichalconium, with geometric
patterns based on talismanic numerology sealed into
it at the level of metal particles, giving it strong
magical defenses as well.
　Its main computer is a Laplace Demon type that
calculates causality to predict various events with
great clarity. However, its performance is heavily
influenced by the operator's own magical power.
　Note that "Cybuster" is not its true name, but a
guardian name used to ward off magical attacks.
BMD\t「どうした、サイバスターの名が泣くぞ」: What's wrong?/　You're shaming the name Cybuster.
FIXH\t 新西暦１８６年末から１８７年にかけて起きた<ＤＣ>に\nよる争乱。:
The conflict waged by the <ＤＣ> from the end of
New Calendar 186 into 187. Rising against the
Earth Federation Government and Federation Forces,
the DC seized military bases across the Earth
Sphere in a blitz using <アーマードモジ
ュール>s. However, Supreme Leader Bian Zoldark
was killed in the Hagane's surprise attack on
Aidoneus Island. Without him, the DC fell into
disarray and was defeated by the Federation.
FIXH\t <ＳＲＸ計画>に参加しているケンゾウ・コバヤシ博士が\n開発した念:
A telekinesis detection and amplification device
developed by Dr. Kenzou Kobayashi of the <ＳＲＸ計画>.
It extracts the T-Alpha Pulse, a special deep
brainwave that governs human thought, and uses it
to control the motion of objects and assist in
piloting mobile weapons, among other things.
It can also generate a force field called a TK
Field, which can be deployed as a barrier or
slammed into enemy units to damage them.
Furthermore, by amplifying thought, it extends the
user's special perception (a sixth sense close to
touch) over a wide area, making it possible to
detect and locate enemy units to some degree.
However, the system's performance depends on the
user's mental state, and excessive linking places
a severe strain on the brain.
In Kenzo's project, people in whom T-Alpha Pulses
above a certain level are detected are called
"telekinetics."
FIXH\t 異星人の侵略を予見したビアン・ゾルダーク博士が、\n<ＥＯＴＩ機関:
A military organization founded by Dr. Bian
Zoldark, who foresaw an alien invasion, using the
<ＥＯＴＩ機関> as its parent body.
Its goal was to establish a powerful military
regime over the Earth Sphere to resist aliens
bent on conquering the Earth.
Besides EOTI members, it drew in Federal
Government staff, some Federation soldiers,
anti-Federation activists, and national
liberation fighters. The <コロニー統合軍> also
pledged its cooperation.
At the end of New Calendar 186, it rebelled
against the <地球連邦政府> and
Federation Forces, seizing military bases across
the Earth Sphere in a blitz using <アーマードモジュール>s.
But the method chosen by Bian and United Colony
Corps Supreme Commander Maier V. Branstein was a
double-edged sword.
By making themselves the "enemy," they meant to
give humanity a simulated taste of its situation
and spur it to rapidly confront an unprecedented
threat. But a prolonged civil war ran a high risk
of exhausting Earth's own fighting strength.
So while seeking a quick end to the DC War, they
had no choice but to preserve the strength of
their foes (the Federation side) to a degree.
Bian also intended, should people strong enough
to defeat him appear, to entrust them with the
future of the Earth Sphere.
It could be said that this contradiction brought
about Bian's defeat and let those who used the DC
for selfish ends grow ever bolder.
Bian was killed in the Hagane's surprise attack
on DC headquarters. Without him, the DC fell into
disarray and was defeated by the Federation.
FIXH\t 出自不明の人型機動兵器。ある企業が開発した新型機に偽装\nを施した:
An unidentified humanoid mobile weapon. It is said
to be a new model built by a certain company and
then disguised.
FIXH\t <ＤＣ戦争>で<ＤＣ>や<コロニー統合軍>が使用していた量産型\n:
A mass-produced <アーマードモジュール> used by the <ＤＣ> and
the <コロニー統合軍> during the <ＤＣ戦争>. <イスルギ重工>
continued production after the war, and it is used by
both <ＤＣ> remnants and the <地球連邦軍>
(Federation model number: RAM-004V). An improved
version of the Lion with enhanced mobility.
  Using a high-efficiency reaction thruster, the
<テスラ・ドライブ>, capable of separating gravitational
and inertial mass, it reduces only its gravitational
mass, floating easily with small downward jets and
flying on the lift of its small main wings. Thrust,
however, comes from separate devices: a large
conventional engine built into the unusual lower
fuselage, which doubles as landing gear, serves as
the main power plant. The lower section also houses
numerous attitude-control thrusters that allow bold
terrain-following flight, letting it handle ground
combat as well. By replacing certain parts, it can
also operate in space. Its structure is extremely
simple for a <テスラ・ドライブ>-equipped unit, and its
production costs are low.
  <イスルギ重工> continued production after the <ＤＣ戦争>,
and it serves as a mainline unit in the
<地球連邦軍> as well.
FIXH\t <アーマードモジュール>・リオンのバリエーション機。正式\n名称は:
A variant of the <アーマードモジュール> Lion. Its official
name is "Lion Type L"; "Landlion" is a nickname.
  Specialized for ground combat, it has four stick
movers in place of legs, giving it excellent
cross-country performance. Setting the stick movers
close to horizontal also lets it lower its profile.
  With lower mobility and maneuverability than the
Lion, it is mainly used to attack and defend ground
bases. For this reason, it carries a large Railgun
more powerful than the standard type's. It can fly
solo using its <テスラ・ドライブ>, but is ill-suited to
aerial combat.
FIXH\t <ＤＣ>残党が使用する量産型<アーマードモジュール>・リオン\nの:
A variant of the mass-produced <アーマードモジュール> Lion
used by <ＤＣ> remnants. Its official name is "Lion
Type C"; "Cosmolion" is a nickname.
  Specialized for space combat, it uses a large
booster unit fitted with an improved <テスラ・ドライブ> to
raise its top speed and extend its operating range.
It also carries a missile container on its back.
Depending on tuning and the Pilot's skill, it can
even operate under gravity.
FIXH\t バレリオン・カスタムをベースにして開発された、バレリオ\nンの最上:
The top model of the Barrelion line, developed from
the Barrelion Custom.
  Now armed with two Bighead Railguns for greater
firepower, it also has further enhanced armor and
maneuverability.
  Though it looks like a large artillery piece, it can
not only move under its own power but also fly solo
using its <テスラ・ドライブ>. Its external armor and other
components are reinforced with a T-Dot Array, which
creates a sturdy frame from minimal structural
material. As a result, everything except essential
modules has a relatively simple structure, making it
easy to maintain and keeping costs low enough for
mass production.
FIXH\t <ＤＣ戦争>で<ＤＣ>や<コロニー統合軍>が使用していた量産型\n:
A mass-produced <アーマードモジュール> used by the <ＤＣ>
and the <コロニー統合軍> during the <ＤＣ戦争>.
<イスルギ重工> continued production after the war, and
it is used by both <ＤＣ> remnants and the
<地球連邦軍> (Federation model number:
RAM-006).
  Designed with combat against humanoid mobile
weapons in mind, it is a high-performance,
general-purpose unit whose improved ballistic
resistance also suits it to localized warfare.
  Deployed as a Commander's <アーマードモジュール>, it
serves as a high-speed battlespace control unit
that can keep pace with main formations of Lions.
It carries the <テスラ・ドライブ>, a high-efficiency
reaction thruster capable of separating
gravitational and inertial mass, and configures
its T-Dot Array as a repulsion and inertial mass
control field that acts as the unit's "shield."
  It also remedies the lack of weapon options, a
flaw of the two preceding models (the Lion and the
Barrelion). Along with advances in limb control
from the LIEON System, it can use a wide range of
weapons, starting with a close-combat blade.
  There is also a lower-cost version that omits
several features, including command and control.
